group.id: Q:ACT 1.3-5+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!1~3#Question:Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~3#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!1~3#Answer:Who do you think God is?-399724789
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He is the supreme being to be worshipped. In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~3#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!1~3#Note:Who do you think God is?-1177391933
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralized. (Or, if it can be pluralized, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods". In one language, the plural form of God, meant "God and those who follow him" and was an appropriate way to translate "saints".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~3#Note:Who do you think God is?

group.id: Q:ACT 1.5+What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!1~5#Question:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?
trans-unit.source: What do you think happens when someone is baptized?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~5#Question:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!1~5#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?815307159
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In ordinary language the Greek verb baptizô (and related words) had both literal and figurative uses. The literal sense of baptizô was "to plunge or drench or immerse something", usually in water. In religious contexts, however, it came to have two more specific senses:
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~5#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!1~5#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?1754303574
trans-unit.source: (a) To wash someone or something in or with water to make him or it ceremonially clean.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~5#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!1~5#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?1281406835
trans-unit.source: (b) To wash someone in or with water as part of their initiation into the religious community. When a person is baptized he is showing publicly his commitment to and union with Jesus Christ. (See "baptize, baptism" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!1~5#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

group.id: Q:ACT 2.5+What do you know about Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!2~5#Answer:What do you know about Jews?1433367075
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A Jew was a member of the nation of Palestine from the 6th century B.C. to the first century A.D. It refers to the descendants of Abraham through his son Isaac. A Jew was a member of the people of Israel. He was committed to the Jewish religious system. All male Jews were circumcised on the 8th day after their birth and this was a mark of being a Jew. (See "Jew" in KBT in the "Israel" entry.)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!2~5#Answer:What do you know about Jews?

group.id: Q:ACT 2.9-11+From what different nationalities and language groups had these visitors to Jerusalem come?

trans-unit.source: The visitors to Jerusalem had come from Parthia, Media, Elam, Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia (not present-day Asia), Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, Libya which is near Cyrene, and even from Rome. The visitors from Rome were Jews and Gentiles converted to Judaism. Some of the people who had come lived on the island of Crete and some of them lived in the region of Arabia.

group.id: Q:ACT 2.34-35+In the verses that Peter quoted from the Psalm, whom did David say spoke, and to whom did that person speak?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!2~34#Question:In the verses that Peter quoted from the Psalm, whom did David say spoke, and to whom did that person speak?
trans-unit.source: In the verses that Peter quoted from the Psalm, whom did David say spoke, and to whom did that person speak?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!2~34#Question:In the verses that Peter quoted from the Psalm, whom did David say spoke, and to whom did that person speak?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!2~34#Answer:In the verses that Peter quoted from the Psalm, whom did David say spoke, and to whom did that person speak?1050854481
trans-unit.source: David wrote that a person whom he described as "The Lord" spoke to another person, whom David described as "my Lord." When David said "The Lord," he meant God the Father. When David said "my Lord" he meant a different person who was also David's superior in authority. The person whom David described as his Lord was the Messiah. Therefore, these verses tell what God the Father said to the Messiah. (34b-35)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!2~34#Answer:In the verses that Peter quoted from the Psalm, whom did David say spoke, and to whom did that person speak?

group.id: Q:ACT 2.38+What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!2~38#Question:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?
trans-unit.source: What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!2~38#Question:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!2~38#Answer:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?1823839563
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Forgiveness always involves two people, one of whom has done something wrong to the other and offended him. Forgiveness takes place when the one, who was offended, sets aside his right to justice and decides not to punish the offender, as he deserved. If the one who offended repents and accepts this forgiveness, the result is that the relationship between the two, which was broken by the offense, is restored and the guilt of the offender is removed.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!2~38#Answer:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!2~38#Note:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?-570225461
trans-unit.source: See "forgive" in KBT.

trans-unit.source: The way the believers lived together showed that the Holy Spirit directed them. They cared for and helped one another as though they all belonged to the same family.

group.id: Q:ACT 2.42+What were some of the things the new believers did frequently to show that they really believed in Jesus Christ?

group.id: Q:ACT 3.9-10+What did the other worshippers think when they saw the man walking, jumping, and praising God?

group.id: Q:ACT 3.11-26+In what way did Peter begin to spread the message of Jesus to the people of Jerusalem who gathered at the temple?

group.id: Q:ACT 3.13+As Peter talked to the crowd of people, how did he refer to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!3~13#Question:As Peter talked to the crowd of people, how did he refer to God?
trans-unit.source: As Peter talked to the crowd of people, how did he refer to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!3~13#Answer:As Peter talked to the crowd of people, how did he refer to God?-881162627
trans-unit.source: He referred to God as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. He also called God "the God of our fathers." (13)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!3~13#Answer:As Peter talked to the crowd of people, how did he refer to God?

group.id: Q:ACT 3.13+What is the reason that Peter called Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob "our fathers"?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!3~13#Answer:What is the reason that Peter called Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob "our fathers"?-80442736
trans-unit.source: Peter and John and the people in the crowd were all Jews, so Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob were their ancestors. (13)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!3~13#Answer:What is the reason that Peter called Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob "our fathers"?

trans-unit.source: What did the wife of Ananias do?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~7#Question:What did the wife of Ananias do?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~7#Answer:What did the wife of Ananias do?-1860237722
trans-unit.source: About three hours after Ananias had died and been buried by the young men, Sapphira, the wife of Ananias, went to where the apostles were who received and distributed money. (7)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~7#Answer:What did the wife of Ananias do?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.8+What did Peter ask her?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~8#Question:What did Peter ask her?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter ask her?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~8#Question:What did Peter ask her?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~8#Answer:What did Peter ask her?-1024371563
trans-unit.source: Peter asked Sapphira if the money that Ananias had given him was the amount that they had received for the field. (8a)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~8#Answer:What did Peter ask her?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.8+What did Sapphira answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~8#Question:What did Sapphira answer?
trans-unit.source: What did Sapphira answer?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~8#Question:What did Sapphira answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~8#Answer:What did Sapphira answer?-1979077543
trans-unit.source: Sapphira answered yes, that was the amount they had been paid for their field. (8b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~8#Answer:What did Sapphira answer?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.8+What do you think is the reason that Peter asked her that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~8#Question:What do you think is the reason that Peter asked her that question?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Peter asked her that question?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~8#Question:What do you think is the reason that Peter asked her that question?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!5~8#Note:What do you think is the reason that Peter asked her that question?-1830882274
trans-unit.source: Probably Peter asked her that in order to know whether Sapphira had known that Ananias was going to lie about the money he received for their field.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~8#Note:What do you think is the reason that Peter asked her that question?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.9+What did Peter then say to her?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~9#Question:What did Peter then say to her?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter then say to her?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~9#Question:What did Peter then say to her?

trans-unit.id: l:!ACT!5~9#Alternate:What did Peter then say to her?-1653123521
trans-unit.source: What did Peter then say to her?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~9#Alternate:What did Peter then say to her?

trans-unit.id: l:!ACT!5~9#Alternate:What did Peter then say to her?180553527
trans-unit.source: What did Peter then ask her?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~9#Alternate:What did Peter then say to her?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~9#Answer:What did Peter then say to her?-1814189252
trans-unit.source: Peter then rebuked Sapphira for having agreed with her husband to try to deceive the apostles by telling them a lie. (9)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~9#Answer:What did Peter then say to her?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.9+How did Peter describe the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~9#Question:How did Peter describe the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?
trans-unit.source: How did Peter describe the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~9#Question:How did Peter describe the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~9#Answer:How did Peter describe the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?1308087582
trans-unit.source: Peter said that Sapphira and her husband had agreed to lie to the Holy Spirit. (9b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~9#Answer:How did Peter describe the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.10+How was Sapphira punished for her part in that sin?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~10#Question:How was Sapphira punished for her part in that sin?
trans-unit.source: How was Sapphira punished for her part in that sin?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~10#Question:How was Sapphira punished for her part in that sin?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~10#Answer:How was Sapphira punished for her part in that sin?1850004668
trans-unit.source: Sapphira received the same punishment that Ananias had received. She immediately fell down dead, just as Ananias had. (10)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~10#Answer:How was Sapphira punished for her part in that sin?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.10+Who buried Sapphira?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~10#Question:Who buried Sapphira?
trans-unit.source: Who buried Sapphira?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~10#Question:Who buried Sapphira?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~10#Answer:Who buried Sapphira?732832146
trans-unit.source: The young men who had buried Ananias came in, carried her body out and buried it beside the body of her husband. (10)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~10#Answer:Who buried Sapphira?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.11+What did the other believers feel who heard about the sudden death of Ananias and Sapphira?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~11#Question:What did the other believers feel who heard about the sudden death of Ananias and Sapphira?
trans-unit.source: What did the other believers feel who heard about the sudden death of Ananias and Sapphira?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~11#Question:What did the other believers feel who heard about the sudden death of Ananias and Sapphira?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~11#Answer:What did the other believers feel who heard about the sudden death of Ananias and Sapphira?1063668260
trans-unit.source: They were very much afraid. (11)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~11#Answer:What did the other believers feel who heard about the sudden death of Ananias and Sapphira?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.11+For what reason do you think they were afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~11#Question:For what reason do you think they were afraid?
trans-unit.source: For what reason do you think they were afraid?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~11#Question:For what reason do you think they were afraid?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!5~11#Note:For what reason do you think they were afraid?587978461
trans-unit.source: They understood that God knows everything and that he is liable to severely punish his people if they do or say something dishonest.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~11#Note:For what reason do you think they were afraid?

trans-unit.id: h:!ACT!5~12#Section Heading

group.id: Q:ACT 5.12-16+What did the apostles do that is described in these verses?

trans-unit.source: The apostles healed many people who were ill and those who were tormented by evil spirits. Other people brought sick people and those tormented by evil spirits to public places. The apostles went to where they were and healed them with power that God gave them. Many who were healed also believed in Jesus.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~12#Answer:What did the apostles do that is described in these verses?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.12+What did the apostles do that showed that [God was giving them power]?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~12#Question:What did the apostles do that showed that [God was giving them power]?
trans-unit.source: What did the apostles do that showed that [God was giving them power]?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~12#Question:What did the apostles do that showed that [God was giving them power]?

trans-unit.source: What did the apostles do that showed that?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~12#Alternate:What did the apostles do that showed that [God was giving them power]?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.13+What is the reason that non-believers did not join the believers in their meetings at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~13#Question:What is the reason that non-believers did not join the believers in their meetings at that time?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that non-believers did not join the believers in their meetings at that time?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~13#Question:What is the reason that non-believers did not join the believers in their meetings at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~13#Answer:What is the reason that non-believers did not join the believers in their meetings at that time?-1990679877
trans-unit.source: They did not join the believers because they were afraid. Many people had heard what happened to Ananias and Sapphira. (13)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~13#Answer:What is the reason that non-believers did not join the believers in their meetings at that time?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.13-14+What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~13#Question:What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?
trans-unit.source: What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~13#Question:What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~13#Answer:What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?499819293
trans-unit.source: People who were not believers greatly respected the believers. (13)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~13#Answer:What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~13#Answer:What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?-1026739146
trans-unit.source: More and more people believed in the Lord and joined the group of believers. (14)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~13#Answer:What was continuing to happen in spite of the fear some of the people had of meeting with the believers?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.15-16+In what way did many people have contact with the apostles, even before they believed in Jesus Christ?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~15#Question:In what way did many people have contact with the apostles, even before they believed in Jesus Christ?
trans-unit.source: In what way did many people have contact with the apostles, even before they believed in Jesus Christ?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~15#Question:In what way did many people have contact with the apostles, even before they believed in Jesus Christ?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~15#Answer:In what way did many people have contact with the apostles, even before they believed in Jesus Christ?-1504602994
trans-unit.source: Many people who heard that the apostles healed people brought sick people that they knew, and those who were troubled by evil spirits. They put the sick people on mats on the streets where they knew that the apostle Peter would pass, and everyone they brought was healed [by God]. (15-16)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~15#Answer:In what way did many people have contact with the apostles, even before they believed in Jesus Christ?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.15-16+How do you think the healing of people by the apostles resulted in the conversion of many who had not believed until that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~15#Question:How do you think the healing of people by the apostles resulted in the conversion of many who had not believed until that time?
trans-unit.source: How do you think the healing of people by the apostles resulted in the conversion of many who had not believed until that time?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~15#Question:How do you think the healing of people by the apostles resulted in the conversion of many who had not believed until that time?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!5~15#Note:How do you think the healing of people by the apostles resulted in the conversion of many who had not believed until that time?-287365487
trans-unit.source: Other passages in Acts imply or state that the apostles told the people whom they healed that the power that had healed them came from God. The apostles also told the people that Jesus was the Messiah. A good number of people were convinced that the message about Jesus Christ was true and believed it. Gradually those who had believed the message in this way joined with the other believers in their times of worship and teaching.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~15#Note:How do you think the healing of people by the apostles resulted in the conversion of many who had not believed until that time?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.16+What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~16#Question:What do you think an evil spirit is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~16#Answer:What do you think an evil spirit is?1237344572
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The terms "evil spirit", "unclean spirit", and "demon" are used interchangeably in the New Testament. They all refer to spiritual beings who serve Satan as his agents, being under his authority. These spiritual beings have power to oppress a human being and even take control of him.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~16#Answer:What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!5~16#Note:What do you think an evil spirit is?917898767
trans-unit.source: See "evil spirit" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~16#Note:What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.source: Acts 5:17-42 The Jewish Council leaders persecuted the apostles.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~17#Section Heading

group.id: Q:ACT 5.17-42+How did the high priest and the other members of the Jewish Supreme Council react to the continued preaching of the apostles?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~17#Question:How did the high priest and the other members of the Jewish Supreme Council react to the continued preaching of the apostles?
trans-unit.source: How did the high priest and the other members of the Jewish Supreme Council react to the continued preaching of the apostles?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~17#Question:How did the high priest and the other members of the Jewish Supreme Council react to the continued preaching of the apostles?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~17#Answer:How did the high priest and the other members of the Jewish Supreme Council react to the continued preaching of the apostles?-1950528883
trans-unit.source: The apostles were called before the Jewish Supreme Council, and these leaders decided they should be put to death. However, one member of the Council who was a Pharisee advised them to delay judgment and see whether perhaps God was on the side of the apostles.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~17#Answer:How did the high priest and the other members of the Jewish Supreme Council react to the continued preaching of the apostles?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.17+What is the reason that the high priest and the other Sadducees were angry with the apostles?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~17#Question:What is the reason that the high priest and the other Sadducees were angry with the apostles?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the high priest and the other Sadducees were angry with the apostles?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~17#Question:What is the reason that the high priest and the other Sadducees were angry with the apostles?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~17#Answer:What is the reason that the high priest and the other Sadducees were angry with the apostles?-575787098
trans-unit.source: They were jealous because many people were going to the apostles and greatly respected them. [Those people now believed the message that Jesus was the Messiah.] (17)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~17#Answer:What is the reason that the high priest and the other Sadducees were angry with the apostles?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.18+How did the high priest and his associates try to stop the work of the apostles?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~18#Question:How did the high priest and his associates try to stop the work of the apostles?
trans-unit.source: How did the high priest and his associates try to stop the work of the apostles?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~18#Question:How did the high priest and his associates try to stop the work of the apostles?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~18#Answer:How did the high priest and his associates try to stop the work of the apostles?1894684404
trans-unit.source: They had the apostles put in prison. (18)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~18#Answer:How did the high priest and his associates try to stop the work of the apostles?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.19+What happened to the apostles after they were put in prison?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~19#Question:What happened to the apostles after they were put in prison?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the apostles after they were put in prison?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~19#Question:What happened to the apostles after they were put in prison?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~19#Answer:What happened to the apostles after they were put in prison?1160612839
trans-unit.source: An angel came during the night and let them out of the prison. (19)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~19#Answer:What happened to the apostles after they were put in prison?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.19+What do you know about angels?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~19#Question:What do you know about angels?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about angels?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~19#Answer:What do you know about angels?-950331278
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Angels are spiritual messengers, who either deliver a message to humans, carry out God's will, praise God, or guard God's throne.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~19#Answer:What do you know about angels?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!5~19#Note:What do you know about angels?606859364
trans-unit.source: See "angel" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~19#Note:What do you know about angels?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.20+What did the angel tell them to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~20#Question:What did the angel tell them to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the angel tell them to do?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~20#Question:What did the angel tell them to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~20#Answer:What did the angel tell them to do?1005195424
trans-unit.source: He told them to go to the temple courts and teach the people about the new life [that Jesus gives to believers]. (20)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~20#Answer:What did the angel tell them to do?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.21+Where were the apostles at daybreak?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~21#Question:Where were the apostles at daybreak?
trans-unit.source: Where were the apostles at daybreak?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~21#Question:Where were the apostles at daybreak?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~21#Answer:Where were the apostles at daybreak?-582080502
trans-unit.source: They were again in the temple courts, teaching the people who had gathered there, as the angel had ordered them. (21a)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~21#Answer:Where were the apostles at daybreak?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.21+What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~21#Question:What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?
trans-unit.source: What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~21#Question:What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~21#Answer:What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?-703967163
trans-unit.source: They called a meeting of all the religious elders of Israel.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~21#Answer:What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~21#Answer:What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?-2108499415
trans-unit.source: Then they sent officers to the jail to bring the apostles. (21b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~21#Answer:What did the high priest and his associates do that morning?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.22-23+What did the officers do?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~22#Question:What did the officers do?
trans-unit.source: What did the officers do?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~22#Question:What did the officers do?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~22#Answer:What did the officers do?-541257615
trans-unit.source: They went to the jail and discovered that the apostles were not in it.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~22#Answer:What did the officers do?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~22#Answer:What did the officers do?-2143885287
trans-unit.source: Then they went back to the religious leaders and told them that the apostles were not in the jail, even though it had been locked and the guards were standing at the doors. (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~22#Answer:What did the officers do?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.24-25+How did the religious leaders and the captain of the temple guards find out where the apostles were?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~24#Question:How did the religious leaders and the captain of the temple guards find out where the apostles were?
trans-unit.source: How did the religious leaders and the captain of the temple guards find out where the apostles were?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~24#Question:How did the religious leaders and the captain of the temple guards find out where the apostles were?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~24#Answer:How did the religious leaders and the captain of the temple guards find out where the apostles were?1590026030
trans-unit.source: Someone came and told them that the apostles were in the temple courts, teaching the people there. (24-25)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~24#Answer:How did the religious leaders and the captain of the temple guards find out where the apostles were?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.26+What is the reason that the captain and the temple guards did not use force to bring the apostles to the assembly of the religious leaders?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~26#Question:What is the reason that the captain and the temple guards did not use force to bring the apostles to the assembly of the religious leaders?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the captain and the temple guards did not use force to bring the apostles to the assembly of the religious leaders?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~26#Question:What is the reason that the captain and the temple guards did not use force to bring the apostles to the assembly of the religious leaders?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~26#Answer:What is the reason that the captain and the temple guards did not use force to bring the apostles to the assembly of the religious leaders?14125787
trans-unit.source: The guards did not use force, because [they knew that many people had heard that the apostles had healed many people]. So they were afraid that the people would stone them if they harmed the apostles. (26)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~26#Answer:What is the reason that the captain and the temple guards did not use force to bring the apostles to the assembly of the religious leaders?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.27-28+When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~27#Question:When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?
trans-unit.source: When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~27#Question:When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~27#Answer:When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?-1590825326
trans-unit.source: He accused them of having disobeyed his orders not to continue to teach and preach about Jesus. Instead, they had taught everyone in Jerusalem about Jesus.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~27#Answer:When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~27#Answer:When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?-599946988
trans-unit.source: He also accused the apostles of telling people that he and the other religious leaders were responsible for the death of Jesus. (27-28)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~27#Answer:When the apostles arrived where the elders of the Jews were assembled, what did the high priest say to them?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.29+What is the reason that Peter and the other apostles dared to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~29#Question:What is the reason that Peter and the other apostles dared to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Peter and the other apostles dared to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~29#Question:What is the reason that Peter and the other apostles dared to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~29#Answer:What is the reason that Peter and the other apostles dared to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders?426564074
trans-unit.source: Peter and the other apostles had obeyed what God had ordered them to do, even though they had to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders. (29)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~29#Answer:What is the reason that Peter and the other apostles dared to disobey the high priest and the other religious leaders?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.30-31+What things about Jesus did Peter say in replying to the high priest?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!5~30#Question:What things about Jesus did Peter say in replying to the high priest?
trans-unit.source: What things about Jesus did Peter say in replying to the high priest?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~30#Question:What things about Jesus did Peter say in replying to the high priest?

group.id: Q:ACT 5.34+What do you know about Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!5~34#Answer:What do you know about Pharisees?521969525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Semitic words mean "the separated ones," which was transliterated into Greek. It came to mean a certain group of Jewish people. So the idea of "separated" does not need to be included here. The name "Pharisee" means "the separated ones." They were the largest and most important of the Jewish religious groups. They controlled the synagogues and exercised great control over the general population. They taught that the way to God was through obeying the law. They opposed Jesus because He refused to accept the teachings of their oral law.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!5~34#Answer:What do you know about Pharisees?

group.id: Q:ACT 7.8+What do you think is the reason that Stephen mentioned the fact that Abraham and his descendants were all circumcised?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!7~8#Note:What do you think is the reason that Stephen mentioned the fact that Abraham and his descendants were all circumcised?332065686
trans-unit.source: Stephen probably mentioned that because circumcision was a sign that God had made them his own people and that they had promised to obey him. His mention of circumcision here takes on deeper significance later in his speech when he comes back to the idea of circumcision in a figurative sense, accusing his hearers of having their hearts and ears uncircumcised. (The respondent might not remember this or be able to make the connection right away).

group.id: Q:ACT 7.44+What do you think the tabernacle was?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!7~44#Answer:What do you think the tabernacle was?-2058927125
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It was a place to worship God. The tabernacle was the portable sanctuary that the people of Israel built under God's direction in the early years of their history, while they were traveling in the wilderness. God was present in the tabernacle in a very special way. In some passages the reference is not to the man-made tabernacle which existed in this world, but to the corresponding tabernacle in heaven, the spiritual reality which the earthly tabernacle represents. (See "tabernacle" in KBT in the "tent" entry.) (44)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!7~44#Answer:What do you think the tabernacle was?

group.id: Q:ACT 7.57+What did the religious leaders do when they heard this?

group.id: Q:ACT 7.57+What did their actions show?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!7~57#Answer:What did their actions show?1564361094
trans-unit.source: They covered their ears, because they did not want to listen to what Stephen said. [They believed it was blasphemy]. (57)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!7~57#Answer:What did their actions show?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!7~57#Note:What did their actions show?-514778868
trans-unit.source: When Stephen referred to Jesus as the Son of Man and said he was standing at God's right hand in heaven, he was saying that Jesus was the Messiah. The religious leaders believed that this was blasphemy, so they covered their ears, in order not to hear Stephen blaspheming.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!7~57#Note:What did their actions show?

trans-unit.source: They needed to do that, because the Holy Spirit had not yet come upon those believers. Philip had baptized them but had not prayed that they would receive the Holy Spirit. (16)

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The most common use of the word "heart" in the Bible is to refer to the spiritual center or innermost part of a human being. In Hebrew and Greek "heart" is most commonly associated with thoughts and ideas.

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!8~21#Note:What does the "heart" mean to you?315764543

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~22#Answer:When Peter told Simon he needed to repent, of what two sins did he tell Simon he was guilty?2134568684
trans-unit.source: Peter told Simon that he needed to repent of thinking that he could work along with the apostles and cause people to receive the Holy Spirit.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~22#Answer:When Peter told Simon he needed to repent, of what two sins did he tell Simon he was guilty?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~22#Answer:When Peter told Simon he needed to repent, of what two sins did he tell Simon he was guilty?125658854
trans-unit.source: He also told Simon that he needed to repent of being envious of the power that Peter and John had. (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~22#Answer:When Peter told Simon he needed to repent, of what two sins did he tell Simon he was guilty?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.24+How did Simon reply to the warning Peter had given to him that he would be eternally lost?

trans-unit.source: Simon was frightened by Peter's warning and asked him and John to pray that the bad things that Peter had warned him about would not happen to him. (24)

group.id: Q:ACT 8.25+What did Peter and John do after that?

trans-unit.source: They preached to the people in that town about Jesus Christ and told them what they personally knew about him, since they had both known Jesus while he was on earth.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~25#Answer:What did Peter and John do after that?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~25#Answer:What did Peter and John do after that?-1943075613

trans-unit.id: h:!ACT!8~26#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Acts 8:26-40 Philip evangelized an official who was returning to Ethiopia.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Section Heading

group.id: Q:ACT 8.26-40+For what reason did Philip leave the city in Samaria, and where did he go?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~26#Question:For what reason did Philip leave the city in Samaria, and where did he go?
trans-unit.source: For what reason did Philip leave the city in Samaria, and where did he go?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Question:For what reason did Philip leave the city in Samaria, and where did he go?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~26#Answer:For what reason did Philip leave the city in Samaria, and where did he go?-490590994
trans-unit.source: Philip was told by an angel, whom the Lord [God] had sent, to leave Samaria and go south to the road that went from Jerusalem to Gaza through a desert area. (26)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Answer:For what reason did Philip leave the city in Samaria, and where did he go?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.26-40+Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~26#Question:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Question:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?-1660677564
trans-unit.source: Philip met a man who was an official of the queen of Ethiopia. (27)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?571606521
trans-unit.source: He was riding in a chariot, and he was reading from a scroll. The scroll had written on it part of the prophecy of Isaiah. (28)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?2003832646
trans-unit.source: Philip overtook the man and asked him whether he understood what he was reading. (30)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?-909972961
trans-unit.source: The man replied that he needed someone to help him, so Philip told him that the part of the scroll which the man was reading was about the Lord Jesus. (31, 34-35)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Answer:Whom did Philip meet on the road to which he went?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.26-40+How did their conversation end?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~26#Question:How did their conversation end?
trans-unit.source: How did their conversation end?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Question:How did their conversation end?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~26#Answer:How did their conversation end?-1456274478
trans-unit.source: The official became a believer in the Lord Jesus, and when they came to a pool of water, he asked Philip to baptize him. (36-38)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~26#Answer:How did their conversation end?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.27-28+What was the official from Ethiopia doing so far away from his own country?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~27#Question:What was the official from Ethiopia doing so far away from his own country?
trans-unit.source: What was the official from Ethiopia doing so far away from his own country?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~27#Question:What was the official from Ethiopia doing so far away from his own country?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~27#Answer:What was the official from Ethiopia doing so far away from his own country?651283519
trans-unit.source: He had been to Jerusalem to worship God and was now on his way home. (27b-28)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~27#Answer:What was the official from Ethiopia doing so far away from his own country?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.28+What was the man doing as he rode along in his chariot?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~28#Question:What was the man doing as he rode along in his chariot?
trans-unit.source: What was the man doing as he rode along in his chariot?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~28#Question:What was the man doing as he rode along in his chariot?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~28#Answer:What was the man doing as he rode along in his chariot?720920208
trans-unit.source: He was reading from a book [or perhaps from a scroll] which contained what the prophet Isaiah had written long ago. (28)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~28#Answer:What was the man doing as he rode along in his chariot?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.29+What did Philip do when he saw the man reading?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~29#Question:What did Philip do when he saw the man reading?
trans-unit.source: What did Philip do when he saw the man reading?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~29#Question:What did Philip do when he saw the man reading?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~29#Answer:What did Philip do when he saw the man reading?1903714555
trans-unit.source: The Holy Spirit told Philip to go to where the Ethiopian was riding along in his chariot and to stay near him in the road, and Philip went there. (29)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~29#Answer:What did Philip do when he saw the man reading?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.30-31+What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~30#Question:What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?
trans-unit.source: What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~30#Question:What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~30#Answer:What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?15729218
trans-unit.source: Philip asked the Ethiopian whether he understood what he was reading, and the Ethiopian replied that he needed somebody to explain it to him.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~30#Answer:What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~30#Answer:What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?-677802147
trans-unit.source: Then he asked Philip to get up beside him in the chariot. (30-31)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~30#Answer:What did Philip and the Ethiopian say to one another when Philip was close enough to be able to speak to the Ethiopian?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.32-33+What was the passage from Isaiah about that the Ethiopian was reading?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~32#Question:What was the passage from Isaiah about that the Ethiopian was reading?
trans-unit.source: What was the passage from Isaiah about that the Ethiopian was reading?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~32#Question:What was the passage from Isaiah about that the Ethiopian was reading?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~32#Answer:What was the passage from Isaiah about that the Ethiopian was reading?-934792519
trans-unit.source: The passage, [which was from Isaiah 53:7-8], described someone who was caused to suffer unjustly. (32-33)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~32#Answer:What was the passage from Isaiah about that the Ethiopian was reading?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.34+What did the Ethiopian ask Philip?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~34#Question:What did the Ethiopian ask Philip?
trans-unit.source: What did the Ethiopian ask Philip?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~34#Question:What did the Ethiopian ask Philip?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~34#Answer:What did the Ethiopian ask Philip?139856331
trans-unit.source: He asked Philip to tell him to whom the passage referred. (34)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~34#Answer:What did the Ethiopian ask Philip?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.35+What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~35#Question:What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?
trans-unit.source: What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~35#Question:What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~35#Answer:What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?1898550184
trans-unit.source: Philip explained to him that the passage was about someone who had suffered unjustly.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~35#Answer:What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~35#Answer:What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?-1948755614
trans-unit.source: Philip then told the Ethiopian that Jesus was the Messiah. (35)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~35#Answer:What answer did Philip give to the Ethiopian?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.36+How did the Ethiopian respond after Philip told him the passage was about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~36#Question:How did the Ethiopian respond after Philip told him the passage was about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did the Ethiopian respond after Philip told him the passage was about Jesus?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~36#Question:How did the Ethiopian respond after Philip told him the passage was about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~36#Answer:How did the Ethiopian respond after Philip told him the passage was about Jesus?-1350764562
trans-unit.source: When the Ethiopian understood that the passage was about Jesus and [why Jesus had suffered], he believed in Jesus and wanted to be baptized. (36)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~36#Answer:How did the Ethiopian respond after Philip told him the passage was about Jesus?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.38+What happened next?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~38#Question:What happened next?
trans-unit.source: What happened next?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~38#Question:What happened next?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~38#Answer:What happened next?-399892856
trans-unit.source: Although the road they were traveling was through a desert area, they came upon a pool of water, or possibly a stream. Philip believed that the Ethiopian had understood the message about Jesus Christ and now believed in him, so Philip baptized him. (38)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~38#Answer:What happened next?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.39-40+What happened when the two men came up out of the water?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~39#Question:What happened when the two men came up out of the water?
trans-unit.source: What happened when the two men came up out of the water?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~39#Question:What happened when the two men came up out of the water?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~39#Answer:What happened when the two men came up out of the water?-1610706500
trans-unit.source: Philip suddenly disappeared, because the Holy Spirit/Spirit of the Lord took him to Azotus. [The town Azotus was some distance away.] (39a, 40)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~39#Answer:What happened when the two men came up out of the water?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.39+What did the man from Ethiopia do after Philip disappeared?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~39#Question:What did the man from Ethiopia do after Philip disappeared?
trans-unit.source: What did the man from Ethiopia do after Philip disappeared?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~39#Question:What did the man from Ethiopia do after Philip disappeared?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~39#Answer:What did the man from Ethiopia do after Philip disappeared?698575785
trans-unit.source: The man from Ethiopia continued on his way back to his own country. He was happy because he now knew what the prophecy meant that he had been reading. He had put his trust in the Lord Jesus [who suffered for him]. (39b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~39#Answer:What did the man from Ethiopia do after Philip disappeared?

group.id: Q:ACT 8.40+What did Philip do after arriving in Azotus?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!8~40#Question:What did Philip do after arriving in Azotus?
trans-unit.source: What did Philip do after arriving in Azotus?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~40#Question:What did Philip do after arriving in Azotus?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!8~40#Answer:What did Philip do after arriving in Azotus?-782612077
trans-unit.source: He preached the message about Jesus Christ there and in all the other towns that he passed through on his way to Caesarea. (40)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!8~40#Answer:What did Philip do after arriving in Azotus?

trans-unit.note: !ACT!9~1#Question:What happened to Saul that the writer recorded in these verses?

trans-unit.note: !ACT!9~1#Answer:What happened to Saul that the writer recorded in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!9~1#Answer:What happened to Saul that the writer recorded in these verses?-477663266
trans-unit.source: He became a believer in Jesus. (18)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!9~1#Answer:What happened to Saul that the writer recorded in these verses?

group.id: Q:ACT 9.1-2+What did Saul plan to do in order to continue persecuting the believers?

trans-unit.source: What did Saul plan to do in order to continue persecuting the believers?

group.id: Q:ACT 9.3-4+Describe what happened to him as he was getting near Damascus.

trans-unit.note: !ACT!9~3#Question:Describe what happened to him as he was getting near Damascus.

trans-unit.source: A light from heaven [brighter than the sun at noon] flashed around him, and he fell to the ground.

trans-unit.source: Several people who Luke has mentioned in Acts had two names. For example, Tabitha, or Dorcas (9:36), Bar-Jesus, or Elymas (13:6, 8), and Saul, or Paul (13:9). (See the NIV footnote on 9:36.) The reason that these people had two names was that one was the person's name in Hebrew, or Aramaic, and the other was his or her name in Greek.

group.id: Q:ACT 14.15-17+What were some of the other things that Paul told the people about the living God?

trans-unit.source: In Jerusalem, some of the Jewish Christians told the group of believers who had come from Antioch that Gentile believers needed to be circumcised and keep the rest of the Law of Moses. group.id: Q:ACT 15.7-8+What did the apostle Peter say to answer this question?

trans-unit.source: The apostle James said that long ago the Old Testament prophets had written that, in the future, a time would come when God would call Gentiles to seek after him and put their trust in him.

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~13#Answer:What did the apostle James say about the Gentiles?-1765548490

group.id: Q:ACT 15.19-20+What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!15~19#Question:What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?
trans-unit.source: What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~19#Question:What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~19#Answer:What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?1186868729
trans-unit.source: James advised that the Gentiles who were now worshipping God should not be required to keep all of the Law of Moses.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~19#Answer:What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~19#Answer:What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?1318400844
trans-unit.source: There were just four things/practices [which Moses had] written in the Law that he believed the Gentiles should no longer do when they became Christians. (19-20)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~19#Answer:What advice did James give concerning the Gentiles who were turning to the true God?

group.id: Q:ACT 15.20+What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!15~20#Question:What were these four things/practices?
trans-unit.source: What were these four things/practices?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Question:What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: l:!ACT!15~20#Alternate:What were these four things/practices?569558888
trans-unit.source: What were these four things?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Alternate:What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: l:!ACT!15~20#Alternate:What were these four things/practices?118149964
trans-unit.source: What were these four practices?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Alternate:What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?1822747460
trans-unit.source: Gentiles who became Christians were to be advised not to eat food that had been offered to idols.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?-1967397912
trans-unit.source: They were not to have a sexual relationship with any person except the one/husband or wife to whom they were married.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?1179587313
trans-unit.source: They were not to eat the meat of any animal that had been killed without draining its blood.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?1586428147
trans-unit.source: They were not to eat or drink the animal's blood. (20)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~20#Answer:What were these four things/practices?

group.id: Q:ACT 15.21+What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!15~21#Question:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~21#Question:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?1498566331
trans-unit.source: James said that the Law of Moses prohibited those four practices, as well as many others. Many Gentiles attended the Jewish synagogue before they believed in the true God and in his Son, Jesus.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?1269097155
trans-unit.source: They had heard the Law of Moses read many times.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?-229092479
trans-unit.source: Therefore, it would please the Jews if the Gentiles who became believers in Jesus Christ would observe/obey those parts of the Mosaic Law. (21)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that James said that Gentiles who became Christians should avoid those four practices?

group.id: Q:ACT 15.22-35+What did the church leaders in Jerusalem say in the letter that they sent to the Christians in Antioch?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!15~22#Question:What did the church leaders in Jerusalem say in the letter that they sent to the Christians in Antioch?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~22#Answer:What did the church leaders in Jerusalem say in the letter that they sent to the Christians in Antioch?-1570102292
trans-unit.source: The church leaders in Jerusalem told the [Gentile] believers in Antioch that they did not need to be circumcised.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~22#Answer:What did the church leaders in Jerusalem say in the letter that they sent to the Christians in Antioch?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~22#Answer:What did the church leaders in Jerusalem say in the letter that they sent to the Christians in Antioch?1074072499

group.id: Q:ACT 15.22-23+How did the leaders of the church in Jerusalem inform the Gentile believers in Antioch what they had decided?

trans-unit.source: The leaders of the Jerusalem church chose two of their own members to accompany Paul and Barnabas to Antioch.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~22#Answer:How did the leaders of the church in Jerusalem inform the Gentile believers in Antioch what they had decided?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!15~22#Answer:How did the leaders of the church in Jerusalem inform the Gentile believers in Antioch what they had decided?-1752620961
trans-unit.source: Also, the leaders wrote a letter to the believers in Antioch, telling them what they had decided Gentile believers should do about the Law of Moses. The leaders sent this letter with the four men to Antioch. (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!15~22#Answer:How did the leaders of the church in Jerusalem inform the Gentile believers in Antioch what they had decided?

group.id: Q:ACT 16.33+What did the jailer and the other people in his home do to show that they believed in Jesus?

group.id: Q:ACT 16.34+How did the jailer feel, after all that had happened?

group.id: Q:ACT 16.37+What did Paul do when he and Silas heard that?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!16~37#Question:What did Paul do when he and Silas heard that?
trans-unit.source: What did Paul do when he and Silas heard that?

trans-unit.source: Instead, Paul told the messengers to go back and tell the city authorities that they had treated him and Silas unfairly, even though they were Roman citizens.

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!16~37#Answer:What did Paul do when he and Silas heard that?422040808

trans-unit.source: Paul told the messengers to request the city authorities to come themselves to the prison and to release/free him and Silas and bring them out. (37b)

trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~32#Answer:What was the crowd of people doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~32#Answer:What was the crowd of people doing?86826417
trans-unit.source: Most of the crowd who had gathered did not know what the silversmiths were shouting about, but they shouted also.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~32#Answer:What was the crowd of people doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~32#Answer:What was the crowd of people doing?-891972520
trans-unit.source: Those people shouted many different things. (32)

group.id: Q:ACT 19.33+There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~33#Question:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?
trans-unit.source: There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~33#Question:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?1107357535
trans-unit.source: Those Jews thought that they could explain to the crowd that there was no reason for them to be angry and to keep shouting.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?-315139055
trans-unit.source: They/the Jews thought that if one of them talked to the crowd, the crowd would become quiet and would listen.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?1185910773
trans-unit.source: So they pushed a Jew whose name was Alexander to the front of the crowd.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?1696624922
trans-unit.source: Alexander made a sign with his hand, to show that he wanted to speak to the people. (33)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~33#Answer:There were some Jews also in the stadium, and they wanted to quiet the crowd. How did they try to do that?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.34+For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~34#Question:For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?
trans-unit.source: For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Question:For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~34#Answer:For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?33137483
trans-unit.source: The crowd recognized that Alexander was a Jew, so they did not give him a chance to speak to them.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Answer:For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~34#Answer:For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?-101816007
trans-unit.source: They did not want to listen to him [because they knew that Jews did not worship the goddess Artemis]. (34a)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Answer:For what reason did the crowd of people not allow Alexander to speak to them?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.34+What did the crowd do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~34#Question:What did the crowd do then?
trans-unit.source: What did the crowd do then?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Question:What did the crowd do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~34#Answer:What did the crowd do then?-1223010369
trans-unit.source: The crowd all joined together shouting, "We Ephesians praise our goddess Artemis!"
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Answer:What did the crowd do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~34#Answer:What did the crowd do then?1158079251
trans-unit.source: OR "Our goddess Artemis is very great/important!"
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Answer:What did the crowd do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~34#Answer:What did the crowd do then?2128307728
trans-unit.source: They continued shouting that way, all together, for about two hours. (34b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~34#Answer:What did the crowd do then?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.35+The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~35#Question:The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?
trans-unit.source: The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~35#Question:The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~35#Answer:The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?-202886866
trans-unit.source: The town clerk told the crowd of people that the whole world knew that the temple of Artemis was in Ephesus.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~35#Answer:The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~35#Answer:The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?-45054383
trans-unit.source: He said that people would certainly continue to respect her and [would continue to] come to her temple. (35)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~35#Answer:The town clerk finally came to the stadium and spoke to the crowd. What did he tell them?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.36+What else did the town clerk tell the crowd?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~36#Question:What else did the town clerk tell the crowd?
trans-unit.source: What else did the town clerk tell the crowd?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~36#Question:What else did the town clerk tell the crowd?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~36#Answer:What else did the town clerk tell the crowd?1441510454
trans-unit.source: He told them to be quiet, and he warned them not to do anything violent. (36)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~36#Answer:What else did the town clerk tell the crowd?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.37+What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~37#Question:What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?
trans-unit.source: What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~37#Question:What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~37#Answer:What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?-554411612
trans-unit.source: He told the people that there was no reason for them to have seized those two men, because they had done nothing wrong.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~37#Answer:What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~37#Answer:What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?-555006309
trans-unit.source: They had not taken anything from the temples of the gods nor spoken evil about Artemis. (37)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~37#Answer:What did the town clerk say about Paul's two companions?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.38-39+What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~38#Question:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?
trans-unit.source: What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~38#Question:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~38#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?-479980745
trans-unit.source: He reminded them that the Roman government had set up courts to which people could go and complain if someone had done them some wrong.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~38#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~38#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?516964102
trans-unit.source: Those courts met at regular times, and the judges at those courts were appointed by the Government.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~38#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~38#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?205885085
trans-unit.source: The people of Ephesus could assemble there and report whatever/any problems [which they had] to those judges. (38-39)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~38#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the crowd that they should do when they had complaints against anyone?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.40+For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~40#Question:For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?
trans-unit.source: For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~40#Question:For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~40#Answer:For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?127542087
trans-unit.source: The town clerk told the people that there was no reason for them to have rioted.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~40#Answer:For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!19~40#Answer:For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?490561660
trans-unit.source: He was afraid that if higher authorities [in the government] should ask him why the people had rioted, he would be in trouble. (40)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~40#Answer:For what reason did the town clerk order the people to stop shouting?

group.id: Q:ACT 19.41+What did the town clerk tell the people after that?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!19~41#Question:What did the town clerk tell the people after that?
trans-unit.source: What did the town clerk tell the people after that?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~41#Question:What did the town clerk tell the people after that?

trans-unit.source: Then he told the crowd to leave the theater, and they did. (41)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!19~41#Answer:What did the town clerk tell the people after that?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~26#Answer:What did the centurion do when Paul asked him that question?1862085999
trans-unit.source: The centurion went right away and told the commander that Paul was a Roman citizen.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~26#Answer:What did the centurion do when Paul asked him that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~26#Answer:What did the centurion do when Paul asked him that question?-625796070
trans-unit.source: He reminded the commander that it was against the law of Rome to whip/beat a Roman citizen who had not committed some crime. (26)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~26#Answer:What did the centurion do when Paul asked him that question?

group.id: Q:ACT 22.27+What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!22~27#Question:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?
trans-unit.source: What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~27#Question:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~27#Answer:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?-1712166566
trans-unit.source: The commander went personally and asked Paul whether he was a Roman citizen.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~27#Answer:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~27#Answer:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?-597336973
trans-unit.source: Paul replied, "Yes, I was born a Roman citizen."
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~27#Answer:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~27#Answer:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?1477149796
trans-unit.source: OR: "Yes, I was a Roman citizen when I was born." (27)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~27#Answer:What did the commander do when he heard what the centurion told him?

group.id: Q:ACT 22.29+What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!22~29#Question:What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?
trans-unit.source: What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~29#Question:What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~29#Answer:What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?1229658669
trans-unit.source: The soldiers did not beat Paul.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~29#Answer:What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~29#Answer:What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?-34078389
trans-unit.source: They left him alone. (29a)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~29#Answer:What did the soldiers do when they heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

group.id: Q:ACT 22.29+What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!22~29#Question:What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~29#Question:What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~29#Answer:What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?-304706192
trans-unit.source: The commander was alarmed, [because he knew that someone with authority higher than his would probably punish him for ordering solders to whip Paul].
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~29#Answer:What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~29#Answer:What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?1905856422
trans-unit.source: [Roman law prohibited any officer from ordering soldiers to make a Roman citizen a prisoner until that person had been tried and it had been proved that he had committed some crime.] (29b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~29#Answer:What is the reason that the commander was alarmed when he heard that Paul was a Roman citizen?

group.id: Q:ACT 22.30-23.11+How did Paul address the members of the Sanhedrin? What did he tell them about himself?

trans-unit.source: Paul addressed the members of the Sanhedrin as "my brothers/fellow countrymen."
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:How did Paul address the members of the Sanhedrin? What did he tell them about himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~30#Answer:How did Paul address the members of the Sanhedrin? What did he tell them about himself?-713012209

group.id: Q:ACT 22.30-23.11+What did the high priest do when he heard Paul say that?

trans-unit.source: He ordered one or two of the people who were standing near Paul to hit/slap him on the mouth. (2)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the high priest do when he heard Paul say that?

group.id: Q:ACT 22.30-23.11+What did Paul say was the reason for which the Sanhedrin was trying him?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~30#Answer:What did Paul say was the reason for which the Sanhedrin was trying him?-690136220
trans-unit.source: Paul said that the Sanhedrin was trying him because he believed that people who have died will one day become alive again. (6c)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:What did Paul say was the reason for which the Sanhedrin was trying him?

group.id: Q:ACT 22.30+What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?

trans-unit.id: q:!ACT!22~30#Question:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?
trans-unit.source: What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Question:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?-834928811
trans-unit.source: The next day, the commander arranged with the Sanhedrin to question Paul.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?-1353792649
trans-unit.source: [The Sanhedrin was the Supreme Court of the Jews.]
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?-2064676960
trans-unit.source: Then he took the chains off Paul and arranged to have him brought before the Sanhedrin.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?110093944
trans-unit.source: The Sanhedrin was then going to ask Paul questions and judge him. (30)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!22~30#Answer:What did the commander do in order to find out for what reason the Jews were accusing Paul?

trans-unit.source: What did Paul say when someone hit him on the mouth?

trans-unit.id: a:!ACT!23~3#Answer:What did Paul say when someone hit him on the mouth?919592640
trans-unit.source: Paul called the high priest a "whitewashed wall" and told him that God was going to hit him. (3a)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!23~3#Answer:What did Paul say when someone hit him on the mouth?

group.id: Q:ACT 23.3+In what way had the high priest disobeyed the laws of Moses?

trans-unit.source: The high priest had ordered someone to strike Paul. (3b)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!23~3#Answer:In what way had the high priest disobeyed the laws of Moses?

trans-unit.id: n:!ACT!23~3#Note:In what way had the high priest disobeyed the laws of Moses?1457916449
trans-unit.source: He/The high priest was authorized to judge Paul's case, but it was against the laws of Moses for a judge to punish a person before that person defended himself.
trans-unit.note: !ACT!23~3#Note:In what way had the high priest disobeyed the laws of Moses?

group.id: Q:ACT 23.4+Of what did the people who were standing near Paul accuse him?

trans-unit.source: They accused Paul of insulting the high priest.

trans-unit.source: They rebuked him/Paul, because the high priest served God. (4)
trans-unit.note: !ACT!23~4#Answer:Of what did the people who were standing near Paul accuse him?
