group.id: Q:GEN 26.7+When the men of Gerar asked about Rebekah, what did Isaac answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~7#Question:When the men of Gerar asked about Rebekah, what did Isaac answer?
trans-unit.source: When the men of Gerar asked about Rebekah, what did Isaac answer?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~7#Question:When the men of Gerar asked about Rebekah, what did Isaac answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~7#Answer:When the men of Gerar asked about Rebekah, what did Isaac answer?-1893334215
trans-unit.source: He said that Rebekah was his sister. (7)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~7#Answer:When the men of Gerar asked about Rebekah, what did Isaac answer?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.7+What was the reason that he answered that way?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~7#Question:What was the reason that he answered that way?
trans-unit.source: What was the reason that he answered that way?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~7#Question:What was the reason that he answered that way?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~7#Answer:What was the reason that he answered that way?-190281672
trans-unit.source: Isaac answered that way because Rebekah was beautiful, and he was afraid that someone would kill him and take Rebekah as a wife. (7)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~7#Answer:What was the reason that he answered that way?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.8+One day, what did King Abimelech see?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~8#Question:One day, what did King Abimelech see?
trans-unit.source: One day, what did King Abimelech see?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~8#Question:One day, what did King Abimelech see?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~8#Answer:One day, what did King Abimelech see?-1393591132
trans-unit.source: He saw Isaac hugging/embracing Rebekah. (8)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~8#Answer:One day, what did King Abimelech see?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.9+Upon seeing that, what did Abimelech realize about Isaac and Rebekah?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~9#Question:Upon seeing that, what did Abimelech realize about Isaac and Rebekah?
trans-unit.source: Upon seeing that, what did Abimelech realize about Isaac and Rebekah?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~9#Question:Upon seeing that, what did Abimelech realize about Isaac and Rebekah?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~9#Answer:Upon seeing that, what did Abimelech realize about Isaac and Rebekah?-960521066
trans-unit.source: He realized that they were not brother and sister, but rather they were husband and wife. (9)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~9#Answer:Upon seeing that, what did Abimelech realize about Isaac and Rebekah?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.9+So what did Abimelech do next?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~9#Question:So what did Abimelech do next?
trans-unit.source: So what did Abimelech do next?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~9#Question:So what did Abimelech do next?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~9#Answer:So what did Abimelech do next?-332618076
trans-unit.source: He summoned Isaac and questioned him about falsely claiming that Rebekah was his sister. (9)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~9#Answer:So what did Abimelech do next?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.9+So what was Isaac's answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~9#Question:So what was Isaac's answer?
trans-unit.source: So what was Isaac's answer?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~9#Question:So what was Isaac's answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~9#Answer:So what was Isaac's answer?713428165
trans-unit.source: Isaac said that he was afraid that someone (from Gerar) might kill him because Rebekah was beautiful and they might want to take her as a wife. (9)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~9#Answer:So what was Isaac's answer?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.10+What is the reason that the king was upset with Isaac?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~10#Question:What is the reason that the king was upset with Isaac?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the king was upset with Isaac?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~10#Question:What is the reason that the king was upset with Isaac?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~10#Answer:What is the reason that the king was upset with Isaac?-515557627
trans-unit.source: The king was upset, because he knew that men from Gerar might think that Rebekah was unmarried. One of the men might then have had sexual relations with Rebekah/might have taken her as his wife. He would then be guilty of sin. And other people of Gerar would share in that guilt. (10)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~10#Answer:What is the reason that the king was upset with Isaac?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.11+So then what did Abimelech command [to] his people?

trans-unit.source: He said that nobody was allowed to harm Isaac or Rebekah. If a person harmed them, that person would have to die. (11)

group.id: Q:GEN 26.12-25+Tell me about the problems that Isaac and his servants experienced at the time of this incident.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!26~12#Question:Tell me about the problems that Isaac and his servants experienced at the time of this incident.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about the problems that Isaac and his servants experienced at the time of this incident.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~12#Question:Tell me about the problems that Isaac and his servants experienced at the time of this incident.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~12#Answer:Tell me about the problems that Isaac and his servants experienced at the time of this incident.376083200
trans-unit.source: Isaac had become very wealthy and his neighbors began to envy him, so they filled in Isaac's (water) wells. And then King Abimelech asked Isaac to move elsewhere. So Isaac moved, and he/his servants dug two new wells, but the neighbors claimed those wells, also. Finally, when they dug a third well, the neighbors no longer bothered them.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~12#Answer:Tell me about the problems that Isaac and his servants experienced at the time of this incident.

group.id: Q:GEN 26.12+While Isaac was living in Gerar, what kind of work was he doing?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~12#Question:While Isaac was living in Gerar, what kind of work was he doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~12#Answer:While Isaac was living in Gerar, what kind of work was he doing?1068853316
trans-unit.source: He was farming the land. (12)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~12#Answer:While Isaac was living in Gerar, what kind of work was he doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~12#Answer:In what way did God bless Isaac?-1555357643
trans-unit.source: God caused Isaac's crops to grow very well/to multiply by 100, and thus Isaac became wealthy and powerful. (12-14)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~12#Answer:In what way did God bless Isaac?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~14#Question:For what reason did the Philistine people envy Isaac?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~14#Answer:For what reason did the Philistine people envy Isaac?-1310973426
trans-unit.source: They envied him because he had/owned so many animals (sheep, goats, and cattle), and servants. (14)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~14#Answer:For what reason did the Philistine people envy Isaac?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.15+So what did the Philistine people do because they were jealous?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~15#Answer:So what did the Philistine people do because they were jealous?

trans-unit.source: While he was there, what did he do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~18#Question:While he was there, what did he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~18#Answer:While he was there, what did he do?-385065266
trans-unit.source: There were some wells in that region which Abraham's servants had dug many years before. Someone had filled in those wells. So Isaac and his men re-opened the wells. They gave the wells the same names that Abraham had given them. (18)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~18#Answer:While he was there, what did he do?

group.id: Q:GEN 26.19+Did they also dig any new wells?

trans-unit.source: Did they also dig any new wells?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~19#Answer:Did they also dig any new wells?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~20#Question:And then what happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!26~20#Answer:And then what happened?-629369460

trans-unit.note: !GEN!26~24#Answer:What did God say was the reason that he would bless Isaac?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.1-40+Tell what happened in Isaac's family.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~1#Question:Tell what happened in Isaac's family.
trans-unit.source: Tell what happened in Isaac's family.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~1#Question:Tell what happened in Isaac's family.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~1#Answer:Tell what happened in Isaac's family.1434104153
trans-unit.source: Isaac had become an old man, and he wanted to pass on his blessing to his firstborn son. So he called in Esau, and asked him to go and hunt for some wild meat (for a meal). Then Isaac would bless him. Meanwhile, Rebekah overheard the conversation. So she called Jacob and told him to go and bring/get two goats from the flock, in order that she could prepare them and send Jacob to his father to receive the blessing. Jacob was worried that his father would discover that he was pretending to be Esau, but Rebekah told him that she would take care of everything. So Esau went off hunting, and Jacob went out and got two goats. His mother cooked/prepared the goats, and also she put some of the goat skin on Jacob's skin/arms to make him hairy like his brother. Jacob took the meal in to his father, Isaac. Isaac was suspicious at first, but he felt the goat skins and thought/supposed that it was Esau's hairy skin. So Isaac proceeded to give the blessing to Jacob. Immediately/Right after that, Esau arrived and found out what had happened. He asked his father to bless him, too, but Isaac could no longer give Esau the blessing of the firstborn. So Isaac gave Esau (only) a lesser blessing.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~1#Answer:Tell what happened in Isaac's family.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~4#Answer:What was Isaac's purpose when he summoned Esau (to his bedside)?1124807759
trans-unit.source: Isaac wanted to give Esau a blessing before he (Isaac) died. A father would usually reserve that type/kind of blessing for the firstborn son. (4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~4#Answer:What was Isaac's purpose when he summoned Esau (to his bedside)?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~4#Answer:What was Isaac's purpose when he summoned Esau (to his bedside)?418041340
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The concept of "blessing" is central to this chapter. It includes the idea of praying to God, asking God to do good for someone. But it also includes the idea of God guiding someone, enabling them to predict what another person will experience. In this chapter, Isaac was a leading person in what would become the nation of Israel; and Isaac had received special promises from God, even as his father, Abraham had. At that time, Isaac was about to pass on those special promises to his son. (See "bless" in KBT A.1.)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~4#Answer:What was Isaac's purpose when he summoned Esau (to his bedside)?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~32#Answer:Then what happened?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.34+When Esau heard his father say that, what did Esau say?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~34#Question:When Esau heard his father say that, what did Esau say?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~34#Answer:When Esau heard his father say that, what did Esau say?1996105800

trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~34#Answer:When Esau heard his father say that, what did Esau say?

trans-unit.source: And what did Isaac answer?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~35#Question:And what did Isaac answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~35#Answer:And what did Isaac answer?222264493
trans-unit.source: Isaac said that he could not ask God to bless Esau as the firstborn. Isaac said that Esau's younger brother had fooled/deceived him (Isaac), and had taken that which Esau was to inherit/that which rightfully belonged to Esau. (35)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~35#Answer:And what did Isaac answer?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.36+What then did Esau say about his younger brother, Jacob?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~36#Question:What then did Esau say about his younger brother, Jacob?
trans-unit.source: What then did Esau say about his younger brother, Jacob?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~36#Question:What then did Esau say about his younger brother, Jacob?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~36#Answer:What then did Esau say about his younger brother, Jacob?94388874
trans-unit.source: Esau said that his brother's name, "Jacob", was appropriate, because that was the second time that Jacob had deceived him (Esau) and had taken that which (rightfully) belonged to Esau. (36)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~36#Answer:What then did Esau say about his younger brother, Jacob?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.36+At that point what did Esau ask?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~36#Question:At that point what did Esau ask?
trans-unit.source: At that point what did Esau ask?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~36#Question:At that point what did Esau ask?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~36#Answer:At that point what did Esau ask?-1303965205
trans-unit.source: He asked Isaac if there was any other prayer/blessing that Isaac could request for Esau. (36)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~36#Answer:At that point what did Esau ask?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~37#Question:What did Isaac answer Esau?
trans-unit.source: What did Isaac answer Esau?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~37#Question:What did Isaac answer Esau?

trans-unit.source: Isaac said that he had already prayed, requesting very much from God for Jacob. Isaac had prayed that God would make Jacob a leader over his relatives, and that God would give Jacob abundant food and drink. (37)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~37#Answer:What did Isaac answer Esau?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~38#Question:Then what did Esau do?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Esau do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~38#Question:Then what did Esau do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~38#Answer:Then what did Esau do?1106273901

trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~38#Answer:Then what did Esau do?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.38+What was Esau doing at this time that indicates that he was very upset?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~38#Question:What was Esau doing at this time that indicates that he was very upset?
trans-unit.source: What was Esau doing at this time that indicates that he was very upset?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~38#Question:What was Esau doing at this time that indicates that he was very upset?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~38#Answer:What was Esau doing at this time that indicates that he was very upset?-163063948

trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~38#Answer:What was Esau doing at this time that indicates that he was very upset?

trans-unit.source: Then what did Isaac do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~39#Question:Then what did Isaac do?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~39#Question:According to Isaac, what would the soil be like where Esau would be living?

trans-unit.source: What do you think is meant by, "You will live by your sword"?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~40#Question:What do you think is meant by, "You will live by your sword"?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~40#Answer:What do you think is meant by, "You will live by your sword"?-185430179
trans-unit.source: Probably it means that Esau would be fighting constantly. (40)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~40#Answer:What do you think is meant by, "You will live by your sword"?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.40+Would Esau serve his brother Jacob for the rest of his life?

trans-unit.source: Would Esau serve his brother Jacob for the rest of his life?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~40#Question:Would Esau serve his brother Jacob for the rest of his life?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~40#Answer:Would Esau serve his brother Jacob for the rest of his life?-866934027
trans-unit.source: No, Esau would oppose his brother until he could remove/free himself from under his brother's power, as/like a cow throwing/getting off its yoke. (40)

trans-unit.source: Genesis 27:41-28:5 Jacob fled (from) Esau.

group.id: Q:GEN 27.41-28.5+What was happening at the time of this incident?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~41#Question:What was happening at the time of this incident?
trans-unit.source: What was happening at the time of this incident?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Question:What was happening at the time of this incident?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~41#Answer:What was happening at the time of this incident?-635836166
trans-unit.source: Esau was plotting to take revenge on Jacob by killing him, so Rebekah told Jacob that he must flee. Rebekah told Isaac that she did not want Jacob to marry a Canaanite woman. Therefore Isaac told Jacob to go to his uncle Laban and to marry one of Laban's daughters. Then Isaac prayed a blessing for/asked God to bless/help Jacob.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Answer:What was happening at the time of this incident?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.41+What was Esau planning to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~41#Question:What was Esau planning to do?
trans-unit.source: What was Esau planning to do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Question:What was Esau planning to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~41#Answer:What was Esau planning to do?-808157778
trans-unit.source: He was planning to wait until his father (had) died, and he would then kill Jacob. (41)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Answer:What was Esau planning to do?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.41+What had Jacob done that caused Esau to be upset?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~41#Question:What had Jacob done that caused Esau to be upset?
trans-unit.source: What had Jacob done that caused Esau to be upset?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Question:What had Jacob done that caused Esau to be upset?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~41#Answer:What had Jacob done that caused Esau to be upset?2083934555
trans-unit.source: Jacob had deceived Isaac and obtained the blessing that would have been Esau's. (41)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Answer:What had Jacob done that caused Esau to be upset?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.41-45+What can you say about Esau's character?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~41#Question:What can you say about Esau's character?
trans-unit.source: What can you say about Esau's character?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Question:What can you say about Esau's character?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~41#Answer:What can you say about Esau's character?-31614175
trans-unit.source: He was willing to retaliate, even to the extent of killing his own brother. (Also, there is some question about whether or not Esau was entitled to the special blessing, since he had sold his rights as firstborn to Jacob in return for some stew.)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~41#Answer:What can you say about Esau's character?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.42+How did Jacob's mother (come to) learn about what Esau was intending to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~42#Question:How did Jacob's mother (come to) learn about what Esau was intending to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~42#Answer:How did Jacob's mother (come to) learn about what Esau was intending to do?-793958620
trans-unit.source: She heard about Esau's plan (perhaps from a friend of Esau's, or a neighbor - it is not specified). (42)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~42#Answer:How did Jacob's mother (come to) learn about what Esau was intending to do?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.42-43+When Rebekah heard of Esau's plan, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~42#Answer:When Rebekah heard of Esau's plan, what did she do?1110532079
trans-unit.source: She summoned Jacob, and told him to quickly flee to his uncle Laban in Haran. (42-43)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~42#Answer:When Rebekah heard of Esau's plan, what did she do?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.45+What else was Rebekah concerned about at that time, in addition to Jacob's safety?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~45#Question:What else was Rebekah concerned about at that time, in addition to Jacob's safety?
trans-unit.source: What else was Rebekah concerned about at that time, in addition to Jacob's safety?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~45#Question:What else was Rebekah concerned about at that time, in addition to Jacob's safety?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~45#Answer:What else was Rebekah concerned about at that time, in addition to Jacob's safety?-1950609292
trans-unit.source: She was afraid that Esau might kill Jacob, and that someone else also might die. She might have been concerned about her husband, Isaac, as he was very old and it seemed that he might soon die. Or she might have been thinking of Esau. If Esau killed Jacob, then someone (else) might want to avenge Jacob/Jacob's death, and kill Esau also. (45)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~45#Answer:What else was Rebekah concerned about at that time, in addition to Jacob's safety?

group.id: Q:GEN 27.46+What did Rebekah say to her husband, Isaac?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!27~46#Question:What did Rebekah say to her husband, Isaac?
trans-unit.source: What did Rebekah say to her husband, Isaac?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~46#Question:What did Rebekah say to her husband, Isaac?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!27~46#Answer:What did Rebekah say to her husband, Isaac?-1809056285
trans-unit.source: She said that she was very upset with Esau's Hittite wives, and that she would die if Jacob took a wife from the Hittites. -OR- She said that she was very upset with Esau's Hittite wives, and that she would rather die than have Jacob take a wife from the Hittites. (46)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!27~46#Answer:What did Rebekah say to her husband, Isaac?

trans-unit.source: He told Jacob not to marry a Canaanite woman. (1)

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!28~1#Answer:What did Isaac say to Jacob?-1036735169
trans-unit.source: He told Jacob to go to Paddan-aram/Mesopotamia, and to get/find a wife there from the family of Laban (who was Jacob's uncle). (2)

group.id: Q:GEN 28.3-4+As Isaac asked God to bless Jacob, what did he (Isaac) request (of God)?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!28~3#Question:As Isaac asked God to bless Jacob, what did he (Isaac) request (of God)?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!28~3#Answer:As Isaac asked God to bless Jacob, what did he (Isaac) request (of God)?2053452369
trans-unit.source: He prayed that Almighty God would give Jacob many descendants, and make him ruler over a group of nations. Isaac prayed that God would bless/do good for Jacob as he (God) had blessed Abraham. And Isaac prayed that Jacob would be able to receive/get the land that God had promised to Abraham. (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!28~3#Answer:As Isaac asked God to bless Jacob, what did he (Isaac) request (of God)?

group.id: Q:GEN 29.1-14a+As Jacob came to the end of his journey, how did it happen that he was able to find out where his uncle Laban was living?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!29~1#Answer:As Jacob came to the end of his journey, how did it happen that he was able to find out where his uncle Laban was living?-1118849955
trans-unit.source: Jacob arrived at a well where sheep were waiting to get their drinking water. It happened that Rachel, a daughter of Laban, also arrived at the well. Jacob drew/got water for Rachel's sheep, and explained who he was. Rachel ran home and summoned/got her father. Laban went to the well to see Jacob and to take/bring him (to Laban's) home.

trans-unit.source: This story has similarities with the story of Abraham's servant traveling a long distance to find/get a wife for Isaac, and meeting Rebekah at a well. group.id: Q:GEN 29.14b-30+Tell me about how Jacob became married.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!29~14#Question:Tell me about how Jacob became married.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about how Jacob became married.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!29~14#Question:Tell me about how Jacob became married.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!29~14#Answer:Tell me about how Jacob became married.-1574545838
trans-unit.source: He was working for his uncle, Laban, and Laban asked Jacob what he (Jacob) wanted for his wages. So Jacob offered to work for Laban for seven years in return for being able to marry Rachel, Laban's younger daughter. After seven years, Laban held a wedding feast, but on the wedding night, Laban substituted Leah, his older daughter, for Rachel. The next morning, Jacob discovered that Laban had deceived him. Laban told him that he (Jacob) could also have Rachel as his wife, if Jacob would work another seven years. So a week after Jacob married Leah, he also married Rachel, and then worked (for) another seven years.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!29~14#Answer:Tell me about how Jacob became married.

trans-unit.source: The Hebrew text uses the number "ten" here. The one responding to these questions should provide an answer which is consistent with the translated text.

group.id: Q:GEN 31.22-42+In this passage, what happened to Jacob and those with him?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!31~22#Question:In this passage, what happened to Jacob and those with him?
trans-unit.source: In this passage, what happened to Jacob and those with him?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!31~22#Question:In this passage, what happened to Jacob and those with him?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!31~22#Answer:In this passage, what happened to Jacob and those with him?-1238124951
trans-unit.source: Laban discovered that Jacob had left, and had taken his wives and children and flocks. So Laban and some of his relatives chased after Jacob and his family. Just before Laban caught up with them, God appeared to Laban and told Laban to be careful (about what he said to Jacob). So Laban arrived at Jacob's camp and asked why Jacob had left secretly. Laban accused Jacob of stealing Laban's household gods/idols. Jacob insisted that he had not stolen the gods/idols, nor had anyone else in his family stolen them. Laban searched everywhere in Jacob's camp, but could not find the gods/idols. Then Jacob scolded Laban very strongly.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!31~22#Answer:In this passage, what happened to Jacob and those with him?

group.id: Q:GEN 31.43-55+How was the conflict between Laban and Jacob finally resolved?

trans-unit.source: How was the conflict between Laban and Jacob finally resolved?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!31~43#Answer:How was the conflict between Laban and Jacob finally resolved?-1540591201
trans-unit.source: The two men made a peace treaty. They affirmed before God that they would not harm each other. They set up a pile of stones as a memorial of the treaty, and they shared a meal together. Then Laban said farewell to his daughters and grandchildren, and he returned home.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!31~43#Answer:How was the conflict between Laban and Jacob finally resolved?

group.id: Q:GEN 31.43-44+After Jacob confronted Laban with the way that Laban had treated Jacob unjustly, how did Laban respond to Jacob?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!31~43#Question:After Jacob confronted Laban with the way that Laban had treated Jacob unjustly, how did Laban respond to Jacob?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!31~43#Answer:After Jacob confronted Laban with the way that Laban had treated Jacob unjustly, how did Laban respond to Jacob?1709693031
trans-unit.source: Laban claimed that he still had rights over Jacob's wives and children, since the wives were his (Laban's) daughters, and Jacob's children were his (Laban's) grandchildren. Laban even claimed that the animals were his (Laban's). But then he admitted that he could not take them from Jacob. So he suggested that he and Jacob make a covenant/agreement. (43-44)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!31~43#Answer:After Jacob confronted Laban with the way that Laban had treated Jacob unjustly, how did Laban respond to Jacob?

group.id: Q:GEN 33.1-20+What happened when Jacob and Esau finally met?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!33~1#Answer:What happened when Jacob and Esau finally met?-1807140328
trans-unit.source: Jacob arranged his family in a line, and went ahead of them to meet Esau. The brothers embraced each other, and then Jacob introduced his wives and children to Esau. Jacob convinced Esau to accept his gifts. Esau offered to accompany Jacob and his family on the rest of their journey, but Jacob declined.

group.id: Q:GEN 33.1-3+When Jacob saw Esau coming, what did he do?

trans-unit.source: When Jacob saw Esau coming, what did he do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!33~1#Question:When Jacob saw Esau coming, what did he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!33~1#Answer:When Jacob saw Esau coming, what did he do?-1700504473
trans-unit.source: He arranged his family into a line/column. He put Leah's and Rachel's servants in front with their children. Then he placed Leah and her children, and at the rear/back, Rachel and Joseph. But Jacob went ahead of them all. (2-3)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!33~1#Answer:When Jacob saw Esau coming, what did he do?

group.id: Q:GEN 33.1-3+In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!33~1#Question:In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?
trans-unit.source: In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!33~1#Question:In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!33~1#Answer:In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?-991864841
trans-unit.source: He did that probably because they were his favorites, and had the highest status within the family. It was probably customary for those of lower status to be the first to bow in submission to a powerful person such as Esau.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!33~1#Answer:In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!33~1#Answer:In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?220747890
trans-unit.source: Also if Esau were to attack them, the wives and children would have an opportunity to escape. Rachel and Joseph, being at the rear, would have the clearest path to flee.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!33~1#Answer:In your opinion, for what reason did Jacob place Rachel and Joseph at the back?

trans-unit.source: First, the two servants of Leah and Rachel (that is, Bilhah and Zilpah), brought their children to Esau, and they all bowed down to him. Then, Leah and her children did the same. Finally, Rachel and Joseph did likewise. (6-7)

trans-unit.id: h:!GEN!34~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Genesis 34:1-31 Jacob's sons deceived Shechem and Hamor and took revenge at Shechem.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!34~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:GEN 34.1-31+Tell what happened here to Jacob's family and what they did in response.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!34~1#Question:Tell what happened here to Jacob's family and what they did in response.
trans-unit.source: Tell what happened here to Jacob's family and what they did in response.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!34~1#Question:Tell what happened here to Jacob's family and what they did in response.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!34~1#Answer:Tell what happened here to Jacob's family and what they did in response.-111687403
trans-unit.source: A powerful young Canaanite man named Shechem raped Dinah, a daughter of Jacob. When Dinah's brothers heard about it, they were extremely upset. Shechem and his father approached Jacob and his family, asking if Shechem could marry Dinah. Her brothers thought of a way/means to take revenge. So they told Shechem that he could marry Dinah only if he and all the men of their town would be circumcised. Shechem agreed to the condition, and he was able to persuade the other men of the town to also be circumcised. And then three days later, when all the men were recovering and unable to defend themselves, two of Dinah's brothers, Levi and Simeon, went to the town and slaughtered all the men. The other sons of Jacob took away all the women and children and wealth. Jacob was now very upset with his two violent sons, but they felt that they were justified because of how Shechem had treated their sister.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!34~1#Answer:Tell what happened here to Jacob's family and what they did in response.

trans-unit.source: Joseph was 17 years old at that time. He looked after sheep with his half-brothers. He sometimes told his father about bad things that his half-brothers did. group.id: Q:GEN 37.12-36+What happened to Joseph?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!37~12#Question:What happened to Joseph?
trans-unit.source: What happened to Joseph?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!37~12#Question:What happened to Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!37~12#Answer:What happened to Joseph?579759350
trans-unit.source: His father sent him to check on his brothers (who were working) in the fields, and his brothers decided to harm him. First they were going to kill him, but Reuben persuaded them to just put Joseph in an empty pit. Later some traders came by, and the brothers sold Joseph to them as a slave. So the traders took Joseph to Egypt. Meanwhile, Joseph's brothers killed a goat, smeared some blood on Joseph's special robe, and took the bloodied robe home to Jacob. When Jacob saw it, he was extremely upset.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!37~12#Answer:What happened to Joseph?

group.id: Q:GEN 37.35+What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!37~35#Question:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!37~35#Question:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!37~35#Answer:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?-911900004
trans-unit.source: He was referring to the place where the spirit/soul of a person goes when he or she dies.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!37~35#Answer:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?

trans-unit.id: n:!GEN!37~35#Note:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?-155656882
trans-unit.source: The Hebrew term here is "sheol". It did not refer specifically to heaven or to hell. It had a more general meaning: the place where the spirit/soul of any person goes when he or she dies.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!37~35#Note:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?

trans-unit.id: n:!GEN!37~35#Note:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?1928835780
trans-unit.source: If a literal term such as "grave" is used in the translation, ensure that it can also carry a more figurative sense (and that that sense is understood in this context) because Jacob could not have meant that he would be buried in the same grave or tomb as Joseph, since he believed that Joseph's body had been eaten.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!37~35#Note:What do you think he meant by "world of the dead"?

group.id: Q:GEN 40.1-23+Tell what Joseph was able to do in prison on this occasion.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!40~1#Question:Tell what Joseph was able to do in prison on this occasion.
trans-unit.source: Tell what Joseph was able to do in prison on this occasion.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!40~1#Question:Tell what Joseph was able to do in prison on this occasion.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!40~1#Answer:Tell what Joseph was able to do in prison on this occasion.-1452725884
trans-unit.source: Pharaoh had imprisoned two of his servants in the same jail where Joseph was. While they were there, one night each of those servants had a special dream. They were upset because they did not know what their dreams meant. But when they told their dreams to Joseph, he told them the meanings of the dreams. He said that Pharaoh would release one of them from prison in three days, but that Pharaoh would execute the other one in three days. And that is (exactly) what happened. But the one whom Pharaoh released from prison forgot all about Joseph.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!40~1#Answer:Tell what Joseph was able to do in prison on this occasion.

group.id: Q:GEN 41.1-36+What was causing Pharaoh to be very upset?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~1#Question:What was causing Pharaoh to be very upset?
trans-unit.source: What was causing Pharaoh to be very upset?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~1#Answer:What was causing Pharaoh to be very upset?-1285684979
trans-unit.source: He had had two dreams one night, and he was sure that they had a meaning, but he did not know what their meaning was. And none of his wise men could tell him the meaning.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~1#Answer:What was causing Pharaoh to be very upset?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.1-36+How was Pharaoh finally able to learn the meaning of his dreams?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~1#Answer:How was Pharaoh finally able to learn the meaning of his dreams?546421853
trans-unit.source: He had Joseph brought to him, and Joseph told him the meaning.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~1#Answer:How was Pharaoh finally able to learn the meaning of his dreams?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.2-4+Tell me about Pharaoh's first dream.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~2#Question:Tell me about Pharaoh's first dream.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about Pharaoh's first dream.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~2#Question:Tell me about Pharaoh's first dream.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~2#Answer:Tell me about Pharaoh's first dream.-1978528522
trans-unit.source: In his dream, he was standing near the Nile River. There he saw seven fat and healthy cows come from the river. And then seven different cows appeared - but they were all very thin and ugly. (At first) they stood near the fat cows. Then (suddenly) the thin cows ate the fat cows. (2-4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~2#Answer:Tell me about Pharaoh's first dream.

group.id: Q:GEN 41.4+What happened to Pharaoh immediately after the first dream?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~4#Question:What happened to Pharaoh immediately after the first dream?
trans-unit.source: What happened to Pharaoh immediately after the first dream?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~4#Question:What happened to Pharaoh immediately after the first dream?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~4#Answer:What happened to Pharaoh immediately after the first dream?1038497014
trans-unit.source: He woke up. (4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~4#Answer:What happened to Pharaoh immediately after the first dream?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.5-7+Tell me about Pharaoh's second dream.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~5#Question:Tell me about Pharaoh's second dream.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about Pharaoh's second dream.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~5#Question:Tell me about Pharaoh's second dream.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~5#Answer:Tell me about Pharaoh's second dream.-984824983
trans-unit.source: In his second dream, he saw a stalk of grain with seven fat, healthy heads/clusters. Then on the same stalk he saw another seven heads/clusters, but they were thin and very unhealthy/withered. And then the thin ones ate the fat ones. (5-7)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~5#Answer:Tell me about Pharaoh's second dream.

trans-unit.source: He said that Pharaoh had put him in prison, along with the chief baker. And that one night, each of them had had a dream. A young Hebrew man who was in prison with them was able to tell them the meaning of their dreams. And everything had happened exactly as the young Hebrew man had said they would. (10-13)

group.id: Q:GEN 41.14+What did Pharaoh do next?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~14#Question:What did Pharaoh do next?
trans-unit.source: What did Pharaoh do next?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~14#Question:What did Pharaoh do next?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~14#Answer:What did Pharaoh do next?1655236961
trans-unit.source: He sent for Joseph. // He had Joseph brought from the prison. (14)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~14#Answer:What did Pharaoh do next?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.14+What did Joseph have to do before he appeared before Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~14#Question:What did Joseph have to do before he appeared before Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph have to do before he appeared before Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~14#Question:What did Joseph have to do before he appeared before Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~14#Answer:What did Joseph have to do before he appeared before Pharaoh?-1043494685
trans-unit.source: He had to shave (his face, and probably cut his hair), and dress in acceptable clothes. (14)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~14#Answer:What did Joseph have to do before he appeared before Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.16+When Pharaoh asked Joseph to tell him the meaning of his dreams, what was Joseph's first response?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~16#Question:When Pharaoh asked Joseph to tell him the meaning of his dreams, what was Joseph's first response?
trans-unit.source: When Pharaoh asked Joseph to tell him the meaning of his dreams, what was Joseph's first response?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~16#Answer:When Pharaoh asked Joseph to tell him the meaning of his dreams, what was Joseph's first response?-652414476
trans-unit.source: He said that he was not able to interpret dreams himself, but that God could reveal the meaning. (16)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~16#Answer:When Pharaoh asked Joseph to tell him the meaning of his dreams, what was Joseph's first response?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.16+What does this suggest about Joseph's character?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!41~16#Question:What does this suggest about Joseph's character?
trans-unit.source: What does this suggest about Joseph's character?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~16#Question:What does this suggest about Joseph's character?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~16#Answer:What does this suggest about Joseph's character?883835580
trans-unit.source: It shows that he trusted (in) God, and that he was humble. He did not want anyone to think that he (Joseph) had powers or abilities which he did not truly have in himself.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~16#Answer:What does this suggest about Joseph's character?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.19+What did Pharaoh say about the thin cows when he first saw them in his dream?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~19#Answer:What did Pharaoh say about the thin cows when he first saw them in his dream?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.21+And after the thin cows had eaten the fat ones, how did they appear?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~21#Answer:And after the thin cows had eaten the fat ones, how did they appear?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.25+According to Joseph, what was the purpose of Pharaoh's two dreams?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.26+What was the meaning of the seven fat cows and seven plump heads of grain in the dreams?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~26#Answer:What was the meaning of the seven fat cows and seven plump heads of grain in the dreams?1159859212
trans-unit.source: They represented seven years of abundance/prosperity, with very good crops. (26)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~26#Answer:What was the meaning of the seven fat cows and seven plump heads of grain in the dreams?

group.id: Q:GEN 41.25-26+Since Pharaoh had two dreams, did that mean that there would be two times of abundance, and that there would also be two times of famine?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!41~25#Answer:Since Pharaoh had two dreams, did that mean that there would be two times of abundance, and that there would also be two times of famine?1105796645
trans-unit.source: No, both of the dreams referred to (the) one time of abundance followed by (the) one seven-year famine. (25-26)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!41~25#Answer:Since Pharaoh had two dreams, did that mean that there would be two times of abundance, and that there would also be two times of famine?

group.id: Q:GEN 42.1-24+Tell what happened with Joseph's family/Joseph's father and brothers during the time of famine.

trans-unit.source: Tell what happened with Joseph's family during the time of famine.

trans-unit.id: l:!GEN!42~1#Alternate:Tell what happened with Joseph's family/Joseph's father and brothers during the time of famine.-1993060735
trans-unit.source: Tell what happened with Joseph's father and brothers during the time of famine.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!42~1#Alternate:Tell what happened with Joseph's family/Joseph's father and brothers during the time of famine.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!42~1#Answer:Tell what happened with Joseph's family/Joseph's father and brothers during the time of famine.1352350810
trans-unit.source: They, too, had no food in Canaan because of the famine, so all of Joseph's brothers, except (for) Benjamin, went to Egypt to buy food. When they arrived, they had to go to Joseph to buy/get grain. They did not recognize him, but he recognized them. He accused the brothers of being foreign spies. They insisted that they were not spies, but rather were brothers who were in need of food. They mentioned that their father and youngest brother were still back in Canaan. Joseph told them that he would not believe them unless they brought their youngest brother to him. So he kept Simeon in jail, and sent the other nine brothers home to get/bring back Benjamin. When they arrived home, they found that the money that was to have been payment for the grain was in their grain sacks. They told Jacob about all that had happened. Jacob was very upset that now he had lost Simeon too (in addition to Joseph). So he said that he would not allow his nine sons/the brothers to take Benjamin back with them to Egypt, because he feared that Benjamin, too, would not return.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!42~1#Answer:Tell what happened with Joseph's family/Joseph's father and brothers during the time of famine.

group.id: Q:GEN 42.25-38+What happened as the brothers traveled back home to Canaan?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!42~25#Answer:What happened as the brothers traveled back home to Canaan?1783629529
trans-unit.source: On the way, one of them found that the money that he had used to buy grain was still inside his grain sack (on top of the grain). They arrived home and told Jacob about what had happened in Egypt. Then they found that the payment money was in all of their grain sacks. They did not understand what was happening and they were terrified. Meanwhile, Jacob was terribly upset because he had not only lost Joseph, but now it appeared that he had also lost Simeon. So he was not willing to risk sending Benjamin to Egypt.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!42~25#Answer:What happened as the brothers traveled back home to Canaan?

trans-unit.source: They told their father, Jacob, about all that had happened. They said that the man in charge in Egypt had spoken roughly to them, and had accused them of being spies. trans-unit.source: Jacob decided that he must allow Benjamin to go to Egypt. So he sent expensive gifts, and double the payment for the grain. (11-14)

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!43~11#Answer:Tell me about the gifts that Jacob had his sons take to Egypt.-302142307
trans-unit.source: They were probably special things that might not have been readily available in Egypt. They included types of nuts (pistachio nuts and almonds), honey, and some plant juice/sap/liquid which was probably used as medicine or perfume. (11)

trans-unit.id: h:!GEN!43~18#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Genesis 43:18-34 Joseph honored/entertained his brothers.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!43~18#Section Heading

group.id: Q:GEN 43.18-34+Tell me about what Joseph's brothers experienced on this occasion.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!43~18#Question:Tell me about what Joseph's brothers experienced on this occasion.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about what Joseph's brothers experienced on this occasion.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!43~18#Question:Tell me about what Joseph's brothers experienced on this occasion.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!43~18#Answer:Tell me about what Joseph's brothers experienced on this occasion.-5165658
trans-unit.source: First, they told the man in charge of Joseph's household about the money that the brothers had found in their grain sacks. The man answered that they did not need to worry about that. Then the man released Simeon from jail and brought him to his brothers. Joseph spoke briefly with them about their father and about Benjamin, the youngest brother. Then Joseph fed them a special meal.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!43~18#Answer:Tell me about what Joseph's brothers experienced on this occasion.

group.id: Q:GEN 43.18+What do you think is the reason that the brothers were afraid to go to Joseph's home?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!43~18#Question:What do you think is the reason that the brothers were afraid to go to Joseph's home?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that the brothers were afraid to go to Joseph's home?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!43~18#Question:What do you think is the reason that the brothers were afraid to go to Joseph's home?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!43~18#Answer:What do you think is the reason that the brothers were afraid to go to Joseph's home?-666065623
trans-unit.source: It was very unusual for someone in Joseph's high position to invite a group such as those to his home. The brothers tried to understand why this was happening. They supposed that someone might have reported that, when the brothers got grain the first time, they did not pay for it. And now Joseph might punish them as though they had stolen the grain. (18)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!43~18#Answer:What do you think is the reason that the brothers were afraid to go to Joseph's home?

group.id: Q:GEN 44.1-34+After Joseph's brothers bought their grain and left for home, what happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!44~1#Question:After Joseph's brothers bought their grain and left for home, what happened?
trans-unit.source: After Joseph's brothers bought their grain and left for home, what happened?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!44~1#Question:After Joseph's brothers bought their grain and left for home, what happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!44~1#Answer:After Joseph's brothers bought their grain and left for home, what happened?-54690464
trans-unit.source: The man in charge of Joseph's household chased after/pursued them and accused them of stealing a special cup from Joseph. The brothers denied it. The man searched their grain sacks and found the cup in Benjamin's sack. He said that Benjamin would have to stay in Egypt as a slave. The brothers all returned to Joseph, and Joseph again said that Benjamin would have to stay as his slave. Then Judah spoke up. He told Joseph that their father, Jacob, would die if Benjamin did not return (with them) to Canaan. And Judah offered to remain in Egypt as Joseph's slave in place of Benjamin.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!44~1#Answer:After Joseph's brothers bought their grain and left for home, what happened?

group.id: Q:GEN 44.1-34+What do you think might have been Joseph's purpose in all of this?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!44~1#Question:What do you think might have been Joseph's purpose in all of this?
trans-unit.source: What do you think might have been Joseph's purpose in all of this?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!44~1#Question:What do you think might have been Joseph's purpose in all of this?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!44~1#Answer:What do you think might have been Joseph's purpose in all of this?46051590
trans-unit.source: Probably he was testing his brothers. Perhaps Benjamin had taken Joseph's place as Jacob's favorite son. And if the other brothers had not changed, then they would use this opportunity to get rid of Benjamin - to cause him to become a slave in Egypt as had happened to Joseph years ago. But if the brothers were sorry for what they had done to Joseph - and to their father, Jacob - then perhaps at this time they would do anything they could to keep Benjamin from being enslaved, and to return him to his father in Canaan.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!44~1#Answer:What do you think might have been Joseph's purpose in all of this?

group.id: Q:GEN 45.1-28+What happened after Judah finished pleading with Joseph?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!45~1#Question:What happened after Judah finished pleading with Joseph?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!45~1#Question:What happened after Judah finished pleading with Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!45~1#Answer:What happened after Judah finished pleading with Joseph?1728871602
trans-unit.source: Joseph told his brothers who he really was - that he was the brother whom they had sold into slavery. He told them not to worry, because it was all a part of God's plan. And then he told them to go home and bring Jacob and all of their families to come and live in Egypt. Pharaoh was pleased to hear of Joseph's brothers and Joseph's father. Pharaoh also said that Jacob and his entire family should move to Egypt. When the brothers arrived home with the news, at first Jacob could not believe them. But they persuaded him, and Jacob agreed to go to Egypt to see Joseph.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!45~1#Answer:What happened after Judah finished pleading with Joseph?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: This is perhaps the first reference in the Old Testament to the concept of "remnant" - that God has acted to preserve some of his people. On this and other occasions, God acts in such a way as to preserve a "remnant" or "remainder" of his people. He will not allow anyone to completely destroy his people, even though many of them will become unfaithful to him.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~3#Answer:What are four wonderful promises that God spoke to/promised to Jacob?1658106513
trans-unit.source: God said that he would be with him in Egypt. He also said that Jacob's descendants would become a great nation. God assured Jacob that Joseph would look after him when Jacob's time came to die/when it came time for Jacob to die. And God promised that he would bring Jacob/would bring Jacob's descendants back to Canaan. (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~3#Answer:What are four wonderful promises that God spoke to/promised to Jacob?

trans-unit.id: n:!GEN!46~3#Note:What are four wonderful promises that God spoke to/promised to Jacob?-452933039
trans-unit.source: It is not certain whether God's promise to bring Jacob back to Canaan is referring specifically to bringing his corpse back to Canaan, or to the Exodus, when God would bring Jacob's descendants back to Canaan. Or perhaps it refers to both Jacob's corpse and to his many descendents.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~3#Note:What are four wonderful promises that God spoke to/promised to Jacob?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~27#Answer:What is the total number of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt?

trans-unit.id: h:!GEN!46~28#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Genesis 46:28-47:12 Jacob and his sons settled in Egypt.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~28#Section Heading

group.id: Q:GEN 46.28-47.12+Tell what happened next to Jacob and his sons.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~28#Question:Tell what happened next to Jacob and his sons.
trans-unit.source: Tell what happened next to Jacob and his sons.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~28#Question:Tell what happened next to Jacob and his sons.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~28#Answer:Tell what happened next to Jacob and his sons.1850145397
trans-unit.source: They arrived in Egypt, and Joseph took some of them to meet Pharaoh. Pharaoh asked them about their work/occupation, and Pharaoh gave permission for them to settle in Goshen. So Joseph helped them to settle there, and provided everything that they needed.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~28#Answer:Tell what happened next to Jacob and his sons.

group.id: Q:GEN 46.28+As Jacob and his family were traveling to Egypt, what did Jacob tell Judah to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~28#Question:As Jacob and his family were traveling to Egypt, what did Jacob tell Judah to do?
trans-unit.source: As Jacob and his family were traveling to Egypt, what did Jacob tell Judah to do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~28#Question:As Jacob and his family were traveling to Egypt, what did Jacob tell Judah to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~28#Answer:As Jacob and his family were traveling to Egypt, what did Jacob tell Judah to do?-840930366
trans-unit.source: He told Judah to go ahead in order to learn the way, and then lead them all to Goshen. (28)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~28#Answer:As Jacob and his family were traveling to Egypt, what did Jacob tell Judah to do?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.29+When Jacob and the family arrived at Goshen, what did Joseph do?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~29#Question:When Jacob and the family arrived at Goshen, what did Joseph do?
trans-unit.source: When Jacob and the family arrived at Goshen, what did Joseph do?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~29#Question:When Jacob and the family arrived at Goshen, what did Joseph do?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~29#Answer:When Jacob and the family arrived at Goshen, what did Joseph do?-2095364634
trans-unit.source: He traveled in his chariot/cart to Goshen (to meet his father and the rest of the family). (29)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~29#Answer:When Jacob and the family arrived at Goshen, what did Joseph do?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.29+Describe Joseph's meeting with his father.

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~29#Question:Describe Joseph's meeting with his father.
trans-unit.source: Describe Joseph's meeting with his father.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~29#Question:Describe Joseph's meeting with his father.

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~29#Answer:Describe Joseph's meeting with his father.-321911990
trans-unit.source: As soon as Joseph arrived, he embraced/hugged his father, and cried for joy (for) a long time. (29)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~29#Answer:Describe Joseph's meeting with his father.

group.id: Q:GEN 46.30+What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~30#Question:What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?
trans-unit.source: What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~30#Question:What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~30#Answer:What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?431989878
trans-unit.source: Jacob said that because he had now seen his long-lost son, he could die peacefully/contentedly. // When he (Jacob) died, he would die peacefully/satisfied. (30)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~30#Answer:What did Jacob say when he met Joseph?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.30+Do you think that Jacob meant that he wanted to die soon?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~30#Question:Do you think that Jacob meant that he wanted to die soon?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jacob meant that he wanted to die soon?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~30#Question:Do you think that Jacob meant that he wanted to die soon?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~30#Answer:Do you think that Jacob meant that he wanted to die soon?903483794
trans-unit.source: No. He was saying that even if he was to die soon, he would die peacefully/contented/in peace.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~30#Answer:Do you think that Jacob meant that he wanted to die soon?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.31-32+What did Joseph say that he would go immediately to tell Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~31#Question:What did Joseph say that he would go immediately to tell Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph say that he would go immediately to tell Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~31#Question:What did Joseph say that he would go immediately to tell Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~31#Answer:What did Joseph say that he would go immediately to tell Pharaoh?1444549319
trans-unit.source: He would tell Pharaoh that his father and relatives had arrived, and that they were sheep and cattle herders/they raised sheep and cattle. And he would tell Pharaoh that his family had brought their sheep and cattle and other possessions with them. (31-32)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~31#Answer:What did Joseph say that he would go immediately to tell Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.33+According to Joseph, what would Pharaoh ask his brothers?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~33#Question:According to Joseph, what would Pharaoh ask his brothers?
trans-unit.source: According to Joseph, what would Pharaoh ask his brothers?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~33#Question:According to Joseph, what would Pharaoh ask his brothers?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~33#Answer:According to Joseph, what would Pharaoh ask his brothers?-2146980950
trans-unit.source: Pharaoh will ask them what is their work/occupation/livelihood. (33)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~33#Answer:According to Joseph, what would Pharaoh ask his brothers?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.34+What did Joseph instruct his brothers to say in response to Pharaoh's question?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~34#Question:What did Joseph instruct his brothers to say in response to Pharaoh's question?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph instruct his brothers to say in response to Pharaoh's question?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~34#Question:What did Joseph instruct his brothers to say in response to Pharaoh's question?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~34#Answer:What did Joseph instruct his brothers to say in response to Pharaoh's question?85363852
trans-unit.source: The brothers were to say that they (and their ancestors) had raised livestock for very many years (and that they wished to continue to do so). (34)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~34#Answer:What did Joseph instruct his brothers to say in response to Pharaoh's question?

group.id: Q:GEN 46.34+What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!46~34#Question:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?
trans-unit.source: What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~34#Question:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?

trans-unit.id: l:!GEN!46~34#Alternate:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?407952660
trans-unit.source: What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~34#Alternate:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?

trans-unit.id: l:!GEN!46~34#Alternate:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?-1599577179
trans-unit.source: What did the Egyptians think about people who worked with livestock?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~34#Alternate:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!46~34#Answer:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?1634545897
trans-unit.source: They despised/looked down on herdsmen/people who worked with livestock. (34)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!46~34#Answer:What did the Egyptians think about herdsmen/people who worked with livestock?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.1+What did Joseph say to Pharaoh at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~1#Question:What did Joseph say to Pharaoh at that time?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph say to Pharaoh at that time?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~1#Question:What did Joseph say to Pharaoh at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~1#Answer:What did Joseph say to Pharaoh at that time?-1353564572
trans-unit.source: Joseph told Pharaoh that his father and brothers had arrived from Canaan, along with their flocks of sheep and herds of cattle, and other possessions. (1)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~1#Answer:What did Joseph say to Pharaoh at that time?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.2+Whom did Joseph take to meet Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~2#Question:Whom did Joseph take to meet Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Joseph take to meet Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~2#Question:Whom did Joseph take to meet Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~2#Answer:Whom did Joseph take to meet Pharaoh?529799153
trans-unit.source: He took five of his brothers. (2)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~2#Answer:Whom did Joseph take to meet Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.3+What was Pharaoh's first question to Joseph's brothers?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~3#Question:What was Pharaoh's first question to Joseph's brothers?
trans-unit.source: What was Pharaoh's first question to Joseph's brothers?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~3#Question:What was Pharaoh's first question to Joseph's brothers?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~3#Answer:What was Pharaoh's first question to Joseph's brothers?-720077872
trans-unit.source: He asked them about their work/occupation/livelihood. (3)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~3#Answer:What was Pharaoh's first question to Joseph's brothers?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.4+According to Joseph's brothers, what were the circumstances that caused them to move to Egypt?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~4#Question:According to Joseph's brothers, what were the circumstances that caused them to move to Egypt?
trans-unit.source: According to Joseph's brothers, what were the circumstances that caused them to move to Egypt?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~4#Question:According to Joseph's brothers, what were the circumstances that caused them to move to Egypt?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~4#Answer:According to Joseph's brothers, what were the circumstances that caused them to move to Egypt?-1832710386
trans-unit.source: There was a severe famine in Canaan, and there had been no food for their flocks of sheep. (4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~4#Answer:According to Joseph's brothers, what were the circumstances that caused them to move to Egypt?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.4+What request did the five brothers ask of Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~4#Question:What request did the five brothers ask of Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: What request did the five brothers ask of Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~4#Question:What request did the five brothers ask of Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~4#Answer:What request did the five brothers ask of Pharaoh?-1393771780
trans-unit.source: They asked Pharaoh to allow them to live (for a period of time) in Goshen. (4)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~4#Answer:What request did the five brothers ask of Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.6+What did Pharaoh offer Joseph and his family?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~6#Question:What did Pharaoh offer Joseph and his family?
trans-unit.source: What did Pharaoh offer Joseph and his family?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~6#Question:What did Pharaoh offer Joseph and his family?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~6#Answer:What did Pharaoh offer Joseph and his family?-112369837
trans-unit.source: He told Joseph to choose the best land/place for his family to live. Pharaoh said that they could live in Goshen, if they wished. (6)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~6#Answer:What did Pharaoh offer Joseph and his family?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.6+Did Pharaoh make any request of Joseph or his brothers?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~6#Question:Did Pharaoh make any request of Joseph or his brothers?
trans-unit.source: Did Pharaoh make any request of Joseph or his brothers?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~6#Question:Did Pharaoh make any request of Joseph or his brothers?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~6#Answer:Did Pharaoh make any request of Joseph or his brothers?-1298951268
trans-unit.source: Yes, Pharaoh asked them to choose some from among their family who knew how to care for livestock/animals to care for his (Pharaoh's) cattle. (6)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~6#Answer:Did Pharaoh make any request of Joseph or his brothers?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.7+After that, whom did Joseph bring to Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~7#Question:After that, whom did Joseph bring to Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: After that, whom did Joseph bring to Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~7#Question:After that, whom did Joseph bring to Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~7#Answer:After that, whom did Joseph bring to Pharaoh?-1712655744
trans-unit.source: He brought his father, Jacob, to meet Pharaoh. (7)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~7#Answer:After that, whom did Joseph bring to Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.7+What did Jacob do as soon as he met Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~7#Question:What did Jacob do as soon as he met Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: What did Jacob do as soon as he met Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~7#Question:What did Jacob do as soon as he met Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~7#Answer:What did Jacob do as soon as he met Pharaoh?-574248304
trans-unit.source: He asked God to bless Pharaoh. -OR- He (formally) greeted Pharaoh. (7)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~7#Answer:What did Jacob do as soon as he met Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.8+What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~8#Question:What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?
trans-unit.source: What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~8#Question:What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~8#Answer:What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?-1982276111
trans-unit.source: He asked Jacob how old he (Jacob) was. (8)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~8#Answer:What did Pharaoh ask Jacob?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.9+What was Jacob's response?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~9#Question:What was Jacob's response?
trans-unit.source: What was Jacob's response?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~9#Question:What was Jacob's response?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~9#Answer:What was Jacob's response?129695757
trans-unit.source: Jacob said that he was 130 years old, and that he had had a difficult life. And he said that his life had been shorter than that of his ancestors. (9)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~9#Answer:What was Jacob's response?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.10+What did Jacob do as he left Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~10#Question:What did Jacob do as he left Pharaoh?
trans-unit.source: What did Jacob do as he left Pharaoh?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~10#Question:What did Jacob do as he left Pharaoh?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~10#Answer:What did Jacob do as he left Pharaoh?-504400285
trans-unit.source: He again asked God to bless Pharaoh. -OR- He (formally) bid farewell to Pharaoh. (10)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~10#Answer:What did Jacob do as he left Pharaoh?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.11+In what area of Egypt did Joseph settle Jacob and his extended family?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~11#Question:In what area of Egypt did Joseph settle Jacob and his extended family?
trans-unit.source: In what area of Egypt did Joseph settle Jacob and his extended family?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~11#Question:In what area of Egypt did Joseph settle Jacob and his extended family?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~11#Answer:In what area of Egypt did Joseph settle Jacob and his extended family?896978872
trans-unit.source: He settled them in the area near/around Rameses. (11)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~11#Answer:In what area of Egypt did Joseph settle Jacob and his extended family?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.12+What else did Joseph do for his father's households?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~12#Question:What else did Joseph do for his father's households?
trans-unit.source: What else did Joseph do for his father's households?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~12#Question:What else did Joseph do for his father's households?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~12#Answer:What else did Joseph do for his father's households?-413998998
trans-unit.source: Joseph provided sufficient food for them all. (12)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~12#Answer:What else did Joseph do for his father's households?

trans-unit.id: h:!GEN!47~13#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Genesis 47:13-26 Joseph ruled wisely in times of famine.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:GEN 47.13-26+How was Joseph able to save very many people from starving (to death)?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~13#Question:How was Joseph able to save very many people from starving (to death)?
trans-unit.source: How was Joseph able to save very many people from starving (to death)?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~13#Question:How was Joseph able to save very many people from starving (to death)?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~13#Answer:How was Joseph able to save very many people from starving (to death)?-1379665183
trans-unit.source: He had ensured that grain was stored up during the seven years of abundant harvests. Then, when the (years of) famine came, he began to sell the grain. When the people had spent all their money, he exchanged grain for livestock. And when the people had exchanged all their livestock for grain, then they sold themselves as slaves to Pharaoh and gave up their land to Pharaoh.
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~13#Answer:How was Joseph able to save very many people from starving (to death)?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.13+In what places did the famine affect people?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~13#Question:In what places did the famine affect people?
trans-unit.source: In what places did the famine affect people?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~13#Question:In what places did the famine affect people?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~13#Answer:In what places did the famine affect people?208058057
trans-unit.source: It affected the people of Egypt and Canaan. (13)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~13#Answer:In what places did the famine affect people?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.14+What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~14#Question:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?

trans-unit.id: l:!GEN!47~14#Alternate:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?931128442

trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~14#Alternate:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?

trans-unit.id: l:!GEN!47~14#Alternate:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?-2101396502
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do with all the money he received from selling the grain?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~14#Alternate:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~14#Answer:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?-2005261201
trans-unit.source: He took it to Pharaoh. -OR- He deposited it in Pharaoh's treasury/palace. (14)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~14#Answer:What did Joseph do with all the money he received from the sale of the grain/from selling the grain?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.15+What did the people do when they had spent all their money to buy food?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~15#Question:What did the people do when they had spent all their money to buy food?
trans-unit.source: What did the people do when they had spent all their money to buy food?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~15#Question:What did the people do when they had spent all their money to buy food?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~15#Answer:What did the people do when they had spent all their money to buy food?-829760235
trans-unit.source: They admitted that they had no more money, and they asked Joseph to have pity on them and give them food. (15)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~15#Answer:What did the people do when they had spent all their money to buy food?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.16+What did Joseph do when the people asked him to give them food?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~16#Question:What did Joseph do when the people asked him to give them food?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do when the people asked him to give them food?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~16#Question:What did Joseph do when the people asked him to give them food?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~16#Answer:What did Joseph do when the people asked him to give them food?-883012385
trans-unit.source: He said that he would give them food in exchange for their cattle/livestock. (16)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~16#Answer:What did Joseph do when the people asked him to give them food?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.17+For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~17#Question:For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?
trans-unit.source: For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~17#Question:For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~17#Alternate:For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?

trans-unit.id: l:!GEN!47~17#Alternate:For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?-283653438

trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~17#Alternate:For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~17#Answer:For how long were the people able to buy food by exchanging their cattle/livestock?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.18+After they had sold all their livestock, then with what did the people offer to pay for their food?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~18#Question:After they had sold all their livestock, then with what did the people offer to pay for their food?
trans-unit.source: After they had sold all their livestock, then with what did the people offer to pay for their food?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~18#Question:After they had sold all their livestock, then with what did the people offer to pay for their food?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~18#Answer:After they had sold all their livestock, then with what did the people offer to pay for their food?1505577116

trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~18#Answer:After they had sold all their livestock, then with what did the people offer to pay for their food?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.20+After a time, who became the owner of all the land in Egypt?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~20#Question:After a time, who became the owner of all the land in Egypt?
trans-unit.source: After a time, who became the owner of all the land in Egypt?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~20#Question:After a time, who became the owner of all the land in Egypt?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~20#Answer:After a time, who became the owner of all the land in Egypt?1298528453
trans-unit.source: Pharaoh became the owner. (20)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~20#Answer:After a time, who became the owner of all the land in Egypt?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.22+What is the reason that Joseph did not buy the land of the priests in Egypt?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~22#Question:What is the reason that Joseph did not buy the land of the priests in Egypt?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Joseph did not buy the land of the priests in Egypt?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~22#Question:What is the reason that Joseph did not buy the land of the priests in Egypt?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~22#Answer:What is the reason that Joseph did not buy the land of the priests in Egypt?-1277538545
trans-unit.source: Pharaoh had been giving the priests food during the famine. As a result, they did not have to sell their land to obtain food. (22)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~22#Answer:What is the reason that Joseph did not buy the land of the priests in Egypt?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.23+How were the people of Egypt to obtain seed so that they could begin planting again (after the famine)?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~23#Question:How were the people of Egypt to obtain seed so that they could begin planting again (after the famine)?
trans-unit.source: How were the people of Egypt to obtain seed so that they could begin planting again (after the famine)?
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~23#Question:How were the people of Egypt to obtain seed so that they could begin planting again (after the famine)?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!47~23#Answer:How were the people of Egypt to obtain seed so that they could begin planting again (after the famine)?999406008
trans-unit.source: Joseph said that he would give them the seed that they needed. (23)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!47~23#Answer:How were the people of Egypt to obtain seed so that they could begin planting again (after the famine)?

group.id: Q:GEN 47.24+What did the people have to do as payment for the seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!GEN!47~24#Question:What did the people have to do as payment for the seed?

trans-unit.source: Jacob died, and his sons took him back to Canaan and buried him.

group.id: Q:GEN 49.29-50.14+How did Joseph and his brothers feel about Jacob's death?

trans-unit.source: They were very sad/upset. They had loved their father, and they mourned greatly.

group.id: Q:GEN 49.29-30+What did Jacob announce at this time, and what did he request of his sons?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!49~29#Answer:What did Jacob announce at this time, and what did he request of his sons?-973110591
trans-unit.source: He announced that he would die very soon. And he requested that his sons take his body/corpse to Canaan. They were to bury him there in/near the place where Jacob's ancestors were buried, in the cave of Machpelah, near Mamre. (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!49~29#Answer:What did Jacob announce at this time, and what did he request of his sons?

group.id: Q:GEN 49.30+By what means had Jacob's family acquired that piece of land?

trans-unit.id: a:!GEN!49~30#Answer:By what means had Jacob's family acquired that piece of land?-1183683711
trans-unit.source: Abraham had bought it from Ephron of the Hit tribe/Ephron the Hittite, to use it as a burial-place. (30)
trans-unit.note: !GEN!49~30#Answer:By what means had Jacob's family acquired that piece of land?

trans-unit.note: !GEN!49~31#Answer:Who else was already buried there?
