group.id: Q:LUK 1.39+Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!1~39#Question:Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?
trans-unit.source: Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?
trans-unit.target: Zekaria na Elisabeti waliishi katika mji gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~39#Question:Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~39#Answer:Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?-942371291
trans-unit.source: It was in the hilly/mountainous region of Judah (Judea). (39)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa katika eneo lenye milima-milima la Yuda (Yudea). (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~39#Answer:Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~39#Note:Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?-564077832
trans-unit.source: Luke wrote the name as "Judah", the Jews' traditional name for the area, the name used in the Old Testament. It referred to the descendants of Judah, whom God had told to live there. At the time Zechariah and Elizabeth lived there, the Roman government called the area the province of "Judea". That name is used elsewhere in the New Testament. Whichever name is in your translation, it should be clear to the target audience as to what the name refers, whether to a tribal/clan territory or to a government name.
trans-unit.target: Luka aliandika jina hilo kuwa "Yuda", jina la kitamaduni la Wayahudi kwa eneo hilo, jina linalotumiwa katika Agano la Kale. Lilirejelea wazao wa Yuda, ambao Mungu alikuwa amewaambia waishi huko. Wakati Zekaria na Elisabeti waliishi huko, serikali ya Kiroma iliita eneo hilo mkoa wa "Yudea". Jina hilo linatumiwa mahali pengine katika Agano Jipya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~39#Note:Where was the town where Zechariah and Elizabeth lived?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.48+What did Mary say it was that made her very joyful?

trans-unit.target: Mungu [alijali juu yake na] alikuwa amemwona, hata ingawa alijifikiria kuwa mtumishi/mtumwa wa Mungu tu/mtu wa kawaida sana, asiye na maana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~48#Answer:What did Mary say it was that made her very joyful?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~48#Answer:What did Mary say it was that made her very joyful?1175018286
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "servant/slave" above at 1:38. Also see "servant, slave" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Tazama "mtumwa/mtumwa" hapo juu saa 1:38. Pia angalia "mtumwa, mtumwa" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~48#Answer:What did Mary say it was that made her very joyful?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~48#Answer:What did Mary say it was that made her very joyful?-1131811259
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "soul" and "spirit" in KBT. The Jews used sets of synonyms to create parallel lines in their Hebrew poetry. Thus, a person can understand "soul" and "spirit" in verses 46 and 47 as synonyms for Mary herself. However, elsewhere in the Bible "soul" refers to a person's inner self, that part we call "life" itself. It refers more to the humanness of a person, that is, his physical aspects rather than his spiritual aspects. "Spirit", on the other hand, refers to a person's relationship with the supernatural world, especially God. Both the physical and the spiritual aspects of Mary, that is, her whole self, was very joyful.
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, mtu anaweza kuelewa "nafsi" na "roho" katika mstari wa 46 na 47 kama maneno yanayomaanisha Maria mwenyewe. Hata hivyo, mahali pengine katika Biblia "nafsi" inahusu utu wa ndani wa mtu, sehemu hiyo ambayo tunaita "uhai" yenyewe. Inamaanisha zaidi ubinadamu wa mtu, yaani, mambo yake ya kimwili badala ya mambo yake ya kiroho. "Roho", kwa upande mwingine, inahusu uhusiano wa mtu na ulimwengu usio wa kawaida, hasa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~48#Answer:What did Mary say it was that made her very joyful?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.59-64+What do you think that the people did to this new baby boy when they circumcised him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~59#Answer:What do you think that the people did to this new baby boy when they circumcised him?1264752189
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: They cut off the ring of foreskin from around the boy's penis. (See peritemnw in L&N in entry 53.51.)
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Walimkata pete ya ngozi ya uzazi kutoka karibu na uume wa mvulana. (Ona peritemnw katika L & N katika kuingia 53.51.)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~59#Note:What do you think that the people did to this new baby boy when they circumcised him?1999685300
trans-unit.source: If the translator is using the name of a cultural ceremony, ask about all its implications physically, culturally and spiritually. The Jews did the ceremony as a religious rite which dedicated the child to God and physically marked him as a Jew. If the translator's culture does not practice circumcision, describing the action may sound offensive and vulgar to any mixed group of men and women or children. The translator may need to use a more general word or phrase in the translation and refer to a footnote or glossary item. In that note the translator can explain clearly what is done to a male's body and tell why it was customary to do it on a Jewish baby's eighth day (see Gen. 17:9-14; Lev. 12:1-3).
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtafsiri anatumia jina la sherehe ya kitamaduni, uliza kuhusu athari zake zote kimwili, kiutamaduni na kiroho. Wayahudi walifanya sherehe kama ibada ya kidini ambayo ilimweka mtoto wakfu kwa Mungu na kumweka alama ya Kiyahudi. Ikiwa utamaduni wa mtafsiri haufanyi tohara, kuelezea kitendo hicho kunaweza kusikika kuwa cha kukera na cha kawaida kwa kikundi chochote cha wanaume na wanawake au watoto. Mtafsiri anaweza kuhitaji kutumia neno au kifungu cha jumla katika tafsiri na kutaja kijachini au kifungu cha msamiati. Katika maelezo hayo mtafsiri anaweza kuelezea wazi kile kinachofanywa kwa mwili wa kiume na kusema kwa nini ilikuwa kawaida kufanya hivyo siku ya nane ya mtoto wa Kiyahudi (tazama Mwanzo 17:9-14; Mambo ya Walawi 12:1-3).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~59#Note:What do you think that the people did to this new baby boy when they circumcised him?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.67-75+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!1~67#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.target: Agano ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~67#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~67#Answer:What is a covenant?-346807889
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is an agreement, an especially binding promise, usually made by two people who are of equal status. If the person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Today it would be called a contract. But the Greek word that is used in the Bible for covenants strongly implies that the terms of the agreement were stated by the person on only one side of the discussion, not both sides. Usually God is the one who says what will happen, that is, what he will do and what people must do. He binds himself to the other party.
trans-unit.target: Mkataba wa mkataba: Mkataba ni ahadi, hasa ahadi ya kisheria, ambayo kwa kawaida hufanywa na watu wawili ambao wana hadhi sawa. Ikiwa mtu wa upande mmoja wa agano hafanyi kama vile wote wawili wamekubaliana, kwa kawaida kuna adhabu kali kwake au analipa fidia kwa mtu mwingine. Leo ingekuwa inaitwa mkataba. Lakini neno la Kigiriki ambalo linatumiwa katika Biblia kwa maagano linaonyesha kwa nguvu kwamba masharti ya makubaliano yalitolewa na mtu wa upande mmoja tu wa majadiliano, sio pande zote mbili. Kwa kawaida Mungu ndiye anayesema nini kitatokea, yaani, ni nini atakachofanya na kile watu wanapaswa kufanya. Anajifunga mwenyewe kwa upande mwingine.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~67#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~67#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "agano" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~67#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~67#Note:What is a covenant?129429708
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent(s) to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make these special agreements, these firm promises. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. If there are some questionable areas, the translator may need to re-think how he used that term in the translation.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa lugha ina jina maalum la kutaja aina hizi za makubaliano, muulize aliyehojiwa ((s) akuambie aina ya hali ambazo watu hufanya makubaliano haya maalum, ahadi hizi thabiti. Sikiliza kwa pointi yoyote ambapo haingefaa kusema kwamba Mungu alifanya aina hiyo ya makubaliano. Ikiwa kuna maeneo ya mashaka, mtafsiri anaweza kuhitaji kufikiria tena jinsi alivyotumia neno hilo katika tafsiri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~67#Note:What is a covenant?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.73+What does a person do when he swears an oath?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!1~73#Question:What does a person do when he swears an oath?
trans-unit.source: What does a person do when he swears an oath?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini anapotoa kiapo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~73#Question:What does a person do when he swears an oath?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~73#Answer:What does a person do when he swears an oath?1755155210
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He uses strong, positive words to show that he will truly do as he has just promised. He also calls on God (Mark 14:71) or another spirit being (Josh. 23:10; Jer. 13:16; Amos 8:14) to punish him very badly if anything he has just said is not completely true. (See 2 Sam. 3:35.)
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Anatumia maneno yenye nguvu, mazuri kuonyesha kwamba atafanya kama alivyoahidi. Pia anamwomba Mungu (Marko 14:71) au kiumbe mwingine wa roho (Yoshua 23:10; Yer. 13:16; Amosi 8:14) amwadhibu vibaya sana ikiwa chochote alichosema si kweli kabisa (Ona 2 Sam. 3:35).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~73#Answer:What does a person do when he swears an oath?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.73+What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!1~73#Question:What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?
trans-unit.source: What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kitakachomhakikishia mtu kwamba Mungu atatimiza ahadi zake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~73#Question:What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~73#Answer:What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?-1570443874
trans-unit.source: God is holy [Amos 4:2] and has all the power necessary to do anything he says. When he makes a promise, the other person will know for sure that God will do it.
trans-unit.target: Mungu ni mtakatifu [Amosi 4:2] na ana nguvu zote zinazohitajika kufanya chochote anachosema. Anapotoa ahadi, mtu mwingine atajua kwa hakika kwamba Mungu ataifanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~73#Answer:What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~73#Note:What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?-128700492
trans-unit.source: Sometimes God says he swears by himself. (See Gen. 22:16, where you will find the covenant and oath Zechariah was talking about here.) He also swears by his name, that is, his reputation (Isa. 45:23). Since God has never failed to keep his promises in the past and has never done any other bad action, he surely will not lie now, either (Ps. 89:34-35).
trans-unit.target: Wakati mwingine Mungu anasema kwamba yeye anaapa kwa yeye mwenyewe. (Ona Mwanzo 22:16, ambapo utapata agano na kiapo ambacho Zekaria alikuwa akizungumzia hapa.) Yeye pia anaapa kwa jina lake, yaani, sifa yake (Isa. 45:23). Kwa kuwa Mungu hajawahi kushindwa kutimiza ahadi zake katika wakati uliopita na hajawahi kufanya kitendo kingine chochote kibaya, hakika hatawadanganya sasa, pia (Zab. 89:34-35).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~73#Note:What do you think will assure a person that God will do what he promises?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.76-79+What is sin?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!1~76#Question:What is sin?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~76#Answer:What is sin?1633878952
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Because God made all people and told us how to live to please him, every time a person's thoughts, words or actions do not follow what God has said is right, that is sin. It is a turning away from being like God wants us to be.
trans-unit.target: Tathmini ya Neno Muhimu: Kwa sababu Mungu aliwaumba watu wote na kutuambia jinsi ya kuishi ili kumpendeza, kila wakati mawazo ya mtu, maneno au matendo hayafuati kile Mungu amesema ni sawa, hiyo ni dhambi. Ni kugeuka mbali na kuwa kama Mungu anataka tuwe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Answer:What is sin?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~76#Note:What is sin?1028415689
trans-unit.source: See "sin, sinner" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "dhambi, mtenda dhambi" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Note:What is sin?

group.id: Q:LUK 1.76-79+What does God do when he forgives sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!1~76#Question:What does God do when he forgives sins?
trans-unit.source: What does God do when he forgives sins?
trans-unit.target: Mungu hufanya nini anapotusamehe dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Question:What does God do when he forgives sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~76#Answer:What does God do when he forgives sins?-770946884
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He removes any record of a person's wrong action. That means that there is no need for the person to compensate God in any way, such as by being punished or by giving him good things or doing extra actions which would please him. God does not think of that person as being a bad person any longer, but as a person who is ready to do good.
trans-unit.target: Muhtasari wa muda muhimu: Yeye huondoa rekodi yoyote ya kitendo kibaya cha mtu. Hiyo inamaanisha kuwa hakuna haja kwa mtu kumlipa Mungu kwa njia yoyote, kama vile kwa kuadhibiwa au kwa kumpa vitu vizuri au kufanya vitendo vya ziada ambavyo vingempendeza. Mungu hafikirii mtu huyo kama mtu mbaya tena, lakini kama mtu aliye tayari kufanya mema.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Answer:What does God do when he forgives sins?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~76#Note:What does God do when he forgives sins?-570225461
trans-unit.source: See "forgive" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "kusamehe" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Note:What does God do when he forgives sins?

trans-unit.source: Tell me what the picture language about the shadows means to you.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~78#Answer:Tell me what the picture language about the sun/darkness/shadows means to you.992743377
trans-unit.source: [THE SUN:] The sun is a picture of the savior coming from heaven to start a new day, a new period in our lives. He makes it clear to us how he saves us. Now we are encouraged about what is going to happen to us.
trans-unit.target: Jua ni picha ya mkombozi kuja kutoka mbinguni kuanza siku mpya, kipindi kipya katika maisha yetu. Yeye inatufanya wazi jinsi yeye anaokoa sisi. Sasa sisi ni moyo kuhusu nini kinachotokea kwetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~78#Answer:Tell me what the picture language about the sun/darkness/shadows means to you.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~78#Answer:Tell me what the picture language about the sun/darkness/shadows means to you.-27184853
trans-unit.source: [DARKNESS/SHADOWS:] The time of not knowing about the true God and of being afraid that something, perhaps God or evil spirits, might soon make us die, ends. (78-79)
trans-unit.target: Wakati wa kutomjua Mungu wa kweli na wa kuhofu kwamba kitu fulani, labda Mungu au roho waovu, huenda kikatufanya tufe, unakwisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~78#Answer:Tell me what the picture language about the sun/darkness/shadows means to you.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!1~78#Note:Tell me what the picture language about the sun/darkness/shadows means to you.207894919
trans-unit.source: This question is only relevant if the translation of verses 78-79 has picture language about the sun or darkness or shadows.
trans-unit.target: Swali hili linafaa tu ikiwa tafsiri ya mistari 78-79 ina lugha ya mfano kuhusu jua au giza au vivuli.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~78#Note:Tell me what the picture language about the sun/darkness/shadows means to you.

group.id: Q:LUK 1.76-79+What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?

trans-unit.source: What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri amani hiyo ambayo Zekaria alitaja ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Question:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~76#Answer:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?-1993143173
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: This peace is a calm heart/spirit which does not worry when we face God because he has already forgiven our sins.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Amani hii ni moyo/roho tulivu ambayo haihangaiki wakati tunakabiliwa na Mungu kwa sababu tayari amesamehe dhambi zetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Answer:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~76#Answer:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Answer:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!1~76#Answer:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?-528568662
trans-unit.source: Long, long ago God promised mankind that he would send someone to save them from the punishment they deserved. Later, God sent Jesus into this world as that savior. When we see clearly that God already has done what he promised to do, we have peace in our hearts. Peace is a calm heart/spirit and being free from worry.
trans-unit.target: Muda mrefu sana uliopita Mungu aliahidi wanadamu kwamba atamtuma mtu kuwaokoa kutoka adhabu waliyostahili. Baadaye, Mungu alimtuma Yesu ulimwenguni kama mwokozi huyo. Tunapoona wazi kwamba Mungu tayari amefanya kile alichoahidi kufanya, tuna amani mioyoni mwetu. Amani ni moyo/roho tulivu na kuwa huru kutoka kwa wasiwasi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!1~76#Answer:What do you think this peace is to which Zechariah referred?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~1#Question:Read the last verse of chapter 1 and the first verse of this chapter again. Will people think that Augustus commanded this when John was still a baby or after John had grown to be a man?

trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alifanya nini aliposikia kuhusu amri ya kujiandikisha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Question:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!2~4#Alternate:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?-823436359
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register his name?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alifanya nini aliposikia kuhusu amri ya kuandikisha jina lake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Alternate:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!2~4#Alternate:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?-312196606
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to record his name?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alifanya nini aliposikia kuhusu amri ya kujiandikisha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Alternate:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?13784703
trans-unit.source: He also obeyed the government's command to have their officials record his name in their book. (4, 5)
trans-unit.target: Pia alitii amri ya serikali kuwa na maafisa wao kuandika jina lake katika kitabu chao. (4, 5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?-1867719741
trans-unit.source: He left the town/village of Nazareth in [the province of] Galilee (4a)
trans-unit.target: Aliondoka katika mji/kijiji cha Nazareti katika [mkoa wa] Galilaya (4a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?-190800774
trans-unit.source: and traveled to the town/village of Bethlehem in [the province of] Judea. (4b)
trans-unit.target: na kusafiri kwenda mji/kijiji cha Bethlehemu katika [mkoa wa] Yudea. (4b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?545301043
trans-unit.source: He traveled with Mary, the young woman who was promised in marriage to him. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alikwenda na Maria, msichana aliyekuwa amechumbiwa na Yosefu. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What did Joseph do when he heard about the command to register/record his name?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.4+Why did Joseph go to the village of Bethlehem?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~4#Question:Why did Joseph go to the village of Bethlehem?
trans-unit.source: Why did Joseph go to the village of Bethlehem?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yosefu alienda kwenye kijiji cha Bethlehemu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Question:Why did Joseph go to the village of Bethlehem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:Why did Joseph go to the village of Bethlehem?-1200123407
trans-unit.source: That was the village where Joseph's ancestor, (the famous king) David, had lived. (4b)
trans-unit.target: Hiyo ilikuwa kijiji ambako babu ya Yusufu, (mfalme mashuhuri) Daudi, alikuwa ameishi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:Why did Joseph go to the village of Bethlehem?

trans-unit.target: Tunajifunza nini kumhusu Maria tunaposikia au kusoma mistari hii?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Alternate:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?

trans-unit.target: Tunapoyasoma, tunajifunza nini kumhusu Maria?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Alternate:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?913709506
trans-unit.source: She had been promised to Joseph to be his wife. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amechumbiwa na Yosefu ili awe mke wake. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?63134566
trans-unit.source: She was pregnant. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mjamzito. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?-135200958
trans-unit.source: She went with Joseph to have the officials record their names in the government book. (4, 5)
trans-unit.target: Alienda pamoja na Yosefu ili afanye majina ya maofisa waandikwe katika kitabu cha serikali (4, 5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?1315493407
trans-unit.source: She delivered a baby boy, her first child, while she and Joseph were at Bethlehem. (6-7)
trans-unit.target: Alipata mtoto wa kiume, mtoto wake wa kwanza, wakati yeye na Yosefu walipokuwa Bethlehemu (6-7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~4#Answer:What do we learn about Mary from hearing/reading these verses?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.7+How did Mary care for her baby son?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~7#Question:How did Mary care for her baby son?
trans-unit.source: How did Mary care for her baby son?
trans-unit.target: Maria alimtunzaje mtoto wake mchanga?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~7#Question:How did Mary care for her baby son?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~7#Answer:How did Mary care for her baby son?-1808853397
trans-unit.source: She wrapped him in pieces of cloth (according to the Jewish custom of that time) and laid him in a manger/an animal's food trough/box. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alimfunga katika vipande vya kitani (kulingana na desturi ya Wayahudi wakati huo) na kumlaza katika hori/kibanda cha chakula cha wanyama. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~7#Answer:How did Mary care for her baby son?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.7+Why did she have to use an animal's food box as the baby's bed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~7#Question:Why did she have to use an animal's food box as the baby's bed?
trans-unit.source: Why did she have to use an animal's food box as the baby's bed?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alitumia sanduku la chakula cha wanyama kama kitanda cha mtoto?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~7#Question:Why did she have to use an animal's food box as the baby's bed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~7#Answer:Why did she have to use an animal's food box as the baby's bed?1685195087
trans-unit.source: Because all the places for travelers to stay (the inns/hotels) were already full of people, Joseph and Mary had to stay in the place where people usually fed their animals. (7)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu mahali pote pa kukaa wasafiri (mahotelo/hoteli) palikuwa tayari kumejaa watu, Yusufu na Mariamu walilazimika kukaa mahali ambapo watu kwa kawaida waliwalisha wanyama wao. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~7#Answer:Why did she have to use an animal's food box as the baby's bed?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.8-20+God sent an angel at night with a message for some shepherds. What had happened that was so important for the shepherds to know?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~8#Question:God sent an angel at night with a message for some shepherds. What had happened that was so important for the shepherds to know?
trans-unit.source: God sent an angel at night with a message for some shepherds. What had happened that was so important for the shepherds to know?
trans-unit.target: Mungu alimtuma malaika usiku akiwa na ujumbe kwa wachungaji fulani. Ni jambo gani lililokuwa limetukia ambalo lilikuwa muhimu sana kwa wachungaji kujua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Question:God sent an angel at night with a message for some shepherds. What had happened that was so important for the shepherds to know?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~8#Answer:God sent an angel at night with a message for some shepherds. What had happened that was so important for the shepherds to know?-546684916
trans-unit.source: The angel brought them the good news that the savior, Christ the Lord, had been born. (11)
trans-unit.target: Malaika aliwapa habari njema kwamba mwokozi, Kristo Bwana, alikuwa amezaliwa. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Answer:God sent an angel at night with a message for some shepherds. What had happened that was so important for the shepherds to know?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.8+What were some shepherds doing the night when Mary bore her baby?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~8#Question:What were some shepherds doing the night when Mary bore her baby?
trans-unit.source: What were some shepherds doing the night when Mary bore her baby?
trans-unit.target: Wachungaji fulani walikuwa wakifanya nini usiku ambao Maria alijifungua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Question:What were some shepherds doing the night when Mary bore her baby?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~8#Answer:What were some shepherds doing the night when Mary bore her baby?-1535390726
trans-unit.source: They were staying out in the open countryside guarding their flocks of sheep/goats at night. (8)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa nje katika maeneo ya mashambani wakilinda makundi yao ya kondoo/mbuzi usiku. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Answer:What were some shepherds doing the night when Mary bore her baby?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.9+What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~9#Question:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?
trans-unit.source: What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wachungaji waliogopa sana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~9#Question:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~9#Answer:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?1808222347
trans-unit.source: They suddenly saw an angel standing in front of them (9a)
trans-unit.target: Waliona malaika akisimama mbele yao ghafla (9a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~9#Answer:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~9#Answer:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?-1825975700
trans-unit.source: and the bright light of God's glory/presence was shining all around them. (9b)
trans-unit.target: na nuru nyangavu ya utukufu/kuwepo kwa Mungu ilikuwa ikiangaza pande zote (9b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~9#Answer:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~9#Note:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?1435305487
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: The Greek word translated "glory" has many variations in meaning and use. Each meaning tries to describe a characteristic of God which people do not have. God is totally without sin. He is so different from sinful mankind that people find it hard to explain or describe what they see or experience when God makes his presence known.
trans-unit.target: (Kichunguzi cha Neno Muhimu: Neno la Kigiriki lililotafsiriwa "utukufu" lina tofauti nyingi katika maana na matumizi. Kila maana hujaribu kueleza sifa ya Mungu ambayo watu hawana. Mungu hana dhambi kabisa. Yeye ni tofauti sana na wanadamu wenye dhambi hivi kwamba watu huona ni vigumu kueleza au kueleza wanachoona au wanachoona wakati Mungu afanya uwepo wake ujulikane.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~9#Note:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~9#Note:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?2112862506
trans-unit.source: You probably will not find a word in your language which includes every aspect of the Greek word for glory and would be correct for every use. You will probably find that the use of "glory" in verse 14 below is already different from its usage here. As much as you are able, translate any one aspect of "glory" consistently. See "glory" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: Labda hutapata neno katika lugha yako ambalo linajumuisha kila kipengele cha neno la Kigiriki kwa utukufu na lingekuwa sahihi kwa kila matumizi. Labda utapata kwamba matumizi ya "utukufu" katika mstari wa 14 hapa chini tayari ni tofauti na matumizi yake hapa. Kadiri unavyoweza, tafsiri yoyote moja ya "utukufu" kwa usahihi. Tazama "utukufu" katika KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~9#Note:What caused the shepherds to be very much afraid?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.10+Why did the angel tell the shepherds they should not be afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~10#Question:Why did the angel tell the shepherds they should not be afraid?
trans-unit.source: Why did the angel tell the shepherds they should not be afraid?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini malaika aliwaambia wachungaji wasiogope?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~10#Question:Why did the angel tell the shepherds they should not be afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~10#Answer:Why did the angel tell the shepherds they should not be afraid?-135521290
trans-unit.source: They were not to be afraid because he had come to tell them some good news which would cause all people to rejoice greatly. (10)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa na hofu kwa sababu alikuwa amekuja kuwaambia habari njema ambayo ingewafanya watu wote washangilie sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~10#Answer:Why did the angel tell the shepherds they should not be afraid?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.11+What was that good news?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~11#Question:What was that good news?
trans-unit.source: What was that good news?
trans-unit.target: Habari hiyo njema ilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Question:What was that good news?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~11#Answer:What was that good news?-1768675069
trans-unit.source: The good news was that the savior had been born that same night. (11)
trans-unit.target: Habari njema ilikuwa kwamba mwokozi alikuwa amezaliwa usiku huohuo. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Answer:What was that good news?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~11#Answer:What was that good news?1268588878
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Luke used the Greek word which means "tell good news." It is the same word he used in 1:19 and we will see it again at 3:18 and 4:18, among many other places. Luke always used it to refer to the good news that God's plan to send the Messiah to save people was already happening. That is also the meaning of the angel's words here [10-11.)
trans-unit.target: Neno muhimu: Luka alitumia neno la Kigiriki linalomaanisha "huhubiri habari njema". Ni neno lile lile alilotumia katika 1:19 na tutaona tena katika 3:18 na 4:18, miongoni mwa sehemu nyingine nyingi. Luka daima alitumia neno hilo kurejelea habari njema kwamba mpango wa Mungu wa kumtuma Masihi kuwaokoa watu ulikuwa tayari unatokea. Hiyo pia ndiyo maana ya maneno ya malaika hapa [10-11.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Answer:What was that good news?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.11+What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~11#Question:What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?
trans-unit.source: What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?
trans-unit.target: Malaika alisema nini ili kuonyesha kwamba mwokozi huyo alikuwa mtu wa pekee sana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Question:What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~11#Answer:What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?1678456838
trans-unit.source: He said that this savior was the Christ (the anointed one sent by God) and Lord (the one with authority to rule and reign over people [See Mic. 5:2]). (11)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mwokozi huyu alikuwa Kristo (mtiwa-mafuta aliyetumwa na Mungu) na Bwana (yule aliye na mamlaka ya kutawala na kutawala juu ya watu [Ona Mika 5:2]). (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Answer:What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~11#Note:What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?2070515884
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Make sure that the title "Christ" is understood to be just that, a title, not a personal name. You may wish to make a footnote or glossary entry which indicates that this is the Greek equivalent to the Hebrew title "Messiah". See "Christ, Messiah" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia maneno muhimu: Hakikisha kwamba jina "Kristo" linaeleweka kuwa jina la cheo, bali si jina la kibinafsi. Huenda ukataka kuandika maelezo ya chini au maelezo ya msamiati yanayoonyesha kwamba hilo ni neno la Kigiriki linalolingana na jina la cheo la Kiebrania "Masihi".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Note:What did the angel say to indicate that this savior was someone very special?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.11+Where did the angel say the savior was born?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~11#Question:Where did the angel say the savior was born?
trans-unit.source: Where did the angel say the savior was born?
trans-unit.target: Malaika alisema mwokozi alizaliwa wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Question:Where did the angel say the savior was born?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~11#Answer:Where did the angel say the savior was born?-1426173023
trans-unit.source: In the village where [their ancestor, King] David had lived (that is, in Bethlehem). (11)
trans-unit.target: Katika kijiji ambako [baba yao wa kale, Mfalme] Daudi alikuwa ameishi (yaani, katika Bethlehemu). (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~11#Answer:Where did the angel say the savior was born?

trans-unit.target: Wachungaji wangejuaje kwamba walikuwa wamempata yule mtoto ambaye malaika alikuwa akizungumza kumhusu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~12#Alternate:What would the shepherds see which would prove to them that what the angel said was true? -OR- How would the shepherds know if they had found the baby which the angel was talking about?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~12#Answer:What would the shepherds see which would prove to them that what the angel said was true? -OR- How would the shepherds know if they had found the baby which the angel was talking about?1440875419
trans-unit.source: They would find the baby wrapped in pieces of cloth (according to their Jewish custom) (12b)
trans-unit.target: Wangempata mtoto mchanga akiwa amefungwa katika vitambaa (kulingana na desturi yao ya Kiyahudi) (12b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~12#Answer:What would the shepherds see which would prove to them that what the angel said was true? -OR- How would the shepherds know if they had found the baby which the angel was talking about?

trans-unit.source: and lying in a manger, that is, an animal's food trough/box. (12c)
trans-unit.target: na kulala katika hori, yaani, sanduku la chakula cha wanyama. (12c)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~12#Answer:What would the shepherds see which would prove to them that what the angel said was true? -OR- How would the shepherds know if they had found the baby which the angel was talking about?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.8-12+What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~8#Question:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini jambo hilo lingekuwa ishara kwao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Question:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?-1343742057
trans-unit.source: People do not customarily put their babies into any animal's food box.
trans-unit.target: Watu hawawekei watoto wao katika sanduku la chakula cha wanyama.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?-980788606
trans-unit.source: The Jews would not expect to find the savior, whom they expected God to send to earth, in such a humble place as a manger.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi hawangeweza kumtazamia mwokozi, ambaye walitarajia Mungu amtume duniani, awe mahali pa hali ya chini kama hori.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?-492122810
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "sign" in KBT in the "miracle, sign, wonder, mighty work" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Ona "ishara" katika KBT katika "mwujiza, ishara, ajabu, kazi yenye nguvu" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason this would be a sign to them?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.13+What suddenly happened near that angel?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~13#Question:What suddenly happened near that angel?
trans-unit.source: What suddenly happened near that angel?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotokea ghafula malaika huyo alipokuwa karibu na malaika huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~13#Question:What suddenly happened near that angel?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~13#Answer:What suddenly happened near that angel?-1050428006
trans-unit.source: A great number of other spirit beings from heaven (angels) appeared. (13)
trans-unit.target: Idadi kubwa ya viumbe wengine wa roho kutoka mbinguni (malaika) walionekana. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~13#Answer:What suddenly happened near that angel?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.13+What were those angels doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~13#Question:What were those angels doing?
trans-unit.source: What were those angels doing?
trans-unit.target: Malaika hao walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~13#Question:What were those angels doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~13#Answer:What were those angels doing?299832302
trans-unit.source: They were praising God. (13)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimsifu Mungu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~13#Answer:What were those angels doing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~13#Note:What were those angels doing?-1924528031
trans-unit.source: The Greek word used here is not one of the eight words used in the rest of the GNT text to refer to songs and singing. It does not tell us whether the angels sang or not. The focus of this verb is on the content and purpose of the action, not the manner.
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki linalotumiwa hapa si moja ya maneno manane yanayotumiwa katika maandishi mengine ya GNT kurejelea nyimbo na kuimba. Haituambii ikiwa malaika waliimba au la. Lengo la kitenzi hiki ni juu ya yaliyomo na kusudi la kitendo, sio njia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~13#Note:What were those angels doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.14+What did their words of praise say about God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~14#Question:What did their words of praise say about God?
trans-unit.source: What did their words of praise say about God?
trans-unit.target: Maneno yao ya sifa yalionyesha nini kumhusu Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Question:What did their words of praise say about God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~14#Answer:What did their words of praise say about God?-1826216779
trans-unit.source: There is glory for God in highest [heaven]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Utukufu ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu katika mbingu za juu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Answer:What did their words of praise say about God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~14#Note:What did their words of praise say about God?539386013
trans-unit.source: "Highest" may refer to either the place where God is, or the place where the praising is occurring. Either way is acceptable, but if it can refer to both, that is even better.
trans-unit.target: "Kuliko juu" yaweza kurejezea ama mahali ambapo Mungu yuko, ama mahali ambapo sifa inatokea. Njia yoyote ni inayokubalika, lakini ikiwa yaweza kurejezea yote mawili, hiyo ni bora hata zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Note:What did their words of praise say about God?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.14+What do you think this glory is?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~14#Question:What do you think this glory is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think this glory is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri utukufu huo ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Question:What do you think this glory is?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~14#Answer:What do you think this glory is?1018178601
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is the best praise, honor, and giving of thanks which can be given to God because of his perfect goodness to them.
trans-unit.target: Kipimo cha Neno Muhimu: Ni sifa bora, heshima, na kutoa shukrani ambazo zinaweza kutolewa kwa Mungu kwa sababu ya wema wake mkamilifu kwao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Answer:What do you think this glory is?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.14+What did the angels say about people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~14#Question:What did the angels say about people?
trans-unit.source: What did the angels say about people?
trans-unit.target: Malaika walisema nini kuhusu watu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Question:What did the angels say about people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~14#Answer:What did the angels say about people?265367978
trans-unit.source: They said that there is peace among the people on the earth whom God has favored/with whom he is pleased. (14)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba amani itakuwa duniani kwa watu ambao Mungu amewafadhili/aliowakubali. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Answer:What did the angels say about people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~14#Answer:What did the angels say about people?-1275676937
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "peace" discussed above at 1:79.
trans-unit.target: Kumbuka: Ona neno "amani" lililozungumziwa hapo juu kwenye 1:79.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Answer:What did the angels say about people?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.14+What do you think was the reason that the angels said these things in their praising God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~14#Question:What do you think was the reason that the angels said these things in their praising God?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the angels said these things in their praising God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri malaika walisema mambo hayo kwa sababu gani walipomsifu Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Question:What do you think was the reason that the angels said these things in their praising God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the angels said these things in their praising God?363806296
trans-unit.source: They were happy that the Savior was born. He would bring that kind of glory to God and peace to mankind. (They recognized that, because the savior had been born, there now was this glory and peace in heaven and on the earth, and they were excited about it.)
trans-unit.target: Walifurahi kwamba Mwokozi alikuwa amezaliwa. Yeye angeleta aina hiyo ya utukufu kwa Mungu na amani kwa wanadamu. (Walifahamu kwamba, kwa sababu mwokozi alikuwa amezaliwa, sasa kulikuwa na utukufu huu na amani mbinguni na duniani, nao walifurahi juu ya hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the angels said these things in their praising God?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.15+When the angels finished praising God, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~15#Question:When the angels finished praising God, what did they do?
trans-unit.source: When the angels finished praising God, what did they do?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya malaika kumaliza kumsifu Mungu, walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~15#Question:When the angels finished praising God, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~15#Answer:When the angels finished praising God, what did they do?91321107
trans-unit.source: They went back to heaven. (15)
trans-unit.target: Walirudi mbinguni. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~15#Answer:When the angels finished praising God, what did they do?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.15+What did the shepherds decide to do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~15#Question:What did the shepherds decide to do then?
trans-unit.source: What did the shepherds decide to do then?
trans-unit.target: Wachungaji hao waliamua kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~15#Question:What did the shepherds decide to do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~15#Answer:What did the shepherds decide to do then?-1600272037
trans-unit.source: They decided to go to Bethlehem and see this thing that [the angel of] the Lord had just told them about had happened there, [the savior had been born that day]. (15)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua kwenda Bethlehemu na kuona jambo hili ambalo [malaika wa] Bwana alikuwa amewaambia tu limetukia huko, [mwokozi alikuwa amezaliwa siku hiyo]. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~15#Answer:What did the shepherds decide to do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~15#Answer:What did the shepherds decide to do then?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~15#Answer:What did the shepherds decide to do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~15#Answer:What did the shepherds decide to do then?5541860
trans-unit.source: They decided to go to Bethlehem and see the savior whom [the angel of] the Lord had just told them had been born there that day. (15)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua kwenda Bethlehemu na kumwona mwokozi ambaye [malaika wa] Bwana alikuwa amewaambia tu kwamba amezaliwa huko siku hiyo. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~15#Answer:What did the shepherds decide to do then?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.16+How do we know the men were very excited to go find this savior who had just been born?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~16#Question:How do we know the men were very excited to go find this savior who had just been born?
trans-unit.source: How do we know the men were very excited to go find this savior who had just been born?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba wanaume hao walifurahi sana kwenda kumtafuta mwokozi huyo ambaye alikuwa amezaliwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~16#Question:How do we know the men were very excited to go find this savior who had just been born?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~16#Answer:How do we know the men were very excited to go find this savior who had just been born?-38568701
trans-unit.source: They went hurriedly on their way. (16)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakaenda zao, nao wana haraka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~16#Answer:How do we know the men were very excited to go find this savior who had just been born?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.16+What did they find when they looked around the village of Bethlehem?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~16#Question:What did they find when they looked around the village of Bethlehem?
trans-unit.source: What did they find when they looked around the village of Bethlehem?
trans-unit.target: Walipata nini walipokuwa wakitafuta mahali pa kulala katika kijiji cha Bethlehemu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~16#Question:What did they find when they looked around the village of Bethlehem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~16#Answer:What did they find when they looked around the village of Bethlehem?1256839718
trans-unit.source: They located Mary and Joseph and saw the baby lying in the manger/an animal's food trough/box. (16)
trans-unit.target: Waliwapata Maria na Yosefu na kumwona mtoto mchanga amelala katika hori/kibanda cha chakula cha wanyama. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~16#Answer:What did they find when they looked around the village of Bethlehem?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.17+After they had seen the baby, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~17#Question:After they had seen the baby, what did they do?
trans-unit.source: After they had seen the baby, what did they do?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kumwona mtoto, walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~17#Question:After they had seen the baby, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~17#Answer:After they had seen the baby, what did they do?-730349244
trans-unit.source: They told people[, including Mary and Joseph,] what [the angel] had said to them about this child. (17)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaambia watu [kutia ndani Mariamu na Yusufu] yale ambayo [malaika] alikuwa amewaambia juu ya mtoto huyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~17#Answer:After they had seen the baby, what did they do?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.18+When the people heard the shepherds' story of what had happened, what did they think?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~18#Question:When the people heard the shepherds' story of what had happened, what did they think?
trans-unit.source: When the people heard the shepherds' story of what had happened, what did they think?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliposikia simulizi la wachungaji walifikiri nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~18#Question:When the people heard the shepherds' story of what had happened, what did they think?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~18#Answer:When the people heard the shepherds' story of what had happened, what did they think?1826711859
trans-unit.source: All of them were amazed. (18) (This kind of thing did not normally happen, so it seemed very strange.)
trans-unit.target: Wote walishangaa. (18) (Jambo la aina hii halikuwa likitokea kwa kawaida, kwa hiyo lilionekana kuwa la ajabu sana.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~18#Answer:When the people heard the shepherds' story of what had happened, what did they think?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.19+How did Mary respond to all that had happened regarding her baby?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~19#Question:How did Mary respond to all that had happened regarding her baby?
trans-unit.source: How did Mary respond to all that had happened regarding her baby?
trans-unit.target: Maria aliitikiaje mambo yote yaliyokuwa yametukia kumhusu mtoto wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~19#Question:How did Mary respond to all that had happened regarding her baby?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~19#Answer:How did Mary respond to all that had happened regarding her baby?33131942
trans-unit.source: She kept thinking about them, wondering very much about what they meant. (19)
trans-unit.target: Aliendelea kuyafikiria, akijiuliza sana maana yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~19#Answer:How did Mary respond to all that had happened regarding her baby?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.20+After the shepherds had told people about these things, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~20#Question:After the shepherds had told people about these things, what did they do?
trans-unit.source: After the shepherds had told people about these things, what did they do?
trans-unit.target: Wachungaji waliwaambia watu mambo hayo, nao wakafanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~20#Question:After the shepherds had told people about these things, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~20#Answer:After the shepherds had told people about these things, what did they do?1541463162
trans-unit.source: They returned [to where they had left their sheep flock outside the town]. (20)
trans-unit.target: Walirudi [mahali ambapo walikuwa wameacha kundi lao la kondoo nje ya mji].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~20#Answer:After the shepherds had told people about these things, what did they do?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.20+As they went back there, what were they saying or doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~20#Question:As they went back there, what were they saying or doing?
trans-unit.source: As they went back there, what were they saying or doing?
trans-unit.target: Walipokuwa wakirudi huko, walikuwa wakisema au kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~20#Question:As they went back there, what were they saying or doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~20#Answer:As they went back there, what were they saying or doing?634939102
trans-unit.source: They were honoring God and saying wonderful things about him./They were talking about the unsurpassed greatness and the goodness of God. (20)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimtukuza Mungu na kusema mambo ya ajabu juu yake./Walikuwa wakizungumza juu ya ukuu usio na kifani na wema wa Mungu. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~20#Answer:As they went back there, what were they saying or doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.20+What did Luke say was the reason for their joy?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~20#Question:What did Luke say was the reason for their joy?
trans-unit.source: What did Luke say was the reason for their joy?
trans-unit.target: Luka alisema ni nini kilichowafanya washangilie?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~20#Question:What did Luke say was the reason for their joy?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~20#Answer:What did Luke say was the reason for their joy?5788805
trans-unit.source: Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said that it would be. (20)
trans-unit.target: Kila kitu walichokuwa wameona na kusikia kilikuwa kama vile malaika alivyokuwa amesema kitakuwa. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~20#Answer:What did Luke say was the reason for their joy?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!2~21#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 2:21 Mary and Joseph name the baby Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Luka 2:21 Maria na Yosefu wanampa mtoto huyo jina Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 2.21+What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~21#Question:What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?
trans-unit.source: What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani lililotukia siku ya nane ya maisha ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Question:What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~21#Answer:What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?-885789050
trans-unit.source: He was circumcised,
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ametahiriwa,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Answer:What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~21#Answer:What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?-173569704
trans-unit.source: and [his parents] named him Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Na [wazazi wake] wakamwita jina lake Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Answer:What happened on the eighth day of Jesus's life?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.21+Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~21#Question:Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Maria na Yosefu walimwita mtoto wao Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Question:Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~21#Answer:Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?636620627
trans-unit.source: It was the name the angel had told Mary to name him even before she was pregnant (1:31).
trans-unit.target: Lilikuwa jina ambalo malaika alimwambia Mariamu amwite hata kabla ya yeye kuwa mjamzito (1:31).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Answer:Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~21#Note:Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?1390276051
trans-unit.source: An angel had also told Joseph to name the baby that name. (See Matt. 1:21).
trans-unit.target: Pia, malaika alimwambia Yosefu amwite mtoto wake jina hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~21#Note:Why did Mary and Joseph name their baby boy Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!2~22#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 2:22-24 Mary and Joseph presented Jesus to God at the temple.
trans-unit.target: Luka 2:22-24 Maria na Yosefu walimtolea Mungu Yesu hekaluni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 2.22-24+Why did Mary and Joseph take the baby Jesus to the temple at that particular time?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~22#Question:Why did Mary and Joseph take the baby Jesus to the temple at that particular time?
trans-unit.source: Why did Mary and Joseph take the baby Jesus to the temple at that particular time?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mariamu na Yusufu walimpeleka mtoto mchanga Yesu hekaluni wakati huo hasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Question:Why did Mary and Joseph take the baby Jesus to the temple at that particular time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~22#Answer:Why did Mary and Joseph take the baby Jesus to the temple at that particular time?509022711
trans-unit.source: The Lord [God] had said that parents must present/dedicate every firstborn male child to him (Exod. 13:2, 12, 15). (22-23)
trans-unit.target: Bwana [Mungu] alikuwa amesema kwamba wazazi wanapaswa kumtolea/kumweka wakfu kila mtoto wa kiume wa kwanza (Kut. 13:2, 12, 15). (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Answer:Why did Mary and Joseph take the baby Jesus to the temple at that particular time?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.22+Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~22#Question:Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?
trans-unit.source: Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Maria na Yosefu walisubiri kwa majuma kadhaa kabla ya kwenda hekaluni kumtolea Mungu mtoto Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Question:Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~22#Answer:Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?1098220667
trans-unit.source: They waited for the days/time to end for Mary to be ritually pure/clean again. (22)
trans-unit.target: Walisubiri siku/wakati wa kumalizika kwa Mariamu kuwa safi/safi tena. (22)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Answer:Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~22#Note:Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?983023006
trans-unit.source: The Law of Moses said that for 40 days after a Jewish woman had delivered a baby, she was not ritually clean/pure, so they waited for that time to end. The woman had to bring a special offering (see Lev. 12:2-8) in order to become ritually clean/pure again. After she did that, she would again be allowed to go to the temple and participate in religious activities.
trans-unit.target: Sheria ya Musa ilisema kwamba kwa siku 40 baada ya mwanamke Myahudi kuzaa mtoto, hakuwa safi kwa desturi, kwa hivyo walisubiri wakati huo ukamilike. Mwanamke huyo alipaswa kuleta toleo maalum (tazama Mambo ya Walawi 12:2-8) ili kuwa safi kwa desturi tena. Baada ya kufanya hivyo, angeruhusiwa tena kwenda hekaluni na kushiriki katika shughuli za kidini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Note:Why did Mary and Joseph wait some weeks before they went to the temple to present the baby Jesus to God?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The words "made clean" here refer to being clean ritually, thus being allowed again into the public worship and the presence of God.
trans-unit.target: Uthibitisho wa Neno Muhimu: Maneno "kusafishwa" hapa hurejezea kuwa safi kidesturi, hivyo kuruhusiwa tena katika ibada ya peupe na kuwapo kwa Mungu.

trans-unit.source: If the translator used a very general word like "clean," check to make sure it does not mean only to remove external things, such as dried blood or dirt from the skin. If the translator is using a cultural term for a ceremony which must be performed by local women when they wish to return to normal activities after childbirth, ask about all its implications physically, culturally and spiritually.
trans-unit.target: Kama mtafsiri alitumia neno la jumla sana kama "safi", kuangalia ili kuhakikisha haina maana tu kuondoa mambo ya nje, kama vile damu kavu au uchafu kutoka ngozi. Kama mtafsiri ni kutumia neno la utamaduni kwa sherehe ambayo lazima kufanyika na wanawake wa ndani wakati wanataka kurudi shughuli za kawaida baada ya kujifungua, kuuliza kuhusu yote ya athari zake kimwili, kiutamaduni na kiroho.

group.id: Q:LUK 2.22-24+What is the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~22#Question:What is the Law of Moses?
trans-unit.source: What is the Law of Moses?
trans-unit.target: Sheria ya Kimusa ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Question:What is the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~22#Answer:What is the Law of Moses?-985849031
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Law of Moses is the laws and instructions which God had revealed to Moses. Although Moses wrote them down, they were God's laws for his people/the Jews/the Israelites to follow. That is why Luke referred to the same laws both as "the Law of Moses" (22) and as "the Law of the Lord" (23, 24).
trans-unit.target: Sheria ya Musa ni sheria na maagizo ambayo Mungu alimfunulia Musa. Ingawa Musa aliyaandika, yalikuwa sheria za Mungu kwa watu wake / Wayahudi / Waisraeli kufuata. Ndiyo sababu Luka alirejelea sheria zile zile kama "sheria ya Musa" (22) na kama "sheria ya Bwana" (23, 24).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Answer:What is the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~22#Note:What is the Law of Moses?1122016529
trans-unit.source: See "law" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia "sheria" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Note:What is the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~22#Note:What is the Law of Moses?-167460301
trans-unit.source: The Jews collected what Moses wrote, and those writings now are the first five books of the Old Testament.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi walikusanya yale Musa aliyoandika, na maandishi hayo sasa ni vitabu vitano vya kwanza vya Agano la Kale.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~22#Note:What is the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amemwona yule ambaye Mungu angewaokoa watu wake, Israeli, na [jamii nyingine] zote./ Alikuwa amemwona yule ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma kuwaokoa watu kutoka kwa jamii zote (30-32).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~30#Answer:What did Simeon say caused him to have a peaceful heart?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.32+In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~32#Question:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu ni kama nuru kwa Waisraeli/Wayahudi na kwa watu wote wasio Wayahudi katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Question:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!2~32#Alternate:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?796090250
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites and for all the people who are not Jews?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu ni kama nuru kwa Waisraeli na watu wote wasio Wayahudi katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Alternate:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!2~32#Alternate:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?-709023700
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu ni nuru kwa Wayahudi na watu wote wasio Wayahudi katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Alternate:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?-430950066
trans-unit.source: In the same way that light allows us to see what is in a dark place, when a person learns about Jesus's work as his savior, that person knows clearly what must happen in order for him to be saved from his sins.
trans-unit.target: Kwa njia ileile ambayo nuru hiyo hutuwezesha kuona kile kilicho mahali penye giza, mtu anapojua juu ya kazi ya Yesu akiwa mwokozi wake, mtu huyo ajua waziwazi ni nini kinachopaswa kutukia ili aweze kuokolewa kutoka kwa dhambi zake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?269080045
trans-unit.source: The people of Israel already knew much about God, but now they would understand even more about him.
trans-unit.target: Tayari watu wa Israeli walijua mambo mengi kumhusu Mungu, lakini sasa wangeelewa mengi zaidi kumhusu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?101790814
trans-unit.source: The people who were/are not Jews would really see the contrast between the way they lived before they knew about God and the life the savior made possible for them. It would be as if Jesus had turned on a light for them to see better.
trans-unit.target: Watu ambao walikuwa/si Wayahudi wangeona tofauti kati ya namna walivyoishi kabla ya kumjua Mungu na maisha ambayo mwokozi aliwawezesha. Ingekuwa ni kana kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewasha nuru ili waweze kuona vizuri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?695155311
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "the nations" in KBT in the "Gentiles, pagans" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Ona "mataifa" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida katika maandishi "Wasio Wayahudi, wapagani".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~32#Answer:In what way, do you think, is Jesus like a light for the Israelites/Jews and for all the people who are not Jews?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.33+What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~33#Question:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?
trans-unit.source: What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?
trans-unit.target: Mariamu na Yusufu walifikiri nini juu ya yale Simeoni aliyosema juu ya mtoto?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~33#Question:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~33#Answer:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?5710798
trans-unit.source: They were amazed that he knew so much about the work Jesus would do. (33)
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa kwamba alijua mengi sana juu ya kazi ambayo Yesu angefanya. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~33#Answer:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~33#Answer:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~33#Answer:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~33#Answer:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?732065689
trans-unit.source: They were amazed that God had revealed some of the same things to Simeon about their baby that the angel had told them. (33)
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemfunulia Simeoni baadhi ya mambo yaleyale ambayo malaika alikuwa amewaambia kuhusu mtoto wao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~33#Answer:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~33#Note:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?-1350961194
trans-unit.source: They did not know any normal reason why Simeon should know these things without God showing them to him. It seemed very strange to them.
trans-unit.target: Hawakujua sababu yoyote ya kawaida kwa nini Simeoni alipaswa kujua mambo hayo bila Mungu kumfunulia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~33#Note:What did Mary and Joseph think about what Simeon said about the baby?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.34+What did Simeon do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~34#Question:What did Simeon do then?
trans-unit.source: What did Simeon do then?
trans-unit.target: Simeoni alifanya nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Question:What did Simeon do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:What did Simeon do then?627815710
trans-unit.source: He asked God to bless them and then spoke to Mary. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alimwomba Mungu awabariki na kisha akazungumza na Mariamu. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:What did Simeon do then?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~34#Note:What did Simeon do then?-2009748606
trans-unit.source: The Greek text literally says "Simeon blessed them", but that means that he asked God to bless them. There are many other blessings which people spoke in the Bible which make this custom of giving a blessing clear to us.
trans-unit.target: Maandishi ya Kigiriki yanasema "Simeoni aliwabariki", lakini hiyo inamaanisha kwamba alimwomba Mungu awabariki. Kuna baraka nyingine nyingi ambazo watu walisema katika Biblia ambazo zinafanya desturi hii ya kutoa baraka iwe wazi kwetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Note:What did Simeon do then?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.34+What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~34#Question:What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri lugha hii ya mfano kuhusu Waisraeli wengi kuanguka na wengine kuinuka kwa sababu ya Yesu inamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Question:What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?1922415674
trans-unit.source: Those Israelites who do not accept Jesus as their savior sent by God will fall away. That means that they will be separated from God and be a part of those people whose bad actions will lead to God destroying them (for all time to come).
trans-unit.target: Wale Waisraeli ambao hawamkubali Yesu kama mwokozi wao aliyetumwa na Mungu wataanguka. Hiyo inamaanisha kwamba watatengwa na Mungu na watakuwa sehemu ya watu ambao matendo yao mabaya yatawaongoza Mungu kuwaangamiza (kwa wakati wote ujao).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?1575202850
trans-unit.source: Those others who do accept Jesus as their savior will rise above the sin of this world. That means that they will be separated from the bad things in this world and will be joined with God (for all time to come). (34)
trans-unit.target: Wale wengine ambao wanamkubali Yesu kama mwokozi wao watainuka juu ya dhambi za dunia hii. Hiyo inamaanisha kwamba watatengwa na mambo mabaya ya dunia hii na wataunganishwa na Mungu (kwa wakati wote ujao).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:What, do you think, is the meaning of this picture language about many Israelite people falling and others rising because of Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.34+What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~34#Question:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?
trans-unit.source: What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu angekuwa ishara ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Question:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?-810125654
trans-unit.source: People would see and realize that God's promises about sending a savior were being fulfilled in what Jesus said and did. (34)
trans-unit.target: Watu wangeona na kutambua kwamba ahadi za Mungu kuhusu kumtuma mwokozi zilikuwa zikitimia katika yale ambayo Yesu alisema na kufanya. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?1194415397
trans-unit.source: He is the one through whom God shows the way for a person to be saved.
trans-unit.target: Yeye ndiye ambaye kupitia kwake Mungu huonyesha njia ya wokovu kwa mtu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?12464408
trans-unit.source: In Jesus, people would see God beginning to rule and reign in people's lives and they would also see how they were to live.
trans-unit.target: Katika Yesu, watu wangeona Mungu akianza kutawala na kutawala katika maisha ya watu na wangeona pia jinsi walivyopaswa kuishi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~34#Note:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?2053654189
trans-unit.source: Any of these answers is good.
trans-unit.target: Yoyote kati ya majibu hayo ni mazuri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Note:What kind of a sign do you think that Jesus was to be?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.34+How would people respond to seeing this sign of Jesus in the world?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~34#Question:How would people respond to seeing this sign of Jesus in the world?
trans-unit.source: How would people respond to seeing this sign of Jesus in the world?
trans-unit.target: Watu wangetendaje walipoona ishara hiyo ya Yesu ulimwenguni?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Question:How would people respond to seeing this sign of Jesus in the world?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~34#Answer:How would people respond to seeing this sign of Jesus in the world?-134421324
trans-unit.source: Many (people) would say bad things about Jesus (and things he would teach). (34)
trans-unit.target: Wengi (watu) wangesema mambo mabaya juu ya Yesu (na mambo ambayo angefundisha).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~34#Answer:How would people respond to seeing this sign of Jesus in the world?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.35+What will happen to the many people who say or think bad things about this sign from God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~35#Question:What will happen to the many people who say or think bad things about this sign from God?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to the many people who say or think bad things about this sign from God?
trans-unit.target: Itakuwaje kwa watu wengi wanaosema au kufikiri mambo mabaya kuhusu ishara hiyo kutoka kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~35#Question:What will happen to the many people who say or think bad things about this sign from God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~35#Answer:What will happen to the many people who say or think bad things about this sign from God?-27576669
trans-unit.source: Their real thoughts would be clearly seen and would show that they were rejecting God and his plan to save them. (35a)
trans-unit.target: Mawazo yao ya kweli yangejitokeza waziwazi na kuonyesha kwamba walikuwa wakimkataa Mungu na mpango wake wa kuwaokoa. (35a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~35#Answer:What will happen to the many people who say or think bad things about this sign from God?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.35+How will the action of people rejecting Jesus's life and work affect his mother, Mary?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~35#Question:How will the action of people rejecting Jesus's life and work affect his mother, Mary?
trans-unit.source: How will the action of people rejecting Jesus's life and work affect his mother, Mary?
trans-unit.target: Tendo la watu wakataao maisha na kazi ya Yesu litamwathirije mama yake, Mariamu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~35#Question:How will the action of people rejecting Jesus's life and work affect his mother, Mary?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~35#Answer:How will the action of people rejecting Jesus's life and work affect his mother, Mary?-1010498601
trans-unit.source: She would feel great sorrow/anguish in her heart like the pain she would feel if someone pierced it with a sword. (35b)
trans-unit.target: Angehisi huzuni kubwa/uchungu moyoni mwake kama maumivu ambayo angehisi ikiwa mtu angeichoma kwa upanga. (35b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~35#Answer:How will the action of people rejecting Jesus's life and work affect his mother, Mary?
