group.id: Q:LUK 2.36-38+What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~36#Question:What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?
trans-unit.source: What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Simeoni alipokuwa amemshika mtoto Yesu na kuzungumza na wazazi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Question:What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?-360615917
trans-unit.source: [The woman/widow] Anna came up to them and thanked God for [sending] the child [to be the savior/Messiah].
trans-unit.target: [Mwanamke huyo/mjane] Ana alikuja kwao na kumshukuru Mungu kwa [kutumia] mtoto [kuwa mwokozi/Masihi].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?-290877664
trans-unit.source: She also told about this child to people who were waiting for God to set free the people [of Israel, represented here by those] living in Jerusalem. (38)
trans-unit.target: Pia alizungumza juu ya mtoto huyo kwa watu waliokuwa wakimngojea Mungu awakomboe watu [wa Israeli, waliowakilishwa hapa na hao] waliokuwa wakiishi Yerusalemu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What happened while Simeon was holding the baby Jesus and speaking to his parents?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.36-38+What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~36#Question:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri tunapaswa kujifunza nini kutokana na yale ambayo Luka aliandika kuhusu Ana kuwa hekaluni?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Question:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?-328509436
trans-unit.source: God's Spirit showed her also (36a) that the baby Jesus was the one God had sent to set free the people [of Israel]. (38).
trans-unit.target: Roho ya Mungu pia alimwonyesha (36a) kwamba mtoto Yesu ndiye ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma ili kuwaweka huru watu [wa Israeli]. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?1156832728
trans-unit.source: It was not just the man Simeon who realized that baby Jesus was the savior [that God had promised to send].
trans-unit.target: Si mtu Simeoni peke yake aliyetambua kwamba mtoto Yesu ndiye mwokozi [ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi kumtuma].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?2124687624
trans-unit.source: Anna was another person who spread the good news that Jesus was the savior, starting already when he was only a few weeks old. (38)
trans-unit.target: Anna alikuwa mtu mwingine aliyeeneza habari njema kwamba Yesu alikuwa mwokozi, akianza tayari wakati alipokuwa na umri wa wiki chache tu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Anna being at the temple?

trans-unit.source: She was a prophetess.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa nabii wa kike.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.-654608777
trans-unit.source: Her father was Phanuel and they had descended from Asher [one of Jacob's/Israel's sons].
trans-unit.target: Baba yake alikuwa Fanueli nao walikuwa wazao wa Asheri [mmoja wa wana wa Yakobo/Israeli].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.-2040535693
trans-unit.source: She had married and then lived with her husband for 7 years [until he died]. (36)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ameoa na kisha akaishi na mume wake kwa miaka 7 [hadi alipokufa]. (36)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.272996786
trans-unit.source: After that, she was a widow and was now 84 years old.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mjane mwenye umri wa miaka 84.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.-299392114
trans-unit.source: She served/worshipped God by means of fasting and praying at the temple grounds from morning until night/all day long. (37)
trans-unit.target: Alimtumikia/alimwabudu Mungu kwa njia ya kufunga na kuomba katika eneo la hekalu kutoka asubuhi hadi usiku/mchana mzima. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.995372987
trans-unit.source: (She, too, seems to have been waiting for God to send the one who would free his people.) (38)
trans-unit.target: (Yeye, pia, yaonekana alikuwa akingojea Mungu amlete mtu ambaye angewakomboa watu wake.) (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~36#Answer:Tell me some of the things you heard/read about Anna in this section.

group.id: Q:LUK 2.37+What do you think that Anna did when she fasted?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.39-40+What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~39#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?1511193847
trans-unit.source: Luke told Theophilus at the beginning of this book (1:1-4) that he wanted to present a true account of Jesus's life. Since Mary and Joseph had come to Bethlehem for having their names recorded, it would be natural for them to return home to Nazareth.
trans-unit.target: Luka alimwambia Theofilo mwanzoni mwa kitabu hiki (1:1-4) kwamba alitaka kuwasilisha simulizi la kweli la maisha ya Yesu. Kwa kuwa Mariamu na Yusufu walikuwa wamekuja Bethlehemu ili majina yao yaandikwe, ingekuwa kawaida kwao kurudi nyumbani Nazareti.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~39#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~39#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~39#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~39#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?-1084627847
trans-unit.source: Jesus did not grow up in his forefather King David's village of Bethlehem, nor in Jerusalem, where the temple of God was. He appeared to be an ordinary child in an ordinary family in an ordinary village.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakulelewa katika kijiji cha babu yake Mfalme Daudi cha Bethlehemu, wala katika Yerusalemu, ambapo hekalu la Mungu lilikuwa. Alionekana kuwa mtoto wa kawaida katika familia ya kawaida katika kijiji cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~39#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~39#Note:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?2134583248
trans-unit.source: People would have to accept him based on the way he lived and what he taught, not on his social status, which would be based on who his ancestors were or on his religious education.
trans-unit.target: Watu wangelazimika kumkubali kwa msingi wa jinsi alivyoishi na mambo aliyofundisha, si kwa sababu ya cheo chake katika jamii, ambacho kingetegemea mababu zake au elimu yake ya kidini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~39#Note:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the family returning to Nazareth?

trans-unit.source: Luke wanted the reader to know that Jesus was very wise, even at that early age. He knew the work God had given him [to be the savior]. (49)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~41#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about the boy Jesus going to the temple in Jerusalem?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.41-42+What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~41#Question:What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?
trans-unit.source: What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wazazi wa Yesu walienda Yerusalemu tena?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~41#Question:What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~41#Answer:What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?1918482660
trans-unit.source: It was their custom to go there every year to celebrate the Feast of the Passover. (41-42)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa desturi yao kwenda huko kila mwaka kuadhimisha Sikukuu ya Kupitwa (41-42).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~41#Answer:What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~41#Note:What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?-479403893
trans-unit.source: Every Jew was to go to the temple in Jerusalem once a year. Many people chose to go at the time for this feast.
trans-unit.target: Kila Myahudi alipaswa kwenda hekaluni huko Yerusalemu mara moja kwa mwaka. Watu wengi waliamua kwenda wakati wa sikukuu hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~41#Note:What was the reason that Jesus's parents went again to Jerusalem?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.41-45+What do you know about this Jewish feast?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!2~41#Question:What do you know about this Jewish feast?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about this Jewish feast?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu sherehe hiyo ya Kiyahudi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~41#Question:What do you know about this Jewish feast?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~41#Answer:What do you know about this Jewish feast?-2130224691
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: This feast was to remember how God's angel passed over the homes of the Jews when they were slaves in Egypt. The angel passed over them because they had put the blood of a perfect lamb on their doorposts as a sign. The Egyptians did not do as God had said, so the angel killed the oldest son and the firstborn animal young in every such house. Because of that, the Egyptian ruler allowed the Jews to leave Egypt and return to the land God had promised to them. (See "The Passover sacrifice" in KBT in the "sacrifice, offering, blood" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Msherehekeo wa neno muhimu: Sikukuu hii ilikuwa kukumbuka jinsi malaika wa Mungu alivyopita juu ya nyumba za Wayahudi wakati walipokuwa watumwa huko Misri. Malaika alipita juu yao kwa sababu walikuwa wameweka damu ya mwana-kondoo mkamilifu kwenye milango yao kama ishara. Wamisri hawakufanya kama Mungu alivyosema, kwa hivyo malaika aliua mwana mkubwa na mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wanyama katika kila nyumba kama hiyo. Kwa sababu hiyo, mtawala wa Misri aliwaruhusu Wayahudi kuondoka Misri na kurudi katika nchi ambayo Mungu alikuwa amewaahidi. (Tazama "Dhabihu ya Pasaka" katika KBT katika "dhabihu, toleo, damu" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~41#Answer:What do you know about this Jewish feast?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!2~42#Answer:How old was Jesus when he went with his parents?1418578633
trans-unit.source: 12 years old. (42)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~42#Note:How old was Jesus when he went with his parents?-386329831
trans-unit.source: A footnote may be good here to indicate that this was the age at which Jewish boys and girls began to be considered/called adult men and women. As adults they had to do all the religious activities that God told the Jews to do, such as to worship in Jerusalem during the Feast of the Passover.
trans-unit.target: Inaweza kuwa vizuri kutaja hapa kwamba huu ulikuwa ni umri ambao wavulana na wasichana Wayahudi walianza kuchukuliwa/kuitwa wanaume na wanawake wazima. Kama watu wazima walipaswa kufanya shughuli zote za kidini ambazo Mungu aliwaambia Wayahudi wafanye, kama vile kuabudu huko Yerusalemu wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~42#Note:How old was Jesus when he went with his parents?

trans-unit.target: "Mwanangu, mbona umetutenda hivi? tazama, baba yako nami tumekuwa tukikutafuta kwa huzuni".

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!2~48#Note:What did his mother say to him about all this?234828439
trans-unit.source: When you translate the words "your father" to refer to Joseph, follow the custom of the people who will use this translation. Use the words normally used by a mother when she speaks to her children about her husband. Because Joseph was not the true physical father of Jesus, some languages may require a translator to use a word similar to "stepfather".
trans-unit.target: Unapotafsiri maneno "baba yenu" kumhusu Yosefu, fuata desturi ya watu watakaotumia tafsiri hiyo. Tumia maneno ambayo kwa kawaida mama hutumia anapozungumza na watoto wake kuhusu mume wake. Kwa kuwa Yosefu hakuwa baba halisi wa Yesu, huenda ikawa lazima kwa mtafsiri kutumia neno linalofanana na "baba wa kambo" katika lugha fulani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!2~48#Note:What did his mother say to him about all this?

group.id: Q:LUK 2.49+Jesus had not been with his parents for three days. What do you think was the reason that he asked his mother, "Why did you have to look for me?"

group.id: Q:LUK 2.52+What did Luke tell us about Jesus growing to be a man?

trans-unit.source: He matured physically and mentally./He grew taller and wiser. (52a)

trans-unit.source: Luke 3:1-6 John the Baptizer prepared the way for Jesus.

group.id: Q:LUK 3.1-6+What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about John the Baptizer's work?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~1#Question:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about John the Baptizer's work?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about John the Baptizer's work?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri tunapaswa kujifunza nini kutokana na yale ambayo Luka aliandika kuhusu kazi ya Yohana Mbatizaji?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~1#Question:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about John the Baptizer's work?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~1#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about John the Baptizer's work?-953326137
trans-unit.source: Luke wanted to show us that John began the work of getting people's hearts ready to hear and obey Jesus's message, just as the angel (1:16-17) and the Holy Spirit (1:76-79) had told Zechariah that John would do.
trans-unit.target: Luka alitaka kutuonyesha kwamba Yohana alianza kazi ya kutayarisha mioyo ya watu kusikia na kutii ujumbe wa Yesu, kama vile malaika (1:16-17) na Roho Mtakatifu (1:76-79) walivyomwambia Zekaria kwamba Yohana angefanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~1#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about John the Baptizer's work?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.1+What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~1#Question:What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?
trans-unit.source: What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?
trans-unit.target: Ni kazi ya aina gani ambayo wanaume Tiberio (Kaisari), Pontio Pilato, ndugu yake Filipo na Lisaniya wote walifanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~1#Question:What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~1#Answer:What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?-889211744
trans-unit.source: They were all high government officials [in areas where the Romans had authority]. (1)
trans-unit.target: Wote walikuwa maofisa wakuu wa serikali [katika maeneo ambayo Waroma walikuwa na mamlaka]. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~1#Answer:What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~1#Note:What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?-1269718689
trans-unit.source: Tiberius was the highest Roman official and lived in Rome. The other men were officials under him in the regions around Jerusalem.
trans-unit.target: Tiberio alikuwa ofisa wa Roma aliye mkuu zaidi na aliishi Roma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~1#Note:What kind of work did the men Tiberius (Caesar), Pontius Pilate, his brother Philip and Lysanias all do?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.2+What kind of work did the men Annas and Caiaphas do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~2#Question:What kind of work did the men Annas and Caiaphas do?
trans-unit.source: What kind of work did the men Annas and Caiaphas do?
trans-unit.target: Wanaume hao Anasi na Kayafa walifanya kazi ya aina gani?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~2#Answer:What kind of work did the men Annas and Caiaphas do?1420105976
trans-unit.source: They were high priests [in Jerusalem]. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa makuhani wakuu [katika Yerusalemu]. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~2#Answer:What kind of work did the men Annas and Caiaphas do?

trans-unit.source: What happened to John during the time when all those men were the leaders of the people?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.3-6+What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?

trans-unit.source: What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?
trans-unit.target: Yohana alifanya nini katika eneo lote kuzunguka Mto Yordani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Question:What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~3#Note:What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?-823626431
trans-unit.source: He preached that people were to repent and then be baptized. (3)
trans-unit.target: Alihubiri kwamba watu wanapaswa kutubu na kisha kubatizwa. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Note:What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~3#Note:What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?1121812983
trans-unit.source: The key terms "preach" and "repent" are discussed here, but "baptize" will be checked below in vs. 7.
trans-unit.target: Maneno muhimu "huhubiri" na "tubu" yanazungumziwa hapa, lakini "batiza" yatachunguzwa hapa chini katika mstari wa 7.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Note:What did John do in all the area around the Jordan River?

trans-unit.source: Neither of these two actions is what the Bible called preaching. When one of the above answers is given, if at all possible, the translator should use other words appropriate to the action found in the verse in the GNT and not automatically use the church word for "preach".

group.id: Q:LUK 3.3-6+What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~3#Question:What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yohana alifanya nini hasa katika sehemu hizo 'alipohubiri'?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Question:What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~3#Answer:What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?-414632247
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: John spoke out with authority to tell some news (that God had sent the savior he had promised to them). In this verse, he also was telling the people how they could respond appropriately to that news.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Uchunguzi: Yohana alizungumza kwa mamlaka ili kutoa habari fulani (kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemtuma mwokozi ambaye alikuwa ameahidi kwao). Katika mstari huu, alikuwa pia akiwaambia watu jinsi wanavyoweza kuitikia habari hiyo kwa njia inayofaa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Answer:What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~3#Note:What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?-1326469477
trans-unit.source: In the GNT, preaching was always done to people who had not yet heard the message. In English translations, three different Greek words are all translated "preach". In this verse the Greek word focuses on the aspect of telling with authority.
trans-unit.target: Katika GNT, kuhubiri kulifanywa kila wakati kwa watu ambao hawakuwa wamesikia ujumbe. Katika tafsiri za Kiingereza, maneno matatu tofauti ya Kigiriki hutafsiriwa "kuhubiri". Katika mstari huu neno la Kigiriki linalenga upande wa kusema kwa mamlaka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Note:What do you think that John actually did in those places when he "preached"?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.3-6+What does a person do when he repents?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~3#Question:What does a person do when he repents?
trans-unit.source: What does a person do when he repents?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini anapotubu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Question:What does a person do when he repents?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~3#Answer:What does a person do when he repents?-1481930895
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He deliberately stops doing the sinful ways that please himself and changes to doing those ways which please God and are right in God's sight.
trans-unit.target: Kipimo cha neno muhimu: Yeye anaacha kwa makusudi kufanya njia za dhambi ambazo zinafurahisha mwenyewe na hubadilika kufanya njia ambazo zinampendeza Mungu na ni sawa machoni pa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Answer:What does a person do when he repents?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~3#Note:What does a person do when he repents?1432929289
trans-unit.source: See "repent" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "tubu" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Note:What does a person do when he repents?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.3+Why did people repent?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~3#Question:Why did people repent?
trans-unit.source: Why did people repent?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walitubu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Question:Why did people repent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~3#Answer:Why did people repent?-375237338
trans-unit.source: They wanted God to forgive/remove their sins. (3)
trans-unit.target: Walitamani Mungu awasamehe/aondoe dhambi zao. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~3#Answer:Why did people repent?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.4-6+What had the prophet Isaiah written about this many years before John and Luke were born?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~4#Question:What had the prophet Isaiah written about this many years before John and Luke were born?
trans-unit.source: What had the prophet Isaiah written about this many years before John and Luke were born?
trans-unit.target: Nabii Isaya alikuwa ameandika nini juu ya jambo hilo miaka mingi kabla ya Yohana na Luka kuzaliwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~4#Question:What had the prophet Isaiah written about this many years before John and Luke were born?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~4#Answer:What had the prophet Isaiah written about this many years before John and Luke were born?229156439
trans-unit.source: He had written that someone would preach in the wilderness that people were to get ready to accept the one whom God would send to save them. (4-6)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ameandika kwamba mtu fulani angehubiri jangwani kwamba watu wanapaswa kuwa tayari kumkubali yule ambaye Mungu angemtuma awaokoe. (4-6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~4#Answer:What had the prophet Isaiah written about this many years before John and Luke were born?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.4-5+How were those people to get ready for this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~4#Question:How were those people to get ready for this?
trans-unit.source: How were those people to get ready for this?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walipaswa kujitayarishaje kwa ajili ya hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~4#Question:How were those people to get ready for this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~4#Answer:How were those people to get ready for this?-1342787533
trans-unit.source: They were to correct/change their lives from living in bad ways to living in ways that pleased God. (They were to do whatever was necessary to get rid of their bad ways, like men straighten and level bad places in a path/road.) (4-5)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kurekebisha/kubadilisha maisha yao kutoka kuishi katika njia mbaya hadi kuishi katika njia zinazompendeza Mungu. (Walipaswa kufanya chochote kilichohitajika kuondoa njia zao mbaya, kama watu wanyoosha na kusawazisha sehemu mbaya kwenye njia/barabara.) (4-5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~4#Answer:How were those people to get ready for this?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.2-4+Why did Luke quote these words which the prophet Isaiah had written?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~2#Question:Why did Luke quote these words which the prophet Isaiah had written?
trans-unit.source: Why did Luke quote these words which the prophet Isaiah had written?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Luka alinukuu maneno haya ambayo nabii Isaya alikuwa ameandika?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~2#Question:Why did Luke quote these words which the prophet Isaiah had written?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~2#Answer:Why did Luke quote these words which the prophet Isaiah had written?-1166276139
trans-unit.source: He wanted to show the readers that John was doing what Isaiah said that someone would do before the savior arrived. (2b-4)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kuwaonyesha wasomaji kwamba Yohana alikuwa akifanya kile ambacho Isaya alisema kwamba mtu fulani angefanya kabla ya mwokozi kuja. (2b-4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~2#Answer:Why did Luke quote these words which the prophet Isaiah had written?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7-20+What did Luke write about in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~7#Question:What did Luke write about in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Luke write about in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Luka aliandika nini katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:What did Luke write about in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:What did Luke write about in these verses?-1316374850
trans-unit.source: He wrote about what John said to different groups of people, especially to those who came to him in order for him to baptize them.
trans-unit.target: Aliandika kuhusu yale ambayo Yohana aliwaambia vikundi mbalimbali vya watu, hasa wale waliomjia ili awabatize.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:What did Luke write about in these verses?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7+How many people came to where John was staying in that uninhabited area/wilderness/desert?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7-9+What do you think that John did with the people when he baptized them?

trans-unit.source: What do you think that John did with the people when he baptized them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yohana alifanya nini na watu alipokuwa akiwabatiza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:What do you think that John did with the people when he baptized them?

trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Alifanya kitu ili maji yageuke juu ya watu ama kwa kuwaweka chini ya maji au kwa kuweka maji juu yao, labda njia ya kwanza (Marko 1:9-10).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:What do you think that John did with the people when he baptized them?

trans-unit.source: See "baptize, baptism" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "batiza, ubatizo" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Note:What do you think that John did with the people when he baptized them?

trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwalinganisha watu hao na nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:With what did John compare these people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:With what did John compare these people?-2140007979
trans-unit.source: He said they were [like] a group of poisonous snakes. (7)

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7-9+What does it mean in your language if one person calls another person a (poisonous) snake?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~7#Question:What does it mean in your language if one person calls another person a (poisonous) snake?
trans-unit.source: What does it mean in your language if one person calls another person a (poisonous) snake?
trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha nini katika lugha yako ikiwa mtu mmoja anamwita mwingine nyoka (mwenye sumu)?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:What does it mean in your language if one person calls another person a (poisonous) snake?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~7#Note:What does it mean in your language if one person calls another person a (poisonous) snake?880018996
trans-unit.source: The translation should reflect an insulting put-down by John. Some bad characteristic of poisonous snakes should be implied, such as their being sly, deceiving, or deadly. It should not be anything that is regarded as speaking well of a person.
trans-unit.target: Tafsiri inapaswa kuonyesha dharau ya Yohana. Baadhi ya sifa mbaya za nyoka wenye sumu zinapaswa kutajwa, kama vile kuwa wao ni wajanja, wadanganyifu, au wauaji. Haipaswi kuwa kitu chochote ambacho kinachukuliwa kuwa kinasema vizuri juu ya mtu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Note:What does it mean in your language if one person calls another person a (poisonous) snake?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7+What were those people doing which reminded John of snakes?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~7#Question:What were those people doing which reminded John of snakes?
trans-unit.source: What were those people doing which reminded John of snakes?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walikuwa wakifanya nini ambacho kilimkumbusha Yohana juu ya nyoka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:What were those people doing which reminded John of snakes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:What were those people doing which reminded John of snakes?766568501
trans-unit.source: [By coming to be baptized, they thought that they were tricking John/God. They wanted him to think that they had already repented of their sins, but they had not repented.] They hoped that in this way they could escape God being angry about their sins and ready to punish them as they deserved. (7)
trans-unit.target: [Kwa kuja kubatizwa, walifikiri kwamba walikuwa wakimdanganya Yohana/Mungu. Walipenda afikiri kwamba tayari walikuwa wametubu dhambi zao, lakini hawakufanya hivyo.] Walitazamia kwamba kwa njia hii wangeweza kuepuka hasira ya Mungu kwa dhambi zao na kuwa tayari kuwaadhibu kama walivyostahili. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:What were those people doing which reminded John of snakes?

trans-unit.source: In other places in the Bible, the devil used the form of a snake to deceive people (see Gen. 3 and 2 Cor. 11:3). Jesus later said that the devil was their father, and called him the Father of Lies (see John 8:44).
trans-unit.target: Katika sehemu nyingine za Biblia, ibilisi alitumia umbo la nyoka kuwapotosha watu (tazama Mwanzo 3 na 2 Kor. 11:3). Yesu baadaye alisema kwamba ibilisi alikuwa baba yao, na akamwita Baba wa uongo (tazama Yohana 8:44).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Note:John called the people a bunch of young snakes who had descended from other snakes. Who do you think those people were, who showed/taught them to act like they were doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.8+If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~8#Question:If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?
trans-unit.source: If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu hao hawakutaka Mungu awaadhibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao, Yohana aliwaambia jambo moja ambalo walipaswa kufanya na jambo moja ambalo hawakupaswa kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~8#Question:If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~8#Answer:If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?1272657731
trans-unit.source: He said that their actions must show that they really had repented/changed. (8a)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba matendo yao lazima yaonyeshe kwamba kwa kweli wametubu/wamebadilika.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~8#Answer:If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~8#Answer:If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?547791413
trans-unit.source: Also, they must not think that, because they were descendants of Abraham, God would not punish them for their sins. (8b)
trans-unit.target: Pia, hawapaswi kufikiri kwamba, kwa sababu wao ni wazao wa Ibrahimu, Mungu hatawaadhibu kwa dhambi zao. (8b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~8#Answer:If those people did not want God to punish them for their sins, John told them one thing they must do and one thing they must not do. What were those two things?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.8+Why did John say that they must not trust in their being descendants of Abraham to keep God from punishing them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~8#Question:Why did John say that they must not trust in their being descendants of Abraham to keep God from punishing them?
trans-unit.source: Why did John say that they must not trust in their being descendants of Abraham to keep God from punishing them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yohana alisema kwamba hawapaswi kutegemea kuwa wao ni wazao wa Abrahamu ili Mungu asiwaadhibu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~8#Question:Why did John say that they must not trust in their being descendants of Abraham to keep God from punishing them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~8#Answer:Why did John say that they must not trust in their being descendants of Abraham to keep God from punishing them?-895015566
trans-unit.source: He said that, if God only wanted a large number of descendants from Abraham, he could change ordinary stones into more descendants. [That meant that God did not need those particular people for any reason.] (8)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba, ikiwa Mungu alitaka tu idadi kubwa ya wazao kutoka kwa Ibrahimu, angeweza kubadilisha mawe ya kawaida kuwa wazao zaidi. [Hiyo ilimaanisha kwamba Mungu hakuhitaji watu hao maalum kwa sababu yoyote.] (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~8#Answer:Why did John say that they must not trust in their being descendants of Abraham to keep God from punishing them?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7-9+In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~7#Question:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?
trans-unit.source: In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 9, Yohana anatumia mfano wa mti na matunda yake, shoka kwenye mizizi ya mti huo, na moto.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?-15617706
trans-unit.source: The tree represents a person.
trans-unit.target: Mti huo unawakilisha mtu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?1943429487
trans-unit.source: The tree's good fruit represents activities the person does which please God.
trans-unit.target: Matunda mazuri ya mti huo huwakilisha utendaji ambao mtu hufanya ambao humfurahisha Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?-321128431
trans-unit.source: People use an ax to cut down fruit trees which do not produce good fruit. John said the ax was already close to the tree roots. When roots are cut, the tree's life is totally ended. Likewise, God is ready to punish/destroy a person because he/she is bad. That will be the end of that person's life.
trans-unit.target: Watu hutumia shoka kukata miti ya matunda ambayo haitoi matunda mazuri. Yohana alisema shoka tayari lilikuwa karibu na mizizi ya mti. Wakati mizizi inapokatwa, maisha ya mti yanaisha kabisa. Vivyo hivyo, Mungu yuko tayari kumwadhibu/kumharibu mtu kwa sababu yeye ni mbaya. Hiyo itakuwa mwisho wa maisha ya mtu huyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?-1292107834
trans-unit.source: The fire represents how that unproductive tree will be destroyed, which suggests the fire of hell for such a person.
trans-unit.target: Moto huo unawakilisha jinsi mti huo usiozaa utakavyoharibiwa, jambo linaloonyesha moto wa helo kwa mtu kama huyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:In verse 9 John used the picture language of a tree and its fruit, an ax at the tree's roots and a fire. What do you think these things represent?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.7-9+Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~7#Question:Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?
trans-unit.source: Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu wa aina gani ambao Yohana alionyesha wakiwa tayari kuchoma katika helo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Question:Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?-1333737362
trans-unit.source: They were the people who had not repented,
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa watu ambao hawakuwa wametubu,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~7#Answer:Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?1465856995
trans-unit.source: and/or they were trusting in their ancestry (who their ancestors were) to save them. (See 3:8.)
trans-unit.target: na/au walikuwa wakitumaini katika ukoo wao (ambao ni mababu zao) kuwaokoa (Tazama 3:8.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~7#Answer:Which type of people did John picture as being ready to burn in hell?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.11+What did John tell the people they should do to show that they had truly repented?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~11#Question:What did John tell the people they should do to show that they had truly repented?
trans-unit.source: What did John tell the people they should do to show that they had truly repented?
trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwaambia watu wafanye nini ili kuonyesha kwamba walikuwa wametubu kikweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~11#Question:What did John tell the people they should do to show that they had truly repented?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~11#Answer:What did John tell the people they should do to show that they had truly repented?-1572622826
trans-unit.source: They should be ready to share their clothing and food with those who have [little or] none. (11)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kuwa tayari kushiriki mavazi na chakula chao pamoja na wale wasio na mavazi au chakula. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~11#Answer:What did John tell the people they should do to show that they had truly repented?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.13+What did John tell the men who collected taxes that they should do to show that they had truly repented?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~13#Question:What did John tell the men who collected taxes that they should do to show that they had truly repented?
trans-unit.source: What did John tell the men who collected taxes that they should do to show that they had truly repented?
trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwaambia wakusanya-kodi kwamba walipaswa kufanya nini ili kuonyesha kwamba walikuwa wametubu kikweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~13#Question:What did John tell the men who collected taxes that they should do to show that they had truly repented?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~13#Answer:What did John tell the men who collected taxes that they should do to show that they had truly repented?252673514
trans-unit.source: They should not collect more money from people than the true amount of tax the people owed [to the Roman government]. (13)
trans-unit.target: Hawakupaswa kukusanya pesa zaidi kutoka kwa watu kuliko kiasi halisi cha kodi ambayo watu walidaiwa [kwa serikali ya Roma]. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~13#Answer:What did John tell the men who collected taxes that they should do to show that they had truly repented?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.14+What did John tell the soldiers they should do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~14#Question:What did John tell the soldiers they should do?
trans-unit.source: What did John tell the soldiers they should do?
trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwaambia askari-jeshi wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~14#Question:What did John tell the soldiers they should do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~14#Answer:What did John tell the soldiers they should do?189269635
trans-unit.source: They should be satisfied with their pay. That is, they should not physically force anyone to give them money. (14)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kuridhika na mshahara wao. Hiyo ni, hawapaswi kimwili kulazimisha mtu yeyote kuwapa fedha. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~14#Answer:What did John tell the soldiers they should do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~14#Answer:What did John tell the soldiers they should do?-726657553
trans-unit.source: They also should not say that if the person would not give them money, they would falsely accuse that person in court [so that person would get into trouble or be put in the jail]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Pia hawapaswi kusema kwamba ikiwa mtu huyo hatawapa pesa, watamshtaki isivyo kweli mahakamani [ili mtu huyo apate matatizo au afungwe gerezani]. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~14#Answer:What did John tell the soldiers they should do?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.15+What do you think that the Jewish people were waiting for and thinking might be happening?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~15#Question:What do you think that the Jewish people were waiting for and thinking might be happening?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that the Jewish people were waiting for and thinking might be happening?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Wayahudi walikuwa wakingojea na kufikiri nini huenda kilikuwa kikitukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Question:What do you think that the Jewish people were waiting for and thinking might be happening?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~15#Answer:What do you think that the Jewish people were waiting for and thinking might be happening?1916282096
trans-unit.source: They were waiting for the Christ/Messiah to come and set them free from their troubles. (15)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakingojea Kristo/Masihi aje na kuwaweka huru kutoka katika matatizo yao. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Answer:What do you think that the Jewish people were waiting for and thinking might be happening?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.15+What were all the people thinking about John in this regard?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~15#Question:What were all the people thinking about John in this regard?
trans-unit.source: What were all the people thinking about John in this regard?
trans-unit.target: Watu wote walikuwa wakifikiria nini juu ya Yohana kwa habari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Question:What were all the people thinking about John in this regard?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~15#Answer:What were all the people thinking about John in this regard?1114409868
trans-unit.source: They were seriously wondering if John himself was the Christ. (15)
trans-unit.target: Watu walikuwa wakijiuliza kwa uzito kama Yohana mwenyewe ndiye Kristo. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Answer:What were all the people thinking about John in this regard?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.16-17+How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~16#Question:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?
trans-unit.source: How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?
trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwajibuje kuhusu kama alikuwa Kristo/Mesiya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Question:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!3~16#Alternate:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?-1889937453
trans-unit.source: How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ?
trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwajibuje kuhusu kama alikuwa Kristo au la?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Alternate:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!3~16#Alternate:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?-1782841593
trans-unit.source: How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Messiah?
trans-unit.target: Yohana aliwajibuje kuhusu kama alikuwa Mesiya au la?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Alternate:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?238865389
trans-unit.source: He himself was not the Christ/Messiah. The Christ/Messiah would have much greater power and authority than he himself had. (16-17)
trans-unit.target: Yeye mwenyewe hakuwa Kristo/Masihi. Kristo/Masihi angekuwa na nguvu na mamlaka kubwa kuliko yeye mwenyewe (16-17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John answer them concerning whether or not he was the Christ/Messiah?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.16-17+How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~16#Question:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?
trans-unit.source: How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?
trans-unit.target: Yohana alionyeshaje kwamba Kristo angefanya kazi kubwa kuliko ile aliyofanya yeye mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Question:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?-377938111
trans-unit.source: The Christ would baptize people with the Holy Spirit and fire, not just with water as John did.
trans-unit.target: Kristo angewabatiza watu kwa Roho Mtakatifu na moto, si kwa maji tu kama Yohana alivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?-1216475808
trans-unit.source: John did not feel he even was important enough to be the servant who might assist Christ by untying his sandals. (16)
trans-unit.target: Yohana hakujisikia kuwa muhimu hata kuwa mtumishi ambaye angeweza kumsaidia Kristo kwa kumfungua viatu vyake. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?-983844109
trans-unit.source: John pictured the Christ as having authority to save and to punish people. (He himself did not have such authority.) (17)
trans-unit.target: Yohana alionyesha Kristo akiwa na mamlaka ya kuokoa na kuwaadhibu watu (yeye mwenyewe hakuwa na mamlaka kama hiyo). (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:How did John show that the Christ would do greater work than he himself was doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.16-17+What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~16#Question:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kwamba Kristo atawabatiza watu kwa Roho Mtakatifu na kwa moto?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Question:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?917951334
trans-unit.source: Those whom Christ causes to repent will receive his Holy Spirit into their hearts,
trans-unit.target: Wale ambao Kristo anawafanya watubu watapokea Roho Mtakatifu wake mioyoni mwao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?947714750
trans-unit.source: but Christ will throw those who do not repent into the fires of hell to destroy them. (17)
trans-unit.target: lakini Kristo atawaangusha wale wasiotubu katika moto wa Jahannamu kuwaangamiza. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?1584374362
trans-unit.source: The Christ would cause people who repent to come under the influence of God's Holy Spirit. The Spirit would get rid of all that was not good in their lives just as a fire does with grass and sticks. (17)
trans-unit.target: Kristo angewafanya watu wenye kutubu wawe chini ya ushawishi wa Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu. Roho angeondoa kila kitu ambacho si kizuri katika maisha yao kama vile moto unavyoondoa nyasi na vijiti. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?-1804687483
trans-unit.source: Baptism with water is only an outward, ritual cleaning to show what we want to happen in our inner being. The Christ will truly clean/cleanse one's inner being by means of his Holy Spirit and remove impurities as fire does. (16-17)
trans-unit.target: Ubatizo wa maji ni utakasaji wa nje tu, wa kidesturi kuonyesha kile tunachotaka kitokee ndani yetu. Kristo atasafisha/kusafisha kwa kweli ndani ya mtu kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu wake na kuondoa uchafu kama vile moto unavyofanya. (16-17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~16#Answer:What do you think it means that Christ will baptize people with the Holy Spirit and with fire?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.17+What is the work of the winnowing fork in the picture language John used?

trans-unit.source: What is the work of the winnowing fork in the picture language John used?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~17#Question:What is the work of the winnowing fork in the picture language John used?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~17#Answer:What is the work of the winnowing fork in the picture language John used?408888104
trans-unit.source: People use it to separate all the rubbish from the good grain. (17)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~17#Answer:What is the work of the winnowing fork in the picture language John used?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.15-18+What, do you think, are the good things and the bad things that the Christ will be separating?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~15#Question:What, do you think, are the good things and the bad things that the Christ will be separating?
trans-unit.source: What, do you think, are the good things and the bad things that the Christ will be separating?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Kristo atatenganisha mambo gani mazuri na mabaya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Question:What, do you think, are the good things and the bad things that the Christ will be separating?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~15#Answer:What, do you think, are the good things and the bad things that the Christ will be separating?-1415704010
trans-unit.source: Christ will separate the good people from the bad people. Those people who repent and believe in him are good. Christ will separate them from those people who do not repent.
trans-unit.target: Kristo atawatenganisha watu wema na waovu, wale wanaotubu na kumwamini, na wale ambao hawajatubu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Answer:What, do you think, are the good things and the bad things that the Christ will be separating?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.17+What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls good?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~17#Question:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls good?
trans-unit.source: What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls good?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kitakachowapata wale ambao Mungu anawaita watu wazuri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~17#Question:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls good?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~17#Answer:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls good?-1840880665
trans-unit.source: He will gather them [into heaven] where he wants to keep them, as a farmer gathers the wheat and stores it in a safe place. (17)
trans-unit.target: Atawakusanya [mbinguni] mahali atakapowaweka, kama vile mkulima akusanyavyo ngano na kuihifadhi mahali salama. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~17#Answer:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls good?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.17+What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls bad?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~17#Question:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls bad?
trans-unit.source: What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls bad?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kitakachowapata wale ambao Mungu anawaita waovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~17#Question:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls bad?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~17#Answer:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls bad?-1945209845
trans-unit.source: They will be burned up/destroyed in the never-ending fires [of hell], as a farmer burns the rubbish parts of the wheat and grass. (17)
trans-unit.target: Watateketezwa/watangamizwa katika moto usioisha [wa helo], kama vile mkulima anavyochoma sehemu za takataka za ngano na nyasi. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~17#Answer:What do you think will happen to those people whom he calls bad?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Good News was that the Christ, the one whom God had promised would come to save his people, was already among them. If they repented and prepared their hearts to accept the savior, God would not throw them into the fires of hell.
trans-unit.target: Habari njema ilikuwa kwamba Masihi, yule ambaye Mungu aliahidi atakuja kuwaokoa watu wake, alikuwa tayari miongoni mwao. Kama wangetubu na kutayarisha mioyo yao kumkubali mwokozi, Mungu hangewatia katika moto wa Jehanamu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~15#Answer:In verse 18 Luke wrote that John kept on urging/strongly requesting [the people to repent of their sins] and that he preached the Good News to them. If people will be punished in the fires of hell, that does not sound like good news. What was the good news that John preached?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~15#Answer:In verse 18 Luke wrote that John kept on urging/strongly requesting [the people to repent of their sins] and that he preached the Good News to them. If people will be punished in the fires of hell, that does not sound like good news. What was the good news that John preached?1473289228
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The words "preached the Good News" in English translations are actually only one word in Greek. The word literally means, "he Good News-ed". The focus is on what he preached, not how he did it. See the discussion above at 3:3.

group.id: Q:LUK 3.19+Why did John rebuke Herod, the king?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~19#Question:Why did John rebuke Herod, the king?
trans-unit.source: Why did John rebuke Herod, the king?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yohana alimkemea Herode, mfalme?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~19#Question:Why did John rebuke Herod, the king?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~19#Answer:Why did John rebuke Herod, the king?86624359
trans-unit.source: Herod had married his brother's wife, Herodias, as well as having done other bad actions. (19)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~19#Answer:Why did John rebuke Herod, the king?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~21#Answer:Who do you think baptized Jesus?1172684566
trans-unit.source: John the Baptizer did (Matt. 3:13-15; Mark 1:9).
trans-unit.target: Yohana Mbatizaji alifanya hivyo (Mt. 3:13-15; Marko 1:9).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Answer:Who do you think baptized Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.21+Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~21#Question:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?
trans-unit.source: Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yohana alimbatiza Yesu kabla ya yeye kuwa gerezani, au baada ya yeye kuwa huko?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Question:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~21#Answer:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?-463743458
trans-unit.source: John did it before he was in the prison.
trans-unit.target: Yohana alifanya hivyo kabla ya yeye kuwa gerezani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Answer:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~21#Note:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?-173179765
trans-unit.source: John died while he was in the prison (see Mark 6:14-29). Try to show in either verse 20 or 21 that the activities in 3:21-22 happened before the activities in vs. 20.
trans-unit.target: Yohana alikufa alipokuwa gerezani (tazama Marko 6:14-29). Jaribu kuonyesha katika mstari 20 au 21 kwamba shughuli katika 3:21-22 ilitokea kabla ya shughuli katika mstari wa 20.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Note:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!3~21#Note:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?475029785
trans-unit.source: You may want to put verses 19-20 into a "verse bridge" along with verses 21-22. Number these verses together as 19-22, and mention Jesus's baptism (from 21-22) first, followed by Herod putting John in prison (19-20).
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukataka kuweka mstari wa 19-20 katika "daraja la mstari" pamoja na mstari wa 21-22. Weka namba ya mstari huu pamoja kuwa 19-22, na utaje ubatizo wa Yesu (kutoka 21-22) kwanza, ukifuatwa na Herode kumtia Yohana gerezani (19-20).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Note:Did John baptize Jesus before he was in the prison, or after being there?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.21-22+What happened while John baptized Jesus and then Jesus was praying?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~21#Question:What happened while John baptized Jesus and then Jesus was praying?
trans-unit.source: What happened while John baptized Jesus and then Jesus was praying?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yohana alipombatiza Yesu na baadaye Yesu alikuwa akisali?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Question:What happened while John baptized Jesus and then Jesus was praying?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~21#Answer:What happened while John baptized Jesus and then Jesus was praying?1506861519
trans-unit.source: [God] opened heaven/the sky (21) and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in a bodily form like a dove. Also, God spoke [to Jesus] from heaven. (22)
trans-unit.target: [Mungu] akafungua mbingu/anga (21) na Roho Mtakatifu akashuka juu yake katika umbo la mwili kama njiwa. Pia, Mungu alizungumza [na Yesu] kutoka mbinguni. (22)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~21#Answer:What happened while John baptized Jesus and then Jesus was praying?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.22+Do Luke's words sound as though this was a vision Jesus saw, or do the words sound as though this really happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~22#Question:Do Luke's words sound as though this was a vision Jesus saw, or do the words sound as though this really happened?
trans-unit.source: Do Luke's words sound as though this was a vision Jesus saw, or do the words sound as though this really happened?
trans-unit.target: Je, maneno ya Luka yanasikika kana kwamba Yesu aliona ono hilo, au maneno yake yanasikika kana kwamba lilitukia kweli kweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~22#Question:Do Luke's words sound as though this was a vision Jesus saw, or do the words sound as though this really happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~22#Answer:Do Luke's words sound as though this was a vision Jesus saw, or do the words sound as though this really happened?1791851892
trans-unit.source: The words, "in a bodily form," show that it really happened. (22) (See John 1:32-34.)
trans-unit.target: Maneno, "katika umbo la mwili", yanaonyesha kwamba hilo lilitukia kweli kweli.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~22#Answer:Do Luke's words sound as though this was a vision Jesus saw, or do the words sound as though this really happened?

group.id: Q:LUK 3.23-38+What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!3~23#Question:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri tunapaswa kujifunza nini kutokana na yale ambayo Luka aliandika kuhusu ukoo wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~23#Question:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~23#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?-118218752
trans-unit.source: He showed the Jews (and us) that Jesus was the Messiah that the prophets had said would come, because he had the same ancestors, such as David and Abraham, as the prophets had said the Messiah would have.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonyesha Wayahudi (na sisi) kwamba Yesu alikuwa Masihi ambaye manabii walisema angekuja, kwa sababu alikuwa na mababu wale wale, kama vile Daudi na Ibrahimu, kama manabii walivyosema Masihi angekuwa nayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~23#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!3~23#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?1854167272
trans-unit.source: He showed us that Jesus was a true human being like us.
trans-unit.target: Alituonyesha kwamba Yesu alikuwa mwanadamu halisi kama sisi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!3~23#Answer:What do you think that we are to learn from what Luke wrote about Jesus's ancestors?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.1-13+Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~1#Question:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?
trans-unit.source: Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?
trans-unit.target: Luka aliandika kuhusu wakati ambapo Ibilisi alimjia Yesu. Unafikiri tunapaswa kujifunza nini kutokana na hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~1#Question:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?-452083521
trans-unit.source: The devil tried to make Jesus disobey God, but Jesus would not disobey.
trans-unit.target: Ibilisi alijaribu kumfanya Yesu asimtii Mungu, lakini Yesu alikataa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?-579299624
trans-unit.source: If Jesus had obeyed the devil, he would have been as sinful as we are. Then he could not have been the one to save all of us who sin.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Yesu angalikuwa amemtii Ibilisi, angalikuwa mwenye dhambi kama sisi. Kisha asingeweza kuwa yule anayeweza kutuokoa sisi sote ambao ni wenye dhambi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?14653513
trans-unit.source: Jesus had human feelings just as we do. When he had not eaten for forty days, he was very hungry. The devil tried to make Jesus obey him instead of obeying God, but Jesus did not obey the devil.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa na hisia za kibinadamu kama zetu. Baada ya kufunga kwa siku arobaini alikuwa na njaa sana. Ibilisi alijaribu kumfanya amtii yeye badala ya kumtii Mungu, lakini Yesu hakumtii Ibilisi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~1#Answer:Luke wrote about the time when the devil came to Jesus. What do you think that we are to learn from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~5#Answer:How did the devil tempt Jesus when they looked at all those kingdoms/nations all over the world?365801372
trans-unit.source: He said that if Jesus would worship him, he would give Jesus all authority [to rule] over the kingdoms/nations/people.

group.id: Q:LUK 4.5-8+What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~5#Question:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu hufanya nini anapoabudu mtu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~5#Question:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~5#Answer:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?-1714023706
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He shows great honor and deep respect for the other person. He acts as though that person has more authority or strength or wisdom or goodness or beauty than any other human, and so is like God. (See L&N entry 53.14 and those at 53.53-64.)
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Yeye huonyesha heshima kubwa na heshima kubwa kwa mtu mwingine. Yeye hutenda kana kwamba mtu huyo ana mamlaka zaidi au nguvu au hekima au wema au uzuri kuliko mwanadamu mwingine yeyote, na hivyo ni kama Mungu. (Ona L & N entry 53.14 na wale katika 53.53-64.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~5#Answer:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~5#Answer:Who do you think gave the devil the authority over the kingdoms/nations/people?641584830
trans-unit.source: God had given that authority to the first people, Adam and his wife, Eve. But they obeyed the devil, rather than what God had told them to do. In that way they gave that authority to the devil.
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa amewapa wanadamu wa kwanza, Adamu na mke wake, Hawa, mamlaka hayo. Lakini walimtii Ibilisi badala ya kufanya yale ambayo Mungu alikuwa amewaambia wafanye. Kwa njia hiyo walimpa Ibilisi mamlaka hayo.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~5#Answer:Who do you think gave the devil the authority over the kingdoms/nations/people?-312708034
trans-unit.source: No one had given that authority to the devil. He lied about it to Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Hakuna mtu aliyempa Ibilisi mamlaka hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~5#Answer:Who do you think gave the devil the authority over the kingdoms/nations/people?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.12+What do you think it means to test God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~12#Question:What do you think it means to test God?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to test God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kumjaribu Mungu kunamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~12#Question:What do you think it means to test God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~12#Answer:What do you think it means to test God?1791763677
trans-unit.source: A person tries to cause God to do what that person wants to happen. The person wants God to feel as though he (God) must do this action in order to show that he is more powerful than the problem the person created.
trans-unit.target: Mtu anajaribu kumfanya Mungu afanye kile anachotaka mtu huyo kitokee. Mtu huyo anataka Mungu ahisi kana kwamba yeye (Mungu) lazima afanye kitendo hiki ili kuonyesha kuwa yeye ni mwenye nguvu zaidi kuliko shida ambayo mtu huyo aliunda.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~12#Answer:What do you think it means to test God?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.14-30+What can we learn from what Luke wrote about the ways that people responded to Jesus's preaching?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~14#Question:What can we learn from what Luke wrote about the ways that people responded to Jesus's preaching?
trans-unit.source: What can we learn from what Luke wrote about the ways that people responded to Jesus's preaching?
trans-unit.target: Tunaweza kujifunza nini kutokana na yale ambayo Luka aliandika kuhusu jinsi watu walivyoitikia mahubiri ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~14#Question:What can we learn from what Luke wrote about the ways that people responded to Jesus's preaching?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~14#Answer:What can we learn from what Luke wrote about the ways that people responded to Jesus's preaching?-703544778
trans-unit.source: People who lived all over Galilee [province] heard about him (14) and praised him (15). From the words of Isaiah (21), the people could see that Jesus was that person whom God had promised to send [as the savior]. However, the people of his hometown would not accept him as sent by God (24). This was because they thought of him as being only a local man whom they had seen grow up (22).
trans-unit.target: Watu walioishi katika Galilaya [mkoa] yote walisikia habari zake (14) na kumsifu (15). Kutokana na maneno ya Isaya (21), watu waliweza kuona kwamba Yesu alikuwa mtu ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi kumtuma [kama mwokozi]. Hata hivyo, watu wa mji wake hawakumkubali kuwa ametumwa na Mungu (24). Hii ilikuwa kwa sababu walimfikiria kuwa ni mtu wa mahali hapo tu ambaye walikuwa wamemwona akiendelea kukua (22).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~14#Answer:What can we learn from what Luke wrote about the ways that people responded to Jesus's preaching?

trans-unit.target: Alifundisha katika masinagogi ya watu katika eneo hilo. (15)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~15#Note:What did Jesus do there in Galilee [province]?-2031939585
trans-unit.source: There is a strong implication that Jesus also had been doing miracles, such as healing people. That is implied from the words "power of the Spirit" and "news about him spread", as well as Jesus later stating that the prophecy of Isaiah was fulfilled in the work he was doing.
trans-unit.target: Kuna maana ya wazi kwamba Yesu pia alikuwa akifanya miujiza, kama vile kuponya watu. Hiyo inaelezwa na maneno "nguvu ya Roho" na "habari juu yake ikaenea", na vilevile Yesu baadaye akisema kwamba unabii wa Isaya ulitimizwa katika kazi aliyokuwa akifanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~15#Note:What did Jesus do there in Galilee [province]?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.14-15+What do you think a synagogue was?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~14#Question:What do you think a synagogue was?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a synagogue was?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri sinagogi lilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~14#Question:What do you think a synagogue was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~14#Answer:What do you think a synagogue was?-330404161
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A synagogue was a building which the Jews built in order to gather for hearing someone read and teach from the Word of God and where they could worship him. Many Jews lived too far away from the temple in Jerusalem to walk there regularly for worship, so they built a synagogue in each village for that purpose.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: Sinagogi lilikuwa jengo ambalo Wayahudi walijenga ili kukusanyika kwa ajili ya kusikia mtu kusoma na kufundisha kutoka Neno la Mungu na ambapo wangeweza kumwabudu. Wayahudi wengi waliishi mbali sana na hekalu huko Yerusalemu kutembea huko kwa ibada ya kawaida, kwa hivyo walijenga sinagogi katika kila kijiji kwa kusudi hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~14#Answer:What do you think a synagogue was?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~14#Note:What do you think a synagogue was?-1199943818
trans-unit.source: See "synagogue" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "sinagogi" katika Kiswahili cha KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~14#Note:What do you think a synagogue was?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.16+Why did Jesus go into the synagogue in Nazareth?

trans-unit.target: Huo ndio mji ambao [Maria na Yosefu] walimlea.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Answer:Why did Jesus go into the synagogue in Nazareth?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.16-17+What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~16#Question:What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.source: What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini hufanya siku fulani iwe Sabato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Question:What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~16#Answer:What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?-1554132335
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is the seventh day of the week, Saturday, the day on which God rested from his work of creating the world. He told people to honor him on that day by resting from their work/by not working. The Jews used that day to meet together to worship God.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Uchunguzi: Ni siku ya saba ya juma, Jumamosi, siku ambayo Mungu alipumzika kutoka kazi yake ya kuumba ulimwengu. Aliwaambia watu kumheshimu siku hiyo kwa kupumzika kutoka kazi zao / kwa kutofanya kazi. Wayahudi walitumia siku hiyo kukutana pamoja kumwabudu Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Answer:What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~16#Note:What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?1395134835
trans-unit.source: See "Sabbath" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Sabato" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Note:What do you think makes a particular day be the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~16#Answer:Why did Jesus stand up in the synagogue?-1787219850
