trans-unit.target: Hiyo ilikuwa njia ya kawaida ya mtu kuonyesha kwamba alitaka kusoma [Neno la Mungu]. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Answer:Why did Jesus stand up in the synagogue?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.16-17+Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~16#Question:Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.
trans-unit.source: Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.
trans-unit.target: Chukua kipande cha karatasi na unionyeshe kile Yesu alifanya ili kujiandaa kusoma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Question:Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~16#Answer:Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.-726040377
trans-unit.source: (The person who is answering these questions may have to roll up the piece of paper first before unrolling it and holding it at a proper distance for reading from it. Jewish Scripture writings happen to be rolled side-to-side, not top-to-bottom, but that is not the key part of the action you want to see happen.)
trans-unit.target: (Mtu anayejibu maswali haya huenda akahitaji kukifunga kipande cha karatasi kwanza kabla ya kukifungua na kukiweka kwa umbali unaofaa ili kukisoma kutoka humo. Maandiko ya Kiyahudi hufanyika kuwa yamefungwa upande kwa upande, si juu chini, lakini hiyo si sehemu muhimu ya kitendo unachotaka kuona kinatokea.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Answer:Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~16#Note:Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.-8812897
trans-unit.source: A footnote or glossary entry may be needed to indicate that long ago people wrote on long pieces of paper or thin animal skin which they kept safe by rolling each one around a wooden rod. In order to read the words, the paper or skin had to be unrolled to find the place where one was to begin reading.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ikawa lazima kuweka kielezi-chini au maandishi ya kamusi ya kuonyesha kwamba zamani za kale watu waliandika juu ya vipande virefu vya karatasi au ngozi nyembamba ya wanyama ambayo walihifadhi kwa kuzungusha kila kipande kuzunguka fimbo ya mbao. Ili kusoma maneno, karatasi au ngozi ilipaswa kufunguliwa ili kupata mahali ambapo mtu angeanza kusoma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~16#Note:Take a piece of paper and show me what Jesus did in order to get ready to read.

group.id: Q:LUK 4.18-19+To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~18#Question:To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Isaya alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani alipoandika "mimi" katika mistari hiyo miwili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Question:To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?-699489211
trans-unit.source: Isaiah was not speaking about himself. He was referring to a special Servant of the Lord whom God would send to the Jews. That special person would say these words to the Jews. The Jews already understood that servant would be the Messiah whom God had promised to send to them. We know from verse 21 that this special person was Jesus himself, but Isaiah did not know Jesus's name when he wrote these words.
trans-unit.target: Isaya hakuwa anaongea juu yake mwenyewe. Alikuwa anazungumzia juu ya Mtumishi maalum wa Bwana ambaye Mungu angemtuma kwa Wayahudi. Mtu huyo maalum angewaambia maneno haya Wayahudi. Wayahudi tayari walielewa kwamba mtumishi huyo atakuwa Masihi ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi kuwatuma kwao. Tunajua kutoka kwa mstari wa 21 kwamba mtu huyu maalum alikuwa Yesu mwenyewe, lakini Isaya hakujua jina la Yesu wakati alipoandika maneno haya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~18#Note:To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?101249503
trans-unit.source: The translator may need make this explicit at the end of verse 17 in the introduction to the quote, such as, "... where it is written about the special Servant of the Lord, ..."
trans-unit.target: Mtafsiri anaweza kuhitaji kueleza wazi jambo hili mwishoni mwa mstari wa 17 katika utangulizi wa nukuu, kama vile, "... ambapo imeandikwa juu ya Mtumishi wa pekee wa Bwana, "...
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Note:To whom, do you think, was Isaiah referring when he wrote "me" in these two verses?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.18-19+What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~18#Question:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?
trans-unit.source: What did Isaiah say this special person would do?
trans-unit.target: Isaya alisema mtu huyo wa pekee angefanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Question:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?1008624935
trans-unit.source: He was to tell/preach the Good News [that God's plan to save them was taking place right then] to the poor people. (18b)
trans-unit.target: Alipaswa kuwaambia/kuhubiri Habari Njema [kwamba mpango wa Mungu wa kuwaokoa ulikuwa ukifanyika wakati huo] kwa watu maskini. (18b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?257344551
trans-unit.source: He was to proclaim [with authority]/preach to the people whose lives were as if they had been captured [by the devil and their own sins] that they could be free [of those things]. (18c)
trans-unit.target: Alipaswa kutangaza [kwa mamlaka]/kuhubiri kwa watu ambao maisha yao yalikuwa kana kwamba walikuwa wametekwa [na ibilisi na dhambi zao wenyewe] kwamba wangeweza kuwa huru [kutoka kwa mambo hayo]. (18c)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?863738516
trans-unit.source: He was to proclaim [with authority]/preach to the blind people that they could see again. (18c)
trans-unit.target: Alipaswa kutangaza [kwa mamlaka]/kuhubiri kwa vipofu kwamba wangeweza kuona tena (18c).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?-1136501338
trans-unit.source: He was to free those who had been treated unfairly. (18d)
trans-unit.target: Alipaswa kuwaweka huru wale ambao walikuwa wametendewa isivyo haki. (18d)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?-620835794
trans-unit.source: He was to proclaim [with authority]/preach that the time when the Lord would show kindness to his people [had come]. (19)
trans-unit.target: Alipaswa kutangaza [kwa mamlaka]/kuhubiri kwamba wakati ulikuwa umefika ambapo Bwana angeonyesha fadhili kwa watu wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~18#Note:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?781873984
trans-unit.source: Has the reference to the Good News been translated in the same way here (4:18b) as it was in 3:18? It should be clearly referring to the same thing both there and here.
trans-unit.target: Je, rejeleo la Habari Njema limetafsiriwa kwa njia ile ile hapa (4:18b) kama lilivyokuwa katika 3:18?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Note:What did Isaiah say this special person would do?

trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo wa pekee angewezaje kujua kwamba alipaswa kufanya kazi hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Question:How would that special person know he was supposed to do that work?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:How would that special person know he was supposed to do that work?1349354991
trans-unit.source: God's Spirit had or would anoint him by coming on/to him in a special way (18a).

trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:How would that special person know he was supposed to do that work?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.18-19+What does it mean to anoint someone?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~18#Question:What does it mean to anoint someone?
trans-unit.source: What does it mean to anoint someone?
trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha nini kumtia mtu mafuta?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Question:What does it mean to anoint someone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:What does it mean to anoint someone?1385757100
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Someone having great authority appoints another person to do a special kind of work on his behalf. That person with authority usually shows this by pouring or rubbing an oil or ointment onto the other person's head. In the Bible times people most often used olive oil to appoint and dedicate a new prophet, priest or king. The focus here is on the appointing function, not on the pouring on of oil.
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno kuu: Mtu mwenye mamlaka kubwa anamteua mtu mwingine kufanya aina maalum ya kazi kwa niaba yake. Mtu huyo mwenye mamlaka kwa kawaida huonyesha hili kwa kumwaga au kumwaga mafuta au marashi juu ya kichwa cha mtu mwingine. Katika nyakati za Biblia watu mara nyingi walitumia mafuta ya zeituni kuteua na kuweka wakfu na nabii mpya, kuhani au mfalme.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:What does it mean to anoint someone?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~18#Note:What does it mean to anoint someone?243637647
trans-unit.source: See "anoint" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mafuta" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Note:What does it mean to anoint someone?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~18#Question:How would that person be able to do all those difficult things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~18#Answer:How would that person be able to do all those difficult things?1942353487

trans-unit.target: Roho ya Mungu ingemwezesha kufanya mambo hayo. (18)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~18#Answer:How would that person be able to do all those difficult things?

trans-unit.source: When Jesus had finished reading part of Isaiah's words written on the scroll, what did he do with that scroll?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kusoma sehemu ya maneno ya Isaya yaliyoandikwa kwenye kitabu cha kukunjwa, alifanya nini na kitabu hicho cha kukunjwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~20#Alternate:When Jesus had finished reading part of Isaiah's words written on the paper/scroll, what did he do with that scroll?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~20#Answer:When Jesus had finished reading part of Isaiah's words written on the paper/scroll, what did he do with that scroll?620704207
trans-unit.source: He rolled it up and gave it back to the man who looked after the writings. (20)
trans-unit.target: Alikifunga na kukirudisha kwa yule mtu aliyechunga maandishi. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~20#Answer:When Jesus had finished reading part of Isaiah's words written on the paper/scroll, what did he do with that scroll?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.20+What do you think was the reason that everyone there was watching him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~20#Question:What do you think was the reason that everyone there was watching him?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that everyone there was watching him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini kila mtu alimtazama?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~20#Question:What do you think was the reason that everyone there was watching him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~20#Answer:What do you think was the reason that everyone there was watching him?-2010548255
trans-unit.source: Because he sat down (as was the custom for a teacher to do), they now expected him to teach them about that text [or even to do some of those things he had read about]. (20)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu aliketi (kama ilivyokuwa desturi kwa mwalimu kufanya), sasa walitarajia awafundishe juu ya andiko hilo [au hata kufanya baadhi ya mambo hayo aliyokuwa amesoma juu yayo].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~20#Answer:What do you think was the reason that everyone there was watching him?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.21+What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~21#Question:What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya maneno hayo aliyosoma katika kitabu cha Isaya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~21#Question:What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~21#Answer:What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?957542802
trans-unit.source: They were now coming true as they heard him speak them [because he was the one about whom Isaiah had written, the one whom God had anointed/chosen to do these things]. (21)
trans-unit.target: Sasa yalikuwa yakitimizwa waliposikia akisema [kwa sababu yeye ndiye yule ambaye Isaya alikuwa ameandika juu yake, yule ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtia mafuta/amemchagua afanye mambo hayo].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~21#Answer:What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~21#Note:What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?-723657728
trans-unit.source: See "Scripture" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Maandiko" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~21#Note:What did Jesus say about those words which he had read from the book by Isaiah?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.22+How did the people think of him at first?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~22#Question:How did the people think of him at first?
trans-unit.source: How did the people think of him at first?
trans-unit.target: Watu walifikiri nini kwanza kumhusu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~22#Question:How did the people think of him at first?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~22#Answer:How did the people think of him at first?-1951051148
trans-unit.source: They thought and spoke well of him and were amazed at his very good way of speaking/the wonderful things he said. (22)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri na kusema vema juu yake na walishangaa juu ya njia yake nzuri sana ya kusema/mambo ya ajabu aliyosema.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~22#Answer:How did the people think of him at first?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.22+Why were they amazed by his speaking ability?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~22#Question:Why were they amazed by his speaking ability?
trans-unit.source: Why were they amazed by his speaking ability?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walishangazwa na uwezo wake wa kusema?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~22#Question:Why were they amazed by his speaking ability?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~22#Answer:Why were they amazed by his speaking ability?-1122954756
trans-unit.source: They knew him as [the carpenter] Joseph's son, [just a local boy with no special schooling]. (22) (They did not know any normal reason why he should know so much about God's Word.)
trans-unit.target: Walimjua kuwa [mchonga-miti] mwana wa Yusufu, [mvulana wa mahali hapo tu asiye na elimu ya pekee]. (22) (Hawakujua sababu yoyote ya kawaida kwa nini alipaswa kujua mengi sana juu ya Neno la Mungu.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~22#Answer:Why were they amazed by his speaking ability?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.23+What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~23#Question:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mithali hii, "Daktari, jiponye mwenyewe kwanza!", inamaanisha nini kuhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Question:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?276315849
trans-unit.source: Since he had done miracles in Capernaum [and other places in the general area], he must do the same things right there in his hometown. This would show everyone that he really was the person about whom the prophet Isaiah had written.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa alikuwa amefanya miujiza katika Kapernaumu [na sehemu nyinginezo katika eneo hilo kwa ujumla], ni lazima awe alifanya mambo yaleyale katika mji wa nyumbani kwake. Hilo lingeonyesha kila mtu kwamba kwa kweli yeye ndiye yule ambaye nabii Isaya alikuwa ameandika juu yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?216220052
trans-unit.source: If a person who claimed to be a doctor was able to cure himself, then what he claimed would be true. In the same way, if Jesus could do miracles, then what he claimed [as being sent by God] would also be true. (23)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu aliyedai kuwa daktari angeweza kujiponya mwenyewe, basi aliyoyasema yangekuwa kweli. Kwa njia ile ile, ikiwa Yesu angeweza kufanya miujiza, basi aliyoyasema [kuwa ametumwa na Mungu] yangekuwa kweli pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What does this proverb, "Doctor, first make yourself well!", mean in regard to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.23-27+What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~23#Question:What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri jibu la Yesu lilimaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Question:What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?957129579
trans-unit.source: A prophet is not accepted by the people in his hometown because they know him and think of him as the same kind of person as themselves. They think he is not able to teach them anything they do not already know about God.
trans-unit.target: Nabii hakaribishwi na watu wake mwenyewe kwa sababu wanamjua na kumwona kama mtu wa aina yao. Wanafikiri hawezi kuwafundisha kitu ambacho hawajui tayari juu ya Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?1908028935
trans-unit.source: Jesus knew that these people did not accept that he was a prophet. He also knew that they did not accept that he was the Christ. Therefore, they would not be able to accept or believe what he said or did right there in front of them.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijua kwamba watu hawa hawakumkubali kuwa nabii na pia walijua kwamba hawakumkubali kuwa ndiye Kristo. Kwa hiyo, hawangeweza kukubali au kuamini yale aliyosema au kufanya mbele yao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus's response to them means?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.25+What caused the Jews to suffer long ago when Elijah lived in Israel?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~25#Question:What caused the Jews to suffer long ago when Elijah lived in Israel?
trans-unit.source: What caused the Jews to suffer long ago when Elijah lived in Israel?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowafanya Wayahudi wateseke zamani za kale Eliya alipokuwa akiishi Israeli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~25#Question:What caused the Jews to suffer long ago when Elijah lived in Israel?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~25#Answer:What caused the Jews to suffer long ago when Elijah lived in Israel?1318014739
trans-unit.source: There was no rain for 3 1/2 years. That caused a severe famine. (25)
trans-unit.target: Hakukuwa na mvua kwa miaka mitatu na nusu. Hilo lilisababisha njaa kali. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~25#Answer:What caused the Jews to suffer long ago when Elijah lived in Israel?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.26+There were many widows in Israel at that time who had great trouble finding food. To whom did God send Elijah?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~26#Question:There were many widows in Israel at that time who had great trouble finding food. To whom did God send Elijah?
trans-unit.source: There were many widows in Israel at that time who had great trouble finding food. To whom did God send Elijah?
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na wajane wengi katika Israeli wakati huo ambao walikuwa na shida kubwa ya kupata chakula. Mungu alimtuma Eliya kwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~26#Question:There were many widows in Israel at that time who had great trouble finding food. To whom did God send Elijah?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~26#Answer:There were many widows in Israel at that time who had great trouble finding food. To whom did God send Elijah?-517876272
trans-unit.source: He sent Elijah to a widow who lived in the town of Zarephath. Zarephath was near the city of Sidon [outside the land of Israel]. (26)
trans-unit.target: Alimtuma Eliya kwa mjane mmoja aliyeishi katika mji wa Sarefathi, karibu na mji wa Sidoni [nje ya nchi ya Israeli]. (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~26#Answer:There were many widows in Israel at that time who had great trouble finding food. To whom did God send Elijah?

trans-unit.source: There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na watu wengi wenye ukoma/ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi katika Israeli wakati Elisha alipoishi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~27#Question:There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~27#Alternate:There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?884671384
trans-unit.source: There were many people sick with leprosy in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na watu wengi wenye ukoma katika Israeli wakati wa Elisha. Mungu alimleta nani kwa Elisha ili aponywe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~27#Alternate:There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~27#Alternate:There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?-1390341045

trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na watu wengi wenye ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi katika Israeli wakati wa Elisha. Mungu alimleta nani kwa Elisha ili aponywe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~27#Alternate:There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~27#Answer:There were many people sick with leprosy/bad skin disease in Israel when Elisha lived. Whom did God bring to Elisha to be made well?-1778423881

trans-unit.target: Naamani, mtu kutoka nchi ya Siria. (27)

group.id: Q:LUK 4.23-27+What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~23#Question:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia nini aliposema kwamba Naamani 'alipona'?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Question:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?-130770110
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He was talking about Naaman having clear skin again after he was well.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu Naamani kuwa na ngozi safi tena baada ya kuponywa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?1961177072
trans-unit.source: He was also talking about the kind of cleanness God required before a person could be allowed into the public worship or allowed to live with his family again.
trans-unit.target: Pia alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu aina ya usafi ambao Mungu alihitaji mtu awe nao kabla ya kuruhusiwa kushiriki katika ibada ya watu wote au kuruhusiwa kuishi tena na familia yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~23#Note:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?-314612674
trans-unit.source: See "clean" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia "safi" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Note:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~23#Note:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?-1790204516
trans-unit.source: If a very general word like "clean" is being used in the translation, make sure it does not refer only to removing external things like dirt or general illness from the body.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa neno la ujumla kama vile "safi" linatumiwa katika tafsiri, hakikisha kwamba halimaanishi kuondoa tu vitu vya nje kama vile uchafu au ugonjwa wa kawaida mwilini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Note:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~23#Note:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?-848433373
trans-unit.source: This is the same Greek word which was used in 2:22 when Mary needed to become "clean" again following childbirth. However, the language of the translation may have separate names for each of these situations due to the male-female distinction or due to blood being involved in one case and not in the other. The words in the translation must be appropriate to each of these references.
trans-unit.target: Neno hili ni neno la Kigiriki ambalo lilitumika katika 2:22 wakati Mariamu alihitaji kuwa "safi" tena baada ya kuzaa. Hata hivyo, lugha ya tafsiri inaweza kuwa na majina tofauti kwa kila moja ya hali hizi kwa sababu ya tofauti ya kiume na kike au kwa sababu ya damu kuhusika katika kesi moja na sio nyingine. Maneno katika tafsiri lazima yawe sahihi kwa kila moja ya marejeleo haya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Note:What do you think that Jesus was talking about when he said that Naaman was made "clean"?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.25-27+How do the two examples from the Old Testament scripture show that what Jesus was saying about prophets was true?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~25#Question:How do the two examples from the Old Testament scripture show that what Jesus was saying about prophets was true?
trans-unit.source: How do the two examples from the Old Testament scripture show that what Jesus was saying about prophets was true?
trans-unit.target: Vielelezo viwili kutoka andiko la Agano la Kale vinaonyeshaje kwamba yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa akisema juu ya manabii yalikuwa ya kweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~25#Question:How do the two examples from the Old Testament scripture show that what Jesus was saying about prophets was true?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~25#Answer:How do the two examples from the Old Testament scripture show that what Jesus was saying about prophets was true?-1470492086
trans-unit.source: The people of Israel did not accept/believe two of their greatest prophets, Elijah and Elisha. Their own people did not accept them as men who spoke for God, so God used them to do his work among other people, some non-Jews who did believe them. (25-27)
trans-unit.target: Watu wa Israeli hawakuwaamini/kuwakubali manabii wao wawili wakubwa, Eliya na Elisha. Watu wao wenyewe hawakuwaamini kama watu waliozungumza kwa niaba ya Mungu, hivyo Mungu aliwatumia kufanya kazi yake miongoni mwa watu wengine, baadhi ya wasio Wayahudi ambao waliwaamini. (25-27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~25#Answer:How do the two examples from the Old Testament scripture show that what Jesus was saying about prophets was true?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.23-27+Thinking about these two examples, if the Nazareth people would not accept Jesus as the Christ, what do you think that he would do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~23#Question:Thinking about these two examples, if the Nazareth people would not accept Jesus as the Christ, what do you think that he would do?
trans-unit.source: Thinking about these two examples, if the Nazareth people would not accept Jesus as the Christ, what do you think that he would do?
trans-unit.target: Unapofikiria mifano hiyo miwili, unafikiri Yesu angefanya nini ikiwa watu wa Nazareti wangekataa kumkubali kuwa Kristo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Question:Thinking about these two examples, if the Nazareth people would not accept Jesus as the Christ, what do you think that he would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~23#Answer:Thinking about these two examples, if the Nazareth people would not accept Jesus as the Christ, what do you think that he would do?-262370119
trans-unit.source: He would go to other places, [as Elijah and Elisha had done,] where the people would accept him as a prophet/the Christ.
trans-unit.target: Angekwenda mahali pengine, [kama Eliya na Elisha walivyokuwa wamefanya,] ambapo watu wangemkubali kuwa nabii/Kristo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~23#Answer:Thinking about these two examples, if the Nazareth people would not accept Jesus as the Christ, what do you think that he would do?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.28+What was the people's response when they heard Jesus say those things in verses 23-27?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~28#Question:What was the people's response when they heard Jesus say those things in verses 23-27?
trans-unit.source: What was the people's response when they heard Jesus say those things in verses 23-27?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliitikiaje waliposikia Yesu akisema maneno hayo kwenye mstari wa 23-27?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Question:What was the people's response when they heard Jesus say those things in verses 23-27?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~28#Answer:What was the people's response when they heard Jesus say those things in verses 23-27?-130753213
trans-unit.source: They were full of anger/furious. (28)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamejaa hasira/hasira. (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Answer:What was the people's response when they heard Jesus say those things in verses 23-27?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.28-30+What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~28#Question:What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walikasirishwa na maneno ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Question:What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?-298004884
trans-unit.source: They knew that he was implying that they were not believing, just as the Jews had done in the time when Elijah and Elisha were prophets.
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba alikuwa akidokeza kwamba hawakuwa wakiamini, kama vile Wayahudi walivyokuwa wamefanya wakati Eliya na Elisha walipokuwa manabii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?1085623548
trans-unit.source: They felt that he was rejecting them and would go to other places to teach God's word and do great things [by God's power] among people who would accept him. He might even go to people who were not Jews.
trans-unit.target: Walihisi kwamba alikuwa akiwaacha na kwamba angeenda mahali pengine ili kufundisha neno la Mungu na kufanya mambo makuu [kwa nguvu za Mungu] miongoni mwa watu ambao wangemkubali.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were so angry about what Jesus had said?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.29+What did those people do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~29#Question:What did those people do to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did those people do to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walimfanyia Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~29#Question:What did those people do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~29#Answer:What did those people do to Jesus?-255282713
trans-unit.source: They [angrily] removed him [from the synagogue and on] out of their town. They took/led him to an edge of the hill on which their town was built, intending to throw him over that edge/cliff [to kill him]. (29)
trans-unit.target: Wakamtoa mjini, wakamchukua mpaka ukingo wa mlima ambao mji wao ulikuwa umejengwa juu yake, ili wamtupe chini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~29#Answer:What did those people do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~29#Note:What did those people do to Jesus?-581430445
trans-unit.source: The town was not on the top of the hill. It was on the side of a hill which has some steep edges at the top. People think that is where the townspeople took Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Jiji hilo halikuwa juu ya mlima bali lilikuwa kwenye upande wa mlima wenye mipaka yenye mteremko juu yake, na watu walidhani kwamba Yesu alipelekwa huko.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~29#Note:What did those people do to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.30+Why were they not able to do what they intended to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~30#Question:Why were they not able to do what they intended to do?
trans-unit.source: Why were they not able to do what they intended to do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakuweza kufanya yale waliyokusudia kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~30#Question:Why were they not able to do what they intended to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~30#Answer:Why were they not able to do what they intended to do?2048943094
trans-unit.source: Because Jesus walked through the middle of the crowd and went on his way, the people did not get to push him over the edge.(30)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu Yesu alitembea katikati ya umati na akaenda zake, watu hawakupata kumsukuma kando ya ukingo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~30#Answer:Why were they not able to do what they intended to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.28-30+What do you think was the reason that he was able to do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~28#Question:What do you think was the reason that he was able to do that?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that he was able to do that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini aliweza kufanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Question:What do you think was the reason that he was able to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that he was able to do that?-2144079834
trans-unit.source: God's Spirit and power helped him.
trans-unit.target: Roho na nguvu za Mungu zilimsaidia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that he was able to do that?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!4~31#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 4:31-37 Jesus made an evil spirit leave a man.
trans-unit.target: Luka 4:31-37 Yesu alimfanya roho mwovu amtoe mtu fulani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 4.31-37+What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~31#Question:What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?
trans-unit.source: What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?
trans-unit.target: Watu katika sinagogi la Kapernaumu walifikiri nini waliposikia na kuona yale ambayo Yesu alifanya huko?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Question:What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~31#Answer:What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?-1284691195
trans-unit.source: They were greatly astounded/astonished. (32, 36)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wameshangaa sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Answer:What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~31#Answer:What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?1011304941
trans-unit.source: They talked about it among themselves (36) and with others (37).
trans-unit.target: Walizungumza juu ya jambo hilo kati yao wenyewe (36) na pamoja na wengine (37).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Answer:What did the people in the Capernaum synagogue think when they heard and saw what Jesus did there?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.31-37+What happened that caused them to think like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~31#Question:What happened that caused them to think like that?
trans-unit.source: What happened that caused them to think like that?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowafanya wafikiri hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Question:What happened that caused them to think like that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~31#Answer:What happened that caused them to think like that?413099687
trans-unit.source: Jesus spoke with so much authority and power that even demons/evil spirits obeyed what he told them to do. (They realized that God must be helping him do those things.) (32, 36)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliongea kwa mamlaka na nguvu nyingi sana hivi kwamba hata mashetani/roho waovu walitii kile alichowaambia wafanye (Walifahamu kwamba ni lazima Mungu awe akimsaidia kufanya mambo hayo). (32, 36)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Answer:What happened that caused them to think like that?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.31+What did Jesus do on the Sabbath Day when he was in the town of Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~31#Question:What did Jesus do on the Sabbath Day when he was in the town of Capernaum?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do on the Sabbath Day when he was in the town of Capernaum?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini siku ya Sabato alipokuwa katika mji wa Kapernaumu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Question:What did Jesus do on the Sabbath Day when he was in the town of Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~31#Answer:What did Jesus do on the Sabbath Day when he was in the town of Capernaum?1182455069
trans-unit.source: He was teaching [God's Word to] the people in the synagogue. (31)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha [Neno la Mungu] watu katika sinagogi. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~31#Answer:What did Jesus do on the Sabbath Day when he was in the town of Capernaum?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.33+Why did a man in the synagogue shout loudly at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~33#Question:Why did a man in the synagogue shout loudly at Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did a man in the synagogue shout loudly at Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mtu mmoja katika sinagogi alimpigia Yesu kelele kwa sauti kubwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Question:Why did a man in the synagogue shout loudly at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~33#Answer:Why did a man in the synagogue shout loudly at Jesus?-758137273
trans-unit.source: He had a demon, that is, an unclean/evil spirit, in him. (33)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na pepo, yaani, roho mchafu/mbaya, ndani yake. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Answer:Why did a man in the synagogue shout loudly at Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.33+What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.source: What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaozungumza lugha yako wanasema ni sifa/ishara zipi za kujua roho ni pepo/roho mbaya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Question:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?-1490069735
trans-unit.source: What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics to know a spirit is a demon?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaozungumza lugha yenu husema ni sifa zipi zinazoonyesha roho ni roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?995684226
trans-unit.source: What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics to know a spirit is an evil spirit?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaozungumza lugha yenu husema ni sifa zipi zinazoonyesha kwamba roho ni roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?1482302278
trans-unit.source: What do the people who speak your language say are the signs to know a spirit is a demon?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaozungumza lugha yenu husema ni ishara zipi zinazoonyesha kwamba roho ni roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?-1532135637
trans-unit.source: What do the people who speak your language say are the signs to know a spirit is an evil spirit?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaozungumza lugha yenu husema ni ishara zipi zinazoonyesha kwamba roho ni roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Alternate:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~33#Answer:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?-847865298
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A demon is a spirit that only does evil things and tries to cause trouble for people, especially those who want to obey God's Word. The demon obeys Satan and opposes what God has said.
trans-unit.target: Uhakiki wa neno muhimu: Pepo ni roho ambayo hufanya mabaya tu na hujaribu kusababisha shida kwa watu, haswa wale ambao wanataka kutii Neno la Mungu. Pepo humtii Shetani na kupinga kile Mungu amesema.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Answer:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~33#Note:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?-799991054
trans-unit.source: Notice that Luke called the same spirit by both names in this verse.
trans-unit.target: Ona kwamba Luka anamwita roho yuleyule kwa majina yote mawili katika mstari huu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Note:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~33#Note:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?-1956773446
trans-unit.source: See "evil spirit, unclean spirit, demon" and "unclean, defiled, impure, uncleanness" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "roho mwovu, roho mchafu, roho mwovu" na "mchafu, mchafu, mchafu, mchafu" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~33#Note:What do the people who speak your language say are the characteristics/signs to know a spirit is a demon/an evil spirit?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.34+What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~34#Question:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Roho mwovu aliyekuwa ndani ya mtu huyo alijua nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~34#Question:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~34#Answer:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?2128858956
trans-unit.source: He knew that Jesus was a man from the town of Nazareth. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba Yesu alikuwa mtu wa mji wa Nazareti. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~34#Answer:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~34#Answer:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?-1461316411
trans-unit.source: He knew that Jesus had power and authority to destroy/get rid of him [and other spirits who were in the man]. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu na mamlaka ya kumwangamiza/kumwondoa [na roho wengine waliokuwa ndani ya mtu huyo]. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~34#Answer:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~34#Answer:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?-1721313131
trans-unit.source: He knew that Jesus was the holy one who had come from God. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba Yesu alikuwa mtakatifu aliyetoka kwa Mungu. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~34#Answer:What did the demon in this man know about Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.35+How did Jesus make the demon leave the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~35#Question:How did Jesus make the demon leave the man?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus make the demon leave the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimfanyaje huyo roho mwovu amtoke mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~35#Question:How did Jesus make the demon leave the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~35#Answer:How did Jesus make the demon leave the man?-132995780
trans-unit.source: He sternly commanded/rebuked the spirit that it must stop what it was saying and doing, and now leave, and it did. (35)
trans-unit.target: Aliamuru/aliikemea roho hiyo kwa ukali kwamba iache kile ilikuwa ikisema na kufanya, na sasa iondoke, nayo ikaondoka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~35#Answer:How did Jesus make the demon leave the man?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.36+Why were the people so astonished?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~36#Question:Why were the people so astonished?
trans-unit.source: Why were the people so astonished?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walishangaa sana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~36#Question:Why were the people so astonished?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~36#Answer:Why were the people so astonished?1307372289
trans-unit.source: Jesus not only taught with authority, but even evil spirits obeyed his commands. (36)
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakufundisha tu kwa mamlaka, lakini hata roho waovu walitii amri zake. (36)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~36#Answer:Why were the people so astonished?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.37+Who heard about these things which Jesus had done there in Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~37#Question:Who heard about these things which Jesus had done there in Capernaum?
trans-unit.source: Who heard about these things which Jesus had done there in Capernaum?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliosikia juu ya mambo ambayo Yesu alikuwa amefanya huko Kapernaumu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~37#Question:Who heard about these things which Jesus had done there in Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~37#Answer:Who heard about these things which Jesus had done there in Capernaum?-353462954
trans-unit.source: People who lived in all the areas around Capernaum heard about these things. (37)
trans-unit.target: Watu walioishi katika maeneo yote karibu na Kapernaumu walisikia juu ya mambo haya. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~37#Answer:Who heard about these things which Jesus had done there in Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!4~38#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 4:38-44 The main work of Jesus was to preach the Good News, not to heal the sick people.
trans-unit.target: Luka 4:38-44 Kazi kuu ya Yesu ilikuwa kuhubiri Habari Njema, wala si kuponya wagonjwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 4.38-44+Why did Luke write about Jesus leaving Capernaum to go to other cities?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~38#Question:Why did Luke write about Jesus leaving Capernaum to go to other cities?
trans-unit.source: Why did Luke write about Jesus leaving Capernaum to go to other cities?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Luka aliandika juu ya Yesu kuondoka Kapernaumu kwenda kwenye majiji mengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Question:Why did Luke write about Jesus leaving Capernaum to go to other cities?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~38#Answer:Why did Luke write about Jesus leaving Capernaum to go to other cities?1708078565
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that the real reason he came down to earth was to preach the Good News that God wanted to rule and reign in each person's life. (43)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba sababu halisi aliyokuja duniani ilikuwa kuhubiri Habari Njema kwamba Mungu alitaka kutawala na kutawala katika maisha ya kila mtu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Answer:Why did Luke write about Jesus leaving Capernaum to go to other cities?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.38+What did the people at Simon's house ask Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~38#Question:What did the people at Simon's house ask Jesus to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the people at Simon's house ask Jesus to do?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliokuwa nyumbani kwa Simoni walimwomba Yesu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Question:What did the people at Simon's house ask Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~38#Answer:What did the people at Simon's house ask Jesus to do?107122378
trans-unit.source: Someone asked him to help [by healing] Simon's mother-in-law who was suffering with a high fever. (38)
trans-unit.target: Mtu fulani alimwomba amsaidie [kwa kumponya] mama-mkwe wa Simoni aliyekuwa akiteseka na homa kali. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Answer:What did the people at Simon's house ask Jesus to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.39+How did Jesus make her well?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~39#Question:How did Jesus make her well?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus make her well?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimponyaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~39#Question:How did Jesus make her well?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~39#Answer:How did Jesus make her well?1101990989
trans-unit.source: Standing/Bending over her, he sternly commanded the sickness to leave her. (39)
trans-unit.target: Akisimama/kuinama juu yake, aliamuru kwa ukali ugonjwa huo umwache. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~39#Answer:How did Jesus make her well?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.39+How do we know that she was well quickly?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~39#Question:How do we know that she was well quickly?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that she was well quickly?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba alipata nafuu haraka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~39#Question:How do we know that she was well quickly?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~39#Answer:How do we know that she was well quickly?1719907238
trans-unit.source: She immediately got up and served [food to] the people there. (39)
trans-unit.target: Mara moja akainuka na kuwatumikia watu huko.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~39#Answer:How do we know that she was well quickly?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.40+What happened later in that day as the sun was setting?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~40#Question:What happened later in that day as the sun was setting?
trans-unit.source: What happened later in that day as the sun was setting?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baadaye siku hiyo jua lilipokuwa likitua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~40#Question:What happened later in that day as the sun was setting?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~40#Answer:What happened later in that day as the sun was setting?1904674518
trans-unit.source: People brought everyone who was sick in some way to Jesus. [They wanted Jesus to heal the sick people.] (40)
trans-unit.target: Watu walimletea Yesu wagonjwa wote. [Walitaka Yesu awaponye wagonjwa hao] (40)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~40#Answer:What happened later in that day as the sun was setting?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.38-41+What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~38#Question:What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu walisubiri jua litue?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Question:What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~38#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?328184225
trans-unit.source: The Jewish laws did not permit people to travel or carry things on the Sabbath Day. A day ended when the sun set, and the new day began. Being a new day, people could then come and bring those who were sick.
trans-unit.target: Sheria za Kiyahudi hazikuruhusu watu kusafiri au kubeba vitu siku ya Sabato. Siku iliisha wakati jua lilipotua, na siku mpya ikaanza. Kwa kuwa ilikuwa siku mpya, watu wangeweza kuja na kuwaleta wagonjwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~38#Note:What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?-2067415069
trans-unit.source: The translator may want to create a footnote or glossary entry to explain this.
trans-unit.target: Mtafsiri anaweza kutaka kuunda maelezo ya chini au kiambishi cha msamiati kuelezea hili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~38#Note:What do you think was the reason that the people waited until the sun was setting?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.40+How did Jesus make them well again?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~40#Question:How did Jesus make them well again?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus make them well again?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaponyaje tena?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~40#Question:How did Jesus make them well again?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~40#Answer:How did Jesus make them well again?1068330732
trans-unit.source: He laid his hands on each one of them and healed them. (40)
trans-unit.target: Akaweka mikono yake juu ya kila mmoja wao, akawaponya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~40#Answer:How did Jesus make them well again?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.41+What did the demons do when they came out of many people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~41#Question:What did the demons do when they came out of many people?
trans-unit.source: What did the demons do when they came out of many people?
trans-unit.target: Roho waovu walifanya nini walipotoka katika miili ya watu wengi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~41#Question:What did the demons do when they came out of many people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~41#Answer:What did the demons do when they came out of many people?1405637697
trans-unit.source: They cried out that Jesus was the son of God. (41a)
trans-unit.target: Walipiga kelele kwamba Yesu alikuwa mwana wa Mungu. (41a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~41#Answer:What did the demons do when they came out of many people?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.41+What else did they know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~41#Question:What else did they know about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What else did they know about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walijua nini kingine kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~41#Question:What else did they know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~41#Answer:What else did they know about Jesus?-904919451
trans-unit.source: They knew that he was the Christ/Messiah. (41b)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba alikuwa Kristo/Masihi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~41#Answer:What else did they know about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~41#Question:What did Jesus strongly warn/sternly command those demons/evil spirits not to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus strongly warn/sternly command those demons/evil spirits not to do?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus strongly warn those demons not to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionya kwa nguvu roho waovu hao wasifanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~41#Alternate:What did Jesus strongly warn/sternly command those demons/evil spirits not to do?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!4~41#Alternate:What did Jesus strongly warn/sternly command those demons/evil spirits not to do?-1143280917
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus strongly warn those evil spirits not to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa onyo gani kali kwa roho hao waovu wasifanye?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.43-44+Why did Jesus not stay there, but went to other towns, even as far away as the synagogues in Judea province?

trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus not stay there, but went to other towns, even as far away as the synagogues in Judea province?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~43#Answer:Why did Jesus not stay there, but went to other towns, even as far away as the synagogues in Judea province?-132421015
trans-unit.source: God had sent him [down to earth] to tell/preach the Good News about the kingdom of God. (43, 44)
trans-unit.target: Na Mwenyezi Mungu alimtuma kumhubiri Injili ya ufalme wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~43#Answer:Why did Jesus not stay there, but went to other towns, even as far away as the synagogues in Judea province?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~43#Answer:Why did Jesus not stay there, but went to other towns, even as far away as the synagogues in Judea province?-439533707
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The two words which are often translated "preach" in English translations are both here in one context. Verse 43 refers to the content of Jesus's message. Verse 44 refers to how he presented that Good News message, doing it "with authority".
trans-unit.target: Mstari wa 43 unarejelea yaliyomo katika ujumbe wa Yesu. Mstari wa 44 unarejelea jinsi alivyotoa ujumbe huo wa Habari Njema, akifanya hivyo "kwa mamlaka".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~43#Answer:Why did Jesus not stay there, but went to other towns, even as far away as the synagogues in Judea province?

group.id: Q:LUK 4.42-44+What is the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!4~42#Question:What is the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: What is the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Ufalme wa Mungu ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~42#Question:What is the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!4~42#Answer:What is the kingdom of God?1367073066
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: God wants to rule over every person and reign in each one's heart and life as a king rules over the people who live in his country. The people in a kingdom submit to the king's rule, obeying his laws. God was establishing his kingship through his son, Jesus, whom he sent to the earth as the Messiah/the Christ he had promised to send.
trans-unit.target: Mungu anataka kutawala juu ya kila mtu na kutawala katika moyo na maisha ya kila mmoja kama mfalme anavyotawala juu ya watu wanaoishi katika nchi yake. Watu katika ufalme hujitiisha kwa utawala wa mfalme, wakiitii sheria zake. Mungu alikuwa akianzisha ufalme wake kupitia mwanawe, Yesu, ambaye alimtuma duniani kama Masihi / Kristo ambaye alikuwa ameahidi kumtuma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~42#Answer:What is the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!4~42#Note:What is the kingdom of God?517268396
trans-unit.source: See "kingdom of God" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "ufalme wa Mungu" katika tafsiri ya Union Version.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!4~42#Note:What is the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.8+Who is this man named Peter?

trans-unit.target: Mtu huyu anayeitwa Petro ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Question:Who is this man named Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:Who is this man named Peter?466916848
trans-unit.source: He is Simon. It is another name for him. (8)
trans-unit.target: Yeye ni Simoni. Ni jina lingine kwake. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:Who is this man named Peter?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~8#Note:Who is this man named Peter?6510006
trans-unit.source: You may wish to have a footnote or glossary entry which indicates that Simon was also called Peter in the Greek language (see John 1:40-42). Simon was his Hebrew name.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukataka kuwa na maelezo ya chini au uandikishaji wa msamiati ambao unaonyesha kwamba Simoni pia aliitwa Petro katika lugha ya Kigiriki (ona Yohana 1:40-42).

group.id: Q:LUK 5.8-11+Show me what you think that Simon did when he "fell down at Jesus's knees".

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~8#Question:Show me what you think that Simon did when he "fell down at Jesus's knees".
trans-unit.source: Show me what you think that Simon did when he "fell down at Jesus's knees".
trans-unit.target: Nionyeshe kile ambacho unafikiri Simoni alifanya 'alipoanguka chini kwenye magoti ya Yesu.'
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Question:Show me what you think that Simon did when he "fell down at Jesus's knees".

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:Show me what you think that Simon did when he "fell down at Jesus's knees".234317415
trans-unit.source: (The respondent should kneel in front of someone or something which represents Jesus's legs. We do not know if Simon bowed his head or not, but that was a sign of honor to the person who was standing or sitting.)
trans-unit.target: (Mjibu anapaswa kupiga magoti mbele ya mtu au kitu ambacho kinawakilisha miguu ya Yesu. Hatujui kama Simoni aliinamisha kichwa chake au la, lakini hiyo ilikuwa ishara ya heshima kwa mtu aliyekuwa amesimama au ameketi.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:Show me what you think that Simon did when he "fell down at Jesus's knees".

group.id: Q:LUK 5.8-9+Why did Simon fall down at Jesus's knees and tell him to go away from him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~8#Question:Why did Simon fall down at Jesus's knees and tell him to go away from him?
trans-unit.source: Why did Simon fall down at Jesus's knees and tell him to go away from him?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Simoni alianguka kwenye magoti ya Yesu na kumwambia aondoke kwake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Question:Why did Simon fall down at Jesus's knees and tell him to go away from him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:Why did Simon fall down at Jesus's knees and tell him to go away from him?764084357
trans-unit.source: He had seen Jesus use God's power and was astonished by it. Now he shows his submission to Jesus. He knew that he was a person who sinned [and that Jesus did not sin]. Simon probably felt unworthy to have one sent by God right there helping him. (8-9)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amemwona Yesu akitumia nguvu za Mungu na alishangazwa nayo. Sasa anaonyesha utii wake kwa Yesu. Alijua kwamba alikuwa mtu ambaye alifanya dhambi [na kwamba Yesu hakufanya dhambi]. Simoni labda alihisi kuwa hastahili kuwa na mtu aliyetumwa na Mungu hapo hapo kumsaidia. (8-9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:Why did Simon fall down at Jesus's knees and tell him to go away from him?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.9-10+Other people also were astonished by this large number of fish they had caught. Who were they?

trans-unit.source: Other people also were astonished by this large number of fish they had caught. Who were they?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~9#Answer:Other people also were astonished by this large number of fish they had caught. Who were they?1315555908
trans-unit.source: They included Simon's companions as well as his partners, James and John (who were sons of the man named Zebedee). (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Walitia ndani waandamani wa Simoni na vilevile washirika wake, Yakobo na Yohana (waliokuwa wana wa mtu aliyeitwa Zebedayo). (9-10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~9#Answer:Other people also were astonished by this large number of fish they had caught. Who were they?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.10+What did Jesus say in response to Simon's words?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~10#Question:What did Jesus say in response to Simon's words?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say in response to Simon's words?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje maneno ya Simoni?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~10#Question:What did Jesus say in response to Simon's words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~10#Answer:What did Jesus say in response to Simon's words?1651439466
trans-unit.source: "Do not be afraid. From now on you will catch men." (10)
trans-unit.target: "Usiogope, tangu sasa na kuendelea utakuwa ukiwavua watu wakiwa hai" (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~10#Answer:What did Jesus say in response to Simon's words?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.8-11+What do you think that Simon would do to "catch men"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~8#Question:What do you think that Simon would do to "catch men"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Simon would do to "catch men"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Simoni angefanya nini ili awe "mvua - watu"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Question:What do you think that Simon would do to "catch men"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:What do you think that Simon would do to "catch men"?1266456199
trans-unit.source: He would not grab people with his hands or his fishing net. This is picture/figurative language. Simon would gather people, both men and women, by encouraging them to become believers in/followers of Jesus in God's kingdom.
trans-unit.target: Simoni angekusanya watu, wanaume na wanawake, kwa kuwatia moyo wawe waumini/wafuasi wa Yesu katika ufalme wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:What do you think that Simon would do to "catch men"?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.10+What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that Simon should not have been afraid of him or his power?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~10#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that Simon should not have been afraid of him or his power?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that Simon should not have been afraid of him or his power?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alimwambia Simoni kwamba hapaswi kumwogopa wala kuogopa nguvu zake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~10#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that Simon should not have been afraid of him or his power?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~10#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that Simon should not have been afraid of him or his power?1527759678
trans-unit.source: They would be working together for the same purpose, not as enemies. Jesus had used his power to help, not to hurt or frighten anyone. (10)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa ametumia nguvu zake kusaidia, si kuumiza au kutisha yeyote. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~10#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that Simon should not have been afraid of him or his power?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.11+How did those men get ready to "catch men"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~11#Question:How did those men get ready to "catch men"?
trans-unit.source: How did those men get ready to "catch men"?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walitayarishaje ili kuwa "wavuvi wa watu"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~11#Question:How did those men get ready to "catch men"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~11#Answer:How did those men get ready to "catch men"?200163953
trans-unit.source: They pulled their boats up on the shore, left everything there and followed Jesus. (11)
trans-unit.target: Basi, baada ya kuzileta zile mashua ukingoni mwa ziwa, wakaacha yote, wakamfuata.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~11#Answer:How did those men get ready to "catch men"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~11#Note:How did those men get ready to "catch men"?770552307
trans-unit.source: The meaning of "to follow Jesus" here includes both walking behind Jesus away from the boats at the lake and learning from him as they went everywhere together.
trans-unit.target: Maana ya "kumfuata Yesu" hapa yatia ndani kutembea nyuma ya Yesu mbali na mashua kwenye ziwa na kujifunza kutoka kwake walipokuwa wakienda mahali popote pamoja.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~11#Note:How did those men get ready to "catch men"?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.8+How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~8#Question:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?
trans-unit.source: How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?
trans-unit.target: Wanaume waliovua samaki wengi waliamuaje kumfuata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Question:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?-1330183634
trans-unit.source: Simon saw that Jesus had real power and authority when he spoke or did something.
trans-unit.target: Simoni aliona kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu na mamlaka halisi aliposema au kufanya jambo fulani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?1625921127
trans-unit.source: He recognized that it was power from God that he, as a normal, sinful human being, did not have. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alitambua kwamba ilikuwa nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu ambayo yeye, akiwa mwanadamu wa kawaida mwenye dhambi, hakuwa nayo. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~8#Answer:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?-893691264
trans-unit.source: The men would learn more about that power and authority [and about Jesus's message] as they went around with him and listened to him teach.
trans-unit.target: Wanaume hao wangejifunza mengi zaidi kuhusu nguvu na mamlaka hiyo [na kuhusu ujumbe wa Yesu] walipokuwa wakitembea pamoja naye na kumsikiliza akifundisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~8#Answer:How did the men catching so many fish helped them decide to follow Jesus? What do you think?
