trans-unit.source: Jesus was in the same town as the man. The man saw him there. (12)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa katika mji uleule ambao mtu huyo alikuwa. Mtu huyo alimwona huko. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Answer:How did Jesus and the man sick with leprosy/the bad skin disease meet?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.12+What did the man do when he saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~12#Question:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the man do when he saw Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alifanya nini alipomwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Question:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~12#Answer:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?-946222662
trans-unit.source: He quickly bowed low, putting his [knees and his] face to the ground [in front of Jesus] and pleaded with/appealed to Jesus to heal him so he would be [physically and ritually] clean. (12)
trans-unit.target: Aliinama chini haraka, akaweka [goti na uso wake] chini [mbele ya Yesu] na kumsihi/aliomba Yesu amponye ili awe safi [kimwili na kidesturi]. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Answer:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.12+This man talked to Jesus as if he was not sure about something. Was he not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him or was he not sure that Jesus had enough power to heal him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~12#Question:This man talked to Jesus as if he was not sure about something. Was he not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him or was he not sure that Jesus had enough power to heal him?
trans-unit.source: This man talked to Jesus as if he was not sure about something. Was he not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him or was he not sure that Jesus had enough power to heal him?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alizungumza na Yesu kana kwamba hakuwa na uhakika kuhusu jambo fulani, kwamba Yesu alitaka kumponya au alikuwa na nguvu za kumponya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Question:This man talked to Jesus as if he was not sure about something. Was he not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him or was he not sure that Jesus had enough power to heal him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~12#Answer:This man talked to Jesus as if he was not sure about something. Was he not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him or was he not sure that Jesus had enough power to heal him?1901688138
trans-unit.source: He was not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him. He knew Jesus had enough power. (12)
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa na uhakika kwamba Yesu alitaka kumponya. Alijua Yesu alikuwa na nguvu za kutosha. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Answer:This man talked to Jesus as if he was not sure about something. Was he not sure that Jesus wanted to heal him or was he not sure that Jesus had enough power to heal him?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.12-13+What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~12#Question:What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu huyo alikuwa akifikiria nini aliposema, "Nitakase"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Question:What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~12#Answer:What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?-944507058
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He was talking both about having clear skin again after he became well and about becoming ritually clean. That means that the priests would allow him to once again be in the public worship and in the presence of God and to live with his family.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya kuwa na ngozi safi tena baada ya kupona na juu ya kuwa safi kidesturi. Hiyo inamaanisha kwamba makuhani wangemruhusu kuwa tena katika ibada ya umma na mbele ya Mungu na kuishi na familia yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Answer:What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~12#Note:What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?949598207
trans-unit.source: See 4:27, above.
trans-unit.target: Ona 4:27, hapo juu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~12#Note:What do you think that the man was thinking about when he said, "Make me clean"?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.13+How did Jesus make the man well again?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~13#Question:How did Jesus make the man well again?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus make the man well again?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimponyaje mtu huyo tena?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~13#Question:How did Jesus make the man well again?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~13#Answer:How did Jesus make the man well again?-102374772
trans-unit.source: He reached out and touched/put his hand on the sick man and told him he was healed. (13)
trans-unit.target: Aliinua mkono wake na kumgusa/kuweka mkono wake juu ya mgonjwa na kumwambia kwamba ameponywa. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~13#Answer:How did Jesus make the man well again?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~13#Note:How did Jesus make the man well again?-1098392245
trans-unit.source: If a person allowed another who was sick with leprosy to be near him or to touch him, that was a culturally bad thing. It meant that the new person also was ritually unclean for a set amount of time. Therefore, no one wanted to touch a person with leprosy, but Jesus felt compassion for the man. The translator may want to have a glossary entry about the Jews' laws and taboos concerning leprosy (see Lev. 13-14).
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu aliruhusu mwingine aliyeugua ukoma kuwa karibu naye au kumgusa, hilo lilikuwa jambo baya kitamaduni. Ilimaanisha kwamba mtu mpya pia alikuwa najisi kwa muda fulani. Kwa hivyo, hakuna mtu aliyetaka kumgusa mtu mwenye ukoma, lakini Yesu alihisi huruma kwa mtu huyo. Mtafsiri anaweza kutaka kuwa na kiingilio cha msamiati kuhusu sheria na vizuizi vya Wayahudi kuhusu ukoma (tazama Law. 13-14).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~13#Note:How did Jesus make the man well again?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.14+What was the man to do after Jesus healed him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~14#Question:What was the man to do after Jesus healed him?
trans-unit.source: What was the man to do after Jesus healed him?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alipaswa kufanya nini baada ya Yesu kumponya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Question:What was the man to do after Jesus healed him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What was the man to do after Jesus healed him?-2066895290
trans-unit.source: He was to go show his healed skin to a priest and then offer the sacrifices which Moses had commanded for a person who was healed of leprosy. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alipaswa kwenda kuonyesha ngozi yake iliyoponywa kwa kuhani na kisha kutoa dhabihu ambazo Musa alikuwa ameamuru kwa mtu aliyeponywa ukoma. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What was the man to do after Jesus healed him?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.14+What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~14#Question:What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?
trans-unit.source: What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini alipomwambia mtu huyo aende kwa kuhani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Question:What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?-1966810042
trans-unit.source: He wanted the people/the priests to know for sure that the man was totally healed [and safe to be near]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka watu/makuhani wajue kwa hakika kwamba mtu huyo alikuwa ameponywa kabisa [na alikuwa salama kuwa karibu naye]. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?-1014424719
trans-unit.source: (It would also show that Jesus followed/obeyed the Laws of Moses and told others to do the same.)
trans-unit.target: (Ingedhihirisha pia kwamba Yesu alifuata/kutii Sheria za Musa na kuwaambia wengine wafanye vivyo hivyo.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What result did Jesus intend when he told the man to go to the priest?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.14-16+What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~14#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alimwamuru mtu huyo asimwambie mtu yeyote juu ya jambo hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?-590331664
trans-unit.source: He did not want people to become excited only about the things he did to help people.
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka watu wavutiwe tu na mambo aliyofanya ili kuwasaidia watu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?-785697289
trans-unit.source: He did not want the man to interact with other people before a priest declared him [ritually] clean.
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka mtu huyo ashughulikie watu wengine kabla ya kuhani kumtangaza kuwa safi [kisherehe].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?-893651524
trans-unit.source: He did not want the priests to hear of the miracle before the man arrived. If they were hostile toward Jesus, they might decide not to say that the man was cured or ritually clean.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa walikuwa maadui wa Yesu, huenda wangeamua kutomwambia mtu huyo kwamba ameponywa au kwamba yeye ni safi kiibada.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~14#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?-24250092
trans-unit.source: If the person who is answering these questions already knows a lot about events in the four gospels, he may give one of the answers below. These answers are still true and acceptable, but they are not found in Luke's gospel up to this point.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu anayejibu maswali haya tayari anajua mengi kuhusu matukio katika Injili nne, anaweza kutoa moja ya majibu yafuatayo. Majibu haya bado ni ya kweli na yanaokubalika, lakini hayapatikani katika injili ya Luka hadi wakati huu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~14#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?2112302050
trans-unit.source: He did not want the people or the priests to think that he disregarded the Laws of Moses.
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka watu au makuhani wafikiri kwamba hakuheshimu Sheria za Musa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~14#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus commanded the man not to tell anyone about this?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.15+Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~15#Question:Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?
trans-unit.source: Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwamuru mtu huyo asimwambie mtu yeyote jambo hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~15#Question:Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~15#Answer:Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?431871512
trans-unit.source: News about Jesus's teaching and miracles spread even more than before.
trans-unit.target: Habari kuhusu mafundisho na miujiza ya Yesu zilienea sana kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~15#Answer:Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~15#Answer:Jesus commanded the man not to say anything to anyone else. What happened anyway?-1437916872

group.id: Q:LUK 5.17-20+What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~17#Question:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu vikundi hivyo viwili vya watu walioitwa Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~17#Question:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~17#Answer:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?-1737110296
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Pharisees were a group of Jewish religious leaders who also were very much like a political party. They followed the teaching of the experts in interpreting the Scriptures (who are often called scribes, or teachers of the Law). After those teachers of the Law had decided how a Jew was to live in order to please God, the Pharisees tried to live that way. They were very proud of themselves and thought that they were better than all the other people who did not live as they did.
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walikuwa kikundi cha viongozi wa dini ya Kiyahudi ambao pia walikuwa kama chama cha kisiasa. Walifuata mafundisho ya wataalam katika kutafsiri Maandiko (ambao mara nyingi huitwa waandishi, au walimu wa Sheria). Baada ya walimu hao wa Sheria kuamua jinsi Myahudi alipaswa kuishi ili kumpendeza Mungu, Mafarisayo walijaribu kuishi kwa njia hiyo. Walijivunia sana na walidhani walikuwa bora kuliko watu wengine wote ambao hawakuishi kama wao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~17#Answer:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~17#Answer:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?1375716065
trans-unit.source: The teachers of the Law were men who had authority to copy the writings of the Old Testament writers. They became the teachers and interpreters of the Old Testament Scriptures, especially the laws of God written down by Moses. Because of that work of writing, those men were called scribes.
trans-unit.target: Walimu wa Sheria walikuwa watu waliokuwa na mamlaka ya kunakili maandishi ya waandishi wa Agano la Kale. Walikuwa walimu na watafsiri wa Maandiko ya Agano la Kale, hasa sheria za Mungu zilizoandikwa na Musa. Kwa sababu ya kazi hiyo ya kuandika, watu hao waliitwa waandishi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~17#Answer:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~17#Note:What do you know about these two groups of men called the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law?-624391239
trans-unit.source: See "Pharisee" and "scribe, teacher of the law" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Mfarisayo" na "mwandishi, mwalimu wa sheria" katika tafsiri ya Union Version.

trans-unit.source: They did not believe that Jesus was God's son. Because only God can forgive sins, when Jesus forgave the man's sins, they wrongly thought that he was blaspheming God/pretending to be like God. Anyone who claimed to be God or to have God's authority was blaspheming God. (21)

trans-unit.source: He was God's son and the Lord God's power was present with him.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mwana wa Mungu na nguvu ya Bwana Mungu ilikuwa pamoja naye.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~22#Answer:How is it, do you think, that Jesus knew their thoughts?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~22#Note:How is it, do you think, that Jesus knew their thoughts?1023512480
trans-unit.source: See verse 17.
trans-unit.target: Ona mstari wa 17.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~22#Note:How is it, do you think, that Jesus knew their thoughts?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.22+What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~22#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba hawakupaswa kufikiria mambo kama hayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~22#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~22#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?-1538188102
trans-unit.source: The things that he had already taught and done should have proven to them that he had come from God and that God had given him authority both to forgive sins and to heal the sick.
trans-unit.target: Mambo ambayo alikuwa amefundisha na kufanya yangethibitisha kwao kwamba alitoka kwa Mungu na kwamba Mungu alikuwa amempa mamlaka ya kusamehe dhambi na kuponya wagonjwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~22#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~22#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~22#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~22#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?-125027309
trans-unit.source: They came expecting to hear Jesus teach God's Word clearly and do some miracles. Since he could only do those things by God's power, he could forgive sins by that same power, too.
trans-unit.target: Walikuja wakitarajia kumsikia Yesu akifundisha Neno la Mungu waziwazi na kufanya miujiza fulani. Kwa kuwa angeweza kufanya mambo hayo kwa nguvu ya Mungu tu, angeweza kusamehe dhambi kwa nguvu ile ile pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~22#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus implied that they should not have thought such things?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.23+What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~23#Question:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri jibu la swali la Yesu kuhusu kama ni rahisi kusamehe dhambi au kuponya mtu aliyepooza ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~23#Question:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~23#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?-1467183953
trans-unit.source: Neither action is possible unless you are God. If Jesus could do one, he must be God, so he could do the other by using that same power.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Yesu angeweza kufanya moja, lazima awe Mungu, hivyo angeweza kufanya nyingine kwa kutumia nguvu hiyo hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~23#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~23#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~23#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~23#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?-1697841836
trans-unit.source: If you say you have power to forgive someone's sins, it may be just empty words, because no one can see whether it is true or not. However, if you say you have power to heal someone, everyone will see whether that happens or not. In that way, healing someone is harder to do, because everyone will see whether you are lying or not.
trans-unit.target: Ukisema una uwezo wa kusamehe dhambi za mtu, huenda ikawa ni maneno matupu tu, kwa sababu hakuna mtu anayeweza kuona ikiwa ni kweli au la. Hata hivyo, ukisema una uwezo wa kumponya mtu, kila mtu ataona ikiwa hilo linatokea au la. Kwa njia hiyo, kuponya mtu ni ngumu zaidi kufanya, kwa sababu kila mtu ataona ikiwa unadanganya au la.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~23#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's question about whether it is easier to forgive sins or to heal a person who is paralyzed?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.24+Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~24#Question:Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?
trans-unit.source: Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu Mwana wa binadamu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~24#Question:Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~24#Answer:Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?-499613921
trans-unit.source: He was speaking about himself. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu yake mwenyewe. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~24#Answer:Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~24#Answer:Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?-1577304698
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: This is a title used in the Old Testament in Dan. 7:13-14. Daniel was referring to a human figure who, nevertheless, is a being in heaven. God gave him authority to be the leader of God's people on earth. The teachers of the Law knew that this title referred to the Messiah. Jesus applied this title to himself. See "Son of Man" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Katika Biblia ya Kiebrania, jina la cheo "Mwana wa Adamu" linatumiwa katika maana ya "Mwana wa Mungu" na linatumiwa katika maana ya "Mwana wa Mungu".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~24#Answer:Whom was Jesus talking about when he spoke about the Son of Man?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.24+Why did Jesus tell the sick man to get up and leave?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~24#Question:Why did Jesus tell the sick man to get up and leave?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus tell the sick man to get up and leave?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo mgonjwa aondoke?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~24#Question:Why did Jesus tell the sick man to get up and leave?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~24#Answer:Why did Jesus tell the sick man to get up and leave?-736843216
trans-unit.source: He said that to the sick man in order that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law would know that he had power from God to heal the man. Then they would know that he also had authority (from God/as God's son) to forgive sins. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alisema hivyo kwa mtu mgonjwa ili Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria wajue kwamba alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu kumponya mtu huyo. Ndipo wangejua kwamba pia alikuwa na mamlaka (kutoka kwa Mungu/kama mwana wa Mungu) kusamehe dhambi. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~24#Answer:Why did Jesus tell the sick man to get up and leave?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.25+How did the people there know that Jesus had healed the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~25#Question:How did the people there know that Jesus had healed the man?
trans-unit.source: How did the people there know that Jesus had healed the man?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliokuwako huko walijuaje kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemponya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~25#Question:How did the people there know that Jesus had healed the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~25#Answer:How did the people there know that Jesus had healed the man?450491744
trans-unit.source: He stood up in front of them, took up his mat/bedding and went home praising God. (25)
trans-unit.target: Akaondoka mbele yao, akachukua kitanda chake, akaenda zake nyumbani kwake, huku akimtukuza Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~25#Answer:How did the people there know that Jesus had healed the man?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.26+What did those people think and do when they saw the man do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~26#Question:What did those people think and do when they saw the man do that?
trans-unit.source: What did those people think and do when they saw the man do that?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walifikiri na kufanya nini walipomwona mtu huyo akifanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~26#Question:What did those people think and do when they saw the man do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~26#Answer:What did those people think and do when they saw the man do that?1401883407
trans-unit.source: They all could hardly believe what they were seeing, and it caused them to have great respect for God and to praise him. They realized that they had seen unusual things happen right there in front of them. (26)
trans-unit.target: Wote walishindwa kuamini walichoona, na jambo hilo liliwafanya wamwogope Mungu na kumtukuza kwa nguvu. Walifahamu kwamba walikuwa wameona mambo ya ajabu yakitendeka mbele yao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~26#Answer:What did those people think and do when they saw the man do that?

trans-unit.source: Luke 5:27-32 Jesus called Levi to follow him.
trans-unit.target: Luka 5:27-32 Yesu alimwita Lawi amfuate.

group.id: Q:LUK 5.27-32+When Jesus called Levi to follow him, how did Levi respond?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~27#Question:When Jesus called Levi to follow him, how did Levi respond?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus called Levi to follow him, how did Levi respond?
trans-unit.target: Lawi aliitikia jinsi gani Yesu alipomwalika amfuate?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Question:When Jesus called Levi to follow him, how did Levi respond?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~27#Answer:When Jesus called Levi to follow him, how did Levi respond?621587717
trans-unit.source: He left everything [related to his government work] and followed Jesus. He even hosted a banquet/feast in Jesus's honor. (27-29)
trans-unit.target: Aliacha kila kitu [kilichohusiana na kazi yake ya serikali] na kumfuata Yesu. Hata aliandaa karamu/karamu kwa heshima ya Yesu. (27-29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Answer:When Jesus called Levi to follow him, how did Levi respond?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.27-32+When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~27#Question:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipokula pamoja na watu wengine wengi katika nyumba ya Lawi, Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria/waandishi waliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Question:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~27#Alternate:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?512631006
trans-unit.source: When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law respond?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipokula pamoja na watu wengine wengi katika nyumba ya Lawi, Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria waliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Alternate:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~27#Alternate:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?-1471849384
trans-unit.source: When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and scribes respond?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipokula pamoja na watu wengine wengi katika nyumba ya Lawi, Mafarisayo na waandishi waliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Alternate:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~27#Answer:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?974721255
trans-unit.source: They complained to his disciples. (30)
trans-unit.target: Walilalamika kwa wanafunzi wake. (30)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Answer:When Jesus ate food with many other people at Levi's house, how did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes respond?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.27-32+Why did Jesus come to this earth?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~27#Question:Why did Jesus come to this earth?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus come to this earth?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alikuja duniani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Question:Why did Jesus come to this earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~27#Answer:Why did Jesus come to this earth?1558397
trans-unit.source: He came to call/invite people who know they sin to repent [of their sins]. (32)
trans-unit.target: Alikuja kuwaita/kuwaalika watu wanaojua kwamba wanatenda dhambi kutubu [dhambi zao]. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Answer:Why did Jesus come to this earth?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.27+What work did Levi do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~27#Question:What work did Levi do?
trans-unit.source: What work did Levi do?
trans-unit.target: Lawi alifanya kazi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Question:What work did Levi do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~27#Answer:What work did Levi do?1258050637
trans-unit.source: He collected tax money [for the Roman government]. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alikusanya fedha za kodi [kwa ajili ya serikali ya Roma]. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Answer:What work did Levi do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~27#Note:What work did Levi do?1502702011
trans-unit.source: You may wish to have a footnote or glossary entry which indicates Levi was also called Matthew in the Greek language (see Matt. 9:9-13). Levi was his Hebrew name.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukataka kuwa na maelezo ya chini au uandikishaji wa msamiati ambao unaonyesha Lawi pia aliitwa Mathayo katika lugha ya Kigiriki (tazama Mt 9:9-13).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Note:What work did Levi do?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.27+Where was Levi when Jesus spoke to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~27#Question:Where was Levi when Jesus spoke to him?
trans-unit.source: Where was Levi when Jesus spoke to him?
trans-unit.target: Lawi alikuwa wapi Yesu alipozungumza naye?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Question:Where was Levi when Jesus spoke to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~27#Answer:Where was Levi when Jesus spoke to him?-649482976
trans-unit.source: He was sitting in a government office collecting taxes. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ameketi katika ofisi ya serikali akikusanya kodi. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Answer:Where was Levi when Jesus spoke to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.27+What did Jesus ask Levi to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~27#Question:What did Jesus ask Levi to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask Levi to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Lawi afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Question:What did Jesus ask Levi to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~27#Answer:What did Jesus ask Levi to do?122137112
trans-unit.source: He asked Levi to follow him [and learn from him as they went everywhere together]. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alimwomba Lawi amfuate [na kujifunza kutoka kwake walipokuwa wakienda kila mahali pamoja]. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~27#Answer:What did Jesus ask Levi to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.28+What did Levi do to show that he already believed in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~28#Question:What did Levi do to show that he already believed in Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Levi do to show that he already believed in Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Lawi alifanya nini kuonyesha kwamba tayari alikuwa amemwamini Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~28#Question:What did Levi do to show that he already believed in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~28#Answer:What did Levi do to show that he already believed in Jesus?560005573
trans-unit.source: He got up, left everything [related to his work] and went with Jesus. (28)
trans-unit.target: Akaacha vyote [vilivyohusiana na kazi yake] akainuka, akamfuata Yesu. (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~28#Answer:What did Levi do to show that he already believed in Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.29+How did Levi honor Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~29#Question:How did Levi honor Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did Levi honor Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Lawi alimheshimuje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Question:How did Levi honor Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~29#Answer:How did Levi honor Jesus?1498481036
trans-unit.source: He made a great banquet/feast for Jesus. (29)
trans-unit.target: Alifanya karamu kubwa kwa ajili ya Yesu. (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Answer:How did Levi honor Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.29-30+What other groups of people were also at this feast?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~29#Question:What other groups of people were also at this feast?
trans-unit.source: What other groups of people were also at this feast?
trans-unit.target: Ni vikundi gani vingine vya watu vilivyokuwa pia kwenye karamu hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Question:What other groups of people were also at this feast?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~29#Answer:What other groups of people were also at this feast?2082413724
trans-unit.source: There was a large crowd of other men who collected taxes (29), some Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes (30), Jesus's disciples (30) and others (29) [whom the Pharisees and teachers of the Law regarded as sinners (30) ].
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na umati mkubwa wa watu wengine waliokuwa wakusanya-kodi (29), baadhi yao Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria/waandishi (30), wanafunzi wa Yesu (30) na wengine (29) [ambao Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria waliwaona kuwa watenda-dhambi (30) ].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Answer:What other groups of people were also at this feast?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.29-32+What kind of a person is a disciple?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~29#Question:What kind of a person is a disciple?
trans-unit.source: What kind of a person is a disciple?
trans-unit.target: Mwanafunzi ni mtu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Question:What kind of a person is a disciple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~29#Answer:What kind of a person is a disciple?-427387972
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A disciple is a person who spends much time learning from someone who is wise. Usually the student follows the teacher everywhere he goes, listening to and discussing with the teacher everything he or she says. The disciple is like an apprentice, but is not learning craft skills.
trans-unit.target: Mfuasi ni mtu ambaye hutumia muda mwingi kujifunza kutoka kwa mtu mwenye hekima. Kwa kawaida mwanafunzi humfuata mwalimu popote aendapo, akisikiliza na kujadili na mwalimu kila kitu anachosema. Mwanafunzi ni kama mwanafunzi, lakini hajifunzi ujuzi wa ufundi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Answer:What kind of a person is a disciple?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~29#Note:What kind of a person is a disciple?632956762
trans-unit.source: See "disciple" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mwanafunzi" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Note:What kind of a person is a disciple?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.29-32+Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~29#Question:Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?
trans-unit.source: Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliokuwa wanafunzi wa Yesu wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Question:Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~29#Answer:Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?1227575344
trans-unit.source: Luke has only written about Simon Peter, James, John (verse 11) and now Levi.
trans-unit.target: Luka ameandika tu juu ya Simoni Petro, Yakobo, Yohana (mstari 11) na sasa Lawi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Answer:Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~29#Note:Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?918494704
trans-unit.source: There probably were many other people who followed Jesus and may be included here. However, we only know the names of those twelve whom he called his apostles (see Luke 6:12-16), and two others who were later considered to replace Judas as an apostle (see Acts 1:21-23).
trans-unit.target: Inawezekana kulikuwa na watu wengine wengi waliomfuata Yesu na wanaweza kuingizwa hapa. Hata hivyo, tunajua tu majina ya wale kumi na wawili ambao aliwaita mitume wake (ona Luka 6:12-16), na wengine wawili ambao baadaye walifikiriwa kuchukua nafasi ya Yuda kama mtume (ona Matendo 1:21-23).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Note:Who were Jesus's disciples at this time?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.30+Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~30#Question:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria/waandishi walinung'unika kwa wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~30#Question:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~30#Alternate:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?-422944253
trans-unit.source: Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law complain to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria walilalamika kwa wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~30#Alternate:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~30#Alternate:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?-2075686637
trans-unit.source: Why did the Pharisees and scribes complain to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo na waandishi walinung'unika kwa wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~30#Alternate:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~30#Answer:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?-962571432
trans-unit.source: Jesus and his disciples were eating with the tax collectors and other people whom the Pharisees regarded as sinners. They were people who did not follow all the ways Pharisees said that were necessary to fully please God. (30)
trans-unit.target: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakila na watoza ushuru na watu wengine ambao Mafarisayo waliwaona kuwa wenye dhambi. Walikuwa watu ambao hawakufuata njia zote ambazo Mafarisayo walisema zilihitajika kumpendeza Mungu kikamilifu. (30)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~30#Answer:Why did the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes complain to the disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.31-32+What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~31#Question:What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini alipotoa mfano kuhusu watu waliohitaji daktari?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~31#Question:What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~31#Answer:What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?858746276
trans-unit.source: Sick people know they need help, so they do whatever the doctor tells them to do to get well again. In the same way, people who know they are sinners, know they need someone to help them become right in God's sight again.
trans-unit.target: Watu wagonjwa wanajua wanahitaji msaada, kwa hiyo wanafanya chochote daktari anawaambia wafanye ili wapate afya tena. Vivyo hivyo, watu wanaojua ni wenye dhambi, wanajua wanahitaji mtu wa kuwasaidia kuwa waadilifu tena mbele za Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~31#Answer:What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~31#Answer:What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?-2026121770
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that he came to help the people who [know they] sin to repent. The people who already think they are well or righteous do not look for, and do not want, any help. (31-32)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba alikuja kuwasaidia watu ambao [wanajua] wanatenda dhambi ili watubu. Watu ambao tayari wanafikiri wao ni wazuri au wenye haki hawatafuti, na hawataki, msaada wowote. (31-32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~31#Answer:What do you think is the meaning of Jesus's illustration about people who need a doctor?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.29-32+Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~29#Question:Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?
trans-unit.source: Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia mfano wa watu wanaojua kwamba ni wagonjwa na wale wanaodhani kwamba ni wenye afya. Unafikiri alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Question:Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~29#Answer:Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?722628666
trans-unit.source: The tax collectors, disciples and those whom the Pharisees called sinners knew that they needed Jesus to help them.
trans-unit.target: Wakusanya - kodi, wanafunzi na wale ambao Mafarisayo waliwaita watenda - dhambi walijua kwamba walihitaji Yesu awasaidie.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Answer:Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~29#Answer:Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?832085146
trans-unit.source: Generally, the Pharisees and teachers of the Law/scribes were the ones who thought that they were good/righteous. Therefore, they thought that they did not need Jesus to forgive them.
trans-unit.target: Kwa ujumla, Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria/waandishi walikuwa wale waliofikiri kuwa wao walikuwa wema/waadilifu. Kwa hiyo, walifikiri kwamba hawakuhitaji Yesu awasamehe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~29#Answer:Jesus used the picture language of people who know they are sick and people who think they are well. To whom, do you think, was he referring?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!5~33#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 5:33-39 Some people asked Jesus about the reason that his disciples did not fast.
trans-unit.target: Luka 5:33-39 Watu fulani walimwuliza Yesu sababu iliyofanya wanafunzi wake wasifunge.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 5.33-39+Jesus's disciples treated fasting and praying differently than John's disciples and the followers of the Pharisees did. How did Jesus show the reason for that difference?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~33#Question:Jesus's disciples treated fasting and praying differently than John's disciples and the followers of the Pharisees did. How did Jesus show the reason for that difference?
trans-unit.source: Jesus's disciples treated fasting and praying differently than John's disciples and the followers of the Pharisees did. How did Jesus show the reason for that difference?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu waliona kufunga na kusali kwa njia tofauti na wanafunzi wa Yohana na wafuasi wa Mafarisayo. Yesu alionyeshaje sababu ya tofauti hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Question:Jesus's disciples treated fasting and praying differently than John's disciples and the followers of the Pharisees did. How did Jesus show the reason for that difference?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:Jesus's disciples treated fasting and praying differently than John's disciples and the followers of the Pharisees did. How did Jesus show the reason for that difference?937613434
trans-unit.source: He told them stories to explain/illustrate the reason. (34-35, 36, 37-39)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia hadithi kuelezea/kuonyesha sababu. (34-35, 36, 37-39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:Jesus's disciples treated fasting and praying differently than John's disciples and the followers of the Pharisees did. How did Jesus show the reason for that difference?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.33-39+What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~33#Question:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha katika lugha yake ya kielezi ni nini kilichokuwa sababu ya tofauti hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Question:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?1087095282
trans-unit.source: Jesus was saying that his disciples were celebrating something new, that is, the son of God was among them. This meant having new ways of responding to God and his Word.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akisema kwamba wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakisherehekea jambo jipya, yaani, mwana wa Mungu alikuwa miongoni mwao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?419225252
trans-unit.source: The old ways were no longer adequate, [even though they had been right and good in their time and had served well].
trans-unit.target: Njia za zamani hazikuwa za kutosha tena, [hata ingawa zilikuwa sahihi na nzuri wakati huo na zilikuwa zimetumika vizuri].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?-1099642840
trans-unit.source: These new ways, however, would not just blend in and match the old, but must totally replace them.
trans-unit.target: Hata hivyo, njia hizi mpya hazingechanganyika tu na zile za zamani, bali lazima zizibadilishe kabisa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~33#Note:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?552971920
trans-unit.source: The more parts of the answer which someone gives, the better the answer, but even one part will be an acceptable answer. Not every part must be understood from this one reading.
trans-unit.target: Sehemu nyingi za jibu ambalo mtu hutoa, jibu bora zaidi, lakini hata sehemu moja itakuwa jibu linalokubalika. Sio kila sehemu lazima ieleweke kutoka kwa usomaji huu mmoja.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Note:What did Jesus show in his picture language was the reason for this difference?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.33-39+What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~33#Question:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba watu fulani wangemtendea? - AU - Yesu alitarajia watu fulani wamtendee jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Question:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~33#Alternate:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?1644492751
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyeshaje kwamba watu fulani wangemtendea jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Alternate:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~33#Alternate:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?1741407825
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitarajia watu fulani wamtendeeje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Alternate:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?1903010458
trans-unit.source: They would reject the new ways [of relating to God which he, Jesus, lived and taught,] and stay with their old ways [as explained by the Pharisees and teachers of the Law]. (39)
trans-unit.target: Wangekataa njia mpya [za kuhusiana na Mungu ambazo yeye, Yesu, aliishi na kufundisha] na kushikamana na njia zao za zamani [kama zilivyoelezwa na Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria]. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:What did Jesus imply that the response of some people would be to him? -OR- How did Jesus expect some people to respond to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.33+How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~33#Question:How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu walikuwa tofauti jinsi gani na wanafunzi wa Yohana na Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Question:How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?1560759632
trans-unit.source: The disciples of John and of the Pharisees often fasted and prayed. Jesus's disciples did not. (33)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yohana na wa Mafarisayo walikuwa wakifunga na kuomba mara nyingi, lakini wanafunzi wa Yesu hawakufunga.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~33#Answer:How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?363160097
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "fasting" discussed at 2:37.
trans-unit.target: Tazama neno "kufunga" linalozungumziwa kwenye 2:37.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~33#Answer:How were Jesus's disciples different from the disciples of John and the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.34-35+What comparisons did Jesus make when he used the picture language about a wedding?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~34#Question:What comparisons did Jesus make when he used the picture language about a wedding?
trans-unit.source: What comparisons did Jesus make when he used the picture language about a wedding?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha mambo gani alipotumia mfano kuhusu arusi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~34#Question:What comparisons did Jesus make when he used the picture language about a wedding?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~34#Answer:What comparisons did Jesus make when he used the picture language about a wedding?789193789
trans-unit.source: He compared his disciples to the friends of the bridegroom and compared himself to the bridegroom. (34-35)
trans-unit.target: Aliwalinganisha wanafunzi wake na marafiki wa bwana-arusi na akajilinganisha mwenyewe na bwana-arusi (34-35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~34#Answer:What comparisons did Jesus make when he used the picture language about a wedding?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.34-35+In what way, do you think, did Jesus's comparison answer their question about why his disciples did not fast?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~34#Question:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's comparison answer their question about why his disciples did not fast?
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, did Jesus's comparison answer their question about why his disciples did not fast?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ulinganisho wa Yesu ulijibu swali lao kuhusu kwa nini wanafunzi wake hawakufunga kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~34#Question:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's comparison answer their question about why his disciples did not fast?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~34#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's comparison answer their question about why his disciples did not fast?-1730704235
trans-unit.source: Jesus's disciples did not fast at that time because they were happy that Jesus was with them (34). Later, when he had been taken away from them [by his enemies], they would fast [because they would be sad] (35).
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu hawakufunga wakati huo kwa sababu walikuwa na furaha kwamba Yesu alikuwa pamoja nao (34). Baadaye, alipokwisha kuchukuliwa kutoka kwao [na maadui wake], wangefunga [kwa sababu wangekuwa na huzuni] (35).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~34#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's comparison answer their question about why his disciples did not fast?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.36+What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~36#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni sababu gani ambayo haikuwa nzuri kurekebisha kipande cha nguo ya zamani kwa kipande kilichokatwa kutoka kwa kipande kipya cha nguo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~36#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?2110093496
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni kwa sababu gani si vizuri kurekebisha kipande cha nguo ya zamani kwa kipande kilichokatwa kutoka katika kipande kipya cha nguo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~36#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?5886492
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni kwa sababu gani si vizuri kurekebisha kipande cha nguo ya zamani kwa kipande kilichokatwa kutoka katika kipande kipya cha nguo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~36#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?-903368046
trans-unit.source: The new one is ruined and the old one looks strange and mismatched.
trans-unit.target: Ile mpya imeharibiwa na ile ya zamani inaonekana kuwa isiyo ya kawaida na isiyofanana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to patch/mend an old piece of clothing with a piece cut from a new piece of clothing?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.36+What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~36#Question:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?
trans-unit.source: What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akilinganisha nini alipotumia mfano wa mavazi mapya na mavazi ya zamani na kiraka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Question:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~36#Alternate:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?-984343474
trans-unit.source: What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akilinganisha nini alipotumia mfano wa vazi jipya na vazi la zamani na kiraka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Alternate:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!5~36#Alternate:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?646429348
trans-unit.source: What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akilinganisha nini alipotumia mfano wa vazi jipya na vazi la zamani na kiraka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Alternate:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~36#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?1565977680
trans-unit.source: The new clothing represented what Jesus was teaching about a person's relationship with God.
trans-unit.target: Nguo hiyo mpya iliwakilisha yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa akifundisha kuhusu uhusiano wa mtu pamoja na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~36#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?1341511327
trans-unit.source: The old clothing represented the ways the religious teachers had taught the people to relate to God in the past.
trans-unit.target: Mavazi hayo ya zamani yaliwakilisha njia ambazo walimu wa kidini walikuwa wamewafundisha watu wawe na uhusiano na Mungu wakati uliopita.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~36#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?167590697
trans-unit.source: The patch was only a small piece of the new way. It did not really make things better.
trans-unit.target: Kuweka alama hiyo kulikuwa sehemu ndogo tu ya njia hiyo mpya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language/parable about the new clothing and the old clothing and a patch?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.36+What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~36#Question:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?
trans-unit.source: What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka watu wabadilike katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Question:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~36#Answer:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?193801910
trans-unit.source: If the people wanted to be in a right relationship with God, they must follow what Jesus taught, and not just try to improve what they were already trying to do.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu walitaka kuwa na uhusiano ufaao pamoja na Mungu, ni lazima wafuate yale ambayo Yesu alifundisha, na si kujaribu tu kuboresha yale ambayo tayari walikuwa wakijaribu kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Answer:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?
