trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A parable shows its meaning indirectly by using picture language to make a comparison. The parts of the comparison are generally not explained. The listeners themselves must think much about the meaning hidden in each part of the picture language. Jesus taught spiritual truths in this story form.
trans-unit.target: Kagua Neno Muhimu: Mfano huonyesha maana yake kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja kwa kutumia lugha ya mfano ili kufanya ulinganisho. Sehemu za ulinganisho kwa ujumla hazielezwi. Wasikilizaji wenyewe lazima wafikirie sana juu ya maana iliyofichwa katika kila sehemu ya lugha ya mfano.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Answer:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!5~36#Note:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.903541393
trans-unit.source: See "parable" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mfano" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~36#Note:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

group.id: Q:LUK 5.37+What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to put new wine into old wineskins?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~37#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to put new wine into old wineskins?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to put new wine into old wineskins?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni kwa sababu gani kwamba si vema kuweka divai mpya katika viriba vya zamani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to put new wine into old wineskins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~37#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to put new wine into old wineskins?-1315868239
trans-unit.source: New wine will [ferment and swell and] burst the old wineskin [which is no longer flexible] and will spill out onto the ground. That will ruin both the wine and the wineskin. Neither one will have any value. (37)
trans-unit.target: Basi divai mpya [huchemka na kuvimba na] kupasua viriba vya zamani [ambavyo haviwezi tena kuwa laini] na kumwagika chini; divai na viriba vitaharibika; vyote havitakuwa na thamani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that it is not good to put new wine into old wineskins?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.37-39+What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~37#Question:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?
trans-unit.source: What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akilinganisha nini alipotumia mfano wa divai mpya na viriba vya zamani vya divai?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Question:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~37#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?2086347907
trans-unit.source: The new wine represented Jesus's new teaching [about a person's relationship with God].
trans-unit.target: Divai mpya iliwakilisha fundisho jipya la Yesu [kuhusu uhusiano wa mtu pamoja na Mungu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~37#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?-1606331680
trans-unit.source: The old wineskin represented the way the people had been relating to God in the past.
trans-unit.target: Kikombe hicho cha zamani cha divai kiliwakilisha jinsi watu walivyokuwa wamemtendea Mungu wakati uliopita.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~37#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?433452959
trans-unit.source: If people tried to fit the new ways into the old patterns [as taught by the Pharisees and traditions], that would not work. The old way, then, was no longer useful and the value of the new way would be lost, too.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wangejaribu kuingiza njia mpya katika mifumo ya zamani [kama ilivyofundishwa na Mafarisayo na mapokeo], hiyo haingefanya kazi. Njia ya zamani, basi, haikuwa na faida tena na thamani ya njia mpya ingepotea pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Answer:What comparison, do you think, was Jesus making when he used the picture language about the new wine and the old wineskin?

group.id: Q:LUK 5.37-39+What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!5~37#Question:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?
trans-unit.source: What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka watu wabadilike katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Question:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!5~37#Answer:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?-371997430
trans-unit.source: (He wanted them to change in the same ways as he had talked about in the parable with the old and the new clothes.) If the people wanted to be in a right relationship with God, they must follow what Jesus taught, and not just try to improve what they were already trying to do, such as fasting.
trans-unit.target: (Alitaka wabadilishe njia zile zile alizokuwa amezungumzia katika mfano wa mavazi ya zamani na mapya.) Ikiwa watu wanataka kuwa na uhusiano mzuri na Mungu, lazima wafuate yale ambayo Yesu alifundisha, na si kujaribu tu kuboresha yale ambayo tayari walikuwa wakijaribu kufanya, kama vile kufunga.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!5~37#Answer:What do you think were ways that Jesus wanted the people to change?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!6~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 6:1-11 Jesus's authority was greater than the laws about the Sabbath Day.
trans-unit.target: Luka 6:1-11 Mamlaka ya Yesu ilikuwa kubwa kuliko sheria juu ya Siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1-11+Why did the Pharisees criticize Jesus and his disciples for picking grain?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:Why did the Pharisees criticize Jesus and his disciples for picking grain?
trans-unit.source: Why did the Pharisees criticize Jesus and his disciples for picking grain?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo walimshutumu Yesu na wanafunzi wake kwa kuokota ngano?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:Why did the Pharisees criticize Jesus and his disciples for picking grain?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:Why did the Pharisees criticize Jesus and his disciples for picking grain?214846065
trans-unit.source: They thought that Jesus and his disciples were disobeying the Laws [of Moses] about [not working on] the Sabbath Day. (2, 7)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakivunja Sheria [za Musa] kuhusu [kutofanya kazi] siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:Why did the Pharisees criticize Jesus and his disciples for picking grain?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1-11+What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini kuhusu Siku ya Sabato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?308054711
trans-unit.source: He said that he, the Son of Man, was Lord over it, that is, he had authority [from God] to say what could be done on the Sabbath Day. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba yeye, Mwana wa Adamu, alikuwa Bwana juu yake, yaani, alikuwa na mamlaka [kutoka kwa Mungu] ya kusema jambo ambalo lingeweza kufanywa siku ya Sabato. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?277496037
trans-unit.source: Also, he implied [with the example from God's Word about David and his companions] that God permitted people to do good, helpful things on the Sabbath Day when there was a special need. (3-4, 9)
trans-unit.target: Pia, alionyesha [kwa kutumia kielelezo cha Neno la Mungu kuhusu Daudi na waandamani wake] kwamba Mungu aliwaruhusu watu wafanye mambo mema, yenye kusaidia katika Siku ya Sabato wakati ambapo kulikuwa na uhitaji wa pekee. (3-4, 9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell them about the Sabbath Day?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1+Where was Jesus walking one Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:Where was Jesus walking one Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.source: Where was Jesus walking one Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akitembea wapi siku moja ya Sabato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:Where was Jesus walking one Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:Where was Jesus walking one Sabbath Day?-1386634458
trans-unit.source: He was going through grain fields. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akipita katika mashamba ya nafaka. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:Where was Jesus walking one Sabbath Day?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1-5+What kind of a place do you think a grain field is?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:What kind of a place do you think a grain field is?
trans-unit.source: What kind of a place do you think a grain field is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri shamba la nafaka ni mahali pa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:What kind of a place do you think a grain field is?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:What kind of a place do you think a grain field is?505844616
trans-unit.source: It is a field/garden where grass crops like wheat or barley are planted to raise the seeds for food.
trans-unit.target: Ni shamba/bustani ambapo mazao ya nyasi kama ngano au shayiri hupandwa ili kuongeza mbegu kwa ajili ya chakula.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:What kind of a place do you think a grain field is?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1+What did Jesus's disciples do as they walked there?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:What did Jesus's disciples do as they walked there?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus's disciples do as they walked there?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu walifanya nini walipokuwa wakitembea huko?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:What did Jesus's disciples do as they walked there?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:What did Jesus's disciples do as they walked there?1753113370
trans-unit.source: They picked some heads of the grain, rubbed them around in their hands [to remove the husks] and ate the kernels. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walivuna vichwa vya nafaka, wakavipapasa-papasa [ili kuondoa magamba] na kula nafaka. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:What did Jesus's disciples do as they walked there?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.3-4+What do you think was the reason that they did that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~3#Question:What do you think was the reason that they did that?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that they did that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walifanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~3#Question:What do you think was the reason that they did that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~3#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they did that?-1389983812
trans-unit.source: They were probably hungry. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea walikuwa na njaa. (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~3#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they did that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~3#Note:What do you think was the reason that they did that?-1784788584
trans-unit.source: They were not stealing the grain. The Law of Moses allowed them to take some grain to eat as they walked along (see Deut. 23:25).
trans-unit.target: Sheria ya Musa iliwaruhusu kuchukua nafaka ili kula walipokuwa wakitembea (ona Kumb 23:25).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~3#Note:What do you think was the reason that they did that?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.2+What do you think that the Pharisees were thinking about when they criticized Jesus and his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~2#Question:What do you think that the Pharisees were thinking about when they criticized Jesus and his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that the Pharisees were thinking about when they criticized Jesus and his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Mafarisayo walikuwa wakifikiria nini walipomshutumu Yesu na wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~2#Question:What do you think that the Pharisees were thinking about when they criticized Jesus and his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~2#Answer:What do you think that the Pharisees were thinking about when they criticized Jesus and his disciples?665322079
trans-unit.source: They regarded what the disciples did as being work, [like harvesting grain or gathering food]. People were not permitted by the Law [of Moses] to do any kind of work activity on the Sabbath Day. (2)
trans-unit.target: Waliona yale ambayo wanafunzi walifanya kuwa kazi, [kama vile kuvuna nafaka au kukusanya chakula]. Watu hawakuruhusiwa na Sheria [ya Musa] kufanya aina yoyote ya utendaji wa kazi katika Siku ya Sabato. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~2#Answer:What do you think that the Pharisees were thinking about when they criticized Jesus and his disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.4+What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~4#Question:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?
trans-unit.source: What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?
trans-unit.target: Daudi na wenzake walifanya nini wakati fulani walipokuwa na njaa na hawakuwa na chakula?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Question:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~4#Answer:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?-738167642
trans-unit.source: They entered [the grounds of] the house of God,
trans-unit.target: Waliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Answer:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~4#Answer:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?1261893182
trans-unit.source: received [from a priest] the bread which only the priests were permitted to eat [after they had offered a new set of fresh bread to God],
trans-unit.target: alipokea [kutoka kwa kuhani] mikate ambayo ni makuhani tu walioruhusiwa kula [baada ya kutoa mkate mpya wa mkate safi kwa Mungu]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Answer:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~4#Answer:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?1587375688
trans-unit.source: and ate it [even though they were not priests]. (4)
trans-unit.target: na wakala matunda yake [ingawa hawakuwa makuhani].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Answer:What did David and his companions once do when they were hungry and had no food?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.4+Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~4#Question:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?
trans-unit.source: Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini chakula/mkate huo ulikuwa wa pekee na ni makuhani tu waliopaswa kula?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Question:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~4#Alternate:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?1540614200
trans-unit.source: Why was that food special and only for the priests to eat?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini chakula hicho kilikuwa cha pekee na ni makuhani tu waliopaswa kukila?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Alternate:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~4#Alternate:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?1611163867
trans-unit.source: Why was that bread special and only for the priests to eat?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mkate huo ulikuwa wa pekee na ulipaswa kuliwa na makuhani tu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Alternate:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~4#Answer:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?1126634273
trans-unit.source: The priests previously had given it to God, setting it out [on a special table] for him. (4)
trans-unit.target: Makuhani hapo awali walikuwa wamemtolea Mungu, wakiiweka [juu ya meza ya pekee] kwa ajili yake. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~4#Answer:Why was that food/bread special and only for the priests to eat?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1-5+Does it sound to you as though Jesus was saying that David and his men had done something wrong?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:Does it sound to you as though Jesus was saying that David and his men had done something wrong?
trans-unit.source: Does it sound to you as though Jesus was saying that David and his men had done something wrong?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akisema kwamba Daudi na wanaume wake walikuwa wamefanya jambo fulani baya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:Does it sound to you as though Jesus was saying that David and his men had done something wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:Does it sound to you as though Jesus was saying that David and his men had done something wrong?-1360776787
trans-unit.source: (It should not sound that way. Rather, Jesus was using this story about David as an example that it is more important to meet a need than to obey the rules of religion.)
trans-unit.target: (Haipaswi kuonekana hivyo, badala yake, Yesu alikuwa akitumia hadithi hii kuhusu Daudi kama kielelezo kwamba ni muhimu zaidi kutimiza uhitaji kuliko kutii sheria za kidini.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:Does it sound to you as though Jesus was saying that David and his men had done something wrong?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.1-5+Who was this "Son of Man" whom Jesus said had authority to decide what was permitted on the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~1#Question:Who was this "Son of Man" whom Jesus said had authority to decide what was permitted on the Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.source: Who was this "Son of Man" whom Jesus said had authority to decide what was permitted on the Sabbath Day?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani huyu "Mwana wa Adamu" ambaye Yesu alisema alikuwa na mamlaka ya kuamua kile kilichoruhusiwa siku ya Sabato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Question:Who was this "Son of Man" whom Jesus said had authority to decide what was permitted on the Sabbath Day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~1#Answer:Who was this "Son of Man" whom Jesus said had authority to decide what was permitted on the Sabbath Day?-999170672
trans-unit.source: Jesus himself was the Son of Man. (See 5:24.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu mwenyewe alikuwa Mwana wa Adamu (Ona 5:24).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~1#Answer:Who was this "Son of Man" whom Jesus said had authority to decide what was permitted on the Sabbath Day?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.6+What was wrong with one man in the synagogue where Jesus was teaching?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~6#Question:What was wrong with one man in the synagogue where Jesus was teaching?
trans-unit.source: What was wrong with one man in the synagogue where Jesus was teaching?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichokuwa kibaya kwa mtu mmoja katika sinagogi ambapo Yesu alikuwa akifundisha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~6#Question:What was wrong with one man in the synagogue where Jesus was teaching?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~6#Answer:What was wrong with one man in the synagogue where Jesus was teaching?-1978945393
trans-unit.source: He had a shriveled/atrophied right hand. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na mkono wa kulia uliokonda/uliopungua nguvu. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~6#Answer:What was wrong with one man in the synagogue where Jesus was teaching?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.7+Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~7#Question:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria/waandishi walikuwa wakimchunguza Yesu kwa uangalifu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~7#Question:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~7#Alternate:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?-1312883263
trans-unit.source: Why were the Pharisees and teachers of the Law carefully watching Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria walikuwa wakimchunguza Yesu kwa uangalifu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~7#Alternate:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~7#Alternate:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?249838112
trans-unit.source: Why were the Pharisees and scribes carefully watching Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo na waandishi walikuwa wakimchunguza Yesu kwa makini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~7#Alternate:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~7#Answer:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?1330674573
trans-unit.source: If Jesus healed that man on the Sabbath Day, they would have a good reason to accuse him of working. The Law [of Moses] did not permit anyone to work on the Sabbath Day. (7) (Then they could punish him or, at least, tell people that he was not a good teacher of God's Word.)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Yesu angemponya mtu huyo siku ya Sabato, wangekuwa na sababu nzuri ya kumshtaki kwa kufanya kazi. Sheria [ya Musa] haikuruhusu mtu yeyote kufanya kazi siku ya Sabato. (7) (Basi wangeweza kumwadhibu au, angalau, kuwaambia watu kwamba hakuwa mwalimu mzuri wa Neno la Mungu.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~7#Answer:Why were the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes carefully watching Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.8+Why did Jesus tell the man with the shriveled hand to stand up in front of everyone else?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~8#Question:Why did Jesus tell the man with the shriveled hand to stand up in front of everyone else?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus tell the man with the shriveled hand to stand up in front of everyone else?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alimwambia mtu aliyekuwa na mkono uliopooza asimame mbele ya watu wote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~8#Question:Why did Jesus tell the man with the shriveled hand to stand up in front of everyone else?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~8#Answer:Why did Jesus tell the man with the shriveled hand to stand up in front of everyone else?179368110
trans-unit.source: He knew what those men were thinking, so he wanted everyone to clearly see him heal the man. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kile ambacho wanaume hao walikuwa wakifikiria, kwa hiyo alitaka kila mtu amwone waziwazi akimponya mtu huyo. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~8#Answer:Why did Jesus tell the man with the shriveled hand to stand up in front of everyone else?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.9+The Pharisees did not answer Jesus's question about which choice should be made. Which of those choices do you think that people should choose?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~9#Question:The Pharisees did not answer Jesus's question about which choice should be made. Which of those choices do you think that people should choose?
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees did not answer Jesus's question about which choice should be made. Which of those choices do you think that people should choose?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo hawakujibu swali la Yesu kuhusu uchaguzi ambao watu walipaswa kufanya. Unafikiri watu wanapaswa kuchagua ipi kati ya hizo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~9#Question:The Pharisees did not answer Jesus's question about which choice should be made. Which of those choices do you think that people should choose?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~9#Answer:The Pharisees did not answer Jesus's question about which choice should be made. Which of those choices do you think that people should choose?1529503536
trans-unit.source: People should choose to do good, which may save someone's life. (9)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanapaswa kuchagua kufanya mema, ambayo yanaweza kuokoa maisha ya mtu fulani. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~9#Answer:The Pharisees did not answer Jesus's question about which choice should be made. Which of those choices do you think that people should choose?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.10+How did the man's hand become perfect again?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~10#Question:How did the man's hand become perfect again?
trans-unit.source: How did the man's hand become perfect again?
trans-unit.target: Mkono wa mtu huyo ulifanywaje kuwa mkamilifu tena?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~10#Question:How did the man's hand become perfect again?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~10#Answer:How did the man's hand become perfect again?1151382747
trans-unit.source: Jesus told him to stretch it out straight. When the man obeyed Jesus, his bad hand became completely well. (10)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia aunyooshe mkono wake, na mtu huyo aliposikia maneno ya Yesu, mkono wake uliopona kabisa. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~10#Answer:How did the man's hand become perfect again?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.11+How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~11#Question:How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?
trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo waliitikiaje Yesu alipowaambia mambo hayo na kisha kumponya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~11#Question:How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~11#Answer:How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?-1794379949
trans-unit.source: They were furiously mad/full of anger at him and began discussing what they could do to [kill] him. (11)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na hasira kali juu yake na wakaanza kujadiliana kile wawezacho kufanya ili [kumwua]. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~11#Answer:How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~11#Note:How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?-451244023
trans-unit.source: See Matt. 12:14 and Mark 3:6, where the Pharisees stated clearly what they intended to do.
trans-unit.target: Ona Mathayo 12:14 na Marko 3:6, ambapo Mafarisayo walieleza waziwazi yale waliyokusudia kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~11#Note:How did the Pharisees respond when Jesus told them these things and then he healed the man?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.9+What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~9#Question:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria walimkasirikia Yesu sana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~9#Question:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?1595694802
trans-unit.source: He neither interpreted the rules, nor obeyed them in the way that they had taught people to obey them.
trans-unit.target: Yeye hakufasiri sheria hizo, wala hakuzitii kwa njia ambayo walikuwa wamewafundisha watu kuzitii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?951527811
trans-unit.source: He implied that, if people followed their rules, they might do something evil or even destroy someone's life. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba, ikiwa watu watafuata sheria zao, huenda wakafanya jambo baya au hata kuharibu maisha ya mtu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?-1560902532
trans-unit.source: He was making them appear to be foolish in front of many people.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiwafanya waonekane kuwa wapumbavu mbele ya watu wengi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law were so angry at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!6~12#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 6:12-16 Jesus chose twelve men and appointed them as his apostles.
trans-unit.target: Luka 6:12-16 Yesu alichagua wanaume kumi na wawili na kuwaweka rasmi kuwa mitume wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~12#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 6.12-16+Why did Jesus spend a whole night praying to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~12#Question:Why did Jesus spend a whole night praying to God?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus spend a whole night praying to God?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alitumia usiku mzima katika kusali kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~12#Question:Why did Jesus spend a whole night praying to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~12#Answer:Why did Jesus spend a whole night praying to God?897518256
trans-unit.source: A large group of disciples followed Jesus. He wanted [God to help him] to carefully choose a few men out of that large group to become his apostles. (12-13)
trans-unit.target: Kikundi kikubwa cha wanafunzi walimfuata Yesu. Alitaka [Mungu amsaidie] kuchagua kwa uangalifu wanaume wachache kutoka kwa kikundi hicho kikubwa ili wawe mitume wake (12-13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~12#Answer:Why did Jesus spend a whole night praying to God?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.12+Do you think that Jesus went alone to pray or that other men went with him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~12#Question:Do you think that Jesus went alone to pray or that other men went with him?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jesus went alone to pray or that other men went with him?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alienda kusali akiwa peke yake au aliandamana na wanaume wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~12#Question:Do you think that Jesus went alone to pray or that other men went with him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~12#Answer:Do you think that Jesus went alone to pray or that other men went with him?1718344928
trans-unit.source: He probably went alone. Luke wrote that Jesus went into the hills to pray and that he wanted to choose some special workers. (He probably would not have asked any other person to join him at that time.) (12)
trans-unit.target: Luka aliandika kwamba Yesu alienda mlimani kusali na kwamba alitaka kuchagua wafanyakazi fulani wa pekee (huenda hakuwa amemwomba mtu mwingine amfuate wakati huo). (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~12#Answer:Do you think that Jesus went alone to pray or that other men went with him?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.13+How do you know God had helped him choose the right men?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~13#Question:How do you know God had helped him choose the right men?
trans-unit.source: How do you know God had helped him choose the right men?
trans-unit.target: Unajuaje kwamba Mungu alimsaidia kuchagua wanaume wanaofaa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Question:How do you know God had helped him choose the right men?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~13#Answer:How do you know God had helped him choose the right men?1884532691
trans-unit.source: He immediately chose them in front of the other people who followed him. (13)
trans-unit.target: Mara moja akawachagua mbele ya watu wengine waliomfuata. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Answer:How do you know God had helped him choose the right men?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.13+How many men did he choose for this special work?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~13#Question:How many men did he choose for this special work?
trans-unit.source: How many men did he choose for this special work?
trans-unit.target: Alichagua wanaume wangapi kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo ya pekee?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Question:How many men did he choose for this special work?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~13#Answer:How many men did he choose for this special work?1355404218
trans-unit.source: Twelve men. (13)
trans-unit.target: Wanaume kumi na wawili. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Answer:How many men did he choose for this special work?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.13+What was the special name Jesus gave this group of twelve men?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~13#Question:What was the special name Jesus gave this group of twelve men?
trans-unit.source: What was the special name Jesus gave this group of twelve men?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilipa jina gani la pekee kikundi hiki cha wanaume kumi na wawili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Question:What was the special name Jesus gave this group of twelve men?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~13#Answer:What was the special name Jesus gave this group of twelve men?395238088
trans-unit.source: He designated them as his apostles. // He named them apostles. (13)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaita mitume wake. // Aliwaita mitume. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Answer:What was the special name Jesus gave this group of twelve men?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.13+What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~13#Question:What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kulikuwa na tofauti gani kati ya kazi ambayo mtume angefanya na ile ambayo mwanafunzi angefanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Question:What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~13#Answer:What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?-17704291
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: An apostle was sent with full authority from the one who had sent him to speak or act in his place. A disciple was really only a student who followed his teacher around. He had no authority to represent the teacher.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: Mtume alitumwa na mamlaka kamili kutoka kwa yule aliyemtuma kusema au kutenda kwa niaba yake. mwanafunzi alikuwa kweli tu mwanafunzi ambaye alifuata mwalimu wake kote. hakuwa na mamlaka ya kuwakilisha mwalimu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Answer:What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~13#Note:What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?-1185645833
trans-unit.source: See "apostle" and "disciple" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mtume" na "mwanafunzi" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~13#Note:What do you think the difference was between the work an apostle would do and the work a disciple would do?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.14-15+Tell me about the two men named Simon.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~14#Question:Tell me about the two men named Simon.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about the two men named Simon.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu wanaume wawili walioitwa Simoni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Question:Tell me about the two men named Simon.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Simon.120527134
trans-unit.source: Jesus gave the name Peter to one Simon. He was the brother of Andrew. (14)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimpa jina Petro Simoni mmoja, ndugu ya Andrea. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Simon.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Simon.1151458396
trans-unit.source: The other Simon was known as the Zealot. (15)
trans-unit.target: Simoni mwingine aliitwa Mzito. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Simon.

group.id: Q:LUK 6.15+What do you think a "Zealot" was?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~14#Question:What do you think a "Zealot" was?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a "Zealot" was?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri "Mhujaa" alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Question:What do you think a "Zealot" was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~14#Answer:What do you think a "Zealot" was?2042396499
trans-unit.source: Jews who really wanted their people and their country to be free from the control and rules of the Roman government were called Zealots. They felt strongly that they should be independent.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi ambao walitaka sana watu wao na nchi yao iwe huru kutokana na udhibiti na sheria za serikali ya Roma waliitwa Wazeloti. Walihisi kwa nguvu kwamba wanapaswa kuwa huru.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Answer:What do you think a "Zealot" was?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~14#Note:What do you think a "Zealot" was?-371364212
trans-unit.source: If the word is not already translated by a descriptive phrase, the translator may want to explain the word in a footnote or glossary item.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa neno hilo halijafasiriwa tayari kwa maneno ya ufafanuzi, huenda mtafsiri akataka kulifafanua katika kielezi-chini au katika orodha ya maneno.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Note:What do you think a "Zealot" was?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.14-15+Tell me about the two men named James.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~14#Question:Tell me about the two men named James.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about the two men named James.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu wanaume wawili walioitwa James.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Question:Tell me about the two men named James.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named James.-1660586865
trans-unit.source: One was a son of Zebedee and the brother of John (see 5:10). They were partners with Simon in the fishing business. (14)
trans-unit.target: Mmoja alikuwa mwana wa Zebedayo na ndugu ya Yohana (ona 5:10). Walikuwa washirika wa Simoni katika biashara ya uvuvi. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named James.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named James.-96211015
trans-unit.source: The other James was the son of a man named Alphaeus. (15)
trans-unit.target: Yakobo mwingine alikuwa mwana wa mtu aliyeitwa Alfayo. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~14#Answer:Tell me about the two men named James.

group.id: Q:LUK 6.15-16+Tell me about the two men named Judas.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~15#Question:Tell me about the two men named Judas.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about the two men named Judas.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu wanaume wawili walioitwa Yuda.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~15#Question:Tell me about the two men named Judas.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~15#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Judas.1049850137
trans-unit.source: One was the son of a man named James. (15)
trans-unit.target: Mmoja alikuwa mwana wa mwanamume aliyeitwa Yakobo. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~15#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Judas.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~15#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Judas.-341529226
trans-unit.source: The other Judas was Judas Iscariot, who [later] became a traitor [to Jesus]/a betrayer [of Jesus]. (16)
trans-unit.target: Yuda yule mwingine alikuwa Yuda Iskariote, ambaye [baada ya muda] akawa msaliti [wa Yesu]/msaliti [wa Yesu]. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~15#Answer:Tell me about the two men named Judas.

group.id: Q:LUK 6.16+What do you think it means for a person to be a traitor/betrayer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~16#Question:What do you think it means for a person to be a traitor/betrayer?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for a person to be a traitor/betrayer?

trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for a person to be a traitor?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~16#Alternate:What do you think it means for a person to be a traitor/betrayer?2016837565

group.id: Q:LUK 6.17-26+What will happen to those who want to know God better and want to please him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~17#Question:What will happen to those who want to know God better and want to please him?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to those who want to know God better and want to please him?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kitakachowapata wale wanaotaka kumjua Mungu vizuri zaidi na wanaotaka kumpendeza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~17#Question:What will happen to those who want to know God better and want to please him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~17#Answer:What will happen to those who want to know God better and want to please him?1567960949
trans-unit.source: They will be happy/feel blessed [by God]. They will receive a great reward in heaven. (20-23)
trans-unit.target: Na hao watakuwa katika furaha, na wao watapata ujira mkubwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~17#Answer:What will happen to those who want to know God better and want to please him?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.17-26+What will happen to those who want to have the things which are part of this world and want to please themselves?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~17#Question:What will happen to those who want to have the things which are part of this world and want to please themselves?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to those who want to have the things which are part of this world and want to please themselves?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~17#Question:What will happen to those who want to have the things which are part of this world and want to please themselves?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~17#Answer:What will happen to those who want to have the things which are part of this world and want to please themselves?-1032218180

trans-unit.target: Na watakuwa na furaha, na watakuwa na furaha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~17#Answer:What will happen to those who want to have the things which are part of this world and want to please themselves?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.17+Who was waiting for Jesus when he came down the mountain?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.18+Why were those people waiting for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~18#Question:Why were those people waiting for Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why were those people waiting for Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu hao walikuwa wakimngojea Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~18#Question:Why were those people waiting for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~18#Answer:Why were those people waiting for Jesus?-406705670
trans-unit.source: They had come to hear him [teach God's Word]
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamekuja kumsikiliza [kufundisha Neno la Mungu]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~18#Answer:Why were those people waiting for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~18#Answer:Why were those people waiting for Jesus?-1625513704

trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~18#Answer:Why were those people waiting for Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.18-19+What happened to some of those people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~18#Question:What happened to some of those people?
trans-unit.source: What happened to some of those people?
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya watu hao walipatwa na nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~18#Question:What happened to some of those people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~18#Answer:What happened to some of those people?658258940

trans-unit.source: They are poor (20), hungry, weeping (21) and hated (that is, excluded, insulted and defamed) by others because they associate with Jesus (22). (That is, they focus on God.)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~20#Note:What are some of the characteristics of those whom Jesus says are happy/feel blessed by God?430005239
trans-unit.source: The Greek word which is translated in these verses as "blessed" is not the same word which Luke used back in 1:42, 1:64, and 2:28 when Elizabeth, Zechariah, and Simeon each blessed someone. The word Luke used here refers to inner happiness, not outward happiness.
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki ambalo limetafsiriwa katika mistari hii kama "barikiwa" si neno lile lile ambalo Luka alitumia nyuma katika 1:42, 1:64, na 2:28 wakati Elisabeti, Zekaria, na Simeoni kila mmoja alibariki mtu. Neno ambalo Luka alitumia hapa linarejelea furaha ya ndani, si furaha ya nje.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~20#Note:What are some of the characteristics of those whom Jesus says are happy/feel blessed by God?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.27+How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~27#Question:How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?
trans-unit.source: How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?
trans-unit.target: Mtu anayemfuata Yesu anapaswa kuwatendeaje adui zake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~27#Question:How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~27#Answer:How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?-1906222044
trans-unit.source: He should love his enemies. (27)
trans-unit.target: Anapaswa kuwapenda adui zake. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~27#Answer:How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~27#Note:How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?-362009003
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek language has several words which are translated "love" in English. The word used here means a gracious, outgoing, active interest in the welfare of another person. John used the same word to explain how much God loves us [John 3:16; 1 John 4:9-11. Jesus used the word to talk about loving God and loving one's neighbor as one loves himself [Mark 12:30-31]. Paul used the word to tell how a husband should act toward his wife [Eph. 5:25]. We should love our enemies the same as God loves us and the same as we love anyone else, including our wives and God. The translator must have good reasons if he/she has used a different word for love in this verse than he/she would use in those other contexts. See "love" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Neno muhimu: Lugha ya Kigiriki ina maneno kadhaa ambayo yametafsiriwa "upendo" katika Kiingereza. Neno lililotumiwa hapa linamaanisha neema, kuondoka, nia ya kazi katika ustawi wa mtu mwingine. Yohana alitumia neno lile lile kuelezea ni kiasi gani Mungu anatupenda [Yohana 3:16; 1 Yohana 4:9-11. Yesu alitumia neno hilo kuzungumza juu ya kumpenda Mungu na kumpenda jirani ya mtu kama mtu anavyojipenda mwenyewe [Marko 12:30-31]. Paulo alitumia neno hilo kuelezea jinsi mume anapaswa kutenda kwa mke wake [Efe. 5:25]. Tunapaswa kuwapenda maadui wetu kama vile Mungu anavyotupenda na vile vile tunapenda mtu mwingine yeyote, pamoja na wake zetu na Mungu. Mtafsiri lazima awe na sababu nzuri ikiwa ametumia neno tofauti kwa upendo katika mstari huu kuliko vile angelitumia katika muktadha huo mwingine. Tazama "upendo" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~27#Note:How should a person who follows Jesus treat his enemies?

trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Anataka uovu na mateso yaingie katika maisha yako, kwa hivyo anauliza viumbe vya roho, iwe Mungu au roho mbaya, kukuumiza au kukuletea shida. Hii ni kinyume kabisa na maana ya "baraka".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~28#Answer:What do you think that a person will say or do if he is cursing you?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~28#Note:What do you think that a person will say or do if he is cursing you?-1852184625
trans-unit.source: See "curse" in KBT in the "bless, blessed, blessing" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia "laana" katika KBT katika "baraka, baraka, baraka" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~28#Note:What do you think that a person will say or do if he is cursing you?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.31+What did Jesus say is a good way to remember how we are to show love to such people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~31#Question:What did Jesus say is a good way to remember how we are to show love to such people?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say is a good way to remember how we are to show love to such people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni njia gani nzuri ya kukumbuka jinsi tunavyopaswa kuwaonyesha upendo watu kama hao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~31#Question:What did Jesus say is a good way to remember how we are to show love to such people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~31#Answer:What did Jesus say is a good way to remember how we are to show love to such people?-1690697825
trans-unit.source: We should do for other people what we want them to do for us. (31)
trans-unit.target: Tunapaswa kuwatendea wengine yale ambayo tungependa watufanyie sisi. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~31#Answer:What did Jesus say is a good way to remember how we are to show love to such people?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.32-33+Why did Jesus not praise people who show love or do good only to those who have already done the same for them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~32#Question:Why did Jesus not praise people who show love or do good only to those who have already done the same for them?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus not praise people who show love or do good only to those who have already done the same for them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hakuwasifu watu wanaoonyesha upendo au kuwatendea mema wale tu ambao tayari wamewatendea hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~32#Question:Why did Jesus not praise people who show love or do good only to those who have already done the same for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~32#Answer:Why did Jesus not praise people who show love or do good only to those who have already done the same for them?-174392627
trans-unit.source: Even people who do not try to obey God, do that. (32-33)
trans-unit.target: Hata watu wasiojaribu kumtii Mungu, hufanya hivyo. (32-33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~32#Answer:Why did Jesus not praise people who show love or do good only to those who have already done the same for them?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.34+What if you lend something to another person knowing that he will repay you?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~34#Question:What if you lend something to another person knowing that he will repay you?
trans-unit.source: What if you lend something to another person knowing that he will repay you?
trans-unit.target: Namna gani ukimkopesha mtu mwingine kitu fulani huku ukijua kwamba atakurudishia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~34#Question:What if you lend something to another person knowing that he will repay you?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~34#Answer:What if you lend something to another person knowing that he will repay you?1788372162
trans-unit.source: That, too, is not any different from what any non-Christian would do. You will not receive any special credit from God for doing that. (34)
trans-unit.target: Na hayo si mbali na yale ambayo asiyeamini angeliyafanya, wala nyinyi hamtapata sifa yoyote mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~34#Answer:What if you lend something to another person knowing that he will repay you?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.35+Jesus said that we are to love our enemies, do good to them (27) and lend things to them without expecting to get anything back (30). If we do like that, what will be the result?

trans-unit.source: Jesus said that we are to love our enemies, do good to them (27) and lend things to them without expecting to get anything back (30). If we do like that, what will be the result?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba tunapaswa kuwapenda adui zetu, kuwafanyia mema (27) na kuwakopesha bila kutarajia kurudishiwa (30). Tukifanya hivyo, matokeo yatakuwa nini?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~35#Answer:Jesus said that we are to love our enemies, do good to them (27) and lend things to them without expecting to get anything back (30). If we do like that, what will be the result?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~35#Answer:Jesus said that we are to love our enemies, do good to them (27) and lend things to them without expecting to get anything back (30). If we do like that, what will be the result?1424271282

group.id: Q:LUK 6.35-36+Why will we be regarded as his children for doing like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~35#Question:Why will we be regarded as his children for doing like that?
trans-unit.source: Why will we be regarded as his children for doing like that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini tutatambuliwa kuwa watoto wake kwa kufanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~35#Question:Why will we be regarded as his children for doing like that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~35#Answer:Why will we be regarded as his children for doing like that?-872512339
trans-unit.source: We will be doing as our heavenly Father, God, does. He is kind and compassionate, even to the people who are ungrateful and wicked. (35-36)
trans-unit.target: Tutakuwa tukifanya kama vile Baba yetu wa kimbingu, Mungu, afanyavyo. Yeye ni mwenye fadhili na huruma, hata kwa watu wasio na shukrani na waovu. (35-36)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~35#Answer:Why will we be regarded as his children for doing like that?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!6~37#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 6:37-42 People should not judge others.
trans-unit.target: Luka 6:37-42 Watu hawapaswi kuwahukumu wengine.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 6.37-42+What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~37#Question:What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu watu wanaohukumu matendo na nia za wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Question:What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~37#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?-2058526717
trans-unit.source: He said that they are like blind people trying to show other blind people the right way (39).
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wao ni kama vipofu wanajaribu kuwaongoza vipofu wengine katika njia sahihi (39).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~37#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?699518237
trans-unit.source: They are hypocrites because they have the same problems in even greater amounts, but do not pay attention to them (42). (They are no help to anyone.)
trans-unit.target: Wao ni wanafiki kwa sababu wana matatizo yale yale kwa kiasi kikubwa zaidi, lakini hawajali (42). (Hawafai mtu yeyote.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who judge the actions and motives of others?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.37-38+What does it mean to judge someone?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~37#Question:What does it mean to judge someone?
trans-unit.source: What does it mean to judge someone?
trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha nini kumhukumu mtu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Question:What does it mean to judge someone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~37#Answer:What does it mean to judge someone?2061558114
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A person sees or hears something about that other person, evaluates it, and decides how he will act towards that other person. Usually the person who judges assumes a position of authority [and superiority] over the one he is judging.
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno kuu: Mtu huona au kusikia jambo fulani kuhusu mtu mwingine, hulikadiria, na kuamua jinsi atakavyotenda kuelekea mtu huyo mwingine.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Answer:What does it mean to judge someone?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~37#Note:What does it mean to judge someone?244876058
trans-unit.source: See "judge, judgment" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "hakimu, hukumu" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Note:What does it mean to judge someone?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.37-38+In what ways can one show God's mercy to another person?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~37#Question:In what ways can one show God's mercy to another person?
trans-unit.source: In what ways can one show God's mercy to another person?
trans-unit.target: Mtu aweza kuonyesha rehema ya Mungu kwa mtu mwingine katika njia zipi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Question:In what ways can one show God's mercy to another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~37#Answer:In what ways can one show God's mercy to another person?-1812739691
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that we are not to judge the other person['s motives] or condemn him/her, that is, we are not to decide what is an appropriate punishment for that person. We should forgive that person (37) and be generous to them (38). That will show God's mercy.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba hatupaswi kumhukumu mtu mwingine [nia zake] au kumhukumu, yaani, hatupaswi kuamua ni adhabu gani inayofaa kwa mtu huyo. Tunapaswa kumsamehe mtu huyo (37) na kuwa wakarimu kwao (38). Hiyo itaonyesha rehema ya Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Answer:In what ways can one show God's mercy to another person?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.37-38+If we do not judge others, but forgive them, how will God act toward us?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~37#Question:If we do not judge others, but forgive them, how will God act toward us?
trans-unit.source: If we do not judge others, but forgive them, how will God act toward us?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa hatuwahukumu wengine, bali tunawaachia wengine, Mungu atatutendeaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Question:If we do not judge others, but forgive them, how will God act toward us?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~37#Answer:If we do not judge others, but forgive them, how will God act toward us?-734763807
trans-unit.source: He will not judge or condemn us, but will forgive us (37). He will be generous to us (to the same degree that we have been generous to others). He will give us even more, in return, than we might have expected (38).
trans-unit.target: Yeye hatatuhukumu au kutuhukumu, lakini atatusamehe (37). Atakuwa mkarimu kwetu (kwa kiwango kile kile ambacho tumekuwa wakarimu kwa wengine). Atatupa hata zaidi, kwa kurudi, kuliko vile tunavyoweza kutarajia (38).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Answer:If we do not judge others, but forgive them, how will God act toward us?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.38+What did Jesus say that tells you that God will be generous to us?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~38#Question:What did Jesus say that tells you that God will be generous to us?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that tells you that God will be generous to us?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini ambacho hukuambia kwamba Mungu atakuwa mkarimu kwetu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~38#Question:What did Jesus say that tells you that God will be generous to us?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~38#Answer:What did Jesus say that tells you that God will be generous to us?1520825287
trans-unit.source: He spoke about a good/full measure, about pressing the things down [in the container], about shaking the things together and about extra things spilling over [the edge of the container]. (38)
trans-unit.target: Alizungumza juu ya kipimo kizuri/kamili, juu ya kusukuma vitu [katika chombo], juu ya kutikisa vitu pamoja na juu ya vitu vya ziada kumwagika [kando ya chombo]. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~38#Answer:What did Jesus say that tells you that God will be generous to us?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.37-38+What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~37#Question:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu anayeuza nafaka (6:38) angeimimina kwenye mapaja ya mnunuzi/juu ya mavazi ya mnunuzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Question:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~37#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?-1641872680
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu aliyekuwa akiuza nafaka (6:38) aliimimina kwenye mapaja ya mnunuzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~37#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?-236207941
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it onto the buyer's clothing?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu aliyekuwa akiuza nafaka (6:38) aliimwaga juu ya vazi la mnunuzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~37#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?808357123
trans-unit.source: The seller did that in order that the buyer could carry the grain away. (Also, the grain would be too much to carry in cupped hands.)
trans-unit.target: Alifanya hivyo ili mnunuzi aweze kubeba nafaka (na pia ili iwe nyingi sana kuichukua kwa mikono miwili).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~37#Note:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?409868957
trans-unit.source: In the Jewish culture of Jesus's time the people wore loose-fitting clothing. Some folds of extra cloth were spread wide at times to be used to carry such things as grain. See TN for Luke 6:38.
trans-unit.target: Katika utamaduni wa Kiyahudi wa wakati wa Yesu watu walivaa nguo za kutosha. Baadhi ya vipande vya nguo za ziada zilikuwa zimeenea kwa wakati mwingine kutumika kubeba vitu kama vile nafaka. Tazama TN kwa Luka 6:38.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~37#Note:What do you think was the reason that the person selling the grain (6:38) would pour it into the buyer's lap/onto the buyer's clothing?

trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ingekuwaje ikiwa kipofu angemfuata kipofu mwingine?

trans-unit.target: Hakuna mtu atakayeona shimo, kwa hiyo wote wawili wataanguka ndani yake.

group.id: Q:LUK 6.40+What other picture language did Jesus use to show us how we are to know what to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~40#Question:What other picture language did Jesus use to show us how we are to know what to do?
trans-unit.source: What other picture language did Jesus use to show us how we are to know what to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia lugha gani nyingine ya kielezi kutuonyesha jinsi tunavyopaswa kujua jambo la kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~40#Question:What other picture language did Jesus use to show us how we are to know what to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~40#Answer:What other picture language did Jesus use to show us how we are to know what to do?265963607
trans-unit.source: He talked about a student learning all that he is able to learn from his teacher. Then he would be like his teacher. (40)
trans-unit.target: Alisema juu ya mwanafunzi kujifunza yote awezayo kujifunza kutoka kwa mwalimu wake. Kisha angekuwa kama mwalimu wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~40#Answer:What other picture language did Jesus use to show us how we are to know what to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.39-40+To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~39#Question:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu mtu aliyepofushwa [katika mstari wa 39]?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~39#Question:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~39#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?-634627551
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man in verse 39?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu yule mtu kipofu katika mstari wa 39?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~39#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!6~39#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?-89919514
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu yule mtu aliyepofuka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~39#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~39#Answer:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?812776972
trans-unit.source: The blind man represents any one who does not know what is the right thing to do. If we follow such a person, we will be just like them. That is, we will not know what is right and will probably get hurt, besides.
trans-unit.target: Mtu kipofu anawakilisha mtu yeyote ambaye hajui jambo sahihi la kufanya. Tukimfuata mtu kama huyo, tutakuwa kama wao tu. Hiyo ni, hatutajua ni nini sahihi na labda tutaumia, zaidi ya hayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~39#Answer:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!6~39#Note:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?-2116512359
trans-unit.source: Jesus may have been referring to Jewish leaders who did not accept that God had sent him to be the savior. Whoever followed their leading would also not believe in him.
trans-unit.target: Huenda Yesu alikuwa akirejezea viongozi Wayahudi ambao hawakukubali kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemtuma kuwa mwokozi. Yeyote ambaye angefuata uongozi wao hangemwamini pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~39#Note:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he talked about a blind man [in verse 39]?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.41+What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~41#Question:What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini katika lugha yake ya mfano kuhusu chembe ya mchanga na ubao mzima?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~41#Question:What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?-897614821
trans-unit.source: A person with a plank in his own eye sees a speck of sawdust/wheat chaff in another person's eye and offers help, not even noticing his own bigger problem. (41)
trans-unit.target: Mtu aliye na ubao katika jicho lake mwenyewe huona chembe ya vumbi la kuonea/mchanga wa ngano katika jicho la mtu mwingine na kutoa msaada, bila hata kutambua tatizo lake mwenyewe lililo kubwa zaidi. (41)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?3905308
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Jesus said that the man with the small thing in his eye was the other man's "brother". If the translation uses the kin term for brother, ask about whom one calls his "brother" in that culture. If that word refers only to people who are one's blood relatives, suggest using a term with a wider meaning. The Greek word for "brother" included a wider sense of referring to other men with whom one interacted regularly, such as one's neighbor. See "the brothers" in KBT in the "disciple" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Yesu alisema kwamba mtu mwenye kitu kidogo katika jicho lake alikuwa "ndugu" ya mtu mwingine. Ikiwa tafsiri hutumia neno la jamaa kwa ndugu, uliza juu ya nani mtu anaita "ndugu" yake katika utamaduni huo. Ikiwa neno hilo linarejelea tu watu ambao ni jamaa za damu, pendekeza kutumia neno na maana pana. Neno la Kigiriki la "ndugu" lilijumuisha maana pana ya kurejelea wanaume wengine ambao mtu aliingiliana nao mara kwa mara, kama vile jirani yake. Tazama "ndugu" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "mwanafunzi".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus say in his picture language about a speck of sawdust and an entire plank?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.41-42+What do you think that Jesus wanted us to learn from this picture language?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~41#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted us to learn from this picture language?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus wanted us to learn from this picture language?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka tujifunze nini kutokana na mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~41#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted us to learn from this picture language?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~41#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted us to learn from this picture language?1921711866
trans-unit.source: We do not notice, or try to correct, our own big problems or very bad actions. Instead, we are quick to see other people's small problems and wrong actions and tell them what to do, as though we are better than they are.
trans-unit.target: Hatuoni, au hatujaribu kurekebisha, matatizo yetu wenyewe makubwa au matendo mabaya sana. Badala yake, sisi ni wepesi kuona matatizo madogo ya watu wengine na matendo mabaya na kuwaambia nini cha kufanya, kana kwamba sisi ni bora kuliko wao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~41#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted us to learn from this picture language?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!6~43#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 6:43-45 Jesus told a parable about recognizing a tree by its fruit.
trans-unit.target: Luka 6:43-45 Yesu alitoa mfano kuhusu kutambulisha mti kwa matunda yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~43#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 6.43-45+How did Jesus compare trees and their fruit to people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~43#Question:How did Jesus compare trees and their fruit to people?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus compare trees and their fruit to people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganishaje miti na matunda yayo na watu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~43#Question:How did Jesus compare trees and their fruit to people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~43#Answer:How did Jesus compare trees and their fruit to people?556975733
trans-unit.source: We can know the true inner character of a person by his/her words and actions (45), just as we can tell the quality of a tree by looking at its fruit (43-44). // In the same way that fruit can only be as good as the tree which produces it (43-44), a person's words and actions will reflect what is in his/her heart (45).
trans-unit.target: Tunaweza kujua tabia ya kweli ya ndani ya mtu kwa maneno yake na matendo (45), kama vile tunaweza kujua ubora wa mti kwa kuangalia matunda yake (43-44). // Kwa njia ile ile ambayo matunda yanaweza kuwa nzuri tu kama mti ambao huzaa (43-44), maneno na matendo ya mtu yataonyesha kile kilicho moyoni mwake (45).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~43#Answer:How did Jesus compare trees and their fruit to people?

group.id: Q:LUK 6.43-44+What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~43#Question:What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu miti na matunda yake katika mfano huu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~43#Question:What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~43#Answer:What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?-1395272726
trans-unit.source: He said that good trees produce good fruit and bad trees have bad fruit. Therefore, one can know whether a tree is good or bad just by looking at its fruit. (43-44)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba miti mizuri huzaa matunda mazuri na miti mibaya huzaa matunda mabaya. Kwa hiyo, mtu anaweza kujua kama mti ni mzuri au mbaya kwa kuangalia tu matunda yake. (43-44)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~43#Answer:What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~43#Answer:What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?1355069392
trans-unit.source: Also, the specific kind of fruit depends on the kind of tree on which it is growing. (44)
trans-unit.target: Pia, aina ya matunda hutegemea aina ya mti ambayo inakua juu yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~43#Answer:What did Jesus say about trees and their fruit in this parable?

trans-unit.source: He said that good people have good qualities in their hearts and those are seen in their behavior. Evil people have evil thoughts in their hearts and those are seen in their evil behavior. A person's words show the kind of thoughts which are in his/her heart. (45)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kuwa watu wema wana sifa nzuri mioyoni mwao na hizo zinaonekana katika tabia zao. Watu wabaya wana mawazo mabaya mioyoni mwao na hayo yanaonekana katika tabia zao mbaya. Maneno ya mtu yanaonyesha aina ya mawazo ambayo yapo moyoni mwake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~45#Answer:What did he say about people and their character and behavior/actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~46#Answer:How did Jesus use the example of the base/foundation for a house to show us how people ought to respond to Jesus's teaching?-2131366408
trans-unit.source: Those who set their way of living [and their faith] on a good, firm basis which will last, do so when they not only hear the words of Jesus, but also obey them.
trans-unit.target: Wale ambao huweka njia yao ya maisha [na imani yao] juu ya msingi mzuri, thabiti, utakaodumu, hufanya hivyo wanaposikia maneno ya Yesu na pia kuyatii.
