group.id: Q:LUK 6.49+What happens when troubles come to such a house or such a person?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!6~49#Question:What happens when troubles come to such a house or such a person?
trans-unit.source: What happens when troubles come to such a house or such a person?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hutukia wakati taabu zinapokuja katika nyumba kama hiyo au kwa mtu kama huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~49#Question:What happens when troubles come to such a house or such a person?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!6~49#Answer:What happens when troubles come to such a house or such a person?-410927314
trans-unit.source: The house does not stand firm. It collapses and is totally destroyed. [Likewise, the troubles destroy a person who does not base his life on Jesus. He will suffer in hell forever].(49)
trans-unit.target: Nyumba hiyo haisimami. Inaanguka na kuharibiwa kabisa. [Vivyo hivyo, shida zinaharibu mtu ambaye haitegemei maisha yake kwa Yesu. Atateseka milele katika moto wa Jehanamu.]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!6~49#Answer:What happens when troubles come to such a house or such a person?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!7~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 7:1-10 Jesus healed the sick and dying slave of a Roman army officer.
trans-unit.target: Luka 7:1-10 Yesu alimponya mtumwa mgonjwa wa ofisa Mroma aliyekuwa karibu kufa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 7.1-10+What did Jesus do to help a Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~1#Question:What did Jesus do to help a Roman army officer?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do to help a Roman army officer?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini ili kumsaidia ofisa Mroma wa jeshi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Question:What did Jesus do to help a Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~1#Answer:What did Jesus do to help a Roman army officer?964091347
trans-unit.source: He healed his servant/slave who was sick and dying [without going directly to the man]. (6, 10)
trans-unit.target: Alimponya mtumishi/mtumwa wake aliyekuwa mgonjwa na karibu kufa [bila kwenda moja kwa moja kwa mtu huyo] (6, 10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Answer:What did Jesus do to help a Roman army officer?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.1-10+Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~1#Question:Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?
trans-unit.source: Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wazee Wayahudi walitaka Yesu amsaidie yule ofisa wa jeshi la Roma?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Question:Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~1#Answer:Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?-843579613
trans-unit.source: They said that the officer loved their Jewish people
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba ofisa huyo aliwapenda Wayahudi wenzake
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Answer:Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~1#Answer:Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?-1913934518
trans-unit.source: and that he even had helped much to build a synagogue for them. (4-5)
trans-unit.target: na kwamba hata alikuwa amesaidia sana kujenga sinagogi kwao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Answer:Why did the Jewish elders want Jesus to help the Roman army officer?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.1-10+What was the real reason that Jesus helped the army officer, even though he was not a Jew?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~1#Question:What was the real reason that Jesus helped the army officer, even though he was not a Jew?
trans-unit.source: What was the real reason that Jesus helped the army officer, even though he was not a Jew?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alimsaidia ofisa wa jeshi, ingawa hakuwa Myahudi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Question:What was the real reason that Jesus helped the army officer, even though he was not a Jew?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~1#Answer:What was the real reason that Jesus helped the army officer, even though he was not a Jew?-231843156
trans-unit.source: Jesus knew that the officer had great faith in him [to heal his servant]. (9)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijua kwamba ofisa huyo alikuwa na imani kubwa katika yeye [kumponya mtumishi wake]. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Answer:What was the real reason that Jesus helped the army officer, even though he was not a Jew?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.2-3+What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~2#Question:What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kilichomfanya ofisa mmoja wa jeshi la Roma amtume Yesu ujumbe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~2#Question:What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~2#Answer:What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?1443800541
trans-unit.source: The servant/slave of the army officer was sick and about to die (2), and the officer heard about Jesus [either that he healed the sick, or that he had returned to Capernaum] (3).
trans-unit.target: Mtumishi/mtumwa wa ofisa wa jeshi alikuwa mgonjwa karibu kufa (2), na ofisa huyo alisikia juu ya Yesu [ama kwamba aliponya wagonjwa, au kwamba alikuwa amerudi Kapernaumu] (3).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~2#Answer:What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~2#Answer:What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?-1745296966
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See 1:38 above for the meaning of "servant" and "slave".
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Ona 1:38 hapo juu kwa maana ya "mtumishi" na "mtumwa".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~2#Answer:What happened that caused a Roman army officer to send a message to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.2+Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?

trans-unit.source: Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwanamume huyo muhimu katika jeshi hata alifikiria mtumishi/mtumwa?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~2#Alternate:Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~2#Alternate:Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?1790725256
trans-unit.source: Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a slave?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwanamume huyo wa cheo cha juu katika jeshi hata alifikiria kumpata mtumwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~2#Alternate:Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~2#Answer:Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?314159533
trans-unit.source: He loved/respected/valued this young man. (2)
trans-unit.target: Alimpenda/alimheshimu/alimthamini kijana huyo. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~2#Answer:Why was this important man in the army even thinking about a servant/slave?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.3+Whom did this army officer send with his message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~3#Question:Whom did this army officer send with his message to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Whom did this army officer send with his message to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo wa jeshi alimtuma nani amwambie Yesu ujumbe wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~3#Question:Whom did this army officer send with his message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~3#Answer:Whom did this army officer send with his message to Jesus?1974909848
trans-unit.source: He sent some elders of the Jews. (3)
trans-unit.target: Aliwatuma baadhi ya wazee wa Wayahudi. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~3#Answer:Whom did this army officer send with his message to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.1-6+What do you think was the reason that the Roman army officer sent those men and not other Romans or himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~1#Question:What do you think was the reason that the Roman army officer sent those men and not other Romans or himself?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the Roman army officer sent those men and not other Romans or himself?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini ofisa huyo Mroma aliwatuma wanaume hao badala ya Waroma wengine au yeye mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Question:What do you think was the reason that the Roman army officer sent those men and not other Romans or himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~1#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Roman army officer sent those men and not other Romans or himself?-1266870159
trans-unit.source: Perhaps he thought that Jesus would listen to elders of his own Jewish people more than to someone who was not a Jew.
trans-unit.target: Labda alifikiri kwamba Yesu angesikiliza wazee wa watu wake mwenyewe Wayahudi kuliko mtu asiye Myahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~1#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Roman army officer sent those men and not other Romans or himself?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.3+What message did this army officer send to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~3#Question:What message did this army officer send to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What message did this army officer send to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo wa jeshi alimpelekea Yesu ujumbe gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~3#Question:What message did this army officer send to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~3#Answer:What message did this army officer send to Jesus?1962305828
trans-unit.source: He wanted Jesus to come and heal his servant. (3)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka Yesu aje na kumponya mtumishi wake. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~3#Answer:What message did this army officer send to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.4+How do you know that those Jewish leaders also wanted Jesus to help this Roman man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~4#Question:How do you know that those Jewish leaders also wanted Jesus to help this Roman man?
trans-unit.source: How do you know that those Jewish leaders also wanted Jesus to help this Roman man?
trans-unit.target: Wajuaje kwamba viongozi hao Wayahudi walitaka pia Yesu amsaidie mtu huyu Mroma?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~4#Question:How do you know that those Jewish leaders also wanted Jesus to help this Roman man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~4#Answer:How do you know that those Jewish leaders also wanted Jesus to help this Roman man?-655497811
trans-unit.source: The words "kept on urging"/"earnestly asked"/"strongly requested" mean that those Jewish leaders wanted Jesus to help the man. They said that he was worthy [in their thinking] to have Jesus help him. (4)
trans-unit.target: Maneno "wakaendelea kumsihi"/"wakaendelea kuomba kwa bidii"/"wakaendelea kuomba kwa bidii" yanamaanisha kwamba viongozi hao Wayahudi walitaka Yesu amsaidie mtu huyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~4#Answer:How do you know that those Jewish leaders also wanted Jesus to help this Roman man?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.6+Whom did this army officer send with another message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~6#Question:Whom did this army officer send with another message to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Whom did this army officer send with another message to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyu wa jeshi alimtuma nani mwingine kwa Yesu akiwa na ujumbe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Question:Whom did this army officer send with another message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~6#Answer:Whom did this army officer send with another message to Jesus?-288588299
trans-unit.source: He sent some of his friends. (6b)
trans-unit.target: Aliwatuma baadhi ya marafiki wake (6b).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Answer:Whom did this army officer send with another message to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~6#Question:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini yule ofisa wa jeshi mwenyewe hakutaka kumsumbua Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Question:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~6#Alternate:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?363158739
trans-unit.source: Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience for Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini yule ofisa wa jeshi hakutaka kumsumbua Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Alternate:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~6#Alternate:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?539390048
trans-unit.source: Why did the army officer himself not want to cause any problem for Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini yule ofisa wa jeshi hakutaka kumsumbua Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Alternate:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~6#Answer:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?867900033
trans-unit.source: He did not feel worthy/good enough to either speak with Jesus or to have Jesus come inside his home. (6b-7)
trans-unit.target: Hakujisikia kuwa anastahili/mzuri wa kutosha kuzungumza na Yesu au kumkaribisha Yesu nyumbani kwake (6b-7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Answer:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~6#Note:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?871290814
trans-unit.source: He also may not have wanted to cause a cultural problem for Jesus, because he knew that it was taboo for a Jew to enter the house of a non-Jew.
trans-unit.target: Huenda pia hakutaka kumfanya Yesu awe na tatizo la kitamaduni, kwa sababu alijua kwamba ilikuwa ni jambo lisilopatana na akili kwa Myahudi kuingia katika nyumba ya mtu asiye Myahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~6#Note:Why did the army officer himself not want to inconvenience/cause any problem for Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.7+How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?

trans-unit.source: How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~7#Question:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~7#Alternate:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?-550460234
trans-unit.source: How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo wa jeshi alitarajiaje kwamba Yesu angemponya mtumishi wake ikiwa Yesu hangeingia ndani ya nyumba ambamo mtu huyo mgonjwa alikuwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~7#Alternate:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~7#Alternate:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?1538751091
trans-unit.source: How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo wa jeshi alitarajiaje kwamba Yesu angemponya mtumwa wake ikiwa Yesu hangeingia ndani ya nyumba ambamo mtu huyo mgonjwa alikuwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~7#Alternate:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~7#Answer:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?1036797142
trans-unit.source: He believed that Jesus needed only to speak [the words of healing from wherever he was] and the sick man would be well again. (7)
trans-unit.target: Aliamini kwamba Yesu alihitaji tu kusema [maneno ya uponyaji kutoka mahali popote alipokuwa] na mtu huyo mgonjwa angekuwa mzima tena. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~7#Answer:How did the army officer expect Jesus to heal the servant/slave if Jesus did not go inside the house where that sick man was?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.8+How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~8#Question:How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?
trans-unit.source: How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo wa jeshi alijuaje kwamba Yesu angeweza kumponya mtumishi wake kwa kusema tu kwamba mtu huyo angepona?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~8#Question:How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~8#Answer:How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?1398496518
trans-unit.source: He knew how authority worked. // He was under some higher authority and others were under his authority. When someone with authority spoke, that command was carried out. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alijua jinsi mamlaka ilifanya kazi. // Alikuwa chini ya mamlaka ya juu na wengine walikuwa chini ya mamlaka yake. Wakati mtu mwenye mamlaka alizungumza, amri hiyo ilifanywa. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~8#Answer:How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~8#Note:How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?173428539
trans-unit.source: By saying this, he showed that he believed that Jesus had been given authority by God over sickness. When Jesus spoke, the sickness would have to end/leave.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kusema hivyo, alionyesha kwamba aliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa amepewa mamlaka na Mungu juu ya ugonjwa. Yesu aliposema, ugonjwa ungekoma/kuondoka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~8#Note:How did the army officer know that Jesus could heal his servant just by saying that the man was to become well?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.9+How did Jesus react to the words of the Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~9#Question:How did Jesus react to the words of the Roman army officer?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus react to the words of the Roman army officer?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje maneno ya yule ofisa wa jeshi Mroma?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~9#Question:How did Jesus react to the words of the Roman army officer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~9#Answer:How did Jesus react to the words of the Roman army officer?424416512
trans-unit.source: He was amazed and told the crowd of people that he had not found [any other person with] great faith like that, not even among the people of Israel. (9) (He knew that this kind of strong faith did not normally happen even among the Jews who had God's Word and who had Jesus himself in their midst.)
trans-unit.target: Alishangaa na kuambia umati wa watu kwamba hakuwa amepata [mtu mwingine yeyote mwenye] imani kubwa kama hiyo, hata miongoni mwa watu wa Israeli. (9) (Alijua kwamba imani yenye nguvu ya aina hiyo haikutukia kwa kawaida hata miongoni mwa Wayahudi waliokuwa na Neno la Mungu na waliokuwa na Yesu mwenyewe miongoni mwao.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~9#Answer:How did Jesus react to the words of the Roman army officer?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.9-10+What does it mean that someone believes/has faith in another person?

trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha nini kwamba mtu anaamini/ana imani katika mtu mwingine?

trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha nini kwamba mtu fulani amwamini mtu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~9#Alternate:What does it mean that someone believes/has faith in another person?

trans-unit.source: What does it mean that someone has faith in another person?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~9#Alternate:What does it mean that someone believes/has faith in another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~9#Answer:What does it mean that someone believes/has faith in another person?-841829499
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means that he believes what that person told him and that he trusts that person to do just as he said that he would do. (See "faith" in KBT in the "believe" entry. Also see 5:22, above.)
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno Angalia: Ina maana kwamba anaamini kile mtu huyo alimwambia na kwamba anaamini mtu huyo kufanya kama vile alisema kwamba angefanya. (Ona "imani" katika KBT katika "kuamini" kuingia. Pia ona 5: 22 hapo juu.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~9#Answer:What does it mean that someone believes/has faith in another person?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~12#Alternate:What did they all see happening as they came near the gate/entranceway in the town wall?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~12#Answer:What did they all see happening as they came near the gate/entranceway in the town wall?-650622292
trans-unit.source: Men were carrying out a dead person [on a stretcher], and many townspeople were with them. (12)
trans-unit.target: Watu walikuwa wakimtoa mtu aliyekufa [katika kitanda], na watu wengi wa mji walikuwa pamoja nao. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~12#Answer:What did they all see happening as they came near the gate/entranceway in the town wall?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~12#Note:What did they all see happening as they came near the gate/entranceway in the town wall?2045350933
trans-unit.source: If the language requires that the manner of carrying a dead person be named, use the appropriate cultural name for such a stretcher or platform. The translation must not imply that the men carried the corpse in their bare hands, even if it was wrapped in cloth. That was taboo for a Jew.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa lugha inahitaji njia ya kubeba maiti ielezwe, tumia jina linalofaa la kitamaduni kwa ajili ya mkeka au jukwaa kama hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~12#Note:What did they all see happening as they came near the gate/entranceway in the town wall?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.11-13+What do you think made this especially sad for the woman?

trans-unit.source: The young man owed his life to Jesus. In wanting to show his never-ending thankfulness to Jesus, the young man might have followed the cultural practice of being like a slave to the one who had saved him. Jesus released the young man from that sense of debt and "gave him back to his mother."
trans-unit.target: Alipotaka kumwonyesha Yesu shukrani yake isiyo na mwisho, huenda kijana huyo alifuata desturi ya kitamaduni ya kuwa kama mtumwa kwa yule aliyemwokoa. Yesu alimwondolea kijana huyo hisia hiyo ya deni na 'kumrudisha kwa mama yake.'
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~14#Note:What do you think it means in 7:15 that "Jesus gave him back to his mother"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~14#Note:What do you think it means in 7:15 that "Jesus gave him back to his mother"?866551347

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~14#Note:What do you think it means in 7:15 that "Jesus gave him back to his mother"?2042597015
trans-unit.source: When the woman's son died, he "left" his mother. When Jesus made the young man alive again, it was as if Jesus was giving a gift to the mother.
trans-unit.target: Mwana wa mwanamke huyo alipokufa, 'alimwacha' mama yake. Yesu alipomfufua kijana huyo, ilikuwa kana kwamba alimpa mama yake zawadi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~14#Note:What do you think it means in 7:15 that "Jesus gave him back to his mother"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~16#Note:How did they now regard Jesus?-198292635
trans-unit.source: If the translation refers to God "visiting" his people, ask what that means when someone who speaks that language does that action in the village. If the primary meaning is to stay with someone you have not seen for a while, suggest a change in terms. The original Greek word had much more focus on coming to care for or look after someone else. The word strongly implies that the visitor takes a continuous responsibility for the one/ones being visited.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa tafsiri inahusu Mungu "kutembelea" watu wake, uliza nini maana yake wakati mtu anayezungumza lugha hiyo anafanya kitendo hicho kijijini. Ikiwa maana ya msingi ni kukaa na mtu ambaye haujaona kwa muda, pendekeza mabadiliko katika masharti. Neno la asili la Kigiriki lilikuwa na umakini zaidi juu ya kuja kumtunza au kumtazama mtu mwingine. Neno hilo linaonyesha kwa nguvu kwamba mgeni anachukua jukumu la kuendelea kwa yule / wale wanaotembelewa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~16#Note:How did they now regard Jesus?

trans-unit.source: The meaning of the Greek verb katharizw includes both physical cleanness and ritual cleanness (see L&N entry 23.137). A different word is used in verse 21 to refer only to being healed. The translation may need to use two verbs to cover all the meaning here. (See the discussion at 5:12-16 about leprosy and people being made clean.)
trans-unit.target: Maana ya kitenzi cha Kigiriki katharizw inajumuisha usafi wa kimwili na usafi wa kidesturi (ona L&N entry 23.137). Neno tofauti linatumiwa katika mstari wa 21 kurejelea tu kuponywa. Tafsiri inaweza kuhitaji kutumia vitenzi viwili ili kufunika maana yote hapa. trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~23#Question:What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?
trans-unit.source: What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?
trans-unit.target: Ni mtu wa aina gani aliyesema Yesu angekuwa mwenye furaha kwelikweli alipofikiria mambo yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa akifanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~23#Question:What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~23#Answer:What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?395035594
trans-unit.source: That person is one who does not stop believing that Jesus was the Messiah whom God had sent into the world. (23)
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo ni yule ambaye haachi kuamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa ndiye Masihi ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma ulimwenguni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~23#Answer:What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~23#Note:What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?1665436236
trans-unit.source: Although verse 23 is worded as a general truth and applies to everyone, Jesus was specifically directing this statement to John, just the same as verse 22. If the person answering these questions has not heard or read much about John's ministry in his/her own language, he will probably not realize that John expected the Messiah to do things differently from the way Jesus was doing them. John expected that Jesus would talk more of God's judgment, as John had done, not of God's love. That is the reason that John sent his disciples to ask the important question in verse 19.
trans-unit.target: Ingawa mstari wa 23 umetajwa kama ukweli wa jumla na unatumika kwa kila mtu, Yesu alikuwa akielekeza maneno haya kwa Yohana, sawa na mstari wa 22. Ikiwa mtu anayejibu maswali haya hajasikia au kusoma mengi juu ya huduma ya Yohana katika lugha yake mwenyewe, labda hataelewa kwamba Yohana alitarajia Masihi afanye mambo tofauti na jinsi Yesu alivyofanya. Yohana alitarajia kwamba Yesu angeongea zaidi juu ya hukumu ya Mungu, kama vile Yohana alivyofanya, sio juu ya upendo wa Mungu. Hiyo ndiyo sababu Yohana aliwatuma wanafunzi wake kuuliza swali muhimu katika mstari wa 19.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~23#Note:What kind of person did Jesus say would be truly happy when he thought about all the things that Jesus was doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.24-26+Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~24#Question:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?
trans-unit.source: Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walikuwa wameenda kwenye eneo lisilokaliwa/jangwa/jangwa ili kumwona Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Question:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~24#Alternate:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?-1955793660
trans-unit.source: Why had people gone into the uninhabited area to see John?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walikuwa wametoka kwenda kwenye eneo lisilo na watu ili kumwona Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Alternate:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~24#Alternate:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?-1563571970
trans-unit.source: Why had people gone into the wilderness to see John?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walikuwa wametoka kwenda nyikani kumwona Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Alternate:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~24#Alternate:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?-2032058760
trans-unit.source: Why had people gone into the desert to see John?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walikuwa wametoka kwenda jangwani kumwona Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Alternate:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~24#Answer:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?214959903
trans-unit.source: They went because he was a prophet, even more than an ordinary prophet. (24-26)
trans-unit.target: Walienda kwa sababu alikuwa nabii, hata zaidi ya nabii wa kawaida (24-26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Answer:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~24#Note:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?-445012429
trans-unit.source: There had not been any prophet from God for over 400 years, so many people went to see John out of curiosity, as well.
trans-unit.target: Hakukuwa na nabii yeyote kutoka kwa Mungu kwa zaidi ya miaka 400, kwa hiyo watu wengi walienda kumwona Yohana kwa udadisi pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Note:Why had people gone into the uninhabited area/wilderness/desert to see John?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.24+In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~24#Question:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?
trans-unit.source: In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?
trans-unit.target: Ni katika njia zipi Yohana hakuwa kama tete linalosukumwa na upepo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Question:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~24#Answer:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?-1736384707
trans-unit.source: Reeds are very ordinary plants like stiff grass, which people commonly see as the wind blows them back and forth.
trans-unit.target: Miwa ni mimea ya kawaida sana kama nyasi ngumu, ambayo watu huona mara nyingi upepo unapoipuliza huku na huku.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Answer:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~24#Answer:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Answer:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~24#Answer:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?211286191
trans-unit.source: Wind blows and pushes reeds back and forth in various directions, but John always was strong to preach the same message about repenting. He did not change his message because someone, such as King Herod, did not like to hear it (see 3:19-20).
trans-unit.target: Upepo huvuma na kusukuma matete mbele na nyuma katika mwelekeo tofauti, lakini Yohana alikuwa daima imara kuhubiri ujumbe huo kuhusu kutubu. Yeye hakubadilisha ujumbe wake kwa sababu mtu fulani, kama vile Mfalme Herode, hakupenda kuisikia (tazama 3:19-20).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~24#Answer:In what ways was John not like a reed in the wind?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.25+In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~25#Question:In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?
trans-unit.source: In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?
trans-unit.target: Ni katika njia zipi Yohana hakuwa kama mtu aliyevaa mavazi mazuri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~25#Question:In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~25#Answer:In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?-1634412119
trans-unit.source: People who wear expensive clothes live in large, beautiful, expensive homes, such as a king does. John lived in the desert (see Luke 1:80b).
trans-unit.target: Watu ambao huvaa nguo za bei ghali huishi katika nyumba kubwa, nzuri, na za bei ghali, kama vile mfalme anavyofanya. Yohana aliishi jangwani (ona Luka 1:80b).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~25#Answer:In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~25#Note:In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?1295697245
trans-unit.source: We also know that John wore clothes made from rough camel hair and ate things which he found in the wilderness/desert (see Mark 1:6).
trans-unit.target: Pia tunajua kwamba Yohana alivaa nguo zilizotengenezwa kwa manyoya ya ngamia na kula vitu ambavyo alipata jangwani/nyika (tazama Marko 1:6).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~25#Note:In what ways was John not like a man in fine clothes?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.27+What was the purpose of John's ministry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~27#Question:What was the purpose of John's ministry?
trans-unit.source: What was the purpose of John's ministry?
trans-unit.target: Huduma ya Yohana ilikuwa na kusudi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~27#Question:What was the purpose of John's ministry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~27#Answer:What was the purpose of John's ministry?-318760854
trans-unit.source: God had sent him as a messenger. John was to tell people to prepare their hearts/thoughts [to accept Jesus as the one whom God had sent to save them]. (27)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa amemtuma kama mjumbe. Yohana alikuwa awaambie watu kutayarisha mioyo yao/fikira zao [kulikubali Yesu kama yule ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma kuwaokoa]. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~27#Answer:What was the purpose of John's ministry?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.28+What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that John was greater than anyone else ever born?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~28#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that John was greater than anyone else ever born?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that John was greater than anyone else ever born?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba Yohana alikuwa mkuu kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepata kuzaliwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that John was greater than anyone else ever born?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that John was greater than anyone else ever born?501325293
trans-unit.source: He had the important work of preparing the way for Jesus, the savior of all mankind.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na kazi muhimu ya kumtayarishia njia Yesu, mwokozi wa wanadamu wote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that John was greater than anyone else ever born?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.28+What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~28#Question:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri ni kwa njia gani mtu yeyote aliye mdogo zaidi katika ufalme wa Mungu ni mkuu kuliko Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Question:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?-1793679916
trans-unit.source: John, the greatest one to announce that the kingdom of God had began, was not as great as the least important person who experiences the joy and blessings of Jesus having saved him and who now obeys God as he rules and reigns in that kingdom.
trans-unit.target: Yohana, yule mkuu zaidi kutangaza kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa umeanza, hakuwa mkubwa kama yule mtu wa chini kabisa aliyepata shangwe na baraka za Yesu kwa kuwa alikuwa amemwokoa na ambaye sasa anamtii Mungu anapotawala na kutawala katika ufalme huo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?113425396
trans-unit.source: John regarded himself as a very unworthy servant (see 3:16), but every one who believes that Jesus has saved him/her is a child of God. That is greater than being a servant.
trans-unit.target: Yohana alijiona kuwa mtumishi asiyefaa kabisa (ona 3:16), lakini kila mtu anayeamini kwamba Yesu amemwokoa ni mtoto wa Mungu. Hiyo ni kubwa kuliko kuwa mtumishi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?-472971690
trans-unit.source: John was in the prison and did not live to see Jesus die for mankind's sins and be raised by God to live again. The least important person who knows that those things did take place and believes that is greater (that is, blessed more) than John.
trans-unit.target: Yohana alikuwa gerezani na hakuishi kuona Yesu akifa kwa ajili ya dhambi za wanadamu na kufufuliwa na Mungu kuishi tena. Mtu wa chini kabisa ambaye anajua kwamba mambo hayo yalitokea na anaamini kwamba ni mkubwa (yaani, amebarikiwa zaidi) kuliko Yohana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?-540728436
trans-unit.source: John understood the kingdom of God as focusing on God's final, great judgment of all the world and on the circumstances which surrounded the Jews. Jesus knew that the kingdom was something inside a person, something spiritual and eternal. The least important person who understands that as Jesus did is, therefore, greater than John.
trans-unit.target: Yohana alielewa ufalme wa Mungu kama unazingatia hukumu ya mwisho ya Mungu, kubwa kwa ulimwengu wote na kwa hali iliyowazunguka Wayahudi. Yesu alijua kwamba ufalme ulikuwa kitu ndani ya mtu, kitu cha kiroho na cha milele. Mtu wa chini kabisa ambaye anaelewa kama Yesu alivyofanya, kwa hivyo, ni mkubwa kuliko Yohana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~28#Answer:What do you think is a way in which whoever is least important in the kingdom of God is greater than John?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~29#Alternate:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~29#Answer:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?-981318846
trans-unit.source: Since John had baptized them, they all acknowledged that God's plan was right. [Part of that plan had been that John had helped them to prepare their hearts for the ministry and teaching of Jesus.] (29)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Yohana alikuwa amewabatiza, wote walikiri kwamba mpango wa Mungu ulikuwa sahihi. [Sehemu ya mpango huo ilikuwa kwamba Yohana alikuwa amewasaidia kutayarisha mioyo yao kwa huduma na mafundisho ya Yesu.] (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~29#Answer:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~29#Answer:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~29#Answer:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~29#Answer:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?-1953948059
trans-unit.source: They all agreed that God was just [in his judging their sins and in his claim on their lives], as they had previously shown by their having had John baptize them. (29)
trans-unit.target: Wote walikubaliana kwamba Mungu alikuwa mwenye haki [katika kuhukumu dhambi zao na katika kudai uhai wao], kama walivyokuwa wameonyesha hapo awali kwa kuwa na Yohana kuwabatiza. (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~29#Answer:How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard Jesus speak about John like this? -OR- How did the people, including those who collected taxes, respond when they heard John preach?

trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa Sheria ya Musa waliitikiaje waliposikia Yesu akisema hivi juu ya Yohana/waliposikia Yohana akisema hivi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~30#Question:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~30#Alternate:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?1601892967
trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa Sheria ya Musa waliitikiaje waliposikia Yesu akisema hivyo juu ya Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~30#Alternate:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~30#Alternate:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?982364978
