trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~30#Alternate:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~30#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?916154102
trans-unit.source: They rejected/refused to accept God's purposes/plans for themselves [in Jesus's message], as they had already shown by refusing to have John baptize them. (30)
trans-unit.target: Walikataa/wakakataa kukubali makusudi/mipango ya Mungu kwa ajili yao wenyewe [katika ujumbe wa Yesu], kama walivyokuwa wameonyesha tayari kwa kukataa kubatizwa na Yohana. (30)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~30#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses respond when they heard Jesus speak of John like this/when they heard John speak like this?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.31+Whom did Jesus compare to little children?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~31#Question:Whom did Jesus compare to little children?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus compare to little children?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwalinganisha nani na watoto wadogo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~31#Question:Whom did Jesus compare to little children?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~31#Answer:Whom did Jesus compare to little children?-846720476
trans-unit.source: The people alive at that time [who had seen and heard both John and Jesus]. (31)
trans-unit.target: Watu walioishi wakati huo [waliokuwa wameona na kusikia Yohana na Yesu] (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~31#Answer:Whom did Jesus compare to little children?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.32+In what ways had those people acted like little children?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~32#Question:In what ways had those people acted like little children?
trans-unit.source: In what ways had those people acted like little children?
trans-unit.target: Ni katika njia zipi watu hao walikuwa wametenda kama watoto wadogo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~32#Question:In what ways had those people acted like little children?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~32#Answer:In what ways had those people acted like little children?1642757890
trans-unit.source: They did not like it when someone was serious and did not join in their lighthearted fun,
trans-unit.target: Hawakuipenda wakati mtu alikuwa mbaya na hakuwa kujiunga katika furaha yao lighthearted,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~32#Answer:In what ways had those people acted like little children?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~32#Answer:In what ways had those people acted like little children?1167138890
trans-unit.source: Neither did they like it when someone was joyous, but they felt he should be more serious. (32)
trans-unit.target: Wala hawakupenda wakati mtu alikuwa na furaha, lakini walihisi kwamba anapaswa kuwa na uzito zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~32#Answer:In what ways had those people acted like little children?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.33+To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been serious, but the people had rejected him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~33#Question:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been serious, but the people had rejected him?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been serious, but the people had rejected him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alirejezea nani kuwa yule aliyekuwa mwenye kuchukua mambo kwa uzito, lakini watu walikuwa wamemkataa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Question:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been serious, but the people had rejected him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~33#Answer:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been serious, but the people had rejected him?-379012720
trans-unit.source: He referred to John the Baptizer. (33)
trans-unit.target: Alirejezea Yohana Mbatizaji. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Answer:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been serious, but the people had rejected him?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.33+What did some people see John do that they did not like?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~33#Question:What did some people see John do that they did not like?
trans-unit.source: What did some people see John do that they did not like?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walimwona Yohana akifanya nini ambacho hawakupenda?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Question:What did some people see John do that they did not like?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~33#Answer:What did some people see John do that they did not like?2121945569
trans-unit.source: They did not like him because he did not eat [food] and drink [wine] as they did. (33)
trans-unit.target: Hawakumpenda kwa sababu hakula [chakula] na kunywa [divai] kama wao walivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Answer:What did some people see John do that they did not like?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.33+What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~33#Question:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?
trans-unit.source: What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu hao walimaanisha nini waliposema kwamba Yohana alikuwa na roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Question:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~33#Alternate:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?-1367207293
trans-unit.source: What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon in him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu hao walimaanisha nini waliposema kwamba Yohana ana roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Alternate:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~33#Alternate:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?-1223720372
trans-unit.source: What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu hao walimaanisha nini waliposema kwamba Yohana alikuwa na roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Alternate:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~33#Answer:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?1773456186
trans-unit.source: The way John lived (his clothes, food, home and appearance) caused people to think a demon was living in him and telling him things. (That was not true, but if it were true, the people would be right to not obey John's message, even though he said that it was from God).
trans-unit.target: Njia ya maisha ya Yohana (mavazi yake, chakula, nyumba na sura yake) ilifanya watu wafikiri kwamba roho mwovu alikuwa ndani yake na kumwambia mambo. (Hiyo haikuwa kweli, lakini ikiwa ilikuwa kweli, watu wangekuwa sahihi kutotii ujumbe wa Yohana, hata ingawa alisema kwamba ulitoka kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~33#Answer:What do you think those people meant when they said that John had a demon [in him]?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.34+To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been joyous, but the people had rejected him also?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~34#Question:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been joyous, but the people had rejected him also?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been joyous, but the people had rejected him also?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alirejezea nani kuwa yule aliyekuwa mwenye shangwe, lakini watu walikuwa wamemkataa pia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~34#Question:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been joyous, but the people had rejected him also?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~34#Answer:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been joyous, but the people had rejected him also?636730976
trans-unit.source: He referred to the Son of Man, (that is, he referred to himself). (34)
trans-unit.target: Alirejezea Mwana wa Adamu, (yaani, alirejezea nafsi yake). (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~34#Answer:To whom did Jesus refer as the one who had been joyous, but the people had rejected him also?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.34+What did some people see Jesus do that they did not like?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~34#Question:What did some people see Jesus do that they did not like?
trans-unit.source: What did some people see Jesus do that they did not like?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walimwona Yesu akifanya nini ambacho hawakupenda?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~34#Question:What did some people see Jesus do that they did not like?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~34#Answer:What did some people see Jesus do that they did not like?1716105483
trans-unit.source: They did not like him because he ate and drank with tax collectors and others whom they regarded as sinners [that is, people whom they thought were socially and religiously unacceptable]. (34)
trans-unit.target: Hawakumpenda kwa sababu alikula na kunywa pamoja na wakusanya-kodi na wengineo ambao wao waliwaona kuwa watenda-dhambi [yaani, watu ambao wao waliwaona kuwa hawafai kijamii na kidini]. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~34#Answer:What did some people see Jesus do that they did not like?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.35+How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~35#Question:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?
trans-unit.source: How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?
trans-unit.target: Mtu yeyote angeweza kujuaje kama huduma za Yohana na za Yesu zilikuwa kweli sehemu ya mpango wa Mungu wenye hekima au la?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~35#Question:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?-658070540
trans-unit.source: Those people who obeyed what John and Jesus taught were the ones who lived according to God's will/wise plan for them, [not those people who rejected both John and Jesus]. (35)
trans-unit.target: Wale watu waliotii kile Yohana na Yesu walifundisha walikuwa wale walioishi kulingana na mapenzi ya Mungu/mpango wa hekima kwao, [si wale watu waliokataa wote wawili Yohana na Yesu]. (35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?-1508213978
trans-unit.source: The lives of those who followed the teaching of John and Jesus showed that this was the right/correct way to be in the will of God. (35)
trans-unit.target: Maisha ya wale waliofuata mafundisho ya Yohana na Yesu yalionyesha kwamba hii ilikuwa njia sahihi ya kuwa katika mapenzi ya Mungu. (35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?-1101438567
trans-unit.source: People prove that God's will/wise plan is right when they live according to what John and Jesus taught, and God accepts them, [while he does not accept those people who reject what John and Jesus taught]. (35)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanathibitisha kwamba mapenzi ya Mungu/mpango wa hekima ni sahihi wanapoishi kulingana na kile Yohana na Yesu walifundisha, na Mungu anawakubali, [wakati yeye hakubali wale watu wanaokataa kile Yohana na Yesu walifundisha]. (35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~35#Answer:How could anyone know whether John's and Jesus's ministries were really part of God's wise plan or not?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!7~36#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 7:36-50 A sinful woman anointed Jesus with perfume.
trans-unit.target: Luka 7:36-50 Mwanamke mwenye dhambi alimtia Yesu marashi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 7.36-50+What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~36#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alimruhusu mwanamke huyo, ambaye watu wengine walimwona kuwa mbaya, amguse na kumtia manukato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~36#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?350952137
trans-unit.source: Jesus allowed her to do what she did in order to teach Simon that God forgives anyone who repents.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimruhusu kufanya alichofanya ili amfundishe Simoni kwamba Mungu husamehe mtu yeyote anayetubu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~36#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~36#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?-2108947896
trans-unit.source: She responded with great love for Jesus because she realized that she had sinned much and God had forgiven her. (The more people realize that they have sinned, the happier they are when God forgives them.) (47)
trans-unit.target: Aliitikia kwa upendo mkubwa kwa Yesu kwa sababu alitambua kwamba alikuwa ametenda dhambi nyingi na Mungu alikuwa amemsamehe. (Watu wengi wanapotambua kwamba wamefanya dhambi, wanafurahi zaidi wakati Mungu anawasamehe.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus allowed this woman, whom other people regarded as bad, to touch him and put perfume on him?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.36-50+What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~36#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni kwa sababu gani alimsamehe mwanamke huyu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~36#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?-914278963
trans-unit.source: She believed/had faith [in Jesus as the one who saved her from sin]. (50)
trans-unit.target: Aliamini/alikuwa na imani [kwa Yesu kama yule aliyemwokoa kutoka kwa dhambi]. (50)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~36#Note:What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?533604097
trans-unit.source: If the person answers that she loved Jesus/God very much, so he forgave her, that is the wrong answer. The translator has misunderstood the meaning of verse 47. Adjust that verse when you discuss it below (see 7:44-47), then read the adjusted section of the translation and ask this Overview question again.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu anajibu kwamba alimpenda Yesu/Mungu sana, kwa hiyo alimsamehe, hiyo ni jibu baya. Mtafsiri ameelewa vibaya maana ya mstari wa 47. Rekebisha mstari huo unapozungumzia hapo chini (ona 7:44-47), kisha soma sehemu iliyobadilishwa ya tafsiri na uulize swali hili la muhtasari tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Note:What did Jesus say was the reason that he had forgiven this woman?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.37+What did Luke write about the woman who came to the Pharisee's house?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~37#Question:What did Luke write about the woman who came to the Pharisee's house?
trans-unit.source: What did Luke write about the woman who came to the Pharisee's house?
trans-unit.target: Luka aliandika nini kuhusu mwanamke aliyekuja nyumbani kwa Farisayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Question:What did Luke write about the woman who came to the Pharisee's house?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:What did Luke write about the woman who came to the Pharisee's house?-559604435
trans-unit.source: She was [regarded by the other people as] a sinner, that is, a person who had done many things which were obviously against the Law of Moses. (37)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa [anaonwa na watu wengine kuwa] mwenye dhambi, yaani, mtu aliyekuwa amefanya mambo mengi yaliyokuwa waziwazi kinyume cha Sheria ya Musa. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:What did Luke write about the woman who came to the Pharisee's house?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.36-37+Why did she come to the Pharisee's house?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~36#Question:Why did she come to the Pharisee's house?
trans-unit.source: Why did she come to the Pharisee's house?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alikuwa nyumbani kwa Farisayo huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Question:Why did she come to the Pharisee's house?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~36#Answer:Why did she come to the Pharisee's house?-1465664580
trans-unit.source: She knew that Jesus was there to eat with the Pharisee. (36-37)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba Yesu alikuwa hapo kula pamoja na Farisayo (36-37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Answer:Why did she come to the Pharisee's house?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.37-38+Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~37#Question:Knowing that, what did she do?
trans-unit.source: Knowing that, what did she do?
trans-unit.target: Alijua hilo, naye alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Question:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?412406814
trans-unit.source: She brought a stone bottle of perfume. (37)
trans-unit.target: Alileta chupa ya mawe ya manukato. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?109737957
trans-unit.source: She stood weeping near Jesus's feet [which were stretched out behind him, as he reclined] (38),
trans-unit.target: Akasimama akilia karibu na miguu ya Yesu [iliyoenea nyuma yake, alipokuwa ameegama] (38),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?-1440362465
trans-unit.source: wetting his feet with her tears (38).
trans-unit.target: akiilowesha miguu yake kwa machozi yake (38).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?-972740992
trans-unit.source: Then she wiped his feet with her [long] hair (38),
trans-unit.target: Kisha akafuta miguu yake kwa nywele zake [ndefu] (38),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?-713672649
trans-unit.source: repeatedly kissed them (38),
trans-unit.target: aliwabusu mara nyingi (38),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?135831931
trans-unit.source: and then poured the perfume on them (38).
trans-unit.target: Kisha tukawamiminia marhamu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Answer:Knowing that, what did she do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~37#Note:Knowing that, what did she do?577408697
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek word which is translated "poured on" in verses 38 of the NIV is translated "anointed" twice in verse 46. It is the same Greek word that Luke used in 4:18, but here the focus is on the literal pouring, not the figurative use for appointing. See "anoint" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki ambalo limetafsiriwa "kumiminwa" katika mstari wa 38 wa NIV limetafsiriwa "kutiwa mafuta" mara mbili katika mstari wa 46. Ni neno lile lile la Kigiriki ambalo Luka alitumia katika 4:18, lakini hapa lengo ni kumimina halisi, sio matumizi ya mfano ya kuteua.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~37#Note:Knowing that, what did she do?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.36-39+In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~36#Question:In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?
trans-unit.source: In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 38 na wa 45, tunasoma maneno "akawabusu miguu yake". Unafikiri mwanamke huyo alikuwa akifanya nini hasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Question:In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~36#Answer:In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?-1709485237
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: She touched or pressed her pursed lips on his feet as a sign of her affection and reverence/respect for him.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Aligusa au kusukuma midomo yake iliyochongoka kwenye miguu yake kama ishara ya mapenzi yake na heshima / heshima kwake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Answer:In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~36#Note:In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?-1689918745
trans-unit.source: If the culture of the translation does not show affection or reverence with the kissing action, it is more important to keep that purpose clear, rather than worry about describing the exact action of the woman. In verse 45, Jesus referred to the kissing action as a sign of greeting, though not done to the feet. It would be best if one action could stand for both, as in Jesus's time, but that may not be possible.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa utamaduni wa tafsiri hauonyeshi shauku au heshima na kitendo cha kumbusu, ni muhimu zaidi kuweka kusudi hilo wazi, badala ya kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kuelezea kitendo halisi cha mwanamke. Katika mstari wa 45, Yesu alitaja kitendo cha kumbusu kama ishara ya salamu, ingawa haikufanywa kwa miguu. Ingekuwa bora ikiwa kitendo kimoja kingeweza kusimama kwa wote wawili, kama wakati wa Yesu, lakini hiyo haiwezekani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~36#Note:In verses 38 and 45 we heard the words "she kissed his feet". What, do you think, was the woman actually doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.39+What did the Pharisee think about this woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~39#Question:What did the Pharisee think about this woman?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisee think about this woman?
trans-unit.target: Farisayo huyo alifikiri nini kumhusu mwanamke huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~39#Question:What did the Pharisee think about this woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~39#Answer:What did the Pharisee think about this woman?-312517976
trans-unit.source: He thought of her as a person who had sinned much [and everyone knew it]. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alifikiri kwamba mwanamke huyo alikuwa amefanya dhambi kubwa [na kila mtu alijua hivyo]. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~39#Answer:What did the Pharisee think about this woman?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.39+What did the Pharisee think about Jesus because he did not forbid the woman to do this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~39#Question:What did the Pharisee think about Jesus because he did not forbid the woman to do this?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisee think about Jesus because he did not forbid the woman to do this?
trans-unit.target: Farisayo huyo alifikiri nini juu ya Yesu kwa sababu hakumkataza mwanamke huyo asifanye hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~39#Question:What did the Pharisee think about Jesus because he did not forbid the woman to do this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~39#Answer:What did the Pharisee think about Jesus because he did not forbid the woman to do this?897846083
trans-unit.source: He thought that Jesus was not a prophet because he allowed a sinful person to do this for him. (The Pharisee expected that a true prophet would have knowledge from God about the woman's bad actions in the past.) (39)
trans-unit.target: Alifikiri kwamba Yesu hakuwa nabii kwa sababu aliruhusu mtu mwenye dhambi amfanyie hivyo. (Mfarisayo alitarajia kwamba nabii wa kweli angekuwa na maarifa kutoka kwa Mungu juu ya matendo mabaya ya mwanamke huyo katika siku za nyuma.) (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~39#Answer:What did the Pharisee think about Jesus because he did not forbid the woman to do this?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.41-42+What did Jesus do to help the Pharisee Simon understand the meaning of the woman's actions?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~41#Question:What did Jesus do to help the Pharisee Simon understand the meaning of the woman's actions?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do to help the Pharisee Simon understand the meaning of the woman's actions?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini ili kumsaidia Farisayo Simoni aelewe maana ya matendo ya mwanamke huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~41#Question:What did Jesus do to help the Pharisee Simon understand the meaning of the woman's actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~41#Answer:What did Jesus do to help the Pharisee Simon understand the meaning of the woman's actions?-1732533243
trans-unit.source: He told a parable about two men who owed another person money. (41-42)
trans-unit.target: Alitoa mfano juu ya watu wawili waliokuwa na deni la fedha kwa mtu mwingine (41-42).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~41#Answer:What did Jesus do to help the Pharisee Simon understand the meaning of the woman's actions?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.41-42+Tell me the parable.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~41#Question:Tell me the parable.
trans-unit.source: Tell me the parable.
trans-unit.target: Niambie mfano huo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~41#Question:Tell me the parable.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~41#Answer:Tell me the parable.1949480982
trans-unit.source: Two men owed money to another person. One owed much more than the other. However, neither man could repay that money, so the moneylender forgave each man his debt. (41-42)
trans-unit.target: Watu wawili walikuwa na deni kwa mtu mwingine. Mmoja alikuwa na deni kubwa kuliko yule mwingine. Hata hivyo, hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyeweza kulipa pesa hizo, kwa hiyo mkopeshaji wa fedha aliwasamehe wote wawili deni lao (41-42).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~41#Answer:Tell me the parable.

group.id: Q:LUK 7.43+Which man did Simon say would love the moneylender more than the other man did?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~43#Question:Which man did Simon say would love the moneylender more than the other man did?
trans-unit.source: Which man did Simon say would love the moneylender more than the other man did?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani kati ya wanaume hao wawili ambaye Simoni alisema angempenda zaidi yule mkopeshaji kuliko yule mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~43#Question:Which man did Simon say would love the moneylender more than the other man did?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~43#Answer:Which man did Simon say would love the moneylender more than the other man did?-182106151
trans-unit.source: He said that it probably was the one who had the bigger debt canceled. (43)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba labda ni yule ambaye deni kubwa zaidi lilifutwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~43#Answer:Which man did Simon say would love the moneylender more than the other man did?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.40-43+What do you think was the reason that would be true?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~40#Question:What do you think was the reason that would be true?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that would be true?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini jambo hilo lingekuwa kweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~40#Question:What do you think was the reason that would be true?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~40#Answer:What do you think was the reason that would be true?47704344
trans-unit.source: The one who had been forgiven much would show it more than the person who had been forgiven less.
trans-unit.target: Yule ambaye alikuwa amesamehewa mengi angetenda zaidi ya yule ambaye alikuwa amesamehewa kidogo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~40#Answer:What do you think was the reason that would be true?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.44-46+If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~44#Question:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?
trans-unit.source: If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Simoni angekuwa mkaribishaji mzuri wa Wayahudi, angalifanya mambo fulani Yesu alipomtembelea.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Question:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~44#Answer:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?-941889338
trans-unit.source: Simon had not given any water to Jesus for [washing] his feet. (44)
trans-unit.target: Simoni hakuwa amempa Yesu maji ya [kuosha] miguu yake. (44)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Answer:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~44#Answer:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?-420042215
trans-unit.source: He had not given Jesus a kiss [of traditional greeting]. (45)
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa amembusu Yesu [kwa salamu ya kidesturi]. (45)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Answer:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~44#Answer:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?1143846299
trans-unit.source: He had not anointed Jesus's head with [olive] oil [to show hospitality]. (46)
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa amemtia mafuta [ya zeituni] kichwani mwa Yesu [kuonyesha ukaribishaji-wageni]. (46)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Answer:If Simon had been a good Jewish host, he would have done certain things when Jesus arrived. What things did Jesus say that Simon had not done for him?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.44-47+Which person showed the greater love for Jesus, Simon or the woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~44#Question:Which person showed the greater love for Jesus, Simon or the woman?
trans-unit.source: Which person showed the greater love for Jesus, Simon or the woman?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyeonyesha upendo mkubwa zaidi kwa Yesu, Simoni au mwanamke huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Question:Which person showed the greater love for Jesus, Simon or the woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~44#Answer:Which person showed the greater love for Jesus, Simon or the woman?337529997
trans-unit.source: Jesus indicated that the woman did.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha kwamba mwanamke huyo alijua.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Answer:Which person showed the greater love for Jesus, Simon or the woman?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.47+On what basis could anyone know that the woman's many sins had already been forgiven by Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~47#Question:On what basis could anyone know that the woman's many sins had already been forgiven by Jesus?
trans-unit.source: On what basis could anyone know that the woman's many sins had already been forgiven by Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa msingi gani mtu yeyote angeweza kujua kwamba dhambi nyingi za mwanamke huyo tayari zilikuwa zimesamehewa na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~47#Question:On what basis could anyone know that the woman's many sins had already been forgiven by Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~47#Answer:On what basis could anyone know that the woman's many sins had already been forgiven by Jesus?-1229852189
trans-unit.source: They could see that she loved [Jesus] very much, [as such a person might do]. (47)
trans-unit.target: Wangeweza kuona kwamba alimpenda [Yesu] sana, [kama vile mtu kama huyo angefanya]. (47)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~47#Answer:On what basis could anyone know that the woman's many sins had already been forgiven by Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.44-47+What do you think that Jesus meant when he implied that Simon had been forgiven few sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~44#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he implied that Simon had been forgiven few sins?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant when he implied that Simon had been forgiven few sins?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba Simoni alikuwa amesamehewa dhambi chache?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he implied that Simon had been forgiven few sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~44#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he implied that Simon had been forgiven few sins?-87088387
trans-unit.source: Simon may have thought that he did not sin much, so he had not ask God to forgive him much. (Simon had not realized how much God had forgiven him, so his response of love was less than the woman's response.)
trans-unit.target: Huenda Simoni alifikiri kwamba hakuwa ametenda dhambi nyingi, kwa hiyo hakuwa amemwomba Mungu amsamehe mengi. (Simoni hakuwa amefahamu kiasi ambacho Mungu alikuwa amemsamehe, kwa hiyo jibu lake la upendo lilikuwa dogo kuliko jibu la mwanamke huyo.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~44#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he implied that Simon had been forgiven few sins?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.48+What did Jesus tell the woman about her sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~48#Question:What did Jesus tell the woman about her sins?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the woman about her sins?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini mwanamke huyo kuhusu dhambi zake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Question:What did Jesus tell the woman about her sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~48#Answer:What did Jesus tell the woman about her sins?47588425
trans-unit.source: They all had been forgiven [by him]. (48)
trans-unit.target: Wote walikuwa wamesamehewa [na yeye].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Answer:What did Jesus tell the woman about her sins?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.50+What was the reason that Jesus had forgiven her many sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~50#Question:What was the reason that Jesus had forgiven her many sins?
trans-unit.source: What was the reason that Jesus had forgiven her many sins?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichokuwa sababu ya Yesu kumsamehe dhambi zake nyingi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~50#Question:What was the reason that Jesus had forgiven her many sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~50#Answer:What was the reason that Jesus had forgiven her many sins?-1100955149
trans-unit.source: She believed/had faith [that Jesus could save her and cause her to have a right relationship with God]. (50)
trans-unit.target: Aliamini/alikuwa na imani [kwamba Yesu angeweza kumwokoa na kumfanya awe na uhusiano mzuri na Mungu]. (50)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~50#Answer:What was the reason that Jesus had forgiven her many sins?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.48-50+What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~48#Question:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?
trans-unit.source: What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri amani hii ni nini ambayo Yesu alisema ingekuwa ndani/na mwanamke huyo alipomwacha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Question:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~48#Alternate:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?-1712896018
trans-unit.source: What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in the woman as she left him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri amani hii ni nini ambayo Yesu alisema ingekuwa ndani ya mwanamke huyo alipomwacha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Alternate:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!7~48#Alternate:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?-63457377
trans-unit.source: What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be with the woman as she left him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri amani hii ni nini ambayo Yesu alisema ingekuwa na mwanamke huyo alipomwacha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Alternate:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~48#Answer:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?-643791465
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is peace which God gives to a person who has trusted Him/who has believed in His Son. This peace is a calm heart/spirit free from worry when we face God because he has already forgiven our sins.
trans-unit.target: Uhakikisho wa neno muhimu: Ni amani ambayo Mungu humpa mtu ambaye amemwamini Yeye/aliyemwamini Mwanawe. Amani hii ni moyo/roho tulivu bila wasiwasi tunapomkabili Mungu kwa sababu tayari amesamehe dhambi zetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Answer:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!7~48#Note:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?-110537080
trans-unit.source: See "peace" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "amani" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~48#Note:What do you think this peace is that Jesus said would be in/with the woman as she left him?

group.id: Q:LUK 7.49+When Jesus told the woman that her sins had been forgiven, what did the other people there think?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!7~49#Question:When Jesus told the woman that her sins had been forgiven, what did the other people there think?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus told the woman that her sins had been forgiven, what did the other people there think?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipomwambia mwanamke huyo kwamba dhambi zake zilikuwa zimesamehewa, watu wengine waliokuwako walifikiri nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~49#Question:When Jesus told the woman that her sins had been forgiven, what did the other people there think?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!7~49#Answer:When Jesus told the woman that her sins had been forgiven, what did the other people there think?1021913545
trans-unit.source: They knew that only God could forgive sins, so they thought that Jesus was taking the place of God [and should be punished (see 5:21) ]. (49)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba ni Mungu tu awezaye kusamehe dhambi, kwa hiyo walifikiri kwamba Yesu alikuwa akichukua nafasi ya Mungu [na anapaswa kuadhibiwa (ona 5:21) ].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!7~49#Answer:When Jesus told the woman that her sins had been forgiven, what did the other people there think?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.1+Tell me what Jesus was doing at that time.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~1#Question:Tell me what Jesus was doing at that time.
trans-unit.source: Tell me what Jesus was doing at that time.
trans-unit.target: Niambie Yesu alikuwa akifanya nini wakati huo.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~1#Answer:Tell me what Jesus was doing at that time.1297162138
trans-unit.source: He traveled to many towns and villages preaching the Good News that the Kingdom of God [had already come/begun]. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alisafiri katika miji na vijiji vingi akihubiri Habari Njema kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu [umekuja/umeanza] (1).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~1#Answer:Tell me what Jesus was doing at that time.

group.id: Q:LUK 8.1-2+Who traveled with him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~1#Question:Who traveled with him?
trans-unit.source: Who traveled with him?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliokuwa pamoja naye?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~1#Question:Who traveled with him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~1#Answer:Who traveled with him?-979013186
trans-unit.source: His twelve apostles/disciples traveled with him. (1)
trans-unit.target: Mitume wake kumi na wawili/wanafunzi wake walisafiri pamoja naye. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~1#Answer:Who traveled with him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~1#Answer:Who traveled with him?1471420482
trans-unit.source: Also with him were some women from whom Jesus had made evil spirits leave or whom he had healed of other diseases. (2)
trans-unit.target: Pia walikuwa pamoja naye wanawake fulani ambao Yesu alikuwa amewafukuza roho waovu au kuwaponya magonjwa mengine. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~1#Answer:Who traveled with him?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.3+How did Jesus and his disciples have enough money for the things they needed?

trans-unit.source: How did Jesus and his disciples have enough money for the things they needed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipataje pesa za kugharimia mahitaji yao?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~3#Answer:How did Jesus and his disciples have enough money for the things they needed?-2065610717
trans-unit.source: The women used some of their own money to help them. (3)
trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao waliwategemeza kwa mali zao wenyewe. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~3#Answer:How did Jesus and his disciples have enough money for the things they needed?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!8~4#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 8:4-15 Jesus told a parable about a man sowing seed in his field.
trans-unit.target: Luka 8:4-15 Yesu alisimulia mfano wa mtu aliyepanda mbegu katika shamba lake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~4#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 8.4-15+What did Jesus teach the people by means of this story about seeds and different types of ground?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~4#Question:What did Jesus teach the people by means of this story about seeds and different types of ground?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach the people by means of this story about seeds and different types of ground?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha watu somo gani kupitia mfano huu kuhusu mbegu na aina mbalimbali za udongo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~4#Question:What did Jesus teach the people by means of this story about seeds and different types of ground?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~4#Answer:What did Jesus teach the people by means of this story about seeds and different types of ground?376221714
trans-unit.source: Different people believe God's message [about the savior] in differing amounts. Some do not want to believe it, others only believe a little bit, and others are ready to believe everything God has said. Only those people whose hearts are ready [to receive and obey Jesus's teaching] will experience the fruit/benefits/good things that will come from believing. (12-15)
trans-unit.target: Watu tofauti wanaamini ujumbe wa Mungu [kuhusu mwokozi] kwa viwango tofauti. Wengine hawataki kuamini, wengine wanaamini kidogo tu, na wengine wako tayari kuamini kila kitu ambacho Mungu amesema. Ni watu wale tu ambao mioyo yao iko tayari [kupokea na kutii mafundisho ya Yesu] watakaopata matunda/faida/mambo mema yatakayotokana na kuamini. (12-15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~4#Answer:What did Jesus teach the people by means of this story about seeds and different types of ground?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.5-8+Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~5#Question:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.
trans-unit.source: Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kilichotokea kwa mbegu katika hadithi ambayo Yesu alisimulia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Question:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.-1969584800
trans-unit.source: Some seeds fell on the path. [People and animals] walked on them and then birds ate them. (5)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya mbegu zilianguka njiani [watu na wanyama] wakazikanyaga na kisha ndege wakazila. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.710793517
trans-unit.source: Some seeds fell on rock. It came up, but withered because there was not enough water. (6)
trans-unit.target: Nyingine zilianguka juu ya mwamba, zikamea, lakini zikauka kwa sababu hakukuwa na maji ya kutosha. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.-1980504769
trans-unit.source: Some seeds fell where thorns grew. The thorns grew [big] and choked the plants. (7)
trans-unit.target: Nyingine zilianguka mahali penye miiba, na miiba ikakua [ikakuza] na kuzisonga. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.-1514858878
trans-unit.source: Some seeds fell on good ground and produced very much/a hundred times as much new seed. (8)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri na kutokeza mbegu nyingi/mara mia zaidi ya mbegu mpya. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Answer:Tell me what happened to the seeds in the story Jesus told.

group.id: Q:LUK 8.5+How did the man plant that seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~5#Question:How did the man plant that seed?
trans-unit.source: How did the man plant that seed?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alipandaje mbegu hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Question:How did the man plant that seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~5#Answer:How did the man plant that seed?2118963598
trans-unit.source: He scattered the seed over the top of the ground. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alitawanya mbegu hiyo juu ya uso wa nchi. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Answer:How did the man plant that seed?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~5#Note:How did the man plant that seed?-2070389302
trans-unit.source: If the people who will use this translation do not plant seed in this way, a footnote may be helpful to explain that scattering seed is appropriate in many cultures. The man was not being foolish when he scattered the seed.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu watakaotumia tafsiri hii hawatapanda mbegu kwa njia hiyo, kielezi-chini chaweza kusaidia kueleza kwamba kutawanya mbegu ni jambo lifaalo katika tamaduni nyingi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~5#Note:How did the man plant that seed?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.8+When Jesus finished telling the story he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think that he meant?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~8#Question:When Jesus finished telling the story he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think that he meant?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus finished telling the story he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think that he meant?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipomaliza kusema mfano huo alisema, "Mwenye masikio na asikie. Kila mtu ana masikio.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~8#Question:When Jesus finished telling the story he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think that he meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~8#Answer:When Jesus finished telling the story he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think that he meant?-263938062
trans-unit.source: He meant that everyone should pay attention [and think carefully about the hidden meaning].
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba kila mtu apaswa kuelekeza uangalifu [na kufikiria kwa uangalifu juu ya maana iliyofichwa].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~8#Answer:When Jesus finished telling the story he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think that he meant?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.9+Why did the disciples ask Jesus to explain the parable?

trans-unit.source: Why did the disciples ask Jesus to explain the parable?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walimwuliza Yesu kuhusu mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~9#Question:Why did the disciples ask Jesus to explain the parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~9#Answer:Why did the disciples ask Jesus to explain the parable?1995537629
trans-unit.source: They did not understand the meaning of the picture language. (9)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuelewa maana ya lugha ya mfano. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~9#Answer:Why did the disciples ask Jesus to explain the parable?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.10+What did Jesus say was hidden in this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~10#Question:What did Jesus say was hidden in this parable?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was hidden in this parable?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichofichwa katika mfano huu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Question:What did Jesus say was hidden in this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~10#Answer:What did Jesus say was hidden in this parable?-1994306719
trans-unit.source: The secrets about the kingdom of God, that is, how God planned to save people and then rule and reign as the one who is most important in their lives. (10)
trans-unit.target: Siri kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu, yaani, jinsi Mungu alivyopanga kuwaokoa watu na kisha kutawala na kutawala kama yule aliye muhimu zaidi katika maisha yao. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Answer:What did Jesus say was hidden in this parable?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.10+To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~10#Question:To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?
trans-unit.source: To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?
trans-unit.target: Yesu angewaeleza nani maana ya mfano huo, na ni nani ambao hangewaeleza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Question:To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~10#Answer:To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?918029699
trans-unit.source: He would explain it to the disciples, but not to the other people. (10)
trans-unit.target: Yeye angewaeleza wanafunzi wake, lakini si watu wengine. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Answer:To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~10#Note:To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?-1933964318
trans-unit.source: The Greek word order shows that Jesus emphasized the contrast between the two groups of people. The pronoun which refers to the disciples was put first in its part of the sentence and the pronoun which refers to the other people was put first in the second part of the sentence. It says, "To you [God] has given ..., but to the rest [it is] in parables." If the translator is able to show a strong contrast between the two groups in the wording of his translation, it would be good to do that here.
trans-unit.target: Mpangilio wa maneno ya Kigiriki unaonyesha kwamba Yesu alikazia tofauti kati ya vikundi viwili vya watu. Kiwakilishi kinachorejelea wanafunzi kiliwekwa kwanza katika sehemu yake ya sentensi na kiwakilishi kinachorejelea watu wengine kiliwekwa kwanza katika sehemu ya pili ya sentensi. Inasema, "Kwenu [Mungu] amewapa ..., lakini kwa wengine [ni] kwa mifano". Ikiwa mtafsiri anaweza kuonyesha tofauti kubwa kati ya vikundi viwili katika maneno ya tafsiri yake, ingekuwa vizuri kufanya hivyo hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Note:To whom would Jesus explain the meaning of the parable, and to whom would he not explain it?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.10+Why were Jesus's disciples able to understand the meaning after he explained it, but the other people did not understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~10#Question:Why were Jesus's disciples able to understand the meaning after he explained it, but the other people did not understand?
trans-unit.source: Why were Jesus's disciples able to understand the meaning after he explained it, but the other people did not understand?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi wa Yesu waliweza kuelewa maana baada ya yeye kuyaeleza, lakini watu wengine hawakuelewa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Question:Why were Jesus's disciples able to understand the meaning after he explained it, but the other people did not understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~10#Answer:Why were Jesus's disciples able to understand the meaning after he explained it, but the other people did not understand?-1573833496
trans-unit.source: Because the disciples believed that Jesus was God and they were following him and learning more about God, he caused/allowed them to understand. (10)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu wanafunzi waliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa Mungu na walikuwa wakimfuata na kujifunza zaidi juu ya Mungu, aliwafanya / akawaruhusu kuelewa. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~10#Answer:Why were Jesus's disciples able to understand the meaning after he explained it, but the other people did not understand?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.9-10+Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~9#Question:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?
trans-unit.source: Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine pia walimwona Yesu akifanya miujiza na kumsikia akisema habari njema kutoka kwa Mungu. Unafikiri ni kwa nini hawakuelewa yale waliyoona na kusikia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~9#Question:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~9#Answer:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?941787128
trans-unit.source: They did not believe that God had sent Jesus to be their savior. Therefore, God did not allow them to understand. They would not have followed God better, even if they had understood the meaning.
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu hawakuamini kwamba Mungu alimtuma Yesu kuwa mwokozi wao, Mungu hakuwapa ufahamu, na hata kama wangeuelewa, hawangemfuata Mungu vizuri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~9#Answer:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~9#Answer:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~9#Answer:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~9#Answer:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?1035213144
trans-unit.source: Jesus quoted what the prophet Isaiah had written. He implied that the same situation was happening again. The Jews living at the time of Jesus did not want to pay attention to God's message just like their forefathers in the time of Isaiah had not paid attention to Isaiah's message from God. (Jesus also implied that the end result for those who did not believe that God had sent him would be the same as it had been for their unbelieving forefathers. Their cities would be destroyed and their people would be scattered. [See Isa. 6:9-12.])
trans-unit.target: Yesu alinukuu yale ambayo nabii Isaya alikuwa ameandika. Alimaanisha kwamba hali hiyo hiyo ilikuwa ikitokea tena. Wayahudi walioishi wakati wa Yesu hawakutaka kulipa kipaumbele ujumbe wa Mungu kama vile babu zao katika wakati wa Isaya hawakuwa wamepa kipaumbele ujumbe wa Isaya kutoka kwa Mungu. (Yesu pia alimaanisha kwamba matokeo ya mwisho kwa wale ambao hawakuamini kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemtuma yangekuwa sawa na yale yaliyokuwa kwa babu zao wasioamini. Miji yao ingeharibiwa na watu wao wangetawanyika. [Ona Isa. 6:9-12.]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~9#Answer:Other people also saw Jesus do miracles and heard him tell the good news from God. What do you think was the reason that they not understand what they saw and heard?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~11#Answer:What did the seed in the parable represent?

trans-unit.target: Hao ndio wanao sikia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~12#Answer:What did Jesus say that the different types of ground represented?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.12-15+What happened to the different listeners?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~12#Question:What happened to the different listeners?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the different listeners?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa wasikilizaji tofauti-tofauti?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~12#Question:What happened to the different listeners?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?-1508717998
trans-unit.source: Some heard God's message, but the people did not pay attention. Then the devil took what they had heard away, that is, he made them forget all about it. (12)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi yao walisikia lakini hawakujali. Kisha Ibilisi akaichukua ile ujumbe kutoka kwao, yaani, aliwafanya wasahau yote waliyosikia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?1763829677
trans-unit.source: Some heard it, received it excitedly and believed it for a while. But when troubles came to them, they stopped believing it. (13)
trans-unit.target: Na wapo miongoni mwao wanao lifurahia, na wakawa na yakini nalo, na ikisha wafikia adhabu wanaacha kuamini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?1498550962
trans-unit.source: Some heard it, but the good things of this world became more important to them than God's message and took over its place in their lives. They thought about the things in this world more and more and they thought about God less and less. Before very long, other people could tell by their words and actions that they did not believe in God any more. (14)
trans-unit.target: Wengine waliisikia, lakini vitu vizuri vya dunia hii vikawa muhimu zaidi kwao kuliko ujumbe wa Mungu na kuchukua nafasi yake katika maisha yao. Walifikiria juu ya vitu vya ulimwengu huu zaidi na zaidi na walidhani juu ya Mungu kidogo na kidogo. Haikuchukua muda mrefu, watu wengine wangeweza kuonyesha kwa maneno yao na matendo yao kwamba hawakuamini tena katika Mungu. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?-1273764366
trans-unit.source: Some who were honest and good heard it and kept it in their hearts and minds. Even through troubles, they continued to believe it. Finally, other people saw many good things that pleased God in their lives. (15)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya watu wema na wanyofu waliisikia na kuiweka mioyoni mwao na akilini mwao. Hata kupitia shida, waliendelea kuiamini. Hatimaye, watu wengine waliona mambo mengi mazuri ambayo yalimpendeza Mungu katika maisha yao. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~12#Answer:What happened to the different listeners?

trans-unit.source: Luke 8:16-18 Jesus used a lamp to explain that he would not hide the truth about the kingdom of God.
trans-unit.target: Luka 8:16-18 Yesu alitumia taa kueleza kwamba hangeficha kweli juu ya ufalme wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~16#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 8.16-18+What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach the people by means of this story about a lamp and its light?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~16#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach the people by means of this story about a lamp and its light?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach the people by means of this story about a lamp and its light?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka kuwafundisha watu somo gani kupitia mfano huo kuhusu taa na nuru yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~16#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach the people by means of this story about a lamp and its light?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~16#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach the people by means of this story about a lamp and its light?335475229
trans-unit.source: The purpose of a lamp is to help people by making light for them to see clearly. Jesus was like the lamp that God had put on earth to make the truths about the kingdom of God clear to those who listened carefully.
trans-unit.target: Kusudi la taa ni kusaidia watu kwa kuwapa nuru ili waweze kuona waziwazi. Yesu alikuwa kama taa ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameweka duniani ili kuwapa nuru kweli kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu kwa wale wanaosikiliza kwa makini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~16#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach the people by means of this story about a lamp and its light?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.16+Why do people light lamps?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~16#Question:Why do people light lamps?
trans-unit.source: Why do people light lamps?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu huwasha taa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~16#Question:Why do people light lamps?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~16#Answer:Why do people light lamps?1088770742
trans-unit.source: People light lamps to give light when they cannot see otherwise. (16)
trans-unit.target: Watu huwasha taa ili kutoa nuru wakati hawawezi kuona vinginevyo. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~16#Answer:Why do people light lamps?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.16+What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?

trans-unit.source: What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini baada ya kuwasha taa?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~16#Answer:What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?-17415748
trans-unit.source: He puts/places it out where it can be useful, as on a lamp holder. He does not hide it under anything. (16)
trans-unit.target: Yeye huiweka mahali ambapo yaweza kuwa yenye manufaa, kama vile kwenye kinara cha taa. Yeye hauifichi chini ya kitu chochote. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~16#Answer:What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.17+When the lamp is lit, what will happen to things that a person could not see in the dark?

trans-unit.source: When the lamp is lit, what will happen to things that a person could not see in the dark?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~17#Answer:When the lamp is lit, what will happen to things that a person could not see in the dark?1046837290
trans-unit.source: The person (and others who are nearby) will see them clearly. They will not be hidden any more. (17)
trans-unit.target: Na mtu atawaona, wala hawatafichwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~17#Answer:When the lamp is lit, what will happen to things that a person could not see in the dark?

trans-unit.source: (The answer should cover the basic outline of the story, including Jesus rebuking the storm and the lake as well as rebuking his disciples. Any part which the person does not mention can be reviewed by using a specific question from below.)

group.id: Q:LUK 8.24+What did the disciples do and say to Jesus?

trans-unit.source: What did the disciples do and say to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walimwambia na kumfanyia nini Yesu?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~24#Answer:What did the disciples do and say to Jesus?-1700987951
trans-unit.source: They woke Jesus and told him they were about to be destroyed [by the storm]. (24a)
trans-unit.target: Walimwamsha Yesu na kumwambia walikuwa karibu kuharibiwa [na dhoruba]. (24a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~24#Answer:What did the disciples do and say to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.23-24+What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~23#Question:What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifikiri dhoruba hiyo ingekuwa na matokeo gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~23#Question:What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~23#Answer:What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?-1167212790
trans-unit.source: They thought that they would violently die [by drowning]. (23-24a)
trans-unit.target: Hakika wao walidhani kuwa wataangamizwa kwa ghafla.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~23#Answer:What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~23#Answer:What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?-281045589
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek word that describes what the disciples thought would happen to them focuses on the destruction and total ruin of people or objects. It is the same word that was used in 5:37 to describe what happened to the wineskins. See "destroy, perish, (be lost" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki linaloelezea kile wanafunzi walidhani kitatokea kwao linalenga uharibifu na uharibifu kamili wa watu au vitu. Ni neno lile lile lililotumiwa katika 5:37 kuelezea kile kilichotokea kwa vikapu vya divai. Tazama "kuharibu, kupotea, (kupotea" katika KBT).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~23#Answer:What did the disciples think would be the final outcome of this storm?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.24+After the disciples woke Jesus, what did he do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~24#Question:After the disciples woke Jesus, what did he do?
trans-unit.source: After the disciples woke Jesus, what did he do?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya wanafunzi kumwamsha Yesu, alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~24#Question:After the disciples woke Jesus, what did he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~24#Answer:After the disciples woke Jesus, what did he do?322131584
trans-unit.source: He sternly commanded/rebuked the wind and the violent, tossing waves (and the storm stopped, and all was calm again). (24)
trans-unit.target: Aliamuru/akakanyaza kwa ukali upepo na mawimbi yenye nguvu, yenye kutikisa (na dhoruba ikakoma, na kila kitu kikawa kimya tena). (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~24#Answer:After the disciples woke Jesus, what did he do?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.25+What do you think was the reason that Jesus asked/talked about the disciples' faith?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus asked/talked about the disciples' faith?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!8~25#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that Jesus asked/talked about the disciples' faith?682037480
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about the disciples' faith?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alizungumza kuhusu imani ya wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that Jesus asked/talked about the disciples' faith?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~25#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus asked/talked about the disciples' faith?-1764450500
trans-unit.source: They had acted just as though they did not believe that he had God's power to do whatever he wanted to do. // They had seen Jesus do great things by God's power, but they did not trust him to save himself and them now. // Their reaction to the storm was the same as the reaction of people who had no faith in God. (25) (See "faith" in KBT in the "believe" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamefanya kama kwamba hawakuamini kwamba alikuwa na nguvu za Mungu kufanya chochote alichotaka kufanya. // Walikuwa wamemwona Yesu akifanya mambo makuu kwa nguvu za Mungu, lakini hawakumwamini kuwa angeweza kujiokoa yeye mwenyewe na wao sasa. // Mwitikio wao kwa dhoruba ulikuwa sawa na mwitikio wa watu ambao hawakuwa na imani katika Mungu. (25) (Tazama "imani" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "kuamini".)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus asked/talked about the disciples' faith?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.25+Why were the disciples amazed at what had happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~25#Question:Why were the disciples amazed at what had happened?
trans-unit.source: Why were the disciples amazed at what had happened?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walishangazwa na mambo yaliyotukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Question:Why were the disciples amazed at what had happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~25#Answer:Why were the disciples amazed at what had happened?1940315199
trans-unit.source: They had seen Jesus use [God's/his] authority over the winds and the water, and they did what he told them to do. (25) (They knew that ordinary people did not have any control over the natural elements.)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamemwona Yesu akitumia mamlaka [ya Mungu/yake] juu ya upepo na maji, na walifanya aliyowaambia wafanye. (25) (Walijua kwamba watu wa kawaida hawakuwa na udhibiti wowote juu ya vitu vya asili.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Answer:Why were the disciples amazed at what had happened?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.25+The storm had ended. Why were the disciples still afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~25#Question:The storm had ended. Why were the disciples still afraid?
trans-unit.source: The storm had ended. Why were the disciples still afraid?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walikuwa bado wakiogopa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Question:The storm had ended. Why were the disciples still afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~25#Answer:The storm had ended. Why were the disciples still afraid?-492284630
trans-unit.source: They realized that they were in the presence of one who had supernatural power to command even the winds and the water to obey him. He was not an ordinary person, as they were. (25)
trans-unit.target: Walifahamu kwamba walikuwa mbele ya mtu mwenye nguvu zisizo za kawaida ambaye hata huamuru upepo na maji na kumtii. Yeye hakuwa mtu wa kawaida, kama wao walivyokuwa. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~25#Answer:The storm had ended. Why were the disciples still afraid?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.26-39+Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~26#Question:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?
trans-unit.source: Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimfukuza roho waovu wengi kutoka kwa mwanamume mmoja. Tunaweza kujifunza nini kumhusu Yesu kutokana na hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Question:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~26#Answer:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?721437761
trans-unit.source: Jesus showed that he had authority over all the fierce demons, [even those outside of Jewish territory].
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha kwamba alikuwa na mamlaka juu ya roho waovu wote wakali, [hata wale waliokuwa nje ya eneo la Wayahudi].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Answer:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~26#Answer:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Answer:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~26#Answer:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?708165469
trans-unit.source: Jesus wanted to help all people, even those who were not Jews and who did not live among the Jews.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka kuwasaidia watu wote, hata wale wasio Wayahudi na ambao hawakuishi kati ya Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Answer:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~26#Note:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?-428082020
trans-unit.source: These people had the same response to Jesus doing a miracle among them as his disciples had on the lake a short time earlier. Both groups were afraid of Jesus's great power being present among them. These Gerasene/Gadarene/Gergesene people rejected Jesus, but the man who was healed, and the disciples earlier, believed that God had sent Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Watu hawa walikuwa na majibu sawa na yale ya Yesu kufanya muujiza miongoni mwao kama wanafunzi wake walivyokuwa na ziwa muda mfupi kabla. Makundi yote mawili yaliogopa nguvu kubwa ya Yesu kuwapo miongoni mwao. Watu hawa wa Gadareni/Gadareni/Gadariseni walimkataa Yesu, lakini mtu aliyeponywa, na wanafunzi wa mapema, waliamini kwamba Mungu alimtuma Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Note:Jesus cast many demons out of one particular man. What can we learn about Jesus from that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~26#Answer:Where is the area where Jesus [and his disciples] went ashore?425681273
trans-unit.source: It is on the other side of the lake across from Galilee [province], in the land of the Gerasene/Gadarene/Gergesene [people]. (26)
trans-unit.target: Ni upande wa pili wa ziwa, kinyume cha Galilaya [mkoa], katika nchi ya Wageraseni/Wagadala/Wagerasi [watu]. (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Answer:Where is the area where Jesus [and his disciples] went ashore?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~26#Note:Where is the area where Jesus [and his disciples] went ashore?-550158189
trans-unit.source: You may want to note in a reference to a map or in a footnote that Jesus was now outside the area the Jews regarded as their own land. The people to whom he talked there were not Jews and they did not worship the true God.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukataka kuona katika rejezo kwenye ramani au katika kielezi-chini kwamba Yesu sasa alikuwa nje ya eneo ambalo Wayahudi waliliona kuwa nchi yao wenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~26#Note:Where is the area where Jesus [and his disciples] went ashore?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.27-29+What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~27#Question:What did Luke tell us about this man?
trans-unit.source: What did Luke tell us about this man?
trans-unit.target: Luka alituambia nini kuhusu mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Question:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?-1338069819
trans-unit.source: The man was from the town [of Gerasa nearby]. (27)
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alikuwa wa mji [wa karibu wa Gerasa]. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?-409676907
trans-unit.source: He had not worn clothes for a long time. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa hajavaa nguo kwa muda mrefu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?1739916993
trans-unit.source: He did not live in a house, but stayed among the tombs. (27)
trans-unit.target: Wala hakuishi nyumbani, bali alikaa makaburini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?-129284556
trans-unit.source: When he saw Jesus [coming], he cried out, (28)
trans-unit.target: Alipomwona Yesu [akija], alipiga kelele, (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?289821585
trans-unit.source: dropped to the ground, lying flat in front of Jesus [as a sign that he submitted himself to Jesus] (28)
trans-unit.target: akaanguka chini, akiwa amelala mbele ya Yesu [kama ishara ya kwamba alijinyenyekeza kwa Yesu] (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?-1016625668
trans-unit.source: and shouted out in a loud voice. (28)
trans-unit.target: Kisha akaita kwa sauti kubwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?-1322775961
trans-unit.source: Many times the demons had seized/controlled the man. (29)
trans-unit.target: Mara nyingi mashetani walikuwa wamemshika/kumdhibiti mtu huyo. (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.target: [Watu] walijaribu kumzuia mtu huyo kwa kumfunga mikono na miguu kwa minyororo (29)

trans-unit.target: Kisha nikamhifadhi!
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about this man?

trans-unit.target: lakini mara nyingi mtu huyo alikuwa amevunja minyororo (29)

trans-unit.target: Na yule ibilisi akamfukuza mpaka jangwani.
