group.id: Q:LUK 8.28+What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~28#Question:What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alimwambia Yesu nini kwa sauti kubwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~28#Question:What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~28#Answer:What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?-988383943
trans-unit.source: He shouted, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I plead with/appeal to you, do not torture me!" (28)
trans-unit.target: Akapiga kelele, akasema, "Una shauri gani nami, wewe Yesu Mwana wa Mungu aliye juu? nakuomba/nakusihi, usinitese!" (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~28#Answer:What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~28#Note:What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?-2000834854
trans-unit.source: The question is a rhetorical one. The man was not asking Jesus for an answer. He was implying that, because Jesus was so different from himself in a spiritual sense, Jesus should leave the man and the spirits in him alone.
trans-unit.target: Swali hilo ni la kusema. Mtu huyo hakuwa akimwuliza Yesu kwa jibu. Alikuwa akionyesha kwamba, kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa tofauti sana na yeye mwenyewe kwa maana ya kiroho, Yesu anapaswa kumwacha mtu huyo na roho ndani yake peke yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~28#Note:What did the man shout in the loud voice to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.29+Why did the man say this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~29#Question:Why did the man say this?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~31#Note:What did the demons keep on urging/earnestly ask/strongly request Jesus not to do to them?2111445996
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "abyss" in KBT in the "hell, Hades, abyss" entry. It is the place where God imprisoned evil spirits and they suffer torment ever since he expelled them from heaven (see Rev. 20:3). They will not leave there until the Judgment (see Matt. 8:29). If the term is not clear in the text, use a footnote or glossary item to explain about this place.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Angalia "abiso" katika KBT katika "kuzimu, Hades, abiso" kuingia. Ni mahali ambapo Mungu alifunga roho waovu na wanateseka mateso tangu alipowafukuza kutoka mbinguni (tazama Ufunuo 20:3). Hawatatoka huko mpaka Hukumu (tazama Mt 8:29). Ikiwa neno hilo halieleweki katika maandishi, tumia maelezo ya chini au kiambishi cha msamiati kuelezea juu ya mahali hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~31#Note:What did the demons keep on urging/earnestly ask/strongly request Jesus not to do to them?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~38#Note:When the man was asking to go with Jesus, where do you think Jesus was?-121204117
trans-unit.source: The last word of 8:37 in the Greek is "he-returned", and in the NIV, "... and left." But what happened in 8:38-39a took place before Jesus actually left the man. To help respondents avoid becoming confused about the order of events, combine the numbering for verses 37-39 and describe the events in the order of verse 38, 39a, 37, and then 39b.
trans-unit.target: Neno la mwisho la 8:37 katika Kigiriki ni "alirudi", na katika NIV, "... na akaondoka". Lakini kile kilichotokea katika 8:38-39a kilitokea kabla ya Yesu kumwacha mtu huyo. Ili kusaidia waliohojiwa kuepuka kuchanganyikiwa juu ya utaratibu wa matukio, changanya nambari za aya 37-39 na ueleze matukio kwa utaratibu wa aya ya 38, 39a, 37, na kisha 39b.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~38#Note:When the man was asking to go with Jesus, where do you think Jesus was?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.43+What had the woman done to try to be healed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~43#Answer:What had the woman done to try to be healed?-14588347
trans-unit.source: She had paid all her [money] to doctors [to help her], but no one had been able to heal her/stop the bleeding. (43)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amewalipa madaktari [wa kumsaidia] [pesa] zake zote, lakini hakuna yeyote aliyekuwa ameweza kumponya/kumzuia kutokwa damu.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~43#Note:What had the woman done to try to be healed?1469168159
trans-unit.source: Many Bible scholars do not believe that Luke wrote the words that we find in some manuscripts about paying doctors. Therefore, the translator may not have included it in this translation, or it may be set apart by special use of punctuation. If those words are not in the translation, then skip this question.
trans-unit.target: Wasomi wengi wa Biblia hawaamini kwamba Luka aliandika maneno tunayoyaona katika hati fulani kuhusu kulipa madaktari. Kwa hiyo, huenda mtafsiri hakuyaingiza katika tafsiri hii, au huenda ikawekwa kando kwa kutumia alama za kipekee.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~43#Note:What had the woman done to try to be healed?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.45-48+Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~45#Question:Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?
trans-unit.source: Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakuwa baba, lakini alimwita mwanamke huyo kwa jina la cheo, "Binti". Unafikiri alimaanisha nini alipomwita "Binti"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~45#Question:Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~45#Answer:Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?259580659
trans-unit.source: Though she was not his real daughter, he wanted to show her that he cared about her and was not angry with her.
trans-unit.target: Ingawa hakuwa binti yake halisi, alitaka kumwonyesha kwamba alimjali na hakumkasirikia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~45#Answer:Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~45#Note:Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?-816173754
trans-unit.source: "Daughter" may not be the term used by the culture of the translation to show this same meaning. Use a culturally appropriate kin term or title for Jesus to address this woman. He wanted to show that he was friendly and caring as a father would be when helping his daughter.
trans-unit.target: "Binti" inaweza kuwa si neno linalotumiwa na utamaduni wa tafsiri kuonyesha maana hii sawa. Tumia neno au jina la utamaduni linalofaa kwa Yesu kumwita mwanamke huyu. Alitaka kuonyesha kwamba alikuwa rafiki na anayejali kama baba angekuwa wakati wa kusaidia binti yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~45#Note:Jesus was not a father, but he called this woman by the title, "Daughter". What do you think that he meant by calling her "Daughter"?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.52+What were other people at Jairus's house doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~52#Question:What were other people at Jairus's house doing?
trans-unit.source: What were other people at Jairus's house doing?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine waliokuwa nyumbani kwa Yairo walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~52#Question:What were other people at Jairus's house doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~52#Answer:What were other people at Jairus's house doing?56678601
trans-unit.source: They were wailing and mourning/showing their sorrow for the [dead] girl. (52)
trans-unit.target: Nao walikuwa wakiomboleza na kuomboleza kwa ajili ya msichana [mfu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~52#Answer:What were other people at Jairus's house doing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!8~52#Note:What were other people at Jairus's house doing?-898090787
trans-unit.source: One of the Greek words for what the people were doing describes their cultural practice of showing sorrow by beating on one's own chest. If the culture of the translation has words for both the crying about a person's death and for a cultural practice always associated with showing one's sadness, both of those terms should be used here.
trans-unit.target: Moja ya maneno ya Kigiriki kwa ajili ya kile watu walikuwa wakifanya inaelezea desturi yao ya kitamaduni ya kuonyesha huzuni kwa kupiga kifua chake mwenyewe. Ikiwa utamaduni wa tafsiri una maneno kwa ajili ya kulia juu ya kifo cha mtu na kwa desturi ya kitamaduni inayohusishwa daima na kuonyesha huzuni ya mtu, maneno hayo yote mawili yanapaswa kutumiwa hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~52#Note:What were other people at Jairus's house doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~54#Answer:What did Jesus do with the girl?-183687290
trans-unit.source: Holding her hand, he spoke loudly and told her to get up. (54)
trans-unit.target: Akimshika mkono, alisema kwa sauti kubwa na kumwambia ainuke.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~54#Answer:What did Jesus do with the girl?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.55+What happened then?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~55#Question:What happened then?
trans-unit.source: What happened then?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~55#Question:What happened then?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~55#Answer:What happened then?339996323
trans-unit.source: The child's spirit/breath returned into her body and she immediately stood up. (55)
trans-unit.target: Roho/pumzi ya mtoto huyo ilirudi ndani ya mwili wake na mara moja akainuka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~55#Answer:What happened then?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.56+What did the girl's parents think about what had just happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~56#Question:What did the girl's parents think about what had just happened?
trans-unit.source: What did the girl's parents think about what had just happened?
trans-unit.target: Wazazi wa msichana huyo walifikiri nini kuhusu jambo lililokuwa limetukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~56#Question:What did the girl's parents think about what had just happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~56#Answer:What did the girl's parents think about what had just happened?1468352352
trans-unit.source: They were greatly astounded. (56)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakishangaa sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~56#Answer:What did the girl's parents think about what had just happened?

group.id: Q:LUK 8.55-56+What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!8~55#Question:What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wazazi wa msichana huyo wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~55#Question:What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~55#Answer:What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?-171760457
trans-unit.source: He ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened. (56)
trans-unit.target: Akawaonya wasimwambie mtu habari zake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~55#Answer:What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!8~55#Answer:What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?-916699322
trans-unit.source: (He also had told someone to give the girl some food to eat. We assume it was her parents who did it.) (55)
trans-unit.target: (Alikuwa pia amemwambia mtu fulani ampe msichana chakula. Tunafikiria ni wazazi wake walifanya hivyo.) (55)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!8~55#Answer:What did Jesus tell the girl's parents to do?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!9~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 9:1-6 Jesus sent out the twelve apostles.
trans-unit.target: Luka 9:1-6 Yesu aliwatuma mitume kumi na wawili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 9.1-6+What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~1#Question:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwatuma mitume wake kumi na wawili wafanye nini kwa niaba yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Question:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~1#Answer:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?-310850607
trans-unit.source: They were to preach/proclaim [that] God was restoring his kingdom [in the words and work of Jesus].
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuhubiri/kutangaza [kwamba] Mungu alikuwa akirudisha ufalme wake [katika maneno na kazi ya Yesu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Answer:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~1#Answer:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?-93378393
trans-unit.source: They were also to heal the sick. (2)
trans-unit.target: Pia walipaswa kuwaponya wagonjwa. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Answer:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~1#Note:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?-777713763
trans-unit.source: This "healing of the sick" probably included casting out demons from people who were bothered/controlled by them.
trans-unit.target: Huenda 'kuponya wagonjwa' huko kulitia ndani kuwafukuza roho waovu kutoka kwa watu waliokuwa wamesumbuliwa au kuongozwa nao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Note:What did Jesus send the twelve apostles to do on his behalf?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.1-6+How were the twelve apostles going to be able to do the great things that Jesus had been doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~1#Question:How were the twelve apostles going to be able to do the great things that Jesus had been doing?
trans-unit.source: How were the twelve apostles going to be able to do the great things that Jesus had been doing?
trans-unit.target: Mitume hao kumi na wawili wangewezaje kufanya mambo makuu ambayo Yesu alikuwa amekuwa akifanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Question:How were the twelve apostles going to be able to do the great things that Jesus had been doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~1#Answer:How were the twelve apostles going to be able to do the great things that Jesus had been doing?1034650440
trans-unit.source: He gave them power and authority to drive/cast out all demons and to cure diseases. (1)
trans-unit.target: Aliwapa nguvu na mamlaka ya kufukuza/kufukuza pepo wote na kuponya magonjwa. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Answer:How were the twelve apostles going to be able to do the great things that Jesus had been doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.1-6+What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~1#Question:What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?
trans-unit.source: What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?
trans-unit.target: Mitume walifanya nini walipokuwa wakizunguka katika vijiji?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Question:What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~1#Answer:What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?1192684612
trans-unit.source: They announced the Good News and healed people everywhere. (6)
trans-unit.target: Walihubiri Habari Njema na kuponya watu kila mahali. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Answer:What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~1#Note:What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?187776202
trans-unit.source: The NIV uses the words "preaching the gospel" in this verse. This translates the Greek word which means "tell good news". The translator should use the same wording here that he used in 3:18 and 4:18 to talk about this message. It was the same message which John and Jesus had preached. (See "gospel" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: NIV inatumia maneno "kuhubiri injili" katika mstari huu. Hii inatafsiri neno la Kigiriki ambalo linamaanisha "kuambia habari njema". Mtafsiri anapaswa kutumia maneno yale yale aliyotumia hapa katika 3:18 na 4:18 kuzungumza juu ya ujumbe huu. Ilikuwa ni ujumbe ule ule ambao Yohana na Yesu walikuwa wamehubiri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~1#Note:What did the apostles do when they went around to villages?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.3+What were the apostles to take with them on their travels?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~3#Question:What were the apostles to take with them on their travels?
trans-unit.source: What were the apostles to take with them on their travels?
trans-unit.target: Mitume wangechukua nini katika safari zao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~3#Question:What were the apostles to take with them on their travels?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~3#Answer:What were the apostles to take with them on their travels?-369738011
trans-unit.source: They were to take nothing; no walking stick, no bag, no money, no food and no extra clothes. (3)
trans-unit.target: Hawakupaswa kuchukua chochote; wala fimbo, wala mkoba, wala pesa, wala chakula wala mavazi ya ziada. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~3#Answer:What were the apostles to take with them on their travels?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.3+Those are all things people take with them when they go on a long walk to another place, even today. In what way, do you think, would the disciples get the things they might need?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~3#Question:Those are all things people take with them when they go on a long walk to another place, even today. In what way, do you think, would the disciples get the things they might need?
trans-unit.source: Those are all things people take with them when they go on a long walk to another place, even today. In what way, do you think, would the disciples get the things they might need?
trans-unit.target: Hayo yote ni vitu ambavyo watu huchukua pamoja nao wanapoenda safari ndefu kwenda mahali pengine, hata leo. Unafikiri wanafunzi wangepataje vitu ambavyo huenda wakahitaji?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~3#Question:Those are all things people take with them when they go on a long walk to another place, even today. In what way, do you think, would the disciples get the things they might need?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~3#Answer:Those are all things people take with them when they go on a long walk to another place, even today. In what way, do you think, would the disciples get the things they might need?-357121685
trans-unit.source: Jesus expected them to trust God to provide for their needs. (They really would have to begin allowing God to rule in their lives.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitarajia wamtumaini Mungu kuandaa mahitaji yao (Kwa kweli wangepaswa kuanza kumruhusu Mungu atawale maisha zao).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~3#Answer:Those are all things people take with them when they go on a long walk to another place, even today. In what way, do you think, would the disciples get the things they might need?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.4+Where were the disciples to stay when they visited a village?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~4#Question:Where were the disciples to stay when they visited a village?
trans-unit.source: Where were the disciples to stay when they visited a village?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walipaswa kukaa wapi walipotembelea kijiji fulani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~4#Question:Where were the disciples to stay when they visited a village?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~4#Answer:Where were the disciples to stay when they visited a village?-1881113859
trans-unit.source: They should stay the whole time they were at that village in the first house where they were welcomed. (4)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kukaa muda wote ambao walikuwa katika kijiji hicho katika nyumba ya kwanza waliyokaribishwa. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~4#Answer:Where were the disciples to stay when they visited a village?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.5+What were they to do if the town's people did not welcome them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~5#Question:What were they to do if the town's people did not welcome them?
trans-unit.source: What were they to do if the town's people did not welcome them?
trans-unit.target: Wangefanya nini ikiwa watu wa mji huo hawangekaribisha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Question:What were they to do if the town's people did not welcome them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~5#Answer:What were they to do if the town's people did not welcome them?-947364361
trans-unit.source: They were to leave that town. As they were leaving, they were to shake off the dust from their feet. (5)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuondoka katika jiji hilo na kuyakung'uta mavumbi kutoka miguuni mwao (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Answer:What were they to do if the town's people did not welcome them?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.5+What would that action do besides help clean their feet?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~5#Question:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?
trans-unit.source: What would that action do besides help clean their feet?
trans-unit.target: Tendo hilo lingetimiza nini zaidi ya kusaidia kusafisha miguu yao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Question:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~5#Answer:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?366592546
trans-unit.source: It would show the town's people that the apostles were separating themselves from them. (5)
trans-unit.target: Ingeonyesha watu wa mji kwamba mitume walikuwa wakijitenga nao. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Answer:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~5#Answer:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?1663879822
trans-unit.source: It would show that the apostles didn't want even dust from that place to go with them [in the work Jesus had given them]. (5)
trans-unit.target: Ingeonyesha kwamba mitume hawakutaka hata mavumbi ya mahali hapo yaende pamoja nao [katika kazi ambayo Yesu alikuwa amewapa]. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Answer:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~5#Answer:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?1532742378
trans-unit.source: It would show that the one who had sent the apostles, Jesus/God, would be angry with those people because of their unbelief. (5)
trans-unit.target: Ingeonyesha kwamba yule aliyekuwa ametuma mitume, Yesu/Mungu, angekasirika na watu hao kwa sababu ya kutoamini kwao. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Answer:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~5#Note:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?-1793573779
trans-unit.source: This custom was practiced by the Jews when they left a non-Jewish/Gentile town because just being there would make the Jews ritually unclean. Then they could not worship at the temple. If the apostles did this in Jewish villages and towns, townspeople would know that they were being treated as people who rejected God.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mitume walifanya hivi katika vijiji vya Wayahudi na miji, watu wa mji wangejua kwamba walikuwa wakitendewa kama watu waliomkataa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~5#Note:What would that action do besides help clean their feet?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!9~7#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 9:7-9 King Herod was confused about who Jesus was.
trans-unit.target: Luka 9:7-9 Mfalme Herode alichanganyikiwa kuhusu Yesu alikuwa nani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~7#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 9.7-9+Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~7#Question:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?
trans-unit.source: Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mfalme Herode alikuwa na mvurugo kuhusu Yesu alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~7#Question:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~7#Answer:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?-802019356
trans-unit.source: He had heard about all that had happened [regarding Jesus's preaching and miracles]. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amesikia kuhusu mambo yote yaliyokuwa yametukia [kuhusu mahubiri na miujiza ya Yesu]. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~7#Answer:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~7#Answer:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?-107986982
trans-unit.source: Some [people] were saying that Jesus might be John [the Baptizer] whom [God] had raised from the dead. (7)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya [watu] walikuwa wakisema kwamba huenda Yesu ndiye Yohana [Mbatizaji] ambaye [Mungu] alikuwa amemfufua kutoka kwa wafu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~7#Answer:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~7#Answer:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?875379043
trans-unit.source: But Herod had seen John's head after [he (Herod) had ordered someone] to cut it off/sever it from his body, so he did not know who Jesus really was. (9)
trans-unit.target: Lakini Herode alikuwa ameona kichwa cha Yohana baada ya [yeye (Herode) alikuwa ameamuru mtu] kukikata/kukikata kutoka kwa mwili wake, kwa hiyo hakujua Yesu alikuwa nani hasa. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~7#Answer:Why was King Herod confused about who Jesus was?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.8+What were other people saying about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~8#Question:What were other people saying about who Jesus was?
trans-unit.source: What were other people saying about who Jesus was?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine walisema Yesu alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~8#Question:What were other people saying about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~8#Answer:What were other people saying about who Jesus was?-442120125
trans-unit.source: Some said that he was [the prophet] Elijah who had reappeared, while still others said that [God] had raised from the dead one of the [other] prophets of long ago. (8)
trans-unit.target: Na wengine wakasema: Huyu ni Eliya, na wengine wakasema: Huyu ni mmojawapo wa manabii wa kale aliyetokea.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~8#Answer:What were other people saying about who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~8#Note:What were other people saying about who Jesus was?77174469
trans-unit.source: Elijah had not died, but God had taken him straight up to heaven (see 2 Kings 2). Be sure the translation does not say that Elijah had "come back to life again".
trans-unit.target: Eliya hakuwa amekufa, lakini Mungu alikuwa amemchukua moja kwa moja mbinguni (ona 2 Wafalme 2).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~8#Note:What were other people saying about who Jesus was?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.9+What did King Herod want to do to end his confusion?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~9#Question:What did King Herod want to do to end his confusion?
trans-unit.source: What did King Herod want to do to end his confusion?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme Herode alitaka kufanya nini ili kumaliza mvurugo wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~9#Question:What did King Herod want to do to end his confusion?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~9#Answer:What did King Herod want to do to end his confusion?2146149756
trans-unit.source: He tried to meet/see Jesus. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alijaribu kukutana/kumwona Yesu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~9#Answer:What did King Herod want to do to end his confusion?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.10-17+Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~10#Question:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mara nyingi watu wengi huketi pamoja kula kwenye karamu. Ni nini ulichosikia katika hadithi hii ambacho kingekufanya useme kwamba muujiza ulitokea wakati watu hao 5,000 walikula pamoja na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Question:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?

trans-unit.source: Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mara nyingi watu wengi huketi pamoja kula kwenye karamu. Ni nini ulichosikia katika hadithi hii ambacho kingekufanya useme kwamba muujiza ulitokea wakati watu hao 5,000 walikula pamoja na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Alternate:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~10#Alternate:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?10789010
trans-unit.source: Often many people sit down together to eat at a feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mara nyingi watu wengi huketi pamoja kula kwenye karamu. Ni nini ulichosikia katika hadithi hii ambacho kingekufanya useme kwamba muujiza ulitokea wakati watu hao 5,000 walikula pamoja na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Alternate:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~10#Answer:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?-1889274754
trans-unit.source: Jesus had only five bread rolls and two fish, but he, being the son of God, caused them to multiply/increase into enough pieces to satisfy all those people. (16)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa na mikate mitano na samaki wawili tu, lakini yeye, akiwa mwana wa Mungu, aliyafanya yaongezeke/kuongezeka kuwa vipande vya kutosha kuridhisha watu wote hao. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Answer:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~10#Answer:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?-740954948
trans-unit.source: Even more, they still had twelve basketfuls left over [uneaten]. (The leftover food was more than they had at the beginning [13], before Jesus blessed the food [16].) (13-17)
trans-unit.target: Hata zaidi, bado walikuwa na vikapu kumi na mbili kamili vilivyobaki [bila kula]. (Chakula kilichobaki kilikuwa zaidi kuliko walivyokuwa nacho mwanzoni [13], kabla ya Yesu kubariki chakula [16].) (13-17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Answer:Often many people sit down together to eat at a banquet/feast. What did you hear in this story that would cause you to say that a miracle happened when those 5,000 people ate together with Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.10+What did the apostles do when they returned from the work Jesus had sent them to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~10#Question:What did the apostles do when they returned from the work Jesus had sent them to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the apostles do when they returned from the work Jesus had sent them to do?
trans-unit.target: Mitume walifanya nini waliporudi kutoka kwenye kazi ambayo Yesu alikuwa amewatuma wafanye?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Question:What did the apostles do when they returned from the work Jesus had sent them to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~10#Answer:What did the apostles do when they returned from the work Jesus had sent them to do?-1920616784
trans-unit.source: They reported to Jesus what they had done [in their time away from him]. (10)
trans-unit.target: Walimwambia Yesu mambo waliyofanya [wakati wao wakiwa mbali naye]. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~10#Answer:What did the apostles do when they returned from the work Jesus had sent them to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.10+Why did Jesus take the apostles to an area near the town of Bethsaida?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.13+How much food did the disciples have altogether?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~13#Question:How much food did the disciples have altogether?
trans-unit.source: How much food did the disciples have altogether?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa na chakula kiasi gani kwa ujumla?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~13#Question:How much food did the disciples have altogether?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~13#Answer:How much food did the disciples have altogether?-551987431
trans-unit.source: They had five bread rolls and two [smoked/cooked] fish. (13)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na mikate mitano na samaki wawili [waliochomwa/kuchemshwa] (13).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~13#Answer:How much food did the disciples have altogether?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~13#Note:How much food did the disciples have altogether?929961699
trans-unit.source: The "bread" of the Middle Eastern cultures is not the size or shape of the loaf of bread common among Westerners. The word used for "fish" either should imply small ones that one person could easily eat at one meal, or it should not imply anything about size. The same story in John 6:9 makes it clear they were small fish or only portions of fish that were ready to be eaten with the bread. (See L&N entry 5.16.)
trans-unit.target: "Mkate" wa tamaduni za Mashariki ya Kati sio ukubwa au umbo la mkate wa kawaida kati ya watu wa Magharibi. Neno linalotumiwa kwa "samaki" linapaswa kumaanisha ndogo ambazo mtu mmoja anaweza kula kwa urahisi kwenye mlo mmoja, au haipaswi kumaanisha chochote juu ya saizi. Hadithi hiyo hiyo katika Yohana 6: 9 inaonyesha wazi kuwa walikuwa samaki wadogo au sehemu tu za samaki ambazo zilikuwa tayari kuliwa na mkate. (Tazama L & N kiingilio 5.16.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~13#Note:How much food did the disciples have altogether?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.12-14+How many people were there with the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~12#Question:How many people were there with the disciples?
trans-unit.source: How many people were there with the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na watu wangapi pamoja na wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~12#Question:How many people were there with the disciples?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~12#Note:How many people were there with the disciples?1088532895
trans-unit.source: 5,000 people were there, counting only the men. (14a)
trans-unit.target: Watu 5,000 walikuwapo, wakihesabu wanaume tu. (14a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~12#Note:How many people were there with the disciples?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~12#Note:How many people were there with the disciples?-1265646948
trans-unit.source: There were probably much fewer women and children present than men because it was far from where people normally lived. Also remember that the Jews began calling a boy a man after he had been through the ritual at the temple at the age of 12 or 13, as Jesus had done. Each culture begins to use the term "man" after different events and different ages. The terms used here should cover all the males aged 13 and older. For example, the Hewa translation in Papua New Guinea used the words "5,000 married-men and mature-boys".
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea kulikuwa na wanawake na watoto wachache kuliko wanaume kwa sababu ilikuwa mbali na mahali ambapo watu waliishi kwa kawaida. Pia kumbuka kwamba Wayahudi walianza kumwita mvulana mwanamume baada ya yeye kupitia ibada katika hekalu akiwa na umri wa miaka 12 au 13, kama Yesu alivyofanya. Kila utamaduni huanza kutumia neno "mwanamume" baada ya matukio tofauti na umri tofauti.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~12#Note:How many people were there with the disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.12-14+Do you think that the disciples wanted to go somewhere to get enough food for all those people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~12#Question:Do you think that the disciples wanted to go somewhere to get enough food for all those people?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that the disciples wanted to go somewhere to get enough food for all those people?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri wanafunzi walitaka kwenda mahali fulani ili wapate chakula cha kutosha kwa ajili ya watu wote hao?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~12#Answer:Do you think that the disciples wanted to go somewhere to get enough food for all those people?1385363555
trans-unit.source: No, they did not. They said earlier that no one lived nearby. It was an impossible option. (Besides, they would need a lot of money and more than 12 men to carry enough food back to that place. See Mark 6:35-37.)
trans-unit.target: La, hawakusema hivyo. Walikuwa wamesema mapema kwamba hakuna mtu aliyeishi karibu na mahali hapo. Haingewezekana. (Zaidi ya hayo, wangehitaji pesa nyingi na wanaume zaidi ya 12 ili kubeba chakula cha kutosha kurudi mahali hapo. Ona Marko 6:35-37.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~12#Answer:Do you think that the disciples wanted to go somewhere to get enough food for all those people?

trans-unit.source: The Greek word order shows us that Jesus was making a strong contrast between the crowd's thinking and the disciples' thinking. It would be good if the translation could show that contrast. In English, it might be like this: "And you? Who do you say that I am?"

group.id: Q:LUK 9.21-27+How should a person act who truly wants to follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~21#Question:How should a person act who truly wants to follow Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How should a person act who truly wants to follow Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mtu anayetaka kumfuata Yesu kikweli anapaswa kutenda jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Question:How should a person act who truly wants to follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~21#Answer:How should a person act who truly wants to follow Jesus?1929326168
trans-unit.source: He must do as Jesus did, being committed each day to God, even when the things of this world look like they will make that person very happy or when people might make fun of him because he believes in Jesus as the savior. Each day that person must deny his human desire to take good care of himself by focusing on getting more and more possessions. Owning all the things in the world will not keep him from dying or being killed. He must do as Jesus did, even if it leads to suffering, rejection or being killed. That will lead him to the kind of life God wants him to have. (23-25)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima afanye kama Yesu alivyofanya, akijitoa kila siku kwa Mungu, hata wakati vitu vya ulimwengu huu vinaonekana kuwa vitamfanya mtu huyo kuwa na furaha sana au wakati watu wanaweza kumdhihaki kwa sababu anaamini katika Yesu kama mwokozi. Kila siku mtu huyo lazima akatae tamaa yake ya kibinadamu ya kujitunza vizuri kwa kuzingatia kupata mali zaidi na zaidi. Kumiliki vitu vyote ulimwenguni hakutamzuia kufa au kuuawa. Lazima afanye kama Yesu alivyofanya, hata kama itasababisha mateso, kukataliwa au kuuawa. Hiyo itampeleka kwa aina ya maisha ambayo Mungu anataka awe nayo. (23-25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Answer:How should a person act who truly wants to follow Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.21-22+What do you think was the reason that Jesus told the disciples not to tell anyone yet about this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~21#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus told the disciples not to tell anyone yet about this?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus told the disciples not to tell anyone yet about this?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus told the disciples not to tell anyone yet about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~21#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus told the disciples not to tell anyone yet about this?665722796
trans-unit.source: He didn't want them to tell other people yet because the Jews had wrongly understood what kind of a savior the Messiah would be. He needed more time to teach more Jews the truth about the savior whom God had now sent.
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka waambie watu wengine kwa sababu Wayahudi walikuwa wameelewa vibaya ni aina gani ya mwokozi Masihi angekuwa. Alihitaji muda zaidi kufundisha Wayahudi zaidi ukweli kuhusu mwokozi ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma sasa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus told the disciples not to tell anyone yet about this?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.22+What did Jesus say would happen to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~22#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema angepata nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~22#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?1983578535
trans-unit.source: He must suffer many things/in many ways/much. (22)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima apate mateso mengi/kwa njia nyingi/mengi. (22)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?2041511998
trans-unit.source: The elders [of the Jews] and the chief priests and the teachers of the Law/scribes would reject him/his claim to be the Messiah. (22)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?322200505
trans-unit.source: People would kill him. (22)
trans-unit.target: Watu wangemuua.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.21-22+What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~21#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alitaja vikundi hivyo vitatu hususa vya watu ambao wangemkataa na alipaswa kusema nini kujihusu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~21#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?2080080364
trans-unit.source: Those three groups were the leaders who together decided what was right or wrong for the Jews to do or think. They would influence all the other people as to what they should think about Jesus or do to him.
trans-unit.target: Makundi hayo matatu yalikuwa viongozi ambao kwa pamoja waliamua kile kilichofaa au kibaya kwa Wayahudi kufanya au kufikiria. Wangeathiri watu wengine wote kuhusu kile wanachopaswa kufikiria juu ya Yesu au kumfanyia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~21#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?-402606462
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check:
trans-unit.target: Key neno Angalia:
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~21#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?126506873
trans-unit.source: The elders (of the Jews) were the older and wiser Jewish men who met to discuss problems in their Jewish society and culture.
trans-unit.target: Wazee (wa Wayahudi) walikuwa wanaume Wayahudi wenye umri mkubwa na wenye hekima zaidi ambao walikutana ili kuzungumzia matatizo katika jamii na utamaduni wao wa Kiyahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~21#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?1230847102
trans-unit.source: The chief priests were the leaders among the priests at the temple in Jerusalem. They decided everything that had to do with worship of God and use of the temple grounds. (See "Chief Priest, High Priest" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: Wakuu wa makuhani walikuwa viongozi miongoni mwa makuhani katika hekalu la Yerusalemu. Waliamua juu ya kila kitu kilichohusiana na ibada ya Mungu na matumizi ya uwanja wa hekalu (Ona "Kuhani Mkuu, Kuhani Mkuu" katika KBT).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~21#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?1504779385
trans-unit.source: The teachers of the Law/scribes were the ones who knew best how to apply the laws God had told to Moses in everyday Jewish life. (See the answer back at 5:17.)
trans-unit.target: Walimu wa Sheria/waandishi ndio waliojua vizuri zaidi jinsi ya kutumia sheria ambazo Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Musa katika maisha ya kila siku ya Wayahudi (Ona jibu nyuma kwenye 5:17).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~21#Note:What do you think was the reason that Jesus named those three specific groups of people who would reject him and what he had to say about himself?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+What must one do if he wants to follow Jesus?

trans-unit.target: Anapaswa kujikana mwenyewe,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:What must one do if he wants to follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:What must one do if he wants to follow Jesus?148432860
trans-unit.source: take up his cross each day and
trans-unit.target: kuchukua msalaba wake kila siku na
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:What must one do if he wants to follow Jesus?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:What must one do if he wants to follow Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+What do you think it means to deny oneself?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:What do you think it means to deny oneself?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to deny oneself?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kujikana mwenyewe kunamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:What do you think it means to deny oneself?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:What do you think it means to deny oneself?-1838612100
trans-unit.source: It means that a person does not think only about himself and those things which make him happy. (Jesus wanted people to think about how to please God and be totally committed to him first.)
trans-unit.target: Maana yake ni kwamba mtu hajifikirii yeye mwenyewe na mambo yanayomfanya awe na furaha (Yesu alitaka watu wafikirie jinsi ya kumpendeza Mungu na kujitolea kabisa kwake kwanza).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:What do you think it means to deny oneself?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?
trans-unit.source: At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?
trans-unit.target: Katika siku za Yesu, mtu alibeba msalaba ilimaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?-485836274
trans-unit.source: It meant that person was on his way to die (by being nailed on crossed timbers until he could not breathe anymore).
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa ikimaanisha kwamba mtu huyo alikuwa njiani kwenda kufa (kwa kutiwa misumari kwenye miti iliyopangwa mpaka asingeweza kupumua tena).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?1920014880
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "cross, crucify" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "msalaba, msalaba" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:At the time Jesus lived, when a person carried a cross, what do you think it meant?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kwa watu leo kuchukua/kubeba msalaba wa mtu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~23#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?1843166661
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for people today to take up one's cross?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kwa watu leo kuchukua msalaba wao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~23#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?-1992087752
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for people today to carry one's cross?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu leo wanapaswa kufanya nini ili waendelee kubeba msalaba wao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?-949343627
trans-unit.source: It means that a person must accept whatever suffering comes because he is one who follows Jesus. He must be willing to die in order to remain faithful to God, even die in a humiliating way like those who died on a cross.
trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha kwamba mtu lazima akubali mateso yoyote yanayotokea kwa sababu yeye ni mmoja wa wafuasi wa Yesu. Lazima awe tayari kufa ili kubaki mwaminifu kwa Mungu, hata kufa kwa njia ya aibu kama wale waliokufa msalabani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:What do you think it means for people today to take up/carry one's cross?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+How often must the person who follows Jesus put his focus on God, not himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:How often must the person who follows Jesus put his focus on God, not himself?
trans-unit.source: How often must the person who follows Jesus put his focus on God, not himself?
trans-unit.target: Ni mara ngapi mtu anayemfuata Yesu apaswa kumkazia fikira Mungu, si yeye mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:How often must the person who follows Jesus put his focus on God, not himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:How often must the person who follows Jesus put his focus on God, not himself?1743852889
trans-unit.source: He must do it every day. Every day he must be willing to suffer whatever happens to him because he has put God first in his life. (This is not an action that a person does once and then forgets about it.)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima afanye hivyo kila siku. Kila siku ni lazima awe tayari kuteseka chochote kinachompata kwa sababu amemtanguliza Mungu maishani mwake. (Hii si tendo ambalo mtu hufanya mara moja na kisha kusahau juu yake.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:How often must the person who follows Jesus put his focus on God, not himself?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.24+What did Jesus say would happen to the person who wanted to save his own life?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~24#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to the person who wanted to save his own life?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to the person who wanted to save his own life?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ingekuwaje kwa mtu aliyetaka kuokoa uhai wake mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~24#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to the person who wanted to save his own life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~24#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to the person who wanted to save his own life?-1207739631
trans-unit.source: He said that person would lose it. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mtu huyo angepoteza ufahamu wake. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~24#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to the person who wanted to save his own life?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?
trans-unit.source: That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?524481831
trans-unit.source: The person who does not do as Jesus just said in verse 23 will lose his chance to have the eternal life that Jesus promised elsewhere in the gospels.
trans-unit.target: Mtu asiyetenda kama vile Yesu alivyosema katika mstari wa 23 atapoteza nafasi yake ya kupata uhai wa milele ambao Yesu aliahidi mahali pengine katika Gospeli.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?-2134816763
trans-unit.source: He may also die physically just as Jesus said that he would in verse 22.
trans-unit.target: Huenda pia akafa kimwili kama vile Yesu alivyosema katika mstari wa 22.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?1841508816
trans-unit.source: Luke had not written anything about eternal life up to this point in his gospel. Therefore, if the respondent has not been a worshipping Christian for a long time, he will find that this question is impossible to answer. He has no background to fit it into, and the words are a paradox. Do not be critical of anyone's answer to this question.
trans-unit.target: Luka hakuwa ameandika chochote kuhusu uzima wa milele hadi wakati huu katika injili yake. Kwa hiyo, ikiwa mtu aliyehojiwa hajawa Mkristo anayemwabudu kwa muda mrefu, ataona kuwa swali hili haliwezekani kujibu. Hana historia ya kuliweka ndani, na maneno ni ya kutatanisha. Usikosoe jibu la mtu yeyote kwa swali hili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.24+What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because he follows Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~24#Question:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because he follows Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because he follows Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ingekuwaje ikiwa mtu angepoteza uhai wake kwa sababu ya kumfuata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~24#Question:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because he follows Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~24#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because he follows Jesus?-646181854
trans-unit.source: He said that person would save it. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mtu huyo ataiokoa. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~24#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because he follows Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by saying that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by saying that?
trans-unit.source: This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by saying that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by saying that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by saying that?-1857954639
trans-unit.source: He was not talking about a person's physical life, so he must have been referring again to spiritual life that is eternal. The person who does as Jesus said in verse 23 will receive the eternal life that Jesus promised.
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa akizungumza kuhusu uhai wa kimwili wa mtu, kwa hiyo lazima awe alikuwa akirejelea tena uhai wa kiroho ambao ni wa milele. Mtu anayefanya kama Yesu alivyosema katika mstari wa 23 atapokea uzima wa milele ambao Yesu aliahidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by saying that?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.25+What did Jesus say about a person who gains control or becomes the owner of everything in the world?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~25#Question:What did Jesus say about a person who gains control or becomes the owner of everything in the world?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about a person who gains control or becomes the owner of everything in the world?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya mtu anayepata mamlaka au anayekuwa mmiliki wa kila kitu ulimwenguni?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~25#Question:What did Jesus say about a person who gains control or becomes the owner of everything in the world?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~25#Answer:What did Jesus say about a person who gains control or becomes the owner of everything in the world?329254155
trans-unit.source: He has gained nothing important if it means that he loses or gives up his own spirit [for all of eternity]. // He has given up the most important, eternal thing in order to have pleasure in this short life. The trade is not worth it, Jesus said. (25)
trans-unit.target: Yeye hajafaidika kitu chochote muhimu ikiwa inamaanisha kwamba yeye hupoteza au kutoa roho yake mwenyewe [kwa umilele wote]. // Yeye ameacha jambo la muhimu zaidi, la milele ili kupata raha katika maisha haya mafupi. Biashara haifai, Yesu alisema. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~25#Answer:What did Jesus say about a person who gains control or becomes the owner of everything in the world?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.26+What will happen to the person who is ashamed when other people know he follows Jesus and obeys what he taught?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~26#Question:What will happen to the person who is ashamed when other people know he follows Jesus and obeys what he taught?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to the person who is ashamed when other people know he follows Jesus and obeys what he taught?
trans-unit.target: Itakuwaje kwa mtu anayeona aibu wakati watu wengine wanapojua kwamba anamfuata Yesu na kutii yale aliyofundisha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~26#Question:What will happen to the person who is ashamed when other people know he follows Jesus and obeys what he taught?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~26#Answer:What will happen to the person who is ashamed when other people know he follows Jesus and obeys what he taught?1436049854
trans-unit.source: The Son of Man, Jesus, will be ashamed of him/her when he comes [back to this earth from heaven, not from the grave,] surrounded by his [own] glory and the glory of the Father and the holy angels. (26)
trans-unit.target: Mwana wa Adamu, Yesu, ataona aibu kwake atakaporudi [duniani kutoka mbinguni, si kutoka kaburini,] akiwa amezungukwa na utukufu wake mwenyewe na utukufu wa Baba na wa malaika watakatifu. (26)

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+Luke has not written anything in the earlier parts of this book about Jesus going away and coming back. To what, do you think, was he referring?

trans-unit.target: Luka hakuandika chochote katika sehemu za mapema za kitabu hiki kuhusu Yesu kwenda na kurudi. Unafikiri alikuwa akirejezea nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:Luke has not written anything in the earlier parts of this book about Jesus going away and coming back. To what, do you think, was he referring?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:Luke has not written anything in the earlier parts of this book about Jesus going away and coming back. To what, do you think, was he referring?68133319
trans-unit.source: Jesus told us elsewhere in the gospels that one day he will come back from heaven to judge all the people on the earth. (See Matt. 16:27; 25:31-47; Mark 13:32-37; Luke 21:8-28.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alituambia mahali pengine katika injili kwamba siku moja atarudi kutoka mbinguni kuhukumu watu wote duniani (Ona Mathayo 16:27; 25:31-47; Marko 13:32-37; Luka 21:8-28).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:Luke has not written anything in the earlier parts of this book about Jesus going away and coming back. To what, do you think, was he referring?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.23+What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~23#Question:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingetukia kabla ya watu fulani waliokuwa wamesimama hapo kufa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Question:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~23#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?1736898887
trans-unit.source: Some of them would see/experience/give their attention to the kingdom of God.
trans-unit.target: Baadhi yao wangeona/kupata uzoefu/kuelekeza fikira zao kwenye ufalme wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?2145403441
trans-unit.source: The Greek word translated "see" is used in many contexts, from ordinary seeing with one's eyes to meanings which include more and more mental understanding which becomes clearer. These would include meanings such as, "pay attention to", "take notice of" and "be concerned about". It also is used figuratively to mean "experience" (see John 3:36 and Heb. 11:5). The exact meaning to which Jesus referred when using this word in this verse is not altogether clear. Some of the possibilities are listed below.
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki lililotafsiriwa "ona" linatumiwa katika muktadha mbalimbali, kuanzia kuona kwa macho ya kawaida hadi maana ambayo inajumuisha ufahamu zaidi na zaidi wa kiakili ambao unakuwa wazi zaidi. Hizi zingejumuisha maana kama vile, "kuzingatia", "kuzingatia" na "kujali". Pia linatumiwa kwa njia ya mfano kumaanisha "uzoefu" (tazama Yohana 3:36 na Waebrania 11:5). Maana halisi ambayo Yesu alirejelea wakati wa kutumia neno hili katika mstari huu haijulikani kabisa. Baadhi ya uwezekano umeorodheshwa hapa chini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?617160343
trans-unit.source: Some of the people would see the brightness of Jesus's glory on a mountain eight days later (9:28-36). (Note: See the discussion about "glory" at 2:9 and 2:14.)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya watu wangeona mwangaza wa utukufu wa Yesu juu ya mlima siku nane baadaye (9:28-36). (Kumbuka: Ona mazungumzo juu ya "utukufu" kwenye 2:9 na 2:14.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?1200769242
trans-unit.source: Some would see Jesus die, rise from the dead to live again and then see him go up to heaven (23:26-24:53).
trans-unit.target: Wengine wangemwona Yesu akifa, akifufuka kutoka kwa wafu ili kuishi tena na kisha kumwona akipaa mbinguni (23:26-24:53).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?-1867366343
trans-unit.source: Some would see the Holy Spirit come on Pentecost. Those who believed that Jesus was the Christ would grow into large numbers of people (Acts 2; 4:23-35).
trans-unit.target: Baadhi yao wangeona Roho Mtakatifu akija siku ya Pentekoste. Wale walioamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa Kristo wangeongezeka kuwa idadi kubwa ya watu (Matendo 2; 4:23-35).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~23#Note:What did Jesus say would happen before some of the people who were standing there would die?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.28-36+What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~28#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka kuwafundisha au kuwaonyesha wanafunzi hao nini kwa kuwaonyesha mambo hayo yaliyotukia mlimani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~28#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~28#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?-1573642941
trans-unit.source: God was confirming that everything Jesus had taught them just the week before, as Luke recorded it in 9:22-27, really was true. They must listen to Jesus and know that the glory about which he had spoken would still come.
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa akithibitisha kwamba kila kitu ambacho Yesu alikuwa amewafundisha juma moja tu kabla, kama ilivyorekodiwa katika Luka 9:22-27, kilikuwa kweli kweli. Ni lazima wasikilize Yesu na kujua kwamba utukufu aliokuwa amezungumzia bado ungekuja.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~28#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~28#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?176605109
trans-unit.source: (He wanted these few disciples to have a brief look at the glory he had been talking about which would come in the kingdom of God. The glory would first be Jesus's and, later on, every believers'. The glory existed already, but God had not yet fully revealed it to all the people. Not even all the believers had experienced it yet.
trans-unit.target: (Alitaka wanafunzi hawa wachache kuona kwa ufupi utukufu ambao alikuwa akiongea juu ya ufalme wa Mungu utakaokuja. Utukufu kwanza kwa Yesu na baadaye kwa kila mwamini. Utukufu tayari upo, lakini Mungu bado haujadhihirishwa kikamilifu kwa watu wote. Hata waumini wote hawajapata uzoefu huo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~28#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~28#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?-423831236
trans-unit.source: They also heard the voice of God telling them that they must listen to Jesus. This was another witness confirming what they had heard Jesus himself already say. He was the one the disciples must follow, regardless of what the religious leaders told them. God had said so directly to them. What Jesus had just taught them in verses 22-27 was that he had insisted on suffering as the way to glory. He also had called on them to give up their own physical lives to gain eternal life, even to bear their own suffering because of their faith in him and follow him through his suffering.)
trans-unit.target: Pia walisikia sauti ya Mungu akiwaambia kwamba lazima wamsikilize Yesu. Huu ulikuwa ni ushuhuda mwingine wa kuthibitisha kile ambacho tayari walikuwa wamesikia Yesu mwenyewe akisema. Yeye ndiye ambaye wanafunzi walipaswa kumfuata, bila kujali kile viongozi wa kidini waliwaambia. Mungu alikuwa amewaambia hivyo moja kwa moja. Yesu alikuwa amewafundisha tu katika mistari ya 22-27 kwamba alikuwa amesisitiza juu ya mateso kama njia ya utukufu. Pia alikuwa amewaita waache maisha yao ya mwili ili kupata uzima wa milele, hata kubeba mateso yao wenyewe kwa sababu ya imani yao kwake na kumfuata kupitia mateso yake.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~28#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted to teach or show these disciples by having them see these things happen on the mountain?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.35+How do you know it was God who spoke?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~35#Question:How do you know it was God who spoke?
trans-unit.source: How do you know it was God who spoke?
trans-unit.target: Unajuaje kwamba Mungu ndiye aliyezungumza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~35#Question:How do you know it was God who spoke?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~35#Answer:How do you know it was God who spoke?-1697115896
trans-unit.source: He called Jesus his son whom he had chosen [to come into the world to die for mankind's sins]. (35)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita Yesu mwana wake ambaye alikuwa amemchagua [kuja ulimwenguni ili afe kwa ajili ya dhambi za wanadamu]. (35)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~35#Note:How do you know it was God who spoke?1003636541
trans-unit.source: The cloud and the brightness were also signs in the Old Testament that God was present. Any voice which people heard in that context was always God's voice. God had already spoken once from heaven when Jesus had been baptized by John (see Luke 3:22).
trans-unit.target: Wingu na mwangaza pia vilikuwa ni ishara katika Agano la Kale kwamba Mungu alikuwapo. Sauti yoyote ambayo watu walisikia katika muktadha huo ilikuwa daima sauti ya Mungu. Mungu alikuwa tayari amesema mara moja kutoka mbinguni wakati Yesu alibatizwa na Yohana (ona Luka 3:22).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~35#Note:How do you know it was God who spoke?

trans-unit.source: He said that Jesus was God's son and God had chosen him [to be the Christ/Messiah/savior]. (35)

group.id: Q:LUK 9.35+What did God say that the disciples should do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~35#Question:What did God say that the disciples should do?
trans-unit.source: What did God say that the disciples should do?
trans-unit.target: Mungu alisema wanafunzi walipaswa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~35#Question:What did God say that the disciples should do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~35#Answer:What did God say that the disciples should do?-257991706
trans-unit.source: They must listen to what Jesus taught them. (35)
trans-unit.target: Lazima wasikilize yale ambayo Yesu aliwafundisha. (35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~35#Answer:What did God say that the disciples should do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~35#Note:What did God say that the disciples should do?-1415106960
trans-unit.source: The Greek wording emphasizes that Jesus is the one they must listen to and obey. When the religious leaders would later openly oppose Jesus concerning the writings of Moses and the prophets, the disciples knew that God had already told them directly whom they must obey. When those same leaders would order the disciples to stop talking about Jesus, the disciples could show from the Old Testament that they must follow God's instructions, not men's.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya Kigiriki yanakazia kwamba ni lazima wasikilize na kutii Yesu. Baadaye viongozi wa kidini walipompinga Yesu waziwazi kuhusu maandishi ya Musa na manabii, wanafunzi walijua kwamba Mungu alikuwa tayari amewaambia moja kwa moja ni nani wanapaswa kumtii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~35#Note:What did God say that the disciples should do?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~37#Answer:What happened when Jesus and the three disciples came down from the mountain?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.37-43a+What do you think was the reason that Jesus was so upset?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~37#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus was so upset?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus was so upset?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alikuwa na hasira hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~37#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus was so upset?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~37#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus was so upset?-740759703
trans-unit.source: He had given all twelve disciples power and authority over these things earlier (9:1). He had told them that the religious officials would reject his teachings and cause him to suffer and die because of it (9:22). They needed to believe completely in Jesus. However, they did not believe as completely as Peter had implied they did when he confessed his belief in who Jesus really was (9:20). Most of the other people also had followed Jesus regularly and heard what he had taught. He knew he was going to leave them all soon and did not have a lot of time to keep on teaching them. They should already have believed completely. This made him upset.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amewapa wanafunzi wote kumi na wawili nguvu na mamlaka juu ya mambo haya mapema (9:1). Alikuwa amewaambia kwamba viongozi wa kidini wangekataa mafundisho yake na kumfanya ateseke na kufa kwa sababu yake (9:22). Walihitaji kumwamini Yesu kikamilifu. Hata hivyo, hawakuamini kikamilifu kama Petro alivyodokeza walifanya wakati alikiri imani yake katika Yesu alikuwa nani kweli (9:20). Watu wengine wengi pia walikuwa wamemfuata Yesu kwa kawaida na kusikia kile alichofundisha. Alijua kuwa alikuwa akienda kuwaacha wote hivi karibuni na hakuwa na muda mwingi wa kuendelea kuwafundisha. Walipaswa kuwa tayari wameamini kabisa. Hii ilimkasirisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~37#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus was so upset?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~39#Answer:How often had that spirit bothered the boy?866551347

group.id: Q:LUK 9.41+How long did Jesus sound as though he wanted to stay and put up with their slow learning?

trans-unit.source: How long did Jesus sound as though he wanted to stay and put up with their slow learning?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionekana kama alitaka kukaa na kuvumilia kujifunza kwao polepole kwa muda gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~41#Question:How long did Jesus sound as though he wanted to stay and put up with their slow learning?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~41#Answer:How long did Jesus sound as though he wanted to stay and put up with their slow learning?-1514692591
trans-unit.source: He did not want to stay any extra time. He had told them everything that was important for them to believe and to live as members of God's kingdom. Jesus knew that his remaining time on earth was short. God would not delay his plan for Jesus to take away mankind's sin.
