trans-unit.source: They were all astounded/amazed at the great power of God to cast out such a powerful demon. (43a) (They knew that ordinary people did not have any control over the spirit world.)
trans-unit.target: Wote walishangaa/walishangaa kwa nguvu kubwa ya Mungu ya kumfukuza pepo mwenye nguvu kama huyo. (43a) (Walijua kwamba watu wa kawaida hawakuwa na udhibiti wowote juu ya ulimwengu wa roho.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~43#Answer:What did all the crowd think about this?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!9~43#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 9:43b-45 Jesus says someone will betray him to his enemies.
trans-unit.target: Luka 9:43b-45 Yesu anasema kwamba mtu fulani atamsaliti kwa adui zake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~43#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 9.43-44+What new information did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~43#Question:What new information did Jesus tell his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What new information did Jesus tell his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake habari gani mpya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~43#Question:What new information did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~43#Answer:What new information did Jesus tell his disciples?-553688494
trans-unit.source: He told them that someone would betray [him,] the Son of Man, into the hands/control of other men. (44)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba mtu fulani angemsaliti [yeye], Mwana wa binadamu, katika mikono/udhibiti wa watu wengine.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~43#Answer:What new information did Jesus tell his disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.44+What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~44#Question:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kumsaliti mtu mikononi/udhibiti wa watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~44#Question:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~44#Alternate:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?926316262
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kumsaliti mtu ili amweke mikononi mwa watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~44#Alternate:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~44#Alternate:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?-1821287874
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's control?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kumsaliti mtu ili awe chini ya udhibiti wa watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~44#Alternate:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~44#Answer:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?576905756
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means to deliver that person into the control of someone whom that person regards as an enemy. The person who betrays another pretends to be a friend or of the same mind as the person who is being betrayed, and then tricks him into making himself vulnerable/accessible to the enemy.
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Inamaanisha kumkabidhi mtu huyo kwa udhibiti wa mtu ambaye mtu huyo anamwona kama adui. Mtu anayemsaliti mwingine anajifanya kuwa rafiki au wa akili sawa na mtu anayesalitiwa, na kisha anamdanganya ili ajifanye kuwa dhaifu / kupatikana kwa adui.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~44#Answer:What do you think it means to betray someone into other people's hands/control?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.43+What were all the other people doing while Jesus talked to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~43#Question:What were all the other people doing while Jesus talked to his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What were all the other people doing while Jesus talked to his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine wote walikuwa wakifanya nini Yesu alipokuwa akizungumza na wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~43#Question:What were all the other people doing while Jesus talked to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~43#Answer:What were all the other people doing while Jesus talked to his disciples?-514448549
trans-unit.source: All the other people were [still] talking about being amazed at what Jesus had done. (43b)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine wote walikuwa [bado] wakisema juu ya kushangazwa na kile Yesu alikuwa amefanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~43#Answer:What were all the other people doing while Jesus talked to his disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.45+How did the disciples respond to what Jesus told them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~45#Question:How did the disciples respond to what Jesus told them?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples respond to what Jesus told them?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu aliwaambia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Question:How did the disciples respond to what Jesus told them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:How did the disciples respond to what Jesus told them?1260016778
trans-unit.source: Even though Jesus had told them to let the words really get set in their minds (that is, listen carefully and not forget), they did not understand what he meant. (45)
trans-unit.target: Ingawa Yesu alikuwa amewaambia waache maneno yawekewe kweli kweli akilini mwao (yaani, wasikilize kwa uangalifu na wasisahau), hawakuelewa alichomaanisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:How did the disciples respond to what Jesus told them?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.45+Why did they not understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~45#Question:Why did they not understand?
trans-unit.source: Why did they not understand?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakuelewa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Question:Why did they not understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not understand?-315922548
trans-unit.source: The clear meaning had been hidden [by God]. As a result, they did not understand it yet. (45)
trans-unit.target: Na hakika Mwenyezi Mungu amewapa wahyi wa kuwa wao hawatamwona, na kwamba wao hawatamfahamu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not understand?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not understand?-1937599925
trans-unit.source: The clear meaning had been hidden [by God] in order that they not understand it yet. (45)
trans-unit.target: Na yalifichwa kwao maana yake ili wasiweze kuyafahamu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not understand?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~45#Note:Why did they not understand?980744250
trans-unit.source: The Greek word hina relates parts of a sentence to each other. In this sentence it could be understood to either make the second part of the sentence be the result of the actions in the first part, or it could make the second part be the purpose of the actions in the first part. The choices above show these two acceptable ways to understand the verse.
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki hina linaunganisha sehemu za sentensi moja na nyingine. Katika sentensi hii inaweza kueleweka ama kufanya sehemu ya pili ya sentensi iwe matokeo ya vitendo katika sehemu ya kwanza, au inaweza kufanya sehemu ya pili iwe kusudi la vitendo katika sehemu ya kwanza. Chaguzi zilizo hapo juu zinaonyesha njia hizi mbili zinazokubalika za kuelewa aya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Note:Why did they not understand?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.45+Why did they not ask Jesus to explain it more clearly?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~45#Question:Why did they not ask Jesus to explain it more clearly?
trans-unit.source: Why did they not ask Jesus to explain it more clearly?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakumwuliza Yesu awaeleze zaidi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Question:Why did they not ask Jesus to explain it more clearly?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not ask Jesus to explain it more clearly?-696902302
trans-unit.source: They were afraid to ask him about it.
trans-unit.target: Nao wakaogopa kumwuliza juu ya hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:Why did they not ask Jesus to explain it more clearly?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.45+What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~45#Question:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini wanafunzi waliogopa kumwuliza Yesu awaeleze maneno yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Question:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?-242227367
trans-unit.source: They may have been afraid he would actually tell them about some terrible thing that was going to happen to him, that is, that he would be more specific about how he was going to die at the hand of others.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ikawa waliogopa kwamba angewaambia kwa kweli juu ya jambo fulani baya ambalo lingempata, yaani, kwamba angeeleza waziwazi zaidi jinsi ambavyo angekufa mikononi mwa wengine.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?-1474653449
trans-unit.source: They thought that all he had said on this matter was too mysterious to want to know more about it.
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba yote aliyokuwa amesema juu ya jambo hili yalikuwa ya ajabu sana wasiweze kujua zaidi juu yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?429731179
trans-unit.source: Jesus just had been angry with the people because they did not believe him. The disciples did not understand his teaching, so they did not want him to know that they did not understand this, either. He might really be angry with them then.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amekasirika tu na watu kwa sababu hawakumwamini. Wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa mafundisho yake, kwa hivyo hawakutaka ajue kuwa hawakuelewa hii pia, ili asiwe na hasira nao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?1885913618
trans-unit.source: Jesus just had shown everyone that he had God's power over evil spirits. It did not seem possible that anyone could trick/fool/betray Jesus into his enemies' hands/control. Therefore, they were afraid to ask about this.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amewaonyesha wote kwamba alikuwa na nguvu za Mungu juu ya roho waovu. Haikuonekana kuwa inawezekana kwamba mtu yeyote angeweza kumdanganya/kumdanganya/kumsaliti Yesu mikononi/udhibiti wa maadui zake. Kwa hivyo, waliogopa kuuliza juu ya hili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~45#Note:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?-153877653
trans-unit.source: There are several possible reasons that they were afraid to ask. Any one of these would be an adequate answer:
trans-unit.target: Kuna sababu kadhaa zinazowezekana kwamba waliogopa kuuliza. Yoyote ya haya ingekuwa jibu la kutosha:
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~45#Note:What do you think was the reason that the disciples were afraid to ask Jesus to explain his words?

trans-unit.source: Luke 9:46-48 Jesus's disciples argued about who would be the greatest in the kingdom of God.
trans-unit.target: Luka 9:46-48 Wanafunzi wa Yesu walibishana kuhusu ni nani angekuwa mkuu zaidi katika ufalme wa Mungu.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~46#Alternate:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~46#Alternate:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?-1932280237

trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nani angekuwa mtu mkuu zaidi katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~46#Alternate:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~46#Alternate:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?163207658

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~46#Alternate:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~46#Answer:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?-786260211
trans-unit.source: He said that the person who is willing to serve in the lowest position of honor is really the one who is the greatest/most important [in God's sight]. (48) (That person has given up all desire for personal greatness.)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mtu aliye tayari kutumikia katika cheo cha chini kabisa cha heshima ndiye aliye mkubwa zaidi/wa maana zaidi [kwa Mungu]. (48) (Mtu huyo ameacha tamaa yote ya ukuu wa kibinafsi.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~46#Answer:Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important disciple? -OR- Who did Jesus say would be the greatest/most important person in the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.46+What were the disciples arguing about among themselves?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~46#Question:What were the disciples arguing about among themselves?
trans-unit.source: What were the disciples arguing about among themselves?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wakibishana juu ya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~46#Question:What were the disciples arguing about among themselves?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~46#Answer:What were the disciples arguing about among themselves?-1487730045
trans-unit.source: They argued about which of them would be the greatest/most important person [in their group of 12/in the kingdom of God]. (46)
trans-unit.target: Walibishana juu ya ni nani kati yao angekuwa mkubwa zaidi/mkuu zaidi [katika kikundi chao cha 12/katika ufalme wa Mungu]. (46)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~46#Answer:What were the disciples arguing about among themselves?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.47+How did Jesus know about their discussion?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~47#Question:How did Jesus know about their discussion?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus know about their discussion?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijuaje mazungumzo yao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~47#Question:How did Jesus know about their discussion?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~47#Answer:How did Jesus know about their discussion?-751518572
trans-unit.source: He knew because he was the son of God. No one told him about it. (47)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwa sababu alikuwa mwana wa Mungu, hakuna mtu aliyemwambia juu ya hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~47#Answer:How did Jesus know about their discussion?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.47-48+What did Jesus do with a small child?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~47#Question:What did Jesus do with a small child?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do with a small child?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini na mtoto mdogo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~47#Question:What did Jesus do with a small child?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~47#Answer:What did Jesus do with a small child?-659956382
trans-unit.source: He got a small child and had him stand beside Jesus. (47)
trans-unit.target: Alichukua mtoto mdogo na kumweka kando ya Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~47#Answer:What did Jesus do with a small child?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~47#Answer:What did Jesus do with a small child?1653370374
trans-unit.source: Then Jesus used that child as a focal point for what he told the disciples about being great/important. (48)
trans-unit.target: Kisha Yesu alitumia mtoto huyo kama msingi wa kile alichowaambia wanafunzi juu ya kuwa mkubwa/muhimu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~47#Answer:What did Jesus do with a small child?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.48+How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~48#Question:How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumiaje mtoto huyu kuwafundisha wanafunzi wake somo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~48#Question:How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~48#Answer:How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?789275218
trans-unit.source: When a person accepts/welcomes and cares for a child like that one in Jesus's name, it is the same as though that person is accepting/welcoming Jesus. And whoever welcomes Jesus is also welcoming/accepting [God] who sent him [into this world]. (48)
trans-unit.target: Mtu akimpokea na kumlea mtoto kama huyu kwa jina la Yesu, ni sawa na kumpokea Yesu; na mtu akimpokea Yesu, amempokea [Mungu] aliyempeleka [duniani].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~48#Answer:How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~48#Answer:How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?857603864
trans-unit.source: (A person whom God considers great/important is one who accepts the work of serving unimportant, ordinary people, as represented by this child. That person's attitude shows that he wants to serve Jesus, and God, who sent Jesus to this earth.)
trans-unit.target: (Mtu ambaye Mungu humwona kuwa mkubwa/muhimu ni yule anayekubali kazi ya kuwatumikia watu wa kawaida, wasio na umuhimu, kama anavyowakilishwa na mtoto huyu. Mtazamo wa mtu huyo unaonyesha kwamba anataka kumtumikia Yesu, na Mungu, aliyemtuma Yesu duniani.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~48#Answer:How did Jesus use this child to teach a lesson to the disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.48+What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~48#Question:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kufanya jambo fulani "katika jina la Yesu" kunamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~48#Question:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~48#Answer:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?-1604623301
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means doing something as Jesus's representative, in his place, or because we love him. It is doing something on the basis of who Jesus was and what he did, that he was holy and that he perfectly reflected God's love to all who would accept him. He did not do it for great honor, but because he loved God, he served him by doing what God wanted him to do among the people here on earth. (See "in the name of" in KBT in the "name" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Ni kufanya kitu kwa msingi wa Yesu alikuwa nani na alichofanya, kwamba alikuwa mtakatifu na kwamba alionyesha kikamilifu upendo wa Mungu kwa wote ambao wangemkubali. Hakufanya hivyo kwa heshima kubwa, lakini kwa sababu alimpenda Mungu, alimtumikia kwa kufanya kile Mungu alitaka afanye kati ya watu hapa duniani. (Ona "kwa jina la" katika KBT katika kiingilio "jina").
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~48#Answer:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?

trans-unit.source: Luke 9:49-50 Whoever is not against you is for you.
trans-unit.target: Luka 9:49-50 Yeyote asiye kinyume chenu yuko kwa ajili yenu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~49#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 9.49+Why did John and the other disciples try to stop a man from casting out demons in Jesus's name?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~49#Question:Why did John and the other disciples try to stop a man from casting out demons in Jesus's name?
trans-unit.source: Why did John and the other disciples try to stop a man from casting out demons in Jesus's name?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yohana na wanafunzi wengine walijaribu kumzuia mtu fulani asifukuze roho waovu katika jina la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~49#Question:Why did John and the other disciples try to stop a man from casting out demons in Jesus's name?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~49#Answer:Why did John and the other disciples try to stop a man from casting out demons in Jesus's name?-238435501
trans-unit.source: They tried to stop him because that man was not a member of their group (of Jesus's followers). (49) (John may have been thinking that Jesus had only given that power and authority to the twelve apostles [9:1].)

group.id: Q:LUK 9.51+What did Jesus do as that time came closer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~51#Question:What did Jesus do as that time came closer?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do as that time came closer?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini wakati huo ulipokaribia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~51#Question:What did Jesus do as that time came closer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~51#Answer:What did Jesus do as that time came closer?1879538321
trans-unit.source: He started to go determinedly towards Jerusalem. (51)
trans-unit.target: Alianza kwenda kwa uamuzi kuelekea Yerusalemu. (51)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~51#Answer:What did Jesus do as that time came closer?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~51#Note:What did Jesus do as that time came closer?690194450
trans-unit.source: This statement by Luke marks a very important change in the way that he wanted us readers to look at the following events and teaching of Jesus. Each one is not just one more separate story, but each is part of how he was preparing himself and his disciples for what would happen to him in Jerusalem. Jesus knew these were his last opportunities to prepare his disciples.
trans-unit.target: Taarifa hii ya Luka inaweka mabadiliko muhimu sana katika njia ambayo alitaka sisi wasomaji tuangalie matukio na mafundisho ya Yesu yafuatayo. Kila moja si hadithi moja tu tofauti, lakini kila moja ni sehemu ya jinsi alivyojiandaa yeye mwenyewe na wanafunzi wake kwa kile ambacho kingetokea kwake huko Yerusalemu. Yesu alijua haya yalikuwa fursa zake za mwisho kuandaa wanafunzi wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~51#Note:What did Jesus do as that time came closer?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.52+What were the messengers supposed to do for him?

trans-unit.source: They went ahead of him to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him [to eat there and stay overnight]. (52)
trans-unit.target: Wakaenda mbele yake wakaingia kijiji cha Wasamaria, ili wamtayarishie mahali.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~52#Answer:What were the messengers supposed to do for him?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.52+Who do you think that the Samaritans were?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~52#Question:Who do you think that the Samaritans were?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think that the Samaritans were?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Wasamaria walikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~52#Question:Who do you think that the Samaritans were?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~52#Answer:Who do you think that the Samaritans were?-2062107431
trans-unit.source: They were the people who lived in the province of Samaria which lay between the Jews' provinces of Judea and Galilee.
trans-unit.target: Hao walikuwa watu walioishi katika mkoa wa Samaria uliokuwa kati ya mikoa ya Kiyahudi na Galilaya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~52#Answer:Who do you think that the Samaritans were?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~52#Note:Who do you think that the Samaritans were?-1614071092
trans-unit.source: Hundreds of years earlier, the king of Assyria had taken most of the Jews away as captives (see 2 Kings 17:24-41). He had then sent people from other lands to live in that area. They married with the few Jews whom the king had left behind. The Samaritans were the descendants of those people. They had to be taught about God, but since the Assyrian king had destroyed the temple in Jerusalem, the Samaritans developed their own worship places and ways to worship. When the Jews returned from being captives, they rebuilt the temple in Jerusalem and stayed separate from the Samaritans, having nothing to do with them.
trans-unit.target: Mamia ya miaka mapema, mfalme wa Ashuru alikuwa amewachukua Wayahudi wengi kama mateka (tazama 2 Wafalme 17:24-41). Kisha alikuwa ametuma watu kutoka nchi nyingine kuishi katika eneo hilo. Walioa na Wayahudi wachache ambao mfalme alikuwa amewaacha nyuma. Wasamaria walikuwa wazao wa watu hao. Walipaswa kufundishwa juu ya Mungu, lakini tangu mfalme wa Ashuru alipoharibu hekalu huko Yerusalemu, Wasamaria waliendeleza maeneo yao ya ibada na njia za kuabudu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~52#Note:Who do you think that the Samaritans were?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.53+What did the Samaritan people decide about Jesus and his disciples staying in their village?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~53#Question:What did the Samaritan people decide about Jesus and his disciples staying in their village?
trans-unit.source: What did the Samaritan people decide about Jesus and his disciples staying in their village?
trans-unit.target: Wasamaria waliamua nini kuhusu Yesu na wanafunzi wake kukaa katika kijiji chao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~53#Question:What did the Samaritan people decide about Jesus and his disciples staying in their village?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~53#Answer:What did the Samaritan people decide about Jesus and his disciples staying in their village?626918340
trans-unit.source: They did not welcome/accept him, that is they refused to allow him to stay. (53)
trans-unit.target: Hawakumkaribisha/kumbukubali, yaani walikataa kumruhusu aendelee kukaa (53).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~53#Answer:What did the Samaritan people decide about Jesus and his disciples staying in their village?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.53+Why did they refuse to have him stay there?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~53#Question:Why did they refuse to have him stay there?
trans-unit.source: Why did they refuse to have him stay there?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walikataa akae huko?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~53#Question:Why did they refuse to have him stay there?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~53#Answer:Why did they refuse to have him stay there?1651595848
trans-unit.source: Because he was headed towards Jerusalem [to worship in the Jewish temple there]. (53)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu alikuwa akienda Yerusalemu [kuabudu katika hekalu la Kiyahudi huko]. (53)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~53#Answer:Why did they refuse to have him stay there?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!9~53#Note:Why did they refuse to have him stay there?-1559913356
trans-unit.source: Because Jesus was headed to Jerusalem to worship, it meant that he did not regard the Samaritans' temple on Mt. Gerazim nearby as a proper place in which to worship the true God. This offended the Samaritans.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa akienda Yerusalemu kuabudu, ilimaanisha kwamba hakuona hekalu la Wasamaria kwenye Mlima Gerizimu uliokuwa karibu kuwa mahali pafaapo pa kuabudu Mungu wa kweli.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~53#Note:Why did they refuse to have him stay there?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!9~57#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 9:57-62 People who want to follow Jesus must let go of everything else they think is important.
trans-unit.target: Luka 9:57-62 Watu wanaotaka kumfuata Yesu ni lazima waache kila kitu ambacho wanaona kuwa muhimu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~57#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 9.57-62+What do you think that Jesus would want us to learn from these examples about following him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~57#Question:What do you think that Jesus would want us to learn from these examples about following him?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus would want us to learn from these examples about following him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu angependa tujifunze nini kutokana na mifano hiyo kuhusu kumfuata?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~57#Question:What do you think that Jesus would want us to learn from these examples about following him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~57#Answer:What do you think that Jesus would want us to learn from these examples about following him?-1805673446
trans-unit.source: To follow Jesus means putting his desires for us as more important in our lives than our desires for our own well-being. We must come to him with no conditions, just as he followed his father's will in his own life. He had no desire for his own well-being, but his only desire was to do his father's will.
trans-unit.target: Kumfuata Yesu kunamaanisha kuweka tamaa zake kwetu kuwa muhimu zaidi katika maisha yetu kuliko tamaa zetu kwa ajili ya hali njema yetu wenyewe. Ni lazima tumwendee bila masharti, kama vile alivyofuata mapenzi ya baba yake katika maisha yake mwenyewe. Hakuwa na tamaa ya hali njema yake mwenyewe, bali tamaa yake pekee ilikuwa kufanya mapenzi ya baba yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~57#Answer:What do you think that Jesus would want us to learn from these examples about following him?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.58+What do foxes and birds have that Jesus said he did not have?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~58#Question:What do foxes and birds have that Jesus said he did not have?
trans-unit.source: What do foxes and birds have that Jesus said he did not have?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini ambacho mbweha na ndege wanacho ambacho Yesu alisema hakuwa nacho?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~58#Question:What do foxes and birds have that Jesus said he did not have?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~58#Answer:What do foxes and birds have that Jesus said he did not have?1320249126
trans-unit.source: Foxes have their [own] dens/holes/homes in the ground and birds have their [own] nests [for rest, safety, and shelter], but he had no such place [of his own] where he could rest/sleep. (58)
trans-unit.target: Mbweha wana mapango yao [yao] ardhini na ndege wana viota vyao [vyao] [kwa ajili ya pumziko, usalama, na makao], lakini yeye hakuwa na mahali [pao] pa kupumzika/kulala.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~58#Answer:What do foxes and birds have that Jesus said he did not have?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.57-58+What do you think that Jesus wanted that man to learn from his answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~57#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted that man to learn from his answer?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus wanted that man to learn from his answer?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka mtu huyo ajifunze nini kutokana na jibu lake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~57#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted that man to learn from his answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~57#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted that man to learn from his answer?209349710
trans-unit.source: If the Son of Man, Jesus, had to live without the comfort of knowing he had his own safe home in which to rest, then his followers should not expect to have that, either. Knowing that other people [like those in the one Samaritan village] would not welcome him into their homes, then anyone who follows Jesus must expect the same thing to happen to him or her.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Mwana wa Adamu, Yesu, alipaswa kuishi bila faraja ya kujua kwamba alikuwa na nyumba yake mwenyewe salama kupumzika, basi wafuasi wake hawapaswi kutarajia kuwa nayo, pia. Kujua kwamba watu wengine [kama wale katika kijiji kimoja cha Wasamaria] hawangemkaribisha katika nyumba zao, basi mtu yeyote anayemfuata Yesu lazima atarajie jambo lile lile litokee kwake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~57#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted that man to learn from his answer?

group.id: Q:LUK 9.59-60+That sounds impossible. What do you think that Jesus wanted the man to learn from that part of his answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!9~59#Question:That sounds impossible. What do you think that Jesus wanted the man to learn from that part of his answer?
trans-unit.source: That sounds impossible. What do you think that Jesus wanted the man to learn from that part of his answer?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~59#Question:That sounds impossible. What do you think that Jesus wanted the man to learn from that part of his answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~59#Answer:That sounds impossible. What do you think that Jesus wanted the man to learn from that part of his answer?896761611
trans-unit.source: Since dead people cannot do anything, Jesus must have meant that the people who have not repented from their sins (that is, those who are spiritually dead) and are not ruled by God (that is, those who are not in the kingdom of God), should care for those parents who need help and might die.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa watu waliokufa hawawezi kufanya lolote, ni lazima Yesu awe alimaanisha kwamba watu ambao hawajatubu dhambi zao (yaani, wale ambao wamekufa kiroho) na ambao hawatawaliwi na Mungu (yaani, wale ambao hawako katika ufalme wa Mungu), wapaswa kuwatunza wazazi hao wanaohitaji msaada na ambao huenda wakafa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~59#Answer:That sounds impossible. What do you think that Jesus wanted the man to learn from that part of his answer?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!9~61#Alternate:What do you think is the way that this picture language of a man preparing his field/garden applies to serving in the kingdom of God?1106711758
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the way that this picture language of a man preparing his garden applies to serving in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa njia gani kwamba lugha hii ya mfano ya mtu anayeandaa bustani yake hutumika kwa kutumikia katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~61#Alternate:What do you think is the way that this picture language of a man preparing his field/garden applies to serving in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!9~61#Answer:What do you think is the way that this picture language of a man preparing his field/garden applies to serving in the kingdom of God?2073521078
trans-unit.source: The person who wants to be a disciple in the kingdom of God must keep his mind centered on God. In that way his work for God will be useful. Thinking about what he may have left behind, and longing for it, will slow him down and he will not be a useful worker (Luke 10:1-16).
trans-unit.target: Mtu anayetaka kuwa mwanafunzi katika ufalme wa Mungu lazima aendelee kumkazia Mungu fikira. Kwa njia hiyo kazi yake kwa Mungu itakuwa na faida. Kufikiria juu ya kile ambacho huenda aliacha nyuma, na kutamani kwa ajili yake, kutamfanya apunguze mwendo wake na hatakuwa mfanyakazi mwenye faida (Luka 10:1-16).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!9~61#Answer:What do you think is the way that this picture language of a man preparing his field/garden applies to serving in the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.1-16+What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~1#Question:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wengine 72 wafanye kazi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~1#Question:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?1352886312
trans-unit.source: They were to go ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go (1) and decide which places would welcome him and which would not welcome him (based on how well they had been received) (8, 10, 16).
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kwenda mbele yake katika kila mji na mahali ambapo alikuwa karibu kwenda (1) na kuamua ni maeneo gani ambayo yangempokea na ambayo hayangepokea (kulingana na jinsi walivyopokelewa vizuri) (8, 10, 16).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?-1691238886
trans-unit.source: They were to speak a blessing of peace wherever they were welcomed (5-6, 8), and to shake off the dust from their feet wherever they were not welcomed [in order to show that God did not approve of what the people who lived at that place had done] (10-12).
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kusema baraka ya amani popote walipokaribishwa (5-6, 8), na kutikisa mavumbi kutoka miguuni mwao popote walipokosa kukaribishwa [ili kuonyesha kwamba Mungu hakukubali yale watu walioishi mahali hapo walikuwa wamefanya] (10-12).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?1442557982
trans-unit.source: They were to heal the sick in the places which welcomed them (9), and in every place tell the people that the kingdom of God had come (9, 11).
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuwaponya wagonjwa mahali popote walipokaribishwa (9), na kuwaambia watu kila mahali kwamba ufalme wa Mungu umekuja (9, 11).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?-1773235823
trans-unit.source: They were to ask God to send out more workers [to those people who were ready to hear the Good News]. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kumwomba Mungu atume wafanyakazi zaidi [kwa watu hao waliokuwa tayari kusikia Habari Njema]. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~1#Answer:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~1#Note:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?-1737923387
trans-unit.source: Some Greek manuscripts refer to only 70 disciples, but the editors of the United Bible Societies' The Greek New Testament, 4th revised edition, 1993, give a slight preference for the number "72" as the original number which Luke wrote here. You may have either number in the translation.
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya hati za Kigiriki hutaja wanafunzi 70 tu, lakini wahariri wa The Greek New Testament, 4th revised edition, 1993, ya United Bible Societies, wanapendelea kidogo namba "72" kuwa nambari ya awali ambayo Luka aliandika hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~1#Note:What work did Jesus tell these 72 other disciples to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.2+Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~2#Question:Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu wafanyakazi na mashamba ambayo yako tayari kuvunwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Question:Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~2#Answer:Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.1782478977
trans-unit.source: Often when a very big harvest is ready to be gathered, there is a need for more workers than are available. The food or grain must be gathered quickly before it falls, rots, spoils, or is ruined by bad weather. The workday is usually long and the work hard.
trans-unit.target: Mara nyingi mavuno yanapofika, wafanyakazi wengi zaidi wanahitajika, na chakula au nafaka zinapaswa kukusanywa haraka kabla hazijaporomoka, kuoza, kuharibika, au kuharibiwa na hali mbaya ya hewa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Answer:Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~2#Note:Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.-140109361
trans-unit.source: In many places, as in Israel, food/seed is planted in all the fields/gardens at the same time because of the times of rain and sun. Therefore, all the food and grain is ready to harvest at about the same time, too. If the culture of the translation has no understanding of this kind of seasonal planting and harvesting, probably a glossary item needs to be prepared for this text.
trans-unit.target: Katika maeneo mengi, kama vile katika Israeli, chakula/mbegu hupandwa katika mashamba/bustani zote kwa wakati mmoja kwa sababu ya nyakati za mvua na jua. Kwa hivyo, chakula na nafaka zote ziko tayari kuvuna karibu wakati huo huo, pia. Ikiwa utamaduni wa tafsiri hauna uelewa wa aina hii ya kupanda na kuvuna kwa msimu, labda kifungu cha msamiati kinahitaji kutayarishwa kwa maandishi haya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Note:Tell me about workers and fields which are ready to be harvested.

group.id: Q:LUK 10.2+What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about workers and fields?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~2#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about workers and fields?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about workers and fields?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu wafanyakazi na mashamba?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about workers and fields?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~2#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about workers and fields?-429138912
trans-unit.source: He was not talking about real fields with food or grain that was ready to be harvested. This was picture language about the many people who were ready to believe in him when those disciples would tell them about the kingdom of God being present/the Good News that Jesus had come to save them.
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa akizungumza juu ya mashamba halisi yenye chakula au nafaka ambayo ilikuwa tayari kuvunwa. Hii ilikuwa lugha ya mfano kuhusu watu wengi waliokuwa tayari kumwamini wakati wanafunzi hao wangewaambia juu ya ufalme wa Mungu kuwapo / Habari Njema kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekuja kuwaokoa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about workers and fields?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.2+What did Jesus say about the number of workers compared to the number of people ready to hear and believe the good news about the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~2#Question:What did Jesus say about the number of workers compared to the number of people ready to hear and believe the good news about the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the number of workers compared to the number of people ready to hear and believe the good news about the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya idadi ya wafanyakazi ikilinganishwa na idadi ya watu walio tayari kusikia na kuamini habari njema juu ya ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Question:What did Jesus say about the number of workers compared to the number of people ready to hear and believe the good news about the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~2#Answer:What did Jesus say about the number of workers compared to the number of people ready to hear and believe the good news about the kingdom of God?1005119125
trans-unit.source: The workers were few, but the number of people who were ready to hear was plentiful/very many. (2)
trans-unit.target: Wafanyakazi walikuwa wachache, lakini idadi ya watu waliokuwa tayari kusikiliza ilikuwa nyingi sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~2#Answer:What did Jesus say about the number of workers compared to the number of people ready to hear and believe the good news about the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.3+Tell me what kind of animals wolves and lambs are.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~3#Question:Tell me what kind of animals wolves and lambs are.
trans-unit.source: Tell me what kind of animals wolves and lambs are.
trans-unit.target: Niambie mbwa-mwitu na kondoo ni wanyama wa aina gani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~3#Question:Tell me what kind of animals wolves and lambs are.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~3#Answer:Tell me what kind of animals wolves and lambs are.-1427337857
trans-unit.source: Wolves are a variety of fierce, wild dogs which like to eat meat. Lambs are baby sheep which have a gentle nature and eat grass. They have no way to protect themselves from a fierce animal like a wolf.
trans-unit.target: Mbwa mwitu ni aina ya mbwa mwitu, mkali, ambaye anapenda kula nyama. Kondoo ni kondoo wadogo ambao wana tabia ya upole na hula nyasi. Hawana njia ya kujikinga na mnyama mkali kama mbwa mwitu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~3#Answer:Tell me what kind of animals wolves and lambs are.

group.id: Q:LUK 10.3+What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about lambs and wolves?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~3#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about lambs and wolves?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about lambs and wolves?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu kondoo na mbwa - mwitu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~3#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about lambs and wolves?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~3#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about lambs and wolves?38203452
trans-unit.source: He was not talking about real animals. This is picture language about the disciples going out among people who would reject their message and might try to harm them. The disciples were not to be fierce, but gentle and harmless in their actions and words. (They were to depend on God to protect them.)
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa akizungumza juu ya wanyama halisi. Hii ni lugha ya mfano juu ya wanafunzi kwenda nje kati ya watu ambao wangekataa ujumbe wao na wangeweza kujaribu kuwaumiza. Wanafunzi hawakupaswa kuwa wakali, lakini wapole na wasio na hatia katika vitendo na maneno yao (walipaswa kumtegemea Mungu kuwalinda).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~3#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he talked about lambs and wolves?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.5-12+What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?

trans-unit.source: What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kusudi la kuwaambia watu hao tena kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa karibu lilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~5#Question:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~5#Answer:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?-1007267319
trans-unit.source: The people would know that by rejecting the disciples and their message they were also rejecting their chance/the opportunity to become part of the kingdom of God. As the disciples left, so did the people's chance/opportunity.
trans-unit.target: Watu wangejua kwamba kwa kukataa wanafunzi na ujumbe wao walikuwa pia wakikataa nafasi/fursa yao ya kuwa sehemu ya ufalme wa Mungu. Wanafunzi walipoondoka, ndivyo ilivyokuwa na nafasi/fursa ya watu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~5#Answer:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~5#Answer:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~5#Answer:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~5#Answer:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?-1908146078
trans-unit.source: The people would know that if they repented/changed their minds quickly, there was still one last chance while the disciples were in their town to tell them more, or they could arrange for Jesus to come and teach them.
trans-unit.target: Watu wangejua kwamba ikiwa wangetubu/kubadilisha mawazo yao upesi, bado kulikuwa na nafasi moja ya mwisho wakati wanafunzi walipokuwa katika mji wao kuwaambia zaidi, au wangeweza kupanga Yesu aje na kuwafundisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~5#Answer:What do you think was the purpose of telling those people once more that the kingdom of God was near?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.12+With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~12#Question:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?
trans-unit.source: With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwalinganisha watu ambao hawakupokea wanafunzi aliowatuma na nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~12#Question:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~12#Answer:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?447381264
trans-unit.source: He said that [the people of the town of] Sodom would bear/endure better the punishment God had for them on The Day [when he would judge all people] than [the people of] that town would be able to bear/endure the [even greater] punishment God had for them. (12)
trans-unit.target: Hakika adhabu ya mji huu itastahimiliwa zaidi kuliko ya mji wa Sodoma siku ya Kiyama.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~12#Answer:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~12#Answer:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~12#Answer:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~12#Answer:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?-740924029
trans-unit.source: He said that on The Day [when God would judge all people] [the people of] that town would have more/greater punishment [from God] than [the people of the town of] Sodom would suffer.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba [watu wa jiji hilo] watapata adhabu kubwa zaidi [kutoka kwa Mungu] kuliko [watu wa jiji la Sodoma] siku hiyo [ya hukumu ya Mungu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~12#Answer:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~12#Note:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?-1261043356
trans-unit.source: There is much implied information in this verse which Jesus, the disciples, and Luke all understood, but which the people who will read this translation may not know. Depending on the level of general Bible knowledge among the people, it may be necessary to have a glossary item which explains that the people who lived in the town of Sodom many years earlier had sinned greatly and God would severely punish them (see Gen. 19). The people of Sodom did not know God's plan to send a savior, so they did not trust God for being saved. By comparison, the people of a town which rejected the disciples and their message about the savior would be punished even more than the people of Sodom.
trans-unit.target: Kuna habari nyingi zilizotajwa katika aya hii ambazo Yesu, wanafunzi, na Luka wote walielewa, lakini ambazo watu watakaosoma tafsiri hii huenda wasijue. Kulingana na kiwango cha maarifa ya jumla ya Biblia miongoni mwa watu, inaweza kuwa muhimu kuwa na kifungu cha msamiati ambacho kinaelezea kwamba watu walioishi katika mji wa Sodoma miaka mingi iliyopita walikuwa wamefanya dhambi kubwa na Mungu angewaadhibu vikali (tazama Mwanzo 19). Watu wa Sodoma hawakujua mpango wa Mungu wa kutuma mwokozi, kwa hivyo hawakumwamini Mungu kwa kuokolewa. Kwa kulinganisha, watu wa mji ambao walikataa wanafunzi na ujumbe wao kuhusu mwokozi wangeadhibiwa hata zaidi kuliko watu wa Sodoma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~12#Note:With what did Jesus compare people who did not welcome the disciples whom he had sent?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:What judgment, do you think, was Jesus talking about in verse 14?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Alternate:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?126599568
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A miracle is something which happens in our physical world that is different from the way that people know that the processes of nature take place. Spirit beings, such as God, use their great power to do these things.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda Check: Muujiza ni kitu ambacho hutokea katika ulimwengu wetu wa kimwili ambayo ni tofauti na njia ambayo watu kujua kwamba michakato ya asili kuchukua nafasi. viumbe roho, kama vile Mungu, kutumia nguvu zao kubwa ya kufanya mambo haya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?-1960662526
trans-unit.source: See "miracle, sign, wonder, mighty work" in KBT. Also see the note in L&N, following entry 76.8.
trans-unit.target: Ona "miujiza, ishara, maajabu, kazi yenye nguvu" katika KBT. Ona pia maelezo katika L&N, baada ya kuingia 76.8.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?1762070260
trans-unit.source: In the NT, all the miracles occurred so that the individual or the group of people who saw it happen would desire a stronger relationship with God.
trans-unit.target: Katika Agano Jipya, miujiza yote ilitokea ili mtu binafsi au kikundi cha watu walioiona ikitokea wangependa uhusiano wenye nguvu na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you understand it is that makes something be called "a miracle"?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.13-14+How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~13#Question:How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganishaje miji hiyo miwili, Korazini na Bethsaida na miji mingine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Question:How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?393668091
trans-unit.source: If the people who lived in the [Gentile/non-Jewish] towns of Tyre and Sidon had seen those miracles, they would have sat in sackcloth and ashes to show that they had repented; but the people in these two Jewish towns had not repented. (13)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu walioishi katika miji ya [Wasio Wayahudi/wasio Wayahudi] ya Tiro na Sidoni wangeona miujiza hiyo, wangeketi katika nguo za magunia na majivu ili kuonyesha kwamba walikuwa wametubu; lakini watu katika miji hiyo miwili ya Kiyahudi hawakuwa wametubu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?-94045106
trans-unit.source: The people of Tyre and Sidon would bear/endure better [the punishment God had for them] when he would judge [all people on The Last Day] than these people would be able to bear/endure the [even greater] punishment God had for them. // When [God] judges [everyone on The Last Day], he will not punish the people of Tyre and Sidon as severely as he will punish the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida. (14)
trans-unit.target: Watu wa Tiro na Sidoni ingekuwa bora / kuvumilia adhabu ya Mungu siku ya hukumu kuliko watu hawa [wote] wangeweza kuvumilia adhabu ya Mungu kwao. // [Mungu] wakati [kila mtu] hukumu [siku ya mwisho] hataadhibu watu wa Tiro na Sidoni kama vile ataadhibu watu wa Chorazin na Bethsaida. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:How did Jesus compare these two towns, Chorazin and Bethsaida with other cities?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.13+What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~13#Question:What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ingemaanisha nini ikiwa watu wa Korazini na Bethsaida wangeketi katika nguo za magunia na majivu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Question:What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?545525764
trans-unit.source: It was the cultural way to show great sorrow and mourning when a great tragedy had occurred. In this case, they would have been showing great sorrow for their sins against God and their desire to obey him from then onward.
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa njia ya kitamaduni ya kuonyesha huzuni kubwa na maombolezo wakati msiba mkubwa ulikuwa umetokea. Katika kesi hii, wangekuwa wakionyesha huzuni kubwa kwa dhambi zao dhidi ya Mungu na tamaa yao ya kumtii tangu wakati huo na kuendelea.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?103758048
trans-unit.source: If this is not the custom for showing sorrow and repentance in the language area, it would be good to make the purpose clear in the text.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa hiyo si desturi ya kuonyesha huzuni na toba katika eneo la lugha hiyo, lingekuwa jambo zuri kueleza kusudi katika andiko.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think it would have meant if the people of Chorazin and Bethsaida had sat in sackcloth and ashes?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.15+What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~15#Question:What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?
trans-unit.source: What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?
trans-unit.target: Watu wa mji wa Kapernaumu wapaswa kutarajia nini kuwapata wakati Mungu atakapowahukumu watu wote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~15#Question:What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~15#Answer:What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?-321573384
trans-unit.source: They should expect to be sent down to the place of the dead [where God would punish them]. They would not be taken up [by God/God's angels] to heaven where God lives. (15)
trans-unit.target: Na wala hawatapanda mbinguni, ambako Mwenyezi Mungu yupo. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~15#Answer:What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~15#Answer:What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?1727028093
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: If the language of the translation has a traditional name for the place of the dead, that name can be used. Here it refers to a place which is the opposite of heaven and all for which it stands. See "Hades" in KBT in the "hell, Hades, abyss" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Ikiwa lugha ya tafsiri ina jina la jadi la mahali pa wafu, jina hilo linaweza kutumiwa. Hapa inahusu mahali ambapo ni kinyume cha mbinguni na yote ambayo inasimama. Angalia "Hades" katika KBT katika "kuzimu, Hades, abyss" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~15#Answer:What should people in the town of Capernaum expect to happen to them in the time when God will judge all people?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.13-16+What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~13#Question:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini huenda watu hao walitarajia kwamba Mungu angewachukua mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Question:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?-1842344560
trans-unit.source: Jesus had indicated that he had done miracles in Capernaum (4:23).
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa ameonyesha kwamba alikuwa amefanya miujiza katika Kapernaumu (4:23).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?500372278
trans-unit.source: He had taught in the synagogue there and driven out the evil spirit from a man (4:31-44).
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amefundisha katika sinagogi huko na kumfukuza roho mwovu kutoka kwa mtu (4:31-44).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?-576878830
trans-unit.source: He had healed the Roman army officer's servant there (see Luke 7:1-10).
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amemponya mtumishi wa ofisa wa jeshi la Kiroma huko (ona Luka 7:1-10).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?-1628987139
trans-unit.source: We know from the other gospel writers that Jesus lived there (see Matt. 4:13; John 2:12),
trans-unit.target: Tunajua kutoka kwa waandishi wengine wa injili kwamba Yesu aliishi huko (tazama Mathayo 4:13; Yohana 2:12),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?1102270875
trans-unit.source: taught about the Kingdom of God there (see Matt. 4:17; John 6:24, 59-64),
trans-unit.target: alifundisha kuhusu Ufalme wa Mungu huko (ona Mt. 4:17; Yoh. 6:24, 59-64),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?-1100523627
trans-unit.source: and healed the paralytic man there (see Mark 2:1-12; Luke 5:17-26).
trans-unit.target: na kumponya mtu aliyepooza huko (tazama Marko 2:1-12; Luka 5:17-26).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?-776742581
trans-unit.source: The people of Capernaum may have thought that God would give them special treatment because Jesus had done all these things in their town, but they had not believed Jesus's message.
trans-unit.target: Huenda watu wa Kapernaumu walifikiri kwamba Mungu angewatendea kwa njia ya pekee kwa sababu ya mambo yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa amefanya katika jiji lao, lakini hawakuamini ujumbe wa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Note:What do you think was the reason those people might have expected that God would take them to heaven?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.13-16+To whom was Jesus talking in verse 16?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~13#Question:To whom was Jesus talking in verse 16?
trans-unit.source: To whom was Jesus talking in verse 16?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza na nani katika mstari wa 16?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Question:To whom was Jesus talking in verse 16?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~13#Answer:To whom was Jesus talking in verse 16?-553476842
trans-unit.source: He was speaking to the 72 disciples he was sending out, not to the people of Capernaum.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza na wanafunzi 72 aliokuwa akiwatuma, si kwa watu wa Kapernaumu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~13#Answer:To whom was Jesus talking in verse 16?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.16+What did Jesus say was the reason why the people who did not accept his disciples would receive great punishment?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~16#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason why the people who did not accept his disciples would receive great punishment?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason why the people who did not accept his disciples would receive great punishment?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni kwa sababu gani watu ambao hawakukubali wanafunzi wake wangepokea adhabu kali?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~16#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason why the people who did not accept his disciples would receive great punishment?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~16#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason why the people who did not accept his disciples would receive great punishment?991513963
trans-unit.source: The disciples were preaching the same message as Jesus, so when the people accepted them, it was the same as though they were receiving the one who sent them, Jesus. When they rejected what the disciples' said, they were rejecting Jesus and his Father who had sent him. [By rejecting Jesus's disciples they were rejecting God's plan for them, so God would reject them. They could not be saved any other way.] (16)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wakihubiri ujumbe ule ule kama Yesu, kwa hiyo watu walipowakubali, ilikuwa ni kama kwamba walikuwa wakimpokea yule aliyewatuma, Yesu. Walipokataa kile wanafunzi walisema, walikuwa wakimkataa Yesu na Baba yake aliyemtuma. [Kwa kukataa wanafunzi wa Yesu walikuwa wakikataa mpango wa Mungu kwao, kwa hivyo Mungu angewakataa. Hawakuweza kuokolewa kwa njia nyingine yoyote.] (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~16#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason why the people who did not accept his disciples would receive great punishment?
