group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-24+What were the 72 disciples rejoicing about?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:What were the 72 disciples rejoicing about?
trans-unit.source: What were the 72 disciples rejoicing about?
trans-unit.target: Wale wanafunzi 72 walifurahi juu ya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:What were the 72 disciples rejoicing about?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What were the 72 disciples rejoicing about?-956717334
trans-unit.source: When they used Jesus's name, even the demons obeyed them [to leave people]./God had given them power even over demons. (17)
trans-unit.target: Walipotumia jina la Yesu, hata mashetani waliwatii [waondoke kwa watu]./Mungu alikuwa amewapa nguvu hata juu ya mashetani. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What were the 72 disciples rejoicing about?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-24+What was the real reason that they should rejoice?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:What was the real reason that they should rejoice?
trans-unit.source: What was the real reason that they should rejoice?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hasa kilichokuwa sababu yao ya kushangilia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:What was the real reason that they should rejoice?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What was the real reason that they should rejoice?1652588141
trans-unit.source: It was that their names were recorded [by God] in heaven where he lives. (20)
trans-unit.target: Ni kwamba majina yao yameandikwa [na Mungu] mbinguni ambako yeye hukaa. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What was the real reason that they should rejoice?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-24+About what was Jesus rejoicing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:About what was Jesus rejoicing?
trans-unit.source: About what was Jesus rejoicing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifurahi kwa sababu ya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:About what was Jesus rejoicing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:About what was Jesus rejoicing?-2009251614
trans-unit.source: God had chosen to give his wisdom and power to these unschooled, unsophisticated, but obedient, men. (21)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa ameamua kuwapa hekima na nguvu zake watu hawa wasio na elimu, wasio na akili nyingi, lakini watiifu. (21)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:About what was Jesus rejoicing?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17+What did the 72 disciples say when they returned to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:What did the 72 disciples say when they returned to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the 72 disciples say when they returned to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wale wanafunzi 72 walisema nini walipomrudia Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:What did the 72 disciples say when they returned to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What did the 72 disciples say when they returned to Jesus?936461722
trans-unit.source: They said that even the demons obeyed them [to leave people] when they (the disciples) used the authority of Jesus's name. (17)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba hata roho waovu waliwatii [waondoke kwa watu] wakati wao (wanafunzi) walipoitumia mamlaka ya jina la Yesu. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What did the 72 disciples say when they returned to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-20+What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?
trans-unit.source: What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamefanya kazi gani nyingine zaidi ya kufukuza roho waovu kutoka kwa watu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?1798264948
trans-unit.source: They had healed the sick and preached the Good News about the kingdom of God. (10:9)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaponya wagonjwa na kuhubiri Habari Njema ya ufalme wa Mungu (10:9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~17#Note:What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?-602887139
trans-unit.source: The words of the disciples implied that the power over demons was more than what they had expected. Luke recorded only that Jesus had given them power over sickness and authority to preach. Jesus had not explained the full range of the authority he had given them until after they had returned (see vs. 19). Their sensing that demons obeyed them was more than they had expected. That sensing of the disciples should be expressed appropriately in the translation.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya wanafunzi yalionyesha kwamba nguvu juu ya pepo ilikuwa zaidi ya walivyotarajia. Luka alirekodi tu kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewapa nguvu juu ya magonjwa na mamlaka ya kuhubiri. Yesu hakuwa ameelezea wigo kamili wa mamlaka aliyokuwa amewapa mpaka baada ya kurudi kwao (tazama mstari wa 19). Hisia zao kwamba pepo waliwatii ilikuwa zaidi ya walivyotarajia. Hisia hiyo ya wanafunzi inapaswa kuonyeshwa kwa usahihi katika tafsiri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Note:What other work had they done besides casting out demons from people?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-20+What do you think was the reason that it was important that the disciples used Jesus's name when they did that work?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:What do you think was the reason that it was important that the disciples used Jesus's name when they did that work?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that it was important that the disciples used Jesus's name when they did that work?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini ilikuwa muhimu kwa wanafunzi kutumia jina la Yesu walipofanya kazi hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:What do you think was the reason that it was important that the disciples used Jesus's name when they did that work?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think was the reason that it was important that the disciples used Jesus's name when they did that work?-960933054
trans-unit.source: The name of Jesus had/held all the power and authority that Jesus had given to them. They had no personal power or authority greater than the demons' power. The power and authority was only theirs because Jesus had given it to them. (Because Jesus was the son of God, the demons also had to obey what his representatives said that Jesus wanted them to do.)
trans-unit.target: Jina la Yesu lilikuwa na/lilikuwa na nguvu na mamlaka yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa amewapa. Hawakuwa na nguvu ya kibinafsi au mamlaka kubwa kuliko nguvu ya mashetani. Nguvu na mamlaka yalikuwa yao tu kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amewapa. (Kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa mwana wa Mungu, mashetani pia walipaswa kutii kile wawakilishi wake walisema kwamba Yesu alitaka wafanye.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think was the reason that it was important that the disciples used Jesus's name when they did that work?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.18+How did Jesus respond to the disciples' excitement?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~18#Question:How did Jesus respond to the disciples' excitement?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus respond to the disciples' excitement?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje msisimuko wa wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~18#Question:How did Jesus respond to the disciples' excitement?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~18#Answer:How did Jesus respond to the disciples' excitement?987296524
trans-unit.source: He said that he had seen Satan fall from heaven [where spirit beings live] just as a bolt of lightning flashes [instantly] from the sky to the earth. (18)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba alimwona Shetani akianguka kutoka mbinguni [ambapo viumbe wa roho wanaishi] kama vile umeme wa radi [wa papo hapo] unavyong'aa kutoka mbinguni hadi duniani. (18)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~18#Answer:How did Jesus respond to the disciples' excitement?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-20+Who is Satan?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:Who is Satan?
trans-unit.source: Who is Satan?
trans-unit.target: Shetani ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:Who is Satan?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:Who is Satan?1207890599
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He is a spirit being who is the chief enemy of God and of those who believe in God's Son, Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Yeye ni kiumbe wa roho ambaye ni adui mkuu wa Mungu na wa wale wanaomwamini Mwana wa Mungu, Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:Who is Satan?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~17#Note:Who is Satan?2119765386
trans-unit.source: See "Satan" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Shetani" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Note:Who is Satan?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~17#Note:Who is Satan?1784942217
trans-unit.source: It is more important to use a term which gives the right understanding of who Satan is, rather than imply that "Satan" is only a personal name.
trans-unit.target: Ni muhimu zaidi kutumia neno ambalo hutoa uelewevu sahihi wa Shetani ni nani, badala ya kudokeza kwamba "Shetani" ni jina la kibinafsi tu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Note:Who is Satan?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.17-20+What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~17#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini alipowajibu wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?-1486216036
trans-unit.source: [In his spirit] he had seen Satan's control of people end each time the disciples [preached, healed, or] cast out a demon in Jesus's name. Satan truly was defeated.
trans-unit.target: [Katika roho yake] alikuwa ameona udhibiti wa Shetani juu ya watu ukikomeshwa kila wakati wanafunzi [walipohubiri, waliponya, au] walipofukuza roho mwovu katika jina la Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?75259680
trans-unit.source: Jesus had actually seen God cast Satan out of heaven before the world began, so the disciples' comments only confirmed that truth and were a sign of it.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amemwona Mungu akimtupa Shetani kutoka mbinguni kabla ya ulimwengu kuumbwa, kwa hiyo maelezo ya wanafunzi yalihakikisha tu ukweli huo na yalikuwa ishara ya hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~17#Note:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?1302484692
trans-unit.source: Any answer that does not contradict what men wrote in the rest of the Bible is acceptable. The Greek words do not clearly indicate whether Jesus was referring to the time when the disciples had been casting out demons or to a time before the world began. The disciples had seen Satan's demons obey their commands in Jesus's name. Jesus told them that he had seen Satan himself have to leave heaven immediately at God's command.
trans-unit.target: Jibu lolote ambalo halipingani na yale ambayo wanadamu waliandika katika sehemu nyingine za Biblia laweza kukubaliwa. Maneno ya Kigiriki hayaonyeshi waziwazi kama Yesu alikuwa akirejezea wakati ambapo wanafunzi walikuwa wakitoa roho waovu au wakati fulani kabla ya ulimwengu kuanza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~17#Note:What do you think that Jesus meant by his response to the disciples?

trans-unit.target: Wangeweza kutembea juu ya nyoka na nge

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~19#Answer:What other examples did Jesus give to the disciples of how they might use the authority he had given to them?-1411438181
trans-unit.source: and to overcome all the power of the enemy.
trans-unit.target: na kushinda nguvu zote za adui.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~19#Answer:What other examples did Jesus give to the disciples of how they might use the authority he had given to them?-816185193

trans-unit.target: Hakuna chochote ambacho kingeweza kuwadhuru [walipokuwa wakitumikia wakiwa wawakilishi wa Yesu].

group.id: Q:LUK 10.20+What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~20#Question:What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?
trans-unit.source: What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?
trans-unit.target: Ni sababu gani nyingine iliyofanya wanafunzi wafurahie zaidi ya kuwa na roho waovu waliowatii?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~20#Question:What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~20#Answer:What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?1674317946
trans-unit.source: It was more important that [God] had recorded their names in heaven. (20)
trans-unit.target: Lilikuwa jambo la maana zaidi kwamba [Mungu] alikuwa ameandika majina yao mbinguni. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~20#Answer:What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~20#Note:What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?1434690864
trans-unit.source: The Greek word that introduces verse 20 shows clearly that Jesus was going to say something different from what the disciples expected him to say. The translation should also show that change in the way that the speakers of that language usually show that.
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki linaloanzisha mstari wa 20 laonyesha wazi kwamba Yesu alikuwa akisema jambo tofauti na lile ambalo wanafunzi wake walitarajia aseme. Tafsiri hiyo yapaswa pia kuonyesha badiliko hilo katika njia ambayo wasemaji wa lugha hiyo kwa kawaida huonyesha hilo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~20#Note:What was a more important reason for the disciples to rejoice than that demons obeyed them?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.20+What do you think this picture language about writing names down means?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~20#Question:What do you think this picture language about writing names down means?
trans-unit.source: What do you think this picture language about writing names down means?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri lugha hii ya picha kuhusu kuandika majina chini inamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~20#Question:What do you think this picture language about writing names down means?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~20#Answer:What do you think this picture language about writing names down means?-1844463626
trans-unit.source: It means that God knew that those disciples believed in Jesus as the savior he had sent. He knew that they were members in his kingdom and that he would allow them to enter heaven. They belonged there. (20)
trans-unit.target: Ina maana kwamba Mungu alijua kwamba wanafunzi hao walimwamini Yesu kama mwokozi aliyetumwa na Mungu. Alijua kwamba walikuwa wanachama wa ufalme wake na kwamba angewaruhusu kuingia mbinguni. Walikuwa wa huko. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~20#Answer:What do you think this picture language about writing names down means?

trans-unit.target: Roho Mtakatifu alifanya hivyo. (21)

group.id: Q:LUK 10.21+For what did Jesus thank his father, God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~21#Question:For what did Jesus thank his father, God?
trans-unit.source: For what did Jesus thank his father, God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimshukuru Mungu, Baba yake, kwa ajili ya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Question:For what did Jesus thank his father, God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:For what did Jesus thank his father, God?1965168306
trans-unit.source: He thanked God that he (God) had hidden these things from those people who [thought that they] were wise and had learned much. He had done that in order that those people would not understand those things. (21)
trans-unit.target: Amemshukuru Mwenyezi Mungu kwa kuwa amewaficha haya watu wenye akili na wenye elimu, ili wasiyaelewe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:For what did Jesus thank his father, God?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.21-24+What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~21#Question:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?
trans-unit.source: What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni mambo gani hayo ambayo Mungu aliwaficha watu waliojiona kuwa wenye hekima na wenye elimu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Question:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?-160605025
trans-unit.source: They were the things the disciples had learned about having authority as a follower of Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Hayo yalikuwa mambo ambayo wanafunzi walikuwa wamejifunza kuhusu kuwa na mamlaka wakiwa wafuasi wa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?1435049140
trans-unit.source: It was the knowledge the disciples had that their names were recorded already by God in heaven.
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa ni ujuzi ambao wanafunzi walikuwa nao kwamba majina yao tayari yalikuwa yameandikwa na Mungu mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?163775886
trans-unit.source: When they had seen God's power at work as they served Jesus, they knew that the kingdom of God had already come.
trans-unit.target: Walipoona nguvu ya Mungu ikifanya kazi walipokuwa wakimtumikia Yesu, walijua kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa umekuja.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?1431475360
trans-unit.source: Satan truly was defeated and his workers had to obey Jesus's followers. God's plan for sending a savior had happened already.
trans-unit.target: Shetani kwa kweli alishindwa na watumishi wake walipaswa kutii wafuasi wa Yesu. Mpango wa Mungu wa kutuma mwokozi ulikuwa tayari umetokea.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~21#Note:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?1257348283
trans-unit.source: The Greek text does not point back clearly to any one particular thing when it says, "these things".
trans-unit.target: Maandishi ya Kigiriki hayarejezei kwa wazi kitu chochote hususa yanaposema, "mambo haya".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Note:What do you think those things were that God had hidden from the people who thought that they were wise and had learned much?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.21-24+To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~21#Question:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kwamba watoto wadogo wameona/kuelewa mambo ambayo Mungu amewaficha wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Question:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kwamba watoto wachanga wameona mambo ambayo Mungu amewaficha wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!10~21#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?2094468737
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had understood things that God had hidden from others?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kwamba watoto wadogo wameelewa mambo ambayo Mungu amewaficha wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Alternate:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?-145786492
trans-unit.source: He was referring to his disciples who were ordinary, working people, not religious scholars. They were humble and willing to believe what he told them, not proud of their learning or stubborn.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu wanafunzi wake ambao walikuwa watu wa kawaida, wenye bidii, na si wasomi wa kidini. Walikuwa wanyenyekevu na walikuwa tayari kuamini mambo aliyowaambia, hawakujivunia elimu yao wala hawakuwa wakaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:To whom, do you think, was Jesus referring when he said that little children had seen/understood things that God had hidden from others?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.21+What do you think it was that God had been pleased to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~21#Question:What do you think it was that God had been pleased to do?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it was that God had been pleased to do?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Mungu alifurahia kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Question:What do you think it was that God had been pleased to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What do you think it was that God had been pleased to do?-1541371178
trans-unit.source: He had hidden his plan from those who thought that they were wise and now had revealed it to those who were like little children in comparison [and they had believed it]. (21)

group.id: Q:LUK 10.21-24+What had the disciples seen?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~21#Question:What had the disciples seen?
trans-unit.source: What had the disciples seen?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wameona nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Question:What had the disciples seen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~21#Answer:What had the disciples seen?-1992127662
trans-unit.source: They had seen Jesus, the Messiah, God's son, bring the Good News that they could be in the kingdom of God. They had also seen Jesus use his authority and power to help people. Now as Jesus's representatives to different places, they had been able to do the same as Jesus had done.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamemwona Yesu, Masihi, Mwana wa Mungu, akileta Habari Njema kwamba wangeweza kuwa katika ufalme wa Mungu. Pia walikuwa wamemwona Yesu akitumia mamlaka na nguvu zake kuwasaidia watu. Sasa kama wawakilishi wa Yesu kwenda mahali tofauti, walikuwa wameweza kufanya kama vile Yesu alivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~21#Answer:What had the disciples seen?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.24+Who had wanted to see these things which the disciples had seen, and hear what they had heard, but had not been able to do so?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~24#Question:Who had wanted to see these things which the disciples had seen, and hear what they had heard, but had not been able to do so?
trans-unit.source: Who had wanted to see these things which the disciples had seen, and hear what they had heard, but had not been able to do so?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani ambaye alitaka kuona mambo haya ambayo wanafunzi waliyaona, na kusikia yale waliyosikia, lakini hawakuweza kuyafanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~24#Question:Who had wanted to see these things which the disciples had seen, and hear what they had heard, but had not been able to do so?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~24#Answer:Who had wanted to see these things which the disciples had seen, and hear what they had heard, but had not been able to do so?-172677404
trans-unit.source: Many prophets and kings had wished that they could have seen and heard what the disciples experienced [while Jesus taught them]. (24)
trans-unit.target: Manabii na wafalme wengi walitamani kwamba wangeweza kuona na kusikia yale ambayo wanafunzi walikabili [Yesu alipokuwa akiwafundisha]. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~24#Answer:Who had wanted to see these things which the disciples had seen, and hear what they had heard, but had not been able to do so?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.25-37+How did what Jesus believed and taught about receiving the eternal life compare with what the Jewish expert in the Law understood about it from the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~25#Question:How did what Jesus believed and taught about receiving the eternal life compare with what the Jewish expert in the Law understood about it from the Law of Moses?
trans-unit.source: How did what Jesus believed and taught about receiving the eternal life compare with what the Jewish expert in the Law understood about it from the Law of Moses?
trans-unit.target: Yale ambayo Yesu aliamini na kufundisha juu ya kupokea uhai wa milele yalinganishwaje na yale ambayo mtaalamu wa Sheria Myahudi alielewa juu ya uhai huo kutokana na Sheria ya Musa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Question:How did what Jesus believed and taught about receiving the eternal life compare with what the Jewish expert in the Law understood about it from the Law of Moses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~25#Answer:How did what Jesus believed and taught about receiving the eternal life compare with what the Jewish expert in the Law understood about it from the Law of Moses?841192702
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the man to do the very same thing that the man had said that Moses had written in the books of the Law. [He had to do what the Law said, not just know what it said.] (26-28)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo afanye jambo lile lile alilosema mtu huyo kwamba Musa alikuwa ameandika katika vitabu vya Sheria. [Alilazimika kufanya yale ambayo Sheria ilisema, si kujua tu yale iliyosema.] (26-28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Answer:How did what Jesus believed and taught about receiving the eternal life compare with what the Jewish expert in the Law understood about it from the Law of Moses?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.25-37+How does a person get eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~25#Question:How does a person get eternal life?
trans-unit.source: How does a person get eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hupataje uhai wa milele?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Question:How does a person get eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~25#Answer:How does a person get eternal life?-634119327
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that we are to love and obey God [perfectly], according to his commands that Moses wrote down. This included loving our neighbor perfectly, too. (26-27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba tunapaswa kumpenda na kumtii Mungu [kwa ukamilifu], kulingana na amri zake ambazo Musa aliandika. Hii ilijumuisha kumpenda jirani yetu kikamilifu, pia. (26-27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Answer:How does a person get eternal life?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~25#Note:How does a person get eternal life?1484055341
trans-unit.source: Every person who tries to do as Jesus said soon finds that he cannot do it all perfectly and will never get eternal life by his own efforts. The only way left is to trust in Jesus's perfect life and in his death so that God could forgive our sins. Thus, eternal life is a gift from God.
trans-unit.target: Kila mtu anayejaribu kufanya kama Yesu alivyosema hivi karibuni atagundua kwamba hawezi kufanya yote kikamilifu na kamwe hataweza kupata uzima wa milele kwa jitihada zake mwenyewe. Njia pekee iliyobaki ni kuamini katika maisha makamilifu ya Yesu na katika kifo chake ili Mungu aweze kusamehe dhambi zetu. Hivyo, uzima wa milele ni zawadi kutoka kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Note:How does a person get eternal life?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.25-37+What is the answer to the expert's second question, "Who is my neighbor?"

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~25#Question:What is the answer to the expert's second question, "Who is my neighbor?"
trans-unit.source: What is the answer to the expert's second question, "Who is my neighbor?"
trans-unit.target: Jibu la swali la pili la mtaalamu huyo ni nini, "Jirani yangu ni nani?"
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Question:What is the answer to the expert's second question, "Who is my neighbor?"

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~25#Answer:What is the answer to the expert's second question, "Who is my neighbor?"-205629807
trans-unit.source: A person's neighbor is anyone/everyone who needs our help in any way. (36-37)
trans-unit.target: Jirani wa mtu ni mtu yeyote/kila mtu anayehitaji msaada wetu kwa njia yoyote ile. (36-37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Answer:What is the answer to the expert's second question, "Who is my neighbor?"

group.id: Q:LUK 10.25+What did the expert in the Law want to know about eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~25#Question:What did the expert in the Law want to know about eternal life?
trans-unit.source: What did the expert in the Law want to know about eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Msomi wa Sheria alitaka kujua nini kuhusu uzima wa milele?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Question:What did the expert in the Law want to know about eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~25#Answer:What did the expert in the Law want to know about eternal life?-1563566713
trans-unit.source: He wanted to know what he had to do so that he could receive/inherit that life. (25)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kujua ni nini alichopaswa kufanya ili apokee/arithi uhai huo. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Answer:What did the expert in the Law want to know about eternal life?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.25-29+What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~25#Question:What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?
trans-unit.source: What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri uzima wa milele ni uhai wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Question:What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~25#Answer:What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?1099190912
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Eternal life is a life that is not affected by time limits, such as whether a person is still alive physically or not. That kind of living can begin now while we are still alive and will go on forever, even after our bodies die. Jesus, in his dying and rising on our behalf, made it possible for us to have that eternal life. God graciously and freely allows us to have that new life. It is a life of having a close relationship with God, obeying him as he rules over us.
trans-unit.target: Uhakiki wa neno muhimu: Maisha ya milele ni maisha ambayo hayaathiriwa na mipaka ya wakati, kama vile ikiwa mtu bado yuko hai kimwili au la. Aina hiyo ya maisha inaweza kuanza sasa wakati bado tuko hai na itaendelea milele, hata baada ya miili yetu kufa. Yesu, kwa kufa na kufufuka kwa niaba yetu, alifanya iwezekane kwetu kuwa na maisha hayo ya milele. Mungu kwa neema na kwa uhuru anaturuhusu kuwa na maisha hayo mapya. Ni maisha ya kuwa na uhusiano wa karibu na Mungu, kumtii kama anavyotawala juu yetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Answer:What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~25#Note:What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?-1430096979
trans-unit.source: See "life" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "maisha" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Note:What kind of life do you think that eternal life is?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.25+Why was that expert in the Law asking that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~25#Question:Why was that expert in the Law asking that question?
trans-unit.source: Why was that expert in the Law asking that question?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mtaalamu huyo wa Sheria aliuliza swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Question:Why was that expert in the Law asking that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~25#Answer:Why was that expert in the Law asking that question?-1597519169
trans-unit.source: He wanted to test Jesus, [whether he really knew about God's laws and how to interpret them or not. He may have hoped to make Jesus appear wrong in front of the other people]. (25)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kumjaribu Yesu, [kama kweli alijua kuhusu sheria za Mungu na jinsi ya kuzifafanua au la. Huenda alitumaini kumfanya Yesu aonekane kuwa na makosa mbele ya watu wengine]. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~25#Answer:Why was that expert in the Law asking that question?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.26+What did Jesus ask the man to tell him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~26#Question:What did Jesus ask the man to tell him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask the man to tell him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo amwambie nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~26#Question:What did Jesus ask the man to tell him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~26#Answer:What did Jesus ask the man to tell him?1732522693
trans-unit.source: He asked the man to tell him what [Moses] had written [about eternal life] in the Law. (26)
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza mtu huyo amwambie [Musa] alikuwa ameandika nini katika Sheria [kuhusu uhai wa milele] (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~26#Answer:What did Jesus ask the man to tell him?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.27+What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~27#Question:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?
trans-unit.source: What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Musa alisema watu walipaswa kufanya nini ili wapate uhai udumuo milele?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~27#Question:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~27#Answer:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?-1904587307
trans-unit.source: A person should love God with every part of him and then love his neighbor as [much as, or in the same way as, he loves] himself. (27)
trans-unit.target: Mtu apaswa kumpenda Mungu kwa kila sehemu ya nafsi yake na kisha kumpenda jirani yake kama [kama, au kwa njia ile ile, anavyojipenda] mwenyewe. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~27#Answer:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~27#Answer:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?-263288979
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek word for "heart" referred to the physical organ in the chest which pumps blood around the body. The word also referred to the center of a person's feelings, desires, and emotions. This verse refers to the heart as the center of emotions. The translation should use the term for whatever body part the culture says is that center of emotions, not necessarily the word for the heart. See "heart" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Neno la msingi: Neno la Kigiriki la "moyo" lilirejelea kiungo cha mwili katika kifua ambacho hupompa damu kote mwilini. Neno hilo pia lilirejelea kituo cha hisia, tamaa, na hisia za mtu. Mstari huu unarejelea moyo kama kituo cha hisia. Tafsiri inapaswa kutumia neno kwa sehemu yoyote ya mwili ambayo utamaduni unasema ni kituo hicho cha hisia, sio lazima neno la moyo. Tazama "moyo" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~27#Answer:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~27#Answer:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?1942546726
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See 1:46-48, above, for comments on "soul". Also see "soul" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia maneno muhimu: Ona maneno ya Yohana 1:46-48 yaliyo hapo juu, kuhusu neno "nafsi".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~27#Answer:What had Moses said that people should do to receive eternal life?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.28+What did Jesus say about the expert's answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~28#Question:What did Jesus say about the expert's answer?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the expert's answer?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu jibu la yule mtaalamu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~28#Question:What did Jesus say about the expert's answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~28#Answer:What did Jesus say about the expert's answer?-2058305773
trans-unit.source: He had answered correctly. If he did that, he would have [eternal] life. (28)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amejibu kwa usahihi. Kama angefanya hivyo, angekuwa na uhai [wa milele]. (28)

trans-unit.target: Alitaka kuonyesha kwamba alikuwa sahihi katika njia ambayo alikuwa akiishi na kuwatendea watu (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~29#Answer:Jesus had answered the expert's first question completely. Why did the expert in the Law ask Jesus another question about this topic?

trans-unit.source: He may have felt embarrassed in front of the other people because Jesus had him answer his own question with Scripture verses that every Jew knew. These verses did not have hidden meaning so that a person needed to be an expert in the Law of Moses in order to understand them.
trans-unit.target: Huenda alihisi aibu mbele ya watu wengine kwa sababu Yesu alimwomba ajibu swali lake mwenyewe kwa kutumia mistari ya Maandiko ambayo kila Myahudi aliijua. Mistari hiyo haikuwa na maana iliyofichwa hivi kwamba mtu alihitaji kuwa mtaalamu wa Sheria ya Kimusa ili kuielewa.

group.id: Q:LUK 10.31-32+Did anyone else walk along that road?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~31#Question:Did anyone else walk along that road?
trans-unit.source: Did anyone else walk along that road?
trans-unit.target: Je, kuna mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepitia njia hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~31#Question:Did anyone else walk along that road?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~31#Answer:Did anyone else walk along that road?-1778071527
trans-unit.source: Yes, a priest and, later, a man from the tribe/clan of Levi [who worked in the temple] [and even later, a Samaritan man,] each came along that road. (31-32)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, kuhani na, baadaye, mtu wa kabila/kabila la Lawi [aliyetumika hekaluni] [na hata baadaye, mtu Msamaria,] kila mmoja alikuja kupitia barabara hiyo. (31-32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~31#Answer:Did anyone else walk along that road?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~31#Answer:Did anyone else walk along that road?1389034984
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "Levite" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Angalia "Levi" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~31#Answer:Did anyone else walk along that road?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~31#Note:Did anyone else walk along that road?851073603
trans-unit.source: The first words in the Greek text in 10:31 indicate that the priest (and other people) did not often come along that road, so the injured man could have died there before another person found him and helped him. It would be good if the translation indicated that another person might not come along that part of the road until a long time after the robbers had beaten the man. See other translations for ideas.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya kwanza katika maandishi ya Kigiriki katika 10:31 yanaonyesha kwamba kuhani (na watu wengine) hawakuja mara nyingi kwenye barabara hiyo, kwa hivyo mtu aliyejeruhiwa angeweza kufa hapo kabla ya mtu mwingine kumpata na kumsaidia. Ingekuwa vizuri ikiwa tafsiri ingeonyesha kwamba mtu mwingine hawezi kuja kwenye sehemu hiyo ya barabara hadi muda mrefu baada ya wanyang'anyi kumpiga mtu huyo. Tazama tafsiri zingine kwa maoni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~31#Note:Did anyone else walk along that road?

trans-unit.target: Akapita upande ule mwingine wa barabara [na hakumsaidia mtu huyo]. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~31#Answer:What did the priest do when he saw the injured man?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.37+Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~37#Question:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?
trans-unit.source: Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?
trans-unit.target: Ni mtu yupi ambaye mtaalamu wa Sheria alisema alikuwa jirani ya mtu aliyeporwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~37#Question:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~37#Answer:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?697880005
trans-unit.source: The man who had mercy on him was the one who acted like a neighbor. (37)
trans-unit.target: Yule mtu aliyemwonyesha rehema ndiye aliyetenda kama jirani. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~37#Answer:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~37#Note:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?1424507834
trans-unit.source: If the respondent answers with, "The Samaritan", skip over the next question.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mwenye nyumba atajibu, "Ni Msamaria", usiulize swali linalofuata.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~37#Note:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~37#Note:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?413172654
trans-unit.source: Because of the bad feelings between the Jews and the Samaritans, this very religious Jew who was asking Jesus the question about eternal life and one's neighbor would not give credit out loud even to a Samaritan in a story by saying his nationality by name. He only described him by the good thing he did. If the language of the translation has a way to refer to a socially ostracized person or group, such as traditional enemies, see if that is an appropriate term for this expert to use here.
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu ya hisia mbaya kati ya Wayahudi na Wasamaria, Myahudi huyu wa kidini sana ambaye alikuwa akimwuliza Yesu swali kuhusu uzima wa milele na jirani ya mtu asingempa sifa kwa sauti hata kwa Msamaria katika hadithi kwa kusema utaifa wake kwa jina. Alimfafanua tu kwa jambo zuri alilofanya. Ikiwa lugha ya tafsiri ina njia ya kutaja mtu au kikundi kilichotengwa kijamii, kama vile maadui wa jadi, angalia ikiwa hiyo ni neno linalofaa kwa mtaalam huyu kutumia hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~37#Note:Which man did the expert in the Law say was acting like a neighbor to the man who had been robbed?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.38-42+What do you think that we should learn for ourselves from this incident?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~38#Question:What do you think that we should learn for ourselves from this incident?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that we should learn for ourselves from this incident?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri tunapaswa kujifunza nini kutokana na tukio hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~38#Question:What do you think that we should learn for ourselves from this incident?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~38#Answer:What do you think that we should learn for ourselves from this incident?1094236052
trans-unit.source: We should be like Mary and choose to do what is most important in life. That is, we should stop being too busy with good activities which we think are important, and learn about God and how he wants us to live.
trans-unit.target: Tunapaswa kuwa kama Mariamu na kuchagua kufanya kile ambacho ni muhimu zaidi katika maisha. Hiyo ni, tunapaswa kuacha kuwa na shughuli nyingi sana na shughuli nzuri ambazo tunafikiri ni muhimu, na kujifunza juu ya Mungu na jinsi anavyotaka tuishi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~38#Answer:What do you think that we should learn for ourselves from this incident?

trans-unit.source: What was that one important thing?
trans-unit.target: Jambo hilo moja muhimu lilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?-1370587105
trans-unit.source: What was the one important thing, which Mary had chosen?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani moja la maana, ambalo Mariamu alikuwa amechagua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?-896123905
trans-unit.source: What was the one important thing?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani moja lililokuwa muhimu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?1509411455
trans-unit.source: What was the one necessary thing, which Mary had chosen?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani moja la lazima, ambalo Mariamu alikuwa amechagua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?550592118
trans-unit.source: What was the one necessary thing?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani moja tu lililokuwa muhimu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Alternate:What was that one important thing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!10~41#Answer:What was that one important thing?794402782
trans-unit.source: What Mary had chosen to do was the more important thing. She had chosen to learn from Jesus. (42)
trans-unit.target: Maria alichagua kufanya jambo muhimu zaidi. Alikuwa amechagua kujifunza kutoka kwa Yesu. (42)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Answer:What was that one important thing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~41#Note:What was that one important thing?-272811842
trans-unit.source: Some Bible scholars say that the "one thing" referred to Martha preparing less food and thus having less work. Then it would have been easy enough for one person to get ready quickly and also have time to hear what Jesus had to say.
trans-unit.target: Wasomi fulani wa Biblia wanasema kwamba maneno "jambo moja" yalimaanisha kwamba Martha alihitaji kutayarisha chakula kidogo na hivyo kufanya kazi kidogo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Note:What was that one important thing?

group.id: Q:LUK 10.41-42+Do the words of Jesus in verses 41-42 sound like he was angry with Martha?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!10~41#Question:Do the words of Jesus in verses 41-42 sound like he was angry with Martha?
trans-unit.source: Do the words of Jesus in verses 41-42 sound like he was angry with Martha?
trans-unit.target: Je, maneno ya Yesu katika mstari wa 41-42 yanaonyesha kwamba alimkasirikia Martha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Question:Do the words of Jesus in verses 41-42 sound like he was angry with Martha?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!10~41#Note:Do the words of Jesus in verses 41-42 sound like he was angry with Martha?-1845063773
trans-unit.source: It should not sound like he was angry. He was chiding/correcting her, but he was gentle and sympathetic to Martha's desire to show her love to him.
trans-unit.target: Haipaswi kuonekana kama alikuwa amekasirika. Alikuwa akimkemea / kumrekebisha, lakini alikuwa mpole na mwenye huruma kwa hamu ya Martha ya kuonyesha upendo wake kwake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!10~41#Note:Do the words of Jesus in verses 41-42 sound like he was angry with Martha?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.1-13+Who do you think is the best example for us to follow when we want to know how to pray?

trans-unit.source: Who do you think is the best example for us to follow when we want to know how to pray?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~1#Question:Who do you think is the best example for us to follow when we want to know how to pray?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~1#Answer:Who do you think is the best example for us to follow when we want to know how to pray?545318256
trans-unit.source: Jesus is. (All that is recorded in the Bible about Jesus praying and what he taught about praying is the starting point for how, when, and where we are to pray meaningfully to God.)

group.id: Q:LUK 11.5-8+What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?

trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka wanafunzi wake wajifunze nini kuhusu sala kutokana na hadithi aliyosimulia kuhusu mtu aliyemwomba jirani yake chakula?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~5#Question:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~5#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?864595830
trans-unit.source: They must come with their needs at any time and persevere/be persistent in praying.
trans-unit.target: Lazima walete mahitaji yao wakati wowote na waendelee / wawe na bidii katika maombi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~5#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~5#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~5#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~5#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?-1709016160
trans-unit.source: If even an unwilling human friend can be moved to act by a person who is persistent in his request for a need, how much more will God be moved by the persistence of one who prays to him for a need.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa hata rafiki wa kibinadamu asiyetaka anaweza kuchochewa kutenda kwa sababu ya mtu anayedumu katika ombi lake la uhitaji, Mungu atachochewa hata zaidi na udumifu wa mtu anayesali kwake kuhusu uhitaji fulani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~5#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the story he told about a man asking a neighbor for some food?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.11-13+What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the examples he gave about a human father responding to his son's request for help?

trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the examples he gave about a human father responding to his son's request for help?

trans-unit.source: God, our Father in heaven, is ready to hear our prayers and answer them even more than a human father would respond to his children's requests.
trans-unit.target: Mungu, Baba yetu wa mbinguni, yuko tayari kusikiliza na kujibu sala zetu hata zaidi ya baba wa kibinadamu anavyoweza kujibu maombi ya watoto wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~11#Answer:What do you think that Jesus wanted his disciples to learn about praying from the examples he gave about a human father responding to his son's request for help?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.2+What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?

trans-unit.target: Mtu apaswa kusali nini kuhusu utawala wa Mungu katika maisha ya watu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Question:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?-212212354
trans-unit.source: One should pray that the time for God to rule over his people should come [soon/quickly].
trans-unit.target: Mtu apaswa kusali kwamba wakati wa Mungu kutawala juu ya watu wake uje [haraka/haraka].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?-1144089552
trans-unit.source: -AND/OR-
trans-unit.target: - NA/AU-
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?-799851045
trans-unit.source: God's rule should come/happen to all people. // All people should submit to God ruling over them. // May all people know/acknowledge God as their king.
trans-unit.target: Utawala wa Mungu unapaswa kuja/kutokea kwa watu wote. // Watu wote wanapaswa kujitiisha kwa Mungu kutawala juu yao. // Huenda watu wote kujua/kutambua Mungu kama mfalme wao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~2#Note:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?-1514588082
trans-unit.source: The language of the translation may not allow an abstract object, such as a kingdom, to "come". Ask about this if the text appears to be a literal translation.
trans-unit.target: Lugha ya tafsiri huenda isiruhusu kitu kisichoeleweka, kama vile ufalme, "kuja". Uliza juu ya hili ikiwa maandishi yaonekana kuwa tafsiri ya neno kwa neno.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Note:What should a person pray about God ruling in people's lives?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.2+If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~2#Question:If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?
trans-unit.source: If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Mungu hawatawali watu fulani, unafikiri ni nani anayewatawala?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Question:If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?-1431308472
trans-unit.source: The devil is ruling them./Satan is ruling them.
trans-unit.target: Ibilisi anawatawala. /Shetani anawatawala.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Answer:If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~2#Note:If God is not ruling over some people, who do you think is ruling over them?-1015794582
trans-unit.source: A person may think that he is ruling/guiding himself, but that is not true. If God is not ruling, then that person has allowed himself to be under Satan's control.
trans-unit.target: Mtu anaweza kufikiri kwamba anajiongoza mwenyewe, lakini hilo si kweli. Ikiwa Mungu haongozi, basi mtu huyo amejiruhusu kuwa chini ya udhibiti wa Shetani.

trans-unit.target: Mtu husameheje mtu mwingine ambaye amemkopesha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Alternate:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?1917902207
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He stops thinking about that person as having done something wrong against him. That means that there is no need for that person to compensate him in any way, such as by being punished or by giving him good things or by doing extra actions which would please him. The one who forgives does not think of that other person as being a bad person any longer.
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Yeye huacha kufikiria mtu huyo kama amemfanyia kitu kibaya. Hiyo inamaanisha kuwa hakuna haja ya mtu huyo kumlipa kwa njia yoyote, kama vile kwa kuadhibiwa au kwa kumpa vitu vizuri au kwa kufanya vitendo vya ziada ambavyo vingemfurahisha. Mtu anayesamehe hafikirii mtu huyo mwingine kama mtu mbaya tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Answer:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~2#Note:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?-570225461
trans-unit.source: See "forgive" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "kusamehe" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Note:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~2#Note:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?-293463245
trans-unit.source: This is the same thing that God does when he forgives a person (see 1:77). If the speakers of the language used in the translation use a term for God forgiving people which is different from the term the people use for forgiving others, check what the people's reasons may be. This can be checked by switching the verbs for forgiveness and asking what makes each one acceptable or unacceptable in the people's minds. The Greek text uses the same word in both references. God expects us to do the same as he has done for us (see Luke 6:37; Matt. 6:14-15; 18:32-35; Mark 11:25).
trans-unit.target: Hii ni kitu kimoja ambacho Mungu hufanya anapomsamehe mtu (tazama 1:77). Ikiwa wasemaji wa lugha inayotumika katika tafsiri hutumia neno kwa Mungu kusamehe watu ambalo ni tofauti na neno ambalo watu hutumia kusamehe wengine, angalia sababu za watu zinaweza kuwa nini. Hii inaweza kudhibitishwa kwa kubadilisha vitenzi kwa msamaha na kuuliza ni nini hufanya kila moja kukubalika au kutokubalika katika akili za watu. Nakala ya Kigiriki hutumia neno moja katika marejeleo yote mawili. Mungu anatarajia tufanye vile vile kama alivyofanya kwa ajili yetu (tazama Luka 6:37; Mt. 6:14-15; 18:32-35; Marko 11:25).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Note:How does a person forgive another person who is indebted to him/who has sinned against him?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about his being tempted to disobey God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about his being tempted to disobey God?866551347

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~2#Answer:What should a person pray about his being tempted to disobey God?-188924616
trans-unit.source: He should ask God not to allow him to do anything that day which would cause God to stop protecting him and, thus, leave him open to the devil's temptations. // He wants God to keep him living according to/submitting to God's perfect will/desires so that Satan has no way to control him.
trans-unit.target: Anapaswa kumwomba Mungu asimruhusu kufanya chochote siku hiyo ambacho kitamfanya Mungu aache kumlinda na hivyo kumwacha wazi kwa majaribu ya shetani. // Anataka Mungu amweke akiishi kulingana na / kujitiisha kwa mapenzi / matakwa kamili ya Mungu ili Shetani asiwe na njia ya kumdhibiti.

group.id: Q:LUK 11.9+What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~9#Question:What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mtu anapaswa kufanya nini anapohitaji kitu fulani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~9#Question:What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~9#Answer:What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?-333366142
trans-unit.source: He is to keep on asking [God for it], seeking [for it] and knocking on God's door [because of it]. (9)
trans-unit.target: Anapaswa kuendelea kuomba [kwa Mungu], kutafuta [kwa ajili ya] na kubisha mlango wa Mungu [kwa sababu ya] hiyo. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~9#Answer:What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~9#Note:What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?-161054727
trans-unit.source: Most writers of commentaries mention that the three phrases convey a sense of increasing intensity to get whatever is needed, knocking on a door being the most intense. However, knocking may not be the normal way in the culture of the target audience to show one's desire to interact with the people inside a neighbor's house. For help in adjusting the translation to be culturally appropriate, see TN, Luke 11:9c.
trans-unit.target: Waandishi wengi wa maelezo wanataja kwamba maneno haya matatu yanaonyesha hisia ya kuongezeka kwa nguvu ili kupata chochote kinachohitajika, kugonga mlango kuwa nguvu zaidi. Hata hivyo, kugonga inaweza kuwa sio njia ya kawaida katika utamaduni wa watazamaji wa lengo kuonyesha hamu ya mtu ya kuingiliana na watu ndani ya nyumba ya jirani. Kwa msaada katika kurekebisha tafsiri kuwa inafaa kiutamaduni, angalia TN, Luka 11: 9c.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~9#Note:What did Jesus say that a person is to do if he needs something?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.13+How did Jesus compare his disciples with God?

trans-unit.source: How did Jesus compare his disciples with God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwalinganishaje wanafunzi wake na Mungu?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~13#Answer:How did Jesus compare his disciples with God?438059187
trans-unit.source: He said that they were bad in contrast to God who is perfect. Even so, they gave good things to their children when they asked. God wants [and is ready] more than they to give perfect gifts, even his own Holy Spirit, to those people who will ask him. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kuwa wao ni wabaya kinyume na Mungu ambaye ni mkamilifu. Hata hivyo, waliwapa watoto wao vitu vizuri walipowaomba. Mungu anataka [na yuko tayari] zaidi kuliko wao kuwapa zawadi kamilifu, hata Roho wake Mtakatifu, kwa wale watu ambao watamwomba. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~13#Answer:How did Jesus compare his disciples with God?

trans-unit.source: How did Jesus's statements about the parts of a divided kingdom being against each other apply to what had just happened?
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya Yesu kuhusu sehemu za ufalme uliogawanyika zikiwa zinajipinga zikitumikaje kwa yale yaliyokuwa yametukia tu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~14#Question:How did Jesus's statements about the parts of a divided kingdom being against each other apply to what had just happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~14#Answer:How did Jesus's statements about the parts of a divided kingdom being against each other apply to what had just happened?-513747244
trans-unit.source: He was referring to what the people had been thinking when he cast out the demon. (18b) If he was one of Satan's workers, he would not cast another of Satan's workers out of a man. That would only weaken Satan's kingdom. Their thinking did not make sense.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akirejelea kile watu walikuwa wakifikiria wakati alipomfukuza pepo. (18b) Kama alikuwa mmoja wa wafanyakazi wa Shetani, asingemfukuza mwingine wa wafanyakazi wa Shetani kutoka kwa mtu. Hiyo ingedhoofisha tu ufalme wa Shetani. Mawazo yao hayakuwa na maana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~14#Answer:How did Jesus's statements about the parts of a divided kingdom being against each other apply to what had just happened?

trans-unit.source: Jesus was casting out a demon that made a man unable to talk/mute/dumb.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~14#Answer:What happened which started many people talking about Jesus's power?-1130885881

group.id: Q:LUK 11.14+How did most of the people who saw that react?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~14#Question:How did most of the people who saw that react?
trans-unit.source: How did most of the people who saw that react?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi walioona hilo waliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~14#Question:How did most of the people who saw that react?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~14#Answer:How did most of the people who saw that react?-1184688745
trans-unit.source: They were amazed. (14)
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~14#Answer:How did most of the people who saw that react?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~14#Note:How did most of the people who saw that react?-192618586
trans-unit.source: Luke already has used this same Greek word "thaumazw" eight times to describe people's reactions to things they saw or heard. Check again at 8:25 and 9:43 to see whether the translation has described this action consistently. Luke wrote that the same thing happened each time, so the translation should reflect that, too.
trans-unit.target: Luka tayari ametumia neno hili la Kigiriki "thaumazw" mara nane kuelezea jinsi watu walivyoitikia mambo waliyoyaona au kuyasikia. Angalia tena kwenye 8:25 na 9:43 ili kuona kama tafsiri imeelezea hatua hii kwa uthabiti. Luka aliandika kwamba jambo lile lile lilitokea kila wakati, kwa hivyo tafsiri inapaswa kutafakari hilo pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~14#Note:How did most of the people who saw that react?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.16+How did other people react?

trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus to show them a sign/miracle from [God in] heaven. They wanted to test him, [that is, to prove that his power and authority really were from God and not from Satan]. (16)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu awaonyeshe ishara/mwujiza kutoka [kwa Mungu aliye] mbinguni. Walitaka kumjaribu, [yaani, kuthibitisha kwamba nguvu na mamlaka yake kwa kweli yalitoka kwa Mungu na si kwa Shetani]. (16)

trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~16#Answer:How did other people react?-1367516352
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus to cause a sign/miracle to happen in the sky or to come from the sky. [Then they would know that God had sent him to do what he was doing.] (16)
trans-unit.target: Walimwomba Yesu afanye ishara/muujiza kutokea mbinguni au kushuka kutoka mbinguni. [Hapo wangejua kwamba Mungu alimtuma kufanya kile alichokuwa akifanya.] (16)

group.id: Q:LUK 11.19+How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~19#Question:How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?
trans-unit.source: How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?
trans-unit.target: Watu, kutia ndani Mafarisayo, wangeweza kuhukumuje kama Yesu alikuwa ametumia nguvu za Shetani au nguvu za Mungu kumfukuza huyo roho mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~19#Question:How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~19#Answer:How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?526404692
trans-unit.source: Since some of the Pharisees' own followers cast out the same kind of demons, the people should ask them if they used Satan's power to do that. (19) (Their own people would quickly show them that such an opinion about anyone, even Jesus, was wrong.)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa baadhi ya wafuasi wa Mafarisayo wenyewe walifukuza aina ile ile ya mashetani, watu wanapaswa kuwauliza kama walitumia nguvu za Shetani kufanya hivyo. (19) (Watu wao wenyewe wangewaonyesha mara moja kwamba maoni kama hayo juu ya mtu yeyote, hata Yesu, yalikuwa makosa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~19#Answer:How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~19#Answer:How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?-202033277
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "judge, judgment" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "hakimu, hukumu" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~19#Answer:How were the people, including Pharisees, to judge whether Jesus had used Satan's power or God's power to cast out that demon?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.17-20+What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~17#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema "ufalme wa Mungu umekuja juu yenu"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~17#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~17#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?61511732
trans-unit.source: God's power was being displayed as far superior to their power, as a victorious force which they could not stand against.
trans-unit.target: Nguvu ya Mungu ilikuwa ikionyeshwa kuwa bora zaidi kuliko nguvu zao, kama nguvu yenye ushindi ambayo hawangeweza kuishinda.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~17#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~17#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?1860153367
trans-unit.source: Jesus' effective use of divine power demonstrated that God's kingdom was being established in their midst.
trans-unit.target: Matumizi yenye matokeo ya Yesu ya nguvu ya kimungu yalionyesha kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa ukisimamishwa katikati yao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~17#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~17#Note:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?1408113208
trans-unit.source: If the text is a literal translation of the Greek "kingdom comes", see how the same wording was adjusted at 11:2.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa andiko hilo ni tafsiri ya neno kwa neno ya Kigiriki "ufalme unakuja", ona jinsi maneno hayo yalivyobadilishwa kwenye 11:2.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~17#Note:What did Jesus mean when he said "the kingdom of God has come upon you"?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.21-22+Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~21#Question:Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?
trans-unit.source: Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa ametoka tu kumfukuza pepo ambaye alikuwa amemfanya mtu asiweze kuongea. Unafikiri ilikuwaje hiyo inahusiana na yale ambayo Yesu alisema juu ya kumwibia mtu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~21#Question:Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~21#Answer:Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?205903129
trans-unit.source: A robber must be stronger than the person he robs. Since Jesus had sent Satan's demons out of the man, then Jesus is clearly stronger than Satan. He overpowered Satan and won the victory.
trans-unit.target: Mhalifu lazima awe na nguvu kuliko mtu anayemwibia. Kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa amewafukuza roho waovu wa Shetani kutoka kwa mtu huyo, basi Yesu ni wazi kuwa na nguvu kuliko Shetani. Alimshinda Shetani na kupata ushindi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~21#Answer:Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~21#Note:Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?-846245426
trans-unit.source: Jesus had defeated Satan in the desert earlier (see Luke 4:1-13). Now he was taking away from Satan the people he had controlled. This was like taking away the things that Satan had owned. Jesus was giving out the benefits of his victory to the members of his own kingdom by freeing them from any demon's control.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amemshinda Shetani jangwani mapema (ona Luka 4:1-13). Sasa alikuwa akiwachukua watu aliokuwa amewaongoza kutoka kwa Shetani. Hii ilikuwa kama kuchukua vitu ambavyo Shetani alikuwa amemiliki. Yesu alikuwa akitoa faida za ushindi wake kwa wanachama wa ufalme wake mwenyewe kwa kuwaweka huru kutoka kwa udhibiti wowote wa pepo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~21#Note:Jesus had just cast out a demon which had made a man unable to talk. What do you think was the way that relates to what Jesus said about robbing another person?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.23+To what, do you think, did Jesus refer when he spoke about gathering and scattering something?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~23#Answer:To what, do you think, did Jesus refer when he spoke about gathering and scattering something?-743155743
trans-unit.source: Jesus referred to gathering people [to follow him] into the kingdom of God. Satan does not want that to happen, so he does things to keep people out of God's kingdom.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~23#Answer:To what, do you think, did Jesus refer when he spoke about gathering and scattering something?

trans-unit.source: The people who had thought that Jesus had used Satan's power to cast out the demon were not helping Jesus [or encouraging others to come to him], but causing other people to stay away.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~27#Answer:Who did the woman say was blessed/truly happy?-460023773
trans-unit.source: [Jesus's mother, being] the woman who had borne and breast-fed him was blessed/happy. (27)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~27#Answer:Who did the woman say was blessed/truly happy?1477636406
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See the explanation of "blessed" at 6:20.
trans-unit.target: Angalia maelezo ya neno "baraka" kwenye 6:20.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~27#Answer:Who did the woman say was blessed/truly happy?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~27#Note:Who did the woman say was blessed/truly happy?-599245474
trans-unit.source: The words which the woman spoke literally mean that the womb and the breasts were the things which were "blessed". She used the poetic pattern of her Hebrew/Aramaic language to express her meaning by using two parallel statements. The two statements together help us understand that the woman's focus was not on the body parts, but on the person to whom they belonged, Jesus's mother. The translation should reflect that focus, regardless whether it is culturally appropriate or not to speak about wombs and breast-feeding in a public gathering, such as a church service.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ambayo mwanamke alisema kwa kweli yanamaanisha kwamba tumbo na matiti yalikuwa vitu ambavyo "vilibarikiwa". Alitumia mtindo wa kishairi wa lugha yake ya Kiebrania / Kiaramu kuelezea maana yake kwa kutumia taarifa mbili sambamba. Taarifa mbili pamoja zinatusaidia kuelewa kwamba mkazo wa mwanamke haukuwa kwenye sehemu za mwili, lakini kwa mtu ambaye wao ni mali yake, mama ya Yesu. Tafsiri inapaswa kuonyesha mkazo huo, bila kujali ikiwa ni sawa kiutamaduni au sio kuzungumza juu ya tumbo na kunyonyesha katika mkusanyiko wa umma, kama vile huduma ya kanisa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~27#Note:Who did the woman say was blessed/truly happy?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~28#Answer:Who did Jesus say were even more blessed/happier than his mother?-1208618308
trans-unit.source: Those [people] who hear the word of God [and do what it says] are even happier. (28)
trans-unit.target: Wale [watu] wanaosikia neno la Mungu [na kufanya lile linalosema] ndio wenye furaha zaidi. (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~28#Answer:Who did Jesus say were even more blessed/happier than his mother?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~28#Note:Who did Jesus say were even more blessed/happier than his mother?-499790605
trans-unit.source: Jesus did not say that his mother was not blessed, but that these people would be even more blessed than his own mother. Actually, his mother's great happiness/blessing was because she had listened and obeyed God's word which the angel had spoken to her (see Luke 1:38, 45; 2:51).
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakusema kwamba mama yake hakuwa amebarikiwa, lakini kwamba watu hawa wangebarikiwa hata zaidi kuliko mama yake mwenyewe. Kwa kweli, furaha kubwa ya mama yake/baraka ilikuwa kwa sababu alikuwa amesikiliza na kutii neno la Mungu ambalo malaika alikuwa amemwambia (ona Luka 1:38, 45; 2:51).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~28#Note:Who did Jesus say were even more blessed/happier than his mother?
