group.id: Q:LUK 11.29-32+What sign did Jesus talk about?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~29#Question:What sign did Jesus talk about?
trans-unit.source: What sign did Jesus talk about?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumzia ishara gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~29#Question:What sign did Jesus talk about?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~29#Answer:What sign did Jesus talk about?-66390002
trans-unit.source: He told them that the only sign about which he would do anything for them was [what they already knew had happened in the prophet] Jonah's life and his preaching (29). [He, Jesus,] the Son of Man would be like Jonah for them (30), and even greater than Jonah (32).
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba ishara pekee ambayo angewafanyia chochote ni [wale ambao tayari walijua kilichotokea katika nabii] maisha ya Yona na mahubiri yake (29). [Yeye, Yesu,] Mwana wa Adamu atakuwa kama Yona kwao (30), na hata mkubwa kuliko Yona (32).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~29#Answer:What sign did Jesus talk about?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~29#Note:What sign did Jesus talk about?-1452171334
trans-unit.source: The things which the people of Nineveh had seen in Jonah's life are named in Matthew's account of this event (see Matt. 12:38-42). Jonah's message was that the people had to repent or be punished. This was the same message which Jesus now preached. Also, Jonah had spent three days and three nights in the stomach of a great fish. It seemed that he had died when he had been thrown into the sea, but then it was as though he rose from the dead when that fish spit him up on the shore. Jesus implied that something similar would happen to him. Because his wisdom was greater than Solomon's and his message greater than Jonah's, the people already had enough reason to believe in him.
trans-unit.target: Mambo ambayo watu wa Ninawi walikuwa wameyaona katika maisha ya Yona yanaelezwa katika simulizi la Mathayo la tukio hili (ona Mt. 12:38-42). Ujumbe wa Yona ulikuwa kwamba watu walipaswa kutubu au kuadhibiwa. Huu ulikuwa ujumbe ule ule ambao Yesu sasa alihubiri. Pia, Yona alikuwa ametumia siku tatu na usiku tatu katika tumbo la samaki mkubwa. Ilionekana kwamba alikuwa amekufa alipotupwa baharini, lakini ilikuwa kana kwamba alifufuka kutoka kwa wafu wakati samaki huyo alipomtemea mate kwenye ukingo. Yesu alionyesha kwamba jambo kama hilo lingetokea kwake. Kwa sababu hekima yake ilikuwa kubwa kuliko ile ya Sulemani na ujumbe wake ulikuwa mkubwa kuliko ule wa Yona, watu tayari walikuwa na sababu ya kutosha kumwamini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~29#Note:What sign did Jesus talk about?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~31#Question:What will the Queen who came from the South and the people of Nineveh do when God later judges all the people of the world?
trans-unit.source: What will the Queen who came from the South and the people of Nineveh do when God later judges all the people of the world?
trans-unit.target: Malkia aliyekuja kutoka Kusini na watu wa Ninawi watafanya nini wakati Mungu baadaye atakapohukumu watu wote wa ulimwengu?

trans-unit.target: Watafufuliwa [kutoka kwa wafu na Mungu] na kulaumu [watu walioishi wakati wa Yesu] kwa sababu watu hao hawakutubu [dhambi zao]. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~31#Answer:What will the Queen who came from the South and the people of Nineveh do when God later judges all the people of the world?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.32+The people would see the same kind of sign as the people of Nineveh had seen when Jonah preached to them long ago. But how had the way that the Nineveh people responded to Jonah been different from the way that the people were now responding to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~32#Question:The people would see the same kind of sign as the people of Nineveh had seen when Jonah preached to them long ago. But how had the way that the Nineveh people responded to Jonah been different from the way that the people were now responding to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: The people would see the same kind of sign as the people of Nineveh had seen when Jonah preached to them long ago. But how had the way that the Nineveh people responded to Jonah been different from the way that the people were now responding to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu wangeona ishara ileile ambayo watu wa Ninawi walikuwa wameona Yona alipohubiri kwao muda mrefu uliopita. Lakini ni jinsi gani watu wa Ninawi walivyoitikia Yona kwa njia tofauti na jinsi watu walivyokuwa wakimwitikia Yesu sasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~32#Question:The people would see the same kind of sign as the people of Nineveh had seen when Jonah preached to them long ago. But how had the way that the Nineveh people responded to Jonah been different from the way that the people were now responding to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~32#Answer:The people would see the same kind of sign as the people of Nineveh had seen when Jonah preached to them long ago. But how had the way that the Nineveh people responded to Jonah been different from the way that the people were now responding to Jesus?-2128118508
trans-unit.source: The people of Nineveh had repented when Jonah preached [to them] (32), [but these people had not repented when Jesus preached to them].
trans-unit.target: Watu wa Ninawi walikuwa wametubu Yona alipowahubiria (32), [lakini watu hawa hawakuwa wametubu Yesu alipowahubiria].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~32#Answer:The people would see the same kind of sign as the people of Nineveh had seen when Jonah preached to them long ago. But how had the way that the Nineveh people responded to Jonah been different from the way that the people were now responding to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!11~33#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 11:33-36 When a person recognizes that Jesus's words and work were from God, it is like a lamp sending light into all parts of that person's life.
trans-unit.target: Luka 11:33-36 Mtu atambuapo kwamba maneno na kazi ya Yesu zilitoka kwa Mungu, hiyo ni kama taa inayotoa nuru katika sehemu zote za maisha ya mtu huyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 11.33-36+What did Jesus try to teach the people by using this story about a lamp and its light and people's eyes?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~33#Question:What did Jesus try to teach the people by using this story about a lamp and its light and people's eyes?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus try to teach the people by using this story about a lamp and its light and people's eyes?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijaribu kuwafundisha watu somo gani kwa kutumia mfano wa taa na nuru yake na macho ya watu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Question:What did Jesus try to teach the people by using this story about a lamp and its light and people's eyes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~33#Answer:What did Jesus try to teach the people by using this story about a lamp and its light and people's eyes?-998512826
trans-unit.source: The purpose of a lamp is to help people to see clearly when it is dark. God put Jesus on the earth to make the truths about [the kingdom of] God clear to those who believe the signs that God had sent him. Those clear truths will affect all areas of those believers' lives. The people who don't believe that about Jesus will not have a clear understanding even of the small amount of truth that they think they have.
trans-unit.target: Kusudi la taa ni kuwasaidia watu kuona wazi wakati wa giza. Mungu alimweka Yesu duniani ili kuwafanya ukweli kuhusu [ufalme wa] Mungu kuwa wazi kwa wale wanaoamini ishara ambazo Mungu alimtuma. Kweli hizo zilizo wazi zitaathiri maeneo yote ya maisha ya waumini hao. Watu ambao hawaamini kwamba kuhusu Yesu hawatakuwa na uelewa wazi hata wa ukweli mdogo ambao wanafikiri wana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Answer:What did Jesus try to teach the people by using this story about a lamp and its light and people's eyes?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.36+What do you think those people should have realized right then in order that their whole lives would have God's truth in them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~36#Question:What do you think those people should have realized right then in order that their whole lives would have God's truth in them?
trans-unit.source: What do you think those people should have realized right then in order that their whole lives would have God's truth in them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu hao walipaswa kutambua nini wakati huo ili kweli ya Mungu iwe katika maisha yao yote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~36#Question:What do you think those people should have realized right then in order that their whole lives would have God's truth in them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~36#Answer:What do you think those people should have realized right then in order that their whole lives would have God's truth in them?886618895
trans-unit.source: They should have realized that Jesus's words and work were showing God's truths to them. Only in believing and accepting that in their lives would they have clear understanding and direction in all that they thought and did.
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kutambua kwamba maneno na kazi ya Yesu yalikuwa yanawaonyesha kweli za Mungu. Ni kwa kuamini na kukubali tu kwamba katika maisha yao wangepata ufahamu na mwongozo ulio wazi katika yote waliyofikiri na kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~36#Answer:What do you think those people should have realized right then in order that their whole lives would have God's truth in them?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.33+Why do people light lamps?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~33#Question:Why do people light lamps?
trans-unit.source: Why do people light lamps?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu huwasha taa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Question:Why do people light lamps?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~33#Answer:Why do people light lamps?61509443
trans-unit.source: People light lamps to give light so people can see when it is too dark otherwise. (33)
trans-unit.target: Watu huwasha taa ili kutoa nuru ili watu waweze kuona wakati ambapo ni giza sana. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Answer:Why do people light lamps?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.33+What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~33#Question:What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?
trans-unit.source: What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini baada ya kuwasha taa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Question:What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~33#Answer:What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?1658209887
trans-unit.source: He puts/places it where it can be useful, such as on a lamp holder. He does not hide it under anything. (33)
trans-unit.target: Anaiweka mahali ambapo inaweza kuwa na faida, kama vile kwenye kinara cha taa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~33#Answer:What does a person do with a lamp after he lights it?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.34+What part of our bodies did Jesus say is like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~34#Question:What part of our bodies did Jesus say is like a lamp?
trans-unit.source: What part of our bodies did Jesus say is like a lamp?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni sehemu gani ya mwili wetu iliyo kama taa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Question:What part of our bodies did Jesus say is like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~34#Answer:What part of our bodies did Jesus say is like a lamp?-1882967872
trans-unit.source: He said that our eyes work as a lamp for our bodies. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba macho yetu hufanya kazi kama taa ya miili yetu. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Answer:What part of our bodies did Jesus say is like a lamp?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.34+What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~34#Question:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini njia ambayo jicho la mtu hufanya kazi kama taa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Question:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?-629097309
trans-unit.source: Good eyes let in lots of light, so the person sees well.
trans-unit.target: Macho mazuri huingiza nuru nyingi, kwa hiyo mtu huona vizuri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?-1645454920
trans-unit.source: But when eyes are bad, the person sees nothing/only darkness. (34)
trans-unit.target: Lakini macho yanapoharibika, mtu haoni chochote/ giza tu. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?-1144089552
trans-unit.source: -AND/OR-
trans-unit.target: - NA/AU-
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?434761421
trans-unit.source: Good eyes let in light and the whole body functions well.
trans-unit.target: Macho mazuri huingiza nuru na mwili wote hufanya kazi vizuri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?-2119397246
trans-unit.source: When the eyes are bad, the whole body does not function well. (34)
trans-unit.target: Macho yanapoharibika, mwili wote haufanyi kazi vizuri. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Answer:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~34#Note:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?918748861
trans-unit.source: The Greek words which Luke used for "good" and "bad" have two ways to be understood. One way is to understand them as evaluating physical things, like real eyes. The other way is to understand them as evaluating what God said about who Jesus was and how he wants us to live. Because this cannot all be included, generally, in the translated text, small footnotes or a glossary item may be needed to make both aspects of the meaning clear. The people who were listening to Jesus understood what he meant.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya Kigiriki ambayo Luka alitumia kwa "mema" na "mabaya" yana njia mbili za kueleweka. Njia moja ni kuyaelewa kama kuyatathmini mambo ya kimwili, kama macho halisi. Njia nyingine ni kuyaelewa kama kuyatathmini yale ambayo Mungu alisema juu ya Yesu alikuwa nani na jinsi anavyotaka tuishi. Kwa sababu haya yote hayawezi kuingizwa, kwa ujumla, katika maandishi yaliyotafsiriwa, maelezo madogo ya chini au kipengee cha msamiati kinaweza kuhitajika ili kufanya pande zote mbili za maana ziwe wazi. Watu waliokuwa wakimsikiliza Yesu walielewa alichomaanisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Note:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~34#Note:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?-797524572
trans-unit.source: Also see "darkness" described above at 1:79.
trans-unit.target: Ona pia "giza" linalotajwa hapo juu kwenye 1:79.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~34#Note:What did Jesus say was the way that a person's eyes work like a lamp?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.35-36+What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~35#Question:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?
trans-unit.source: What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka watu waelewe jambo gani lililofichwa katika mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~35#Question:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~35#Answer:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?484258494
trans-unit.source: Those people thought that they already had a clear understanding about God, but it really was not clear.
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walifikiri kwamba tayari walikuwa na uelewevu ulio wazi juu ya Mungu, lakini kwa kweli haukuwa wazi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~35#Answer:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~35#Answer:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?-2100081974
trans-unit.source: Actually, since they had not believed in Jesus, they real did not know God.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kweli, kwa kuwa hawakuwa wamemwamini Yesu, kwa kweli hawakumjua Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~35#Answer:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~35#Note:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?-347296975
trans-unit.source: Using the figurative language of Jesus about light and darkness, we could say that because they did not have the light of Jesus in them, their lives were still in darkness.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kutumia lugha ya ufananisho ya Yesu kuhusu nuru na giza, tungeweza kusema kwamba kwa sababu hawakuwa na nuru ya Yesu ndani yao, maisha yao yalikuwa bado gizani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~35#Note:What hidden meaning, do you think, did Jesus want the people to understand from this?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!11~37#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 11:37-54 Jesus warned the religious leaders that God would punish their hypocrisy.
trans-unit.target: Luka 11:37-54 Yesu aliwaonya viongozi wa kidini kwamba Mungu angewaadhibu kwa sababu ya unafiki wao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 11.37-54+The Pharisees pretended to please God, but they were really only pleasing themselves. What should the Pharisees have expected to happen to them because of what they were doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~37#Question:The Pharisees pretended to please God, but they were really only pleasing themselves. What should the Pharisees have expected to happen to them because of what they were doing?
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees pretended to please God, but they were really only pleasing themselves. What should the Pharisees have expected to happen to them because of what they were doing?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walijifanya kuwa wanampendeza Mungu, lakini kwa kweli walikuwa wakijipendeza wenyewe tu. Mafarisayo walipaswa kutarajia nini kuwapata kwa sababu ya yale waliyokuwa wakifanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Question:The Pharisees pretended to please God, but they were really only pleasing themselves. What should the Pharisees have expected to happen to them because of what they were doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~37#Answer:The Pharisees pretended to please God, but they were really only pleasing themselves. What should the Pharisees have expected to happen to them because of what they were doing?1843807858
trans-unit.source: They should expect [that God would punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them. (42, 43, 44, 46, 47, 50-51, 52)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kutarajia [kwamba Mungu angewaadhibu kwa kusababisha] mambo mabaya yawatendeke.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Answer:The Pharisees pretended to please God, but they were really only pleasing themselves. What should the Pharisees have expected to happen to them because of what they were doing?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.37-54+What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~37#Question:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?
trans-unit.source: What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini zilikuwa sababu za wataalamu wa Sheria kutarajia Mungu asababishe mambo yenye kuogofya yawapate wao pia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Question:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~37#Answer:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?1981055473
trans-unit.source: They made so many rules for the people, it was almost impossible to obey them all. The experts never helped/made it easier for the people to obey them, not even a little bit. (46)
trans-unit.target: Waliweka sheria nyingi sana kwa watu, ilikuwa karibu haiwezekani kuzifuata zote. Wataalam hawakuwahi kusaidia/kufanya iwe rahisi kwa watu kuzifuata, hata kidogo. (46)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Answer:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~37#Answer:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?637574921
trans-unit.source: They built tombs/special burial places for the prophets their own forefathers/ancestors had killed, and in that way showed that they approved of what their forefathers had done. Those experts in the Law were not honoring/obeying the prophets God sent them, [meaning John the Baptizer and Jesus,] any more than their forefathers had honored/obeyed God's prophets in their time. (47-51) (Note: It was as if they were honoring their forefathers for having killed the prophets, not that they were honoring the prophets. It was as if the only good prophet was a dead one.)
trans-unit.target: Walijenga makaburi maalum kwa ajili ya manabii ambao mababu zao/mababu zao wenyewe walikuwa wamewaua, na kwa njia hiyo walionyesha kwamba walikubali kile ambacho mababu zao walikuwa wamefanya. Wataalamu hao wa Sheria hawakuwa wakiwaheshimu/kuwa watiifu kwa manabii ambao Mungu alikuwa amewatuma, [wakimaanisha Yohana Mbatizaji na Yesu,] zaidi ya vile mababu zao walivyowaheshimu/kuwa watiifu kwa manabii wa Mungu katika wakati wao. (47-51) (Kumbuka: Ilikuwa kana kwamba walikuwa wakiwaheshimu mababu zao kwa kuwa waliwaua manabii, sio kwamba walikuwa wakiwaheshimu manabii. Ilikuwa kana kwamba nabii pekee mzuri alikuwa amekufa.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Answer:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~37#Answer:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?1521832083
trans-unit.source: They had not shared with the people how to really know [God or God's plan for the Messiah to save them nor how to understand the Scriptures which pointed to the Messiah]. This kept those who [wanted to] enter [the kingdom of God/a proper relationship with God] from doing so, and even they themselves were not entering. (52)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa wamewajulisha watu jinsi ya kumjua [Mungu au mpango wa Mungu kwa ajili ya Masihi kuwaokoa wala jinsi ya kuelewa Maandiko yaliyoelekeza kwa Masihi]. Hii iliwazuia wale [waliotaka kuingia] [ufalme wa Mungu/uhusiano sahihi na Mungu] wasiingie, na hata wao wenyewe hawakuingia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Answer:What were the reasons that the experts in the Law should expect God to cause horrible things to happen to them also?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.37+What happened when Jesus had finished speaking about those things?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~37#Question:What happened when Jesus had finished speaking about those things?
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus had finished speaking about those things?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipomaliza kusema juu ya mambo hayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Question:What happened when Jesus had finished speaking about those things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~37#Answer:What happened when Jesus had finished speaking about those things?-1085077888
trans-unit.source: A Pharisee invited Jesus to eat with him. (37)
trans-unit.target: Farisayo mmoja alimwalika Yesu kula naye (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~37#Answer:What happened when Jesus had finished speaking about those things?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.38+What did Jesus do that surprised the Pharisee?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~38#Question:What did Jesus do that surprised the Pharisee?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do that surprised the Pharisee?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini kilichomshangaza Farisayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~38#Question:What did Jesus do that surprised the Pharisee?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~38#Answer:What did Jesus do that surprised the Pharisee?-1168398046
trans-unit.source: Jesus did not first [ritually] wash before eating the [midday] meal. (38)
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakuoga kwanza [kwa desturi] kabla ya kula mlo wa [katikati ya mchana]. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~38#Answer:What did Jesus do that surprised the Pharisee?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.39+What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' concern about cleaning things?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~39#Question:What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' concern about cleaning things?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' concern about cleaning things?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu hangaiko la Mafarisayo juu ya usafi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~39#Question:What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' concern about cleaning things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~39#Answer:What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' concern about cleaning things?-330051453
trans-unit.source: They worried about [pleasing God by ritually] cleaning the outsides of [physical] things like plates and cups.
trans-unit.target: Walihangaikia [kumfurahisha Mungu kwa desturi ya] kusafisha sehemu ya nje ya vitu [vya kimwili] kama vile sahani na vikombe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~39#Answer:What did Jesus say about the Pharisees' concern about cleaning things?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.39+What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~39#Question:What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichokuwa ndani ya Mafarisayo hao ambacho hakikumfurahisha Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~39#Question:What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~39#Answer:What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?1220939470
trans-unit.source: They were very greedy and very wicked. (39)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wenye pupa sana na waovu sana. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~39#Answer:What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~39#Note:What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?-150066119
trans-unit.source: Jesus explained in Mark 7:15-23 about what should be regarded as clean or unclean in God's eyes. Both of the Greek words which name bad things here in verse 39 are also included in Mark's passage in a longer list of bad actions which come out of a person's heart and make him unclean.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alielezea katika Marko 7:15-23 kuhusu kile kinachopaswa kuonekana kuwa safi au najisi machoni pa Mungu. Maneno yote mawili ya Kigiriki ambayo yanataja mambo mabaya hapa katika mstari wa 39 pia yanajumuishwa katika kifungu cha Marko katika orodha ndefu ya matendo mabaya ambayo hutoka moyoni mwa mtu na kumfanya kuwa najisi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~39#Note:What did Jesus say was inside those Pharisees that did not please God?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.40+Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~40#Question:Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?
trans-unit.source: Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu aliumba sehemu zote za mtu, unafikiri Mungu anataka mtu huyo ahangaikie sehemu gani hasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~40#Question:Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~40#Answer:Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?215992918
trans-unit.source: Probably he wants people to be concerned about all parts, but especially the inside, [because that is where bad actions start].
trans-unit.target: Labda anataka watu wahangaikie sehemu zote, lakini hasa ndani, [kwa sababu hapo ndipo matendo mabaya huanzia].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~40#Answer:Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~40#Note:Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?-842934335
trans-unit.source: The person who answers this question will probably name the specific part of the body which he regards as the place of emotions, thoughts or belief. That is a good answer. The translation should not be so general that hearers will think that Jesus contrasted the physical outside with the physical organs inside the abdomen.
trans-unit.target: Mtu anayejibu swali hili labda atataja sehemu maalum ya mwili ambayo yeye anaona kama mahali pa hisia, mawazo au imani. Hiyo ni jibu nzuri. Tafsiri haipaswi kuwa ya jumla sana kwamba wasikilizaji watafikiri kwamba Yesu alitofautisha nje ya mwili na viungo vya mwili ndani ya tumbo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~40#Note:Since God made all parts of a person, which parts, do you think, does God want that person to be most concerned about?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.42-44+How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~42#Question:How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?
trans-unit.source: How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Mafarisayo walikuwa kama makaburi yasiyo na alama jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Question:How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~42#Answer:How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?-672240076
trans-unit.source: [They appeared to obey God, but they were hiding their bad attitudes and actions. In a spiritual sense] they were like dead bodies rotting inside graves of which people were not aware. The people around the Pharisees did not know that they were like that [in their hearts].
trans-unit.target: [Walionekana kuwa watiifu kwa Mungu, lakini walikuwa wakificha mitazamo na matendo yao mabaya. Katika maana ya kiroho] walikuwa kama maiti zinazooza ndani ya makaburi ambayo watu hawakujua. Watu waliozunguka Mafarisayo hawakujua kwamba walikuwa kama hao [katika mioyo yao].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Answer:How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~42#Note:How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?709747383
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees were contaminating those people by teaching them to follow the Pharisees' own bad example. See Num. 19:16 to read how a person became contaminated by stepping on a grave. (44)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walikuwa wakiwatia unajisi watu hao kwa kuwafundisha kufuata mfano mbaya wa Mafarisayo wenyewe. Ona Hesabu 19:16 ili kusoma jinsi mtu alivyokuwa mchafu kwa kukanyaga kaburi. (44)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Note:How, do you think, were the Pharisees like unmarked graves?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.42-44+What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!11~42#Question:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?
trans-unit.source: What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walikuwa na sababu gani za kutarajia [kwamba Mungu angewaadhibu kwa kusababisha] mambo yenye kuogofya yawapate?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Question:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!11~42#Alternate:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?2124631324
trans-unit.source: What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect that God will punish them by causing horrible things to happen to them?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walipaswa kutarajia Mungu awaadhibu kwa kusababisha mambo mabaya yawatendeke kwa sababu zipi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Alternate:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!11~42#Alternate:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?1902707759
trans-unit.source: What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect horrible things to happen to them?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walikuwa na sababu zipi za kutazamia mambo mabaya yawatendeke?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Alternate:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~42#Answer:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?1401280212
trans-unit.source: They were careful to give God one-tenth of every kind of little plant in their gardens, but they did not care at all about judging [others] fairly or loving God. (42a)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa waangalifu kumpa Mungu sehemu ya kumi ya kila aina ya mimea midogo katika bustani zao, lakini hawakujali hata kidogo kuhukumu [wengine] kwa haki au kumpenda Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Answer:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~42#Answer:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?-1231906452
trans-unit.source: They loved to have [people] honor them when they were in public places, like the synagogue and marketplace. (43)
trans-unit.target: Walipenda [watu] wawaheshimu walipokuwa katika mahali pa umma, kama vile katika masinagogi na sokoni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Answer:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~42#Answer:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?1781218232
trans-unit.source: People [who thought that the Pharisees were good examples to follow in order to obey God] did not realize how bad/evil the Pharisees were on the inside, (that is, in their attitudes and actions). [In a spiritual sense] the Pharisees were dead and rotting. [That caused all the people who followed the Pharisees to become contaminated/unclean in God's eyes just as the Pharisees were.] (44)
trans-unit.target: Watu [waliodhani kwamba Mafarisayo walikuwa mifano mizuri ya kufuata ili kumtii Mungu] hawakufahamu jinsi Mafarisayo walivyokuwa wabaya/waovu ndani, (yaani, katika mitazamo na matendo yao). [Kwa maana ya kiroho] Mafarisayo walikuwa wamekufa na kuoza. [Hilo lilifanya watu wote waliowafuata Mafarisayo kuwa wachafu/wachafu machoni pa Mungu kama Mafarisayo walivyokuwa.] (44)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Answer:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~42#Note:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?1513789157
trans-unit.source: See 10:25-28 where these two things are agreed upon as being the two most important things God wants in a person's life.
trans-unit.target: Angalia 10:25-28 ambapo mambo haya mawili yamekubaliwa kuwa ni mambo mawili muhimu zaidi ambayo Mungu anataka katika maisha ya mtu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~42#Note:What were the reasons that the Pharisees should expect [that God will punish them by causing] horrible things to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!11~45#Note:How did one man respond to that powerful/strong talk of Jesus?-847758452
trans-unit.source: Those teachers said that they knew the most about what Moses wrote that God wanted in a person's life. The Pharisees made their own rules to help them live according to what these experts had said.
trans-unit.target: Walimu hao walisema kwamba walijua zaidi kuhusu yale ambayo Musa aliandika kwamba Mungu alitaka katika maisha ya mtu. Mafarisayo walifanya sheria zao wenyewe kuwasaidia kuishi kulingana na yale ambayo wataalamu hawa walisema.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~45#Note:How did one man respond to that powerful/strong talk of Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.50-51+Whom will God hold responsible for the prophets who had been killed by the Jews?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.52+Jesus used a word picture about a key. To what do you think Jesus referred when he spoke of "the key of knowledge"?

trans-unit.source: Jesus used a word picture about a key. To what do you think Jesus referred when he spoke of "the key of knowledge"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia mfano wa ufunguo. Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu "ufunguo wa ujuzi"?

trans-unit.source: He referred to a correct understanding of their [Old Testament] scriptures, which would show the people that Jesus was the Messiah whom God had promised to send to them.
trans-unit.target: Yeye alirejezea uelewevu sahihi wa maandiko yao [ya Agano la Kale], ambayo yangeonyesha watu kwamba Yesu alikuwa ndiye Mesiya ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi kuwatuma kwao.

trans-unit.source: They would also see that they could then enter into a direct relationship with God, accepting his ruling and reigning over them [in the kingdom of God].
trans-unit.target: Pia wangeona kwamba wangeweza kuingia katika uhusiano wa moja kwa moja na Mungu, wakikubali utawala wake na kutawala juu yao [katika ufalme wa Mungu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~52#Answer:Jesus used a word picture about a key. To what do you think Jesus referred when he spoke of "the key of knowledge"?

group.id: Q:LUK 11.53-54+What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?

trans-unit.source: What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya Yesu kumaliza kusema na kuondoka mahali hapo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~53#Question:What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~53#Answer:What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?1266822097
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law/scribes began to oppose Jesus fiercely/to be hostile towards him. (53a)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria/waandishi walianza kumpinga Yesu kwa ukali/kuwa na uadui kwake. (53a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~53#Answer:What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!11~53#Answer:What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?-894380091
trans-unit.source: They raised a lot of questions/They mentioned many topics, just waiting until he said something [which they considered wrong. Then the Jewish leaders could punish him] (53-54).
trans-unit.target: Waliuliza maswali mengi/Walisema mambo mengi, wakisubiri tu hadi aseme jambo fulani [ambao waliliona kuwa kosa. Ndipo viongozi wa Kiyahudi wangeweza kumwadhibu] (53-54).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!11~53#Answer:What happened after Jesus finished talking and left that place?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.1+Tell me about yeast.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~1#Question:Tell me about yeast.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about yeast.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu chachu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~1#Question:Tell me about yeast.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~1#Answer:Tell me about yeast.-924201815
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: If yeast is mixed with water and honey or sugar it grows and ferments, causing air bubbles. If a person makes dough by adding flour to that mixture, the yeast will make that dough swell and increase in size.
trans-unit.target: Uchunguzi wa neno muhimu: Ikiwa chachu imechanganywa na maji na asali au sukari inakua na kuyeyuka, na kusababisha Bubbles za hewa. Ikiwa mtu hufanya unga kwa kuongeza unga kwenye mchanganyiko huo, chachu itafanya unga huo uvimbe na kuongezeka kwa ukubwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~1#Answer:Tell me about yeast.

group.id: Q:LUK 12.1+What is hypocrisy?/What does a person do who is a hypocrite?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~1#Question:What is hypocrisy?/What does a person do who is a hypocrite?
trans-unit.source: What is hypocrisy?/What does a person do who is a hypocrite?
trans-unit.target: Unafiki ni nini?/Mnafiki hufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~1#Question:What is hypocrisy?/What does a person do who is a hypocrite?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~1#Answer:What is hypocrisy?/What does a person do who is a hypocrite?-115689908
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A hypocritical person pretends to believe or do that which other people will approve or that for which other people praise him. He does not do it because he really believes that what he does is right or good.
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Mtu mnafiki hujifanya anaamini au kufanya mambo ambayo watu wengine watakubali au ambayo watu wengine wanamsifu. Yeye hafanyi hivyo kwa sababu anaamini kweli kwamba kile anachofanya ni sawa au kizuri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~1#Answer:What is hypocrisy?/What does a person do who is a hypocrite?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to the things the Pharisees or others had covered up or hidden?

trans-unit.target: Siri zao zingefichuliwa/kufunuliwa na kujulikana [kwa wengine]. // [Mungu] angezifichua/kuzifunua, na kufanya [iwezekane kwa watu wengine] kujua juu yao. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~2#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to the things the Pharisees or others had covered up or hidden?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.3+How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~3#Question:How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alielezaje jambo hilo zaidi kwa wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~3#Question:How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~3#Answer:How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?-1215358740
trans-unit.source: What they had said in some dark [place or time] would be heard out in the daylight, [that is, out in the open for all to hear]. (3)
trans-unit.target: Waliyosema gizani [mahali au wakati] watayasikia katika nuru ya mchana, [yaani, nje kwa wote kusikia]. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~3#Answer:How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~3#Answer:How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?902126413
trans-unit.source: What they had whispered into [someone's] ear inside a room would be proclaimed/spoken loudly from the rooftops/housetops. (3)
trans-unit.target: Mambo waliyosema kwa sauti ya chini katika sikio la mtu fulani ndani ya chumba fulani yangetangazwa kwa sauti kubwa kutoka kwenye paa za nyumba. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~3#Answer:How did Jesus explain this further to his disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.4+What did Jesus say was the reason that the disciples were not to fear other men?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~4#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that the disciples were not to fear other men?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the reason that the disciples were not to fear other men?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni kwa sababu gani wanafunzi hawakupaswa kuwaogopa wanadamu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~4#Question:What did Jesus say was the reason that the disciples were not to fear other men?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~4#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that the disciples were not to fear other men?1626791006
trans-unit.source: People could only kill their bodies, but then could do nothing more [to hurt them]. (4)
trans-unit.target: Watu wangeweza tu kuua miili yao, lakini basi hawangeweza kufanya lolote zaidi [ili kuwaumiza]. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~4#Answer:What did Jesus say was the reason that the disciples were not to fear other men?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.5+Whom should the disciples fear?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~5#Question:Whom should the disciples fear?
trans-unit.source: Whom should the disciples fear?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wanapaswa kumwogopa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~5#Question:Whom should the disciples fear?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~5#Answer:Whom should the disciples fear?-1822579753
trans-unit.source: They should fear him who could kill their bodies and who also has authority to throw them into hell. (5)
trans-unit.target: Na wamwogope Yeye awezaye kuua na ambaye pia ana mamlaka ya kumtupa katika Gehena. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~5#Answer:Whom should the disciples fear?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.4-7+What kind of a place is hell?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~4#Question:What kind of a place is hell?
trans-unit.source: What kind of a place is hell?
trans-unit.target: Kuzimu ni mahali pa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~4#Question:What kind of a place is hell?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~4#Answer:What kind of a place is hell?291712890
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Hell is a place of punishment for all people who disobey God. It is pictured as a place where fire always burns and it is separated from where God lives. (See "hell" in KBT in the "hell, Hades, abyss" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Neno muhimu: Kuzimu ni mahali pa adhabu kwa watu wote ambao hawamtii Mungu. Inaonyeshwa kama mahali ambapo moto huwaka kila wakati na imejitenga na mahali ambapo Mungu anaishi. (Tazama "kuzimu" katika KBT katika "kuzimu, Hades, abyss" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~4#Answer:What kind of a place is hell?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.4-7+Who do you think the person is whom they should fear?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~4#Question:Who do you think the person is whom they should fear?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think the person is whom they should fear?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani wanaopaswa kumwogopa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~4#Question:Who do you think the person is whom they should fear?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~4#Answer:Who do you think the person is whom they should fear?-231036930
trans-unit.source: He is God. Only God has that power and authority.
trans-unit.target: Yeye ni Mungu, na ni Mungu peke yake aliye na nguvu na mamlaka hayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~4#Answer:Who do you think the person is whom they should fear?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.6-7+What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~6#Question:What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?
trans-unit.source: What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwasimulia wanafunzi wake mifano gani miwili ili kuonyesha kwamba Mungu anawajali?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~6#Question:What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~6#Answer:What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?86566885
trans-unit.source: God does not forget about each [little] sparrow which, when it is sold, it is worth only a very, very small amount of money. (6)
trans-unit.target: Mwenyezi Mungu hamsahau hata mmoja wa hao ndege, na wanapo kuuzwa wanakuwa na thamani ndogo mno.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~6#Answer:What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~6#Answer:What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?-69367781
trans-unit.source: God even knows each and every hair on a person's head. (7)
trans-unit.target: Mungu hata anajua kila nywele moja kwenye kichwa cha mtu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~6#Answer:What two examples did Jesus tell the disciples in order to show that God cared for them?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.8+What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?

trans-unit.source: What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?
trans-unit.target: Yesu, Mwana wa Adamu, atafanya nini wakati mtu anapoamini/kuambia watu waziwazi kwamba anaamini Yesu ni mwokozi?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~8#Alternate:What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?-707120943
trans-unit.source: What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges that he believes that Jesus is the savior?
trans-unit.target: Yesu, Mwana wa Adamu, atafanya nini mtu atakapokiri kwamba amemwamini Yesu kuwa mwokozi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~8#Alternate:What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~8#Alternate:What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?-2082232130
trans-unit.source: What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?
trans-unit.target: Yesu, Mwana wa Adamu, atafanya nini wakati mtu anapowaambia watu waziwazi kwamba anaamini Yesu ndiye mwokozi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~8#Alternate:What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~8#Answer:What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?1442798044
trans-unit.source: Jesus will acknowledge/openly say before God's angels [that that person belongs to him]. (8)
trans-unit.target: Yesu atakubali/atasema waziwazi mbele ya malaika wa Mungu [kwamba mtu huyo ni wake]. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~8#Answer:What will Jesus, the Son of Man, do when a person acknowledges/openly says to people that he believes that Jesus is the savior?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.9+What will Jesus do when a person denies to people that he has any association with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~9#Question:What will Jesus do when a person denies to people that he has any association with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What will Jesus do when a person denies to people that he has any association with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Yesu atafanya nini mtu anapokataa mbele ya watu kwamba ana uhusiano wowote na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~9#Question:What will Jesus do when a person denies to people that he has any association with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~9#Answer:What will Jesus do when a person denies to people that he has any association with Jesus?2084966055
trans-unit.source: Jesus will disown/deny him before God's angels [that that person belongs to him]. (9)
trans-unit.target: Yesu atamkana mbele ya malaika wa Mungu [kwamba mtu huyo ni wake]. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~9#Answer:What will Jesus do when a person denies to people that he has any association with Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.10+Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~10#Question:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba kuna dhambi nzito ambayo ingeweza kusamehewa na nyingine ambayo isingeweza kusamehewa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~10#Question:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~10#Answer:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?-1723016398
trans-unit.source: Everyone who says something disrespectful/evil/bad about the Son of Man, Jesus, can be forgiven [by God],
trans-unit.target: Yeyote asemaye neno lisilo la heshima/ubaya/baya juu ya Mwana wa Adamu, Yesu, anaweza kusamehewa [na Mungu],
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~10#Answer:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~10#Answer:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?-1681145423
trans-unit.source: but a person who blasphemes the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven [by God]. (10)
trans-unit.target: lakini mtu atakayekufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~10#Answer:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?575656063
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See the comments on "blaspheme" at 5:21.
trans-unit.target: Angalia maneno muhimu: Ona maelezo juu ya "kufuru" kwenye 5:21.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~10#Answer:Jesus said that there was a serious sin which could be forgiven and one which could not be forgiven. What were those two sins?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.12+Why should the disciples not worry about what they would say when they needed to defend themselves before people in the synagogue or in the government?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~12#Question:Why should the disciples not worry about what they would say when they needed to defend themselves before people in the synagogue or in the government?
trans-unit.source: Why should the disciples not worry about what they would say when they needed to defend themselves before people in the synagogue or in the government?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi hawapaswi kuhangaikia watavyosema wanapohitaji kujitetea mbele ya watu katika sinagogi au mbele ya serikali?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~12#Question:Why should the disciples not worry about what they would say when they needed to defend themselves before people in the synagogue or in the government?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~12#Answer:Why should the disciples not worry about what they would say when they needed to defend themselves before people in the synagogue or in the government?-306715030
trans-unit.source: The Holy Spirit would teach them at that time what they should say. (12)
trans-unit.target: Kwa maana Roho Mtakatifu atawafundisha saa ile ile yawapasayo kusema.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~12#Answer:Why should the disciples not worry about what they would say when they needed to defend themselves before people in the synagogue or in the government?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 12.13-21+Jesus warned the people who were listening to him to be on their guard against something. What was it?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~13#Question:Jesus warned the people who were listening to him to be on their guard against something. What was it?
trans-unit.source: Jesus warned the people who were listening to him to be on their guard against something. What was it?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya wasikilizaji wake wajihadhari na jambo gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Question:Jesus warned the people who were listening to him to be on their guard against something. What was it?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Jesus warned the people who were listening to him to be on their guard against something. What was it?693348224
trans-unit.source: They must protect themselves from all the ways of being greedy, that is, desiring to possess more and more money and things. They should not become like that. (15)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima wajihadhari na njia zote za kuwa wenye pupa, yaani, kutamani kuwa na fedha na vitu zaidi na zaidi. Hawapaswi kuwa kama hao. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Jesus warned the people who were listening to him to be on their guard against something. What was it?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.13-21+Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~13#Question:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.
trans-unit.source: Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.
trans-unit.target: Niambie mfano ambao Yesu alitoa kuhusu mtu mwenye pupa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Question:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.1150001523
trans-unit.source: A rich man's land produced a good crop of grain/wheat.
trans-unit.target: Shamba la mtu mmoja tajiri lilizaa nafaka/ngano nyingi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.491288810
trans-unit.source: He wanted to keep all of it, but his storage buildings were too small.
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kuhifadhi pesa zote, lakini maghala yake yalikuwa madogo sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.823090775
trans-unit.source: He decided to take down the old buildings and put up larger ones.
trans-unit.target: Aliamua kubomoa majengo ya zamani na kujenga mengine makubwa zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.-1196625549
trans-unit.source: He boasted to himself that his many good things would take care of him for many years.
trans-unit.target: Alijivunia kwamba vitu vyake vingi vizuri vingemtunza kwa miaka mingi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.1474241180
trans-unit.source: Therefore, now he could have feasts and enjoy himself and not worry about working hard any more.
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, sasa angeweza kuwa na karamu na kujifurahisha mwenyewe na asihangaike juu ya kufanya kazi ngumu tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.538092754
trans-unit.source: But God said that man was foolish to think only about himself and his future when he did not know that he was about to die that night.
trans-unit.target: Lakini Mungu alisema kwamba mtu huyo alikuwa mpumbavu kufikiria tu juu yake mwenyewe na wakati wake ujao wakati hakujua kwamba alikuwa karibu kufa usiku huo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.-975338103
trans-unit.source: Others would use all those things he had saved for himself. (16-20)
trans-unit.target: Wengine wangetumia vitu vyote ambavyo alikuwa amejiwekea akiba (16-20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:Tell me the parable that Jesus told about a greedy man.

group.id: Q:LUK 12.13-21+What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~13#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kingetokea kwa yeyote aliye mwenye ubinafsi na mwenye pupa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?1767106841
trans-unit.source: God will judge those people who are selfish, holding on to the things they possess [and do not share them].
trans-unit.target: Mungu atawahukumu watu hao wenye ubinafsi, wanaoshikilia vitu walivyo navyo [na wasivyoshiriki].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?-966450746
trans-unit.source: He may make them die to show how foolish all their selfish work was. [Anyone who thinks only of his many possessions and does not think how to please God, will perish/will not have eternal life.] (21)
trans-unit.target: Anaweza kuwafanya wafe ili kuonyesha jinsi kazi yao yote ya ubinafsi ilivyokuwa ya kipumbavu. [Yeyote anayefikiria tu mali zake nyingi na hafikirii jinsi ya kumpendeza Mungu, atapotea/hatakuwa na uzima wa milele.] (21)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to anyone who is selfish and greedy?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.13-21+What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~13#Question:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?
