trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Question:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~13#Alternate:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?1279964324
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy with the things he has?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mtu apaswa kufanya nini badala ya kuwa mwenye pupa kwa vitu alivyo navyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Alternate:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~13#Alternate:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?157714876
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being selfish with the things he has?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mtu apaswa kufanya nini badala ya kuwa mwenye ubinafsi kwa vitu alivyo navyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Alternate:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?1381812042
trans-unit.source: Instead of trying to become rich with the things that make him happy,
trans-unit.target: Badala ya kujaribu kuwa tajiri kwa vitu vinavyomfanya awe na furaha,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?1671088868
trans-unit.source: a person should greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God. (21)
trans-unit.target: mtu anapaswa kufurahia kutumia pesa na uwezo wake kufanya yale yanayompendeza Mungu. (21)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:What did Jesus say a person should do instead of being greedy/selfish with the things he has?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.21+What do you think are ways that a person could greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~21#Question:What do you think are ways that a person could greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God?
trans-unit.source: What do you think are ways that a person could greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni katika njia gani mtu anaweza kufurahia kutumia pesa na uwezo wake kufanya mambo yanayompendeza Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~21#Question:What do you think are ways that a person could greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~21#Answer:What do you think are ways that a person could greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God?113678610
trans-unit.source: He should first obey God and then use his material wealth in Christian love and compassion. He should try to relieve the needs of others in his family, in the family of believers, and among others. He should do it for God's glory, not his own.
trans-unit.target: Anapaswa kwanza kumtii Mungu na kisha atumie utajiri wake wa kimwili katika upendo wa Kikristo na huruma. Anapaswa kujaribu kupunguza mahitaji ya wengine katika familia yake, katika familia ya waamini, na miongoni mwa wengine. Anapaswa kufanya hivyo kwa utukufu wa Mungu, si wake mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~21#Answer:What do you think are ways that a person could greatly enjoy using his money and abilities to do what pleases God?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.13+What did one person in the crowd want Jesus to do for him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~13#Question:What did one person in the crowd want Jesus to do for him?
trans-unit.source: What did one person in the crowd want Jesus to do for him?
trans-unit.target: Mtu mmoja katika umati alitaka Yesu amfanyie nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Question:What did one person in the crowd want Jesus to do for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~13#Answer:What did one person in the crowd want Jesus to do for him?555899947
trans-unit.source: He wanted Jesus to tell his (the man's) brother to divide [properly/fairly] what they had inherited [from their father]. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka Yesu amwambie ndugu yake (mtu huyo) aamue [kwa haki] kile walichorithi [kutoka kwa baba yao]. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~13#Answer:What did one person in the crowd want Jesus to do for him?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.14+How did Jesus respond to this man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~14#Question:How did Jesus respond to this man?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus respond to this man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimjibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~14#Question:How did Jesus respond to this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~14#Answer:How did Jesus respond to this man?-391828324
trans-unit.source: He said that [no one] had appointed him to judge how those brothers were to divide what they had inherited [from their father]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba [hakuna] mtu aliyemweka rasmi kuhukumu jinsi ndugu hao walivyopaswa kugawanya urithi [wa baba yao]. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~14#Answer:How did Jesus respond to this man?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.15+What did Jesus say about how a person should think about the things he possesses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~15#Question:What did Jesus say about how a person should think about the things he possesses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about how a person should think about the things he possesses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu jinsi mtu apaswavyo kufikiri juu ya vitu alivyo navyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~15#Question:What did Jesus say about how a person should think about the things he possesses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~15#Answer:What did Jesus say about how a person should think about the things he possesses?-922645730
trans-unit.source: He said that possessing many things will not make a person's life better/happier nor will it make him live longer. // Having a good life is not based on how many things a person possesses. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kuwa kuwa na vitu vingi hakutakufanya maisha ya mtu kuwa bora/ya furaha wala hakutakufanya aishi muda mrefu. // Kuwa na maisha mazuri haitegemei ni vitu vingapi mtu anamiliki. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~15#Answer:What did Jesus say about how a person should think about the things he possesses?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.16+What made the rich man in the parable very happy?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~16#Question:What made the rich man in the parable very happy?
trans-unit.source: What made the rich man in the parable very happy?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomfanya yule tajiri katika mfano huo awe na furaha sana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~16#Question:What made the rich man in the parable very happy?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~16#Answer:What made the rich man in the parable very happy?-1493116665
trans-unit.source: His land had produced a good crop. (16)
trans-unit.target: Nchi yake ilikuwa imezaa mazao mazuri. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~16#Answer:What made the rich man in the parable very happy?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.17+What problem was that man thinking about?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~17#Question:What problem was that man thinking about?
trans-unit.source: What problem was that man thinking about?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alikuwa akifikiria tatizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~17#Question:What problem was that man thinking about?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~17#Answer:What problem was that man thinking about?-896782116
trans-unit.source: He did not have [enough] place to store all the crops. (17)
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa na mahali pa kuhifadhi mazao yake yote. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~17#Answer:What problem was that man thinking about?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.18+What did he decide to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~18#Question:What did he decide to do?
trans-unit.source: What did he decide to do?
trans-unit.target: Aliamua kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~18#Question:What did he decide to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~18#Answer:What did he decide to do?464571287
trans-unit.source: He decided to tear down/take apart his [small/old] buildings and build larger ones in which to store his grain. (18)
trans-unit.target: Aliamua kubomoa/kuvunja majengo yake [madogo/ya zamani] na kujenga makubwa zaidi ili kuhifadhi nafaka yake. (18)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~18#Answer:What did he decide to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.19+How would he then feel about all those things he was saving?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~19#Question:How would he then feel about all those things he was saving?
trans-unit.source: How would he then feel about all those things he was saving?
trans-unit.target: Angehisije kuhusu vitu vyote ambavyo alikuwa akihifadhi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~19#Question:How would he then feel about all those things he was saving?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~19#Answer:How would he then feel about all those things he was saving?1207646668
trans-unit.source: He would feel satisfied. He also felt that he could relax and enjoy life, thinking that those things would take care of him for many years to come. (19)
trans-unit.target: Alihisi kwamba angeridhika na pia alihisi kwamba angeweza kupumzika na kufurahia maisha, akifikiri kwamba vitu hivyo vingemtunza kwa miaka mingi ijayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~19#Answer:How would he then feel about all those things he was saving?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.20+How did God feel about that man's thinking and his actions?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~20#Question:How did God feel about that man's thinking and his actions?
trans-unit.source: How did God feel about that man's thinking and his actions?
trans-unit.target: Mungu alihisije juu ya kufikiri na matendo ya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~20#Question:How did God feel about that man's thinking and his actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~20#Answer:How did God feel about that man's thinking and his actions?2120186064
trans-unit.source: God called him a fool for not realizing he might/would die that same night and never enjoy all the things he had saved for himself. (20)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alimwita mpumbavu kwa kutotambua kwamba anaweza kufa usiku huo huo na kamwe asifurahie vitu vyote alivyokuwa amejiwekea akiba. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~20#Answer:How did God feel about that man's thinking and his actions?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!12~22#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 12:22-34 Do not worry about the things you need.
trans-unit.target: Luka 12:22-34 Usihangaikie mahitaji yako.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 12.22-34+Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~22#Question:Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?
trans-unit.source: Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi wa Yesu hawakupaswa kuhangaikia chakula na mavazi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Question:Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?884542121
trans-unit.source: Being alive has more important aspects than worrying about [having enough] food.
trans-unit.target: Kuwa hai kuna mambo muhimu zaidi kuliko kuhangaikia chakula [cha kutosha].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?-1518166265
trans-unit.source: Their bodies were also more important than what clothes they would wear on them. (23)
trans-unit.target: Miili yao pia ilikuwa muhimu zaidi kuliko mavazi ambayo wangevaa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:Why were Jesus's disciples not to worry about eating to stay alive and covering their bodies with clothing?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.22-34+From all that Jesus had just said about the foolish rich man in verses 16-20, what do you think makes such worrying about one's food and clothes bad?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~22#Question:From all that Jesus had just said about the foolish rich man in verses 16-20, what do you think makes such worrying about one's food and clothes bad?
trans-unit.source: From all that Jesus had just said about the foolish rich man in verses 16-20, what do you think makes such worrying about one's food and clothes bad?
trans-unit.target: Kutokana na yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa ametoka tu kusema kuhusu yule tajiri mpumbavu katika mstari wa 16-20, unafikiri ni nini kinachofanya mahangaiko kama hayo kuhusu chakula na mavazi yawe mabaya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Question:From all that Jesus had just said about the foolish rich man in verses 16-20, what do you think makes such worrying about one's food and clothes bad?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:From all that Jesus had just said about the foolish rich man in verses 16-20, what do you think makes such worrying about one's food and clothes bad?-799774417
trans-unit.source: When a person worries, he thinks about only himself and what he wants, not about God and what he wants for us (28b, 34). It also has no lasting value (26, 33).
trans-unit.target: Mtu anapokuwa na wasiwasi, anajifikiria yeye mwenyewe na kile anachotaka, sio juu ya Mungu na kile anachotaka kwetu (28b, 34). Pia haina thamani ya kudumu (26, 33).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:From all that Jesus had just said about the foolish rich man in verses 16-20, what do you think makes such worrying about one's food and clothes bad?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.22-34+About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~22#Question:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?
trans-unit.source: About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?
trans-unit.target: Mwanafunzi au mfuasi wa Yesu apaswa kufikiria nini na kukazia nini maisha yake badala ya kuhangaikia chakula na mavazi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Question:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?-23543221
trans-unit.source: He should seek ways for God to rule and reign in his life and in the lives of others. Then [God] will provide those things [as the person needs them]. (31)
trans-unit.target: Anapaswa kutafuta njia za Mungu kutawala na kutawala katika maisha yake na katika maisha ya wengine. Kisha [Mungu] atatoa vitu hivyo [kama mtu anavyovihitaji]. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?-1186128734
trans-unit.source: When he allows God to rule in his life, God will provide whatever he needs to live, so he should not worry about those things. (31)
trans-unit.target: Anapomruhusu Mungu kutawala katika maisha yake, Mungu atampa kila kitu anachohitaji ili aishi, kwa hivyo hapaswi kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya vitu hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:About what should a disciple or follower of Jesus be thinking and on what should he focus his life instead of worrying about food and clothing?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.22-34+Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~22#Question:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?
trans-unit.source: Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu tayari amependezwa kutoa baraka zinazohusiana na ufalme wake/utawala wake juu yetu na kutuandalia mahitaji yetu, watu walio katika ufalme wa Mungu wanapaswa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Question:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~22#Alternate:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?1937071992
trans-unit.source: Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu tayari amependezwa kutoa baraka zinazohusiana na ufalme wake, watu walio katika ufalme wa Mungu wapaswa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Alternate:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~22#Alternate:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?-16755720
trans-unit.source: Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu tayari amependezwa kutupa baraka zinazohusiana na utawala wake juu yetu na kutuandalia mahitaji yetu, watu walio katika ufalme wa Mungu wapaswa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Alternate:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~22#Answer:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?-919889659
trans-unit.source: They should think more about using their possessions to help people who are in need, and think less about keeping things safe for themselves. When they help others, it is as though they are putting treasure in heaven to use and enjoy later. Their focus will be on pleasing God, not themselves. (33-34)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kufikiria zaidi juu ya kutumia mali zao kuwasaidia watu wenye uhitaji, na kufikiria kidogo juu ya kuweka vitu salama kwa ajili yao wenyewe. Wakati wanawasaidia wengine, ni kana kwamba wanajiwekea hazina mbinguni ambayo wataitumia na kufurahia baadaye. Watazingatia kumpendeza Mungu, sio wao wenyewe. (33-34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~22#Answer:Since God has been pleased already to give blessings related to his kingdom/his ruling over us and providing for us, what should the people who are in God's kingdom do?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.24+How were the ravens to be an example for Jesus's disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~24#Question:How were the ravens to be an example for Jesus's disciples?
trans-unit.source: How were the ravens to be an example for Jesus's disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kunguru walipaswa kuwa kielelezo kwa wanafunzi wa Yesu katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Question:How were the ravens to be an example for Jesus's disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~24#Answer:How were the ravens to be an example for Jesus's disciples?1427888927
trans-unit.source: They do not sow/plant [seeds] or reap/harvest [what they had sown/planted], and they do not have special places in which to store [extra food so they could use it later]. Even so, God provides food for them. (24a)
trans-unit.target: Hazipandiki wala hazikusanyi wala hazina ghala, lakini Mwenyezi Mungu huwapa riziki.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Answer:How were the ravens to be an example for Jesus's disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.24+Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~24#Question:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu hufanya hivyo kwa ndege, ambao hawajifanyi tayari kwa ajili ya wakati wa ukame/baridi ambapo hakuna chakula kipya kitakikua, hilo lapaswa kuwaonyesha nini wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Question:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~24#Alternate:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?-615240901
trans-unit.source: Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu hufanya hivyo kwa ndege, ambao hawajifanyi tayari kwa ajili ya wakati wa ukame wakati ambapo hakuna chakula kipya kitakikua, hilo lapaswa kuwaonyesha nini wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Alternate:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~24#Alternate:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?-977339721
trans-unit.source: Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu hufanya hivyo kwa ndege, ambao hawajitayarishi kwa ajili ya majira ya baridi kali wakati ambapo hakuna chakula kipya kitakikua, hilo lapaswa kuwaonyesha nini wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Alternate:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~24#Answer:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?24789251
trans-unit.source: It shows that God will provide them with at least all their basic needs. (24b)
trans-unit.target: Inaonyesha kwamba Mungu atawatimizia mahitaji yao yote ya msingi (24b).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Answer:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~24#Answer:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Answer:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~24#Answer:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?-749570515
trans-unit.source: It shows that God will do more for them because they are worth much more [to him] than the birds. (24b)
trans-unit.target: Inaonyesha kwamba Mungu atafanya mengi zaidi kwa ajili yao kwa sababu wao ni wenye thamani zaidi [kwake] kuliko ndege. (24b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~24#Answer:Since God does that for birds, which do not get ready for the dry time/cold time when no new food will grow, what should that show to the disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.25+How much longer did Jesus say that a person can make himself live just by worrying about it?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~25#Question:How much longer did Jesus say that a person can make himself live just by worrying about it?
trans-unit.source: How much longer did Jesus say that a person can make himself live just by worrying about it?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mtu anaweza kujiruzuku kwa muda gani kwa kuhangaika tu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~25#Question:How much longer did Jesus say that a person can make himself live just by worrying about it?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~25#Answer:How much longer did Jesus say that a person can make himself live just by worrying about it?624767639
trans-unit.source: He said that a person cannot make himself live even one hour longer. (25)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mtu hawezi kujifanya aishi hata saa moja zaidi. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~25#Answer:How much longer did Jesus say that a person can make himself live just by worrying about it?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.26+Which part of a person's life can worrying about it help?/How does it help a person to worry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~26#Question:Which part of a person's life can worrying about it help?/How does it help a person to worry?
trans-unit.source: Which part of a person's life can worrying about it help?/How does it help a person to worry?
trans-unit.target: Ni sehemu gani ya maisha ya mtu ambayo inaweza kusaidia kuhangaika juu yake?/Inamsaidiaje mtu kuwa na wasiwasi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~26#Question:Which part of a person's life can worrying about it help?/How does it help a person to worry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~26#Answer:Which part of a person's life can worrying about it help?/How does it help a person to worry?-1864215392
trans-unit.source: No part of a person's life is helped./Worrying does not help in any way. (26)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna sehemu ya maisha ya mtu inayosaidiwa./Kuwa na wasiwasi hakusaidii kwa njia yoyote. (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~26#Answer:Which part of a person's life can worrying about it help?/How does it help a person to worry?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.27+What example did Jesus use next to teach his disciples not to worry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~27#Question:What example did Jesus use next to teach his disciples not to worry?
trans-unit.source: What example did Jesus use next to teach his disciples not to worry?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia mfano gani baadaye ili kuwafundisha wanafunzi wake wasihangaike?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Question:What example did Jesus use next to teach his disciples not to worry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~27#Answer:What example did Jesus use next to teach his disciples not to worry?781168241
trans-unit.source: He told about the wild flowers/lilies. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alieleza kuhusu maua ya mwituni/mashada. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Answer:What example did Jesus use next to teach his disciples not to worry?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.27+How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~27#Question:How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?
trans-unit.source: How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?
trans-unit.target: Maua ya mwituni yapasa kuwaje kielelezo kwao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Question:How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~27#Answer:How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?899770225
trans-unit.source: They do not do any kind of work, but God makes them very beautiful anyway. Not even [ancient King] Solomon in all his beautiful clothes ever dressed as beautifully as one wild flower (27).
trans-unit.target: Hawafanyi kazi ya namna yoyote, lakini Mungu huwafanya kuwa wazuri sana hata hivyo. Hata [Mfalme wa kale] Sulemani katika mavazi yake yote mazuri hakuvaa vizuri kama ua moja la mwituni (27).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Answer:How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!12~27#Note:How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?-2083405518
trans-unit.source: The two kinds of work which Jesus named referred specifically to general physical labor, such as Jewish men did, and to the twisting of fibers into thread/yarn/string, which Jewish women did. If the culture of the translation has similar roles which divide the work of men and women, or if it has two other work roles to which they traditionally refer as indicating men and women, do try to use one of those divisions here.
trans-unit.target: Aina mbili za kazi ambazo Yesu alizitaja zilirejelea hasa kazi ya kawaida ya mwili, kama vile wanaume Wayahudi walivyofanya, na kuunganisha nyuzi kuwa uzi/kamba/kamba, ambayo wanawake Wayahudi walifanya. Ikiwa utamaduni wa tafsiri una majukumu sawa ambayo hugawanya kazi ya wanaume na wanawake, au ikiwa ina majukumu mengine mawili ya kazi ambayo kwa kawaida hutaja kama kuonyesha wanaume na wanawake, jaribu kutumia moja ya mgawanyiko huo hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Note:How are the wild flowers to be an example for them?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.28+If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~28#Question:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa Mungu hufanya hivyo kwa maua ya mwituni ambayo huishi kwa muda mfupi tu, hilo lingewaonyesha nini wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~28#Question:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~28#Answer:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?1440166541
trans-unit.source: It should have shown that God would provide them with at least all their basic needs. (28)
trans-unit.target: Ingepaswa kuonyesha kwamba Mungu angewapa angalau mahitaji yao yote ya msingi.28
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~28#Answer:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~28#Answer:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~28#Answer:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~28#Answer:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?-443712678
trans-unit.source: It should have shown that God would do even more for them because they would have a longer, lasting purpose than the flowers (28).
trans-unit.target: Ingepaswa kuonyesha kwamba Mungu angewafanyia mengi zaidi kwa sababu wangekuwa na kusudi la muda mrefu, lenye kudumu kuliko maua (28).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~28#Answer:If God does that for the wild flowers which are alive only a very short time, what should that have shown to the disciples?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.27-31+What do you think was the reason that Jesus compared the beauty of the wild flowers to Solomon?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~27#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus compared the beauty of the wild flowers to Solomon?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus compared the beauty of the wild flowers to Solomon?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alilinganisha uzuri wa maua ya porini na Sulemani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus compared the beauty of the wild flowers to Solomon?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~27#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus compared the beauty of the wild flowers to Solomon?-1584287975
trans-unit.source: Solomon had been king of Israel a long time before Jesus lived. God made him the richest man in all the world. He could buy any beautiful clothing or jewelry that he wanted. Even so, God made the wild flowers more beautiful than King Solomon had ever been.
trans-unit.target: Sulemani alikuwa mfalme wa Israeli kwa muda mrefu kabla ya Yesu kuzaliwa, na Mungu alimpa utajiri mwingi kuliko wa dunia yote, na angeweza kununua mavazi mazuri na vito vya thamani ambavyo alitaka. Hata hivyo, Mungu alifanya maua ya porini kuwa mazuri kuliko Mfalme Sulemani aliyewahi kuwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~27#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus compared the beauty of the wild flowers to Solomon?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.32+How might the disciples be like a little flock of sheep which did not need to worry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~32#Question:How might the disciples be like a little flock of sheep which did not need to worry?
trans-unit.source: How might the disciples be like a little flock of sheep which did not need to worry?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wangewezaje kuwa kama kundi dogo la kondoo ambao hawakuhitaji kuhangaika?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~32#Question:How might the disciples be like a little flock of sheep which did not need to worry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~32#Answer:How might the disciples be like a little flock of sheep which did not need to worry?-623579057
trans-unit.source: By themselves they could become lost and in danger without a shepherd, but [God,] their Father, was watching out for them and had been pleased to provide [them with his] kingdom/what they needed spiritually. He would provide their physical needs, as well. (32)
trans-unit.target: Kwao wenyewe wangepotea na kuwa katika hatari bila mchungaji, lakini [Mungu,] Baba yao, alikuwa akiwatazama na alikuwa amefurahi kuwapa ufalme wake/walichohitaji kiroho. Angeandaa mahitaji yao ya kimwili pia. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~32#Answer:How might the disciples be like a little flock of sheep which did not need to worry?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.33+What did Jesus tell his disciples to do which would show that they were not worrying about the things they needed every day?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples to do which would show that they were not worrying about the things they needed every day?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wafanye nini ambacho kingeonyesha kwamba hawakuwa wakihangaikia mambo waliyohitaji kila siku?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~33#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do which would show that they were not worrying about the things they needed every day?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~33#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do which would show that they were not worrying about the things they needed every day?-811286265
trans-unit.source: They should sell what they possessed and give [the money] to the poor [people]. (33a)
trans-unit.target: Na wauze waliyo nayo na wawape maskini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~33#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do which would show that they were not worrying about the things they needed every day?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~33#Question:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?
trans-unit.source: Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~33#Question:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~33#Alternate:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?792807500
trans-unit.source: Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions, what should he be valuing and gathering?
trans-unit.target: Badala ya mtu anayemfuata Yesu kuthamini na kukusanya mali za kidunia, anapaswa kuthamini na kukusanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~33#Alternate:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!12~33#Alternate:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?805382851
trans-unit.source: Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?
trans-unit.target: Badala ya mtu amfuataye Yesu kuthamini na kukusanya hazina za kidunia, apaswa kuthamini na kukusanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~33#Alternate:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~33#Answer:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?-1190310765
trans-unit.source: He should gather things having great value in heaven where they will never lose their value. He should not gather things like money which falls out of a purse when it wears out and has holes in it. No thief will steal those things in heaven and no moth will destroy those things by eating holes in them. They will last forever. (33)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima ajiwekee hazina kubwa mbinguni ambapo hazitapoteza thamani yake. Asiwekee hazina kama fedha ambayo inapoanguka kutoka kwenye mfuko wa fedha wakati inapochakaa na ina mashimo ndani yake. Hakuna mwizi atakayeiba vitu hivyo mbinguni wala nondo hataharibu kwa kula mashimo ndani yake. Vitu hivyo vitadumu milele. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~33#Answer:Instead of a person who follows Jesus valuing and gathering earthly possessions/treasures, what should he be valuing and gathering?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.34+What did Jesus say made this matter so very important to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~34#Question:What did Jesus say made this matter so very important to God?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say made this matter so very important to God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichofanya jambo hilo liwe muhimu sana kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~34#Question:What did Jesus say made this matter so very important to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~34#Answer:What did Jesus say made this matter so very important to God?2021969134
trans-unit.source: What a person regards as very important will be the thing on which he focuses his thoughts and desires. If the focus of a person's heart is on earthly things, God will know that person is not focusing on him. A person should value pleasing God, not pleasing himself. (34)
trans-unit.target: Kile ambacho mtu anachokiona kuwa muhimu sana kitakuwa kile ambacho anazingatia mawazo na tamaa zake. Kama moyo wa mtu unakazia mambo ya kidunia, Mungu atajua kwamba mtu huyo hajamkazia yeye. Mtu anapaswa kuthamini kumpendeza Mungu, sio kujipendeza mwenyewe. (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~34#Answer:What did Jesus say made this matter so very important to God?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.47-48+How will the master decide which bad servant deserves many blows of punishment and which one deserves only a few blows?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.56+What name did Jesus call the people who did not recognize the meaning of those signs he had been doing?

trans-unit.source: He called them hypocrites. (56)

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!12~57#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 12:57-59 People must make peace with others quickly.

group.id: Q:LUK 12.57-59+What lesson did Jesus try to teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~57#Question:What lesson did Jesus try to teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What lesson did Jesus try to teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijaribu kuwafundisha watu somo gani katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~57#Question:What lesson did Jesus try to teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~57#Answer:What lesson did Jesus try to teach the people in these verses?200098324
trans-unit.source: He urged people to make peace with other people and with God before they must pay the penalty for their doing wrong. If they do not make peace, they might be punished and never be free again. (58-59)
trans-unit.target: Aliwahimiza watu wafanye amani na watu wengine na na Mungu kabla ya kulazimika kulipa adhabu kwa kosa lao. Kama hawatafanya amani, huenda wakaadhibiwa na hawatakuwa huru tena (58-59).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~57#Answer:What lesson did Jesus try to teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.57+What did Jesus advise his listeners to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~57#Question:What did Jesus advise his listeners to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus advise his listeners to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwashauri wasikilizaji wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~57#Question:What did Jesus advise his listeners to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~57#Answer:What did Jesus advise his listeners to do?1312194956
trans-unit.source: They should decide what is right on their own. (57)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kuamua wenyewe yaliyo sawa. (57)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~57#Answer:What did Jesus advise his listeners to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.58-59+What picture language did Jesus use here?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~58#Question:What picture language did Jesus use here?
trans-unit.source: What picture language did Jesus use here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia lugha gani ya mfano?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~58#Question:What picture language did Jesus use here?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~58#Answer:What picture language did Jesus use here?-144734218
trans-unit.source: He used the picture of one person taking another to the court to settle a dispute, apparently over money. If the person who has/owes the debt does not straighten the problem quickly, he may be thrown into the jail and be forced to stay there. (58-59)
trans-unit.target: Alitumia picha ya mtu mmoja akimpeleka mwingine mahakamani ili kutatua mzozo, inaonekana ni juu ya pesa. Ikiwa mtu aliye na/ana deni hatatatua tatizo hilo haraka, huenda akatupwa gerezani na kulazimika kukaa huko. (58-59)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~58#Answer:What picture language did Jesus use here?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.58+What did Jesus imply was the right thing to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~58#Question:What did Jesus imply was the right thing to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus imply was the right thing to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha kwamba jambo linalofaa ni nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~58#Answer:What did Jesus imply was the right thing to do?780509689
trans-unit.source: The person being taken to the judge/court should admit that he did wrong to his accuser/opponent and work hard to settle the problem quickly. (58)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~58#Answer:What did Jesus imply was the right thing to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.59+What did Jesus say was the only way for that person to get out of the jail?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~59#Question:What did Jesus say was the only way for that person to get out of the jail?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the only way for that person to get out of the jail?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema njia pekee ya mtu huyo kutoka gerezani ilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~59#Question:What did Jesus say was the only way for that person to get out of the jail?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~59#Answer:What did Jesus say was the only way for that person to get out of the jail?572321754
trans-unit.source: He could get out only if he paid back everything, including the last small part [of the debt] which he owed. (59)
trans-unit.target: Angeweza kuachiliwa tu ikiwa alilipa yote, kutia na sehemu ya mwisho ya [deni] alilokuwa nalo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~59#Answer:What did Jesus say was the only way for that person to get out of the jail?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.59+Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~59#Question:Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?
trans-unit.source: Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?
trans-unit.target: Je, inaonekana kama inawezekana kulipa fedha nyuma wakati wewe ni katika jela, kama hakuwa na kulipa nyuma kabla ya wewe akaenda gerezani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~59#Question:Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~59#Answer:Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?-292277893
trans-unit.source: No, it probably is not possible.
trans-unit.target: La, labda haiwezekani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~59#Answer:Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!12~59#Note:Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?-1867254212
trans-unit.source: Debtors held in Roman prisons could be imprisoned until their friends or family paid the debt.
trans-unit.target: Wakopeshaji waliowekwa katika magereza ya Kiroma wangeweza kufungwa hadi marafiki au familia zao walipolipa deni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~59#Note:Does it sound to you as though it is possible to pay the money back while you are in jail, if you did not have it to pay back before you went into jail?

group.id: Q:LUK 12.57-59+If this picture language is referring to God as our judge, and we stand before him and have not repented, what did Jesus imply would happen to us?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!12~57#Question:If this picture language is referring to God as our judge, and we stand before him and have not repented, what did Jesus imply would happen to us?
trans-unit.source: If this picture language is referring to God as our judge, and we stand before him and have not repented, what did Jesus imply would happen to us?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa lugha hiyo ya mfano inarejezea Mungu kuwa hakimu wetu, na sisi tunasimama mbele yake na hatujatubu, Yesu alimaanisha kwamba ni nini kingetupata?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~57#Question:If this picture language is referring to God as our judge, and we stand before him and have not repented, what did Jesus imply would happen to us?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!12~57#Answer:If this picture language is referring to God as our judge, and we stand before him and have not repented, what did Jesus imply would happen to us?-704535680
trans-unit.source: [God] will put us into Hell and we will never get/come out.
trans-unit.target: Na Mwenyezi Mungu atatuingiza Motoni, wala hatutakuwa wenye kutoka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!12~57#Answer:If this picture language is referring to God as our judge, and we stand before him and have not repented, what did Jesus imply would happen to us?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!13~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 13:1-5 If a person does not repent, God will destroy him/his soul.
trans-unit.target: Luka 13:1-5 Ikiwa mtu hawezi kutubu, Mungu atauharibu nafsi yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 13.1-5+What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~1#Question:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonyaje watu waliokuwa wakimsikiliza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Question:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?-1087354769
trans-unit.source: He warned them that unless they repented, they would perish/die/be destroyed [by the Roman soldiers] in the same way as those men from Galilee. (1, 3, 5)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya kwamba wasipotubu, wataangamia/watakufa/wataharibiwa [na askari Waroma] kwa njia ile ile kama wale watu kutoka Galilaya. (1, 3, 5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?-2075761050
trans-unit.source: He warned them that unless they repented, they also would perish/die/be destroyed [by God]. (3, 5)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya kwamba wasipotubu, wao pia wataangamia/kufa/kuharibiwa [na Mungu]. (3, 5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?-1923147617
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "destroy, perish, (be lost" in KBT. Although the same Greek word was used in 5:37, 8:24 and 11:51 in non-spiritual contexts, the language of the translation may not allow that earlier translation to be used here to mean the total destruction of spiritual things.)
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Angalia "kuharibu, kupotea, (kupotea" katika KBT. Ingawa neno lile lile la Kigiriki lilitumiwa katika 5:37, 8:24 na 11:51 katika muktadha usio wa kiroho, lugha ya tafsiri huenda isiruhusu tafsiri hiyo ya awali itumiwe hapa kumaanisha uharibifu kamili wa mambo ya kiroho.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Answer:What did Jesus warn the people who were listening to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.1+What did some people in the crowd with Jesus tell him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~1#Question:What did some people in the crowd with Jesus tell him?
trans-unit.source: What did some people in the crowd with Jesus tell him?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani katika umati waliokuwa pamoja na Yesu walimwambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Question:What did some people in the crowd with Jesus tell him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~1#Answer:What did some people in the crowd with Jesus tell him?-907889065
trans-unit.source: Some [Jews] from Galilee [province] had been killed by [the Roman governor] Pilate['s soldiers] while they were offering sacrifices [to God within the temple grounds], and their blood mixed with [the blood of] their sacrifices. (1)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya [Wayahudi] kutoka Galilaya [mkoa] walikuwa wameuawa na [gavana Mroma] Pilato [askari] walipokuwa wakitoa dhabihu [kwa Mungu ndani ya uwanja wa hekalu], na damu yao ilichanganywa na [damu ya] dhabihu zao. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~1#Answer:What did some people in the crowd with Jesus tell him?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.2+What did Jesus imply as to how the people seemed to regard that terrible act?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~2#Question:What did Jesus imply as to how the people seemed to regard that terrible act?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus imply as to how the people seemed to regard that terrible act?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini kuhusu jinsi watu walivyoona tendo hilo lenye kuogofya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~2#Question:What did Jesus imply as to how the people seemed to regard that terrible act?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~2#Answer:What did Jesus imply as to how the people seemed to regard that terrible act?954513336
trans-unit.source: They seemed to have thought that God had punished those people because they had sinned more [than the rest of the people]. (2)
trans-unit.target: Yaonekana walifikiri kwamba Mungu alikuwa amewaadhibu watu hao kwa sababu walikuwa wamefanya dhambi nyingi zaidi [kuliko watu wengine wote]. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~2#Answer:What did Jesus imply as to how the people seemed to regard that terrible act?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.4+What was the similar example which Jesus himself wanted the people to think about?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~4#Question:What was the similar example which Jesus himself wanted the people to think about?
trans-unit.source: What was the similar example which Jesus himself wanted the people to think about?
trans-unit.target: Yesu mwenyewe alitaka watu wafikirie mfano gani unaofanana na huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~4#Question:What was the similar example which Jesus himself wanted the people to think about?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~4#Answer:What was the similar example which Jesus himself wanted the people to think about?246441261
trans-unit.source: Eighteen people had been killed/had died when a tower at Siloam [in Jerusalem] fell on them. Jesus did not want the people to also think that those people had died because they were greater/worse sinners than the other people who lived in Jerusalem. (4)
trans-unit.target: Watu kumi na nane waliuawa au walikufa wakati mnara ulipoanguka juu yao huko Siloamu [Yerusalemu]. Yesu hakutaka watu pia wafikiri kwamba watu hao walikufa kwa sababu walikuwa wenye dhambi zaidi au wabaya zaidi kuliko watu wengine walioishi Yerusalemu. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~4#Answer:What was the similar example which Jesus himself wanted the people to think about?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.3-5+What did Jesus say about that as being the reason that all those people had died in each of those troubles?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~3#Question:What did Jesus say about that as being the reason that all those people had died in each of those troubles?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about that as being the reason that all those people had died in each of those troubles?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya hilo kuwa sababu ya watu hao wote kufa katika kila moja ya matatizo hayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~3#Question:What did Jesus say about that as being the reason that all those people had died in each of those troubles?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~3#Answer:What did Jesus say about that as being the reason that all those people had died in each of those troubles?-808447359
trans-unit.source: He said strongly, "No, [that is not right]." (3, 5)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwa uthabiti, "Hapana, [hiyo si sawa]". (3, 5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~3#Answer:What did Jesus say about that as being the reason that all those people had died in each of those troubles?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!13~6#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 13:6-9 Jesus told a parable about a fig tree that produced no fruit.
trans-unit.target: Luka 13:6-9 Yesu alitoa mfano wa mtini ambao haukuzaa matunda.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 13.6-9+(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~6#Question:(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?
trans-unit.source: (Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?
trans-unit.target: (Soma tena 13:5) Unafikiri Yesu alitaka watu waelewe mfano huo jinsi gani baada tu ya kuwaambia watubu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Question:(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~6#Answer:(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?-37628021
trans-unit.source: The way that a man judges a fruit tree is the same way that God will judge a person's life.
trans-unit.target: Jinsi mwanadamu anavyohukumu mti wa matunda ndivyo Mungu atakavyohukumu maisha ya mtu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Answer:(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~6#Answer:(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?-1371082776
trans-unit.source: If people do not repent and begin doing what pleases God, then they also are of no value to him and he will destroy them.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu hawatatubu na kuanza kufanya yale yanayompendeza Mungu, basi wao pia hawana thamani kwake naye atawaangamiza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Answer:(Read 13:5 again.) What do you think was the way that Jesus wanted the people to understand the meaning of this parable after just having talked to them about repenting?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.6+Where had the man planted this fig tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~6#Question:Where had the man planted this fig tree?
trans-unit.source: Where had the man planted this fig tree?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alikuwa amepanda mtini huo wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Question:Where had the man planted this fig tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~6#Answer:Where had the man planted this fig tree?-967589097
trans-unit.source: He planted it in his vineyard/grape garden. (6)
trans-unit.target: Aliupanda katika shamba lake la mizabibu. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Answer:Where had the man planted this fig tree?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.6+What did the man see when he went to find fruit on that tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~6#Question:What did the man see when he went to find fruit on that tree?
trans-unit.source: What did the man see when he went to find fruit on that tree?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo aliona nini alipoenda kutafuta matunda kwenye mti huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Question:What did the man see when he went to find fruit on that tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~6#Answer:What did the man see when he went to find fruit on that tree?-435238587
trans-unit.source: He did not find any [fruit there]. (6)
trans-unit.target: Hakupata [matunda yoyote] huko. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~6#Answer:What did the man see when he went to find fruit on that tree?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.7+How many years had that man come to check on that tree, but had never found any fruit?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~7#Question:How many years had that man come to check on that tree, but had never found any fruit?
trans-unit.source: How many years had that man come to check on that tree, but had never found any fruit?
trans-unit.target: Ni miaka mingapi ambayo mtu huyo alikuwa amekuja kuangalia mti huo, lakini hakuwa amepata matunda yoyote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~7#Question:How many years had that man come to check on that tree, but had never found any fruit?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~7#Answer:How many years had that man come to check on that tree, but had never found any fruit?1304209643
trans-unit.source: He had come for three years. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amekuja kwa miaka mitatu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~7#Answer:How many years had that man come to check on that tree, but had never found any fruit?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.7+Why did he tell the man who took care of his garden to cut down that tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~7#Question:Why did he tell the man who took care of his garden to cut down that tree?
trans-unit.source: Why did he tell the man who took care of his garden to cut down that tree?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alimwambia mtu aliyetunza bustani yake akatue mti huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~7#Question:Why did he tell the man who took care of his garden to cut down that tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~7#Answer:Why did he tell the man who took care of his garden to cut down that tree?-1536057378
trans-unit.source: The tree was using [valuable] space and/or plant food/nourishment which were/was in the ground. (7)
trans-unit.target: Mti ulikuwa ukitumia nafasi [ya thamani] na/au chakula cha mimea/lishe iliyokuwa/ilikuwa ardhini. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~7#Answer:Why did he tell the man who took care of his garden to cut down that tree?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.8+What did the gardener suggest that he should do first before the owner cut down that tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~8#Question:What did the gardener suggest that he should do first before the owner cut down that tree?
trans-unit.source: What did the gardener suggest that he should do first before the owner cut down that tree?
trans-unit.target: Mkulima alipendekeza kwamba afanye nini kwanza kabla ya mwenye shamba kukata mti huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~8#Question:What did the gardener suggest that he should do first before the owner cut down that tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~8#Answer:What did the gardener suggest that he should do first before the owner cut down that tree?119170679
trans-unit.source: He said that over the next year he would dig around it and put manure/fertilizer [into the dirt]. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kwa mwaka mmoja uliofuata angechimba kuzunguka na kuweka mbolea [katika udongo]. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~8#Answer:What did the gardener suggest that he should do first before the owner cut down that tree?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.9+How would the owner know whether he should allow that tree to stay or cut it down?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~9#Question:How would the owner know whether he should allow that tree to stay or cut it down?
trans-unit.source: How would the owner know whether he should allow that tree to stay or cut it down?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba angewezaje kujua ikiwa anapaswa kuuacha mti huo au kuukata?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~9#Question:How would the owner know whether he should allow that tree to stay or cut it down?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~9#Answer:How would the owner know whether he should allow that tree to stay or cut it down?1165181392
trans-unit.source: If it bore fruit the next year, [it could stay], if not, [the owner] should cut it down. (9)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa utazaa matunda mwaka ujao, [inaweza kubaki], la sivyo, [mmiliki] ataukata. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~9#Answer:How would the owner know whether he should allow that tree to stay or cut it down?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!13~10#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 13:10-17 Jesus healed a crippled woman on the Sabbath Day.
trans-unit.target: Luka 13:10-17 Yesu alimponya mwanamke mlemavu siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 13.10-17+What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~10#Question:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Tukio hili linalotukia katika sinagogi siku ya Sabato latuonyesha nini juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Question:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?479736058
trans-unit.source: He used God's power over Satan (13, 16) and [other] spirits (11-12).
trans-unit.target: Alitumia nguvu za Mungu dhidi ya Shetani (13, 16) na roho [wengine] (11-12).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?-56825814
trans-unit.source: He had compassion on people who needed help, regardless of which day it was. (11-12, 14)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonyesha huruma watu waliohitaji msaada, bila kujali siku hiyo ilikuwa siku gani. (11-12, 14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?927819027
trans-unit.source: He had power from God which showed his authority over rules and regulations made by men. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu ambayo ilionyesha mamlaka yake juu ya sheria na kanuni zilizofanywa na wanadamu. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event happening in the synagogue on a Sabbath Day show us about Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.10-17+What does this event show us about some of the Jews' religious leaders?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~10#Question:What does this event show us about some of the Jews' religious leaders?
trans-unit.source: What does this event show us about some of the Jews' religious leaders?
trans-unit.target: Tukio hili latuonyesha nini juu ya baadhi ya viongozi wa kidini Wayahudi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Question:What does this event show us about some of the Jews' religious leaders?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event show us about some of the Jews' religious leaders?88300811
trans-unit.source: They did not believe that Jesus's power and teaching showed that he was the one God had sent to be the Messiah or savior. Because they did not believe that he had any authority from God over spiritual things, they also did not believe that he had any authority to disobey their rules about the Sabbath Day.
trans-unit.target: Hawakuamini kwamba nguvu na mafundisho ya Yesu yalionyesha kwamba yeye ndiye yule aliyetumwa na Mungu kuwa Mesiya au mwokozi. Kwa sababu hawakuamini kwamba alikuwa na mamlaka yoyote kutoka kwa Mungu juu ya mambo ya kiroho, wala hawakuamini kwamba alikuwa na mamlaka yoyote ya kutotii sheria zao kuhusu Siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~10#Answer:What does this event show us about some of the Jews' religious leaders?

trans-unit.source: She had been crippled for eighteen years./She was bent over and could not straighten up. (11)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amelala chini kwa miaka kumi na minane. Alikuwa ameinama na hakuweza kunyooka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~11#Answer:What was wrong with one woman who was in the synagogue?

trans-unit.source: He called her [to come] and told her that she had been set free from/healed of her problem. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita [aje] na kumwambia kwamba alikuwa amefunguliwa/aponywa tatizo lake. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~12#Answer:What did Jesus tell that woman?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.13+How was she able to stand up straight again?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~13#Question:How was she able to stand up straight again?
trans-unit.source: How was she able to stand up straight again?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~13#Question:How was she able to stand up straight again?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~13#Answer:How was she able to stand up straight again?-1471693538
trans-unit.source: Jesus touched her and she was normal/standing straight again [by God's power]. (13)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimgusa na akawa sawa/kusimama tena kwa nguvu za Mungu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~13#Answer:How was she able to stand up straight again?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~13#Question:What did the woman do after she was standing straight again?
