trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~13#Question:What did the woman do after she was standing straight again?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~13#Answer:What did the woman do after she was standing straight again?349409401
trans-unit.source: She praised God. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alimsifu Mungu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~13#Answer:What did the woman do after she was standing straight again?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.14+What made the ruler of the synagogue angry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~14#Question:What made the ruler of the synagogue angry?
trans-unit.source: What made the ruler of the synagogue angry?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomkasirisha mkuu wa sinagogi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~14#Question:What made the ruler of the synagogue angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~14#Answer:What made the ruler of the synagogue angry?1716443509
trans-unit.source: It was the Sabbath Day, but Jesus had healed [the woman anyway]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa siku ya Sabato, lakini Yesu alikuwa amemponya [yule mwanamke] hata hivyo. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~14#Answer:What made the ruler of the synagogue angry?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.14-17+What do you think was the reason that made him angry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~14#Question:What do you think was the reason that made him angry?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that made him angry?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kilichomkasirisha?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~14#Question:What do you think was the reason that made him angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that made him angry?-842085121
trans-unit.source: The Jewish leaders had said that was work, and God had said that no one was to work on the Sabbath Day. (See Exod. 20:9 and Deut. 5:13.)
trans-unit.target: Viongozi wa Kiyahudi walikuwa wamesema kwamba hiyo ilikuwa kazi, na Mungu alikuwa amesema kwamba hakuna mtu alipaswa kufanya kazi siku ya Sabato (Ona Kutoka 20:9 na Kumbukumbu la Torati 5:13).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~14#Answer:What do you think was the reason that made him angry?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.14+What did the ruler say to the people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~14#Question:What did the ruler say to the people?
trans-unit.source: What did the ruler say to the people?
trans-unit.target: Mtawala huyo aliwaambia watu nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~14#Question:What did the ruler say to the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~14#Answer:What did the ruler say to the people?1678966976
trans-unit.source: He said that they should come on one of the other six days [of the week when it was right to work] and be healed then. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kuja siku moja kati ya zile siku sita [za juma ambapo ilikuwa sawa kufanya kazi] na kuponywa wakati huo. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~14#Answer:What did the ruler say to the people?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.15+What did Jesus call this man and the others who felt the same way?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~15#Question:What did Jesus call this man and the others who felt the same way?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus call this man and the others who felt the same way?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwitaje mtu huyo na wengine waliokuwa na maoni kama yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~15#Question:What did Jesus call this man and the others who felt the same way?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~15#Answer:What did Jesus call this man and the others who felt the same way?-1856621105
trans-unit.source: He called them hypocrites. (15)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaita wanafiki. (15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~15#Answer:What did Jesus call this man and the others who felt the same way?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.15-16+What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~15#Question:What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?
trans-unit.source: What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa sababu gani ya kuwaita viongozi wa sinagogi wanafiki?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~15#Question:What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~15#Answer:What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?1669591760
trans-unit.source: They untied their oxen and donkeys [which had been tied only a short time] on the Sabbath to walk around and get water to drink, but they did not want [Jesus on the Sabbath] to set free this woman who had been bound (i.e., controlled) by the devil for 18 years. (15-16)
trans-unit.target: Walifungua ng'ombe na punda wao [ambao walikuwa wamefungwa kwa muda mfupi tu] siku ya Sabato kutembea na kupata maji ya kunywa, lakini hawakutaka [Yesu siku ya Sabato] kumweka huru mwanamke huyu ambaye alikuwa amefungwa (yaani, alidhibitiwa) na ibilisi kwa miaka 18. (15-16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~15#Answer:What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~15#Note:What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?77164676
trans-unit.source: If the leaders thought that God cared about how they treated their animals on the Sabbath Day, then he surely cared much more about one of his chosen people. The synagogue leaders considered healing to be work. Jesus pointed out that caring for their animals also was work! Therefore they were hypocrites regarding not working on the Sabbath.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa viongozi walidhani kwamba Mungu alijali jinsi walivyowatendea wanyama wao siku ya Sabato, basi hakika alijali zaidi juu ya mmoja wa watu wake waliochaguliwa. Viongozi wa sinagogi waliona uponyaji kuwa kazi. Yesu alionyesha kwamba kutunza wanyama wao pia ilikuwa kazi! Kwa hiyo walikuwa wanafiki kuhusu kutofanya kazi siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~15#Note:What reason did Jesus give for calling the synagogue leaders hypocrites?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.16+What was the woman's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~16#Question:What was the woman's relationship to Abraham?
trans-unit.source: What was the woman's relationship to Abraham?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alikuwa na uhusiano gani na Abrahamu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~16#Question:What was the woman's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~16#Answer:What was the woman's relationship to Abraham?156751653
trans-unit.source: Jesus called her Abraham's daughter. That meant she was a descendant of the Jew's ancestor Abraham.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwita binti ya Abrahamu. Hilo lilimaanisha kwamba alikuwa mzao wa Abrahamu babu ya Myahudi huyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~16#Answer:What was the woman's relationship to Abraham?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.17+How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~17#Question:How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?
trans-unit.source: How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?
trans-unit.target: Vikundi mbalimbali vya watu vilitiije yale ambayo Yesu alisema na kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~17#Question:How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~17#Answer:How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?-1180831897
trans-unit.source: Those men who had opposed Jesus were humiliated/shamed.
trans-unit.target: Watu hao waliompinga Yesu walinyenyekezwa/kuona aibu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~17#Answer:How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~17#Answer:How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?-225414610
trans-unit.source: The [other] people rejoiced at all the wonderful/splendid things Jesus was doing. (17)
trans-unit.target: Watu [wengine] walifurahi kwa mambo yote ya ajabu/ya ajabu ambayo Yesu alikuwa akifanya. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~17#Answer:How did the different groups of people react to what Jesus had said and done?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!13~18#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 13:18-21 Jesus told two parables to show how the kingdom of God would increase.
trans-unit.target: Luka 13:18-21 Yesu alitoa mifano miwili kuonyesha jinsi ufalme wa Mungu ungeongezeka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~18#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 13.18-21+What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~18#Question:What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?
trans-unit.source: What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akijaribu kuwafundisha watu nini kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu katika mifano hiyo miwili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~18#Question:What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~18#Answer:What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?92559215
trans-unit.source: The kingdom of God may appear to be very small and insignificant [at the time of Jesus], but it would increase in size and influence. // He was teaching that those who were in God's kingdom were few [in number] then, but there would be a large group in the future.
trans-unit.target: Ufalme wa Mungu unaweza kuonekana kuwa mdogo sana na usio na maana [wakati wa Yesu], lakini ungeongezeka kwa ukubwa na ushawishi. // Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba wale waliokuwa katika ufalme wa Mungu walikuwa wachache [kwa idadi] wakati huo, lakini kungekuwa na kikundi kikubwa katika wakati ujao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~18#Answer:What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~18#Answer:What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?69655448
trans-unit.source: In the end, the kingdom of God would affect everyone and be a place of rest for many people. (19b, 21b)
trans-unit.target: Mwishowe, ufalme wa Mungu ungeathiri kila mtu na kuwa mahali pa kupumzika kwa watu wengi. (19b, 21b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~18#Answer:What, do you think, was Jesus trying to teach the people about the kingdom of God in these two parables?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.19+To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~19#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa Mungu na nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~19#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?-1229196211
trans-unit.source: To a seed of the mustard tree/plant. (19)
trans-unit.target: Kwa mbegu ya haradali.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~19#Note:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?1722833383
trans-unit.source: (Note: If the mustard tree/plant is not part of the local culture, the translation does not have to say that the seed is from that specific plant. It should, however, definitely refer to some very small seed that the people know will grow into a strong plant.
trans-unit.target: (Kumbuka: Ikiwa mti wa haradali/mimea si sehemu ya utamaduni wa mahali hapo, tafsiri haipaswi kusema kwamba mbegu ni kutoka kwa mmea huo maalum. Hata hivyo, inapaswa dhahiri kutaja mbegu ndogo sana ambayo watu wanajua itakua kuwa mmea wenye nguvu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Note:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~19#Note:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?-1867680358
trans-unit.source: If the mustard tree/plant is used in the translation, deciding whether to call it a "tree" or a "plant" will depend on the way that the culture classifies all the growing things.)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mti wa haradali/mimea inatumiwa katika tafsiri, kuamua kama utaita "mti" au "mimea" itategemea jinsi utamaduni unavyoweka vitu vyote vinavyokua.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Note:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.19+Tell me about that seed.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~19#Question:Tell me about that seed.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about that seed.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu mbegu hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Question:Tell me about that seed.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~19#Answer:Tell me about that seed.210645302
trans-unit.source: The seed is very tiny, but it grows into a large, strong tree/plant with branches. Birds make nests/places to rest in it. (19)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu ni ndogo sana, lakini inakua kuwa mti mkubwa, wenye nguvu na matawi. Ndege hufanya viota/mahali pa kupumzika ndani yake. (19)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Answer:Tell me about that seed.

group.id: Q:LUK 13.19+What happened to the tiny seed in Jesus's story?/What did that tiny seed do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~19#Question:What happened to the tiny seed in Jesus's story?/What did that tiny seed do?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the tiny seed in Jesus's story?/What did that tiny seed do?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotokea kwa mbegu ndogo katika hadithi ya Yesu?/Mbegu hiyo ndogo ilifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Question:What happened to the tiny seed in Jesus's story?/What did that tiny seed do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~19#Answer:What happened to the tiny seed in Jesus's story?/What did that tiny seed do?324226188
trans-unit.source: A man threw it into his garden and it grew there, became a tree/a plant as tall as a tree, and birds made nests/places to rest in its branches. (19)
trans-unit.target: Mtu mmoja aliitupa katika bustani yake, ikaota na kuwa mti, na ndege wakafanya viota katika matawi yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~19#Answer:What happened to the tiny seed in Jesus's story?/What did that tiny seed do?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.21+To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~21#Question:To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa Mungu na nini kingine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~21#Question:To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.source: He compared the kingdom of God to yeast. (21)
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha ufalme wa Mungu na chachu. (21)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~21#Answer:To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~21#Note:To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?-2028689820
trans-unit.source: See 12:1 above.
trans-unit.target: Ona 12:1 hapo juu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~21#Note:To what else did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.21+What happened to the yeast in Jesus's story?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~21#Question:What happened to the yeast in Jesus's story?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the yeast in Jesus's story?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa chachu katika mfano wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~21#Question:What happened to the yeast in Jesus's story?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~21#Answer:What happened to the yeast in Jesus's story?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.20-21+What do you think the yeast did to the dough when it was mixed in well?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~20#Question:What do you think the yeast did to the dough when it was mixed in well?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the yeast did to the dough when it was mixed in well?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri chachu ilifanya nini kwa mchuzi huo ulipochanganywa vizuri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~20#Question:What do you think the yeast did to the dough when it was mixed in well?

trans-unit.source: It caused all the dough to swell/increase in size.
trans-unit.target: Ilifanya unga wote uvimbe / kuongezeka kwa ukubwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~20#Answer:What do you think the yeast did to the dough when it was mixed in well?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!13~22#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 13:22-30 There is only one right way to enter the kingdom of God.
trans-unit.target: Luka 13:22-30 Kuna njia moja tu ya haki ya kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 13.22-30+How did the house owner in the parable decide which people were allowed to enter and which people were told to leave?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~22#Question:How did the house owner in the parable decide which people were allowed to enter and which people were told to leave?
trans-unit.source: How did the house owner in the parable decide which people were allowed to enter and which people were told to leave?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye nyumba katika mfano huo aliamua jinsi gani ni nani aliyeruhusiwa kuingia na ni nani aliyeruhusiwa kutoka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Question:How did the house owner in the parable decide which people were allowed to enter and which people were told to leave?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~22#Answer:How did the house owner in the parable decide which people were allowed to enter and which people were told to leave?2070488193
trans-unit.source: Only those people who had come through the narrow door/the correct way (24) before the door was shut (25) were allowed to enter. The others were told to leave. (27)
trans-unit.target: Ni wale tu waliokuja kupitia mlango mwembamba/njia sahihi (24) kabla mlango haujafungwa (25) ndio walioruhusiwa kuingia. Wengine waliambiwa waondoke (27).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Answer:How did the house owner in the parable decide which people were allowed to enter and which people were told to leave?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.22-30+What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~22#Question:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mlango mwembamba ni picha ya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Question:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~22#Answer:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?863928712
trans-unit.source: Jesus meant that there is only one small way to enter the kingdom of God. (Perhaps it referred to repenting of one's sins as being the only way to enter the kingdom of God). (24)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha kwamba kuna njia moja tu ndogo ya kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu. (Labda ilimaanisha kutubu dhambi za mtu kuwa ndiyo njia pekee ya kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu). (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Answer:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~22#Answer:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Answer:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~22#Answer:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?2013445192
trans-unit.source: Jesus meant that there are not many opportunities left to enter the kingdom of God, so they must do so quickly. (25)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha kwamba hakuna fursa nyingi zilizobaki za kuingia ufalme wa Mungu, kwa hiyo ni lazima wafanye hivyo haraka. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Answer:What do you think that the narrow door is a picture of?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.22+What was Jesus doing as he traveled on his way to Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~22#Question:What was Jesus doing as he traveled on his way to Jerusalem?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus doing as he traveled on his way to Jerusalem?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifanya nini alipokuwa akisafiri kwenda Yerusalemu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Question:What was Jesus doing as he traveled on his way to Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~22#Answer:What was Jesus doing as he traveled on his way to Jerusalem?1503543837
trans-unit.source: He went through cities and villages teaching [the people]. (22)
trans-unit.target: Alitembea katika miji na vijiji akifundisha [watu]. (22)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Answer:What was Jesus doing as he traveled on his way to Jerusalem?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.23+What did someone ask Jesus about the people whom God was saving?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~23#Question:What did someone ask Jesus about the people whom God was saving?
trans-unit.source: What did someone ask Jesus about the people whom God was saving?
trans-unit.target: Mtu fulani alimwuliza Yesu nini juu ya watu ambao Mungu alikuwa akiokoa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~23#Question:What did someone ask Jesus about the people whom God was saving?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~23#Answer:What did someone ask Jesus about the people whom God was saving?-220606312
trans-unit.source: He asked if only a few people were to be saved. (23)
trans-unit.target: Aliuliza kama ni watu wachache tu watakaookolewa. (23)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~23#Answer:What did someone ask Jesus about the people whom God was saving?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.22-27+To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he spoke about entering a narrow door into a house?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~22#Question:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he spoke about entering a narrow door into a house?
trans-unit.source: To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he spoke about entering a narrow door into a house?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia nini aliposema kuhusu kuingia katika nyumba kupitia mlango mwembamba?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Question:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he spoke about entering a narrow door into a house?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~22#Answer:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he spoke about entering a narrow door into a house?1267069073
trans-unit.source: He was talking about entering the kingdom of God.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~22#Answer:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he spoke about entering a narrow door into a house?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.24+To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he told the people to work hard at entering the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~24#Question:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he told the people to work hard at entering the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he told the people to work hard at entering the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akirejezea nini alipowaambia watu wafanye kazi kwa bidii ili kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Question:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he told the people to work hard at entering the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~24#Answer:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he told the people to work hard at entering the kingdom of God?-314747526
trans-unit.source: He meant that it is not easy/simple for anyone to get in.
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba si rahisi kwa mtu yeyote kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Answer:To what, do you think, was Jesus referring when he told the people to work hard at entering the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.24+How many people did he say will try to enter the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~24#Question:How many people did he say will try to enter the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: How many people did he say will try to enter the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu wangapi alisema watajaribu kuingia ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Question:How many people did he say will try to enter the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~24#Answer:How many people did he say will try to enter the kingdom of God?814834133
trans-unit.source: Many [people] will try to enter. (24)
trans-unit.target: Wengi [watu] watajaribu kuingia. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Answer:How many people did he say will try to enter the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.24+How many people will enter?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~24#Question:How many people will enter?
trans-unit.source: How many people will enter?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu wangapi watakaoingia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Question:How many people will enter?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~24#Answer:How many people will enter?2105431440
trans-unit.source: Not many will enter./Not nearly as many will enter as tried to enter. (24)
trans-unit.target: Wengi hawataingia./Hata kidogo kama wengi watakaoingia walivyojaribu kuingia. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Answer:How many people will enter?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.24+To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~24#Question:To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?
trans-unit.source: To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mwenye nyumba katika mfano huo alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Question:To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~24#Answer:To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?2096175307
trans-unit.source: He referred to Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza kumhusu Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Answer:To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~24#Note:To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?1525452614
trans-unit.source: Jesus is understood to be the owner, rather than God, his father. That comes from other times when Jesus spoke of the banquet/feast as a wedding feast in which he is the bridegroom. It can also be implied from verse 25 in the passive verb "has been raised/has risen".
trans-unit.target: Yesu anaeleweka kuwa ndiye mmiliki, badala ya Mungu, baba yake. Hii inatokana na nyakati zingine wakati Yesu alizungumza juu ya karamu / karamu kama karamu ya harusi ambayo yeye ni bwana harusi. Inaweza pia kuelezewa kutoka kwa aya ya 25 katika kitenzi cha pasifu "amekufa/amekufa".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~24#Note:To whom, do you think, did the owner of the house in the parable really refer?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.25+What will people do after Jesus closes the door of the kingdom?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~25#Question:What will people do after Jesus closes the door of the kingdom?
trans-unit.source: What will people do after Jesus closes the door of the kingdom?
trans-unit.target: Watu watafanya nini baada ya Yesu kufunga mlango wa ufalme?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~25#Question:What will people do after Jesus closes the door of the kingdom?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~25#Answer:What will people do after Jesus closes the door of the kingdom?-2051754361
trans-unit.source: People will stand on the outside knocking and asking the Lord to open the door for them. (25)
trans-unit.target: Watu watasimama nje na kubisha na kumwomba Bwana awafungulie mlango. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~25#Answer:What will people do after Jesus closes the door of the kingdom?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.25+What will Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~25#Question:What will Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: What will Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu atawajibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~25#Question:What will Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~25#Answer:What will Jesus answer them?1823185850
trans-unit.source: He will say he did not know them or where they had come from. (He had no close association or relationship with them.) (25)
trans-unit.target: Atasema kuwa hajui wametoka wapi (hajawahi kuwa na uhusiano wa karibu nao wala uhusiano wa karibu nao).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~25#Answer:What will Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.26+How will those people who are outside the kingdom try to show that they thought that they had a relationship with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~26#Question:How will those people who are outside the kingdom try to show that they thought that they had a relationship with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How will those people who are outside the kingdom try to show that they thought that they had a relationship with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walio nje ya ufalme watajaribuje kuonyesha kwamba walifikiri walikuwa na uhusiano na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~26#Question:How will those people who are outside the kingdom try to show that they thought that they had a relationship with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~26#Answer:How will those people who are outside the kingdom try to show that they thought that they had a relationship with Jesus?1198277700
trans-unit.source: They will say they ate [meals] with him and that he had taught in their streets/towns. (26)
trans-unit.target: Watasema: Tulikula naye, na alikuwa akifundisha katika njia zao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~26#Answer:How will those people who are outside the kingdom try to show that they thought that they had a relationship with Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.27+What will Jesus then tell them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~27#Question:What will Jesus then tell them?
trans-unit.source: What will Jesus then tell them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu atawaambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~27#Question:What will Jesus then tell them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~27#Answer:What will Jesus then tell them?267988717
trans-unit.source: He will tell them the same thing as before. He had no personal relationship with them. (27)
trans-unit.target: Atawaambia yale yale kama hapo awali. hakuwa na uhusiano wa kibinafsi nao. (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~27#Answer:What will Jesus then tell them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~27#Answer:What will Jesus then tell them?1985301277
trans-unit.source: He also will tell them to go away from him, (27)
trans-unit.target: Pia atawaambia waondoke kwake, (27)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~27#Answer:What will Jesus then tell them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~27#Answer:What will Jesus then tell them?-2034016536
trans-unit.source: and he will call them all [people who] do evil things. (27)
trans-unit.target: Na atawaita hao madhaalimu wote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~27#Answer:What will Jesus then tell them?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.28+What will those people who did not enter the kingdom do when they see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom, but they themselves are not in it?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~28#Question:What will those people who did not enter the kingdom do when they see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom, but they themselves are not in it?
trans-unit.source: What will those people who did not enter the kingdom do when they see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom, but they themselves are not in it?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao ambao hawajaingia katika ufalme watafanya nini watakapoona Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na manabii wote katika ufalme, lakini wao wenyewe hawako ndani yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Question:What will those people who did not enter the kingdom do when they see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom, but they themselves are not in it?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~28#Answer:What will those people who did not enter the kingdom do when they see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom, but they themselves are not in it?332640940
trans-unit.source: They will weep and grind their teeth [in rage and frustration]. (28)
trans-unit.target: Humo watakuwa na kulia na kusaga meno.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Answer:What will those people who did not enter the kingdom do when they see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom, but they themselves are not in it?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.29+Where will the people who are at the feast in the kingdom of God come from?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~29#Question:Where will the people who are at the feast in the kingdom of God come from?
trans-unit.source: Where will the people who are at the feast in the kingdom of God come from?
trans-unit.target: Watu watakaokuwa kwenye karamu katika ufalme wa Mungu watatoka wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~29#Question:Where will the people who are at the feast in the kingdom of God come from?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~29#Answer:Where will the people who are at the feast in the kingdom of God come from?-271151654
trans-unit.source: They will come from all the directions/parts of the world, (east, west, north, and south) [where the Gentiles/the non-Jews live]. (29)
trans-unit.target: Watakuja kutoka pande zote/sehemu za ulimwengu, (mashariki, magharibi, kaskazini, na kusini) [ambapo Wasio Wayahudi/wasio Wayahudi wanaishi]. (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~29#Answer:Where will the people who are at the feast in the kingdom of God come from?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.28-30+Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were last, but will be first in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~28#Question:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were last, but will be first in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were last, but will be first in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani watu ambao Yesu alisema walikuwa wa mwisho, lakini watakuwa wa kwanza katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Question:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were last, but will be first in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~28#Answer:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were last, but will be first in the kingdom of God?382173882
trans-unit.source: Some of the people from all over the world [who are not Jews, or who are not important in ways that the world thinks is important, or who hear last about Jesus as their savior].
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya watu kutoka duniani kote [ambao si Wayahudi, au ambao si muhimu katika njia ambazo ulimwengu unafikiri ni muhimu, au ambao wanasikia mwisho juu ya Yesu kama mwokozi wao].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Answer:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were last, but will be first in the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.28-30+Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were first, but would be last in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~28#Question:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were first, but would be last in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were first, but would be last in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani watu ambao Yesu alisema walikuwa wa kwanza, lakini wangekuwa wa mwisho katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Question:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were first, but would be last in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~28#Answer:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were first, but would be last in the kingdom of God?-937004251
trans-unit.source: Some of the Jews [who thought that God would automatically allow them to enter because they were descendants of Abraham]. (God had said that they were his special people. They also had been the first culture to hear the Good News about being saved.)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya Wayahudi [walifikiri kwamba Mungu angewaruhusu kuingia kwa sababu walikuwa wazao wa Abrahamu] (Mungu alikuwa amesema kuwa wao ni watu wake wa pekee. Pia utamaduni wao ulikuwa umesikia juu ya wokovu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Answer:Who do you think are the people whom Jesus said were first, but would be last in the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.28-30+What is the reason, do you think, that those people will be as angry and frustrated as the people in this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~28#Question:What is the reason, do you think, that those people will be as angry and frustrated as the people in this parable?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason, do you think, that those people will be as angry and frustrated as the people in this parable?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu hao watakuwa na hasira na kukata tamaa kama watu wa mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Question:What is the reason, do you think, that those people will be as angry and frustrated as the people in this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~28#Answer:What is the reason, do you think, that those people will be as angry and frustrated as the people in this parable?1063970923
trans-unit.source: They will see some of their ancestors and other Jews there in the kingdom and will feel they, too, should be there because they are also Jews. But Jesus does not choose people on that basis, so they are left outside the kingdom (and the blessings people will receive there).
trans-unit.target: Wataona baadhi ya mababu zao na Wayahudi wengine huko katika ufalme na watahisi kwamba wao pia wanapaswa kuwa huko kwa sababu wao pia ni Wayahudi. Lakini Yesu hawachagui watu kwa msingi huo, kwa hiyo wanaachwa nje ya ufalme (na baraka ambazo watu watapokea huko).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~28#Answer:What is the reason, do you think, that those people will be as angry and frustrated as the people in this parable?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!13~31#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 13:31-35 Jesus was not concerned about how King Herod would treat him, but how the people of Jerusalem treated God's messengers.
trans-unit.target: Luka 13:31-35 Yesu hakuhangaikia jinsi Mfalme Herode angemtendea, bali jinsi watu wa Yerusalemu walivyowatendea wajumbe wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 13.31-35+What did Jesus's words about King Herod imply to you about changing his plans to continue going towards Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~31#Question:What did Jesus's words about King Herod imply to you about changing his plans to continue going towards Jerusalem?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus's words about King Herod imply to you about changing his plans to continue going towards Jerusalem?
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya Yesu kuhusu Mfalme Herode yalimaanisha nini kwako kuhusu kubadilisha mipango yake ya kuendelea kuelekea Yerusalemu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Question:What did Jesus's words about King Herod imply to you about changing his plans to continue going towards Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~31#Answer:What did Jesus's words about King Herod imply to you about changing his plans to continue going towards Jerusalem?-712669130
trans-unit.source: Jesus talked as though he was not worried about King Herod, but would continue doing just as he had already planned to do./Jesus indicated he did not intend to change his plans.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumza kana kwamba hakuwa na wasiwasi juu ya Mfalme Herode, lakini angeendelea kufanya kama vile alikuwa tayari amepanga kufanya./Yesu alionyesha hakukusudia kubadilisha mipango yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Answer:What did Jesus's words about King Herod imply to you about changing his plans to continue going towards Jerusalem?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.31-35+What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~31#Question:What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichokuwa sababu za yeye kusema kwa huzuni sana juu ya Yerusalemu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Question:What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~31#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?716678492
trans-unit.source: Jesus spoke sadly because [the people of] Jerusalem had often killed the prophets and other messengers God had sent to them, (34)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwa huzuni kwa sababu [watu wa] Yerusalemu mara nyingi waliwaua manabii na wajumbe wengine waliotumwa na Mungu kwao, (34)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~31#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?877664100
trans-unit.source: and they had been refusing his (Jesus') attempts to protect them from dangers. (34)
trans-unit.target: Na walikuwa wakikataa kuwaokoa na hatari.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that he spoke so sadly about Jerusalem?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.31+Why did some Pharisees tell Jesus to go to another place?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~31#Question:Why did some Pharisees tell Jesus to go to another place?
trans-unit.source: Why did some Pharisees tell Jesus to go to another place?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo fulani walimwambia Yesu aende mahali pengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Question:Why did some Pharisees tell Jesus to go to another place?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~31#Answer:Why did some Pharisees tell Jesus to go to another place?-1716655892
trans-unit.source: They said that [King] Herod wanted to kill him. (31)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba [Mfalme] Herode alitaka kumwua. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~31#Answer:Why did some Pharisees tell Jesus to go to another place?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.32+What name did Jesus call King Herod?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~32#Question:What name did Jesus call King Herod?
trans-unit.source: What name did Jesus call King Herod?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwita Mfalme Herode kwa jina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~32#Question:What name did Jesus call King Herod?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~32#Answer:What name did Jesus call King Herod?-2103781514
trans-unit.source: He called him a fox (or some other culturally appropriate comparison). (32)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita mbweha (au kulinganisha nyingine kiutamaduni sahihi). (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~32#Answer:What name did Jesus call King Herod?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.32+What did Jesus say about his plans and King Herod?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~32#Question:What did Jesus say about his plans and King Herod?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about his plans and King Herod?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu mipango yake na Mfalme Herode?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~32#Question:What did Jesus say about his plans and King Herod?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~32#Answer:What did Jesus say about his plans and King Herod?511929077
trans-unit.source: He said that he would continue for a [short] time to cast out demons [from people] and heal [their] diseases and then would reach his goal/the end of his work just as he had planned. He said that the Pharisees could tell King Herod that. (32)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba angeendelea kwa muda [mfupi] kufukuza pepo [kutoka kwa watu] na kuponya magonjwa [yao] na kisha angefika lengo lake/mwisho wa kazi yake kama alivyopanga. Alisema kwamba Mafarisayo wangeweza kumwambia Mfalme Herode hilo. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~32#Answer:What did Jesus say about his plans and King Herod?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.34+What had the people who lived in Jerusalem done to prophets and other messengers whom God had sent to them?

trans-unit.source: What had the people who lived in Jerusalem done to prophets and other messengers whom God had sent to them?

group.id: Q:LUK 13.34-35+Tell me about stoning people.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~34#Question:Tell me about stoning people.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about stoning people.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu kuwapiga watu mawe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~34#Question:Tell me about stoning people.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~34#Answer:Tell me about stoning people.-137623420
trans-unit.source: Stoning refers to throwing stones, big or small, at a person for the purpose of killing him. Usually many people joined in the throwing.
trans-unit.target: Mshambuliaji huyo aliuawa kwa kupigwa mawe, na watu wengi walijiunga naye.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~34#Answer:Tell me about stoning people.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~34#Note:Tell me about stoning people.-1161659062
trans-unit.source: Stoning was a way that God had said the Jews were to punish a person who blasphemed him. When the people of Jerusalem had stoned God's messengers, it was because the people or leaders had not accepted those prophets' messages as having come from God. They said that the messenger had made fun of God and had been disrespectful to him. The punishment for that was to die by stoning. (See Lev. 24:13-16.)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa amewaambia Wayahudi kwamba watu wanapaswa kumpiga mawe mtu anayemkufuru Mungu. Wakati watu wa Yerusalemu walipopiga mawe wajumbe wa Mungu, ilikuwa kwa sababu watu au viongozi hawakuwa wamepokea ujumbe wa manabii hao kuwa umetoka kwa Mungu. Walisema kwamba mjumbe alikuwa amemdhihaki Mungu na alikuwa amemdharau. Adhabu ya hiyo ilikuwa kufa kwa kupigwa mawe (Ona Law. 24:13-16).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~34#Note:Tell me about stoning people.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~34#Note:Tell me about stoning people.-1509194174
trans-unit.source: Use this question only if the translation does not already make the meaning clear.
trans-unit.target: Tumia swali hilo ikiwa tafsiri haijafafanua maana ya maneno hayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~34#Note:Tell me about stoning people.

group.id: Q:LUK 13.35+What did Jesus want them to realize?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!13~35#Question:What did Jesus want them to realize?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus want them to realize?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka watambue nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~35#Question:What did Jesus want them to realize?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!13~35#Answer:What did Jesus want them to realize?-1818018706
trans-unit.source: Their city/temple/country was no longer protected [by God]. It would be destroyed. (35)
trans-unit.target: Mji/hekalu/nchi yao haikuwa tena chini ya ulinzi [wa Mungu] na ingeharibiwa. (35)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!13~35#Note:What did Jesus want them to realize?-1865243750
trans-unit.source: The Roman army did destroy Jerusalem and the temple and sent all the Jews away from there while the disciple John was still living. See Matt. 27:25.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!13~35#Note:What did Jesus want them to realize?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~3#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the experts in the Law did not answer Jesus either time he asked them a question/made a strong statement to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~3#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the experts in the Law did not answer Jesus either time he asked them a question/made a strong statement to them?-409728483
trans-unit.source: The way that Jesus had asked/said what he did implied that everyone would agree with him.
trans-unit.target: Njia ambayo Yesu alikuwa ameuliza/kusema alichofanya ilionyesha kwamba kila mtu angekubaliana naye.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~3#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the experts in the Law did not answer Jesus either time he asked them a question/made a strong statement to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~3#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the experts in the Law did not answer Jesus either time he asked them a question/made a strong statement to them?-1447377454
trans-unit.source: What he had said was what each of them knew they should do or wanted to do, even on the Sabbath Day.
trans-unit.target: Alilowaambia lilikuwa ni jambo ambalo kila mmoja wao alijua kwamba alipaswa kufanya au alitaka kufanya, hata siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~3#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and the experts in the Law did not answer Jesus either time he asked them a question/made a strong statement to them?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.1+Where was Jesus when he healed the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~1#Question:Where was Jesus when he healed the man?
trans-unit.source: Where was Jesus when he healed the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa wapi alipomponya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~1#Question:Where was Jesus when he healed the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~1#Answer:Where was Jesus when he healed the man?622085897
trans-unit.source: He was at the house of a leader/ruler of the Pharisees. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa nyumbani kwa kiongozi/mtawala wa Mafarisayo. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~1#Answer:Where was Jesus when he healed the man?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.2+What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~2#Question:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu/Mfarisayo waliokuwapo walimchunguza Yesu kwa makini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~2#Question:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~2#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?-1360287753
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the people who were there were watching Jesus carefully?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu waliokuwa hapo walimtazama Yesu kwa makini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~2#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~2#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?-765766318
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mafarisayo waliokuwapo walimchunguza Yesu kwa makini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~2#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~2#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?1068226605
trans-unit.source: There was a man with swollen arms and legs there in front of Jesus (2). They probably wanted to see if Jesus would heal him on the Sabbath Day.
trans-unit.target: Mbele yake kulikuwa na mtu aliyevimba mikono na miguu (2). Labda walitaka kuona ikiwa Yesu angemponya mtu huyo siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~2#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~2#Note:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?-443916460
trans-unit.source: The experts in the Law were right there to be witnesses who later could accuse Jesus of breaking God's Law and, thusly, deserved to die (see Exod. 20: 8-11; Num. 15:32-36).
trans-unit.target: Wataalamu wa Sheria walikuwa pale pale ili wawe mashahidi ambao baadaye wangeweza kumshtaki Yesu kwa kuvunja Sheria ya Mungu na, kwa hivyo, alistahili kufa (ona Kutoka 20: 8-11; Hes. 15:32-36).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~2#Note:What do you think was the reason that the people/Pharisees who were there were watching Jesus carefully?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.4+How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law answer Jesus's question to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~4#Question:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law answer Jesus's question to them?
trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law answer Jesus's question to them?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa Sheria walijibuje swali la Yesu kwao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~4#Question:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law answer Jesus's question to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~4#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law answer Jesus's question to them?215928332
trans-unit.source: They were silent./They did not answer him. (4)
trans-unit.target: Wakanyamaza. / Hawakumjibu. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~4#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the experts in the Law answer Jesus's question to them?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.1-4+What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and experts in the Law did not answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~1#Question:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and experts in the Law did not answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and experts in the Law did not answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa Sheria hawakumjibu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~1#Question:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and experts in the Law did not answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~1#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and experts in the Law did not answer Jesus?1589721119
trans-unit.source: They did not want to answer Jesus's questions because they knew they had not been doing what God wanted them to do. [Moses's Law was their guide, and they knew that they were not following it as they should.]
trans-unit.target: Hawakutaka kujibu maswali ya Yesu kwa sababu walijua kwamba hawakuwa wakifanya kile ambacho Mungu alitaka wafanye. [Sheria ya Kimusa ilikuwa mwongozo wao, na walijua kwamba hawakuifuata kama ilivyofaa.]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~1#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the Pharisees and experts in the Law did not answer Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.4+What did Jesus do with the sick man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~4#Question:What did Jesus do with the sick man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do with the sick man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini kwa ajili ya mtu huyo mgonjwa?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~4#Answer:What did Jesus do with the sick man?-1925632476
trans-unit.source: Jesus took hold of the man and healed him, then sent him away. (4)
trans-unit.target: Yesu anamshika mtu huyo na kumponya, kisha anamwambia aende zake. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~4#Answer:What did Jesus do with the sick man?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.5-6+Tell me about wells.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~5#Question:Tell me about wells.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about wells.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu visima.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~5#Question:Tell me about wells.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~5#Answer:Tell me about wells.-679673914
trans-unit.source: A well is a hole men dig for the purpose of bringing some liquid up from under the ground. In Jesus's example, the people would have understood it to be a well for water.
trans-unit.target: Katika mfano wa Yesu, watu wangeelewa kwamba kisima hicho ni kisima cha maji.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~5#Answer:Tell me about wells.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~5#Note:Tell me about wells.-1509194174
trans-unit.source: Use this question only if the translation does not already make the meaning clear.
trans-unit.target: Tumia swali hilo ikiwa tafsiri haijafafanua maana ya maneno hayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~5#Note:Tell me about wells.

trans-unit.source: Luke 14:7-14 God honors people who are humble.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 14.7-14+What did Jesus tell the people at the Pharisee's feast about receiving great honor and not great shame?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~7#Question:What did Jesus tell the people at the Pharisee's feast about receiving great honor and not great shame?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the people at the Pharisee's feast about receiving great honor and not great shame?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini watu kwenye karamu ya Farisayo juu ya kupokea heshima kubwa na si aibu kubwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Question:What did Jesus tell the people at the Pharisee's feast about receiving great honor and not great shame?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~7#Answer:What did Jesus tell the people at the Pharisee's feast about receiving great honor and not great shame?402143592
trans-unit.source: People who seek honor for themselves will be shamed/embarrassed/humiliated. It is the person who is humble whom [God] will honor. (11) (A person should not expect to be honored. Others should decide if, or how, a person is to be honored.)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaojitafutia utukufu wao wenyewe watafedheheshwa/kufedheheshwa/kufedheheshwa. Ni mtu ambaye ni mnyenyekevu ambaye [Mungu] atamheshimu. (11) (Mtu haipaswi kutarajia kuheshimiwa. Wengine wanapaswa kuamua ikiwa, au jinsi, mtu anapaswa kuheshimiwa.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Answer:What did Jesus tell the people at the Pharisee's feast about receiving great honor and not great shame?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.7-14+What did he tell them about being a good host?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~7#Question:What did he tell them about being a good host?
trans-unit.source: What did he tell them about being a good host?
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia nini kuhusu kuwa wenyeji wazuri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Question:What did he tell them about being a good host?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~7#Answer:What did he tell them about being a good host?-1509998238
trans-unit.source: The host should honor the poor [people] and those who have physical problems by inviting them to special meals. (12-14)
trans-unit.target: Mwenyeji apaswa kuwaheshimu maskini na wale walio na matatizo ya kimwili kwa kuwaalika kwenye milo ya pekee. (12-14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Answer:What did he tell them about being a good host?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.7-14+How should people decide when they should be honored and when other people should be honored?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~7#Question:How should people decide when they should be honored and when other people should be honored?
trans-unit.source: How should people decide when they should be honored and when other people should be honored?
trans-unit.target: Watu wapaswa kuamuaje wakati wao wanapopaswa kuheshimiwa na wakati watu wengine wanapopaswa kuheshimiwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Question:How should people decide when they should be honored and when other people should be honored?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~7#Answer:How should people decide when they should be honored and when other people should be honored?-1997056685
trans-unit.source: We should always be humble (11) and allow others, or God, to honor us when they decide it is appropriate (14).
trans-unit.target: Sikuzote tunapaswa kuwa wanyenyekevu (11) na kuwaruhusu wengine, au Mungu, atuheshimu wanapoamua kwamba inafaa (14).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~7#Answer:How should people decide when they should be honored and when other people should be honored?

trans-unit.source: The host might come with someone else who has greater honor than he does.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~8#Answer:What did Jesus say might happen if a guest sat in/chose the most honored place at a wedding feast?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~8#Answer:What did Jesus say might happen if a guest sat in/chose the most honored place at a wedding feast?1340684210
trans-unit.source: The host might tell him to move to some other place because the host wants to honor the other guest more. (8-9)
trans-unit.target: Mwenye kumkaribisha huenda akamwambia aende mahali pengine kwa sababu mwenye kumkaribisha ataka kumheshimu mgeni mwingine zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~8#Answer:What did Jesus say might happen if a guest sat in/chose the most honored place at a wedding feast?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.9+How would that first guest feel? What would he have to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~9#Question:How would that first guest feel? What would he have to do?
trans-unit.source: How would that first guest feel? What would he have to do?
trans-unit.target: Mgeni huyo wa kwanza angehisije? Angehitaji kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~9#Question:How would that first guest feel? What would he have to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~9#Answer:How would that first guest feel? What would he have to do?1895750703
trans-unit.source: The first guest would be embarrassed to have to move to the place of least honor. (9)
trans-unit.target: Mgeni wa kwanza angejiona kuwa mwenye kuaibika kwa kulazimika kuhamia mahali pa chini zaidi. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~9#Answer:How would that first guest feel? What would he have to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.10+What did Jesus say a guest should do instead of taking the place of most honor?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~10#Question:What did Jesus say a guest should do instead of taking the place of most honor?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a guest should do instead of taking the place of most honor?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mgeni apaswa kufanya nini badala ya kuchukua mahali pa heshima zaidi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Question:What did Jesus say a guest should do instead of taking the place of most honor?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~10#Answer:What did Jesus say a guest should do instead of taking the place of most honor?1854200245
trans-unit.source: He said that the guest should choose the place of least honor. (10)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mgeni apaswa kuchagua mahali pa chini zaidi. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Answer:What did Jesus say a guest should do instead of taking the place of most honor?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.10+What might the host of the feast say to that guest?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~10#Question:What might the host of the feast say to that guest?
trans-unit.source: What might the host of the feast say to that guest?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye-mlo anaweza kumwambia nini mgeni huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Question:What might the host of the feast say to that guest?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~10#Answer:What might the host of the feast say to that guest?-1181948890
trans-unit.source: He might say, "[My] Friend, move to a better (more honored) place." (10)
trans-unit.target: Huenda akasema, "[Rafiki yangu] ondoka uende mahali pazuri zaidi". (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Answer:What might the host of the feast say to that guest?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~10#Note:What might the host of the feast say to that guest?-1833030428
trans-unit.source: Many of the English language translations refer to the places of honor in this story with words such as "move up/higher/forward" or "move down/lower/backward" to reflect greater or lesser honor. That is culturally appropriate for English, but may not be the appropriate way to express greater or lesser honor in the language of the translation. Use what is correct for the language of the translation.
trans-unit.target: Tafsiri nyingi za lugha ya Kiingereza zinarejelea mahali pa heshima katika hadithi hii kwa maneno kama "kuhamia juu / juu / mbele" au "kuhamia chini / chini / nyuma" ili kuonyesha heshima kubwa au ndogo. Hiyo ni sawa kwa Kiingereza, lakini inaweza kuwa sio njia sahihi ya kuelezea heshima kubwa au ndogo katika lugha ya tafsiri. Tumia kile sahihi kwa lugha ya tafsiri.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Note:What might the host of the feast say to that guest?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.10+What will be the result of that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~10#Question:What will be the result of that?
trans-unit.source: What will be the result of that?
trans-unit.target: Matokeo yatakuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Question:What will be the result of that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~10#Answer:What will be the result of that?-1007777638
trans-unit.source: All the other guests will see him being honored by the host. [And they, too, will honor him.] (10)
trans-unit.target: Na atamtukuza mbele ya wale walio kuwa pamoja naye, na wote watakuwa pamoja naye.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~10#Answer:What will be the result of that?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.12+Whom would you say that people usually invite to come and eat food with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~12#Question:Whom would you say that people usually invite to come and eat food with them?
trans-unit.source: Whom would you say that people usually invite to come and eat food with them?
trans-unit.target: Ungesema watu huwaalika nani kwa kawaida ili wale chakula pamoja nao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Question:Whom would you say that people usually invite to come and eat food with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~12#Answer:Whom would you say that people usually invite to come and eat food with them?1364719053
trans-unit.source: They invite only their friends, relatives, or people whom they want to impress/influence, such as those who are rich neighbors. (12a)
trans-unit.target: Wao hualika tu marafiki zao, jamaa, au watu ambao wanataka kuwavutia/kushawishi, kama wale ambao ni majirani tajiri. (12a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Answer:Whom would you say that people usually invite to come and eat food with them?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.12+What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema sababu ya kutofanya hivyo ni ipi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?-916660773
trans-unit.source: Those people are all able to invite us in return and pay us back. (12b)
trans-unit.target: Watu hao wote wanaweza kutualika na kutulipa. (12b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~12#Note:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?1204663226
trans-unit.source: He implied that there is no long term benefit in doing that. We have already received whatever good might come back to us (see 14:14b).
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba hakuna faida ya muda mrefu katika kufanya hivyo. Tayari tumepokea chochote kizuri ambacho kinaweza kurudi kwetu (tazama 14:14b).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Note:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should not do that?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.12-14+Whom should people also invite to come and eat a feast with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~12#Question:Whom should people also invite to come and eat a feast with them?
trans-unit.source: Whom should people also invite to come and eat a feast with them?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani wengine ambao watu wapaswa kuwaalika waje kula karamu pamoja nao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Question:Whom should people also invite to come and eat a feast with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~12#Answer:Whom should people also invite to come and eat a feast with them?-959960064
trans-unit.source: We should invite [people who are] poor, crippled, lame, or blind. (13)
trans-unit.target: Badala yake, tunapaswa kuwaalika maskini, vilema, vilema, na vipofu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Answer:Whom should people also invite to come and eat a feast with them?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.12-14+What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema sababu ya kufanya hivyo ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?-2006273286
trans-unit.source: We truly will be happy/feel good about it. (14a)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kweli tutakuwa na furaha/kujisikia vizuri juu yake. (14a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?512221594
trans-unit.source: God will repay us in some way when he raises all the righteous people back to life. (14c)
trans-unit.target: Mungu atatuthawabisha kwa njia fulani atakapowafufua watu wote waadilifu. (14c)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~12#Note:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?1204725332
trans-unit.source: See the explanation of "blessed" at 6:20.
trans-unit.target: Ona maelezo ya "wenye furaha" kwenye 6:20.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~12#Note:What did Jesus say is the reason that we should do that?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!14~15#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 14:15-24 Jesus told a parable about people who refused to come to a great feast.

group.id: Q:LUK 14.15-24+Some people had been invited first, but refused to come when the servant/slave told them everything for the feast was ready. Who do you think that the people who were listening to Jesus understood those people to be?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~15#Question:Some people had been invited first, but refused to come when the servant/slave told them everything for the feast was ready. Who do you think that the people who were listening to Jesus understood those people to be?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.15-24+What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~15#Question:What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kitakachowapata wale walioalikwa kwanza lakini ambao hawakutaka kuja kwenye karamu hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~15#Question:What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~15#Answer:What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?795745746
trans-unit.source: Not one of them will be able to have even a small idea (or, figuratively, even a taste,) of how good God's feast/blessing is. (24)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna mmoja wao atakayeweza kuwa na wazo dogo (au, kwa njia ya mfano, hata kuonja,) jinsi karamu/baraka ya Mungu ilivyo nzuri. (24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~15#Answer:What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~15#Note:What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?-1557028426
trans-unit.source: Jesus implied that those people would not have another opportunity to come. God will not send his messengers to ask/invite them again.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha kwamba watu hao hawangekuwa na nafasi nyingine ya kuja. Mungu hatatuma wajumbe wake kuwauliza/kuwaalika tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~15#Note:What will happen to those people who had been invited first, but did not want to come to that feast?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.15-24+Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~15#Question:Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?
trans-unit.source: Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri mfano wa Yesu ulionyesha kwamba mtu anayetajwa katika mstari wa 15 alikuwa sahihi, au alikuwa amekosea?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~15#Question:Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~15#Answer:Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?-1865082267
trans-unit.source: He was right about the blessings for those people who come to the feast,
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa sahihi kuhusu baraka kwa wale watu ambao kuja sikukuu,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~15#Answer:Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~15#Answer:Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?-2038040650
trans-unit.source: but Jesus also made it clear that many who had first been invited had refused to come when everything was ready (17b-20). They would not receive another opportunity to enjoy the blessings, even though, earlier, they once had been invited (24).
trans-unit.target: lakini Yesu pia aliweka wazi kuwa wengi ambao walikuwa wamealikwa kwanza walikuwa wamekataa kuja wakati kila kitu kilikuwa tayari (17b-20). Hawangekuwa na nafasi nyingine ya kufurahia baraka, ingawa, hapo awali, walikuwa wamealikwa mara moja (24).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~15#Answer:Read verse 15 again. Do you think that Jesus's parable showed that the man who spoke in verse 15 was right in what he said, or that he was wrong?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.21+Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?

trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri kwamba mtumishi / mtumwa akaenda, alifanya hivyo na kurudi, au unafikiri kwamba alikuwa tayari amefanya hivyo, kabla ya mwenye nyumba alimwambia afanye hivyo?

trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri mtumwa huyo alienda, akafanya hivyo na kurudi, au unafikiri kwamba tayari alikuwa amefanya hivyo, kabla ya bwana-mkubwa wa nyumba kumwambia afanye hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~21#Alternate:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~21#Alternate:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?-966468561
trans-unit.source: Do you think that the slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri mtumwa huyo alienda, akafanya hivyo na kurudi, au unafikiri kwamba tayari alikuwa amefanya hivyo, kabla ya bwana-mkubwa wa nyumba kumwambia afanye hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~21#Alternate:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~21#Answer:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?1979672881
trans-unit.source: A servant/slave probably would not have done it before his lord/master told him to do so. He probably did go quickly and bring back those people he had found.
trans-unit.target: Mtumishi/mtumwa pengine asingefanya hivyo mpaka bwana/bwana wake amwambie afanye hivyo. Pengine alienda haraka na kuwaleta wale watu aliowapata.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~21#Answer:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~21#Note:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?1721440729
trans-unit.source: It may be that the brief wording here indicates just how quickly the servant went and did what his master had told him to do. If the translation seems to imply wrongly that he had already done this, suggest ways to avoid that wrong implication. One way may be to say very briefly at the end of verse 21 or at the beginning of verse 22, "The servant went quickly, did that and returned." A different way might be to say in verse 22, "The servant some time later said, ‘...'"
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa tafsiri inaonekana inamaanisha kimakosa kwamba tayari alikuwa amefanya hivyo, toa madokezo ya jinsi ya kuepuka maana hiyo isiyofaa. Njia moja ya kufanya hivyo ni kusema kwa ufupi sana mwishoni mwa mstari wa 21 au mwanzoni mwa mstari wa 22, "Yule mtumishi akaenda zake, akafanya hivyo, akarudi".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~21#Note:Do you think that the servant/slave went, did that and returned, or do you think that he had done it already, before the house owner told him to do it?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!14~25#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 14:25-35 A person who wants to be Jesus's disciple must be ready to let go of everything else he has and expect to be treated the same as Jesus was.
trans-unit.target: Luka 14:25-35 Mtu anayetaka kuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu lazima awe tayari kuacha kila kitu alicho nacho na kutarajia kutendewa kama Yesu alivyotendewa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 14.25-35+What did Jesus say would prevent a person from becoming his disciple?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~25#Question:What did Jesus say would prevent a person from becoming his disciple?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would prevent a person from becoming his disciple?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingemzuia mtu asiwe mwanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Question:What did Jesus say would prevent a person from becoming his disciple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~25#Answer:What did Jesus say would prevent a person from becoming his disciple?-628899533
trans-unit.source: If that person did not hate his family members and even his own life, he could not be Jesus's disciple. (A disciple must be ready to let go of anything else that might prevent him from following Jesus completely.) (26)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu huyo hawachukii washiriki wa familia yake na hata maisha yake mwenyewe, hawezi kuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu. (Mwanafunzi lazima awe tayari kuacha kitu kingine chochote ambacho kingeweza kumzuia asimfuate Yesu kikamili.) (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Answer:What did Jesus say would prevent a person from becoming his disciple?
