group.id: Q:LUK 14.25-35+How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~25#Question:How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?
trans-unit.source: How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?
trans-unit.target: Njia ambayo mfalme hujitayarisha kupigana vita inafananaje na njia ambayo mtu hujitayarisha kuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Question:How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~25#Answer:How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?-439902998
trans-unit.source: When a king prepares to fight in a battle, he first evaluates whether or not he has a large enough army to defeat the enemy (31). If he does not, he [submits to the other leader and] seeks to settle the conflict peacefully.
trans-unit.target: Mfalme anapojitayarisha kupigana vita, kwanza yeye huchunguza kama ana jeshi kubwa la kutosha kushinda adui (31). Ikiwa hana, yeye [hujitiisha kwa kiongozi mwingine na] hutafuta kusuluhisha mzozo kwa amani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Answer:How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~25#Answer:How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?-963379864
trans-unit.source: If a person tries to be a disciple by his own resources, and does not first realize that he never will be able to do so on his own, he is sure to fail. He must first be willing to give up his claim on all the things he has/owns [and submit to God]. (33)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu anajaribu kuwa mwanafunzi kwa uwezo wake mwenyewe, na hajui kwanza kwamba hawezi kamwe kufanya hivyo peke yake, hakika atashindwa. Lazima kwanza awe tayari kuacha madai yake juu ya vitu vyote alivyo navyo/anavyo [na kujisalimisha kwa Mungu]. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Answer:How is the way that a king prepares to fight a battle like someone getting ready to be Jesus's disciple?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.25-35+What do you think is the way that salt which loses its flavor could be like a disciple of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~25#Question:What do you think is the way that salt which loses its flavor could be like a disciple of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the way that salt which loses its flavor could be like a disciple of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri chumvi ambayo imepoteza ladha yake inaweza kuwa kama mwanafunzi wa Yesu kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Question:What do you think is the way that salt which loses its flavor could be like a disciple of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~25#Answer:What do you think is the way that salt which loses its flavor could be like a disciple of Jesus?1230698581
trans-unit.source: If a person tries to be a disciple, it is a very good thing, but if he does not first evaluate everything that might be required of him (26, 27, 28, 33), his life will be as useless/worthless as salt which has lost its flavor (34-35).
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu anajaribu kuwa mwanafunzi, ni jambo zuri sana, lakini ikiwa kwanza hachanganui kila kitu ambacho kinaweza kuhitajika kwake (26, 27, 28, 33), maisha yake yatakuwa ya bure / yasiyo na thamani kama chumvi ambayo imepoteza ladha yake (34-35).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Answer:What do you think is the way that salt which loses its flavor could be like a disciple of Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.26+When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~26#Question:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?
trans-unit.source: When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?
trans-unit.target: Mtu anapochukua kwa uzito kumfuata Yesu, ni lazima awe na maoni gani kuhusu familia yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Question:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~26#Alternate:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?-2068302364
trans-unit.source: When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard his family?
trans-unit.target: Mtu anapochukua kwa uzito kumfuata Yesu, ni lazima aioneje familia yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Alternate:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~26#Alternate:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?451747557
trans-unit.source: When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he think about his family?
trans-unit.target: Mtu anapochukua kwa uzito kumfuata Yesu, ni lazima awe na maoni gani kuhusu familia yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Alternate:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~26#Answer:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?1979509328
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that he must hate his family, (that is, he must love Jesus more than he loves his family). (26)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba ni lazima aichukie familia yake, (yaani, ni lazima ampende Yesu zaidi ya anavyopenda familia yake). (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Answer:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~26#Note:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?2030304965
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Note:When a person is serious about following Jesus, how must he regard/think about his family?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.25-27+God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~25#Question:God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?
trans-unit.source: God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?
trans-unit.target: Mungu anatuambia katika mistari mingine ya Biblia tupende na kuwatii wazazi wetu na kuwapenda wake zetu na watoto wetu. Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba mwanafunzi anapaswa kuwachukia watu wa familia yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Question:God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~25#Answer:God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?-1357397296
trans-unit.source: Jesus did not mean that we should literally hate our family. He was comparing a person's love for his family with a true disciple's love for him/God. Compared to how great a disciple is to love Jesus, his love for his family is like hate.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakumaanisha kwamba tunapaswa kuchukia familia yetu kihalisi. Alikuwa akilinganisha upendo wa mtu kwa familia yake na upendo wa mwanafunzi wa kweli kwake / kwa Mungu. Ikilinganishwa na jinsi mwanafunzi mkubwa anavyompenda Yesu, upendo wake kwa familia yake ni kama chuki.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Answer:God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~25#Note:God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?-215317274
trans-unit.source: Jesus again was speaking extremely strong words/speaking in exaggerations to shock the people into paying close attention to what he meant. This was a way of teaching which Jewish teachers used then, and it was not meant for people to obey literally.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa tena akisema maneno yenye nguvu sana / akiongea kwa kupita kiasi ili kuwashtua watu ili wawe makini sana na kile alichomaanisha. Hii ilikuwa njia ya kufundisha ambayo walimu wa Kiyahudi walitumia wakati huo, na haikukusudiwa watu kutii kihalisi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Note:God tells us in other verses in the Bible to love and obey our parents and to love our wives and children. What do you think that Jesus meant here when he said that a disciple must hate the people in his family?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~26#Question:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?
trans-unit.source: How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo anapaswa kuonaje/kufikirije kuhusu maisha yake mwenyewe na mambo anayotarajia yatakayompata?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Question:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~26#Alternate:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?1444142874

trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo apaswa kuonaje maisha yake mwenyewe na mambo anayotumaini yatakayompata?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Alternate:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~26#Alternate:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?-1867197589
trans-unit.source: How must that person think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo apaswa kufikiriaje maisha yake mwenyewe na mambo anayotumaini yatakayompata?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Alternate:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~26#Answer:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?2017893560
trans-unit.source: He must hate that, too, [compared to how much he is to love Jesus]. (26)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~26#Note:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?1108251330

trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~26#Note:How must that person regard/think about his own life and the things he hopes will happen to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.25-27+What do you think it means to hate oneself?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~25#Question:What do you think it means to hate oneself?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to hate oneself?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kujichukia kunamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Question:What do you think it means to hate oneself?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~25#Answer:What do you think it means to hate oneself?-1994872906
trans-unit.source: It means that a person does not think only about staying alive at all costs. He also does not think only about gathering more of the things which make him happy. (Jesus wanted people to think about God and be totally committed to him first.)
trans-unit.target: Maana yake ni kwamba mtu hafikirii tu kuhusu kuendelea kuishi kwa gharama yoyote ile, wala hafikirii tu kuhusu kukusanya vitu vingi vinavyomfanya awe na furaha (Yesu alitaka watu wafikirie juu ya Mungu na kujitolea kabisa kwake kwanza).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~25#Answer:What do you think it means to hate oneself?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.27+What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~27#Question:What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ilimaanisha nini wakati Yesu alipokuwa duniani mtu alipopeleka msalaba wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Question:What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~27#Answer:What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?-1436711155
trans-unit.source: It meant that person was on his way to die (by being nailed on crossed timbers until he could not breath anymore).
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa ikimaanisha kwamba mtu huyo alikuwa njiani kwenda kufa (kwa kutiwa misumari kwenye miti iliyopangwa mpaka asingeweza kupumua tena).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Answer:What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!14~27#Note:What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?1920014880
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "cross, crucify" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "msalaba, msalaba" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Note:What do you think it meant at the time Jesus lived when a person carried his cross?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.27+What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~27#Question:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kwa watu leo kubeba/kubeba msalaba wa mtu na kumfuata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Question:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~27#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?-1883683005
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for people today to carry one's cross and follow Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri leo watu wanapaswa kuchukua msalaba wao na kumfuata Yesu kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!14~27#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?1918705649
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for people today to bear one's cross and follow Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri leo watu wanapaswa kuchukua msalaba wao na kumfuata Yesu kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Alternate:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~27#Answer:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?-1480037932
trans-unit.source: It means that a person must be willing to suffer whatever happens to him because he is one who follows Jesus. He must be willing to die, even die on a cross, as criminals used to die, in order to remain faithful to God. That person's focus must be on Jesus, not himself.
trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha kwamba mtu lazima awe tayari kuteseka chochote kinachompata kwa sababu yeye ni mmoja wa wafuasi wa Yesu. Lazima awe tayari kufa, hata kufa msalabani, kama wahalifu walivyokuwa wakifa, ili kubaki mwaminifu kwa Mungu. Mtu huyo lazima awe na mtazamo wa Yesu, si juu yake mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~27#Answer:What do you think it means for people today to carry/bear one's cross and follow Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.28+What does a person do before he starts to build any building?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~28#Question:What does a person do before he starts to build any building?
trans-unit.source: What does a person do before he starts to build any building?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini kabla ya kuanza kujenga jengo lolote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~28#Question:What does a person do before he starts to build any building?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~28#Answer:What does a person do before he starts to build any building?-757901440
trans-unit.source: He decides whether he can gather enough resources (such as himself or the help of friends or money) to complete the building once he starts. (28)
trans-unit.target: Anaamua kama anaweza kukusanya rasilimali za kutosha (kama yeye mwenyewe au msaada wa marafiki au pesa) kumaliza jengo mara tu anapoanza. (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~28#Answer:What does a person do before he starts to build any building?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.29-30+What is one result that the builder does not want to happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~29#Question:What is one result that the builder does not want to happen?
trans-unit.source: What is one result that the builder does not want to happen?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini moja ya matokeo ambayo mjenzi hataki yatokee?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~29#Question:What is one result that the builder does not want to happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~29#Answer:What is one result that the builder does not want to happen?606686751
trans-unit.source: If he makes the foundation/base and then does not have enough resources to finish the building, the people who see that will mock/make fun of him (29) because he was not able to finish what he started (30).
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa ataweka msingi/msingi na kisha ashindwe kuwa na rasilimali za kutosha kumaliza jengo hilo, watu wanaouona watamdhihaki/kumdhihaki (29) kwa sababu hakuweza kumaliza kile alichoanza (30).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~29#Answer:What is one result that the builder does not want to happen?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.31+What will a king do before he goes out to fight an enemy and defeat him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~31#Question:What will a king do before he goes out to fight an enemy and defeat him?
trans-unit.source: What will a king do before he goes out to fight an enemy and defeat him?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme atafanya nini kabla ya kwenda kupigana na adui na kumshinda?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~31#Question:What will a king do before he goes out to fight an enemy and defeat him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~31#Answer:What will a king do before he goes out to fight an enemy and defeat him?1635189139
trans-unit.source: He decides whether he has enough men/soldiers to fight and win over the enemy. (31)
trans-unit.target: Anaamua kama ana wanaume / askari wa kutosha kupigana na kushinda adui. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~31#Answer:What will a king do before he goes out to fight an enemy and defeat him?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.32+What will that king do if he decides his group of men is not large enough or strong enough to win such a fight?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~32#Question:What will that king do if he decides his group of men is not large enough or strong enough to win such a fight?
trans-unit.source: What will that king do if he decides his group of men is not large enough or strong enough to win such a fight?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme huyo atafanya nini akiamua kwamba kikundi chake cha wanaume si kikubwa vya kutosha au chenye nguvu vya kutosha kushinda vita hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~32#Question:What will that king do if he decides his group of men is not large enough or strong enough to win such a fight?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~32#Answer:What will that king do if he decides his group of men is not large enough or strong enough to win such a fight?1081370762
trans-unit.source: He will send a group quickly to represent him to the other king and ask what they must do to have peace. (32)
trans-unit.target: Atatuma kikundi haraka kumwakilisha kwa mfalme mwingine na kuuliza ni nini wanapaswa kufanya ili kuwa na amani. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~32#Answer:What will that king do if he decides his group of men is not large enough or strong enough to win such a fight?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.35+After salt loses its salty flavor, for what can it be used?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~35#Question:After salt loses its salty flavor, for what can it be used?
trans-unit.source: After salt loses its salty flavor, for what can it be used?
trans-unit.target: Chumvi inapopoteza ladha yake, inaweza kutumiwa kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~35#Question:After salt loses its salty flavor, for what can it be used?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~35#Answer:After salt loses its salty flavor, for what can it be used?-169946601
trans-unit.source: Nothing. It is not even useful [to mix in] with dirt or manure/dung [for later use as fertilizer]. (35)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna kitu. Haifai hata kuchanganywa na uchafu au mbolea [ili itumike baadaye kama mbolea]. (35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~35#Answer:After salt loses its salty flavor, for what can it be used?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.35+What happens to that kind of salt?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~35#Question:What happens to that kind of salt?
trans-unit.source: What happens to that kind of salt?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hutukia kwa chumvi ya aina hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~35#Question:What happens to that kind of salt?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~35#Answer:What happens to that kind of salt?147841142
trans-unit.source: It is thrown out [on the ground as being useless]. (35)
trans-unit.target: Basi utafukuzwa (kwa majini).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~35#Answer:What happens to that kind of salt?

group.id: Q:LUK 14.35+When Jesus finished telling these three comparisons about a person being his disciple, he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think he meant?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!14~35#Question:When Jesus finished telling these three comparisons about a person being his disciple, he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think he meant?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus finished telling these three comparisons about a person being his disciple, he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think he meant?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kutoa mifano hii mitatu kuhusu mtu kuwa mwanafunzi wake, alisema kwamba watu wenye masikio na wasikilize. Kila mtu ana masikio. Unafikiri alimaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~35#Question:When Jesus finished telling these three comparisons about a person being his disciple, he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think he meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!14~35#Answer:When Jesus finished telling these three comparisons about a person being his disciple, he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think he meant?-1069372203
trans-unit.source: He meant that everyone should pay attention [and think carefully about the hidden meaning behind each illustration].
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba kila mtu apaswa kusikiliza [na kufikiria kwa uangalifu maana iliyofichwa ya kila kielezi].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!14~35#Answer:When Jesus finished telling these three comparisons about a person being his disciple, he said that the people with ears should listen. Every person has ears. What do you think he meant?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!15~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 15:1-7 Jesus told a parable about a man who looked for a lost sheep until he found it.
trans-unit.target: Luka 15:1-7 Yesu alisimulia mfano wa mtu aliyemtafuta kondoo aliyepotea mpaka alipompata.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 15.1-7+How did Jesus relate the lost sheep to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~1#Question:How did Jesus relate the lost sheep to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus relate the lost sheep to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganishaje kondoo waliopotea na wale watu ambao Mafarisayo waliwaita "watenda dhambi"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~1#Question:How did Jesus relate the lost sheep to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~1#Answer:How did Jesus relate the lost sheep to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?996347831
trans-unit.source: He said that there is more rejoicing in heaven [by God] over one sinner who repents than over the 99 [people] who are/who think they are righteous [already] and do not need to repent. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kuna shangwe zaidi mbinguni [na Mungu] juu ya mtenda dhambi mmoja atubuye kuliko juu ya [watu] 99 ambao wanafikiri kwamba wao ni waadilifu [tayari] na hawahitaji kutubu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~1#Answer:How did Jesus relate the lost sheep to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.1-2+The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~1#Question:The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?
trans-unit.source: The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?
trans-unit.target: Kikundi cha mwisho cha watu ambao Yesu alizungumza nao kilikuwa umati mkubwa (14:25). Ni nani waliofanya watu kumsikiliza Yesu sasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~1#Question:The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~1#Answer:The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?-779931659
trans-unit.source: Men who collected taxes and other people whom the religious leaders regarded as sinners. Those were people who did not follow all the ways Pharisees said that were necessary to fully please God. (1)
trans-unit.target: Watu waliotenda dhambi, kama walivyoitwa na viongozi wa kidini, walikuwa watoza ushuru na wengine ambao hawakufuata njia zote ambazo Mafarisayo walisema zilihitajika ili kumpendeza Mungu kikamili. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~1#Answer:The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~1#Answer:The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?-2142174811
trans-unit.source: There also were Pharisees and teachers of the Law there. (2)
trans-unit.target: Pia, Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria walikuwapo. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~1#Answer:The last group of people to whom Jesus spoke had been a large crowd (14:25). Who made up the people listening to Jesus now?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.2+What was the Pharisees' concern?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~2#Question:What was the Pharisees' concern?
trans-unit.source: What was the Pharisees' concern?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walihangaikia nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~2#Question:What was the Pharisees' concern?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~2#Answer:What was the Pharisees' concern?873367095
trans-unit.source: They did not like it that Jesus welcomed the "sinners" and ate with them. (2)
trans-unit.target: Hawakufurahia kwamba Yesu aliwakaribisha "watenda-dhambi" na kula pamoja nao. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~2#Answer:What was the Pharisees' concern?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.4+What did Jesus say a person does when he loses one sheep out of his flock of 100?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~4#Question:What did Jesus say a person does when he loses one sheep out of his flock of 100?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a person does when he loses one sheep out of his flock of 100?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mtu hufanya nini wakati mmojawapo wa kondoo zake 100 anapopotea?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~4#Question:What did Jesus say a person does when he loses one sheep out of his flock of 100?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~4#Answer:What did Jesus say a person does when he loses one sheep out of his flock of 100?920548763
trans-unit.source: He leaves the 99 [sheep] out in the open countryside and goes after the lost [sheep] until he finds it. (4)
trans-unit.target: Anaacha wale 99 nyikani na kwenda kumtafuta yule aliyepotea mpaka ampate. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~4#Answer:What did Jesus say a person does when he loses one sheep out of his flock of 100?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.5-6+What does that person do when he finds that sheep?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~5#Question:What does that person do when he finds that sheep?
trans-unit.source: What does that person do when he finds that sheep?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo hufanya nini anapompata kondoo huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~5#Question:What does that person do when he finds that sheep?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~5#Answer:What does that person do when he finds that sheep?-271046650
trans-unit.source: He joyfully puts it on his shoulders (5), and goes home (6).
trans-unit.target: Analichukua kwa shangwe na kulibeba juu ya mabega yake (5), kisha anaondoka kwenda nyumbani (6).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~5#Answer:What does that person do when he finds that sheep?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~5#Answer:What does that person do when he finds that sheep?1611711919
trans-unit.source: Going into the house, he calls together [his] friends and neighbors to rejoice with him. (6)
trans-unit.target: Akiingia nyumbani, yeye huwaita pamoja marafiki [wake] na majirani ili washangilie pamoja naye. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~5#Answer:What does that person do when he finds that sheep?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!15~8#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 15:8-10 Jesus told a parable about a woman who looked for her lost coin until she found it.
trans-unit.target: Luka 15:8-10 Yesu alitoa mfano wa mwanamke aliyeitafuta sarafu yake iliyopotea mpaka aliipata.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 15.8-10+How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~8#Question:How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganishaje sarafu iliyopotea na wale ambao Mafarisayo waliwaita "watenda-dhambi"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Question:How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~8#Answer:How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?-470895217
trans-unit.source: He said that there is rejoicing in the presence of God's angels over one sinner who repents. (10)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kuna shangwe mbele ya malaika wa Mungu juu ya mtenda-dhambi mmoja atubuye. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Answer:How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!15~8#Note:How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?405638927
trans-unit.source: This probably means that God rejoices and his "friends and neighbors", the angels, rejoice with him. God's joy over a sinner who repents and turns back to him is the theme of all of this chapter.
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea hilo lamaanisha kwamba Mungu hushangilia na "rafiki zake na majirani", malaika, hushangilia pamoja naye. Shangwe ya Mungu juu ya mtenda-dhambi atubuyeye na kumrudia ndiyo kichwa kikuu cha sura hii yote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Note:How did Jesus relate the lost coin to those people whom the Pharisees referred to as "sinners"?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.8+How many coins did the woman first have and how many did she lose?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~8#Question:How many coins did the woman first have and how many did she lose?
trans-unit.source: How many coins did the woman first have and how many did she lose?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alikuwa na sarafu ngapi kwanza na alipoteza ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Question:How many coins did the woman first have and how many did she lose?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~8#Answer:How many coins did the woman first have and how many did she lose?1863616711
trans-unit.source: She first had 10 (silver) coins, but lost one. (8)
trans-unit.target: Mwanzoni alikuwa na sarafu 10 (za fedha), lakini akapoteza moja. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Answer:How many coins did the woman first have and how many did she lose?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.8+What did Jesus say that woman did about the lost coin?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~8#Question:What did Jesus say that woman did about the lost coin?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that woman did about the lost coin?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mwanamke huyo alifanya nini kuhusu sarafu iliyopotea?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Question:What did Jesus say that woman did about the lost coin?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~8#Answer:What did Jesus say that woman did about the lost coin?-1639855472
trans-unit.source: She lighted a lamp and swept the house and searched carefully until she found it. (8)
trans-unit.target: Anawasha taa na kufagia nyumba na kutafuta kwa uangalifu mpaka ampate. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~8#Answer:What did Jesus say that woman did about the lost coin?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.9+What did that woman do when she found that coin?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~9#Question:What did that woman do when she found that coin?
trans-unit.source: What did that woman do when she found that coin?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alifanya nini alipopata sarafu hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~9#Question:What did that woman do when she found that coin?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~9#Answer:What did that woman do when she found that coin?130179190
trans-unit.source: She called together [her] friends and neighbors to rejoice with her. (9)
trans-unit.target: Anawaita marafiki na majirani wake ili washangilie pamoja naye. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~9#Answer:What did that woman do when she found that coin?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!15~11#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 15:11-32 Jesus told a parable about a son who came back to his father.
trans-unit.target: Luka 15:11-32 Yesu alisimulia mfano wa mwana aliyerudi kwa baba yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 15.11-32+What people are in this parable which Jesus told?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~11#Question:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?
trans-unit.source: What people are in this parable which Jesus told?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu gani katika mfano huu ambao Yesu alitoa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Question:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?1159102949
trans-unit.source: There is a father and his two sons (11),
trans-unit.target: Kuna baba na wanawe wawili (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?-679823814
trans-unit.source: the citizen/national of a far away country (15),
trans-unit.target: raia/mwananchi wa nchi ya mbali (15),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?-448123053
trans-unit.source: and the father's servants/slaves (22, 26).
trans-unit.target: na watumishi/watumwa wa baba (22, 26).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:What people are in this parable which Jesus told?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.11-32+How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~11#Question:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?
trans-unit.source: How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?
trans-unit.target: Mfano kuhusu baba na wanawe wawili unafananaje na hadithi za kondoo aliyepotea (ona 15:6-7) na sarafu iliyopotea (ona 15:9-10)?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Question:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?800784383
trans-unit.source: The father said that his younger son had been lost and now was found. (24b, 32c)
trans-unit.target: Baba alisema kwamba mwana wake mdogo alikuwa amepotea na sasa amepatikana. (24b, 32c)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?668508667
trans-unit.source: He also told others to celebrate with him about this. (23b, 24c, 32a)
trans-unit.target: Pia aliwaambia wengine kusherehekea pamoja naye juu ya hili (23b, 24c, 32a).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?640536472
trans-unit.source: He was rejoicing more over one sinning son who repented than over the faithful son who had stayed with him and thought that he always acted rightly (29) and did not need to repent. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na furaha zaidi juu ya mwana mmoja mwenye dhambi aliyetubu kuliko juu ya mwana mwaminifu aliyekuwa amekaa naye na kufikiri kwamba sikuzote alitenda sawasawa (29) na hakuhitaji kutubu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the parable about the father and his two sons similar to the stories of the lost sheep (see 15:6-7) and the lost coin (see 15:9-10)?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.11-32+How is the father in the story a picture of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~11#Question:How is the father in the story a picture of God?
trans-unit.source: How is the father in the story a picture of God?
trans-unit.target: Baba katika hadithi hiyo ni mfano wa Mungu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Question:How is the father in the story a picture of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the father in the story a picture of God?-610805411
trans-unit.source: God is ready to forgive any sinner who truly repents and comes back to him. (17-24)
trans-unit.target: Mungu yuko tayari kumsamehe mtenda dhambi yeyote anayetubu kikweli na kumrudia (17-24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the father in the story a picture of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the father in the story a picture of God?-1831394783
trans-unit.source: God and those who belong to him are happy when each sinner does repent and return to God. (23b, 24c, 32)
trans-unit.target: Mungu na wale walio wake wanafurahi wakati kila mtenda dhambi anapotubu na kumrudia Mungu. (23b, 24c, 32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the father in the story a picture of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the father in the story a picture of God?-609749498
trans-unit.source: God wants all those people who feel they are better children of God's than some other people who come back to God later on (29) to recognize the true reason for rejoicing (32). The faithfulness of that long-term, continuous service to God will be adequately rewarded later (31), but that should not stop them from rejoicing every time a lost "brother" or "sister" returns to the family of God.
trans-unit.target: Mungu anataka watu wote wanaohisi kuwa ni watoto wa Mungu bora kuliko watu wengine ambao baadaye wanamrudia Mungu (29) watambue sababu ya kweli ya kushangilia (32). Uaminifu wa utumishi huo wa muda mrefu, wa kuendelea kwa Mungu utathawabishwa vya kutosha baadaye (31), lakini hiyo haipaswi kuwazuia kufurahi kila wakati "ndugu" au "dada" aliyepotea anarudi kwenye familia ya Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:How is the father in the story a picture of God?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.11-32+A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~11#Question:A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?
trans-unit.source: A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?
trans-unit.target: Watu mbalimbali walikuwa wakimsikiliza Yesu akieleza hadithi hizi, Mafarisayo, walimu wa Sheria, wakusanya kodi na "watenda dhambi" (15:1-2).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Question:A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?1885665183
trans-unit.source: The older son thought of his younger brother in the same way that the Pharisees and teachers of the Law thought of those people whom they referred to as "sinners". (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Mwana mkubwa alifikiri juu ya ndugu yake mdogo kwa njia ileile ambayo Mafarisayo na walimu wa Sheria walifikiri juu ya watu hao ambao waliwarejezea kuwa "wenye dhambi" (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?-8326895
trans-unit.source: The younger son had done things which did not please his father, but he had finally repented and come back to ask his father to forgive him. He wanted to please his father now, just as the tax collectors and "sinners" were doing.
trans-unit.target: Mwana mdogo alikuwa amefanya mambo ambayo hayampendezi baba yake, lakini mwishowe alikuwa ametubu na kurudi kumwomba baba yake amsamehe. Alitaka kumpendeza baba yake sasa, kama vile wakusanya kodi na "watenda dhambi" walivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:A variety of people were listening to Jesus tell these stories, the Pharisees, the teachers of the Law, the tax collectors and the "sinners" (15:1-2). In what ways, do you think, was Jesus talking about them in this parable?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.12+What did the younger son want from his father?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~12#Question:What did the younger son want from his father?
trans-unit.source: What did the younger son want from his father?
trans-unit.target: Mwana mdogo alitaka nini kutoka kwa baba yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~12#Question:What did the younger son want from his father?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~12#Answer:What did the younger son want from his father?-378356546
trans-unit.source: He wanted his share of the father's possessions, that part which would be his when the father died. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka sehemu yake ya mali ya baba, sehemu ambayo ingekuwa yake wakati baba atakapokufa. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~12#Answer:What did the younger son want from his father?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.12+What did the father decide to do about that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~12#Question:What did the father decide to do about that?
trans-unit.source: What did the father decide to do about that?
trans-unit.target: Baba huyo aliamua kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~12#Question:What did the father decide to do about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~12#Answer:What did the father decide to do about that?-1407232222
trans-unit.source: He did divide his property/possessions between the [two sons]. (12)
trans-unit.target: Aligawanya mali yake kati ya [wanawe wawili]. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~12#Answer:What did the father decide to do about that?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.11-16+In what way, do you think, was it divided between the two sons?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~11#Question:In what way, do you think, was it divided between the two sons?
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, was it divided between the two sons?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mali hiyo iligawanywaje kati ya wana hao wawili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Question:In what way, do you think, was it divided between the two sons?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~11#Answer:In what way, do you think, was it divided between the two sons?2059297448
trans-unit.source: (The translation should not say or imply that it was divided equally. The Law of Moses [Deut. 21:17] had said that the oldest son would get an extra portion, or double what any other individual son might receive.)
trans-unit.target: (Tafsiri haipaswi kusema au kudokeza kwamba iligawanywa kwa usawa. Sheria ya Musa [Kumbukumbu 21:17] ilikuwa imesema kwamba mwana mkubwa angepata sehemu ya ziada, au mara mbili ya kile ambacho mwana mwingine yeyote angeweza kupokea.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:In what way, do you think, was it divided between the two sons?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.13+What did the younger son do with his part?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~13#Question:What did the younger son do with his part?
trans-unit.source: What did the younger son do with his part?
trans-unit.target: Mwana mdogo alifanya nini na fungu lake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~13#Question:What did the younger son do with his part?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~13#Answer:What did the younger son do with his part?-1649534445
trans-unit.source: He took it and went to a distant country/region and there he wasted his money in wild/extravagant/careless ways. (13)
trans-unit.target: Aliichukua na kwenda nchi/eneo la mbali na huko akaitumia pesa zake kwa njia za kupindukia/kupitia kiasi/kutokuwa na uangalifu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~13#Answer:What did the younger son do with his part?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.14+What happened after his money was all spent/finished?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~14#Question:What happened after his money was all spent/finished?
trans-unit.source: What happened after his money was all spent/finished?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotokea baada ya pesa zake zote kutumiwa/kukamilika?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~14#Question:What happened after his money was all spent/finished?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!15~14#Alternate:What happened after his money was all spent/finished?-1360110973
trans-unit.source: What happened after his money was all spent?

trans-unit.source: It was bad work for a Jew to work for or live with a non-Jew. It was even worse to work with pigs, which were regarded as ritually unclean and unfit to be eaten. (See Lev. 11:7-8 and 24-26.)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa kazi mbaya kwa Myahudi kufanya kazi kwa au kuishi na asiye Myahudi. Ilikuwa mbaya hata zaidi kufanya kazi na nguruwe, ambao walionekana kuwa wachafu na wasiofaa kuliwa (Ona Law. 11:7-8 na 24-26).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~11#Answer:Do you think that this was good work or bad work for this boy/son?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.21+What did the son say to his father?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~21#Question:What did the son say to his father?
trans-unit.source: What did the son say to his father?
trans-unit.target: Mwana huyo alimwambia nini baba yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~21#Question:What did the son say to his father?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~21#Answer:What did the son say to his father?-963712369
trans-unit.source: He said, "Father, I have sinned against [God in] heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son." (21)
trans-unit.target: Akasema: "Ee baba yangu, nimekosa juu ya mbingu na juu yako, sistahili kuitwa mwana wako tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~21#Answer:What did the son say to his father?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!15~21#Note:What did the son say to his father?-665667489
trans-unit.source: These words are exactly the same words and word order as in verse 18-19a. The translation should also have exactly the same wording in both places for these sentences. What the son said in verse 19b does not seem to have been said again to the father before he interrupted his son. Although the words of 19b are repeated in some Greek manuscripts, the most reliable ones do not have that sentence included here. If the translator wishes to have it in a footnote, then the wording should be exactly the same as in 19b.
trans-unit.target: Maneno haya ni sawa kabisa na maneno na utaratibu wa maneno kama katika mstari wa 18-19a. Tafsiri pia inapaswa kuwa na maneno sawa kabisa katika sehemu zote mbili kwa sentensi hizi. Kile mwana alisema katika mstari wa 19b haionekani kuwa alisema tena kwa baba kabla ya kumkatiza mwanawe. Ingawa maneno ya 19b yanarudiwa katika baadhi ya hati za Kigiriki, zile za kuaminika zaidi hazina sentensi hiyo iliyojumuishwa hapa. Ikiwa mtafsiri anataka kuwa nayo katika maelezo ya chini, basi maneno yanapaswa kuwa sawa kabisa na katika 19b.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~21#Note:What did the son say to his father?

trans-unit.source: He became angry and did not want/he refused to enter [the house]. (28a)
trans-unit.target: Akawaka hasira, akakataa kuingia ndani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~28#Answer:How did the older brother feel about that?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.28+What did the father do about his older son?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~28#Question:What did the father do about his older son?
trans-unit.source: What did the father do about his older son?
trans-unit.target: Baba huyo alifanya nini kuhusu mwana wake mkubwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~28#Question:What did the father do about his older son?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~28#Answer:What did the father do about his older son?1559965758
trans-unit.source: He came out[side] and kept on urging/earnestly asked for/strongly requested him [to go into the house and join in the celebrating]. (28b)
trans-unit.target: Alikuja nje [upande] na kuendelea kumsihi/kwa bidii kumwomba/kwa nguvu kumwomba [aende ndani ya nyumba na kujiunga na sherehe]. (28b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~28#Answer:What did the father do about his older son?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.29-30+What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~29#Question:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?
trans-unit.source: What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?
trans-unit.target: Ndugu mkubwa alimwambia baba yake ni nini sababu za hasira yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~29#Question:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~29#Answer:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?718612480
trans-unit.source: He had worked like a slave for his father for so many years and had never disobeyed his orders, but the father had never given him [even] a young goat in order that he might have a party with his friends. (29)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amemfanyia kazi baba yake kama mtumwa kwa miaka mingi sana na hakuwa amemwasi kamwe, lakini baba yake hakuwa amempa [hata] mwana-mbuzi ili aweze kufanya karamu pamoja na rafiki zake. (29)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~29#Answer:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~29#Answer:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?-1208803694
trans-unit.source: But for his brother who had used up [the money from] their father's property with prostitutes, and [just now] come home, the father had [servants] kill the fattened calf! (30)
trans-unit.target: Lakini ndugu yake, ambaye alikuwa ametumia [fedha za baba yao] pamoja na makahaba, na [sasa tu] amerudi nyumbani, baba yake [waja] aliamuru [watumishi] waue ndama aliyenoneshwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~29#Answer:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!15~29#Note:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?144919985
trans-unit.source: The older son's choice of words shows that he felt as if his father had slighted him, that the father was rewarding the younger son's foolishness and disobedience and not rewarding the older son's hard work and obedience. If the translation can convey that feeling of anger and disappointment, it would reflect Luke's text well.
trans-unit.target: Chaguo la maneno la mwana mkubwa laonyesha kwamba alihisi kana kwamba baba yake alikuwa amemdharau, kwamba baba alikuwa akimthawabisha mwana mdogo kwa upumbavu na kutotii kwake na si kumthawabisha mwana mkubwa kwa kazi yake ngumu na utii wake. Ikiwa tafsiri yaweza kueleza hisia hiyo ya hasira na kukata tamaa, ingeonyesha vizuri maandishi ya Luka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~29#Note:What did the older brother tell his father were the reasons that he was angry?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.31+What did the father say to show that he was not treating his older son badly?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~31#Question:What did the father say to show that he was not treating his older son badly?
trans-unit.source: What did the father say to show that he was not treating his older son badly?
trans-unit.target: Baba alisema nini ili kuonyesha kwamba hakuwa akimtendea vibaya mwana wake mkubwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~31#Question:What did the father say to show that he was not treating his older son badly?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~31#Answer:What did the father say to show that he was not treating his older son badly?585697185
trans-unit.source: He said that the older son had always been with him and everything the father owned now belonged to the older son. (They had been together enjoying life and those possessions all along and still had them!) (31)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mwana mkubwa alikuwa pamoja naye siku zote na kila kitu baba alichokuwa nacho sasa kilikuwa cha mwana mkubwa. (Walikuwa pamoja wakifurahia maisha na mali hizo muda wote na bado walikuwa nazo.) (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~31#Answer:What did the father say to show that he was not treating his older son badly?

group.id: Q:LUK 15.32+What did the father say to show that he was not celebrating the younger son's past foolish actions?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!15~32#Question:What did the father say to show that he was not celebrating the younger son's past foolish actions?
trans-unit.source: What did the father say to show that he was not celebrating the younger son's past foolish actions?
trans-unit.target: Baba alisema nini ili kuonyesha kwamba hakuwa akisherehekea matendo ya zamani ya kipumbavu ya mwana wake mdogo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~32#Question:What did the father say to show that he was not celebrating the younger son's past foolish actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!15~32#Answer:What did the father say to show that he was not celebrating the younger son's past foolish actions?-1735378468
trans-unit.source: He said that he had to celebrate because the younger brother had returned from [foolish actions which were like] being dead or lost. Now he was alive again and found. (32)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba alipaswa kusherehekea kwa sababu ndugu yake mdogo alikuwa amerudi kutoka [vitendo vya upumbavu ambavyo vilikuwa kama] kuwa amekufa au kupotea. Sasa alikuwa hai tena na kupatikana. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!15~32#Answer:What did the father say to show that he was not celebrating the younger son's past foolish actions?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!16~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 16:1-13 Jesus told a parable about a shrewd/clever servant manager.
trans-unit.target: Luka 16:1-13 Yesu alisimulia mfano kuhusu msimamizi-nyumba mwenye busara.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 16.1-13+On what point did Jesus want his disciples to focus their attention from this parable? (See 16:8.)

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~1#Question:On what point did Jesus want his disciples to focus their attention from this parable? (See 16:8.)
trans-unit.source: On what point did Jesus want his disciples to focus their attention from this parable? (See 16:8.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka wanafunzi wake wakazie fikira jambo gani katika mfano huu? (Ona 16:8.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~1#Question:On what point did Jesus want his disciples to focus their attention from this parable? (See 16:8.)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~1#Answer:On what point did Jesus want his disciples to focus their attention from this parable? (See 16:8.)1272375857
trans-unit.source: The servant manager had thought shrewdly about his situation and had prepared for his future life. This was typical of people who deal with each other in worldly things. They do that better than the people who focus on spiritual things do. (8)
trans-unit.target: Msimamizi wa mtumishi alikuwa amefikiria kwa busara hali yake na alikuwa amejitayarisha kwa maisha yake ya baadaye. Hii ilikuwa ni kawaida ya watu ambao hushughulika na kila mmoja katika mambo ya kidunia. Wanafanya hivyo vizuri zaidi kuliko watu ambao wanazingatia mambo ya kiroho. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~1#Answer:On what point did Jesus want his disciples to focus their attention from this parable? (See 16:8.)

group.id: Q:LUK 16.1-13+If a person cannot be trusted with the things God has given him on this earth, how will that affect spiritual things which God would like to give him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~1#Question:If a person cannot be trusted with the things God has given him on this earth, how will that affect spiritual things which God would like to give him?
trans-unit.source: If a person cannot be trusted with the things God has given him on this earth, how will that affect spiritual things which God would like to give him?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu hawezi kuaminiwa na vitu ambavyo Mungu amempa duniani, hilo litaathirije mambo ya kiroho ambayo Mungu angependa kumpa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~1#Question:If a person cannot be trusted with the things God has given him on this earth, how will that affect spiritual things which God would like to give him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~1#Answer:If a person cannot be trusted with the things God has given him on this earth, how will that affect spiritual things which God would like to give him?-2079397210
trans-unit.source: God will not reward that person with things of great spiritual/eternal value. [They belong only to those who are faithful.] (11-12)
trans-unit.target: Mungu hatamthawabisha mtu huyo kwa vitu vyenye thamani kubwa ya kiroho/ya milele. [Ni vya wale tu walio waaminifu.] (11-12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~1#Answer:If a person cannot be trusted with the things God has given him on this earth, how will that affect spiritual things which God would like to give him?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~3#Answer:Why did he not want to get work digging gardens or begging for money from other people?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.9+How should the children of the light be like the people who are focused on the things of this world?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~9#Question:How should the children of the light be like the people who are focused on the things of this world?
trans-unit.source: How should the children of the light be like the people who are focused on the things of this world?
trans-unit.target: Watoto wa nuru wapaswa kuwa kama watu wanaokazia mambo ya ulimwengu huu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~9#Question:How should the children of the light be like the people who are focused on the things of this world?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~9#Answer:How should the children of the light be like the people who are focused on the things of this world?784686304
trans-unit.source: They should use wealth to make friends for themselves, so that when the wealth fails [to be able to take care of them, the new friends, or, the friends already in heaven, namely God and the angels] will welcome them into eternal homes. (9)
trans-unit.target: Na wajitafutie marafiki kwa mali, ili zinapokwisha [wasiweze kuwatunza, marafiki wapya, au, marafiki walio mbinguni, yaani Mungu na malaika] wawapokee katika makao ya milele. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~9#Answer:How should the children of the light be like the people who are focused on the things of this world?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.10+What did he say about a person who cannot be trusted with very small amounts of money or goods?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~10#Answer:What did he say about a person who cannot be trusted with very small amounts of money or goods?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.11+How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~11#Question:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumiaje mawazo hayo kwa kitu chenye thamani ndogo na kitu kingine chenye thamani ya kweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~11#Question:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~11#Answer:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?-876057852
trans-unit.source: He spoke about worldly wealth as something which has very little value (11),
trans-unit.target: Alisema juu ya utajiri wa kidunia kama kitu ambacho kina thamani kidogo sana (11),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~11#Answer:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~11#Answer:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?227652632
trans-unit.source: and implied that true wealth and riches was made up of spiritual things.
trans-unit.target: na kuashiria kwamba utajiri wa kweli na utajiri ulifanywa kwa mambo ya kiroho.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~11#Answer:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!16~11#Note:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?1334610788
trans-unit.source: Jesus spoke about this already in 12:32-34.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumza juu ya hili tayari katika 12:32-34.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~11#Note:How did Jesus apply those thoughts to something which has small value and something else having true value?

trans-unit.source: Who do you think it is that wants to trust us with true riches?

trans-unit.source: What kind of person will be entrusted by God with true riches and possessions of his own?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~11#Question:What kind of person will be entrusted by God with true riches and possessions of his own?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~11#Answer:What kind of person will be entrusted by God with true riches and possessions of his own?1271739498

trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~11#Answer:What kind of person will be entrusted by God with true riches and possessions of his own?

trans-unit.source: Who do you think has already given us things in this world to look after for him?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.13+If a person's desire for money controls all his thinking and actions, then money is his master and he is a slave to it. What will that person's thoughts/attitudes be toward God?

trans-unit.source: If a person's desire for money controls all his thinking and actions, then money is his master and he is a slave to it. What will that person's thoughts/attitudes be toward God?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa tamaa ya mtu ya pesa inatawala mawazo na matendo yake yote, basi pesa ni bwana wake na yeye ni mtumwa wake. Mawazo/mtazamo wa mtu huyo utakuwaje kuelekea Mungu?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~13#Answer:If a person's desire for money controls all his thinking and actions, then money is his master and he is a slave to it. What will that person's thoughts/attitudes be toward God?652653504
trans-unit.source: That person will hate him or despise him/think of him with contempt.
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo atamchukia au kumdharau/kumfikiria kwa dharau.

trans-unit.source: Luke 16:14-18 God knows when a person pretends to obey him, but is really just pleasing himself.

group.id: Q:LUK 16.14-18+What was the sin of the Pharisees which Jesus described in verses 14 and 15?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~14#Question:What was the sin of the Pharisees which Jesus described in verses 14 and 15?
trans-unit.source: What was the sin of the Pharisees which Jesus described in verses 14 and 15?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini lililokuwa dhambi ya Mafarisayo ambayo Yesu alifafanua katika mistari ya 14 na 15?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Question:What was the sin of the Pharisees which Jesus described in verses 14 and 15?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~14#Answer:What was the sin of the Pharisees which Jesus described in verses 14 and 15?-117491138
trans-unit.source: They wanted people to think of them as doing the right thing/having a right relationship with God, but God knew their hearts [were not focused on him, but on money or themselves]. (14-15)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka watu wafikiri kuwa wanafanya jambo sahihi/wana uhusiano sahihi na Mungu, lakini Mungu alijua mioyo yao [haikuwa imezingatia yeye, bali pesa au wao wenyewe]. (14-15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Answer:What was the sin of the Pharisees which Jesus described in verses 14 and 15?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.14-18+What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~14#Question:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?
trans-unit.source: What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumzia mambo gani mawili ambayo Mafarisayo hawakumtii Mungu kwa njia iliyompendeza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Question:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~14#Answer:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?-1731740053
trans-unit.source: He talked about [their] love of money (14-15),
trans-unit.target: Alizungumza kuhusu kupenda pesa (14-15),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Answer:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~14#Answer:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?1001228460
trans-unit.source: and about divorce and adultery (18).
trans-unit.target: na kuhusu talaka na uzinzi (18).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Answer:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!16~14#Note:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?-1667967850
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees said that they obeyed all the Law as God had commanded them to do, but Jesus was telling them that in the way they regarded money and divorce they were not obeying God's laws, but only pleasing themselves.
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walisema kwamba wao walitii Sheria yote kama vile Mungu alivyokuwa amewaamuru wafanye, lakini Yesu alikuwa akiwaambia kwamba katika njia waliyoona fedha na talaka hawakuwa wakiitii sheria za Mungu, bali walikuwa wakijipendeza wenyewe tu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Note:What two topics did Jesus talk about in which the Pharisees did not obey God in a way that pleased him?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.14+How did the Pharisees who were also listening to Jesus react to what he had been saying?

trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees who were also listening to Jesus react to what he had been saying?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo waliokuwa wakimsikiliza Yesu waliitikiaje yale aliyokuwa amesema?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Question:How did the Pharisees who were also listening to Jesus react to what he had been saying?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~14#Answer:How did the Pharisees who were also listening to Jesus react to what he had been saying?-298960569
trans-unit.source: They were sneering/scoffing/laughing at Jesus and at what he was saying. (14)
trans-unit.target: Walimdhihaki Yesu na maneno yake. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Answer:How did the Pharisees who were also listening to Jesus react to what he had been saying?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.14+Why did they not like what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.source: Why did they not like what Jesus had said?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakupenda yale ambayo Yesu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Question:Why did they not like what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~14#Answer:Why did they not like what Jesus had said?1794783838
trans-unit.source: They loved money. (14)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~14#Answer:Why did they not like what Jesus had said?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.16+Before John the Baptizer had come, how did the people know about the way that God wanted them to live?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~16#Question:Before John the Baptizer had come, how did the people know about the way that God wanted them to live?
trans-unit.source: Before John the Baptizer had come, how did the people know about the way that God wanted them to live?
trans-unit.target: Kabla ya kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji, watu walijuaje juu ya njia ambayo Mungu alitaka waishi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Question:Before John the Baptizer had come, how did the people know about the way that God wanted them to live?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~16#Answer:Before John the Baptizer had come, how did the people know about the way that God wanted them to live?1494282918
trans-unit.source: The Law [of Moses] and [the writings of] the Prophets [had been read and taught to them as their guide for living]. (16)
trans-unit.target: Sheria [ya Musa] na [maandishi ya] Manabii [yalisomwa na kufundishwa kwao kuwa mwongozo wao wa maisha]. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Answer:Before John the Baptizer had come, how did the people know about the way that God wanted them to live?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.16+What changed after John began to preach?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~16#Question:What changed after John began to preach?
trans-unit.source: What changed after John began to preach?
trans-unit.target: Ni badiliko gani lililotokea baada ya Yohana kuanza kuhubiri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Question:What changed after John began to preach?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~16#Answer:What changed after John began to preach?207938231
trans-unit.source: Since then the Good News about the kingdom of God was being proclaimed/preached [first by John, then by Jesus and his disciples]. (16)
trans-unit.target: Tangu wakati huo Habari Njema juu ya ufalme wa Mungu ilikuwa ikitangazwa/kuhubiriwa [kwanza na Yohana, kisha na Yesu na wanafunzi wake]. (16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Answer:What changed after John began to preach?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.16-18+What was that Good News?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~16#Question:What was that Good News?
trans-unit.source: What was that Good News?
trans-unit.target: Habari Njema hiyo ilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Question:What was that Good News?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~16#Answer:What was that Good News?1955107301
trans-unit.source: It was that God wanted to rule over every person and reign in each one's heart and life like a king rules over the people who live in his country. That time had arrived when John and Jesus began to tell about the need for people to repent and believe that Jesus had been sent by God to save them from their sins.
trans-unit.target: Ni kwamba Mungu alitaka kutawala juu ya kila mtu na kutawala katika moyo na maisha ya kila mmoja kama mfalme anavyotawala juu ya watu wanaoishi katika nchi yake. Wakati huo ulikuwa umefika wakati Yohana na Yesu walipoanza kuwaambia watu juu ya hitaji la kutubu na kuamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa ametumwa na Mungu kuwaokoa kutoka kwa dhambi zao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Answer:What was that Good News?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.16+What did Jesus say had been the result of that preaching?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~16#Note:What did Jesus say had been the result of that preaching?

trans-unit.source: 2) This refers to those who did not believe the Good News, but were trying to be included some other way.
trans-unit.target: 2) Hii inahusu wale ambao hawakuamini Habari Njema, lakini walikuwa wakijaribu kuingizwa kwa njia nyingine.

group.id: Q:LUK 16.18+According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~18#Question:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?
trans-unit.source: According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na ufafanuzi wa Yesu wa Sheria, ni nani pia watakaokuwa na hatia ya kufanya uzinzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~18#Question:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~18#Answer:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?17283250
trans-unit.source: It is the one who divorces his wife and marries another,
trans-unit.target: Huyo ndiye anaye jitenga na mkewe, na akamwoa mwingine,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~18#Answer:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~18#Answer:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?270454237
trans-unit.source: and it is the one who marries a woman whose husband has divorced her. (18)
trans-unit.target: Na anaye muoa mwanamke aliyetalikiwa na mumewe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~18#Answer:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!16~18#Note:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?-411709408
trans-unit.source: God's view of marriage, divorce, and adultery can be found in Gen. 2:24, Exod. 20:14, and Mal. 2:14-16. Jesus's explained what that meant in the kingdom of God in Matt. 19:3-9, and Mark 10:9, as well as here.
trans-unit.target: Maoni ya Mungu juu ya ndoa, talaka, na uzinzi yanaweza kupatikana katika Mwanzo 2:24, Kutoka 20:14, na Mal. 2:14-16. Yesu alieleza maana ya jambo hilo katika ufalme wa Mungu katika Mathayo 19:3-9, na Marko 10:9, na pia hapa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~18#Note:According to Jesus's explanation of the Law, who will also be guilty of committing adultery?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.19-31+This complete chapter has focused on wealth and one's relationship to God. How do you see this parable doing that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~19#Question:This complete chapter has focused on wealth and one's relationship to God. How do you see this parable doing that?
trans-unit.source: This complete chapter has focused on wealth and one's relationship to God. How do you see this parable doing that?
trans-unit.target: Sura hii nzima imezungumzia utajiri na uhusiano wa mtu pamoja na Mungu. Unaona mfano huu unafanyaje hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~19#Question:This complete chapter has focused on wealth and one's relationship to God. How do you see this parable doing that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~19#Answer:This complete chapter has focused on wealth and one's relationship to God. How do you see this parable doing that?-715311790
trans-unit.source: This parable emphasizes obeying God's word as they know it and the importance of having the right attitude toward money and possessions. If people refuse to listen to and obey God's message which was in the Old Testament, then they will refuse the message about the kingdom of God which Jesus brought, even after seeing the miracles he did or seeing him after he rose from the dead.
trans-unit.target: Mfano huu unasisitiza utii kwa neno la Mungu kama wanavyolijua na umuhimu wa kuwa na mtazamo sahihi kuelekea pesa na mali. Ikiwa watu wanakataa kusikiliza na kutii ujumbe wa Mungu ambao ulikuwa katika Agano la Kale, basi watakataa ujumbe kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu ambao Yesu alileta, hata baada ya kuona miujiza aliyofanya au kumwona baada ya kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~19#Answer:This complete chapter has focused on wealth and one's relationship to God. How do you see this parable doing that?
