group.id: Q:LUK 16.23-26+The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~23#Question:The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?
trans-unit.source: The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?
trans-unit.target: Mtajiri alimwita Abrahamu baba yake katika mstari wa 24. Kisha Abrahamu akamwita tajiri mwanawe. Uhusiano halisi kati ya hao wawili ulikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~23#Question:The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~23#Answer:The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?1329902347
trans-unit.source: Abraham was the ancestor of all the Jews, so the rich man was being respectful of the man who started his entire group of people. Abraham replied with the appropriate response [in the Jewish culture].
trans-unit.target: Ibrahimu alikuwa babu wa Wayahudi wote, hivyo tajiri alikuwa akiheshimu mtu aliyeanzisha kikundi chake chote cha watu. Ibrahimu alijibu kwa jibu linalofaa [katika utamaduni wa Kiyahudi].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~23#Answer:The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!16~23#Note:The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?708079527
trans-unit.source: The translation may use whatever terms from the culture would show respect for such a forefather and from that forefather back to his descendant.
trans-unit.target: Tafsiri inaweza kutumia maneno yoyote kutoka kwa utamaduni ambayo yangeonyesha heshima kwa babu kama huyo na kutoka kwa babu huyo kurudi kwa mzao wake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~23#Note:The rich man called Abraham his father in verse 24. Then Abraham called the rich man his son. What was the real relationship between the two?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.24+How did he want Abraham to relieve some of his pain?

trans-unit.target: Yehova alitaka Abrahamu afanye nini ili kupunguza uchungu wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~24#Question:How did he want Abraham to relieve some of his pain?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~24#Answer:How did he want Abraham to relieve some of his pain?905455885
trans-unit.source: He asked Abraham to have mercy/pity on him and send Lazarus to dip a finger in water and place it on the rich man's tongue in order to cool him off [a little bit]. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alimwomba Ibrahimu amhurumie na kumtuma Lazaro achovye kidole chake katika maji na kukiweka kwenye ulimi wa tajiri huyo ili apate kutulia [kidogo].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~24#Answer:How did he want Abraham to relieve some of his pain?

group.id: Q:LUK 16.25-26+What two reasons did Abraham give for not doing as the rich man had asked?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!16~25#Question:What two reasons did Abraham give for not doing as the rich man had asked?
trans-unit.source: What two reasons did Abraham give for not doing as the rich man had asked?
trans-unit.target: Abrahamu alitoa sababu gani mbili za kukataa kufanya jambo aliloombwa na tajiri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~25#Question:What two reasons did Abraham give for not doing as the rich man had asked?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!16~25#Answer:What two reasons did Abraham give for not doing as the rich man had asked?935718461
trans-unit.source: 1) He said that the rich man should remember that when he was alive, he had received his good things, but Lazarus had received bad [things]. Now in this place Lazarus was comforted/comfortable, and the rich man was in great pain/torture/agony. (25)
trans-unit.target: 1) Alisema kwamba yule tajiri anapaswa kukumbuka kwamba alipokuwa hai, alipokea vitu vyake vyema, lakini Lazaro alipokea [mambo] mabaya. Sasa katika mahali hapa Lazaro alifarijiwa/alipata faraja, na yule tajiri alikuwa katika maumivu/kuteswa/maumivu makali. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!16~25#Answer:What two reasons did Abraham give for not doing as the rich man had asked?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.3-4+How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~3#Question:How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?
trans-unit.source: How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka wanafunzi wake wawasamehe wengine mara ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~3#Question:How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~3#Answer:How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?478735811
trans-unit.source: He said that the number "seven" in his example as representing as many times as that person repents.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba idadi "saba" katika kielezi chake huwakilisha mara nyingi kadiri mtu huyo anavyotubu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~3#Answer:How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~3#Note:How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?-1428459388
trans-unit.source: The number "seven" in the language of the Jews, Hebrew, sounded like the word "vow, oath". This made the number have a strong sense of being fulfilled, of being complete. Thus, "seven" here stands for all the times that this situation might happen. In English, that sense is present when a person says something happened "a dozen times" or "a hundred times". The number's absolute value as "12" or "100" is not in focus so much as that a set of a large number of occurrences of that action has taken place.
trans-unit.target: Katika lugha ya Wayahudi, Kiebrania, nambari "saba" ilionekana kama neno "nadhiri, kiapo". Hii ilifanya idadi hiyo iwe na maana kubwa ya kutimizwa, ya kuwa kamili. Kwa hivyo, "saba" hapa inasimama kwa nyakati zote ambazo hali hii inaweza kutokea. Katika Kiingereza, maana hiyo iko wakati mtu anasema kitu kilitokea "mara kumi na mbili" au "mara mia moja". Thamani kamili ya nambari kama "12" au "100" sio katika mwelekeo sana kama kwamba seti ya idadi kubwa ya matukio ya kitendo hicho yamefanyika.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~3#Note:How many times did Jesus want the disciples to forgive others?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.11-14+Many sick people had come right in front of Jesus in order to be healed by him. What do you think was the reason these men called out to him from a distance?

trans-unit.source: Many sick people had come right in front of Jesus in order to be healed by him. What do you think was the reason these men called out to him from a distance?

trans-unit.source: God had told Moses not to permit people with leprosy/bad skin diseases to come close to others without letting the others know a person with leprosy was there. (See Lev. 13:9-17, 45-46 and Num. 5:1-5.)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Musa asiwaruhusu watu wenye ukoma/ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi kuwa karibu na wengine bila kuwaacha wengine wajue mtu mwenye ukoma yuko hapo (Ona Law. 13:9-17, 45-46 na Hes. 5:1-5.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~11#Answer:Many sick people had come right in front of Jesus in order to be healed by him. What do you think was the reason these men called out to him from a distance?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~11#Note:Many sick people had come right in front of Jesus in order to be healed by him. What do you think was the reason these men called out to him from a distance?-826758308
trans-unit.source: If these Scripture-related cultural items are not known to the respondent (or not likely to be known by the target audience), consider making a footnote or glossary item.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa habari hizi za kitamaduni zinazohusiana na Maandiko hazijulikani kwa yule anayejibu (au haielekei kuwa zinajulikana na wasikilizaji wa lengo), fikiria kuandika maelezo ya chini au habari ya msamiati.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~11#Note:Many sick people had come right in front of Jesus in order to be healed by him. What do you think was the reason these men called out to him from a distance?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.15-16+What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~15#Question:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?
trans-unit.source: What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?
trans-unit.target: Wanaume hao walifanya nini walipoona kwamba wameponywa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~15#Question:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~15#Answer:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?269529268
trans-unit.source: Only one of them returned, praising God in a loud voice (15).
trans-unit.target: Ni mmoja tu kati yao aliyerudi, akimsifu Mungu kwa sauti kubwa (15).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~15#Answer:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~15#Answer:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?-1642430753
trans-unit.source: He quickly lowered his body, putting [his knees and] his face to the ground [in front of] Jesus's feet, and thanked him (16). [The rest went to see a priest, we assume.]
trans-unit.target: Aliinama haraka, akaweka [magoti yake na] uso wake chini [mbele ya] miguu ya Yesu, na kumshukuru (16). [Tunadhani wengine walienda kumwona kuhani.]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~15#Answer:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~15#Note:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?-811318326
trans-unit.source: The Greek text emphasizes that this man was not a Jew, but a Samaritan. If that element of surprise can be included in the translation, it would reflect Luke's writing better.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa jambo hilo la kushangaza linaweza kuingizwa katika tafsiri hiyo, lingefanya maandishi ya Luka yaeleweke vizuri zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~15#Note:What did the men do when they saw that they were healed?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.17+How do we know Jesus was surprised and disappointed at all this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~17#Question:How do we know Jesus was surprised and disappointed at all this?
trans-unit.source: How do we know Jesus was surprised and disappointed at all this?
trans-unit.target: Twajuaje kwamba Yesu alishangaa na kuvunjika moyo kwa hayo yote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~17#Question:How do we know Jesus was surprised and disappointed at all this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~17#Answer:How do we know Jesus was surprised and disappointed at all this?1718239549
trans-unit.source: He asked [rhetorical questions] about where the other nine men were who had also been healed/made ritually clean. (17).
trans-unit.target: Aliuliza [maswali ya ki-rhetoric] juu ya mahali ambapo wale wanaume wengine tisa walikuwa pia wameponywa/kutakaswa kimadhimisho (17).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~17#Answer:How do we know Jesus was surprised and disappointed at all this?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.18+Why did he become so surprised and disappointed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~18#Question:Why did he become so surprised and disappointed?
trans-unit.source: Why did he become so surprised and disappointed?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alishangaa na kuvunjika moyo sana?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~18#Question:Why did he become so surprised and disappointed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~18#Answer:Why did he become so surprised and disappointed?484657893
trans-unit.source: Because they had not returned to give praise to God, but only the non-Jew [Samaritan] had. (18)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu wao hawakuwa wamerudi kumtukuza Mungu, bali ni wasio Wayahudi [Wasamaria] tu waliokuwa wamerudi (18)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~18#Answer:Why did he become so surprised and disappointed?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.19+What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~19#Question:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichokuwa sababu ya yule Msamaria kuponywa/kuokolewa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~19#Question:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!17~19#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?-170075254
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichokuwa kisababishi cha kuponywa kwa yule Msamaria?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~19#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!17~19#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?1318188992
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being saved?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichokuwa kisababishi cha wokovu wa yule Msamaria?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~19#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~19#Answer:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?1389030725
trans-unit.source: He had faith/believed that Jesus could heal/save him [by God's power when no other way was possible]. (19)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na imani/aliamini kwamba Yesu angeweza kumponya/kumwokoa [kwa nguvu za Mungu wakati hakuna njia nyingine iwezekanavyo]. (19)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~19#Answer:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~19#Note:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?-2061646388
trans-unit.source: The Greek verb used in this sentence means both things in this case. It can also be translated as "rescued". Jesus had healed all ten men. He may have meant here that this one man also had his sins forgiven because he had recognized the power of God at work in Jesus (see Luke 7:50).
trans-unit.target: Neno la Kigiriki lililotumiwa katika sentensi hii linamaanisha mambo yote mawili katika kesi hii. Linaweza pia kutafsiriwa kama "kuokolewa". Yesu alikuwa amewaponya wanaume wote kumi. Huenda alimaanisha hapa kwamba mtu huyu mmoja pia alikuwa na dhambi zake kusamehewa kwa sababu alikuwa alitambua nguvu ya Mungu kufanya kazi katika Yesu (ona Luka 7:50).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~19#Note:What did Jesus say was the cause of the Samaritan man being healed/being saved?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.14+Jesus told this man to get up and go. Where was he going when he stopped and came back to Jesus?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~14#Answer:Jesus told this man to get up and go. Where was he going when he stopped and came back to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~32#Answer:What example did Jesus give to show what would happen if someone did that?956909854
trans-unit.source: He told them to remember [what happened to] Lot's wife. (32)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wakumbuke [lililowapata] mke wa Loti.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~32#Answer:What example did Jesus give to show what would happen if someone did that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~32#Note:What example did Jesus give to show what would happen if someone did that?-1693967859
trans-unit.source: All the Jews who were listening to Jesus knew what had happened to Lot's wife. She had thought more about her possessions which she was leaving behind than about obeying God and him saving her. She died the same as all the other people who had not obeyed God. This may need to be in a footnote or glossary item. See Gen. 19:15, 17, and 26.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi wote waliokuwa wakimsikiliza Yesu walijua kilichomtokea mke wa Lutu. Alikuwa amefikiria zaidi juu ya mali yake aliyokuwa akiiacha nyuma kuliko juu ya kumtii Mungu na yeye kumwokoa. Alikufa sawa na watu wengine wote ambao hawakuwa wamemtii Mungu. Hii inaweza kuhitaji kuwa katika maelezo ya chini au kifungu cha msamiati. Tazama Mwanzo 19:15, 17, na 26.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~32#Note:What example did Jesus give to show what would happen if someone did that?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.31-33+That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~31#Question:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?
trans-unit.source: That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~31#Question:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~31#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?1490992988
trans-unit.source: The person who does not do as Jesus just said in verse 31 will lose his chance to have the spiritual, eternal life Jesus promised elsewhere in the gospels.
trans-unit.target: Mtu asiyetenda kama vile Yesu alivyosema katika mstari wa 31 atapoteza nafasi yake ya kupata uhai wa kiroho, wa milele ambao Yesu aliahidi mahali pengine katika injili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~31#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~31#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?1238689951
trans-unit.source: He may also die physically just like Jesus implied in verse 32 that Lot's wife died.
trans-unit.target: Huenda akafa kimwili pia kama vile Yesu alivyodokeza katika mstari wa 32 kwamba mke wa Loti alikufa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~31#Answer:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~31#Note:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?900901856
trans-unit.source: If the respondent has not been a worshipping Christian for some time, he will find this question is impossible to answer. He has no context to fit it into, and the words are a paradox. Do not be critical of anyone's answer to this question.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mtu aliyehojiwa hajawa Mkristo anayemwabudu kwa muda fulani, ataona swali hili haliwezekani kujibu. Hana muktadha wa kuliweka, na maneno ni ya kinyume. Usiwe mkosoaji wa jibu la mtu yeyote kwa swali hili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~31#Note:That sounds like a contradiction in the way that people understand life and death. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because of his following Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ingekuwaje ikiwa mtu angepoteza uhai wake kwa sababu ya kumfuata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~33#Question:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because of his following Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~33#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because of his following Jesus?2104486223
trans-unit.source: He will save it/keep on living [eternally]. (33b)
trans-unit.target: Yeye ataiokoa/iendelee kuishi [kwa umilele wote]. (33b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~33#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen when a person loses his life because of his following Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.31-33+This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~31#Question:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?
trans-unit.source: This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema maneno hayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~31#Question:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~31#Answer:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?1113796034
trans-unit.source: He cannot be talking about a person's physical life, so he must be referring again to spiritual life. The person who does as Jesus just said in verse 31 will receive the spiritual, eternal life which he promised to give him.
trans-unit.target: Hawezi kuwa anazungumza juu ya maisha ya mtu ya kimwili, kwa hivyo lazima awe anazungumza tena juu ya maisha ya kiroho. Mtu anayefanya kama Yesu alivyosema katika mstari wa 31 atapokea maisha ya kiroho, ya milele ambayo aliahidi kumpa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~31#Answer:This, too, sounds like a contradiction in terms. What do you think that Jesus meant by that?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.34-35+Will it be night or day when the Son of Man returns?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~34#Question:Will it be night or day when the Son of Man returns?
trans-unit.source: Will it be night or day when the Son of Man returns?
trans-unit.target: Je, ni usiku au mchana Mwana wa binadamu atakapokuja?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~34#Question:Will it be night or day when the Son of Man returns?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~34#Answer:Will it be night or day when the Son of Man returns?1212052618
trans-unit.source: Both. Some people will be sleeping at night [on one side of the world], others will be working in the daylight [on the other side of the earth]. [Which one it will be at any one place we do not know.] (34-35)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine watalala usiku [katika upande mmoja wa ulimwengu], wengine watafanya kazi mchana [katika upande mwingine wa dunia]. [Ni ipi itakayokuwa mahali fulani hatujui.] (34-35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~34#Answer:Will it be night or day when the Son of Man returns?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.34-35+What will happen to people at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~34#Question:What will happen to people at that time?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to people at that time?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kitakachowapata watu wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~34#Question:What will happen to people at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~34#Answer:What will happen to people at that time?-1491536067
trans-unit.source: Some will be taken along, some left behind, [even within families or among friends]. (34, 35)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi yao watachukuliwa, na wengine wataachwa nyuma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~34#Answer:What will happen to people at that time?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!17~34#Note:What will happen to people at that time?-924037505
trans-unit.source: Jesus had not said where he would be taking those people, but it would be somewhere safe. From what he said in 16:19-23, he implied they would be taken to heaven like the man Lazarus had been.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakuwa amesema ambapo angewapeleka watu hao, lakini ingekuwa mahali salama. Kutokana na aliyosema katika 16:19-23, alimaanisha kwamba wangechukuliwa mbinguni kama vile mtu Lazaro alikuwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~34#Note:What will happen to people at that time?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.30-37+What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~30#Question:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walitaka kujua nini kuhusu kurudi huku kwa Mwana wa binadamu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~30#Question:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~30#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?1431909936
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus where [his return would take place]. (30)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu [kurudi kwake kungetukia] wapi. (30)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~30#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~30#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~30#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~30#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?1474027125
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus where [the things he just talked about in verses 30-35 would take place]. (37)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu mahali ambapo [mambo aliyotaja katika mistari ya 30-35 yangetukia]. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~30#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about this return of the Son of Man?

group.id: Q:LUK 17.37+In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!17~37#Question:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri maneno ya Yesu kuhusu ndege na maiti yalijibu swali lao jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~37#Question:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~37#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?1603958381
trans-unit.source: Just like [it is obvious to people even far away when] vultures gather and circle over a dead body, Jesus's return will be obvious [as he already said in 17:24].
trans-unit.target: Kama vile [ni dhahiri kwa watu hata walio mbali wakati] ndege wakubwa wanapokusanyika na kuzunguka juu ya maiti, kurudi kwa Yesu kutakuwa dhahiri [kama alivyosema katika 17:24].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~37#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~37#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~37#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!17~37#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?-1287713335
trans-unit.source: When the Jews/mankind was totally dead spiritually, he would return to punish those people. (37)
trans-unit.target: Wakati Wayahudi/wanadamu wangekuwa wamekufa kabisa kiroho, angerejea kuwaadhibu watu hao. (37)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!17~37#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus's words about vultures and dead bodies answer their question?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!18~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 18:1-8 God will listen to the prayers of those who continue to ask him to help them and do not give up.
trans-unit.target: Luka 18:1-8 Mungu atasikiliza sala za wale wanaoendelea kumwomba msaada na ambao hawaachi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 18.1-8+Tell me the parable about the widow and the judge.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~1#Question:Tell me the parable about the widow and the judge.
trans-unit.source: Tell me the parable about the widow and the judge.
trans-unit.target: Niambie mfano wa mjane na mwamuzi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Question:Tell me the parable about the widow and the judge.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~1#Answer:Tell me the parable about the widow and the judge.-1770221903
trans-unit.source: (The answer should cover the basic outline of the story, including the judge's attitudes toward people, the widow being persistent, and the judge's reasons to finally answer her repeated requests.)
trans-unit.target: (Jibu linapaswa kuzungumzia mambo makuu ya hadithi hiyo, kutia ndani mtazamo wa mwamuzi kuelekea watu, udumifu wa mjane, na sababu za mwamuzi za mwisho za kujibu maombi yake yaliyorudiwa-rudiwa.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Answer:Tell me the parable about the widow and the judge.

group.id: Q:LUK 18.1-8+What did Jesus want his disciples to learn from this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~1#Question:What did Jesus want his disciples to learn from this parable?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus want his disciples to learn from this parable?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka wanafunzi wake wajifunze nini kutokana na mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Question:What did Jesus want his disciples to learn from this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~1#Answer:What did Jesus want his disciples to learn from this parable?537197631
trans-unit.source: They should always pray [to God] and not get tired of it/give up/be discouraged doing it. (1)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kusali [kwa Mungu] daima na wasichoke/waache/wavunjike moyo kufanya hivyo. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Answer:What did Jesus want his disciples to learn from this parable?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.1-8+How can we compare the judge and God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~1#Question:How can we compare the judge and God?
trans-unit.source: How can we compare the judge and God?
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kumlinganishaje hakimu na Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Question:How can we compare the judge and God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~1#Answer:How can we compare the judge and God?-276325324
trans-unit.source: The judge did not care about God or people (4), but God cares about the ones he has chosen (7).
trans-unit.target: Hakimu huyo hakumjali Mungu wala watu (4), lakini Mungu anawahangaikia wale ambao amewachagua (7).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Answer:How can we compare the judge and God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~1#Answer:How can we compare the judge and God?22934443
trans-unit.source: The judge kept putting off helping the widow, even though she was persistent (3, 4), but God will not do like that; he will help quickly [when he decides to act] (8).
trans-unit.target: Hakimu aliendelea kuahirisha kumsaidia mjane, hata ingawa mwanamke huyo aliendelea kuomba-omba (3, 4), lakini Mungu hatafanya hivyo; atasaidia haraka [anapoamua kuchukua hatua] (8).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Answer:How can we compare the judge and God?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.2-4+In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~2#Question:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?
trans-unit.source: In what way did Jesus describe the judge?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimfafanuaje hakimu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Question:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?473468066
trans-unit.source: The judge did not respect/revere God [and God's standard of right and wrong]
trans-unit.target: Hakimu huyo hakumheshimu Mungu [na viwango vya Mungu vya mema na mabaya]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?-880152644
trans-unit.source: and he was not concerned about what people might think about the way that he decided court cases.
trans-unit.target: na hakujali jinsi watu walivyoona maamuzi yake mahakamani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?473468066
trans-unit.source: The judge did not respect/revere God [and God's standard of right and wrong]
trans-unit.target: Hakimu huyo hakumheshimu Mungu [na viwango vya Mungu vya mema na mabaya]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?2090462280
trans-unit.source: and he did not care about the people involved in the cases he decided. (2, 4)
trans-unit.target: na hakujali watu waliohusika katika kesi alizoamua. (2, 4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~2#Note:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?-1048872819
trans-unit.source: The same Greek word was used to describe a judge in 11:19 and 12:58. The translation here should describe the judge and his role in as much the same way as it was in those verses.
trans-unit.target: Neno hilohilo la Kigiriki lilitumiwa kumfafanua hakimu katika 11:19 na 12:58. Tafsiri ya hapa inapaswa kumfafanua hakimu na daraka lake kwa njia ileile kama ilivyokuwa katika mistari hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~2#Note:In what way did Jesus describe the judge?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.1-5+What do you think that Jesus meant when he said that the disciples should always pray to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~1#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he said that the disciples should always pray to God?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant when he said that the disciples should always pray to God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba wanafunzi wake wanapaswa kusali kwa Mungu sikuzote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he said that the disciples should always pray to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~1#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he said that the disciples should always pray to God?979931911
trans-unit.source: He meant that they should pray very often and regularly to God and depend on him for all their needs. He did not mean they must only pray and do nothing else.
trans-unit.target: Yeye alimaanisha kwamba wao wapaswa kusali mara nyingi sana na kwa ukawaida na kumtegemea Mungu kwa mahitaji yao yote. Hakumaanisha kwamba wapaswa kusali tu na wasifanye kitu kingine chochote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~1#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he said that the disciples should always pray to God?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.3+In what way did Jesus describe the widow?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~3#Question:In what way did Jesus describe the widow?
trans-unit.source: In what way did Jesus describe the widow?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimfafanuaje mjane huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~3#Question:In what way did Jesus describe the widow?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~3#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the widow?-1539802578
trans-unit.source: She was persistent/kept on coming to the judge to do what was right. (3)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mwenye kuendelea/aliendelea kumwendea mwamuzi ili kufanya yaliyo sawa. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~3#Answer:In what way did Jesus describe the widow?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.3+What did the widow want from that judge?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~3#Question:What did the widow want from that judge?
trans-unit.source: What did the widow want from that judge?
trans-unit.target: Mjane huyo alitaka nini kutoka kwa hakimu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~3#Question:What did the widow want from that judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~3#Answer:What did the widow want from that judge?1206795744
trans-unit.source: She wanted him to listen to her problem (3),
trans-unit.target: Alitaka amsikilize tatizo lake (3),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~3#Answer:What did the widow want from that judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~3#Answer:What did the widow want from that judge?4580452
trans-unit.source: decide that another person was taking advantage of her (3),
trans-unit.target: kuamua kwamba mtu mwingine alikuwa kuchukua faida yake (3),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~3#Answer:What did the widow want from that judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~3#Answer:What did the widow want from that judge?1040719193
trans-unit.source: and correct it [in her favor] (3).
trans-unit.target: na akaifanya iwe sawa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~3#Answer:What did the widow want from that judge?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.4+Why did the widow keep on coming to that judge?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~4#Question:Why did the widow keep on coming to that judge?
trans-unit.source: Why did the widow keep on coming to that judge?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mjane huyo aliendelea kumwendea mwamuzi huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~4#Question:Why did the widow keep on coming to that judge?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~4#Answer:Why did the widow keep on coming to that judge?274227590
trans-unit.source: Because he would not take the time to listen to, and settle, the woman's complaint. (4)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu hakupata wakati wa kusikiliza na kusuluhisha malalamiko ya mwanamke huyo. (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~4#Answer:Why did the widow keep on coming to that judge?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.5+Why did he finally do what the woman had wanted for a long time?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~5#Question:Why did he finally do what the woman had wanted for a long time?
trans-unit.source: Why did he finally do what the woman had wanted for a long time?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hatimaye alifanya kile ambacho mwanamke huyo alikuwa ametaka kwa muda mrefu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~5#Question:Why did he finally do what the woman had wanted for a long time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~5#Answer:Why did he finally do what the woman had wanted for a long time?1420424134
trans-unit.source: Because she was bothering him/wearing him out with her repeated requests. (5)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu alikuwa akimsumbua/kumchosha kwa maombi yake ya kurudia-rudia. (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~5#Answer:Why did he finally do what the woman had wanted for a long time?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.5-8+What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~5#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wasikilize maneno au mawazo ya mwamuzi huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~5#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~5#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?-677452922
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wasikilize maneno ya mwamuzi huyo mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~5#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~5#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?1678633867
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had thought?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wasikilize maoni ya mwamuzi huyo mwovu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~5#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?-29615952
trans-unit.source: The judge said that he would help the woman because of her being persistent (5). Jesus then made a comparison to God answering our prayers to him (7-8).
trans-unit.target: Hakimu huyo alisema kwamba angemsaidia mwanamke huyo kwa sababu ya udumifu wake (5). Kisha Yesu alitoa mfano wa jinsi Mungu anavyojibu sala zetu (7-8).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus said that his disciples were to pay attention to what the corrupt judge had said/thought?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.8+If the people God has chosen as his have a need and are serious to have him help them, what are they to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~8#Question:If the people God has chosen as his have a need and are serious to have him help them, what are they to do?
trans-unit.source: If the people God has chosen as his have a need and are serious to have him help them, what are they to do?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu waliochaguliwa na Mungu wakiwa wake wana uhitaji na wanataka kwa uzito kwamba awasaidie, ni lazima wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~8#Question:If the people God has chosen as his have a need and are serious to have him help them, what are they to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~8#Answer:If the people God has chosen as his have a need and are serious to have him help them, what are they to do?-2186154
trans-unit.source: They are to pray day and night/very regularly each day for that need. (8)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kusali mchana na usiku/mara kwa mara kila siku kwa ajili ya uhitaji huo. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~8#Answer:If the people God has chosen as his have a need and are serious to have him help them, what are they to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.6-8+Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~6#Question:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu hao ambao Mungu amewachagua ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~6#Question:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~6#Answer:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?-1781548226
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: They are the people who believe that God sent Jesus as the Messiah/Christ to earth to save them from their sins. God knows who will believe that and he will save them. He also knows who will not believe that and he will punish them. (See Deut. 7:6-8a, 9:4-6; Matt. 22:14; John 15:16; and Rom. 8:28-33.)
trans-unit.target: Tathmini ya neno muhimu: Ni watu wanaoamini kwamba Mungu alimtuma Yesu duniani kama Masihi/Kristo ili awaokoe kutoka kwa dhambi zao. Mungu anajua ni nani atakayeamini hilo na atawaokoa. Pia anajua ni nani atakayeamini hilo na atawaadhibu (Tazama Kumbukumbu 7:6-8a, 9:4-6; Mt. 22:14; Yoh. 15:16; na Rom. 8:28-33).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~6#Answer:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~9#Alternate:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~9#Alternate:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?-1229398381
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha nini wasikilizaji wake kupitia mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~9#Alternate:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~9#Answer:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?-136626295
trans-unit.source: A person who sins and humbly pleads for God to remove his sin/to be merciful to him [and forgive him] is declared right/acceptable by God.
trans-unit.target: Mtu ambaye hutenda dhambi na kwa unyenyekevu anamwomba Mungu aondoe dhambi yake/kumhurumia [na kumsamehe] anatangazwa kuwa mwadilifu/kubaliwa na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~9#Answer:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~9#Answer:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?587937948
trans-unit.source: Those who believe that they can depend of their own good actions [to make them right with God] and who think that they are better than all other people will not be declared right/acceptable by God. They will be humiliated/shamed/embarrassed [by him] (14).
trans-unit.target: Hakika wale wanao jiona bora kuliko watu, hawatakuwa na haki mbele ya Mwenyezi Mungu, na hao ndio madhaalimu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~9#Answer:What did Jesus explain/teach by means of this parable to those who were listening to him?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~11#Question:To whom did the Pharisee compare himself when he prayed (to God)?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~11#Answer:To whom did the Pharisee compare himself when he prayed (to God)?-1496630503
trans-unit.source: He compared himself to all other people [and made them look bad while he made himself look good]. (11-12)

group.id: Q:LUK 18.11-12+What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~11#Question:What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?
trans-unit.target: Mfarisayo alisema ni sababu zipi alizofikiri zilizomfanya Mungu amheshimu au kumsaidia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~11#Question:What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~11#Answer:What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?234807968
trans-unit.source: He said that he was not like all the other people, whom he said robbed people, cheated people/did evil things, committed adultery or collected [more money than they should for] taxes. (11)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba hakuwa kama watu wengine wote, ambao alisema waliwaibia watu, waliwadanganya watu/walifanya mambo mabaya, walifanya uzinzi au kukusanya [pesa zaidi kuliko wanavyopaswa kwa] ushuru. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~11#Answer:What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~11#Answer:What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?88693478
trans-unit.source: [He implied he was better than others when] he said that he fasted two times each week and gave one-tenth of all that he got. (12) (See 11:42a.)
trans-unit.target: [Alidokeza kwamba yeye alikuwa bora kuliko wengine wakati] aliposema kwamba yeye hufunga mara mbili kila juma na kutoa sehemu ya kumi ya yote apatazo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~11#Answer:What did the Pharisee say were reasons that he thought that God should honor or help him?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.13+To whom or what did the man who collected tax money compare himself?

trans-unit.source: To whom or what did the man who collected tax money compare himself?
trans-unit.target: Mtu aliyechukua pesa za kodi alijilinganisha na nani au na nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~13#Answer:To whom or what did the man who collected tax money compare himself?-2126269179

trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Answer:To whom or what did the man who collected tax money compare himself?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.13+What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~13#Question:What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?
trans-unit.source: What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alisema ni sababu zipi zilizofanya afikiri kwamba Mungu apaswa kumsaidia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Question:What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?1992181219
trans-unit.source: He asked God to have mercy on him and remove/forgive his sin. (13)
trans-unit.target: Akamwomba Mwenyezi Mungu amrehemu na amwondolee dhambi yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~13#Note:What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?-2124058728
trans-unit.source: The Greek verb Luke used here includes more than the one English language action of "have mercy". Both of the actions in the answer above should be included in the translation (see L&N entries 40.9 and 88.75).
trans-unit.target: Kitenzi cha Kigiriki ambacho Luka alitumia hapa kina zaidi ya kitendo kimoja cha lugha ya Kiingereza cha "kuwa na rehema". Vitendo vyote viwili katika jibu hapo juu vinapaswa kuingizwa katika tafsiri (tazama viingilio vya L & N 40.9 na 88.75).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Note:What did that man say were reasons that he thought that God should help him?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.13+What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~13#Question:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?
trans-unit.source: What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alifanya nini kinachotuthibitishia kwamba alikuwa mnyenyekevu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Question:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?-1639659896
trans-unit.source: He stood at a distance [apart from others] (13),
trans-unit.target: Alipo kuwa mbali,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?-727160809
trans-unit.source: he would not even look up toward [God in] heaven (13),
trans-unit.target: hata asingeinua macho yake kuelekea mbinguni (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?-575904189
trans-unit.source: but was beating on/thumping his chest [as a sign of his sorrow over sins] (13).
trans-unit.target: Lakini alikuwa akipiga kifua chake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?785393660
trans-unit.source: The words of his prayer show that he did not think of himself as worthy of anything good from God. (13)
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya sala yake yanaonyesha kwamba hakujiona kuwa anastahili chochote kizuri kutoka kwa Mungu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~13#Answer:What did that man do which shows us that he was humble?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.14+What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~14#Question:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema sala za wanaume hao wawili zilikuwa na matokeo gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~14#Question:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~14#Answer:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?1230507861
trans-unit.source: God declared/made this tax collector right in his sight, that is, he forgave him,
trans-unit.target: Mungu alitangaza/alifanya mkusanya kodi huyu kuwa mwenye haki machoni pake, yaani, alimsamehe,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~14#Answer:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~14#Answer:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?-664324024
trans-unit.source: but that Pharisee was not forgiven/made right with God. (14a)
trans-unit.target: lakini yule Farisayo hakusamehewa/kufanywa kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu. (14a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~14#Answer:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~14#Note:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?-1874953602
trans-unit.source: The last half of verse 14 is exactly the same Greek wording as Luke wrote in 14:11. Try to make the translation here as much the same as you did there.
trans-unit.target: Nusu ya mwisho ya mstari wa 14 ni maneno yale yale ya Kigiriki aliyoandika Luka katika 14:11. Jaribu kufanya tafsiri hapa iwe sawa na ulivyofanya hapo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~14#Note:What did Jesus say was the result of those two men's prayers?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.15-17+Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~15#Question:Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nani wangekuwa watu ambao hawataingia katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~15#Question:Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~15#Answer:Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?-468895383
trans-unit.source: They would be the people who would not [humbly] accept his authority over them, like young children [accept authority over them]. (17)
trans-unit.target: Wao wangekuwa watu ambao hawangekubali [kwa unyenyekevu] mamlaka yake juu yao, kama watoto wadogo [kubali mamlaka juu yao]. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~15#Answer:Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~15#Note:Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?165123200
trans-unit.source: Luke wrote a strong negative word here in order to show Jesus's strong feelings about this. The translation should try to reflect a strong feeling, whether it states this verse in a positive or a negative way.
trans-unit.target: Luka aliandika neno baya sana hapa ili kuonyesha hisia kali za Yesu juu ya jambo hili. Tafsiri inapaswa kujaribu kutafakari hisia kali, iwe inataja mstari huu kwa njia nzuri au mbaya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~15#Note:Whom did Jesus say would be the people who would not enter God's kingdom?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.18+What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~18#Question:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?
trans-unit.source: What kind of life do you think eternal life is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri uhai wa milele ni uhai wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~18#Question:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~18#Answer:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?504107683
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is a life that is not affected by time limits, such as whether a person is still alive physically or not. It can begin now while we still are alive and will go on forever, even after our bodies die. Jesus in his dying and rising on our behalf made it possible for us to have that eternal life. God graciously and freely allows us to have that new life. It is a life of having a close relationship with God, obeying him as he rules over us.
trans-unit.target: Kipimo cha Muda Muhimu: Ni maisha ambayo hayaathiriwa na mipaka ya wakati, kama vile ikiwa mtu bado yuko hai kimwili au la. Inaweza kuanza sasa wakati bado tuko hai na itaendelea milele, hata baada ya miili yetu kufa. Yesu kwa kufa na kufufuka kwake kwa niaba yetu alifanya iwezekane kwetu kuwa na uzima huo wa milele. Mungu kwa neema na kwa uhuru anaturuhusu kuwa na maisha hayo mapya. Ni maisha ya kuwa na uhusiano wa karibu na Mungu, kumtii kama anavyotawala juu yetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~18#Answer:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~18#Note:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?-1430096979
trans-unit.source: See "life" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "maisha" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~18#Note:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~18#Note:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?379964436
trans-unit.source: If all the same people have continued to check Luke's gospel from 10:25 right through to this point, you may skip this question. But, if the consultant, translator, key assistants, or respondents have changed, or if there has been a time break of a week or more, please ask the question again.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wale wale wameendelea kuangalia injili ya Luka kuanzia 10:25 hadi kufikia hapa, unaweza kukipuka swali hili. Lakini, ikiwa mshauri, mtafsiri, wasaidizi wakuu, au waliojibu wamebadilika, au ikiwa kumekuwa na mapumziko ya wiki moja au zaidi, tafadhali uliza swali tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~18#Note:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~22#Note:According to Jesus, what more did the man have to do?-2038354238
trans-unit.source: The translator may want to have a footnote or glossary item which indicates that Jesus was showing the man that there was still one more command which he had not obeyed in his dealings with other people. In the list of ten commands which God had spoken to Moses, the last one spoke about coveting, that is, wrongly desiring to have things. That sin was preventing this man from receiving the eternal life which he wanted. His desire for things got in the way of his desire for God.
trans-unit.target: Mtafsiri anaweza kutaka kuwa na maelezo ya chini au kiambishi cha msamiati ambacho kinaonyesha kwamba Yesu alikuwa akimwonyesha mtu huyo kwamba bado kulikuwa na amri moja zaidi ambayo hakuwa ametii katika kushughulika kwake na watu wengine. Katika orodha ya amri kumi ambazo Mungu alikuwa amemwambia Musa, ya mwisho ilizungumza juu ya kutamani, yaani, kutamani vitu vibaya. Dhambi hiyo ilikuwa ikimzuia mtu huyu kupata uzima wa milele ambao alitaka. Tamaa yake ya vitu iliingia katika njia ya tamaa yake kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~22#Note:According to Jesus, what more did the man have to do?

trans-unit.target: Mambo [ambayo] hayawezekani kwa wanadamu yanawezekana kwa Mungu. (27) (Mungu anaweza kufanya kile ambacho wanadamu hawawezi kufanya. Mungu humwokoa mtu. Mtu hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe kwa kuwa na vitu vingi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~27#Answer:What was Jesus's answer?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.28+What did Peter say about the disciples and the things they had possessed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~28#Question:What did Peter say about the disciples and the things they had possessed?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter say about the disciples and the things they had possessed?
trans-unit.target: Petro alisema nini kuhusu wanafunzi na vitu walivyokuwa navyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~28#Question:What did Peter say about the disciples and the things they had possessed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~28#Answer:What did Peter say about the disciples and the things they had possessed?-1226143503
trans-unit.source: He reminded Jesus that they had left [all] their own things/family to follow him. (28)
trans-unit.target: Alimkumbusha Yesu kwamba walikuwa wameacha [vitu] vyao/familia yao ili wamfuate. (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~28#Answer:What did Peter say about the disciples and the things they had possessed?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.29-30+What reward will a person have for having left home and family for the sake of the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.source: What reward will a person have for having left home and family for the sake of the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Mtu atapata thawabu gani kwa kuacha nyumba na familia kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~29#Question:What reward will a person have for having left home and family for the sake of the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~29#Answer:What reward will a person have for having left home and family for the sake of the kingdom of God?-1252992029
trans-unit.source: He will receive many times the amount he left behind, both in this time [of physical life] and in eternal life. (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Atapokea mara nyingi kiasi alichoacha nyuma, katika wakati huu [wa maisha ya kimwili] na katika uhai wa milele.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~29#Answer:What reward will a person have for having left home and family for the sake of the kingdom of God?
