trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!18~31#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 18:31-34 Jesus told his disciples again that he would die and rise to live again.
trans-unit.target: Luka 18:31-34 Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake tena kwamba angekufa na kufufuliwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 18.31-34+Jesus has spoken several times to his disciples about these things. What do they now understand from hearing him all those times?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~31#Question:Jesus has spoken several times to his disciples about these things. What do they now understand from hearing him all those times?
trans-unit.source: Jesus has spoken several times to his disciples about these things. What do they now understand from hearing him all those times?
trans-unit.target: Yesu ameongea mara kadhaa na wanafunzi wake juu ya mambo haya. Ni nini wanachoelewa sasa kwa kumsikiliza mara hizo zote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Question:Jesus has spoken several times to his disciples about these things. What do they now understand from hearing him all those times?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~31#Answer:Jesus has spoken several times to his disciples about these things. What do they now understand from hearing him all those times?-82479385
trans-unit.source: Nothing. They still do not understand what, or how, all this could happen to Jesus. It is as if the clear meaning was hidden [by God] from them [until after the events]. (34)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna; bado hawaelewi ni nini, au jinsi gani, yote haya yanaweza kutokea kwa Yesu. Ni kana kwamba maana iliyo wazi imefichwa [na Mungu] kwao [hadi baada ya matukio].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Answer:Jesus has spoken several times to his disciples about these things. What do they now understand from hearing him all those times?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.31+What did Jesus do with his apostles?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~31#Question:What did Jesus do with his apostles?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do with his apostles?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini pamoja na mitume wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Question:What did Jesus do with his apostles?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~31#Answer:What did Jesus do with his apostles?1802614208
trans-unit.source: He took them [aside from the larger group of disciples or others] and told them what would happen to him after they reached Jerusalem. (31)
trans-unit.target: Aliwachukua [kutoka kwa kikundi kikubwa cha wanafunzi au wengine] na kuwaambia kile ambacho kingempata baada ya wao kufika Yerusalemu. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Answer:What did Jesus do with his apostles?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.31+What did Jesus say would happen to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~31#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema angepata nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?610401007
trans-unit.source: Everything that the prophets had written [in the Old Testament] about the Son of Man would be accomplished/take place. (31)
trans-unit.target: Yote ambayo manabii wameandika [katika Agano la Kale] juu ya Mwana wa binadamu yatatimizwa/yatatukia. (31)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.32-33+What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~32#Question:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?
trans-unit.source: What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?
trans-unit.target: Ni mambo gani hususa ambayo Yesu alisema yangetukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Question:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?1688790901
trans-unit.source: [Someone] would betray him to the Gentile/non-Jewish people. (32)
trans-unit.target: [Mtu fulani] angemsaliti kwa watu wasio Wayahudi. (32)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?-308886250
trans-unit.source: They would mock/make fun of him (32),
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimfanyia maskhara,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?643187226
trans-unit.source: insult him (32),
trans-unit.target: kumtukana (32),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?219550741
trans-unit.source: spit on him (32),
trans-unit.target: kumtemea mate (32),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?2119698106
trans-unit.source: and flogging/whipping him, they would kill him (33).
trans-unit.target: na kumpiga mijeledi, wangemuua (33).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Answer:What things did Jesus specifically say would happen?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.32+Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~32#Question:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.
trans-unit.source: Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.
trans-unit.target: Niambie watu wa kijiji chako wangefikiri nini ikiwa mtu angewatemea mate au kuwagombeza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Question:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.-1874457198
trans-unit.source: Tell me what your people would think if someone spit on them or at them.
trans-unit.target: Niambie watu wako wangefikiri nini ikiwa mtu angewatemea mate au kuwagombeza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.1099659676
trans-unit.source: Tell me what you would think if someone spit at you.
trans-unit.target: Niambie ungefikiria nini ikiwa mtu angekuvulia mate.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.47314714
trans-unit.source: What you would think if someone spit at you?
trans-unit.target: Ungehisije ikiwa mtu angekuvulia mate?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.-1779752655
trans-unit.source: Tell me what the people in your language area would think if someone spit on them or at them.
trans-unit.target: Niambie watu katika eneo unalosema lugha yao wangefikiri nini ikiwa mtu angewatemea mate au kuwagombeza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Alternate:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~32#Answer:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.2046724800
trans-unit.source: In that time, spitting on someone, especially in that person's face, was an extreme insult.
trans-unit.target: Wakati huo, kumtemea mtu mate, hasa usoni, kulikuwa dhihaka kubwa sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Answer:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~32#Note:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.867998936
trans-unit.source: The answer should show the translator or consultant whether the intent of those who would spit on Jesus was also understood correctly or not.
trans-unit.target: Jibu hilo linapaswa kumwonyesha mtafsiri au mshauri ikiwa nia ya wale ambao wangemtupia Yesu mate ilieleweka kwa usahihi au la.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~32#Note:Tell me what the people in your village would think if someone spit on them or at them.

group.id: Q:LUK 18.33+What did Jesus say would happen after that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~33#Question:What did Jesus say would happen after that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen after that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingetokea baada ya hapo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~33#Question:What did Jesus say would happen after that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~33#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen after that?-2100253796
trans-unit.source: On the third day he would rise again [to life]. (33)
trans-unit.target: Lakini siku ya tatu atafufuliwa".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~33#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen after that?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.34+What did the disciples think about all this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~34#Question:What did the disciples think about all this?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples think about all this?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifikiri nini kuhusu mambo hayo yote?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~34#Question:What did the disciples think about all this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~34#Answer:What did the disciples think about all this?189365067
trans-unit.source: They understood nothing about it, that is, they did not know what he was talking about. (34)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuelewa chochote cha jambo hilo, yaani, hawakujua alichokuwa akisema.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~34#Answer:What did the disciples think about all this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~34#Answer:What did the disciples think about all this?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~34#Answer:What did the disciples think about all this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~34#Answer:What did the disciples think about all this?1141193311
trans-unit.source: The meaning of what [Jesus] had said had been hidden from them [by God/by their own misunderstanding]. (34)
trans-unit.target: Maana ya yale [Yesu] aliyosema yalifichwa kwao [na Mungu/kwa sababu ya kutoelewa kwao wenyewe].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~34#Answer:What did the disciples think about all this?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!18~35#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 18:35-43 Jesus healed a blind beggar who persisted in asking for help.
trans-unit.target: Luka 18:35-43 Yesu alimponya mwombaji kipofu aliyeendelea kuomba msaada.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 18.35-43+What special name did the blind man call Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~35#Question:What special name did the blind man call Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What special name did the blind man call Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni jina gani la pekee ambalo yule mwanamume kipofu alimwita Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Question:What special name did the blind man call Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~35#Answer:What special name did the blind man call Jesus?659840444
trans-unit.source: He called him the Son of David. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita Mwana wa Daudi. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Answer:What special name did the blind man call Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.35-43+What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~35#Question:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichomfanya mtu huyo kipofu aweze kuona tena/kuokolewa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Question:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~35#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?357292499
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichomfanya mwanamume huyo kipofu aone tena?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!18~35#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?1322773794
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being saved?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kilichokuwa kisababishi cha kuokolewa kwa yule mwanamume kipofu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Alternate:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~35#Answer:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?197389632
trans-unit.source: He had faith/believed that Jesus could heal/save him [by God's power when no other way was possible]. (42)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na imani/aliamini kwamba Yesu angeweza kumponya/kumwokoa [kwa nguvu ya Mungu wakati hakuna njia nyingine iwezekanavyo]. (42)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Answer:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~35#Note:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?-1182126445
trans-unit.source: These are the same Greek words as Luke wrote at 7:50 and 17:19. Try to make the translation here as much the same wording as was used in those other verses.
trans-unit.target: Haya ni maneno yaleyale ya Kigiriki ambayo Luka aliandika kwenye 7:50 na 17:19. Jaribu kufanya tafsiri hapa iwe sawa na maneno yaleyale yaliyotumiwa katika mistari hiyo mingine.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Note:What did Jesus say was the cause of the blind man being able to see again/being saved?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.35+Where did Jesus meet the blind man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~35#Question:Where did Jesus meet the blind man?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus meet the blind man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikutana na mwanamume huyo kipofu wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Question:Where did Jesus meet the blind man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~35#Answer:Where did Jesus meet the blind man?2146888460
trans-unit.source: Jesus was approaching Jericho and the blind man was sitting by the side of that road begging [for money from the people who walked past him]. (35)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipokuwa akikaribia Yeriko, mtu mmoja kipofu alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba [pesa kutoka kwa watu waliokuwa wakitembea kupitia kwake].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~35#Answer:Where did Jesus meet the blind man?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.36+Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~36#Question:Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?
trans-unit.source: Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini yule mwanamume kipofu aliwauliza wengine ni nini kilichokuwa kikitendeka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~36#Question:Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~36#Answer:Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?836345024
trans-unit.source: He heard a crowd going past [him]. (36)
trans-unit.target: Akasikia umati ukipita [kando yake].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~36#Answer:Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~36#Note:Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?-2146458509
trans-unit.source: This implied that something important was happening, or that someone important was passing by. An important person with a crowd of people following him might be generous to the blind man when all those other people were watching.
trans-unit.target: Hilo lilimaanisha kwamba jambo fulani la maana lilikuwa likiendelea, au kwamba mtu fulani wa maana alikuwa akipita. Mtu wa maana mwenye umati wa watu wenye kumfuata huenda akawa mkarimu kwa yule kipofu huku watu hao wengine wote wakitazama.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~36#Note:Why did the blind man ask others what was happening?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.36+Who do you think that crowd of people was?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~36#Question:Who do you think that crowd of people was?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think that crowd of people was?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri umati huo ulikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~36#Question:Who do you think that crowd of people was?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~36#Answer:Who do you think that crowd of people was?-2087769644
trans-unit.source: It was Jesus's 12 apostles and other disciples, at the least; maybe even other people who were also going to Jerusalem [for the Passover festival]. (36)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa mitume 12 wa Yesu na wanafunzi wengine, angalau; labda hata watu wengine waliokuwa pia wakienda Yerusalemu [kwa sikukuu ya Kupitwa]. (36)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~36#Answer:Who do you think that crowd of people was?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.37+What did people tell him was happening?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~37#Question:What did people tell him was happening?
trans-unit.source: What did people tell him was happening?
trans-unit.target: Watu walimwambia nini kilichokuwa kikitendeka?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~37#Question:What did people tell him was happening?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~37#Answer:What did people tell him was happening?-1456235892
trans-unit.source: They told him that Jesus from [the town of] Nazareth was passing by. (37)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwambia, Yesu Mnazareti anapita.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~37#Answer:What did people tell him was happening?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.38+When the blind man heard it was Jesus, what did he do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~38#Question:When the blind man heard it was Jesus, what did he do?
trans-unit.source: When the blind man heard it was Jesus, what did he do?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo kipofu aliposikia kwamba ni Yesu, alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~38#Question:When the blind man heard it was Jesus, what did he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~38#Answer:When the blind man heard it was Jesus, what did he do?-721474650
trans-unit.source: He shouted out to Jesus to have mercy/pity on him. (38)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita Yesu kwa sauti kubwa ili amhurumie. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~38#Answer:When the blind man heard it was Jesus, what did he do?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.39+How did those people who were coming along at the front of that crowd respond to his calling out?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~39#Question:How did those people who were coming along at the front of that crowd respond to his calling out?
trans-unit.source: How did those people who were coming along at the front of that crowd respond to his calling out?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao waliokuwa wakija mbele ya umati huo waliitikiaje mwito wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Question:How did those people who were coming along at the front of that crowd respond to his calling out?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~39#Answer:How did those people who were coming along at the front of that crowd respond to his calling out?1826628815
trans-unit.source: They sternly commanded/rebuked him to be quiet. (39)
trans-unit.target: Wakamkata/wakamkaripia kwa ukali ili anyamaze. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Answer:How did those people who were coming along at the front of that crowd respond to his calling out?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.39+How did that man respond when the others commanded him to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~39#Question:How did that man respond when the others commanded him to be quiet?
trans-unit.source: How did that man respond when the others commanded him to be quiet?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo aliitikiaje wengine walipomwamuru anyamaze?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Question:How did that man respond when the others commanded him to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~39#Answer:How did that man respond when the others commanded him to be quiet?-1331989645
trans-unit.source: He cried out/screamed to Jesus even more [loudly] for Jesus to have mercy/pity on him. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alilia/alipiga kelele kwa Yesu hata zaidi [kwa sauti] kwa Yesu kuwa na huruma/huruma juu yake. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Answer:How did that man respond when the others commanded him to be quiet?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.39+David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~39#Question:David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?
trans-unit.source: David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?
trans-unit.target: Daudi alikuwa mfalme wa Wayahudi mamia ya miaka mapema. Unafikiri ni kwa nini yule mwanamume kipofu alimwita Yesu Mwana wa Daudi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Question:David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~39#Answer:David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?-1513380696
trans-unit.source: The man had heard about Jesus being the Messiah whom God had promised to send, so now the man called him by a common Jewish title for the Messiah. (39)
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alikuwa amesikia juu ya Yesu kuwa Mesiya ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi kumtuma, kwa hiyo sasa mtu huyo alimwita kwa jina la cheo la kawaida la Kiyahudi kwa Mesiya. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Answer:David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!18~39#Note:David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?-385840162
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~39#Note:David had been a king of the Jews many hundreds of years earlier. What do you think was the reason that the blind man called Jesus the Son of David?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.40+How did Jesus react to the blind man's shouting?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~40#Question:How did Jesus react to the blind man's shouting?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus react to the blind man's shouting?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje kilio cha yule mwanamume kipofu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~40#Question:How did Jesus react to the blind man's shouting?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~40#Answer:How did Jesus react to the blind man's shouting?1298868092
trans-unit.source: Jesus stopped [walking] and commanded that [someone] bring the man to him. (40)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisimama [kutembea] na kuamuru [mtu fulani] amlete mtu huyo kwake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~40#Answer:How did Jesus react to the blind man's shouting?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.41+What did Jesus ask the blind man?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~41#Question:What did Jesus ask the blind man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask the blind man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza nini yule mwanamume kipofu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~41#Question:What did Jesus ask the blind man?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~41#Answer:What did Jesus ask the blind man?-269893784
trans-unit.source: He asked, "What do you want me to do for you?" (41)
trans-unit.target: Akawauliza, "Mnataka niwafanyie nini?" (41)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~41#Answer:What did Jesus ask the blind man?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.41+What did the man want Jesus to do for him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~41#Question:What did the man want Jesus to do for him?
trans-unit.source: What did the man want Jesus to do for him?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alitaka Yesu amfanyie nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~41#Question:What did the man want Jesus to do for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~41#Answer:What did the man want Jesus to do for him?-847025545
trans-unit.source: He said that he wanted to see [again]./He said that he wanted [Jesus to do something] in order that he might see [again]. (41)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba alitaka kuona [tena]./Alisema kwamba alitaka [Yesu afanye jambo fulani] ili aweze kuona [tena]. (41)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~41#Answer:What did the man want Jesus to do for him?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.42-43+What did Jesus do to make the man see again?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~42#Question:What did Jesus do to make the man see again?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do to make the man see again?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini ili kumponya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~42#Question:What did Jesus do to make the man see again?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~42#Answer:What did Jesus do to make the man see again?-1478207407
trans-unit.source: He only spoke the words, "See again." (42a, 43a)
trans-unit.target: Alisema maneno tu, "Ona tena". (42a, 43a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~42#Answer:What did Jesus do to make the man see again?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.43+How did the man respond to his being able to see?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~43#Question:How did the man respond to his being able to see?
trans-unit.source: How did the man respond to his being able to see?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alitendaje alipoona?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~43#Question:How did the man respond to his being able to see?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~43#Answer:How did the man respond to his being able to see?-1158575455
trans-unit.source: He followed Jesus, praising God. (43b)
trans-unit.target: Alimfuata Yesu, akimsifu Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~43#Answer:How did the man respond to his being able to see?

group.id: Q:LUK 18.40-43+How did all the other people who were walking with Jesus respond to this?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!18~40#Question:How did all the other people who were walking with Jesus respond to this?
trans-unit.source: How did all the other people who were walking with Jesus respond to this?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine wote waliokuwa wakitembea pamoja na Yesu waliitikiaje hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~40#Question:How did all the other people who were walking with Jesus respond to this?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!18~40#Answer:How did all the other people who were walking with Jesus respond to this?-359313488
trans-unit.source: All the people [who] saw what happened were [also] praising God. (43c)
trans-unit.target: Watu wote [walioona] yaliyotokea walimsifu Mungu [pia].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!18~40#Answer:How did all the other people who were walking with Jesus respond to this?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!19~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 19:1-10 A tax collector named Zacchaeus met Jesus and repented.
trans-unit.target: Luka 19:1-10 Mtoza kodi aitwaye Zakayo alikutana na Yesu na kutubu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 19.1-10+Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~1#Question:Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?
trans-unit.target: Yesu na mwanamume Zakayo walikutana na kuzungumza wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Question:Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~1#Answer:Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?93339934
trans-unit.source: In the town of Jericho when Jesus stopped under the tree in which Zacchaeus had climbed. (1, 4, 5)
trans-unit.target: Katika mji wa Yeriko wakati Yesu aliposimama chini ya mti ambao Zakayo alikuwa amepanda. (1, 4, 5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Answer:Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~1#Answer:Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?-532869856
trans-unit.source: Later they talked at Zacchaeus's house. (6-9)
trans-unit.target: Baadaye walizungumza katika nyumba ya Zakayo (6-9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Answer:Where did Jesus and the man Zacchaeus meet and talk?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.1-10+How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~1#Question:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?
trans-unit.target: Ziara ya Yesu kwa Zakayo ilibadilije maisha yake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Question:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~1#Answer:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?1864419510
trans-unit.source: He gave half of his possessions to the poor [people] (8)
trans-unit.target: Aliwapa maskini nusu ya mali zake (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Answer:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~1#Answer:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?-1837854226
trans-unit.source: and, if he had cheated anyone of anything, he promised to pay back four times as much. (8)
trans-unit.target: na ikiwa alikuwa amemwibia mtu kitu fulani, aliahidi kulipa mara nne zaidi. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Answer:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!19~1#Note:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?-1383225789
trans-unit.source: Although the Greek words are translated "If …," and leave the point unclear in English, the Greek grammar shows that Zacchaeus was admitting that he had sometimes cheated people concerning their taxes. He said, in effect, "To those people whom I have cheated, I now offer four times the amount back."
trans-unit.target: Ingawa maneno ya Kigiriki yanatafsiriwa "Ikiwa . . . " na hivyo maneno hayo hayana maana kamili katika Kiswahili, sarufi ya Kigiriki inaonyesha kwamba Zakayo alikuwa akikubali kwamba nyakati nyingine aliwadanganya watu kuhusu kodi zao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Note:How did Jesus's visit with Zacchaeus change Zacchaeus's way of living?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.1-10+What did Jesus say was the real purpose of him stopping to talk to Zacchaeus and staying at his house?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~1#Question:What did Jesus say was the real purpose of him stopping to talk to Zacchaeus and staying at his house?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was the real purpose of him stopping to talk to Zacchaeus and staying at his house?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kusudi halisi la yeye kusimama ili kuzungumza na Zakayo na kukaa nyumbani mwake lilikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Question:What did Jesus say was the real purpose of him stopping to talk to Zacchaeus and staying at his house?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~1#Answer:What did Jesus say was the real purpose of him stopping to talk to Zacchaeus and staying at his house?-471077886
trans-unit.source: [He], the Son of Man, had come [to this earth] to search out and save those [people like Zacchaeus] who knew they were [spiritually] lost/without hope. (10)
trans-unit.target: [Yeye], Mwana wa Adamu, alikuwa amekuja [katika dunia hii] kuwatafuta na kuwaokoa wale [watu kama Zakayo] ambao alijua walikuwa [kiroho] wamepotea/bila tumaini. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~1#Answer:What did Jesus say was the real purpose of him stopping to talk to Zacchaeus and staying at his house?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.2-3+Tell me about Zacchaeus.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~2#Question:Tell me about Zacchaeus.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about Zacchaeus.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu Zakayo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~2#Question:Tell me about Zacchaeus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.-1312214833
trans-unit.source: He was a chief/a superintendent/a highly ranked collector of taxes [for the Roman government], (2)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mkuu/msimamizi/mtoza kodi mwenye cheo cha juu [kwa serikali ya Roma] (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.1496745899
trans-unit.source: He was rich, (2)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa tajiri, (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.-923105716
trans-unit.source: He was a short man, (3)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mtu mfupi, (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.1902732560
trans-unit.source: but he wanted to see who Jesus was. (3)
trans-unit.target: lakini alitaka kumwona Yesu alikuwa nani. (3)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~2#Answer:Tell me about Zacchaeus.

group.id: Q:LUK 19.4+What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~4#Question:What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?
trans-unit.source: What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?
trans-unit.target: Alifanya nini ili amwone Yesu akipita?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~4#Question:What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~4#Answer:What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?581241540
trans-unit.source: He ran ahead [of where Jesus was or would pass by]
trans-unit.target: Akakimbia mbele [ya mahali ambapo Yesu alikuwa au angepita]
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~4#Answer:What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~4#Answer:What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?-2067988399
trans-unit.source: and climbed a (sycamore) tree. (4)
trans-unit.target: Na nikapanda mti wa mtini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~4#Answer:What did he do in order to see Jesus pass by?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.5+What happened when Jesus came up the place where Zacchaeus was in the tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~5#Question:What happened when Jesus came up the place where Zacchaeus was in the tree?
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus came up the place where Zacchaeus was in the tree?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipopanda mahali ambapo Zakayo alikuwa katika ule mti?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~5#Question:What happened when Jesus came up the place where Zacchaeus was in the tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~5#Answer:What happened when Jesus came up the place where Zacchaeus was in the tree?-267008475
trans-unit.source: He looked up and spoke to Zacchaeus (about coming down because Jesus wanted to stay overnight at Zacchaeus's house with him). (5)
trans-unit.target: Aliinua macho yake na kuzungumza na Zakayo (kuhusu kushuka kwa sababu Yesu alitaka kukaa usiku huo katika nyumba ya Zakayo pamoja naye). (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~5#Answer:What happened when Jesus came up the place where Zacchaeus was in the tree?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.6+How did Zacchaeus respond to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~6#Question:How did Zacchaeus respond to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did Zacchaeus respond to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Zakayo alimtendeaje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~6#Question:How did Zacchaeus respond to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~6#Answer:How did Zacchaeus respond to Jesus?-1494322699
trans-unit.source: He came down hurriedly and happily welcomed him [to stay at his home overnight]. (6)
trans-unit.target: Akashuka upesi, akamkaribisha kwa furaha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~6#Answer:How did Zacchaeus respond to Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.7+Many people saw Jesus and Zacchaeus talking and walking together. What did they all think?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~7#Question:Many people saw Jesus and Zacchaeus talking and walking together. What did they all think?
trans-unit.source: Many people saw Jesus and Zacchaeus talking and walking together. What did they all think?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi waliona Yesu na Zakayo wakizungumza na kutembea pamoja. Wote walifikiri nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~7#Question:Many people saw Jesus and Zacchaeus talking and walking together. What did they all think?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~7#Answer:Many people saw Jesus and Zacchaeus talking and walking together. What did they all think?863440429
trans-unit.source: They were muttering/grumbling [among themselves] that Jesus had entered the house to stay overnight with a [man they assumed to be a blatant] sinner. (7)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimnung'unikia/kunung'unika [miongoni mwao wenyewe] kwamba Yesu alikuwa ameingia nyumbani ili kulala na [mtu waliyefikiri kuwa mtenda dhambi] mwenye dhambi. (7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~7#Answer:Many people saw Jesus and Zacchaeus talking and walking together. What did they all think?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.7-10+What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~7#Question:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Zakayo alisema kwamba ataacha pesa zake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~7#Question:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?-2031848691
trans-unit.source: His work was with tax money and giving those taxes to the [enemy] Roman government. People thought, or knew, that Zacchaeus had gotten rich by keeping more of that tax money than was right.
trans-unit.target: Watu walifikiri, au walijua, kwamba Zakayo alikuwa ametajiri kwa kuweka zaidi ya fedha hizo za kodi kuliko ilivyokuwa lazima.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?-507895621
trans-unit.source: He changed because being with Jesus made him sorry for his past wrong actions.
trans-unit.target: Alibadilika kwa sababu kuwa pamoja na Yesu kulimfanya ajute juu ya matendo yake mabaya ya wakati uliopita.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Zacchaeus spoke about giving away his money?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.9+What did Jesus say about Zacchaeus's promises?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~9#Question:What did Jesus say about Zacchaeus's promises?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about Zacchaeus's promises?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu ahadi za Zakayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~9#Question:What did Jesus say about Zacchaeus's promises?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~9#Answer:What did Jesus say about Zacchaeus's promises?-548541146
trans-unit.source: He said that people [who lived] in that house, [that is Zacchaeus and, maybe, all those who lived there,] had that day been saved [by God from the punishment they deserved because of their sins]. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu [waliokaa] katika nyumba hiyo, [yaani Zakayo na, labda, wote walioishi huko,] walikuwa wameokolewa siku hiyo [na Mungu kutokana na adhabu waliyostahili kwa sababu ya dhambi zao]. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~9#Answer:What did Jesus say about Zacchaeus's promises?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.9+What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~9#Question:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?
trans-unit.source: What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?
trans-unit.target: Zakeo alikuwa na uhusiano gani na Abrahamu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~9#Question:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~9#Answer:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?-1010280643
trans-unit.source: Jesus called him Abraham's son, but that meant he was a descendant of the Jews' ancestor Abraham. (See 13:16.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwita mwana wa Abrahamu, lakini hilo lilimaanisha kwamba alikuwa mzao wa Abrahamu babu ya Wayahudi (Ona 13:16.)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~9#Answer:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~9#Answer:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~9#Answer:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~9#Answer:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?-475174786
trans-unit.source: Jesus referred to Zacchaeus's believing and trusting in God as being just like [ancestor] Abraham had done.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaja kwamba Zakayo aliamini na kumtumaini Mungu kama vile Abrahamu [baba yake wa zamani] alivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~9#Answer:What was Zacchaeus's relationship to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!19~11#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 19:11-27 Jesus told a parable about a man who trusted each of ten of his servants with a valuable gold coin/a large amount of money while he went away to be made a king.
trans-unit.target: Luka 19:11-27 Yesu alisimulia mfano juu ya mtu aliyewapa kila mmoja wa watumwa wake kumi sarafu ya dhahabu yenye thamani kubwa/ kiasi kikubwa cha fedha alipokuwa akienda mbali ili afanywe mfalme.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 19.11-27+What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~11#Question:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?
trans-unit.source: What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa na sababu zipi za kuwaambia watu mfano huu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Question:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~11#Answer:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?943014190
trans-unit.source: He was [relatively] near Jerusalem [on his way there] (11)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa [kwa kulinganishwa] karibu na Yerusalemu [akiwa njiani kwenda huko] (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Answer:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~11#Answer:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?-1346291167
trans-unit.source: and the [people] thought that the kingdom of God was about to appear at any moment [especially when he would reach Jerusalem]. (11)
trans-unit.target: na [watu] walidhani kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa karibu kutokea wakati wowote [hasa wakati ambapo angefikia Yerusalemu]. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Answer:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!19~11#Note:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?1808290621
trans-unit.source: The respondent may answer with the words from verse 26, discussed below. That is all right, but do point out the wording in verse 11 again, as well.
trans-unit.target: Huenda yule anayejibu akajibu kwa maneno ya mstari wa 26, yanayozungumziwa hapa chini. Hiyo ni sawa, lakini onyesha maneno ya mstari wa 11 tena, pia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Note:What were Jesus's reasons for telling this parable to the people?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.11-27+How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~11#Question:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?
trans-unit.source: How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?
trans-unit.target: Huenda Yesu alitaka wasikilizaji wake waeleweje mfano wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Question:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~11#Answer:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?-1031981821
trans-unit.source: Jesus would be going away and would not return until God made him to be king over all the people. In the meantime, other Jews would oppose him being the king over them. They should only expect to receive punishment when he returns.
trans-unit.target: Yesu angetoka na hangeweza kurudi mpaka Mungu amfanye awe mfalme juu ya watu wote. Wakati huo huo, Wayahudi wengine wangempinga kuwa mfalme juu yao. Wanapaswa tu kutarajia adhabu atakaporudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Answer:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~11#Answer:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Answer:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~11#Answer:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?-1131887123
trans-unit.source: While he would be gone, his disciples must serve him faithfully and use the abilities he had given them for his overall good. Any disciple who was not faithful would be judged.
trans-unit.target: Wakati ambapo angekuwa ameondoka, wanafunzi wake walipaswa kumtumikia kwa uaminifu na kutumia uwezo ambao alikuwa amewapa kwa ajili ya wema wake wa ujumla.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~11#Answer:How might Jesus have wanted the listeners to understand his parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~47#Answer:What did Jesus himself do in the temple grounds/area each day?811953414
trans-unit.source: He taught [the people about the kingdom of God]. (47)
trans-unit.target: Alifundisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Answer:What did Jesus himself do in the temple grounds/area each day?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.47+What did the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and leaders of the people want to do about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~47#Question:What did the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and leaders of the people want to do about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and leaders of the people want to do about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu, waandishi, na viongozi wa watu wanataka kufanya nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Question:What did the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and leaders of the people want to do about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~47#Answer:What did the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and leaders of the people want to do about Jesus?618934239
trans-unit.source: They tried to find a way to kill him. (47)
trans-unit.target: Walitafuta njia ya kumwua.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Answer:What did the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and leaders of the people want to do about Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.47-48+What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~47#Question:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walikuwa na hasira kiasi cha kutaka Yesu auawe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Question:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~47#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?-319854292
trans-unit.source: Because they felt that they were the important religious leaders.
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu walijiona kuwa viongozi wa kidini wenye kuheshimika.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~47#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?-1982143594
trans-unit.source: They felt they were the ones who had authority to decide what could happen inside the temple grounds, not Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Walihisi kwamba wao ndio waliokuwa na mamlaka ya kuamua kile ambacho kingeweza kutukia ndani ya uwanja wa hekalu, si Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~47#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?1458073577
trans-unit.source: They felt they were the ones to teach the people about God, not Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Walihisi kwamba wao ndio waliopaswa kuwafundisha watu juu ya Mungu, si Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~47#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were angry enough to want Jesus to die?

group.id: Q:LUK 19.48+Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!19~48#Question:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?
trans-unit.source: Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakumuua Yesu mara moja?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~48#Question:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!19~48#Answer:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?-407029306
trans-unit.source: [They were afraid the crowd would turn against them] because all the people were listening closely to what he taught them. (48)
trans-unit.target: [Wao waliogopa umati ungewageukia] kwa sababu watu wote walikuwa wakisikiliza kwa makini yale aliyokuwa akiwafundisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!19~48#Answer:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!20~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 20:1-8 The religious leaders asked Jesus about where his authority came from.
trans-unit.target: Luka 20:1-8 Viongozi wa kidini walimwuliza Yesu mamlaka yake yalitoka wapi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 20.1-8+What did the groups of leaders of the Jews want to know from Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~1#Question:What did the groups of leaders of the Jews want to know from Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the groups of leaders of the Jews want to know from Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Vikundi vya viongozi Wayahudi vilitaka kujua nini kutoka kwa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Question:What did the groups of leaders of the Jews want to know from Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~1#Answer:What did the groups of leaders of the Jews want to know from Jesus?-734485586
trans-unit.source: They wanted to know who had given him authority to do the things he had been doing. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kujua ni nani aliyempa mamlaka ya kufanya mambo aliyokuwa akifanya. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Answer:What did the groups of leaders of the Jews want to know from Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.1-8+What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not give those men an answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~1#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not give those men an answer?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not give those men an answer?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu hakujibu maswali yao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not give those men an answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~1#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not give those men an answer?-533272070
trans-unit.source: Since they did not believe that God had given authority to John to baptize, then they also would not believe that God had given him (Jesus) authority to do what he had been doing. Therefore, it would be useless to say that God had sent him. They would not believe him anyway. (4-8)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa hawakuamini kwamba Mungu alimpa Yohana mamlaka ya kubatiza, basi wao pia hawakuamini kwamba Mungu alimpa (Yesu) mamlaka ya kufanya yale aliyofanya. Kwa hivyo, ingekuwa bure kusema kwamba Mungu alimtuma. Hawangemwamini hata hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not give those men an answer?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.1+What was Jesus doing when the groups of leaders of the Jews came to talk to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~1#Question:What was Jesus doing when the groups of leaders of the Jews came to talk to him?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus doing when the groups of leaders of the Jews came to talk to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifanya nini wakati vikundi vya viongozi wa Kiyahudi vilipoja kuzungumza naye?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Question:What was Jesus doing when the groups of leaders of the Jews came to talk to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~1#Answer:What was Jesus doing when the groups of leaders of the Jews came to talk to him?-878228085
trans-unit.source: He was in the temple area teaching the people [who believed in him] and preaching the Good News [to others] [that God's plan to send the Messiah to save people was happening right then]. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa katika eneo la hekalu akifundisha watu [waliomwamini] na kuhubiri Habari Njema [kwa wengine] [kwamba mpango wa Mungu wa kutuma Mesiya ili kuwaokoa watu ulikuwa ukitendeka wakati huohuo]. (1)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~1#Answer:What was Jesus doing when the groups of leaders of the Jews came to talk to him?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.2+What question did they ask him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~2#Question:What question did they ask him?
trans-unit.source: What question did they ask him?
trans-unit.target: Waliuliza swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~2#Question:What question did they ask him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~2#Answer:What question did they ask him?-66497979
trans-unit.source: They asked him who had given him the authority to do what he was doing at the temple. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza ni nani aliyempa mamlaka ya kufanya mambo aliyofanya hekaluni. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~2#Answer:What question did they ask him?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.3-4+How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~3#Question:How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~3#Question:How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~3#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?1765315891
trans-unit.source: He asked them a question whether it was God who had given authority to John to baptize [people] or whether only other people had given that authority to John. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza swali kama ilikuwa ni Mungu aliyetoa mamlaka kwa Yohana kubatiza [watu] au kama watu wengine tu walitoa mamlaka hayo kwa Yohana. (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~3#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.5-6+Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~5#Question:Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini vikundi hivyo vya viongozi Wayahudi viliongea juu ya jambo hilo miongoni mwao wenyewe kwanza kabla ya kumjibu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~5#Question:Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~5#Answer:Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?24840019
trans-unit.source: They knew that if they said [God in] heaven had given authority to John [to baptize people], then Jesus would ask them, "Why did you not believe him/believe what he said?" (5)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba ikiwa wangesema [Mungu aliye mbinguni] alikuwa amempa Yohana mamlaka [ya kubatiza watu], basi Yesu angewauliza, "Kwa nini hamkumwamini/kuamini aliyosema?" (5)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~5#Answer:Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~5#Answer:Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?-308710147
trans-unit.source: However, if they said it was [not God, but some other] people, then all the people who believed that John was a prophet [sent by God] would kill those leaders with large stones. (6)
trans-unit.target: Hata hivyo, wakisema ni [si Mungu, bali mtu fulani] watu, basi watu wote wanaoamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii [aliyetumwa na Mungu] wangewaua viongozi hao kwa mawe makubwa. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~5#Answer:Why did those groups of leaders of the Jews first talk about this among themselves before they answered Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.7+How did they answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~7#Question:How did they answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did they answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walimjibu Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~7#Question:How did they answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~7#Answer:How did they answer Jesus?-1318869286
trans-unit.source: They said, "We do not know [who gave authority to John]." (7)
trans-unit.target: Wakasema: Hatujui.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~7#Answer:How did they answer Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.8+How did Jesus then answer their question?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~8#Question:How did Jesus then answer their question?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus then answer their question?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje swali lao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~8#Question:How did Jesus then answer their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~8#Answer:How did Jesus then answer their question?-419048220
trans-unit.source: He said that, since they would not tell him [who had authorized John to baptize people], he would also not tell them who had authorized him to do what he was doing. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba, kwa kuwa hawakutaka kumwambia [ambaye alikuwa amempa Yohana mamlaka ya kubatiza watu], yeye pia hangewaambia ni nani aliyekuwa amempa mamlaka ya kufanya yale aliyokuwa akifanya. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~8#Answer:How did Jesus then answer their question?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!20~9#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 20:9-19 Jesus told a parable about a landowner who rented his vineyard to some tenants.
trans-unit.target: Luka 20:9-19 Yesu alitoa mfano kuhusu mwenye shamba la mizabibu ambaye aliwakodisha wakulima fulani shamba lake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 20.9-19+Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~9#Question:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.
trans-unit.source: Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.
trans-unit.target: Niambie ni vikundi gani vya watu vilivyo katika mfano wa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Question:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.-734500642
trans-unit.source: There was a man who planted a vineyard/grape garden (9b),
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na mtu aliyepanda shamba la mizabibu (9b),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.-119559357
trans-unit.source: some farmers who rented/leased the vineyard (9c),
trans-unit.target: wakulima fulani ambao walilipa kodi/kukodisha shamba la mizabibu (9c),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.1186749344
trans-unit.source: some servants whom the owner sent to get his share of the fruit which had grown (10-12),
trans-unit.target: baadhi ya watumishi waliotumwa na mwenye shamba ili wapate sehemu ya matunda yaliyokuwa yamepanda (10-12),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.-731353411
trans-unit.source: and the owner's son (13-15).
trans-unit.target: na mwana wa mwenye nyumba (13-15).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Tell me the different groups of people who are in Jesus's parable.

group.id: Q:LUK 20.9-19+What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~9#Question:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?
trans-unit.source: What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima/waajiri ambao walipaswa kulinda shamba la mizabibu walitaka kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Question:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!20~9#Alternate:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?779366638
trans-unit.source: What were the farmers who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima ambao walipaswa kulinda shamba la mizabibu walitaka kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Alternate:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!20~9#Alternate:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?1402411385
trans-unit.source: What were the tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?
trans-unit.target: Wale wapangaji ambao walipaswa kulinda shamba la mizabibu walitaka kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Alternate:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?1222424058
trans-unit.source: They wanted to have all the fruit from the vineyard and even own the vineyard themselves. (10b-15a)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kuwa na matunda yote kutoka shamba la mizabibu na hata kumiliki shamba la mizabibu wenyewe. (10b-15a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:What were the farmers/tenants who were supposed to watch over the vineyard wanting to do?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.9-19+What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~9#Question:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini wale waliosikiliza mfano wa Yesu hawakutaka jambo baya kama hilo liwatendeke? (16b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Question:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)-2028040414
trans-unit.source: They recognized that Jesus was using picture language to tell them their leaders had rejected the many servants, that is, prophets, whom God had sent to the Jews.
trans-unit.target: Walitambua kwamba Yesu alikuwa akitumia lugha ya mfano kuwaambia kwamba viongozi wao walikuwa wamewakataa watumishi wengi, yaani, manabii, ambao Mungu alikuwa amewatuma kwa Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)-418553361
trans-unit.source: Jesus was also telling them with this picture language that God had sent Jesus, his much-loved son, also, but the leaders had rejected him and would kill him outside the city.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa pia akiwaambia kwa lugha hii ya mfano kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemtuma Yesu, mwana wake mpendwa sana, pia, lakini viongozi walikuwa wamemkataa na wangemuua nje ya jiji.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)1467594777
trans-unit.source: The picture language also showed them that God would punish the leaders for all they had done,
trans-unit.target: Lugha ya mfano pia iliwaonyesha kuwa Mungu angewaadhibu viongozi kwa yote waliyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)1798041293
trans-unit.source: and he would give his people to others to care for, which those listeners understood to be non-Jews. The listeners did not like any of this.
trans-unit.target: na kuwaacha watu wake kwa wengine wawatunze, ambao wasikilizaji hao walielewa kuwa si Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:What do you think was the reason those who listened to Jesus's parable did not want such a terrible thing to ever happen to them? (16b)

group.id: Q:LUK 20.9-12+Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~9#Question:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?
trans-unit.source: Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliokuwa watu ambao Yesu aliwasimulia mfano huu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Question:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?1800663403
trans-unit.source: These were the same Jewish leaders who asked him that last question,
trans-unit.target: Hawa walikuwa viongozi walewale wa Kiyahudi waliomwuliza swali hilo la mwisho,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?773819831
trans-unit.source: namely, the chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and the elders (20:1),
trans-unit.target: yaani, wakuu wa makuhani, walimu wa Sheria, na wazee (20:1),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~9#Answer:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?-1438147915
trans-unit.source: but the other people to whom Jesus had been teaching or preaching were also there.
trans-unit.target: lakini watu wengine ambao Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha au kuwahubiria walikuwa pia huko.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Who were the people to whom Jesus told this parable?

trans-unit.source: He was going away for a long time [and wanted them to take care of it for him]. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akienda mbali kwa muda mrefu [na alitaka wamtunze kwa ajili yake]. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~9#Answer:Why did the owner of the vineyard/grape garden rent it out to some farmers/tenants?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.10+Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~10#Question:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?
trans-unit.source: Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwenye shamba alimtuma mtumishi/mtumwa kwa wakulima hao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Question:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!20~10#Alternate:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?1462242636
trans-unit.source: Why did the owner send a servant back to those farmers?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwenye shamba alimtuma mtumwa mmoja arudi kwa wakulima hao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Alternate:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!20~10#Alternate:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?2057092412
trans-unit.source: Why did the owner send a slave back to those farmers?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwenye shamba alimtuma mtumwa mmoja arudi kwa wakulima hao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Alternate:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~10#Answer:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?-192780825
trans-unit.source: So that the farmers would give the servant/slave some of the fruit [which had grown] in the vineyard [to take back to the owner]. (10)
trans-unit.target: Ili wakulima wampe mtumwa/mtumwa baadhi ya matunda [yaliyokuwa yamekua] katika shamba la mizabibu [ya kumrudishia mwenye shamba hilo]. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Answer:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~10#Note:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?-1847678486
trans-unit.source: It is also all right if the translation says that the servants came to get some of the money from selling the fruit, instead of saying they came to get some of the actual fruit.
trans-unit.target: Pia ni sawa ikiwa tafsiri inasema kwamba watumishi walikuja kuchukua baadhi ya pesa kutoka kwa kuuza matunda, badala ya kusema walikuja kuchukua baadhi ya matunda halisi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Note:Why did the owner send a servant/slave back to those farmers?
