group.id: Q:LUK 20.10-12+What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~10#Question:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?
trans-unit.source: What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima walifanya nini mtumishi alipowajia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Question:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~10#Answer:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?-1510789803
trans-unit.source: They beat one servant/slave and sent him back with nothing. (10)
trans-unit.target: Walipiga mtumwa mmoja na kumrudisha akiwa hana kitu. (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Answer:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~10#Answer:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?199097044
trans-unit.source: They beat another, did shameful things/gave shame to him and sent him back with nothing. (11)
trans-unit.target: Walimpiga mwingine, wakafanya mambo ya aibu/wakamfedhehesha na kumrudisha akiwa hana kitu. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Answer:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~10#Answer:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?875439515
trans-unit.source: They wounded a third servant and threw him out [of the vineyard]. (12)
trans-unit.target: Wakamjeruhi mtumishi wa tatu na kumtupa nje [ya shamba la mizabibu]. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~10#Answer:What did the farmers do when a servant came to them?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.13+Why did the owner of the vineyard send his much-loved son to the farmers?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~13#Question:Why did the owner of the vineyard send his much-loved son to the farmers?
trans-unit.source: Why did the owner of the vineyard send his much-loved son to the farmers?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwenye shamba la mizabibu alimtuma mwana wake mpendwa kwa wakulima?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~13#Question:Why did the owner of the vineyard send his much-loved son to the farmers?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~13#Answer:Why did the owner of the vineyard send his much-loved son to the farmers?302762173
trans-unit.source: He thought that they would respect/honor his son. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alifikiri kwamba wangemheshimu mwanawe. (13)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~13#Answer:Why did the owner of the vineyard send his much-loved son to the farmers?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.14+What did the farmers say when they saw the owner's son coming?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~14#Question:What did the farmers say when they saw the owner's son coming?
trans-unit.source: What did the farmers say when they saw the owner's son coming?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima walisema nini walipomwona mwana wa mwenye shamba akija?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~14#Question:What did the farmers say when they saw the owner's son coming?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~14#Answer:What did the farmers say when they saw the owner's son coming?1297401784
trans-unit.source: They decided they should kill him so that they could get the vineyard for themselves. (14)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua kwamba wanapaswa kumuua ili waweze kupata shamba la mizabibu kwa ajili yao wenyewe. (14)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~14#Answer:What did the farmers say when they saw the owner's son coming?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.15+What did those farmers do to the owner's son?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~15#Question:What did those farmers do to the owner's son?
trans-unit.source: What did those farmers do to the owner's son?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima hao walimfanyia nini mwana wa mwenye shamba?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~15#Question:What did those farmers do to the owner's son?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~15#Answer:What did those farmers do to the owner's son?1175504661
trans-unit.source: They threw him outside the vineyard and killed him. (15a)
trans-unit.target: Wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamwua. (15a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~15#Answer:What did those farmers do to the owner's son?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.16+What did Jesus say the owner of the vineyard would do when the farmers had killed his son?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~16#Question:What did Jesus say the owner of the vineyard would do when the farmers had killed his son?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say the owner of the vineyard would do when the farmers had killed his son?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mwenye shamba la mizabibu angefanya nini wakati wakulima walipomuua mwana wake?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~16#Question:What did Jesus say the owner of the vineyard would do when the farmers had killed his son?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~16#Answer:What did Jesus say the owner of the vineyard would do when the farmers had killed his son?-115720771
trans-unit.source: He said the owner would come and destroy those people and give the vineyard to others [to care for]. (16a)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mwenye shamba la mizabibu atakuja na kuwaangamiza watu hao na kuwapa wengine shamba hilo la mizabibu [walitunze]. (16a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~16#Answer:What did Jesus say the owner of the vineyard would do when the farmers had killed his son?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.16+What did the listeners to Jesus's parable think about that result?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~16#Question:What did the listeners to Jesus's parable think about that result?
trans-unit.source: What did the listeners to Jesus's parable think about that result?
trans-unit.target: Wasikilizaji wa mfano wa Yesu walifikiri nini kuhusu matokeo hayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~16#Question:What did the listeners to Jesus's parable think about that result?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~16#Answer:What did the listeners to Jesus's parable think about that result?-1500946148
trans-unit.source: They said that should never happen. (16b)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba hilo halipaswi kamwe kutukia. (16b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~16#Answer:What did the listeners to Jesus's parable think about that result?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.17+Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~17#Question:Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?
trans-unit.source: Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?
trans-unit.target: Mtu fulani alikuwa ameandika lugha ya mfano juu ya wajenzi na jiwe la ujenzi, na sasa Yesu aliwakumbusha watu maneno hayo. Maneno hayo yaliandikwa wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Question:Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?1037438936
trans-unit.source: Someone wrote them in God's Word/in the part of the Bible we call the Old Testament. (17)
trans-unit.target: Mtu fulani aliyaandika katika Neno la Mungu/katika sehemu ya Biblia tunayoiita Agano la Kale. (17)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~17#Note:Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?510437917
trans-unit.source: The original words can be found in Ps. 118:22.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya awali ya Zaburi 118:22 yanapatikana katika Biblia ya Kiswahili.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Note:Someone had written picture language about builders and a building stone, and now Jesus reminded the people of those words. Where were those words written?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.17+What did those words say about a building stone?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~17#Question:What did those words say about a building stone?
trans-unit.source: What did those words say about a building stone?
trans-unit.target: Maneno hayo yalionyesha nini kuhusu jiwe la ujenzi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Question:What did those words say about a building stone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?845825882
trans-unit.source: Builders rejected a stone for their building,
trans-unit.target: Jiwe walilokataa waashi, Jiwe hilo lilitumika kama nguzo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?-278383974
trans-unit.source: but that stone is now the most important one to hold up the house.
trans-unit.target: Lakini jiwe hilo sasa ndilo muhimu zaidi kuitegemeza nyumba.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?-1778233343
trans-unit.source: but that stone is now the most important one to hold everything else in its proper place. (17b)
trans-unit.target: lakini jiwe hilo sasa ni moja muhimu zaidi kushikilia kila kitu kingine katika nafasi yake sahihi. (17b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:What did those words say about a building stone?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.18+What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~18#Question:What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini katika lugha yake mwenyewe ya mfano kuhusu jiwe hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~18#Question:What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~18#Answer:What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?-1185480937
trans-unit.source: Everyone who falls over that stone will be broken into pieces
trans-unit.target: Mtu yeyote akianguka juu ya jiwe hilo, atavunjika vipandevipande.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~18#Answer:What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~18#Answer:What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?-1122224104
trans-unit.source: and everyone on whom the stone falls will be crushed (to fine powder). (18)
trans-unit.target: Na anaye mshukia huyo jiwe, basi huyo atakuwa ni mwenye kuangamizwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~18#Answer:What did Jesus say in his own picture language about that stone?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.17-18+Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~17#Question:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alitaka watu wafikiri kwamba sehemu mbalimbali za mfano huo ziliwakilisha nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Question:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?967164200
trans-unit.source: They were to think that the builders were a picture of the leaders of the Jews, (17b)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kufikiri kwamba wajenzi walikuwa picha ya viongozi wa Wayahudi, (17b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?-1953538960
trans-unit.source: the stone which they rejected was Jesus, (17b)
trans-unit.target: jiwe walilokataa lilikuwa Yesu, (17b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?-292213189
trans-unit.source: the people who fall over that stone are those who do not believe that God sent Jesus (18a)
trans-unit.target: watu ambao huanguka juu ya jiwe hilo ni wale ambao hawaamini kwamba Mungu alimtuma Yesu (18a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?1545584354
trans-unit.source: and the people on whom the stone falls are those who are punished forever because they do not believe in Jesus (18b).
trans-unit.target: na watu ambao jiwe huanguka juu yao ni wale ambao wanaadhibiwa milele kwa sababu hawaamini katika Yesu (18b).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus wanted the people to think were represented by the various parts of this picture language?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.17-19+Did those who were listening to Jesus understand that he was talking about them in those word pictures?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~17#Question:Did those who were listening to Jesus understand that he was talking about them in those word pictures?
trans-unit.source: Did those who were listening to Jesus understand that he was talking about them in those word pictures?
trans-unit.target: Je, wale waliomsikiliza Yesu walielewa kwamba alikuwa akizungumza kuwahusu katika mifano hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Question:Did those who were listening to Jesus understand that he was talking about them in those word pictures?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~17#Answer:Did those who were listening to Jesus understand that he was talking about them in those word pictures?-1965728056
trans-unit.source: Yes, they did understand.
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, walielewa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~17#Answer:Did those who were listening to Jesus understand that he was talking about them in those word pictures?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.19+How do you know that they understood what Jesus meant?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~19#Question:How do you know that they understood what Jesus meant?
trans-unit.source: How do you know that they understood what Jesus meant?
trans-unit.target: Unajuaje kwamba walielewa alichomaanisha Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~19#Question:How do you know that they understood what Jesus meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~19#Answer:How do you know that they understood what Jesus meant?-387981098
trans-unit.source: The teachers of the Law/scribes and the chief priests tried to find a way to arrest Jesus right then. (19a)
trans-unit.target: Walimu wa Sheria/waandishi na makuhani wakuu walijaribu kutafuta njia ya kumkamata Yesu wakati huo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~19#Answer:How do you know that they understood what Jesus meant?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.19+Why did they not do it right then?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~19#Question:Why did they not do it right then?
trans-unit.source: Why did they not do it right then?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakufanya hivyo mara moja?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~19#Question:Why did they not do it right then?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~19#Answer:Why did they not do it right then?-1308436517
trans-unit.source: They were afraid of the people [who were right there and believed that God had sent both John and Jesus]. (19b)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaogopa watu [waliokuwa hapo na kuamini kwamba Mungu alikuwa amewatuma Yohana na Yesu]. (19b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~19#Answer:Why did they not do it right then?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~20#Question:Some men told Jesus that they wanted to know about paying taxes to the enemy Roman government, but what did they really want?
trans-unit.source: Some men told Jesus that they wanted to know about paying taxes to the enemy Roman government, but what did they really want?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walimwambia Yesu kwamba walitaka kujua kuhusu kulipa kodi kwa serikali ya Roma iliyokuwa adui, lakini walitaka nini hasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Question:Some men told Jesus that they wanted to know about paying taxes to the enemy Roman government, but what did they really want?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~20#Answer:Some men told Jesus that they wanted to know about paying taxes to the enemy Roman government, but what did they really want?-1487203277
trans-unit.source: They wanted to make Jesus say something against the Roman government so they could arrest him and put him under the authority and control of the Roman government. (20)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kumfanya Yesu aseme jambo fulani dhidi ya serikali ya Kiroma ili waweze kumkamata na kumweka chini ya mamlaka na udhibiti wa serikali ya Kiroma. (20)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Answer:Some men told Jesus that they wanted to know about paying taxes to the enemy Roman government, but what did they really want?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.20-26+What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~20#Question:What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu kutii sheria za serikali, kama vile kulipa kodi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Question:What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~20#Answer:What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?1242313622
trans-unit.source: He said that people should do whatever the king/government says they all must do, such as pay their taxes,
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu wanapaswa kufanya chochote mfalme/serikali anasema wote lazima kufanya, kama kulipa kodi zao,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Answer:What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~20#Answer:What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?917820731
trans-unit.source: (and they should also do whatever God says they all must do). (25)
trans-unit.target: (na pia wafanye chochote ambacho Mungu anasema wote wanapaswa kufanya). (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Answer:What did Jesus say about obeying the government's laws, such as paying taxes?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.20-22+Who were sending men to spy on Jesus and catch him saying something wrong?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~20#Question:Who were sending men to spy on Jesus and catch him saying something wrong?
trans-unit.source: Who were sending men to spy on Jesus and catch him saying something wrong?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliokuwa wakituma watu wampeleleze Yesu na kumkamata akisema jambo fulani lisilofaa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Question:Who were sending men to spy on Jesus and catch him saying something wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~20#Answer:Who were sending men to spy on Jesus and catch him saying something wrong?-788020463
trans-unit.source: They were the teachers of the Law and the chief priests mentioned in verse 19.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa walimu wa Sheria na wakuu wa makuhani wanaotajwa katika mstari wa 19.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Answer:Who were sending men to spy on Jesus and catch him saying something wrong?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.20+How did those spies get near to Jesus in order to listen and ask him questions?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~20#Question:How did those spies get near to Jesus in order to listen and ask him questions?
trans-unit.source: How did those spies get near to Jesus in order to listen and ask him questions?
trans-unit.target: Wapelelezi hao walimkaribia Yesu jinsi gani ili wamsikilize na kumuuliza maswali?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Question:How did those spies get near to Jesus in order to listen and ask him questions?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~20#Answer:How did those spies get near to Jesus in order to listen and ask him questions?2052862765
trans-unit.source: They pretended to be concerned about doing the right thing. (20a)
trans-unit.target: Walijifanya kuwa wanahangaikia kufanya jambo linalofaa. (20a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Answer:How did those spies get near to Jesus in order to listen and ask him questions?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.20+What would those men do if Jesus said something wrong?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~20#Question:What would those men do if Jesus said something wrong?
trans-unit.source: What would those men do if Jesus said something wrong?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao wangefanya nini ikiwa Yesu angesema jambo fulani lisilofaa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Question:What would those men do if Jesus said something wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~20#Answer:What would those men do if Jesus said something wrong?-1186516690
trans-unit.source: They wanted to turn him over to the [Roman] governor's authority and control. (20b)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kumkabidhi kwa mamlaka na udhibiti wa gavana [Waroma]. (20b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~20#Answer:What would those men do if Jesus said something wrong?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.21+What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~21#Question:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?
trans-unit.source: What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?
trans-unit.target: Wapelelezi walimwambia Yesu nini kuhusu jinsi walivyomjua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~21#Question:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~21#Answer:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?-576545176
trans-unit.source: They said that they knew he spoke and taught correctly
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba walijua alizungumza na kufundisha kwa usahihi
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~21#Answer:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~21#Answer:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?791770112
trans-unit.source: and that he was not influenced by who people were,
trans-unit.target: na kwamba hakuathiriwa na watu walivyokuwa,
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~21#Answer:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~21#Answer:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?2033894243
trans-unit.source: but that he truthfully taught the way that God [wanted people to live]. (21)
trans-unit.target: Na kwamba amefundisha Njia ya Mwenyezi Mungu kwa haki.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~21#Answer:What did the spies tell Jesus that they knew about him?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.22+What did they want to know about taxes?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~22#Question:What did they want to know about taxes?
trans-unit.source: What did they want to know about taxes?
trans-unit.target: Walihitaji kujua nini kuhusu kodi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~22#Question:What did they want to know about taxes?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~22#Answer:What did they want to know about taxes?1032234135
trans-unit.source: They wanted to know if it was proper [for a Jew] to pay taxes to [the Roman Emperor/king] Caesar. (22)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kujua kama ilikuwa sawa [kwa Myahudi] kumlipa Kaisari [Mtawala wa Roma/mfalme] kodi. (22)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~22#Answer:What did they want to know about taxes?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.23+What words tell you that Jesus was not fooled by those men trying to make trouble for him?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~23#Question:What words tell you that Jesus was not fooled by those men trying to make trouble for him?
trans-unit.source: What words tell you that Jesus was not fooled by those men trying to make trouble for him?
trans-unit.target: Ni maneno gani yanayokuambia kwamba Yesu hakudanganywa na wale watu waliojaribu kumtatiza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~23#Question:What words tell you that Jesus was not fooled by those men trying to make trouble for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~23#Answer:What words tell you that Jesus was not fooled by those men trying to make trouble for him?-677539120
trans-unit.source: Luke says that Jesus clearly understood their attempt to trick him. (23)
trans-unit.target: Luka anasema kwamba Yesu alielewa waziwazi jaribio lao la kumdanganya. (23)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~23#Answer:What words tell you that Jesus was not fooled by those men trying to make trouble for him?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.25+Whose were they?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~25#Question:Whose were they?
trans-unit.source: Whose were they?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~25#Question:Whose were they?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~25#Answer:Whose were they?2031434831
trans-unit.source: [The Roman emperor/king] Caesar's. (25a)
trans-unit.target: [Mtawala wa Roma] Kaisari. (25a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~25#Answer:Whose were they?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.25+Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~25#Question:Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?
trans-unit.source: Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba wanapaswa kufanya lolote lililokuwa sehemu ya kazi ya serikali, kama vile kulipa kodi zao. Basi, watu walipaswa kufanya nini kuhusu mambo ambayo Mungu alisema wanapaswa kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~25#Question:Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~25#Answer:Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?-293127001
trans-unit.source: Jesus said they should do both things, those which the government said were necessary
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wanapaswa kufanya mambo yote mawili, yale ambayo serikali ilisema ni muhimu
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~25#Answer:Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~25#Answer:Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?-929317587
trans-unit.source: and those which God had said were necessary. (25b)
trans-unit.target: na yale ambayo Mungu alisema yalikuwa ya lazima. (25b)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~25#Answer:Jesus said they should do whatever was a part of the government work, such as pay their taxes. What, then, were the people to do about the things God said they should do?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.26+How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~26#Question:How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?
trans-unit.source: How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?
trans-unit.target: Je, njama ya watu hao ilifanikiwa, yaani, njama yao ya kumnasa Yesu akisema jambo fulani lisilofaa mbele ya watu wengi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~26#Question:How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~26#Answer:How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?-1137671269
trans-unit.source: It did not work. The men were unable to catch him in what he said.
trans-unit.target: Waliposhindwa kufanya hivyo, walishindwa kumnasa kwa maneno yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~26#Answer:How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~26#Answer:How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?2014789077
trans-unit.source: They were so amazed at his answer that they were silent/they had nothing more to say. (26)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakishangaa sana kwa jibu lake hivi kwamba walinyamaza/hawakupata la kusema zaidi. (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~26#Answer:How well did those men's plan work, their plan to catch Jesus saying something wrong in front of many people?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!20~27#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 20:27-40 Some Sadducees asked Jesus about people being married after they died and rose to live again.
trans-unit.target: Luka 20:27-40 Masadukayo fulani walimwuliza Yesu juu ya watu kuoa na kuolewa baada ya kufa na kufufuliwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 20.27-40+Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~27#Question:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.
trans-unit.source: Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Niambie hadithi fupi kuhusu ndugu saba ambayo Masadukayo walimwambia Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Question:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.-1466205128
trans-unit.source: The first brother of seven married a woman, but died without children. (29)
trans-unit.target: Yule wa kwanza alioa mke, akafa bila kuacha mtoto.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.2088791996
trans-unit.source: The second [brother], then the third married her, but they also died childless. (30-31a)
trans-unit.target: Na wa pili [ndugu], kisha wa tatu, akamwoa, lakini wao pia wakafa bila kuacha watoto. (30-31a)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.642380210
trans-unit.source: The [rest of the] seven [brothers] were the same, [marrying her, but] leaving no children [when they each] died. (31b)
trans-unit.target: Na wale saba [waliobaki] walikuwa mtu mmoja, [wakamwoa lakini] hawakuacha watoto [wakati kila mmoja wao alipokufa].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.-196243710
trans-unit.source: Lastly, the woman died. (32)
trans-unit.target: Mwishowe akafa pia yule mwanamke.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~27#Note:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.330401571
trans-unit.source: The translation should not imply that the woman caused the men to die. This is not a true story about real men. The Sadducees created the story to try to trick Jesus. Its focus is on the idea of rising again after dying.
trans-unit.target: Tafsiri haipaswi kudokeza kwamba mwanamke huyo aliwasababisha wanaume hao kufa. Hii si hadithi ya kweli kuhusu wanaume halisi. Masadukayo waliunda hadithi hiyo kujaribu kumdanganya Yesu. Inakazia wazo la kufufuka tena baada ya kufa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Note:Tell me the little story about seven brothers which the Sadducees told to Jesus.

group.id: Q:LUK 20.27-40+What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~27#Question:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walimwuliza Yesu swali gani [la ujanja]?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Question:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!20~27#Alternate:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?252837500
trans-unit.source: What was the trick question the Sadducees asked Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walimwuliza Yesu swali gani la hila?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Alternate:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!20~27#Alternate:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?-620969917
trans-unit.source: What was the question the Sadducees asked Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Alternate:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?1631477182
trans-unit.source: "When people are raised by God to live again after dying, whose wife will she be, having been the wife of each of the seven?" (33)
trans-unit.target: "Wakati watu watakapofufuliwa na Mungu kuishi tena baada ya kufa, atakuwa mke wa nani, kwa kuwa alikuwa mke wa kila mmoja wa wale saba?" (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What was the [trick] question the Sadducees asked Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.27-40+What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~27#Question:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya watu na ufufuo wao baada ya kufa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Question:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?317950256
trans-unit.source: He said that people [whom God] declared worthy would rise to live again after being dead (35, 37),
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu [ambao Mungu] aliwatangaza kuwa wanastahili wangefufuliwa waishi tena baada ya kufa (35, 37),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?2065013008
trans-unit.source: but they would not marry (35),
trans-unit.target: lakini hawangetaka kuoa (35),
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?338731632
trans-unit.source: they cannot die again [because they are like the angels] (36).
trans-unit.target: Wala hawatakufa tena.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?1100093047
trans-unit.source: [Those people] are children of God, because they have been raised [by God] to live again [with him] (36c-d).
trans-unit.target: [Watu hao] ni watoto wa Mungu, kwa sababu wamefufuliwa [na Mungu] ili waishi tena [pamoja naye] (36c-d).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?-1324009361
trans-unit.source: Even Moses showed that the [people who are] dead will be raised [by God] to live again when he referred to [God when he spoke to Moses out of] the burning bush as the God of Abraham, of Isaac and of Jacob, [ancestors who no longer were living on the earth] (37).
trans-unit.target: Hata Musa alionyesha kwamba [watu ambao] wamekufa watafufuliwa [na Mungu] waishi tena alipotaja [Mungu alipozungumza na Musa kutoka] ule mti wa miiba ukiwaka moto kuwa ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, wa Isaka na wa Yakobo, [mababu ambao hawakuwa hai duniani] (37).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Jesus say about people and their rising after being dead?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.27-40+The Sadducees told Jesus that they wanted to know about people being married after they rose from being dead, but what do you think they really wanted?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~27#Question:The Sadducees told Jesus that they wanted to know about people being married after they rose from being dead, but what do you think they really wanted?
trans-unit.source: The Sadducees told Jesus that they wanted to know about people being married after they rose from being dead, but what do you think they really wanted?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walimwambia Yesu kwamba walitaka kujua juu ya watu kuoa na kuolewa baada ya ufufuo, lakini unafikiri walitaka nini hasa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Question:The Sadducees told Jesus that they wanted to know about people being married after they rose from being dead, but what do you think they really wanted?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:The Sadducees told Jesus that they wanted to know about people being married after they rose from being dead, but what do you think they really wanted?2131410272
trans-unit.source: Because they did not believe that people would rise again after being dead (27), they wanted to make Jesus look foolish as he tried to make an answer for something which they thought would never happen.
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu hawakuamini kwamba watu watafufuka tena baada ya kufa (27), walitaka kumfanya Yesu aonekane mpumbavu alipojaribu kutoa jibu kwa jambo ambalo walifikiri halitatokea kamwe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:The Sadducees told Jesus that they wanted to know about people being married after they rose from being dead, but what do you think they really wanted?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.27+What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~27#Question:What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?
trans-unit.source: What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?
trans-unit.target: Luka alituambia nini kuhusu kikundi kilichoitwa Masadukayo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Question:What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?-1822752621
trans-unit.source: He said that they did not believe that people would rise after being dead. (27)
trans-unit.target: Akasema kwamba hawakuamini kuwa watu watafufuliwa baada ya kufa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?-490358663
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Sadducees were a group, like a political party. They were rich, important Jewish families. Most of the members were priests who regarded the Laws of Moses as the most important part of God's Word. They did not believe that angels or Satan were real. See "Sadducee" in KBT in the "Pharisee, Sadducee" entry.
trans-unit.target: Kiini cha neno: Masadukayo walikuwa kikundi, kama chama cha kisiasa. Walikuwa matajiri, familia muhimu za Kiyahudi. Wajumbe wengi walikuwa makuhani ambao waliona Sheria za Musa kama sehemu muhimu zaidi ya Neno la Mungu. Hawakuamini kwamba malaika au Shetani walikuwa halisi. Tazama "Sadukayo" katika KBT katika "Mfarisayo, Sadukayo" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~27#Answer:What did Luke tell us about the group called the Sadducees?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.28+What did the Sadducees say was the rule about marriage which Moses had written down and taught to the Jews?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~28#Question:What did the Sadducees say was the rule about marriage which Moses had written down and taught to the Jews?
trans-unit.source: What did the Sadducees say was the rule about marriage which Moses had written down and taught to the Jews?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walisema ni nini sheria juu ya ndoa ambayo Musa alikuwa ameandika na kuwafundisha Wayahudi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~28#Question:What did the Sadducees say was the rule about marriage which Moses had written down and taught to the Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~28#Answer:What did the Sadducees say was the rule about marriage which Moses had written down and taught to the Jews?-1594332923
trans-unit.source: If a man's brother died, leaving his widow, but no children, that man should marry the [dead brother's] widow and have some children for his brother. (28)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa ndugu ya mtu amekufa, na kuacha mjane wake bila watoto, mtu huyo apaswa kuoa mjane [wa ndugu aliyekufa] na kuzaa watoto kwa ndugu yake. (28)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~28#Answer:What did the Sadducees say was the rule about marriage which Moses had written down and taught to the Jews?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.35+How do people get to be one of those whom God will raise to live again after dying?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~35#Question:How do people get to be one of those whom God will raise to live again after dying?
trans-unit.source: How do people get to be one of those whom God will raise to live again after dying?
trans-unit.target: Watu hupataje kuwa miongoni mwa wale ambao Mungu atafufua waishi tena baada ya kufa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~35#Question:How do people get to be one of those whom God will raise to live again after dying?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~35#Answer:How do people get to be one of those whom God will raise to live again after dying?-792442325
trans-unit.source: They are the people whom [God] has called/considered/regarded as worthy. (35)
trans-unit.target: Hao ndio watu ambao [Mungu] amewaita/amewaona/amewaona kuwa wanastahili. (35)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~35#Answer:How do people get to be one of those whom God will raise to live again after dying?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.38+Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~38#Question:Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?
trans-unit.source: Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?
trans-unit.target: Si kila mtu tunayejua ambaye amemwamini Yesu kama mwokozi wake yuko hai leo. Wengine wamekufa. Unafikiri ni njia gani, basi, kwamba wote wako hai kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~38#Question:Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~38#Answer:Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?-84015547
trans-unit.source: We think about the bodies of those people and say they are dead, but God looks at their spirit and says they all live on. (38)
trans-unit.target: Tunafikiri juu ya miili ya watu hao na kusema kwamba wamekufa, lakini Mungu huangalia roho zao na kusema kwamba wote wanaishi. (38)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~38#Answer:Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~38#Note:Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?-1610762762
trans-unit.source: God also knows that on the Last Day he will raise up the bodies of those who believe in Jesus (see John 6:39-40, 11:24 and 1 Thess. 4:13-18).
trans-unit.target: Mungu pia anajua kwamba katika Siku ya Mwisho atafufua miili ya wale wanaomwamini Yesu (ona Yohana 6:39-40, 11:24 na 1 The. 4:13-18).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~38#Note:Not every person whom we know who has believed in Jesus as his or her savior is still alive today. Some are dead. What do you think is the way, then, that they are all alive to God?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.39+Who praised Jesus for his good answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~39#Question:Who praised Jesus for his good answer?
trans-unit.source: Who praised Jesus for his good answer?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomsifu Yesu kwa jibu lake zuri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~39#Question:Who praised Jesus for his good answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~39#Answer:Who praised Jesus for his good answer?1772180391
trans-unit.source: Some of the teachers of the Law/scribes. (39)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya walimu wa Sheria/waandishi. (39)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~39#Answer:Who praised Jesus for his good answer?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.39-40+Why did they praise Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~39#Question:Why did they praise Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did they praise Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walimsifu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~39#Question:Why did they praise Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~39#Answer:Why did they praise Jesus?-1147882773
trans-unit.source: They believed that his answer was correct (that is, it fit with their understanding of the Scriptures).
trans-unit.target: Waliamini kwamba jibu lake lilikuwa sahihi (yaani, lilipatana na uelewevu wao wa Maandiko).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~39#Answer:Why did they praise Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~39#Answer:Why did they praise Jesus?-1531278341
trans-unit.source: Perhaps also, they were happy to see that he had silenced the Sadducees [by showing their ideas to be wrong]. (40)
trans-unit.target: Labda pia, walifurahi kuona kwamba alikuwa amewanyamazisha Masadukayo [kwa kuonyesha maoni yao kuwa makosa].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~39#Answer:Why did they praise Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~39#Note:Why did they praise Jesus?-399131375
trans-unit.source: We assume that these teachers of the Law were not part of the Sadducees, but were part of the Pharisees, who did believe that God raised people to be alive again after dying. They also believed in angels. They often disagreed with the Sadducees about these things (see Acts 23:6-9).
trans-unit.target: Tunafikiri kwamba walimu hawa wa sheria hawakuwa sehemu ya Masadukayo, lakini walikuwa sehemu ya Mafarisayo, ambao waliamini kwamba Mungu hufufua watu baada ya kufa. Pia waliamini katika malaika. Mara nyingi hawakubaliani na Masadukayo juu ya mambo haya (tazama Matendo 23:6-9).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~39#Note:Why did they praise Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!20~41#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 20:41-44 Jesus showed that the Messiah was greater than King David.
trans-unit.target: Luka 20:41-44 Yesu alionyesha kwamba Mesiya alikuwa mkuu kuliko Mfalme Daudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~41#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 20.41-44+Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~41#Question:Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha ni nani aliyekuwa mtu mkuu zaidi, Mfalme Daudi au Kristo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~41#Question:Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?790530700
trans-unit.source: He was indicating that the Christ was greater than even King David had been. (41-44)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akionyesha kwamba Kristo alikuwa mkuu hata kuliko Mfalme Daudi (41-44).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~41#Note:Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?-1349437429
trans-unit.source: See the discussion in Translator's Notes on this section.
trans-unit.target: Ona mazungumzo katika maelezo ya mtafsiri katika sehemu hii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~41#Note:Whom did Jesus indicate was the greater person, King David or the Christ?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.41+How did the people of Jesus's time describe the Christ whom God said he would send to this earth?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~41#Question:How did the people of Jesus's time describe the Christ whom God said he would send to this earth?
trans-unit.source: How did the people of Jesus's time describe the Christ whom God said he would send to this earth?
trans-unit.target: Watu wa wakati wa Yesu walimfafanuaje Kristo ambaye Mungu alisema angemtuma duniani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~41#Question:How did the people of Jesus's time describe the Christ whom God said he would send to this earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~41#Answer:How did the people of Jesus's time describe the Christ whom God said he would send to this earth?979482123
trans-unit.source: They called him the [Special] Descendant of [King] David. (41)
trans-unit.target: Walimwita [Mzao wa Pekee] wa [Mfalme] Daudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~41#Answer:How did the people of Jesus's time describe the Christ whom God said he would send to this earth?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.42-44+How had David himself described the Christ?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~42#Question:How had David himself described the Christ?
trans-unit.source: How had David himself described the Christ?
trans-unit.target: Daudi mwenyewe alikuwa amemfafanuaje Kristo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~42#Question:How had David himself described the Christ?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~42#Answer:How had David himself described the Christ?105370126
trans-unit.source: David had called him his Lord. (42, 44)
trans-unit.target: Na Daudi alimwita Mola wake Mlezi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~42#Answer:How had David himself described the Christ?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.42+Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~42#Question:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?
trans-unit.source: Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliokuwa wale Mabwana wawili ambao Daudi aliandika juu yao katika Zaburi ambayo Yesu alinukuu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~42#Question:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~42#Answer:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?716031344
trans-unit.source: The one who spoke was Yahweh, the supreme, eternal God of the Jews.
trans-unit.target: Yule aliyesema alikuwa Yahweh, Mungu mkuu wa milele wa Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~42#Answer:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~42#Answer:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?-668047659
trans-unit.source: The one whom David called "my Lord" was the Messiah, the Christ, whom God had promised to send to save God's people.
trans-unit.target: Yule ambaye Daudi alimwita "Bwana wangu" alikuwa ndiye Mesiya, Kristo, ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi kumtuma ili kuwaokoa watu wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~42#Answer:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!20~42#Note:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?1243334749
trans-unit.source: Although the two persons are both called by the same name in the Greek and in the English bibles, in the original Hebrew writing, the words are clearly different and would not have been confusing.
trans-unit.target: Ingawa watu hao wawili wanaitwa kwa jina lilelile katika Biblia za Kigiriki na za Kiingereza, katika maandishi ya awali ya Kiebrania, maneno hayo ni tofauti kabisa na hayangeweza kuchanganya.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~42#Note:Who were the two Lords whom David wrote about in the Psalm which Jesus quoted?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.44+What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~44#Question:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri jibu la swali la mwisho la Yesu kuhusu Kristo kuwa mzao wa Mfalme Daudi na Bwana wake wakati uleule ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~44#Question:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~44#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?1081895590
trans-unit.source: The Christ [Jesus] was physically a human descendant in the family line of King David.
trans-unit.target: Kristo [Yesu] alikuwa wa kimwili wa kibinadamu katika ukoo wa familia ya Mfalme Daudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~44#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~44#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?-1440903143
trans-unit.source: He also was a far greater person than King David because he was God's own son, who had been sent to this earth from heaven.
trans-unit.target: Pia alikuwa mtu mkuu zaidi kuliko Mfalme Daudi kwa sababu alikuwa mwana wa Mungu mwenyewe, aliyetumwa duniani kutoka mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~44#Answer:What do you think is the answer to Jesus's last question about the Christ being both a descendant of King David and his Lord at the same time?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!20~45#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 20:45-47 Jesus told people to not do as the teachers of the Law did.
trans-unit.target: Luka 20:45-47 Yesu aliwaambia watu wasifanye kama walimu wa Sheria.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~45#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 20.45-47+What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~45#Question:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mungu angewaadhibu watu wa aina ambayo Yesu alizungumzia hapa hata zaidi ya watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~45#Question:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~45#Answer:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?1534909350
trans-unit.source: They pretended to be blessed because they obeyed God so well, but their example was teaching people to think mostly about themselves. (47)
trans-unit.target: Walijifanya kuwa wamebarikiwa kwa sababu walimtii Mungu vizuri sana, lakini mfano wao ulikuwa unawafundisha watu kufikiria zaidi juu yao wenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~45#Answer:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?

group.id: Q:LUK 20.46-47+Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!20~46#Question:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?
trans-unit.source: Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya watu kuhusu jinsi walimu wa Sheria walivyotenda. Walifanya mambo ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~46#Question:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?-908902156
trans-unit.source: They walked around in fancy clothes in market/public places in order to enjoy [people] greeting them [with great respect]. (46)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakitembea katika masoko/mahali pa umma wakiwa na mavazi ya kifahari ili wafurahie [watu] kuwasalimu [kwa heshima kubwa]. (46)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?-1937724838
trans-unit.source: They enjoyed [people] honoring [them] by having them sit in special places both in synagogues and at feasts. (46)
trans-unit.target: Wao hufurahia [watu] kuwaheshimu kwa kuwa na viti vya mbele katika masinagogi na katika karamu. (46)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?831081934
trans-unit.source: They did wrong things [in order to become rich], such as becoming the owners of widows' homes [and possessions]. (47)
trans-unit.target: Walifanya mambo mabaya [ili wawe matajiri], kama vile kuwa wamiliki wa nyumba za wajane [na mali zao].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?-715029872
trans-unit.source: They showed off by saying long prayers [in public places] (that is, they pretended to be very religious). (47)
trans-unit.target: Walifanya sala ndefu [katika mahali pa umma] ili kujionyesha (yaani, walijifanya kuwa wa kidini sana).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!20~46#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: h:!LUK!21~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Luke 21:1-4 A widow gave everything she had to God.
trans-unit.target: Luka 21:1-4 Mjane mmoja alitoa yote aliyokuwa nayo kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 21.1-4+Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~1#Question:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alithamini mchango wa mjane kuliko wa matajiri?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~1#Question:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~1#Answer:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?-529689006
trans-unit.source: She gave God everything she had to live on. The rich people only gave part of the large amount of money which they had. (It was money they did not really need in order to stay alive.) (4)
trans-unit.target: Alitoa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho kwa ajili ya maisha yake. Matajiri walitoa sehemu tu ya kiasi kikubwa cha pesa walichokuwa nacho (walitoa pesa ambazo hawakuhitaji ili waishi.) (4)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~1#Answer:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.1+Where were the people putting their gifts for God?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~1#Question:Where were the people putting their gifts for God?
trans-unit.source: Where were the people putting their gifts for God?
trans-unit.target: Watu walikuwa wakitia wapi zawadi zao kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~1#Question:Where were the people putting their gifts for God?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~1#Answer:Where were the people putting their gifts for God?289694711
trans-unit.source: They put their gifts into a box/boxes for that purpose in the temple area. (1)
trans-unit.target: Waliweka zawadi zao katika sanduku au masanduku ya michango katika eneo la hekalu (1).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~1#Answer:Where were the people putting their gifts for God?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.2+How much money did the widow put into the box?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~2#Question:How much money did the widow put into the box?
trans-unit.source: How much money did the widow put into the box?
trans-unit.target: Mjane huyo aliweka kiasi gani cha pesa ndani ya sanduku hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~2#Question:How much money did the widow put into the box?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~2#Answer:How much money did the widow put into the box?1170233791
trans-unit.source: She put in two coins of the smallest value that there was. (2)
trans-unit.target: Alitia ndani sarafu mbili za thamani ndogo zaidi zilizokuwepo. (2)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~2#Answer:How much money did the widow put into the box?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.4+How much money did the rich people put into that box?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~4#Question:How much money did the rich people put into that box?
trans-unit.source: How much money did the rich people put into that box?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.5-24+What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~5#Question:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?
trans-unit.source: What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wafuasi wake wapaswa kujilinda na matatizo gani makubwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Question:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?-2108396375
trans-unit.source: Enemies would destroy the temple. (5-7)
trans-unit.target: Maadui wataharibu hekalu (5-7)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?742730625
trans-unit.source: There would be wars, earthquakes, famines, and other disasters on the earth
trans-unit.target: Kungekuwa na vita, matetemeko ya nchi, njaa, na misiba mingine duniani
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?-1930914177
trans-unit.source: and strange signs in the sky. (8-11)
trans-unit.target: na ishara za ajabu angani.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?538793195
trans-unit.source: People, even family members, would persecute believers and cause some to die. (12-19)
trans-unit.target: Watu, hata washiriki wa familia, wangewatesa waamini na kusababisha wengine wauawe (12-19)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?-38900537
trans-unit.source: Enemies would destroy Jerusalem. (20-24)
trans-unit.target: Maadui wataharibu Yerusalemu (20-24)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:What major troubles did Jesus say his followers should watch for?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.5-24+Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~5#Question:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?
trans-unit.source: Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wafuasi wa Yesu hawakupaswa kuhangaika mambo hayo yalipotukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Question:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?-684935195
trans-unit.source: Those things would not be marks that time/the world was about to end. (9)
trans-unit.target: Mambo hayo hayangeonyesha kwamba wakati/ulimwengu ulikuwa karibu kukoma. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?2117475803
trans-unit.source: Jesus would give them the right wise words to say as a testimony to their faith in him. (13-15)
trans-unit.target: Yesu angewapa maneno sahihi ya hekima ya kusema kama ushuhuda wa imani yao kwake (13-15)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?1835725128
trans-unit.source: By continuing [to have faith] in the midst of the difficult circumstances, they would save their lives. (19)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuendelea [kuwa na imani] katikati ya hali ngumu, wangeokoa uhai wao. (19)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:Why were those who followed Jesus not to worry when those things happened?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.5-24+Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~5#Question:Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?
trans-unit.source: Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini jiji la Yerusalemu lingeharibiwa kabisa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Question:Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?1322320163
trans-unit.source: It would be time for [God] to punish the people there just like [prophets] had written it would be. (22)
trans-unit.target: Ingekuwa wakati wa [Mungu] kuwaadhibu watu wa huko kama vile [manabii] walivyokuwa wameandika ingekuwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!21~5#Note:Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?-480851737
trans-unit.source: Some of the things which prophets had said would happen you can read in these Old Testament books: Dan. 9:26; 1 Kings 9:6-9; Mic. 3:5-12; Mal. 4:1-2.
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya mambo ambayo manabii walisema yangetokea unaweza kuyasoma katika vitabu hivi vya Agano la Kale: Dan. 9:26; 1 Wafalme 9:6-9; Mika 3:5-12; Mal. 4:1-2.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Note:Why was the city of Jerusalem going to be totally destroyed?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.5-24+What do you think the people had done which showed that it was time for God to punish them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~5#Question:What do you think the people had done which showed that it was time for God to punish them?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the people had done which showed that it was time for God to punish them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu walikuwa wamefanya nini kilichoonyesha kwamba wakati ulikuwa umefika kwa Mungu kuwaadhibu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Question:What do you think the people had done which showed that it was time for God to punish them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What do you think the people had done which showed that it was time for God to punish them?-250291240
trans-unit.source: The people had rejected Jesus as the one whom God had sent to them to save them from their sins.
trans-unit.target: Watu walikuwa wamemkataa Yesu kuwa yule ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma kwao ili awaokoe kutoka kwa dhambi zao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Answer:What do you think the people had done which showed that it was time for God to punish them?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~5#Alternate:What were some of the people/disciples talking about while they were in the temple grounds with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!21~5#Alternate:What were some of the people/disciples talking about while they were in the temple grounds with Jesus?-1308491262

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~5#Answer:What were some of the people/disciples talking about while they were in the temple grounds with Jesus?588306878
trans-unit.source: They were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts which people had offered to God. (5)
trans-unit.target: Basi, baadhi ya watu walikuwa wakizungumza juu ya Hekalu, jinsi lilivyopambwa kwa mawe mazuri na kwa sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Mungu.

group.id: Q:LUK 21.6+What did Jesus say about the stones?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~6#Question:What did Jesus say about the stones?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the stones?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu mawe?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~6#Question:What did Jesus say about the stones?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~6#Answer:What did Jesus say about the stones?228526510
trans-unit.source: He said that at a later time not one stone would be left on top of another, [that is, someone would break those walls down into a pile of rocks]. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba baadaye hakuna jiwe lingebaki juu ya jiwe lingine, [yaani, mtu fulani angebomoa kuta hizo na kuzifanya kuwa rundo la mawe]. (6)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~6#Answer:What did Jesus say about the stones?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.7+What was their response to Jesus's statement?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~7#Answer:What was their response to Jesus's statement?1696162026

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~7#Answer:What was their response to Jesus's statement?725475012

trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu/wanafunzi wawe waangalifu sana kuhusu jambo hili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~8#Question:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!21~8#Alternate:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?904856157
trans-unit.source: Why must the people be very careful about this matter?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu wawe waangalifu sana kuhusu jambo hili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~8#Alternate:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!21~8#Alternate:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?-1466268049
trans-unit.source: Why must the disciples be very careful about this matter?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini ni lazima wanafunzi wawe waangalifu sana kuhusu jambo hili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~8#Alternate:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~8#Answer:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?1622023355
trans-unit.source: They could be deceived by [one of the] many [men] who would claim that he was the real Christ whom God had sent to save all the people in the world. (8)
trans-unit.target: Wangeweza kudanganywa na [mmoja wa] [wanaume] wengi ambao wangedai kwamba yeye ndiye Kristo wa kweli aliyetumwa na Mungu kuwaokoa watu wote ulimwenguni. (8)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~8#Answer:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~8#Answer:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?-901482730
trans-unit.source: They may also become frightened when hearing [people talk] about wars and civil unrest. (9)
trans-unit.target: Pia huenda wakaogopa wanaposikia [watu wakisema] juu ya vita na misukosuko ya kiraia. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~8#Answer:Why must the people/disciples be very careful about this matter?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.10-11+What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~10#Question:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?
trans-unit.source: What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?
trans-unit.target: Ni mambo gani ambayo yangetokea baadaye ambayo yangeweza pia kuwafanya watu wafikiri kwamba mwisho wa ulimwengu ulikuwa karibu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~10#Question:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~10#Answer:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?1152981127
trans-unit.source: Some countries would fight against other countries; (10)
trans-unit.target: Nchi fulani zingepigana na nchi nyingine; (10)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~10#Answer:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~10#Answer:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?-1932753263
trans-unit.source: there would be severe earthquakes, and famine and horrible diseases in place after place. (11)
trans-unit.target: kutakuwa na matetemeko makubwa ya nchi, na njaa na magonjwa ya kuambukiza mahali mahali. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~10#Answer:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~10#Answer:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?1048784298
trans-unit.source: People will see strange/unusual things happen in the sky which would make them be terribly afraid and wonder [if the world was about to end]. (11)
trans-unit.target: Watu wataona mambo ya ajabu/ya ajabu yakitokea mbinguni ambayo yangewafanya wawe na hofu na kujiuliza [kama ulimwengu ulikuwa karibu kuisha]. (11)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~10#Answer:What kinds of things would happen later which could also cause people to think that the world was about to end?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.9+Why are people not to worry at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~9#Question:Why are people not to worry at that time?
trans-unit.source: Why are people not to worry at that time?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu wasiwe na wasiwasi wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~9#Question:Why are people not to worry at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~9#Answer:Why are people not to worry at that time?-970242750
trans-unit.source: Those things would happen, but that would not yet be the end of the world/time. (9)
trans-unit.target: Mambo hayo yangetukia, lakini bado si mwisho wa ulimwengu/wakati. (9)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~9#Answer:Why are people not to worry at that time?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.12+What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~12#Question:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?
trans-unit.source: What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kingetukia hata kabla ya vita hivyo na matetemeko ya nchi na mambo mengine yenye kuogofya?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~12#Question:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~12#Answer:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?1225664467
trans-unit.source: Other people would seize the disciples/those who believed in Jesus and persecute them. (12)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine wangewakamata wanafunzi/wale walioamini katika Yesu na kuwatesa. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~12#Answer:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~12#Answer:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?792174167
trans-unit.source: Those people would turn the believers over to [the leaders of] the synagogues and prisons. (12)
trans-unit.target: Hao ndio watu ambao wangewapeleka [viongozi wa] masinagogi na magereza. (12)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~12#Answer:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~12#Answer:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?928604583
trans-unit.source: They would take the believers in front of kings and governors [to be tried in court] .(12)
trans-unit.target: Waliwapeleka waamini mbele ya wafalme na magavana [wahukumiwe mahakamani] .
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~12#Answer:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!21~12#Note:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?-940380592
trans-unit.source: Check whether any changes which you may have made to the Key Term "persecute" back at 11:49 should be applied to verse 12 as well.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kama mabadiliko yoyote ambayo huenda ukawa umefanya kwa Neno la msingi "kutesa" nyuma katika 11:49 yapaswa kutumiwa kwa mstari wa 12 vilevile.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~12#Note:What would happen even before those wars and earthquakes and other terrible things?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.12-17+Why would those people do like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~12#Question:Why would those people do like that?
trans-unit.source: Why would those people do like that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu hao wafanye hivyo?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~12#Answer:Why would those people do like that?-1004056427
trans-unit.source: They would do that because the disciples/believers were associated with Jesus (and his name). (12, 17)

trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~12#Answer:Why would those people do like that?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.25-28+Why should those who believe in Jesus be so excited and happy about seeing him return to earth?

trans-unit.source: He will be coming to release them/get them back [from the troubles and disasters taking place in the world due to sin and Satan]. (28)
