trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~25#Answer:Why should those who believe in Jesus be so excited and happy about seeing him return to earth?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.25-26+What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~25#Question:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?
trans-unit.source: What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?
trans-unit.target: Ni mambo gani yasiyo ya kawaida ambayo watu wataona au kupata yatakayowafanya wawe na wasiwasi na kuogopa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~25#Question:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~25#Answer:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?2109569947
trans-unit.source: They will see signs in the sun, moon, and stars. (25)
trans-unit.target: Na katika jua na mwezi na nyota zimo Ishara.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~25#Answer:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~25#Answer:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?-944598001
trans-unit.source: Their thinking will be confused and fearful because of the sea roaring and the waves tossing wildly. (25)
trans-unit.target: Mawazo yao yatavurugika na wataogopa kwa sababu ya bahari inayovuma na mawimbi yanayoenda kwa kasi. (25)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~25#Answer:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~25#Answer:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?-616390872
trans-unit.source: They will faint from fear, not knowing what will happen to the world, because stars [and other things we see in the sky] will waver/totter/move as if someone shook them around. (26)
trans-unit.target: Watashikwa na hofu, bila kujua kitakachotokea ulimwenguni, kwa sababu nyota [na vitu vingine tunavyoona angani] zitakuwa zikiyumba-yumba kama mtu anavyozitikisa. (26)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~25#Answer:What unusual things will people see or experience that will make them worry and be afraid?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.29-33+How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~29#Question:How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?
trans-unit.source: How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?
trans-unit.target: Watu wangejuaje kwamba yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha yangetukia kweli kweli?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~29#Question:How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~29#Answer:How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?-367848827
trans-unit.source: Just like new sprouts on a fig tree help people to know that summer is near, even so, when people see certain things happen [in nature], they should realize that other things which Jesus also predicted will naturally follow soon after that. (30-31)
trans-unit.target: Kama vile vichipukizi vipya kwenye mtini huwasaidia watu kujua kwamba majira ya kiangazi yamekaribia, vivyo hivyo, watu wanapoona mambo fulani yakitukia [katika asili], wanapaswa kutambua kwamba mambo mengine ambayo Yesu pia alitabiri yatafuata kwa kawaida baada ya hapo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~29#Answer:How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~29#Answer:How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?-817804944
trans-unit.source: When Jesus said something will happen, it will happen, even if the sky and the earth and the things we see there cease to exist. (33)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliposema kitu kitatokea, kitatokea, hata kama mbingu na dunia na vitu tunavyoona huko vitaacha kuwepo. (33)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~29#Answer:How would the people know that what Jesus was teaching them really would happen?

group.id: Q:LUK 21.30+What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!21~30#Question:What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?
trans-unit.source: What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?
trans-unit.target: Watu hujua nini wanapoona vichipukizi vikichipuka kwenye mtini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~30#Question:What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!21~30#Answer:What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?1281456538
trans-unit.source: They know that the time for summer is near. (30)
trans-unit.target: Wanajua kwamba majira ya kiangazi yako karibu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~30#Answer:What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!21~30#Note:What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?904266215
trans-unit.source: See possible cultural alternatives to use instead of "summer" in TN.
trans-unit.target: Angalia uwezekano wa utamaduni mbadala kutumia badala ya "majira ya joto" katika TN.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~30#Note:What do people know when they see sprouts appear on a fig tree?

trans-unit.source: They would happen before the people who were living then at Jesus's time would die. (32)

trans-unit.source: Although some people interpret the words "this generation" in several other ways, when one looks at the other places where Luke used these words, they clearly refer to the people living in Jesus's time. See Luke 7:31; 11:29, 30, 31, 32, 50, 51; and Acts 2:40.
trans-unit.target: Ingawa watu fulani hufasiri maneno "kizazi hiki" kwa njia nyingine kadhaa, mtu anapoangalia mahali pengine ambapo Luka alitumia maneno haya, kwa wazi yanarejezea watu walioishi wakati wa Yesu. Ona Luka 7:31; 11:29, 30, 31, 32, 50, 51; na Matendo 2:40.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!21~32#Note:When would those things happen?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.16+What did Jesus mean by that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~16#Question:What did Jesus mean by that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean by that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~16#Question:What did Jesus mean by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~16#Answer:What did Jesus mean by that?1529319164
trans-unit.source: When Jesus said this, he referred to the Passover festival. He was going to be the [true] sacrificial lamb. After that, he would not celebrate the Passover anymore [on earth], but he would celebrate the final rescue of God's people in heaven.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliposema hayo, alikuwa akirejezea sikukuu ya Pasaka. Yeye mwenyewe angekuwa mwana-kondoo wa dhabihu [wa kweli]. Baada ya hapo, hangesherehekea tena Sikukuu ya Kupitwa [duniani], bali angesherehekea ukombozi wa mwisho wa watu wa Mungu mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~16#Answer:What did Jesus mean by that?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!22~16#Note:What did Jesus mean by that?1699042665
trans-unit.source: There is a lot of deep significance contained in Jesus' statement. Many respondents will probably only be able to understand a small part of what Jesus meant.
trans-unit.target: Kuna maana nyingi sana zilizo ndani ya taarifa ya Yesu. Wajibu wengi labda wataweza kuelewa sehemu ndogo tu ya alilomaanisha Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~16#Note:What did Jesus mean by that?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.37+Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~37#Question:Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"
trans-unit.source: Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani aliyesema maneno haya mwanzoni: "Akahesabiwa pamoja na wakosaji"?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~37#Question:Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~37#Answer:Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"-671677987
trans-unit.source: Isaiah said these words (Isaiah 53:12)
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliye na mamlaka ya kutawala juu ya dunia? (Zaburi 115:16)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~37#Answer:Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!22~37#Note:Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"-959729276
trans-unit.source: Unless the translation (or a footnote) makes it clear or the respondent has a good knowledge of the Old Testament, it is unlikely that they would know this was written by Isaiah. However, it should be clear from the text that this is a prophecy and not words being spoken for the first time by Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Isipokuwa tafsiri (au maelezo ya chini) inaweka wazi au mjibu ana ujuzi mzuri wa Agano la Kale, ni vigumu kwamba wangejua hii iliandikwa na Isaya. Hata hivyo, inapaswa kuwa wazi kutoka kwa maandishi kwamba hii ni unabii na sio maneno yanayosemwa kwa mara ya kwanza na Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~37#Note:Who do you think originally said the words: "And he was numbered with the transgressors?"

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~40#Answer:What temptation do you think Jesus meant?1930693601
trans-unit.source: Jesus had already told the disciples that they would abandon him, so he was probably referring to the temptation to be afraid and fall away.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~40#Answer:What temptation do you think Jesus meant?-1356288500

trans-unit.source: What did they ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Question:What did they ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~67#Answer:What did they ask Jesus?1502379808
trans-unit.source: They asked him, "If you are the Messiah, tell us."
trans-unit.target: Wakamwambia, "Kama wewe ndiye Kristo, tuambie".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Answer:What did they ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.67+What do you think the term "Messiah" means?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~67#Question:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the term "Messiah" means?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri neno "Masihi" linamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Question:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~67#Answer:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?2114464983
trans-unit.source: Messiah means deliverer and anointed.
trans-unit.target: Masihi humaanisha mkombozi na mtiwa-mafuta.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Answer:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~67#Answer:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?1738974248
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is the transliteration of the Hebrew word meaning "anointed one" that was translated into Greek as Christos.
trans-unit.target: Tafuta Neno Muhimu: Neno hilo ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiebrania linalomaanisha "mtiwa-mafuta" ambalo lilitafsiriwa katika Kigiriki kuwa Christos.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Answer:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!22~67#Note:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?1462518645
trans-unit.source: See "Messiah" in KBT in the "Christ, Messiah" entry.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Masihi" katika tafsiri ya Union Version katika maandishi "Kristo, Masihi".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Note:What do you think the term "Messiah" means?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.67-69+What answer did Jesus give to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~67#Question:What answer did Jesus give to them?
trans-unit.source: What answer did Jesus give to them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa jibu gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Question:What answer did Jesus give to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~67#Answer:What answer did Jesus give to them?-692138355
trans-unit.source: Jesus answered, "If I tell you, you will not believe me, and if I asked you, you would not answer. But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God."
trans-unit.target: Yesu akawajibu, "Hata nikiwaambieni hamtaniamini, na nikiwauliza swali, hamtanijibu. Lakini tangu sasa, Mwana wa Adamu atakuwa ameketi upande wa kulia wa Mungu Mwenyezi".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Answer:What answer did Jesus give to them?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.67-70+What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~67#Question:What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?
trans-unit.source: What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?
trans-unit.target: Wanaume hao walielewa nini kutokana na jibu la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Question:What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~67#Answer:What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?182376778
trans-unit.source: These men understood that Jesus was claiming to have a special relationship to God [as the Christ/the Son of God].
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walielewa kwamba Yesu alikuwa akidai kuwa na uhusiano wa pekee pamoja na Mungu [kama Kristo/Mwana wa Mungu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Answer:What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~67#Answer:What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?-896844279
trans-unit.source: They also thought that Jesus was blaspheming.
trans-unit.target: Pia walifikiri kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekufuru.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~67#Answer:What did these men understand from Jesus' answer?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.70+Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~70#Question:Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)
trans-unit.source: Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)
trans-unit.target: Je, walielewa jibu la Yesu kwa usahihi? (Je, kweli alisema walichofikiri?)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Question:Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~70#Answer:Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)318780080
trans-unit.source: They were correct in understanding that Jesus was claiming to be the Christ.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa sahihi katika kuelewa kwamba Yesu alikuwa akidai kuwa ndiye Kristo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Answer:Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~70#Answer:Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)-738772566
trans-unit.source: They incorrectly believed his words to be blasphemy [because he really was the Christ].
trans-unit.target: Waliamini kimakosa maneno yake kuwa makufuru [kwa sababu kwa kweli yeye alikuwa Kristo].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Answer:Was their understanding of Jesus' answer correct? (Did he really say what they thought?)

group.id: Q:LUK 22.70+How did Jesus' answer their second question?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~70#Question:How did Jesus' answer their second question?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus' answer their second question?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje swali lao la pili?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Question:How did Jesus' answer their second question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~70#Answer:How did Jesus' answer their second question?-1484842701
trans-unit.source: Jesus answered, "You say that I am."
trans-unit.target: Yesu akawajibu, "Ninyi wenyewe mnasema kwamba mimi ndiye".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Answer:How did Jesus' answer their second question?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.70+What did Jesus mean when he said that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~70#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he said that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~70#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that?1267098057
trans-unit.source: Jesus was affirming that he was the Son of God.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akithibitisha kwamba yeye ni Mwana wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~70#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.71+What did they say about [being] witnesses?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~71#Question:What did they say about [being] witnesses?
trans-unit.source: What did they say about [being] witnesses?
trans-unit.target: Walisema nini kuhusu [kuwa] mashahidi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Question:What did they say about [being] witnesses?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!22~71#Alternate:What did they say about [being] witnesses?849468296
trans-unit.source: What did they say about being witnesses?
trans-unit.target: Walisema nini kuhusu kuwa mashahidi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Alternate:What did they say about [being] witnesses?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!22~71#Alternate:What did they say about [being] witnesses?805981698
trans-unit.source: What did they say about witnesses?
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na mashahidi gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Alternate:What did they say about [being] witnesses?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~71#Answer:What did they say about [being] witnesses?-532968193
trans-unit.source: They said they themselves were witnesses because they heard what Jesus said.
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba wao wenyewe walikuwa mashahidi kwa sababu walisikia aliyosema Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Answer:What did they say about [being] witnesses?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.71+What legal conclusion did they reach based on Jesus' words?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~71#Question:What legal conclusion did they reach based on Jesus' words?
trans-unit.source: What legal conclusion did they reach based on Jesus' words?
trans-unit.target: Walifikia mkataa gani wa kisheria kwa msingi wa maneno ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Question:What legal conclusion did they reach based on Jesus' words?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~71#Answer:What legal conclusion did they reach based on Jesus' words?-415633644
trans-unit.source: They said that Jesus was blaspheming because he claimed to be the Son of God.
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekufuru kwa sababu alidai kuwa Mwana wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Answer:What legal conclusion did they reach based on Jesus' words?

group.id: Q:LUK 22.71+Do you think their conclusion was correct?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!22~71#Question:Do you think their conclusion was correct?
trans-unit.source: Do you think their conclusion was correct?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri walifikia mkataa unaofaa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Question:Do you think their conclusion was correct?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!22~71#Answer:Do you think their conclusion was correct?1681336755
trans-unit.source: No. Their conclusion was incorrect.
trans-unit.target: La, mkataa wao haukuwa sahihi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!22~71#Answer:Do you think their conclusion was correct?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.1-5+What type of assembly/meeting is being described?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~1#Question:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?
trans-unit.source: What type of assembly/meeting is being described?
trans-unit.target: Ni mkusanyiko au mkutano wa aina gani unaozungumziwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Question:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~1#Alternate:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?-202634663
trans-unit.source: What type of assembly is being described?
trans-unit.target: Ni mkusanyiko wa aina gani unaofafanuliwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Alternate:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~1#Alternate:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?1734272810
trans-unit.source: What type of meeting is being described?
trans-unit.target: Ni mkutano wa aina gani unaozungumziwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Alternate:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?-2077812005
trans-unit.source: This was a trial/legal hearing [held before Pilate, the Roman governor].
trans-unit.target: Hilo lilikuwa kesi ya kisheria [iliyofanywa mbele ya Pilato, gavana Mroma].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:What type of assembly/meeting is being described?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.1-5+In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~1#Question:In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?
trans-unit.source: In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?
trans-unit.target: Katika kesi iliyotajwa katika sehemu iliyotangulia, wanaume hao walimpata Yesu na hatia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Question:In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?393359736
trans-unit.source: This trial was a secular trial to determine if Jesus had broken any Roman laws.
trans-unit.target: Kesi hiyo ilikuwa ya kilimwengu ili kuamua kama Yesu alikuwa amekiuka sheria yoyote ya Roma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?671328795
trans-unit.source: This trial was different because only a Roman governor could give a punishment/sentence someone to death.
trans-unit.target: Kesi hiyo ilikuwa tofauti kwa sababu ni gavana Mroma pekee ambaye angeweza kutoa adhabu ya kifo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:In the trial told about in the previous section, the men found Jesus guilty. How is this trial different?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.1-5+Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~1#Question:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Pilato hakuweza kupata kosa lolote katika Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Question:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?777324260
trans-unit.source: Pilate couldn't find any fault in Jesus because he couldn't find any basis for a charge.
trans-unit.target: Pilato hakuweza kupata kosa lolote katika Yesu kwa sababu hakuweza kupata msingi wowote wa shtaka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?-1785077699
trans-unit.source: Jesus had not broken any Roman laws.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakuwa amekiuka sheria yoyote ya Roma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~1#Note:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?708199347
trans-unit.source: Although Pilate might have accused Jesus of leading an insurrection because he did claim to be the king of the Jews, probably seeing Jesus demeanor and poor estate he did not take the charge or the claim very seriously.
trans-unit.target: Ingawa Pilato angeweza kumshtaki Yesu kwa kuongoza uasi kwa sababu alidai kuwa mfalme wa Wayahudi, labda kwa kuona tabia ya Yesu na hali yake duni hakuchukua mashtaka au madai hayo kwa uzito sana.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Note:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~1#Note:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?1521798432
trans-unit.source: John's gospel reveals that there was more to this conversation, so Pilate might well have understood that Jesus' claim to be the king posed no credible threat to the Roman government.
trans-unit.target: Injili ya Yohana inafunua kwamba mazungumzo hayo hayakuwa ya kijuujuu tu, kwa hiyo huenda Pilato alielewa kwamba dai la Yesu la kuwa mfalme halikuwa tisho kwa serikali ya Roma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Note:Why do you think Pilate was not able to find any fault in Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.1+Where did they take Jesus after that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~1#Question:Where did they take Jesus after that?
trans-unit.source: Where did they take Jesus after that?
trans-unit.target: Kisha wakampeleka Yesu wapi?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Question:Where did they take Jesus after that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:Where did they take Jesus after that?1859347714
trans-unit.source: They took Jesus to Pilate.
trans-unit.target: Walimpeleka Yesu kwa Pilato.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:Where did they take Jesus after that?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.1+Who was Pilate?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~1#Question:Who was Pilate?
trans-unit.source: Who was Pilate?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Question:Who was Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~1#Answer:Who was Pilate?-1862463432
trans-unit.source: Pilate was a Roman governor.
trans-unit.target: Pilato alikuwa gavana Mroma.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Answer:Who was Pilate?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~1#Note:Who was Pilate?-841077164
trans-unit.source: Unless the translation (or a footnote) makes it clear or the respondent has independent knowledge of the characters in this account, they might have to guess. If guesses reveal an inaccurate understanding, it might be worth considering how to improve clarity.
trans-unit.target: Isipokuwa tafsiri (au maelezo ya chini) hufanya iwe wazi au mhojiwa ana maarifa ya kujitegemea ya wahusika katika akaunti hii, wanaweza kuwa na nadhani. Ikiwa nadhani zinaonyesha uelewa usio sahihi, inaweza kuwa na thamani ya kuzingatia jinsi ya kuboresha uwazi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~1#Note:Who was Pilate?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.2+What accusations did they bring against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~2#Question:What accusations did they bring against Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What accusations did they bring against Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walileta mashtaka gani dhidi ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~2#Question:What accusations did they bring against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~2#Answer:What accusations did they bring against Jesus?1987568738
trans-unit.source: They claimed Jesus was undermining the government by opposing payment of taxes to Caesar.
trans-unit.target: Walidai kwamba Yesu alikuwa akipinga serikali kwa kupinga kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~2#Answer:What accusations did they bring against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~2#Answer:What accusations did they bring against Jesus?-139751582
trans-unit.source: They said Jesus claimed to be the Messiah, a king [implying that he was opposing Caesar's throne].
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba Yesu alidai kuwa Mesiya, mfalme [akimaanisha kwamba alikuwa akipinga kiti cha ufalme cha Kaisari].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~2#Answer:What accusations did they bring against Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.2+Why do you think their accusations would be of concern to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~2#Question:Why do you think their accusations would be of concern to Pilate?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think their accusations would be of concern to Pilate?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri mashtaka yao yangemhangaisha Pilato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~2#Question:Why do you think their accusations would be of concern to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~2#Answer:Why do you think their accusations would be of concern to Pilate?1827382537
trans-unit.source: It would be a threat to the Roman Empire [if Jesus really were trying to establish a kingdom to seize power from the Roman government].
trans-unit.target: Ingekuwa tisho kwa Milki ya Roma [ikiwa kweli Yesu alikuwa akijaribu kuanzisha ufalme ili kunyakua mamlaka kutoka kwa serikali ya Kiroma].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~2#Answer:Why do you think their accusations would be of concern to Pilate?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.3+What did Pilate ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~3#Question:What did Pilate ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Pilate ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alimwuliza Yesu maswali gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Question:What did Pilate ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~3#Answer:What did Pilate ask Jesus?-1538979751
trans-unit.source: Pilate asked Jesus "Are you the king of the Jews?"
trans-unit.target: Pilato alimwuliza Yesu hivi: "Je, wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?"
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Answer:What did Pilate ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.3+How did Jesus respond?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~3#Question:How did Jesus respond?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus respond?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Question:How did Jesus respond?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~3#Answer:How did Jesus respond?-666402180
trans-unit.source: Jesus replied "You have said so."
trans-unit.target: Yesu akajibu: "Wewe mwenyewe umesema".
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Answer:How did Jesus respond?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.3+What did Jesus mean when he said that?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~3#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he said that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~3#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that?-782282863
trans-unit.source: When Jesus said that, he implied/affirmed that he is the king of the Jews.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliposema hivyo, alimaanisha/alikuwa akithibitisha kwamba yeye ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.3+What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~3#Question:What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?
trans-unit.source: What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alielewa nini kutokana na jibu la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Question:What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~3#Answer:What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?-1460825615
trans-unit.source: Pilate understood that Jesus was agreeing that he was indeed the king of the Jews.
trans-unit.target: Pilato alielewa kwamba Yesu alikuwa akikubali kwamba kwa kweli yeye alikuwa mfalme wa Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Answer:What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~3#Note:What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?-595072899
trans-unit.source: The text here does not necessarily make this clear, nor does it offer any explanation about how Pilate interpreted this claim, but since Pilate goes on to say that Jesus was innocent, he apparently did not interpret that claim as an act of treason or insurrection.
trans-unit.target: Andiko hapa halionyeshi waziwazi jambo hilo, wala halisemi jinsi Pilato alivyofafanua dai hilo, lakini kwa kuwa Pilato anaendelea kusema kwamba Yesu hakuwa na hatia, inaonekana hakufafanua dai hilo kuwa tendo la usaliti au uasi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~3#Note:What did Pilate understand from Jesus' answer?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.4+What legal conclusion did Pilate reach?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~4#Question:What legal conclusion did Pilate reach?
trans-unit.source: What legal conclusion did Pilate reach?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alifikia mkataa gani wa kisheria?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~4#Question:What legal conclusion did Pilate reach?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~4#Answer:What legal conclusion did Pilate reach?-2083011500
trans-unit.source: Pilate's conclusion was that Jesus was innocent.
trans-unit.target: Pilato alifikia mkataa kwamba Yesu hakuwa na hatia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~4#Answer:What legal conclusion did Pilate reach?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.5+What did those people continue to say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~5#Question:What did those people continue to say about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did those people continue to say about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao waliendelea kusema nini juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~5#Question:What did those people continue to say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~5#Answer:What did those people continue to say about Jesus?1658425201
trans-unit.source: The people said that Jesus was stirring up people all over Judea by his teaching.
trans-unit.target: Watu walisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa akiwachochea watu katika Yudea yote kwa mafundisho yake.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~5#Answer:What did those people continue to say about Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.5+Where did they say Jesus began teaching?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.6-12+How was Herod’s interaction with Jesus different form Pilate's?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~6#Question:How was Herod’s interaction with Jesus different form Pilate's?
trans-unit.source: How was Herod’s interaction with Jesus different form Pilate's?
trans-unit.target: Uhusiano wa Herode na Yesu ulikuwaje tofauti na ule wa Pilato?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Question:How was Herod’s interaction with Jesus different form Pilate's?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~6#Answer:How was Herod’s interaction with Jesus different form Pilate's?-1264341607
trans-unit.source: At first, Herod was pleased to see Jesus but when Jesus did not answer his questions, he started to mock Jesus with the other teachers of law and soldiers. Pilate was more considerate to Jesus. He found no basis for a charge and he did not mock Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Mwanzoni, Herode alifurahi kumwona Yesu lakini wakati Yesu hakujibu maswali yake, alianza kumdhihaki pamoja na waandishi wengine na askari. Pilato alimheshimu zaidi Yesu. Hakuona sababu ya kumshtaki na hakumdhihaki.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Answer:How was Herod’s interaction with Jesus different form Pilate's?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.6-12+If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~6#Question:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?
trans-unit.source: If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa yeyote wa mamlaka za ulimwengu huu atamwuliza Yesu maswali, je, wafikiri kwamba anahitaji kuwajibu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Question:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?-1283027540
trans-unit.source: If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa yeyote wa mamlaka za ulimwengu huu atamwuliza Yesu maswali, je, wafikiri kwamba anahitaji kuwajibu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?-654639742
trans-unit.source: If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them or not?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa yeyote wa mamlaka za ulimwengu huu atamwuliza Yesu, je, unafikiri anahitaji kuwajibu au la?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?170922736
trans-unit.source: If any of the world’s authorities question God’s son, Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them or not?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa yeyote wa mamlaka za ulimwengu huu atamwuliza mwana wa Mungu, Yesu, je, unafikiri anahitaji kuwajibu au la?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~6#Answer:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?-1737306233
trans-unit.source: Jesus is a very powerful king, so he is not obligated to answer anyone's questions.
trans-unit.target: Yesu ni mfalme mwenye nguvu sana, kwa hiyo si lazima ajibu maswali ya mtu yeyote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Answer:If any of the world’s authorities question Jesus, do you think he needs to answer them?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.6-12+[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~6#Question:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?
trans-unit.source: [Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?
trans-unit.target: [Kufufua wafu, kutuliza dhoruba, kuponya magonjwa yote, kufa na kurudi tena kwenye uhai sisi huita miujiza ya aina hii.] Unafikiri ni nani anayeweza kufanya miujiza ya aina hii?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Question:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?-104513623
trans-unit.source: Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles. Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?
trans-unit.target: Kufufua wafu, kutuliza dhoruba, kuponya magonjwa yote, kufa na kurudi tena kwenye maisha - tunaita miujiza ya aina hii. Unafikiri ni nani anayeweza kufanya miujiza ya aina hii?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?2085131548
trans-unit.source: Raising the dead, calming a storm, healing sicknesses, and coming back to life after dying are examples of miracles. Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?
trans-unit.target: Kufufua wafu, kutuliza dhoruba, kuponya magonjwa, na kufufuliwa baada ya kufa ni mifano ya miujiza. Unafikiri ni nani anayeweza kufanya miujiza ya aina hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?158936568
trans-unit.source: Miracles are things like raising the dead, calming a storm, healing sicknesses, and dying and coming back to life. Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?
trans-unit.target: Miujiza ni mambo kama kufufua wafu, kutuliza dhoruba, kuponya magonjwa, na kufa na kurudi tena kwenye uhai. Unafikiri ni nani anayeweza kufanya miujiza ya aina hii?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?409240877
trans-unit.source: Who do you think is able to perform miracles?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani anayeweza kufanya miujiza?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Alternate:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~6#Answer:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?591304608
trans-unit.source: Jesus [because he is God] is able to do these kinds of miracles.
trans-unit.target: Yesu [kwa sababu yeye ni Mungu] anaweza kufanya miujiza ya aina hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Answer:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~6#Answer:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?782545202
trans-unit.source: God can also empower Jesus' followers to perform miracles.
trans-unit.target: Mungu pia aweza kuwapa wafuasi wa Yesu nguvu za kufanya miujiza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Answer:[Raising the dead, calming the storm, healing all sicknesses, dying and coming back to life — we call these kinds of things miracles.] Who do you think is able to do these kinds of miracles?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.6-7+Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~6#Question:Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?
trans-unit.source: Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Pilato alimpeleka Yesu kwa Herode?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Question:Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~6#Answer:Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?-1303647906
trans-unit.source: Pilate sent Jesus to Herod because Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction.
trans-unit.target: Pilato alimpeleka Yesu kwa Herode kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa chini ya mamlaka ya Herode.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Answer:Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~6#Note:Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?-610534823
trans-unit.source: An astute respondent might also point out that this was easy to do since Herod was in Jerusalem (rather than up in Galilee).
trans-unit.target: Mwombaji mwenye busara pia angeweza kuonyesha kwamba hilo lilikuwa rahisi kufanya kwa kuwa Herode alikuwa Yerusalemu (badala ya kuwa juu Galilaya).
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~6#Note:Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~8#Answer:How did Herod feel when he first saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.8+Why did Herod want to see Jesus?

trans-unit.target: Herode alitaka kumwona Yesu kwa sababu alitumaini kwamba Yesu angefanya muujiza.

group.id: Q:LUK 23.9+How did Jesus respond to Herod's questions?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~9#Question:How did Jesus respond to Herod's questions?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus respond to Herod's questions?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje maswali ya Herode?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~9#Question:How did Jesus respond to Herod's questions?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~9#Answer:How did Jesus respond to Herod's questions?1033128607
trans-unit.source: Jesus gave no answer to Herod’s questions.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakumjibu Herode maswali yoyote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~9#Answer:How did Jesus respond to Herod's questions?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.9+Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~9#Question:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu hakumjibu Herode?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~9#Question:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~9#Answer:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?-1195432608
trans-unit.source: Perhaps if Jesus answered Herod, he might have been set free, but because he came to earth to be a sacrifice for us, his purpose would have defeated if he said anything to Herod.
trans-unit.target: Labda kama Yesu angejibu Herode, angaliweza kuachiliwa, lakini kwa sababu alikuja duniani kuwa dhabihu kwa ajili yetu, kusudi lake lingeshindwa kama angaliambia Herode jambo lolote.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~9#Answer:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~9#Answer:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?-1143326718
trans-unit.source: Jesus knew Herod's motives and he did not want to give Herod the satisfaction of a reply.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijua nia za Herode naye hakutaka kumpa Herode uradhi wa jibu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~9#Answer:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~9#Answer:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?830523624
trans-unit.source: It had been prophesied that Jesus would be silent before his accusers, so this fulfilled that prophecy.
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa imetabiriwa kwamba Yesu angekaa kimya mbele ya washtaki wake, kwa hiyo hilo lilitimiza unabii huo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~9#Answer:Why do you think Jesus did not answer Herod?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 23.13-25+Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~13#Question:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.
trans-unit.source: Tell in your own words what happened in this section.
trans-unit.target: Eleza kwa maneno yako mwenyewe kilichotukia katika sehemu hii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~13#Question:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~13#Answer:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.754919535
trans-unit.source: In this section, Pilate and Herod found Jesus innocent. However the crowd wanted Jesus to be crucified instead of Barabbas (a man thrown into prison for insurrection in the city and for murder). Pilate appealed to them but they kept shouting and Pilate gave up. He released Barabbas and ordered Jesus to be crucified.
trans-unit.target: Katika sehemu hii Pilato na Herode walimwona Yesu kuwa hana hatia. Hata hivyo umati ulitaka asulubiwe badala ya Baraba (mtu aliyekuwa ametupwa gerezani kwa ajili ya uasi katika jiji na kwa ajili ya uuaji). Pilato aliwasihi lakini waliendelea kupiga kelele na Pilato akakubali. Basi akamwachilia Baraba na kuamuru Yesu asulubiwe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~13#Answer:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

group.id: Q:LUK 23.13-25+If any of these events surprised you, explain why.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~13#Question:If any of these events surprised you, explain why.
trans-unit.source: If any of these events surprised you, explain why.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa jambo lolote kati ya hayo lilikushangaza, eleza sababu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~13#Question:If any of these events surprised you, explain why.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~13#Answer:If any of these events surprised you, explain why.1054277261
trans-unit.source: The surprising event in this section is the crowd wanting Jesus dead. A few days before this event, the crowd called Jesus the king of kings and welcomed him with palm leaves. A few days later, they wanted him dead.
trans-unit.target: Tukio la kushangaza katika sehemu hii ni umati wa watu ambao walitaka Yesu afe. Siku chache kabla ya tukio hili, umati wa watu walimwita Yesu mfalme wa wafalme na kumkaribisha kwa majani ya mitende. Siku chache baadaye, walitaka afe.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~13#Answer:If any of these events surprised you, explain why.

trans-unit.source: Pilate wanted to release Jesus and not Barabbas because he found no evidence for their charges against him. Barabbas was a bad person who was thrown into prison for insurrection in the city and for murder.

trans-unit.source: Most likely this was Pilate's attempt to appease the accusers.
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea Pilato alijaribu kuwaridhisha washtaki wake kwa kufanya hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~16#Answer:Why was Pilate going to punish Jesus [if he had not found him guilty]?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~16#Note:Why was Pilate going to punish Jesus [if he had not found him guilty]?-866838117
trans-unit.source: Respondent might rely on personal or cultural biases about government corruption or the tendency of people in power to be cruel to explain this. Or they might try to relate an understanding about the Roman government and its attitude toward the Jews. Nothing in the text should lead a respondent to conclude that Pilate had found Jesus guilty of something (i.e., a lesser crime) that was worthy of punishment but not death.
trans-unit.target: Mhojiwa anaweza kutegemea upendeleo wa kibinafsi au wa kitamaduni kuhusu ufisadi wa serikali au tabia ya watu wenye mamlaka kuwa wakatili kuelezea hili. Au wanaweza kujaribu kuelezea uelewa juu ya serikali ya Kirumi na mtazamo wake kwa Wayahudi. Hakuna chochote katika maandishi kinapaswa kumfanya mhojiwa afikie hitimisho kwamba Pilato alikuwa amemwona Yesu kuwa na hatia ya kitu (yaani, uhalifu mdogo) ambao unastahili adhabu lakini sio kifo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~16#Note:Why was Pilate going to punish Jesus [if he had not found him guilty]?

trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~28#Answer:Why did Jesus tell those women not to cry for him?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~28#Note:Why did Jesus tell those women not to cry for him?-607470056
trans-unit.source: The exact reason may be difficult to determine from the text, but ensure that the translation is not implying any ideas that as incorrect.
trans-unit.target: Sababu halisi inaweza kuwa vigumu kuamua kutoka maandishi, lakini kuhakikisha kwamba tafsiri si kuashiria mawazo yoyote kwamba kama makosa.

group.id: Q:LUK 23.29-31+Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~29#Question:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?
trans-unit.source: Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?
trans-unit.target: Ni siku/wakati gani ambao Yesu alisema unakuja?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Question:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~29#Alternate:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?1580436452
trans-unit.source: Which time did Jesus say is coming?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni wakati gani utakaokuja?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Alternate:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~29#Alternate:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?-1245015228
trans-unit.source: Which days did Jesus say are coming?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni siku zipi zitakazokuja?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Alternate:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~29#Answer:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?-2079338388
trans-unit.source: Jesus said the time will come when women will say "Blessed are the childless women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!" Then they will say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!"
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba siku zinakuja wakati wanawake watasema "Heri walio tasa, na matumbo yasiyozaa, na maziwa yasiyonyonyesha". Ndipo watakapoanza kuiambia milima, "Tuangukieni!" na vilima, "Tufunikeni!"
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Answer:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~29#Answer:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?-579493394
trans-unit.source: Jesus said a time of dryness [or death] was coming.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba wakati wa ukame [au kifo] ungekuja.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Answer:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~29#Answer:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?419328180
trans-unit.source: Jesus predicted a time of judgment or tribulation, when people would wish to be dead or hidden [from God].
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitabiri wakati wa hukumu au dhiki, wakati ambapo watu wangetamani kufa au kufichwa [kutoka kwa Mungu].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Answer:Which days/time did Jesus say are/is coming?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.29-31+Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~29#Question:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?
trans-unit.source: Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu matukio ambayo yangetukia wakati ujao, au jambo ambalo tayari limetukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Question:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~29#Answer:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?1594495413
trans-unit.source: Jesus was probably speaking [primarily] of the literal destruction of Jerusalem.
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea Yesu alikuwa akizungumza [hasa] juu ya uharibifu halisi wa Yerusalemu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Answer:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~29#Answer:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?735545614
trans-unit.source: Jesus words also could apply to future tribulation and judgment.
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya Yesu yangeweza pia kutumiwa kwa dhiki na hukumu ya wakati ujao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Answer:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~29#Note:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?-83962932
trans-unit.source: Most commentators agree that Jesus' word foretold the Roman siege of Jerusalem, which happened about 40 years later in A.D. 70.
trans-unit.target: Wafafanuzi wengi hukubali kwamba maneno ya Yesu yalitabiri kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu na Waroma, kulikotukia miaka 40 hivi baadaye katika 70 W.K.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~29#Note:Do you think Jesus was speaking of events that are still in the future, or of something that has already happened?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.31+What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~31#Question:What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?
trans-unit.source: What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini maana ya mti kuwa kijani au kavu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~31#Question:What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~31#Answer:What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?2124024270
trans-unit.source: The green tree is a representation of Jesus, and the dry tree is the [evil] people. If Jesus is being crucified, despite being found innocent, the people should expect even greater persecution.
trans-unit.target: Mti wa kijani ni uwakilishi wa Yesu, na mti mkavu ni watu [waovu]. Ikiwa Yesu anateswa msalabani, ijapokuwa alipatikana kuwa hana hatia, watu wanapaswa kutarajia mnyanyaso mkubwa hata zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~31#Answer:What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~31#Answer:What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?561328715
trans-unit.source: OR The green tree represents of the time when Jesus was alive, speaking words of life to the people. Later, when Jesus was gone, people would behave even worse [and suffer for their evil actions].
trans-unit.target: AU Mti wa kijani huwakilisha wakati ambapo Yesu alikuwa hai, akisema maneno ya uhai kwa watu. Baadaye, Yesu alipoondoka, watu wangejiendesha hata vibaya zaidi [na kuteseka kwa sababu ya matendo yao mabaya].
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~31#Answer:What is the meaning of the tree being green or dry?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.32-34+Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~32#Question:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri ni vigumu kwa mtu wa kawaida kumwomba Mungu msamaha kwa watu wanaompigia au kumwua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~32#Question:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~32#Alternate:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?-1311315630
trans-unit.source: Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri ni vigumu kwa mtu wa kawaida kumwomba Mungu msamaha kwa watu wanaompigia au kumwua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~32#Alternate:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~32#Alternate:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?-1686043077
trans-unit.source: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to pray like that when people are beating him or taking his life?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema, "Baba, uwasamehe, kwa kuwa hawajui watendalo". Kwa nini unafikiri ni vigumu kwa mtu wa kawaida kusali kama huyo wakati watu wanapompiga au kuua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~32#Alternate:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!23~32#Alternate:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?58640966
trans-unit.source: Do you think it would be difficult for you to ask God to forgive people who are beating you or taking your life? Why?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri ingekuwa vigumu kwako kumwomba Mungu akusamehe watu wanaokupigia au kukuua?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~32#Alternate:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~32#Answer:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?1709188696
trans-unit.source: It is difficult because people want to live. Most people would prefer life over death. People would probably do anything to escape death and it's hard to forgive someone who takes away a life.
trans-unit.target: Ni vigumu kwa sababu watu wanataka kuishi. Watu wengi wangependelea maisha kuliko kifo. Watu pengine wangefanya chochote ili kuepuka kifo na ni vigumu kumsamehe mtu ambaye huondoa maisha.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~32#Answer:Why do you think it is difficult for an ordinary person to ask God to forgive people who are beating him or taking his life?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.34+How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~34#Question:How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?
trans-unit.source: How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?
trans-unit.target: Askari waliamuaje ni nani angepata sehemu mbalimbali za mavazi ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~34#Question:How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~34#Answer:How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?-1458738385
trans-unit.source: The soldiers cast lots/gambled.
trans-unit.target: Askari walipiga kura.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~34#Answer:How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~34#Note:How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?-542378736
trans-unit.source: Cultures have different ways of "fairly" distributing limited items up among numerous persons. Although "casting lots" was sometimes used by believers who understood God to be in control of everything, the translation here should not imply that the soldiers here attached any religious significance to their game.
trans-unit.target: Utamaduni mbalimbali una njia tofauti za kugawanya "kwa haki" vitu vichache kati ya watu wengi. Ingawa "kupiga kura" kulitumiwa wakati mwingine na waamini ambao walielewa kuwa Mungu alikuwa akidhibiti kila kitu, tafsiri hapa haipaswi kudokeza kwamba askari-jeshi hapa waliweka umuhimu wowote wa kidini kwa mchezo wao.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~34#Note:How did the soldiers decide who would get the various articles of Jesus' clothing?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.35-43+Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~35#Question:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.
trans-unit.source: Tell in your own words what happened in this section.
trans-unit.target: Eleza kwa maneno yako mwenyewe kilichotukia katika sehemu hii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~35#Question:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~35#Answer:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.1006180959
trans-unit.source: In this section, the rulers, the people, the soldiers and even one of the criminals mocked Jesus on the cross. The other criminal rebuked the criminal and believed Jesus. Jesus told him that he would be in paradise.
trans-unit.target: Katika sehemu hii, watawala, watu, askari na hata mmoja wa wahalifu walimdhihaki Yesu msalabani. Mwhalifu mwingine alimkemea mhalifu na kumwamini Yesu. Yesu alimwambia kwamba atakuwa katika paradiso.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~35#Answer:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

group.id: Q:LUK 23.39+Tell about the differences you see between the two criminals.

trans-unit.source: Tell about the differences you see between the two criminals.

trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~39#Question:Tell about the differences you see between the two criminals.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~39#Answer:Tell about the differences you see between the two criminals.-1751717898
trans-unit.source: The first criminal (insulting Jesus) had no respect, faith or humility. However the second criminal rebuked him and accepted responsibility for the crimes that he had done. He feared God and believed that Jesus is the Messiah.
trans-unit.target: Mhalifu wa kwanza (aliyemtukana Yesu) hakuwa na heshima, imani au unyenyekevu. Hata hivyo mhalifu wa pili alimkemea na kukubali jukumu la uhalifu aliokuwa ameufanya. Alimwogopa Mungu na kuamini kuwa Yesu ni Masihi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~39#Answer:Tell about the differences you see between the two criminals.

trans-unit.source: Luke 23:44-49 The Death of Jesus
trans-unit.target: Luka 23:44-49 Kifo cha Yesu
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~44#Section Heading

group.id: Q:LUK 23.44-49+Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~44#Question:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.
trans-unit.source: Tell in your own words what happened in this section.
trans-unit.target: Eleza kwa maneno yako mwenyewe kilichotukia katika sehemu hii.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~44#Question:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~44#Answer:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.638905310
trans-unit.source: In this section, the sun stopped shining and darkness came over the land. The temple curtain tore in two and the Jesus committed his spirit and died. Many people witnessed this and were in anguish. A centurion believed that Jesus was a righteous man.
trans-unit.target: Katika sehemu hii jua liliacha kung'aa na giza likaja juu ya nchi. Pazia la hekalu likapasuka vipande viwili, na Yesu akaitoa roho yake na kufa. Watu wengi waliona hilo na kuumia sana. Ofisa mmoja wa jeshi aliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa mtu mwadilifu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~44#Answer:Tell in your own words what happened in this section.

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~44#Answer:What were the different reactions people had to Jesus' death?508830385
trans-unit.source: A centurion praised God and said that Jesus is a righteous man. The witnesses beat their breasts and went away. The women who had followed him watched from a distance.

group.id: Q:LUK 23.44-45+What unusual or miraculous things happened that afternoon as Jesus was being crucified?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~44#Question:What unusual or miraculous things happened that afternoon as Jesus was being crucified?
trans-unit.source: What unusual or miraculous things happened that afternoon as Jesus was being crucified?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~44#Answer:What unusual or miraculous things happened that afternoon as Jesus was being crucified?601764479
trans-unit.source: When Jesus was being crucified, at noon, darkness came over the whole land and the sun stopped shining.
trans-unit.target: Wakati Yesu aliposulubiwa, saa sita mchana, nchi nzima ikawa giza na jua likaacha kung'aa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~44#Answer:What unusual or miraculous things happened that afternoon as Jesus was being crucified?

group.id: Q:LUK 23.56+What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!23~56#Question:What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)
trans-unit.source: What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Sabato inamaanisha nini? (Kwa nini walihitaji kupumzika?)
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~56#Question:What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!23~56#Answer:What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)-1685334513
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Sabbath is the name of the seventh and last day of the week. It was set aside by the Jews as a strict day of rest from the normal work that was done on the six other days of the week. The Jews continue to observe the Sabbath on Saturday.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: Sabato ni jina la siku ya saba na ya mwisho ya wiki. Ilikuwa imewekwa kando na Wayahudi kama siku kali ya kupumzika kutoka kwa kazi ya kawaida ambayo ilifanywa katika siku sita nyingine za wiki. Wayahudi wanaendelea kuzingatia Sabato Jumamosi.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~56#Answer:What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!23~56#Note:What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)1395134835
trans-unit.source: See "Sabbath" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Sabato" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!23~56#Note:What do you think the Sabbath means? (Why did they need to rest?)

group.id: Q:LUK 24.1-12+What was the surprise that the women witnessed?

trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao walishuhudia jambo gani lenye kushangaza?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~1#Answer:What was the surprise that the women witnessed?1513693238
trans-unit.source: Jesus was no longer in the tomb. He had risen from the dead.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakuwa kaburini tena, alikuwa amefufuliwa.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~1#Answer:What was the surprise that the women witnessed?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.1-12+What change did these women have as a result of this experience?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~1#Question:What change did these women have as a result of this experience?
trans-unit.source: What change did these women have as a result of this experience?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao walifanya mabadiliko gani kwa sababu ya jambo hilo?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~1#Answer:What change did these women have as a result of this experience?653227832
trans-unit.source: The women remembered what Jesus had said about coming back to life, and they believed.
trans-unit.target: Basi, wakakumbuka yale maneno aliyowaambia Yesu juu ya ufufuo, nao wakaamini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~1#Answer:What change did these women have as a result of this experience?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~1#Answer:What change did these women have as a result of this experience?1729563461
trans-unit.source: The women thought that they lost their teacher but they were hopeful and happy after this experience.
trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao walifikiri kuwa wamepoteza mwalimu wao lakini walikuwa na matumaini na furaha baada ya uzoefu huu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~1#Answer:What change did these women have as a result of this experience?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~5#Answer:What did those men/angels tell the women?1269014722
trans-unit.source: The men/angels told the women that Jesus has risen! They reminded the women about Jesus’ words: "The Son of Man must be delivered over to the hands of sinners, be crucified and on the third day be raised again."
trans-unit.target: Wanaume/malaika waliwaambia wanawake kwamba Yesu amefufuka! Waliwakumbusha wanawake juu ya maneno ya Yesu: "Mwana wa Adamu lazima atakabidhiwa katika mikono ya wenye dhambi, na kusulubiwa, na siku ya tatu kufufuka tena".

group.id: Q:LUK 24.12+What did Peter go and do?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~12#Question:What did Peter go and do?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter go and do?
trans-unit.target: Petro alienda kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~12#Question:What did Peter go and do?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~12#Answer:What did Peter go and do?1006871123
trans-unit.source: Peter ran to the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying by themselves and he went away wondering what happened.
trans-unit.target: Petro akakimbia akaenda kaburini, akaona sanda tu; akaenda zake, akashangaa sana kwa yaliyotokea.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~12#Answer:What did Peter go and do?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.12+Why do you think Peter came home surprised?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~12#Question:Why do you think Peter came home surprised?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think Peter came home surprised?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini Petro alikuja nyumbani akiwa ameshangaa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~12#Question:Why do you think Peter came home surprised?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~12#Answer:Why do you think Peter came home surprised?985688434
trans-unit.source: I think Peter found it hard to believe that Jesus was alive.
trans-unit.target: Nadhani Petro aliona ni vigumu kuamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa hai.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~12#Answer:Why do you think Peter came home surprised?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.12+After Peter saw inside the tomb, do you think he believed the women?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~12#Question:After Peter saw inside the tomb, do you think he believed the women?
trans-unit.source: After Peter saw inside the tomb, do you think he believed the women?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya Petro kuona ndani ya kaburi, je, unafikiri aliamini wanawake hao?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~12#Question:After Peter saw inside the tomb, do you think he believed the women?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~12#Answer:After Peter saw inside the tomb, do you think he believed the women?1051380651
trans-unit.source: Peter apparently believed the women's report about Jesus body being gone, but he still had doubts or questions about what had happened.
trans-unit.target: Inaonekana Petro aliamini habari za wanawake hao kwamba mwili wa Yesu haukuwapo, lakini bado alikuwa na shaka au maswali kuhusu jambo lililotukia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~12#Answer:After Peter saw inside the tomb, do you think he believed the women?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.13-24+At this point, who believed that Jesus was alive, and who still doubted or had questions about what had happened?

trans-unit.source: At this point, who believed that Jesus was alive, and who still doubted or had questions about what had happened?
trans-unit.target: Kufikia wakati huu, ni nani walioamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa hai, na ni nani waliobaki na shaka au maswali kuhusu yale yaliyokuwa yametukia?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~13#Question:At this point, who believed that Jesus was alive, and who still doubted or had questions about what had happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~13#Answer:At this point, who believed that Jesus was alive, and who still doubted or had questions about what had happened?762293923
trans-unit.source: At this point, the women believed that Jesus was alive. The others (including Peter) had questions or doubted.
trans-unit.target: Wakati huo, wanawake hao waliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa hai. Wengine (kutia ndani Petro) walikuwa na maswali au shaka.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~13#Answer:At this point, who believed that Jesus was alive, and who still doubted or had questions about what had happened?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.16+What was unusual about this meeting with Jesus?

trans-unit.source: The unusual thing about this meeting with Jesus is that they did not recognize him.

group.id: Q:LUK 24.17+Why do you think Jesus asked this question?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~17#Question:Why do you think Jesus asked this question?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think Jesus asked this question?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini Yesu aliuliza swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~17#Question:Why do you think Jesus asked this question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~17#Answer:Why do you think Jesus asked this question?1480427365
trans-unit.source: Jesus wanted to join in the discussion, and it would seem strange to them if he appeared to know already what they were talking about.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka kujiunga na mazungumzo hayo, na ingeonekana kuwa ajabu kwao ikiwa angeonekana tayari kujua kile walichokuwa wakizungumzia.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~17#Answer:Why do you think Jesus asked this question?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.17+How were these two disciples feeling?

trans-unit.source: How were these two disciples feeling?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~17#Answer:How were these two disciples feeling?-2133943186
trans-unit.source: The two disciples felt upset. Their faces were downcast.

group.id: Q:LUK 24.17-18+How did the disciples respond to Jesus question?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~17#Question:How did the disciples respond to Jesus question?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples respond to Jesus question?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje swali la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~17#Question:How did the disciples respond to Jesus question?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~17#Answer:How did the disciples respond to Jesus question?-1555672797
trans-unit.source: One of the disciples, Cleopas responded to Jesus’ question. He asked, "Are you the only one visiting Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?"
trans-unit.target: Mmoja wao, aitwaye Kleopa, akamjibu, "Je, wewe ni mgeni peke yako Yerusalemu ambaye hujui yaliyotukia huko siku hizi?"
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~17#Answer:How did the disciples respond to Jesus question?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.18+How widely was the news of Jesus death known?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~18#Question:How widely was the news of Jesus death known?
trans-unit.source: How widely was the news of Jesus death known?
trans-unit.target: Habari za kifo cha Yesu zilijulikana kwa kadiri gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~18#Question:How widely was the news of Jesus death known?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~18#Answer:How widely was the news of Jesus death known?1114546007
trans-unit.source: The news of Jesus’ death was widely known. The men thought everyone in Jerusalem knew about it.
trans-unit.target: Habari za kifo cha Yesu zilienea sana hivi kwamba wanaume hao walifikiri kwamba wakazi wote wa Yerusalemu walijua habari hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~18#Answer:How widely was the news of Jesus death known?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.18-19+Did Jesus understand what Cleopas was asking about?

trans-unit.source: The chief priests and the rulers condemned Jesus to be killed.

group.id: Q:LUK 24.20+What had they hoped for?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~20#Question:What had they hoped for?
trans-unit.source: What had they hoped for?
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na tumaini gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~20#Question:What had they hoped for?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~20#Answer:What had they hoped for?392493468
trans-unit.source: They hoped that Jesus was going to redeem Israel.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakitumaini kwamba Yesu alikuwa karibu kukomboa Israeli.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~20#Answer:What had they hoped for?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.20+Why did it now seem impossible to realize that hope?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~20#Question:Why did it now seem impossible to realize that hope?
trans-unit.source: Why did it now seem impossible to realize that hope?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini ilionekana kuwa haiwezekani sasa kutimiza tumaini hilo?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~20#Question:Why did it now seem impossible to realize that hope?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~20#Answer:Why did it now seem impossible to realize that hope?565156737
trans-unit.source: It seemed impossible to realize that hope because Jesus had been dead for three days. No one expected a person to revive after three days in the tomb.
trans-unit.target: Ilionekana kwamba tumaini hilo halingeweza kutimizwa kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amekufa kwa siku tatu. Hakuna mtu aliyetazamia mtu fulani afufuliwe baada ya siku tatu kaburini.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~20#Answer:Why did it now seem impossible to realize that hope?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.21+How many days earlier had these events taken place?

group.id: Q:LUK 24.22-24+What additional (amazing or confusing) information did they tell Jesus?

trans-unit.source: What additional (amazing or confusing) information did they tell Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni habari gani za ziada (za kushangaza au zenye kutatanisha) walizomwambia Yesu?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~22#Answer:What additional (amazing or confusing) information did they tell Jesus?1071892394
trans-unit.source: The additional information they told Jesus is that the women didn't find his body in the tomb and that they saw angels saying that he was alive.
trans-unit.target: Habari ya ziada waliyomwambia Yesu ni kwamba wanawake hawakuupata mwili wake kaburini na kwamba waliona malaika wakisema kwamba alikuwa hai.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~22#Answer:What additional (amazing or confusing) information did they tell Jesus?
