group.id: Q:LUK 24.25-27+Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~25#Question:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri kuna maandiko kuhusu Yesu tangu muda mrefu kabla hajazaliwa? // Kwa kawaida mtu yeyote akitaka kuandika kuhusu mtu, wangeandika kuhusu jinsi alivyokaa na kile alichofanya katika maisha yake. Hiyo ingekuwa kawaida. Lakini hata kabla hajazaliwa, [kutoka 1500BC na kuendelea,] kuna maandiko kuhusu Yesu. Unafikiri Yesu ni mtu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~25#Question:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!24~25#Alternate:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?-801571245
trans-unit.source: Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. But long before he was born, there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kawaida mtu akitaka kuandika juu ya mtu fulani, yeye huandika juu ya jinsi alivyokaa na kile alichofanya wakati wa maisha yake. Lakini muda mrefu kabla hajazaliwa, kuna maandishi juu ya Yesu. Unafikiri Yesu ni mtu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~25#Alternate:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!24~25#Alternate:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. trans-unit.source: Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini kuna maandishi kumhusu Yesu yaliyoandikwa muda mrefu kabla hajazaliwa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~25#Alternate:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?

trans-unit.id: l:!LUK!24~25#Alternate:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?154626488
trans-unit.source: Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, from 1500BC onwards, there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kawaida mtu akitaka kuandika juu ya mtu, ataandika juu ya jinsi alivyokaa na kile alichofanya katika maisha yake. Hiyo itakuwa kawaida. Lakini hata kabla hajazaliwa, kuanzia 1500BC na kuendelea, kuna maandishi juu ya Yesu. Unafikiri Yesu ni mtu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~25#Alternate:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~25#Answer:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?1323386743
trans-unit.source: God loved his people and promised his people that a Savior would come and rescue everyone. Jesus is God. He loves everybody and he sacrificed himself for us.
trans-unit.target: Mungu aliwapenda watu wake na kuwaahidi watu wake kwamba Mwokozi atakuja na kuwaokoa watu wote. Yesu ni Mungu. Anawapenda watu wote na kujitoa mwenyewe kwa ajili yetu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~25#Answer:Why do you think there are writings about Jesus from long before he was born? // Normally if anyone wants to write about someone, they would write about how he lived and what he did within his lifetime. That would be normal. But even before he was born, [from 1500BC onwards,] there are writings about Jesus. What kind of person do you think Jesus is?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~25#Answer:What did Jesus say to those [two] disciples/men?-195316871
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that the events were supposed to happen. He said, "How foolish you are, and how slow to believe all that the prophets have spoken. Did not the Messiah have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?"
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba matukio hayo lazima yatukie. "Enyi wapumbavu, wenye mioyo mizito ya kuamini yote waliyoyasema manabii! Je, haikumpasa Kristo kuteswa kwa njia hiyo, na kuingia katika utukufu wake?"

group.id: Q:LUK 24.27+What specific things do you think Jesus might have explained?

trans-unit.id: q:!LUK!24~27#Question:What specific things do you think Jesus might have explained?
trans-unit.source: What specific things do you think Jesus might have explained?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alieleza mambo gani hususa?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~27#Question:What specific things do you think Jesus might have explained?

trans-unit.id: n:!LUK!24~27#Note:What specific things do you think Jesus might have explained?-647638351
trans-unit.source: Respondents with a more extensive knowledge of the Old Testament (or who remember some of the details of prophetic fulfillment mentioned in Luke or the other gospels) might be able to give details about specific prophecies and how Jesus fulfilled them. Others might have difficulty with this question, but some may be able to draw on verse 26 for an answer.
trans-unit.target: Wale waliohojiwa ambao wana ujuzi mwingi zaidi wa Agano la Kale (au ambao wanakumbuka baadhi ya maelezo ya unabii uliotimizwa unaotajwa katika Luka au injili nyingine) wanaweza kutoa maelezo kuhusu unabii hususa na jinsi Yesu alivyoutimiza. Huenda wengine wakawa na ugumu na swali hili, lakini wengine wanaweza kutegemea mstari wa 26 kwa jibu.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~27#Note:What specific things do you think Jesus might have explained?

trans-unit.source: Eventually, we find out that Jesus went to Jerusalem to see the disciples. At this point, the text just says he disappeared. The translation should not imply that this was a ghostly apparition.
trans-unit.target: Hatimaye, tunajifunza kwamba Yesu alikwenda Yerusalemu kuwaona wanafunzi. Katika hatua hii, maandishi tu anasema yeye kutoweka. tafsiri haipaswi kudokeza kwamba hii ilikuwa maono ghostly.

trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Yesu ana mwili wa nyama (kama sisi), unafikiri anaweza kufanya mambo ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~32#Alternate:Since Jesus has a [physical] body like us, what [kinds of work] do you think he is able to do?

trans-unit.source: Jesus said, "I have body and bones which an evil-spirit does not." Due to Jesus having a body like us, what kinds of work do you think he is able to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema, "Mimi nina mwili na mifupa ambayo roho mwovu hana". Kwa sababu Yesu ana mwili kama wetu, unafikiri anaweza kufanya kazi ya aina gani?

trans-unit.id: a:!LUK!24~32#Answer:Since Jesus has a [physical] body like us, what [kinds of work] do you think he is able to do?775441037
trans-unit.source: Jesus can do all sorts of things with his body (just like us). He can eat, sleep, touch objects, smell, hear, taste, etc.
trans-unit.target: Yesu anaweza kufanya kila aina ya mambo na mwili wake (kama sisi). Anaweza kula, kulala, kugusa vitu, kunusa, kusikia, kuonja, nk.
trans-unit.note: !LUK!24~32#Answer:Since Jesus has a [physical] body like us, what [kinds of work] do you think he is able to do?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The word "lord" refers to a person who has authority over another person. (See "Lord" in KBT in both the "Christ" entry and the "God" entry.)

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?527518160
trans-unit.source: Other answers you are likely to hear are:
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukasikia majibu yafuatayo:
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?462253665
trans-unit.source: 1) He teaches more of the parts of the Bible to the people who believe the talk about Jesus.
trans-unit.target: 1) Anafundisha sehemu zaidi za Biblia kwa watu wanaoiamini hotuba kuhusu Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?-1005092609
trans-unit.source: 2) He harangues the believers to behave better than they have been doing.
trans-unit.target: Na anawakumbusha Waumini wafanye wema kuliko walivyo kuwa wakifanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?-1502686228
trans-unit.source: Neither of these two actions is what the Bible refers to as preaching. When one of the above answers is given, if at all possible, the translator should use other words that are appropriate to the action found in the Greek NT text. He should not automatically use the church word for "preach." Please ask the next question below before making any word changes.
trans-unit.target: Hakuna moja ya vitendo hivi mbili ambayo Biblia inaita kuhubiri. Wakati moja ya majibu ya hapo juu inapewa, ikiwa inawezekana, mtafsiri anapaswa kutumia maneno mengine ambayo yanafaa kwa kitendo kinachopatikana katika maandishi ya Kigiriki ya NT. Haipaswi kutumia moja kwa moja neno kanisa kwa "kuhubiri". Tafadhali uliza swali linalofuata hapa chini kabla ya kufanya mabadiliko yoyote ya neno.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~3#Note:If a person preaches in a village, what does he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~11#Answer:What do we learn about Jesus from what God said?1676703713
trans-unit.source: Also, God loves him and is pleased with him. (11)
trans-unit.target: Na Mwenyezi Mungu anampenda na anamridhia. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~11#Answer:What do we learn about Jesus from what God said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~11#Answer:What do we learn about Jesus from what God said?1878938587
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek language has several words which are translated "love" in English. The word used here means that a person has a gracious, outgoing, active interest in the welfare of another person. Jesus used the same word to talk about loving God and loving one's neighbor as one loves himself (Mark 12:30-31. Some cultures have a special term for a father's love for his oldest son or his only child. (See "beloved" in KBT in the "love" entry.) ]
trans-unit.target: Neno muhimu: Lugha ya Kigiriki ina maneno kadhaa ambayo yametafsiriwa "upendo" kwa Kiingereza. Neno linalotumiwa hapa linamaanisha kwamba mtu ana neema, anayeenda nje, anayependezwa na ustawi wa mtu mwingine. Yesu alitumia neno lile lile kuzungumza juu ya kumpenda Mungu na kumpenda jirani kama mtu anavyojipenda mwenyewe (Marko 12:30-31. Tamaduni zingine zina neno maalum kwa upendo wa baba kwa mwanawe mkubwa au mtoto wake wa pekee. (Tazama "mpendwa" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "upendo".)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~11#Answer:What do we learn about Jesus from what God said?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~22#Answer:Why were they so amazed?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "teacher of the law" in KBT in the "scribe" entry.

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~22#Note:Why were they so amazed?-1134221098
trans-unit.source: The teachers of their Jewish law never taught like that. They mostly repeated what other people had said or written about the various laws.
trans-unit.target: Walimu wao wa sheria ya Kiyahudi hawakufundisha kama wao. Walirudia hasa yale ambayo watu wengine walikuwa wamesema au kuandika juu ya sheria mbalimbali.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~22#Note:Why were they so amazed?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.23-24+Why did a man shout out when Jesus was teaching?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.23-24+Why did the man say "us" part of the time?

trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwanamume huyo alisema "sisi" wakati fulani?

trans-unit.source: The evil spirit spoke through the man's voice and knew that all of the evil spirits were in danger. That is why he said "us". (23-24)

group.id: Q:MRK 1.24+What do you think it means when it says that Jesus was God's holy one?

trans-unit.source: Jesus was set apart from the way people lived to please themselves. God set him apart to totally serve him. Jesus was morally pure, acting in all ways like God would act. (24)

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~24#Note:What do you think it means when it says that Jesus was God's holy one?993151743
trans-unit.source: Key Term: See "holy" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Neno Muhimu: Ona "takatifu" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~24#Note:What do you think it means when it says that Jesus was God's holy one?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.32-34+What does it mean to "cast out a spirit" from a person?

trans-unit.target: Ni nini maana ya 'kufukuza roho' kutoka kwa mtu?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~32#Answer:What does it mean to "cast out a spirit" from a person?1235630678
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A person with authority from God does something or says something that shows a demon in another person that it must obey him and leave that person.. The person with God's authority usually tells the spirit that it must immediately leave the person alone and go away.
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Mtu aliye na mamlaka kutoka kwa Mungu hufanya kitu au anasema kitu ambacho kinaonyesha pepo katika mtu mwingine kwamba lazima amtii na kumwacha mtu huyo .. Mtu aliye na mamlaka ya Mungu kawaida humwambia roho kwamba lazima amwache mtu huyo peke yake na aende.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~32#Answer:What does it mean to "cast out a spirit" from a person?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~32#Note:What does it mean to "cast out a spirit" from a person?-1710383995
trans-unit.source: If a cultural term is in the translation here, ask where the power comes from which makes the evil spirit obey the speaker's words. If that power is not from God, that term must be modified or changed altogether.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa neno la kitamaduni liko katika tafsiri hapa, uliza ni wapi nguvu inatoka ambayo inafanya roho mbaya kutii maneno ya msemaji. Ikiwa nguvu hiyo haitoki kwa Mungu, neno hilo lazima libadilishwe au kubadilishwa kabisa.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~36#Question:Why did Simon Peter and the others go looking for him?
trans-unit.source: Why did Simon Peter and the others go looking for him?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Simoni Petro na wengine walimtafuta?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~36#Question:Why did Simon Peter and the others go looking for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~36#Answer:Why did Simon Peter and the others go looking for him?1925772984
trans-unit.source: They wanted to tell him that many people were looking for him. (36-37)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kumwambia kwamba watu wengi walikuwa wakimtafuta (36-37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~36#Answer:Why did Simon Peter and the others go looking for him?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.35-37+Why do you think that the people were looking for him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~35#Question:Why do you think that the people were looking for him?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the people were looking for him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu walikuwa wakimtafuta?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~35#Question:Why do you think that the people were looking for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~35#Answer:Why do you think that the people were looking for him?1945366102
trans-unit.source: They probably wanted him to heal and cast demons out of more of their people.
trans-unit.target: Inaelekea walitaka aponye na kufukuza roho waovu kutoka kwa watu wengi zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~35#Answer:Why do you think that the people were looking for him?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.38-39+Did Jesus go back, or what did he do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~38#Question:Did Jesus go back, or what did he do?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus go back, or what did he do?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alirudi, au alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~38#Question:Did Jesus go back, or what did he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~38#Answer:Did Jesus go back, or what did he do?1264042455
trans-unit.source: No. He went away from there so that he could go throughout Galilee [province]. (38-39)
trans-unit.target: Hapana. Alitoka huko ili aweze kusafiri katika Galilaya yote [mkoa]. (38-39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~38#Answer:Did Jesus go back, or what did he do?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.38+Why did he do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~38#Question:Why did he do that?
trans-unit.source: Why did he do that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alifanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~38#Question:Why did he do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~38#Answer:Why did he do that?740924202
trans-unit.source: He did that because he had come into the world to tell people God's message. (38)
trans-unit.target: Alifanya hivyo kwa sababu alikuwa amekuja ulimwenguni kuwaambia watu ujumbe wa Mungu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~38#Answer:Why did he do that?

trans-unit.target: Marko 1:40-45 Yesu alimponya mtu mwenye ukoma.

group.id: Q:MRK 1.40-45+What happened after Jesus healed a man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~40#Question:What happened after Jesus healed a man?
trans-unit.source: What happened after Jesus healed a man?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya Yesu kumponya mtu fulani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Question:What happened after Jesus healed a man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~40#Answer:What happened after Jesus healed a man?569209319
trans-unit.source: Many people heard about it and wanted to come to him for healing. (45)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi walisikia juu yake na walitaka kuja kwake ili waponywe. (45)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Answer:What happened after Jesus healed a man?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.40+What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~40#Question:What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume aliyemwendea Yesu alikuwa na tatizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Question:What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~40#Answer:What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?786298050
trans-unit.source: He had a disease called leprosy. [Key Term Check: leprosy]
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na ugonjwa unaoitwa ukoma.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Answer:What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~40#Note:What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?2047262052
trans-unit.source: You may want a glossary entry about the cultural taboos in Bible times about leprosy.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukataka orodha ya maneno kuhusu mambo ambayo yalionwa kuwa ni maovu katika nyakati za Biblia kuhusu ukoma.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Note:What was wrong with the man who came to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.40+What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~40#Question:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu huyo mwenye ukoma alipiga magoti mbele ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Question:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!1~40#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?-405616076
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy kneeled down in front of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu huyo mwenye ukoma alipiga magoti mbele ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!1~40#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?237641681
trans-unit.source: Why do you think the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu huyo mwenye ukoma alipiga magoti mbele ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Alternate:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~40#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?1327171048
trans-unit.source: In that way he showed that he knew that Jesus was much greater than he.
trans-unit.target: Kwa njia hiyo alionyesha kwamba alitambua kwamba Yesu alikuwa mkuu zaidi kuliko yeye.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Answer:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~40#Note:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?843278443
trans-unit.source: In Matthew's account (Matt. 8:2), he makes it clear that this was an act of worship, not merely a posture of humility, so while that would be an acceptable answer, it is not clear from Mark's account.
trans-unit.target: Katika simulizi la Mathayo (Mt. 8:2), anaweka wazi kuwa hii ilikuwa tendo la ibada, sio tu hali ya unyenyekevu, kwa hivyo wakati hiyo itakuwa jibu linalokubalika, haijulikani kutoka kwa akaunti ya Marko.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Note:What do you think was the reason that the man with leprosy knelt down in front of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.40+What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~40#Question:What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu huyo alimaanisha nini aliposema, "Nitakase"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Question:What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~40#Answer:What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?-1258091370
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He was talking both about having clear skin again after he became well and about becoming ritually clean. That means that the priests would allow him to again be in the public worship and to live with his family.
trans-unit.target: Kipimo cha Maneno Muhimu: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya kuwa na ngozi safi tena baada ya kupona na pia juu ya kuwa safi kidesturi. Hiyo inamaanisha kwamba makuhani wangemruhusu awe tena katika ibada ya umma na kuishi na familia yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Answer:What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~40#Note:What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?-314612674
trans-unit.source: See "clean" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia "safi" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Note:What do you think that the man meant when he said, "Make me clean"?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.40+Did this man believe that Jesus would heal him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~40#Question:Did this man believe that Jesus would heal him?
trans-unit.source: Did this man believe that Jesus would heal him?
trans-unit.target: Je, mtu huyo aliamini kwamba Yesu angemponya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Question:Did this man believe that Jesus would heal him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~40#Answer:Did this man believe that Jesus would heal him?1234852389
trans-unit.source: He believed that Jesus had the power to heal him, but did not know if he wanted to or not.
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba Yesu alikuwa na uwezo wa kumponya, lakini hakujua ikiwa Yesu alitaka kumponya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~40#Answer:Did this man believe that Jesus would heal him?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.41-42+What did Jesus do with the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~41#Question:What did Jesus do with the man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do with the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini na mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~41#Question:What did Jesus do with the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~41#Answer:What did Jesus do with the man?-1622902947
trans-unit.source: He touched the man who had leprosy and healed him. (41-42)
trans-unit.target: Aligusa mtu mwenye ukoma na kumponya (41-42)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~41#Answer:What did Jesus do with the man?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.43-44+What did Jesus tell the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~43#Question:What did Jesus tell the man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~43#Question:What did Jesus tell the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?-1419728361
trans-unit.source: Jesus told him that he should not tell anyone about what Jesus had done for him,
trans-unit.target: Yesu akamwamuru asimwambie mtu ye yote juu ya jambo hilo alilokuwa amemfanyia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?1575553018
trans-unit.source: but he should go to the priest [at the temple in Jerusalem] and show him that he was healed of leprosy.
trans-unit.target: bali aende kwa kuhani [katika hekalu katika Yerusalemu] na kumwonyesha kwamba ameponywa ukoma.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?1793850131
trans-unit.source: Then he should offer [a sacrifice to God]. (43-44)
trans-unit.target: Kisha atoe [dhabihu kwa Mungu].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?-935040868
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "offering" in KBT in the "sacrifice" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Tazama "toleo" katika KBT katika "dhabihu" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.44+Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~44#Question:Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alimwambia atoe dhabihu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~44#Question:Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~44#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?-591591391
trans-unit.source: Moses had written in the Old Testament that Jewish people who were healed of leprosy must offer such a gift to God. (44)
trans-unit.target: Musa alikuwa ameandika katika Agano la Kale kwamba Wayahudi walioponywa ukoma walipaswa kutoa zawadi kama hiyo kwa Mungu. (44)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~44#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~44#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?-1184923908
trans-unit.source: (Also, the people around there would then know that the man was cured, and they would not need to avoid being near him or avoid touching him any more.)
trans-unit.target: (Pia, watu waliokuwa karibu wangejua kwamba mtu huyo ameponywa, na hawangehitaji kuepuka kuwa karibu naye au kuepuka kumgusa tena.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~44#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told him to offer a sacrifice?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.41-45+What do you think a priest did when he worked?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~41#Question:What do you think a priest did when he worked?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a priest did when he worked?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kasisi alifanya nini alipokuwa akifanya kazi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~41#Question:What do you think a priest did when he worked?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~41#Answer:What do you think a priest did when he worked?1041276939
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A priest represented the people who came to worship God. He acted in their place by offering their sacrifices, prayers and gifts to God. He also represented God to those people when he announced that God had accepted their offerings and had forgiven their sins.
trans-unit.target: Muhtasari wa neno muhimu: Kuhani aliwakilisha watu waliokuja kumwabudu Mungu. Alitenda kwa niaba yao kwa kutoa dhabihu zao, sala na zawadi kwa Mungu. Pia alimwakilisha Mungu kwa watu hao wakati alitangaza kwamba Mungu alikuwa amekubali sadaka zao na alikuwa amesamehewa dhambi zao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~41#Answer:What do you think a priest did when he worked?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!1~41#Note:What do you think a priest did when he worked?1321972067
trans-unit.source: See "priest" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "padri" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~41#Note:What do you think a priest did when he worked?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.45+Did the man obey all that Jesus had said to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~45#Question:Did the man obey all that Jesus had said to him?
trans-unit.source: Did the man obey all that Jesus had said to him?
trans-unit.target: Je, mtu huyo alitii yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa amemwambia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Question:Did the man obey all that Jesus had said to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~45#Answer:Did the man obey all that Jesus had said to him?-1677257692
trans-unit.source: No, he did not. (45)
trans-unit.target: La, hakufanya hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Answer:Did the man obey all that Jesus had said to him?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.45+What did he do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~45#Question:What did he do?
trans-unit.source: What did he do?
trans-unit.target: Alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Question:What did he do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~45#Answer:What did he do?585736567
trans-unit.source: He went and told many people what Jesus had done for him. (45)
trans-unit.target: Akaenda zake, akahubiri habari za mambo yote Yesu aliyomtendea.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Answer:What did he do?

group.id: Q:MRK 1.45+Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!1~45#Question:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?
trans-unit.source: Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hakuweza kuingia katika mji wowote kwa njia ya wazi/ya umma?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Question:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!1~45#Alternate:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?-2146883160
trans-unit.source: Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open way?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hangeweza kuingia katika mji wowote kwa njia ya wazi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Alternate:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!1~45#Alternate:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?-1172344212
trans-unit.source: Why could Jesus not enter any town in an public way?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hangeweza kuingia katika jiji lolote kwa njia ya peupe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Alternate:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!1~45#Answer:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?-2110982445
trans-unit.source: People would crowd around him so that he could not do anything. They all wanted to see him and have him heal their sick people. (45)
trans-unit.target: Watu walimzunguka kwa ukaribu sana hivi kwamba hangeweza kufanya lolote. Wote walitaka kumwona na kuponywa na wagonjwa wao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!1~45#Answer:Why could Jesus not enter any town in an open/public way?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!2~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 2:1-12 Jesus healed a paralyzed man.
trans-unit.target: Marko 2:1-12 Yesu alimponya mtu aliyepooza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 2.1-12+Why did the scribes think that Jesus should not say he forgave the paralyzed man's sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~1#Question:Why did the scribes think that Jesus should not say he forgave the paralyzed man's sins?
trans-unit.source: Why did the scribes think that Jesus should not say he forgave the paralyzed man's sins?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini waandishi walifikiri kwamba Yesu hakupaswa kusema kwamba alikuwa amemsamehe dhambi za yule mtu aliyepooza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~1#Question:Why did the scribes think that Jesus should not say he forgave the paralyzed man's sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~1#Answer:Why did the scribes think that Jesus should not say he forgave the paralyzed man's sins?-1216414196
trans-unit.source: They did not believe that God had sent him, therefore, they thought that he was offending God by acting as if he could take God's place and forgive sin. (7)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuamini kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemtuma, kwa hiyo, walifikiri kwamba alikuwa akimkosea Mungu kwa kutenda kana kwamba angeweza kuchukua mahali pa Mungu na kusamehe dhambi. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~1#Answer:Why did the scribes think that Jesus should not say he forgave the paralyzed man's sins?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.1-2+What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~1#Question:What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoenda kwenye mji wa Kapernaumu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~1#Question:What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~1#Answer:What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?1239365814
trans-unit.source: A large crowd gathered in, and around, the house where he was
trans-unit.target: Umati mkubwa ulikusanyika ndani, na kuzunguka, nyumba ambapo alikuwa
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~1#Answer:What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~1#Answer:What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?1968116098
trans-unit.source: and he taught them God's message.
trans-unit.target: Na akawafundisha ujumbe wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~1#Answer:What happened when Jesus went to the town of Capernaum?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.3+Who came looking for Jesus there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~3#Question:Who came looking for Jesus there?
trans-unit.source: Who came looking for Jesus there?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomtafuta Yesu huko?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~3#Question:Who came looking for Jesus there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~3#Answer:Who came looking for Jesus there?698922352
trans-unit.source: Some people who were bringing a paralyzed man came to him. (3)
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walimletea mtu aliyepooza. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~3#Answer:Who came looking for Jesus there?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.4+What problem did they have when they got there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~4#Question:What problem did they have when they got there?
trans-unit.source: What problem did they have when they got there?
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na tatizo gani walipofika huko?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Question:What problem did they have when they got there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~4#Answer:What problem did they have when they got there?-919637753
trans-unit.source: They could not get near Jesus because there were so many people in the house. (4)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuweza kumkaribia Yesu kwa sababu kulikuwa na watu wengi sana ndani ya nyumba hiyo. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Answer:What problem did they have when they got there?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.4+What did they do about that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~4#Question:What did they do about that?
trans-unit.source: What did they do about that?
trans-unit.target: Walifanya nini kuhusu hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Question:What did they do about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?1442590996
trans-unit.source: They climbed [by outside stairs] to the [flat] roof,
trans-unit.target: Walipokuwa wamepanda juu ya dari,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?2045514777
trans-unit.source: removed some of the roof material,
trans-unit.target: kuondolewa baadhi ya vifaa vya paa,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?-1056097929
trans-unit.source: attached ropes to the man's mat,
trans-unit.target: Na tukamfunga kamba kwenye kitanda chake,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?1352458179
trans-unit.source: and lowered him to the place where Jesus was standing. (4)
trans-unit.target: na kumshusha mahali ambapo Yesu alikuwa amesimama (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~4#Answer:What did they do about that?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.5+When they did that, what did Jesus realize about them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~5#Question:When they did that, what did Jesus realize about them?
trans-unit.source: When they did that, what did Jesus realize about them?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.3-5+What does a person do when they forgive another person?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~3#Question:What does a person do when they forgive another person?
trans-unit.source: What does a person do when they forgive another person?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini anapomsamehe mtu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~3#Question:What does a person do when they forgive another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~3#Answer:What does a person do when they forgive another person?32959486
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: They stop thinking about that person as having done something wrong against them. There is no need for the person who did wrong to compensate them, either by receiving punishment or by giving good things in return.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Wao huacha kufikiri kwamba mtu huyo aliwatendea jambo fulani baya. Hakuna haja ya mtu aliyetenda jambo baya kuwalipa, ama kwa kupewa adhabu ama kwa kuwapa vitu vizuri.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~3#Answer:What does a person do when they forgive another person?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~3#Note:What does a person do when they forgive another person?-570225461
trans-unit.source: See "forgive" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "kusamehe" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~3#Note:What does a person do when they forgive another person?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~3#Note:What does a person do when they forgive another person?123298413
trans-unit.source: If the translation has a term for God forgiving people that is different from the term ordinarily used for people forgiving others, check into the reason for this difference. Try switching the verbs for forgiveness and ask what makes each one unacceptable in the people's minds. The Greek text uses the same word in both cases. God expects us to forgive others the same as he has done for us (see Mark 11:25; Matt. 6:14-15; 18:32-3; Luke 6:37).
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa tafsiri ina neno kwa Mungu kusamehe watu ambayo ni tofauti na neno kwa kawaida kutumika kwa watu kusamehe wengine, kuangalia katika sababu ya tofauti hii. Jaribu kubadilisha vitenzi kwa msamaha na kuuliza nini hufanya kila moja isiyokubalika katika akili ya watu. maandishi ya Kigiriki inatumia neno moja katika kesi zote mbili. Mungu anatarajia tusamehe wengine sawa na vile ametufanyia (tazama Marko 11:25; Mt. 6:14-15; 18:32-3; Luka 6:37).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~3#Note:What does a person do when they forgive another person?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.9+What did they think about what Jesus said to the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~9#Question:What did they think about what Jesus said to the man?
trans-unit.source: What did they think about what Jesus said to the man?
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri nini kuhusu yale ambayo Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~9#Question:What did they think about what Jesus said to the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~9#Answer:What did they think about what Jesus said to the man?-902396211
trans-unit.source: They were angry. They thought that Jesus had no right to say he forgave the man's sin, since only God can forgive people's sin. (They were not willing to believe that Jesus was God's son, nor even that God had sent him.) (9)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na hasira. Walifikiri kwamba Yesu hakuwa na haki ya kusema alimsamehe mtu huyo dhambi, kwani ni Mungu pekee anayeweza kusamehe dhambi za watu. (Hawakutaka kuamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu, wala hata kwamba Mungu alimtuma.) (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~9#Answer:What did they think about what Jesus said to the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~8#Answer:How do you think that Jesus knew what the teachers of the law were thinking?208004264
trans-unit.source: Since he is God, he knows everything.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa yeye ni Mungu, anajua kila kitu.

trans-unit.source: He could also see the expression on their faces as he talked.
trans-unit.target: Pia aliweza kuona nyuso zao alipokuwa akizungumza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~8#Answer:How do you think that Jesus knew what the teachers of the law were thinking?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.9-10+After he said that he forgave the paralyzed man's sins, Jesus indicated to the teachers of the law that they could learn from what he was about to do. What did he expect them to learn?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~9#Question:After he said that he forgave the paralyzed man's sins, Jesus indicated to the teachers of the law that they could learn from what he was about to do. What did he expect them to learn?
trans-unit.source: After he said that he forgave the paralyzed man's sins, Jesus indicated to the teachers of the law that they could learn from what he was about to do. What did he expect them to learn?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kusema kwamba alikuwa amemsamehe yule mtu aliyepooza dhambi zake, Yesu alionyesha walimu wa sheria kwamba wangeweza kujifunza kutokana na yale aliyokuwa karibu kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~9#Question:After he said that he forgave the paralyzed man's sins, Jesus indicated to the teachers of the law that they could learn from what he was about to do. What did he expect them to learn?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~9#Answer:After he said that he forgave the paralyzed man's sins, Jesus indicated to the teachers of the law that they could learn from what he was about to do. What did he expect them to learn?-513170853
trans-unit.source: He told them that when he forgave the paralyzed man, they did not believe that he really had done that. Now he would heal the man. Then they could know that he was from God, and therefore able both to heal and to forgive sin. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wakati alipomsamehe mtu aliyepooza, hawakuamini kwamba kweli amefanya hivyo. Sasa angemponya mtu huyo. Ndipo wangejua kwamba alikuwa ametoka kwa Mungu, na kwa hivyo anaweza kuponya na kusamehe dhambi (9-10).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~9#Answer:After he said that he forgave the paralyzed man's sins, Jesus indicated to the teachers of the law that they could learn from what he was about to do. What did he expect them to learn?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.10+Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~10#Question:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?
trans-unit.source: Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu "Mwana wa binadamu"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~10#Question:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~10#Answer:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?-1727344404
trans-unit.source: He was speaking of himself.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiongea juu yake mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~10#Answer:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~10#Answer:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?-1612173654
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: "Son of Man" is a title that the prophet Daniel used in Dan. 7:13-14. Daniel was referring to a human figure who is, nevertheless, a heavenly being. God gave him authority to be the leader of God's people on earth. The teachers of the law knew that this title referred to the Messiah. Jesus applied this title to himself.
trans-unit.target: Neno muhimu: "Mwana wa Adamu" ni jina la cheo ambalo nabii Danieli alitumia katika Dan. 7:13-14. Danieli alikuwa akirejelea mtu wa kibinadamu ambaye, hata hivyo, ni kiumbe wa mbinguni. Mungu alimpa mamlaka ya kuwa kiongozi wa watu wa Mungu duniani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~10#Answer:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~10#Note:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?-394730868
trans-unit.source: See "Son of Man" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Mwana wa Adamu" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~10#Note:Who was Jesus talking about when he mentioned the "Son of Man"?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.12+How did the people know that the man was healed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~12#Answer:How did the people know that the man was healed?51381536
trans-unit.source: They saw him get up and walk away, carrying his mat. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walimwona akiondoka na kutembea, akichukua kitanda chake. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~12#Answer:How did the people know that the man was healed?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.12+What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~12#Question:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?
trans-unit.source: What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?
trans-unit.target: Watu walifikiri nini walipomwona mtu huyo akiondoka na kutembea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~12#Question:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~12#Answer:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?-895152853
trans-unit.source: They were amazed and praised (glorified/gave glory to) God. (12)
trans-unit.target: Basi walishangaa, na wakamtukuza Mwenyezi Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~12#Answer:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~12#Note:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?1746499307
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek word translated here as "praised" is the Key Term "glory/glorify". Each meaning of that Greek word tries to describe a characteristic of God that people do not have. In this verse it refers to the best praise, honor, and giving of thanks that anyone can give to God because of his perfect goodness to them.
trans-unit.target: Uhakiki wa Maneno Muhimu: Neno la Kigiriki lililotafsiriwa hapa kuwa "aliyemsifu" ni Neno Muhimu "utukufu/kumtukuza". Kila maana ya neno hilo la Kigiriki hujaribu kueleza sifa ya Mungu ambayo wanadamu hawana. Katika mstari huu linarejezea sifa bora, heshima, na kutoa shukrani ambayo mtu yeyote aweza kumpa Mungu kwa sababu ya wema wake mkamilifu kwao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~12#Note:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~12#Note:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?-591711204
trans-unit.source: See "glorify" in KBT in the "glory" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia "kuhimidi" katika KBT katika "utukufu" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~12#Note:What did the people think when they saw the man get up and walk away?
