group.id: Q:MRK 2.15+Did Jesus walk around, sit and talk with such people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~15#Question:Did Jesus walk around, sit and talk with such people?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus walk around, sit and talk with such people?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alitembea, akaketi, na kuzungumza na watu kama hao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~15#Question:Did Jesus walk around, sit and talk with such people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~15#Answer:Did Jesus walk around, sit and talk with such people?1250133395
trans-unit.source: Yes, he often did. (Many of those people became his followers). (15)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, mara nyingi aliwatembelea (wengi kati ya watu hao wakawa wafuasi wake). (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~15#Answer:Did Jesus walk around, sit and talk with such people?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.16-17+When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~16#Question:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?
trans-unit.source: When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?
trans-unit.target: Watu wasomapo haya watafikiri Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria walikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Question:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~16#Answer:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?609598387
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Pharisees were people of the Pharisee party. The teachers of the law were usually Pharisees they taught God's laws and the Jewish rules passed down for generations that they also called laws.
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walikuwa watu wa chama cha Mafarisayo. Walimu wa sheria walikuwa Mafarisayo kwa kawaida walifundisha sheria za Mungu na sheria za Kiyahudi zilipitishwa kwa vizazi ambavyo pia waliviita sheria.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Answer:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~16#Note:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?1608715828
trans-unit.source: See "Pharisee" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Mfarisayo" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Note:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~16#Note:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?218263431
trans-unit.source: (Note: You may want glossary entries on the Pharisees and the teachers of the law).
trans-unit.target: (Kumbuka: Huenda ukataka maandishi ya kamusi juu ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Note:When people read this who will they think that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.16+What caused them to become unhappy?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~16#Question:What caused them to become unhappy?
trans-unit.source: What caused them to become unhappy?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowafanya wawe wasio na furaha?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Question:What caused them to become unhappy?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~16#Answer:What caused them to become unhappy?675668954
trans-unit.source: They saw Jesus eating with people who did not follow all of the Jewish rules and regulations that the Pharisees though Jewish people should follow. (16)
trans-unit.target: Walimwona Yesu akila na watu ambao hawakufuata sheria na maagizo yote ya Kiyahudi ambayo Mafarisayo ingawa watu wa Kiyahudi wanapaswa kufuata. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Answer:What caused them to become unhappy?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.16-17+Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~16#Question:Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mafarisayo walifikiri kwamba haikuwa vizuri kwa Yesu kushirikiana na watu kama hao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Question:Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~16#Answer:Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?1525505385
trans-unit.source: They thought that good people should not mix with sinful people (lest the sinful people make the righteous people unclean in God's sight). (16-17)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba watu wema hawapaswi kuchangamana na watu wenye dhambi (kwamba watu wenye dhambi hawapaswi kuwachafua watu wema mbele za Mungu). (16-17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Answer:Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~16#Answer:Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?772800075
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "righteous" in KBT under "just, justify" entry.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "waadilifu" katika KBT chini ya "tu, kuhalalisha" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~16#Answer:Why do you think that the Pharisees thought that it was not good for Jesus to be with such people?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.17+Why do you think that Jesus talked about sick people and a doctor?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~17#Question:Why do you think that Jesus talked about sick people and a doctor?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus talked about sick people and a doctor?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alizungumza kuhusu wagonjwa na daktari?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~17#Question:Why do you think that Jesus talked about sick people and a doctor?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~17#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus talked about sick people and a doctor?970935167
trans-unit.source: He compared himself to a doctor and sinners to sick people. (17)
trans-unit.target: Alijilinganisha na daktari na watenda dhambi na wagonjwa. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~17#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus talked about sick people and a doctor?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.17+Why did Jesus go to where sinners were?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~17#Question:Why did Jesus go to where sinners were?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus go to where sinners were?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alienda mahali ambapo watenda-dhambi walikuwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~17#Question:Why did Jesus go to where sinners were?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~17#Answer:Why did Jesus go to where sinners were?1782258263
trans-unit.source: He went to where they were because his work was to call the sinners to repent and follow God. (17)
trans-unit.target: Alienda mahali walipokuwa kwa sababu kazi yake ilikuwa kuwaita wenye dhambi kutubu na kumfuata Mungu. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~17#Answer:Why did Jesus go to where sinners were?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!2~18#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 2:18-22 People asked Jesus why his disciples did not fast.
trans-unit.target: Marko 2:18-22 Watu walimwuliza Yesu kwa nini wanafunzi wake hawakufunga.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18-22+What was the most important thing that Jesus was trying to show people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:What was the most important thing that Jesus was trying to show people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What was the most important thing that Jesus was trying to show people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani la maana zaidi ambalo Yesu alikuwa akijaribu kuwaonyesha watu katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:What was the most important thing that Jesus was trying to show people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:What was the most important thing that Jesus was trying to show people in these verses?-314460951
trans-unit.source: He was trying to show them that his teaching involved a whole new approach. If they tried to follow their traditions and just add some of his new teaching, it would not work. (19-22)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akijaribu kuwaonyesha kwamba mafundisho yake yalitia ndani njia mpya kabisa. Kama wangejaribu kufuata mapokeo yao na kuongeza tu baadhi ya mafundisho yake mapya, haingefanikiwa. (19-22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:What was the most important thing that Jesus was trying to show people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18+What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?
trans-unit.source: What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yohana na Mafarisayo walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?1165756979
trans-unit.source: They fasted, that is, they went without food for a period of time (to help them think about God). (18)
trans-unit.target: Walifunga, yaani, waliendelea bila kula kwa kipindi fulani (ili kuwasaidia kumkumbuka Mungu).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?-2038364351
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: When they fasted, they avoided eating food for certain periods of time according to the Jewish traditions and teaching of their religious leaders. The purpose was to focus their thoughts better on God.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Walipofunga, waliepuka kula kwa vipindi fulani kulingana na mapokeo ya Kiyahudi na mafundisho ya viongozi wao wa kidini. Kusudi lilikuwa kukazia fikira zao zaidi juu ya Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:What was it that the disciples of John and the Pharisees did?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18-20+Did the followers of Jesus do the same thing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:Did the followers of Jesus do the same thing?
trans-unit.source: Did the followers of Jesus do the same thing?
trans-unit.target: Je, wafuasi wa Yesu walifanya hivyo pia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:Did the followers of Jesus do the same thing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:Did the followers of Jesus do the same thing?-1118076026
trans-unit.source: No. (implied in 18-19)
trans-unit.target: Hapana (ina maana katika 18-19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:Did the followers of Jesus do the same thing?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18+What did the people ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:What did the people ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the people ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu walimwuliza Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:What did the people ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:What did the people ask Jesus?-81739110
trans-unit.source: They asked him why his disciples did not fast when the disciples of John and those of the Pharisees fasted regularly. (18)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza kwa nini wanafunzi wake hawakufunga wakati wanafunzi wa Yohana na wale wa Mafarisayo walifunga kwa ukawaida. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:What did the people ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.19+How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~19#Question:How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~19#Question:How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~19#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?431526785
trans-unit.source: He answered them by using picture language (that is, he told a story with a hidden meaning). He said that during a wedding festival, friends of the honored man (that is, the bridegroom) would not fast. (19)
trans-unit.target: Akawajibu kwa kutumia lugha ya mfano (yaani, aliwasimulia mfano wenye maana iliyofichwa). Alisema kwamba wakati wa sikukuu ya arusi, marafiki wa mtu mwenye heshima (yaani, bwana-arusi) hawatafunga. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~19#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.19+What did Jesus say would happen one day?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~19#Question:What did Jesus say would happen one day?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen one day?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingetukia siku moja?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~19#Question:What did Jesus say would happen one day?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~19#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen one day?2052301321
trans-unit.source: He said that the honored man (bridegroom) would be taken away from them (killed). That is the time when his friends would fast. (19)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mwanamume mwenye kuheshimiwa (mwanamume aliyeolewa) angeondolewa kwao (auawe). Hiyo ndiyo siku ambayo marafiki wake wangefunga. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~19#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen one day?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18-20+Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu bwana-arusi na rafiki zake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?-512497935
trans-unit.source: He was talking about himself and his disciples being together and later being separated.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya yeye na wanafunzi wake kuwa pamoja na baadaye kutenganishwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~18#Note:Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?-1261950774
trans-unit.source: Both the near and the distant context suggests this meaning.
trans-unit.target: Muktadha wa karibu na wa mbali waonyesha maana hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Note:Who do you think that Jesus was talking about when he spoke of the bridegroom, and his friends?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18-20+What answer did Jesus's picture language give them about why Jesus's followers did not fast?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:What answer did Jesus's picture language give them about why Jesus's followers did not fast?
trans-unit.source: What answer did Jesus's picture language give them about why Jesus's followers did not fast?
trans-unit.target: Ni jibu gani ambalo lugha ya kielezi ya Yesu iliwapa juu ya sababu iliyofanya wafuasi wa Yesu wasifunge?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:What answer did Jesus's picture language give them about why Jesus's followers did not fast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:What answer did Jesus's picture language give them about why Jesus's followers did not fast?75144803
trans-unit.source: Jesus showed them that his disciples were right to rejoice and not fast (a sign of sorrow) while he was with them.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonyesha kwamba wanafunzi wake walikuwa na haki ya kushangilia na si kufunga (ishara ya huzuni) alipokuwa pamoja nao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:What answer did Jesus's picture language give them about why Jesus's followers did not fast?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18-20+Do you think Jesus would care if his disciples fasted if they decided to do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:Do you think Jesus would care if his disciples fasted if they decided to do that?
trans-unit.source: Do you think Jesus would care if his disciples fasted if they decided to do that?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu angechukia ikiwa wanafunzi wake wangefunga ikiwa wangeamua kufanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:Do you think Jesus would care if his disciples fasted if they decided to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:Do you think Jesus would care if his disciples fasted if they decided to do that?-1667450890
trans-unit.source: No.
trans-unit.target: La, sivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:Do you think Jesus would care if his disciples fasted if they decided to do that?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.18-20+How can we tell that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~18#Question:How can we tell that?
trans-unit.source: How can we tell that?
trans-unit.target: Tunaweza kujuaje hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Question:How can we tell that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~18#Answer:How can we tell that?1065628513
trans-unit.source: He said in his picture talk that later, when people took him away from them, his disciples would have a real reason to fast.
trans-unit.target: Alisema katika hotuba yake ya kielezi kwamba baadaye, watu walipomchukua kutoka kwao, wanafunzi wake wangekuwa na sababu halisi ya kufunga.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~18#Answer:How can we tell that?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.21+What was one thing that Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~21#Question:What was one thing that Jesus said people do not do?
trans-unit.source: What was one thing that Jesus said people do not do?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani moja ambalo Yesu alisema watu hawafanyi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Question:What was one thing that Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~21#Answer:What was one thing that Jesus said people do not do?1313499053
trans-unit.source: They do not mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth. (21)
trans-unit.target: Hawatoshi nguo ya zamani kwa kitambaa kipya. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Answer:What was one thing that Jesus said people do not do?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.21-22+Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~21#Question:Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?
trans-unit.source: Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?
trans-unit.target: Je, watu katika kijiji chako wamewahi kurekebisha vazi la zamani kwa kipande cha kitambaa kipya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Question:Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!2~21#Alternate:Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?-327308684
trans-unit.source: Do your people ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?
trans-unit.target: Je! watu wenu wamewahi kurekebisha vazi la zamani kwa kipande cha kitambaa kipya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Alternate:Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~21#Note:Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?-21789092
trans-unit.source: Check for possible mismatching contrast with local cultural practice here.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwa tofauti ya kutofautisha iwezekanavyo na mazoea ya kitamaduni ya hapa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Note:Do people in your village ever mend an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.22+What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~22#Question:What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?
trans-unit.source: What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani la pili ambalo Yesu alisema watu hawapaswi kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~22#Question:What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~22#Answer:What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?459652666
trans-unit.source: They do not put new wine in an old goatskin [bag/bottle]. (22)
trans-unit.target: Hawatumii divai mpya katika viriba vikuukuu vya ngozi ya mbuzi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~22#Answer:What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~22#Note:What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?-290699719
trans-unit.source: When people seal new wine in a leather container, it will ferment and swell up. An old leather bag is no longer pliable and will break. Both the wine and the bag are ruined.
trans-unit.target: Wala watu hawaweki divai mpya katika viriba vipya; divai mpya hiyo itachacha na kujaa. Vilevile viriba vya zamani vitaharibika, divai itapasuka na viriba vitapotea.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~22#Note:What was the second thing that Jesus said people do not do?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.21-22+When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~21#Question:When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha nini watu aliposema juu ya kitambaa na divai na chupa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Question:When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~21#Answer:When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?1645994144
trans-unit.source: CLOTH-Jesus was teaching that his new teachings cannot be like a patch on the peoples' old system of beliefs. They needed to change their whole approach to God and their belief system.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha kwamba mafundisho yake mapya hayawezi kuwa kama kiraka kwenye mfumo wa zamani wa imani za watu. Walihitaji kubadilisha njia yao yote ya kumfikia Mungu na mfumo wao wa imani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Answer:When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~21#Note:When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?649960458
trans-unit.source: WINE BOTTLE-Pouring some of his teaching into their old non-pliable system was not going to work. They needed to realize that his teaching was new and they needed to follow it all. (Note: Watch carefully for people understanding the meaning wrongly because they are living in a different time and place than Jesus and his listeners.)
trans-unit.target: (Kumbuka: Jihadharini na watu kuelewa maana vibaya kwa sababu wanaishi katika wakati na mahali tofauti na Yesu na wasikilizaji wake.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~21#Note:When Jesus spoke about cloth and about the wine and bottle, what was he teaching the people?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!2~23#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 2:23-28 Jesus showed the Pharisees that he had authority over the Sabbath day.
trans-unit.target: Marko 2:23-28 Yesu aliwaonyesha Mafarisayo kwamba ana mamlaka juu ya siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 2.23-28+Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~23#Question:Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?
trans-unit.source: Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo walisema kwamba wanafunzi walikuwa wakifanya jambo fulani lisilofaa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Question:Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~23#Answer:Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?-29514422
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees felt it was wrong to do anything like work because it was the Sabbath day. (23)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walihisi kwamba ilikuwa ni kosa kufanya kazi yoyote kwa sababu ilikuwa siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Answer:Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!2~23#Note:Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?72791186
trans-unit.source: According to the Jewish rules (traditions), that they had added to the Old Testament laws, people were not supposed to do anything that was even a bit like work on the Sabbath day.
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na sheria za Kiyahudi (mapokeo), ambazo walikuwa wameongeza kwenye sheria za Agano la Kale, watu hawakupaswa kufanya chochote ambacho hata kidogo kilifanana na kazi siku ya Sabato.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Note:Why did the Pharisees say that the disciples were doing something wrong?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.23+What were the disciples doing as they walked along a path?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~23#Question:What were the disciples doing as they walked along a path?
trans-unit.source: What were the disciples doing as they walked along a path?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wakifanya nini walipokuwa wakitembea barabarani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Question:What were the disciples doing as they walked along a path?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~23#Answer:What were the disciples doing as they walked along a path?-1947931039
trans-unit.source: They were breaking off some of the grain and eating it. (23)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakivunja baadhi ya nafaka na kuila. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Answer:What were the disciples doing as they walked along a path?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.23-24+Why do you think that they did that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~23#Question:Why do you think that they did that?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they did that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walifanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Question:Why do you think that they did that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~23#Answer:Why do you think that they did that?1910235338
trans-unit.source: Because they were hungry. (implied from verse 25)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu walikuwa na njaa. (Inamaanisha kutoka mstari wa 25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~23#Answer:Why do you think that they did that?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.24+What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~24#Question:What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walisema ni nini kilichokuwa kibaya kuhusu hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~24#Question:What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~24#Answer:What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?2099060714
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees said that the disciples were breaking the law by working on the day of rest. (24)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walisema kwamba wanafunzi walikuwa wakivunja sheria kwa kufanya kazi siku ya sabato. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~24#Answer:What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~24#Answer:What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?-1070272510
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "law" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "sheria" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~24#Answer:What did the Pharisees say was wrong about that?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.24+What work did they accuse them of doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~24#Question:What work did they accuse them of doing?
trans-unit.source: What work did they accuse them of doing?
trans-unit.target: Waliwashtaki kwamba walikuwa wakifanya kazi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~24#Question:What work did they accuse them of doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~24#Answer:What work did they accuse them of doing?-526501319
trans-unit.source: They implied that picking some grain and taking the husks off to eat it, was the same as harvesting grain on the Sabbath. (24)
trans-unit.target: Walidokeza kwamba kuokota nafaka na kuchukua magamba yake ili kula, ilikuwa sawa na kuvuna nafaka siku ya Sabato. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~24#Answer:What work did they accuse them of doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.25-26+Why did Jesus remind them about what their honored ancestor David had done?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~25#Question:Why did Jesus remind them about what their honored ancestor David had done?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus remind them about what their honored ancestor David had done?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu aliwakumbusha kuhusu jambo ambalo Daudi, babu yao aliyeheshimiwa, alikuwa amefanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~25#Question:Why did Jesus remind them about what their honored ancestor David had done?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~25#Answer:Why did Jesus remind them about what their honored ancestor David had done?832404570
trans-unit.source: That situation was similar to the disciples picking a bit of food on the rest day. In David's case, he had gone against the law concerning special bread that was kept in the temple. Only priests were allowed to eat that bread. When he and his men arrived at the temple hungry, he had asked the priest, and received from him, some of that special bread. He ate part of it. Then he also gave some to his men to eat(and God did not punish him.) (25-26)
trans-unit.target: Hali hiyo ilikuwa sawa na wanafunzi kuokota chakula kidogo siku ya Sabato. Katika kisa cha Daudi, alikuwa ameenda kinyume na sheria kuhusu mkate maalum uliowekwa hekaluni. Ni makuhani tu walioruhusiwa kula mkate huo. Wakati yeye na watu wake walipofika hekaluni wakiwa na njaa, alikuwa amemwuliza kuhani, na kupokea kutoka kwake, baadhi ya mkate huo maalum. Alikula sehemu yake. Kisha pia aliwapa baadhi ya watu wake kula ((na Mungu hakumwadhibu.) (25-26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~25#Answer:Why did Jesus remind them about what their honored ancestor David had done?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.27+What do you think that Jesus was implying about what David and his men had done?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~27#Question:What do you think that Jesus was implying about what David and his men had done?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus was implying about what David and his men had done?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu jambo ambalo Daudi na watu wake walifanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~27#Question:What do you think that Jesus was implying about what David and his men had done?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~27#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was implying about what David and his men had done?-983455407
trans-unit.source: He was showing that it was all right for them to do that when they were hungry and the special bread was all they could get to eat.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akionyesha kwamba ilikuwa sawa kwao kufanya hivyo wakati walipokuwa na njaa na mkate wa pekee ndio tu ambao wangeweza kupata kula.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~27#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was implying about what David and his men had done?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.27+What was Jesus teaching the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~27#Question:What was Jesus teaching the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus teaching the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha Mafarisayo somo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~27#Question:What was Jesus teaching the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~27#Answer:What was Jesus teaching the Pharisees?1750529093
trans-unit.source: He was teaching them that the rest day was not meant to make people suffer, like going without food. The rest day is to help people. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiwafundisha kwamba siku ya Sabato haikuwa kwa ajili ya kuwafanya watu wateseke, kama vile kufunga. Siku ya Sabato ni kuwasaidia watu (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~27#Answer:What was Jesus teaching the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MRK 2.28+The Pharisees had asked why the followers of Jesus were doing work on the Sabbath day and therefore were breaking the laws. How did Jesus answer that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!2~28#Question:The Pharisees had asked why the followers of Jesus were doing work on the Sabbath day and therefore were breaking the laws. How did Jesus answer that question?
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees had asked why the followers of Jesus were doing work on the Sabbath day and therefore were breaking the laws. How did Jesus answer that question?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walikuwa wameuliza kwa nini wafuasi wa Yesu walikuwa wakifanya kazi siku ya Sabato na hivyo walikuwa wakivunja sheria. Yesu alijibuje swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~28#Question:The Pharisees had asked why the followers of Jesus were doing work on the Sabbath day and therefore were breaking the laws. How did Jesus answer that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!2~28#Answer:The Pharisees had asked why the followers of Jesus were doing work on the Sabbath day and therefore were breaking the laws. How did Jesus answer that question?-1258347982
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that he, the Son of Man, is the boss over the Sabbath day, and therefore knows how to apply the Sabbath day laws. (28)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba yeye, Mwana wa Adamu, ni bwana juu ya siku ya Sabato, na kwa hiyo anajua jinsi ya kutumia sheria za siku ya Sabato. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!2~28#Answer:The Pharisees had asked why the followers of Jesus were doing work on the Sabbath day and therefore were breaking the laws. How did Jesus answer that question?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!3~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 3:1-6 Jesus healed a man with a crippled hand.
trans-unit.target: Marko 3:1-6 Yesu alimponya mtu aliyekuwa na mkono uliopooza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 3.1-6+Why did the Pharisees watch Jesus intently after he entered the synagogue?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~1#Question:Why did the Pharisees watch Jesus intently after he entered the synagogue?
trans-unit.source: Why did the Pharisees watch Jesus intently after he entered the synagogue?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo walimchunguza Yesu kwa makini baada ya yeye kuingia katika sinagogi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Question:Why did the Pharisees watch Jesus intently after he entered the synagogue?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~1#Answer:Why did the Pharisees watch Jesus intently after he entered the synagogue?1306834924
trans-unit.source: They watched to see if he would heal a man who had a withered hand on the Jewish Sabbath day. If he did that, then they would have something about which they could accuse him [to try to stop him from preaching his message]. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimtazama kuona kama angemponya mtu aliyekuwa na mkono uliopooza siku ya Sabato ya Kiyahudi. Kama angefanya hivyo, basi wangekuwa na jambo la kumshtaki [kujaribu kumzuia asihubiri ujumbe wake]. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Answer:Why did the Pharisees watch Jesus intently after he entered the synagogue?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.1-2+When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~1#Question:When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipoingia katika sinagogi siku ya Sabato ni nani waliokuwapo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Question:When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~1#Answer:When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?1031121874
trans-unit.source: A man with a shriveled hand was there
trans-unit.target: Na tazama, palikuwa na mtu mwenye mkono uliopooza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Answer:When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~1#Answer:When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?-1533730910
trans-unit.source: and some other people who were watching Jesus closely were there. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: na watu wengine waliokuwa wakimtazama Yesu kwa karibu walikuwapo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Answer:When Jesus went into the synagogue on a Sabbath day who was there?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.2+Why were those people watching him closely?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~2#Question:Why were those people watching him closely?
trans-unit.source: Why were those people watching him closely?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu hao walikuwa wakimchunguza kwa makini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~2#Question:Why were those people watching him closely?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~2#Answer:Why were those people watching him closely?-321911654
trans-unit.source: They wanted to see if he would heal the man so they could accuse him of working on the rest day. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kuona kama angemponya mtu huyo ili waweze kumshtaki kwamba alifanya kazi siku ya sabato. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~2#Answer:Why were those people watching him closely?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.3+What did Jesus say to the man with the shriveled hand?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~3#Question:What did Jesus say to the man with the shriveled hand?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the man with the shriveled hand?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini mtu aliyekuwa na mkono uliopooza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~3#Question:What did Jesus say to the man with the shriveled hand?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~3#Answer:What did Jesus say to the man with the shriveled hand?1025784045
trans-unit.source: He told him to stand up in order that everyone could see him. (3)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia asimame ili kila mtu amwone. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~3#Answer:What did Jesus say to the man with the shriveled hand?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.3+Do you think that the man stood up?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~3#Question:Do you think that the man stood up?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that the man stood up?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri mwanamume huyo alisimama?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~3#Question:Do you think that the man stood up?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~3#Answer:Do you think that the man stood up?-1359599391
trans-unit.source: Yes. (Jesus continued talking to the man, so we assume that the man had obeyed him.) (3)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. (Yesu aliendelea kuzungumza na mtu huyo, kwa hiyo tunafikiri kwamba mtu huyo alimtii.) (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~3#Answer:Do you think that the man stood up?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.4+What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~4#Question:What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?
trans-unit.source: What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza watu waliokuwapo swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~4#Question:What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~4#Answer:What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?-938212592
trans-unit.source: He asked them if it was all right to do bad things or to do good things on the rest day. He also asked if it was all right to kill people or to save them from dying on the rest day. (4)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kama ni halali kufanya mabaya au kufanya mema siku ya Sabato. Pia aliwauliza kama ni halali kuua watu au kuwaokoa wasife siku ya Sabato. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~4#Answer:What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~4#Answer:What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?1987858156
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "save" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "kuhifadhi" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~4#Answer:What question did Jesus ask the people who were there?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.4+How did they answer him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~4#Question:How did they answer him?
trans-unit.source: How did they answer him?
trans-unit.target: Walijibuje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~4#Question:How did they answer him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~4#Answer:How did they answer him?1848149559
trans-unit.source: They did not say anything. (4)
trans-unit.target: Hawakusema lolote. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~4#Answer:How did they answer him?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.1-4+Why do you think that they did not say anything?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~1#Question:Why do you think that they did not say anything?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they did not say anything?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini hawakusema lolote?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Question:Why do you think that they did not say anything?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~1#Answer:Why do you think that they did not say anything?253637563
trans-unit.source: They knew that they could never say it was all right to do bad or to kill people. They did not want to say it was all right to do good on the Sabbath day, since it would then be all right for Jesus to heal the man that day. They must have thought it best not to say anything.
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba hawawezi kamwe kusema kwamba ni halali kutenda mabaya au kuua mtu, ili wasiseme kwamba ni halali kufanya mema siku ya Sabato, kwa kuwa basi ingekuwa halali kwa Yesu kumponya mtu siku hiyo. Lazima wawe walifikiri ingekuwa bora kukaa kimya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~1#Answer:Why do you think that they did not say anything?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.2-5+Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~2#Question:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alikasirika na kuudhika sana alipowaangalia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~2#Question:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~2#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?865733249
trans-unit.source: It seems clear that they did not feel sorry for the man with the shriveled hand.
trans-unit.target: Inaonekana wazi kwamba hawakumhurumia mtu huyo mwenye mkono uliopooza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~2#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~2#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?373060275
trans-unit.source: They did not want to learn more about God nor to change. (2-5)
trans-unit.target: Hawakutaka kujifunza mengi zaidi juu ya Mungu wala kubadilika (2-5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~2#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry and upset as he looked at them?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.5+What did Jesus say to the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~5#Question:What did Jesus say to the man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~5#Question:What did Jesus say to the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~5#Answer:What did Jesus say to the man?1662968973
trans-unit.source: He told him to stretch out his hand. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia anyoshe mkono wake. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~5#Answer:What did Jesus say to the man?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.5+Then what happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~5#Question:Then what happened?
trans-unit.source: Then what happened?
trans-unit.target: Kisha ni nini kilichotokea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~5#Question:Then what happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~5#Answer:Then what happened?1561028616
trans-unit.source: As the man stretched out his hand, [God] healed him. (5)
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo aliponyoosha mkono wake, [Mungu] akamponya. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~5#Answer:Then what happened?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.6+What did the Pharisees do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~6#Question:What did the Pharisees do then?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees do then?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~6#Question:What did the Pharisees do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~6#Answer:What did the Pharisees do then?1579723307
trans-unit.source: They went and started planning how they could destroy Jesus (that is, how they could ruin all that Jesus was doing, probably by killing him). (6)
trans-unit.target: Wakaenda wakaanza kupanga jinsi wangeweza kumwangamiza Yesu (yaani, jinsi wangeweza kuharibu yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa akifanya, labda kwa kumwua). (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~6#Answer:What did the Pharisees do then?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!3~7#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 3:7-12 Some people asked Jesus why his disciples did not fast.
trans-unit.target: Marko 3:7-12 Watu fulani walimwuliza Yesu kwa nini wanafunzi wake hawakufunga.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~7#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 3.7-12+What can we learn from this passage about the way that most of the people felt about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~7#Question:What can we learn from this passage about the way that most of the people felt about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What can we learn from this passage about the way that most of the people felt about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kujifunza nini kutokana na andiko hili kuhusu jinsi watu wengi walivyohisi juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~7#Question:What can we learn from this passage about the way that most of the people felt about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~7#Answer:What can we learn from this passage about the way that most of the people felt about Jesus?-911938607
trans-unit.source: We can determine that people were pleased with him. Everybody was talking about the amazing things he was doing and huge crowds were following him wherever he went.
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kuthibitisha kwamba watu walimfurahia. Kila mtu alikuwa akisema juu ya mambo ya ajabu ambayo alikuwa akifanya na umati mkubwa ulimfuata popote alipoenda.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~7#Answer:What can we learn from this passage about the way that most of the people felt about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.7-8+What happened when Jesus went off to a place near the lake with his disciples to be alone with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~7#Question:What happened when Jesus went off to a place near the lake with his disciples to be alone with them?
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus went off to a place near the lake with his disciples to be alone with them?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoondoka pamoja na wanafunzi wake kwenda mahali pa faragha karibu na ziwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~7#Question:What happened when Jesus went off to a place near the lake with his disciples to be alone with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~7#Answer:What happened when Jesus went off to a place near the lake with his disciples to be alone with them?75544091
trans-unit.source: Many people from Galilee [province] and surrounding areas came.
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi kutoka Galilaya [mkoa] na maeneo ya karibu walikuja.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~7#Answer:What happened when Jesus went off to a place near the lake with his disciples to be alone with them?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.9+Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~9#Question:Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake watayarishe mashua ndogo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~9#Question:Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~9#Answer:Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?-1520402377
trans-unit.source: He asked them to do that so that he would not be bumped around by the crowd.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wafanye hivyo ili asipigwe na umati.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~9#Answer:Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~9#Answer:Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?-195845376
trans-unit.source: (Also, he probably needed to get a bit of space between him and them so they could see him and hear him speak). (9)
trans-unit.target: (Pia, labda alihitaji kupata nafasi kidogo kati yake na wao ili waweze kumwona na kumsikia akisema). (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~9#Answer:Why did Jesus tell his disciples to prepare a small boat?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.10+Why were the people pushing around him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~10#Question:Why were the people pushing around him?
trans-unit.source: Why were the people pushing around him?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walikuwa wakimzunguka?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~10#Question:Why were the people pushing around him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~10#Answer:Why were the people pushing around him?-276773946
trans-unit.source: He had healed many people, with the results that others who needed healing were coming to touch him. (10)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amewaponya watu wengi, na matokeo yakawa kwamba wengine waliohitaji kuponywa walikuwa wakija kumgusa. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~10#Answer:Why were the people pushing around him?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.11+What were the evil spirits saying?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~11#Question:What were the evil spirits saying?
trans-unit.source: What were the evil spirits saying?
trans-unit.target: Roho waovu walikuwa wakisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Question:What were the evil spirits saying?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:What were the evil spirits saying?1765046160
trans-unit.source: They said that Jesus was the Son of God. (11)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:What were the evil spirits saying?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.11-12+Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~11#Question:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia roho waovu wanyamaze?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Question:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?-1737176408
trans-unit.source: He wanted to carry on his teaching and work so that people could see who he was and then believe in him.
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kuendelea na mafundisho na kazi yake ili watu waone yeye ni nani na kisha wamwamini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?-1789504050
trans-unit.source: He did not want to start an argument with the Jewish leaders about his being the Son of God.
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka kuanza kubishana na viongozi Wayahudi kuhusu kuwa kwake Mwana wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?-1985399754
trans-unit.source: He did not want people to think that evil spirits were helping him to do his teaching.
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka watu wafikiri kwamba roho waovu walikuwa wakimsaidia kufanya kazi yake ya kufundisha.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?-1339958638
trans-unit.source: (It does not tell us why. There may be other possible answers.)
trans-unit.target: (Haituambii sababu. Huenda kukawa na majibu mengine yanayowezekana.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~11#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus would tell the evil spirits to be quiet?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!3~13#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 3:13-19 Jesus chose twelve apostles from among his many disciples.
trans-unit.target: Marko 3:13-19 Yesu alichagua mitume kumi na wawili kutoka miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake wengi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 3.13-19+What did Jesus do at this time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~13#Question:What did Jesus do at this time?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do at this time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Question:What did Jesus do at this time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~13#Answer:What did Jesus do at this time?-132724612
trans-unit.source: He picked out 12 men to be his apostles/sent-ones from among a larger number of his followers. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alichagua wanaume 12 wawe mitume wake/watumwa kutoka miongoni mwa idadi kubwa ya wafuasi wake. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Answer:What did Jesus do at this time?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.13+Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~13#Question:Where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Question:Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~13#Answer:Where did Jesus go?201471004
trans-unit.source: He went up into the hills. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alipanda milimani. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Answer:Where did Jesus go?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.13-15+Whom did Jesus call to come up there with him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~13#Question:Whom did Jesus call to come up there with him?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus call to come up there with him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaita nani waende pamoja naye huko juu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Question:Whom did Jesus call to come up there with him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~13#Answer:Whom did Jesus call to come up there with him?-1433441173
trans-unit.source: He invited a large number of people he had already chosen. (13)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaalika idadi kubwa ya watu ambao tayari alikuwa amewachagua. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~13#Answer:Whom did Jesus call to come up there with him?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.14-15+What did he do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~14#Question:What did he do then?
trans-unit.source: What did he do then?
trans-unit.target: Alifanya nini baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~14#Question:What did he do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~14#Answer:What did he do then?1350202442
trans-unit.source: He chose twelve men from among them to be extra near him. That way he could teach them more and then send them out to represent him as they preached and drove demons/evil spirits out of people. (14-15)
trans-unit.target: Alichagua watu kumi na wawili miongoni mwao ili wawe karibu naye. Kwa njia hiyo angeweza kuwafundisha zaidi na kisha kuwatuma kumwakilisha wakati wa kuhubiri na kufukuza pepo / roho mbaya kutoka kwa watu. (14-15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~14#Answer:What did he do then?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!3~14#Note:What did he do then?1170229836
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: See "apostle" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: (Kichunguzi cha Neno Muhimu: Ona "mtume" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~14#Note:What did he do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.16-17+What special name did Jesus give to Simon?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~16#Question:What special name did Jesus give to Simon?
trans-unit.source: What special name did Jesus give to Simon?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimpa Simoni jina gani la pekee?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Question:What special name did Jesus give to Simon?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~16#Answer:What special name did Jesus give to Simon?-1050949041
trans-unit.source: He gave Simon the name, Peter. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alimpa Simoni jina Petro. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Answer:What special name did Jesus give to Simon?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.16-17+What special name did Jesus give to James and John, and what does that name mean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~16#Question:What special name did Jesus give to James and John, and what does that name mean?
trans-unit.source: What special name did Jesus give to James and John, and what does that name mean?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa Yakobo na Yohana jina gani la pekee, na jina hilo lamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Question:What special name did Jesus give to James and John, and what does that name mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~16#Answer:What special name did Jesus give to James and John, and what does that name mean?-325859689
trans-unit.source: He called them Boanerges. That means "sons of thunder" or, "the thunder ones". (17)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaita Boanerge, yaani "wana wa ngurumo" au "walio kama ngurumo". (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Answer:What special name did Jesus give to James and John, and what does that name mean?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.16-17+Why do you think that he called them that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~16#Question:Why do you think that he called them that?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that he called them that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini aliwaita hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Question:Why do you think that he called them that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~16#Answer:Why do you think that he called them that?-1799030890
trans-unit.source: We are not sure why he called them that. This may describe some trait of theirs like a fiery nature.
trans-unit.target: Hatujui kwa nini aliwaita hivyo, lakini huenda hilo linaonyesha kwamba walikuwa na tabia ya moto.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Answer:Why do you think that he called them that?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!3~16#Note:Why do you think that he called them that?-926841886
trans-unit.source: These questions are to check for any obviously wrong understanding of the names.
trans-unit.target: Maswali haya ni ya kuangalia kwa uelewa wowote dhahiri usio sahihi wa majina.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~16#Note:Why do you think that he called them that?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.18-19+What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~18#Question:What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?
trans-unit.source: What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?
trans-unit.target: Tunajua nini kuhusu mwanafunzi mwingine aliyeitwa pia Simoni?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~18#Question:What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~18#Answer:What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?-1157835112
trans-unit.source: He was probably a patriot, that is, one who wanted to be free from foreigners ruling his people. He even may have been ready to fight to free his country.
trans-unit.target: Huenda alikuwa mzalendo, yaani, alitaka kuwa huru kutokana na utawala wa kigeni, na hata huenda alikuwa tayari kupigana ili kuliweka huru taifa lake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~18#Answer:What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!3~18#Note:What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?131440871
trans-unit.source: The Romans ruled over the Jews at that time.
trans-unit.target: Wakati huo, Waroma walikuwa wakitawala Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~18#Note:What do we know about the other disciple also named Simon?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.19+What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~19#Question:What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?
trans-unit.source: What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?
trans-unit.target: Marko anasema nini hapa kuhusu Yuda Iskariote?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~19#Question:What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~19#Answer:What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?1861850959
trans-unit.source: Judas was the one who would later betray Jesus by turning him over to his enemies. (19)
trans-unit.target: Baadaye, Yuda ndiye aliyemsaliti Yesu kwa kumkabidhi kwa adui zake. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~19#Answer:What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!3~19#Note:What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?-1322274512
trans-unit.source: Check that the way these verses are written does not imply that Judas had already betrayed Jesus. Mark wrote these verses after Judas betrayed Jesus, but that had not yet happened at this point in Jesus's life.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwamba namna mistari hii ilivyoandikwa haimaanishi kwamba Yuda alikuwa tayari amemsaliti Yesu. Marko aliandika mistari hii baada ya Yuda kumsaliti Yesu, lakini hiyo haikuwa imetokea wakati huu katika maisha ya Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~19#Note:What does Mark say here about Judas Iscariot?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.18-19+What do you think it means to betray someone?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~18#Question:What do you think it means to betray someone?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to betray someone?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini maana ya kumsaliti mtu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~18#Question:What do you think it means to betray someone?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~18#Answer:What do you think it means to betray someone?-891853011
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Betraying someone means to act like their friend while turning them over to their enemies.
trans-unit.target: Mtajo Muhimu: Kumsaliti mtu kunamaanisha kutenda kama rafiki yake huku ukimkabidhi kwa adui zake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~18#Answer:What do you think it means to betray someone?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!3~20#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 3:20-30 The teachers of the law said that the chief of evil spirits controlled Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Marko 3:20-30 Walimu wa sheria walisema kwamba mkuu wa roho waovu alikuwa na mamlaka juu ya Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 3.20-30+What were some people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~20#Question:What were some people saying about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What were some people saying about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walisema nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Question:What were some people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~20#Answer:What were some people saying about Jesus?1547404475
trans-unit.source: Some people said that his power to cast out evil spirits came from Beelzebub/Satan. (22-23)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine walisema kwamba nguvu zake za kufukuza roho waovu zilitoka kwa Beelzebuli/Shetani. (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Answer:What were some people saying about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.20-30+What was Jesus teaching by means of his parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~20#Question:What was Jesus teaching by means of his parables?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus teaching by means of his parables?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha nini kupitia mifano yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Question:What was Jesus teaching by means of his parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~20#Answer:What was Jesus teaching by means of his parables?-1661579739
trans-unit.source: He was teaching that Satan would not drive the other evil spirits out of a person. (23-26)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba Shetani hangeweza kuwafukuza roho wengine waovu kutoka kwa mtu. (23-26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Answer:What was Jesus teaching by means of his parables?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.20-30+How did Jesus show that his power did not come from Satan?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~20#Question:How did Jesus show that his power did not come from Satan?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus show that his power did not come from Satan?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyeshaje kwamba nguvu zake hazikutoka kwa Shetani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Question:How did Jesus show that his power did not come from Satan?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~20#Answer:How did Jesus show that his power did not come from Satan?-1894100714
trans-unit.source: He told the men that if his power came from Satan, he would not then fight against Satan by driving evil spirits out of people. Satan would always be on the same side as his own spirits who work against what God wants. (23-27)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia watu kwamba ikiwa nguvu yake ilitoka kwa Shetani, basi hangepigana dhidi ya Shetani kwa kuwafukuza roho waovu kutoka kwa watu. Shetani angekuwa kila wakati upande mmoja na roho zake mwenyewe ambao hufanya kazi dhidi ya kile Mungu anataka (23-27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Answer:How did Jesus show that his power did not come from Satan?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.20+What happened when Jesus went into someone's house to eat with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~20#Question:What happened when Jesus went into someone's house to eat with them?
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus went into someone's house to eat with them?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoingia katika nyumba ya mtu fulani ili kula pamoja nao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Question:What happened when Jesus went into someone's house to eat with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~20#Answer:What happened when Jesus went into someone's house to eat with them?1647029578
trans-unit.source: So many people pushed in wanting his attention that he and his disciples had no chance to even eat. (20)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi sana waliingia wakitaka uangalifu wake hivi kwamba yeye na wanafunzi wake hawakuwa na nafasi hata ya kula.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~20#Answer:What happened when Jesus went into someone's house to eat with them?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.21+What did Jesus's family think about this?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~21#Question:What did Jesus's family think about this?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus's family think about this?
trans-unit.target: Familia ya Yesu ilifikiri nini juu ya hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~21#Question:What did Jesus's family think about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~21#Answer:What did Jesus's family think about this?-1189719945
trans-unit.source: They thought that he was going becoming insane.
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba alikuwa anaugua akili.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~21#Answer:What did Jesus's family think about this?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~21#Answer:What did Jesus's family think about this?-182531541
trans-unit.source: They wanted to go [to him] and take him away from there. (21)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakataka kwenda kumchukua huko.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~21#Answer:What did Jesus's family think about this?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.22+What did the teachers of the Jewish law say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~22#Question:What did the teachers of the Jewish law say about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the teachers of the Jewish law say about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walimu wa sheria ya Kiyahudi walisema nini juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~22#Question:What did the teachers of the Jewish law say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~22#Answer:What did the teachers of the Jewish law say about Jesus?1679396748
trans-unit.source: They said that Beelzebub possessed him. (22)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba alikuwa amepagawa na Beelzebuli. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~22#Answer:What did the teachers of the Jewish law say about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.22+Who is Beelzebub?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~22#Question:Who is Beelzebub?
trans-unit.source: Who is Beelzebub?
trans-unit.target: Beelzebuli ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~22#Question:Who is Beelzebub?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~22#Answer:Who is Beelzebub?-1402714742
trans-unit.source: He is the chief of demons/evil spirits. (22)
trans-unit.target: Yeye ndiye mkuu wa mashetani/roho waovu. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~22#Answer:Who is Beelzebub?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.22-26+What is the difference between Beelzebub and Satan?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~22#Question:What is the difference between Beelzebub and Satan?
trans-unit.source: What is the difference between Beelzebub and Satan?
trans-unit.target: Kuna tofauti gani kati ya Beelzebuli na Shetani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~22#Question:What is the difference between Beelzebub and Satan?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~22#Answer:What is the difference between Beelzebub and Satan?459604361
trans-unit.source: They are not two different people. They are just two different names for the same spirit being.
trans-unit.target: Wao si watu wawili tofauti, bali ni majina mawili tofauti ya kiumbe wa roho yuleyule.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~22#Answer:What is the difference between Beelzebub and Satan?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.23-26+If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~23#Question:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.
trans-unit.source: If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wanaozungumza lugha yako hutumia lugha ya picha/mithali, niambie mojawapo ya hadithi hizo na kisha niambie maana yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~23#Question:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!3~23#Alternate:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.2019661025
trans-unit.source: If the people who speak your language use picture language, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wanaozungumza lugha yako hutumia lugha ya picha, niambie mojawapo ya hadithi hizo kisha niambie maana yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~23#Alternate:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!3~23#Alternate:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.966642417
trans-unit.source: If the people who speak your language use parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wanaozungumza lugha yako hutumia mifano, niambie mojawapo ya hadithi hizo kisha unieleze maana yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~23#Alternate:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~23#Answer:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.-849149677
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A parable shows its meaning indirectly by using picture language to make a comparison. The storyteller generally does not explain the parts of the comparison. The listeners themselves must think about the meaning that the storyteller has hidden in the different parts of his picture language. Jesus taught spiritual truths in this story form.
trans-unit.target: Mfano huonyesha maana yake kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja kwa kutumia lugha ya picha ili kufanya kulinganisha. Msimulizi wa hadithi kwa ujumla haelezi sehemu za kulinganisha. Wasikilizaji wenyewe lazima wafikirie juu ya maana ambayo simulizi ameficha katika sehemu tofauti za lugha yake ya picha. Yesu alifundisha kweli za kiroho katika fomu hii ya hadithi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~23#Answer:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!3~23#Note:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.903541393
trans-unit.source: See "parable" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mfano" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~23#Note:If the people who speak your language use picture language/parables, tell me one of those stories and then tell me its meaning.

group.id: Q:MRK 3.26+Why would Satan not drive out evil spirits?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~26#Question:Why would Satan not drive out evil spirits?
trans-unit.source: Why would Satan not drive out evil spirits?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Shetani hawezi kufukuza roho waovu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~26#Question:Why would Satan not drive out evil spirits?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~26#Answer:Why would Satan not drive out evil spirits?-1175147935
trans-unit.source: Groups like families, clans, and governments, do not fight with each other otherwise they would break up. Likewise, Satan would not oppose his own evil spirits and cast them out, or soon he would no longer have any evil spirits to follow him that he could rule over. (26)
trans-unit.target: Makundi kama vile familia, makabila, na serikali, hayapigani, vinginevyo yangevunjika. Vivyo hivyo, Shetani hawezi kupinga roho zake mbaya na kuwafukuza, au hivi karibuni hatakuwa na roho mbaya yoyote ya kumfuata ili aweze kutawala. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~26#Answer:Why would Satan not drive out evil spirits?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.27+Who is the "strong man" that Jesus spoke about here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~27#Question:Who is the "strong man" that Jesus spoke about here?
trans-unit.source: Who is the "strong man" that Jesus spoke about here?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliye "mwanamume mwenye nguvu" ambaye Yesu alizungumza kumhusu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~27#Question:Who is the "strong man" that Jesus spoke about here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~27#Answer:Who is the "strong man" that Jesus spoke about here?-747923856
trans-unit.source: He was speaking about Satan. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akisema juu ya Shetani. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~27#Answer:Who is the "strong man" that Jesus spoke about here?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.27+What was Jesus saying about himself and Satan here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~27#Question:What was Jesus saying about himself and Satan here?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus saying about himself and Satan here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akisema nini hapa juu yake mwenyewe na Shetani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~27#Question:What was Jesus saying about himself and Satan here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~27#Answer:What was Jesus saying about himself and Satan here?-1433811599
trans-unit.source: Jesus was pointing out that he had more power than Satan. That is, Jesus had God's power and could control Satan and cast out Satan's evil spirits. Otherwise, Satan would not let Jesus take from him those who had been his subjects. (27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akisema kwamba alikuwa na nguvu zaidi kuliko Shetani. Hiyo ni, Yesu alikuwa na nguvu ya Mungu na angeweza kumdhibiti Shetani na kufukuza roho waovu wa Shetani. Vinginevyo, Shetani hangemruhusu Yesu kuchukua kutoka kwake wale ambao walikuwa raia zake. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~27#Answer:What was Jesus saying about himself and Satan here?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.29-30+Why did Jesus begin talking about people who speak against the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~29#Question:Why did Jesus begin talking about people who speak against the Holy Spirit?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus begin talking about people who speak against the Holy Spirit?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alianza kuzungumza juu ya watu wanaosema dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~29#Question:Why did Jesus begin talking about people who speak against the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~29#Answer:Why did Jesus begin talking about people who speak against the Holy Spirit?-371262740
trans-unit.source: When those people saw Jesus use the power of the Holy Spirit, but said that Jesus was using the power of Satan, they were speaking (that is, blaspheming) against the Holy Spirit. (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Wakati watu hao walipoona Yesu akitumia nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu, lakini wakasema kwamba Yesu alikuwa akitumia nguvu ya Shetani, walikuwa wakisema (yaani, wakimkufuru) dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu. (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~29#Answer:Why did Jesus begin talking about people who speak against the Holy Spirit?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.29+What did Jesus say about the punishment for anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~29#Question:What did Jesus say about the punishment for anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the punishment for anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu adhabu ya mtu yeyote anayesema vibaya dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~29#Question:What did Jesus say about the punishment for anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~29#Answer:What did Jesus say about the punishment for anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit?-89003735
trans-unit.source: He said that (God) will never forgive people that do like that. Their punishment will last forever. (29)
trans-unit.target: Akasema: Mwenyezi Mungu hatawasamehe watu wanaofanya hayo, na wao watadumu katika adhabu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~29#Answer:What did Jesus say about the punishment for anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.source: Mark 3:31-35 Those who follow Jesus are the same as being his mother or his brothers and sisters.

trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 3.31-35+What do you think was the important point Jesus was teaching in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~31#Question:What do you think was the important point Jesus was teaching in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the important point Jesus was teaching in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akifundisha jambo gani muhimu katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~31#Question:What do you think was the important point Jesus was teaching in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~31#Answer:What do you think was the important point Jesus was teaching in these verses?-1057134342
trans-unit.source: Jesus was teaching that everyone who does what pleases God is special to Jesus. They are like his own family. (31-34)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha kwamba kila mtu afanyaye yale yanayompendeza Mungu ni wa pekee kwa Yesu. Wao ni kama familia yake mwenyewe (31-34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~31#Answer:What do you think was the important point Jesus was teaching in these verses?

trans-unit.source: Who came to look for Jesus?

trans-unit.source: How did Jesus know that his mother and brothers were there?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~32#Question:How did Jesus know that his mother and brothers were there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~32#Answer:How did Jesus know that his mother and brothers were there?691673183
