trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~32#Answer:How did Jesus know that his mother and brothers were there?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.33-35+What did Jesus want to teach to those people that day?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~33#Question:What did Jesus want to teach to those people that day?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus want to teach to those people that day?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka kuwafundisha nini watu hao siku hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~33#Question:What did Jesus want to teach to those people that day?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~33#Answer:What did Jesus want to teach to those people that day?1794563104
trans-unit.source: He wanted them to learn that all who do what God wants are like family members to him. (34-35)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka wajifunze kwamba wote wanaofanya mapenzi ya Mungu ni kama washiriki wa familia yake (34-35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~33#Answer:What did Jesus want to teach to those people that day?

group.id: Q:MRK 3.33-35+Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!3~33#Question:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alikataa kwenda na kuzungumza na familia yake mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~33#Question:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!3~33#Answer:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?1565700628
trans-unit.source: Mark did not tell us about that, but only about what Jesus wanted to teach from that situation.
trans-unit.target: Marko hakutuambia juu ya hilo, bali tu juu ya yale ambayo Yesu alitaka kufundisha kutokana na hali hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~33#Answer:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!3~33#Note:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?-1977509450
trans-unit.source: Jewish teachers used to start with something that was happening and then teach something else from it. When the crowd mentioned family, Jesus similarly started from that thought and taught about his close relationship to people who obey God. This was the important part that Mark wanted us to know. He did not bother to go back and tell us more about his introduction to this incident and whether Jesus talked with his mother and brothers afterward or not.
trans-unit.target: Walimu Wayahudi walikuwa na desturi ya kuanza na kitu fulani kilichokuwa kikitokea na kisha kufundisha kitu kingine kutoka kwa hicho. Umati ulipotaja familia, Yesu vilevile alianza kutoka kwa wazo hilo na kufundisha juu ya uhusiano wake wa karibu na watu wanaomtii Mungu. Hii ilikuwa sehemu muhimu ambayo Marko alitaka tujue. Yeye hakujishughulisha kurudi na kutuambia zaidi juu ya utangulizi wake kwa tukio hili na kama Yesu alizungumza na mama yake na ndugu zake baadaye au la.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!3~33#Note:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na aina nyingi za udongo ambao mbegu hiyo ilianguka juu yake (3-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~1#Answer:In this parable, what did Jesus say about the different seed that the farmer sowed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~1#Answer:In this parable, what did Jesus say about the different seed that the farmer sowed?852838425
trans-unit.source: Some seed did not get a chance to sprout.
trans-unit.target: Mbegu fulani hazikuwa na nafasi ya kuchipuka.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~1#Answer:In this parable, what did Jesus say about the different seed that the farmer sowed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~1#Answer:In this parable, what did Jesus say about the different seed that the farmer sowed?-149079497
trans-unit.source: Other seed sprouted and grew. The new seed these seeds produced varied from an acceptable crop to a very good crop.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~8#Answer:What happened to the other seed?-1353026128
trans-unit.source: Other seed fell on good soil, grew well, and produced a crop all the way from an acceptable amount of food to others having an abundant amount of food. (8)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri, zikakua vizuri, na kutoa mazao kuanzia kiasi cha chakula kinachokubalika hadi nyingine zenye kiasi kikubwa cha chakula. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~8#Answer:What happened to the other seed?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.9+What did Jesus mean by what he said here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~9#Question:What did Jesus mean by what he said here?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean by what he said here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~9#Question:What did Jesus mean by what he said here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~9#Answer:What did Jesus mean by what he said here?348363488
trans-unit.source: People need to think seriously about this parable so that they will understand and learn from its warning.
trans-unit.target: Watu wanahitaji kufikiria kwa uzito mfano huo ili waelewe na kujifunza kutokana na onyo lake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~9#Answer:What did Jesus mean by what he said here?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!4~10#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 4:10-20 Jesus explained the parable about the sower.
trans-unit.target: Marko 4:10-20 Yesu alifafanua mfano wa mpandaji.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 4.10-20+What was Jesus teaching with this parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~10#Question:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus teaching with this parable?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha somo gani kwa mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Question:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~10#Answer:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?-2072344807
trans-unit.source: Jesus was teaching that God causes all kinds of people to hear his message. (14-20)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha kwamba Mungu hufanya watu wa kila aina wasikie ujumbe wake (14-20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Answer:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~10#Answer:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?-797994278
trans-unit.source: On some people, his message has no effect or no lasting effect.
trans-unit.target: Ujumbe wake hauathiri watu fulani au hauathiri watu wengine kwa muda mrefu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Answer:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~10#Answer:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?-70685571
trans-unit.source: On other people, it produces a real lasting effect, making them fruitful, very fruitful or truly very fruitful.
trans-unit.target: Kwa watu wengine, inaleta athari ya kudumu, ikiwafanya wawe na matunda, wawe na matunda sana au wawe na matunda sana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Answer:What was Jesus teaching with this parable?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.10+How do we know that Jesus's disciples and the others with them did not understand the meaning of the story about the seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~10#Question:How do we know that Jesus's disciples and the others with them did not understand the meaning of the story about the seed?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus's disciples and the others with them did not understand the meaning of the story about the seed?
trans-unit.target: Twajuaje kwamba wanafunzi wa Yesu na wengine waliokuwa pamoja nao hawakuelewa maana ya kielezi cha mbegu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Question:How do we know that Jesus's disciples and the others with them did not understand the meaning of the story about the seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~10#Answer:How do we know that Jesus's disciples and the others with them did not understand the meaning of the story about the seed?1778164574
trans-unit.source: The disciples asked him to tell them the meaning. (10)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wake walimwuliza awaeleze maana yake. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Answer:How do we know that Jesus's disciples and the others with them did not understand the meaning of the story about the seed?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.11+What previously untaught truths did Jesus say that God was now causing them to understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~11#Question:What previously untaught truths did Jesus say that God was now causing them to understand?
trans-unit.source: What previously untaught truths did Jesus say that God was now causing them to understand?
trans-unit.target: Ni kweli zipi ambazo hapo awali hazikuwa zimefundishwa ambazo Yesu alisema kwamba Mungu alikuwa sasa akiwafanya waelewe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~11#Question:What previously untaught truths did Jesus say that God was now causing them to understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~11#Answer:What previously untaught truths did Jesus say that God was now causing them to understand?-1593639236
trans-unit.source: God wanted them to understand the truth about God's kingdom, (that is, about God's plan of how he would rule in peoples' lives/hearts). (11)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alitaka waelewe ukweli kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu, (yaani, kuhusu mpango wa Mungu wa jinsi atakavyotawala katika maisha/mioyo ya watu). (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~11#Answer:What previously untaught truths did Jesus say that God was now causing them to understand?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.11+When Jesus said that God had revealed this truth to them, to whom was he talking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~11#Question:When Jesus said that God had revealed this truth to them, to whom was he talking?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus said that God had revealed this truth to them, to whom was he talking?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliposema kwamba Mungu alikuwa amewafunulia kweli hii, alikuwa akizungumza na nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~11#Question:When Jesus said that God had revealed this truth to them, to whom was he talking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~11#Answer:When Jesus said that God had revealed this truth to them, to whom was he talking?1460856407
trans-unit.source: He was talking to those who were his followers (that is, those who believed in him). (11)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiongea na wale waliomfuata (yaani, wale waliomwamini).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~11#Answer:When Jesus said that God had revealed this truth to them, to whom was he talking?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.10-12+What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~10#Question:What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?
trans-unit.target: Namna gani wale wengine, wale ambao hawakuwa wafuasi wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Question:What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~10#Answer:What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?849351622
trans-unit.source: They were like some of the Israelite people of Isaiah's time. Isaiah wrote of them that they saw and heard what God was doing, but they did not understand the meaning of it. They did not want to change, and were not seeking God's forgiveness.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa kama baadhi ya Waisraeli wa wakati wa Isaya, aliyeandika juu yao kwamba waliona na kusikia yale Mungu alikuwa akifanya, lakini hawakuelewa maana yake, hawakutaka kutubu, na hawakutaka kutafuta msamaha wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Answer:What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!4~10#Note:What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?549819129
trans-unit.source: In what Isaiah had written, it was the people's own choice that they did not respond. They were the ones thinking "lest at any time we should turn and be converted." Here in these verses some of the hearers were hostile, so Jesus used parables to help him proclaim the message without causing them to reject it.
trans-unit.target: Katika yale ambayo Isaya alikuwa ameandika, ilikuwa ni chaguo la watu wenyewe kwamba hawakuitikia. Walikuwa ndio waliofikiri "ili wakati wowote tusirudi na kuongoka". Hapa katika mistari hii baadhi ya wasikilizaji walikuwa wenye uhasama, kwa hiyo Yesu alitumia mifano kumsaidia kutangaza ujumbe bila kuwafanya wakatae.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~10#Note:What happened to the others, those who were not Jesus's followers?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.13+How do we know that Jesus was surprised that his followers had not understood the parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~13#Question:How do we know that Jesus was surprised that his followers had not understood the parable?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus was surprised that his followers had not understood the parable?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba Yesu alishangaa kwamba wafuasi wake hawakuelewa mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~13#Question:How do we know that Jesus was surprised that his followers had not understood the parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~13#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was surprised that his followers had not understood the parable?-581031140
trans-unit.source: He gently rebuked them.
trans-unit.target: Aliwakemea kwa upole.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~13#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was surprised that his followers had not understood the parable?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.14+In the parable, what did the seed that the man sowed represent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~14#Question:In the parable, what did the seed that the man sowed represent?
trans-unit.source: In the parable, what did the seed that the man sowed represent?
trans-unit.target: Katika mfano huo, mbegu ambayo mtu huyo alipanda ilifananisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~14#Question:In the parable, what did the seed that the man sowed represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~14#Answer:In the parable, what did the seed that the man sowed represent?1889908710
trans-unit.source: The seed represented God's message, the gospel, as God caused people to hear it. (14)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliwakilisha ujumbe wa Mungu, injili, kama Mungu alivyofanya watu waisikie. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~14#Answer:In the parable, what did the seed that the man sowed represent?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.15+What does the seed that fell on the path and was eaten by the birds represent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~15#Question:What does the seed that fell on the path and was eaten by the birds represent?
trans-unit.source: What does the seed that fell on the path and was eaten by the birds represent?
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliyoanguka njiani na kuliwa na ndege inawakilisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~15#Question:What does the seed that fell on the path and was eaten by the birds represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~15#Answer:What does the seed that fell on the path and was eaten by the birds represent?581941376
trans-unit.source: That seed represents the people who hear the message, but Satan influences them to forget it so that the message has no effect on the way they live. (15)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu hiyo huwakilisha watu wanaosikia ujumbe, lakini Shetani huwashawishi walisahau ili ujumbe huo usiwe na uvutano juu ya njia yao ya maisha. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~15#Answer:What does the seed that fell on the path and was eaten by the birds represent?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.16-17+What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~16#Question:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?
trans-unit.source: What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliyoanguka kwenye mahali penye miamba huwakilisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~16#Question:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~16#Answer:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?-1919201609
trans-unit.source: The seed that fell on the rocky place represents people who hear the message and at first respond to it happily. (16)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliyoanguka kwenye mahali penye miamba huwakilisha watu wanaosikia ujumbe na mwanzoni huitikia kwa furaha. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~16#Answer:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~16#Answer:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?769274748
trans-unit.source: But when others oppress and harass them, causing them to suffer pain and be frustrated for following God's Word, they soon give up and stop obeying the message. (17)
trans-unit.target: Lakini wengine wanapowaonea na kuwadhulumu, na kuwafanya wateseke na kufadhaika kwa sababu ya kufuata Neno la Mungu, upesi wao huacha na kuacha kutii ujumbe huo. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~16#Answer:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~16#Answer:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?327736473
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: persecute
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: kuteswa
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~16#Answer:What does the seed that fell in the rocky place represent?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.18-19+What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~18#Question:What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?
trans-unit.source: What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliyoanguka katikati ya magugu yenye miiba inafananisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~18#Question:What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~18#Answer:What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?1508063379
trans-unit.source: The seed that fell among the weed represents people who obey the message at first, but who do not continue to follow its teaching. Their concerns about life in this world (or, in these times) and a desire for money and other things take all their attention away from God's Word.
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliyoanguka miongoni mwa magugu huwakilisha watu ambao hutii ujumbe huo mwanzoni, lakini ambao hawaendelei kufuata mafundisho yake. Mahangaiko yao juu ya maisha ya ulimwengu huu (au, katika nyakati hizi) na tamaa ya pesa na mambo mengine huondoa uangalifu wao wote kutoka kwa Neno la Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~18#Answer:What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~18#Answer:What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?-376222365
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "world, age" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "dunia, umri" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~18#Answer:What does the seed that fell among the thorny weeds represent?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.20+What kind of people are represented by the seed that fell in good soil?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~20#Question:What kind of people are represented by the seed that fell in good soil?
trans-unit.source: What kind of people are represented by the seed that fell in good soil?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu wa aina gani wanaowakilishwa na mbegu iliyoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~20#Question:What kind of people are represented by the seed that fell in good soil?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~20#Answer:What kind of people are represented by the seed that fell in good soil?-1033397716
trans-unit.source: The seed that fell on good soil represents those who hear the word of God, believe it, and allow it to change their lives so that they do what is pleasing to God.
trans-unit.target: Na zile zilizoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri ni wale wanaolisikia neno la Mungu, na kulikubali, na kuliruhusu kubadili maisha yao ili wafanye yale yanayompendeza Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~20#Answer:What kind of people are represented by the seed that fell in good soil?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!4~21#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 4:21-25 Jesus told a proverb about a lamp.
trans-unit.target: Marko 4:21-25 Yesu alitoa mfano kuhusu taa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 4.21-25+What do you think that Jesus was teaching here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think that Jesus was teaching here?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus was teaching here?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akifundisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think that Jesus was teaching here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was teaching here?1403799885
trans-unit.source: He was teaching that whoever understands the truth must make it clear to others by the way they live. People must be active in applying what they know of God, then God will help them to understand more. If, on the other hand, they do not come up to a minimum amount of understanding and doing what God says, the little bit they understand and do God will not count in their favor. (That is, they do not become part of his kingdom.)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba yeyote anayeelewa ukweli lazima aeleze kwa wengine kwa njia wanayoishi. Watu lazima wawe na bidii katika kutumia kile wanachojua juu ya Mungu, basi Mungu atawasaidia kuelewa zaidi. Kwa upande mwingine, ikiwa hawatakuja kwa kiwango cha chini cha uelewa na kufanya kile Mungu anasema, kidogo wanachoelewa na kufanya Mungu hatahesabu kwa neema yake. (Yaani, hawawezi kuwa sehemu ya ufalme wake).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was teaching here?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.21-22+What did Jesus say is the purpose of a lamp?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~21#Question:What did Jesus say is the purpose of a lamp?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say is the purpose of a lamp?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema taa inatumiwa kwa kusudi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Question:What did Jesus say is the purpose of a lamp?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~21#Answer:What did Jesus say is the purpose of a lamp?1110228723
trans-unit.source: It's purpose is to give light to everyone. People are to put a lamp where it's light can shine out. They never (light it and then) put it under a box or bed.
trans-unit.target: Watu huweka taa mahali ambapo inaweza kuangaza. Haitumiwi kamwe (kuwasha na kisha) kuiweka chini ya sanduku au kitanda.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Answer:What did Jesus say is the purpose of a lamp?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.21-22+What do you think he meant by talking about the lamp here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think he meant by talking about the lamp here?
trans-unit.source: What do you think he meant by talking about the lamp here?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu taa hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think he meant by talking about the lamp here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think he meant by talking about the lamp here?-812357900
trans-unit.source: He was talking of the good news.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu habari njema.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think he meant by talking about the lamp here?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.21-22+What do you think that Jesus was saying about this good news?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think that Jesus was saying about this good news?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus was saying about this good news?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akisema nini kuhusu habari njema hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think that Jesus was saying about this good news?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was saying about this good news?2071372633
trans-unit.source: God's purpose was to make clear to people how he wants to receive them through what Jesus did in dying for them.
trans-unit.target: Kusudi la Mungu lilikuwa kuwaonyesha watu wazi jinsi anavyotaka kuwakaribisha kupitia yale ambayo Yesu alifanya kwa kufa kwa ajili yao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was saying about this good news?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.21-22+What do you think that God had hidden which he was then making clear to people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think that God had hidden which he was then making clear to people?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that God had hidden which he was then making clear to people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Mungu alificha nini ambacho kisha akawafunulia watu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Question:What do you think that God had hidden which he was then making clear to people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think that God had hidden which he was then making clear to people?2100430168
trans-unit.source: He was only then making his plan clear about Jesus dying for us. Jesus's dying for us was so that God can rule in our lives. That is the good news!
trans-unit.target: Wakati huo tu alikuwa akiweka wazi mpango wake kuhusu Yesu kufa kwa ajili yetu. Yesu kufa kwa ajili yetu ilikuwa ili Mungu aweze kutawala katika maisha yetu. Hiyo ni habari njema!
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~21#Answer:What do you think that God had hidden which he was then making clear to people?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.23-24+What warning did Jesus give here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~23#Question:What warning did Jesus give here?
trans-unit.source: What warning did Jesus give here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa onyo gani hapa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~23#Question:What warning did Jesus give here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~23#Answer:What warning did Jesus give here?-461061581
trans-unit.source: Jesus warned people that they must pay attention to what they hear, so that God will help them to understand more. (23-24)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya watu kwamba lazima wawe makini kwa kile wanachosikia, ili Mungu awasaidie kuelewa zaidi (23-24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~23#Answer:What warning did Jesus give here?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.25+What further warning is there in verse 25?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~25#Question:What further warning is there in verse 25?
trans-unit.source: What further warning is there in verse 25?
trans-unit.target: Ni onyo gani zaidi lililo katika mstari wa 25?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~25#Question:What further warning is there in verse 25?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~25#Answer:What further warning is there in verse 25?-44250267
trans-unit.source: He warned that people are to understand that if their response to God's good news (of providing forgiveness for their sin and so forth) is inadequate, the little bit they know will not help them any. (25)
trans-unit.target: Alionya kwamba watu wanapaswa kuelewa kwamba ikiwa itikio lao kwa habari njema ya Mungu (ya kutoa msamaha kwa dhambi zao na kadhalika) halifai, kidogo wanachojua hakitawasaidia chochote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~25#Answer:What further warning is there in verse 25?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!4~26#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 4:26-29 Jesus explained that the kingdom of God is like seed that grows.
trans-unit.target: Marko 4:26-29 Yesu alieleza kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ni kama mbegu inayokua.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 4.26-29+To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~26#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa Mungu na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~26#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?1193807113
trans-unit.source: He compared the kingdom of God to seed that someone sowed and he talked of how it grows gradually. It continues to grow until the harvest time comes, although no one can see a cause for it to grow.
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha ufalme wa Mungu na mbegu ambayo mtu hupanda na akazungumza juu ya jinsi inavyokua hatua kwa hatua. Inaendelea kukua mpaka wakati wa mavuno, ingawa hakuna mtu anayeweza kuona sababu ya kukua kwake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.26-29+What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~26#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini alipotoa mfano huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~26#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?1408039069
trans-unit.source: The effect of God's word on a person goes on growing (progressing) until God's full purpose in that person is completed.
trans-unit.target: Matokeo ya neno la Mungu juu ya mtu huendelea kukua (kusonga mbele) hadi kusudi kamili la Mungu katika mtu huyo litimizwe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~26#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~26#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?1168533846
trans-unit.source: The effect of God's word in the world is something that goes on growing until God's full purpose in the world is completed.
trans-unit.target: Uvutano wa neno la Mungu ulimwenguni ni jambo linaloendelea kukua hadi kusudi kamili la Mungu litimizwe ulimwenguni.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by this illustration?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.26+What was Jesus really talking about in this parable of the seed growing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~26#Question:What was Jesus really talking about in this parable of the seed growing?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus really talking about in this parable of the seed growing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia nini hasa katika mfano huu wa ukuzi wa mbegu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Question:What was Jesus really talking about in this parable of the seed growing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~26#Answer:What was Jesus really talking about in this parable of the seed growing?1820309857
trans-unit.source: He was talking about the way in which God is bringing about his rule in people's lives and/or in the world. (26)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya njia ambayo Mungu analeta utawala wake katika maisha ya watu na/au katika ulimwengu. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Answer:What was Jesus really talking about in this parable of the seed growing?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.26+What illustration did he use?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~26#Question:What illustration did he use?
trans-unit.source: What illustration did he use?
trans-unit.target: Alitumia mfano gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Question:What illustration did he use?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~26#Answer:What illustration did he use?-1077626854
trans-unit.source: He used the illustration of seed that a man sowed on a farm. (26)
trans-unit.target: Alitumia kielezi cha mbegu ambayo mtu alipanda katika shamba (26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~26#Answer:What illustration did he use?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.27+What happened to the seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~27#Question:What happened to the seed?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the seed?
trans-unit.target: Mbegu hiyo ilipatwa na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~27#Question:What happened to the seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~27#Answer:What happened to the seed?1954723439
trans-unit.source: It grew slowly/gradually all of the time. (27)
trans-unit.target: Ilikua polepole/kwa taratibu wakati wote. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~27#Answer:What happened to the seed?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.28+What caused it to grow?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~28#Question:What caused it to grow?
trans-unit.source: What caused it to grow?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichofanya liongezeke?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~28#Question:What caused it to grow?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~28#Answer:What caused it to grow?1251544611
trans-unit.source: No one knows. An unseen source of energy caused it. (28)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna ajuaye, lakini chanzo kisichoonekana cha nishati kilitokeza hilo. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~28#Answer:What caused it to grow?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.29+What happened at the end of the growing season?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~29#Question:What happened at the end of the growing season?
trans-unit.source: What happened at the end of the growing season?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotokea baada ya majira ya kupanda?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~29#Question:What happened at the end of the growing season?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~29#Answer:What happened at the end of the growing season?1758601883
trans-unit.source: At the end of the growing season the crop was ready, so the owner harvested it.
trans-unit.target: Mwisho wa majira ya ukuzi, mazao yalikuwa tayari, kwa hiyo mwenye shamba akavuna.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~29#Answer:What happened at the end of the growing season?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.29+Who do you think the owner really is and what did Jesus mean when he talked about the owner harvesting his crop?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~29#Question:Who do you think the owner really is and what did Jesus mean when he talked about the owner harvesting his crop?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think the owner really is and what did Jesus mean when he talked about the owner harvesting his crop?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani hasa mwenye shamba na Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema juu ya mwenye shamba kuvuna mazao yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~29#Question:Who do you think the owner really is and what did Jesus mean when he talked about the owner harvesting his crop?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~29#Answer:Who do you think the owner really is and what did Jesus mean when he talked about the owner harvesting his crop?-2099682784
trans-unit.source: The owner is God. Jesus meant that God will take those people who become his very own to be with him when the time is right. (29)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha kwamba Mungu atawachukua watu hao ambao wanakuwa mali yake mwenyewe ili wakae pamoja naye wakati unaofaa. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~29#Answer:Who do you think the owner really is and what did Jesus mean when he talked about the owner harvesting his crop?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!4~30#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 4:30-34 Jesus explained that the kingdom of God is like a tiny seed that grows into a large shrub.
trans-unit.target: Marko 4:30-34 Yesu alieleza kwamba ufalme wa Mungu ni kama mbegu ndogo inayokua na kuwa kichaka kikubwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 4.30-34+What illustration did Jesus use to show what God was doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~30#Question:What illustration did Jesus use to show what God was doing?
trans-unit.source: What illustration did Jesus use to show what God was doing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia kielezi gani kuonyesha yale ambayo Mungu alikuwa akifanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Question:What illustration did Jesus use to show what God was doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~30#Answer:What illustration did Jesus use to show what God was doing?-307646724
trans-unit.source: He used the illustration of a tiny seed that grew into a tree-size plant. (30-36)
trans-unit.target: Alitumia kielezi cha mbegu ndogo ambayo ilikua ikawa mmea wenye ukubwa wa mti (30-36)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Answer:What illustration did Jesus use to show what God was doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.30-34+What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~30#Question:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni jambo gani muhimu alilokuwa akifundisha kutoka kwenye mti/mti mdogo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Question:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!4~30#Alternate:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?-1914200693
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni jambo gani muhimu alilokuwa akifundisha kutokana na mti huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Alternate:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!4~30#Alternate:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?-197436358
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the shrub?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri jambo muhimu alilofundisha kutoka kwenye kichaka hicho ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Alternate:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~30#Answer:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?650315628
trans-unit.source: He was teaching that at first a small number of people believe Jesus and become God's people. He will rule over them. Gradually God will rule over more and more people as more believe on Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba mwanzoni watu wachache watamwamini Yesu na kuwa watu wa Mungu. Atawatawala. Hatua kwa hatua Mungu atatawala juu ya watu wengi zaidi na zaidi kadiri wanavyoamini juu ya Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Answer:What do you think is the important thing he was teaching from the tree/shrub?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.30+Why did Jesus ask these (rhetorical questions)? Did he not know how to describe the Kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~30#Question:Why did Jesus ask these (rhetorical questions)? Did he not know how to describe the Kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus ask these (rhetorical questions)? Did he not know how to describe the Kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu aliuliza maswali hayo (ya ki-rhetorical)? Je, hakujua jinsi ya kuelezea Ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Question:Why did Jesus ask these (rhetorical questions)? Did he not know how to describe the Kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~30#Answer:Why did Jesus ask these (rhetorical questions)? Did he not know how to describe the Kingdom of God?411270940
trans-unit.source: He knew but he was introducing the topic of the kingdom of God by making people think about it.
trans-unit.target: Alijua lakini alikuwa akianzisha mada ya ufalme wa Mungu kwa kuwafanya watu wafikirie juu yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Answer:Why did Jesus ask these (rhetorical questions)? Did he not know how to describe the Kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.30+About what subject was Jesus teaching here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~30#Question:About what subject was Jesus teaching here?
trans-unit.source: About what subject was Jesus teaching here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha somo gani hapa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Question:About what subject was Jesus teaching here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~30#Answer:About what subject was Jesus teaching here?-311243542
trans-unit.source: He was still teaching about what would happen when God began his new way of ruling over people. (See verse 26.)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa bado akifundisha kuhusu jambo ambalo lingetukia wakati ambapo Mungu angeanza kutawala wanadamu kwa njia mpya (Ona mstari wa 26.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~30#Answer:About what subject was Jesus teaching here?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.31+What is special about a mustard seed that would make Jesus's comparison a good way for him to teach about the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~31#Question:What is special about a mustard seed that would make Jesus's comparison a good way for him to teach about the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: What is special about a mustard seed that would make Jesus's comparison a good way for him to teach about the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilicho cha pekee kuhusu mbegu ya haradali ambacho kingefanya ulinganisho wa Yesu uwe njia nzuri kwake ya kufundisha juu ya ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~31#Question:What is special about a mustard seed that would make Jesus's comparison a good way for him to teach about the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~31#Answer:What is special about a mustard seed that would make Jesus's comparison a good way for him to teach about the kingdom of God?-284366719
trans-unit.source: A mustard seed is very small when it is planted. (31)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu ya haradali ni ndogo sana inapopandwa. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~31#Answer:What is special about a mustard seed that would make Jesus's comparison a good way for him to teach about the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.32+What happens to mustard seed when it grows?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~32#Question:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?
trans-unit.source: What happens to mustard seed when it grows?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hutokea kwa mbegu ya haradali inapoota?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~32#Question:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~32#Answer:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?-1486233994
trans-unit.source: It becomes a large plant with branches big enough for shade for birds.
trans-unit.target: Mti huo unakua na kuwa mmea mkubwa wenye matawi makubwa ya kutosha kwa ndege kupata kivuli.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~32#Answer:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~32#Answer:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~32#Answer:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~32#Answer:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?282559633
trans-unit.source: It becomes a large plant with branches big enough for birds to make their nests there. (32)
trans-unit.target: Inakuwa mmea mkubwa wenye matawi makubwa ya kutosha kwa ndege kujenga viota vyao huko. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~32#Answer:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!4~32#Note:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?-1127060175
trans-unit.source: The translator may want a glossary note to explain that Jesus spoke about the tallest plant in the gardens of Israel, a very dry land. The mustard tree does not compare to the much taller or thicker trees that grow in forests in wetter lands.
trans-unit.target: Huenda mtafsiri akataka maelezo ya fafanuzi ya kufafanua kwamba Yesu alikuwa akizungumza juu ya mmea mrefu zaidi katika bustani za Israeli, nchi kavu sana. Mti wa haradali haulinganishwi na miti mirefu zaidi au yenye unene zaidi inayokua katika misitu katika nchi zenye unyevunyevu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~32#Note:What happens to mustard seed when it grows?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.33-34+What else did Mark tell us about the way that Jesus was teaching people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~33#Question:What else did Mark tell us about the way that Jesus was teaching people?
trans-unit.source: What else did Mark tell us about the way that Jesus was teaching people?
trans-unit.target: Marko anatuambia nini kingine kuhusu njia ambayo Yesu aliwafundisha watu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Question:What else did Mark tell us about the way that Jesus was teaching people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~33#Answer:What else did Mark tell us about the way that Jesus was teaching people?1178050294
trans-unit.source: Jesus used only parables. (33-34)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia mifano tu (33-34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Answer:What else did Mark tell us about the way that Jesus was teaching people?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.33-34+With whom did Jesus use the parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~33#Question:With whom did Jesus use the parables?
trans-unit.source: With whom did Jesus use the parables?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia mifano kwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Question:With whom did Jesus use the parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~33#Answer:With whom did Jesus use the parables?-1747432430
trans-unit.source: He used the parables with the crowds of people who came to hear him.
trans-unit.target: Alitumia mifano hiyo alipozungumza na umati wa watu waliokuja kumsikiliza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Answer:With whom did Jesus use the parables?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!4~33#Note:With whom did Jesus use the parables?371112463
trans-unit.source: Verse 34 shows that these are other people, not his disciples. Other men besides Mark who wrote about this show that Jesus did this with the crowds.
trans-unit.target: Mstari wa 34 waonyesha kwamba hawa ni watu wengine, si wanafunzi wake. Watu wengine zaidi ya Marko walioandika juu ya hili waonyesha kwamba Yesu alifanya hivyo pamoja na makutano.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Note:With whom did Jesus use the parables?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.33+Why did he use only parables with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~33#Question:Why did he use only parables with them?
trans-unit.source: Why did he use only parables with them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alitumia mifano tu pamoja nao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Question:Why did he use only parables with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~33#Answer:Why did he use only parables with them?1322629944
trans-unit.source: He used parables because he only taught people as much as they would understand/accept. (33)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia mifano kwa sababu aliwafundisha watu tu kadiri walivyoweza kuelewa/kuelewa. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Answer:Why did he use only parables with them?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!4~33#Note:Why did he use only parables with them?-842526940
trans-unit.source: They could listen to his parables without being offended. Thinking about these or discussing them with others they could gradually learn more. With their view being so different from what Jesus knew about the kingdom of God and the Messiah his using parables helped to keep them from rejecting him completely and not listening anymore.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na uwezo wa kusikiliza mifano yake bila kukasirika. Kufikiria juu ya haya au kujadili na wengine wangeweza kujifunza zaidi hatua kwa hatua. Kwa kuwa maoni yao yalikuwa tofauti sana na yale Yesu aliyojua juu ya ufalme wa Mungu na Masihi kutumia kwake mifano kuliwasaidia wasimkatae kabisa na wasisikilize tena.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~33#Note:Why did he use only parables with them?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.34+To whom did he explain all of the parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~34#Question:To whom did he explain all of the parables?
trans-unit.source: To whom did he explain all of the parables?
trans-unit.target: Aliwaeleza nani mifano hiyo yote?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~34#Question:To whom did he explain all of the parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~34#Answer:To whom did he explain all of the parables?-1944971209
trans-unit.source: He explained them to his followers. (They really wanted to know and follow his teaching.) (34)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaeleza wafuasi wake (kwa kweli walitaka kujua na kufuata mafundisho yake).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~34#Answer:To whom did he explain all of the parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~35#Question:Where was Jesus at that time?
trans-unit.source: Where was Jesus at that time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa wapi wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~35#Question:Where was Jesus at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~35#Answer:Where was Jesus at that time?1013007951
trans-unit.source: He was in the boat. (4:1, 36)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ndani ya mashua. (4:1, 36)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~35#Answer:Where was Jesus at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.36+What did the disciples do after Jesus said that they should cross over the lake?

trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifanya nini baada ya Yesu kuwaambia kwamba wanapaswa kuvuka ziwa?

trans-unit.source: They started out with him in the boat. (36)
trans-unit.target: Wakaenda naye ndani ya mashua.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~36#Answer:What did the disciples do after Jesus said that they should cross over the lake?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.36+What about the crowd of people that was there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~36#Question:What about the crowd of people that was there?
trans-unit.source: What about the crowd of people that was there?
trans-unit.target: Namna gani umati wa watu waliokuwapo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~36#Question:What about the crowd of people that was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~36#Answer:What about the crowd of people that was there?1681988680
trans-unit.source: Jesus and his disciples left them behind on the shore of the lake. (36)

trans-unit.source: What happened as Jesus and his men were crossing the lake?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu na watu wake walipokuwa wakivuka ziwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~37#Question:What happened as Jesus and his men were crossing the lake?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~37#Answer:What happened as Jesus and his men were crossing the lake?-1382500587
trans-unit.source: The wind became very strong and the waves started filling up the boat. (37)
trans-unit.target: Upepo ukaongezeka sana, mawimbi yakaanza kuijaza mashua. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~37#Answer:What happened as Jesus and his men were crossing the lake?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.38+What was Jesus doing at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~38#Question:What was Jesus doing at that time?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus doing at that time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifanya nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~38#Question:What was Jesus doing at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~38#Answer:What was Jesus doing at that time?1333978078
trans-unit.source: He was asleep in the back part of the boat. (38)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amelala nyuma ya mashua. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~38#Answer:What was Jesus doing at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.38+How did the disciples feel about the storm?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~38#Question:How did the disciples feel about the storm?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples feel about the storm?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walihisije juu ya dhoruba hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~38#Question:How did the disciples feel about the storm?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~38#Answer:How did the disciples feel about the storm?1048950005
trans-unit.source: They were very afraid. They thought that they were about to die. (38)
trans-unit.target: Waliogopa sana, na wakafikiri kwamba walikuwa karibu kufa. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~38#Answer:How did the disciples feel about the storm?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.38+What did they do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~38#Question:What did they do then?
trans-unit.source: What did they do then?
trans-unit.target: Walifanya nini baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~38#Question:What did they do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~38#Answer:What did they do then?-372075380
trans-unit.source: They woke Jesus and complained. They were thinking that he did not care that the storm was about to cause them all to drown/die. (38)
trans-unit.target: Walimwamsha Yesu na kulalamika. Walikuwa wakifikiri kwamba hakujali kwamba dhoruba ilikuwa karibu kuwafanya wote wanywe maji/wafe. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~38#Answer:What did they do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.39+What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~39#Question:What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~39#Question:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~39#Answer:What did Jesus do?-826469470
trans-unit.source: He awoke and told the wind to stop and the waves to be calm. (39)
trans-unit.target: Aliamka na kuamuru upepo ukome na mawimbi yawe shwari. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~39#Answer:What did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.39+What happened then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~39#Question:What happened then?
trans-unit.source: What happened then?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~39#Question:What happened then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~39#Answer:What happened then?-1251269655
trans-unit.source: The storm immediately stopped. (39)
trans-unit.target: Dhoruba hiyo ikakoma mara moja. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~39#Answer:What happened then?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.40+What did Jesus have to say to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~40#Question:What did Jesus have to say to his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus have to say to his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa na jambo gani la kuwaambia wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~40#Question:What did Jesus have to say to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~40#Answer:What did Jesus have to say to his disciples?365921365
trans-unit.source: He rebuked them. (40)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakemea.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~40#Answer:What did Jesus have to say to his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.40+Why did He rebuke them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~40#Question:Why did He rebuke them?
trans-unit.source: Why did He rebuke them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aliwakemea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~40#Question:Why did He rebuke them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~40#Answer:Why did He rebuke them?2002288112
trans-unit.source: He rebuked them because they were afraid, which showed that they did not yet really trust him yet nor realize his power. (40)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakemea kwa sababu walikuwa na hofu, ambayo ilionyesha kwamba bado hawakumwamini wala kutambua nguvu zake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~40#Answer:Why did He rebuke them?

group.id: Q:MRK 4.41+What new thing did the disciples realize about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!4~41#Question:What new thing did the disciples realize about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What new thing did the disciples realize about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walitambua jambo gani jipya juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~41#Question:What new thing did the disciples realize about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!4~41#Answer:What new thing did the disciples realize about Jesus?-752222318
trans-unit.source: Since he could stop the wind and waves by just speaking, they realized that he must be more than an ordinary person. (41)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa angeweza kutuliza upepo na mawimbi kwa kusema tu, walitambua kwamba lazima awe zaidi ya mtu wa kawaida. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!4~41#Answer:What new thing did the disciples realize about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!5~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 5:1-20 Jesus sent many evil spirits out of a man.
trans-unit.target: Marko 5:1-20 Yesu alifukuza roho waovu wengi kutoka kwa mtu mmoja.

group.id: Q:MRK 5.1-20+How did Jesus show God's power in this story?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~1#Question:How did Jesus show God's power in this story?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus show God's power in this story?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyeshaje nguvu ya Mungu katika hadithi hii?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~1#Question:How did Jesus show God's power in this story?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~1#Answer:How did Jesus show God's power in this story?2076318126
trans-unit.source: He sent out many evil spirits from a man (and allowed them to go into a herd of pigs). (2-13)
trans-unit.target: Alifukuza roho waovu wengi kutoka kwa mtu (na kuwaacha waingie katika kundi la nguruwe). (2-13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~1#Answer:How did Jesus show God's power in this story?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.1+Where did Jesus and his disciples go in the boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~1#Question:Where did Jesus and his disciples go in the boat?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus and his disciples go in the boat?
trans-unit.target: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walienda wapi katika mashua?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~1#Question:Where did Jesus and his disciples go in the boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~1#Answer:Where did Jesus and his disciples go in the boat?772232509
trans-unit.source: They went to the Gerasa area. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walienda katika eneo la Gerasa. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~1#Answer:Where did Jesus and his disciples go in the boat?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.2+Who came to meet Jesus as he got out of the boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~2#Question:Who came to meet Jesus as he got out of the boat?
trans-unit.source: Who came to meet Jesus as he got out of the boat?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomlaki Yesu alipotoka kwenye mashua?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~2#Question:Who came to meet Jesus as he got out of the boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~2#Answer:Who came to meet Jesus as he got out of the boat?-81495303
trans-unit.source: A man who was possessed by an evil spirit met Jesus. (2)
trans-unit.target: Mtu aliyekuwa na roho mwovu alikutana na Yesu. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~2#Answer:Who came to meet Jesus as he got out of the boat?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.3-5+What does the text say about this man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~3#Question:What does the text say about this man?
trans-unit.source: What does the text say about this man?
trans-unit.target: Andiko hilo linasema nini kumhusu mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~3#Question:What does the text say about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~3#Answer:What does the text say about this man?509891779
trans-unit.source: He lived in tombs (that is, caves where people were buried). (3)
trans-unit.target: Aliishi katika makaburi (yaani, mapango ambamo watu walizikwa). (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~3#Answer:What does the text say about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~3#Answer:What does the text say about this man?1274018463
trans-unit.source: Whenever people had tried to tie him up, he had broken the chains or ropes they used. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Kila mara watu walipokuwa wamejaribu kumfunga, alikuwa ameivunja minyororo au kamba waliyotumia (3-4).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~3#Answer:What does the text say about this man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~3#Answer:What does the text say about this man?-1924550647
trans-unit.source: He cried out loudly and cut himself with stones. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alipiga kelele na kujikata-kata kwa mawe. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~3#Answer:What does the text say about this man?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.6+What did the man do when he saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~6#Question:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the man do when he saw Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alifanya nini alipomwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~6#Question:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~6#Answer:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?-690673680
trans-unit.source: He ran to Jesus, knelt in front of him and worshipped him. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alikimbia kwa Yesu, akapiga magoti mbele yake na kumwabudu. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~6#Answer:What did the man do when he saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.6-8+What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~6#Question:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu hufanya nini anapoabudu mtu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~6#Question:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~6#Answer:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?1659417007
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He shows great honor and deep respect for the other person. He acts as though that person has more authority or strength or wisdom or goodness or beauty than any other human, and so is like God. (See Louw & Nida entry 53.14 and those at 53.53-64.)
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Yeye huonyesha heshima kubwa na heshima kubwa kwa mtu mwingine. Yeye hutenda kana kwamba mtu huyo ana mamlaka zaidi au nguvu au hekima au wema au uzuri kuliko mwanadamu mwingine yeyote, na hivyo ni kama Mungu. (Ona Louw & Nida entry 53.14 na wale katika 53.53-64.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~6#Answer:What do you think that a person does when he worships another person?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.7+How do we know that the man knew who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~7#Question:How do we know that the man knew who Jesus was?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that the man knew who Jesus was?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba mtu huyo alijua Yesu ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~7#Question:How do we know that the man knew who Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~7#Answer:How do we know that the man knew who Jesus was?834030332
trans-unit.source: He called Jesus the Son of God. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita Yesu Mwana wa Mungu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~7#Answer:How do we know that the man knew who Jesus was?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.7+How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~7#Question:How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba mtu huyo aliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~7#Question:How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~7#Answer:How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?-1862303268
trans-unit.source: He was afraid of what Jesus might do to him. (7)
trans-unit.target: Aliogopa kile ambacho Yesu angemfanyia. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~7#Answer:How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!5~7#Note:How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?593210981
trans-unit.source: Actually, it was the evil spirits within him who were afraid of what Jesus might do to them.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kweli, roho waovu waliokuwa ndani yake ndio waliogopa yale ambayo Yesu angeweza kuwafanyia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~7#Note:How do we know that the man believed that Jesus had power?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.8+What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~8#Question:What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?
trans-unit.source: What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amesema nini kilichomfanya mtu huyo (na roho mwovu aliyekuwa ndani yake) aseme, "Usinitese"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~8#Question:What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~8#Answer:What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?264804451
trans-unit.source: Jesus already had commanded the evil spirit to come out of the man. (8)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa tayari ameamuru roho mwovu atoke ndani ya mtu huyo. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~8#Answer:What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!5~8#Note:What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?-1698974010
trans-unit.source: In verse 8, Mark was telling what happened even before the events in verse 7. If the translation here causes confusion, the translator could move verse 8 and its events to first position and then put those of verse 7 following that. The verse number should then be combined as 7-8.
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 8, Marko alikuwa akieleza mambo yaliyotukia hata kabla ya matukio katika mstari wa 7. Ikiwa tafsiri hapa inasababisha mvurugo, mtafsiri angeweza kuhamisha mstari wa 8 na matukio yake kwenye nafasi ya kwanza na kisha kuweka yale ya mstari wa 7 baada ya hapo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~8#Note:What had Jesus said that caused the man (and the evil spirit in him) to say, "Do not torture me"?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.9+What question did Jesus ask the evil spirit in the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~9#Question:What question did Jesus ask the evil spirit in the man?
trans-unit.source: What question did Jesus ask the evil spirit in the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza swali gani roho mwovu aliyekuwa ndani ya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~9#Question:What question did Jesus ask the evil spirit in the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~9#Answer:What question did Jesus ask the evil spirit in the man?237396846
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked him what his name was. (9)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza jina lake. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~9#Answer:What question did Jesus ask the evil spirit in the man?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.9+What did the evil spirit say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~9#Question:What did the evil spirit say?
trans-unit.source: What did the evil spirit say?
trans-unit.target: Roho mwovu alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~9#Question:What did the evil spirit say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~9#Answer:What did the evil spirit say?1788707803
trans-unit.source: The evil spirit said that his name was legion (that is, many), because there were many evil spirits in the man. (9)
trans-unit.target: Roho yule mwovu akasema jina lake ni Legioni (yaani, wengi), kwa sababu kulikuwa na roho waovu wengi ndani ya mtu huyo. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~9#Answer:What did the evil spirit say?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.12+Since these evil spirits knew that they had to leave the man, where did they want to go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~12#Question:Since these evil spirits knew that they had to leave the man, where did they want to go?
trans-unit.source: Since these evil spirits knew that they had to leave the man, where did they want to go?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa roho hao waovu walijua kwamba walipaswa kumwacha mtu huyo, walitaka kwenda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~12#Question:Since these evil spirits knew that they had to leave the man, where did they want to go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~12#Answer:Since these evil spirits knew that they had to leave the man, where did they want to go?-1411299041
trans-unit.source: They did not want to go far away. They asked that Jesus allow them to go into some pigs that were nearby. (12)
trans-unit.target: Hawakutaka kwenda mbali. walimsihi Yesu awape ruhusa kuingia katika baadhi ya nguruwe waliokuwa karibu. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~12#Answer:Since these evil spirits knew that they had to leave the man, where did they want to go?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.13+What happened then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~13#Question:What happened then?
trans-unit.source: What happened then?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~13#Question:What happened then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~13#Answer:What happened then?-1762719570
trans-unit.source: Jesus agreed that the evil spirits could go into the pigs, and they did so.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikubali roho waovu hao waingie ndani ya nguruwe, nao wakaingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~13#Answer:What happened then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~13#Answer:What happened then?-952358745
trans-unit.source: Then the whole herd of pigs ran down a steep incline into the sea, where they drowned. (13)
trans-unit.target: Kisha kundi lote la nguruwe likashuka kwa kasi kwenye mwinuko wa bahari na kuzama.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~13#Answer:What happened then?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.14-15+What did the people who looked after the pigs do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~14#Question:What did the people who looked after the pigs do?
trans-unit.source: What did the people who looked after the pigs do?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliowatunza nguruwe walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Question:What did the people who looked after the pigs do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~14#Answer:What did the people who looked after the pigs do?-356404404
trans-unit.source: They went and told the people around there what had happened.
trans-unit.target: Nao wakaenda wakawaambia watu wote wa nchi ile.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Answer:What did the people who looked after the pigs do?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.14+What did those people do when they heard about it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~14#Question:What did those people do when they heard about it?
trans-unit.source: What did those people do when they heard about it?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walifanya nini waliposikia juu ya hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Question:What did those people do when they heard about it?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~14#Answer:What did those people do when they heard about it?1449478704
trans-unit.source: Many (of those) people went out to see what had happened. (14)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi (wa hao) walitoka kwenda kuona kilichokuwa kimetukia. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Answer:What did those people do when they heard about it?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.15+What did they notice about the man that the evil spirits had continually tormented?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~15#Question:What did they notice about the man that the evil spirits had continually tormented?
trans-unit.source: What did they notice about the man that the evil spirits had continually tormented?
trans-unit.target: Waliona nini kumhusu mtu huyo ambaye roho waovu walikuwa wamemtesa daima?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~15#Question:What did they notice about the man that the evil spirits had continually tormented?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~15#Answer:What did they notice about the man that the evil spirits had continually tormented?-442761092
trans-unit.source: They could see that the demons/evil spirits had left him and he was dressed and completely well. (15)
trans-unit.target: Waliweza kuona kwamba roho waovu walikuwa wamemtoka na alikuwa amevaa na alikuwa na afya nzuri kabisa. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~15#Answer:What did they notice about the man that the evil spirits had continually tormented?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.14-15+Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~14#Question:Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu waliogopa walipoona hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Question:Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~14#Answer:Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?-1687683177
trans-unit.source: They knew how strong the evil spirits had been in the man and realized that Jesus was very powerful.
trans-unit.target: Walijua jinsi roho waovu walivyokuwa na nguvu na walitambua kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu nyingi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Answer:Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!5~14#Note:Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?1164964189
trans-unit.source: There may be other reasonable answers besides this one.
trans-unit.target: Huenda kukawa na majibu mengine yenye kupatana na akili mbali na hili.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~14#Note:Why do you think that the people were afraid when they saw this?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.16+How did the people who came later learn more about what had happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~16#Question:How did the people who came later learn more about what had happened?
trans-unit.source: How did the people who came later learn more about what had happened?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliokuja baadaye walijifunzaje zaidi juu ya kilichokuwa kimetukia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~16#Question:How did the people who came later learn more about what had happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~16#Answer:How did the people who came later learn more about what had happened?-557625951
trans-unit.source: Those who had seen it happen told them about it. (16)
trans-unit.target: Na wale walioona waliwaambia habari zake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~16#Answer:How did the people who came later learn more about what had happened?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.17+What did the people want Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~17#Question:What did the people want Jesus to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the people want Jesus to do?
trans-unit.target: Watu walitaka Yesu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~17#Question:What did the people want Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~17#Answer:What did the people want Jesus to do?-1425678704
trans-unit.source: They begged him to go away. (17)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakamsihi aondoke kwao. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~17#Answer:What did the people want Jesus to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.18+How do we know that Jesus agreed to leave there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~18#Question:How do we know that Jesus agreed to leave there?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus agreed to leave there?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba Yesu alikubali kuondoka huko?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Question:How do we know that Jesus agreed to leave there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~18#Answer:How do we know that Jesus agreed to leave there?518501680
trans-unit.source: He got into the boat. (18)
trans-unit.target: Alipanda ndani ya mashua. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Answer:How do we know that Jesus agreed to leave there?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.18+What did the man whom evil spirits had possessed ask of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~18#Question:What did the man whom evil spirits had possessed ask of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the man whom evil spirits had possessed ask of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mtu aliyekuwa na roho waovu alimwomba Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Question:What did the man whom evil spirits had possessed ask of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~18#Answer:What did the man whom evil spirits had possessed ask of Jesus?-1884231122
trans-unit.source: He asked Jesus to allow him to go with Jesus. (18)
trans-unit.target: Alimwomba Yesu amruhusu aende pamoja na Yesu. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Answer:What did the man whom evil spirits had possessed ask of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.18-20+What did Jesus tell him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~18#Question:What did Jesus tell him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Question:What did Jesus tell him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~18#Answer:What did Jesus tell him?-587531157
trans-unit.source: Jesus told him to go home and tell his own people about God having had compassion on him and helping him. (19)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia aende nyumbani na kuwaambia watu wake mwenyewe juu ya Mungu kuwa amemhurumia na kumsaidia. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Answer:What did Jesus tell him?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!5~18#Note:What did Jesus tell him?-773149862
trans-unit.source: Jesus had deep feelings of genuine compassion and loving concern for the man, and thus helped him out of his situation. (See "mercy" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa na hisia za ndani za huruma ya kweli na hangaiko lenye upendo kwa mtu huyo, na hivyo akamsaidia kutoka katika hali yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~18#Note:What did Jesus tell him?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.20+What did the man do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~20#Question:What did the man do?
trans-unit.source: What did the man do?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~20#Question:What did the man do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~20#Answer:What did the man do?1270274993
trans-unit.source: He went around that whole area telling people what Jesus had done for him. (20)
trans-unit.target: Akaenda akizungukia nchi ile yote, akihubiri ni mambo gani Yesu aliyomtendea.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~20#Answer:What did the man do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!5~21#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 5:21-43 Jesus healed a sick woman and raised a dead girl back to life.
trans-unit.target: Marko 5:21-43 Yesu alimponya mwanamke mgonjwa na kumfufua msichana aliyekufa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 5.21-43+In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~21#Question:In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?
trans-unit.source: In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha nguvu za Mungu katika njia gani mbili?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Question:In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~21#Answer:In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?1442244962
trans-unit.source: He healed a woman (whom doctors had not made better in 12 years) (25-34),
trans-unit.target: Alimponya mwanamke (ambaye madaktari hawakuwa wamemponya kwa miaka 12) (25-34),
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Answer:In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~21#Answer:In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?-1888348791
trans-unit.source: and raised a dead girl back to life (21-24a, 35-43).
trans-unit.target: na akamfufua msichana aliyekufa (21-24a, 35-43).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Answer:In what two ways did Jesus show God's power?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.21+Where did Jesus go next?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~21#Question:Where did Jesus go next?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go next?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Question:Where did Jesus go next?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~21#Answer:Where did Jesus go next?-301060256
trans-unit.source: He went across the lake. (21)
trans-unit.target: Alivuka ziwa. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Answer:Where did Jesus go next?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.21+What happened when he arrived?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~21#Question:What happened when he arrived?
trans-unit.source: What happened when he arrived?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia alipowasili?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Question:What happened when he arrived?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~21#Answer:What happened when he arrived?-234526393
trans-unit.source: A crowd gathered around him. (21)
trans-unit.target: Umati ukakusanyika kumzunguka.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~21#Answer:What happened when he arrived?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.22+Then who came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~22#Question:Then who came to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Then who came to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Basi ni nani aliyemwendea Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~22#Question:Then who came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~22#Answer:Then who came to Jesus?1022308537
trans-unit.source: Jairus, a leader of a synagogue came to Jesus. (22)
trans-unit.target: Yairo, kiongozi wa sinagogi alimjia Yesu. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~22#Answer:Then who came to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.23+What did Jairus ask Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~23#Question:What did Jairus ask Jesus to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jairus ask Jesus to do?
trans-unit.target: Yairo alimwomba Yesu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~23#Question:What did Jairus ask Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~23#Answer:What did Jairus ask Jesus to do?1404948025
trans-unit.source: Jairus asked Jesus to go with him to his house to touch and heal his daughter who was about to die. (23)
trans-unit.target: Yairo alimwomba Yesu aende naye nyumbani kwake ili amguse na kumponya binti yake aliyekuwa karibu kufa. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~23#Answer:What did Jairus ask Jesus to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.23+How was Jairus feeling at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~23#Question:How was Jairus feeling at that time?
trans-unit.source: How was Jairus feeling at that time?
trans-unit.target: Yairo alihisije wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~23#Question:How was Jairus feeling at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~23#Answer:How was Jairus feeling at that time?2103451644
trans-unit.source: He was very concerned and begged Jesus to help him. (23)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na wasiwasi sana na akamsihi Yesu amsaidie. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~23#Answer:How was Jairus feeling at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.24+What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~24#Question:What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~24#Question:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~24#Answer:What did Jesus do?-2042736585
trans-unit.source: He started to go to Jairus's house. (24)
trans-unit.target: Anaanza kwenda nyumbani kwa Yairo. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~24#Answer:What did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.24+Did anyone else go with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~24#Question:Did anyone else go with them?
trans-unit.source: Did anyone else go with them?
trans-unit.target: Je, kuna mtu mwingine aliyeenda pamoja nao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~24#Question:Did anyone else go with them?
