trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~24#Answer:Did anyone else go with them?-1257544524
trans-unit.source: Yes. There was a large crowd of people pushing all around them. (24)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. Umati mkubwa wa watu ulikuwa ukiwakaribia. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~24#Answer:Did anyone else go with them?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.25+What was wrong with the woman in the crowd?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~25#Question:What was wrong with the woman in the crowd?
trans-unit.source: What was wrong with the woman in the crowd?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo aliyekuwa katika umati alikuwa na tatizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~25#Question:What was wrong with the woman in the crowd?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~25#Answer:What was wrong with the woman in the crowd?684596890
trans-unit.source: She had not stopped bleeding for twelve years. (25)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amekuwa na mtiririko wa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~25#Answer:What was wrong with the woman in the crowd?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.26+Had she been to doctors?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~26#Question:Had she been to doctors?
trans-unit.source: Had she been to doctors?
trans-unit.target: Je, alikuwa ameenda kwa madaktari?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~26#Question:Had she been to doctors?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~26#Answer:Had she been to doctors?-772783008
trans-unit.source: Yes, and she had spent all her money on them, but they did not help her. (26)
trans-unit.target: Naam, na alikuwa ametumia mali yake yote juu yao, lakini hawakumsaidia. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~26#Answer:Had she been to doctors?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.27+What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~27#Question:What did the woman do?
trans-unit.source: What did the woman do?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~27#Question:What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~27#Answer:What did the woman do?1585525140
trans-unit.source: She came up behind Jesus and touched his clothes. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alijaribu kutoka nyuma ya Yesu na kugusa vazi lake (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~27#Answer:What did the woman do?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.28+Why did she do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~28#Question:Why did she do that?
trans-unit.source: Why did she do that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alifanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~28#Question:Why did she do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~28#Answer:Why did she do that?-584734140
trans-unit.source: She did that because she thought if she did that, she would be healed. (28)
trans-unit.target: Alifanya hivyo kwa sababu alifikiri kwamba kwa kufanya hivyo, angeponywa. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~28#Answer:Why did she do that?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.29+Was she healed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~29#Question:Was she healed?
trans-unit.source: Was she healed?
trans-unit.target: Je, aliponywa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~29#Question:Was she healed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~29#Answer:Was she healed?-2045071520
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~29#Answer:Was she healed?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.29+How did she know it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~29#Question:How did she know it?
trans-unit.source: How did she know it?
trans-unit.target: Alijuaje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~29#Question:How did she know it?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~29#Answer:How did she know it?-1743462939
trans-unit.source: She felt a change in her body. (29)
trans-unit.target: Alihisi mabadiliko katika mwili wake. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~29#Answer:How did she know it?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.30+Did Jesus know that something had happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~30#Question:Did Jesus know that something had happened?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus know that something had happened?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alijua kwamba jambo fulani lilikuwa limetukia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~30#Question:Did Jesus know that something had happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~30#Answer:Did Jesus know that something had happened?1918508663
trans-unit.source: Yes. Jesus felt healing power going to someone. (30)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. Yesu alihisi nguvu ya uponyaji ikienda kwa mtu fulani. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~30#Answer:Did Jesus know that something had happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~30#Answer:Did Jesus know that something had happened?-862249090
trans-unit.source: (Check that "power passing from him" does not seem to indicate that his healing of her left him with less power than before.)
trans-unit.target: (Ona kwamba "nguvu zikamwacha" hazionekani kuonyesha kwamba kuponywa kwake hakukumwacha akiwa na nguvu kidogo kuliko hapo awali.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~30#Answer:Did Jesus know that something had happened?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.31+How did his disciples answer Jesus's question about who had touched him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~31#Question:How did his disciples answer Jesus's question about who had touched him?
trans-unit.source: How did his disciples answer Jesus's question about who had touched him?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wake waliitikiaje swali la Yesu juu ya ni nani aliyekuwa amemgusa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~31#Question:How did his disciples answer Jesus's question about who had touched him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~31#Answer:How did his disciples answer Jesus's question about who had touched him?1559115159
trans-unit.source: They were surprised that he had asked such a question. They said that many were pushing around him. Therefore some would touch him. (31)
trans-unit.target: Wakashangaa kwamba aliuliza swali kama hilo. Walisema kwamba watu wengi walikuwa wakimzunguka. Kwa hiyo wengine wangemgusa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~31#Answer:How did his disciples answer Jesus's question about who had touched him?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.33+What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~33#Question:What did the woman do?
trans-unit.source: What did the woman do?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~33#Question:What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~33#Answer:What did the woman do?1852966721
trans-unit.source: She was very worried but came and told Jesus what she had done. (33)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na wasiwasi sana lakini akaja na kumwambia Yesu kile alichokuwa amefanya (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~33#Answer:What did the woman do?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.34+What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~34#Question:What did Jesus say to the woman?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mwanamke huyo nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~34#Question:What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~34#Answer:What did Jesus say to the woman?-1952963920
trans-unit.source: He assured her of God's peacefulness in her life and told her that her believing in him had enabled him to heal her. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alimhakikishia amani ya Mungu katika maisha yake na kumwambia kwamba imani yake kwake ilimwezesha kumponya. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~34#Answer:What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!5~34#Note:What did Jesus say to the woman?1262221746
trans-unit.source: (See "peace" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: (Ona "amani" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~34#Note:What did Jesus say to the woman?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.35+What message did the men from Jairus's house bring?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~35#Question:What message did the men from Jairus's house bring?
trans-unit.source: What message did the men from Jairus's house bring?
trans-unit.target: Watu kutoka nyumba ya Yairo walileta ujumbe gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~35#Question:What message did the men from Jairus's house bring?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~35#Answer:What message did the men from Jairus's house bring?-1038163233
trans-unit.source: They brought the news that Jairus's daughter had already died. (35)
trans-unit.target: Walileta habari kwamba binti ya Yairo alikuwa amekufa tayari. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~35#Answer:What message did the men from Jairus's house bring?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.36+What did Jesus say to Jairus then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~36#Question:What did Jesus say to Jairus then?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to Jairus then?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Yairo nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~36#Question:What did Jesus say to Jairus then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~36#Answer:What did Jesus say to Jairus then?1712070151
trans-unit.source: Jesus said, "Do not fear, just believe (that is, keep on trusting in me)." (36)
trans-unit.target: (Yule mtoto) akasema: Usiogope, amini tu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~36#Answer:What did Jesus say to Jairus then?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.37+Whom did Jesus allow to go with them to Jairus's house?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~37#Question:Whom did Jesus allow to go with them to Jairus's house?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus allow to go with them to Jairus's house?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliruhusu nani waende pamoja naye nyumbani kwa Yairo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~37#Question:Whom did Jesus allow to go with them to Jairus's house?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~37#Answer:Whom did Jesus allow to go with them to Jairus's house?721772308
trans-unit.source: Jesus allowed only Peter, James and John to go with them. (37)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliruhusu Petro, Yakobo na Yohana tu waende pamoja nao. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~37#Answer:Whom did Jesus allow to go with them to Jairus's house?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.38+What was happening at Jairus's house?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~38#Question:What was happening at Jairus's house?
trans-unit.source: What was happening at Jairus's house?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia katika nyumba ya Yairo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~38#Question:What was happening at Jairus's house?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~38#Answer:What was happening at Jairus's house?1774308461
trans-unit.source: People there were crying and mourning. (38)
trans-unit.target: Watu walikuwa wakilia na kuomboleza. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~38#Answer:What was happening at Jairus's house?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.39+Why did the people laugh at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~39#Question:Why did the people laugh at Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did the people laugh at Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walimcheka Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~39#Question:Why did the people laugh at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~39#Answer:Why did the people laugh at Jesus?1555676886
trans-unit.source: He had said that Jairus's daughter was asleep. They knew that she was really dead not just sleeping, so they ridiculed him. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amesema kwamba binti ya Yairo alikuwa amelala. Walijua kwamba alikuwa amekufa kweli kweli si kulala tu, kwa hiyo wakamdhihaki. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~39#Answer:Why did the people laugh at Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.37-40+Do you think that Jesus thought that she had not died?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~37#Question:Do you think that Jesus thought that she had not died?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jesus thought that she had not died?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alifikiri kwamba hakuwa amekufa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~37#Question:Do you think that Jesus thought that she had not died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~37#Answer:Do you think that Jesus thought that she had not died?1431472494
trans-unit.source: No. He knew she had died.
trans-unit.target: La, alijua kwamba alikuwa amekufa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~37#Answer:Do you think that Jesus thought that she had not died?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.37-40+Why do you think that he said she was sleeping?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~37#Question:Why do you think that he said she was sleeping?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that he said she was sleeping?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini alisema kwamba alikuwa akilala?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~37#Question:Why do you think that he said she was sleeping?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~37#Answer:Why do you think that he said she was sleeping?726708847
trans-unit.source: He probably said that because he knew that she would soon be alive again.
trans-unit.target: Huenda alisema hivyo kwa sababu alijua kwamba binti yake angefufuliwa baada ya muda mfupi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~37#Answer:Why do you think that he said she was sleeping?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.40-41+What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~40#Question:What did Jesus do then?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do then?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~40#Question:What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~40#Answer:What did Jesus do then?-307989358
trans-unit.source: He sent most of the people out of the room. He then took the girl by the hand and commanded her to wake up. (40-41)
trans-unit.target: Kisha, baada ya kuwafukuza watu wengi chumbani, akamshika msichana huyo mkono na kumwamuru amwamshe (40-41).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~40#Answer:What did Jesus do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.42+Then what happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~42#Question:Then what happened?
trans-unit.source: Then what happened?
trans-unit.target: Kisha ni nini kilichotokea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~42#Question:Then what happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~42#Answer:Then what happened?-819556069
trans-unit.source: The girl came to life and stood up. (42)
trans-unit.target: Msichana huyo akawa hai na kusimama. (42)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~42#Answer:Then what happened?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.42+Was the girl big enough to stand up by herself?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~42#Question:Was the girl big enough to stand up by herself?
trans-unit.source: Was the girl big enough to stand up by herself?
trans-unit.target: Je, msichana huyo alikuwa mkubwa vya kutosha kusimama peke yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~42#Question:Was the girl big enough to stand up by herself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~42#Answer:Was the girl big enough to stand up by herself?1886558528
trans-unit.source: Yes. She was twelve years old. (42)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. Alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili. (42)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~42#Answer:Was the girl big enough to stand up by herself?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.42+What was the reaction of her parents?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~42#Question:What was the reaction of her parents?
trans-unit.source: What was the reaction of her parents?
trans-unit.target: Wazazi wake waliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~42#Question:What was the reaction of her parents?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~42#Answer:What was the reaction of her parents?-757188496
trans-unit.source: Her parents were amazed. (42)
trans-unit.target: Wazazi wake walishangaa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~42#Answer:What was the reaction of her parents?

group.id: Q:MRK 5.43+What did Jesus tell her parents to do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!5~43#Question:What did Jesus tell her parents to do then?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell her parents to do then?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wazazi wake wafanye nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~43#Question:What did Jesus tell her parents to do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!5~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell her parents to do then?758991408
trans-unit.source: They were not to tell anyone, but to give her something to eat. (43)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwambia mtu ye yote asijue habari hiyo, ila wampe chakula.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!5~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell her parents to do then?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!6~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 6:1-6 Jesus went to his own town but the people rejected him.
trans-unit.target: Marko 6:1-6 Yesu alienda kwenye mji wake mwenyewe lakini watu walimkataa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 6.1-6+How did the people of Jesus's home town feel about him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~1#Question:How did the people of Jesus's home town feel about him?
trans-unit.source: How did the people of Jesus's home town feel about him?
trans-unit.target: Watu wa mji wa nyumbani wa Yesu walihisije juu yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Question:How did the people of Jesus's home town feel about him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~1#Answer:How did the people of Jesus's home town feel about him?-197662831
trans-unit.source: Many people were impressed with him, but then they rejected him anyway. (2-3)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi walivutiwa naye, lakini walimkataa hata hivyo (2-3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Answer:How did the people of Jesus's home town feel about him?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.1-6+What caused them to decide to reject him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~1#Question:What caused them to decide to reject him?
trans-unit.source: What caused them to decide to reject him?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowafanya waamue kumkataa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Question:What caused them to decide to reject him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~1#Answer:What caused them to decide to reject him?1114777688
trans-unit.source: They knew that the members of his family were just ordinary people. Therefore they did not believe that he could be anyone special. (2-3)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba washiriki wa familia yake walikuwa watu wa kawaida tu. Kwa hiyo hawakuamini kwamba angeweza kuwa mtu wa pekee. (2-3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Answer:What caused them to decide to reject him?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.1-4+Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~1#Question:Where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Question:Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~1#Answer:Where did Jesus go?819677033
trans-unit.source: He went to his hometown where his family lived and where he had grown up.
trans-unit.target: Alienda kwenye mji wa kwao ambako familia yake iliishi na ambako alikuwa amelelewa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Answer:Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~1#Note:Where did Jesus go?1250543557
trans-unit.source: This was not the place where he was born.
trans-unit.target: Hapo si mahali alipozaliwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Note:Where did Jesus go?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.2-3+What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~2#Question:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?
trans-unit.source: What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?
trans-unit.target: Watu wa mji wa nyumbani wa Yesu walifikiri nini juu yake, mafundisho yake, na miujiza yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~2#Question:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~2#Answer:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?931636961
trans-unit.source: They were amazed by his teaching and miracles;
trans-unit.target: Watu walishangazwa na mafundisho yake na miujiza yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~2#Answer:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~2#Answer:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?64265003
trans-unit.source: but they knew that he and his family were some of their own village people.
trans-unit.target: lakini walijua kwamba yeye na familia yake walikuwa baadhi ya watu wa kijiji chao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~2#Answer:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~2#Answer:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?154261336
trans-unit.source: Therefore they thought that he could not be an important person with important teaching. (2-3)
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo walifikiri kwamba hawezi kuwa mtu muhimu mwenye mafundisho muhimu. (2-3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~2#Answer:What did the people of Jesus's home town think about him, his teaching, and his miracles?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.1-4+Did Jesus know how they felt?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~1#Question:Did Jesus know how they felt?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus know how they felt?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alijua jinsi walivyohisi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Question:Did Jesus know how they felt?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~1#Answer:Did Jesus know how they felt?-13935755
trans-unit.source: Yes, he knew.
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, alijua.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~1#Answer:Did Jesus know how they felt?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.4+What did he say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~4#Question:What did he say?
trans-unit.source: What did he say?
trans-unit.target: Alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~4#Question:What did he say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~4#Answer:What did he say?-1242059959
trans-unit.source: He quoted a saying his people had saying, "Prophets are honored everywhere except in their own home town and among their own people." (4)
trans-unit.target: Alitoa mfano wa maneno ya watu wake waliosema: "Nabii anaheshimiwa kila mahali isipokuwa katika nchi yake mwenyewe na miongoni mwa watu wake mwenyewe". (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~4#Answer:What did he say?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.5+What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~5#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu hakufanya miujiza mingi katika mji wa kwao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~5#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?1275663103
trans-unit.source: The people refused to believe that God had sent him. (5)
trans-unit.target: Watu walikataa kuamini kwamba alikuwa ametumwa na Mungu. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?96814142
trans-unit.source: The people knew him when he was a small boy, so they did not honor him as God's prophet. (5)
trans-unit.target: Watu walimjua tangu alipokuwa mvulana mdogo, kwa hiyo hawakumheshimu kuwa nabii wa Mungu. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~5#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there in his home town?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.5+What had he been able to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~5#Question:What had he been able to do?
trans-unit.source: What had he been able to do?
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ameweza kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~5#Question:What had he been able to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~5#Answer:What had he been able to do?-373412796
trans-unit.source: He did heal a few sick people. (5)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaponya wagonjwa wachache. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~5#Answer:What had he been able to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.6+How did Jesus feel about the people's reaction to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~6#Question:How did Jesus feel about the people's reaction to him?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus feel about the people's reaction to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alihisije juu ya itikio la watu kwake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~6#Question:How did Jesus feel about the people's reaction to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~6#Answer:How did Jesus feel about the people's reaction to him?417913347
trans-unit.source: He was really surprised that they did not believe in him. (6)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kweli alishangaa kwamba hawakumwamini (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~6#Answer:How did Jesus feel about the people's reaction to him?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!6~7#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 6:7-13 Jesus sent out his twelve disciples to preach the gospel and do his work.
trans-unit.target: Marko 6:7-13 Yesu aliwatuma wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kuhubiri injili na kufanya kazi yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 6.7-13+What does this section tell us about Jesus's work and his influencing people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~7#Question:What does this section tell us about Jesus's work and his influencing people?
trans-unit.source: What does this section tell us about Jesus's work and his influencing people?
trans-unit.target: Sehemu hii yatuambia nini juu ya kazi ya Yesu na uvutano wake juu ya watu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Question:What does this section tell us about Jesus's work and his influencing people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~7#Answer:What does this section tell us about Jesus's work and his influencing people?-129226042
trans-unit.source: He had taught and given power/authority to his disciples so that they could teach and help others much as he did. In that way, many more people became aware of what he was doing.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amewafundisha na kuwapa nguvu/mamlaka wanafunzi wake ili waweze kufundisha na kuwasaidia wengine kama alivyofanya. Kwa njia hiyo, watu wengi zaidi walifahamu kile alichokuwa akifanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Answer:What does this section tell us about Jesus's work and his influencing people?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.7-9+Whom did Jesus call to come to him at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~7#Question:Whom did Jesus call to come to him at that time?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus call to come to him at that time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaita nani waje kwake wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Question:Whom did Jesus call to come to him at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~7#Answer:Whom did Jesus call to come to him at that time?-1169459628
trans-unit.source: He called together his twelve disciples whom he had chosen.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaita wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili ambao alikuwa amewachagua.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Answer:Whom did Jesus call to come to him at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.7-9+Why did Jesus send them away?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~7#Question:Why did Jesus send them away?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus send them away?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu aliwafukuza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Question:Why did Jesus send them away?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~7#Answer:Why did Jesus send them away?976645374
trans-unit.source: He sent them to do his work.
trans-unit.target: Aliwatuma wafanye kazi yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Answer:Why did Jesus send them away?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~7#Note:Why did Jesus send them away?-397265852
trans-unit.source: We will ask about more specific information later, but check here that the respondents understand that Jesus was sending them to work for him, not just sending them away.
trans-unit.target: Tutauliza habari zaidi maalum baadaye, lakini angalia hapa kwamba waliohojiwa wanaelewa kuwa Yesu alikuwa akiwapeleka kufanya kazi kwake, sio tu kuwapeleka mbali.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Note:Why did Jesus send them away?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.7+Did Jesus say that the twelve disciples should travel together?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~7#Question:Did Jesus say that the twelve disciples should travel together?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus say that the twelve disciples should travel together?
trans-unit.target: Je! Yesu alisema kwamba wanafunzi kumi na wawili wapaswa kusafiri pamoja?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Question:Did Jesus say that the twelve disciples should travel together?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~7#Answer:Did Jesus say that the twelve disciples should travel together?2043626544
trans-unit.source: No. He said that they should go in groups of two. (7)
trans-unit.target: La, alisema kwamba wanapaswa kwenda katika vikundi vya watu wawili-wawili.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Answer:Did Jesus say that the twelve disciples should travel together?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.7+What special authority did Jesus give his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~7#Question:What special authority did Jesus give his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What special authority did Jesus give his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa wanafunzi wake mamlaka gani ya pekee?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Question:What special authority did Jesus give his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~7#Answer:What special authority did Jesus give his disciples?1560748950
trans-unit.source: He gave them authority to use God's power to send evil spirits out of people. (7)
trans-unit.target: Aliwapa mamlaka ya kutumia nguvu za Mungu kuwatoa pepo wabaya kutoka kwa watu. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~7#Answer:What special authority did Jesus give his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.8-9+What are some of the things Jesus told the disciples they could and could not take with them on their journey?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~8#Question:What are some of the things Jesus told the disciples they could and could not take with them on their journey?
trans-unit.source: What are some of the things Jesus told the disciples they could and could not take with them on their journey?
trans-unit.target: Ni baadhi ya vitu gani ambavyo Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wangeweza na hawangeweza kuchukua pamoja nao katika safari yao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~8#Question:What are some of the things Jesus told the disciples they could and could not take with them on their journey?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~8#Answer:What are some of the things Jesus told the disciples they could and could not take with them on their journey?1612334763
trans-unit.source: They were not to carry food or money or extra clothes with them, only their walking stick. They could wear sandals on their feet. (8-9)
trans-unit.target: Hawakupaswa kuchukua chakula wala fedha wala mavazi ya ziada pamoja nao, ila fimbo yao ya kutembea. Wangeweza kuvaa viatu miguuni mwao (8-9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~8#Answer:What are some of the things Jesus told the disciples they could and could not take with them on their journey?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.10-11+If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~10#Question:If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?
trans-unit.source: If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa wanafunzi hawakuchukua chakula au pesa au mavazi ya ziada, ni nani angeyatunza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~10#Question:If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~10#Note:If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?1035295305
trans-unit.source: Wherever they went and taught, their hosts were to provide their food and other things.
trans-unit.target: Popote walipoenda na kufundisha, wenyeji wao walipaswa kuwaandalia chakula na vitu vingine.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~10#Note:If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~10#Note:If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?626772401
trans-unit.source: If they refused to do that, then the disciples should go to another place.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa walikataa kufanya hivyo, basi wanafunzi walipaswa kwenda mahali pengine.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~10#Note:If the disciples did not take food or money or extra clothing with them, who would take care of that?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.10+What did Jesus tell them about moving around to different homes within the various villages they visited?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~10#Question:What did Jesus tell them about moving around to different homes within the various villages they visited?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell them about moving around to different homes within the various villages they visited?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini juu ya kwenda kwenye nyumba tofauti-tofauti ndani ya vijiji mbalimbali walivyovitembelea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~10#Question:What did Jesus tell them about moving around to different homes within the various villages they visited?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~10#Answer:What did Jesus tell them about moving around to different homes within the various villages they visited?-2088794426
trans-unit.source: He told them to stay only with the people who first invited them until they left that village. (They were not to move out just because they would rather stay some place else.) (10)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wakae tu na watu wa kwanza waliowaalika mpaka watoke kijiji hicho (hawakupaswa kuondoka kwa sababu tu wangependa kukaa mahali pengine). (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~10#Answer:What did Jesus tell them about moving around to different homes within the various villages they visited?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.11+If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~11#Question:If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wa mji fulani wasingewasikiliza, wanafunzi wangefanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~11#Question:If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~11#Answer:If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?326157556
trans-unit.source: They were to shake the dust off their feet as they left the village. That would be a sign of warning to those people. (11)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kutikisa mavumbi kutoka miguuni mwao walipokuwa wakitoka kijijini. Hiyo ingekuwa ishara ya onyo kwa watu hao. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~11#Answer:If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~11#Note:If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?496263920
trans-unit.source: This was a cultural way to show clearly that they had given the people of that village a chance to hear God's message, but the people had refused to listen.
trans-unit.target: Hiyo ilikuwa njia ya kitamaduni ya kuonyesha wazi kwamba walikuwa wamewapa watu wa kijiji hicho nafasi ya kusikia ujumbe wa Mungu, lakini watu hao walikataa kusikiliza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~11#Note:If the people of any town would not listen to them, what were the disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.12-13+After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~12#Question:After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?
trans-unit.source: After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kusikia maagizo ya Yesu, wanafunzi wake walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~12#Question:After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~12#Answer:After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?357797336
trans-unit.source: They went out and preached the message that everyone should repent and stop sinning. (12)
trans-unit.target: Basi, wakaenda, wakahubiri watu watubu na waache dhambi. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~12#Answer:After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~12#Answer:After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?-353800718
trans-unit.source: They also healed many people, and sent demons/evil spirits out of many people. (13)
trans-unit.target: Pia waliwaponya watu wengi, na waliwafukuza pepo wachafu/roho waovu kutoka kwa watu wengi. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~12#Answer:After they had heard Jesus's instructions, what did the disciples do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.13+What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~13#Question:What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifanya nini kwa wagonjwa kabla ya kuponywa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~13#Question:What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~13#Answer:What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?1892081325
trans-unit.source: They anointed them with [olive] oil. (13)
trans-unit.target: Waliwapaka mafuta ya zeituni. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~13#Answer:What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~13#Note:What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?500124871
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: Anointed. A person with authority pours or rubs an oil or ointment onto the other person's head or the body part which was hurting. See "anoint" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: (Kichunguzo cha neno muhimu: Alitiwa mafuta. Mtu mwenye mamlaka anamwaga au kumwaga mafuta au marhamu juu ya kichwa cha mtu mwingine au sehemu ya mwili iliyokuwa ikiumiza. Tazama "mafuta" katika KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~13#Note:What did the disciples do to the sick people before they became well again?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!6~14#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 6:14-29 Herod ordered his men to behead John the Baptist.
trans-unit.target: Marko 6:14-29 Herode aliwaamuru watu wake wamkata kichwa Yohana Mbatizaji.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~14#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 6.14-29+How did it happen that Herod ordered a soldier to kill John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~14#Question:How did it happen that Herod ordered a soldier to kill John the Baptist?
trans-unit.source: How did it happen that Herod ordered a soldier to kill John the Baptist?
trans-unit.target: Herode aliagiza askari-jeshi amuue Yohana Mbatizaji jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~14#Question:How did it happen that Herod ordered a soldier to kill John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~14#Answer:How did it happen that Herod ordered a soldier to kill John the Baptist?-151168522
trans-unit.source: Herodias and her daughter persuaded Herod to have someone kill John. (21-26)
trans-unit.target: Herodia na binti yake walimshawishi Herode amfanye mtu amwue Yohana (21-26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~14#Answer:How did it happen that Herod ordered a soldier to kill John the Baptist?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.14+What was it that King Herod heard?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~14#Question:What was it that King Herod heard?
trans-unit.source: What was it that King Herod heard?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme Herode alisikia habari gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~14#Question:What was it that King Herod heard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~14#Answer:What was it that King Herod heard?-1901622772
trans-unit.source: He heard about all that Jesus and his disciples were doing. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alisikia kuhusu mambo yote ambayo Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakifanya. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~14#Answer:What was it that King Herod heard?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.15+What were some people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~15#Question:What were some people saying about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What were some people saying about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walisema nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~15#Question:What were some people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~15#Answer:What were some people saying about Jesus?1758185910
trans-unit.source: Some people were saying that Jesus was really John the Baptist and that God had raised him back to life. (15)
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani walikuwa wakisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa Yohana Mbatizaji na kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemfufua kutoka kwa wafu. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~15#Answer:What were some people saying about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.15+What were other people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~15#Question:What were other people saying about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What were other people saying about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine walisema nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~15#Question:What were other people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~15#Answer:What were other people saying about Jesus?894024798
trans-unit.source: Some said that he was the prophet Elijah.
trans-unit.target: Wengine walisema kwamba alikuwa nabii Eliya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~15#Answer:What were other people saying about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~15#Answer:What were other people saying about Jesus?-1835002420
trans-unit.source: Others said that he was a prophet like Elijah and other prophets who had spoken for God many years earlier. (15)
trans-unit.target: Wengine walisema kwamba alikuwa nabii kama Eliya na manabii wengine waliokuwa wamesema kwa ajili ya Mungu miaka mingi mapema. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~15#Answer:What were other people saying about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.16+Who did Herod think that Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~16#Question:Who did Herod think that Jesus was?
trans-unit.source: Who did Herod think that Jesus was?
trans-unit.target: Herode alifikiri Yesu alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~16#Question:Who did Herod think that Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~16#Answer:Who did Herod think that Jesus was?1672257103
trans-unit.source: He thought that Jesus was John (the Baptist) whose head he (Herod) had ordered his men to cut off. Herod thought that (God) caused John to become alive again. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alifikiri kwamba Yesu alikuwa Yohana (Mbatizaji) ambaye yeye (Herode) alikuwa ameamuru watu wake wamkata kichwa. Herode alifikiri kwamba (Mungu) alimfufua Yohana. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~16#Answer:Who did Herod think that Jesus was?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.18+Why had Herod given orders for John the Baptist to be put in prison?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~18#Question:Why had Herod given orders for John the Baptist to be put in prison?
trans-unit.source: Why had Herod given orders for John the Baptist to be put in prison?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Herode alikuwa ameamuru Yohana Mbatizaji afungwe gerezani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~18#Question:Why had Herod given orders for John the Baptist to be put in prison?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~18#Answer:Why had Herod given orders for John the Baptist to be put in prison?-1357551749
trans-unit.source: Herod order his men to put John in prison because John had been telling Herod that it was wrong for him (Herod) to have Herodias as his wife. Herodias was Herod's brother's wife (not widow). (18)
trans-unit.target: Herode aliwaamuru watu wake wamweke Yohana gerezani kwa sababu Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode kwamba ilikuwa ni kosa kwake (Herode) kumwoa Herodia. Herodia alikuwa mke wa ndugu ya Herode (si mjane). (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~18#Answer:Why had Herod given orders for John the Baptist to be put in prison?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.19-20+What did Herodias want to happen to John?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~19#Question:What did Herodias want to happen to John?
trans-unit.source: What did Herodias want to happen to John?
trans-unit.target: Herodia alitaka Yohana afanyiwe nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~19#Question:What did Herodias want to happen to John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~19#Answer:What did Herodias want to happen to John?1991119442
trans-unit.source: She (was very angry and) wanted Herod to order someone to kill John. (19)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa (amewaka hasira sana na) alitaka Herode amwamuru mtu fulani amwue Yohana. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~19#Answer:What did Herodias want to happen to John?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.19-20+Why was Herodias not able to have John killed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~19#Question:Why was Herodias not able to have John killed?
trans-unit.source: Why was Herodias not able to have John killed?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Herodia hangeweza kufanya Yohana auawe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~19#Question:Why was Herodias not able to have John killed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~19#Answer:Why was Herodias not able to have John killed?-1716198494
trans-unit.source: She was unsuccessful because Herod would not let her do that. (19-20)
trans-unit.target: Hajafanikiwa kwa sababu Herode hakumruhusu afanye hivyo (19-20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~19#Answer:Why was Herodias not able to have John killed?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.20+Why would Herod not let her kill John?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~20#Question:Why would Herod not let her kill John?
trans-unit.source: Why would Herod not let her kill John?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Herode hangemruhusu amwue Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~20#Question:Why would Herod not let her kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~20#Answer:Why would Herod not let her kill John?966226816
trans-unit.source: Herod knew that John was really a man whom God had set apart to serve him. Therefore, Herod was afraid to kill him.
trans-unit.target: Herode alijua kwamba Yohana alikuwa mtu aliyetakaswa na Mungu ili kumtumikia, kwa hiyo aliogopa kumwua.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~20#Answer:Why would Herod not let her kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~20#Answer:Why would Herod not let her kill John?-498549209
trans-unit.source: He also liked to listen to John talk about God, even though it made him quite upset. (20)
trans-unit.target: Pia alipenda kumsikiliza John akizungumza juu ya Mungu, hata ingawa jambo hilo lilimkasirisha sana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~20#Answer:Why would Herod not let her kill John?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.21-24+How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~21#Question:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?
trans-unit.source: How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?
trans-unit.target: Herodia alipataje fursa ya kufanya mtu fulani amuue Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~21#Question:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~21#Answer:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?-318084911
trans-unit.source: On Herod's birthday her daughter danced for Herod's guests.
trans-unit.target: Katika siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Herode, binti yake alicheza dansi mbele ya wageni wa Herode.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~21#Answer:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~21#Answer:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?-310630052
trans-unit.source: Herod was very pleased and made a strong promise to give the girl anything she wanted.
trans-unit.target: Herode alifurahi sana na akaahidi kumpa chochote ambacho msichana huyo angetaka.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~21#Answer:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~21#Answer:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?1508223946
trans-unit.source: Her mother told her to ask for John the Baptist's head. Therefore that is what she did.(21-24)
trans-unit.target: Mama yake alimwambia aombe kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji. Kwa hiyo ndivyo alivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~21#Answer:How did Herodias get an opportunity to have someone kill John?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.25+When Herodias's daughter went and asked Herod for John's head, was he happy to give it to her?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~25#Question:When Herodias's daughter went and asked Herod for John's head, was he happy to give it to her?
trans-unit.source: When Herodias's daughter went and asked Herod for John's head, was he happy to give it to her?
trans-unit.target: Binti ya Herodia alipomwendea na kumwomba Herode amnyang'anye kichwa cha Yohana, je, Herode alifurahi kumpa kichwa hicho?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~25#Question:When Herodias's daughter went and asked Herod for John's head, was he happy to give it to her?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~25#Answer:When Herodias's daughter went and asked Herod for John's head, was he happy to give it to her?-2109771817
trans-unit.source: No. He was very upset; he did not want to kill John. (25)
trans-unit.target: La, alikasirika sana; hakutaka kumuua Yohana (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~25#Answer:When Herodias's daughter went and asked Herod for John's head, was he happy to give it to her?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.26+Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~26#Question:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?
trans-unit.source: Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Herode alienda mbele na kuamuru askari-jeshi amwue Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~26#Question:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~26#Answer:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?-232833393
trans-unit.source: He was ashamed to break the strong promise he had made in front of his guests. (26)
trans-unit.target: Aliona aibu kuvunja ahadi kali aliyokuwa ameitoa mbele ya wageni wake. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~26#Answer:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~26#Answer:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?-1546398039
trans-unit.source: (Ordering people to be killed was a common practice of some kings in those times.)
trans-unit.target: (Kutoa amri ya kuwaua watu kulikuwa zoea la kawaida la wafalme fulani katika nyakati hizo.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~26#Answer:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~26#Answer:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?-850468943
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "oath" in KBT in the "covenant" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Tazama "kumbukumbu" katika KBT katika "mkataba" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~26#Answer:Why did Herod go ahead and order a soldier to kill John?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.27+What order did Herod give?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~27#Question:What order did Herod give?
trans-unit.source: What order did Herod give?
trans-unit.target: Herode alitoa amri gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~27#Question:What order did Herod give?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~27#Answer:What order did Herod give?-1339975838
trans-unit.source: He ordered one of his men to go and cut off John's head and bring it back to him. (27)
trans-unit.target: Akamwamuru mmoja wa askari wake aende na kukata kichwa cha Yohana na kukileta kwake. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~27#Answer:What order did Herod give?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.28+What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~28#Question:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?
trans-unit.source: What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosoma tafsiri watafikiri ni kwa nini mtu alibeba kichwa cha Yohana kwenye sahani/mchoro?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~28#Question:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!6~28#Alternate:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?-788601441
trans-unit.source: What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosoma tafsiri watafikiri ni kwa nini mtu fulani alibeba kichwa cha Yohana kwenye sahani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~28#Alternate:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!6~28#Alternate:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?-1532707114
trans-unit.source: What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a tray?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosoma tafsiri watafikiri ni kwa nini mtu fulani alibeba kichwa cha Yohana kwenye sinia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~28#Alternate:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~28#Answer:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?1626878641
trans-unit.source: That was the kind of container they thought was best for everyone to see that John was dead. (28)
trans-unit.target: Hiyo ilikuwa aina ya chombo walichodhani ilikuwa bora kwa kila mtu kuona kwamba Yohana alikuwa amekufa. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~28#Answer:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~28#Note:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?-871685963
trans-unit.source: Check whether people in the target culture use the item named in the translation for carrying or holding food. No one was intending to eat John's head, so that is not what should be inferred here. The name of a relatively flat, stiff item to carry the head on should be used in the translation instead.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kama watu katika tamaduni ya lengo kutumia bidhaa zilizotajwa katika tafsiri kwa kubeba au kushikilia chakula. Hakuna mtu alikuwa na nia ya kula kichwa cha Yohana, hivyo si kwamba ni nini lazima kuhitimishwa hapa. Jina la gorofa, ngumu bidhaa kubeba kichwa juu ya lazima kutumika katika tafsiri badala yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~28#Note:What will people who read the translation think was the reason that someone carried John's head on a plate/tray?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.27-29+Why do you think that the girl took John the Baptist's head to her mother?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~27#Question:Why do you think that the girl took John the Baptist's head to her mother?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the girl took John the Baptist's head to her mother?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini msichana huyo alimpelekea mama yake kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~27#Question:Why do you think that the girl took John the Baptist's head to her mother?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~27#Answer:Why do you think that the girl took John the Baptist's head to her mother?-1952434385
trans-unit.source: Her mother could then see for herself that the man she hated so much was truly dead.
trans-unit.target: Kisha mama yake akajionea mwenyewe kwamba mtu aliyemchukia sana alikuwa amekufa kweli kweli.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~27#Answer:Why do you think that the girl took John the Baptist's head to her mother?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.29+What happened to the body of John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~29#Question:What happened to the body of John the Baptist?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the body of John the Baptist?
trans-unit.target: Mwili wa Yohana Mbatizaji ulipatwa na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~29#Question:What happened to the body of John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~29#Answer:What happened to the body of John the Baptist?376802913
trans-unit.source: John's disciples came and took it and buried it. (29)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yohana wakaja wakauchukua mwili wake na kuuzika (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~29#Answer:What happened to the body of John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!6~30#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 6:30-44 Jesus fed five thousand men (plus women and children).
trans-unit.target: Marko 6:30-44 Yesu aliwalisha wanaume elfu tano (pamoja na wanawake na watoto).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~30#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 6.30-44+What miracle did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~30#Question:What miracle did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What miracle did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya muujiza gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~30#Question:What miracle did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~30#Answer:What miracle did Jesus do?812571823
trans-unit.source: Jesus fed a huge crowd from five loaves of bread and two (cooked) fish.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilisha umati mkubwa kwa mikate mitano na samaki wawili (waliopikwa).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~30#Answer:What miracle did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.30+What was it that the disciples of Jesus told him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~30#Question:What was it that the disciples of Jesus told him?
trans-unit.source: What was it that the disciples of Jesus told him?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini ambacho wanafunzi wa Yesu walimwambia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~30#Question:What was it that the disciples of Jesus told him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~30#Answer:What was it that the disciples of Jesus told him?464729099
trans-unit.source: They told him all about what had happened while they were out preaching and healing people. (30)
trans-unit.target: Walimweleza yote yaliyotukia walipokuwa wakihubiri na kuponya watu. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~30#Answer:What was it that the disciples of Jesus told him?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.31+What did Jesus say to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~31#Question:What did Jesus say to them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~31#Question:What did Jesus say to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~31#Answer:What did Jesus say to them?-1110835206
trans-unit.source: He said that they should all go to a quiet place and rest for a while. (31)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wote wapaswa kwenda mahali pa faragha na kupumzika kwa muda. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~31#Answer:What did Jesus say to them?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.31+Why could they not rest right there where they were?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~31#Question:Why could they not rest right there where they were?
trans-unit.source: Why could they not rest right there where they were?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakuweza kupumzika mahali hapo hapo walipokuwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~31#Question:Why could they not rest right there where they were?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~31#Answer:Why could they not rest right there where they were?118762554
trans-unit.source: They could not rest there because many people were coming, wanting their attention. (31)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuweza kupumzika huko kwa sababu watu wengi walikuwa wakija, wakitaka uangalifu wao. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~31#Answer:Why could they not rest right there where they were?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.32+So what did Jesus and the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~32#Question:So what did Jesus and the disciples do?
trans-unit.source: So what did Jesus and the disciples do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo Yesu na wanafunzi wake walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~32#Question:So what did Jesus and the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~32#Answer:So what did Jesus and the disciples do?1436589742
trans-unit.source: They got into a boat to go to a quiet place. (32)
trans-unit.target: Basi, wakaondoka peke yao kwa mashua, wakaenda mahali pa faragha pasipo na watu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~32#Answer:So what did Jesus and the disciples do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.33+Why were they not able to find a quiet place?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~33#Question:Why were they not able to find a quiet place?
trans-unit.source: Why were they not able to find a quiet place?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakuweza kupata mahali pa utulivu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~33#Question:Why were they not able to find a quiet place?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~33#Answer:Why were they not able to find a quiet place?945585566
trans-unit.source: People saw them leaving, so they ran along the shore and arrived at the place where the disciples were going before they did! (33)
trans-unit.target: Watu waliwaona wakienda, kwa hiyo wakakimbia kando ya pwani na kufika mahali ambapo wanafunzi walikuwa wakienda kabla ya wao! (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~33#Answer:Why were they not able to find a quiet place?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.34+When Jesus saw all the people waiting for them, how did he feel?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~34#Question:When Jesus saw all the people waiting for them, how did he feel?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus saw all the people waiting for them, how did he feel?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alihisije alipoona watu wote wakimsubiri?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~34#Question:When Jesus saw all the people waiting for them, how did he feel?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~34#Answer:When Jesus saw all the people waiting for them, how did he feel?1614644736
trans-unit.source: He was sorry for them because they were like sheep without anyone to guide and take care of them. (34)
trans-unit.target: Aliwahurumia kwa sababu walikuwa kama kondoo wasio na mtu wa kuwaongoza na kuwatunza. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~34#Answer:When Jesus saw all the people waiting for them, how did he feel?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.34+So what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~34#Question:So what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: So what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~34#Question:So what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~34#Answer:So what did Jesus do?835380837
trans-unit.source: He taught them. (34)
trans-unit.target: Akawafundisha.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~34#Answer:So what did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.35+What time of day was it by then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~35#Question:What time of day was it by then?
trans-unit.source: What time of day was it by then?
trans-unit.target: Kufikia wakati huo ilikuwa saa ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~35#Question:What time of day was it by then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~35#Answer:What time of day was it by then?2052404797
trans-unit.source: It was late afternoon. (35)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa ni alasiri ya baadaye. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~35#Answer:What time of day was it by then?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!6~35#Note:What time of day was it by then?-1000149658
trans-unit.source: Also see 6:47, which must mean "when it became dark".
trans-unit.target: Ona pia 6:47, ambalo lazima lamaanisha "ilipokuwa giza".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~35#Note:What time of day was it by then?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.35-36+Why were the disciples concerned?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~35#Question:Why were the disciples concerned?
trans-unit.source: Why were the disciples concerned?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walihangaika?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~35#Question:Why were the disciples concerned?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~35#Answer:Why were the disciples concerned?-1733299292
trans-unit.source: They were concerned because the people were hungry and there was no food nearby. (35-36)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na wasiwasi kwa sababu watu walikuwa na njaa na hakukuwa na chakula karibu (35-36)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~35#Answer:Why were the disciples concerned?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.37+What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~37#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~37#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~37#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?-264528246
trans-unit.source: He told them to give the people food to eat. (37)
trans-unit.target: Akawaambia wawape watu chakula. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~37#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.37+Why were the disciples surprised when Jesus told them to do that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~37#Question:Why were the disciples surprised when Jesus told them to do that?
trans-unit.source: Why were the disciples surprised when Jesus told them to do that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walishangaa Yesu alipowaambia wafanye hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~37#Question:Why were the disciples surprised when Jesus told them to do that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~37#Answer:Why were the disciples surprised when Jesus told them to do that?-1387401411
trans-unit.source: It would have cost them very much to feed all of those people. (37)
trans-unit.target: Ingekuwa gharama kubwa sana kuwalisha watu hao wote. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~37#Answer:Why were the disciples surprised when Jesus told them to do that?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.38+What did Jesus then ask the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~38#Question:What did Jesus then ask the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus then ask the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza wanafunzi swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~38#Question:What did Jesus then ask the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~38#Answer:What did Jesus then ask the disciples?174184722
trans-unit.source: He asked them how many loaves of bread they had. (38)
trans-unit.target: Akawauliza wana mikate mingapi (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~38#Answer:What did Jesus then ask the disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.38+What did they answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~38#Question:What did they answer?
trans-unit.source: What did they answer?
trans-unit.target: Walijibuje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~38#Question:What did they answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~38#Answer:What did they answer?-1622943741
trans-unit.source: They said that they had five loaves and two (cooked) fish. (38)
trans-unit.target: Wakasema: Tuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~38#Answer:What did they answer?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.39+What did Jesus have the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~39#Question:What did Jesus have the disciples do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus have the disciples do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~39#Question:What did Jesus have the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~39#Answer:What did Jesus have the disciples do?-887817261
trans-unit.source: He told the disciples to have the people sit down on the grass in groups. (39)
trans-unit.target: Akawaamuru watu wote waketi makundimakundi juu ya majani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~39#Answer:What did Jesus have the disciples do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.40+How were the people arranged on the grass?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~40#Question:How were the people arranged on the grass?
trans-unit.source: How were the people arranged on the grass?
trans-unit.target: Watu walipangwaje kwenye nyasi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~40#Question:How were the people arranged on the grass?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~40#Answer:How were the people arranged on the grass?1112402867
trans-unit.source: They sat down in groups of fifty people and one hundred people. (40)
trans-unit.target: Nao wakaketi makundimakundi ya watu hamsini na ya watu mia moja.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~40#Answer:How were the people arranged on the grass?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.41+What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~41#Question:What did Jesus do then?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do then?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~41#Question:What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus do then?-1835382910
trans-unit.source: He took the five loaves of bread and the two fish and thanked God for them.
trans-unit.target: Anachukua ile mikate mitano na samaki wawili na kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus do then?1000805935
trans-unit.source: Then he broke them in pieces and gave them to his disciples to give to the people. (41)
trans-unit.target: Kisha akaivunja vipande vipande, akawapa wanafunzi wake, nao wakawagawia watu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~41#Answer:What did Jesus do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.42-43+How do we know that there was enough food for all of those people to eat all they wanted?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~42#Question:How do we know that there was enough food for all of those people to eat all they wanted?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that there was enough food for all of those people to eat all they wanted?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba kulikuwa na chakula cha kutosha kuwalisha watu hao wote?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~42#Question:How do we know that there was enough food for all of those people to eat all they wanted?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~42#Answer:How do we know that there was enough food for all of those people to eat all they wanted?1292828707
trans-unit.source: We know there was plenty because it says that they ate and were satisfied, and there was some food left. (42-43)
trans-unit.target: Tunajua kwamba kulikuwa na chakula kingi kwa sababu inasema kwamba walikula na kushiba, na kwamba chakula fulani kiliachwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~42#Answer:How do we know that there was enough food for all of those people to eat all they wanted?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.43+How much food was left after everyone had eaten?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~43#Question:How much food was left after everyone had eaten?
trans-unit.source: How much food was left after everyone had eaten?
trans-unit.target: Ni chakula kiasi gani kilichobaki baada ya kila mtu kula?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~43#Question:How much food was left after everyone had eaten?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~43#Answer:How much food was left after everyone had eaten?-669569757
trans-unit.source: There was enough food to fill twelve baskets with the leftover pieces (not crumbs). (43)
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na chakula cha kutosha kujaza vikapu kumi na viwili vya vipande vilivyobaki (si makombo).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~43#Answer:How much food was left after everyone had eaten?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.44+How many people were there in the crowd?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~44#Question:How many people were there in the crowd?
trans-unit.source: How many people were there in the crowd?
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na watu wangapi katika umati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~44#Question:How many people were there in the crowd?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~44#Answer:How many people were there in the crowd?2087060074
trans-unit.source: There were five thousand men (plus their wives and children).
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na wanaume elfu tano (bila kuhesabu wake zao na watoto).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~44#Answer:How many people were there in the crowd?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.44+How could all of those people be fed like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~44#Question:How could all of those people be fed like that?
trans-unit.source: How could all of those people be fed like that?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao wote wangewezaje kulishwa hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~44#Question:How could all of those people be fed like that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~44#Answer:How could all of those people be fed like that?2119710903
trans-unit.source: God caused the food to increase, that is, God did a miracle.
trans-unit.target: Mungu alifanya chakula kiongezeke, yaani, Mungu alifanya muujiza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~44#Answer:How could all of those people be fed like that?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!6~45#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 6:45-52 Jesus walked on the top of the water.
trans-unit.target: Marko 6:45-52 Yesu alitembea juu ya maji.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 6.45-52+What was this new miraculous thing that Jesus did?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~45#Question:What was this new miraculous thing that Jesus did?
trans-unit.source: What was this new miraculous thing that Jesus did?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini lililokuwa jambo hili jipya la kimuujiza ambalo Yesu alifanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Question:What was this new miraculous thing that Jesus did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~45#Answer:What was this new miraculous thing that Jesus did?-259225277
trans-unit.source: He walked on top of the sea [lake]. (48)
trans-unit.target: Alitembea juu ya bahari [ziwa]. (48)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Answer:What was this new miraculous thing that Jesus did?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.45+What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~45#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~45#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?1520041704
trans-unit.source: He told them to get into their boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida. (45)
trans-unit.target: Akawaagiza waingie katika mashua yao na kwenda mbele yake hadi Bethsaida.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.45+What did Jesus do after they left in the boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~45#Question:What did Jesus do after they left in the boat?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do after they left in the boat?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini baada ya wao kushuka kutoka kwenye mashua?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Question:What did Jesus do after they left in the boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~45#Answer:What did Jesus do after they left in the boat?-253101375
trans-unit.source: He stayed on the shore and said goodbye to the many people as they departed. (45)
trans-unit.target: Alikaa ukingoni mwa bahari na kuwaaga watu wengi walipokuwa wakiondoka. (45)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~45#Answer:What did Jesus do after they left in the boat?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.46+What did Jesus do after he said good-by to the crowd?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~46#Question:What did Jesus do after he said good-by to the crowd?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do after he said good-by to the crowd?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini baada ya kuaga umati?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~46#Question:What did Jesus do after he said good-by to the crowd?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~46#Answer:What did Jesus do after he said good-by to the crowd?-1707772091
trans-unit.source: He went up into the hills to pray. (46)
trans-unit.target: Akaenda zake mlimani kuomba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~46#Answer:What did Jesus do after he said good-by to the crowd?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.47+When it got dark, where was Jesus, and where were his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~47#Question:When it got dark, where was Jesus, and where were his disciples?
trans-unit.source: When it got dark, where was Jesus, and where were his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Giza lilipoingia, Yesu alikuwa wapi, nao wanafunzi wake walikuwa wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~47#Question:When it got dark, where was Jesus, and where were his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~47#Answer:When it got dark, where was Jesus, and where were his disciples?-1180185608
trans-unit.source: He was alone on the land, and the disciples were in the boat in the middle of the lake. (47)
trans-unit.target: Yeye alikuwa peke yake katika nchi kavu, na wanafunzi wake walikuwa katika mashua katikati ya ziwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~47#Answer:When it got dark, where was Jesus, and where were his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.48+What trouble were the disciples having?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~48#Question:What trouble were the disciples having?
trans-unit.source: What trouble were the disciples having?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa na tatizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~48#Question:What trouble were the disciples having?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~48#Answer:What trouble were the disciples having?945416974
trans-unit.source: They were having to row the boat against a strong wind. (48)
trans-unit.target: Walilazimika kuvuta mashua dhidi ya upepo mkali. (48)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~48#Answer:What trouble were the disciples having?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.48+What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~48#Question:What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~48#Question:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~48#Answer:What did Jesus do?1530924159
trans-unit.source: He walked on the water to them and started to go past them. (48)
trans-unit.target: Akawaendea akitembea juu ya maji na kuanza kuwapita.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~48#Answer:What did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.49+What happened when the disciples saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~49#Question:What happened when the disciples saw Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What happened when the disciples saw Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia wanafunzi walipomwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~49#Question:What happened when the disciples saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~49#Answer:What happened when the disciples saw Jesus?-591498785
trans-unit.source: They became scared and screamed. (49)
trans-unit.target: Wakaingiwa na khofu na wakawa wanapiga kelele.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~49#Answer:What happened when the disciples saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.49-50+Why were they so afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~49#Question:Why were they so afraid?
trans-unit.source: Why were they so afraid?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini waliogopa sana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~49#Question:Why were they so afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~49#Answer:Why were they so afraid?1630982501
trans-unit.source: They thought that he was a ghost. (49-50)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba alikuwa mzuka.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~49#Answer:Why were they so afraid?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.49-50+Why do you think that they thought he was a ghost?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~49#Question:Why do you think that they thought he was a ghost?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they thought he was a ghost?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri kwamba walidhani alikuwa roho?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~49#Question:Why do you think that they thought he was a ghost?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~49#Answer:Why do you think that they thought he was a ghost?1445618173
trans-unit.source: They thought he was a ghost because ordinarily people cannot walk on water.
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri alikuwa roho kwa sababu kwa kawaida watu hawawezi kutembea juu ya maji.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~49#Answer:Why do you think that they thought he was a ghost?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.50+What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~50#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~50#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~50#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?774582245
trans-unit.source: He told them that it was only he, they did not need to be afraid. (50)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba ni yeye tu, hawahitaji kuogopa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~50#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.51+What happened as soon as Jesus got into the boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~51#Question:What happened as soon as Jesus got into the boat?
trans-unit.source: What happened as soon as Jesus got into the boat?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia mara tu Yesu alipopanda ndani ya mashua?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~51#Question:What happened as soon as Jesus got into the boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~51#Answer:What happened as soon as Jesus got into the boat?-1082976096
trans-unit.source: The strong wind ceased. (51)
trans-unit.target: Upepo wenye nguvu ukakoma. (51)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~51#Answer:What happened as soon as Jesus got into the boat?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.52+Why were the disciples so astonished?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~52#Question:Why were the disciples so astonished?
trans-unit.source: Why were the disciples so astonished?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walishangaa sana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~52#Question:Why were the disciples so astonished?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~52#Answer:Why were the disciples so astonished?-2144163872
trans-unit.source: They were surprised because they did not yet understand that Jesus had power to do miracles, such as making food increase, (and walking on water). (52)
