trans-unit.target: Walishangaa kwa sababu hawakuwa bado wameelewa kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu ya kufanya miujiza, kama vile kufanya chakula kuongezeka, (na kutembea juu ya maji). (52)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~52#Answer:Why were the disciples so astonished?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.51-52+Why do you think that Jesus could do those things?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~51#Question:Why do you think that Jesus could do those things?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus could do those things?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliweza kufanya mambo hayo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~51#Question:Why do you think that Jesus could do those things?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~51#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus could do those things?976888705
trans-unit.source: He is God./He had God's power.
trans-unit.target: Yeye ni Mungu. / Alikuwa na nguvu za Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~51#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus could do those things?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!6~53#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 6:53-56 Jesus healed people at Gennesaret.
trans-unit.target: Marko 6:53-56 Yesu aliwaponya watu huko Genesareti.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~53#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 6.53+Where did Jesus and his disciples come to land?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~53#Question:Where did Jesus and his disciples come to land?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus and his disciples come to land?
trans-unit.target: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walifika wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~53#Question:Where did Jesus and his disciples come to land?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~53#Answer:Where did Jesus and his disciples come to land?1578543435
trans-unit.source: They came to land at Gennesaret. (53)
trans-unit.target: Wakafika nchi kavu Genesareti. (53)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~53#Answer:Where did Jesus and his disciples come to land?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.54-55+What happened at Gennesaret as soon as they got out of the boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~54#Question:What happened at Gennesaret as soon as they got out of the boat?
trans-unit.source: What happened at Gennesaret as soon as they got out of the boat?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Genesareti mara tu waliposhuka kutoka katika mashua?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~54#Question:What happened at Gennesaret as soon as they got out of the boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~54#Answer:What happened at Gennesaret as soon as they got out of the boat?-830006668
trans-unit.source: People recognized Jesus, so they ran through the whole region and brought back their sick people for him to heal. (54-55)
trans-unit.target: Watu wa sehemu ile yote walimtambua, wakaenda mbio kumleta kila mtu aliyekuwa na wagonjwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~54#Answer:What happened at Gennesaret as soon as they got out of the boat?

group.id: Q:MRK 6.56+What happened wherever Jesus went?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!6~56#Question:What happened wherever Jesus went?
trans-unit.source: What happened wherever Jesus went?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia popote Yesu alipoenda?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~56#Question:What happened wherever Jesus went?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!6~56#Answer:What happened wherever Jesus went?-1997379863
trans-unit.source: People brought their sick people to where he was going to pass by in order that they could touch him and be healed. All who even touched the edge of his clothes were healed. (56)
trans-unit.target: Watu waliwaleta wagonjwa wao wote ili wapate kumgusa na kuponywa. Na wote waliogusa pindo la vazi lake waliponywa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!6~56#Answer:What happened wherever Jesus went?

trans-unit.source: Mark 7:1-23 Jesus explained what causes people to become unclean in God's sight.
trans-unit.target: Marko 7:1-23 Yesu alieleza ni nini kinachowafanya watu wawe wachafu machoni pa Mungu.

group.id: Q:MRK 7.1-23+What did some of Jesus's disciples do that the Pharisees saw and became upset?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~1#Question:What did some of Jesus's disciples do that the Pharisees saw and became upset?
trans-unit.source: What did some of Jesus's disciples do that the Pharisees saw and became upset?
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Yesu walifanya nini ambacho kiliwakasirisha Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Question:What did some of Jesus's disciples do that the Pharisees saw and became upset?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~1#Answer:What did some of Jesus's disciples do that the Pharisees saw and became upset?-265255087
trans-unit.source: His disciples ate food without first washing their hands in the proper ritual as their ancestors had said that all Jewish people should do to please God. (2-5)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wake walikula chakula bila kwanza kunawa mikono yao katika ibada sahihi kama vile babu zao walivyosema kwamba watu wote wa Kiyahudi wanapaswa kufanya ili kumpendeza Mungu. (2-5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Answer:What did some of Jesus's disciples do that the Pharisees saw and became upset?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.1-23+What is it that really makes people unclean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~1#Question:What is it that really makes people unclean?
trans-unit.source: What is it that really makes people unclean?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hasa kinachowafanya watu wawe najisi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Question:What is it that really makes people unclean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~1#Answer:What is it that really makes people unclean?1108985028
trans-unit.source: It is the evil things that they think and do, coming from their own evil nature/desires. (23)
trans-unit.target: Ni mambo mabaya wanayofikiri na kufanya, yanatokana na asili yao wenyewe/tamaa zao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Answer:What is it that really makes people unclean?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.1-5+What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law see some of the disciples doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~1#Question:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law see some of the disciples doing?
trans-unit.source: What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law see some of the disciples doing?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na waandishi fulani waliona baadhi ya wanafunzi wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Question:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law see some of the disciples doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~1#Answer:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law see some of the disciples doing?1040573163
trans-unit.source: They saw them eat without first washing their hands in a special way for ceremonial cleaning. (1-4)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaona wakila bila kwanza kunawa mikono yao kwa njia ya pekee kwa ajili ya utakaso wa kidesturi (1-4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Answer:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law see some of the disciples doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.1-5+What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~1#Question:What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walitaka wanafunzi wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Question:What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?1684411730
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees wanted them to clean their hands from a religious uncleanness as their ancestors used to do. (5)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walitaka wasafishe mikono yao kutokana na uchafu wa kidini kama vile mababu zao walivyokuwa wakifanya. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!7~1#Note:What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?-18441690
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: unclean/defiled)
trans-unit.target: (Key Term Check: unclean/defiled)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Note:What did the Pharisees want the disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.1-5+Why do you think that the Pharisees kept thinking that their custom of special washings was so important?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~1#Question:Why do you think that the Pharisees kept thinking that their custom of special washings was so important?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the Pharisees kept thinking that their custom of special washings was so important?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mafarisayo waliendelea kufikiri kwamba desturi yao ya kuoga kwa njia ya pekee ilikuwa muhimu sana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Question:Why do you think that the Pharisees kept thinking that their custom of special washings was so important?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~1#Answer:Why do you think that the Pharisees kept thinking that their custom of special washings was so important?1573587983
trans-unit.source: They believed that people who did not follow this custom, were doing bad in God's sight. They thought that people had to follow certain rituals to stay clean in order to show that they wanted to obey God's laws.
trans-unit.target: Waliamini kwamba watu ambao hawakufuata desturi hii, walikuwa wakifanya mabaya machoni pa Mungu. Walifikiri kwamba watu walipaswa kufuata desturi fulani ili kubaki safi ili kuonyesha kwamba walitaka kutii sheria za Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~1#Answer:Why do you think that the Pharisees kept thinking that their custom of special washings was so important?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.6-8+What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~6#Question:What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walifanya nini kilichomkasirisha Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Question:What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~6#Answer:What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?178919702
trans-unit.source: They insisted that people must obey their Jewish customs that their ancestors had made,
trans-unit.target: Waliwasisitiza watu kwamba ni lazima wazingatie desturi za Wayahudi ambazo baba zao walikuwa wameziweka.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Answer:What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~6#Answer:What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?-768058669
trans-unit.source: but were not concerned about obeying what God had commanded. (6-8)
trans-unit.target: lakini hawakujali kutii kile Mungu alichoamuru (6-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Answer:What did the Pharisees do that caused Jesus to become angry?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.6-8+What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~6#Question:What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?
trans-unit.source: What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?
trans-unit.target: Mtu anayezungumza lugha hiyo angefanya nini ili watu wengine wa taifa lake wamwite mnafiki?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Question:What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~6#Answer:What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?1161108445
trans-unit.source: (Listen for any possible wrong understanding of what Jesus meant here.)
trans-unit.target: (Sikiliza kwa uelewevu wowote usiofaa wa yale ambayo Yesu alimaanisha hapa.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Answer:What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~6#Answer:What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?1635828244
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: hypocrite. Such a person pretends to believe or do what other people will approve of or praise him for. He does not do it because he really believes that what he does is right or good.
trans-unit.target: Neno la msingi la kuangalia: mnafiki. Mtu kama huyo hujifanya kuamini au kufanya kile ambacho watu wengine watakubali au kumsifu. Yeye hafanyi hivyo kwa sababu anaamini kweli kwamba kile anachofanya ni sawa au kizuri.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Answer:What might a person that speaks this language do that would cause other of his people to call him a hypocrite?

trans-unit.source: What commands/commandments do you think that the Lord expects people to obey?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni amri/amri zipi ambazo Bwana anatarajia watu watii?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni amri gani ambazo Bwana anatazamia watu watii?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!7~6#Alternate:What commands/commandments do you think that the Lord expects people to obey?1546286368

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: commandment. The answer should focus on actions like those God named in the Ten Commandments (Exod. 20:1-17; Deut. 5:1-21. It also may include other instructions God gave to his people, as well.]
trans-unit.target: Jibu linapaswa kuzingatia vitendo kama vile ambavyo Mungu aliviorodhesha katika Amri Kumi (Kutoka 20:1-17; Kumbukumbu la Torati 5:1-21. Pia inaweza kuhusisha maagizo mengine ambayo Mungu aliwapa watu wake, pia.]

group.id: Q:MRK 7.6-8+Why did Jesus talk about Isaiah?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~6#Question:Why did Jesus talk about Isaiah?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus talk about Isaiah?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alizungumza juu ya Isaya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Question:Why did Jesus talk about Isaiah?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~6#Answer:Why did Jesus talk about Isaiah?418488845
trans-unit.source: Isaiah had written (in the Old Testament) about Jewish people of that time who were just like these Pharisees. Those people acted like they cared for and worked for God, but they really were only concerned with themselves. (6-9)
trans-unit.target: Isaya alikuwa ameandika (katika Agano la Kale) kuhusu Wayahudi wa wakati huo ambao walikuwa kama Mafarisayo hawa. Watu hao walitenda kana kwamba walimjali na kufanya kazi kwa Mungu, lakini kwa kweli walijijali wao wenyewe tu (6-9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~6#Answer:Why did Jesus talk about Isaiah?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.9-13+Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~9#Question:Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Je, watu wanaosoma mstari wa 9 wanafikiri kwamba Yesu alikuwa akiwasifu Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Question:Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?-1862740418
trans-unit.source: He was not praising them. He was angry at what they were doing.
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa akiwapongeza bali alikuwa akikasirika kwa sababu ya mambo waliyokuwa wakifanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!7~9#Note:Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?1427347415
trans-unit.source: Jesus was using a figure of speech called ‘irony'. That is, he was saying the very opposite of what he meant. When he said, "You have a great way of setting aside God's commandments...," he meant, "You have a very bad way of acting. You ignore God's commands and make up your own rules that do not agree with what God has said."
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akitumia mfano wa kusema unaoitwa irony'. Yaani, alikuwa akisema kinyume kabisa cha alichomaanisha. Aliposema, "Una njia nzuri ya kuweka kando amri za Mungu..., " alimaanisha, "Una njia mbaya sana ya kutenda. Unapuuza amri za Mungu na kutengeneza sheria zako ambazo hazipatani na kile Mungu amesema. "
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Note:Will people who read verse 9 think that Jesus was praising the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.9-13+Jesus gave an example to show how the Pharisees were teaching the people wrongly. They were not following God and his teaching like they pretended they were. What were they doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~9#Question:Jesus gave an example to show how the Pharisees were teaching the people wrongly. They were not following God and his teaching like they pretended they were. What were they doing?
trans-unit.source: Jesus gave an example to show how the Pharisees were teaching the people wrongly. They were not following God and his teaching like they pretended they were. What were they doing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa mfano kuonyesha jinsi Mafarisayo walivyowafundisha watu vibaya. Hawakumfuata Mungu na mafundisho yake kama walivyodai kuwa. Walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Question:Jesus gave an example to show how the Pharisees were teaching the people wrongly. They were not following God and his teaching like they pretended they were. What were they doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:Jesus gave an example to show how the Pharisees were teaching the people wrongly. They were not following God and his teaching like they pretended they were. What were they doing?1837224180
trans-unit.source: They said that they were teaching God's laws, while they were actually teaching their Jewish traditions. (9)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba walikuwa wakifundisha sheria za Mungu, ilhali kwa kweli walikuwa wakifundisha mapokeo yao ya Kiyahudi. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:Jesus gave an example to show how the Pharisees were teaching the people wrongly. They were not following God and his teaching like they pretended they were. What were they doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.9-13+What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~9#Question:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?
trans-unit.source: What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na tofauti gani kati ya amri ambayo Musa aliwapa kutoka kwa Mungu na yale ambayo Mafarisayo walikuwa wakisema na kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Question:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?1318645860
trans-unit.source: Moses had given them a firm command that people should respect and help their parents.
trans-unit.target: Musa alikuwa amewapa amri thabiti kwamba watu wapaswa kuwaheshimu na kuwasaidia wazazi wao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?1697575480
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees were now telling people that if they ever dedicated things to God as an offering, they could not later change their minds and use those things to help their parents, even though their parents may have no other goods or money. (10-12)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo sasa walikuwa wakiwaambia watu kwamba ikiwa wao wakati wowote wangemtolea Mungu vitu kama toleo, hawangeweza baadaye kubadili akili zao na kutumia vitu hivyo kuwasaidia wazazi wao, hata ingawa huenda wazazi wao wasiwe na mali au pesa nyinginezo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?2130091875
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees were now saying that people could avoid giving to their needy parents by making an oath that set aside what they owned as being already dedicated for future offerings to God. (10-12)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo sasa walikuwa wakisema kwamba watu wangeweza kuepuka kuwapa wazazi wao wenye uhitaji kwa kufanya kiapo ambacho kingeweka kando kile walichomiliki kuwa tayari kimetengwa kwa ajili ya matoleo ya wakati ujao kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:What was the difference between the command that Moses gave them from God and what the Pharisees were saying and doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.9-13+Why was what the Pharisees were doing so bad?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~9#Question:Why was what the Pharisees were doing so bad?
trans-unit.source: Why was what the Pharisees were doing so bad?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo walikuwa na hatia kubwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Question:Why was what the Pharisees were doing so bad?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~9#Answer:Why was what the Pharisees were doing so bad?-1418827477
trans-unit.source: They were using their own customs and traditions to avoid having to follow God's commandments. (13)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakitumia desturi na mapokeo yao wenyewe ili kuepuka kufuata amri za Mungu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~9#Answer:Why was what the Pharisees were doing so bad?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.14-16+What did Jesus say to all the people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~14#Question:What did Jesus say to all the people?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to all the people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia watu wote nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~14#Question:What did Jesus say to all the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~14#Answer:What did Jesus say to all the people?-278667917
trans-unit.source: He said that we can not be made unacceptable to God by what we eat (like wrong food or some uncleanness) coming into our bodies. Rather, it is the evil actions that start in our own inner thoughts that make us unacceptable to God. (15-16)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba hatuwezi kufanywa kuwa hatukubaliki kwa Mungu kwa kile tunachokula (kama vile chakula kibaya au uchafu fulani) unaingia katika miili yetu. Badala yake, ni vitendo viovu vinavyoanza katika mawazo yetu ya ndani ambayo hutufanya kuwa hatukubaliki kwa Mungu. (15-16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~14#Answer:What did Jesus say to all the people?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.17-19+Did the other people there that day and the disciples understand easily what Jesus was teaching them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~17#Question:Did the other people there that day and the disciples understand easily what Jesus was teaching them?
trans-unit.source: Did the other people there that day and the disciples understand easily what Jesus was teaching them?
trans-unit.target: Je, watu wengine waliokuwapo siku hiyo na wanafunzi walielewa kwa urahisi yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~17#Question:Did the other people there that day and the disciples understand easily what Jesus was teaching them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~17#Answer:Did the other people there that day and the disciples understand easily what Jesus was teaching them?-1780012257
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~17#Answer:Did the other people there that day and the disciples understand easily what Jesus was teaching them?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.17-19+According to Jesus's explanation to the disciples, what was he talking about when he mentioned, "the things which are outside of people which enter them"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~17#Question:According to Jesus's explanation to the disciples, what was he talking about when he mentioned, "the things which are outside of people which enter them"?
trans-unit.source: According to Jesus's explanation to the disciples, what was he talking about when he mentioned, "the things which are outside of people which enter them"?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na maelezo ya Yesu kwa wanafunzi wake, alikuwa akizungumza juu ya nini aliposema, "mambo yaliyo nje ya mtu huingia ndani yake"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~17#Question:According to Jesus's explanation to the disciples, what was he talking about when he mentioned, "the things which are outside of people which enter them"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~17#Answer:According to Jesus's explanation to the disciples, what was he talking about when he mentioned, "the things which are outside of people which enter them"?-1470373642
trans-unit.source: He was talking about food (and any physical or ritual uncleanness) which goes into people's bodies. (18-19)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya chakula (na uchafu wowote wa kimwili au wa kidesturi) ambao huingia katika miili ya watu (18-19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~17#Answer:According to Jesus's explanation to the disciples, what was he talking about when he mentioned, "the things which are outside of people which enter them"?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.17-19+What do you think may have made it difficult for the disciples and the others who heard Jesus teach that day to understand that what people eat does not offend God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~17#Question:What do you think may have made it difficult for the disciples and the others who heard Jesus teach that day to understand that what people eat does not offend God?
trans-unit.source: What do you think may have made it difficult for the disciples and the others who heard Jesus teach that day to understand that what people eat does not offend God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini ilikuwa vigumu kwa wanafunzi na wengine waliomsikiliza Yesu siku hiyo kuelewa kwamba chakula hakimpendezi Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~17#Question:What do you think may have made it difficult for the disciples and the others who heard Jesus teach that day to understand that what people eat does not offend God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~17#Answer:What do you think may have made it difficult for the disciples and the others who heard Jesus teach that day to understand that what people eat does not offend God?-158045613
trans-unit.source: The Jewish religious leaders emphasized a lot of food and touching restrictions. Jesus's teaching was quite different and they had difficulty understanding that he was actually saying that breaking the many of food and pollution restrictions was not what would offend God. They needed to make a decision as to whether they would follow Jesus or their tradition. He said that their slowness to understand was caused by their hardness of heart. (6:52; 8:14-21)
trans-unit.target: Viongozi wa dini ya Kiyahudi waliweka mkazo sana juu ya chakula na vikwazo vya kugusa. Mafundisho ya Yesu yalikuwa tofauti kabisa na walikuwa na ugumu wa kuelewa kwamba alikuwa akisema kwamba kuvunja vikwazo vingi vya chakula na uchafuzi sio kile ambacho kingemkasirisha Mungu. Walihitaji kufanya uamuzi kama wangemfuata Yesu au mila yao. Alisema kuwa polepole kwao kuelewa ilitokana na ugumu wa mioyo yao. (6:52; 8:14-21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~17#Answer:What do you think may have made it difficult for the disciples and the others who heard Jesus teach that day to understand that what people eat does not offend God?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.20-23+What did Jesus mean when he spoke of "the things that come out from a person"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~20#Question:What did Jesus mean when he spoke of "the things that come out from a person"?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he spoke of "the things that come out from a person"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema juu ya "mambo yatokayo kwa mtu"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~20#Question:What did Jesus mean when he spoke of "the things that come out from a person"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~20#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he spoke of "the things that come out from a person"?1094425210
trans-unit.source: He was talking about the bad things we do because of bad desires that come from within us. (20-23)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya mambo mabaya tunayofanya kwa sababu ya tamaa mbaya zinazotoka ndani yetu. (20-23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~20#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he spoke of "the things that come out from a person"?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.20-23+Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~20#Question:Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.
trans-unit.source: Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.
trans-unit.target: Je, unaweza kutaja matendo matatu mabaya ambayo Yesu alisema huanza katika mawazo yetu wenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~20#Question:Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~20#Answer:Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.686224329
trans-unit.source: Evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft/stealing, murder, adultery, (21)
trans-unit.target: Mawazo mabaya, ukosefu wa adili katika ngono, wizi/wizi, uuaji, uzinzi, (21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~20#Answer:Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~20#Answer:Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.-1184386148
trans-unit.source: coveting/greed, malice/meanness/wickedness, deceit, lewdness/sensuality, envy, slander/insults, arrogance/pride, folly/foolishness (22)
trans-unit.target: pupa/pupa, uovu/ubaya/uovu, udanganyifu, ukosefu wa adili/uhusani, wivu, uchongezi/matusi, kiburi/majivuno, upumbavu/upumbavu (22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~20#Answer:Can you name three of the bad actions which Jesus said start in our own thoughts.

group.id: Q:MRK 7.24-30+Why do you think Mark wanted to be sure we knew where this woman came from?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~24#Question:Why do you think Mark wanted to be sure we knew where this woman came from?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think Mark wanted to be sure we knew where this woman came from?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri Mark alitaka kuwa na uhakika kwamba tulijua mahali ambapo mwanamke huyu alikuja kutoka?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~24#Question:Why do you think Mark wanted to be sure we knew where this woman came from?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~24#Answer:Why do you think Mark wanted to be sure we knew where this woman came from?465840228
trans-unit.source: We need to know that to understand what she and Jesus were talking about. Also people need to know that Jesus helps and receives both Jews and non-Jews.
trans-unit.target: Tunahitaji kujua kwamba kuelewa nini yeye na Yesu walikuwa kuzungumza kuhusu. Pia watu wanahitaji kujua kwamba Yesu husaidia na kupokea Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~24#Answer:Why do you think Mark wanted to be sure we knew where this woman came from?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~24#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not want people to know where he was?-999318021
trans-unit.source: He was trying to have a time of quietness away from the many people. (24)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~24#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus did not want people to know where he was?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.24+Where did Jesus go to get away from all those people?

trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go to get away from all those people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~24#Answer:Where did Jesus go to get away from all those people?1868102635
trans-unit.source: He went to the area near [the city of] Tyre [in the Syrian province of Phoenicia]. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alienda kwenye eneo lililo karibu na [jiji la] Tiro [katika mkoa wa Foinike ya Siria]. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~24#Answer:Where did Jesus go to get away from all those people?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.24+Why do you think that he was not able to stop people from knowing where he was?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~24#Answer:Why do you think that he was not able to stop people from knowing where he was?-1461912419
trans-unit.source: He was not able to remain hidden because he had become well known and people were talking about him [even outside the regions of the Jews]. (24)
trans-unit.target: Hangeweza kubaki akiwa amejificha kwa sababu alikuwa amepata kujulikana sana na watu walikuwa wakisema juu yake [hata nje ya maeneo ya Wayahudi].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~24#Answer:Why do you think that he was not able to stop people from knowing where he was?

trans-unit.source: Does Jesus's reply [in verse 27] sound as if he was agreeing to do what the woman had asked?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~27#Question:Does Jesus's reply [in verse 27] sound as if he was agreeing to do what the woman had asked?

trans-unit.source: Does Jesus's reply in verse 27 sound as if he was agreeing to do what the woman had asked?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~27#Alternate:Does Jesus's reply [in verse 27] sound as if he was agreeing to do what the woman had asked?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!7~27#Alternate:Does Jesus's reply [in verse 27] sound as if he was agreeing to do what the woman had asked?642084956

trans-unit.target: Je, jibu la Yesu lilionekana kana kwamba alikubali kufanya alichoombwa na mwanamke huyo?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.27-28+What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~27#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu watoto na mkate na mbwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~27#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~27#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?-736234462
trans-unit.source: Jesus was saying that he had come to help the "children", the Jews, and that they should be helped first before he helped the "dogs" (which is what Jews sometimes called non-Jews).
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akisema kwamba alikuwa amekuja kusaidia "watoto", Wayahudi, na kwamba wao wapaswa kusaidiwa kwanza kabla ya yeye kusaidia "mbwa" (ambao ni kile Wayahudi nyakati nyingine waliita wasio Wayahudi).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~27#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!7~27#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?-1834305041
trans-unit.source: The meaning of what Jesus said here probably will not be easy for people to understood.
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea watu hawataelewa kwa urahisi maana ya maneno ya Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~27#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!7~27#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?202133666
trans-unit.source: Points to check: Is it clear that Jesus was using a "proverb" with figurative meaning? If not, is it possible to include some clue to indicate that? Is the fact that the woman was not a Jew shown plainly enough (vss. 24 & 26)? It may be possible to put that in the section heading.
trans-unit.target: Mambo ya kuangalia: Je, ni wazi kwamba Yesu alikuwa akitumia "mithali" yenye maana ya mfano? Kama sivyo, je, inawezekana kuingiza kiashiria fulani kuonyesha hilo? Je, ukweli kwamba mwanamke huyo hakuwa Myahudi umeonyeshwa waziwazi vya kutosha (mstari wa 24 & 26)? Inawezekana kuingiza hilo katika kichwa cha sehemu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~27#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about children and bread and dogs?

trans-unit.source: She said that even the dogs under the table get some of the crumbs. (28)

group.id: Q:MRK 7.28+What do you think she meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~28#Answer:What do you think she meant?1881713557
trans-unit.source: She meant that maybe there could be some small amount of help that Jesus could use for a non-Jew, such as her, too. (28)
trans-unit.target: Alidhani kwamba labda kunaweza kuwa na kiasi kidogo cha msaada ambacho Yesu angeweza kutumia kwa asiye Myahudi, kama yeye, pia. (28)

trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus was pleased with the woman's reply?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~29#Question:Why do you think that Jesus was pleased with the woman's reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus looked toward heaven?276848391
trans-unit.source: He looked toward heaven because he was praying to God who is in heaven.
trans-unit.target: Alitazama mbinguni kwa sababu alikuwa akisali kwa Mungu aliye mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus looked toward heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus looked toward heaven?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus looked toward heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus looked toward heaven?217569451
trans-unit.source: He looked toward heaven because he wanted the people to know that he was asking God's help as he commanded the man's ears to open.
trans-unit.target: Alitazama mbinguni kwa sababu alitaka watu wajue kwamba alikuwa akimwomba Mungu msaada alipoamuru masikio ya mtu huyo yafunguke.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus looked toward heaven?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.33-34+What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~33#Question:What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?
trans-unit.source: What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?
trans-unit.target: Neno "Efatha" katika lugha ya Kiyahudi lilimaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~33#Question:What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~33#Answer:What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?-2084520509
trans-unit.source: It means, "Be open!".
trans-unit.target: Maana yake ni, "Fungua moyo wako!"
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~33#Answer:What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~33#Answer:What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?335027969
trans-unit.source: -OR- "May these ears be opened!" (33-34)
trans-unit.target: -AO - "Masikio haya yafunguke!" (33-34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~33#Answer:What did the word "Ephphatha" from the language the Jews spoke mean?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.35+How do we know that the man was able to hear and speak?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~35#Question:How do we know that the man was able to hear and speak?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that the man was able to hear and speak?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba mtu huyo aliweza kusikia na kuzungumza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~35#Question:How do we know that the man was able to hear and speak?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~35#Answer:How do we know that the man was able to hear and speak?1624662991
trans-unit.source: Mark told us that the man could hear and he began to speak plainly. (The talk in Greek about his tongue being loosened is most likely just a way of saying that he had no more speech problem.) (35)
trans-unit.target: Marko alituambia kwamba mtu huyo angeweza kusikia na akaanza kusema waziwazi. (Hotuba katika Kigiriki juu ya ulimi wake kufunguliwa ni uwezekano mkubwa tu njia ya kusema kwamba hakuwa na tatizo la kuzungumza tena.) (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~35#Answer:How do we know that the man was able to hear and speak?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.36+What did Jesus command the people who were present?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~36#Question:What did Jesus command the people who were present?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus command the people who were present?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaamuru nini watu waliokuwapo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~36#Question:What did Jesus command the people who were present?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~36#Answer:What did Jesus command the people who were present?269635875
trans-unit.source: He said that they should not tell others about what he had done. (36)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wasiwaambie wengine juu ya yale aliyokuwa amefanya. (36)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~36#Answer:What did Jesus command the people who were present?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.37+How do we know that the people did not obey Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~37#Question:How do we know that the people did not obey Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that the people did not obey Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba watu hawakumtii Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~37#Question:How do we know that the people did not obey Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~37#Answer:How do we know that the people did not obey Jesus?-69499760
trans-unit.source: Mark told us that they began talking more and more about what Jesus did. (37)
trans-unit.target: Marko alituambia kwamba walianza kusema zaidi na zaidi juu ya yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amefanya. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~37#Answer:How do we know that the people did not obey Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 7.37+What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!7~37#Question:What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?
trans-unit.source: What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi walifikiri nini waliposikia kuhusu mtu ambaye sasa angeweza kusikia na kuzungumza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~37#Question:What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!7~37#Answer:What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?951593547
trans-unit.source: They said, "Jesus does everything well/just right, even making the deaf people hear and the mute to speak." They were overwhelmed. (37)
trans-unit.target: Wakasema: Amefanya kila kitu chema kabisa. Hata huwafanya viziwi wasikie, na mabubu waseme.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~37#Answer:What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!7~37#Note:What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?1052224336
trans-unit.source: Their statement may have meant that what Jesus did fit well with everything that was predicted about the Messiah for whom they had been waiting. See Isa. 35:3-6.
trans-unit.target: Huenda maneno yao yakamaanisha kwamba yale aliyofanya Yesu yalilingana na yote yaliyotabiriwa juu ya Mesiya ambaye walikuwa wakimngojea. Ona Isa. 35:3-6.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!7~37#Note:What did most of the people think when they heard about the man who could now hear and speak?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!8~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 8:1-10 Jesus fed four thousand men, plus women and children.
trans-unit.target: Marko 8:1-10 Yesu aliwalisha wanaume elfu nne, na vilevile wanawake na watoto.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 8.1-10+What miracle did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~1#Question:What miracle did Jesus do?

trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya muujiza gani?

trans-unit.source: He fed four thousand men [plus the women and children] from seven loaves of bread and a few small fish. (6-9)
trans-unit.target: Aliwalisha wanaume elfu nne [pamoja na wanawake na watoto] kwa mikate saba na samaki wadogo wachache (6-9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~1#Answer:What miracle did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.2+Why was Jesus feeling sorry for the people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~2#Question:Why was Jesus feeling sorry for the people?
trans-unit.source: Why was Jesus feeling sorry for the people?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu aliwahurumia watu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~2#Question:Why was Jesus feeling sorry for the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~2#Answer:Why was Jesus feeling sorry for the people?1710465394
trans-unit.source: They were hungry; they had been there with him for three days and had eaten all their food. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na njaa; walikuwa wamekaa naye kwa siku tatu na walikuwa wamekula chakula chao chote. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~2#Answer:Why was Jesus feeling sorry for the people?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.3+What did Jesus think might happen if they sent the hungry people home?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~3#Question:What did Jesus think might happen if they sent the hungry people home?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus think might happen if they sent the hungry people home?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifikiri kungetokea nini ikiwa wangewarudisha watu wenye njaa nyumbani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~3#Question:What did Jesus think might happen if they sent the hungry people home?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~3#Answer:What did Jesus think might happen if they sent the hungry people home?2013379674
trans-unit.source: He thought that some who had come a long way might collapse before reaching home. (3)
trans-unit.target: Alifikiri kwamba huenda baadhi ya wale waliosafiri mbali wakazimia kabla ya kufika nyumbani. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~3#Answer:What did Jesus think might happen if they sent the hungry people home?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.4+What did the disciples think about themselves being able to feed the people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~4#Question:What did the disciples think about themselves being able to feed the people?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples think about themselves being able to feed the people?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walionaje juu yao wenyewe kuweza kuwalisha watu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~4#Question:What did the disciples think about themselves being able to feed the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~4#Answer:What did the disciples think about themselves being able to feed the people?-1660251124
trans-unit.source: They thought that it would be impossible to find enough food to feed all those people in that place where few people lived. (4)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba haingewezekana kupata chakula cha kutosha kuwalisha watu hao wote katika eneo hilo lenye watu wachache. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~4#Answer:What did the disciples think about themselves being able to feed the people?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.5+How much bread did the disciples have?

trans-unit.source: How much bread did the disciples have?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~5#Question:How much bread did the disciples have?

trans-unit.source: They had seven loaves of bread. (5)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~5#Answer:How much bread did the disciples have?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.6+What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~6#Question:What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~6#Question:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~6#Answer:What did Jesus do?848988449
trans-unit.source: He told the crowd of people to sit down.
trans-unit.target: Akawaamuru watu wakae chini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~6#Answer:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~6#Answer:What did Jesus do?-718472567
trans-unit.source: Taking the seven loaves of bread and then thanking God for them,
trans-unit.target: Akayachukua hayo mikate saba, akamshukuru Mungu, akawagawia wanafunzi wake, akasema,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~6#Answer:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~6#Answer:What did Jesus do?1629240521
trans-unit.source: he broke them (in pieces) and gave them to his disciples to pass out to the people. (6)
trans-unit.target: Kisha akaivunja vipande vipande, akawapa wanafunzi wake wawagawie watu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~6#Answer:What did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.7+What else did they have to eat besides the loaves of bread?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~7#Question:What else did they have to eat besides the loaves of bread?
trans-unit.source: What else did they have to eat besides the loaves of bread?

trans-unit.source: They had a few small fish. (7)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~7#Answer:What else did they have to eat besides the loaves of bread?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.6-10+How much food was left when everyone had eaten enough?

trans-unit.source: How much food was left when everyone had eaten enough?

trans-unit.source: After they all had eaten, there was enough food left to fill seven baskets with broken pieces. (8)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~6#Note:How much food was left when everyone had eaten enough?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~6#Note:How much food was left when everyone had eaten enough?-1447480710

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~10#Answer:When the crowd had left, what did Jesus and his disciples do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!8~11#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 8:11-13 The Pharisees asked Jesus for a miraculous sign to prove that God had sent him.
trans-unit.target: Marko 8:11-13 Mafarisayo walimwomba Yesu awaonyeshe ishara ya kimuujiza ili kuthibitisha kwamba alitumwa na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~11#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 8.11+When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~11#Question:When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?
trans-unit.source: When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo hao walipomjia Yesu, unafikiri walitaka kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~11#Question:When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~11#Answer:When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?938670795
trans-unit.source: They apparently wanted to trick him into making some mistake.
trans-unit.target: Inaonekana walitaka kumdanganya ili afanye kosa fulani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~11#Answer:When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~11#Answer:When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?-1532144155
trans-unit.source: Then they could use that mistake as a reason to say that God had not sent him.
trans-unit.target: Kisha wangeweza kutumia kosa hilo kuwa sababu ya kusema kwamba Mungu hakumtuma.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~11#Answer:When those Pharisees came to Jesus, what do you think that they wanted to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.12+Did Jesus agree to cause a miraculous sign for them?

trans-unit.source: Did Jesus agree to cause a miraculous sign for them?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alikubali kuwapa ishara ya kimuujiza?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~12#Question:Did Jesus agree to cause a miraculous sign for them?

trans-unit.source: No, he refused.
trans-unit.target: La, alikataa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~12#Answer:Did Jesus agree to cause a miraculous sign for them?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~12#Note:Did Jesus agree to cause a miraculous sign for them?-1886820888
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "sign" in KBT in the "miracle" entry.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "ishara" katika KBT katika "muujiza" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~12#Note:Did Jesus agree to cause a miraculous sign for them?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.12+Why do you think that Jesus sighed deeply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~12#Question:Why do you think that Jesus sighed deeply?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus sighed deeply?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliugua sana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~12#Question:Why do you think that Jesus sighed deeply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus sighed deeply?1402160964
trans-unit.source: He probably sighed deeply because the Pharisees continually rejected him and God's plan for people.
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea aliugua sana kwa sababu Mafarisayo walimkataa yeye na mpango wa Mungu kwa ajili ya wanadamu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus sighed deeply?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.13+When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~13#Question:When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi baada ya kuwaacha Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~13#Question:When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~13#Answer:When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?751405241
trans-unit.source: To the other side of the Sea of Galillee.
trans-unit.target: Ng'ambo ya Bahari ya Galilaya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~13#Answer:When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~13#Note:When Jesus left the Pharisees, where did he go?1722280852
trans-unit.source: The name of the body of water is not mentioned explicitly here, but the respondent should understand that he crossed a body of water in the boat.
trans-unit.target: Jina la mwili wa maji si zilizotajwa wazi hapa, lakini mhojiwa lazima kuelewa kwamba yeye kuvuka mwili wa maji katika mashua.

group.id: Q:MRK 8.14-21+Why did he rebuke them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~14#Question:Why did he rebuke them?
trans-unit.source: Why did he rebuke them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aliwakemea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Question:Why did he rebuke them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~14#Answer:Why did he rebuke them?-210359470
trans-unit.source: He rebuked them because they were so slow to understand what his teaching meant and the true meaning of what he was doing. (17-21)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakemea kwa sababu walikuwa wepesi sana kuelewa maana ya mafundisho yake na maana ya kweli ya kile alichokuwa akifanya (17-21).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Answer:Why did he rebuke them?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.14+What had the disciples forgotten to bring with them?

trans-unit.source: What had the disciples forgotten to bring with them?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wamesahau kuleta nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Question:What had the disciples forgotten to bring with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~14#Answer:What had the disciples forgotten to bring with them?-633496120
trans-unit.source: The disciples had forgotten to bring [an adequate amount of] food. (They had just one loaf of bread with them.) (14)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wamesahau kuchukua chakula, na walikuwa na mkate mmoja tu pamoja nao.

group.id: Q:MRK 8.15+What did Jesus say to them at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~15#Answer:What did Jesus say to them at that time?-1345151766
trans-unit.source: He warned them to be careful to avoid "the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod." (15)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya wajihadhari na "chachu ya Mafarisayo na ya Herode". (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~15#Answer:What did Jesus say to them at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.14-16+Tell me about yeast.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~14#Question:Tell me about yeast.
trans-unit.source: Tell me about yeast.
trans-unit.target: Niambie kuhusu chachu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Question:Tell me about yeast.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~14#Answer:Tell me about yeast.366442342
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: If yeast is mixed with water and honey or sugar, it grows and ferments causing air bubbles. If a person makes dough by adding flour to that mixture, the yeast will spread through to lump of dough and cause it to increase in size.
trans-unit.target: Uchunguzi wa neno muhimu: Chachu ikichanganywa na maji na asali au sukari, inakua na kuchacha na kusababisha Bubbles za hewa. Ikiwa mtu hufanya unga kwa kuongeza unga kwenye mchanganyiko huo, chachu itaenea kwenye kipande cha unga na kusababisha kuongezeka kwa ukubwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Answer:Tell me about yeast.

group.id: Q:MRK 8.16+What did the disciples think that Jesus was talking about?

trans-unit.source: What did the disciples think that Jesus was talking about?

trans-unit.target: -AO- Walifikiri kwamba alikuwa akionyesha kwamba alikuwa anajua kwamba walikuwa wamesahau kuleta chakula cha kutosha. (16)

group.id: Q:MRK 8.14-16+How do we know that Jesus was not talking about the food we call bread?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~14#Question:How do we know that Jesus was not talking about the food we call bread?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus was not talking about the food we call bread?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Question:How do we know that Jesus was not talking about the food we call bread?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~14#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was not talking about the food we call bread?-1859298440
trans-unit.source: He compared it to the miracles he had done, not the actual food.
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha na miujiza aliyofanya, si na chakula halisi.

group.id: Q:MRK 8.14-16+What do you think that Jesus was meaning when he spoke about yeast?

trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus was meaning when he spoke about yeast?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu chachu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Question:What do you think that Jesus was meaning when he spoke about yeast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~14#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was meaning when he spoke about yeast?-59621231
trans-unit.source: He was talking about the bad influence of the Pharisees and of Herod. (He was using a common Jewish figurative meaning of yeast as something that people mixed in and it affected all it touched.)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya uvutano mbaya wa Mafarisayo na wa Herode. (Alikuwa akitumia maana ya kawaida ya Wayahudi ya mfano ya chachu kama kitu ambacho watu walichanganya na kilichoathiri kila mmoja aliyeigusa.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~14#Answer:What do you think that Jesus was meaning when he spoke about yeast?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.17-21+What did Jesus think about the way that the disciples were reasoning?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus think about the way that the disciples were reasoning?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionaje njia ya wanafunzi ya kufikiri?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~17#Answer:What did Jesus think about the way that the disciples were reasoning?-1382678693
trans-unit.source: He was not pleased. He rebuked them firmly for being so slow to understand that he did not need to be concerned about a shortage of food. (17-21)
trans-unit.target: Yeye hakufurahishwa. Aliwakemea kwa nguvu kwa kuwa polepole sana kuelewa kwamba hakuwa na haja ya kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya ukosefu wa chakula (17-21).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~17#Answer:What did Jesus think about the way that the disciples were reasoning?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~17#Note:What did Jesus think about the way that the disciples were reasoning?-1057553155
trans-unit.source: Check that there is strong emotional feeling here. The Greek text shows strong feeling here by a number of rhetorical questions, one after the other.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwamba kuna hisia kali za kihisia-moyo hapa. maandishi ya Kigiriki yanaonyesha hisia kali hapa kwa maswali kadhaa ya maneno, moja baada ya nyingine.

trans-unit.source: His disciples said that some people were saying that he was John the Baptist. Some were saying that he was Elijah. Some said that he was one of the Old Testament prophets. (28)

group.id: Q:MRK 8.29-30+Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~29#Question:Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?
trans-unit.source: Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Kristo ni nani, au ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Question:Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~29#Answer:Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?-287750269
trans-unit.source: [Key Term Check: The name "Christ" is a title, not a personal name. The meaning of the word refers to anointing God's special representatives with olive oil. The Christ was the one whom God had sent especially to save God's people. (See "Christ" and "Messiah" in KBT in the "Christ" entry.) ]
trans-unit.target: [Kichunguzi cha neno muhimu: Jina "Kristo" ni jina la cheo, sio jina la kibinafsi. Maana ya neno inahusu kumtia mafuta mwakilishi maalum wa Mungu kwa mafuta ya mzeituni. Kristo alikuwa yule ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma hasa kuwaokoa watu wa Mungu. (Tazama "Kristo" na "Masihi" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "Kristo".)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Answer:Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~29#Note:Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?1931180550
trans-unit.source: You may wish to make a footnote or glossary entry which indicates that this is the Greek equivalent to the Hebrew title "Messiah".
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukataka kuandika maelezo ya chini au maelezo ya msamiati yanayoonyesha kwamba hilo ni neno la Kigiriki linalolingana na jina la cheo la Kiebrania "Masihi".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Note:Who, or what, do you think that a Christ is?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.29-30+Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Question:Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?

trans-unit.source: He may have told them that because at that time he wanted people to believe in him for what he himself did and said, rather than what others said.

trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?-1867470062
trans-unit.source: He may have told them that because Jewish leaders and others might immediately reject him before they personally saw him and heard him speak.
trans-unit.target: Huenda akawa aliwaambia hivyo kwa sababu viongozi Wayahudi na wengine wangeweza kumkataa mara moja kabla ya kumwona na kumsikia akisema.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus told his disciples not to tell people who he was?
