trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema kuhusu "Mwana wa binadamu"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Question:About whom was Jesus speaking when he talked about the "Son of Man"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~31#Answer:About whom was Jesus speaking when he talked about the "Son of Man"?-1727344404
trans-unit.source: He was speaking of himself.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiongea juu yake mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Answer:About whom was Jesus speaking when he talked about the "Son of Man"?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.31+What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~31#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingempata kadiri wakati ulivyopita?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?-1994127294
trans-unit.source: He said that he would experience great difficulties.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba angekabili matatizo makubwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?1425762051
trans-unit.source: The Jewish leaders (that is, the elders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the law) would reject him,
trans-unit.target: Viongozi wa Wayahudi, yaani, wazee, makuhani wakuu na walimu wa Sheria walimkataa,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?-429563070
trans-unit.source: and people would kill him,
trans-unit.target: na watu wangemuua,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?171474979
trans-unit.source: but after three days he would rise to live again. (31)
trans-unit.target: lakini siku ya tatu atafufuliwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~31#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to him as time went on?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.32+How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~32#Question:How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba wanafunzi hawakuelewa kile ambacho Yesu alikuwa akisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~32#Question:How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~32#Answer:How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?-344557291
trans-unit.source: Peter was not happy with what Jesus said.
trans-unit.target: Petro hakufurahia yale ambayo Yesu alisema.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~32#Answer:How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~32#Answer:How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?-38280790
trans-unit.source: He tried to tell Jesus that it must not happen like that. (32)
trans-unit.target: Alijaribu kumwambia Yesu kwamba haipaswi kutokea hivyo. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~32#Answer:How do we know that the disciples did not understand what Jesus was talking about?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.33+How did Jesus reply to Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~33#Question:How did Jesus reply to Peter?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus reply to Peter?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimjibuje Petro?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Question:How did Jesus reply to Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~33#Answer:How did Jesus reply to Peter?-2029252683
trans-unit.source: He rebuked him. (33)
trans-unit.target: Akamkaripia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Answer:How did Jesus reply to Peter?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.33+Why do you think that Jesus called Peter "Satan"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~33#Question:Why do you think that Jesus called Peter "Satan"?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus called Peter "Satan"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alimwita Petro "Shetani"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Question:Why do you think that Jesus called Peter "Satan"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus called Peter "Satan"?878734995
trans-unit.source: Jesus referred to Peter as Satan because he knew that Satan was trying to use Peter's words to persuade Jesus to not be willing to die to save people. (33)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimtaja Petro kama Shetani kwa sababu alijua kwamba Shetani alikuwa akijaribu kutumia maneno ya Petro kumshawishi Yesu asiwe tayari kufa ili kuwaokoa watu. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus called Peter "Satan"?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.33+What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~33#Question:What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro nini kuhusu njia ya kufikiri ya Petro?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Question:What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~33#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?-452538710
trans-unit.source: He told Peter that he was thinking about things that were important to humans [such as staying alive].
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia Petro kwamba alikuwa akifikiria mambo yaliyo ya maana kwa wanadamu [kama vile kuendelea kuishi].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~33#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?1596355356
trans-unit.source: He was not thinking about things that were important to God. (33)
trans-unit.target: Hakufikiria mambo yaliyo muhimu kwa Mungu. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~33#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter about Peter's way of thinking?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.34+What did Jesus mean when he said that they must "take up their cross"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~34#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that they must "take up their cross"?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he said that they must "take up their cross"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba ni lazima 'wauchukue msalaba wao'?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that they must "take up their cross"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~34#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that they must "take up their cross"?-277026207
trans-unit.source: He meant that they must be ready to be criticized, to suffer and even to die so that they could identify themselves as his followers no matter what happened to them as a result. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba lazima wawe tayari kukosolewa, kuteseka na hata kufa ili waweze kujitambulisha wenyewe kuwa wafuasi wake bila kujali matokeo yatakayotokea kwao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that they must "take up their cross"?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.35+What was Jesus teaching here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~35#Question:What was Jesus teaching here?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus teaching here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha nini hapa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~35#Question:What was Jesus teaching here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~35#Answer:What was Jesus teaching here?-1829099830
trans-unit.source: He was teaching that a person who wants to have a good life in this world, [and gain things for his own pleasure] will lose his true (eternal) life.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba mtu anayetaka kuwa na maisha mazuri katika ulimwengu huu, [na kupata vitu kwa ajili ya raha yake mwenyewe] atapoteza uhai wake wa kweli (wa milele).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~35#Answer:What was Jesus teaching here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~35#Answer:What was Jesus teaching here?-1643206284
trans-unit.source: On the other hand, God will give eternal life to people who are willing to serve Jesus and tell the Good News, even if it means that they will suffer or that someone will kill them because of their serving him. (35)
trans-unit.target: Kwa upande mwingine, Mungu atawapa uzima wa milele watu ambao wako tayari kumtumikia Yesu na kutangaza Habari Njema, hata kama itamaanisha kwamba watateseka au mtu fulani atawaua kwa sababu ya kumtumikia. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~35#Answer:What was Jesus teaching here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~35#Answer:What was Jesus teaching here?1987858156
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "save" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "kuhifadhi" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~35#Answer:What was Jesus teaching here?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.34-38+What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~34#Question:What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu anapaswa kufanya nini ili apate uzima wa milele?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Question:What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~34#Answer:What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?-294659108
trans-unit.source: There is nothing that a person can trade for eternal life. It is impossible to buy back your own soul/life. [Key Term Check: See "soul" in KBT.]
trans-unit.target: Hakuna kitu ambacho mtu anaweza kubadilisha kwa uzima wa milele. Haiwezekani kununua tena nafsi yako/uhai wako.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Answer:What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~34#Note:What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?-811533842
trans-unit.source: This is implied by Jesus using rhetorical questions (that is, questions that do not expect an answer), as he did in verses 36 and 37.
trans-unit.target: Hilo ladokezwa na Yesu kwa kutumia maswali ya kifumbo (yaani, maswali yasiyotarajia jibu), kama alivyofanya katika mstari wa 36 na 37.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Note:What do you think that a person can do in order that he may experience eternal life?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.38+What warning did Jesus give?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~38#Question:What warning did Jesus give?
trans-unit.source: What warning did Jesus give?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa onyo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~38#Question:What warning did Jesus give?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~38#Answer:What warning did Jesus give?743220009
trans-unit.source: Jesus warned against people being ashamed of openly being associated with him. He said that if anyone is ashamed in this world now to say that they follow Jesus and what he teaches, then Jesus will reject them when he (Jesus) comes back to this world again. (38)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya watu wasione haya ya kuungana naye waziwazi. Alisema kwamba ikiwa mtu yeyote anaona aibu katika ulimwengu huu sasa kusema kwamba wanamfuata Yesu na kile anachofundisha, basi Yesu atamkataa atakaporudi tena ulimwenguni. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~38#Answer:What warning did Jesus give?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.38+What will people see when Jesus returns to earth as the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~38#Question:What will people see when Jesus returns to earth as the Son of Man?
trans-unit.source: What will people see when Jesus returns to earth as the Son of Man?
trans-unit.target: Watu wataona nini Yesu arudipo duniani akiwa Mwana wa Adamu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~38#Question:What will people see when Jesus returns to earth as the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~38#Answer:What will people see when Jesus returns to earth as the Son of Man?-1277982599
trans-unit.source: They will see his father's glory and the holy angels will be with him. (38)
trans-unit.target: Wataona utukufu wa Baba yake na malaika watakatifu watakuwa pamoja naye. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~38#Answer:What will people see when Jesus returns to earth as the Son of Man?

group.id: Q:MRK 8.34-38+What do you think that glory is which people will see?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!8~34#Question:What do you think that glory is which people will see?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that glory is which people will see?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri utukufu ambao watu wataona ni upi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Question:What do you think that glory is which people will see?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!8~34#Answer:What do you think that glory is which people will see?1214651026
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: As mentioned above (see 2:12), glory has many aspects of meaning. Here the meaning focuses on God's goodness and greatness shown by a bright, beautiful light surrounding Jesus and the angels.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Kama ilivyotajwa hapo juu (ona 2:12), utukufu una maana nyingi. Hapa maana inazingatia wema na ukuu wa Mungu ulioonyeshwa na nuru mkali, nzuri inayomzunguka Yesu na malaika.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Answer:What do you think that glory is which people will see?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!8~34#Note:What do you think that glory is which people will see?-1704878480
trans-unit.source: See "glory" in KBT. (Also see "holy" at 1:24, above.)
trans-unit.target: Ona "utukufu" katika Kiswahili cha Union Version (ona pia "mtakatifu" kwenye 1:24, juu.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!8~34#Note:What do you think that glory is which people will see?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.1+What did Jesus tell the people that they were going to see?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~1#Question:What did Jesus tell the people that they were going to see?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the people that they were going to see?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia watu kwamba wangeona nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~1#Question:What did Jesus tell the people that they were going to see?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell the people that they were going to see?-592611151
trans-unit.source: He said that they would see God ruling in a new way. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wangeona Mungu akitawala kwa njia mpya. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell the people that they were going to see?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.1+When were people going to see this?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~1#Question:When were people going to see this?
trans-unit.source: When were people going to see this?
trans-unit.target: Watu wangeona hili lini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~1#Question:When were people going to see this?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~1#Answer:When were people going to see this?-1945272408
trans-unit.source: They would see this soon, within the lifetime of some of the people who were standing there. (1)
trans-unit.target: Wangeona hilo karibuni, katika maisha ya watu fulani waliokuwa wamesimama hapo. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~1#Answer:When were people going to see this?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!9~2#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 9:2-13 Jesus changed in his appearance and three of his disciples saw his glory.
trans-unit.target: Marko 9:2-13 Yesu aligeuzwa sura na watatu wa wanafunzi wake wakaona utukufu wake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 9.2-13+What happened to Jesus on the mountain?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~2#Question:What happened to Jesus on the mountain?
trans-unit.source: What happened to Jesus on the mountain?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichompata Yesu mlimani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Question:What happened to Jesus on the mountain?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~2#Answer:What happened to Jesus on the mountain?-1804883864
trans-unit.source: The way Jesus looked changed, and, for a while, the disciples saw him in a dazzling white brightness (that is, God's glory). They were able to see him more clearly as the pure and powerful person he really is. (2-3)
trans-unit.target: Mwonekano wa Yesu ulibadilika, na kwa muda, wanafunzi walimwona katika mwangaza mweupe wa kupendeza (yaani, utukufu wa Mungu). Waliweza kumwona wazi zaidi kama mtu safi na mwenye nguvu ambaye yeye kweli ni. (2-3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Answer:What happened to Jesus on the mountain?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.2+Whom did Jesus take up the hill with him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~2#Question:Whom did Jesus take up the hill with him?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus take up the hill with him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipanda mlima huo pamoja na nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Question:Whom did Jesus take up the hill with him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~2#Answer:Whom did Jesus take up the hill with him?-1901834155
trans-unit.source: He took three of his disciples: Peter, James, and John. (2)
trans-unit.target: Anawachukua wanafunzi wake watatu: Petro, Yakobo, na Yohana. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Answer:Whom did Jesus take up the hill with him?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.2+When they first arrived on the mountain, who else was there with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~2#Question:When they first arrived on the mountain, who else was there with them?
trans-unit.source: When they first arrived on the mountain, who else was there with them?
trans-unit.target: Walipofika mlimani kwa mara ya kwanza, ni nani mwingine aliyekuwa pamoja nao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Question:When they first arrived on the mountain, who else was there with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~2#Answer:When they first arrived on the mountain, who else was there with them?2023477219
trans-unit.source: No one; they were all alone. (2)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna yeyote; wote walikuwa peke yao. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~2#Answer:When they first arrived on the mountain, who else was there with them?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.4+Who else then appeared, and what did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~4#Question:Who else then appeared, and what did they do?
trans-unit.source: Who else then appeared, and what did they do?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani wengine waliotokea, nao walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~4#Question:Who else then appeared, and what did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~4#Answer:Who else then appeared, and what did they do?-2124151827
trans-unit.source: Elijah and Moses appeared and talked with Jesus. (4)
trans-unit.target: Eliya na Musa wanaonekana, wakizungumza na Yesu. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~4#Answer:Who else then appeared, and what did they do?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.5+What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~5#Question:What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?
trans-unit.target: Petro alimwambia Yesu nini kuhusu yale aliyokuwa ameona?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~5#Question:What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~5#Answer:What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?2086810798
trans-unit.source: He said that it was good that he and the other two disciples were there.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba ni vizuri kwamba yeye na wale wanafunzi wengine wawili walikuwapo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~5#Answer:What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~5#Answer:What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?-1402497199
trans-unit.source: They should put up three shelters: one for Jesus, one for Moses, and one for Elijah. (5)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kujenga vibanda vitatu: kimoja cha Yesu, kimoja cha Musa, na kimoja cha Eliya. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~5#Answer:What did Peter say to Jesus about what he was seeing?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.6+Why did Peter say that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~6#Question:Why did Peter say that?
trans-unit.source: Why did Peter say that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Petro alisema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~6#Question:Why did Peter say that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~6#Answer:Why did Peter say that?-1383999102
trans-unit.source: He was so very afraid because of what he was seeing, that he apparently thought that he would feel better if he said something. (6)
trans-unit.target: Aliogopa sana kwa sababu ya yale aliyoona, kwamba inaonekana alifikiri kwamba angehisi vizuri zaidi ikiwa angesema jambo fulani. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~6#Answer:Why did Peter say that?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.7-8+Whose voice do you think it was that they heard speaking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~7#Question:Whose voice do you think it was that they heard speaking?
trans-unit.source: Whose voice do you think it was that they heard speaking?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri walisikia sauti ya nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Question:Whose voice do you think it was that they heard speaking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~7#Answer:Whose voice do you think it was that they heard speaking?968582303
trans-unit.source: They heard God speak.
trans-unit.target: Walimsikia Mungu akisema.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Answer:Whose voice do you think it was that they heard speaking?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.7+How do you know that God spoke?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~7#Question:How do you know that God spoke?
trans-unit.source: How do you know that God spoke?
trans-unit.target: Unajuaje kwamba Mungu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Question:How do you know that God spoke?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~7#Answer:How do you know that God spoke?2086900610
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that the voice came from heaven [where God lives]
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba sauti hiyo ilitoka mbinguni [ambapo Mungu anaishi]
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Answer:How do you know that God spoke?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~7#Answer:How do you know that God spoke?2053197836
trans-unit.source: and that he called Jesus his son. (7)
trans-unit.target: na kwamba alimwita Yesu mwanawe. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Answer:How do you know that God spoke?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.7+What did he say about Jesus, his son?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~7#Question:What did he say about Jesus, his son?
trans-unit.source: What did he say about Jesus, his son?
trans-unit.target: Alisema nini kumhusu Yesu, mwana wake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Question:What did he say about Jesus, his son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~7#Answer:What did he say about Jesus, his son?605478321
trans-unit.source: He said that he loves Jesus, and that [the disciples] should listen to him. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba anampenda Yesu, na kwamba [wanafunzi] wanapaswa kumsikiliza. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~7#Answer:What did he say about Jesus, his son?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.8+What did the disciples notice then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~8#Question:What did the disciples notice then?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples notice then?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliona nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~8#Question:What did the disciples notice then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~8#Answer:What did the disciples notice then?223306100
trans-unit.source: They noticed that they could no longer see Moses and Elijah; [they had gone]. (8)
trans-unit.target: Waliona kwamba hawangeweza kuwaona Musa na Eliya tena; [walikuwa wameondoka]. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~8#Answer:What did the disciples notice then?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.9+What instructions did Jesus give the disciples as they were coming down from the hilltop?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~9#Question:What instructions did Jesus give the disciples as they were coming down from the hilltop?
trans-unit.source: What instructions did Jesus give the disciples as they were coming down from the hilltop?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa wanafunzi wake maagizo gani walipokuwa wakishuka kutoka juu ya mlima?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~9#Question:What instructions did Jesus give the disciples as they were coming down from the hilltop?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~9#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give the disciples as they were coming down from the hilltop?-1065669694
trans-unit.source: He told them not to tell people what they had seen until later when he had risen from the dead. (9)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaamuru wasimwambie mtu yeyote yale waliyoyaona mpaka baada ya kufufuka kwake kutoka kwa wafu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~9#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give the disciples as they were coming down from the hilltop?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.10+How do you know that the disciples did not understand what he meant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~10#Question:How do you know that the disciples did not understand what he meant?
trans-unit.source: How do you know that the disciples did not understand what he meant?
trans-unit.target: Wajuaje kwamba wanafunzi hawakuelewa alichomaanisha?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~10#Question:How do you know that the disciples did not understand what he meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~10#Answer:How do you know that the disciples did not understand what he meant?-1711004266
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that they did not tell others, but discussed among themselves what he meant by "rising from being dead." (10)
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba hawakuwaambia wengine, lakini walijadiliana wenyewe kile alichomaanisha kwa "kufufuka katika wafu".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~10#Answer:How do you know that the disciples did not understand what he meant?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.11+What question did the disciples ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~11#Question:What question did the disciples ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What question did the disciples ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~11#Question:What question did the disciples ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~11#Answer:What question did the disciples ask Jesus?650480561
trans-unit.source: They asked him why the teachers of the law said that Elijah must come before the Christ/Messiah would come. (11)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwuliza kwa nini walimu wa sheria walisema kwamba ni lazima Eliya aje kabla ya Kristo/Masihi kuja. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~11#Answer:What question did the disciples ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.12-13+What did Jesus reply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~12#Question:What did Jesus reply?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~12#Question:What did Jesus reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~12#Answer:What did Jesus reply?1468117134
trans-unit.source: He said that it was true that Elijah had to come first [before the Messiah/Christ]. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba ni kweli kwamba Eliya alipaswa kuja kwanza [kabla ya Mesiya/Kristo]. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~12#Answer:What did Jesus reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~12#Answer:What did Jesus reply?-1305218926
trans-unit.source: He also said that Elijah had come already. When he came, however, people had treated him badly, doing whatever they liked to him, just like [the prophets long ago had predicted] in what they had written. (13)
trans-unit.target: Pia alisema kwamba Eliya alikuwa amekwisha kuja. Hata hivyo, alipotokea watu walimtendea vibaya, wakimfanyia walivyotaka, kama vile [manabii walivyokuwa wametabiri zamani] katika yale yaliyoandikwa. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~12#Answer:What did Jesus reply?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.12+Of what fact about himself did Jesus remind them again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~12#Question:Of what fact about himself did Jesus remind them again?
trans-unit.source: Of what fact about himself did Jesus remind them again?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwakumbusha tena jambo gani juu yake mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~12#Question:Of what fact about himself did Jesus remind them again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~12#Answer:Of what fact about himself did Jesus remind them again?-553227541
trans-unit.source: He reminded them again that [the prophets long ago] had written in God's Book that he, the Son of Man, would have to suffer much [pain] and be rejected [by the people]. (12)
trans-unit.target: Akawakumbusha tena kwamba [manabii wa zamani] walikuwa wameandika katika Kitabu cha Mungu kwamba yeye, Mwana wa Adamu, angelazimika kuteseka [maumivu] mengi na kukataliwa [na watu]. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~12#Answer:Of what fact about himself did Jesus remind them again?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!9~14#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 9:14-29 Jesus sent an evil spirit out of a boy.
trans-unit.target: Marko 9:14-29 Yesu alimfukuza roho mwovu kutoka kwa mvulana fulani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~14#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 9.14-29+What miracle did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~14#Question:What miracle did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What miracle did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya muujiza gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~14#Question:What miracle did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~14#Answer:What miracle did Jesus do?-251741589
trans-unit.source: He sent an evil spirit out of a boy. (25-26)
trans-unit.target: Alimfukuza roho mwovu kutoka kwa mvulana (25-26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~14#Answer:What miracle did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.14+What did Jesus and the three disciples see when they came down from the hill?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~14#Question:What did Jesus and the three disciples see when they came down from the hill?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus and the three disciples see when they came down from the hill?
trans-unit.target: Yesu na wale wanafunzi watatu waliona nini waliposhuka kutoka mlimani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~14#Question:What did Jesus and the three disciples see when they came down from the hill?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~14#Answer:What did Jesus and the three disciples see when they came down from the hill?-821214455
trans-unit.source: They saw a large crowd of people gathered together where some teachers of the law were arguing with the other disciples. (14)
trans-unit.target: Waliona umati mkubwa wa watu wakiwa wamekusanyika pamoja na baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakibishana na wanafunzi wengine.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~14#Answer:What did Jesus and the three disciples see when they came down from the hill?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.15+What did the people do when they saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~15#Question:What did the people do when they saw Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the people do when they saw Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu walifanya nini walipomwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~15#Question:What did the people do when they saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~15#Answer:What did the people do when they saw Jesus?692642330
trans-unit.source: They were amazed and they ran to greet him. (15)
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa na kukimbia kumsalimu. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~15#Answer:What did the people do when they saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.15+Why do you think that they were so amazed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~15#Question:Why do you think that they were so amazed?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they were so amazed?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini walishangaa sana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~15#Question:Why do you think that they were so amazed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~15#Answer:Why do you think that they were so amazed?-1534086930
trans-unit.source: Probably they were amazed because he was coming just when they needed him. (15)
trans-unit.target: Labda walishangaa kwa sababu alikuwa akija wakati ambapo walimhitaji. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~15#Answer:Why do you think that they were so amazed?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!9~15#Note:Why do you think that they were so amazed?-67633572
trans-unit.source: There could be other reasons. Mark did not tell us.
trans-unit.target: Huenda kukawa na sababu nyingine ambazo Marko hakutuambia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~15#Note:Why do you think that they were so amazed?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.16+What question did Jesus ask his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~16#Question:What question did Jesus ask his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What question did Jesus ask his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza wanafunzi wake swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~16#Question:What question did Jesus ask his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~16#Answer:What question did Jesus ask his disciples?-1283057924
trans-unit.source: He asked them what they were discussing so much. (16)
trans-unit.target: Akawauliza ni nini mlichokuwa mkijadiliana. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~16#Answer:What question did Jesus ask his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.17-18+Who replied to Jesus's question, and what did he say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~17#Question:Who replied to Jesus's question, and what did he say?
trans-unit.source: Who replied to Jesus's question, and what did he say?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyejibu swali la Yesu, naye alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~17#Question:Who replied to Jesus's question, and what did he say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~17#Answer:Who replied to Jesus's question, and what did he say?1073396929
trans-unit.source: A man in the crowd replied. He said that he brought his son who was possessed by an evil spirit that made him unable to speak. He said that he had asked the disciples to send the spirit out of the boy, but they had not been able to do so. (17-18)
trans-unit.target: Mtu mmoja katika umati akajibu. Alisema kwamba alimleta mwanawe ambaye alikuwa na pepo mchafu ambaye alimfanya asiweze kuzungumza. Alisema kwamba alikuwa amewaomba wanafunzi wake wamfukuze roho huyo kutoka kwa kijana huyo, lakini hawakuweza kufanya hivyo. (17-18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~17#Answer:Who replied to Jesus's question, and what did he say?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.18+What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~18#Question:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alisema roho hiyo ilimfanya mvulana huyo afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~18#Question:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~18#Answer:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?-2070782536
trans-unit.source: The spirit caused the boy to be unable to speak.
trans-unit.target: Roho huyo alimfanya mvulana huyo asiweze kusema.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~18#Answer:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~18#Answer:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?623003076
trans-unit.source: At times it would also throw him on the ground and cause him to foam at the mouth,
trans-unit.target: Nyakati nyingine pia ilimtupa chini na kumfanya atoke pumzi kinywani,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~18#Answer:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~18#Answer:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?51949832
trans-unit.source: grind his teeth, and become rigid. (18)
trans-unit.target: Atasaga meno yake na kuwa mgumu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~18#Answer:What did the man say that the spirit had caused the boy to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.19+How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~19#Question:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba Yesu alihuzunishwa na mambo yaliyokuwa yakitendeka huko?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~19#Question:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~19#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?-1067616762
trans-unit.source: He showed that he was disappointed that they still did not believe in his power after all he had done and said to them.
trans-unit.target: Alionyesha kwamba alivunjika moyo kwa sababu bado hawakuamini katika nguvu zake baada ya yote aliyokuwa amewafanyia na kuwaambia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~19#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~19#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?2002845078
trans-unit.source: He told them [in a sharp manner] to bring the boy to him. (19)
trans-unit.target: Akawaambia [kwa njia ya ukali] wamlete mvulana huyo kwake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~19#Answer:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!9~19#Note:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?-1057553155
trans-unit.source: Check that there is strong emotional feeling here. The Greek text shows strong feeling here by a number of rhetorical questions, one after the other.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwamba kuna hisia kali za kihisia-moyo hapa. maandishi ya Kigiriki yanaonyesha hisia kali hapa kwa maswali kadhaa ya maneno, moja baada ya nyingine.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~19#Note:How do we know that Jesus was upset about what had been happening there?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.20+What happened when the spirit saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~20#Question:What happened when the spirit saw Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What happened when the spirit saw Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia roho hiyo ilipomwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~20#Question:What happened when the spirit saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~20#Answer:What happened when the spirit saw Jesus?-908528789
trans-unit.source: It immediately threw the boy to the ground and caused him to convulse violently. (20)
trans-unit.target: Mara ikaangusha mvulana huyo chini na kumfanya atetemeke kwa nguvu. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~20#Answer:What happened when the spirit saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.21+How long had the boy been like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~21#Question:How long had the boy been like that?
trans-unit.source: How long had the boy been like that?
trans-unit.target: Mvulana huyo alikuwa amekuwa hivyo kwa muda gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~21#Question:How long had the boy been like that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~21#Answer:How long had the boy been like that?-1188526934
trans-unit.source: The father said that the boy had been like that since he was a small child. (21)
trans-unit.target: Baba alisema kwamba mvulana huyo alikuwa hivyo tangu alipokuwa mtoto mdogo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~21#Answer:How long had the boy been like that?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.22+Did the man believe that Jesus could heal his son?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~22#Question:Did the man believe that Jesus could heal his son?
trans-unit.source: Did the man believe that Jesus could heal his son?
trans-unit.target: Je, mtu huyo aliamini kwamba Yesu angeweza kumponya mwana wake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~22#Question:Did the man believe that Jesus could heal his son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~22#Answer:Did the man believe that Jesus could heal his son?-1300962072
trans-unit.source: He was not sure. (22)
trans-unit.target: Hakuwa na uhakika.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~22#Answer:Did the man believe that Jesus could heal his son?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.22+How often did that spirit bother the boy?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~22#Question:How often did that spirit bother the boy?
trans-unit.source: How often did that spirit bother the boy?
trans-unit.target: Roho huyo alimsumbua mvulana huyo mara ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~22#Question:How often did that spirit bother the boy?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~22#Answer:How often did that spirit bother the boy?1350088453
trans-unit.source: The evil spirit attacked the boy so often that it was destroying/killing the boy. (22)
trans-unit.target: Roho mbaya alimshambulia mvulana mara nyingi sana hivi kwamba alikuwa akimharibu/kumwua mvulana huyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~22#Answer:How often did that spirit bother the boy?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.23+What words did the man say that surprised Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~23#Question:What words did the man say that surprised Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What words did the man say that surprised Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni maneno gani ambayo mtu huyo alisema ambayo yalimshangaza Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~23#Question:What words did the man say that surprised Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~23#Answer:What words did the man say that surprised Jesus?-1695483608
trans-unit.source: Jesus was surprised that the man said, "If you can, …." (23)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alishangaa kwamba mtu huyo alisema, "Ikiwa unaweza, ...." (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~23#Answer:What words did the man say that surprised Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.23+What did Jesus say about the man's words "If you can, …"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~23#Question:What did Jesus say about the man's words "If you can, …"?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the man's words "If you can, …"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu maneno ya mtu huyo, "Ikiwa unaweza, . . ".?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~23#Question:What did Jesus say about the man's words "If you can, …"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~23#Answer:What did Jesus say about the man's words "If you can, …"?-588969167
trans-unit.source: He gently rebuked the man, saying that it was not a problem of Jesus's ability, but rather a problem of whether the man would believe (that is, keep on trusting) in Jesus. (23)
trans-unit.target: Alimkemea mtu huyo kwa upole, akisema kwamba haikuwa tatizo la uwezo wa Yesu, bali ni tatizo la kama mtu huyo angemwamini (yaani, aendelee kumtumaini) Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~23#Answer:What did Jesus say about the man's words "If you can, …"?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.23+What did Jesus tell the man about believing that he (Jesus) could help the boy?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~23#Question:What did Jesus tell the man about believing that he (Jesus) could help the boy?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the man about believing that he (Jesus) could help the boy?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini yule mtu kuhusu kuamini kwamba yeye (Yesu) angeweza kumsaidia mvulana huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~23#Question:What did Jesus tell the man about believing that he (Jesus) could help the boy?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~23#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man about believing that he (Jesus) could help the boy?-218945132
trans-unit.source: He told him that, if a person believes when he asks [God] to do something, then [God] will do what he asks of him. (23)
trans-unit.target: Akamwambia kwamba, ikiwa mtu anaamini wakati anaomba [Mungu] kufanya kitu, basi [Mungu] atafanya kile anachomwomba. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~23#Answer:What did Jesus tell the man about believing that he (Jesus) could help the boy?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.24+What did the man say about believing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~24#Question:What did the man say about believing?
trans-unit.source: What did the man say about believing?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alisema nini kuhusu kuamini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~24#Question:What did the man say about believing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?-1191796341
trans-unit.source: He told Jesus that he did believe [that Jesus could do it for him].
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia Yesu kwamba aliamini [kwamba Yesu angeweza kumponya].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?-2105538445
trans-unit.source: He begged Jesus to help his tendency to not believe [enough that Jesus was able to help him].
trans-unit.target: Alimsihi Yesu amsaidie asiwe na imani [ya kutosha ili Yesu aweze kumsaidia].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?235597677
trans-unit.source: He begged Jesus to help his son, even though he himself had a tendency to not believe well. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alimsihi Yesu amsaidie mwanawe, hata ingawa yeye mwenyewe alikuwa na mwelekeo wa kutoamini vizuri. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~24#Answer:What did the man say about believing?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.25+Why did Jesus speak to the spirit to send it out of the boy at that particular time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~25#Question:Why did Jesus speak to the spirit to send it out of the boy at that particular time?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus speak to the spirit to send it out of the boy at that particular time?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alimwambia roho huyo amfukuze mvulana huyo wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~25#Question:Why did Jesus speak to the spirit to send it out of the boy at that particular time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~25#Answer:Why did Jesus speak to the spirit to send it out of the boy at that particular time?-1179071590
trans-unit.source: He began to send the spirit out of the boy right then because a crowd of (curious) people was running together (around him). (25)
trans-unit.target: Basi akaanza kumfukuza roho mara, na watu walikuwa wakimkimbilia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~25#Answer:Why did Jesus speak to the spirit to send it out of the boy at that particular time?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.26+When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~26#Question:When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipozungumza na roho huyo, ni nini kilichompata mvulana huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~26#Question:When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~26#Answer:When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?2103672679
trans-unit.source: The spirit shrieked/screamed, shook the boy violently, and came out of him.
trans-unit.target: Roho huyo alipiga kelele, akamtikisa sana, akatoka ndani yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~26#Answer:When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~26#Answer:When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?1061856098
trans-unit.source: The boy lay still, like a dead person. (26)
trans-unit.target: Mvulana huyo alilala kimya, kama mtu aliyekufa. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~26#Answer:When Jesus spoke to the spirit, what happened to the boy?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.27+What did Jesus do to him then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~27#Question:What did Jesus do to him then?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do to him then?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimtendeaje?

trans-unit.source: Jesus took his hand and helped him to stand up. (27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu akamshika mkono akamsaidia kusimama (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~27#Answer:What did Jesus do to him then?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.28+What did the disciples ask Jesus about that event?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~28#Question:What did the disciples ask Jesus about that event?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples ask Jesus about that event?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walimwuliza Yesu nini kuhusu tukio hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~28#Question:What did the disciples ask Jesus about that event?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~28#Answer:What did the disciples ask Jesus about that event?86653395
trans-unit.source: They asked him why they were not able to send out that evil spirit from the boy. (28)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza kwa nini hawakuweza kumfukuza huyo roho mwovu kutoka kwa mvulana huyo. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~28#Answer:What did the disciples ask Jesus about that event?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.29+What did Jesus reply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~29#Question:What did Jesus reply?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~29#Question:What did Jesus reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~29#Answer:What did Jesus reply?-2091608461
trans-unit.source: He replied that one can send out such a spirit only through praying. (29)
