trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~29#Answer:What did Jesus reply?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!9~30#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 9:30-32 Jesus again told his disciples that someone would betray him and kill him.
trans-unit.target: Marko 9:30-32 Yesu aliwaambia tena wanafunzi wake kwamba mtu fulani angemsaliti na kumuua.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~30#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 9.30-32+What was Jesus encouraging his disciples to understand?.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~30#Question:What was Jesus encouraging his disciples to understand?.
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus encouraging his disciples to understand?.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akiwatia moyo wanafunzi wake waelewe nini?.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~30#Question:What was Jesus encouraging his disciples to understand?.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~30#Answer:What was Jesus encouraging his disciples to understand?.1902928192
trans-unit.source: He wanted them to realize that he would be killed and would rise to live again. (31)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka waelewe kwamba angeuawa na angefufuka tena kuishi. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~30#Answer:What was Jesus encouraging his disciples to understand?.

group.id: Q:MRK 9.30-31+Why did Jesus not want people to know where he was at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~30#Question:Why did Jesus not want people to know where he was at that time?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus not want people to know where he was at that time?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hakutaka watu wajue mahali alipokuwa wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~30#Question:Why did Jesus not want people to know where he was at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~30#Answer:Why did Jesus not want people to know where he was at that time?-1352850426
trans-unit.source: Jesus did not want people to know where he was right then because he wanted to be able to teach his disciples privately. (30-31)
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakutaka watu wajue mahali alipokuwa wakati huo kwa sababu alitaka kuwa na uwezo wa kufundisha wanafunzi wake faraghani (30-31).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~30#Answer:Why did Jesus not want people to know where he was at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.31+What was he teaching them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~31#Question:What was he teaching them?
trans-unit.source: What was he teaching them?
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~31#Question:What was he teaching them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~31#Answer:What was he teaching them?-2039903672
trans-unit.source: He was teaching them that (someone) was going to betray him to other men who would kill him, the Son of Man, but after three days he would rise to life again. (31)
trans-unit.target: akawafundisha kwamba, 'Mwana wa Mtu atakabidhiwa kwa watu ambao watamuua; lakini siku ya tatu atafufuka.' "
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~31#Answer:What was he teaching them?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.32+What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~32#Question:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?
trans-unit.source: What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini wanafunzi walikuwa na ugumu sana wa kuelewa yale ambayo Yesu alisema kuhusu kufa na kufufuka tena?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~32#Question:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!9~32#Alternate:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?-392890986
trans-unit.source: What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini wanafunzi walikuwa na ugumu sana wa kuelewa yale ambayo Yesu alisema kuhusu kufa na kufufuka tena?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~32#Alternate:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!9~32#Alternate:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?1347863412
trans-unit.source: Why do you think the disciples had so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini wanafunzi walikuwa na tatizo kubwa sana la kuelewa yale ambayo Yesu alisema kuhusu kufa na kufufuliwa tena?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~32#Alternate:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~32#Answer:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?1487049436
trans-unit.source: They expected him to become their king soon and dying did not seem to them like it could be related to what they expected the Christ/Messiah to do.
trans-unit.target: Walitarajia kuwa mfalme wao hivi karibuni na kufa hakuonekana kwao kama inaweza kuhusishwa na kile walichotarajia Kristo / Masihi kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~32#Answer:What do you think about the disciples having so much difficulty understanding what Jesus said about dying and rising again?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.32+What kept the disciples from asking Jesus to explain what he meant about dying and rising to live again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~32#Question:What kept the disciples from asking Jesus to explain what he meant about dying and rising to live again?
trans-unit.source: What kept the disciples from asking Jesus to explain what he meant about dying and rising to live again?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowazuia wanafunzi wasimwulize Yesu afasirie alichomaanisha kuhusu kufa na kufufuliwa ili kuishi tena?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~32#Question:What kept the disciples from asking Jesus to explain what he meant about dying and rising to live again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~32#Answer:What kept the disciples from asking Jesus to explain what he meant about dying and rising to live again?933067962
trans-unit.source: They were afraid to ask him.. (32)
trans-unit.target: Na wakaogopa kumwuliza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~32#Answer:What kept the disciples from asking Jesus to explain what he meant about dying and rising to live again?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!9~33#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 9:33-37 Jesus told his disciples that, if they wanted to be great in God's kingdom, they must be servants to all people.
trans-unit.target: Marko 9:33-37 Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba, ikiwa walitaka kuwa wakubwa katika ufalme wa Mungu, ni lazima wawe watumishi wa watu wote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~33#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 9.33-37+What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~33#Question:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akijaribu kuwasaidia wanafunzi wake waelewe nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~33#Question:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~33#Answer:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?427190672
trans-unit.source: He wanted them to understand that anyone who wants to be ranked as first (most important) in the kingdom of God must have the attitude of being the least important person and serve others. (35)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka waelewe kwamba yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza (wa muhimu zaidi) katika ufalme wa Mungu lazima awe na mtazamo wa kuwa mtu wa maana zaidi na kuwatumikia wengine. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~33#Answer:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!9~33#Note:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?-1056271930
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: See "servant" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: (Key Term Check: Angalia "mtumishi" katika KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~33#Note:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.34+What were the disciples arguing about as they traveled along?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~34#Question:What were the disciples arguing about as they traveled along?
trans-unit.source: What were the disciples arguing about as they traveled along?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wakibishana juu ya nini walipokuwa wakisafiri?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~34#Question:What were the disciples arguing about as they traveled along?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~34#Answer:What were the disciples arguing about as they traveled along?901787185
trans-unit.source: They were arguing about which of them was the most important [among them]. (34)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakibishana wao kwa wao ni nani aliye mkubwa zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~34#Answer:What were the disciples arguing about as they traveled along?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.35+How do we know that Jesus knew what they had been arguing about?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~35#Question:How do we know that Jesus knew what they had been arguing about?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus knew what they had been arguing about?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba Yesu alijua kile walichokuwa wakibishana juu yacho?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~35#Question:How do we know that Jesus knew what they had been arguing about?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~35#Answer:How do we know that Jesus knew what they had been arguing about?680883462
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that Jesus began to talk about people being first (most important) and last (least important). (35)
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba Yesu alianza kuzungumza juu ya watu kuwa wa kwanza (wa muhimu zaidi) na wa mwisho (wa chini kabisa). (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~35#Answer:How do we know that Jesus knew what they had been arguing about?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.36-37+Why did Jesus take a small child in his arms?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~36#Question:Why did Jesus take a small child in his arms?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus take a small child in his arms?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alimchukua mtoto mdogo mikononi mwake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~36#Question:Why did Jesus take a small child in his arms?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~36#Answer:Why did Jesus take a small child in his arms?635861010
trans-unit.source: He wanted to show the disciples that they should not worry about how important they were relative to others. They should be helpful to everyone, including those who appear less important, such as a child. (36-37)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kuwaonyesha wanafunzi kwamba hawapaswi kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya jinsi walivyokuwa muhimu kwa wengine. Wanapaswa kuwa msaada kwa kila mtu, pamoja na wale wanaoonekana kuwa hawafai, kama vile mtoto (36-37).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~36#Answer:Why did Jesus take a small child in his arms?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.36-37+What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~36#Question:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kufanya jambo fulani "katika jina la Yesu" kunamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~36#Question:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~36#Answer:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?2002165371
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Doing something in the name of Jesus means doing it as Jesus's representative, (that is, in his place, or because of love for him). Jesus was holy and he perfectly reflected God's love to all who would accept him. Jesus did not work in order to gain honor for himself. He served God because of is love for him. When a person does like that because of Jesus, he does it "in Jesus's name". (See "in the name of" in KBT in the "name" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Kufanya kitu kwa jina la Yesu ni kufanya kama mwakilishi wa Yesu, (yaani, kwa nafasi yake, au kwa sababu ya upendo kwake). Yesu alikuwa mtakatifu na alionyesha kikamilifu upendo wa Mungu kwa wote ambao wangemkubali. Yesu hakufanya kazi ili kupata heshima kwa ajili yake mwenyewe. Alimtumikia Mungu kwa sababu ya upendo wake kwake. Wakati mtu anafanya hivyo kwa sababu ya Yesu, anafanya "kwa jina la Yesu". (Tazama "kwa jina la" katika KBT katika "jina" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~36#Answer:What do you think it means to do something "in the name of Jesus"?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!9~38#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 9:38-41 Jesus said that whoever is not opposing him and his people is on his side.
trans-unit.target: Marko 9:38-41 Yesu alisema kwamba yeyote ambaye hampingi yeye na watu wake yuko upande wake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 9.38-41+What did Jesus say about people who do good things in his name, even though they are not in association with his other followers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~38#Question:What did Jesus say about people who do good things in his name, even though they are not in association with his other followers?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about people who do good things in his name, even though they are not in association with his other followers?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu watu wanaofanya mambo mema katika jina lake, hata ingawa hawajiungi na wafuasi wake wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Question:What did Jesus say about people who do good things in his name, even though they are not in association with his other followers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~38#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who do good things in his name, even though they are not in association with his other followers?88503623
trans-unit.source: He said that we should allow them to keep on doing good things in his name. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba tunapaswa kuwaruhusu waendelee kufanya mambo mema katika jina lake. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who do good things in his name, even though they are not in association with his other followers?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.38+What was it that the disciples had seen which they did not like?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~38#Question:What was it that the disciples had seen which they did not like?
trans-unit.source: What was it that the disciples had seen which they did not like?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini ambacho wanafunzi walikuwa wameona ambacho hawakupenda?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Question:What was it that the disciples had seen which they did not like?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~38#Answer:What was it that the disciples had seen which they did not like?1592874774
trans-unit.source: They had seen a person who was not one of their group driving out demons/evil spirits in the Jesus's name. (38)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wameona mtu ambaye hakuwa mmoja wa kundi lao akifukuza pepo wachafu/roho waovu katika jina la Yesu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Answer:What was it that the disciples had seen which they did not like?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.38+What had they said to the person?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~38#Question:What had they said to the person?
trans-unit.source: What had they said to the person?
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamemwambia nini mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Question:What had they said to the person?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~38#Answer:What had they said to the person?-344482248
trans-unit.source: They had told him to stop using Jesus's name when he wanted to expel demons from people. (38)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamemwambia aache kutumia jina la Yesu alipotaka kuwafukuza roho waovu kutoka kwa watu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~38#Answer:What had they said to the person?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.39+What did Jesus say to his disciples about telling that person to stop?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~39#Question:What did Jesus say to his disciples about telling that person to stop?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to his disciples about telling that person to stop?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake nini kuhusu kumwambia mtu huyo aache?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~39#Question:What did Jesus say to his disciples about telling that person to stop?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~39#Answer:What did Jesus say to his disciples about telling that person to stop?-415735558
trans-unit.source: He said that they should allow such a person to continue. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kumruhusu mtu kama huyo aendelee. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~39#Answer:What did Jesus say to his disciples about telling that person to stop?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.39-40+Why should he continue?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~39#Question:Why should he continue?
trans-unit.source: Why should he continue?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aendelee?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~39#Question:Why should he continue?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~39#Answer:Why should he continue?764732901
trans-unit.source: If people do miracles in Jesus's name, they will only speak well of him. They are really on his side. (39-40)
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu hufanya miujiza katika jina la Yesu, watamtaja tu kwa njia nzuri. Kwa kweli wao ni upande wake (39-40)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~39#Answer:Why should he continue?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.41+What else did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~41#Question:What else did Jesus say?
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus say?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kingine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~41#Question:What else did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~41#Answer:What else did Jesus say?-858480640
trans-unit.source: He said that God will be sure to reward anyone who gives even a cup of cold water to a follower of his because of their being his follower. (41)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Mungu hakika atamlipa yeyote atakayempa mfuasi wake hata kikombe cha maji baridi kwa sababu wao ni wafuasi wake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~41#Answer:What else did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!9~42#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 9:42-50 Jesus warned his disciples to be careful not to do anything that would cause people who believe in him to fall away.
trans-unit.target: Marko 9:42-50 Yesu aliwaonya wanafunzi wake wawe waangalifu wasifanye jambo lolote ambalo lingewafanya watu wanaomwamini waanguke.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~42#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 9.42-50+What did Jesus teach here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~42#Question:What did Jesus teach here?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach here?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha nini hapa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~42#Question:What did Jesus teach here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~42#Answer:What did Jesus teach here?2017586288
trans-unit.source: He taught that it is a serious thing for a person to do anything that would cause one of his "little ones" to sin.
trans-unit.target: Alifundisha kwamba ni jambo zito kwa mtu kufanya jambo lolote ambalo lingemfanya mmoja wa "wale wadogo" wa Yesu atende dhambi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~42#Answer:What did Jesus teach here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~42#Answer:What did Jesus teach here?1137424216
trans-unit.source: Also, we must be serious enough to do what ever it takes to stop sinning.
trans-unit.target: Pia, ni lazima tuwe na uzito wa kutosha kufanya lolote linalohitajiwa ili kuacha dhambi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~42#Answer:What did Jesus teach here?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.42+What did Jesus say about any person who would cause an immature follower of his to sin?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~42#Question:What did Jesus say about any person who would cause an immature follower of his to sin?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about any person who would cause an immature follower of his to sin?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya mtu yeyote ambaye angesababisha mfuasi wake asiye mkomavu atende dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~42#Question:What did Jesus say about any person who would cause an immature follower of his to sin?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~42#Answer:What did Jesus say about any person who would cause an immature follower of his to sin?-2048247116
trans-unit.source: He said that it would have been better for that person if someone had caused him to (sink to the bottom of deep water and) drown first so that he would not have lived to cause the other person to fall away from Christ. (The punishment from God will be worse than drowning.) (42)
trans-unit.target: Akasema: Ingeli kuwa bora kwa mtu huyo kama angeli kuwa amezamishwa (katika maji ya kina kirefu na kuzamishwa) kwanza, ili asiwe hai kumfanya mtu mwingine amwache Kristo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~42#Answer:What did Jesus say about any person who would cause an immature follower of his to sin?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.43-47+What did Jesus teach in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~43#Question:What did Jesus teach in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~43#Question:What did Jesus teach in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~43#Answer:What did Jesus teach in these verses?-1232212516
trans-unit.source: When people sin it is very serious matter. We must stop sinning, no matter what we lose because of stopping. (43-47)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanapotenda dhambi ni jambo zito sana. Ni lazima tuache kutenda dhambi, bila kujali ni nini tunachopoteza kwa sababu ya kuacha.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~43#Answer:What did Jesus teach in these verses?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.46-47+What will happen to people who continue in sin?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~46#Question:What will happen to people who continue in sin?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to people who continue in sin?
trans-unit.target: Itakuwaje kwa watu wanaodumu katika dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~46#Question:What will happen to people who continue in sin?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~46#Answer:What will happen to people who continue in sin?854857315
trans-unit.source: God will have his angels throw them into hell because of it. (46-47)
trans-unit.target: Mwenyezi Mungu atawaamrisha Malaika wake wawatupie katika Jahannamu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~46#Answer:What will happen to people who continue in sin?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.47-48+What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~47#Question:What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?
trans-unit.source: What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?
trans-unit.target: Na ni mahali pabaya mno watapo tupwa wakosefu!
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~47#Question:What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~47#Answer:What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?-1104062435
trans-unit.source: Hell is a very undesirable place of torment. It is described as being like a rubbish heap, where the fire keeps burning and the maggots keep chewing. (47-48)
trans-unit.target: Jahannamu ni mahali pa mateso pasipofaa sana. Imeelezwa kuwa kama rundo la takataka, ambapo moto unaendelea kuwaka na mabuu yanaendelea kutafuna.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~47#Answer:What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!9~47#Note:What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?447909615
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: hell)
trans-unit.target: (Key Term Check: kuzimu)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~47#Note:What kind of a place is the place where they will throw the sinners?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.48+Do you think that God wants people to cut off part of their body or gouge out an eye if it causes them to sin?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~48#Question:Do you think that God wants people to cut off part of their body or gouge out an eye if it causes them to sin?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that God wants people to cut off part of their body or gouge out an eye if it causes them to sin?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Mungu anataka watu wakate sehemu ya mwili wao au wachome jicho ikiwa hilo linawafanya watende dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~48#Question:Do you think that God wants people to cut off part of their body or gouge out an eye if it causes them to sin?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~48#Answer:Do you think that God wants people to cut off part of their body or gouge out an eye if it causes them to sin?-703634974
trans-unit.source: No. He does not want that. Jesus was teaching how very serious sin is so people would understand that and not sin. By not sinning, they would avoid God's serious punishment for disobeying him, that punishment being even worse than cutting off part of one's body. (48)
trans-unit.target: Hapana. Yeye hataki hilo. Yesu alikuwa akifundisha jinsi dhambi ilivyo nzito sana ili watu waelewe hilo na sio dhambi. Kwa kutotenda dhambi, wangeepuka adhabu nzito ya Mungu kwa kutomtii, adhabu hiyo ikiwa mbaya zaidi kuliko kukata sehemu ya mwili wa mtu. (48)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~48#Answer:Do you think that God wants people to cut off part of their body or gouge out an eye if it causes them to sin?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.49+Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~49#Question:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?
trans-unit.source: Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini ni lazima kwa watu kupitia magumu (kama ' kunyunyiziwa moto ')?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~49#Question:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~49#Answer:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?-1838525975
trans-unit.source: In this way they will become more serious and more pure like God wants them to be.
trans-unit.target: Kwa njia hiyo watakuwa wenye uzito zaidi na safi zaidi kama vile Mungu atakavyo wawe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~49#Answer:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~49#Answer:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?-293025981
trans-unit.source: (Just as intense heat purifies metal as it is being made, so a sprinkling of difficulties in our lives tends to cause us to allow God to cleanse us and make us useful to him.)
trans-unit.target: (Kama vile joto kali linavyosafisha chuma wakati kinafanyizwa, ndivyo kunyunyizia matatizo katika maisha yetu kunavyoelekea kutufanya tumruhusu Mungu atusafishe na kutufanya tuwe wenye mafaa kwake.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~49#Answer:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!9~49#Note:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?879141651
trans-unit.source: There are different possible interpretations of verse 49. Check which interpretation the translators used in the translation. See if it fits with what Mark wrote before and after this verse.
trans-unit.target: Kuna tafsiri mbalimbali zinazowezekana za mstari wa 49. Angalia tafsiri ambayo watafsiri walitumia katika tafsiri. Angalia ikiwa inalingana na yale Marko aliandika kabla na baada ya mstari huu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~49#Note:Why is it necessary for people to go through difficulties (like being "sprinkled with fire")?

group.id: Q:MRK 9.50+What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!9~50#Question:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akiwatia moyo wanafunzi wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~50#Question:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~50#Answer:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?1263105381
trans-unit.source: Jesus was encouraging the disciples to live the kind of lives God wanted them to live
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akiwatia moyo wanafunzi wake waishi maisha ambayo Mungu alitaka waishi
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~50#Answer:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!9~50#Answer:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?1348392450
trans-unit.source: and to have peace among themselves.
trans-unit.target: na kuwa na amani kati yao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~50#Answer:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!9~50#Note:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?1533564037
trans-unit.source: There are different possible interpretations of this section on salt and fire. The figurative use of salt here could refer to the flavoring quality or the preserving quality of salt. Watch especially for wrong meaning that does not fit general Biblical teaching. Check the meaning understood by those who hear or read this to see if it fits this context.
trans-unit.target: Kuna tafsiri mbalimbali zinazowezekana za sehemu hii kuhusu chumvi na moto. Matumizi ya mfano ya chumvi hapa inaweza kurejelea ubora wa ladha au ubora wa kuhifadhi chumvi. Jihadharini hasa na maana mbaya ambayo haifai mafundisho ya jumla ya Biblia. Angalia maana inayoeleweka na wale wanaosikia au kusoma hii ili kuona ikiwa inafaa muktadha huu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!9~50#Note:What was Jesus encouraging the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!10~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 10:1-12 Jesus said that when anyone divorces their wife or husband they break God's command.
trans-unit.target: Marko 10:1-12 Yesu alisema kwamba mtu yeyote anapomtaliki mke au mume wake, anavunja amri ya Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 10.1-12+What did Jesus teach about divorce?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~1#Question:What did Jesus teach about divorce?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach about divorce?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha nini juu ya talaka?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~1#Question:What did Jesus teach about divorce?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~1#Answer:What did Jesus teach about divorce?-1918426923
trans-unit.source: He taught that God joined husbands and wives and they should never divorce. (5-8)
trans-unit.target: Alifundisha kwamba Mungu aliunganisha waume na wake na kwamba hawapaswi kamwe kutalikiana (5-8).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~1#Answer:What did Jesus teach about divorce?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.2+What question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~2#Question:What question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~2#Question:What question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~2#Answer:What question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?-42052453
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus whether it was against the law [of God] for a man to divorce his wife. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu kama ilikuwa kinyume cha sheria [ya Mungu] kwa mwanamume kumtaliki mke wake. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~2#Answer:What question did the Pharisees ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.2+Why did they ask Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~2#Question:Why did they ask Jesus that question?
trans-unit.source: Why did they ask Jesus that question?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walimuuliza Yesu swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~2#Question:Why did they ask Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~2#Answer:Why did they ask Jesus that question?-1287175402
trans-unit.source: They were testing him, (trying to get him to say something that they could use against him.) (2)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimjaribu, (wakijaribu kupata kitu kutoka kinywani mwake ambacho wangeweza kutumia dhidi yake.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~2#Answer:Why did they ask Jesus that question?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.3+How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~3#Question:How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~3#Question:How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~3#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?-189226070
trans-unit.source: He asked them what Moses had commanded about divorce [when he wrote God's laws]. (3)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza Musa aliamuru nini juu ya talaka [alipoandika sheria za Mungu]. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~3#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.4+What did the Pharisees reply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~4#Question:What did the Pharisees reply?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees reply?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walijibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~4#Question:What did the Pharisees reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~4#Answer:What did the Pharisees reply?-59718987
trans-unit.source: The Pharisees said that Moses did allow a man to write a paper/certificate of divorce and to send his wife away with it. (4)
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walisema kwamba Musa alimruhusu mwanamume aandike hati ya talaka na kumfukuza mke wake. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~4#Answer:What did the Pharisees reply?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.5+What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~5#Question:What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya sababu Musa alitoa sheria juu ya wanaume kuandika taarifa ya talaka wanapowataliki wake zao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~5#Question:What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~5#Answer:What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?-864061515
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that Moses made that rule about writing a divorce notice because of people stubbornly resisting God's [true] way for them. (5)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Musa aliweka sheria hiyo kuhusu kuandika taarifa ya talaka kwa sababu watu walikataa kwa ukaidi njia ya Mungu [ya kweli] kwa ajili yao. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~5#Answer:What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~5#Note:What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?1503702130
trans-unit.source: Moses did not start the divorcing. He knew that men were divorcing their wives and he insisted that if they were doing that, they must give the wife an official notice. In that way people would know that the man and woman had divorced.
trans-unit.target: Musa hakuanzisha talaka. Alijua kwamba wanaume walikuwa wakimtaliki mke wao na alisisitiza kwamba ikiwa wangefanya hivyo, walipaswa kumpa mkeo taarifa rasmi. Kwa njia hiyo watu wangejua kwamba mwanamume na mwanamke walikuwa wamemtaliki.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~5#Note:What did Jesus say about why Moses made a rule about men writing out a notice of divorce when divorcing their wives?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.6-9+What was God's plan for married couples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~6#Question:What was God's plan for married couples?
trans-unit.source: What was God's plan for married couples?
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikuwa na mpango gani kwa wenzi wa ndoa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~6#Question:What was God's plan for married couples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~6#Answer:What was God's plan for married couples?-1505290929
trans-unit.source: God intended that a man should leave his parents and have a very strong tie with his wife—their special relationship makes them one unit, so people should not separate them. (6-9)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alikusudia kwamba mwanamume awaache wazazi wake na kuwa na uhusiano wa karibu sana na mke wake. Uhusiano wao wa pekee unawafanya kuwa kiungo kimoja, kwa hivyo watu hawapaswi kuwatenganisha. (6-9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~6#Answer:What was God's plan for married couples?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.11-12+What did Jesus teach about divorced people marrying again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~11#Question:What did Jesus teach about divorced people marrying again?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach about divorced people marrying again?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifundisha nini juu ya watu waliotalikiana kuoa au kuolewa tena?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~11#Question:What did Jesus teach about divorced people marrying again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~11#Answer:What did Jesus teach about divorced people marrying again?-553205075
trans-unit.source: He said that, if a man divorces his wife or a woman her husband and then marries again, he/she commits adultery. (11-12)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba, ikiwa mwanamume atamtaliki mkewe au mwanamke mumewe na kisha kuoa tena, yeye / yeye anafanya uzinzi. (11-12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~11#Answer:What did Jesus teach about divorced people marrying again?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.11-12+What does a person do when he or she commits adultery?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~11#Question:What does a person do when he or she commits adultery?
trans-unit.source: What does a person do when he or she commits adultery?
trans-unit.target: Mtu hufanya nini anapofanya uzinzi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~11#Question:What does a person do when he or she commits adultery?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~11#Answer:What does a person do when he or she commits adultery?-144441718
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Adultery. A married person has sexual intercourse with someone who is not that married person's spouse. This term is also used in the cases where an unmarried person has sexual intercourse with someone who is married.
trans-unit.target: Neno Muhimu: Uzinzi. Mtu aliyefunga ndoa ana mahusiano ya kingono na mtu ambaye si mwenzi wa ndoa. Neno hili pia hutumiwa katika visa ambapo mtu asiyefunga ndoa ana mahusiano ya kingono na mtu aliyefunga ndoa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~11#Answer:What does a person do when he or she commits adultery?

trans-unit.source: Mark 10:13-16 People brought small children to Jesus and he blessed them.
trans-unit.target: Marko 10:13-16 Watu walimletea Yesu watoto wadogo naye akawabariki.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 10.13-16+How did Jesus feel about children coming to him?

trans-unit.source: How did Jesus feel about children coming to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alihisije kuhusu watoto waliomjia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Question:How did Jesus feel about children coming to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~13#Answer:How did Jesus feel about children coming to him?649758535
trans-unit.source: He was happy for the children to come to him. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alifurahi watoto walipomjia. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Answer:How did Jesus feel about children coming to him?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.13-16+What did Jesus say about the only way that a person can come under God's rule and authority?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the only way that a person can come under God's rule and authority?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya njia pekee ambayo mtu aweza kuwa chini ya utawala na mamlaka ya Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Question:What did Jesus say about the only way that a person can come under God's rule and authority?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~13#Answer:What did Jesus say about the only way that a person can come under God's rule and authority?2126079199
trans-unit.source: He said that a person must submit to God as a child does. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mtu anapaswa kujitiisha kwa Mungu kama mtoto anavyofanya. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Answer:What did Jesus say about the only way that a person can come under God's rule and authority?

trans-unit.source: What was happening that the disciples did not like?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani lililokuwa likiendelea ambalo halikuwapendeza wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Question:What was happening that the disciples did not like?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~13#Answer:What was happening that the disciples did not like?1838489070
trans-unit.source: People were bringing small children to Jesus. (13)
trans-unit.target: Watu walimletea Yesu watoto wadogo. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Answer:What was happening that the disciples did not like?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.13+What did the people want Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~13#Question:What did the people want Jesus to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the people want Jesus to do?
trans-unit.target: Watu walitaka Yesu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Question:What did the people want Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~13#Answer:What did the people want Jesus to do?1996735305

group.id: Q:MRK 10.13+What did the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~13#Question:What did the disciples do?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples do?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Question:What did the disciples do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~13#Answer:What did the disciples do?-619198684
trans-unit.source: They rebuked the people and tried to stop them from bringing their children to Jesus. (13)
trans-unit.target: Waliwakemea watu na kujaribu kuwazuia wasiwalete watoto wao kwa Yesu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~13#Answer:What did the disciples do?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.14+What did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~14#Question:What did Jesus say?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~14#Question:What did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~14#Answer:What did Jesus say?1331851840
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they should permit the children to come to him. (14)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba wanapaswa kuwaruhusu watoto wamkaribie. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~14#Answer:What did Jesus say?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.15+What else did he say about that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~15#Question:What else did he say about that?
trans-unit.source: What else did he say about that?
trans-unit.target: Alisema nini kingine kuhusu hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~15#Question:What else did he say about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~15#Answer:What else did he say about that?-1964955361
trans-unit.source: He also said that the citizens of God's kingdom are people who will accept God's rule over them as children do. A person can only become one of God's people by becoming like a child. (15)
trans-unit.target: Pia alisema kwamba raia wa ufalme wa Mungu ni watu ambao watakubali utawala wa Mungu juu yao kama watoto wanavyofanya. Mtu anaweza tu kuwa mmoja wa watu wa Mungu kwa kuwa kama mtoto. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~15#Answer:What else did he say about that?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.16+What did Jesus do with the children?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~16#Question:What did Jesus do with the children?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do with the children?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini na watoto?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~16#Question:What did Jesus do with the children?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~16#Answer:What did Jesus do with the children?-958703784
trans-unit.source: He took them up in his arms, put his hands on them, and blessed them. (16)
trans-unit.target: Akawakumbatia, akaweka mikono yake juu yao, akawabarikia. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~16#Answer:What did Jesus do with the children?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.16+When people read that Jesus "blessed" them, what will they think that he did?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~16#Question:When people read that Jesus "blessed" them, what will they think that he did?
trans-unit.source: When people read that Jesus "blessed" them, what will they think that he did?
trans-unit.target: Watu wasomapo kwamba Yesu 'aliwabariki,' watafikiri alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~16#Question:When people read that Jesus "blessed" them, what will they think that he did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~16#Answer:When people read that Jesus "blessed" them, what will they think that he did?402447511
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He probably said, "May God bless you." That was how the Jewish religious teachers used to do at that time. (See "bless" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Huenda alisema, "Mungu akubariki". Hivyo ndivyo walimu wa dini ya Kiyahudi walivyofanya wakati huo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~16#Answer:When people read that Jesus "blessed" them, what will they think that he did?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!10~17#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 10:17-22 Jesus talked to a rich young man about eternal life.
trans-unit.target: Marko 10:17-22 Yesu alizungumza na kijana mmoja tajiri kuhusu uzima wa milele.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 10.17-22+What did Jesus tell the rich man that he would have to do in order to receive eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~17#Question:What did Jesus tell the rich man that he would have to do in order to receive eternal life?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the rich man that he would have to do in order to receive eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia yule tajiri kwamba ni lazima afanye nini ili apokee uhai wa milele?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Question:What did Jesus tell the rich man that he would have to do in order to receive eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~17#Answer:What did Jesus tell the rich man that he would have to do in order to receive eternal life?105406303
trans-unit.source: He told him that he needed to sell all his possessions, give the money to the poor, and then be one of Jesus's followers. (21)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia kwamba alihitaji kuuza mali zake zote, kuwapa maskini pesa hizo, kisha awe mmoja wa wafuasi wa Yesu. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Answer:What did Jesus tell the rich man that he would have to do in order to receive eternal life?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.17+As Jesus was leaving that place, what did one man do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~17#Question:As Jesus was leaving that place, what did one man do?
trans-unit.source: As Jesus was leaving that place, what did one man do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipokuwa akiondoka mahali hapo, mtu mmoja alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Question:As Jesus was leaving that place, what did one man do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~17#Answer:As Jesus was leaving that place, what did one man do?940860175
trans-unit.source: He ran to Jesus and knelt down in front of him.
trans-unit.target: Alikimbia kwa Yesu na kupiga magoti mbele yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Answer:As Jesus was leaving that place, what did one man do?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.17+What question did he ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~17#Question:What question did he ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What question did he ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Alimuuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Question:What question did he ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~17#Answer:What question did he ask Jesus?1522624609
trans-unit.source: He asked Jesus what he must do in order to have eternal life.
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza Yesu kile ambacho alipaswa kufanya ili apate uzima wa milele.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Answer:What question did he ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.17+What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~17#Question:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?
trans-unit.source: What kind of life do you think eternal life is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri uhai wa milele ni uhai wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Question:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~17#Answer:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?1665342316
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Eternal life is not affected by time. God can cause it to begin now while we are still alive and it will go on forever, even after our bodies die.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Maisha ya milele hayaathiriwi na wakati. Mungu anaweza kuifanya ianze sasa wakati bado tuko hai na itaendelea milele, hata baada ya miili yetu kufa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Answer:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~17#Note:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?-1430096979
trans-unit.source: See "life" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "maisha" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Note:What kind of life do you think eternal life is?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.17+How did the man address Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~17#Question:How did the man address Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did the man address Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alimwita Yesu kwa jina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Question:How did the man address Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~17#Answer:How did the man address Jesus?-959964762
trans-unit.source: He called Jesus "Good teacher/master."
trans-unit.target: Alimwita Yesu "Mwalimu/bwana Mwema".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~17#Answer:How did the man address Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.18-19+When Jesus replied to the man, did he mean that the man should not call him "good"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~18#Question:When Jesus replied to the man, did he mean that the man should not call him "good"?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus replied to the man, did he mean that the man should not call him "good"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipomjibu mtu huyo, je, alimaanisha kwamba mtu huyo hakupaswa kumwita "mwema"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~18#Question:When Jesus replied to the man, did he mean that the man should not call him "good"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~18#Answer:When Jesus replied to the man, did he mean that the man should not call him "good"?-1667450890
trans-unit.source: No.
trans-unit.target: La, sivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~18#Answer:When Jesus replied to the man, did he mean that the man should not call him "good"?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.18+What did Jesus want the man to think about when he asked him why he called him good, and then said that only God is good?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~18#Question:What did Jesus want the man to think about when he asked him why he called him good, and then said that only God is good?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus want the man to think about when he asked him why he called him good, and then said that only God is good?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka mtu huyo afikirie nini alipomwuliza kwa nini alimwita mwema, kisha akasema kwamba Mungu peke yake ndiye mwema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~18#Question:What did Jesus want the man to think about when he asked him why he called him good, and then said that only God is good?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~18#Answer:What did Jesus want the man to think about when he asked him why he called him good, and then said that only God is good?415576392
trans-unit.source: Jesus wanted the man to realize that Jesus was good because he is God's anointed one (the Christ). (18)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka mtu huyo atambue kwamba Yesu alikuwa mwema kwa sababu yeye ndiye mtiwa-mafuta wa Mungu (Kristo). (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~18#Answer:What did Jesus want the man to think about when he asked him why he called him good, and then said that only God is good?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.19+In Jesus reply to the man, what did he indicate that a person needs to do in order to have eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~19#Question:In Jesus reply to the man, what did he indicate that a person needs to do in order to have eternal life?
trans-unit.source: In Jesus reply to the man, what did he indicate that a person needs to do in order to have eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Katika kujibu kwa mtu huyo, Yesu alionyesha kwamba ni lazima mtu afanye nini ili apate uhai wa milele?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~19#Question:In Jesus reply to the man, what did he indicate that a person needs to do in order to have eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~19#Answer:In Jesus reply to the man, what did he indicate that a person needs to do in order to have eternal life?-2139873931
trans-unit.source: Jesus showed that people need to obey God's commandments. (19)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha kwamba watu wanahitaji kutii amri za Mungu. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~19#Answer:In Jesus reply to the man, what did he indicate that a person needs to do in order to have eternal life?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.20+What kind of life had the man lived?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~20#Question:What kind of life had the man lived?
trans-unit.source: What kind of life had the man lived?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alikuwa na maisha ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~20#Question:What kind of life had the man lived?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~20#Answer:What kind of life had the man lived?-1331116700
trans-unit.source: He had been obeying God's commandments all his life. (20)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amekuwa akitii amri za Mungu maisha yake yote. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~20#Answer:What kind of life had the man lived?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.21+How did Jesus feel as he looked at the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~21#Question:How did Jesus feel as he looked at the man?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus feel as he looked at the man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alihisije alipomtazama mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~21#Question:How did Jesus feel as he looked at the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~21#Answer:How did Jesus feel as he looked at the man?-513806294
trans-unit.source: He loved him. (He knew that the man was sincerely asking these questions, not just "testing" him as others often did.) (21)
trans-unit.target: Alimpenda. (Alijua kwamba mtu huyo alikuwa akiuliza maswali haya kwa unyofu, si tu "kumjaribu" kama wengine walivyofanya mara nyingi.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~21#Answer:How did Jesus feel as he looked at the man?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.21+What else did Jesus tell the man to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~21#Question:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus tell the man to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo afanye jambo gani jingine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~21#Question:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~21#Answer:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?-1605246996
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that he must sell all his possessions and give the money to the poor.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba alipaswa kuuza mali zake zote na kuwapa maskini pesa hizo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~21#Answer:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~21#Answer:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?-1358469146
trans-unit.source: Then he would receive his reward in heaven.
trans-unit.target: Kisha angepokea thawabu yake mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~21#Answer:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~21#Answer:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?1298630066
trans-unit.source: He also told him that when he had done that, he should come and follow Jesus. (21)
trans-unit.target: Pia alimwambia kwamba baada ya kufanya hivyo, anapaswa kuja na kumfuata Yesu. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~21#Answer:What else did Jesus tell the man to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.22+How did the young man respond to what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~22#Question:How did the young man respond to what Jesus said?
trans-unit.source: How did the young man respond to what Jesus said?
trans-unit.target: Kijana huyo aliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~22#Question:How did the young man respond to what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~22#Answer:How did the young man respond to what Jesus said?647640
trans-unit.source: He was sad, and went away. (22)
trans-unit.target: Akahuzunika, akaenda zake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~22#Answer:How did the young man respond to what Jesus said?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.22+Why did the man feel sad?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~22#Question:Why did the man feel sad?
trans-unit.source: Why did the man feel sad?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mtu huyo alihuzunika?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~22#Question:Why did the man feel sad?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~22#Answer:Why did the man feel sad?479188154
trans-unit.source: He owned many things [and did not want to sell them]. (22)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na mali nyingi [na hakutaka kuziuza]. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~22#Answer:Why did the man feel sad?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!10~23#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 10:23-27 Jesus said that it is difficult for a rich person to come under God's rule.
trans-unit.target: Marko 10:23-27 Yesu alisema kwamba ni vigumu kwa tajiri kuingia katika utawala wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~23#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 10.23-27+What did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~23#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~23#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~23#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples?-667649950
trans-unit.source: He told them that it is hard for a rich person to become one that God rules over. (23)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba ni vigumu kwa mtu tajiri kuwa mtu ambaye Mungu humtawala. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~23#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.23-27+Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~23#Question:Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba ni vigumu kwa tajiri kuwa mmoja wa watu wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~23#Question:Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~23#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?2033947374
trans-unit.source: He said that because their possessions can be more important to them than doing what God wants them to do.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba ni kwa sababu mali zao zinaweza kuwa muhimu zaidi kwao kuliko kufanya yale ambayo Mungu anataka wafanye.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~23#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~23#Note:Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?49795709
trans-unit.source: This is a check for misunderstanding. Jesus did not say that rich people cannot come under God's rule. He only said that possessing many things makes it harder to submit to God.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakusema kwamba matajiri hawawezi kuwa chini ya utawala wa Mungu. Alisema tu kwamba kuwa na vitu vingi hufanya iwe vigumu kujitiisha kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~23#Note:Why do you think that Jesus said that it is hard for a rich person to become one of God's people?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.24-25+What illustration did Jesus use to show how hard it is for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~24#Question:What illustration did Jesus use to show how hard it is for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?
trans-unit.source: What illustration did Jesus use to show how hard it is for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia kielezi gani kuonyesha jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa mtu tajiri kuwa raia wa ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~24#Question:What illustration did Jesus use to show how hard it is for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~24#Answer:What illustration did Jesus use to show how hard it is for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?485591242
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to become one that God truly rules over. (24-25)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba ni rahisi kwa ngamia kupita katika tundu la sindano, kuliko kwa mtu tajiri kuwa mmoja ambaye Mungu kweli kutawala juu. (24-25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~24#Answer:What illustration did Jesus use to show how hard it is for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.26+What did the disciples think when they heard what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~26#Question:What did the disciples think when they heard what Jesus said?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples think when they heard what Jesus said?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifikiri nini waliposikia yale ambayo Yesu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~26#Question:What did the disciples think when they heard what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~26#Answer:What did the disciples think when they heard what Jesus said?2014316708
trans-unit.source: They could hardly believe what he said. (26)
trans-unit.target: Basi hawakuwa wenye kuamini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~26#Answer:What did the disciples think when they heard what Jesus said?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.27+Why were they so amazed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~27#Question:Why were they so amazed?
trans-unit.source: Why were they so amazed?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walishangaa sana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~27#Question:Why were they so amazed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~27#Answer:Why were they so amazed?1405634822
trans-unit.source: They thought [if it was difficult for people whom God had favored to be under God's rule] how could ordinary people [like them] be accepted by God? (27)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri [ikiwa ilikuwa vigumu kwa watu ambao Mungu alikuwa amewafadhili kuwa chini ya utawala wa Mungu] watu wa kawaida [kama wao] wangewezaje kukubaliwa na Mungu? (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~27#Answer:Why were they so amazed?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~27#Note:Why were they so amazed?879946158
trans-unit.source: The Jews thought that if a person was rich, that was a sign that God was very pleased with him.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi walifikiri kwamba ikiwa mtu alikuwa tajiri, hiyo ilikuwa ishara ya kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemkubali sana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~27#Note:Why were they so amazed?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.27+Did Jesus say it was impossible for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~27#Question:Did Jesus say it was impossible for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus say it was impossible for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?
trans-unit.target: Je! Yesu alisema haiwezekani kwa mtu tajiri kuwa raia wa ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~27#Question:Did Jesus say it was impossible for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~27#Answer:Did Jesus say it was impossible for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?1191965598
trans-unit.source: No, he said that the love of riches makes it almost impossible for a person to stop trusting the riches and only trust God. (God, of course, can do all kinds of things, including help a rich person understand that God's plan for him is more important than all kinds of riches.) (27)
trans-unit.target: La, alisema kwamba kupenda mali hufanya iwe vigumu kwa mtu kuacha kutegemea mali na kumtumaini Mungu tu. (Mungu, bila shaka, anaweza kufanya mambo ya kila aina, kutia ndani kumsaidia mtu tajiri aelewe kwamba mpango wa Mungu kwake ni muhimu zaidi kuliko mali ya kila aina.) (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~27#Answer:Did Jesus say it was impossible for a rich person to become a citizen of God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!10~28#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 10.31+What do you think Jesus meant by the saying, "Many who are first will be last"?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema, "Wengi walio wa kwanza watakuwa wa mwisho"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~31#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by the saying, "Many who are first will be last"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~31#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by the saying, "Many who are first will be last"?1606186758
trans-unit.source: He meant that many of those people whom the society or culture honors the most in this life will be honored the least in the next life.

trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~31#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by the saying, "Many who are first will be last"?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!10~35#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 10:35-45 James and John asked Jesus to do something for them.
trans-unit.target: Marko 10:35-45 Yakobo na Yohana walimwomba Yesu awasaidie.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 10.35-45+What did James and John ask of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~35#Question:What did James and John ask of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did James and John ask of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Yakobo na Yohana walimwomba Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Question:What did James and John ask of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~35#Answer:What did James and John ask of Jesus?-337356228
trans-unit.source: They asked that when Jesus had the honor of being king in God's kingdom he would allow one of them to sit at his right side and the other at his left side (that is, in the seats for the most-honored people, one on each side of him). (37)
trans-unit.target: Waliomba kwamba Yesu atakapokuwa na heshima ya kuwa mfalme katika ufalme wa Mungu, aruhusu mmoja wao kuketi upande wake wa kulia na mwingine upande wake wa kushoto (yaani, katika viti vya watu wenye kuheshimiwa zaidi, mmoja upande wake wa kushoto). (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Answer:What did James and John ask of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~35#Note:What did James and John ask of Jesus?1123586736
trans-unit.source: In Jewish custom the right hand side of important people was the most honored position anyone could ever have. The left hand side was the next most honored position.
trans-unit.target: Katika desturi ya Kiyahudi upande wa kulia wa watu mashuhuri ulikuwa ndio mahali pa heshima zaidi ambapo mtu yeyote angeweza kuwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Note:What did James and John ask of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.35-45+Who do you think would decide about the people who will be honored in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~35#Question:Who do you think would decide about the people who will be honored in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think would decide about the people who will be honored in the kingdom of God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani anayeamua ni nani atakayeheshimiwa katika ufalme wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Question:Who do you think would decide about the people who will be honored in the kingdom of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~35#Answer:Who do you think would decide about the people who will be honored in the kingdom of God?478477132
trans-unit.source: God [the Father] has already decided who will have that honor. (40)
trans-unit.target: Mungu [Baba] tayari ameamua ni nani atakayekuwa na heshima hiyo. (40)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Answer:Who do you think would decide about the people who will be honored in the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.35-45+What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~35#Question:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akijaribu kuwasaidia wanafunzi wake waelewe nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Question:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~35#Answer:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?-967407466
trans-unit.source: Anyone who wants to be first in importance in the kingdom of God must have the attitude of a slave (that is, he must regard himself as the least important person of all, and serve all the others). (44)
trans-unit.target: Yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza katika umuhimu katika ufalme wa Mungu lazima awe na mtazamo wa mtumwa (yaani, lazima ajione kuwa mtu wa chini kabisa, na kuwatumikia wengine wote).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Answer:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~35#Note:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?-434063507
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: See "slave" in KBT in the "servant" entry.)
trans-unit.target: (Key Term Check: Angalia "mtumwa" katika KBT katika "mtumishi" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Note:What was Jesus trying to make his disciples understand?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.35-38+How did Jesus answer James and John's request?

trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer James and John's request?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje ombi la Yakobo na Yohana?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Question:How did Jesus answer James and John's request?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~35#Answer:How did Jesus answer James and John's request?1984873704
trans-unit.source: He told them that they did not know what they were [really] asking.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba hawakujua [kwa kweli] walichokuwa wakiomba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Answer:How did Jesus answer James and John's request?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.38+What did Jesus then ask them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~38#Question:What did Jesus then ask them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus then ask them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~38#Question:What did Jesus then ask them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~38#Answer:What did Jesus then ask them?1555831330
trans-unit.source: He asked them whether they would be able to drink [what was in] the cup that he would have to drink.
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kama wangeweza kunywa kikombe ambacho yeye alikuwa akinywa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~38#Answer:What did Jesus then ask them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~38#Answer:What did Jesus then ask them?-927007388
trans-unit.source: And he asked them if they would be able to endure being baptized in the way that he would be baptized. (38)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~38#Answer:What did Jesus then ask them?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.35-38+What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~35#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema [katika mstari wa 38], "Je, mnaweza kunywa kikombe ambacho mimi ninakunywa?"
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!10~35#Alternate:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"-722850221
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said in verse 38, "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema hivi katika mstari wa 38: "Je, mnaweza kunywa kikombe ambacho mimi ninakunywa?"
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Alternate:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!10~35#Alternate:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"-1241509383
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said, "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema, "Je, mnaweza kunywa kikombe ambacho mimi ninakunywa?"
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Alternate:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~35#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"-113291302
trans-unit.source: He was asking if they could endure the kind of suffering that he would experience.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiuliza ikiwa wangeweza kuvumilia aina ya mateso ambayo yeye angekabili.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!10~35#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"889232842
trans-unit.source: The figure of speech in Greek referring to drinking from a cup came from comparing a difficult experience to drinking a bitter fluid, possibly even a poison which would cause people to die.
trans-unit.target: Mfano wa lugha ya Kigiriki unaohusu kunywa kutoka kikombe ulitokana na kulinganisha hali ngumu na kunywa kioevu chenye uchungu, labda hata sumu ambayo ingeweza kusababisha kifo cha watu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he said [in verse 38], "Can you drink the cup that I drink?"

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~35#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by his question asking if they would be able to endure being baptized the same as he would endure being baptized?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant by his question asking if they would be able to endure being baptized the same as he would endure being baptized?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini kwa swali lake la kuuliza kama wangeweza kuvumilia kubatizwa kama vile ambavyo yeye angevumilia kubatizwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by his question asking if they would be able to endure being baptized the same as he would endure being baptized?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~35#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by his question asking if they would be able to endure being baptized the same as he would endure being baptized?-973409273
trans-unit.source: In this second figure of speech he was not talking about his being baptized. He had already been baptized by John the Baptist a couple of years before this time. He was comparing having many troubles to being totally surrounded by water as when people are baptized. His meaning here was something like, "You want the glory of this leadership position, but have you thought it through? Can you endure the deep sufferings like I will have to endure before taking that position?"
trans-unit.target: Katika mfano huu wa pili wa usemi hakuwa anaongea juu ya kubatizwa kwake. Alikuwa tayari amebatizwa na Yohana Mbatizaji miaka michache kabla ya wakati huu. Alikuwa akilinganisha kuwa na shida nyingi na kuzungukwa kabisa na maji kama watu wanapobatizwa. Maana yake hapa ilikuwa kitu kama, "Unataka utukufu wa nafasi hii ya uongozi, lakini umefikiria vizuri? Je, unaweza kuvumilia mateso makubwa kama nitakavyovumilia kabla ya kuchukua nafasi hiyo?"
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~35#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by his question asking if they would be able to endure being baptized the same as he would endure being baptized?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.39+What did James and John reply?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.45+What did Jesus say about himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!10~45#Question:What did Jesus say about himself?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!10~45#Answer:What did Jesus say about himself?-690961766
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "ransom" in KBT in the "redeem" entry.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Angalia "fidia" katika KBT katika "kulipia" kuingia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!10~45#Answer:What did Jesus say about himself?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.47+Do you think that the blind man had heard about Jesus before?

group.id: Q:MRK 10.46-47+In what way, do you think, was Jesus the "Son of David"?
