trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~1#Question:Where were the villages of Bethphage and Bethany?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~1#Answer:Where were the villages of Bethphage and Bethany?385895474
trans-unit.source: They were on the hill called "the mountain of Olives," quite near to Jerusalem. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa kwenye kilima kiitwacho "Mlima wa Mizeituni", karibu sana na Yerusalemu. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~1#Answer:Where were the villages of Bethphage and Bethany?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.2+What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~2#Question:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa wanafunzi wake wawili maagizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~2#Question:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~2#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?-1170094062
trans-unit.source: He told them to go to the village [that they could see] ahead of them, enter it,
trans-unit.target: Akawaambia, Enendeni katika kijiji kile kilicho mbele yenu, nanyi mkiingia mtaona mtu mmoja anawateka nyara.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~2#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~2#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?-615531277
trans-unit.source: and they would find a young donkey tied there, one that no one had ever ridden.
trans-unit.target: Wakamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa, ambaye hakuna mtu aliyewahi kumpanda.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~2#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~2#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?1366929104
trans-unit.source: He said that they were to untie it and bring it [to him]. (2)
trans-unit.target: Akasema kwamba wamfungue na kumletea [yeye]. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~2#Answer:What instructions did Jesus give to two of his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.3+What should they say if anyone asked them what they were doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~3#Question:What should they say if anyone asked them what they were doing?
trans-unit.source: What should they say if anyone asked them what they were doing?
trans-unit.target: Wangejibuje ikiwa mtu yeyote angewauliza walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~3#Question:What should they say if anyone asked them what they were doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~3#Answer:What should they say if anyone asked them what they were doing?-1226264675
trans-unit.source: They were to say that the Lord needed [the donkey] and would send it back soon. (3)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kusema kwamba Bwana anauhitaji [punda-dume] na atamrudisha hivi karibuni. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~3#Answer:What should they say if anyone asked them what they were doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.4-6+What happened when the disciples reached the village?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~4#Question:What happened when the disciples reached the village?
trans-unit.source: What happened when the disciples reached the village?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia wanafunzi walipofika kijijini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~4#Question:What happened when the disciples reached the village?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?-300326726
trans-unit.source: They found the donkey just as Jesus had said that they would. (4)
trans-unit.target: Walimkuta punda kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amesema wangemwona. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?1068970264
trans-unit.source: People asked them why they were untying it. (5)
trans-unit.target: Watu waliwauliza kwa nini walikuwa wakifungua. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?178184489
trans-unit.source: They told [them] that Jesus had told them to [do it]. -OR-
trans-unit.target: Waliwaambia [wao] kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewaambia [wafanye hivyo]. - AU-
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?1890881803
trans-unit.source: They told [them] what Jesus had told them to say. (6)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaambia [wale wanafunzi] yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amewaambia waseme. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?-330518823
trans-unit.source: The people allowed them to take it [to Jesus]. (4-6)
trans-unit.target: Watu waliwaruhusu wampeleke [Yesu] maji hayo (4-6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~4#Answer:What happened when the disciples reached the village?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.7-8+What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~7#Question:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya wanafunzi wawili kumletea Yesu mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~7#Question:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~7#Answer:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?1544813685
trans-unit.source: Some disciples threw their outer clothing over the donkey's back for Jesus to sit on. (7)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya wanafunzi walitupa mavazi yao ya nje juu ya mgongo wa punda ili Yesu apande juu yake. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~7#Answer:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~7#Answer:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?-1635658939
trans-unit.source: Many people spread their outer clothing on the road,
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani, naye Yesu akawaaga.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~7#Answer:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~7#Answer:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?-1125309933
trans-unit.source: and other people spread [palm] branches on the road. (8)
trans-unit.target: Na wengine waliweka matawi ya mitende juu ya njia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~7#Answer:What happened after the two disciples brought the young donkey to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.7-8+Why do you think that they were doing like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~7#Question:Why do you think that they were doing like that?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they were doing like that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walifanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~7#Question:Why do you think that they were doing like that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~7#Answer:Why do you think that they were doing like that?680291384
trans-unit.source: They did it to prepare the path in a special way to honor Jesus like they did their kings.
trans-unit.target: Walifanya hivyo ili kutayarisha njia kwa njia ya pekee ya kumheshimu Yesu kama walivyofanya wafalme wao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~7#Answer:Why do you think that they were doing like that?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.9+What did the people shout?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~9#Question:What did the people shout?
trans-unit.source: What did the people shout?
trans-unit.target: Watu walipaaza sauti gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~9#Question:What did the people shout?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~9#Answer:What did the people shout?-698876774
trans-unit.source: They shouted praises for Jesus, saying that God had blessed him by giving him power to save them. (9)
trans-unit.target: Walipaaza sauti kumsifu Yesu, wakisema kwamba Mungu alikuwa amembariki kwa kumpa nguvu za kuwaokoa. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~9#Answer:What did the people shout?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.9+Whom did they say Jesus was representing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~9#Question:Whom did they say Jesus was representing?
trans-unit.source: Whom did they say Jesus was representing?
trans-unit.target: Walidai kwamba Yesu alikuwa akiwakilisha nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~9#Question:Whom did they say Jesus was representing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~9#Answer:Whom did they say Jesus was representing?2079219516
trans-unit.source: They said that Jesus was representing God. (9)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa akimwakilisha Mungu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~9#Answer:Whom did they say Jesus was representing?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.10+What do you think that they thought was going to happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~10#Question:What do you think that they thought was going to happen?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that they thought was going to happen?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri walifikiri nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~10#Question:What do you think that they thought was going to happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~10#Answer:What do you think that they thought was going to happen?49023855
trans-unit.source: They apparently thought that Jesus would immediately fulfill the Old Testament prophesies about the Messiah/Christ setting up his kingdom on earth. (They probably thought that Jesus would become king over their land, perhaps even the world, and cause the Romans to leave their country.) (10)
trans-unit.target: Inaonekana walifikiri kwamba Yesu angetimiza mara moja unabii wa Agano la Kale kuhusu Masihi/Kristo akianzisha ufalme wake duniani. (Labda walifikiri kwamba Yesu angekuwa mfalme juu ya nchi yao, labda hata ulimwengu, na kusababisha Warumi kuondoka nchi yao.) (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~10#Answer:What do you think that they thought was going to happen?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.11+After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~11#Question:After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.source: After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kuingia Yerusalemu, Yesu alienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~11#Question:After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~11#Answer:After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?-2137598567
trans-unit.source: He went to the temple area. (11)
trans-unit.target: Alienda kwenye eneo la hekalu. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~11#Answer:After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!11~11#Note:After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?1288179776
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: See "temple" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: (Kichunguzi cha Maneno Muhimu: Ona "hekalu" katika Kiswahili cha Ulimwengu Mpya.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~11#Note:After entering Jerusalem, where did Jesus go?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.11+What did he do when he reached the temple?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~11#Question:What did he do when he reached the temple?
trans-unit.source: What did he do when he reached the temple?
trans-unit.target: Alifanya nini alipofika hekaluni?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~11#Question:What did he do when he reached the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~11#Answer:What did he do when he reached the temple?1579352508
trans-unit.source: He looked around and then went back to Bethany, since it was late [in the day]. (11)
trans-unit.target: Akaangalia huku na huku, kisha akarudi Bethania, kwa kuwa ilikuwa jioni [katika siku hiyo]. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~11#Answer:What did he do when he reached the temple?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!11~12#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 11:12-19 Jesus drove the traders out of the temple courtyard.
trans-unit.target: Marko 11:12-19 Yesu aliwafukuza wafanyabiashara kutoka katika ua wa hekalu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 11.12-19+What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~12#Question:What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?
trans-unit.source: What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia asubuhi iliyofuata Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakitembea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Question:What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~12#Answer:What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?-2110180022
trans-unit.source: Jesus saw a fig tree. He went and checked it for fruit,
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipoona mtini, akaenda kuutazama.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Answer:What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~12#Answer:What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?-1772640646
trans-unit.source: and finding it had none, said that it would never bear fruit again. (12-14)
trans-unit.target: na akakuta hakuna, akasema kwamba haitazaa matunda tena kamwe. (12-14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Answer:What happened the next morning as Jesus and his disciples were walking along?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.12-19+Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~12#Question:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwakasirikia sana wafanyabiashara waliokuwa katika ua wa hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Question:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?159328884
trans-unit.source: He was angry because those people were not thinking about God and praying to him there at the temple, but were using the temple area for getting a profit, just like a group of robbers would do.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa na hasira kwa sababu watu hao hawakuwa wakimfikiria Mungu na kusali kwake huko hekaluni, bali walikuwa wakitumia eneo la hekalu ili kupata faida, kama vile kikundi cha wanyang'anyi kingefanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?1637818267
trans-unit.source: In the noise of doing their business, they were making it hard for other people who really had come there to pray. (17)
trans-unit.target: Katika kelele za kufanya biashara zao, walikuwa wanawafanya watu wengine ambao walikuwa wamekuja hapo kusali kuwa ngumu. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus was so angry at the businessmen in the temple courtyard?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.12+Why did Jesus go to look at the fig tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~12#Question:Why did Jesus go to look at the fig tree?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus go to look at the fig tree?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alienda kutazama mtini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Question:Why did Jesus go to look at the fig tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~12#Answer:Why did Jesus go to look at the fig tree?-1728737575
trans-unit.source: He went and looked because he was hungry. He wanted to see if it had anything to eat on it. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alienda na kuangalia kwa sababu alikuwa na njaa. Alitaka kuona kama alikuwa na kitu cha kula juu yake. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Answer:Why did Jesus go to look at the fig tree?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.12-14+Why did the tree not have any figs on it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~12#Question:Why did the tree not have any figs on it?
trans-unit.source: Why did the tree not have any figs on it?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mti huo haukuwa na tini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Question:Why did the tree not have any figs on it?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!11~12#Note:Why did the tree not have any figs on it?2146305924
trans-unit.source: It did not have figs because it was not the time for figs. (13)
trans-unit.target: Haikuwa na tini kwa sababu haukuwa wakati wa tini. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Note:Why did the tree not have any figs on it?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!11~12#Note:Why did the tree not have any figs on it?-164121616
trans-unit.source: Some people say that in March poorer people ate small buds that would later drop off as the fruit formed. It was probably April at this time, and this tree did not have the edible buds on it. Therefore it may be that the tree would not have had any figs that year anyway, even when it became time for the fruit.
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine husema kwamba katika Machi watu maskini walikula buds ndogo ambayo baadaye kuanguka mbali kama matunda sumu. Pengine ilikuwa Aprili wakati huu, na mti huu hakuwa buds chakula juu yake. Kwa hiyo inaweza kuwa kwamba mti bila kuwa na tini yoyote mwaka huo hata hivyo, hata wakati ikawa wakati wa matunda.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Note:Why did the tree not have any figs on it?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.12-14+What did Jesus say to the tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~12#Question:What did Jesus say to the tree?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the tree?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini mti huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Question:What did Jesus say to the tree?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!11~12#Note:What did Jesus say to the tree?1829973955
trans-unit.source: He said that the tree would never bear fruit again. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mti huo haungezaa matunda tena. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~12#Note:What did Jesus say to the tree?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.15+When Jesus reached Jerusalem, where did he go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~15#Question:When Jesus reached Jerusalem, where did he go?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus reached Jerusalem, where did he go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi alipofika Yerusalemu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Question:When Jesus reached Jerusalem, where did he go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~15#Answer:When Jesus reached Jerusalem, where did he go?1510382627
trans-unit.source: He went to the temple area (that is, the courtyard around the temple building). (15)
trans-unit.target: Alienda kwenye eneo la hekalu (yaani, ua uliozunguka jengo la hekalu). (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Answer:When Jesus reached Jerusalem, where did he go?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.15+What were some of the people in the temple area doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~15#Question:What were some of the people in the temple area doing?
trans-unit.source: What were some of the people in the temple area doing?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani waliokuwa hekaluni walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Question:What were some of the people in the temple area doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~15#Answer:What were some of the people in the temple area doing?-925173825
trans-unit.source: They were buying and selling things and changing money. (15)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakinunua na kuuza vitu na kubadilisha pesa. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Answer:What were some of the people in the temple area doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.15-17+What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~15#Question:What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Question:What did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~15#Answer:What did Jesus do?-509784640
trans-unit.source: He told them that they were doing wrong and he drove them out of the temple area. (15-17)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba walikuwa wakifanya vibaya na akawafukuza kutoka eneo la hekalu (15-17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Answer:What did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.15-16+What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~15#Question:What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini kilichoonyesha jinsi alivyokuwa amekasirishwa na matendo ya watu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Question:What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~15#Answer:What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?-1853174546
trans-unit.source: He turned over the tables of those who were changing money and the benches of those who were selling doves. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadili pesa na viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Answer:What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~15#Answer:What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?111036007
trans-unit.source: He would not allow anyone to carry things for their business across the temple courtyard. (16)
trans-unit.target: Hakumruhusu mtu yeyote kubeba vitu kwa ajili ya biashara yao kupitia ua wa hekalu. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~15#Answer:What did Jesus do that showed how angry he was about the peoples' actions?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.17+What did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~17#Question:What did Jesus say?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~17#Question:What did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~17#Answer:What did Jesus say?-1654257476
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that [the prophets long ago] had written that God said his house was to be a place where all cultural groups would pray. These traders, however, had made it into a robbers' den (that is, like a place for robbers to gather and then go out to harm people). (17)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba [manabii wa zamani] walikuwa wameandika kwamba Mungu alisema nyumba yake ilikuwa mahali ambapo vikundi vyote vya kitamaduni vingesali. Hata hivyo, wafanyabiashara hawa walikuwa wameifanya kuwa pango la wanyang'anyi (yaani, kama mahali ambapo wanyang'anyi hukusanyika na kisha kwenda kuwadhuru watu). (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~17#Answer:What did Jesus say?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.18+What did the chief priests and teachers of the law do when they heard what Jesus had done?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~18#Question:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law do when they heard what Jesus had done?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and teachers of the law do when they heard what Jesus had done?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi walifanya nini waliposikia yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amefanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~18#Question:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law do when they heard what Jesus had done?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~18#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law do when they heard what Jesus had done?242313271
trans-unit.source: They were very angry and began to plan how they could destroy Jesus (that is, how they could ruin all that Jesus was doing, probably by killing him). (18)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na hasira sana na wakaanza kupanga jinsi wangeweza kumwangamiza Yesu (yaani, jinsi wangeweza kuharibu yote ambayo Yesu alikuwa akifanya, labda kwa kumuua). (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~18#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law do when they heard what Jesus had done?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.18-19+Why do you think that they were so angry?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~18#Question:Why do you think that they were so angry?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they were so angry?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walikuwa na hasira hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~18#Question:Why do you think that they were so angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~18#Answer:Why do you think that they were so angry?-1149313118
trans-unit.source: They were angry because they thought that Jesus had no authority to run those people out. They felt they were the bosses of the temple and the area around it.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na hasira kwa sababu walidhani kwamba Yesu hakuwa na mamlaka ya kuwafukuza watu hao. Walifikiri kwamba wao ndio wakuu wa hekalu na eneo lililolizunguka.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~18#Answer:Why do you think that they were so angry?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.18+Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~18#Question:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?
trans-unit.source: Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakumuua Yesu mara moja?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~18#Question:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~18#Answer:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?-2043511786
trans-unit.source: They were afraid that the crowd would turn against them because the people were amazed by what he taught them. (18)
trans-unit.target: Waliogopa kwamba umati ungewageukia kwa sababu watu walishangazwa na mafundisho yake. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~18#Answer:Why did they not just kill Jesus immediately?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!11~20#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 11:20-26 Jesus taught the disciples that if a person prays believing that God will do something for him, God will do it.
trans-unit.target: Marko 11:20-26 Yesu aliwafundisha wanafunzi wake kwamba ikiwa mtu anasali akiwa na imani kwamba Mungu atamfanyia jambo fulani, Mungu atamfanyia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 11.20-26+What was Jesus teaching his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~20#Question:What was Jesus teaching his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus teaching his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha wanafunzi wake nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Question:What was Jesus teaching his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~20#Answer:What was Jesus teaching his disciples?-2056039951
trans-unit.source: He was teaching that when a person prays, he must believe that God will answer his prayer, and then God will do what they ask of him. (22-24)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba mtu anaposali, lazima aamini kwamba Mungu atajibu sala yake, na kisha Mungu atafanya kile wanachomwomba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Answer:What was Jesus teaching his disciples?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.20-21+As the disciples walked along the next morning, what did they see?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~20#Question:As the disciples walked along the next morning, what did they see?
trans-unit.source: As the disciples walked along the next morning, what did they see?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walipotembea asubuhi iliyofuata, waliona nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Question:As the disciples walked along the next morning, what did they see?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~20#Answer:As the disciples walked along the next morning, what did they see?-634274665
trans-unit.source: They saw that the fig tree on which Jesus had put a curse the day before had withered. (20-21)
trans-unit.target: Waliona kwamba mtini ambao Yesu alikuwa ameulaani siku moja kabla ya hapo ulikuwa umenyauka (20-21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Answer:As the disciples walked along the next morning, what did they see?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.20-21+Tell me some examples of people putting a curse on something.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~20#Question:Tell me some examples of people putting a curse on something.
trans-unit.source: Tell me some examples of people putting a curse on something.
trans-unit.target: Nipe mifano ya watu waliotumia laana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Question:Tell me some examples of people putting a curse on something.

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!11~20#Note:Tell me some examples of people putting a curse on something.2097195740
trans-unit.source: This is a check whether or not the respondent assumes that Jesus used power from Satan to make the curse happen. If so a different expression will probably need to be used.
trans-unit.target: Hii ni kuangalia kama au si mhojiwa anaamini kwamba Yesu alitumia nguvu kutoka kwa Shetani kufanya laana kutokea. Kama ni hivyo labda itakuwa na matumizi ya maneno tofauti.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~20#Note:Tell me some examples of people putting a curse on something.

group.id: Q:MRK 11.22+What did Jesus say that they must do to have their prayers answered?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~22#Question:What did Jesus say that they must do to have their prayers answered?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that they must do to have their prayers answered?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni lazima wafanye nini ili sala zao zijibiwe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~22#Question:What did Jesus say that they must do to have their prayers answered?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~22#Answer:What did Jesus say that they must do to have their prayers answered?-939510867
trans-unit.source: As they pray, they must believe that God will do what they ask. (22)
trans-unit.target: Wanaposali, lazima waamini kwamba Mungu atafanya kile wanachoomba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~22#Answer:What did Jesus say that they must do to have their prayers answered?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.23+What illustration did Jesus give to show what sorts of things are possible if we trust God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~23#Question:What illustration did Jesus give to show what sorts of things are possible if we trust God?
trans-unit.source: What illustration did Jesus give to show what sorts of things are possible if we trust God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa kielezi gani kuonyesha ni mambo ya aina gani yawezayo kutukia tukimtumaini Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~23#Question:What illustration did Jesus give to show what sorts of things are possible if we trust God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~23#Answer:What illustration did Jesus give to show what sorts of things are possible if we trust God?-104098525
trans-unit.source: He said that if they would say to a mountain that it should move and fall into the sea, God would cause it to happen. (23)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kama wangemwambia mlima, Ondoka ukaanguke baharini, Mungu angefanya iwe hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~23#Answer:What illustration did Jesus give to show what sorts of things are possible if we trust God?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.24+What must people do so that God will cause what they pray for to happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~24#Question:What must people do so that God will cause what they pray for to happen?
trans-unit.source: What must people do so that God will cause what they pray for to happen?
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima watu wafanye nini ili Mungu afanye yatendeke yale wanayoomba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~24#Question:What must people do so that God will cause what they pray for to happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~24#Answer:What must people do so that God will cause what they pray for to happen?-2043309641
trans-unit.source: They must believe that God has already done it for them. (24)
trans-unit.target: Lazima waamini kwamba Mungu tayari amewafanyia hivyo. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~24#Answer:What must people do so that God will cause what they pray for to happen?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.25+What else must a person do as he prays?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~25#Question:What else must a person do as he prays?
trans-unit.source: What else must a person do as he prays?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kingine ambacho ni lazima mtu afanye anaposali?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~25#Question:What else must a person do as he prays?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~25#Answer:What else must a person do as he prays?127852575
trans-unit.source: He must forgive everyone for anything they have done against him. (25)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima amsamehe kila mtu kwa lolote ambalo wamemfanyia. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~25#Answer:What else must a person do as he prays?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.25-26+What happens when a person who belongs to God forgives others?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~25#Question:What happens when a person who belongs to God forgives others?
trans-unit.source: What happens when a person who belongs to God forgives others?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hutukia mtu wa Mungu anapowasamehe wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~25#Question:What happens when a person who belongs to God forgives others?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~25#Answer:What happens when a person who belongs to God forgives others?1947151460
trans-unit.source: They make the way clear for God to forgive (or keep on forgiving) them.
trans-unit.target: Wanafanya njia ya Mungu kuwaghufiria.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~25#Answer:What happens when a person who belongs to God forgives others?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!11~27#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 11:27-33 The religious leaders asked Jesus who had given him authority to do the things he did.
trans-unit.target: Marko 11:27-33 Viongozi wa kidini walimwuliza Yesu ni nani aliyempa mamlaka ya kufanya mambo aliyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~27#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 11.27-33+What were the chief priests and teachers of the law asking Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~27#Question:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law asking Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What were the chief priests and teachers of the law asking Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi wanamwuliza Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~27#Question:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law asking Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~27#Answer:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law asking Jesus?695994099
trans-unit.source: They were asking who had given him the authority to do the things he was doing [in the temple area]. (28)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimwuliza ni nani aliyempa mamlaka ya kufanya mambo aliyokuwa akifanya [katika eneo la hekalu]. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~27#Answer:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law asking Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.27+Where was Jesus when the chief priests and teachers of the law were asking where he got his authority?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~27#Question:Where was Jesus when the chief priests and teachers of the law were asking where he got his authority?
trans-unit.source: Where was Jesus when the chief priests and teachers of the law were asking where he got his authority?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa wapi wakati wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi walipomwuliza alitoka wapi mamlaka yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~27#Question:Where was Jesus when the chief priests and teachers of the law were asking where he got his authority?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~27#Answer:Where was Jesus when the chief priests and teachers of the law were asking where he got his authority?1527343671
trans-unit.source: He was walking in the temple area. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akitembea katika eneo la hekalu. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~27#Answer:Where was Jesus when the chief priests and teachers of the law were asking where he got his authority?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.29+How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~29#Question:How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~29#Question:How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~29#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?-506752751
trans-unit.source: He asked them a question. (29)
trans-unit.target: Basi akawauliza swali.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~29#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.29-30+What was Jesus's question to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~29#Question:What was Jesus's question to them?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus's question to them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~29#Question:What was Jesus's question to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~29#Answer:What was Jesus's question to them?-2121157952
trans-unit.source: He asked them whether it was God who had given authority to John to baptize people, or whether John had done it on his own authority. (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kama ilikuwa ni Mungu aliyetoa mamlaka kwa Yohana kubatiza watu, au kama Yohana alifanya hivyo kwa mamlaka yake mwenyewe. (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~29#Answer:What was Jesus's question to them?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.31-32+Why did the chief priests and teachers of the law find it difficult to answer that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~31#Question:Why did the chief priests and teachers of the law find it difficult to answer that question?
trans-unit.source: Why did the chief priests and teachers of the law find it difficult to answer that question?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini makuhani wakuu na waandishi waliona vigumu kujibu swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~31#Question:Why did the chief priests and teachers of the law find it difficult to answer that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~31#Answer:Why did the chief priests and teachers of the law find it difficult to answer that question?-1027445115
trans-unit.source: They knew that if they said that God had sent John to preach and baptize, then Jesus would ask why they did not believe John the Baptist's message. If, however, they said that it was not God who sent John the Baptist, then the people would turn against them because the people believed that God had chosen John to be one of his prophets. (31-32)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba kama wangesema kwamba Mungu alimtuma Yohana kuhubiri na kubatiza, basi Yesu angeuliza kwa nini hawakuamini ujumbe wa Yohana Mbatizaji. Hata hivyo, kama wangesema kwamba haikutoka kwa Mungu kumtuma Yohana Mbatizaji, basi watu wangewageukia kwa sababu watu waliamini kwamba Mungu alikuwa amemchagua Yohana kuwa mmoja wa manabii wake. (31-32)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~31#Answer:Why did the chief priests and teachers of the law find it difficult to answer that question?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.33+How did they answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~33#Question:How did they answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did they answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walimjibu Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~33#Question:How did they answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~33#Answer:How did they answer Jesus?-1201991367
trans-unit.source: They said that they did not know whether John the Baptist had God's authority to do what he did or not. (33)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba hawakujua kama Yohana Mbatizaji alikuwa na mamlaka ya Mungu ya kufanya aliyofanya au la. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~33#Answer:How did they answer Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 11.33+What did Jesus say to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!11~33#Question:What did Jesus say to them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~33#Question:What did Jesus say to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!11~33#Answer:What did Jesus say to them?-1994333258
trans-unit.source: He said that, since they would not answer his question about who sent John to preach and baptize, he would not answer their question about who gave him authority to do what he was doing. (33)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba, kwa kuwa hawakutaka kujibu swali lake juu ya ni nani aliyemtuma Yohana kuhubiri na kubatiza, yeye hangejibu swali lao juu ya ni nani aliyempa mamlaka ya kufanya yale aliyokuwa akifanya. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!11~33#Answer:What did Jesus say to them?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!12~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 12:1-12 Jesus told a parable about a man who rented his grapevine garden to wicked tenants.
trans-unit.target: Marko 12:1-12 Yesu alitoa mfano wa mtu aliyewakodisha wakulima waovu shamba lake la mizabibu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1-12+In the story which Jesus told, what were the vine growers wanting to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:In the story which Jesus told, what were the vine growers wanting to do?
trans-unit.source: In the story which Jesus told, what were the vine growers wanting to do?
trans-unit.target: Katika hadithi ambayo Yesu alisimulia, wakulima wa mizabibu walitaka kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:In the story which Jesus told, what were the vine growers wanting to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:In the story which Jesus told, what were the vine growers wanting to do?636789563
trans-unit.source: They were wanting to obtain all of the fruit from the vineyard, and even the vineyard itself, for themselves by stealing and killing. (2-7)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wanataka kupata matunda yote kutoka shamba la mizabibu, na hata shamba la mizabibu lenyewe, kwa wenyewe kwa kuiba na kuua. (2-7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:In the story which Jesus told, what were the vine growers wanting to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1-12+What do you think they were supposed to be doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:What do you think they were supposed to be doing?
trans-unit.source: What do you think they were supposed to be doing?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri walipaswa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:What do you think they were supposed to be doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:What do you think they were supposed to be doing?-255293782
trans-unit.source: They were supposed to grow much fruit
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuzaa matunda mengi
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:What do you think they were supposed to be doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:What do you think they were supposed to be doing?-892620044
trans-unit.source: and give some of the [first] fruit [probably ¼ to ½ of the harvest] to the owner of the garden. (2)
trans-unit.target: Na mtoe baadhi ya matunda yake kwa mwenye shamba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:What do you think they were supposed to be doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?
trans-unit.source: To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza na nani wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?1214339757
trans-unit.source: He was speaking to the Jewish leaders-the chief priests, teachers of the law, and elders.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza na viongozi wa Wayahudi - makuhani wakuu, waandishi, na wazee.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~1#Note:To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?-210702688
trans-unit.source: This information should be clear from 11:27, but it may be good to say it again here in 12:1. It is important for a correct understanding of the meaning of the parable.
trans-unit.target: Habari hii inapaswa kuwa wazi kutoka 11:27, lakini inaweza kuwa nzuri kuisema tena hapa katika 12:1. Ni muhimu kwa uelewa sahihi wa maana ya mfano.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Note:To whom was Jesus speaking at this time?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+What kind of speaking was Jesus using here? (That is, was he telling a history, a story, a parable, or what?)

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:What kind of speaking was Jesus using here? (That is, was he telling a history, a story, a parable, or what?)
trans-unit.source: What kind of speaking was Jesus using here? (That is, was he telling a history, a story, a parable, or what?)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akitumia usemi wa aina gani hapa? (Yaani, je, alikuwa akieleza historia, hadithi, mfano, au nini?)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:What kind of speaking was Jesus using here? (That is, was he telling a history, a story, a parable, or what?)

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:What kind of speaking was Jesus using here? (That is, was he telling a history, a story, a parable, or what?)2007328104
trans-unit.source: Jesus was using a parable, a story with a deeper meaning.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akitumia mfano, hadithi yenye maana kubwa zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:What kind of speaking was Jesus using here? (That is, was he telling a history, a story, a parable, or what?)

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+Jesus began his parable speaking of a certain man. What did this man do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:Jesus began his parable speaking of a certain man. What did this man do?
trans-unit.source: Jesus began his parable speaking of a certain man. What did this man do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alianza mfano wake kwa kusema juu ya mtu fulani. Mtu huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:Jesus began his parable speaking of a certain man. What did this man do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:Jesus began his parable speaking of a certain man. What did this man do?-1914770660
trans-unit.source: He planted a vineyard.
trans-unit.target: Alipanda shamba la mizabibu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:Jesus began his parable speaking of a certain man. What did this man do?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+Why do you think that the man made a fence around the vineyard?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:Why do you think that the man made a fence around the vineyard?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the man made a fence around the vineyard?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu huyo alijenga ua kuzunguka shamba la mizabibu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:Why do you think that the man made a fence around the vineyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:Why do you think that the man made a fence around the vineyard?1661129930
trans-unit.source: He made a fence to show that it was his and to protect it.
trans-unit.target: Alijenga ua ili kuonyesha kwamba ni mali yake na kuilinda.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:Why do you think that the man made a fence around the vineyard?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+Why do you think that the man dug a pit?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:Why do you think that the man dug a pit?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the man dug a pit?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini mtu huyo alichimba shimo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:Why do you think that the man dug a pit?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:Why do you think that the man dug a pit?-137228497
trans-unit.source: He dug a pit so that he would have a place to put the grapes in order to tramp the juice out of them.
trans-unit.target: Alichimba shimo ili awe na mahali pa kuweka zabibu ili apige maji yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:Why do you think that the man dug a pit?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+Why do you think that he built a tower?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:Why do you think that he built a tower?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that he built a tower?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini alijenga mnara huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:Why do you think that he built a tower?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:Why do you think that he built a tower?1941955359
trans-unit.source: He made a tower so that he could go there and watch for wild animals or birds that might eat or ruin the grapes.(The tower probably provided a place to stay and to store grain as well as a good placed above the vines from which to watch the field.)
trans-unit.target: Alijenga mnara ili aweze kwenda huko na kuangalia wanyama wa porini au ndege ambao wangeweza kula au kuharibu zabibu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:Why do you think that he built a tower?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.1+What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~1#Question:What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?
trans-unit.source: What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?
trans-unit.target: Mkulima alifanya nini alipomaliza kutayarisha shamba la mizabibu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Question:What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?1858561710
trans-unit.source: He put it in the care of some people who would rent it,
trans-unit.target: Aliiweka katika utunzaji wa watu ambao wangeikodisha,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~1#Answer:What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?1604540588
trans-unit.source: and then he went away to another country. (1)
trans-unit.target: Kisha akaenda nchi nyingine. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~1#Answer:What did the man do when he had finished preparing the vineyard?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.2+What happened when the harvest time came?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~2#Question:What happened when the harvest time came?
trans-unit.source: What happened when the harvest time came?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia wakati wa mavuno ulipofika?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~2#Question:What happened when the harvest time came?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~2#Answer:What happened when the harvest time came?845377835
trans-unit.source: The owner sent a servant/slave to collect some of the harvest from the vineyard. (2)
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alituma mtumishi/mtumwa kukusanya baadhi ya mavuno kutoka katika shamba la mizabibu. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~2#Answer:What happened when the harvest time came?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.2-5+Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~2#Question:Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri kwamba watu waliotunza shamba la mizabibu walipaswa kumpa mtumishi fulani baadhi ya mavuno yao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~2#Question:Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~2#Answer:Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?-485955181
trans-unit.source: That was part of their agreement. The owner of the vineyard was supposed to receive [the first] part of the harvest as payment for them using his vineyard.
trans-unit.target: Mmiliki wa shamba hilo la mizabibu alipaswa kupewa sehemu ya kwanza ya mavuno ili kuwalipa wafanyakazi hao kwa ajili ya shamba lake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~2#Answer:Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~2#Note:Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?-818075795
trans-unit.source: This is a check for any misunderstanding.
trans-unit.target: Hii ni hundi kwa ajili ya kutokuelewana yoyote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~2#Note:Do you think that the people who took care of the vineyard should have to give some of their harvest to the servant?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.3+How do we know that those people did not give a part of the harvest to the servant whom the owner sent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~3#Question:How do we know that those people did not give a part of the harvest to the servant whom the owner sent?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that those people did not give a part of the harvest to the servant whom the owner sent?
trans-unit.target: Twajuaje kwamba watu hao hawakumpa sehemu ya mavuno mtumishi aliyetumwa na mwenye shamba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~3#Question:How do we know that those people did not give a part of the harvest to the servant whom the owner sent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~3#Answer:How do we know that those people did not give a part of the harvest to the servant whom the owner sent?-1277435462
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that they beat him and sent him away with nothing. (3)
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba walimpiga na kumrudisha akiwa mikono mitupu. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~3#Answer:How do we know that those people did not give a part of the harvest to the servant whom the owner sent?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.4-5+What did the owner of the vineyard do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~4#Question:What did the owner of the vineyard do then?
trans-unit.source: What did the owner of the vineyard do then?
trans-unit.target: Basi, yule mwenye shamba atafanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~4#Question:What did the owner of the vineyard do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~4#Answer:What did the owner of the vineyard do then?994192189
trans-unit.source: He sent other servants/slaves, but the people looking after the vineyard rejected them all, beating some and killing some. (4-5)
trans-unit.target: Aliwatuma watumishi/watumwa wengine, lakini watu waliokuwa wakitunza shamba la mizabibu waliwakataa wote, wakipiga baadhi yao na kuwaua wengine. (4-5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~4#Answer:What did the owner of the vineyard do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.6+Whom did the owner of the vineyard send last?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~6#Question:Whom did the owner of the vineyard send last?
trans-unit.source: Whom did the owner of the vineyard send last?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba la mizabibu alimtuma nani mwisho?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~6#Question:Whom did the owner of the vineyard send last?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~6#Answer:Whom did the owner of the vineyard send last?-1397208194
trans-unit.source: He sent his own son. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alimtuma mwana wake mwenyewe. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~6#Answer:Whom did the owner of the vineyard send last?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.7-8+What did the people looking after the vineyard do when they saw the son of the owner come near?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~7#Question:What did the people looking after the vineyard do when they saw the son of the owner come near?
trans-unit.source: What did the people looking after the vineyard do when they saw the son of the owner come near?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliokuwa wakitunza shamba la mizabibu walifanya nini walipomwona mwana wa mwenye shamba la mizabibu akikaribia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~7#Question:What did the people looking after the vineyard do when they saw the son of the owner come near?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~7#Answer:What did the people looking after the vineyard do when they saw the son of the owner come near?-160936568
trans-unit.source: They decided that they should kill him so that they could take over the vineyard for themselves. (7-8)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua kwamba wanapaswa kumuua ili waweze kuchukua shamba la mizabibu kwa ajili yao wenyewe. (7-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~7#Answer:What did the people looking after the vineyard do when they saw the son of the owner come near?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.9+What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~9#Question:What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mwenye shamba la mizabibu angefanya nini baada ya mwana wake kuuawa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~9#Question:What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~9#Answer:What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?1296019877
trans-unit.source: He said that the owner would come and kill those people
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mmiliki atakuja na kuwaua watu hao
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~9#Answer:What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~9#Answer:What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?-1140636125
trans-unit.source: and find others to care for his vineyard. (9)
trans-unit.target: na kutafuta wengine watunze shamba lake la mizabibu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~9#Answer:What did Jesus say that the owner of the vineyard would do after they had killed his son?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.10-11+When Jesus said, "Surely you have read in Scripture ...", to what did he refer?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~10#Question:When Jesus said, "Surely you have read in Scripture ...", to what did he refer?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus said, "Surely you have read in Scripture ...", to what did he refer?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliposema, "Je, hamkusoma katika Maandiko"..., alikuwa akirejezea nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Question:When Jesus said, "Surely you have read in Scripture ...", to what did he refer?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~10#Answer:When Jesus said, "Surely you have read in Scripture ...", to what did he refer?493315074
trans-unit.source: He was talking about the part of the Bible we now call Old Testament. [Key Term Check: See "Scripture" in KBT.]
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumzia sehemu ya Biblia ambayo leo tunaita Agano la Kale.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Answer:When Jesus said, "Surely you have read in Scripture ...", to what did he refer?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.10+To whom was Jesus speaking when he said that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~10#Question:To whom was Jesus speaking when he said that?
trans-unit.source: To whom was Jesus speaking when he said that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza na nani aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Question:To whom was Jesus speaking when he said that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~10#Answer:To whom was Jesus speaking when he said that?704689902
trans-unit.source: He was speaking to the chief priests and other Jewish leaders who were there. (10)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza na wakuu wa makuhani na viongozi wengine Wayahudi waliokuwapo. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Answer:To whom was Jesus speaking when he said that?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.10+What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~10#Question:What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?
trans-unit.source: What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?
trans-unit.target: Ni usemi gani ambao Yesu alitaja kutoka kitabu cha Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Question:What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~10#Answer:What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?1079012187
trans-unit.source: He said, "The stone which the builders had refused to use, has become the most important stone in [supporting] the [whole] house." (10)
trans-unit.target: Alisema: "Jiwe walilokataa wajenzi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Answer:What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~10#Note:What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?-896844634
trans-unit.source: Check whether it is clear to the respondent that this is a proverb. It should be clear, at least, that it has a meaning other than being about building a real house.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kama ni wazi kwa waliohojiwa kwamba hii ni mithali. Ni lazima kuwa wazi, angalau, kwamba ina maana nyingine zaidi ya kuwa juu ya kujenga nyumba halisi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~10#Note:What is the saying which Jesus then quoted from God's book?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.12+What was the reaction of the chief priests and teachers of the law to what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~12#Question:What was the reaction of the chief priests and teachers of the law to what Jesus said?
trans-unit.source: What was the reaction of the chief priests and teachers of the law to what Jesus said?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi waliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Question:What was the reaction of the chief priests and teachers of the law to what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~12#Answer:What was the reaction of the chief priests and teachers of the law to what Jesus said?1035421815
trans-unit.source: They were very angry and began planning to arrest him. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na hasira sana na wakaanza kupanga kumkamata. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Answer:What was the reaction of the chief priests and teachers of the law to what Jesus said?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.12+Why were they so angry?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~12#Question:Why were they so angry?
trans-unit.source: Why were they so angry?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walikuwa na hasira hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Question:Why were they so angry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~12#Answer:Why were they so angry?561977786
trans-unit.source: They knew that Jesus's story was about them. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba hadithi ya Yesu iliwahusu wao. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Answer:Why were they so angry?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.12+In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~12#Question:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?
trans-unit.source: In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri sehemu za hadithi hiyo zilihusu viongozi Wayahudi katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Question:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~12#Answer:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?1472996901
trans-unit.source: They knew that God often used a vineyard to represent Israel in the Old Testament scriptures. They also knew that they were the ones whom God had put in charge of his people, but they and their ancestors had rejected the prophets whom God had sent, and treated them badly. Jesus was warning that as the owner of his vineyard God would punish those leaders and get others to watch over his vineyard (his people).
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba Mungu mara nyingi alitumia shamba la mizabibu kuwakilisha Israeli katika maandiko ya Agano la Kale. Pia walijua kwamba wao ndio ambao Mungu alikuwa amewaweka kuwa na jukumu la watu wake, lakini wao na baba zao walikuwa wamewakataa manabii ambao Mungu alikuwa amewatuma, na kuwachukulia vibaya. Yesu alikuwa akionya kwamba kama mmiliki wa shamba lake la mizabibu Mungu angewaadhibu viongozi hao na kupata wengine waangalie shamba lake la mizabibu (watu wake).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Answer:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~12#Note:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?213810091
trans-unit.source: The person who is answering these questions may not know that God used the picture of a vineyard often to refer to the Jews.
trans-unit.target: Huenda mtu anayejibu maswali hayo asijue kwamba mara nyingi Mungu alitumia mfano wa shamba la mizabibu kurejelea Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Note:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~12#Note:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?-577617965
trans-unit.source: Check that at least the following is communicated: (a) Jesus was speaking with hidden meaning in the illustrations about the vineyard and the stone that the builders rejected. (b) The story was told as a warning to the Jewish leaders, and they had reacted strongly to it.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwamba angalau yafuatayo yamewasilishwa: (a) Yesu alikuwa akisema kwa maana iliyofichwa katika vielezi juu ya shamba la mizabibu na jiwe ambalo wajenzi walikataa. (b) Hadithi hiyo ilielezwa kama onyo kwa viongozi Wayahudi, nao walikuwa wameitikia kwa nguvu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Note:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~12#Note:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?-681761226
trans-unit.source: (The translator could explain in a footnote that the Old Testament writers commonly referred to Israel as God's vineyard.)
trans-unit.target: (Mtafsiri angeweza kueleza katika kielezi cha chini kwamba waandikaji wa Agano la Kale kwa kawaida walirejezea Israeli kuwa shamba la mizabibu la Mungu.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Note:In what way do you think that the parts of the story were about the Jewish leaders?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.12+Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~12#Question:Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?
trans-unit.source: Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini viongozi Wayahudi waliogopa umati?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Question:Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~12#Answer:Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?793703690
trans-unit.source: The Jewish leaders were afraid because they knew that the ordinary people believed that God was with Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Viongozi Wayahudi waliogopa kwa sababu walijua kwamba watu wa kawaida waliamini kwamba Mungu alikuwa pamoja na Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Answer:Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~12#Answer:Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?-2127020333
trans-unit.source: They knew that the people might rebel against them if they tried to arrest and kill him. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba watu wangewaasi ikiwa wangejaribu kumkamata na kumuua. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~12#Answer:Why were the Jewish leaders afraid of the crowd?

trans-unit.target: Marko 12:13-17 Mafarisayo fulani walimwuliza Yesu kama inafaa kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, mfalme wa Waroma.
