group.id: Q:MRK 12.13-17+Were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod able to trick Jesus into saying something that was wrong and to show that he therefore was not sent by God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~13#Question:Were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod able to trick Jesus into saying something that was wrong and to show that he therefore was not sent by God?
trans-unit.source: Were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod able to trick Jesus into saying something that was wrong and to show that he therefore was not sent by God?
trans-unit.target: Je! Mafarisayo na wafuasi wa Herode waliweza kumdanganya Yesu aseme jambo fulani lisilofaa na hivyo kuonyesha kwamba hakutumwa na Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~13#Question:Were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod able to trick Jesus into saying something that was wrong and to show that he therefore was not sent by God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~13#Answer:Were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod able to trick Jesus into saying something that was wrong and to show that he therefore was not sent by God?1547234769
trans-unit.source: No. They were not able to trick him.
trans-unit.target: La, hawakuweza kumdanganya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~13#Answer:Were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod able to trick Jesus into saying something that was wrong and to show that he therefore was not sent by God?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.13+What were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod who came to Jesus trying to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~13#Question:What were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod who came to Jesus trying to do?
trans-unit.source: What were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod who came to Jesus trying to do?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na wafuasi wa Herode waliokuja kwa Yesu walikuwa wakijaribu kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~13#Question:What were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod who came to Jesus trying to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~13#Answer:What were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod who came to Jesus trying to do?1471973125
trans-unit.source: They were trying to trick Jesus into saying something for which they could accuse him [of breaking God's laws or the Roman laws] or in any way cause him trouble. (13)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakijaribu kumdanganya Yesu aseme jambo ambalo wangeweza kumshtaki [kwa kuvunja sheria za Mungu au sheria za Kiroma] au kumsumbua kwa njia yoyote ile. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~13#Answer:What were the Pharisees and the followers of Herod who came to Jesus trying to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.14+What did they tell him that they knew about him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~14#Question:What did they tell him that they knew about him?
trans-unit.source: What did they tell him that they knew about him?
trans-unit.target: Walimwambia nini ambacho walijua kumhusu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~14#Question:What did they tell him that they knew about him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~14#Answer:What did they tell him that they knew about him?-21624469
trans-unit.source: They said that they knew that he was an honest man who would not change his message to please people no matter who they might be. He only taught God's message. (14)
trans-unit.target: Wakasema kwamba wao walijua kuwa yeye ni mtu mwaminifu ambaye hangebadilisha ujumbe wake ili kuwafurahisha watu bila kujali wao ni nani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~14#Answer:What did they tell him that they knew about him?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.14-15+What question did they then ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~14#Question:What question did they then ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What question did they then ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Basi walimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~14#Question:What question did they then ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~14#Answer:What question did they then ask Jesus?-806533823
trans-unit.source: They asked him whether it was right to pay taxes to Caesar, or not. (14-15a)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza kama ilikuwa halali kumlipa Kaisari kodi, au la (14-15a).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~14#Answer:What question did they then ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~14#Note:What question did they then ask Jesus?161001759
trans-unit.source: Check that it is clear who Caesar was, if "Emperor" or "King" is not mentioned in the translated text. The word "Caesar" is a title, not a man's personal name.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwamba ni wazi ni nani Kaisari alikuwa, ikiwa "Mtawala" au "Mfalme" haitajwi katika maandishi ya kutafsiriwa. Neno "Kaisari" ni jina la cheo, si jina la mtu binafsi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~14#Note:What question did they then ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.15+What did Jesus know about what the Pharisees were thinking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~15#Question:What did Jesus know about what the Pharisees were thinking?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus know about what the Pharisees were thinking?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijua nini kuhusu yale Mafarisayo walikuwa wakifikiri?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~15#Question:What did Jesus know about what the Pharisees were thinking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~15#Answer:What did Jesus know about what the Pharisees were thinking?1085744374
trans-unit.source: He knew they were only acting nice to him so they could get him to say something about which they could accuse him. (15b)
trans-unit.target: Alijua walikuwa wanajifanya tu kuwa wema kwake ili waweze kumfanya aseme jambo ambalo wangeweza kumshtaki (15b).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~15#Answer:What did Jesus know about what the Pharisees were thinking?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.15+What did Jesus tell them to bring him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~15#Question:What did Jesus tell them to bring him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell them to bring him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wamletee nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~15#Question:What did Jesus tell them to bring him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~15#Answer:What did Jesus tell them to bring him?995854355
trans-unit.source: He told them to bring [a Roman coin called] a denarius to him. (15b)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wamletee dinari moja [sarafu ya Kiroma inayoitwa dinari]. (15b)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~15#Answer:What did Jesus tell them to bring him?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.16+After they brought the coin to him, what question did Jesus ask them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~16#Question:After they brought the coin to him, what question did Jesus ask them?
trans-unit.source: After they brought the coin to him, what question did Jesus ask them?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kumletea sarafu hiyo, Yesu aliwauliza swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~16#Question:After they brought the coin to him, what question did Jesus ask them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~16#Answer:After they brought the coin to him, what question did Jesus ask them?1613461103
trans-unit.source: He asked them about the person whose picture and name they saw on the coin. (16)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kuhusu mtu ambaye picha na jina lake lilionekana kwenye sarafu hiyo. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~16#Answer:After they brought the coin to him, what question did Jesus ask them?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.16+What did they answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~16#Question:What did they answer?
trans-unit.source: What did they answer?
trans-unit.target: Walijibuje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~16#Question:What did they answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~16#Answer:What did they answer?1037791635
trans-unit.source: They answered that it was Caesar (the emperor/king of Rome) whose picture and name was on the coin. (16)
trans-unit.target: Walijibu kwamba ni Kaisari (maliki/mfalme wa Roma) ambaye picha na jina lake lilikuwa kwenye sarafu. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~16#Answer:What did they answer?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.17+Then what did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~17#Question:Then what did Jesus say?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus say?
trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~17#Question:Then what did Jesus say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~17#Answer:Then what did Jesus say?1020289287
trans-unit.source: He said that they should go ahead and serve Caesar with things like that money that were related to him, but at the same time they should serve God (as he requires). (17)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kwenda mbele na kumtumikia Kaisari na vitu kama vile pesa ambazo zilihusiana naye, lakini wakati huo huo wanapaswa kumtumikia Mungu (kama anavyohitaji). (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~17#Answer:Then what did Jesus say?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.15-17+Why do you think amazed them so much when they heard his answer to their trick question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~15#Question:Why do you think amazed them so much when they heard his answer to their trick question?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think amazed them so much when they heard his answer to their trick question?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walishangaa sana waliposikia jibu lake kwa swali lao la hila?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~15#Question:Why do you think amazed them so much when they heard his answer to their trick question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~15#Answer:Why do you think amazed them so much when they heard his answer to their trick question?-1641991739
trans-unit.source: They were amazed because he made such a wise answer that fit the situation and stopped their trick from working.
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa kwa sababu alitoa jibu la hekima kama hilo lililofaa hali hiyo na kuzuia mbinu yao isifanye kazi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~15#Answer:Why do you think amazed them so much when they heard his answer to their trick question?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!12~18#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 12:18-27 Some Sadducees questioned Jesus about people rising to live again after dying.
trans-unit.target: Marko 12:18-27 Masadukayo fulani walimwuliza Yesu kuhusu watu wanaofufuliwa baada ya kufa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 12.18-27+How did Jesus show that people live on after dying?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~18#Question:How did Jesus show that people live on after dying?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus show that people live on after dying?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyeshaje kwamba watu huendelea kuishi baada ya kufa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Question:How did Jesus show that people live on after dying?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~18#Answer:How did Jesus show that people live on after dying?2004352476
trans-unit.source: He showed that God refers to some who died as being alive. He said that even after Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob were dead God had said, "I am their God." (So Jesus showed that God knows that when his people's bodies die, their spirits continue to live on with him.) (26-27)
trans-unit.target: Alionyesha kwamba Mungu anawataja baadhi ya wafu kuwa ni wenye uhai. Alisema kwamba hata baada ya Abrahamu, Isaka, na Yakobo kufa Mungu alisema, "Mimi ni Mungu wao". (Kwa hivyo Yesu alionyesha kwamba Mungu anajua kwamba wakati miili ya watu wake inakufa, roho zao zinaendelea kuishi naye.) (26-27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Answer:How did Jesus show that people live on after dying?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.18+Who were the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~18#Question:Who were the Sadducees?
trans-unit.source: Who were the Sadducees?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Question:Who were the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~18#Answer:Who were the Sadducees?1622687780
trans-unit.source: The Sadducees were a Jewish group [like a political party who were mostly (rich) priests]
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walikuwa kikundi cha Kiyahudi [kama chama cha kisiasa ambacho kilikuwa hasa makuhani (matajiri) ]
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Answer:Who were the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~18#Answer:Who were the Sadducees?-2028862909
trans-unit.source: [They had their own views on certain spiritual things, such as,] they believed that people would not live again after dying. (18)
trans-unit.target: [Walikuwa na maoni yao wenyewe juu ya mambo fulani ya kiroho, kama vile,] waliamini kwamba watu hawangekuwa hai tena baada ya kufa. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Answer:Who were the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~18#Answer:Who were the Sadducees?1125389489
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "Sadducee" in KBT in the "Pharisee" entry.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Ona "Sadukayo" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida katika maandishi "Mfarisayo".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Answer:Who were the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~18#Note:Who were the Sadducees?903979027
trans-unit.source: It may be good to have a glossary entry on the Sadducees.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ikafaa kuwa na orodha ya majina ya Masadukayo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Note:Who were the Sadducees?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.19+What Jewish marriage rule that Moses had written down did the Sadducees quote?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~19#Question:What Jewish marriage rule that Moses had written down did the Sadducees quote?
trans-unit.source: What Jewish marriage rule that Moses had written down did the Sadducees quote?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walinukuu sheria gani ya ndoa ya Kiyahudi iliyoandikwa na Musa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~19#Question:What Jewish marriage rule that Moses had written down did the Sadducees quote?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~19#Answer:What Jewish marriage rule that Moses had written down did the Sadducees quote?-719317202
trans-unit.source: They quoted the rule that if a man died without any children, his brother should marry his widow [and have some children to inherit the dead brother's land and possessions.] (19)
trans-unit.target: Walitaja sheria ya kwamba ikiwa mtu angekufa bila kuwa na watoto, ndugu yake angepaswa kumwoa mjane wake [na kuwa na watoto fulani wa kurithi ardhi na mali za ndugu aliyekufa.] (19)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~19#Answer:What Jewish marriage rule that Moses had written down did the Sadducees quote?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.20-22+Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~20#Question:Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.
trans-unit.source: Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Niambie sehemu kuu ya hadithi ambayo Masadukayo walimwambia Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~20#Question:Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~20#Answer:Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.-1559279939
trans-unit.source: They said that there were seven brothers, and the first married and died without having any children. (20)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba kulikuwa na ndugu saba, na wa kwanza akaoa na kufa bila kuacha watoto wowote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~20#Answer:Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~20#Answer:Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.-1331099623
trans-unit.source: Then the second brother married that widow and later died, also without having any children. All seven brothers, one after the other, in the same way each married that same woman and each died without having any children. (21-22)
trans-unit.target: Yule ndugu wa pili akamwoa yule mjane, naye pia akafa bila kuacha mtoto. Ndivyo walivyofanya wale wengine saba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~20#Answer:Tell me the main part of the story that the Sadducees told to Jesus.

group.id: Q:MRK 12.23+What did they want Jesus to decide from their story?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~23#Question:What did they want Jesus to decide from their story?
trans-unit.source: What did they want Jesus to decide from their story?
trans-unit.target: Walipenda Yesu afikie mkataa gani kutokana na hadithi yao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~23#Question:What did they want Jesus to decide from their story?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~23#Answer:What did they want Jesus to decide from their story?1211795192
trans-unit.source: They wanted him to tell them whose wife she would be, when all seven of her husbands were alive again after the resurrection. (23)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka awaambie atakuwa mke wa nani, wakati waume wote saba watakapokuwa hai tena baada ya ufufuo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~23#Answer:What did they want Jesus to decide from their story?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.18-23+Why do you think that the Sadducees asked that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~18#Question:Why do you think that the Sadducees asked that question?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the Sadducees asked that question?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Masadukayo waliuliza swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Question:Why do you think that the Sadducees asked that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~18#Answer:Why do you think that the Sadducees asked that question?1612071543
trans-unit.source: It was a trick question. They thought that in order to answer it Jesus would have to choose to disagree with God's law that Moses wrote or else agree with them that his own teaching that people live after dying was wrong.
trans-unit.target: Lilikuwa swali la hila. Walifikiri kwamba ili kulijibu Yesu angehitaji kuchagua kati ya kutoafikiana na sheria ya Mungu iliyoandikwa na Musa au kukubaliana nao kwamba fundisho lake mwenyewe kwamba watu huendelea kuishi baada ya kufa lilikuwa kosa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~18#Answer:Why do you think that the Sadducees asked that question?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.24+What was Jesus's attitude toward the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~24#Question:What was Jesus's attitude toward the Sadducees?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus's attitude toward the Sadducees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa na mtazamo gani kuelekea Masadukayo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~24#Question:What was Jesus's attitude toward the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~24#Answer:What was Jesus's attitude toward the Sadducees?-1321141670
trans-unit.source: He rebuked them for not knowing the scriptures and not understanding how powerful God really is. (24)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakemea kwa sababu hawakujua maandiko na hawakuelewa jinsi Mungu alivyo na nguvu kweli. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~24#Answer:What was Jesus's attitude toward the Sadducees?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.25+How did Jesus answer their question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~25#Question:How did Jesus answer their question?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer their question?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje swali lao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~25#Question:How did Jesus answer their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~25#Answer:How did Jesus answer their question?-410923848
trans-unit.source: He said that after people have risen from death, they will not be marrying each other. (25)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba baada ya watu kufufuka kutoka kwa wafu, hawataoa au kuolewa. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~25#Answer:How did Jesus answer their question?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.25+In what way, do you think, did Jesus mean that people will be like the angels in heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~25#Question:In what way, do you think, did Jesus mean that people will be like the angels in heaven?
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, did Jesus mean that people will be like the angels in heaven?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba watu watakuwa kama malaika mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~25#Question:In what way, do you think, did Jesus mean that people will be like the angels in heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~25#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus mean that people will be like the angels in heaven?-231021501
trans-unit.source: Just as angels are not married now, people will not be married then. (25)
trans-unit.target: Kama vile malaika hawaoi sasa, watu hawataoa wakati huo. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~25#Answer:In what way, do you think, did Jesus mean that people will be like the angels in heaven?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.26-27+How did Jesus show that people will rise again from death?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~26#Question:How did Jesus show that people will rise again from death?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus show that people will rise again from death?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyeshaje kwamba watu watafufuliwa tena kutoka kwa wafu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~26#Question:How did Jesus show that people will rise again from death?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~26#Answer:How did Jesus show that people will rise again from death?-1395063289
trans-unit.source: Jesus pointed out from the Old Testament that after the Jewish ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had died, God said, "I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob." So since God spoke of himself being their God after they had died, he knew that they were still living. (26-27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alionyesha kutoka Agano la Kale kwamba baada ya mababu wa Kiyahudi Abrahamu, Isaka, na Yakobo kufa, Mungu alisema, "Mimi ni Mungu wa Ibrahimu, Isaka, na Yakobo". Kwa hivyo kwa kuwa Mungu alisema kuwa yeye ni Mungu wao baada ya kufa, alijua kwamba bado walikuwa hai. (26-27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~26#Answer:How did Jesus show that people will rise again from death?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.26-27+What were the Sadducees mistaken about?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~26#Question:What were the Sadducees mistaken about?
trans-unit.source: What were the Sadducees mistaken about?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walikosea kuhusu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~26#Question:What were the Sadducees mistaken about?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~26#Answer:What were the Sadducees mistaken about?942119242
trans-unit.source: They were mistaken when they said that no one lives again after death. (26-27)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamekosea waliposema kwamba hakuna mtu anayeishi tena baada ya kufa (26-27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~26#Answer:What were the Sadducees mistaken about?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!12~28#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 12:28-34 Jesus told a teacher of the law which of God's commandments are the most important.
trans-unit.target: Marko 12:28-34 Yesu alimwambia mwalimu wa sheria amri muhimu zaidi kati ya amri zote za Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 12.28-34+Which did Jesus say were the two most important commandments of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~28#Question:Which did Jesus say were the two most important commandments of God?
trans-unit.source: Which did Jesus say were the two most important commandments of God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni amri gani mbili zilizo kuu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Question:Which did Jesus say were the two most important commandments of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~28#Answer:Which did Jesus say were the two most important commandments of God?-37841794
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that to love God with all your being, and to love other people as you love yourself are the two most important commandments. (31-32)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba kumpenda Mungu kwa nafsi yako yote, na kuwapenda watu wengine kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe ni amri mbili muhimu zaidi. (31-32)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Answer:Which did Jesus say were the two most important commandments of God?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.28+What question did one of the teachers of the law ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~28#Question:What question did one of the teachers of the law ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What question did one of the teachers of the law ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mmoja wa walimu wa sheria alimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Question:What question did one of the teachers of the law ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~28#Answer:What question did one of the teachers of the law ask Jesus?1342704929
trans-unit.source: One of them asked, "Which is the most important commandment that God gave?" (28)
trans-unit.target: Mmoja wao aliuliza hivi: "Ni amri ipi iliyo kuu zaidi ambayo Mungu alitoa?" (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Answer:What question did one of the teachers of the law ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.28+Why did he ask Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~28#Question:Why did he ask Jesus that question?
trans-unit.source: Why did he ask Jesus that question?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini alimwuliza Yesu swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Question:Why did he ask Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~28#Answer:Why did he ask Jesus that question?-840504241
trans-unit.source: He asked that question because he knew Jesus had given a very good answer to the Sadducees' trick question and he had this real question of his own that he wanted Jesus to answer. (28)
trans-unit.target: Aliuliza swali hilo kwa sababu alijua Yesu alikuwa ametoa jibu zuri sana kwa swali la hila la Masadukayo na alikuwa na swali hili halisi la kibinafsi ambalo alitaka Yesu ajibu. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~28#Answer:Why did he ask Jesus that question?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.29+What did Jesus say about God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~29#Question:What did Jesus say about God?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kumhusu Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~29#Question:What did Jesus say about God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~29#Answer:What did Jesus say about God?467571200
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that there is only one God. The LORD (that is, Yahweh) is the only God. (29)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba kuna Mungu mmoja tu. BWANA (yaani, Yahweh) ndiye Mungu mmoja tu. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~29#Answer:What did Jesus say about God?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.29+To whom do the words "O Israel" refer?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~29#Question:To whom do the words "O Israel" refer?
trans-unit.source: To whom do the words "O Israel" refer?
trans-unit.target: Maneno "Ee Israeli" yanarejelea nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~29#Question:To whom do the words "O Israel" refer?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~29#Answer:To whom do the words "O Israel" refer?-1294716101
trans-unit.source: Those words refer to the Jews, [God's chosen people]. (29)
trans-unit.target: Maneno hayo hurejezea Wayahudi, [watu wa Mungu waliochaguliwa]. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~29#Answer:To whom do the words "O Israel" refer?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.30+What did Jesus say is the most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~30#Question:What did Jesus say is the most important commandment?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say is the most important commandment?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni amri gani iliyo kuu zaidi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~30#Question:What did Jesus say is the most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~30#Answer:What did Jesus say is the most important commandment?-1713423925
trans-unit.source: He said that most important commandment is that we must love God with every part of our being and with all of our ability. (30)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba amri iliyo muhimu zaidi ni kwamba ni lazima tumpende Mungu kwa kila sehemu ya kuwa kwetu na kwa uwezo wetu wote. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~30#Answer:What did Jesus say is the most important commandment?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.31+What is the second most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~31#Question:What is the second most important commandment?
trans-unit.source: What is the second most important commandment?
trans-unit.target: Ni amri gani ya pili iliyo kuu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~31#Question:What is the second most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~31#Answer:What is the second most important commandment?2062016916
trans-unit.source: The second most important commandment is that we are to love other people in the same way that we love ourselves. (31)
trans-unit.target: Amri ya pili muhimu zaidi ni kwamba tunapaswa kuwapenda watu wengine kwa njia ile ile ambayo tunajipenda wenyewe. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~31#Answer:What is the second most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~31#Answer:What is the second most important commandment?722136235
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Greek word for "love" that is used here means that a person has a gracious, outgoing, active interest in the welfare of another person.
trans-unit.target: Neno Muhimu: Neno la Kigiriki linalotafsiriwa "upendo" linamaanisha kwamba mtu ana nia ya fadhili, ya kushirikiana, na ya kupendezwa kikweli na hali njema ya mtu mwingine.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~31#Answer:What is the second most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~31#Note:What is the second most important commandment?-1612556004
trans-unit.source: See "love" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona neno "upendo" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~31#Note:What is the second most important commandment?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~31#Note:What is the second most important commandment?2002161660
trans-unit.source: John used the same word to explain how much God loves us (John 3:16; 1 John 4:9-11). The translator must explain his reasons if he did not use the same word for love in each of verses 30 and 31.
trans-unit.target: Yohana alitumia neno lile lile kueleza jinsi Mungu anavyotupenda sana (Yohana 3:16; 1 Yohana 4:9-11).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~31#Note:What is the second most important commandment?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.32-33+What did the teacher of the law say about Jesus's reply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~32#Question:What did the teacher of the law say about Jesus's reply?
trans-unit.source: What did the teacher of the law say about Jesus's reply?
trans-unit.target: Mwalimu wa sheria alisema nini juu ya jibu la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~32#Question:What did the teacher of the law say about Jesus's reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~32#Answer:What did the teacher of the law say about Jesus's reply?-1028882826
trans-unit.source: He said that Jesus had spoken the truth. (32-33)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa amesema kweli. (32-33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~32#Answer:What did the teacher of the law say about Jesus's reply?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.34+Then what did Jesus say to the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~34#Question:Then what did Jesus say to the man?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus say to the man?
trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~34#Question:Then what did Jesus say to the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~34#Answer:Then what did Jesus say to the man?-915852223
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that the man was very near to entering God's kingdom (that is, ready to put himself under God's authority and allow God to rule over him). (34)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba mtu huyo alikuwa karibu sana kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu (yaani, tayari kujitia chini ya mamlaka ya Mungu na kumruhusu Mungu amtawale). (34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~34#Answer:Then what did Jesus say to the man?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.32-34+What do you think it means here when it says that from then on no one dared to question Jesus any more?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~32#Question:What do you think it means here when it says that from then on no one dared to question Jesus any more?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means here when it says that from then on no one dared to question Jesus any more?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini hapa inaposema kwamba tangu wakati huo hakuna mtu aliyethubutu kumwuliza Yesu swali lolote tena?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~32#Question:What do you think it means here when it says that from then on no one dared to question Jesus any more?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~32#Answer:What do you think it means here when it says that from then on no one dared to question Jesus any more?1805605946
trans-unit.source: What Mark means is that they gave up using trick questions to try to cause Jesus to say something that would make him look foolish to the people. At this time they gave up because each time they questioned him he would give such good answers that the people would trust him more instead of less.
trans-unit.target: Marko anamaanisha kwamba waliacha kutumia maswali ya hila kujaribu kumfanya Yesu aseme kitu ambacho kingemfanya aonekane kuwa mpumbavu kwa watu. Wakati huu waliacha kwa sababu kila wakati walipomuuliza angetoa majibu mazuri sana hivi kwamba watu wangemwamini zaidi badala ya kidogo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~32#Answer:What do you think it means here when it says that from then on no one dared to question Jesus any more?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!12~35#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 12:35-37 Jesus explained from scripture that the Messiah they were expecting to come had to be greater than their ancestor King David.
trans-unit.target: Marko 12:35-37 Yesu alieleza kutoka katika andiko kwamba Mesiya waliyengojea kuja alipaswa kuwa mkubwa kuliko babu yao Mfalme Daudi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 12.35-37+Was Jesus teaching that King David or the Messiah (the one God appointed to come as savior and king) was greater?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~35#Question:Was Jesus teaching that King David or the Messiah (the one God appointed to come as savior and king) was greater?
trans-unit.source: Was Jesus teaching that King David or the Messiah (the one God appointed to come as savior and king) was greater?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alikuwa akifundisha kwamba Mfalme Daudi au Mesiya (yule aliyewekwa rasmi na Mungu kuja akiwa mwokozi na mfalme) alikuwa mkubwa zaidi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Question:Was Jesus teaching that King David or the Messiah (the one God appointed to come as savior and king) was greater?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~35#Answer:Was Jesus teaching that King David or the Messiah (the one God appointed to come as savior and king) was greater?2016938452
trans-unit.source: He was teaching that the Messiah (the Christ) was to be greater than David. Jesus said that David himself had called him "Lord." (35-37)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifundisha kwamba Mesiya (Kristo) angekuwa mkubwa kuliko Daudi. Yesu alisema kwamba Daudi mwenyewe alikuwa amemwita "Bwana" (35-37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Answer:Was Jesus teaching that King David or the Messiah (the one God appointed to come as savior and king) was greater?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.35-37+Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~35#Question:Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?
trans-unit.target: Je! Yesu alisema kwamba Mesiya angekuwa mzao wa Daudi alipokuja, au la?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Question:Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~35#Answer:Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?-349349549
trans-unit.source: He allowed for that. Here he was causing the people to think it through and realize that the Christ they often talked about and were expecting was more than what just being David's offspring would make him. (35-37)
trans-unit.target: Hapa alikuwa akiwashawishi watu wafikirie na kutambua kwamba Kristo waliyekuwa wakizungumza juu yake mara nyingi na kumtarajia alikuwa zaidi ya kile tu kuwa uzao wa Daudi kungemfanya awe. (35-37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Answer:Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!12~35#Note:Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?1963216192
trans-unit.source: The Jerusalem Bible translates verse 37 as: "… in what way then can he be his [that is, David's] son?" Translating it something like that should make the real meaning of Jesus's question easier to understand.
trans-unit.target: Tafsiri ya The Jerusalem Bible hutafsiri mstari wa 37 hivi: "Ni kwa njia gani basi anaweza kuwa mwana wake [yaani, wa Daudi]?" Kulitafsiri kwa njia hiyo kunapaswa kufanya maana halisi ya swali la Yesu iwe rahisi zaidi kuelewa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Note:Did Jesus say that the Messiah would be a descendant of David when he came, or not?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.35-37+Why do you think the crowd of people was delighted with what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~35#Question:Why do you think the crowd of people was delighted with what Jesus had said?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think the crowd of people was delighted with what Jesus had said?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini umati wa watu ulifurahia yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amesema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Question:Why do you think the crowd of people was delighted with what Jesus had said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~35#Answer:Why do you think the crowd of people was delighted with what Jesus had said?1035365774
trans-unit.source: Jesus had shown clearly that the teachers of the law did not follow their own teaching about the Messiah (the Christ). (35-37)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa ameonyesha waziwazi kwamba walimu wa sheria hawakufuata mafundisho yao wenyewe juu ya Mesiya (Kristo). (35-37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Answer:Why do you think the crowd of people was delighted with what Jesus had said?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.35+What did the teachers of the law say about the Messiah?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~35#Question:What did the teachers of the law say about the Messiah?
trans-unit.source: What did the teachers of the law say about the Messiah?
trans-unit.target: Walimu wa sheria walisema nini juu ya Mesiya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Question:What did the teachers of the law say about the Messiah?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~35#Answer:What did the teachers of the law say about the Messiah?26337398
trans-unit.source: They said that the Messiah was to be born as a descendant of David. (35)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba Mesiya angezaliwa akiwa mzao wa Daudi. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Answer:What did the teachers of the law say about the Messiah?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.35+Do you think that Jesus agreed with that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~35#Question:Do you think that Jesus agreed with that?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jesus agreed with that?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alikubaliana na hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Question:Do you think that Jesus agreed with that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~35#Answer:Do you think that Jesus agreed with that?-799446165
trans-unit.source: Yes, he would have since that is also scripture. (But here he is making a point about a more important relationship, that is: that the Messiah (the Christ) is the son of God. The religious teachers should have also understood that, but they did not.)
trans-unit.target: Ndio, angekuwa nayo kwa kuwa hiyo pia ni maandiko. (Lakini hapa anafanya hoja juu ya uhusiano muhimu zaidi, yaani: kwamba Masihi (Kristo) ni mwana wa Mungu. Walimu wa kidini pia wanapaswa kuelewa hilo, lakini hawakuelewa.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~35#Answer:Do you think that Jesus agreed with that?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.36+What did Jesus say that David himself had said about the Christ?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~36#Question:What did Jesus say that David himself had said about the Christ?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that David himself had said about the Christ?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini ambacho Daudi mwenyewe alikuwa amesema juu ya Kristo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~36#Question:What did Jesus say that David himself had said about the Christ?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~36#Answer:What did Jesus say that David himself had said about the Christ?1018330632
trans-unit.source: David had referred to the Christ as his (David's) Lord. (36)
trans-unit.target: Daudi alimwita Kristo Bwana wake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~36#Answer:What did Jesus say that David himself had said about the Christ?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.36-37+Did David think that Christ was more important or less important than himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~36#Question:Did David think that Christ was more important or less important than himself?
trans-unit.source: Did David think that Christ was more important or less important than himself?
trans-unit.target: Je, Daudi alifikiri kwamba Kristo alikuwa wa maana zaidi au wa maana kidogo kuliko yeye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~36#Question:Did David think that Christ was more important or less important than himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~36#Answer:Did David think that Christ was more important or less important than himself?1151406340
trans-unit.source: By calling Christ his Lord, David honored Christ. By doing that, he showed that Christ was greater than he himself.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kumwita Kristo Bwana wake, Daudi alimheshimu Kristo. Kwa kufanya hivyo, alionyesha kwamba Kristo alikuwa mkuu kuliko yeye mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~36#Answer:Did David think that Christ was more important or less important than himself?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.36+What would the Lord God do while Jesus sat in the place of honor beside him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~36#Question:What would the Lord God do while Jesus sat in the place of honor beside him?
trans-unit.source: What would the Lord God do while Jesus sat in the place of honor beside him?
trans-unit.target: Bwana Mungu angefanya nini wakati Yesu alikuwa ameketi mahali pa heshima kando yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~36#Question:What would the Lord God do while Jesus sat in the place of honor beside him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~36#Answer:What would the Lord God do while Jesus sat in the place of honor beside him?308727644
trans-unit.source: God would make Jesus's enemies be submitted to him (that is, make them have to obey whatever he said. (36)
trans-unit.target: Mungu angewafanya maadui wa Yesu wamnyenyekee (yaani, awafanye wamtii chochote alichosema).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~36#Answer:What would the Lord God do while Jesus sat in the place of honor beside him?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!12~38#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 12:38-40 Jesus told people to not do as the teachers of the law did.
trans-unit.target: Marko 12:38-40 Yesu aliwaambia watu wasifanye kama walimu wa sheria walivyofanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 12.38-40+What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~38#Question:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mungu angewaadhibu watu wa aina ambayo Yesu alizungumzia hapa [katika mstari wa 40] hata zaidi kuliko watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Question:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!12~38#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?1657737395
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here in verse 40 even more than other people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mungu angewaadhibu watu wa aina ambayo Yesu alizungumzia hapa katika mstari wa 40 hata zaidi ya watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!12~38#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?-1204731430
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here even more than other people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mungu angewaadhibu watu wa aina ambayo Yesu alizungumzia hapa hata zaidi ya watu wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~38#Answer:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?41970832
trans-unit.source: They worked at making people think that they were obeying God especially well, but by their own example they were teaching people be selfish.
trans-unit.target: Walijitahidi kuwafanya watu wafikiri kwamba walikuwa wakimtii Mungu hasa, lakini kwa kielelezo chao wenyewe walikuwa wakiwafundisha watu kuwa wenye ubinafsi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Answer:What do you think is the reason that God would punish the kind of people Jesus talked about here [in verse 40] even more than other people?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.38-40+Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~38#Question:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?
trans-unit.source: Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya watu kuhusu jinsi walimu wa Sheria walivyotenda. Walifanya mambo ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Question:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?1465931607
trans-unit.source: They walked around in fancy clothes in public places in order to enjoy [people] greeting them. (38)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakitembea katika mavazi ya kifahari katika mahali pa umma ili kufurahia [watu] kuwasalimu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?-589686096
trans-unit.source: They enjoyed [people] honoring [them] by having them sit in places set aside for honored people, both in synagogues and at feasts. (39)
trans-unit.target: Wao hupenda [watu] wawape [wao] heshima kwa kuwa na viti vya heshima katika masinagogi na katika karamu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?1087756518
trans-unit.source: They cheated people [in order to become rich], such as becoming the owners of widows' homes [and possessions]. (40)
trans-unit.target: Waliwadanganya watu [ili wawe matajiri], kama vile kuwa wamiliki wa nyumba za wajane [na mali zao].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?-715029867
trans-unit.source: They showed off by saying long prayers [in public places] (that is, they pretended to be very religious). (40)
trans-unit.target: Walifanya sala ndefu [katika mahali pa umma] ili kujionyesha (yaani, walijifanya kuwa wa kidini sana).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Answer:Jesus warned the people about the way that the teachers of the Law acted. What kind of things did they do?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.38-40+Why do you think that Jesus said that God would punish the teachers of the law severely?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~38#Question:Why do you think that Jesus said that God would punish the teachers of the law severely?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus said that God would punish the teachers of the law severely?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba Mungu angewaadhibu vikali walimu wa sheria?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Question:Why do you think that Jesus said that God would punish the teachers of the law severely?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~38#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus said that God would punish the teachers of the law severely?-741527420
trans-unit.source: God would punish them because they not only did evil, but covered it up by acting like they were really serving God. (38-40)
trans-unit.target: Mungu angewaadhibu kwa sababu hawakufanya tu mabaya, bali waliyaficha kwa kutenda kana kwamba walikuwa wanamtumikia Mungu kweli kweli. (38-40)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~38#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus said that God would punish the teachers of the law severely?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!12~41#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 12:41-44 A widow gave everything she had to God.
trans-unit.target: Marko 12:41-44 Mjane mmoja alimpa Mungu kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 12.41-44+For what did Jesus praise the widow?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~41#Question:For what did Jesus praise the widow?
trans-unit.source: For what did Jesus praise the widow?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimpongeza mjane huyo kwa sababu gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Question:For what did Jesus praise the widow?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~41#Answer:For what did Jesus praise the widow?1748580383
trans-unit.source: Jesus praised the widow for being willing to give her last bit of money to God, which was all she had left for staying alive. (43-44)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimsifu mjane kwa kuwa alikuwa tayari kumpa Mungu pesa zake za mwisho, ambazo ndizo tu alizokuwa nazo ili aendelee kuishi. (43-44)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Answer:For what did Jesus praise the widow?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.41+Where in the temple area was Jesus sitting?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~41#Question:Where in the temple area was Jesus sitting?
trans-unit.source: Where in the temple area was Jesus sitting?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa ameketi katika eneo gani la hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Question:Where in the temple area was Jesus sitting?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~41#Answer:Where in the temple area was Jesus sitting?-879790869
trans-unit.source: Jesus was sitting near the box where people used to put their gifts for God. (41)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa ameketi karibu na sanduku ambapo watu walikuwa wakitia zawadi zao kwa Mungu. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Answer:Where in the temple area was Jesus sitting?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.41-42+What did he see as he sat there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~41#Question:What did he see as he sat there?
trans-unit.source: What did he see as he sat there?
trans-unit.target: Aliona nini alipokuwa ameketi hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Question:What did he see as he sat there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~41#Answer:What did he see as he sat there?-1524898
trans-unit.source: He saw many rich people who gave large amounts [of money]. (41)
trans-unit.target: Aliona matajiri wengi wakitoa kiasi kikubwa cha fedha.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Answer:What did he see as he sat there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~41#Answer:What did he see as he sat there?1414570493
trans-unit.source: Then he saw one poor widow who put in two coins of the smallest value that there was. (42)
trans-unit.target: Akaona pia mwanamke mmoja mjane maskini akitumbukiza humo sarafu mbili ndogo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~41#Answer:What did he see as he sat there?

group.id: Q:MRK 12.44+Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!12~44#Question:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alithamini mchango wa mjane kuliko wa matajiri?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~44#Question:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!12~44#Answer:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?1767636594
trans-unit.source: She gave God everything she had to live on. The rich people only gave part of the large amount of money that they had. (It was money they did not really need in order to stay alive.) (44)
trans-unit.target: Alitoa kila kitu alichokuwa nacho ili kuishi. Matajiri walitoa sehemu tu ya wingi wa pesa zao (kuwa ni pesa ambazo hawakuhitaji ili kuishi).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!12~44#Answer:Why did Jesus regard the widow's money as more than the rich people's money?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!13~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 13:1-27 Jesus told his disciples about the signs that will show that he is about to return to this world.
trans-unit.target: Marko 13:1-27 Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake juu ya ishara ambazo zingethibitisha kwamba alikuwa karibu kurudi katika ulimwengu huu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 13.1-27+Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~1#Question:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.
trans-unit.source: Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.
trans-unit.target: Taja baadhi ya mambo ambayo Yesu alisema yangetukia kabla ya mwisho wa ulimwengu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Question:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.668284245
trans-unit.source: He said that there will be many people who will claim to be the Christ who has returned. (6 and 21-22)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kutakuwa na watu wengi ambao watadai kuwa Kristo ambaye amerudi (6 na 21-22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.-1539749873
trans-unit.source: There will be wars, earthquakes, and much trouble. (7-8)
trans-unit.target: Kutakuwa na vita, matetemeko ya nchi, na taabu nyingi. (7-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.1740888678
trans-unit.source: People will arrest those who believe in Jesus, take them into court, and beat them. (9)
trans-unit.target: Watu watawakamata wale wanaomwamini Yesu, watawapeleka mahakamani, na kuwapiga. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.-1793558116
trans-unit.source: People would preach the Good News to all the nations. (10)
trans-unit.target: Watu wangehubiri Habari Njema kwa mataifa yote. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.-499378561
trans-unit.source: People will hate those who follow Jesus, even if they are their own relatives. (12-13)
trans-unit.target: Watu watawachukia wale wanaomfuata Yesu, hata kama ni jamaa zao wenyewe. (12-13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.787632097
trans-unit.source: Something/Someone will try to dishonor God (or, take his honor for itself) in a very shocking/disgusting way. (14)
trans-unit.target: Kitu/Mtu fulani atajaribu kumvunjia Mungu heshima (au, kuchukua heshima yake mwenyewe) kwa njia ya kushangaza/kuchukiza sana. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.-1603687946
trans-unit.source: The sun and moon will no longer give light, the stars will fall from the sky, and everything in the universe will be shaken. (24-25)
trans-unit.target: Jua na mwezi hazitatoa nuru yao tena, nyota zitaanguka kutoka mbinguni, na vitu katika ulimwengu vitatikiswa. (24-25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!13~1#Note:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.12188212
trans-unit.source: If the respondent does not read the text themselves but only hears someone read it, do not expect them to remember more than about three of these items. Otherwise, a respondent should probably be able to recall about five items.
trans-unit.target: Kama kujibu haina kusoma maandishi wenyewe lakini tu kusikia mtu kusoma, wala kutarajia yao kukumbuka zaidi ya tatu ya mambo haya. Vinginevyo, kujibu lazima pengine kuwa na uwezo wa kukumbuka kuhusu tano mambo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Note:Mention some of the things that Jesus said would happen before the end of the world.

group.id: Q:MRK 13.1-27+When all those troubles happen, how will there be any believers who are still alive in the world?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~1#Question:When all those troubles happen, how will there be any believers who are still alive in the world?
trans-unit.source: When all those troubles happen, how will there be any believers who are still alive in the world?
trans-unit.target: Matatizo hayo yote yatakapotokea, waamini wowote watakuwaje hai duniani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Question:When all those troubles happen, how will there be any believers who are still alive in the world?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:When all those troubles happen, how will there be any believers who are still alive in the world?1035082586
trans-unit.source: God will allow those troubles to happen only for a short time. (20)
trans-unit.target: Mungu ataruhusu matatizo hayo yatukie kwa muda mfupi tu. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:When all those troubles happen, how will there be any believers who are still alive in the world?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.1-27+What will happen to those believers when the Son of Man returns?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~1#Question:What will happen to those believers when the Son of Man returns?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to those believers when the Son of Man returns?
trans-unit.target: Itakuwaje kwa wale walioamini wakati Mwana wa binadamu atakaporudi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Question:What will happen to those believers when the Son of Man returns?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:What will happen to those believers when the Son of Man returns?215264324
trans-unit.source: He will send his angels to gather them from every part of the world. (27)
trans-unit.target: Naye atawatuma malaika wake; atawakusanya kutoka pepo zote;
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:What will happen to those believers when the Son of Man returns?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.1+What did one of Jesus's disciples say about the buildings in the temple area?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~1#Question:What did one of Jesus's disciples say about the buildings in the temple area?
trans-unit.source: What did one of Jesus's disciples say about the buildings in the temple area?
trans-unit.target: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wa Yesu alisema nini kuhusu majengo katika eneo la hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Question:What did one of Jesus's disciples say about the buildings in the temple area?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~1#Answer:What did one of Jesus's disciples say about the buildings in the temple area?1636104841
trans-unit.source: His disciple said that the temple was a wonderful building made of great stones. (1)
trans-unit.target: Mwanafunzi wake alisema kwamba hekalu lilikuwa jengo zuri lililojengwa kwa mawe makubwa. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~1#Answer:What did one of Jesus's disciples say about the buildings in the temple area?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.2+What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~2#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingetokea kwa hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~2#Question:What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~2#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?-2040041340
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that people would completely break down the temple. (2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watu wangevunja hekalu kabisa. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~2#Answer:What did Jesus say would happen to the temple?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.3-4+What did Jesus's disciples later ask him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~3#Question:What did Jesus's disciples later ask him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus's disciples later ask him?
trans-unit.target: Baadaye wanafunzi wa Yesu walimwuliza nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~3#Question:What did Jesus's disciples later ask him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~3#Answer:What did Jesus's disciples later ask him?1033135730
trans-unit.source: They ask him when the things he had told about would take place [when would people destroy the temple]. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Wanamuuliza mambo aliyoyasema yatatukia lini [watu wangeharibu hekalu lini] (3-4).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~3#Answer:What did Jesus's disciples later ask him?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.5+As Jesus answered them, what warning did he give?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~5#Question:As Jesus answered them, what warning did he give?
trans-unit.source: As Jesus answered them, what warning did he give?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa onyo gani alipowajibu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~5#Question:As Jesus answered them, what warning did he give?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~5#Answer:As Jesus answered them, what warning did he give?221724035
trans-unit.source: He said that they should be careful not to let people trick them [about when people would destroy the temple]. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kuwa waangalifu wasiwaruhusu watu wawapotoshe [kuhusu wakati ambapo watu wangeliharibu hekalu]. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~5#Answer:As Jesus answered them, what warning did he give?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.6+What did he say many people would come and claim?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~6#Question:What did he say many people would come and claim?
trans-unit.source: What did he say many people would come and claim?
trans-unit.target: Alisema watu wengi wangekuja kudai nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~6#Question:What did he say many people would come and claim?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~6#Answer:What did he say many people would come and claim?-869282059
trans-unit.source: He said that many would come and claim that they were the Christ, and in that way deceive many people. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wengi wangekuja na kudai kuwa wao ndio Kristo, na kwa njia hiyo wangewapotosha watu wengi. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~6#Answer:What did he say many people would come and claim?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.7-8+What troubles did he say there would be?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~7#Question:What troubles did he say there would be?
trans-unit.source: What troubles did he say there would be?
trans-unit.target: Alisema kungekuwa na matatizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~7#Question:What troubles did he say there would be?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~7#Answer:What troubles did he say there would be?393419227
trans-unit.source: He said that there would be wars nearby and far away. There would be earthquakes and famines in various places. (7-8)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kungekuwa na vita karibu na mbali. Kungekuwa na matetemeko ya nchi na njaa mahali mbalimbali. (7-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~7#Answer:What troubles did he say there would be?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.7-8+To what time do you think these earthly troubles (here compared to first birth-pains) would show movement?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~7#Question:To what time do you think these earthly troubles (here compared to first birth-pains) would show movement?
trans-unit.source: To what time do you think these earthly troubles (here compared to first birth-pains) would show movement?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri matatizo haya ya kidunia (hapa ikilinganishwa na uchungu wa kwanza wa kuzaa) yangeonyesha mwendo hadi wakati gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~7#Question:To what time do you think these earthly troubles (here compared to first birth-pains) would show movement?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~7#Answer:To what time do you think these earthly troubles (here compared to first birth-pains) would show movement?748311636
trans-unit.source: Those troubles would show progress toward the end of this present age (that is, toward the finalizing of the "these things" his disciples spoke about in verse 4 and Christ's coming to earth a second time). (7-8)
trans-unit.target: Matatizo hayo yangeonyesha maendeleo kuelekea mwisho wa enzi hii ya sasa (yaani, kuelekea kukamilishwa kwa "mambo haya" ambayo wanafunzi wake walisema juu yayo katika mstari wa 4 na kuja kwa Kristo duniani kwa mara ya pili).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~7#Answer:To what time do you think these earthly troubles (here compared to first birth-pains) would show movement?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.9+Who was it that Jesus said people would arrest and take to court?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~9#Question:Who was it that Jesus said people would arrest and take to court?
trans-unit.source: Who was it that Jesus said people would arrest and take to court?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani ambaye Yesu alisema watu wangemkamata na kumpeleka mahakamani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Question:Who was it that Jesus said people would arrest and take to court?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~9#Answer:Who was it that Jesus said people would arrest and take to court?1818588200
trans-unit.source: Jesus was speaking to his followers here, so he was referring to his followers.

trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Answer:Who was it that Jesus said people would arrest and take to court?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.9+According to Jesus's words, why would people arrest them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~9#Question:According to Jesus's words, why would people arrest them?
trans-unit.source: According to Jesus's words, why would people arrest them?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na maneno ya Yesu, kwa nini watu wangewakamata?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Question:According to Jesus's words, why would people arrest them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~9#Answer:According to Jesus's words, why would people arrest them?945996917
trans-unit.source: They would arrest them because they followed Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Wangewakamata kwa sababu walimfuata Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Answer:According to Jesus's words, why would people arrest them?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.9+What would his followers have opportunity to do when people took them to trial?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~9#Question:What would his followers have opportunity to do when people took them to trial?
trans-unit.source: What would his followers have opportunity to do when people took them to trial?
trans-unit.target: Wafuasi wake wangekuwa na fursa ya kufanya nini watu walipowapeleka mahakamani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Question:What would his followers have opportunity to do when people took them to trial?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~9#Answer:What would his followers have opportunity to do when people took them to trial?1799351605
trans-unit.source: They would have opportunities to tell kings and officials about Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Wangekuwa na nafasi za kuwaambia wafalme na maofisa kumhusu Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Answer:What would his followers have opportunity to do when people took them to trial?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.9+What else did Jesus say would happen to his followers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~9#Question:What else did Jesus say would happen to his followers?
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus say would happen to his followers?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kingine ambacho kingewapata wafuasi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Question:What else did Jesus say would happen to his followers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~9#Answer:What else did Jesus say would happen to his followers?-1803223428
trans-unit.source: He said people would turn then over to the council [of Jewish leaders] who would whip them in the synagogues.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu wangewapeleka mahakamani [ya viongozi Wayahudi] ambao wangewapiga mijeledi katika masinagogi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Answer:What else did Jesus say would happen to his followers?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.9+Why would they do like that to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~9#Question:Why would they do like that to them?
trans-unit.source: Why would they do like that to them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wangewafanyia hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Question:Why would they do like that to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~9#Answer:Why would they do like that to them?-1246615525
trans-unit.source: They would do that to them his followers because they were identified with Jesus (and with his name).
trans-unit.target: Wangewafanyia hivyo wafuasi wake kwa sababu walihusianishwa na Yesu (na jina lake).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~9#Answer:Why would they do like that to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~10#Question:What must people do first concerning the gospel?
trans-unit.source: What must people do first concerning the gospel?
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima watu wafanye nini kwanza kuhusu injili?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~10#Answer:What must people do first concerning the gospel?1832632224
trans-unit.source: Christ's followers must first preach the gospel to all nations. (10)

group.id: Q:MRK 13.10-11+What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~10#Question:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kitakachotokea, watu wakiisha kuhubiri injili kwa mataifa yote?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~10#Question:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!13~10#Note:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?1947019001
trans-unit.source: "The end" will arrive, as stated in verse 7, that is, the end of this time which we are in now. (Note: This time will end with Christ's returns. See verses 26-37.)
trans-unit.target: "Mwisho" utakuja, kama ilivyotajwa katika mstari wa 7, yaani, mwisho wa wakati huu ambao tunaishi sasa. (Kumbuka: Wakati huu utakwisha kwa kurudi kwa Kristo. Ona mstari wa 26-37.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~10#Note:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!13~10#Note:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~10#Note:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!13~10#Note:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?-576804429
trans-unit.source: All "these things" which Andrew had mentioned in his question in verse 4 will happen.
trans-unit.target: "Mambo haya" yote ambayo Andrea alikuwa ameyataja katika swali lake katika mstari wa 4 yatatukia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~10#Note:What do you think it is that will happen, once people have preached the gospel to all nations?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.11+How will the followers of Jesus know what they should say when people take them to court?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~11#Question:How will the followers of Jesus know what they should say when people take them to court?
trans-unit.source: How will the followers of Jesus know what they should say when people take them to court?
trans-unit.target: Wafuasi wa Yesu watajuaje yale wanayopaswa kusema watu wanapowapeleka mahakamani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~11#Question:How will the followers of Jesus know what they should say when people take them to court?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~11#Answer:How will the followers of Jesus know what they should say when people take them to court?52843253
trans-unit.source: God's Spirit will help them to say the right things at the time, so they should not worry about what they will say. (11)
trans-unit.target: Roho ya Mungu itawasaidia kusema mambo sahihi kwa wakati, kwa hivyo hawapaswi kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kile watasema. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~11#Answer:How will the followers of Jesus know what they should say when people take them to court?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.12+What terrible things will happen within some families?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~12#Question:What terrible things will happen within some families?
trans-unit.source: What terrible things will happen within some families?
trans-unit.target: Ni mambo gani yenye kuogofya yatakayotukia katika familia fulani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~12#Question:What terrible things will happen within some families?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.13+Why will many people hate the followers of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~13#Question:Why will many people hate the followers of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why will many people hate the followers of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu wengi watawachukia wafuasi wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~13#Question:Why will many people hate the followers of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~13#Answer:Why will many people hate the followers of Jesus?265979534
trans-unit.source: They will hate them because they follow him. (13)
trans-unit.target: Watawachukia kwa sababu wanamfuata. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~13#Answer:Why will many people hate the followers of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.13+Whom did Jesus say God would accept?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~13#Question:Whom did Jesus say God would accept?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus say God would accept?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema Mungu angekubali nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~13#Question:Whom did Jesus say God would accept?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~13#Answer:Whom did Jesus say God would accept?663370075
trans-unit.source: He will accept those who firmly remain faithful to him. (13)
trans-unit.target: Atawakubali wale ambao kwa uthabiti wanabaki waaminifu kwake. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~13#Answer:Whom did Jesus say God would accept?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.14-17+What do you think Mark meant when he wrote about an "abomination of desolation"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~14#Question:What do you think Mark meant when he wrote about an "abomination of desolation"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Mark meant when he wrote about an "abomination of desolation"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Marko alimaanisha nini alipoandika kuhusu "chukizo la uharibifu"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~14#Question:What do you think Mark meant when he wrote about an "abomination of desolation"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~14#Answer:What do you think Mark meant when he wrote about an "abomination of desolation"?-334291277
trans-unit.source: (The meaning in the Greek text is not very clear. It should be clear from the translation, though, that something shocking enough to cause people to draw back in horror will be in a (holy) place where it should never be. Because of this shocking thing, God will withdraw from that place leaving it desolate.)
trans-unit.target: (Maana katika maandishi ya Kigiriki si wazi sana. Inapaswa kuwa wazi kutokana na tafsiri, hata hivyo, kwamba kitu cha kushangaza cha kutosha kusababisha watu kuondoka kwa hofu kitakuwa mahali (patakatifu) ambapo hakipaswi kuwa. Kwa sababu ya jambo hili la kushangaza, Mungu atajiondoa kutoka mahali hapo na kuiacha ukiwa.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~14#Answer:What do you think Mark meant when he wrote about an "abomination of desolation"?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.14-16+When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~14#Question:When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?
trans-unit.source: When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanapoona kitu (au mtu) huyo mwenye kushtua akiingia mahali ambapo hakupaswa kamwe kuwa, wanapaswa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~14#Question:When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~14#Answer:When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?-1018358919
trans-unit.source: They are not to hesitate, thinking of getting anything from their houses.
trans-unit.target: Hawapaswi kusita, wakifikiri kwamba watapata kitu fulani kutoka katika nyumba zao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~14#Answer:When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~14#Answer:When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?131856718
trans-unit.source: They must flee for their lives to a safe place, such as the mountains. (14-16)
trans-unit.target: Lazima wakimbilie mahali salama, kama vile milimani, ili kuokoa uhai wao. (14-16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~14#Answer:When people see this shocking thing (or person) taking over where it (or he) should never be, what are they to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.17+What do you think will make it so dreadful for pregnant women and those with small children?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.18+Why did Jesus say to pray that this would not happen in the winter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~18#Question:Why did Jesus say to pray that this would not happen in the winter?
trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus say to pray that this would not happen in the winter?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alisema wasali jambo hilo lisitendeke katika majira ya baridi kali?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~18#Question:Why did Jesus say to pray that this would not happen in the winter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~18#Answer:Why did Jesus say to pray that this would not happen in the winter?1747726633
trans-unit.source: He said that because he knew it would be a time of much suffering, and would be worse still if the weather was bad, such as cold and rainy. (18)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~18#Answer:Why did Jesus say to pray that this would not happen in the winter?

trans-unit.source: Would the suffering of that time be very serious?
trans-unit.target: Je, kuteseka kwa wakati huo kungekuwa kwa uzito sana?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~19#Answer:Would the suffering of that time be very serious?1459052454
trans-unit.source: Yes, it would be the worst suffering that had ever happened or would ever happen. (19)

group.id: Q:MRK 13.20+What has God done for the sake of his chosen people?
