group.id: Q:MRK 13.18-20+Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~18#Question:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu hao ambao Mungu amewachagua ni nani?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~18#Answer:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?-1421713394
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The "elect" (or "chosen ones") are the people who believe that God sent Jesus as the Christ to earth to save them from their sins. God knows who will believe that and he has chosen to save them.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: "Wateule" (au "wachaguliwa") ni watu ambao wanaamini kwamba Mungu alimtuma Yesu duniani kama Kristo kuwaokoa kutoka kwa dhambi zao. Mungu anajua nani atakayeamini hilo na amechagua kuwaokoa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~18#Answer:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!13~18#Note:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?2031285210
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~18#Note:Who do you think these people are whom God has chosen?

trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus warn his followers about?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya wafuasi wake juu ya jambo gani jingine?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~21#Answer:What else did Jesus warn his followers about?-443478382
trans-unit.source: He warned them that many different men would come and falsely claim to be prophets or claim to be the Christ/Messiah. (21-23)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya kwamba watu wengi tofauti-tofauti wangekuja na kudai kwa uwongo kuwa manabii au kudai kuwa Kristo/Mesiya. (21-23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~21#Answer:What else did Jesus warn his followers about?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.26+When this time of trouble and suffering is over, what is going to happen?

trans-unit.source: When this time of trouble and suffering is over, what is going to happen?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~26#Question:When this time of trouble and suffering is over, what is going to happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~26#Answer:When this time of trouble and suffering is over, what is going to happen?-708692189
trans-unit.source: Jesus will come back to this world. (26)

trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~26#Answer:When this time of trouble and suffering is over, what is going to happen?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.24-25+What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~24#Question:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?
trans-unit.source: What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?
trans-unit.target: Ni ishara zipi ambazo watu wataona zikitukia mwishoni mwa wakati huu wa kuteseka?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~24#Question:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~24#Answer:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?112751343
trans-unit.source: The sun and moon will no longer give light,
trans-unit.target: Jua na mwezi havitatoa nuru yao tena,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~24#Answer:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~24#Answer:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?1084380301
trans-unit.source: the stars will fall from the sky,
trans-unit.target: Nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~24#Answer:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~24#Answer:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?493413110
trans-unit.source: and everything in the universe will be shaken. (24-25)
trans-unit.target: Na kila kilichomo mbinguni kitatikiswa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~24#Answer:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!13~24#Note:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?-477351333
trans-unit.source: These verses could be either figurative language or could be understood literally. In comparing this with Isaiah 24:21-23 and 34:4 and Rev. 6:13-14, it seems that this could be figurative language for great disruption in or complete loss of leadership when the Jews are scattered, or when Christ sets up his final reign, or both.
trans-unit.target: Aya hizi zinaweza kuwa lugha ya mfano au zinaweza kueleweka kihalisi. Kwa kulinganisha hii na Isaya 24:21-23 na 34:4 na Ufunuo 6:13-14, inaonekana kwamba hii inaweza kuwa lugha ya mfano kwa usumbufu mkubwa au upotezaji kamili wa uongozi wakati Wayahudi wanapotawanyika, au wakati Kristo anapoanzisha utawala wake wa mwisho, au zote mbili.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~24#Note:What signs will people see happening at the end of this time of suffering?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!13~28#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 13:28-31 Jesus said that people can know about the time of his coming back to this world if they take note of earlier events that he told them would happen before his return.
trans-unit.target: Marko 13:28-31 Yesu alisema kwamba watu wanaweza kujua juu ya wakati wa kurudi kwake kwenye ulimwengu huu ikiwa watazingatia matukio ya mapema ambayo aliwaambia yangetukia kabla ya kurudi kwake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 13.28-31+What is it that we can learn from the fig tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~28#Question:What is it that we can learn from the fig tree?
trans-unit.source: What is it that we can learn from the fig tree?
trans-unit.target: Tunaweza kujifunza nini kutokana na mtini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Question:What is it that we can learn from the fig tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~28#Answer:What is it that we can learn from the fig tree?-616090994
trans-unit.source: There are predictable patterns, such as, when fig tree leaves appear, we know that summer is near. [The same is true about knowing when Christ will return to this world.] (28-29)
trans-unit.target: Kuna mifumo inayoweza kutabiriwa, kama vile, wakati majani ya mtini yanapoonekana, tunajua kwamba majira ya joto yamekaribia. [Vivyo hivyo ni kweli juu ya kujua wakati Kristo atarudi ulimwenguni huu.] (28-29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Answer:What is it that we can learn from the fig tree?

trans-unit.source: How do the people in your culture know that the "summer" or rainy time is near?

trans-unit.source: Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"
trans-unit.target: Je, waweza kueleza maana ya maneno ya Yesu, "mwonapo mambo hayo yanaanza kutokea, jueni ya kuwa yu karibu milangoni?"
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Question:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!13~28#Alternate:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"318921013
trans-unit.source: Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it is near?"
trans-unit.target: Je, unaweza kueleza maana ya maneno ya Yesu, "mnapoona mambo hayo yakitukia, jueni kwamba yuko karibu milangoni"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Alternate:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!13~28#Alternate:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"-1779528287
trans-unit.source: Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that he is near?"
trans-unit.target: Je, unaweza kueleza maana ya maneno ya Yesu, "mnapoona mambo hayo yakitukia, jueni kwamba yuko karibu milangoni"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Alternate:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~28#Answer:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"1046082008
trans-unit.source: He meant that when they saw wars, earthquakes, famines, suffering, persecution, and the "abomination of desolation" take place they would know that the end time was near.
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba walipoona vita, matetemeko ya nchi, njaa kuu, kuteseka, mnyanyaso, na "chukizo la uharibifu" likifanyika wangejua kwamba wakati wa mwisho ulikuwa karibu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~28#Answer:Can you explain the meaning of Jesus's words, "When you see these things happen, you know that it/he is near?"

trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~30#Answer:When were "these things" going to happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~30#Answer:When were "these things" going to happen?866551347

trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~30#Answer:When were "these things" going to happen?

trans-unit.source: If the translation can be ambiguous as to which of the above two choices is to be made that would be good since it appears he may have left it that way because it refers to both. That is, there was a time of trouble and destruction of the temple in the year 70, but there will be another time of trouble as well.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa tafsiri inaweza kuwa na utata kuhusu ni ipi kati ya chaguzi mbili zilizo hapo juu inapaswa kufanywa hiyo itakuwa nzuri kwani inaonekana kwamba anaweza kuwa aliiacha kwa njia hiyo kwa sababu inahusu zote mbili. Hiyo ni, kulikuwa na wakati wa shida na uharibifu wa hekalu katika mwaka wa 70, lakini kutakuwa na wakati mwingine wa shida pia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~30#Note:When were "these things" going to happen?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.32-35+What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~32#Question:What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?
trans-unit.source: What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia ulinganisho gani kufundisha jinsi kurudi kwake kutakavyokuwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~32#Question:What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~32#Answer:What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?-404351980
trans-unit.source: He used an illustration about a man who assigned work to his servants/slaves
trans-unit.target: Alitumia kielezi kuhusu mtu aliyewapa watumishi wake kazi
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~32#Answer:What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~32#Answer:What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?-1997844059
trans-unit.source: and then left on a trip without telling them when he would come back. (32-35)
trans-unit.target: kisha akaondoka bila kuwaambia atarudi lini (32-35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~32#Answer:What comparison did Jesus use to teach what his return will be like?

group.id: Q:MRK 13.36-37+What was Jesus's instruction to his followers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!13~36#Question:What was Jesus's instruction to his followers?
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus's instruction to his followers?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa wafuasi wake maagizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~36#Question:What was Jesus's instruction to his followers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!13~36#Answer:What was Jesus's instruction to his followers?-460968551
trans-unit.source: They must always be ready for his return. (36-37)
trans-unit.target: Lazima wawe tayari sikuzote kwa ajili ya kurudi kwake (36-37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!13~36#Answer:What was Jesus's instruction to his followers?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!14~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 14:1-11 The religious leaders plotted how they might kill Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Marko 14:1-11 Viongozi wa kidini walipanga njama ya kumuua Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 14.1-11+What were the chief priests and teachers of the law trying to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~1#Question:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law trying to do?
trans-unit.source: What were the chief priests and teachers of the law trying to do?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi walikuwa wakijaribu kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Question:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law trying to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~1#Answer:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law trying to do?1278651703
trans-unit.source: They were trying to find a way to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakijaribu kutafuta njia ya kumkamata Yesu kwa siri na kumwua. (1-2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Answer:What were the chief priests and teachers of the law trying to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.1-11+What reason did Jesus give for saying that the woman had done well to pour the ointment on him, rather than to sell it and to give the money to the poor?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~1#Question:What reason did Jesus give for saying that the woman had done well to pour the ointment on him, rather than to sell it and to give the money to the poor?
trans-unit.source: What reason did Jesus give for saying that the woman had done well to pour the ointment on him, rather than to sell it and to give the money to the poor?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa sababu gani ya kusema kwamba mwanamke huyo alikuwa amefanya vema kumwaga mafuta hayo, badala ya kuyauza na kuwapa maskini pesa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Question:What reason did Jesus give for saying that the woman had done well to pour the ointment on him, rather than to sell it and to give the money to the poor?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~1#Answer:What reason did Jesus give for saying that the woman had done well to pour the ointment on him, rather than to sell it and to give the money to the poor?-850727969
trans-unit.source: He said that the poor people would always be there with them. They could help them any time, but he would not always be there. (He also said that the woman was preparing his body beforehand for when people would bury it.) (7-8)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba maskini watakuwa pamoja nao siku zote. Wanaweza kuwasaidia wakati wowote, lakini yeye hatakuwa pamoja nao siku zote. (Alisema pia kwamba mwanamke alikuwa akiutayarisha mwili wake mapema kwa wakati ambapo watu wangeuzika. (7-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Answer:What reason did Jesus give for saying that the woman had done well to pour the ointment on him, rather than to sell it and to give the money to the poor?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.1+What was it that was going to happen after two more days?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~1#Question:What was it that was going to happen after two more days?
trans-unit.source: What was it that was going to happen after two more days?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini ambacho kingetokea baada ya siku mbili zaidi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Question:What was it that was going to happen after two more days?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~1#Answer:What was it that was going to happen after two more days?1592260066
trans-unit.source: Two Jewish festivals would start. They called the one the Passover and the other the Festival of Eating Bread Made with No Yeast. (1)
trans-unit.target: Sherehe mbili za Kiyahudi zilianza, moja iliitwa Pasaka na nyingine Sherehe ya Keki Zisizo na Chachu. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Answer:What was it that was going to happen after two more days?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~1#Answer:What was it that was going to happen after two more days?-266170351
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: See "The Passover sacrifice" in KBT in the "sacrifice" entry.
trans-unit.target: Kuthibitisha Neno Muhimu: Ona "Dhabihu ya Pasaka" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida katika maandishi "dhabihu".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Answer:What was it that was going to happen after two more days?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.1-2+What did the chief priests and teachers decide not to do during the festivals?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~1#Question:What did the chief priests and teachers decide not to do during the festivals?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and teachers decide not to do during the festivals?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na walimu waliamua kutofanya nini wakati wa sherehe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Question:What did the chief priests and teachers decide not to do during the festivals?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~1#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers decide not to do during the festivals?1707527145
trans-unit.source: They decided not to arrest and kill Jesus. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua wasimkamate na kumwua Yesu. (1-2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~1#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers decide not to do during the festivals?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.2+Why did they say that they should not do it during the festivals?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~2#Question:Why did they say that they should not do it during the festivals?
trans-unit.source: Why did they say that they should not do it during the festivals?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walisema kwamba hawapaswi kufanya hivyo wakati wa sherehe?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~2#Question:Why did they say that they should not do it during the festivals?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~2#Answer:Why did they say that they should not do it during the festivals?-1866225895
trans-unit.source: They said that they should not do it then because the crowds of people who came to the festival might riot [and the Roman soldiers would punish all the Jews for that]. (2)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba hawapaswi kufanya hivyo wakati huo kwa sababu umati wa watu waliokuja kwenye sikukuu huenda ukafanya ghasia [na askari Waroma wangewaadhibu Wayahudi wote kwa ajili ya hilo]. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~2#Answer:Why did they say that they should not do it during the festivals?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.3+Where was Jesus at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~3#Question:Where was Jesus at that time?
trans-unit.source: Where was Jesus at that time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa wapi wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Question:Where was Jesus at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~3#Answer:Where was Jesus at that time?1720455123
trans-unit.source: Jesus was at Bethany, in the house of Simon [who had been] a leper. (3)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa Bethania, katika nyumba ya Simoni [aliyekuwa] mwenye ukoma. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Answer:Where was Jesus at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.3+What happened while Jesus was still eating in Simon's house?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~3#Question:What happened while Jesus was still eating in Simon's house?
trans-unit.source: What happened while Jesus was still eating in Simon's house?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipokuwa bado akila katika nyumba ya Simoni?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Question:What happened while Jesus was still eating in Simon's house?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~3#Answer:What happened while Jesus was still eating in Simon's house?1892072753
trans-unit.source: A woman came in, bringing some very expensive perfume (made of a plant called nard). It was in a beautiful jar made of an alabaster stone. (3)
trans-unit.target: akaja mwanamke mmoja mwenye chupa ya marhamu ya nardo yenye thamani kubwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Answer:What happened while Jesus was still eating in Simon's house?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.3+What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~3#Question:What did the woman do?
trans-unit.source: What did the woman do?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Question:What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~3#Answer:What did the woman do?-577942154
trans-unit.source: She broke open the jar and poured the perfume on Jesus's head. (3)
trans-unit.target: Anaivunja ile chupa na kumimina mafuta hayo yenye marashi juu ya kichwa cha Yesu. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Answer:What did the woman do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~3#Note:What did the woman do?1386240326
trans-unit.source: The only way to open that type of container was to break the thin neck of the jar. Breaking the jar was not an accident, they did that on purpose to get the liquid out.
trans-unit.target: Njia pekee ya kufungua chombo hicho ni kuvunja shingo yake nyembamba, na kufanya hivyo ni kusudi la kuondoa maji.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~3#Note:What did the woman do?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.4-5+How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~4#Question:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?
trans-unit.source: How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya watu waliohudhuria walihisije kuhusu jambo hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~4#Question:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~4#Answer:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?-95431339
trans-unit.source: They complained that she had wasted the perfume.
trans-unit.target: Walilalamika kwamba alikuwa ametumia marashi hayo ovyoovyo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~4#Answer:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~4#Answer:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?1931046107
trans-unit.source: They said that someone should have sold it for a lot of money,
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba mtu fulani alipaswa kuuzwa kwa pesa nyingi,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~4#Answer:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~4#Answer:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?-1430900962
trans-unit.source: and given that money to the poor people. (4-5)
trans-unit.target: na fedha hizo apewe maskini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~4#Answer:How did some of the people there feel about her doing that?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.6+What did Jesus say to the people who were rebuking the woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~6#Question:What did Jesus say to the people who were rebuking the woman?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the people who were rebuking the woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini watu waliokuwa wakimkemea mwanamke huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~6#Question:What did Jesus say to the people who were rebuking the woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~6#Answer:What did Jesus say to the people who were rebuking the woman?-529506604
trans-unit.source: He said that they should leave her alone. She had done a very good thing to him. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kumwacha kwa kuwa alikuwa amemtendea jambo zuri sana. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~6#Answer:What did Jesus say to the people who were rebuking the woman?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.7+Did Jesus say that it was not good to help the poor?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~7#Question:Did Jesus say that it was not good to help the poor?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus say that it was not good to help the poor?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alisema kwamba si vema kuwasaidia maskini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~7#Question:Did Jesus say that it was not good to help the poor?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~7#Answer:Did Jesus say that it was not good to help the poor?-1363347973
trans-unit.source: No. He wanted people to help the poor, but he said that it was good that the woman had used this perfume on him as she did. (7)
trans-unit.target: Hapana. Alitaka watu kuwasaidia maskini, lakini alisema ni vizuri kwamba mwanamke huyo alikuwa amemtia manukato kwa njia hiyo. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~7#Answer:Did Jesus say that it was not good to help the poor?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.7-8+Jesus's words show that he knew something was about to happen to him. What was it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~7#Question:Jesus's words show that he knew something was about to happen to him. What was it?
trans-unit.source: Jesus's words show that he knew something was about to happen to him. What was it?
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya Yesu yanaonyesha kwamba alijua jambo fulani ambalo lingetokea.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~7#Question:Jesus's words show that he knew something was about to happen to him. What was it?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~7#Answer:Jesus's words show that he knew something was about to happen to him. What was it?-358215558
trans-unit.source: He knew that people were going to kill him and bury him. (7-8)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba watu wangemuua na kumzika (7-8)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~7#Answer:Jesus's words show that he knew something was about to happen to him. What was it?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.10-11+What did Judas Iscariot do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~10#Question:What did Judas Iscariot do?
trans-unit.source: What did Judas Iscariot do?
trans-unit.target: Yuda Iskariote alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~10#Question:What did Judas Iscariot do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~10#Answer:What did Judas Iscariot do?-219721841
trans-unit.source: He went to the chief priests and told them that he would help them to capture Jesus. (10-11)
trans-unit.target: Aenda kwa wakuu wa makuhani na kuwaambia kwamba atawasaidia kumkamata Yesu (10-11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~10#Answer:What did Judas Iscariot do?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.11+What did the chief priests promise they would do for Judas in return?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~11#Question:What did the chief priests promise they would do for Judas in return?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests promise they would do for Judas in return?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu waliahidi kumfanyia nini Yuda ili kumlipa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~11#Question:What did the chief priests promise they would do for Judas in return?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~11#Answer:What did the chief priests promise they would do for Judas in return?-296696193
trans-unit.source: They promised that if he would betray Jesus to them, they would give him money. (11)
trans-unit.target: Waliahidi kwamba ikiwa angewatia Yesu mikononi mwao, wangempa pesa. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~11#Answer:What did the chief priests promise they would do for Judas in return?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!14~12#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 14:12-26 Jesus ate the Passover meal with his disciples.
trans-unit.target: Marko 14:12-26 Yesu alikula mlo wa Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi wake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 14.12-26+What did Jesus tell his disciples about the bread and the wine that he gave them during the Passover meal?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples about the bread and the wine that he gave them during the Passover meal?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples about the bread and the wine that he gave them during the Passover meal?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake nini kuhusu mkate na divai aliyotumia katika mlo wa Pasaka?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples about the bread and the wine that he gave them during the Passover meal?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples about the bread and the wine that he gave them during the Passover meal?1043109685
trans-unit.source: He said that the bread was his body and the wine was his blood. (22, 24)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mkate ulikuwa mwili wake na divai ilikuwa damu yake. (22, 24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples about the bread and the wine that he gave them during the Passover meal?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.12-26+What was to be the purpose of Jesus's blood spilling out?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~12#Question:What was to be the purpose of Jesus's blood spilling out?
trans-unit.source: What was to be the purpose of Jesus's blood spilling out?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini lililopaswa kuwa kusudi la damu ya Yesu iliyomwagwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Question:What was to be the purpose of Jesus's blood spilling out?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~12#Answer:What was to be the purpose of Jesus's blood spilling out?-84244547
trans-unit.source: By letting his blood spill out he would establish a covenant [between God and] many people.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuacha damu yake imwagike yeye angeanzisha agano [kati ya Mungu na] wengi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Answer:What was to be the purpose of Jesus's blood spilling out?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.12+In the custom of the Jews, what did they do on the first day of the festival?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~12#Question:In the custom of the Jews, what did they do on the first day of the festival?
trans-unit.source: In the custom of the Jews, what did they do on the first day of the festival?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na desturi ya Wayahudi, wao walifanya nini siku ya kwanza ya sikukuu hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Question:In the custom of the Jews, what did they do on the first day of the festival?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~12#Answer:In the custom of the Jews, what did they do on the first day of the festival?-1590211420
trans-unit.source: They sacrificed a lamb, called the Passover lamb. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walitoa dhabihu ya mwana-kondoo, aliyeitwa mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Answer:In the custom of the Jews, what did they do on the first day of the festival?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.12+What did Jesus's disciples ask him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus's disciples ask him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus's disciples ask him?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu walimwuliza nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Question:What did Jesus's disciples ask him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus's disciples ask him?165028977
trans-unit.source: They asked him where they should go to prepare things so that he and they could eat this special Passover meal together. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza mahali ambapo wangeenda kutayarisha mambo ili yeye na wao waweze kula mlo huu wa pekee wa Pasaka pamoja. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~12#Answer:What did Jesus's disciples ask him?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.13+How many disciples did Jesus send to prepare for him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~13#Question:How many disciples did Jesus send to prepare for him?
trans-unit.source: How many disciples did Jesus send to prepare for him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alituma wanafunzi wangapi ili wamtayarishie?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Question:How many disciples did Jesus send to prepare for him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~13#Answer:How many disciples did Jesus send to prepare for him?687359274
trans-unit.target: Mbili. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Answer:How many disciples did Jesus send to prepare for him?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.13+Where did he say that they should go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~13#Question:Where did he say that they should go?
trans-unit.source: Where did he say that they should go?
trans-unit.target: Alisema wanapaswa kwenda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Question:Where did he say that they should go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~13#Answer:Where did he say that they should go?1970099160
trans-unit.source: He said that they should go into the town. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kwenda mjini. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Answer:Where did he say that they should go?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.13-14+What did he say they should do next?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~13#Question:What did he say they should do next?
trans-unit.source: What did he say they should do next?
trans-unit.target: Alisema wangefanya nini baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Question:What did he say they should do next?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~13#Answer:What did he say they should do next?528680545
trans-unit.source: He said that they would see a man coming towards them carrying a jar of water.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wangemwona mwanamume akiwabeba mtungi wa maji akija kwao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Answer:What did he say they should do next?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~13#Answer:What did he say they should do next?-938043775
trans-unit.source: They should follow him to the house where he went. (13-14)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kumfuata hadi kwenye nyumba aliyoingia (13-14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Answer:What did he say they should do next?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.13-16+In what way, do you think, would they know which man carrying water to follow home?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~13#Question:In what way, do you think, would they know which man carrying water to follow home?
trans-unit.source: In what way, do you think, would they know which man carrying water to follow home?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri wangetambua jinsi gani mtu ambaye alikuwa akichukua maji ambaye wangemfuata nyumbani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Question:In what way, do you think, would they know which man carrying water to follow home?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~13#Answer:In what way, do you think, would they know which man carrying water to follow home?-758408367
trans-unit.source: Jesus knew there would only be one such man. (Besides, in Jewish culture, women were the ones to carry water, not men. A man carrying water would be unusual.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijua kwamba ni mtu mmoja tu ambaye angeweza kumsaidia. (Zaidi ya hayo, katika utamaduni wa Kiyahudi, wanawake ndio waliopaswa kuteka maji, si wanaume.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~13#Answer:In what way, do you think, would they know which man carrying water to follow home?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.14-15+What would they find at that house?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.20-21+To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~20#Question:To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?
trans-unit.source: To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akirejezea nini aliposema kwamba jambo lililotukia lingetukia "kama ilivyoandikwa"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~20#Question:To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~20#Answer:To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?-1173274362
trans-unit.source: The prophets long ago had written in God's what would happen to the savior whom God would send. Now what they had written was about to come true as those things happened to Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Sasa, mambo yote yaliyoandikwa kumhusu Yesu yalitimia. Manabii wa Mungu walitabiri zamani kuhusu kile ambacho kingempata Mwokozi ambaye Mungu angemtuma.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~20#Answer:To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~20#Note:To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?696183574
trans-unit.source: Jesus and the men who wrote the various parts of the New Testament often quoted statements that the prophets had written long before Jesus's lifetime. The speakers were not simply illustrating a point, but were showing that God was causing things to happen just as he had predicted through his prophets in the Old Testament writings.
trans-unit.target: Yesu na watu walioandika sehemu mbalimbali za Agano Jipya mara nyingi walinukuu taarifa ambazo manabii walikuwa wameandika muda mrefu kabla ya maisha ya Yesu. Wasemaji hawakuwa tu wakionyesha jambo fulani, bali walikuwa wakionyesha kwamba Mungu alikuwa akisababisha mambo yatukie kama alivyotabiri kupitia manabii wake katika maandishi ya Agano la Kale.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~20#Note:To what was Jesus referring when he said what happened would be "just as it had been written"?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.20-21+Why do you think that it would have been better for that man if he had not been born?

trans-unit.target: Kwa nini unafikiri kwamba ingekuwa afadhali kwa mtu huyo kama hangekuwa amezaliwa?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~20#Note:Why do you think that it would have been better for that man if he had not been born?-677361451
trans-unit.source: If he had not been born, he could not have sinned by betraying the savior whom God had sent into the world. Then he would not have had to receive the punishment for that great sin. (implied 21)
trans-unit.target: Kama asingelizaliwa, asingefanya dhambi kwa kumsaliti mwokozi ambaye Mungu alikuwa amemtuma ulimwenguni. Basi asingelipaswa kupokea adhabu kwa dhambi hiyo kubwa. (iliyohusishwa na 21)

trans-unit.target: (Kumbuka: Watu wengine wanaelewa hii kumaanisha kwamba Mungu alifanya mabadiliko ya kimuujiza au ya kiroho katika mkate).

trans-unit.source: In many situations when there is more than one possible meaning, it is sufficient to follow one of them. group.id: Q:MRK 14.22+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~22#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.target: Agano ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~22#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~22#Answer:What is a covenant?-576269227
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do. [See "covenant" in KBT.]
trans-unit.target: Mkataba ni makubaliano, hasa ahadi ya kisheria. Ikiwa mtu mmoja katika upande mmoja wa agano hafanye kama vile wote wawili wamekubaliana, kwa kawaida kuna adhabu kali kwa ajili yake au yeye hulipa fidia kwa mtu mwingine. Makubaliano kama hayo sasa yanaitwa mikataba. Hata hivyo, Mungu anapofanya makubaliano na watu, anafanya ahadi thabiti ya kile atakachofanya na anasema kile wanachopaswa kufanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~22#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~22#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa lugha ina jina maalum la kutaja aina hizi za makubaliano, muulize aliyehojiwa akuambie aina ya hali ambazo watu hufanya makubaliano. Sikiliza kwa pointi yoyote ambapo haingefaa kusema kwamba Mungu alifanya aina hiyo ya makubaliano. Kisha kurekebisha tafsiri kama inahitajika.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~22#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.source: What do you think these words mean: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri maneno haya yanamaanisha nini: "Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanyika"?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~27#Question:What do you think these words mean: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~27#Answer:What do you think these words mean: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?389162332
trans-unit.source: It means that God would cause others to strike down the leader, and his followers would scatter. (27)
trans-unit.target: Inamaanisha kwamba Mungu angewafanya wengine wamwue kiongozi huyo, na wafuasi wake wangetawanyika. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~27#Answer:What do you think these words mean: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~27#Note:What do you think these words mean: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?-759855900
trans-unit.source: Here it means specifically that Jesus's disciples would scatter when the Jews would arrest, try, and crucify Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Hapa inamaanisha hasa kwamba wanafunzi wa Yesu wangetawanyika wakati Wayahudi wangemkamata, kumhukumu, na kumtundika Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~27#Note:What do you think these words mean: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered"?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.28+What did Jesus say was going to happen after he died?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say was going to happen after he died?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingetukia baada ya kifo chake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~28#Question:What did Jesus say was going to happen after he died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~28#Answer:What did Jesus say was going to happen after he died?1299189086
trans-unit.source: He would rise to live again, and go ahead of the disciples to Galilee [province]. (28)
trans-unit.target: Yeye angefufuka kuishi tena, na kwenda mbele ya wanafunzi wake kwenda Galilaya [mkoa]. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~28#Answer:What did Jesus say was going to happen after he died?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.29-31+What was Peter so sure about that he said it twice?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~29#Answer:What was Peter so sure about that he said it twice?1294289537

trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~34#Answer:What did he tell Peter, James and John to do?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.36+How did Jesus say God was to decide what he should do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~36#Question:How did Jesus say God was to decide what he should do?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus say God was to decide what he should do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisemaje kwamba Mungu ndiye alipaswa kuamua kile alichopaswa kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~36#Question:How did Jesus say God was to decide what he should do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~36#Answer:How did Jesus say God was to decide what he should do?1852474950
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that God should do what pleased himself rather than what Jesus wanted. (36)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Mungu anapaswa kufanya kile kinachomfurahisha mwenyewe badala ya kile Yesu alitaka. (36)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~36#Answer:How did Jesus say God was to decide what he should do?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.36+How did Jesus address God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~36#Question:How did Jesus address God?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus address God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwitaje Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~36#Question:How did Jesus address God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~36#Answer:How did Jesus address God?118100385
trans-unit.source: He addressed him as "Abba" (that is, "Daddy"). (36)
trans-unit.target: Alimwita "Abba" (yaani, "Baba"). (36)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~36#Answer:How did Jesus address God?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~36#Note:How did Jesus address God?1918005410
trans-unit.source: "Abba" is the actual word Jesus used in his Aramaic language to address his father. In the translation, use the appropriate word for when a son addresses his own father. If it sounds very similar to "Abba," only use the vernacular word. If the two words sound somewhat different from each other, transliterate Jesus's own word "Abba" and use the local word in addition as the translation of the Greek word for "[My] Father".
trans-unit.target: "Abba" ni neno halisi ambalo Yesu alitumia katika lugha yake ya Kiaramu kumwita baba yake. Katika tafsiri, tumia neno linalofaa kwa wakati mwana anapozungumza na baba yake mwenyewe. Ikiwa inasikika sawa na "Abba", tumia neno la lugha ya kienyeji tu. Ikiwa maneno mawili yanasikika tofauti kidogo na kila mmoja, andika neno la Yesu mwenyewe "Abba" na utumie neno la mahali hapo kama tafsiri ya neno la Kigiriki kwa "[Baba] yangu".
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~36#Note:How did Jesus address God?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.37+When Jesus returned to his three disciples, what did he find?

trans-unit.source: When Jesus returned to his three disciples, what did he find?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliporudi kwa wanafunzi wake watatu, alipata nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~37#Question:When Jesus returned to his three disciples, what did he find?

trans-unit.target: Akawakuta wamelala.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~37#Answer:When Jesus returned to his three disciples, what did he find?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.37-38+What did Jesus say to those disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~37#Question:What did Jesus say to those disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to those disciples?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~37#Question:What did Jesus say to those disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~37#Answer:What did Jesus say to those disciples?210115984
trans-unit.source: He rebuked them for sleeping. (37)

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~37#Answer:What did Jesus say to those disciples?-1858202022

group.id: Q:MRK 14.38+What did Jesus say about why the disciples did not obey what he asked them to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~38#Question:What did Jesus say about why the disciples did not obey what he asked them to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about why the disciples did not obey what he asked them to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu sababu iliyofanya wanafunzi wasitii yale aliyowaambia wafanye?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~38#Question:What did Jesus say about why the disciples did not obey what he asked them to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~38#Answer:What did Jesus say about why the disciples did not obey what he asked them to do?-1470931223
trans-unit.source: He said, "The spirit is willing, but the body is weak." (He knew that they wanted to obey him, but they were not able by themselves and needed to pray for God's help.) (38)
trans-unit.target: Alisema, "Roho iko tayari, lakini mwili ni dhaifu". (Alijua kwamba walitaka kumtii, lakini hawakuweza kwa nguvu zao wenyewe na walihitaji kuomba msaada wa Mungu.) (38)

trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walitoa jibu gani la kueleza matendo yao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~40#Question:What answer did the disciples have to explain their actions?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~40#Answer:What answer did the disciples have to explain their actions?-406029411

group.id: Q:MRK 14.41-42+What did Jesus then tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~41#Question:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus then tell his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~41#Question:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~41#Answer:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?2063040238
trans-unit.source: He told them that the time for praying and sleeping was over.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wakati wa kusali na kulala ulikuwa umekwisha.

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~41#Answer:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?-1060306600
trans-unit.source: The time had come to go forward to meet those who were coming.
trans-unit.target: Wakati ulikuwa umefika wa kwenda mbele ili kukutana na wale waliokuwa wakija.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~41#Answer:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~41#Answer:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?-1046041596
trans-unit.source: Someone had betrayed him, the Son of Man, to sinful men.
trans-unit.target: Mtu fulani alikuwa amemsaliti Mwana wa binadamu kwa watu wenye dhambi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~41#Answer:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~41#Note:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?194725780
trans-unit.source: Check carefully that when Jesus said, "Let us go," the translation does not imply that Jesus was saying they should leave in order to avoid the betrayer or the bad situation. He was going forward to meet the betrayer; he was not talking of running in the opposite direction.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwa makini kwamba Yesu aliposema, "Twendeni", tafsiri haikumaanisha kwamba Yesu alikuwa akisema kwamba wanapaswa kuondoka ili kuepuka msaliti au hali mbaya. Alikuwa akienda mbele kukutana na msaliti; hakuwa akizungumza juu ya kukimbia katika mwelekeo tofauti.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~41#Note:What did Jesus then tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~44#Answer:Why did Judas kiss Jesus?-1267859053
trans-unit.source: It was a sign to the men who came with Judas. He had told them that the person he would kiss was the man whom they were to arrest. (44)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amewapa ishara wale watu waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja naye, kwamba yule ambaye angeambusu ndiye yule ambaye wangemkamata.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~44#Answer:Why did Judas kiss Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~44#Answer:Why did Judas kiss Jesus?-710239779
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: kiss. In Jewish culture it was proper for one person to press his pursed lips on the side of another person's face. That was a sign of affection and reverence/respect for that other person. (See "kiss" in KBT in the "love" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Katika utamaduni wa Kiyahudi ilikuwa sahihi kwa mtu mmoja kushinikiza midomo yake iliyofungwa upande wa uso wa mtu mwingine. Hiyo ilikuwa ishara ya mapenzi na heshima / heshima kwa mtu huyo mwingine. (Tazama "busu" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "upendo".)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~44#Answer:Why did Judas kiss Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~44#Note:Why did Judas kiss Jesus?-1341036297
trans-unit.source: If the culture of the translation does not show affection or reverence with the kissing action, it is more important to keep that purpose clear, rather than worry about describing the exact action of Judas.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa utamaduni wa tafsiri hauonyeshi shauku au heshima na kitendo cha kumbusu, ni muhimu zaidi kuweka kusudi hilo wazi, badala ya kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kuelezea hatua halisi ya Yuda.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~44#Note:Why did Judas kiss Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.48+Why did Jesus act surprised that they had come armed with swords and clubs?

trans-unit.source: Why did Jesus act surprised that they had come armed with swords and clubs?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~48#Answer:Why did Jesus act surprised that they had come armed with swords and clubs?-2083336456

trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~48#Answer:Why did Jesus act surprised that they had come armed with swords and clubs?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~48#Answer:Why did Jesus act surprised that they had come armed with swords and clubs?100523195
trans-unit.source: He pointed out to them that they could have arrested him easily any time when he was teaching in the temple area (that is, in a very public place). (48)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonyesha kwamba wangeweza kumkamata kwa urahisi wakati wowote alipokuwa akifundisha katika eneo la hekalu (yaani, mahali pa umma sana). (48)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~48#Answer:Why did Jesus act surprised that they had come armed with swords and clubs?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.53-65+Why did the leaders of the Jews gather in the night at the High Priest's house?

trans-unit.source: They met for a court session and tried Jesus, deciding that he must die. (55-64)

group.id: Q:MRK 14.53-65+What was the reason that the Jewish council members said that Jesus must die?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~53#Question:What was the reason that the Jewish council members said that Jesus must die?

trans-unit.target: Kwa nini washiriki wa baraza la Kiyahudi walisema kwamba Yesu alipaswa kufa?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~53#Answer:What was the reason that the Jewish council members said that Jesus must die?-895315933
trans-unit.source: They all agreed with the High Priest that Jesus had blasphemed God by claiming that he was the Christ, the Son of God. (61b-64)
trans-unit.target: Wote walikubaliana na Kuhani wa Cheo cha Juu kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemkufuru Mungu kwa kudai kwamba alikuwa ndiye Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~53#Note:What was the reason that the Jewish council members said that Jesus must die?-295111833
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~53#Note:What was the reason that the Jewish council members said that Jesus must die?

trans-unit.target: Petro alifika karibu kadiri gani na mahali ambapo viongozi Wayahudi walimjaribu Yesu?

trans-unit.target: Aliingia moja kwa moja ndani ya ua (yaani, eneo la ua wa wazi) wa nyumba ya kuhani wa cheo cha juu
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~54#Answer:How close did Peter come to the place where the Jewish leaders were trying Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~54#Answer:How close did Peter come to the place where the Jewish leaders were trying Jesus?-133165742

trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wameketi pamoja na walinzi, wakiota moto.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~54#Answer:How close did Peter come to the place where the Jewish leaders were trying Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.55+What were the leaders of the Jews trying to do?

trans-unit.source: What were the leaders of the Jews trying to do?

trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~55#Question:What were the leaders of the Jews trying to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~55#Answer:What were the leaders of the Jews trying to do?-1563969598
trans-unit.source: They were trying to find evidence to prove that Jesus was guilty of something for which they might condemn him to die. (55)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakitafuta uthibitisho wa kuthibitisha kwamba Yesu alikuwa na hatia ya jambo fulani ambalo wangeweza kumhukumu kifo.

group.id: Q:MRK 14.56+Why do you think they could not find proof that Jesus had done something wrong?

trans-unit.source: Why do you think they could not find proof that Jesus had done something wrong?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini hawakuweza kupata uthibitisho kwamba Yesu alikuwa amefanya jambo lolote baya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~56#Question:Why do you think they could not find proof that Jesus had done something wrong?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~56#Answer:Why do you think they could not find proof that Jesus had done something wrong?1644507678
trans-unit.source: They could not find proof because Jesus had not done anything wrong.
trans-unit.target: Hawakuweza kupata uthibitisho kwa sababu Yesu hakuwa amefanya kosa lolote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~56#Answer:Why do you think they could not find proof that Jesus had done something wrong?

trans-unit.target: Na pia, watu waliokuja kama mashahidi na kusema uwongo [kumhusu Yesu] walikuwa na hadithi zinazopingana. (56)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~56#Answer:Why do you think they could not find proof that Jesus had done something wrong?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.56+Why were they having conflicting stories?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~56#Question:Why were they having conflicting stories?
trans-unit.source: Why were they having conflicting stories?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walikuwa na hadithi zinazopingana?

trans-unit.source: Some or all of them were lying about him. (56)

group.id: Q:MRK 14.58+What was it that some witnesses said about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~58#Answer:What was it that some witnesses said about Jesus?730644020

trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~58#Answer:What was it that some witnesses said about Jesus?

trans-unit.source: What was wrong with their testimony about this one topic?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~59#Answer:What was wrong with their testimony about this one topic?736294848
trans-unit.source: Even in that one thing the witnesses did not agree. (59)
trans-unit.target: Hata hivyo, ushahidi wao haukupatana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~59#Answer:What was wrong with their testimony about this one topic?

trans-unit.source: What did the High Priest say to Jesus?

trans-unit.source: What surprised him?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomshangaza?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.60-61+What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~60#Question:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?
trans-unit.source: What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!14~60#Alternate:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?2065435417
trans-unit.source: What will people who read this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosoma haya watafikiri nini sababu ya Yesu kutokujibu maswali ya Kuhani Mkuu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~60#Alternate:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!14~60#Alternate:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?843913909
trans-unit.source: What will people who hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosikia hili watafikiri nini sababu ilikuwa kwamba Yesu hakujibu maswali ya Kuhani wa Cheo cha Juu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~60#Alternate:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~60#Answer:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?-994369730
trans-unit.source: The High Priest already knew Jesus had not done anything wrong,
trans-unit.target: Kuhani Mkuu tayari alijua Yesu hakuwa amefanya kosa lolote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~60#Answer:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~60#Answer:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?886242285
trans-unit.source: and Jesus was ready to die for us, so there was no need for him to say anything.
trans-unit.target: na Yesu alikuwa tayari kufa kwa ajili yetu, kwa hiyo hakukuwa na haja ya yeye kusema chochote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~60#Answer:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~60#Note:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?483320953
trans-unit.source: In some places, if someone accuses another person, but that person does not answer any questions, people assume that he is guilty. This question is a check for such possible misunderstanding of Jesus's not replying.
trans-unit.target: Katika sehemu fulani, ikiwa mtu amshtaki mtu mwingine, lakini mtu huyo hajibu maswali yoyote, watu hudhani kwamba ana hatia. Swali hili ni kuangalia kwa uelewaji kama huo usiofaa wa kutokuwa na jibu la Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~60#Note:What will people who read/hear this think the reason was that Jesus did not answer the High Priest's questions?
