trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~61#Answer:What question did the High Priest then ask Jesus?-1206363043
trans-unit.source: He asked Jesus whether he was the Christ, the Son of God, or not. (61b)
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza Yesu kama alikuwa Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, au la. (61b)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~61#Answer:What question did the High Priest then ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.62+How did Jesus answer?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~62#Question:How did Jesus answer?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliitikiaje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Question:How did Jesus answer?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~62#Answer:How did Jesus answer?1466460417
trans-unit.source: He said that he was. He also said that one day they would see him, the Son of Man, sitting at God's right hand and coming back to this world. (62)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba alikuwa. Pia alisema kwamba siku moja watamwona Mwana wa Adamu ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu na kuja tena ulimwenguni (62).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Answer:How did Jesus answer?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.62+What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~62#Question:What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?
trans-unit.source: What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosoma haya watafikiri inamaanisha nini Yesu aliposema kwamba 'angeketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu'?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Question:What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~62#Answer:What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?-877294363
trans-unit.source: This refers to him being equal to or next in authority with God. (62)
trans-unit.target: Hii inahusu kuwa sawa au wa pili kwa mamlaka na Mungu. (62)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Answer:What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~62#Note:What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?-1608609943
trans-unit.source: In Jewish custom the right hand side of important people was the most honored position anyone could ever have. Therefore, this figure fits well and shows that Jesus now is there next to God, sharing in what God does.
trans-unit.target: Katika desturi ya Kiyahudi upande wa kulia wa watu mashuhuri ulikuwa ndio mahali pa heshima zaidi ambapo mtu yeyote angeweza kuwa. Kwa hiyo, takwimu hii yafaa vizuri na yaonyesha kwamba Yesu sasa yuko karibu na Mungu, akishiriki katika yale ambayo Mungu hufanya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Note:What will the people who read this think it means when Jesus said he would be "sitting at the right hand of God"?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.63+Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~63#Question:Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Kuhani Mkuu alirarua mavazi yake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~63#Question:Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~63#Answer:Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?375182523
trans-unit.source: He tore his clothes as a sign to show his very strong concern about what Jesus had said. (63)
trans-unit.target: Aliyararua mavazi yake kama ishara ya kuonyesha hangaiko lake kubwa sana juu ya yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amesema. (63)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~63#Answer:Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~63#Note:Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?53174786
trans-unit.source: This was a Jewish custom to show extreme sorrow.
trans-unit.target: Huo ulikuwa desturi ya Wayahudi ya kuonyesha huzuni yao kubwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~63#Note:Why do you think that the High Priest tore his clothes?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.62+Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~62#Question:Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?
trans-unit.source: Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Kuhani Mkuu alisema kwamba hawakuhitaji mashahidi wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Question:Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~62#Answer:Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?-140328741
trans-unit.source: Jesus had openly claimed that he was the Son of God, and they all had heard him say it. (62)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amejitangaza waziwazi kuwa yeye ni Mwana wa Mungu, na wote walikuwa wamemsikia akisema hivyo. (62)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Answer:Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~62#Note:Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?-1742914238
trans-unit.source: By the Jewish law and by the scriptures no ordinary person could claim that he was equal to or greater than God. So, since they would not admit that he was God's son, they thought that they had enough evidence to condemn him to die.
trans-unit.target: Kwa sheria ya Kiyahudi na kwa maandiko hakuna mtu wa kawaida angeweza kudai kwamba alikuwa sawa na au mkubwa kuliko Mungu. Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa hawakukubali kwamba alikuwa mwana wa Mungu, walifikiri kwamba walikuwa na ushahidi wa kutosha kumhukumu kifo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~62#Note:Why did the High Priest say that they did not need to find any more witnesses?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.64+What did the court officials say that Jesus's punishment would be?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~64#Question:What did the court officials say that Jesus's punishment would be?
trans-unit.source: What did the court officials say that Jesus's punishment would be?
trans-unit.target: Maofisa wa mahakama walisema Yesu angeadhibiwaje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~64#Question:What did the court officials say that Jesus's punishment would be?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~64#Answer:What did the court officials say that Jesus's punishment would be?-132244315
trans-unit.source: They said that he would have to die. (64)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba lazima afe. (64)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~64#Answer:What did the court officials say that Jesus's punishment would be?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.65+What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~65#Question:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni baadhi ya mambo gani ambayo watu walimfanyia Yesu wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~65#Question:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~65#Answer:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?308877959
trans-unit.source: They began to spit on him.
trans-unit.target: Wakaanza kumtemea mate.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~65#Answer:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~65#Answer:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?-759513773
trans-unit.source: They tied a cloth around his eyes and, while he could not see, they hit him and mockingly told him to tell them who it was who struck him.
trans-unit.target: Walifunga kitambaa machoni pake, na alipokuwa kipofu, walimpiga na kumwambia kwa dhihaka awaambie ni nani aliyempiga.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~65#Answer:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~65#Answer:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?-14467959
trans-unit.source: Those who were guards for the High Priest's house and the temple beat him.
trans-unit.target: Wale waliokuwa walinzi wa nyumba ya Kuhani wa Cheo cha Juu na hekalu walimpiga.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~65#Answer:What are some of the things people then did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!14~66#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 14:66-72 Peter said that he did not know Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Marko 14:66-72 Petro alisema kwamba hamjui Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 14.66-72+What was it that Peter said three times?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~66#Question:What was it that Peter said three times?
trans-unit.source: What was it that Peter said three times?
trans-unit.target: Petro alisema nini mara tatu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Question:What was it that Peter said three times?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~66#Answer:What was it that Peter said three times?523771652
trans-unit.source: He said that he did not know Jesus. (68, 70, 71)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba hakumjua Yesu. (68, 70, 71)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Answer:What was it that Peter said three times?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.66-70+Where was Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~66#Question:Where was Peter?
trans-unit.source: Where was Peter?
trans-unit.target: Petro alikuwa wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Question:Where was Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~66#Answer:Where was Peter?715282923
trans-unit.source: He was in the courtyard, the open space in the compound of the High Priest. (54, 66)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa katika ua, mahali pa wazi katika jengo la Kuhani wa Cheo cha Juu. (54, 66)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Answer:Where was Peter?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.66-70+What was he doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~66#Question:What was he doing?
trans-unit.source: What was he doing?
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Question:What was he doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~66#Answer:What was he doing?-149539131
trans-unit.source: He was sitting by the fire, warming himself. (54, 67)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa ameketi karibu na moto, akijipasha joto.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~66#Answer:What was he doing?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.67+What did the servant girl say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~67#Question:What did the servant girl say to Peter?
trans-unit.source: What did the servant girl say to Peter?
trans-unit.target: Msichana huyo mtumishi alimwambia Petro nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~67#Question:What did the servant girl say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~67#Answer:What did the servant girl say to Peter?1445636371
trans-unit.source: She said that he had been in the group who followed Jesus. (67)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba alikuwa katika kundi ambalo lilimfuata Yesu. (67)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~67#Answer:What did the servant girl say to Peter?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.68+What did Peter say to her?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~68#Question:What did Peter say to her?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter say to her?
trans-unit.target: Petro alimwambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~68#Question:What did Peter say to her?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~68#Answer:What did Peter say to her?697875567
trans-unit.source: Peter said that he did not know or understand anything about what she was saying. (68)
trans-unit.target: Peter alisema kwamba hakujua wala kuelewa chochote kuhusu kile alichokuwa akisema. (68)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~68#Answer:What did Peter say to her?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.69+How do we know that the servant girl did not believe what Peter had said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~69#Question:How do we know that the servant girl did not believe what Peter had said?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that the servant girl did not believe what Peter had said?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba msichana mtumishi hakuamini yale ambayo Petro alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~69#Question:How do we know that the servant girl did not believe what Peter had said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~69#Answer:How do we know that the servant girl did not believe what Peter had said?463732756
trans-unit.source: When the girl saw him again near the entrance of the compound, she said again that he was one of [the followers of Jesus]. (69)
trans-unit.target: Msichana alipomwona tena karibu na mlango wa kambi, alisema tena kwamba alikuwa mmoja wa [wafuasi wa Yesu]. (69)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~69#Answer:How do we know that the servant girl did not believe what Peter had said?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.70+How did Peter respond to her this second time that she accused him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~70#Question:How did Peter respond to her this second time that she accused him?
trans-unit.source: How did Peter respond to her this second time that she accused him?
trans-unit.target: Petro aliitikiaje aliposhtakiwa mara ya pili?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~70#Question:How did Peter respond to her this second time that she accused him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~70#Answer:How did Peter respond to her this second time that she accused him?-1251917176
trans-unit.source: He denied that what she said was true. (70a)
trans-unit.target: Akakana kuwa aliyo yasema ni kweli.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~70#Answer:How did Peter respond to her this second time that she accused him?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.70+Then another person said that Peter was one of the followers of Jesus. What reason did he give?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~70#Question:Then another person said that Peter was one of the followers of Jesus. What reason did he give?
trans-unit.source: Then another person said that Peter was one of the followers of Jesus. What reason did he give?
trans-unit.target: Kisha mtu mwingine akasema kwamba Petro alikuwa mmoja wa wafuasi wa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~70#Question:Then another person said that Peter was one of the followers of Jesus. What reason did he give?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~70#Answer:Then another person said that Peter was one of the followers of Jesus. What reason did he give?-1672007720
trans-unit.source: He said that Peter came from Galilee [province], the same as Jesus. (Probably the man could tell where Peter came from by the way he talked.) (70b)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Petro alitoka Galilaya [mkoa], sawa na Yesu. (Labda mtu huyo angeweza kujua Petro alitoka wapi kwa njia aliyozungumza.) (70b)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~70#Answer:Then another person said that Peter was one of the followers of Jesus. What reason did he give?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.71+How did Peter respond to that person?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~71#Question:How did Peter respond to that person?
trans-unit.source: How did Peter respond to that person?
trans-unit.target: Petro alimjibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~71#Question:How did Peter respond to that person?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~71#Answer:How did Peter respond to that person?-2107840563
trans-unit.source: He spoke very strongly, binding himself by an oath that God should punish him if he was lying. Doing that, he said that he did not know Jesus at all. (71)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwa nguvu sana, akijifunga mwenyewe kwa kiapo kwamba Mungu amwadhibu ikiwa ni mwongo. Kwa kufanya hivyo, alisema kwamba hamjui Yesu hata kidogo. (71)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~71#Answer:How did Peter respond to that person?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!14~71#Note:How did Peter respond to that person?1332149966
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: See "curse" in KBT in the "bless" entry.)
trans-unit.target: (Kichunguzi cha Neno Muhimu: Ona "laana" katika KBT katika "baraka" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~71#Note:How did Peter respond to that person?

group.id: Q:MRK 14.72+What was it that made Peter weep?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!14~72#Question:What was it that made Peter weep?
trans-unit.source: What was it that made Peter weep?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Petro alilia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~72#Question:What was it that made Peter weep?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!14~72#Answer:What was it that made Peter weep?-983514577
trans-unit.source: Peter heard the rooster crow the second time. Hearing the rooster crow reminded him that Jesus had told him that he (Peter) would say three times that he did not know Jesus before the rooster crowed the second time. (72)
trans-unit.target: Petro alisikia jogoo akiwika mara ya pili. Kusikia jogoo akiwika alimkumbusha kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemwambia kwamba yeye (Petro) atamkana Yesu mara tatu kabla ya jogoo kuwika mara ya pili (72).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!14~72#Answer:What was it that made Peter weep?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!15~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 15:1-15 They took Jesus to Pilate so that Pilate could try him in his court.
trans-unit.target: Marko 15:1-15 Yesu alipelekwa kwa Pilato ili ahukumiwe katika mahakama yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 15.1-15+What did the leaders of the Jews do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~1#Question:What did the leaders of the Jews do with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the leaders of the Jews do with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Viongozi wa Kiyahudi walimfanyia Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Question:What did the leaders of the Jews do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:What did the leaders of the Jews do with Jesus?1172092921
trans-unit.source: They took him to Pilate, the Roman governor, to stand trial there. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walimpeleka kwa Pilato, gavana Mroma, ili ahukumiwe huko. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:What did the leaders of the Jews do with Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.1-15+Did Pilate think that Jesus had done evil?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~1#Question:Did Pilate think that Jesus had done evil?
trans-unit.source: Did Pilate think that Jesus had done evil?
trans-unit.target: Je, Pilato alifikiri kwamba Yesu alikuwa ametenda jambo baya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Question:Did Pilate think that Jesus had done evil?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:Did Pilate think that Jesus had done evil?-838685687
trans-unit.source: No, he knew that the chief priests only wanted to kill Jesus because they were jealous of him. (10)
trans-unit.target: La, alijua kwamba wakuu wa makuhani walitaka tu kumwua Yesu kwa sababu walimwonea wivu. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:Did Pilate think that Jesus had done evil?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.1-15+What did Pilate want to do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~1#Question:What did Pilate want to do to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Pilate want to do to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alitaka kumfanya Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Question:What did Pilate want to do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:What did Pilate want to do to Jesus?1086534786
trans-unit.source: He wanted to set Jesus free. (9, 14)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kumweka Yesu huru (9, 14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:What did Pilate want to do to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.1-15+What did he do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~1#Question:What did he do with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did he do with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Alimtendeaje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Question:What did he do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:What did he do with Jesus?1863152757
trans-unit.source: He ordered that [some of his men] beat Jesus, and then he handed him over [to the soldiers for them] to nail him to a cross. (15)
trans-unit.target: Aliamuru [baadhi ya wanaume wake] wamchape Yesu, kisha akamkabidhi [askari-jeshi] ili wamsulibishe. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:What did he do with Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.1+What time was it by then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~1#Question:What time was it by then?
trans-unit.source: What time was it by then?
trans-unit.target: Kufikia wakati huo ilikuwa saa ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Question:What time was it by then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:What time was it by then?229023407
trans-unit.source: It was very early in the morning. (1)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa asubuhi na mapema sana. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:What time was it by then?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.1+Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~1#Question:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini viongozi wa Kiyahudi walimfunga Yesu kabla ya kumpeleka kwa Pilato?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Question:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?2113509415
trans-unit.source: They may have wanted to convince Pilate that Jesus was a bad man.
trans-unit.target: Huenda walitaka kumsadikisha Pilato kwamba Yesu alikuwa mtu mbaya.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?1680744674
trans-unit.source: They may have been afraid that he would try to escape.
trans-unit.target: Huenda waliogopa kwamba angejaribu kukimbia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?-136375372
trans-unit.source: They may have been afraid that his followers would try to rescue him.
trans-unit.target: Huenda waliogopa kwamba wafuasi wake wangejaribu kumwokoa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~1#Answer:Why do you think that the leaders of the Jews tied Jesus before they took him to Pilate?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.2+What question did Pilate ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~2#Question:What question did Pilate ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What question did Pilate ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~2#Question:What question did Pilate ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~2#Answer:What question did Pilate ask Jesus?-1483300715
trans-unit.source: He asked whether Jesus was the king of the Jews or not. (2)
trans-unit.target: Aliuliza kama Yesu alikuwa mfalme wa Wayahudi au la. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~2#Answer:What question did Pilate ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.2+Did Jesus agree that he was the king of the Jews?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~2#Question:Did Jesus agree that he was the king of the Jews?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus agree that he was the king of the Jews?
trans-unit.target: Je! Yesu alikubali kwamba alikuwa mfalme wa Wayahudi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~2#Question:Did Jesus agree that he was the king of the Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~2#Answer:Did Jesus agree that he was the king of the Jews?1927134537
trans-unit.source: Yes. He said that it was as Pilate stated. (2)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, alisema kwamba ilikuwa kama Pilato alivyosema. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~2#Answer:Did Jesus agree that he was the king of the Jews?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.3+What did the chief priests say to Pilate about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~3#Question:What did the chief priests say to Pilate about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests say to Pilate about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu walimwambia Pilato nini juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~3#Question:What did the chief priests say to Pilate about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~3#Answer:What did the chief priests say to Pilate about Jesus?-1769594277
trans-unit.source: They accused him of having done many [evil] things. (3)
trans-unit.target: Walimshtaki kwamba alifanya mambo mengi [maovu]. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~3#Answer:What did the chief priests say to Pilate about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.4-5+What surprised Pilate?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~4#Question:What surprised Pilate?
trans-unit.source: What surprised Pilate?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomshangaza Pilato?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~4#Question:What surprised Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~4#Answer:What surprised Pilate?-1063143424
trans-unit.source: Pilate was surprised that Jesus did not answer or defend himself against the accusations. (4-5)
trans-unit.target: Pilato alishangaa kwamba Yesu hakujibu wala kujitetea dhidi ya mashtaka (4-5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~4#Answer:What surprised Pilate?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.6-11+What did the Roman governor usually do at the time of the annual Jewish festival?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~6#Question:What did the Roman governor usually do at the time of the annual Jewish festival?
trans-unit.source: What did the Roman governor usually do at the time of the annual Jewish festival?
trans-unit.target: Gavana Mroma alikuwa na desturi ya kufanya nini wakati wa sherehe ya kila mwaka ya Kiyahudi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~6#Question:What did the Roman governor usually do at the time of the annual Jewish festival?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~6#Answer:What did the Roman governor usually do at the time of the annual Jewish festival?159921121
trans-unit.source: He would release one Jewish prisoner to the Jewish people.
trans-unit.target: Angemfungua mfungwa mmoja Myahudi kwa ajili ya Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~6#Answer:What did the Roman governor usually do at the time of the annual Jewish festival?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.6+How did the Roman governor decide whom they would release?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~6#Question:How did the Roman governor decide whom they would release?
trans-unit.source: How did the Roman governor decide whom they would release?
trans-unit.target: Gavana Mroma aliamuaje ni nani ambao wangeachiliwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~6#Question:How did the Roman governor decide whom they would release?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~6#Answer:How did the Roman governor decide whom they would release?-174166041
trans-unit.source: They allowed the Jewish people pick the prisoner they wanted him to release. (6)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaacha Wayahudi wachague mfungwa ambaye walitaka aachiliwe. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~6#Answer:How did the Roman governor decide whom they would release?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.7+Who was Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~7#Question:Who was Barabbas?
trans-unit.source: Who was Barabbas?
trans-unit.target: Baraba alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~7#Question:Who was Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~7#Answer:Who was Barabbas?-1447585200
trans-unit.source: He was a [Jewish] prisoner that the Romans had put in prison for leading a rebellion against the Roman government, the and for murdering someone during that rebellion. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mfungwa [Myahudi] ambaye Warumi walikuwa wamemtia gerezani kwa kuongoza uasi dhidi ya serikali ya Kirumi, na kwa kuua mtu wakati wa uasi huo. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~7#Answer:Who was Barabbas?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.8-11+What did the people ask Pilate concerning Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~8#Question:What did the people ask Pilate concerning Barabbas?
trans-unit.source: What did the people ask Pilate concerning Barabbas?
trans-unit.target: Watu walimwuliza Pilato nini kuhusu Baraba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~8#Question:What did the people ask Pilate concerning Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~8#Answer:What did the people ask Pilate concerning Barabbas?1564151023
trans-unit.source: They asked that Pilate would follow the usual custom and release a prisoner to them. They requested that he release one called Barabbas. (8, 11)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakamwendea Pilato wakamwomba awafungulie mfungwa mmoja kama ilivyokuwa desturi yao.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~8#Answer:What did the people ask Pilate concerning Barabbas?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.9-10+Whom did Pilate want to release to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~9#Question:Whom did Pilate want to release to them?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Pilate want to release to them?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alitaka kuwafungulia nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~9#Question:Whom did Pilate want to release to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~9#Answer:Whom did Pilate want to release to them?-2086909139
trans-unit.source: He wanted to release Jesus. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kumwachilia Yesu (9-10)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~9#Answer:Whom did Pilate want to release to them?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.9-14+Why was it that Pilate wanted to release Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~9#Question:Why was it that Pilate wanted to release Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why was it that Pilate wanted to release Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Pilato alitaka kumweka Yesu huru?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~9#Question:Why was it that Pilate wanted to release Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~9#Answer:Why was it that Pilate wanted to release Jesus?1270078802
trans-unit.source: He knew that Jesus had not done anything wrong, and he knew that the chief priests had arrested him because they were jealous of him. (9-10, 14)
trans-unit.target: Alijua kwamba Yesu hakuwa amefanya kosa lolote, na alijua kwamba wakuu wa makuhani walikuwa wamemkamata kwa sababu ya wivu. (9-10, 14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~9#Answer:Why was it that Pilate wanted to release Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.11+Why did the people not ask for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~11#Question:Why did the people not ask for Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did the people not ask for Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu hawakumwuliza Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~11#Question:Why did the people not ask for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~11#Answer:Why did the people not ask for Jesus?-256000471
trans-unit.source: They did not ask for Jesus because the chief priests urged them to ask for Barabbas. (11)
trans-unit.target: Hawakumwomba Yesu kwa sababu wakuu wa makuhani waliwahimiza wamwombe Baraba. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~11#Answer:Why did the people not ask for Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.13-14+What did the people say should happen with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~13#Question:What did the people say should happen with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the people say should happen with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu walisema Yesu apasa kupatwa na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~13#Question:What did the people say should happen with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~13#Answer:What did the people say should happen with Jesus?-187261549
trans-unit.source: They said that Pilate should [have some of his men] nail Jesus to a cross [to suffer there until he died]. (13-14)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba Pilato apaswa [kuwa na baadhi ya watu wake] kumtundika Yesu mtini [kuteseka huko hadi afe]. (13-14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~13#Answer:What did the people say should happen with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~13#Note:What did the people say should happen with Jesus?-1112393827
trans-unit.source: (Key Term Check: See "crucify" in KBT in the "cross" entry.)
trans-unit.target: (Key Term Check: Angalia "kusulubisha" katika KBT katika "msalaba" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~13#Note:What did the people say should happen with Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.15+Why did Pilate finally agree to release Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~15#Question:Why did Pilate finally agree to release Barabbas?
trans-unit.source: Why did Pilate finally agree to release Barabbas?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hatimaye Pilato alikubali kumweka huru Baraba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~15#Question:Why did Pilate finally agree to release Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~15#Answer:Why did Pilate finally agree to release Barabbas?-1519977170
trans-unit.source: Pilate agreed only because he wanted to please the people. (15)
trans-unit.target: Pilato alikubali tu kwa sababu alitaka kuwapendeza watu. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~15#Answer:Why did Pilate finally agree to release Barabbas?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!15~16#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 15:16-20 Soldiers mocked Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Marko 15:16-20 Askari-jeshi walimdhihaki Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~16#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 15.16-20+Why did the soldiers do what they did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~16#Question:Why did the soldiers do what they did to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did the soldiers do what they did to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini askari walimtendea Yesu hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~16#Question:Why did the soldiers do what they did to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~16#Answer:Why did the soldiers do what they did to Jesus?20839556
trans-unit.source: He had said that he was a king. They did not believe him, so they were mocking him by pretending that he was their king. (17-20)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amesema kwamba yeye ni mfalme. Hawakumwamini, kwa hiyo walimdhihaki kwa kujifanya kuwa yeye ni mfalme wao (17-20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~16#Answer:Why did the soldiers do what they did to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.16+Where did the soldiers take Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~16#Question:Where did the soldiers take Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Where did the soldiers take Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Askari walimpeleka Yesu wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~16#Question:Where did the soldiers take Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~16#Answer:Where did the soldiers take Jesus?820490134
trans-unit.source: They took him to an inner part of the compound of Pilate's palace as the Roman governor. (16)
trans-unit.target: Wakampeleka ndani ya jumba la Pilato akiwa gavana Mroma. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~16#Answer:Where did the soldiers take Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.17+Why do you think that the soldiers chose a purple robe to put on Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~17#Question:Why do you think that the soldiers chose a purple robe to put on Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that the soldiers chose a purple robe to put on Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini askari walimvika Yesu vazi la zambarau?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~17#Question:Why do you think that the soldiers chose a purple robe to put on Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~17#Answer:Why do you think that the soldiers chose a purple robe to put on Jesus?-843531346
trans-unit.source: That is the kind of robe which kings wore; they were dressing him up as a king. (17)
trans-unit.target: Hiyo ndiyo aina ya vazi ambalo wafalme walivaa; walikuwa wakimvika kama mfalme. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~17#Answer:Why do you think that the soldiers chose a purple robe to put on Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.17+What did they put on Jesus's head?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~17#Question:What did they put on Jesus's head?
trans-unit.source: What did they put on Jesus's head?
trans-unit.target: Waliweka nini juu ya kichwa cha Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~17#Question:What did they put on Jesus's head?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~17#Answer:What did they put on Jesus's head?1138764932
trans-unit.source: They put on him a crown made of thorny branches, shaped like the crown which kings wore. (17)
trans-unit.target: Wakamvika taji ya miiba, kama ile taji ya wafalme. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~17#Answer:What did they put on Jesus's head?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.18+How did they greet Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~18#Question:How did they greet Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How did they greet Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Walimkaribishaje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~18#Question:How did they greet Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~18#Answer:How did they greet Jesus?552060062
trans-unit.source: They greeted him as if he were a king. (18)
trans-unit.target: Walimsalimu kana kwamba alikuwa mfalme. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~18#Answer:How did they greet Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.18-20+Why did they honor Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~18#Question:Why did they honor Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why did they honor Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini walimheshimu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~18#Question:Why did they honor Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~18#Answer:Why did they honor Jesus?-1874238404
trans-unit.source: They were not really worshipping him, but mocking him. (18-20)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa wakimwabudu kwa kweli, bali walikuwa wakimdhihaki (18-20)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~18#Answer:Why did they honor Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.20+When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~20#Question:When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?
trans-unit.source: When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya askari-jeshi kumaliza kumdhihaki Yesu, wao hufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~20#Question:When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~20#Answer:When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?1618095654
trans-unit.source: They put his own clothes on him again.
trans-unit.target: Walimvika tena mavazi yake.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~20#Answer:When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~20#Answer:When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?-1648141498
trans-unit.source: Then they led him out in order to nail him to a cross. (20)
trans-unit.target: Kisha wakamtoa nje ili wamsulibishe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~20#Answer:When the soldiers had finished mocking Jesus, what did they do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!15~21#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 15:21-32 The Roman soldiers took Jesus and nailed him to a cross.
trans-unit.target: Marko 15:21-32 Askari Waroma walimchukua Yesu na kumtundika kwenye msalaba.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 15.21-32+What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~21#Question:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the soldiers do to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Askari walimfanyia Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Question:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~21#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?-1724098441
trans-unit.source: They nailed him to a cross [to suffer there until he died]. (25)
trans-unit.target: Wakamsulibisha [kuteseka huko hadi kifo chake]. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.21-32+Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~21#Question:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?
trans-unit.source: Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomdhihaki Yesu alipokuwa msalabani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Question:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!15~21#Alternate:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?-1170338605
trans-unit.source: Who mocked Jesus while he hung on the cross?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomdhihaki Yesu alipokuwa akining'inia kwenye msalaba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Alternate:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!15~21#Alternate:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?-329420499
trans-unit.source: Who ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomdhihaki Yesu alipokuwa akining'inia kwenye msalaba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Alternate:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~21#Answer:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?-1217205390
trans-unit.source: The people who passed by that place mocked him. (29)
trans-unit.target: Na wale wanao pita karibu yake humfanyia maskhara.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Answer:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~21#Answer:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?-1765468275
trans-unit.source: The chief priests and the teachers of the law mocked him among themselves. (31)
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na walimu wa Sheria walimdhihaki miongoni mwao wenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Answer:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~21#Answer:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?799082752
trans-unit.source: The men who were hanging there on the other crosses also insulted him. (32)
trans-unit.target: Wale waporaji waliosulibiwa pamoja naye walimtukana pia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Answer:Who mocked/ridiculed Jesus while he hung on the cross?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.21+How do we know that Jesus did not carry his cross all the way to the place where they nailed him to it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~21#Question:How do we know that Jesus did not carry his cross all the way to the place where they nailed him to it?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus did not carry his cross all the way to the place where they nailed him to it?
trans-unit.target: Twajuaje kwamba Yesu hakubeba msalaba wake hadi mahali walipomsulibisha?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Question:How do we know that Jesus did not carry his cross all the way to the place where they nailed him to it?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~21#Answer:How do we know that Jesus did not carry his cross all the way to the place where they nailed him to it?646159083
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that the soldiers forced the man Simon (from Cyrene, whom they met on the way) to carry it for him. (21)
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba askari walimlazimisha mtu mmoja aitwaye Simoni (kutoka Kirene, ambaye walikutana naye njiani) amchukue. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~21#Answer:How do we know that Jesus did not carry his cross all the way to the place where they nailed him to it?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.22+What was the name of the place where they nailed Jesus to the cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~22#Question:What was the name of the place where they nailed Jesus to the cross?
trans-unit.source: What was the name of the place where they nailed Jesus to the cross?
trans-unit.target: Jina la mahali ambapo Yesu alitundikwa mtini liliitwaje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~22#Question:What was the name of the place where they nailed Jesus to the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~22#Answer:What was the name of the place where they nailed Jesus to the cross?1756504087
trans-unit.source: The place was called Golgotha (which means "The place of a skull"). (22)
trans-unit.target: Mahali hapo paliitwa Golgotha (linalomaanisha "Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa"). (22)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~22#Answer:What was the name of the place where they nailed Jesus to the cross?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.23+What did they offer Jesus to drink?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~23#Question:What did they offer Jesus to drink?
trans-unit.source: What did they offer Jesus to drink?
trans-unit.target: Walimpa Yesu kinywaji gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Question:What did they offer Jesus to drink?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~23#Answer:What did they offer Jesus to drink?875890933
trans-unit.source: They offered him wine with some medicine in it. (23)
trans-unit.target: Wakampa divai iliyochanganywa na dawa. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Answer:What did they offer Jesus to drink?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.23-24+Why do you think that they offered it to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~23#Question:Why do you think that they offered it to him?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they offered it to him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini walimpa zawadi hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Question:Why do you think that they offered it to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~23#Answer:Why do you think that they offered it to him?-1597795932
trans-unit.source: They offered it probably to help him not feel the pain so much.
trans-unit.target: Walimtolea labda ili kumsaidia asihisi uchungu sana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Answer:Why do you think that they offered it to him?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~23#Note:Why do you think that they offered it to him?2057175844
trans-unit.source: This is a check for any wrong meaning.
trans-unit.target: Hii ni kuangalia kwa maana yoyote ya makosa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Note:Why do you think that they offered it to him?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.23-24+Why do you think that Jesus refused to drink it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~23#Question:Why do you think that Jesus refused to drink it?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus refused to drink it?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alikataa kuinywa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Question:Why do you think that Jesus refused to drink it?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~23#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus refused to drink it?-1895767074
trans-unit.source: He probably refused because he had decided to suffer the full pain for mankind's sins.
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea alikataa kwa sababu alikuwa ameamua kuteseka kabisa kwa ajili ya dhambi za wanadamu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus refused to drink it?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.23-24+What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~23#Question:What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?
trans-unit.source: What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?
trans-unit.target: Askari walifanya nini na mavazi ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Question:What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~23#Note:What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?-453545473
trans-unit.source: They threw "lots" to see which of them would get the different pieces of Jesus's clothing. (24)
trans-unit.target: Walipiga "miiba" ili kuona ni nani kati yao angepata vipande tofauti vya mavazi ya Yesu. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Note:What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~23#Note:What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?1454907425
trans-unit.source: What the men did was something like people now sometimes throw dice to choose a winner.
trans-unit.target: Wanaume hao walifanya kama vile watu leo wanavyocheza kamari ili kuchagua mshindi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Note:What did the soldiers do with Jesus's clothes?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.23-24+If the people who speak your language do something like the soldiers did in order to help them decide things, tell me what they do.

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~23#Question:If the people who speak your language do something like the soldiers did in order to help them decide things, tell me what they do.
trans-unit.source: If the people who speak your language do something like the soldiers did in order to help them decide things, tell me what they do.
trans-unit.target: Kama watu wanaozungumza lugha yako wanafanya kitu kama kile ambacho wanajeshi walifanya ili kuwasaidia kuamua mambo, niambie wanafanya nini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Question:If the people who speak your language do something like the soldiers did in order to help them decide things, tell me what they do.

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~23#Note:If the people who speak your language do something like the soldiers did in order to help them decide things, tell me what they do.222640732
trans-unit.source: The translator should not use words that refer to actions that are illegal or that the Christian churches in the language area oppose. People in the Bible who believed in God sometimes used this same method to find out God's will for them (Luke 1:9; Act 1:26).
trans-unit.target: Mtafsiri haipaswi kutumia maneno ambayo yanahusu vitendo ambavyo ni kinyume cha sheria au ambavyo makanisa ya Kikristo katika eneo la lugha yanapinga. Watu katika Biblia ambao walimwamini Mungu wakati mwingine walitumia njia hii ile ile ili kujua mapenzi ya Mungu kwao (Luka 1:9; Matendo 1:26).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~23#Note:If the people who speak your language do something like the soldiers did in order to help them decide things, tell me what they do.

group.id: Q:MRK 15.25+What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~25#Question:What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?
trans-unit.source: What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitundikwa mtini saa ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~25#Question:What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~25#Answer:What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?592182363
trans-unit.source: It was the third hour of daylight (that is, about nine o'clock in the morning). (25)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa saa tatu ya mchana (yaani, karibu saa tisa za asubuhi). (25)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~25#Answer:What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~25#Note:What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?1425545356
trans-unit.source: It may be important to explain in a footnote or glossary item how the Jews determined the beginning of a day and how they counted time during a day.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ikawa muhimu kueleza katika kielezi-chini au katika kamusi jinsi Wayahudi walivyoamua mwanzo wa siku na jinsi walivyohesabu wakati wakati wa siku.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~25#Note:What time was it when they nailed Jesus to the cross?

trans-unit.source: The Jewish leaders had accused Jesus in front of Pilate saying that he (Jesus) claimed to be a king.
trans-unit.target: Viongozi Wayahudi walikuwa wamemshtaki Yesu mbele ya Pilato wakisema kwamba yeye (Yesu) alidai kuwa mfalme.

trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~25#Note:Why did someone write "King of the Jews" [on a board or paper] and put it above Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.27+Whom else did they crucify at the same time as Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~27#Question:Whom else did they crucify at the same time as Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Whom else did they crucify at the same time as Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani mwingine waliyemsulibisha wakati uleule ambao Yesu alikuwa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~27#Question:Whom else did they crucify at the same time as Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~27#Answer:Whom else did they crucify at the same time as Jesus?-240916261
trans-unit.source: They crucified two robbers at the same time. (27)
trans-unit.target: Wakamsulubisha pamoja na watu wawili wahalifu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~27#Answer:Whom else did they crucify at the same time as Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.29+What was the attitude of those who passed by?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~29#Question:What was the attitude of those who passed by?
trans-unit.source: What was the attitude of those who passed by?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliokuwa wakipita hapo walikuwa na mtazamo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Question:What was the attitude of those who passed by?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~29#Answer:What was the attitude of those who passed by?-233591514
trans-unit.source: They insulted and mocked Jesus. (29)
trans-unit.target: Walimtukana na kumdhihaki Yesu (29)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Answer:What was the attitude of those who passed by?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.29-30+Why do you think that those people shook their heads at him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~29#Question:Why do you think that those people shook their heads at him?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that those people shook their heads at him?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu hao walimwinamia?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Question:Why do you think that those people shook their heads at him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~29#Answer:Why do you think that those people shook their heads at him?1343311900
trans-unit.source: Shaking their heads was a cultural way to show that they were ridiculing him.
trans-unit.target: Kutikisa vichwa vyao kulikuwa njia ya kitamaduni ya kuonyesha kwamba walikuwa wakimdhihaki.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Answer:Why do you think that those people shook their heads at him?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.29-30+What did those people say was the reason that they ridiculed him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~29#Question:What did those people say was the reason that they ridiculed him?
trans-unit.source: What did those people say was the reason that they ridiculed him?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walisema ni kwa nini walimdhihaki?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Question:What did those people say was the reason that they ridiculed him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~29#Answer:What did those people say was the reason that they ridiculed him?1849748725
trans-unit.source: They said that since he was the one who said that he would destroy and rebuild the temple in three days, he should be able to get down off the cross and save his own life. (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba kwa kuwa yeye ndiye aliyesema kwamba angeibomoa na kuijenga upya hekalu katika siku tatu, yeye apaswa aweze kushuka kutoka msalabani na kuokoa uhai wake mwenyewe. (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Answer:What did those people say was the reason that they ridiculed him?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.29-30+Why do you think that Jesus did not use his power and come down from the cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~29#Question:Why do you think that Jesus did not use his power and come down from the cross?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that Jesus did not use his power and come down from the cross?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu hakutumia nguvu zake na kushuka kutoka msalabani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Question:Why do you think that Jesus did not use his power and come down from the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus did not use his power and come down from the cross?-1885396078
trans-unit.source: He did not come down from the cross because he knew that we all needed to have him take our place and die for our sin. By his suffering in our place, God then could receive us into the group of those who are his very own.
trans-unit.target: Yeye hakushuka kutoka msalabani kwa sababu alijua kwamba sisi sote tulihitaji kuwa naye kuchukua mahali petu na kufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu. Kwa kuteseka kwake badala yetu, Mungu angeweza kutukaribisha katika kundi la watu wake mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~29#Answer:Why do you think that Jesus did not use his power and come down from the cross?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.31-32+What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~31#Question:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi wanasema nini ili kumdhihaki Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~31#Question:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~31#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?1489328976
trans-unit.source: They said that he had saved other people, but he could not save himself. (31)
trans-unit.target: Walisema: "Aliwaokoa watu wengine, lakini hakuweza kujiokoa mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~31#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~31#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?508368919
trans-unit.source: They said that if he would come down from the cross, they would believe that he was the Christ, the king of the Jews. (32)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba kama angeshuka kutoka msalabani, wangeamini kwamba yeye ndiye Kristo, mfalme wa Wayahudi. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~31#Answer:What did the chief priests and teachers of the law say to mock Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!15~33#Section Heading
