group.id: Q:MRK 15.33-41+What happened to Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~33#Question:What happened to Jesus while he hung on the cross?
trans-unit.source: What happened to Jesus while he hung on the cross?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichompata Yesu alipokuwa akining'inia kwenye msalaba?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Question:What happened to Jesus while he hung on the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~33#Answer:What happened to Jesus while he hung on the cross?788363825
trans-unit.source: He cried out to God (34) and then he died (37).
trans-unit.target: Alimlilia Mungu (34) kisha akafa (37).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Answer:What happened to Jesus while he hung on the cross?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.33-41+What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~33#Question:What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?
trans-unit.source: What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?
trans-unit.target: Ni mambo gani yasiyo ya kawaida yaliyotukia Yesu alipokuwa akining'inia kwenye msalaba na kisha kufa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Question:What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~33#Answer:What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?612098879
trans-unit.source: It became dark everywhere for three hours in the middle of the day. (33)
trans-unit.target: Kulikuwa na giza katika nchi yote kwa muda wa saa tatu katikati ya mchana.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Answer:What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~33#Answer:What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?-1545506887
trans-unit.source: The curtain that hung in the temple tore from the top down. (38)
trans-unit.target: Pazia la hekalu likapasuka vipande viwili kuanzia juu hadi chini. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Answer:What unusual things happened while Jesus hung on the cross and then died?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.33+What happened at the sixth hour of daylight (that is, about midday)?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~33#Question:What happened at the sixth hour of daylight (that is, about midday)?
trans-unit.source: What happened at the sixth hour of daylight (that is, about midday)?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia saa sita za mchana (yaani, karibu adhuhuri)?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Question:What happened at the sixth hour of daylight (that is, about midday)?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~33#Answer:What happened at the sixth hour of daylight (that is, about midday)?-725010727
trans-unit.source: It became dark. (33)
trans-unit.target: Ikawa giza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Answer:What happened at the sixth hour of daylight (that is, about midday)?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.33+How long did it remain dark?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~33#Question:How long did it remain dark?
trans-unit.source: How long did it remain dark?
trans-unit.target: Giza liliendelea kwa muda gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Question:How long did it remain dark?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~33#Answer:How long did it remain dark?-559882110
trans-unit.source: It remained dark for about three hours. (33)
trans-unit.target: Giza liliendelea kwa muda wa saa tatu hivi. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~33#Answer:How long did it remain dark?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.34+How do we know that Jesus did not feel that God was near to him at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~34#Question:How do we know that Jesus did not feel that God was near to him at that time?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus did not feel that God was near to him at that time?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba Yesu hakuhisi kwamba Mungu alikuwa karibu naye wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~34#Question:How do we know that Jesus did not feel that God was near to him at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~34#Answer:How do we know that Jesus did not feel that God was near to him at that time?-1566078331
trans-unit.source: Jesus cried out (in a loud voice), asking God why he had left him all alone. (34)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilia (kwa sauti kubwa), akimwuliza Mungu kwa nini amemwacha peke yake. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~34#Answer:How do we know that Jesus did not feel that God was near to him at that time?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.34+What was it that Jesus cried out loudly?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~34#Question:What was it that Jesus cried out loudly?
trans-unit.source: What was it that Jesus cried out loudly?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipaaza sauti kubwa akisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~34#Question:What was it that Jesus cried out loudly?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~34#Answer:What was it that Jesus cried out loudly?1499817153
trans-unit.source: He cried out, "My God, My God, why have you left me all by myself?" (34)
trans-unit.target: Alilia, "Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha peke yangu?" (34)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~34#Answer:What was it that Jesus cried out loudly?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.35+What did some of the people nearby think that he was saying?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~35#Question:What did some of the people nearby think that he was saying?
trans-unit.source: What did some of the people nearby think that he was saying?
trans-unit.target: Watu fulani waliokuwa karibu walifikiri alikuwa akisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Question:What did some of the people nearby think that he was saying?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~35#Answer:What did some of the people nearby think that he was saying?-2062397763
trans-unit.source: They thought that he was calling out to [the prophet] Elijah. (35)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba alikuwa akimwita [nabii] Eliya. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Answer:What did some of the people nearby think that he was saying?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.35-36+Why do you think that they thought that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~35#Question:Why do you think that they thought that?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they thought that?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walifikiri hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Question:Why do you think that they thought that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~35#Answer:Why do you think that they thought that?-625593005
trans-unit.source: They thought that because the word "Eloi" (that is, "My God") sounds rather like "Elijah" in the Aramaic language which Jesus was speaking.
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba kwa sababu neno "Eloi" (yaani, "Mungu Wangu") linasikika kama "Eliya" katika lugha ya Kiaramu ambayo Yesu alikuwa akizungumza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Answer:Why do you think that they thought that?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.36+What did one man do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~36#Question:What did one man do then?
trans-unit.source: What did one man do then?
trans-unit.target: Mtu mmoja alifanya nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~36#Question:What did one man do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~36#Answer:What did one man do then?-136788257
trans-unit.source: One of them dipped a sponge in some ordinary wine, put it on a stick, and held it up to Jesus's mouth for him to drink. (36)
trans-unit.target: Mmoja wao akachukua sifongo akailowesha katika divai safi, akaiweka juu ya mwanzi, akamnywesha.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~36#Answer:What did one man do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.35-36+Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~35#Question:Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alikunywa kile ambacho mtu huyo alimpa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Question:Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~35#Answer:Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?-175665502
trans-unit.source: Yes
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Answer:Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~35#Note:Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?440884205
trans-unit.source: Mark does not tell us, but John wrote in his gospel that Jesus had asked for something to drink and then did drink from the sponge (John 19:28-30).
trans-unit.target: Marko hatusemi, lakini Yohana aliandika katika injili yake kwamba Yesu alikuwa ameomba kitu cha kunywa na kisha akanywa kutoka kwa sifongo (Yohana 19:28-30).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~35#Note:Do you think that Jesus drank what the man offered him?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.37+What did Jesus do at the moment when he died?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~37#Question:What did Jesus do at the moment when he died?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do at the moment when he died?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini wakati alipokufa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~37#Question:What did Jesus do at the moment when he died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~37#Answer:What did Jesus do at the moment when he died?218995979
trans-unit.source: He cried out loudly. (37)
trans-unit.target: Basi aliita kwa sauti kubwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~37#Answer:What did Jesus do at the moment when he died?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.37+How do we know that Jesus died and was not just unconscious?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~37#Question:How do we know that Jesus died and was not just unconscious?
trans-unit.source: How do we know that Jesus died and was not just unconscious?
trans-unit.target: Tunajuaje kwamba Yesu alikufa na hakuwa tu bila fahamu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~37#Question:How do we know that Jesus died and was not just unconscious?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~37#Answer:How do we know that Jesus died and was not just unconscious?-181351735
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that Jesus stopped breathing (that is, he died). (37)
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba Yesu aliacha kupumua (yaani, alikufa). (37)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~37#Answer:How do we know that Jesus died and was not just unconscious?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.38+What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~38#Question:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?
trans-unit.source: What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia hekaluni wakati Yesu alipokufa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~38#Question:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~38#Answer:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?-1466768216
trans-unit.source: The [heavy] curtain [which closed off the entrance to the holy place] in the temple was torn apart from the top to the bottom. (38)
trans-unit.target: Pazia [zito] [lililofunga mlango wa mahali patakatifu] katika hekalu likararuka vipande viwili kutoka juu hadi chini. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~38#Answer:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~38#Answer:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~38#Answer:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~38#Answer:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?2005840956
trans-unit.source: God caused the curtain in the temple to tare apart from the top to the bottom. (38)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alifanya pazia katika hekalu lipasuke vipande viwili toka juu mpaka chini. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~38#Answer:What happened in the temple at the time when Jesus died?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.37-39+Who do you think caused that curtain to tear from the top part down to the bottom of it?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~37#Question:Who do you think caused that curtain to tear from the top part down to the bottom of it?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think caused that curtain to tear from the top part down to the bottom of it?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani aliyetokeza mvunjiko huo wa pazia kutoka sehemu ya juu hadi chini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~37#Question:Who do you think caused that curtain to tear from the top part down to the bottom of it?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~37#Answer:Who do you think caused that curtain to tear from the top part down to the bottom of it?554239200
trans-unit.source: God caused it to tear like that; no person would be able to do that, especially from the top down.
trans-unit.target: Mungu aliirarua hivyo; hakuna mwanadamu ambaye angeweza kufanya hivyo, hasa ikiwa angeinuka kutoka juu hadi chini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~37#Answer:Who do you think caused that curtain to tear from the top part down to the bottom of it?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.39+Who was one of the people watching Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~39#Question:Who was one of the people watching Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Who was one of the people watching Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyekuwa mmoja wa watu waliomtazama Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Question:Who was one of the people watching Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~39#Answer:Who was one of the people watching Jesus?1012144776
trans-unit.source: A Roman centurion (that is, an officer over other soldiers) stood there opposite Jesus. (39)
trans-unit.target: Ofisa mmoja Mroma (yaani, ofisa-jeshi juu ya askari wengine) alikuwa amesimama hapo mbele ya Yesu. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Answer:Who was one of the people watching Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.39+What did he say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~39#Question:What did he say about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did he say about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Alisema nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Question:What did he say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~39#Answer:What did he say about Jesus?59044694
trans-unit.source: He said that Jesus was certainly the Son of God. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu hakika. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Answer:What did he say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~39#Answer:What did he say about Jesus?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Answer:What did he say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~39#Answer:What did he say about Jesus?1933750775
trans-unit.source: He said that Jesus was certainly a son of a god (that is, someone superior to any human). (39)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kwa hakika Yesu alikuwa mwana wa mungu (yaani, mtu aliye juu zaidi ya mwanadamu yeyote). (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Answer:What did he say about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.39+Why did that officer of the Roman soldiers say that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~39#Question:Why did that officer of the Roman soldiers say that?
trans-unit.source: Why did that officer of the Roman soldiers say that?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini ofisa huyo wa jeshi la Roma alisema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Question:Why did that officer of the Roman soldiers say that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~39#Answer:Why did that officer of the Roman soldiers say that?2051285493
trans-unit.source: He saw the darkness, heard what Jesus cried out, and he saw how he died. (39)
trans-unit.target: Aliona giza, akasikia kile ambacho Yesu alilia, na akaona jinsi alivyokufa. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~39#Answer:Why did that officer of the Roman soldiers say that?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.40-41+Who else was standing a little distance away and watching?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~40#Question:Who else was standing a little distance away and watching?
trans-unit.source: Who else was standing a little distance away and watching?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani mwingine aliyekuwa amesimama kwa mbali kidogo na kutazama?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~40#Question:Who else was standing a little distance away and watching?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~40#Answer:Who else was standing a little distance away and watching?-239363835
trans-unit.source: Some of the women who had followed Jesus were watching [what happened to him]. They included (a) Mary Magdalene, (b) Mary the mother of James and Joses, and (c) Salome (40), plus many others (41).
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya wanawake waliokuwa wamemfuata Yesu walikuwa wakitazama [lilimpata Yesu]. Walitia ndani (a) Maria Magdalene, (b) Maria mama ya Yakobo na Yosefu, na (c) Salome (40), na wengine wengi (41).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~40#Answer:Who else was standing a little distance away and watching?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.41+What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~41#Question:What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao walikuwa wamemfanyia nini Yesu walipokuwa wakisafiri pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~41#Question:What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~41#Answer:What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?-903105837
trans-unit.source: They had followed Jesus and looked after him. (41)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamemfuata Yesu na kumtunza. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~41#Answer:What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~41#Note:What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?1312175294
trans-unit.source: This implies cooking, providing food, etc. They would have been looking after his disciples too, although it does not specifically say so here.
trans-unit.target: Hii inamaanisha kupika, kutoa chakula, nk. Wangekuwa wakitunza wanafunzi wake pia, ingawa haisemi hivyo hasa hapa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~41#Note:What had these women been doing for Jesus as they traveled with him and his disciples?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!15~42#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 15:42-47 Joseph of Arimathea took the body of Jesus down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.
trans-unit.target: Marko 15:42-47 Yosefu wa Arimathea alichukua mwili wa Yesu kutoka kwenye msalaba na kuuweka katika kaburi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 15.42-47+What happened to the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~42#Question:What happened to the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mwili wa Yesu ulipatwa na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Question:What happened to the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~42#Answer:What happened to the body of Jesus?418239026
trans-unit.source: Joseph put it in a tomb (that is, in a burial cave). (46)
trans-unit.target: Yusufu akauweka katika kaburi (yaani, katika pango la kuzikia).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Answer:What happened to the body of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.42+What day was it when Jesus died?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~42#Question:What day was it when Jesus died?
trans-unit.source: What day was it when Jesus died?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikufa siku gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Question:What day was it when Jesus died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~42#Answer:What day was it when Jesus died?2119144254
trans-unit.source: It was the day for the Jews to get [food and other things] ready for the Sabbath day. (42)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa siku ambayo Wayahudi walitayarisha [chakula na vitu vingine] kwa ajili ya siku ya Sabato. (42)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Answer:What day was it when Jesus died?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.43+Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~43#Question:Who was Joseph?
trans-unit.source: Who was Joseph?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Question:Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~43#Answer:Who was Joseph?-2011473725
trans-unit.source: Joseph was a man from [the town of] Arimathea.
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alikuwa mtu wa Arimathea.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Answer:Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~43#Answer:Who was Joseph?192636721
trans-unit.source: He was an important member of the council [of Jewish leaders].
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mshiriki wa maana wa baraza [la viongozi Wayahudi].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Answer:Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~43#Answer:Who was Joseph?-1499883605
trans-unit.source: He was waiting for the time when God would rule his people. (43)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akingojea wakati ambapo Mungu angetawala watu wake. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Answer:Who was Joseph?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.42-43+Do you think that he was the Joseph who was the husband of Mary?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~42#Question:Do you think that he was the Joseph who was the husband of Mary?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that he was the Joseph who was the husband of Mary?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri kwamba alikuwa yule Yosefu aliyekuwa mume wa Maria?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Question:Do you think that he was the Joseph who was the husband of Mary?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~42#Answer:Do you think that he was the Joseph who was the husband of Mary?146565035
trans-unit.source: No, he was not. That was another person called Joseph.
trans-unit.target: Hapana, alikuwa mtu mwingine aliyeitwa Yosefu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Answer:Do you think that he was the Joseph who was the husband of Mary?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.43+What did this Joseph do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~43#Question:What did this Joseph do?
trans-unit.source: What did this Joseph do?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Question:What did this Joseph do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~43#Answer:What did this Joseph do?-1306777924
trans-unit.source: He went to Pilate and asked [Pilate to permit him] to take away Jesus's body. (43)
trans-unit.target: Akaenda kwa Pilato na kumwomba [Pilato amruhusu] kuchukua mwili wa Yesu. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Answer:What did this Joseph do?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.43+Do you think that he was afraid to go to Pilate to ask this?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~43#Question:Do you think that he was afraid to go to Pilate to ask this?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that he was afraid to go to Pilate to ask this?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri aliogopa kwenda kwa Pilato na kumwomba jambo hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Question:Do you think that he was afraid to go to Pilate to ask this?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~43#Answer:Do you think that he was afraid to go to Pilate to ask this?-1274525266
trans-unit.source: Perhaps, but he went boldly, without showing any fear. (43)
trans-unit.target: Labda, lakini alienda kwa ujasiri, bila kuonyesha hofu yoyote.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~43#Answer:Do you think that he was afraid to go to Pilate to ask this?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.42+What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~42#Question:What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?
trans-unit.source: What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?
trans-unit.target: Marko anafunua nini kuhusu kwa nini huenda Yosefu alikuwa na ujasiri?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Question:What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~42#Answer:What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?1579678175
trans-unit.source: Mark wrote that it was nearing the evening time (42).
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika kwamba ilikuwa karibu jioni (42).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Answer:What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?

trans-unit.id: n:!MRK!15~42#Note:What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?316983056
trans-unit.source: The Jewish people considered that the Sabbath day began when the sun had set on what we call Friday, so no Jewish person would be allowed to do anything to bury Jesus's body after about six o'clock. Darkness was not the main problem.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi waliamini kwamba siku ya Sabato ilianza jua lilipotua siku ambayo sisi huita Ijumaa, kwa hiyo hakuna Myahudi yeyote ambaye angeruhusiwa kufanya lolote ili kuuzika mwili wa Yesu baada ya saa sita hivi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~42#Note:What did Mark write that tells us why Joseph may have been so bold?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.44+What was it that surprised Pilate?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~44#Question:What was it that surprised Pilate?
trans-unit.source: What was it that surprised Pilate?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomshangaza Pilato?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~44#Question:What was it that surprised Pilate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~44#Answer:What was it that surprised Pilate?-1957617181
trans-unit.source: He was surprised to hear that Jesus had already died. (44)
trans-unit.target: Alishangaa kusikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa tayari amekufa. (44)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~44#Answer:What was it that surprised Pilate?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.45+How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~45#Question:How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?
trans-unit.source: How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alihakikishaje kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekufa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Question:How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~45#Answer:How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?-1994460662
trans-unit.source: He called the officer of the Roman soldiers [who had been at the cross],
trans-unit.target: Akamwita yule akida [wa askari Waroma waliokuwa msalabani],
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Answer:How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~45#Answer:How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?617243230
trans-unit.source: and asked him if it was true that Jesus had already died. (45)
trans-unit.target: na akamwuliza kama ni kweli kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekufa. (45)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Answer:How did Pilate check that Jesus really was dead?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.45+What did the officer reply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~45#Question:What did the officer reply?
trans-unit.source: What did the officer reply?
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo alijibuje?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Question:What did the officer reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~45#Answer:What did the officer reply?1944329189
trans-unit.source: The officer said that Jesus was dead. (45)
trans-unit.target: Ofisa huyo alisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekufa. (45)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Answer:What did the officer reply?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.45+What did Pilate do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~45#Question:What did Pilate do then?
trans-unit.source: What did Pilate do then?
trans-unit.target: Pilato alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Question:What did Pilate do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~45#Answer:What did Pilate do then?1645670499
trans-unit.source: He permitted Joseph to take Jesus's body. (45)
trans-unit.target: Alimruhusu Yusufu achukue mwili wa Yesu. (45)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~45#Answer:What did Pilate do then?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.46+What did Joseph do with the Jesus's body?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~46#Question:What did Joseph do with the Jesus's body?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do with the Jesus's body?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alifanya nini na mwili wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~46#Question:What did Joseph do with the Jesus's body?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~46#Answer:What did Joseph do with the Jesus's body?-588290183
trans-unit.source: He took it down from the cross, wrapped it in a linen cloth and put it in a tomb. (46)
trans-unit.target: Akaushusha kutoka msalabani, akauzungushia sanda, akauweka kaburini.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~46#Answer:What did Joseph do with the Jesus's body?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.46+What did Mark write about the tomb where Joseph laid the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~46#Question:What did Mark write about the tomb where Joseph laid the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Mark write about the tomb where Joseph laid the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika nini juu ya kaburi ambamo Yusufu aliweka mwili wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~46#Question:What did Mark write about the tomb where Joseph laid the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~46#Answer:What did Mark write about the tomb where Joseph laid the body of Jesus?-1720852288
trans-unit.source: He wrote that the tomb (that is, the burial cave) had been dug out of rock. (46)
trans-unit.target: Aliandika kwamba kaburi (yaani, pango la kuzikia) lilikuwa limechimbwa katika mwamba. (46)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~46#Answer:What did Mark write about the tomb where Joseph laid the body of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.46+How did Joseph close the opening to the tomb?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~46#Question:How did Joseph close the opening to the tomb?
trans-unit.source: How did Joseph close the opening to the tomb?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alifungaje mlango wa kaburi lake?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~46#Question:How did Joseph close the opening to the tomb?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~46#Answer:How did Joseph close the opening to the tomb?1084166705
trans-unit.source: [Others helped him] roll a large stone across the opening. (46)
trans-unit.target: [Wengine wakamsaidia] kuviringisha jiwe kubwa kwenye mlango. (46)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~46#Answer:How did Joseph close the opening to the tomb?

group.id: Q:MRK 15.47+Who saw the place where Joseph put the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!15~47#Question:Who saw the place where Joseph put the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Who saw the place where Joseph put the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyeona mahali ambapo Yosefu aliweka mwili wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~47#Question:Who saw the place where Joseph put the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!15~47#Answer:Who saw the place where Joseph put the body of Jesus?-1260868511
trans-unit.source: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw where his body was. (47)
trans-unit.target: Maria Magdalene na Maria mama yake Yosefu walipaona mahali alipolazwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!15~47#Answer:Who saw the place where Joseph put the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!MRK!16~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Mark 16:1-20 God raised Jesus back to life.
trans-unit.target: Marko 16:1-20 Mungu alimfufua Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MRK 16.1-20+Why were the women not able to find the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~1#Question:Why were the women not able to find the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Why were the women not able to find the body of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanawake hawakuweza kupata mwili wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Question:Why were the women not able to find the body of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:Why were the women not able to find the body of Jesus?-1701562998
trans-unit.source: They could not find his body because he [was alive again and] had risen and left the tomb. (6)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuweza kupata mwili wake kwa sababu alikuwa [hai tena na] alikuwa amefufuka na kutoka kaburini. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:Why were the women not able to find the body of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.1-20+To whom did Jesus show himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~1#Question:To whom did Jesus show himself?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus show himself?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijionyesha kwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Question:To whom did Jesus show himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:To whom did Jesus show himself?-1378784343
trans-unit.source: He showed himself to Mary Magdalene (9),
trans-unit.target: alimtokea Maria Magdalene,
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:To whom did Jesus show himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:To whom did Jesus show himself?-147023550
trans-unit.source: to two of his other followers (12),
trans-unit.target: kwa wawili kati ya wafuasi wake wengine (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:To whom did Jesus show himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:To whom did Jesus show himself?722379149
trans-unit.source: and to all eleven of his disciples (14).
trans-unit.target: na kwa wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja (14).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:To whom did Jesus show himself?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.1-20+What happened to Jesus after he told his disciples what they should then do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~1#Question:What happened to Jesus after he told his disciples what they should then do?
trans-unit.source: What happened to Jesus after he told his disciples what they should then do?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya Yesu kuwaambia wanafunzi wake jambo ambalo walipaswa kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Question:What happened to Jesus after he told his disciples what they should then do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:What happened to Jesus after he told his disciples what they should then do?224808349
trans-unit.source: [God] took him up to heaven (and he sat at the right hand side of God). (19)
trans-unit.target: [Mungu] alimchukua mbinguni (na akaketi kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Mungu).
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:What happened to Jesus after he told his disciples what they should then do?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.1+What did the women do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~1#Question:What did the women do?
trans-unit.source: What did the women do?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Question:What did the women do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:What did the women do?-699845452
trans-unit.source: They bought some spices/ointments to anoint (that is, rub on) the body of Jesus. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walinunua manukato/mafuta ya kutiwa mafuta (yaani, kuyapaka) mwili wa Yesu. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:What did the women do?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.1+When was it that the women bought those spices?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~1#Question:When was it that the women bought those spices?
trans-unit.source: When was it that the women bought those spices?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake hao walinunua manukato hayo wakati gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Question:When was it that the women bought those spices?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~1#Answer:When was it that the women bought those spices?-1235257972
trans-unit.source: They bought them after sunset, when the Sabbath day had ended. (1)
trans-unit.target: Waliwanunua baada ya jua kutua, siku ya Sabato ilipokwisha. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~1#Answer:When was it that the women bought those spices?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.2+What time was it when the women went to the tomb?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~2#Question:What time was it when the women went to the tomb?
trans-unit.source: What time was it when the women went to the tomb?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake walienda kwenye kaburi saa ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~2#Question:What time was it when the women went to the tomb?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~2#Answer:What time was it when the women went to the tomb?-165000807
trans-unit.source: It was very early in the morning on [the day after the Sabbath day,] the first day of the Jewish week [which in English we call, "Sunday."] (2)
trans-unit.target: Ilikuwa asubuhi na mapema sana siku ya kwanza ya juma la Kiyahudi [ambayo kwa Kiingereza tunaita, "Jumapili".] (2)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~2#Answer:What time was it when the women went to the tomb?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.3+What caused the women to be anxious?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~3#Question:What caused the women to be anxious?
trans-unit.source: What caused the women to be anxious?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowafanya wanawake hao wawe na wasiwasi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~3#Question:What caused the women to be anxious?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~3#Answer:What caused the women to be anxious?-670640071
trans-unit.source: They knew that they would not be strong enough to roll aside the very large stone that covered the opening of the tomb, so they wondered who would do it [for them]. (3)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba hawangekuwa na nguvu za kutosha kuondoa lile jiwe kubwa sana lililokuwa kwenye mlango wa kaburi, kwa hiyo walijiuliza ni nani ambaye angelikung'uta [kwa ajili yao]. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~3#Answer:What caused the women to be anxious?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.4+What did the women find when they reached the tomb?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~4#Question:What did the women find when they reached the tomb?
trans-unit.source: What did the women find when they reached the tomb?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake walipata nini walipofika kwenye kaburi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~4#Question:What did the women find when they reached the tomb?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~4#Answer:What did the women find when they reached the tomb?338737906
trans-unit.source: They found that [someone] already had rolled aside the (very large) stone. (4)
trans-unit.target: Walikuta jiwe limeviringishwa.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~4#Answer:What did the women find when they reached the tomb?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.5+What did they see when they went into the tomb?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~5#Question:What did they see when they went into the tomb?
trans-unit.source: What did they see when they went into the tomb?
trans-unit.target: Waliona nini walipoingia ndani ya kaburi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~5#Question:What did they see when they went into the tomb?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~5#Answer:What did they see when they went into the tomb?1872017724
trans-unit.source: They saw a young man dressed in white clothes, sitting on [their] right hand side. (5)
trans-unit.target: Waliona kijana mmoja aliyevaa vazi jeupe ameketi upande wa kuume wao. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~5#Answer:What did they see when they went into the tomb?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.6+What did they feel when they saw this person sitting there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~6#Question:What did they feel when they saw this person sitting there?
trans-unit.source: What did they feel when they saw this person sitting there?
trans-unit.target: Walihisije walipomwona mtu huyu akiwa ameketi hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Question:What did they feel when they saw this person sitting there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~6#Answer:What did they feel when they saw this person sitting there?-1375931330
trans-unit.source: They were frightened/alarmed. (6)
trans-unit.target: Waliogopa/kuogopa. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Answer:What did they feel when they saw this person sitting there?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.6-8+Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~6#Question:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini waliogopa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Question:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!16~6#Alternate:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?-205997858
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they were frightened?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kwa nini waliogopa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Alternate:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!16~6#Alternate:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?1707495540
trans-unit.source: Why do you think that they were alarmed?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini waliogopa?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Alternate:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~6#Answer:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?-945759994
trans-unit.source: They did not know who this man was, and he probably appeared unusual.
trans-unit.target: Hawakujua mtu huyo alikuwa nani, na yaelekea alionekana kuwa wa ajabu.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Answer:Why do you think that they were frightened/alarmed?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.6+What did the young man say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~6#Question:What did the young man say about Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the young man say about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kijana huyo alisema nini kumhusu Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Question:What did the young man say about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~6#Answer:What did the young man say about Jesus?-1572179073
trans-unit.source: He said that Jesus was not there because he had risen after being dead. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Yesu hakuwapo kwa sababu alikuwa amefufuliwa baada ya kufa. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~6#Answer:What did the young man say about Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.7+What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~7#Question:What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?
trans-unit.source: What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?
trans-unit.target: Kijana huyo alikuwa na ujumbe gani kutoka kwa Yesu kwa ajili yao?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~7#Question:What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~7#Answer:What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?-776107840
trans-unit.source: He told them that Jesus said that they were to go and tell Peter and the other disciples that he (Jesus) had gone ahead of them to Galilee [province].
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba Yesu alisema waende na kumwambia Petro na wanafunzi wengine kwamba yeye (Yesu) alikuwa amewatangulia kwenda Galilaya [mkoa].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~7#Answer:What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~7#Answer:What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?-1010734944
trans-unit.source: Jesus also had said that they would see him when they arrived there, just like he had told them before. (7)
trans-unit.target: Yesu pia alikuwa amesema kwamba wangemwona walipofika huko, kama vile tu alivyokuwa amewaambia hapo awali. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~7#Answer:What message from Jesus did the young man have for them?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.8+How did the women respond to those things happening at the tomb?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~8#Question:How did the women respond to those things happening at the tomb?
trans-unit.source: How did the women respond to those things happening at the tomb?
trans-unit.target: Wanawake waliitikiaje mambo hayo yaliyokuwa yakitendeka kwenye kaburi?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~8#Question:How did the women respond to those things happening at the tomb?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~8#Answer:How did the women respond to those things happening at the tomb?227365461
trans-unit.source: Because they were afraid and confused about all that was happening, they hurried away from the tomb. They also did not tell anyone [along the way] what they had seen and heard. (8)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu ya hofu na kuchanganyikiwa juu ya yote yaliyokuwa yametukia, waliondoka kaburini upesi; wala hawakumwambia mtu yeyote [ njiani] yale waliyoona na kusikia.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~8#Answer:How did the women respond to those things happening at the tomb?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.9+What day was it when Jesus rose from being dead?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~9#Question:What day was it when Jesus rose from being dead?
trans-unit.source: What day was it when Jesus rose from being dead?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifufuliwa siku gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~9#Question:What day was it when Jesus rose from being dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~9#Answer:What day was it when Jesus rose from being dead?295583257
trans-unit.source: He rose on the first day of the [Jewish] week, the day after the Sabbath day. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alifufuka siku ya kwanza ya juma [la Kiyahudi], siku iliyofuata siku ya Sabato. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~9#Answer:What day was it when Jesus rose from being dead?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.9+What had Jesus previously done for Mary Magdalene?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~9#Question:What had Jesus previously done for Mary Magdalene?
trans-unit.source: What had Jesus previously done for Mary Magdalene?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa amemfanyia nini Maria Magdalene hapo awali?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~9#Question:What had Jesus previously done for Mary Magdalene?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~9#Answer:What had Jesus previously done for Mary Magdalene?2007773915
trans-unit.source: He had cast out seven demons/evil spirits from her. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amefukuza roho waovu saba kutoka kwake. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~9#Answer:What had Jesus previously done for Mary Magdalene?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.10+What did Mary do after she had seen Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~10#Question:What did Mary do after she had seen Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Mary do after she had seen Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Maria alifanya nini baada ya kumwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~10#Question:What did Mary do after she had seen Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~10#Answer:What did Mary do after she had seen Jesus?-1500771223
trans-unit.source: She went and told [the news] to those who had been with him and [now] were mourning. (10)
trans-unit.target: Basi akaenda akawaambia walio kuwa naye, nao walikuwa wakiomboleza.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~10#Answer:What did Mary do after she had seen Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.11+What did Mary tell them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~11#Question:What did Mary tell them?
trans-unit.source: What did Mary tell them?
trans-unit.target: Maria aliwaambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~11#Question:What did Mary tell them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~11#Answer:What did Mary tell them?1788307825
trans-unit.source: She told them that Jesus was alive again and that she had seen him [herself]. (11)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba Yesu alikuwa hai tena na kwamba alikuwa amemwona [yeye mwenyewe]. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~11#Answer:What did Mary tell them?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.11+What did the disciples do when they heard what Mary said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~11#Question:What did the disciples do when they heard what Mary said?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples do when they heard what Mary said?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje waliposikia yale ambayo Mariamu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~11#Question:What did the disciples do when they heard what Mary said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~11#Answer:What did the disciples do when they heard what Mary said?-250400627
trans-unit.source: They did not believe her report. (11)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuamini ripoti yake. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~11#Answer:What did the disciples do when they heard what Mary said?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.12+To whom else did Jesus show himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~12#Question:To whom else did Jesus show himself?
trans-unit.source: To whom else did Jesus show himself?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijionyesha kwa nani wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~12#Question:To whom else did Jesus show himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~12#Answer:To whom else did Jesus show himself?1020117062
trans-unit.source: He showed himself to two of his other followers as they were walking out in the country. (12)
trans-unit.target: Aliwatokea wanafunzi wake wawili walipokuwa wakitembea mashambani. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~12#Answer:To whom else did Jesus show himself?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.12+What did Mark write about the way that Jesus looked when the two followers saw him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~12#Question:What did Mark write about the way that Jesus looked when the two followers saw him?
trans-unit.source: What did Mark write about the way that Jesus looked when the two followers saw him?
trans-unit.target: Marko aliandika nini kuhusu jinsi Yesu alivyoonekana wakati wanafunzi hao wawili walipomwona?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~12#Question:What did Mark write about the way that Jesus looked when the two followers saw him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~12#Answer:What did Mark write about the way that Jesus looked when the two followers saw him?863678996
trans-unit.source: He looked different somehow, but it does not say in what way he looked different. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alionekana tofauti kwa njia fulani, lakini haisemi kwa njia gani alionekana tofauti. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~12#Answer:What did Mark write about the way that Jesus looked when the two followers saw him?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.13+What did these two disciples do after they realized that they had seen Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~13#Question:What did these two disciples do after they realized that they had seen Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did these two disciples do after they realized that they had seen Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi hao wawili walifanya nini baada ya kutambua kwamba walikuwa wamemwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~13#Question:What did these two disciples do after they realized that they had seen Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~13#Answer:What did these two disciples do after they realized that they had seen Jesus?1872178377
trans-unit.source: They went back to Jerusalem and told the other disciples. (13)
trans-unit.target: Walirudi Yerusalemu na kuwaambia wanafunzi wengine. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~13#Answer:What did these two disciples do after they realized that they had seen Jesus?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.13+What did the other disciples do when they heard what these two said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~13#Question:What did the other disciples do when they heard what these two said?
trans-unit.source: What did the other disciples do when they heard what these two said?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wengine waliitikiaje waliposikia yale ambayo hao wawili walisema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~13#Question:What did the other disciples do when they heard what these two said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~13#Answer:What did the other disciples do when they heard what these two said?1033058711
trans-unit.source: They did not believe what they told them either. (13)
trans-unit.target: Wala hawakuamini waliyoambiwa. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~13#Answer:What did the other disciples do when they heard what these two said?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.14+To whom did Jesus then show himself?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~14#Question:To whom did Jesus then show himself?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus then show himself?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijionyesha kwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~14#Question:To whom did Jesus then show himself?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~14#Answer:To whom did Jesus then show himself?664364354
trans-unit.source: He showed himself to all of the eleven disciples (as they were eating). (14)
trans-unit.target: Aliwatokea wanafunzi wote kumi na mmoja (walipokuwa wakila). (14)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~14#Answer:To whom did Jesus then show himself?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.14+Why did he rebuke them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~14#Question:Why did he rebuke them?
trans-unit.source: Why did he rebuke them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aliwakemea?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~14#Question:Why did he rebuke them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~14#Answer:Why did he rebuke them?2034918849
trans-unit.source: He rebuked them because they had refused to believe the people who told them that they had seen him after he had risen [from being dead]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakemea kwa sababu walikataa kuamini watu waliowaambia kwamba walikuwa wamemwona baada ya yeye kufufuka [kutoka kwa wafu].
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~14#Answer:Why did he rebuke them?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.15+To whom did Jesus say that the disciples should tell the Good News?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~15#Question:To whom did Jesus say that the disciples should tell the Good News?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus say that the disciples should tell the Good News?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wanafunzi wanapaswa kuwahubiria nani Habari Njema?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~15#Question:To whom did Jesus say that the disciples should tell the Good News?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~15#Answer:To whom did Jesus say that the disciples should tell the Good News?239634610
trans-unit.source: He said that they should tell the Good News to all people everywhere in the world. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kuwahubiria watu wote kila mahali Habari Njema. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~15#Answer:To whom did Jesus say that the disciples should tell the Good News?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.15-18+What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~15#Question:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?
trans-unit.source: What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alisema walipaswa kutangaza ujumbe gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~15#Question:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!16~15#Alternate:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?-831185599
trans-unit.source: What message do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alisema walipaswa kutangaza ujumbe gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~15#Alternate:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?

trans-unit.id: l:!MRK!16~15#Alternate:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?294530801
trans-unit.source: What news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu aliwaambia wahubiri habari gani?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~15#Alternate:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~15#Answer:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?182957098
trans-unit.source: They should tell the message about how God's son, Jesus, has provided a way for God to forgive and receive people, even though they have sinned.
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kusema ujumbe juu ya jinsi mwana wa Mungu, Yesu, alivyoandaa njia kwa ajili ya Mungu kusamehe na kupokea watu, hata ingawa wametenda dhambi.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~15#Answer:What message/news do you think it was that Jesus said they should tell?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.16+What must people do in order that God will not condemn them to eternal punishment?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~16#Question:What must people do in order that God will not condemn them to eternal punishment?
trans-unit.source: What must people do in order that God will not condemn them to eternal punishment?
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima watu wafanye nini ili Mungu asiwahukumu adhabu ya milele?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~16#Question:What must people do in order that God will not condemn them to eternal punishment?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~16#Answer:What must people do in order that God will not condemn them to eternal punishment?-2036370307
trans-unit.source: They must believe [the gospel] and be baptized. (16)
trans-unit.target: Ni lazima waamini [injili] na kubatizwa. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~16#Answer:What must people do in order that God will not condemn them to eternal punishment?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.16+What will happen to people who do not believe the gospel?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~16#Question:What will happen to people who do not believe the gospel?
trans-unit.source: What will happen to people who do not believe the gospel?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kitakachowapata watu wasioiamini injili?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~16#Question:What will happen to people who do not believe the gospel?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~16#Answer:What will happen to people who do not believe the gospel?445861511
trans-unit.source: God will condemn them [to eternal punishment]. (16)
trans-unit.target: Mwenyezi Mungu atawalaani.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~16#Answer:What will happen to people who do not believe the gospel?

group.id: Q:MRK 16.17-18+What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MRK!16~17#Question:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Mungu angewawezesha wale wanaomwamini wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~17#Question:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~17#Answer:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?-1418685561
trans-unit.source: They would be able to send/cast out demons/evil spirits from people;
trans-unit.target: Wangekuwa na uwezo wa kutuma/kufukuza pepo/roho mbaya kutoka kwa watu;
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~17#Answer:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~17#Answer:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?1703469020
trans-unit.source: they would speak new languages [in the power of the Holy Spirit];
trans-unit.target: Wangesema lugha mpya [kwa nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu];
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~17#Answer:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~17#Answer:What did Jesus say that God would enable those who believed in him to do?-571782048
trans-unit.source: they would pick up snakes in their hands [without being harmed]; (17)
trans-unit.target: Wangechukua nyoka kwa mikono yao [bila kujeruhiwa] (17)

group.id: Q:MRK 16.19+What do you think it means when it says that Jesus sat down at the right hand side of God?

trans-unit.source: What do you think it means when it says that Jesus sat down at the right hand side of God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini inaposema kwamba Yesu aliketi kwenye mkono wa kuume wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~19#Question:What do you think it means when it says that Jesus sat down at the right hand side of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MRK!16~19#Answer:What do you think it means when it says that Jesus sat down at the right hand side of God?168117462
trans-unit.source: In Jewish custom the right hand side of important people was the most honored position anyone could ever have. His position there also shows his great authority along with God over the universe.
trans-unit.target: Katika desturi ya Kiyahudi upande wa kulia wa watu mashuhuri ulikuwa nafasi ya heshima zaidi ambayo mtu yeyote angeweza kuwa nayo.
trans-unit.note: !MRK!16~19#Answer:What do you think it means when it says that Jesus sat down at the right hand side of God?

group.id: Q:MAT 1.1+What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!1~1#Question:What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?
trans-unit.source: What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?
trans-unit.target: Mstari wa kwanza hutuambia nini juu ya jinsi Yesu Kristo alivyohusiana na Abrahamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Question:What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!1~1#Answer:What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?900138061
trans-unit.source: Jesus, counting through Joseph's ancestors, was a descendant/descendant of David; and David was a descendant of Abraham. (1)
trans-unit.target: Yesu, akihesabiwa kupitia mababu wa Yusufu, alikuwa mzao/mzao wa Daudi; na Daudi alikuwa mzao wa Abrahamu. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Answer:What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!1~1#Note:What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?-1917574593
trans-unit.source: With this question, the checker/consultant can find out whether the translation suggests that Jesus was the immediate son of David and that David was the immediate son of Abraham.
trans-unit.target: Kwa swali hili, mhakiki/mshauri anaweza kujua kama tafsiri inaonyesha kwamba Yesu alikuwa mwana wa Daudi wa moja kwa moja na kwamba Daudi alikuwa mwana wa Abrahamu wa moja kwa moja.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Note:What does verse one tell us about the way in which Jesus Christ was related to Abraham?

group.id: Q:MAT 1.1-17+What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!1~1#Question:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?
trans-unit.source: What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?
trans-unit.target: Maneno yanayounganisha mstari wa 17 na mistari inayotangulia yanamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Question:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!1~1#Alternate:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?-1214707064
trans-unit.source: What does the linking word that joins verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini maana ya neno linalounganisha mstari wa 17 na mistari inayotangulia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Alternate:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!1~1#Alternate:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?-1500728253
trans-unit.source: What do the linking words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?
trans-unit.target: Maneno yanayounganisha mstari wa 17 na mistari inayotangulia yanamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Alternate:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!1~1#Answer:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?-1801088264
trans-unit.source: The link back to the earlier verses should show that all the ancestors/generations, mentioned in this account, are fourteen in each section/case. That is, between Abraham and David, between David and the deportation to Babylon, and again between the deportation and the birth of the Christ/Messiah, there are fourteen generations listed.
trans-unit.target: Kiungo cha nyuma kwa mistari ya awali kinapaswa kuonyesha kwamba mababu / vizazi vyote, vilivyotajwa katika akaunti hii, ni kumi na nne katika kila sehemu / kesi. Hiyo ni, kati ya Ibrahimu na Daudi, kati ya Daudi na uhamisho wa Babeli, na tena kati ya uhamisho na kuzaliwa kwa Kristo / Masihi, kuna vizazi kumi na nne vilivyoorodheshwa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Answer:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!1~1#Note:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?295734025
trans-unit.source: Genealogies did not have to mention every generation/all of the actual generations to be a valid proof of a person's lineage; and this one does not show all of the generations in each set. Some had more than the fourteen listed here.
trans-unit.target: Uzazi haukuhitaji kutaja kila kizazi/vizazi vyote vya kweli kuwa uthibitisho halali wa ukoo wa mtu; na hii haionyeshi vizazi vyote katika kila seti.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~1#Note:What does the linking word or words that join verse 17 to the earlier verses mean?

group.id: Q:MAT 1.22-23+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!1~22#Question:Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Mungu ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~22#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!1~22#Answer:Who do you think God is?-1244809445
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He is the supreme being whom people should worship. In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being whom people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.target: Neno "mungu" linaloandikwa kwa herufi ndogo ya "g" kama vile "mungu" au "miungu mingi", linaweza kurejelea kiumbe yeyote wa kiroho ambaye watu wanamwabudu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~22#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!1~22#Note:Who do you think God is?-186246600
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralized. (Or, if it can be pluralized, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.target: Katika lugha nyingi neno la Mungu ni jina la kibinafsi na haliwezi kutumiwa kumrejelea mtu yeyote isipokuwa muumba mkuu wa ulimwengu. Haiwezi kuwa na wingi. (Au, ikiwa inaweza kuwa na wingi, maana inaweza kuwa kitu tofauti sana na "miungu" ya Kiingereza.) (Tazama "Mungu" katika KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!1~22#Note:Who do you think God is?

group.id: Q:MAT 2.1-2+What do you know about Jews?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!2~1#Question:What do you know about Jews?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about Jews?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu Wayahudi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~1#Question:What do you know about Jews?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!2~1#Answer:What do you know about Jews?1308740391
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A Jew was a member of the nation of Palestine from the 6th century B.C. to the first century A.D. The term "Jews" refers to the descendants of Abraham through his son Isaac. A Jew was a member of the people of Israel. He was committed to the Jewish religious system. All male Jews were circumcised on the 8th day after their birth, and this was a mark of being a Jew. (See "Jew" in KBT in the "Israel" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Myahudi alikuwa mshiriki wa taifa la Palestina kutoka karne ya 6 K.K. hadi karne ya kwanza B.K. Neno "Wayahudi" linarejelea wazao wa Ibrahimu kupitia mwanawe Isaka. Myahudi alikuwa mshiriki wa watu wa Israeli. Alikuwa amejitolea kwa mfumo wa kidini wa Kiyahudi. Waume wote wa Kiyahudi walitahiriwa siku ya 8 baada ya kuzaliwa kwao, na hii ilikuwa alama ya kuwa Myahudi. (Tazama "Myahudi" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "Israeli")
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~1#Answer:What do you know about Jews?

group.id: Q:MAT 2.3+What caused Herod to be worried?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!2~3#Answer:What caused Herod to be worried?-321689338
trans-unit.source: When Herod heard that the king of the Jews had been born, he was worried that this Jewish boy might cause the Jews to reject him, since he was a Roman king who was ruling over them. (3)
trans-unit.target: Herode aliposikia kwamba mfalme wa Wayahudi alikuwa amezaliwa, aliogopa kwamba huenda mtoto huyo Myahudi akafanya Wayahudi wamkatae, kwa kuwa alikuwa mfalme Mroma aliyekuwa akiwatawala. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~3#Answer:What caused Herod to be worried?

trans-unit.source: Rachel refers to Isaac's wife who is/was viewed as the ancestral mother of the nation of Israel.
trans-unit.target: Raheli amrejezea mke wa Isaka ambaye huonwa kuwa mama wa kale wa taifa la Israeli.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~16#Answer:How did killing the Bethlehem children like that fulfill what the prophet Jeremiah had said/written [in a kind of poetry which is quoted here] [in verse 18]?

trans-unit.source: The introduction to the Old Testament quote/quotation in the translation here may need to state that the prophet said/wrote this about a place in the Bethlehem area. The original readers would have known that Ramah and Bethlehem were (located in) the same area.
trans-unit.target: Utangulizi wa nukuu / nukuu ya Agano la Kale katika tafsiri hapa inaweza kuhitaji kusema kwamba nabii alisema / aliandika hii juu ya mahali katika eneo la Bethlehemu. Wasomaji wa asili wangejua kuwa Rama na Bethlehemu zilikuwa (ziko) katika eneo moja.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~16#Note:How did killing the Bethlehem children like that fulfill what the prophet Jeremiah had said/written [in a kind of poetry which is quoted here] [in verse 18]?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!2~16#Note:How did killing the Bethlehem children like that fulfill what the prophet Jeremiah had said/written [in a kind of poetry which is quoted here] [in verse 18]?887399932
trans-unit.source: Also note: Rachel, who died many, many years before this was written, was buried in that area. Since she (being Isaac's wife) was viewed as the mother of all Jewish people, she is described in this poetry as crying for the children. However, it is her Jewish descendants many generations later, who lived in that area, who actually wept. In the translation of this fulfillment it may be necessary to speak of the descendants of Rachel mourning and weeping for their children just as Rachel had mourned long ago. You will probably want to keep the Old Testament context of the quote/quotation in mind, too, as you work on this.
trans-unit.target: Pia kumbuka: Raheli, ambaye alikufa miaka mingi kabla ya hii kuandikwa, alizikwa katika eneo hilo. Kwa kuwa yeye (kuwa mke wa Isaka) alionekana kama mama wa watu wote wa Kiyahudi, yeye ni ilivyoelezwa katika shairi hili kama kulia kwa ajili ya watoto. Hata hivyo, ni wazao wake Wayahudi vizazi vingi baadaye, ambao waliishi katika eneo hilo, ambao kwa kweli walilia. Katika tafsiri ya utimilifu huu inaweza kuwa muhimu kusema wazao wa Raheli wakiomboleza na kulia kwa ajili ya watoto wao kama vile Raheli alikuwa ameomboleza muda mrefu uliopita. Labda utahitaji kuweka muktadha wa Agano la Kale wa nukuu / nukuu katika akili, pia, unapofanya kazi juu ya hii.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~16#Note:How did killing the Bethlehem children like that fulfill what the prophet Jeremiah had said/written [in a kind of poetry which is quoted here] [in verse 18]?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!2~23#Question:How did that move, which Joseph and Mary made, help fulfill what had been predicted about the Messiah?
trans-unit.source: How did that move, which Joseph and Mary made, help fulfill what had been predicted about the Messiah?
trans-unit.target: Kuhama kwa Yosefu na Maria kulitimiza jinsi gani unabii kumhusu Masihi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~23#Question:How did that move, which Joseph and Mary made, help fulfill what had been predicted about the Messiah?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!2~23#Answer:How did that move, which Joseph and Mary made, help fulfill what had been predicted about the Messiah?71744941
trans-unit.source: Since Jesus lived at Nazareth, people would tend to call him a "Nazarene". By doing that, they fulfilled what one of the prophets had foretold, saying/writing that the Messiah would be called a Nazarene. (23)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Yesu aliishi Nazareti, watu wangeelekea kumwita "Mnazareti". Kwa kufanya hivyo, walitimiza kile ambacho mmoja wa manabii alikuwa ametabiri, akisema/kuandika kwamba Masihi angeitwa Mnazareti. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!2~23#Answer:How did that move, which Joseph and Mary made, help fulfill what had been predicted about the Messiah?

group.id: Q:MAT 3.1-12+What sort of person do you think was the man John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~1#Question:What sort of person do you think was the man John the Baptist?
trans-unit.source: What sort of person do you think was the man John the Baptist?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yohana Mbatizaji alikuwa mtu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Question:What sort of person do you think was the man John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~1#Answer:What sort of person do you think was the man John the Baptist?-107407109
trans-unit.source: He was one who lived simply and he proclaimed God's message. (He was much like the Old Testament prophets.)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mtu aliyeishi maisha ya kawaida na alitangaza ujumbe wa Mungu. (Alikuwa kama manabii wa Agano la Kale.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Answer:What sort of person do you think was the man John the Baptist?

group.id: Q:MAT 3.1-12+What did John the Baptist do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~1#Question:What did John the Baptist do?
trans-unit.source: What did John the Baptist do?
trans-unit.target: Yohana Mbatizaji alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Question:What did John the Baptist do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~1#Answer:What did John the Baptist do?-934627076
trans-unit.source: He told the people that there was a much more important person among them, whom they should follow, namely Jesus. He told them all to repent and obey God, since the time when God would rule them was near. (1-12)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia watu kwamba kuna mtu muhimu zaidi miongoni mwao, ambaye wanapaswa kumfuata, yaani Yesu. Aliwaambia wote watubu na kumtii Mungu, kwa kuwa wakati ambapo Mungu atawaongoza ulikuwa karibu (1-12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Answer:What did John the Baptist do?

group.id: Q:MAT 3.1+What do you think Matthew meant when he wrote that John the Baptist "came" or "appeared"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~1#Question:What do you think Matthew meant when he wrote that John the Baptist "came" or "appeared"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Matthew meant when he wrote that John the Baptist "came" or "appeared"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Mathayo alimaanisha nini alipoandika kwamba Yohana Mbatizaji 'alikuja' au 'alionekana'?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Question:What do you think Matthew meant when he wrote that John the Baptist "came" or "appeared"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~1#Answer:What do you think Matthew meant when he wrote that John the Baptist "came" or "appeared"?-1153789065
trans-unit.source: He did not mean that John came to a certain place, but that he came into the public view, that is, he appeared on the scene, doing a public ministry. (1)
trans-unit.target: Hakumaanisha kwamba Yohana alikuja mahali fulani, bali kwamba alikuja mbele ya watu, yaani, alionekana mahali hapo, akifanya huduma ya peupe. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Answer:What do you think Matthew meant when he wrote that John the Baptist "came" or "appeared"?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Alternate:From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "came"/"appeared"?

trans-unit.source: From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "appeared"?
trans-unit.target: Kutokana na yale ambayo Mathayo aliandika, unafikiri 'alitokea' wakati gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Alternate:From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "came"/"appeared"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~1#Answer:From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "came"/"appeared"?257035961
trans-unit.source: The words of verse 1, "In those days", refers to the time while Jesus still lived at Nazareth. (1)
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya mstari wa 1, "Katika siku hizo", yanarejelea wakati ambapo Yesu alikuwa akiishi huko Nazareti. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Answer:From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "came"/"appeared"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!3~1#Note:From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "came"/"appeared"?1419740098
trans-unit.source: We know that these events mentioned here in this text occurred many years after Jesus started living at Nazareth. At that time Jesus and John would have both been about 30 years old.
trans-unit.target: Twajua kwamba matukio hayo yanayotajwa hapa katika andiko hili yalitukia miaka mingi baada ya Yesu kuanza kuishi katika Nazareti. Wakati huo Yesu na Yohana wote wawili wangekuwa na umri wa miaka 30 hivi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Note:From what Matthew wrote, when do you think he "came"/"appeared"?

trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Uchunguzi: Inamaanisha kwamba mtu anajuta dhambi zake na kutokuamini, anageuka kutoka kwao na kumfuata Mungu.

group.id: Q:MAT 3.1-3+What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~1#Question:What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?
trans-unit.source: What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yohana alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba ufalme wa mbinguni ulikuwa karibu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Question:What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~1#Answer:What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?-1051732164
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The English word kingdom is used here in its nearly obsolete meaning of kingship. It refers to the fact of God's ruling in people's lives rather than referring to the area of the earth over which he rules. The meaning here is that the King [that is, Jesus,] was near, that the time when God will rule over people (in a special way) was to occur soon.
trans-unit.target: Uhakiki wa Neno Muhimu: Neno la Kiingereza ufalme linatumiwa hapa katika maana yake ya zamani ya ufalme. Larejezea uhakika wa utawala wa Mungu katika maisha ya watu badala ya kurejezea eneo la dunia ambalo yeye hutawala. Maana hapa ni kwamba Mfalme [yaani, Yesu,] alikuwa karibu, kwamba wakati ambapo Mungu atatawala juu ya watu (kwa njia ya pekee) ulikuwa karibu kutokea.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Answer:What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!3~1#Note:What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?-676826690
trans-unit.source: See "kingdom of heaven" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "ufalme wa mbinguni" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~1#Note:What do you think John meant when he said that the kingdom of heaven was near?
