group.id: Q:MAT 3.5-6+How can we tell?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~5#Question:How can we tell?
trans-unit.source: How can we tell?
trans-unit.target: Tunaweza kujuaje?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~5#Question:How can we tell?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~5#Answer:How can we tell?23801067
trans-unit.source: Matthew wrote that people from the whole surrounding area went to hear/and heard John's teaching. They confessed their sins, and he baptized them. (5-6)
trans-unit.target: Mathayo aliandika kwamba watu kutoka eneo lote la karibu walienda kumsikiliza/na kumsikiliza Yohana akifundisha. Waliungama dhambi zao, naye akawabatiza. (5-6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~5#Answer:How can we tell?

group.id: Q:MAT 3.7-10+What do you think was the reason that John was not glad that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him to be baptized?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~7#Question:What do you think was the reason that John was not glad that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him to be baptized?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that John was not glad that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him to be baptized?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yohana hakufurahi kwamba Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walimjia ili abatizwe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~7#Question:What do you think was the reason that John was not glad that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him to be baptized?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that John was not glad that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him to be baptized?-1970735524
trans-unit.source: He was not glad because he knew that they did not come wanting/in pursuit of a right relationship with God. They were just acting as though they agreed with John's teaching about repenting and worshipping God so that others would think well of them. (7-10)
trans-unit.target: Hakufurahi kwa sababu alijua kwamba hawakuja kutaka/kufuatilia uhusiano sahihi na Mungu. Walikuwa tu wakifanya kana kwamba walikubaliana na mafundisho ya Yohana juu ya kutubu na kumwabudu Mungu ili wengine wawafikirie vizuri. (7-10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~7#Answer:What do you think was the reason that John was not glad that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to him to be baptized?

group.id: Q:MAT 3.7-10+What do you know about Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!3~7#Question:What do you know about Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~7#Question:What do you know about Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~7#Answer:What do you know about Pharisees?1694237653
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Pharisees were the largest and most important of the Jewish religious groups. They controlled the synagogues and exercised great control over the general population. They taught that the way to God was through obeying the law. They opposed Jesus because He refused to accept the teachings of their oral law.
trans-unit.target: Mtazamaji wa neno muhimu: Mafarisayo walikuwa kubwa na muhimu zaidi ya vikundi vya kidini vya Kiyahudi. Walidhibiti masinagogi na kutumia udhibiti mkubwa juu ya idadi ya watu kwa ujumla. Walifundisha kwamba njia ya Mungu ilikuwa kwa kutii sheria. Walimpinga Yesu kwa sababu alikataa kukubali mafundisho ya sheria yao ya mdomo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~7#Answer:What do you know about Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!3~7#Note:What do you know about Pharisees?1608715828
trans-unit.source: See "Pharisee" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Mfarisayo" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~7#Note:What do you know about Pharisees?

trans-unit.source: John was showing that God wanted people who will truly serve him. He will treat those who will not serve him as/in the same manner that men do their fruit trees that do not produce good fruit. They cut them down and burn them. (Context of 7-10 and broader NT context.)

trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~7#Answer:What do you think is the reason that John talked about cutting down trees that did not bear good fruit?

group.id: Q:MAT 3.11-12+When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)1457871115
trans-unit.source: There are different possible interpretations of what John meant.
trans-unit.target: Kuna fasiri mbalimbali zinazowezekana za alilomaanisha Yohana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)215321092
trans-unit.source: In the Bible:
trans-unit.target: Katika Biblia:
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)586422295
trans-unit.source: 1) Fire is used figuratively to indicate purification, since fire is sometimes used to burn up less costly and less permanent elements, while leaving the valuable elements unharmed. This purification figure is commonly applied/used to apply to Christians in the New Testament.
trans-unit.target: 1) Moto hutumiwa kwa njia ya mfano kuonyesha utakaso, kwani moto wakati mwingine hutumiwa kuteketeza vitu vya gharama nafuu na visivyo vya kudumu, huku ukiacha vitu vyenye thamani bila kuharibiwa. Mfano huu wa utakaso hutumiwa kwa kawaida / kutumika kwa Wakristo katika Agano Jipya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)964361634
trans-unit.source: 2) Fire is used to indicate punishment/judgment from God by association with the pain of burning. Such punishment/judgment would usually apply to non-believers in the New Testament.
trans-unit.target: 2) Moto hutumiwa kuashiria adhabu/hukumu kutoka kwa Mungu kwa kuhusishwa na maumivu ya kuchoma. adhabu/hukumu kama hiyo kwa kawaida ingewahusu wasioamini katika Agano Jipya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~11#Answer:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!3~11#Note:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)-1786955027
trans-unit.source: From John's concern that, at least some of them, might depend on their status of being descendants of Abraham and miss God's blessing, he could be referring to some of them as being baptized with the Holy Spirit and others being baptized with fire. This would then make fire here mean about the same as in verses 10 and 12, where it means judgment/punishment.
trans-unit.target: Kutokana na wasiwasi wa Yohana kwamba, angalau baadhi yao, wangeweza kutegemea hadhi yao ya kuwa wazao wa Ibrahimu na kukosa baraka za Mungu, angeweza kuwa anawarejelea baadhi yao kama kubatizwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu na wengine kubatizwa kwa moto. Hii ingefanya moto hapa kumaanisha sawa na katika aya ya 10 na 12, ambapo inamaanisha hukumu / adhabu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!3~11#Note:When John said that Jesus would "baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire", what do you think he meant by "fire"? (This is a check for any obviously wrong meaning.)

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means that the Devil tries to make the person obey him or to do something to disobey higher authorities, such as parents, the government, or God.

group.id: Q:MAT 4.1-11+What do you know about the Devil?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!4~1#Question:What do you know about the Devil?

trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kumhusu Ibilisi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~1#Question:What do you know about the Devil?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!4~1#Answer:What do you know about the Devil?1903611659
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The term/word "Devil" is the Greek equivalent of the Hebrew word "Satan." Satan is the chief enemy of God. He is the supreme evil spiritual being, who leads and directs all other evil spiritual beings. (See "Devil" in KBT in the "Satan" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Neno/neno "Ibilisi" ni sawa na neno la Kiyunani la neno la Kiebrania "Shetani". Shetani ni adui mkuu wa Mungu. Yeye ni kiumbe wa kiroho wa juu kabisa, ambaye anaongoza na kuelekeza viumbe vingine vyote vya kiroho vya uovu. (Tazama "Ibilisi" katika KBT katika kuingia kwa "Shetani".)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~1#Answer:What do you know about the Devil?

group.id: Q:MAT 4.14-16+How did that move fulfill what had been predicted by the prophet Isaiah in the Old Testament?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!4~14#Question:How did that move fulfill what had been predicted by the prophet Isaiah in the Old Testament?
trans-unit.source: How did that move fulfill what had been predicted by the prophet Isaiah in the Old Testament?
trans-unit.target: Hatua hiyo ilitimizaje yale yaliyotabiriwa na nabii Isaya katika Agano la Kale?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~14#Question:How did that move fulfill what had been predicted by the prophet Isaiah in the Old Testament?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!4~14#Answer:How did that move fulfill what had been predicted by the prophet Isaiah in the Old Testament?1214859263
trans-unit.source: After he moved/After he made that move, Jesus was in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali near the Sea of Galilee, where many non-Jewish people lived. Isaiah had predicted in the Old Testament that the Gentiles (non-Jewish people) would hear about a great light (salvation), after having been in [spiritual] darkness [without a relationship to God]. This move by Jesus caused those Gentiles near those places/there to hear about/have the light of Jesus teaching to guide them to become right with God. (14-16)
trans-unit.target: Baada ya yeye kuhamia/Baada ya yeye kufanya hatua hiyo, Yesu alikuwa katika eneo la Zabuloni na Naftali karibu na Bahari ya Galilaya, ambapo watu wengi wasio Wayahudi aliishi. Isaya alikuwa ametabiri katika Agano la Kale kwamba Mataifa (watu wasio Wayahudi) watasikia kuhusu mwanga mkubwa (wokovu), baada ya kuwa katika [kiroho] giza [bila uhusiano na Mungu]. hatua hii na Yesu kusababisha wale Mataifa karibu na maeneo hayo/huko kusikia kuhusu/kuwa na mwanga wa mafundisho ya Yesu kuwaongoza kuwa haki na Mungu. (14-16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~14#Answer:How did that move fulfill what had been predicted by the prophet Isaiah in the Old Testament?

group.id: Q:MAT 4.17+What reason did Jesus give that people should repent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!4~17#Question:What reason did Jesus give that people should repent?
trans-unit.source: What reason did Jesus give that people should repent?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa sababu gani ya watu kutubu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~17#Question:What reason did Jesus give that people should repent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!4~17#Answer:What reason did Jesus give that people should repent?-574346761
trans-unit.source: He said that people should repent because the kingdom of heaven (the time of God's ruling on earth in a special way) was to occur now. (17)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu wanapaswa kutubu kwa sababu ufalme wa mbinguni (wakati wa utawala wa Mungu duniani kwa njia ya pekee) ulikuwa utakuja sasa. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~17#Answer:What reason did Jesus give that people should repent?

group.id: Q:MAT 4.17+When people hear or read this scripture passage, what do you think they will understand about what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!4~17#Question:When people hear or read this scripture passage, what do you think they will understand about what Jesus said?
trans-unit.source: When people hear or read this scripture passage, what do you think they will understand about what Jesus said?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaposikia au kusoma andiko hilo, unafikiri wataelewa nini kuhusu yale ambayo Yesu alisema?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~17#Question:When people hear or read this scripture passage, what do you think they will understand about what Jesus said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!4~17#Answer:When people hear or read this scripture passage, what do you think they will understand about what Jesus said?1864402028
trans-unit.source: The king whom God sent [that is, Christ,] had arrived and it was time for them/people to repent and submit to his authority. (17)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme ambaye Mungu alimtuma [yaani, Kristo] alikuwa amekuja na wakati ulikuwa umefika kwa watu kutubu na kujisalimisha kwa mamlaka yake. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~17#Answer:When people hear or read this scripture passage, what do you think they will understand about what Jesus said?

group.id: Q:MAT 4.23+What do you think someone is doing when he preaches?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!4~23#Answer:What do you think someone is doing when he preaches?1151851797
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: When someone preaches, he is proclaiming the gospel to those who are listening. This also means that the one who preaches/a person urges others to accept or abandon an idea or course of action.
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Mtu anapohubiri, anawatangazia wale wanaosikiliza injili. Hii pia inamaanisha kwamba yule anayehubiri / mtu anawaomba wengine kukubali au kuacha wazo au mwendo wa vitendo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~23#Answer:What do you think someone is doing when he preaches?

group.id: Q:MAT 4.24-25+What happened then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!4~24#Question:What happened then?
trans-unit.source: What happened then?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~24#Question:What happened then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!4~24#Answer:What happened then?-1149210321
trans-unit.source: People from all over Syria heard of Jesus and began bringing their sick and demon possessed people to him and he healed them. So people heard about him and large crowds from several of the surrounding areas followed him. (24-25)
trans-unit.target: Watu kutoka Siria yote walisikia habari za Yesu, wakaanza kumletea wagonjwa wao na wale waliokuwa na roho waovu, naye akawaponya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~24#Answer:What happened then?

group.id: Q:MAT 4.24+What do you think it means for someone to have a demon/be demon possessed?

trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for someone to have a demon?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!4~24#Alternate:What do you think it means for someone to have a demon/be demon possessed?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!4~24#Alternate:What do you think it means for someone to have a demon/be demon possessed?-358521955
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for someone to be demon possessed?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means that the person is troubled or controlled by the demon, i.e. the demon is exercising its evil power over him. (See "demon" in KBT in the "evil spirit, unclean spirit" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Angalia neno muhimu: Inamaanisha kwamba mtu anafadhaishwa au kudhibitiwa na pepo, yaani pepo anafanya nguvu zake mbaya juu yake. (Ona "pepo" katika KBT katika "roho mbaya, roho mbaya" kuingia.)

group.id: Q:MAT 5.1-12+What do you think a disciple is?

trans-unit.source: What do you think a disciple is?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~1#Question:What do you think a disciple is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~1#Answer:What do you think a disciple is?-1308643174
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The word "disciple" means one who has attached himself to a given teacher, i.e., a "learner." A disciple is a person who receives instruction from another person. A disciple is a person who accepts the ideas/teachings of another person and assists in spreading or implementing them.
trans-unit.target: Mfuasi ni mtu anayepokea mafundisho kutoka kwa mtu mwingine. Mfuasi ni mtu anayepokea mawazo/mafundisho ya mtu mwingine na kusaidia katika kuyaeneza au kuyafanya yatimie.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~1#Answer:What do you think a disciple is?

trans-unit.source: See "disciple" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mwanafunzi" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~1#Note:What do you think a disciple is?

trans-unit.source: Who do you think would cause the different types of people, of whom Jesus speaks, to be "blessed" in the various ways that he said they would be blessed?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani ambaye angewafanya watu wa aina mbalimbali ambao Yesu anazungumza kuwahusu 'wabarikiwe' katika njia mbalimbali ambazo alisema wangebarikiwa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~3#Question:Who do you think would cause the different types of people, of whom Jesus speaks, to be "blessed" in the various ways that he said they would be blessed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~3#Answer:Who do you think would cause the different types of people, of whom Jesus speaks, to be "blessed" in the various ways that he said they would be blessed?-1858888006
trans-unit.source: God would bless them. // God blesses them. // God does the blessing. (1)
trans-unit.target: Mungu angewabariki. // Mungu awabariki. // Mungu hufanya baraka. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~3#Answer:Who do you think would cause the different types of people, of whom Jesus speaks, to be "blessed" in the various ways that he said they would be blessed?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~3#Note:Who do you think would cause the different types of people, of whom Jesus speaks, to be "blessed" in the various ways that he said they would be blessed?653517974
trans-unit.source: Jesus was speaking to Jewish people so he did not need to mention who would do the blessing. It may need to be made clear in some translations.

trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~3#Note:Who do you think would cause the different types of people, of whom Jesus speaks, to be "blessed" in the various ways that he said they would be blessed?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.3-12+What do you think Jesus wanted his hearers to do in order that they could receive that kind of blessing from God?

trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus wanted his hearers to do in order that they could receive that kind of blessing from God?

trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to be "poor in spirit"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri "maskini wa roho" ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~3#Question:What do you think it means to be "poor in spirit"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~3#Answer:What do you think it means to be "poor in spirit"?1390909368
trans-unit.source: This refers to one who knows that he needs/those who know that they need help. (That is, they needed God's help to have a good relationship with him.) (3)
trans-unit.target: Hii inahusu mtu anayejua kwamba anahitaji/wale wanaojua kwamba wanahitaji msaada. (Yaani, walihitaji msaada wa Mungu kuwa na uhusiano mzuri pamoja naye.) (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~3#Answer:What do you think it means to be "poor in spirit"?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.4+About what sort of "mourning" do you think Jesus was talking when he said, "Blessed are those who mourn"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~4#Question:About what sort of "mourning" do you think Jesus was talking when he said, "Blessed are those who mourn"?
trans-unit.source: About what sort of "mourning" do you think Jesus was talking when he said, "Blessed are those who mourn"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia "kuomboleza" kwa aina gani aliposema, "Wenye furaha ni wale wanaoomboleza"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~4#Question:About what sort of "mourning" do you think Jesus was talking when he said, "Blessed are those who mourn"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~4#Answer:About what sort of "mourning" do you think Jesus was talking when he said, "Blessed are those who mourn"?10370846
trans-unit.source: Any grief could be in focus. Especially fitting would be grief from knowing how much they needed God's help to be free from their sins. (4)
trans-unit.target: Hasa inafaa kuwa huzuni kutokana na kujua jinsi walivyohitaji msaada wa Mungu ili wawe huru kutoka kwa dhambi zao. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~4#Answer:About what sort of "mourning" do you think Jesus was talking when he said, "Blessed are those who mourn"?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.5+What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~5#Question:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?
trans-unit.source: What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu wa aina gani hao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~5#Question:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!5~5#Alternate:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?-1160212406
trans-unit.source: What sort of people are those who are meek people?
trans-unit.target: Watu wenye hali pole ni watu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~5#Alternate:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!5~5#Alternate:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?1333030745
trans-unit.source: What sort of people are these meek people?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao wapole ni watu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~5#Alternate:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~5#Answer:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?2073960342
trans-unit.source: Meek people/They are mild mannered. They do not go about demanding all their rights. (5)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanyenyekevu/Wana tabia pole. Hawatembei wakidai haki zao zote. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~5#Answer:What sort of people are those who are/these meek people?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.6+What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of people hungering and thirsting for righteousness?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~6#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of people hungering and thirsting for righteousness?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of people hungering and thirsting for righteousness?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba watu wana njaa na kiu ya uadilifu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~6#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of people hungering and thirsting for righteousness?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~6#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of people hungering and thirsting for righteousness?1401792501
trans-unit.source: He was speaking about/talking about/of people who feel a real need to be right with God, much like people who feel the need/feeling a real need to have food to eat and water to drink. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza/akizungumza kuhusu/watu ambao wanahisi hitaji la kweli kuwa sawa na Mungu, sawa na watu ambao wanahisi hitaji/hisia ya hitaji la kweli kuwa na chakula cha kula na maji ya kunywa. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~6#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of people hungering and thirsting for righteousness?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.6+What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~6#Question:What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu anapaswa kuwa mwadilifu kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~6#Question:What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~6#Answer:What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?-1735360453
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: If someone is righteous it means that he or she has been cleansed from his or her sin and they have a/are in a right relationship with God. (See "righteous" in KBT in the "just, justify" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: Kama mtu ni haki ina maana kwamba yeye au yeye imekuwa kusafishwa kutoka dhambi yake na wao kuwa na / ni katika uhusiano wa haki na Mungu. (Ona "haki" katika KBT katika "tu, kuhalalisha" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~6#Answer:What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.8+What kind of people will see God according to verse 8?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~8#Question:What kind of people will see God according to verse 8?
trans-unit.source: What kind of people will see God according to verse 8?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu wa aina gani watakaomwona Mungu kulingana na mstari wa 8?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~8#Question:What kind of people will see God according to verse 8?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~8#Answer:What kind of people will see God according to verse 8?-715562959
trans-unit.source: Those who have the same desires which God has will see God. (8)
trans-unit.target: Wale walio na matamanio yale yale ambayo Mungu anavyo watamwona Mungu. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~8#Answer:What kind of people will see God according to verse 8?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.9+What do peacemakers do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~9#Question:What do peacemakers do?
trans-unit.source: What do peacemakers do?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaofanya amani hufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~9#Question:What do peacemakers do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~9#Answer:What do peacemakers do?-1183406449
trans-unit.source: Peacemakers help/cause people to be reconciled. Here it probably refers to causing people to be reconciled with God. (9)
trans-unit.target: Wafanya amani husaidia/husababisha watu kupatanishwa. Hapa inawezekana inahusu kusababisha watu kupatanishwa na Mungu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~9#Answer:What do peacemakers do?

trans-unit.source: In verses 11 and 12 Jesus said that it is a good sign if people insult you and do evil/bad to you because you obey him. What does that good sign show?

trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 11 na 12, Yesu alisema kwamba ni ishara nzuri watu wakikutukana na kukufanyia mambo mabaya kwa sababu unamtii.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~11#Alternate:In verses 11 and 12 Jesus said that it is a good sign if people insult you and do evil/bad to you because you obey him. What does that good sign show?

trans-unit.source: It shows that you must be obeying the Lord, just as people mistreated the prophets long ago when the prophets obeyed the Lord. (11-12)
trans-unit.target: Inaonyesha kwamba lazima umtii Bwana, kama vile watu walivyodhulumu manabii zamani wakati manabii walimtii Bwana (11-12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~11#Answer:In verses 11 and 12 Jesus said that it is a good sign if people insult you and do evil/bad to you because you obey him. What does that good sign show?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!5~13#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 5:13-16 Believers in Jesus are like salt and are like light.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 5:13-16 Waamini katika Yesu ni kama chumvi na ni kama nuru.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 5.13-16+What did Jesus tell his followers in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~13#Question:What did Jesus tell his followers in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his followers in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wafuasi wake katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Question:What did Jesus tell his followers in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~13#Answer:What did Jesus tell his followers in these verses?-1895158605
trans-unit.source: He told them that they were the salt of the earth and the light of the world. (13-14)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wao ni chumvi ya dunia na nuru ya ulimwengu (13-14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Answer:What did Jesus tell his followers in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.13+What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~13#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba wafuasi wake ni "chumvi ya dunia"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~13#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?-591579852
trans-unit.source: He may have been saying that his followers help to keep individuals or society from being destroyed, like salt helps to keep food from spoiling.
trans-unit.target: Huenda alikuwa akisema kwamba wafuasi wake wanasaidia kuzuia watu au jamii isiangamizwe, kama vile chumvi inavyozuia chakula kisiharibike.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~13#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~13#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?194194099
trans-unit.source: He may have been saying that his followers add a pleasant quality to the people of earth, like salt adds pleasantness to the taste of food. (13)
trans-unit.target: Huenda alikuwa akisema kwamba wafuasi wake wanaongeza sifa nzuri kwa watu wa dunia, kama vile chumvi inavyoongeza ladha ya chakula. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~13#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?-1951482304
trans-unit.source: It is difficult to understand exactly what Jesus meant by salt in this verse. This question is here to check for any obviously wrong meaning from the translation of his statement (after it is translated).
trans-unit.target: Ni vigumu kuelewa hasa Yesu alimaanisha nini kwa chumvi katika mstari huu. Swali hili ni hapa kuangalia kwa maana yoyote dhahiri makosa kutoka tafsiri ya taarifa yake (baada ya kutafsiriwa).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~13#Note:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the salt of the earth"?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.14+What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the light of the world"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~14#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the light of the world"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the light of the world"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba wafuasi wake walikuwa "nuru ya ulimwengu"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~14#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the light of the world"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~14#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the light of the world"?2097846728
trans-unit.source: He meant that they were the ones who could show others the way [to a good relationship with God]. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba wao ndio wangeweza kuwaonyesha wengine njia [ya kuwa na uhusiano mzuri pamoja na Mungu]. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~14#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that his followers were "the light of the world"?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.15-16+What is the reason that Jesus talked about putting a light under a container?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~15#Question:What is the reason that Jesus talked about putting a light under a container?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus talked about putting a light under a container?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alizungumza kuhusu kuweka taa chini ya kikapu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~15#Question:What is the reason that Jesus talked about putting a light under a container?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~15#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus talked about putting a light under a container?-600433833
trans-unit.source: Jesus wanted those who have experienced God's mercy to tell others about their experience of receiving God's mercy/how to experience his mercy. (15-16)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka wale ambao wamepata huruma ya Mungu kuwaambia wengine kuhusu uzoefu wao wa kupokea huruma ya Mungu / jinsi ya kupata huruma yake. (15-16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~15#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus talked about putting a light under a container?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!5~17#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 5:17-20 Jesus explained that he came to this world in order to fulfill the laws that God gave Moses for the people of Israel.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 5:17-20 Yesu alieleza kwamba alikuja ulimwenguni ili kutimiza sheria ambazo Mungu alimpa Musa kwa ajili ya watu wa Israeli.

group.id: Q:MAT 5.17-20+What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~17#Question:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?
trans-unit.source: What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa sababu gani ya kuja/kusema kwamba alikuwa amekuja ulimwenguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~17#Question:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!5~17#Alternate:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?149045967

trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema alikuja ulimwenguni kwa sababu gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~17#Alternate:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!5~17#Alternate:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?-1877016223

trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba alikuja ulimwenguni kwa kusudi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~17#Alternate:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~17#Answer:What reason did Jesus give for his coming to/say that he had come to this world?-1953575129
trans-unit.source: He said that he had come to this world to fulfill what was taught in the Mosaic law and what was taught by the prophets in the Old Testament. (17)

group.id: Q:MAT 5.17-20+What do you think Jesus meant when he said that he had come to this world?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~17#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that he had come to this world?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said that he had come to this world?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba alikuwa amekuja ulimwenguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~17#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that he had come to this world?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~17#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that he had come to this world?1062979034

group.id: Q:MAT 5.17-18+What did Jesus mean when he said that he had come to fulfill "the law and the prophets"?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.25-26+In verse 25, Jesus did not say to whom he was referring when he spoke of their opponent. Whom do you think he meant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~25#Question:In verse 25, Jesus did not say to whom he was referring when he spoke of their opponent. Whom do you think he meant?
trans-unit.source: In verse 25, Jesus did not say to whom he was referring when he spoke of their opponent. Whom do you think he meant?
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 25, Yesu hakusema alikuwa akizungumzia nani aliposema kuhusu mpinzani wao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~25#Question:In verse 25, Jesus did not say to whom he was referring when he spoke of their opponent. Whom do you think he meant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~25#Answer:In verse 25, Jesus did not say to whom he was referring when he spoke of their opponent. Whom do you think he meant?-1502691324
trans-unit.source: Here their opponent could be anyone who had something against them and might/could take them to court. Here the opponent is pictured as the local (Jewish Sanhedrin) court. (25-26)
trans-unit.target: Hapa mpinzani wao anaweza kuwa mtu yeyote ambaye ana kitu dhidi yao na anaweza/anaweza kuwapeleka mahakamani. Hapa mpinzani anaonyeshwa kama mahakama ya eneo hilo (Sanhedrini ya Kiyahudi). (25-26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~25#Answer:In verse 25, Jesus did not say to whom he was referring when he spoke of their opponent. Whom do you think he meant?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.25-26+Who else could this opponent be?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~25#Question:Who else could this opponent be?
trans-unit.source: Who else could this opponent be?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani mwingine ambaye angekuwa mpinzani huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~25#Question:Who else could this opponent be?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~25#Note:Who else could this opponent be?-863792276
trans-unit.source: This opponent could be God himself.
trans-unit.target: Mpinzani huyo anaweza kuwa Mungu mwenyewe.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~25#Note:Who else could this opponent be?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~25#Note:Who else could this opponent be?1211127305
trans-unit.source: Jesus was teaching about our relationship with God, so he was not suddenly switching to speaking of/talking about avoiding people in the local court here at the end of this section. Rather, he is using figurative language to make a strong rhetorical point. He is saying, "Do not be in a wrong relationship with God, lest you find yourself in court with him and not be able to satisfy the penalty for your wrong doing." Emphasizing the inability to pay the penalty may help to make this point clearer in the translation.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akifundisha kuhusu uhusiano wetu na Mungu, kwa hivyo hakuwa akibadilisha kwa ghafla kuzungumza juu ya / kuzungumza juu ya kuwaepuka watu katika korti ya mahali hapa mwishoni mwa sehemu hii. Badala yake, anatumia lugha ya mfano kufanya hoja kali ya maneno. Anasema, "Usiwe katika uhusiano mbaya na Mungu, usije ukajikuta katika korti naye na usiweze kutosheleza adhabu kwa kosa lako". Kusisitiza kutoweza kulipa adhabu kunaweza kusaidia kufanya hoja hii iwe wazi zaidi katika tafsiri.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~25#Note:Who else could this opponent be?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.27+What do you think it means to commit adultery with another person?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.29-30+What did he mean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~29#Question:What did he mean?
trans-unit.source: What did he mean?
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~29#Question:What did he mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~29#Answer:What did he mean?374705670
trans-unit.source: Jesus again is using rhetoric that his hearers would have understood. He meant for us to think how very serious sin is and to stop doing it. (In fact, gouging out one eye would not help much, since there would still be an eye left. The same is true of cutting off an arm.) Thinking how serious sin really is, though, should help a person to obey God, so that he can help that person.
trans-unit.target: Yesu tena anatumia usemi ambao wasikilizaji wake wangeweza kuelewa. Alitaka tufikirie jinsi dhambi ilivyo nzito sana na tuache kuifanya. (Kwa kweli, kung'oa jicho moja hakungesaidia sana, kwa kuwa bado kungebaki jicho moja. Ndivyo ilivyo na kukatwa mkono.) Hata hivyo, kufikiria jinsi dhambi ilivyo nzito kwa kweli, kwapaswa kumsaidia mtu amtii Mungu, ili aweze kumsaidia mtu huyo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~29#Answer:What did he mean?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!5~31#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 5:31-32 Jesus taught about divorce.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 5:31-32 Yesu alifundisha juu ya talaka.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 5.31-32+About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~31#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~31#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~31#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?-182670874
trans-unit.source: He taught them that a man should not divorce his wife.
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha kwamba mwanamume hapaswi kumtaliki mke wake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~31#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.31+What did the Jews commonly teach about divorcing one's spouse?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~31#Question:What did the Jews commonly teach about divorcing one's spouse?
trans-unit.source: What did the Jews commonly teach about divorcing one's spouse?
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi walifundisha nini kwa kawaida juu ya kumtaliki mwenzi wa mtu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~31#Question:What did the Jews commonly teach about divorcing one's spouse?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~31#Answer:What did the Jews commonly teach about divorcing one's spouse?-1956538706
trans-unit.source: They taught that, if a man divorced his wife, he had to make it clear to her and to everyone else that he had divorced her by writing a statement saying that he had divorced her. (31)
trans-unit.target: Walifundisha kwamba, ikiwa mwanamume alimtaliki mkewe, alipaswa kumweleza wazi kwa mkewe na kwa kila mtu mwingine kwamba alikuwa amemtaliki kwa kuandika taarifa ikisema kwamba alikuwa amemtaliki (31).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~31#Answer:What did the Jews commonly teach about divorcing one's spouse?

trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alisema kwamba kumpa mwanamke huyo hati ya talaka iliyoandikwa kulifanya talaka iwe halali/sawa mbele za Mungu?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.32+What did he say?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~32#Question:What did he say?
trans-unit.source: What did he say?
trans-unit.target: Alisema nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~32#Question:What did he say?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~32#Answer:What did he say?1322136601
trans-unit.source: He said that, if a man divorced his wife and she remarried, he was causing her to sin/commit adultery and also causing whoever then married her to sin. (32)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba, ikiwa mwanamume amemtaliki mkewe na yeye akaoa mwingine, anamfanya kufanya dhambi/kufanya uzinzi na pia anamfanya yeyote ambaye amemwoa kufanya dhambi. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~32#Answer:What did he say?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!5~33#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 5:33-37 Jesus taught about their custom of making promises.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 5:33-37 Yesu alifundisha juu ya desturi yao ya kutoa ahadi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~33#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 5.33-37+About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~33#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~33#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~33#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?1340300454
trans-unit.source: He taught them not to make promises and then making them firm by swearing by heaven or by earth or by Jerusalem or by one's head.
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha wasifanye ahadi na kisha kuzifanya ziwe thabiti kwa kuapa kwa mbingu au kwa dunia au kwa Yerusalemu au kwa kichwa cha mtu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~33#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.33+What was it that the Jewish people often taught about promises?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~33#Question:What was it that the Jewish people often taught about promises?
trans-unit.source: What was it that the Jewish people often taught about promises?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini ambacho Wayahudi walifundisha mara nyingi kuhusu ahadi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~33#Question:What was it that the Jewish people often taught about promises?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~33#Answer:What was it that the Jewish people often taught about promises?-1165719802
trans-unit.source: They taught that, if one had made a promise, he or she had to do as he or she had promised, no matter what happened to them or others. (33)
trans-unit.target: Walifundisha kwamba, ikiwa mtu alikuwa ametoa ahadi, yeye au yeye alikuwa na kufanya kama alivyoahidi, bila kujali nini kilitokea kwao au wengine.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~33#Answer:What was it that the Jewish people often taught about promises?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.34-37+What did Jesus say about that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~34#Question:What did Jesus say about that?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu jambo hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~34#Question:What did Jesus say about that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~34#Answer:What did Jesus say about that?-120253308
trans-unit.source: He said that people should not make those promises such as saying, "As sure as heaven…", or, "As sure as God's throne, … I will do such and such." If a person is honest, he should be able to just say "yes" or "no" and let that be enough for his hearers, without adding other promises. (34-37)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu hawapaswi kutoa ahadi kama vile kusema, "Hakika kama mbingu...", au, "Hakika kama kiti cha enzi cha Mungu, ... nitafanya hivi na hivi". Ikiwa mtu ni mwaminifu, anapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kusema tu "ndiyo" au "hapana" na acha hiyo iwe ya kutosha kwa wasikilizaji wake, bila kuongeza ahadi nyingine. (34-37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~34#Answer:What did Jesus say about that?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.37+What is the reason that Jesus did not want them to make those kinds of promises?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~37#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did not want them to make those kinds of promises?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus did not want them to make those kinds of promises?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Yesu hakutaka wafanye aina hizo za ahadi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~37#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did not want them to make those kinds of promises?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~37#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want them to make those kinds of promises?-848656075
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they should tell the truth. Lies are caused by Satan. (37)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba wanapaswa kusema ukweli. Uongo hutokana na Shetani. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~37#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want them to make those kinds of promises?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!5~38#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 5:38-42 Jesus taught that people should not try to get revenge against others.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 5:38-42 Yesu alifundisha kwamba watu hawapaswi kulipiza kisasi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 5.38-42+About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~38#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~38#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?-318312563
trans-unit.source: He taught them not to take revenge on/retaliate against others.
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha wasilipize kisasi kwa wengine.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.38+What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~38#Question:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?
trans-unit.source: What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?
trans-unit.target: Watu walimaanisha nini waliposema "Jicho kwa jicho na jino kwa jino"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Question:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~38#Answer:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?720911505
trans-unit.source: They meant that, if someone puts out a person's eye, he was to put out their eye.
trans-unit.target: Walimaanisha kwamba, ikiwa mtu atamwondoa jicho la mtu, yeye pia alipaswa kuliondoa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Answer:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~38#Answer:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?938869793
trans-unit.source: Or, if they knock out a person's tooth, then he was permitted to knock out one of theirs. (38)
trans-unit.target: Au, wakimwondoa mtu jino, basi aliruhusiwa kumwondoa mmoja wao. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Answer:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~38#Note:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?-612561746
trans-unit.source: In the Old Testament it was the leaders who were to give this punishment to keep people from carelessly or purposefully hurting others in the future.
trans-unit.target: Katika Agano la Kale viongozi ndio waliopaswa kutoa adhabu hii ili kuwazuia watu wasiwaumize wengine bila kujali au kwa makusudi katika siku zijazo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~38#Note:What did people mean by the words "An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth"?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.39-42+Did Jesus think that people should insist on punishing another person when that person did wrong to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~39#Question:Did Jesus think that people should insist on punishing another person when that person did wrong to them?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus think that people should insist on punishing another person when that person did wrong to them?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu alifikiri kwamba watu wanapaswa kusisitiza kumwadhibu mtu mwingine anapofanya kosa dhidi yao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~39#Question:Did Jesus think that people should insist on punishing another person when that person did wrong to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~39#Answer:Did Jesus think that people should insist on punishing another person when that person did wrong to them?381544924
trans-unit.source: No. He said we should be willing not to react against people who make unfair demands of us. We should be willing to give more than people request of us, rather than being so concerned about their request being fair. (39-42)
trans-unit.target: La. Alisema tunapaswa kuwa tayari kutojibu dhidi ya watu wanaotuwekea madai yasiyo ya haki. Tunapaswa kuwa tayari kutoa zaidi ya watu wanaotuomba, badala ya kuwa na wasiwasi sana juu ya ombi lao kuwa la haki. (39-42)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~39#Answer:Did Jesus think that people should insist on punishing another person when that person did wrong to them?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.43+What did the Jewish leaders teach the people?

trans-unit.source: What did the Jewish leaders teach the people?
trans-unit.target: Viongozi Wayahudi waliwafundisha watu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~43#Question:What did the Jewish leaders teach the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~43#Answer:What did the Jewish leaders teach the people?867919178
trans-unit.source: They taught that people should love their neighbors and hate their enemies. (43)
trans-unit.target: Walifundisha kwamba watu wanapaswa kuwapenda majirani wao na kuwachukia adui zao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~43#Answer:What did the Jewish leaders teach the people?

group.id: Q:MAT 5.43-44+What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~43#Question:What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini mtu anapompenda mtu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~43#Question:What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~43#Answer:What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?-1855778936
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The person, who loves another person, seeks the good of that person. His attitude to the one whom he loves is an attitude of persistent and selfless goodwill.
trans-unit.target: Mtazamo wake kwa yule anayempenda ni mtazamo wa nia njema ya kuendelea na isiyo ya ubinafsi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~43#Answer:What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~43#Note:What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?-1612556004
trans-unit.source: See "love" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona neno "upendo" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~43#Note:What do you think it means when someone loves someone else?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!5~44#Question:What did Jesus say that his disciples should do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that his disciples should do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wanafunzi wake wapaswa kufanya nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~44#Answer:What did Jesus say that his disciples should do?-460811008
trans-unit.source: He said that they should love their enemies and pray for the ones who persecuted them. (44)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanapaswa kuwapenda adui zao na kuwaombea wale wanaowatesa. (44)

group.id: Q:MAT 5.45+What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?

trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba kuwapenda adui zao kungewafanya wawe wana wa Baba yao wa mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~45#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!5~45#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?260170786
trans-unit.source: Loving their enemies would not make them into children of God, but it would demonstrate to others that they were children of God. The people to whom he was talking here were already related to God, as we can tell by the fact that he called God their Father. The terms "son of" and "daughters of," in that culture, were often used to mean "a typical representative of." Compare the term "daughters of Jerusalem" which they used to talk about typical women of Jerusalem. (45)
trans-unit.target: Kuwapenda adui zao hakukuwafanya kuwa watoto wa Mungu, lakini ingewadhihirisha wengine kwamba walikuwa watoto wa Mungu. Watu ambao alikuwa anazungumza nao hapa tayari walikuwa na uhusiano na Mungu, kama tunavyoweza kusema kwa ukweli kwamba alimwita Mungu Baba yao. Maneno "mwana wa" na "binti wa", katika utamaduni huo, mara nyingi yalitumika kumaanisha "wakilishi wa mfano wa". Linganisha neno "binti za Yerusalemu" ambalo walitumia kuzungumza juu ya wanawake wa mfano wa Yerusalemu. (45)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~45#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!5~45#Note:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?-2024501417
trans-unit.source: The Jewish people used "sons" here in a different sense than some languages can use such words. Implied information may need to be made explicit in the translation.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi walitumia neno "wana" hapa kwa maana tofauti na ile ambayo lugha nyinginezo hutumia maneno kama hayo. Huenda habari iliyotiwa ndani ikahitaji kufasiriwa katika tafsiri.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!5~45#Note:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that loving their enemies would make them sons of their father in heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~7#Answer:Should our prayers be long, short, or what, according to verses 7 and 8?407366213
trans-unit.source: We should not try to make our prayers long with meaningless words and phrases or a lot of repetition. Our prayers do not need to be long, since God already knows what we need before we ask. (7-8)

trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~7#Answer:Should our prayers be long, short, or what, according to verses 7 and 8?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~12#Answer:What do you think happens when a person/someone forgives someone else?1823839563
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Forgiveness always involves two people, one of whom has done something wrong to the other and offended him. Forgiveness takes place when the one, who was offended, sets aside his right to justice and decides not to punish the offender, as he deserved. If the one who offended repents and accepts this forgiveness, the result is that the relationship between the two, which was broken by the offense, is restored and the guilt of the offender is removed.
trans-unit.target: Msamaha daima unahusisha watu wawili, mmoja wao amemfanyia mwenzake jambo baya na kumkosea. Msamaha hufanyika wakati yule aliyekosewa, anapoweka kando haki yake ya haki na kuamua kutomwadhibu mkosaji, kama alivyostahili. Ikiwa yule aliyekosewa anatubu na kukubali msamaha huu, matokeo yake ni kwamba uhusiano kati ya wawili, ambao ulivunjwa na kosa, unarejeshwa na hatia ya mkosaji imeondolewa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~12#Answer:What do you think happens when a person/someone forgives someone else?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!6~12#Note:What do you think happens when a person/someone forgives someone else?-570225461
trans-unit.source: See "forgive" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "kusamehe" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~12#Note:What do you think happens when a person/someone forgives someone else?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.13+What did Jesus suggest as one appropriate way to pray so that God would keep them from sinning?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~13#Question:What did Jesus suggest as one appropriate way to pray so that God would keep them from sinning?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus suggest as one appropriate way to pray so that God would keep them from sinning?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alidokeza nini kuwa njia moja ifaayo ya kusali ili Mungu awaepushe na dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~13#Question:What did Jesus suggest as one appropriate way to pray so that God would keep them from sinning?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~13#Answer:What did Jesus suggest as one appropriate way to pray so that God would keep them from sinning?733971311
trans-unit.source: They could ask God to protect them from being tempted (beyond what they could withstand) and thus God would rescue them from evil/the evil one. (13)
trans-unit.target: Wangeweza kumwomba Mungu awalinde wasijaribiwe (zaidi ya kile wanachoweza kuvumilia) na hivyo Mungu angewakomboa kutoka kwa yule mwovu/movu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~13#Answer:What did Jesus suggest as one appropriate way to pray so that God would keep them from sinning?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.13+Who do you think the evil one is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~13#Question:Who do you think the evil one is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think the evil one is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri yule mwovu ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~13#Question:Who do you think the evil one is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~13#Answer:Who do you think the evil one is?1049369062
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The "evil one" is another name for Satan. (See "evil one" in KBT in the "Satan" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Angalia maneno haya muhimu: "Mtu mwovu" ni jina lingine la Shetani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~13#Answer:Who do you think the evil one is?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!6~16#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 6:16-18 Jesus taught his disciples about fasting.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 6:16-18 Yesu aliwafundisha wanafunzi wake kuhusu kufunga.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 6.16-18+What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~16#Question:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Question:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~16#Answer:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?-1719232004
trans-unit.source: He taught them about fasting.
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha kuhusu kufunga.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Answer:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.16-18+What do you think it means to fast?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~16#Question:What do you think it means to fast?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to fast?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kufunga kunamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Question:What do you think it means to fast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~16#Answer:What do you think it means to fast?1772231599
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: When someone fasts he chooses not to eat food for certain periods of time, so that he could focus his thoughts better on God and not on his bodily needs.
trans-unit.target: Kipimo cha muda muhimu: Mtu anapofunga anachagua kutokula chakula kwa vipindi fulani vya wakati, ili aweze kuzingatia mawazo yake kwa Mungu na sio kwa mahitaji yake ya mwili.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Answer:What do you think it means to fast?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.16+What do you think is the reason that some people would try to go around looking sad when they fasted?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~16#Question:What do you think is the reason that some people would try to go around looking sad when they fasted?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that some people would try to go around looking sad when they fasted?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watu fulani hujaribu kutembea huku na huku wakiwa na huzuni wanapofunga?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Question:What do you think is the reason that some people would try to go around looking sad when they fasted?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~16#Answer:What do you think is the reason that some people would try to go around looking sad when they fasted?-1511699384
trans-unit.source: Some people went around looking sad in order to show/to demonstrate to others that they were fasting. They wanted other people to think that they were good/religious/holy people. (16)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine walitembea wakionekana kuwa na huzuni ili kuonyesha/kuonyesha wengine kwamba walikuwa wakifunga.Walitaka watu wengine wafikiri kwamba walikuwa watu wema/wa kidini/watakatifu. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Answer:What do you think is the reason that some people would try to go around looking sad when they fasted?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.16+Would God be pleased with people who fasted just to make other people think that they were seriously worshipping God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~16#Question:Would God be pleased with people who fasted just to make other people think that they were seriously worshipping God?
trans-unit.source: Would God be pleased with people who fasted just to make other people think that they were seriously worshipping God?
trans-unit.target: Je, Mungu angependezwa na watu ambao wanafunga ili tu kuwafanya wengine wafikiri kwamba wanamwabudu Mungu kwa unyoofu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Question:Would God be pleased with people who fasted just to make other people think that they were seriously worshipping God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~16#Answer:Would God be pleased with people who fasted just to make other people think that they were seriously worshipping God?2084527812
trans-unit.source: No. That would not make God happy.
trans-unit.target: La, hilo halingemfurahisha Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Answer:Would God be pleased with people who fasted just to make other people think that they were seriously worshipping God?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.16+What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~16#Question:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?
trans-unit.source: What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema watu kama hao wanapata faida gani/wanapata nini kwa kufunga kwa namna hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Question:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~16#Alternate:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?285324044
trans-unit.source: What gain did Jesus say such people earn from fasting like that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema watu hao hupata faida gani kutokana na kufunga kwa njia hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Alternate:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~16#Alternate:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?-647146309
trans-unit.source: What gain did Jesus say such people achieve from fasting like that?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema watu hao walipata faida gani kutokana na kufunga kwa njia hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Alternate:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~16#Answer:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?1851868756
trans-unit.source: He said that the only thing they would gain from such fasting would be the attention of those other people. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kitu pekee ambacho wangepata kutokana na kufunga kama hivyo ni tahadhari ya watu wengine. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~16#Answer:What gain did Jesus say such people earn/achieve from fasting like that?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.17-18+What should we do then, if we decide to fast?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~17#Question:What should we do then, if we decide to fast?
trans-unit.source: What should we do then, if we decide to fast?
trans-unit.target: Basi, tunapaswa kufanya nini tukiwa tumeamua kufunga?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~17#Question:What should we do then, if we decide to fast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~17#Answer:What should we do then, if we decide to fast?-709695853
trans-unit.source: We should dress and wash ourselves as usual, so that only God knows that we are fasting.
trans-unit.target: Tunapaswa kuvaa na kuoga kama kawaida, ili tu Mungu ajue kwamba tunafunga.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~17#Answer:What should we do then, if we decide to fast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~17#Answer:What should we do then, if we decide to fast?1516216288
trans-unit.source: Since God knows everything, he will know what we are doing and can bless us. (17-18)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Mungu anajua kila kitu, atajua tunachofanya na anaweza kutubariki. (17-18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~17#Answer:What should we do then, if we decide to fast?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!6~19#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 6:19-24 Jesus taught that people should value what they will receive in heaven more than what they have while on earth.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 6:19-24 Yesu alifundisha kwamba watu wapaswa kuthamini zaidi kile watakachopokea mbinguni kuliko kile walicho nacho wakiwa duniani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~19#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 6.19-24+What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~19#Question:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~19#Question:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~19#Answer:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?2095604185
trans-unit.source: He taught them that they should store up treasures in heaven.
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha kwamba wanapaswa kujiwekea hazina mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~19#Answer:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.20+What did Jesus say we should store up for ourselves in heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~20#Question:What did Jesus say we should store up for ourselves in heaven?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say we should store up for ourselves in heaven?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema tunapaswa kujiwekea akiba gani mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Question:What did Jesus say we should store up for ourselves in heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~20#Answer:What did Jesus say we should store up for ourselves in heaven?-1361666274
trans-unit.source: We should store up heavenly treasure. (20)
trans-unit.target: Tunapaswa kujiwekea hazina mbinguni. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Answer:What did Jesus say we should store up for ourselves in heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.20+What do you think Jesus meant when he said we should store up our treasure in heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~20#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said we should store up our treasure in heaven?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said we should store up our treasure in heaven?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba tunapaswa kujiwekea hazina mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said we should store up our treasure in heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~20#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said we should store up our treasure in heaven?-210301469
trans-unit.source: He meant that we need to put the highest value on our relationship to God and the good that he does for us/spiritual blessings he sends to us.
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba tunahitaji kuweka thamani kubwa zaidi kwenye uhusiano wetu na Mungu na mema ambayo yeye hututendea/baraka za kiroho ambazo yeye hututumia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said we should store up our treasure in heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.19-21+What do you think Jesus meant by earthly treasure?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~19#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by earthly treasure?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant by earthly treasure?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu hazina za kidunia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~19#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by earthly treasure?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~19#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by earthly treasure?-1848063023
trans-unit.source: He meant anything on earth that people value and which might distract them from maintaining/continuing their relationship with God.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumzia kitu chochote duniani ambacho watu wanathamini na ambacho kinaweza kuwakengeusha wasiendelee kuwa na uhusiano mzuri pamoja na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~19#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by earthly treasure?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.20-21+What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~20#Question:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yesu kutotaka tutumie wakati mwingi na jitihada nyingi katika kukusanya/kusanya mali nyingi hapa duniani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Question:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~20#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?368184420
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating many possessions here on earth?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hataki tutumie wakati na jitihada nyingi katika kujikusanyia vitu vingi vya kimwili hapa duniani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~20#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?-1307783510
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort to accumulate many possessions here on earth?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu hataki tutumie wakati na nguvu nyingi kujikusanyia vitu vingi vya kimwili hapa duniani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~20#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?516640220
trans-unit.source: The things that people/we value here on earth are not long lasting, and they will tend to distract people/us from the/our lifetime goal of loving and serving God. (20-21)
trans-unit.target: Vitu ambavyo watu/tunavyothamini hapa duniani havidumu kwa muda mrefu, na vitakuwa na mwelekeo wa kuwapotosha watu/sisi kutoka kwa lengo la maisha yetu ya kumpenda na kumtumikia Mungu. (20-21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~20#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus does not want us to spend much time and great effort in accumulating/to accumulate many possessions here on earth?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.22+What is the purpose of our eyes?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~22#Question:What is the purpose of our eyes?
trans-unit.source: What is the purpose of our eyes?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kusudi la macho yetu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~22#Question:What is the purpose of our eyes?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~22#Answer:What is the purpose of our eyes?324176168
trans-unit.source: We see with our eyes and they show the rest of the body the way we want/the person wants to go. (22)
trans-unit.target: Tunaona kwa macho yetu na wao kuonyesha wengine wa mwili njia tunataka / mtu anataka kwenda. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~22#Answer:What is the purpose of our eyes?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.22-23+What, then, is the difference between a good eye and a bad eye for the body?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~22#Question:What, then, is the difference between a good eye and a bad eye for the body?
trans-unit.source: What, then, is the difference between a good eye and a bad eye for the body?
trans-unit.target: Basi, kuna tofauti gani kati ya jicho zuri na jicho baya kwa mwili?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~22#Question:What, then, is the difference between a good eye and a bad eye for the body?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~22#Answer:What, then, is the difference between a good eye and a bad eye for the body?871530760
trans-unit.source: With a good eye the person can see where he wants to go. If our/a person's eye is bad, we/he cannot see where he wants/we want to go. (22-23)
trans-unit.target: Kwa jicho zuri mtu anaweza kuona mahali anataka kwenda. Kama jicho letu/la mtu ni mbaya, hatuwezi kuona mahali anataka/twataka kwenda. (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~22#Answer:What, then, is the difference between a good eye and a bad eye for the body?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.22-23+What do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of a person having a "good eye" and when he spoke of a person having a "bad eye"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~22#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of a person having a "good eye" and when he spoke of a person having a "bad eye"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of a person having a "good eye" and when he spoke of a person having a "bad eye"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba jicho ni "jema" na jicho ni "mbaya"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~22#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of a person having a "good eye" and when he spoke of a person having a "bad eye"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~22#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of a person having a "good eye" and when he spoke of a person having a "bad eye"?890634043
trans-unit.source: A person who can see is like a person who has a heart to know God. A person who can not see is like a person who has a heart not to know God and not to do his will.
trans-unit.target: Mtu anayeweza kuona ni kama mtu aliye na moyo wa kumjua Mungu; mtu asiyeweza kuona ni kama mtu aliye na moyo wa kutomjua Mungu na kutotenda mapenzi yake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~22#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of a person having a "good eye" and when he spoke of a person having a "bad eye"?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.24+What did Jesus say about a person trying to serve two masters?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~24#Question:What did Jesus say about a person trying to serve two masters?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about a person trying to serve two masters?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu mtu kujaribu kutumikia mabwana wawili?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~24#Question:What did Jesus say about a person trying to serve two masters?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~24#Answer:What did Jesus say about a person trying to serve two masters?-115942311
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that if a person tries to serve two masters, he will always have more devotion for one master than for the other. Therefore, by neglecting one of the two masters, he will not be serving that one at all. (24)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba ikiwa mtu anajaribu kutumikia mabwana wawili, siku zote atakuwa na ujitoaji zaidi kwa bwana mmoja kuliko kwa mwingine. Kwa hiyo, kwa kupuuza mmoja wa mabwana wawili, hatakuwa akimtumikia yule mwingine kabisa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~24#Answer:What did Jesus say about a person trying to serve two masters?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.23-24+Should becoming wealthy or should serving God be our main desire in life?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~23#Question:Should becoming wealthy or should serving God be our main desire in life?
trans-unit.source: Should becoming wealthy or should serving God be our main desire in life?
trans-unit.target: Je, tunapaswa kutanguliza utajiri au kumtumikia Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~23#Question:Should becoming wealthy or should serving God be our main desire in life?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~23#Answer:Should becoming wealthy or should serving God be our main desire in life?1245397297
trans-unit.source: Serving God should always be of more value to us than becoming wealthy. (23-24)
trans-unit.target: Kumtumikia Mungu sikuzote kwapaswa kuwa na thamani kubwa zaidi kwetu kuliko kuwa matajiri. (23-24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~23#Answer:Should becoming wealthy or should serving God be our main desire in life?
