trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Yesu hakutaka waamini wake wahangaikie mahitaji yao ya wakati ujao ya chakula na mavazi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~25#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~25#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?-1535705668
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus did not want people to be overly concerned about their future needs for food and clothing?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Yesu hakutaka watu wawe na hangaiko kupita kiasi juu ya mahitaji yao ya wakati ujao ya chakula na mavazi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~25#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~25#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?-894392565
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus did not want people to worry about their future needs for food and clothing?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini Yesu hakutaka watu wawe na wasiwasi juu ya mahitaji yao ya wakati ujao ya chakula na mavazi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~25#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~25#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?2114068186
trans-unit.source: He wanted their first concern to be that of having a good relationship with God rather than being concerned/worrying about food and clothing. (25, 32-33)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka hangaiko lao la kwanza liwe lile la kuwa na uhusiano mzuri pamoja na Mungu badala ya kuwa na wasiwasi/hangaiko juu ya chakula na mavazi. (25, 32-33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~25#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~25#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?-1144089552
trans-unit.source: -AND/OR-
trans-unit.target: - NA/AU-
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~25#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~25#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?543791385
trans-unit.source: He did not want them to be overly concerned/worried about their future needs. Rather, he wanted them to trust God to supply their daily needs/needs day by day. (33-34)
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka wawe na wasiwasi kupita kiasi/wasiwasi kuhusu mahitaji yao ya baadaye. Badala yake, alitaka wamwamini Mungu kuwapa mahitaji yao ya kila siku siku kwa siku. (33-34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~25#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want his followers/believers/people to be overly concerned/worry about their future needs for food and clothing?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.26-33+What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~26#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba uhai ni muhimu kuliko chakula na mavazi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~26#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~26#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?1504892343
trans-unit.source: Having a body and being alive we have the opportunity to have a true/proper/genuine relationship with God.
trans-unit.target: Kuwa na mwili na kuwa hai tuna nafasi ya kuwa na uhusiano wa kweli/sahihi/wa kweli na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~26#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~26#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?-1852228042
trans-unit.source: Having and continuing/maintaining a true/proper/genuine right relationship with God is more important than having food and clothing. (26-27, 33)
trans-unit.target: Kuwa na kuendelea/kudumisha uhusiano wa kweli/sahihi/wa kweli na Mungu ni muhimu zaidi kuliko kuwa na chakula na mavazi. (26-27, 33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~26#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about life being more important than food and clothing?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.26+Who values us as more important than birds?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~26#Question:Who values us as more important than birds?
trans-unit.source: Who values us as more important than birds?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani anayetuona kuwa wa maana zaidi kuliko ndege?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~26#Question:Who values us as more important than birds?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~26#Answer:Who values us as more important than birds?-926425321
trans-unit.source: God values us as more important than the birds. (26)
trans-unit.target: Mungu hututhamini kuliko ndege. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~26#Answer:Who values us as more important than birds?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.27+What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~27#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwauliza swali kuhusu ni nani anayeweza kuishi muda mrefu zaidi/kuongeza siku nyingi katika maisha yake kwa kuhangaika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~27#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?1261826119
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer more days to their life by worrying?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwauliza swali hilo kuhusu ni nani anayeweza kuongeza siku zake kwa kuwa na wasiwasi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!6~27#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?230678085
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live add more days to their life by worrying?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwauliza swali kuhusu ni nani anayeweza kuongeza kipimo cha siku kwa maisha yake kwa kuhangaika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~27#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?-1635389546
trans-unit.source: He was not asking in order to learn something from them. He was using a question to emphasize to them that worrying does not help anyone/does no good.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakuwauliza ili ajifunze jambo fulani kutoka kwao, badala yake alitumia swali ili kukazia kwamba kuhangaika hakumsaidii mtu yeyote.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!6~27#Note:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?-2025120398
trans-unit.source: Ask this question only if verse 27 is in a question form after being translated.
trans-unit.target: Uliza swali hili ikiwa tu mstari wa 27 uko katika namna ya swali baada ya kutafsiriwa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Note:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked them the question about who could live longer/add more days to their life by worrying?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.27+What do you think is the meaning of the word "life" in verse 27?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~27#Question:What do you think is the meaning of the word "life" in verse 27?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the meaning of the word "life" in verse 27?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri neno "uhai" katika mstari wa 27 linamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Question:What do you think is the meaning of the word "life" in verse 27?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~27#Answer:What do you think is the meaning of the word "life" in verse 27?1767923200
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In this verse the word "life" refers to physical life/the earthly existence of a human being.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno Angalia: Katika mstari huu neno "uhai" linarejelea maisha ya kimwili/kuwepo duniani kwa mwanadamu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~27#Answer:What do you think is the meaning of the word "life" in verse 27?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.28+If verse 28 is translated with a question form then ask: In verse 28, did Jesus want them to tell him why they still worried about their clothing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~28#Question:If verse 28 is translated with a question form then ask: In verse 28, did Jesus want them to tell him why they still worried about their clothing?
trans-unit.source: If verse 28 is translated with a question form then ask: In verse 28, did Jesus want them to tell him why they still worried about their clothing?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa mstari wa 28 umetafsiriwa kwa namna ya swali basi uliza: Katika mstari wa 28, je, Yesu alitaka wamwambie kwa nini bado walihangaikia mavazi yao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~28#Question:If verse 28 is translated with a question form then ask: In verse 28, did Jesus want them to tell him why they still worried about their clothing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~28#Answer:If verse 28 is translated with a question form then ask: In verse 28, did Jesus want them to tell him why they still worried about their clothing?-424932887
trans-unit.source: No. He was telling them/saying in an emphatic way that they should not worry about their clothing/about having clothes to wear. (28)
trans-unit.target: La. Alikuwa akiwaambia/kuwaambia kwa njia ya kusisitiza kwamba hawapaswi kuwa na wasiwasi juu ya mavazi yao/ya kuwa na mavazi ya kuvaa. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~28#Answer:If verse 28 is translated with a question form then ask: In verse 28, did Jesus want them to tell him why they still worried about their clothing?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.28-30+What can we learn from the way that God decorates some of the wild plants?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~28#Question:What can we learn from the way that God decorates some of the wild plants?
trans-unit.source: What can we learn from the way that God decorates some of the wild plants?
trans-unit.target: Tunajifunza nini kuhusu jinsi Mungu anavyopamba mimea fulani ya shambani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~28#Question:What can we learn from the way that God decorates some of the wild plants?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~28#Answer:What can we learn from the way that God decorates some of the wild plants?-313169856
trans-unit.source: We can learn that he can also provide clothes to decorate us too. (28-30)
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kujifunza kwamba yeye pia aweza kutuandalia mavazi ya kutupamba sisi pia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~28#Answer:What can we learn from the way that God decorates some of the wild plants?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.29+Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~29#Question:Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?
trans-unit.source: Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyekuwa Sulemani anayetajwa katika mstari wa 29?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~29#Question:Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~29#Answer:Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?-1034042379
trans-unit.source: Solomon was a rich king of Israel who lived many years before Jesus made this statement.
trans-unit.target: Sulemani alikuwa mfalme tajiri wa Israeli aliyeishi miaka mingi kabla ya Yesu kusema maneno hayo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~29#Answer:Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!6~29#Note:Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?-1164245796
trans-unit.source: This is general knowledge known to the/Jesus's original audience/the people who were listening to Jesus speak.
trans-unit.target: Hii ni maarifa ya jumla inayojulikana kwa / wasikilizaji wa asili wa Yesu / watu ambao walikuwa wakimsikiliza Yesu akizungumza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~29#Note:Who was the person named Solomon mentioned in verse 29?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.32+Who made satisfying their bodily needs for food, drink and clothing the first goal of their lives?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~32#Question:Who made satisfying their bodily needs for food, drink and clothing the first goal of their lives?
trans-unit.source: Who made satisfying their bodily needs for food, drink and clothing the first goal of their lives?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliofanya kutimiza mahitaji yao ya kimwili ya chakula, kinywaji na mavazi kuwa lengo la kwanza maishani mwao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~32#Question:Who made satisfying their bodily needs for food, drink and clothing the first goal of their lives?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~32#Answer:Who made satisfying their bodily needs for food, drink and clothing the first goal of their lives?-914330553
trans-unit.source: The people, who had made satisfying their bodily needs the first goal of their lives, were those people who had not trusted/followed/learned about God. (32)
trans-unit.target: Watu, ambao walikuwa wamefanya kutimiza mahitaji yao ya kimwili kuwa lengo la kwanza la maisha yao, walikuwa watu ambao hawakuwa wamemwamini/wamemfuata/wamemjua Mungu. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~32#Answer:Who made satisfying their bodily needs for food, drink and clothing the first goal of their lives?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.33+In verse 33, how will people have their needs met when they focus on pleasing God?

trans-unit.source: In verse 33, how will people have their needs met when they focus on pleasing God?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na mstari wa 33, watu watapataje mahitaji yao ya lazima wanapozingatia kumpendeza Mungu?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~33#Answer:In verse 33, how will people have their needs met when they focus on pleasing God?-1288813124
trans-unit.source: God will take care of them. (33)
trans-unit.target: Mwenyezi Mungu atawatunza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~33#Answer:In verse 33, how will people have their needs met when they focus on pleasing God?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!6~33#Note:In verse 33, how will people have their needs met when they focus on pleasing God?-2115153118
trans-unit.source: This is implied.
trans-unit.target: Hilo linadokezwa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~33#Note:In verse 33, how will people have their needs met when they focus on pleasing God?

group.id: Q:MAT 6.34+If the translation still says so, then ask: How can a day actually be able to think enough to worry?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!6~34#Question:If the translation still says so, then ask: How can a day actually be able to think enough to worry?
trans-unit.source: If the translation still says so, then ask: How can a day actually be able to think enough to worry?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa tafsiri bado inasema hivyo, basi uliza: Siku moja yawezaje kufikiri vya kutosha kuhangaika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~34#Question:If the translation still says so, then ask: How can a day actually be able to think enough to worry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!6~34#Answer:If the translation still says so, then ask: How can a day actually be able to think enough to worry?2093200384
trans-unit.source: Of course, a day cannot think or worry. The meaning is that there will be a certain amount of concern for us each day [also God will provide daily for us]. So we/people should not worry ahead of time. (34)
trans-unit.target: Bila shaka, siku haiwezi kufikiri au kuwa na wasiwasi. Maana yake ni kwamba kutakuwa na kiasi fulani cha wasiwasi kwetu kila siku [Mungu pia atatuandalia kila siku]. Kwa hivyo sisi / watu hawapaswi kuwa na wasiwasi kabla ya wakati. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!6~34#Answer:If the translation still says so, then ask: How can a day actually be able to think enough to worry?

trans-unit.source: Matthew 7:1-6 Do not judge others unless you are ready to be scrutinized yourself.

group.id: Q:MAT 7.1-6+What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~1#Question:What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hii?

trans-unit.source: He taught them that they should not judge other people.
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha kwamba hawapaswi kuwahukumu wengine.

group.id: Q:MAT 7.1-6+What do you think it means to judge someone?

trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to judge someone?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~1#Answer:What do you think it means to judge someone?1637049343

group.id: Q:MAT 7.1-2+If we scrutinize others with the idea of judging them what will happen to us?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~1#Question:If we scrutinize others with the idea of judging them what will happen to us?
trans-unit.source: If we scrutinize others with the idea of judging them what will happen to us?
trans-unit.target: Tukichunguza wengine kwa uangalifu tukiwa na wazo la kuwahukumu, ni nini kitakachotupata?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~1#Question:If we scrutinize others with the idea of judging them what will happen to us?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~1#Answer:If we scrutinize others with the idea of judging them what will happen to us?-139726215
trans-unit.source: If we continually judge others, God will (have to) judge us. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: Tukiendelea kuwahukumu wengine, Mungu atatuhukumu. (1-2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~1#Answer:If we scrutinize others with the idea of judging them what will happen to us?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.1-2+What do you think judgment means?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~1#Question:What do you think judgment means?
trans-unit.source: What do you think judgment means?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri hukumu inamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~1#Question:What do you think judgment means?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~1#Answer:What do you think judgment means?-372507328
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means that someone decides that something is either good or bad. He considers the facts and reaches a conclusion. (See "judgment" in KBT in the "judge" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Mtu fulani huamua kwamba jambo fulani ni zuri au baya kwa kuchunguza mambo ya hakika na kufikia mkataa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~1#Answer:What do you think judgment means?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.3-5+What should the Pharisee have done, or anyone else do before they could guide others?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~3#Question:What should the Pharisee have done, or anyone else do before they could guide others?
trans-unit.source: What should the Pharisee have done, or anyone else do before they could guide others?
trans-unit.target: Mfarisayo huyo, au mtu mwingine yeyote, alipaswa kufanya nini kabla ya kuwaongoza wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~3#Question:What should the Pharisee have done, or anyone else do before they could guide others?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~3#Answer:What should the Pharisee have done, or anyone else do before they could guide others?737707027
trans-unit.source: They needed to repent and obey God before they could guide others. (3-5)
trans-unit.target: Walihitaji kutubu na kumtii Mungu kabla ya kuwaongoza wengine (3-5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~3#Answer:What should the Pharisee have done, or anyone else do before they could guide others?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.6+What do you think that Jesus meant when he mentioned dogs and pigs in verse 6?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~6#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he mentioned dogs and pigs in verse 6?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant when he mentioned dogs and pigs in verse 6?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu mbwa na nguruwe katika mstari wa 6?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~6#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant when he mentioned dogs and pigs in verse 6?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~6#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he mentioned dogs and pigs in verse 6?-1472825215
trans-unit.source: He meant that people who did not appreciate the good news that Jesus preached/brought were like dogs and pigs. (6)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba watu ambao hawakuithamini habari njema ambayo Yesu alihubiri/alileta walikuwa kama mbwa na nguruwe. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~6#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant when he mentioned dogs and pigs in verse 6?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.6+What did Jesus say about people who react strongly against those who preach the good news?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~6#Question:What did Jesus say about people who react strongly against those who preach the good news?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about people who react strongly against those who preach the good news?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu watu ambao huitikia vikali wale wanaohubiri habari njema?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~6#Question:What did Jesus say about people who react strongly against those who preach the good news?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~6#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who react strongly against those who preach the good news?274903533
trans-unit.source: Those people will reject it and also will seek to harm the ones who proclaim the good news to them. (6)
trans-unit.target: Watu hao wataikataa na pia watajaribu kuwadhuru wale wanaowatangazia habari njema. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~6#Answer:What did Jesus say about people who react strongly against those who preach the good news?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.9-10+What else did Jesus say that earthly fathers would not do to their sons?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~9#Question:What else did Jesus say that earthly fathers would not do to their sons?
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus say that earthly fathers would not do to their sons?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini kingine ambacho baba wa kidunia hawangemfanyia mwana wao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~9#Question:What else did Jesus say that earthly fathers would not do to their sons?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~9#Answer:What else did Jesus say that earthly fathers would not do to their sons?-1486374116
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that earthly fathers would certainly not trick their children by giving them a stone when they ask for an egg. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba baba wa kidunia kwa hakika hawangedanganya watoto wao kwa kuwapa jiwe wanapoomba yai (9-10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~9#Answer:What else did Jesus say that earthly fathers would not do to their sons?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.11+What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~11#Question:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kingine kutufanya tujue kwa hakika/uhisi hakika kwamba Mungu atafanya tu kile kilicho chema kwetu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~11#Question:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!7~11#Alternate:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?-921646759
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure that God will only do what is good for us?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kingine ili kutufanya tujue kwa uhakika kwamba Mungu atatufanyia mema tu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~11#Alternate:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!7~11#Alternate:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?-6022007
trans-unit.source: What else did Jesus say to make us feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kingine ili kutufanya tuhisi kwamba Mungu atatufanyia tu yaliyo mema?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~11#Alternate:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~11#Answer:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?86904649
trans-unit.source: He said that if people who are his children/followers, who tend to do bad/evil deeds, give only good things to their children; then people should understand how God deals with his children. If people/his children/those who follow him pray to him/to God/to their heavenly father, he will do only what is good for them. (11)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba ikiwa watu ambao ni watoto wake/wafuasi wake, ambao wana tabia ya kufanya matendo mabaya/maovu, wanawapa watoto wao vitu vizuri tu; basi watu wanapaswa kuelewa jinsi Mungu anavyoshughulika na watoto wake. Ikiwa watu/watoto wake/wale wanaomfuata wanamwomba/Mungu/baba yao wa mbinguni, atawafanyia mema tu. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~11#Answer:What else did Jesus say to make us know for sure/feel sure that God will only do what is good for us?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!7~13#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 7:13-14 Jesus taught the people/his disciples/his followers about the narrow gate and the wide gate.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 7:13-14 Yesu aliwafundisha watu/wanafunzi wake/wafuasi wake kuhusu lango jembamba na lango pana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 7.13-14+What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a narrow gate and a wide gate, and also a wide road?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~13#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a narrow gate and a wide gate, and also a wide road?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a narrow gate and a wide gate, and also a wide road?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema juu ya lango jembamba na lango pana, na pia barabara pana?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~13#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a narrow gate and a wide gate, and also a wide road?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~13#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a narrow gate and a wide gate, and also a wide road?-740874820
trans-unit.source: He was warning them not to do what large groups of people do because that would not help them to live forever with God. Relatively few people accept God's way to have eternal life; so just following the crowd is not a good plan. (13-14)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiwaonya wasifanye kile ambacho vikundi vikubwa vya watu hufanya kwa sababu hiyo haitawasaidia kuishi milele na Mungu. Watu wachache sana wanakubali njia ya Mungu ya kupata uzima wa milele; kwa hivyo kufuata umati sio mpango mzuri. (13-14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~13#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a narrow gate and a wide gate, and also a wide road?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.13-14+What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~13#Question:What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu anaweza kupata uzima wa milele kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~13#Question:What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~13#Answer:What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?922548155
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means that a person will live forever with God.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: Ina maana kwamba mtu ataishi milele na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~13#Answer:What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!7~13#Note:What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?668372763
trans-unit.source: This eternal life is in the spiritual realm, not in the physical.
trans-unit.target: Uhai huu wa milele uko katika ulimwengu wa kiroho, si wa kimwili.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~13#Note:What do you think it means for a person to have eternal life?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!7~15#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 7:15-23 Jesus taught his followers to guard against/be aware of the teaching of false prophets.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 7:15-23 Yesu aliwafundisha wafuasi wake wajihadhari na mafundisho ya manabii wa uwongo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 7.15-23+Of what kind of people did Jesus teach his disciples to be aware?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~15#Question:Of what kind of people did Jesus teach his disciples to be aware?
trans-unit.source: Of what kind of people did Jesus teach his disciples to be aware?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha wanafunzi wake wajihadhari na watu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Question:Of what kind of people did Jesus teach his disciples to be aware?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~15#Answer:Of what kind of people did Jesus teach his disciples to be aware?752313344
trans-unit.source: He told them to beware of false prophets.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wajihadhari na manabii bandia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Answer:Of what kind of people did Jesus teach his disciples to be aware?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.15+In what way are false prophets like sheep, and how are they like wolves?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~15#Question:In what way are false prophets like sheep, and how are they like wolves?
trans-unit.source: In what way are false prophets like sheep, and how are they like wolves?
trans-unit.target: Manabii wa uwongo ni kama kondoo katika njia gani, nao ni kama mbwa-mwitu katika njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Question:In what way are false prophets like sheep, and how are they like wolves?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~15#Answer:In what way are false prophets like sheep, and how are they like wolves?1260530293
trans-unit.source: False prophets are not harmless like sheep are harmless. They are like wolves, but they try to appear as harmless as/like harmless sheep, so that they can enter and mingle among the sheep in order to harm them. (15)
trans-unit.target: Manabii wa uongo si wasio na madhara kama kondoo wasio na madhara. Wao ni kama mbwa mwitu, lakini wanajaribu kuonekana wasio na madhara kama/kama kondoo wasio na madhara, ili waweze kuingia na kuingiliana kati ya kondoo ili kuwaumiza. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Answer:In what way are false prophets like sheep, and how are they like wolves?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.15+What do you think a false prophet did?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~15#Question:What do you think a false prophet did?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a false prophet did?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri nabii wa uwongo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Question:What do you think a false prophet did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~15#Answer:What do you think a false prophet did?560709000
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A false prophet was a person who claimed to be a prophet of God, but he was not. His messages were deceptive and led to confusion. (See "false prophet" in KBT in the "prophet" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda wa Angalia: Nabii wa uongo alikuwa mtu ambaye alidai kuwa nabii wa Mungu, lakini hakuwa. Ujumbe wake ulikuwa wa udanganyifu na kusababisha machafuko. (Ona "nabii wa uongo" katika KBT katika "nabii" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Answer:What do you think a false prophet did?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.15+What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~15#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu kondoo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~15#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep?-1486437211
trans-unit.source: He meant that his people were like sheep, whom the false prophets tried/try to harm by teaching them false ideas. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba watu wake walikuwa kama kondoo, ambao manabii wa uongo walijaribu kuwadhuru kwa kuwafundisha mawazo ya uongo. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~15#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.16-20+How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~16#Question:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?
trans-unit.source: How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?
trans-unit.target: Tunawezaje kutambua/kuwatambua wale ambao ni manabii bandia kutoka kwa wale ambao kwa kweli wanafundisha yale ambayo Mungu anataka wafundishe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~16#Question:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!7~16#Alternate:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?-1768960106
trans-unit.source: How can we recognize which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kuwatambuaje manabii wasio wa kweli kutoka kwa wale ambao kwa kweli wanafundisha yale ambayo Mungu ataka wafundishe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~16#Alternate:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!7~16#Alternate:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?-1908843876
trans-unit.source: How can we discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kutofautishaje manabii bandia na wale ambao kwa kweli wanafundisha yale ambayo Mungu ataka wafundishe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~16#Alternate:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~16#Answer:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?134721682
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that we can recognize them by the results of their teaching in their own lives and in the lives of those who follow them. (16-20)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba tunaweza kuwatambua kwa matokeo ya mafundisho yao katika maisha yao wenyewe na katika maisha ya wale wanaofuata. (16-20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~16#Answer:How can we recognize/discern which ones are false prophets from those who are really teaching what God wants them to teach?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.19+What did Jesus say happens to trees that do not produce good fruit?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~19#Question:What did Jesus say happens to trees that do not produce good fruit?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say happens to trees that do not produce good fruit?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini hutukia kwa miti isiyotoa matunda mazuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~19#Question:What did Jesus say happens to trees that do not produce good fruit?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~19#Answer:What did Jesus say happens to trees that do not produce good fruit?209229297
trans-unit.source: Their owners cut them down and burn them. (19)
trans-unit.target: Wamiliki wao huzikata na kuziteketeza. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~19#Answer:What did Jesus say happens to trees that do not produce good fruit?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.21+If calling Jesus Lord is not enough to cause Jesus to accept us what is enough?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~21#Question:If calling Jesus Lord is not enough to cause Jesus to accept us what is enough?
trans-unit.source: If calling Jesus Lord is not enough to cause Jesus to accept us what is enough?
trans-unit.target: Kama kumwita Yesu Bwana haitoshi kumfanya Yesu atukubali ni nini kinachotosheleza?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~21#Question:If calling Jesus Lord is not enough to cause Jesus to accept us what is enough?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~21#Answer:If calling Jesus Lord is not enough to cause Jesus to accept us what is enough?-583154298
trans-unit.source: Acknowledging him as Lord and obeying his father will cause him to accept us. (21)
trans-unit.target: Kumtambua yeye kuwa Bwana na kumtii baba yake kutamfanya atukubali. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~21#Answer:If calling Jesus Lord is not enough to cause Jesus to accept us what is enough?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.21-23+If people say Jesus sent them to preach, and they even claim to do miracles and cast out demons, will that prove that they belong to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~21#Question:If people say Jesus sent them to preach, and they even claim to do miracles and cast out demons, will that prove that they belong to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: If people say Jesus sent them to preach, and they even claim to do miracles and cast out demons, will that prove that they belong to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa watu wanasema kwamba Yesu aliwatuma kuhubiri, na hata wanadai kufanya miujiza na kufukuza roho waovu, je, hilo litathibitisha kwamba wao ni wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~21#Question:If people say Jesus sent them to preach, and they even claim to do miracles and cast out demons, will that prove that they belong to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~21#Answer:If people say Jesus sent them to preach, and they even claim to do miracles and cast out demons, will that prove that they belong to Jesus?-571702128
trans-unit.source: No. They must truly obey him from their hearts, not just claim to serve him. (21-23)
trans-unit.target: La, ni lazima wamtii kwa kweli kutoka moyoni mwao, si kudai tu kumtumikia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~21#Answer:If people say Jesus sent them to preach, and they even claim to do miracles and cast out demons, will that prove that they belong to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 7.22+What do you think a demon is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!7~22#Question:What do you think a demon is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a demon is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri roho mwovu ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~22#Question:What do you think a demon is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!7~22#Answer:What do you think a demon is?411550999
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The terms "evil spirit", "unclean spirit", and "demon" are used interchangeably in the New Testament. All of these terms refer to spiritual beings who serve as Satan's agents/Satan as his agents, being under his authority. These spiritual beings have power to oppress a human being and even to take control of him. (See "demon" in KBT in the "evil spirit, unclean spirit" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Neno muhimu: Maneno "roho mbaya", "roho mchafu", na "roho mwovu" yanatumiwa kwa njia tofauti katika Agano Jipya. Maneno haya yote yanarejelea viumbe wa kiroho ambao hutumikia kama mawakala wa Shetani / Shetani kama mawakala wake, wakiwa chini ya mamlaka yake. Viumbe hawa wa kiroho wana nguvu ya kumnyanyasa mwanadamu na hata kumdhibiti. (Tazama "roho mwovu" katika KBT katika "roho mbaya, roho mchafu" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!7~22#Answer:What do you think a demon is?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.6+What do you think a servant does?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~6#Question:What do you think a servant does?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a servant does?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtumishi hufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~6#Question:What do you think a servant does?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~6#Answer:What do you think a servant does?726346214
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A servant is a person who is required to work for another person and to obey him. A servant is one who is (usually) paid for his/her work. A slave is owned by his master, so he is not paid for working.
trans-unit.target: Mtumwa ni mtu anayehitajika kufanya kazi kwa mtu mwingine na kumtii. Mtumwa ni mtu ambaye (kawaida) analipwa kwa kazi yake. Mtumwa ni mali ya bwana wake, kwa hivyo hawalipiwi kwa kufanya kazi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~6#Answer:What do you think a servant does?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.7-9+What do you think is the reason that the centurion told Jesus that he obeyed his superiors and also that those whom he commanded obeyed his orders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~7#Question:What do you think is the reason that the centurion told Jesus that he obeyed his superiors and also that those whom he commanded obeyed his orders?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that the centurion told Jesus that he obeyed his superiors and also that those whom he commanded obeyed his orders?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini ofisa huyo alimwambia Yesu kwamba aliwatii wakuu wake na pia kwamba wale aliowaamuru walitii amri zake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~7#Question:What do you think is the reason that the centurion told Jesus that he obeyed his superiors and also that those whom he commanded obeyed his orders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~7#Answer:What do you think is the reason that the centurion told Jesus that he obeyed his superiors and also that those whom he commanded obeyed his orders?860161
trans-unit.source: He believed that Jesus had similar power to just speak and what he said would happen to the centurion's servant. He believed that Jesus did not need to walk to his house in order to heal his servant. He believed that Jesus could speak and cause his servant to be healed without first going near him. He believed that Jesus had power and authority to heal people. (7-9)
trans-unit.target: Aliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu sawa ya kusema tu na kile alichosema kitatokea kwa mtumishi wa yule jemadari. Aliamini kwamba Yesu hakuhitaji kutembea nyumbani kwake ili kumponya mtumishi wake. Aliamini kwamba Yesu angeweza kusema na kumfanya mtumishi wake aponywe bila kumkaribia kwanza. Aliamini kwamba Yesu alikuwa na nguvu na mamlaka ya kuponya watu. (7-9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~7#Answer:What do you think is the reason that the centurion told Jesus that he obeyed his superiors and also that those whom he commanded obeyed his orders?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.10-11+What is the reason that Jesus was so surprised?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~10#Question:What is the reason that Jesus was so surprised?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus was so surprised?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alishangaa sana?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~10#Question:What is the reason that Jesus was so surprised?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~10#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus was so surprised?816152241
trans-unit.source: Jesus was surprised because this Gentile man/non-Jew had demonstrated/shown that he believed in Jesus's power more than the Jews who had been taught about God all their lives. (10-11)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alishangaa kwa sababu mtu huyu wa Mataifa/asiye Myahudi alikuwa ameonyesha/kuonyesha kwamba aliamini katika nguvu za Yesu zaidi ya Wayahudi ambao walikuwa wamefundishwa juu ya Mungu maisha yao yote. (10-11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~10#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus was so surprised?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.11+Who do you think Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~11#Question:Who do you think Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Abrahamu, Isaka, na Yakobo walikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~11#Question:Who do you think Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~11#Answer:Who do you think Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were?1217639605
trans-unit.source: They were important ancestors of the Jews, who had lived many years/a long time before Jesus was on earth.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa mababu muhimu wa Wayahudi, walioishi miaka mingi/muda mrefu kabla ya Yesu kuja duniani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~11#Answer:Who do you think Abraham, Isaac and Jacob were?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.11+What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~11#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alizungumza juu ya karamu pamoja na Abrahamu, Isaka na Yakobo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~11#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~11#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?-1256226522
trans-unit.source: The Jews used to refer to/talk about the time of going to be with God and meeting with all of his people, who had previously died, as a great feast (time of fellowship). (See Isaiah 25:6.)
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi walikuwa wakirejelea/kuzungumza juu ya wakati wa kwenda kuwa na Mungu na kukutana na watu wake wote, ambao hapo awali walikuwa wamekufa, kama sikukuu kubwa (wakati wa ushirika). (Ona Isaya 25:6.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~11#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke of a feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.11+What do you think that Jesus meant by people coming from the east and the west to the feast in God's kingdom?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~11#Question:What do you think that Jesus meant by people coming from the east and the west to the feast in God's kingdom?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that Jesus meant by people coming from the east and the west to the feast in God's kingdom?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba watu watakuja kutoka mashariki na magharibi kwenye karamu katika ufalme wa Mungu?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~11#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by people coming from the east and the west to the feast in God's kingdom?2079500894
trans-unit.source: He was talking about many non-Jews from different parts of the world (also) being part of God's chosen ones and being a part of his kingdom. (11)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya wasio Wayahudi wengi kutoka sehemu tofauti za ulimwengu (pia) kuwa sehemu ya wateule wa Mungu na kuwa sehemu ya ufalme wake. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~11#Answer:What do you think that Jesus meant by people coming from the east and the west to the feast in God's kingdom?

trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus refer when he said "the sons of (—Or—subjects of) the kingdom"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akirejelea nani aliposema "wana wa (Auwatii wa) ufalme"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~12#Question:To whom did Jesus refer when he said "the sons of (—Or—subjects of) the kingdom"?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.21+What do you think about the other man who was one of Jesus disciples? How long do you think it might have been before he returned to follow Jesus, if Jesus had said it was all right for him to go first and do what he wanted to do? Then he could return to become Jesus's disciple.

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~21#Question:What do you think about the other man who was one of Jesus disciples? How long do you think it might have been before he returned to follow Jesus, if Jesus had said it was all right for him to go first and do what he wanted to do? Then he could return to become Jesus's disciple.
trans-unit.source: What do you think about the other man who was one of Jesus disciples? How long do you think it might have been before he returned to follow Jesus, if Jesus had said it was all right for him to go first and do what he wanted to do? Then he could return to become Jesus's disciple.
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ingechukua muda gani kwa mwanafunzi huyo mwingine wa Yesu kurudi ili amfuate Yesu, ikiwa Yesu angesema kwamba ni sawa kwa mwanafunzi huyo kwenda kwanza na kufanya kile alichotaka? Kisha angerudi na kuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~21#Question:What do you think about the other man who was one of Jesus disciples? How long do you think it might have been before he returned to follow Jesus, if Jesus had said it was all right for him to go first and do what he wanted to do? Then he could return to become Jesus's disciple.

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~21#Answer:What do you think about the other man who was one of Jesus disciples? How long do you think it might have been before he returned to follow Jesus, if Jesus had said it was all right for him to go first and do what he wanted to do? Then he could return to become Jesus's disciple.-1384642152
trans-unit.source: It seems quite clear that the man wanted to stay close to/around home until after his father died and was buried, not just stay home to bury someone who had already died. That could have delayed his following Jesus for a very long time. (21)
trans-unit.target: Inaonekana wazi kabisa kwamba mtu huyo alitaka kukaa karibu na/karibu na nyumbani mpaka baada ya baba yake kufa na kuzikwa, sio kukaa tu nyumbani kumzika mtu ambaye tayari alikuwa amekufa. Hiyo inaweza kuwa ilichelewesha kumfuata Yesu kwa muda mrefu sana. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~21#Answer:What do you think about the other man who was one of Jesus disciples? How long do you think it might have been before he returned to follow Jesus, if Jesus had said it was all right for him to go first and do what he wanted to do? Then he could return to become Jesus's disciple.

group.id: Q:MAT 8.22+What did Jesus mean when he said to let dead people bury their own dead people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~22#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said to let dead people bury their own dead people?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he said to let dead people bury their own dead people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema waache wafu wawazike wafu wao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~22#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said to let dead people bury their own dead people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~22#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said to let dead people bury their own dead people?694171849
trans-unit.source: He meant that people who did not truly follow God, could attend to their parents and eventually bury them when they died. The person to whom Jesus was speaking was united/devoted/loyal/faithful to God and could serve by following Jesus. His/That service was more important than his staying home. (22)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba watu ambao hawakumfuata Mungu kweli, wangeweza kuwatunza wazazi wao na hatimaye kuwazika walipokufa. Mtu ambaye Yesu alikuwa anazungumza naye alikuwa ameunganishwa/mwenye kujitolea/mshikamanifu/mwaminifu kwa Mungu na angeweza kumtumikia kwa kumfuata Yesu. Huduma yake ilikuwa muhimu zaidi kuliko kukaa kwake nyumbani. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~22#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said to let dead people bury their own dead people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~29#Answer:About what were those two men concerned?1964954101
trans-unit.source: (Actually it was the demons in the men speaking through them.) They were concerned that Jesus had come to disturb them before the time set for demons to be punished. (29)
trans-unit.target: (Kwa kweli walikuwa mashetani katika watu ambao walikuwa wakizungumza kupitia wao.) Walikuwa na wasiwasi kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekuja kuwasumbua kabla ya wakati uliowekwa wa mashetani kuadhibiwa. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~29#Answer:About what were those two men concerned?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.30-31+When Jesus was going to drive the demons out of those two men, where did the demons ask to go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~30#Question:When Jesus was going to drive the demons out of those two men, where did the demons ask to go?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus was going to drive the demons out of those two men, where did the demons ask to go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipokuwa karibu kuwafukuza roho waovu hao wawili, roho hao waovu waliomba waende wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~30#Question:When Jesus was going to drive the demons out of those two men, where did the demons ask to go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~30#Answer:When Jesus was going to drive the demons out of those two men, where did the demons ask to go?1085667546
trans-unit.source: The demons asked him to allow them to go out among a herd of pigs that was a short distance from there. (30-31)
trans-unit.target: Roho waovu walimsihi awape ruhusa waende ndani ya kundi la nguruwe waliokuwa umbali mfupi kutoka hapo (30-31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~30#Answer:When Jesus was going to drive the demons out of those two men, where did the demons ask to go?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.32+Did Jesus give them permission to go among the pigs?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~32#Question:Did Jesus give them permission to go among the pigs?
trans-unit.source: Did Jesus give them permission to go among the pigs?
trans-unit.target: Je, Yesu aliwapa ruhusa ya kwenda miongoni mwa nguruwe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~32#Question:Did Jesus give them permission to go among the pigs?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~32#Answer:Did Jesus give them permission to go among the pigs?123630934
trans-unit.source: Yes, he did. (32)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, alifanya hivyo. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~32#Answer:Did Jesus give them permission to go among the pigs?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.32+Then what happened?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~32#Question:Then what happened?
trans-unit.source: Then what happened?
trans-unit.target: Kisha ni nini kilichotokea?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~32#Question:Then what happened?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~32#Answer:Then what happened?-2086347554
trans-unit.source: The demons caused the pigs to run down a steep bank into the Sea of Galilee and drown. (32)
trans-unit.target: Mashetani hao walifanya nguruwe hao waruke kwa kasi kutoka kwenye ukingo wa ziwa kuingia Bahari ya Galilaya na kuzama. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~32#Answer:Then what happened?

group.id: Q:MAT 8.33-34+What happened after the pigs drowned?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!8~33#Question:What happened after the pigs drowned?
trans-unit.source: What happened after the pigs drowned?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya wale nguruwe kufa maji?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~33#Question:What happened after the pigs drowned?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!8~33#Answer:What happened after the pigs drowned?-661789190
trans-unit.source: The people, who took care of the pigs, ran to the town and told the people there what had happened. Many people came from the town and pleaded with Jesus to leave their area. (33-34)
trans-unit.target: Wale waliokuwa wakichunga wale nguruwe wakakimbia, wakaenda mjini, wakawaambia watu habari za tukio hilo. Watu wengi wa mji ule wakaja, wakamsihi Yesu aondoke katika nchi yao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!8~33#Answer:What happened after the pigs drowned?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.1-8+What did Jesus do for a paralyzed man in these verses?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do for a paralyzed man in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimfanyia nini mtu aliyepooza katika mistari hii?

trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu alienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~1#Question:Then where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~1#Answer:Then where did Jesus go?-1258863843
trans-unit.source: Jesus went to his home town. (1)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda kwenye mji wa kwao. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~1#Answer:Then where did Jesus go?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.2+What did Jesus notice about the man and his companions before he healed him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~2#Question:What did Jesus notice about the man and his companions before he healed him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus notice about the man and his companions before he healed him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliona nini kuhusu mtu huyo na waandamani wake kabla ya kumponya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~2#Question:What did Jesus notice about the man and his companions before he healed him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~2#Answer:What did Jesus notice about the man and his companions before he healed him?-129682868
trans-unit.source: Jesus noticed that the man and his companions believed that Jesus could and would heal/forgive and heal the man. (2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliona kwamba mtu huyo na wenzake waliamini kwamba Yesu angeweza na angeweza kumponya/kusamehe na kumponya mtu huyo. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~2#Answer:What did Jesus notice about the man and his companions before he healed him?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.2+What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~2#Question:What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini mtu aliyepooza?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~2#Question:What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~2#Answer:What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man?-1804059210
trans-unit.source: Jesus said, "Be encouraged. I forgive your sins." (2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema, "Jipe moyo. Nimekusamehe dhambi zako". (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~2#Answer:What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.3+What did the teachers of the law think when Jesus said that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~3#Question:What did the teachers of the law think when Jesus said that?
trans-unit.source: What did the teachers of the law think when Jesus said that?
trans-unit.target: Walimu wa sheria walifikiri nini Yesu aliposema hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~3#Question:What did the teachers of the law think when Jesus said that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~3#Answer:What did the teachers of the law think when Jesus said that?649914554
trans-unit.source: They thought that Jesus was acting wrongly and sinfully, as though he could take God's place and forgive sin. (3)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba Yesu alikuwa akitenda isivyofaa na kwa dhambi, kana kwamba angeweza kuchukua mahali pa Mungu na kusamehe dhambi. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~3#Answer:What did the teachers of the law think when Jesus said that?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.4+How could Jesus know their thoughts?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~4#Question:How could Jesus know their thoughts?
trans-unit.source: How could Jesus know their thoughts?
trans-unit.target: Yesu angeweza kujuaje mawazo yao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Question:How could Jesus know their thoughts?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:How could Jesus know their thoughts?-1595670090
trans-unit.source: Being God's son, Jesus knew everything. (4)
trans-unit.target: Akiwa Mwana wa Mungu, Yesu alijua kila kitu. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:How could Jesus know their thoughts?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.4+What did Jesus say about their refusing to realize that he could rightfully forgive the man sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~4#Question:What did Jesus say about their refusing to realize that he could rightfully forgive the man sins?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about their refusing to realize that he could rightfully forgive the man sins?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya kukataa kwao kutambua kwamba angeweza kwa haki kusamehe dhambi za mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Question:What did Jesus say about their refusing to realize that he could rightfully forgive the man sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:What did Jesus say about their refusing to realize that he could rightfully forgive the man sins?-939600998
trans-unit.source: He said that they had evil thoughts in their hearts. (4)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba walikuwa na mawazo maovu mioyoni mwao. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:What did Jesus say about their refusing to realize that he could rightfully forgive the man sins?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.4+What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~4#Question:What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?
trans-unit.source: What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?
trans-unit.target: Unapotumia neno "moyo" unamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Question:What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?-1253781270
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The most common use of the word "heart" in the Bible is to refer to the spiritual center or innermost part of a human being. In Hebrew and Greek, "heart" is most commonly associated with thoughts and ideas.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno: Katika Biblia neno "moyo" linatumiwa mara nyingi kurejelea kituo cha kiroho au sehemu ya ndani kabisa ya mwanadamu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~4#Note:What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?315764543
trans-unit.source: See "heart" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "moyo" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Note:What does it mean to you to talk about the "heart"?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.4+What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~4#Question:What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?
trans-unit.source: What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri walimu hao wa sheria walifanya kosa gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Question:What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?-1542040658
trans-unit.source: They refused to believe God's son when he was right there with them.
trans-unit.target: Walikataa kumwamini mwana wa Mungu alipokuwa pamoja nao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?293223873
trans-unit.source: They were accusing Jesus of wrongfully claiming divine authority to forgive.
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimshtaki Yesu kwa kudai kimakosa mamlaka ya kimungu ya kusamehe.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:What evil do you think those teachers of the law did?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.4-5+Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~4#Question:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?
trans-unit.source: Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alitarajia watu kujibu swali lake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Question:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~4#Alternate:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?-1594498838
trans-unit.source: Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alitarajia watu kujibu swali lake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Alternate:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~4#Alternate:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?938522236
trans-unit.source: Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer him?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alitarajia watu wamjibu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Alternate:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?-844491706
trans-unit.source: No, he did not.
trans-unit.target: La, hakufanya hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~4#Note:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?1012474137
trans-unit.source: Use this question only if the translated text uses a question for what Jesus says in verse 4 and/or verse 5.
trans-unit.target: Tumia swali hilo ikiwa tu maandishi yaliyotafsiriwa yanatumia swali kuhusu maneno ya Yesu katika mstari wa 4 na/au mstari wa 5.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Note:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~4#Note:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?-343414585
trans-unit.source: He asked those question(s) to make them start thinking. In verse 4 he was simply saying, with emphasis, that they should not think as they were. They should be willing to accept Jesus as one sent from God.
trans-unit.target: Aliuliza maswali hayo ili kuwafanya waanze kufikiri. Katika mstari wa 4 alikuwa akisema tu, kwa mkazo, kwamba hawapaswi kufikiri kama walivyokuwa. Wanapaswa kuwa tayari kumkubali Yesu kama yule aliyetumwa kutoka kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Note:Do you think Jesus expected the people to answer his question(s)?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.5+What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~4#Question:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?
trans-unit.target: Unaonaje kuhusu mstari wa 5? Yesu alikuwa akiwaambia nini kwa kuwauliza ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi kusema, "Ninasamehe dhambi zako", au "Simama utembee"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Question:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~4#Alternate:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?105082778
trans-unit.source: What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?
trans-unit.target: Unaonaje kuhusu mstari wa 5? Yesu alikuwa akiwaambia nini kwa kuwauliza ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi kusema, "Ninasamehe dhambi zako", au "Simama utembee"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Alternate:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~4#Alternate:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?405194346
trans-unit.source: What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akiwaambia nini kwa kuuliza ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi kusema, "Umesamehewa dhambi zako", au, "Simama, utembee"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Alternate:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~4#Answer:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?1262868869
trans-unit.source: In verse 5 he was teaching/informing/advising/showing them that to forgive sins or to heal were equally easy for him because he was the Son of God.
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 5 alikuwa akiwafundisha/kuwajulisha/kuwapa ushauri/kuwaonyesha kwamba kusamehe dhambi au kuponya ilikuwa rahisi kwake kwa sababu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Answer:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~4#Note:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?-398776894
trans-unit.source: It wasn't that one phrase was easier to say than the other phrase. Jesus demonstrated that he had power from God to heal the man. Therefore he had power to forgive sin.
trans-unit.target: Haikuwa kwamba sentensi moja ilikuwa rahisi kusema kuliko sentensi nyingine. Yesu alionyesha kwamba alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu kumponya mtu huyo. Kwa hiyo alikuwa na nguvu ya kusamehe dhambi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~4#Note:What do you think about verse 5? What was Jesus telling them by asking which was easier to say, "I forgive your sins," or "Get up and walk"?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.6-7+How did Jesus prove that he could forgive people's sins?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~6#Question:How did Jesus prove that he could forgive people's sins?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus prove that he could forgive people's sins?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alithibitishaje kwamba angeweza kusamehe dhambi za watu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~6#Question:How did Jesus prove that he could forgive people's sins?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~6#Answer:How did Jesus prove that he could forgive people's sins?1319983549
trans-unit.source: He proved to them that he could forgive sins because he had power from God/God's power to heal the man. (6-7)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonyesha kuwa anaweza kusamehe dhambi kwa sababu alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu/nguvu ya Mungu kumponya mtu huyo. (6-7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~6#Answer:How did Jesus prove that he could forgive people's sins?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.8+What do you think the crowd thought once Jesus had healed the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~8#Question:What do you think the crowd thought once Jesus had healed the man?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the crowd thought once Jesus had healed the man?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri umati ulifikiri nini baada ya Yesu kumponya mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~8#Question:What do you think the crowd thought once Jesus had healed the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~8#Answer:What do you think the crowd thought once Jesus had healed the man?1733993917
trans-unit.source: It sounds as though/as if they assumed that Jesus had power from God. But they did not understand that Jesus was also God. (8)
trans-unit.target: Inaonekana kana kwamba walifikiri kuwa Yesu alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu. Lakini hawakuelewa kuwa Yesu alikuwa pia Mungu. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~8#Answer:What do you think the crowd thought once Jesus had healed the man?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!9~9#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 9:9-13 Jesus called Matthew to follow him.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 9:9-13 Yesu alimwita Mathayo amfuate.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~9#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 9.9-13+What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~9#Question:What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?
trans-unit.source: What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?
trans-unit.target: Mathayo alifanya kazi ya aina gani kabla ya Yesu kumwita amfuate?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~9#Question:What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~9#Answer:What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?1044128602
trans-unit.source: He was a tax collector. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mkusanya-kodi. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~9#Answer:What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~9#Note:What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?688211844
trans-unit.source: The Jews thought that tax collectors were dishonest people because many of them charged/collected/took more tax than the government required, then kept the extra money for themselves. Also, people did not like them because they collected for the Roman government, which had occupied/taken over Israel by force.
trans-unit.target: Wayahudi walifikiri kwamba watoza ushuru walikuwa watu wasio waaminifu kwa sababu wengi wao walidai / kukusanya / kuchukua ushuru zaidi kuliko serikali ilihitaji, kisha wakaweka pesa za ziada kwa wenyewe. Pia, watu hawakuwapenda kwa sababu walikusanya kwa serikali ya Kirumi, ambayo ilikuwa imechukua / kuchukua Israeli kwa nguvu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~9#Note:What kind of work did Matthew do before Jesus called him to follow him?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.10-11+What did the Pharisees think about Jesus eating with tax collectors and others, whom the Pharisees called sinners?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~10#Question:What did the Pharisees think about Jesus eating with tax collectors and others, whom the Pharisees called sinners?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees think about Jesus eating with tax collectors and others, whom the Pharisees called sinners?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walifikiri nini juu ya Yesu kula pamoja na wakusanya - kodi na wengineo, ambao Mafarisayo waliwaita watenda - dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~10#Question:What did the Pharisees think about Jesus eating with tax collectors and others, whom the Pharisees called sinners?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~10#Answer:What did the Pharisees think about Jesus eating with tax collectors and others, whom the Pharisees called sinners?-1081669812
trans-unit.source: They thought that Jesus should not eat with them. (10-11)
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri kwamba Yesu hapaswi kula pamoja nao (10-11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~10#Answer:What did the Pharisees think about Jesus eating with tax collectors and others, whom the Pharisees called sinners?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.12+What is the reason that Jesus thought it was all right for him to mix with such people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~12#Question:What is the reason that Jesus thought it was all right for him to mix with such people?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus thought it was all right for him to mix with such people?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alifikiri kwamba ni sawa kuchangamana na watu kama hao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~12#Question:What is the reason that Jesus thought it was all right for him to mix with such people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~12#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus thought it was all right for him to mix with such people?-995938252
trans-unit.source: Jesus's idea was that, if people were bad, they needed help from God. (He referred to them as sick people needing a doctor.) (12)
trans-unit.target: Wazo la Yesu lilikuwa kwamba, ikiwa watu walikuwa wabaya, walihitaji msaada kutoka kwa Mungu. (Aliwaita kama wagonjwa wanaohitaji daktari.) (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~12#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus thought it was all right for him to mix with such people?
