trans-unit.source: Jesus talked about the/our need to be merciful to others, at that time, because the Pharisees were proud of doing all of the culturally right religious acts; but they were not kind to other people, including the sinners in their midst. Also they were trying to stop Jesus from being kind to those sinners. (Their religious acts included sacrificing animals.) (13)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumza juu ya/uhitaji wetu wa kuwa na huruma kwa wengine, wakati huo, kwa sababu Mafarisayo walijivunia kufanya vitendo vyote vya kidini vya kitamaduni; lakini hawakuwa wema kwa watu wengine, pamoja na wenye dhambi katikati yao. Pia walikuwa wakijaribu kumzuia Yesu kuwa mwema kwa wenye dhambi hao. (Matendo yao ya kidini yalijumuisha dhabihu za wanyama.) (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think is the reason that, right in the middle of this/his talk/teaching about his eating with sinners, Jesus talked about mercy being better than making sacrifices?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.13+What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~13#Question:What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu anaweza kuonyesha rehema kwa mwingine kwa njia gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Question:What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?1544417381
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: "Mercy" in the New Testament is an act of kindness by God or someone else toward people who are in need. The person (God or man) acts to relieve some kind of suffering or distress.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno: "Rehema" katika Agano Jipya ni tendo la fadhili na Mungu au mtu mwingine kwa watu ambao wanahitaji. Mtu (Mungu au mtu) anafanya kazi ili kupunguza aina fulani ya mateso au shida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~13#Note:What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?-38295105
trans-unit.source: See "mercy" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "rehema" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Note:What do you think it means for someone to show mercy to someone else?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.13+What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~13#Question:What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu anapojidhabihu, hilo linamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Question:What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?-77693959
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: "Sacrifice" is the religious act of making a gift to God, or to some other powerful spiritual being. The gift is given in order to establish, maintain, or restore a proper relationship between the sacrificer and the deity. Something is given up in order to achieve a purpose.
trans-unit.target: "Dhabihu" ni kitendo cha kidini cha kumpa zawadi Mungu, au mtu mwingine mwenye nguvu ya kiroho. Zawadi hiyo hutolewa ili kuanzisha, kudumisha, au kurejesha uhusiano sahihi kati ya mtoaji na mungu. Kitu fulani kinatolewa ili kufikia kusudi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~13#Note:What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?1051220597
trans-unit.source: See "sacrifice" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "dhabihu" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Note:What do you think it means when someone makes a sacrifice?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.13+What do you think is the reason that Jesus told them that he came to call sinners and not righteous people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~13#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus told them that he came to call sinners and not righteous people?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus told them that he came to call sinners and not righteous people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia kwamba alikuja kuwaita watenda-dhambi wala si watu waadilifu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus told them that he came to call sinners and not righteous people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus told them that he came to call sinners and not righteous people?670840303
trans-unit.source: He said that because he came to help people who were not in/did not have a right relationship with God. (Also probably because the scribes and Pharisees (who were talking to him) called themselves "righteous people." They would not admit their need or come to ask him to forgive their sins.) (13)
trans-unit.target: Alisema hivyo kwa sababu alikuja kuwasaidia watu ambao hawakuwa na/walikuwa na uhusiano sahihi na Mungu. (Pia labda kwa sababu waandishi na Mafarisayo (waliokuwa wakizungumza naye) walijiita "watu waadilifu". Hawakukubali uhitaji wao au kuja kumwomba awasamehe dhambi zao.) (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus told them that he came to call sinners and not righteous people?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.13+What did Jesus want the scribes and Pharisees to learn?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~13#Question:What did Jesus want the scribes and Pharisees to learn?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus want the scribes and Pharisees to learn?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka waandishi na Mafarisayo wajifunze nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Question:What did Jesus want the scribes and Pharisees to learn?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~13#Answer:What did Jesus want the scribes and Pharisees to learn?-74481614
trans-unit.source: He wanted them to learn that God wants them to have compassion on others, rather than giving gifts to him. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka wajifunze kwamba Mungu anataka wawe na huruma kwa wengine, badala ya kumpa zawadi. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~13#Answer:What did Jesus want the scribes and Pharisees to learn?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.15+What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the bridegroom being taken away from his friends?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~15#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the bridegroom being taken away from his friends?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the bridegroom being taken away from his friends?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba bwana-arusi aliondolewa kutoka kwa marafiki wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~15#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the bridegroom being taken away from his friends?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~15#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the bridegroom being taken away from his friends?66931208
trans-unit.source: He was telling them what would happen to him. He used the figure of a bridegroom to refer to himself. Then he explained to/told them that there would be a reason for his disciples to fast when he was taken away from them. (15)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kile ambacho kitampata. Alitumia mfano wa bwana harusi kujihusu mwenyewe. Kisha akawaeleza/akawaambia kwamba kutakuwa na sababu kwa wanafunzi wake kufunga wakati atakapoondolewa kutoka kwao. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~15#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the bridegroom being taken away from his friends?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.15+What do you think is the reason that Jesus had taught his disciples about when to fast and when not to fast?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~15#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus had taught his disciples about when to fast and when not to fast?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus had taught his disciples about when to fast and when not to fast?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwafundisha wanafunzi wake kuhusu wakati wa kufunga na wakati wa kutofunga?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~15#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus had taught his disciples about when to fast and when not to fast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~15#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus had taught his disciples about when to fast and when not to fast?1511630823
trans-unit.source: Probably he had taught them not to just follow traditions without thinking about what they were doing. They should fast when there was a reason to fast. (15)
trans-unit.target: Labda alikuwa amewafundisha wasifuate tu mila bila kufikiria kile wanachofanya. Wanapaswa kufunga wakati kuna sababu ya kufunga. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~15#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus had taught his disciples about when to fast and when not to fast?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.16+What did Jesus say is one thing that people do not do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~16#Question:What did Jesus say is one thing that people do not do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say is one thing that people do not do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni jambo gani moja ambalo watu hawafanyi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~16#Question:What did Jesus say is one thing that people do not do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~16#Answer:What did Jesus say is one thing that people do not do?-1366071685
trans-unit.source: He said that people do not repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu hawatengenezi vazi la zamani kwa kipande cha kitambaa kipya. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~16#Answer:What did Jesus say is one thing that people do not do?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.16-17+Do people you know sometimes repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~16#Question:Do people you know sometimes repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth?
trans-unit.source: Do people you know sometimes repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth?
trans-unit.target: Je! watu unaowajua nyakati nyingine hurekebisha vazi la zamani kwa kipande cha kitambaa kipya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~16#Question:Do people you know sometimes repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~16#Note:Do people you know sometimes repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth?-339335180
trans-unit.source: Check for possible mismatch with local practice. At least Jesus and his hearers did not usually patch new cloth onto old cloth.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kama kuna uwezekano wa kutopatana na desturi ya mahali hapo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~16#Note:Do people you know sometimes repair an old garment with a piece of new cloth?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.17+What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~17#Question:What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?
trans-unit.source: What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?
trans-unit.target: Ni jambo gani la pili ambalo Yesu alisema watu hawapaswi kufanya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~17#Question:What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~17#Answer:What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?11213032
trans-unit.source: He said that they did not put new wine in an old goatskin (old leather bottle). (17)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba hawakuweka divai mpya katika viriba vya zamani vya ngozi ya mbuzi (vijiko vya zamani vya ngozi). (17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~17#Answer:What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!9~17#Note:What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?1225833389
trans-unit.source: Check that the point of the illustration itself is clear. When someone seals new wine in a non-pliable leather container, the wine will swell while fermenting. That will cause the container to break and result in a total loss of the contents/wine.
trans-unit.target: Angalia kwamba hoja ya mfano yenyewe ni wazi. Mtu akiweka divai mpya katika chombo cha ngozi kisichoweza kukunjwa, divai itavimba wakati wa kuchacha. Hiyo itasababisha chombo kuvunjika na kusababisha upotezaji kamili wa yaliyomo / divai.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~17#Note:What was the second thing Jesus said people do not do?

trans-unit.source: He taught them that his teachings could not be a part of their old teachings/traditions/traditional system. They needed to change what they believed and also to change their way of worshipping God. (16-17)
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha kwamba mafundisho yake hayangeweza kuwa sehemu ya mafundisho yao ya zamani/mapokeo/mfumo wa jadi. Walihitaji kubadilisha kile walichokiamini na pia kubadilisha njia yao ya kumwabudu Mungu (16-17).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~16#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus spoke here about cloth, and about the wine and about hardened leather containers/bottles? What was he teaching the people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~18#Answer:Did he believe that Jesus could do that?-1807169668
trans-unit.source: Yes. We know that he did because he said, "Put your hand on her and she will live." (18)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. Twajua kwamba alifanya hivyo kwa sababu alisema, "Uweke mkono wako juu yake naye ataishi". (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~18#Answer:Did he believe that Jesus could do that?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.20+What happened as Jesus and his disciples were walking along the road to the ruler's house?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~20#Question:What happened as Jesus and his disciples were walking along the road to the ruler's house?
trans-unit.source: What happened as Jesus and his disciples were walking along the road to the ruler's house?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakitembea barabarani kuelekea nyumba ya mtawala huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~20#Question:What happened as Jesus and his disciples were walking along the road to the ruler's house?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~20#Answer:What happened as Jesus and his disciples were walking along the road to the ruler's house?-714483340
trans-unit.source: A woman, who had a bleeding problem for twelve years, came up behind Jesus and touched him. (20)
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke mmoja, aliyekuwa na tatizo la kutokwa damu kwa miaka kumi na miwili, alimkaribia Yesu kutoka nyuma na kumgusa. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~20#Answer:What happened as Jesus and his disciples were walking along the road to the ruler's house?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.21+What is the reason that she touched him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~21#Question:What is the reason that she touched him?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that she touched him?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini alimgusa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~21#Question:What is the reason that she touched him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~21#Answer:What is the reason that she touched him?-21973431
trans-unit.source: She touched him because she thought that, if she could just touch him, he would make her well again. (21)
trans-unit.target: Alimgusa kwa sababu alifikiri kwamba, ikiwa angeweza kumgusa tu, angemponya tena.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~21#Answer:What is the reason that she touched him?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.22+What did Jesus say to her when she touched him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~22#Question:What did Jesus say to her when she touched him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to her when she touched him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia nini mwanamke huyo alipomgusa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~22#Question:What did Jesus say to her when she touched him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say to her when she touched him?2033092807
trans-unit.source: He told her to be encouraged. Because she believed in him, he had made her well. (22)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia awe na moyo mkuu. Kwa sababu alimwamini, alikuwa amemponya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~22#Answer:What did Jesus say to her when she touched him?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.22+Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~22#Question:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?
trans-unit.source: Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?
trans-unit.target: Je, alikuwa na matatizo mengine ya (kimatibabu/afya) baada ya hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~22#Question:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~22#Alternate:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?871118982
trans-unit.source: Did she have any more (medical) problems after that?
trans-unit.target: Je, alikuwa na matatizo mengine ya (kisaikolojia) baada ya hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~22#Alternate:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~22#Alternate:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?1118253076
trans-unit.source: Did she have any more (health) problems after that?
trans-unit.target: Je, alikuwa na matatizo mengine ya (afya) baada ya hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~22#Alternate:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~22#Answer:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?-694551924
trans-unit.source: No. She was healed right away/immediately/at once. (22)
trans-unit.target: Hapana. Aliponya mara moja.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~22#Answer:Did she have any more (medical/health) problems after that?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.23+When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, who was there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~23#Question:When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, who was there?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, who was there?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipofika nyumbani kwa mtawala huyo, ni nani waliokuwapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~23#Question:When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, who was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~23#Answer:When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, who was there?-1125070184
trans-unit.source: Flute players and a noisy crowd of people were there. (23)
trans-unit.target: Waimbaji wa filimbi na umati wenye kelele walikuwapo. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~23#Answer:When Jesus arrived at the ruler's house, who was there?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.23+What do you think was the reason that they were there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~23#Question:What do you think was the reason that they were there?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that they were there?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri walikuwa huko kwa sababu gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~23#Question:What do you think was the reason that they were there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~23#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were there?-537965340
trans-unit.source: They were there because they had come to mourn the death of the little girl. (This is implied by the Jewish/Jews' cultural practice of having flute players come to play their flutes as a part of the/their mourning (ceremony) for a dead relative.) (23)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa huko kwa sababu walikuwa wamekuja kuomboleza kifo cha msichana mdogo. (Hii inaelezewa na utamaduni wa Kiyahudi / Wayahudi wa kuwa na wachezaji wa filimbi kuja kucheza filimbi zao kama sehemu ya maombolezo yao (sherehe) kwa jamaa aliyekufa.) (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~23#Answer:What do you think was the reason that they were there?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.24+What is the reason that the crowd laughed at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~24#Question:What is the reason that the crowd laughed at Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the crowd laughed at Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini umati ulimcheka Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~24#Question:What is the reason that the crowd laughed at Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~24#Answer:What is the reason that the crowd laughed at Jesus?1036346311
trans-unit.source: They laughed because he said that the girl was not dead, but (only) asleep. They knew she was dead. (24)
trans-unit.target: Wakamcheka kwa kuwa alisema: Huyu hakufa, bali amelala tu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~24#Answer:What is the reason that the crowd laughed at Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.24+What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~24#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu (aliweza) kusema kwamba msichana alikuwa amelala wakati alikuwa (kweli/tayari) amekufa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~24#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~24#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?-816929806
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really) dead?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu (aliweza) kusema kwamba msichana huyo alikuwa amelala usingizi alipokuwa (kwa kweli) amekufa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~24#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!9~24#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?-1118594943
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (already) dead?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu (labda) alisema kwamba msichana huyo alikuwa amelala usingizi alipokuwa (tayari) amekufa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~24#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~24#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?1807540892
trans-unit.source: He knew her condition was temporary, since he was at the point of bringing/about to bring her back to life. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alijua hali yake ilikuwa ya muda tu, kwa kuwa alikuwa karibu kumrudisha kwenye uhai. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~24#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus (might have) said that the girl was sleeping when she was (really/already) dead?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.25+What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~25#Question:What did Jesus do then?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do then?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~25#Question:What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~25#Answer:What did Jesus do then?508030186
trans-unit.source: He went inside/in the house/to her bedside and took her hand; and she came back to life. (25)
trans-unit.target: Aliingia ndani/katika nyumba/kando ya kitanda chake na kumshika mkono; na akafufuka. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~25#Answer:What did Jesus do then?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!9~27#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 9:27-34 Jesus healed two blind men and he also healed a man who could not talk so that he could speak.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 9:27-34 Yesu aliwaponya wanaume wawili vipofu na pia alimponya mtu aliyekuwa bubu ili aweze kuzungumza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 9.27-34+What miracles did Jesus do in this section?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~27#Question:What miracles did Jesus do in this section?
trans-unit.source: What miracles did Jesus do in this section?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya miujiza gani katika sehemu hii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Question:What miracles did Jesus do in this section?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~27#Answer:What miracles did Jesus do in this section?-1517383010
trans-unit.source: He made two blind men able to see and he made a man, who was unable to speak, able to speak.
trans-unit.target: Aliwawezesha vipofu wawili kuona na bubu mmoja kusema.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Answer:What miracles did Jesus do in this section?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.27+Who followed Jesus as he walked along the road?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~27#Question:Who followed Jesus as he walked along the road?
trans-unit.source: Who followed Jesus as he walked along the road?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomfuata Yesu alipokuwa akitembea barabarani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Question:Who followed Jesus as he walked along the road?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~27#Answer:Who followed Jesus as he walked along the road?-1100449423
trans-unit.source: Two blind men followed him. (27)
trans-unit.target: Vipofu wawili walimfuata. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Answer:Who followed Jesus as he walked along the road?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.27+What did they want?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~27#Question:What did they want?
trans-unit.source: What did they want?
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wanataka nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Question:What did they want?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~27#Answer:What did they want?-1645102361
trans-unit.source: The two blind men wanted Jesus to take pity on them and heal them (of their blindness). (27)
trans-unit.target: Vipofu wawili walimwomba Yesu awahurumie na awaponye. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Answer:What did they want?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.27+What do you think is the reason that they called him "Son of David"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~27#Question:What do you think is the reason that they called him "Son of David"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that they called him "Son of David"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini walimwita "Mwana wa Daudi"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Question:What do you think is the reason that they called him "Son of David"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~27#Answer:What do you think is the reason that they called him "Son of David"?927344683
trans-unit.source: They were identifying him as the descendant of King David, the one who would be the Anointed one (the Messiah) promised in the Old Testament. (27)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakimtambulisha kuwa mzao wa Mfalme Daudi, yule ambaye angekuwa Mtiwa-Mafuta (Masihi) aliyeahidiwa katika Agano la Kale. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~27#Answer:What do you think is the reason that they called him "Son of David"?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.28+What did Jesus ask them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~28#Question:What did Jesus ask them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza maswali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~28#Question:What did Jesus ask them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~28#Answer:What did Jesus ask them?-390545569
trans-unit.source: He asked them if they believed that he was able to heal them. (28)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kama waliamini kwamba angeweza kuwaponya. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~28#Answer:What did Jesus ask them?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.28+Did they believe that he was able to heal them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~28#Question:Did they believe that he was able to heal them?
trans-unit.source: Did they believe that he was able to heal them?
trans-unit.target: Je, waliamini kwamba angewaponya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~28#Question:Did they believe that he was able to heal them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~28#Answer:Did they believe that he was able to heal them?575064274
trans-unit.source: Yes. They believed that Jesus would/could heal them. (28)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo. waliamini kwamba Yesu angeweza kuwaponya. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~28#Answer:Did they believe that he was able to heal them?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.29-30+What did Jesus do to make them able to see?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~29#Question:What did Jesus do to make them able to see?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do to make them able to see?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini ili kuwawezesha kuona?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~29#Question:What did Jesus do to make them able to see?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~29#Answer:What did Jesus do to make them able to see?-1400180438
trans-unit.source: He touched their eyes. (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Aligusa macho yao (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~29#Answer:What did Jesus do to make them able to see?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.30+What did Jesus tell them after he healed them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~30#Question:What did Jesus tell them after he healed them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell them after he healed them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini baada ya kuwaponya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~30#Question:What did Jesus tell them after he healed them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~30#Answer:What did Jesus tell them after he healed them?-807818323
trans-unit.source: He told them not to let anyone know what he had done for them. (30)
trans-unit.target: Akawaamuru wasimwambie mtu ye yote habari ya jambo hili alilowatendea. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~30#Answer:What did Jesus tell them after he healed them?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.31+Did they obey what he said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~31#Question:Did they obey what he said?
trans-unit.source: Did they obey what he said?
trans-unit.target: Je, walitii alichosema?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~31#Question:Did they obey what he said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~31#Answer:Did they obey what he said?824215972
trans-unit.source: No. They told people around the whole area. (31)
trans-unit.target: Lakini wao wakaeneza habari hii katika nchi ile yote.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~31#Answer:Did they obey what he said?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.32+What was wrong with the man they brought to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~32#Question:What was wrong with the man they brought to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What was wrong with the man they brought to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume aliyetumwa kwa Yesu alikuwa na tatizo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~32#Question:What was wrong with the man they brought to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~32#Answer:What was wrong with the man they brought to Jesus?-1668521688
trans-unit.source: He was demon possessed and could not speak. (32)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amepagawa na pepo na hakuweza kusema. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~32#Answer:What was wrong with the man they brought to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.32-34+Who made the demon leave the man so that he was able to speak again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~32#Question:Who made the demon leave the man so that he was able to speak again?
trans-unit.source: Who made the demon leave the man so that he was able to speak again?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyemfanya roho mwovu amtemke mtu huyo ili aweze kuongea tena?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~32#Question:Who made the demon leave the man so that he was able to speak again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~32#Answer:Who made the demon leave the man so that he was able to speak again?536451540
trans-unit.source: Jesus did. (This is implied from the reason they gave for bringing the man to Jesus. It is also implied by/as the cause of the Pharisees false complaint against Jesus in verse 34.)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya hivyo. (Hili linaelezwa kutokana na sababu waliyotoa kwa kumleta mtu huyo kwa Yesu. Pia linaelezwa na/kama sababu ya malalamiko ya uwongo ya Mafarisayo dhidi ya Yesu katika mstari wa 34.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~32#Answer:Who made the demon leave the man so that he was able to speak again?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.33+What did the crowd of people think when Jesus did that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~33#Question:What did the crowd of people think when Jesus did that?
trans-unit.source: What did the crowd of people think when Jesus did that?
trans-unit.target: Umati wa watu ulifikiri nini Yesu alipofanya hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~33#Question:What did the crowd of people think when Jesus did that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~33#Answer:What did the crowd of people think when Jesus did that?1443934264
trans-unit.source: They were amazed at the miracles Jesus was doing in their land. (33)
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa kwa miujiza ambayo Yesu alikuwa akifanya katika nchi yao. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~33#Answer:What did the crowd of people think when Jesus did that?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.34+By the miracles that Jesus did, were the Pharisees convinced that Jesus was the Messiah?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~34#Question:By the miracles that Jesus did, were the Pharisees convinced that Jesus was the Messiah?
trans-unit.source: By the miracles that Jesus did, were the Pharisees convinced that Jesus was the Messiah?
trans-unit.target: Je, Mafarisayo walisadiki kwamba Yesu alikuwa Mesiya kwa sababu ya miujiza aliyofanya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~34#Question:By the miracles that Jesus did, were the Pharisees convinced that Jesus was the Messiah?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~34#Answer:By the miracles that Jesus did, were the Pharisees convinced that Jesus was the Messiah?541235456
trans-unit.source: No. They said that Satan was helping him to drive out Satan's own demons. That was not true. (34)
trans-unit.target: Bali walisema kwamba Shet'ani humsaidia katika kuwafukuza mashet'ani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~34#Answer:By the miracles that Jesus did, were the Pharisees convinced that Jesus was the Messiah?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.35+What did Jesus do as he traveled around to all of the towns and villages of Galilee?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~35#Question:What did Jesus do as he traveled around to all of the towns and villages of Galilee?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do as he traveled around to all of the towns and villages of Galilee?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini alipokuwa akisafiri katika miji na vijiji vyote vya Galilaya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~35#Question:What did Jesus do as he traveled around to all of the towns and villages of Galilee?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~35#Answer:What did Jesus do as he traveled around to all of the towns and villages of Galilee?1122807324
trans-unit.source: He went to the synagogues and proclaimed the good news about God's new way of ruling over people. Also he healed all kinds of sicknesses which the people had. (35)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za ufalme wa Mungu, na kuponya kila ugonjwa na kila udhaifu miongoni mwa watu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~35#Answer:What did Jesus do as he traveled around to all of the towns and villages of Galilee?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.37+What do you think Jesus meant when he said that the harvest was plentiful, but there was a shortage of workers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~37#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that the harvest was plentiful, but there was a shortage of workers?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he said that the harvest was plentiful, but there was a shortage of workers?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba mavuno yalikuwa mengi lakini wafanya kazi walikuwa wachache?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~37#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that the harvest was plentiful, but there was a shortage of workers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~37#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that the harvest was plentiful, but there was a shortage of workers?-1170570891
trans-unit.source: He meant that there were many people ready to come under God's authority (enter Christ's messianic kingdom); but there were (far) too few people to instruct and lead them. (37)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba kulikuwa na watu wengi walio tayari kuja chini ya mamlaka ya Mungu (kuingia katika ufalme wa kimesiya wa Kristo); lakini kulikuwa na watu wachache sana (kupita kiasi) kuwafundisha na kuwaongoza. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~37#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he said that the harvest was plentiful, but there was a shortage of workers?

group.id: Q:MAT 9.38+To whom did Jesus mention this shortage of workers? What did he ask them to do about the shortage?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!9~38#Question:To whom did Jesus mention this shortage of workers? What did he ask them to do about the shortage?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus mention this shortage of workers? What did he ask them to do about the shortage?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaja upungufu huu wa wafanyakazi kwa nani? Aliwaomba wafanye nini juu ya upungufu huo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~38#Question:To whom did Jesus mention this shortage of workers? What did he ask them to do about the shortage?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!9~38#Answer:To whom did Jesus mention this shortage of workers? What did he ask them to do about the shortage?-1491681830
trans-unit.source: He mentioned the need to his disciples (probably many more than just the twelve); and he told them to pray to God (the overseer of the harvest) and ask him to send (out) the needed workers. (38)
trans-unit.target: Aliwataja wanafunzi wake (labda wengi zaidi ya wale kumi na wawili) kuwa wanahitaji kazi hiyo; na akawaambia wamwombe Mungu (mwangalizi wa mavuno) na kumwomba awatume (watume) wafanyakazi wanaohitajika. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!9~38#Answer:To whom did Jesus mention this shortage of workers? What did he ask them to do about the shortage?

trans-unit.source: This chapter is about Jesus instructing his disciples before he sent them out to teach and to heal people. (1-8)

trans-unit.source: When Jesus called his disciples to follow him, what do you think he told them that they would have power to do as they traveled around from village to village?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipowaita wanafunzi wake wamfuate, unafikiri aliwaambia wangeweza kufanya nini walipokuwa wakisafiri kutoka kijiji hadi kijiji?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~1#Question:When Jesus called his disciples to follow him, what do you think he told them that they would have power to do as they traveled around from village to village?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~1#Answer:When Jesus called his disciples to follow him, what do you think he told them that they would have power to do as they traveled around from village to village?-99616697
trans-unit.source: He told them that he was giving them the power to cast out demons and to cure all of the various kinds of sicknesses that people have. (1)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba alikuwa akiwapa nguvu za kufukuza roho waovu na kuponya aina zote za magonjwa mbalimbali ambayo watu wanayo. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~1#Answer:When Jesus called his disciples to follow him, what do you think he told them that they would have power to do as they traveled around from village to village?

trans-unit.target: Simoni, mwanafunzi wa Yesu, aliitwa pia kwa jina gani?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.4+The text mentions Judas Iscariot and says he betrayed Jesus. When do you think he did that, before or after this time when Jesus was sending them out?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~4#Question:The text mentions Judas Iscariot and says he betrayed Jesus. When do you think he did that, before or after this time when Jesus was sending them out?
trans-unit.source: The text mentions Judas Iscariot and says he betrayed Jesus. When do you think he did that, before or after this time when Jesus was sending them out?
trans-unit.target: Andiko hilo linamtaja Yuda Iskariote na kusema kwamba alimsaliti Yesu. Unafikiri alifanya hivyo wakati gani, kabla au baada ya wakati huu ambapo Yesu alikuwa akiwapeleka nje?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~4#Question:The text mentions Judas Iscariot and says he betrayed Jesus. When do you think he did that, before or after this time when Jesus was sending them out?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~4#Answer:The text mentions Judas Iscariot and says he betrayed Jesus. When do you think he did that, before or after this time when Jesus was sending them out?158163994
trans-unit.source: He betrayed Jesus at a later time. (It may need to read something like, "the one who later betrayed him".) (4)
trans-unit.target: Alimsaliti Yesu baadaye. (Inaweza kuhitaji kusomwa kitu kama, "yule ambaye baadaye alimsaliti".) (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~4#Answer:The text mentions Judas Iscariot and says he betrayed Jesus. When do you think he did that, before or after this time when Jesus was sending them out?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.5-6+When Jesus sent his disciples out to preach and to heal people, to what group of people did he want them to go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~5#Question:When Jesus sent his disciples out to preach and to heal people, to what group of people did he want them to go?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus sent his disciples out to preach and to heal people, to what group of people did he want them to go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alipowatuma wanafunzi wake wakahubiri na kuponya watu, alitaka waende kwa kikundi gani cha watu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~5#Question:When Jesus sent his disciples out to preach and to heal people, to what group of people did he want them to go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~5#Answer:When Jesus sent his disciples out to preach and to heal people, to what group of people did he want them to go?-214123703
trans-unit.source: He said that they should not go to the non-Jews/non-Jewish people nor to the Samaritans. At that time they were to go only to the people of Israel (the Jewish people). (5-6)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba hawapaswi kwenda kwa watu wasio Wayahudi/wasio Wayahudi wala kwa Wasamaria. Wakati huo walipaswa kwenda tu kwa watu wa Israeli (watu wa Kiyahudi). (5-6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~5#Answer:When Jesus sent his disciples out to preach and to heal people, to what group of people did he want them to go?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.7+What were they supposed to preach as they traveled around?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~7#Question:What were they supposed to preach as they traveled around?
trans-unit.source: What were they supposed to preach as they traveled around?
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuhubiri nini walipokuwa wakisafiri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~7#Question:What were they supposed to preach as they traveled around?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~7#Answer:What were they supposed to preach as they traveled around?1706467653
trans-unit.source: They were supposed to tell people that the time of God's ruling in a new way was near (or actually present). (7)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuwaambia watu kwamba wakati wa Mungu kutawala kwa njia mpya ulikuwa karibu (au kwa kweli ulikuwapo). (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~7#Answer:What were they supposed to preach as they traveled around?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.8+What else were they to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~8#Question:What else were they to do?
trans-unit.source: What else were they to do?
trans-unit.target: Wangefanya nini kingine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~8#Question:What else were they to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~8#Answer:What else were they to do?1347250887
trans-unit.source: They were to heal people, including those with leprosy. They were to raise people back to life, who had died, and to cast out the demons from people who were possessed by them. (8)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuwaponya watu, kutia ndani wenye ukoma. Walipaswa kuwafufua watu, waliokuwa wamekufa, na kuwafukuza roho waovu kutoka kwa watu waliokuwa wamepagawa nao. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~8#Answer:What else were they to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.9-10+What are some of the things the disciples were not to take with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~9#Question:What are some of the things the disciples were not to take with them?
trans-unit.source: What are some of the things the disciples were not to take with them?
trans-unit.target: Ni baadhi ya vitu gani ambavyo wanafunzi hawakupaswa kubeba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~9#Question:What are some of the things the disciples were not to take with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~9#Answer:What are some of the things the disciples were not to take with them?191821131
trans-unit.source: They were not to take money, no bag [for carrying food], nor were they to take/carry an extra outer garment or sandals or walking stick. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Hawakupaswa kuchukua fedha, wala mfuko [wa kubeba chakula], wala hawakupaswa kuchukua/kubeba vazi la nje la ziada au viatu au fimbo ya kutembea. (9-10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~9#Answer:What are some of the things the disciples were not to take with them?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.10+What is the reason that they were not to take such things with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~10#Question:What is the reason that they were not to take such things with them?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that they were not to take such things with them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini hawakupaswa kuchukua vitu hivyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~10#Question:What is the reason that they were not to take such things with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~10#Answer:What is the reason that they were not to take such things with them?1086893443
trans-unit.source: They were not to take such things with them because his disciples were going out to help/serve others, and those to whom they went to help/serve were to supply their needs. (10)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa na kuchukua vitu hivyo pamoja nao kwa sababu wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakienda kuwasaidia/kuwahudumia wengine, na wale ambao walienda kuwasaidia/kuwahudumia walipaswa kuandaa mahitaji yao. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~10#Answer:What is the reason that they were not to take such things with them?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.11+What sort of household were they to find to stay while they taught and healed in a particular area?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~11#Question:What sort of household were they to find to stay while they taught and healed in a particular area?
trans-unit.source: What sort of household were they to find to stay while they taught and healed in a particular area?
trans-unit.target: Walipata watu wa aina gani wa kukaa nao walipokuwa wakifundisha na kuponya katika eneo fulani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~11#Question:What sort of household were they to find to stay while they taught and healed in a particular area?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~11#Answer:What sort of household were they to find to stay while they taught and healed in a particular area?561934815
trans-unit.source: They were to find a household where the people were worthy to have them stay with them. They/Those would be people who realized the true value of the message the disciples were bringing. (11)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kupata nyumba ambapo watu waliostahili kuwa nao walipaswa kukaa nao. Wao/Wao wangekuwa watu ambao walitambua thamani ya kweli ya ujumbe ambao wanafunzi walikuwa wakileta. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~11#Answer:What sort of household were they to find to stay while they taught and healed in a particular area?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.12-13+What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~12#Question:What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?
trans-unit.source: What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuwasalimuje wenye nyumba walipoingia katika nyumba zao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~12#Question:What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~12#Answer:What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?-1357703912
trans-unit.source: They were to greet the home owners with "[May God give you] peace." (12-13)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuwasalimu wenye nyumba kwa kusema "Mungu na akupe [amani]". (12-13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~12#Answer:What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!10~12#Note:What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?-1634257837
trans-unit.source: It may be necessary to add the implied "may God give you" in the translation here.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ikawa lazima kuongeza maneno "Mungu akupe" katika tafsiri hapa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~12#Note:What sort of greeting (salute) were they to give to home owners when they entered their homes?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.12-14+What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~12#Question:What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wangefanya nini ikiwa nyumba au kijiji kingewakataa baada ya kuwapa salamu ifaayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~12#Question:What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~12#Answer:What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?-370086152
trans-unit.source: They were to realize that the greeting of God's peace, or "God will help you live well," was not the correct message for those people. Then they were to proceed to treat them as the Jews usually treated outsiders who did not follow God. They were to shake the dust of that home or village from their feet to demonstrate to those people that they were acting in a way that would not allow them to receive anything from God. (12-14)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kutambua kwamba salamu ya amani ya Mungu, au "Mungu atakusaidia kuishi vizuri", haikuwa ujumbe sahihi kwa watu hao. Kisha walipaswa kuendelea kuwatendea kama Wayahudi walivyowatendea watu wa nje ambao hawakumfuata Mungu. Walipaswa kutikisa vumbi la nyumba hiyo au kijiji kutoka miguuni mwao ili kuonyesha kwa watu hao kwamba walikuwa wakifanya kwa njia ambayo haingewaruhusu kupokea chochote kutoka kwa Mungu. (12-14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~12#Answer:What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!10~12#Note:What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?658282801
trans-unit.source: In the Jewish manner of speaking/way of talking about this they would speak/talk of the disciples "taking the peace back to themselves." In English we could say, "In that case, take back your greeting." We could demonstrate the seriousness of what they have done by shaking their dust off of our feet.
trans-unit.target: Katika njia ya Kiyahudi ya kusema/njia ya kusema juu ya hili wangesema/kuzungumza juu ya wanafunzi "kuchukua amani yao wenyewe". Katika Kiingereza tunaweza kusema, "Katika hali hiyo, chukua salamu yako". Tunaweza kuonyesha uzito wa kile walichokifanya kwa kutikisa vumbi lao kutoka miguuni mwetu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~12#Note:What did Jesus say that they were to do if the household or village rejected them after they had greeted them with the proper greeting?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.15+What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~15#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alitaja majiji ya Sodoma na Gomora hapa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~15#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~15#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?898189974
trans-unit.source: He mentioned those towns because his hearers knew, from the Old Testament, that the people of those two towns had rejected God's ways; and God had destroyed them. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alitaja miji hiyo kwa sababu wasikilizaji wake walijua, kutoka Agano la Kale, kwamba watu wa miji hiyo miwili walikuwa wamezikataa njia za Mungu; kwa hiyo Mungu aliiharibu. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~15#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!10~15#Note:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?1654576157
trans-unit.source: You may need to add implied information here so that it is more clearly understood what Jesus meant by speaking of Sodom and Gomorrah.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ukahitaji kuongeza habari iliyotajwa hapa ili ieleweke wazi zaidi yale ambayo Yesu alimaanisha aliposema juu ya Sodoma na Gomora.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~15#Note:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah here?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.16+What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep and wolves and about the disciples needing to be, in some ways, like snakes and doves?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~16#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep and wolves and about the disciples needing to be, in some ways, like snakes and doves?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep and wolves and about the disciples needing to be, in some ways, like snakes and doves?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kuhusu kondoo na mbwa - mwitu na kwamba wanafunzi wanahitaji kuwa kama nyoka na njiwa kwa njia fulani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~16#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep and wolves and about the disciples needing to be, in some ways, like snakes and doves?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~16#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep and wolves and about the disciples needing to be, in some ways, like snakes and doves?1030376924
trans-unit.source: He meant that some of the people, that they would see, would be (just) waiting to harm them. So for that reason they needed to have a good plan of action to escape danger. Snakes were viewed as having that ability, but they were not to harm anyone, just as doves do not harm anyone. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba baadhi ya watu, ambao wangewaona, wangekuwa (wakingojea tu) kuwadhuru. Kwa hiyo kwa sababu hiyo walihitaji kuwa na mpango mzuri wa hatua ili kutoroka hatari. Nyoka walionekana kuwa na uwezo huo, lakini hawakupaswa kumdhuru mtu yeyote, kama vile njiwa hawaumdhuru mtu yeyote. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~16#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he talked about sheep and wolves and about the disciples needing to be, in some ways, like snakes and doves?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.17+What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~17#Question:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?
trans-unit.target: Ni sababu gani aliyowaambia wanafunzi wake wawe waangalifu, na kuwa na nia nzuri tu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~17#Question:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!10~17#Alternate:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?488077273
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out and to have only good motives?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wawe macho na wawe na nia nzuri tu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~17#Alternate:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!10~17#Alternate:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?-364871305
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that he told the disciples to be careful and to have only good motives?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wawe waangalifu na wawe na nia nzuri tu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~17#Alternate:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~17#Answer:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?-47836374
trans-unit.source: They were to be careful because people would bring them before the local Jewish council meeting in the synagogue and have them beaten. (17)
trans-unit.target: Walipaswa kuwa waangalifu kwa sababu watu wangewapeleka mbele ya baraza la Wayahudi la mahali hapo lililokuwa likikutana katika sinagogi na kuwapiga. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~17#Answer:What is the reason that he told the disciples to watch out/be careful, and to have only good motives?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.18+What is the reason that people would take them to the courts of kings and governors?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~18#Question:What is the reason that people would take them to the courts of kings and governors?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that people would take them to the courts of kings and governors?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu wangewapeleka mbele ya wafalme na magavana?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~18#Question:What is the reason that people would take them to the courts of kings and governors?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~18#Answer:What is the reason that people would take them to the courts of kings and governors?382852317
trans-unit.source: They would be representing Jesus, so people who were hostile to Jesus would take them to court. (18)
trans-unit.target: Wangekuwa wakimwakilisha Yesu, kwa hiyo watu ambao walikuwa maadui wa Yesu wangewapeleka mahakamani. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~18#Answer:What is the reason that people would take them to the courts of kings and governors?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.18+What would happen when they were in court before the Kings?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~18#Question:What would happen when they were in court before the Kings?
trans-unit.source: What would happen when they were in court before the Kings?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini ambacho kingetukia wangekutana na Wafalme mahakamani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~18#Question:What would happen when they were in court before the Kings?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~18#Answer:What would happen when they were in court before the Kings?-1411036046
trans-unit.source: Kings, governors and people of the various nations would hear their testimony about Jesus as they spoke in court. (18)
trans-unit.target: Wafalme, magavana na watu wa mataifa mbalimbali wangesikia ushuhuda wao juu ya Yesu waliposema mahakamani. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~18#Answer:What would happen when they were in court before the Kings?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.19-20+What is the reason that they should not worry about what to say if they were (being) brought to court for serving Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~19#Question:What is the reason that they should not worry about what to say if they were (being) brought to court for serving Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that they should not worry about what to say if they were (being) brought to court for serving Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni sababu gani ambayo wao hawapaswi kuhangaika juu ya kile watakachosema ikiwa wangepelekwa mahakamani kwa ajili ya kumtumikia Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~19#Question:What is the reason that they should not worry about what to say if they were (being) brought to court for serving Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~19#Answer:What is the reason that they should not worry about what to say if they were (being) brought to court for serving Jesus?1857446538
trans-unit.source: They were not to be worried about what to say in the court session because God's spirit would help them to know what to say to the leaders/officials as they were in the act of speaking. (19-20)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kile walichosema katika kikao cha mahakama kwa sababu roho ya Mungu ingewasaidia kujua la kusema kwa viongozi/maofisa walipokuwa katika tendo la kusema. (19-20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~19#Answer:What is the reason that they should not worry about what to say if they were (being) brought to court for serving Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.21-25+After reading verses 21-25, can you think why some men would turn their own brothers over to the authorities to be killed? Or why some parents would take their own children and have them put to death? Or why some children would take their own parents and have them put to death?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~21#Question:After reading verses 21-25, can you think why some men would turn their own brothers over to the authorities to be killed? Or why some parents would take their own children and have them put to death? Or why some children would take their own parents and have them put to death?
trans-unit.source: After reading verses 21-25, can you think why some men would turn their own brothers over to the authorities to be killed? Or why some parents would take their own children and have them put to death? Or why some children would take their own parents and have them put to death?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kusoma mstari wa 21 hadi wa 25, je, unaweza kufikiria kwa nini watu fulani wangewaua ndugu zao wenyewe? au kwa nini wazazi fulani wangewaua watoto wao wenyewe? au kwa nini watoto fulani wangewaua wazazi wao wenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~21#Question:After reading verses 21-25, can you think why some men would turn their own brothers over to the authorities to be killed? Or why some parents would take their own children and have them put to death? Or why some children would take their own parents and have them put to death?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~21#Answer:After reading verses 21-25, can you think why some men would turn their own brothers over to the authorities to be killed? Or why some parents would take their own children and have them put to death? Or why some children would take their own parents and have them put to death?-99658345
trans-unit.source: Because family members, who did not love or believe/follow Jesus, would be so very much against those who believed/followed him that they would accuse them before leaders to have them killed. Local leaders had called Jesus, Beelzebub, that is Satan, so of course they would not like his believers/people/followers either. The believers/his people/followers needed to be ready to be rejected. (21-25)
trans-unit.target: Kwa sababu wanafamilia, ambao hawakumpenda au kumwamini/kumfuata Yesu, wangekuwa dhidi ya wale waliomwamini/kumfuata, kiasi kwamba wangewashtaki mbele ya viongozi ili wauawe. Viongozi wa mahali hapo walimwita Yesu, Beelzebuli, yaani Shetani, kwa hiyo bila shaka hawangempenda muumini/watu/wafuasi wake pia. Waumini/watu/wafuasi wake walihitaji kuwa tayari kukataliwa. (21-25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~21#Answer:After reading verses 21-25, can you think why some men would turn their own brothers over to the authorities to be killed? Or why some parents would take their own children and have them put to death? Or why some children would take their own parents and have them put to death?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.26-31+Whom were they not to fear?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~26#Question:Whom were they not to fear?
trans-unit.source: Whom were they not to fear?
trans-unit.target: Hawakupaswa kumwogopa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~26#Question:Whom were they not to fear?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~26#Answer:Whom were they not to fear?-269479544
trans-unit.source: They were not to fear those who called Jesus, Beelzebub, in verse 25. That is, they were not to fear the Jewish religious leaders.
trans-unit.target: Hawakupaswa kuwaogopa wale waliomwita Yesu, Beelzebuli, katika mstari wa 25. Yaani, hawakupaswa kuwaogopa viongozi wa kidini Wayahudi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~26#Answer:Whom were they not to fear?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.26+What is the reason that they should not fear?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~26#Question:What is the reason that they should not fear?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that they should not fear?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani hawapaswi kuogopa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~26#Question:What is the reason that they should not fear?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~26#Answer:What is the reason that they should not fear?2128502201
trans-unit.source: They were not to fear because God would judge those leaders for whatever they did to them, when/at the time he judges all people. He might even judge them before that final judgment day. (26)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa na hofu kwa sababu Mungu angewahukumu viongozi hao kwa chochote walichowafanyia, wakati/wakati atakapohukumu watu wote. Huenda hata angewahukumu kabla ya siku hiyo ya mwisho ya hukumu. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~26#Answer:What is the reason that they should not fear?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~27#Answer:About what was Jesus talking when he mentioned his speaking to them "in the dark" and "whispering in their ears"?

trans-unit.source: About what was he talking when he referred to their "speaking in the daylight" and "proclaiming from the house tops"?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~27#Question:About what was he talking when he referred to their "speaking in the daylight" and "proclaiming from the house tops"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~27#Answer:About what was he talking when he referred to their "speaking in the daylight" and "proclaiming from the house tops"?1334636938
trans-unit.source: He was saying that they needed to proclaim the message, that/which he had taught them privately, to the people publicly/out among the people so that everyone would hear it. (27)

trans-unit.target: Laiti angemhofu yule awezaye kuua na kuwasha moto! (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~28#Answer:Whom did he say they should fear?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alianza kuzungumza juu ya / kuzungumza juu ya shomoro?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~29#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!10~29#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?736273677
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of sparrows?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alianza kuzungumza kuhusu shomoro?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~29#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!10~29#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?1089887526
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus started talking about sparrows?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alianza kuzungumza kuhusu shomoro?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~29#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~29#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?-1804148112
trans-unit.source: He mentioned sparrows because he wanted them to know that God, who watches over rather insignificant parts of his creation, like sparrows, will certainly watch over his people. (29-31)
trans-unit.target: Aliwataja shomoro kwa sababu alitaka wajue kwamba Mungu, ambaye huangalia sehemu zisizo na maana za uumbaji wake, kama shomoro, hakika ataangalia watu wake. (29-31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~29#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus started speaking of/talking about sparrows?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~30#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus mentioned that fact here?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.32-33+After talking about how they should not be afraid of people, what was Jesus trying to make plain to his disciples in verses 32 and 33?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~32#Question:After talking about how they should not be afraid of people, what was Jesus trying to make plain to his disciples in verses 32 and 33?
trans-unit.source: After talking about how they should not be afraid of people, what was Jesus trying to make plain to his disciples in verses 32 and 33?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kusema juu ya jinsi ambavyo hawapaswi kuwaogopa watu, Yesu alikuwa akijaribu kuwaelewesha wanafunzi wake nini katika mstari wa 32 na 33?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~32#Question:After talking about how they should not be afraid of people, what was Jesus trying to make plain to his disciples in verses 32 and 33?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~32#Answer:After talking about how they should not be afraid of people, what was Jesus trying to make plain to his disciples in verses 32 and 33?-1643359541
trans-unit.source: They needed to acknowledge/confess/admit to being his people, so that he could state to the Father that they were his people. (32-33)
trans-unit.target: Walihitaji kukubali/kutoa/kukubali kuwa watu wake, ili aweze kumwambia Baba kwamba wao ni watu wake. (32-33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~32#Answer:After talking about how they should not be afraid of people, what was Jesus trying to make plain to his disciples in verses 32 and 33?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.34+People who lived at the time Jesus was here on earth were thinking that the Messiah's (Christ's) kingdom would bring peace on the earth. Did Jesus say that would happen since he had come?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~34#Question:People who lived at the time Jesus was here on earth were thinking that the Messiah's (Christ's) kingdom would bring peace on the earth. Did Jesus say that would happen since he had come?
trans-unit.source: People who lived at the time Jesus was here on earth were thinking that the Messiah's (Christ's) kingdom would bring peace on the earth. Did Jesus say that would happen since he had come?
trans-unit.target: Watu walioishi wakati Yesu alipokuwa hapa duniani walikuwa wakifikiri kwamba ufalme wa Mesiya (Kristo) ungeleta amani duniani. Je! Yesu alisema kwamba hilo lingetukia tangu awe amekuja?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~34#Question:People who lived at the time Jesus was here on earth were thinking that the Messiah's (Christ's) kingdom would bring peace on the earth. Did Jesus say that would happen since he had come?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~34#Answer:People who lived at the time Jesus was here on earth were thinking that the Messiah's (Christ's) kingdom would bring peace on the earth. Did Jesus say that would happen since he had come?-457257930
trans-unit.source: No. He said that his having come would cause strife. (34)
trans-unit.target: La, alisema kwamba kuja kwake kungesababisha ugomvi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~34#Answer:People who lived at the time Jesus was here on earth were thinking that the Messiah's (Christ's) kingdom would bring peace on the earth. Did Jesus say that would happen since he had come?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.34-36+What do you think it means to be at peace?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~34#Question:What do you think it means to be at peace?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to be at peace?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri amani ya kweli inamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~34#Question:What do you think it means to be at peace?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~34#Answer:What do you think it means to be at peace?-189487353
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: To be at peace is to have a mental or spiritual condition marked by freedom from disquieting or oppressive thoughts or emotions.
trans-unit.target: Kuangalia Neno Muhimu: Kuwa na amani ni kuwa na hali ya akili au ya kiroho inayoonyeshwa na kutokuwa na mawazo au hisia zenye kusumbua au zenye kuonea.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~34#Answer:What do you think it means to be at peace?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.35-36+About what sort of strife was Jesus talking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~35#Question:About what sort of strife was Jesus talking?
trans-unit.source: About what sort of strife was Jesus talking?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia mapambano ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~35#Question:About what sort of strife was Jesus talking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~35#Answer:About what sort of strife was Jesus talking?-1069987733
trans-unit.source: He said that people who were of the same household would be against one another [because some would choose to believe/follow him and the others would hate them]. (35-36)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba watu wa nyumba moja wangekuwa dhidi ya mmoja na mwenzake [kwa sababu wengine wangechagua kumwamini/kumfuata na wengine wangewachukia]. (35-36)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~35#Answer:About what sort of strife was Jesus talking?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.37-39+In such a case will it be all right with Jesus for people to do as their relatives do, who will have nothing to do with Jesus, to keep peace in the family?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~37#Question:In such a case will it be all right with Jesus for people to do as their relatives do, who will have nothing to do with Jesus, to keep peace in the family?
trans-unit.source: In such a case will it be all right with Jesus for people to do as their relatives do, who will have nothing to do with Jesus, to keep peace in the family?
trans-unit.target: Katika hali kama hiyo, je, itakuwa sawa kwa Yesu kwa watu kufanya kama vile watu wao wa ukoo, ambao hawatakuwa na uhusiano wowote na Yesu, wanavyofanya ili kudumisha amani katika familia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~37#Question:In such a case will it be all right with Jesus for people to do as their relatives do, who will have nothing to do with Jesus, to keep peace in the family?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~37#Answer:In such a case will it be all right with Jesus for people to do as their relatives do, who will have nothing to do with Jesus, to keep peace in the family?-2036709257
trans-unit.source: No, it will not be all right.
trans-unit.target: La, haitakuwa sawa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~37#Answer:In such a case will it be all right with Jesus for people to do as their relatives do, who will have nothing to do with Jesus, to keep peace in the family?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.37+Why will it not be all right?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~37#Question:Why will it not be all right?
trans-unit.source: Why will it not be all right?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini haitafaa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~37#Question:Why will it not be all right?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~37#Answer:Why will it not be all right?-1632419845
trans-unit.source: It will not be all right because Jesus said that, if people cared more for their family than for him, then they were not worthy of being one of his people/counted as his. (37)
trans-unit.target: Haitakuwa sawa kwa sababu Yesu alisema kwamba, ikiwa watu wanajali zaidi familia zao kuliko yeye, basi hawastahili kuwa mmoja wa watu wake/ kuhesabiwa kama wake. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~37#Answer:Why will it not be all right?

trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant in verse 38, when he said people needed to carry their cross and follow him?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~37#Note:What do you think Jesus meant in verse 38, when he said people needed to carry their cross and follow him?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.39+What did Jesus mean by what he said in verse 39?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~39#Question:What did Jesus mean by what he said in verse 39?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean by what he said in verse 39?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema maneno yaliyo katika mstari wa 39?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~39#Question:What did Jesus mean by what he said in verse 39?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~39#Answer:What did Jesus mean by what he said in verse 39?-264626750
trans-unit.source: People who try to save themselves from any troubles or from death by not obeying him will lose their chance to have life eternal. Those who are willing to die on earth in order to follow him will have life eternal. (39)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaojaribu kujiokoa wenyewe kutoka kwa shida yoyote au kutoka kwa kifo kwa kutomtii watapoteza nafasi yao ya kupata uzima wa milele. Wale walio tayari kufa duniani ili kumfuata watapata uzima wa milele. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~39#Answer:What did Jesus mean by what he said in verse 39?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.40-42+What do you think Jesus meant by the word "receive" when he said, "whoever receives you receives me"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~40#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by the word "receive" when he said, "whoever receives you receives me"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant by the word "receive" when he said, "whoever receives you receives me"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini kwa neno "kupokea" aliposema, "yeyote anayewakaribisha ninyi ananikaribisha mimi"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~40#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by the word "receive" when he said, "whoever receives you receives me"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~40#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by the word "receive" when he said, "whoever receives you receives me"?726219185
trans-unit.source: It is a bit difficult to know if the first reference here is to receiving them into their homes, or if Jesus is now referring mostly to people receiving rather than rejecting them and their message. However, those who would receive them because they are Jesus's disciples, would almost certainly receive them in all the above manners/ways. (40-42)
trans-unit.target: Ni vigumu kidogo kujua kama marejeo ya kwanza hapa ni kuwakaribisha ndani ya nyumba zao, au kama Yesu sasa anazungumzia hasa watu wanaopokea badala ya kukataa wao na ujumbe wao. Hata hivyo, wale ambao wangewakaribisha kwa sababu wao ni wanafunzi wa Yesu, karibu hakika wangewakaribisha kwa njia zote zilizotajwa hapo juu. (40-42)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~40#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by the word "receive" when he said, "whoever receives you receives me"?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~40#Answer:Jesus said that when they receive his disciples, they are at the same time receiving him and also the one who sent him. Whom do you think people, who read the translation, will think Jesus meant when he said, "the one who sent me"?

group.id: Q:MAT 10.41+How will Jesus reward those who are good to people who serve God?

trans-unit.source: How will Jesus reward those who are good to people who serve God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu atawathawabishaje wale wanaowafanyia mema watu wanaomtumikia Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~41#Question:How will Jesus reward those who are good to people who serve God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~41#Answer:How will Jesus reward those who are good to people who serve God?-1817918299
