group.id: Q:MAT 10.40+What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!10~40#Question:What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Mungu huwapa watu hao thawabu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~40#Question:What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!10~40#Answer:What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?-600182294
trans-unit.source: He will reward them because they are the ones who truly follow him. (40)
trans-unit.target: Atawalipa kwa sababu wao ndio wamemfuata kwa kweli.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~40#Answer:What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!10~40#Note:What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?-123551906
trans-unit.source: This answer comes from the context and draws the passage together somewhat, but would be difficult to elicit/obtain from a respondent to these questions, who was reading the passage for the first time (the ideal kind). See especially verses 13 and 14 and verse 40. Jesus's coming caused people to make a choice for or against him as seen in verse 34 and following/and subsequent verses/onward.
trans-unit.target: Jibu hili linatokana na muktadha na huleta kifungu pamoja kwa kiasi fulani, lakini itakuwa ngumu kupata kutoka kwa mjibu wa maswali haya, ambaye alikuwa akisoma kifungu kwa mara ya kwanza (aina bora). Angalia hasa aya ya 13 na 14 na aya ya 40. Kuja kwa Yesu kuliwafanya watu kufanya uchaguzi kwa au dhidi yake kama inavyoonekana katika aya ya 34 na ifuatayo / na aya zinazofuata / kuendelea.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!10~40#Note:What do you think is the reason that God rewards such people?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.4-5+What reply did he send (with them) back to John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~4#Question:What reply did he send (with them) back to John the Baptist?
trans-unit.source: What reply did he send (with them) back to John the Baptist?
trans-unit.target: Alipeleka jibu gani (pamoja nao) kwa Yohana Mbatizaji?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~4#Question:What reply did he send (with them) back to John the Baptist?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~4#Answer:What reply did he send (with them) back to John the Baptist?89836257
trans-unit.source: He sent back a reply/replied saying that he did all kinds of miracles, including raising dead people back to life, and that he also preached the good news to the poor (as predicted of the Messiah in the Old Testament in Isaiah 19:18-21 and 35:5-6). (4-5)
trans-unit.target: Alipeleka jibu/alijibu akisema kwamba alifanya miujiza ya kila aina, ikiwemo kuwafufua wafu, na kwamba pia alihubiri habari njema kwa maskini (kama ilivyotabiriwa ya Masihi katika Agano la Kale katika Isaya 19:18-21 na 35:5-6). (4-5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~4#Answer:What reply did he send (with them) back to John the Baptist?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.4-6+How did Jesus answer John's question when he sent his reply?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~4#Question:How did Jesus answer John's question when he sent his reply?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer John's question when he sent his reply?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibuje swali la Yohana alipompelekea jibu lake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~4#Question:How did Jesus answer John's question when he sent his reply?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~4#Answer:How did Jesus answer John's question when he sent his reply?-1582843011
trans-unit.source: Jesus gave evidence that he was sent by God. That is, he was doing the various types of miracles predicted of the Messiah who was to come, including raising dead people back to life. (4-6)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitoa uthibitisho kwamba alitumwa na Mungu. Hiyo ni, alikuwa akifanya aina mbalimbali za miujiza iliyotabiriwa ya Masihi ambaye angekuja, kutia ndani kuwafufua watu wafu. (4-6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~4#Answer:How did Jesus answer John's question when he sent his reply?

trans-unit.source: When John's disciples left, where do you think they went?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yohana walipoondoka, unafikiri walienda wapi?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~2#Answer:When John's disciples left, where do you think they went?-340383285
trans-unit.source: They went back to where John was in prison to give him their report concerning whether Jesus was the Messiah or not. (2-7)
trans-unit.target: Walirudi mahali Yohana alipokuwa gerezani ili kumwambia ripoti yao kuhusu kama Yesu alikuwa Mesiya au la (2-7).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~2#Answer:When John's disciples left, where do you think they went?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus start talking about to the people after John the Baptist's disciples left?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alianza kuzungumza na watu kuhusu nini baada ya wanafunzi wa Yohana Mbatizaji kuondoka?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~7#Answer:What did Jesus start talking about to the people after John the Baptist's disciples left?368680272
trans-unit.source: Jesus began to talk to them about John the Baptist. (7)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alianza kuzungumza nao juu ya Yohana Mbatizaji. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~7#Answer:What did Jesus start talking about to the people after John the Baptist's disciples left?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.9-11+To what occasion do you suppose Jesus was referring when he spoke to the people there about their going out into the desert at a previous time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~9#Question:To what occasion do you suppose Jesus was referring when he spoke to the people there about their going out into the desert at a previous time?
trans-unit.source: To what occasion do you suppose Jesus was referring when he spoke to the people there about their going out into the desert at a previous time?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akirejezea pindi gani alipozungumza na watu hapo juu ya kutoka kwao kwenda nyikani wakati uliopita?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~9#Question:To what occasion do you suppose Jesus was referring when he spoke to the people there about their going out into the desert at a previous time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~9#Answer:To what occasion do you suppose Jesus was referring when he spoke to the people there about their going out into the desert at a previous time?781691693
trans-unit.source: Jesus was talking about the time when they went out from the towns to the sparsely settled area in order to hear John the Baptist teach and to be baptized by him. (9-11)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza juu ya wakati walipotoka katika miji kwenda kwenye eneo lisilokuwa na watu wengi ili kumsikiliza Yohana Mbatizaji akifundisha na kubatizwa naye. (9-11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~9#Answer:To what occasion do you suppose Jesus was referring when he spoke to the people there about their going out into the desert at a previous time?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.7+What do you think most people, who read verse 7, would think Jesus meant when he asked if they had gone out to see a reed bent back and forth by the wind?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~7#Question:What do you think most people, who read verse 7, would think Jesus meant when he asked if they had gone out to see a reed bent back and forth by the wind?
trans-unit.source: What do you think most people, who read verse 7, would think Jesus meant when he asked if they had gone out to see a reed bent back and forth by the wind?
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi waliosoma mstari wa 7 wangefikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini alipouliza ikiwa walitoka nje ili kuona mwanzi uliopinda-pinda kwa sababu ya upepo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~7#Question:What do you think most people, who read verse 7, would think Jesus meant when he asked if they had gone out to see a reed bent back and forth by the wind?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~7#Answer:What do you think most people, who read verse 7, would think Jesus meant when he asked if they had gone out to see a reed bent back and forth by the wind?740563649
trans-unit.source: In Jesus's question he was asking them if they had found John to be an easily influenced person who was like a tall thin reed that bends different ways according to which way the wind was blowing/coming. (7)
trans-unit.target: Katika swali la Yesu alikuwa akiwauliza kama walimwona Yohana kuwa mtu anayeweza kushawishiwa kwa urahisi ambaye alikuwa kama mwanzi mrefu mwembamba ambao hujipinda kwa njia tofauti kulingana na njia ambayo upepo ulikuwa ukivuma/kuja. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~7#Answer:What do you think most people, who read verse 7, would think Jesus meant when he asked if they had gone out to see a reed bent back and forth by the wind?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.8+What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked if they had gone out to see someone in fine clothes?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~8#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked if they had gone out to see someone in fine clothes?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked if they had gone out to see someone in fine clothes?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwauliza ikiwa walitoka nje kumwona mtu aliyevaa mavazi mazuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~8#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked if they had gone out to see someone in fine clothes?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked if they had gone out to see someone in fine clothes?-609208339
trans-unit.source: He probably asked that because their other religious leaders wore fine clothes, but John was different. (8)
trans-unit.target: Labda aliuliza hivyo kwa sababu viongozi wao wengine wa kidini walivaa mavazi mazuri, lakini Yohana alikuwa tofauti. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~8#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus asked if they had gone out to see someone in fine clothes?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.9+In verse 9, what do you think Jesus meant when he said that John was a prophet and more than a prophet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~9#Question:In verse 9, what do you think Jesus meant when he said that John was a prophet and more than a prophet?
trans-unit.source: In verse 9, what do you think Jesus meant when he said that John was a prophet and more than a prophet?
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 9, unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii na hata zaidi ya nabii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~9#Question:In verse 9, what do you think Jesus meant when he said that John was a prophet and more than a prophet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~9#Answer:In verse 9, what do you think Jesus meant when he said that John was a prophet and more than a prophet?1145327460
trans-unit.source: He meant that John was truly a prophet; but he was not just a prophet, he was a special prophet. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii kweli kweli; lakini hakuwa nabii tu, alikuwa nabii wa pekee. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~9#Answer:In verse 9, what do you think Jesus meant when he said that John was a prophet and more than a prophet?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.10+In verse 10, who do you think spoke, and to whom was he speaking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~10#Question:In verse 10, who do you think spoke, and to whom was he speaking?
trans-unit.source: In verse 10, who do you think spoke, and to whom was he speaking?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nani aliyesema katika mstari wa 10, na alikuwa akizungumza na nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~10#Question:In verse 10, who do you think spoke, and to whom was he speaking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~10#Answer:In verse 10, who do you think spoke, and to whom was he speaking?-1594366679
trans-unit.source: It is clear from the Old Testament and the way the Old Testament quotation/quote is used here that it was God speaking to his son, the Messiah. (10)
trans-unit.target: Ni wazi kutoka Agano la Kale na njia ambayo nukuu ya Agano la Kale inatumiwa hapa kwamba ilikuwa Mungu akizungumza na mwanawe, Masihi. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~10#Answer:In verse 10, who do you think spoke, and to whom was he speaking?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.10+What can we learn from that Old Testament quotation given here in verse 10? What was so special about John that Jesus said he was "more than a prophet"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~10#Question:What can we learn from that Old Testament quotation given here in verse 10? What was so special about John that Jesus said he was "more than a prophet"?
trans-unit.source: What can we learn from that Old Testament quotation given here in verse 10? What was so special about John that Jesus said he was "more than a prophet"?
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kujifunza nini kutokana na nukuu hiyo ya Agano la Kale iliyotolewa hapa katika mstari wa 10? Ni nini kilichokuwa cha pekee sana juu ya Yohana hivi kwamba Yesu alisema alikuwa "mkubwa kuliko nabii"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~10#Question:What can we learn from that Old Testament quotation given here in verse 10? What was so special about John that Jesus said he was "more than a prophet"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~10#Answer:What can we learn from that Old Testament quotation given here in verse 10? What was so special about John that Jesus said he was "more than a prophet"?1358580848
trans-unit.source: From the Old Testament/this quotation we learn that John was the messenger whom God sent to precede the Messiah in order to prepare the people to receive the Messiah. (10)
trans-unit.target: Kutoka Agano la Kale/nukuu hii tunajifunza kwamba Yohana alikuwa mjumbe ambaye Mungu alimtuma kumtanguliza Masihi ili kuandaa watu kumpokea Masihi. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~10#Answer:What can we learn from that Old Testament quotation given here in verse 10? What was so special about John that Jesus said he was "more than a prophet"?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.11+In verse 11 Jesus continued talking about how important John was. To whom did Jesus compare John when he said that John was the greatest among them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~11#Question:In verse 11 Jesus continued talking about how important John was. To whom did Jesus compare John when he said that John was the greatest among them?
trans-unit.source: In verse 11 Jesus continued talking about how important John was. To whom did Jesus compare John when he said that John was the greatest among them?
trans-unit.target: Katika mstari wa 11 Yesu aliendelea kusema juu ya jinsi Yohana alivyokuwa wa maana. Yesu alimlinganisha Yohana na nani aliposema kwamba Yohana alikuwa mkubwa zaidi miongoni mwao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~11#Question:In verse 11 Jesus continued talking about how important John was. To whom did Jesus compare John when he said that John was the greatest among them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~11#Answer:In verse 11 Jesus continued talking about how important John was. To whom did Jesus compare John when he said that John was the greatest among them?1386742629
trans-unit.source: He compared John to everyone who had been born before/up until that time. (Except Jesus himself. Since he was the speaker, he could omit himself from the comparison.) (11)
trans-unit.target: Alimlinganisha Yohana na kila mtu aliyezaliwa kabla/hadi wakati huo. (Isipokuwa Yesu mwenyewe. Kwa kuwa alikuwa msemaji, angeweza kujiondoa katika ulinganisho huo.) (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~11#Answer:In verse 11 Jesus continued talking about how important John was. To whom did Jesus compare John when he said that John was the greatest among them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~12#Answer:What did Jesus say had been happening since the time John preached his message?307508952
trans-unit.source: There are several interpretations:
trans-unit.target: Kuna tafsiri kadhaa:

trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~12#Answer:What did Jesus say had been happening since the time John preached his message?

trans-unit.source: 2. From the time John the Baptist began preaching and baptizing, eager multitudes have been pressing/thronging into the kingdom. (12)

group.id: Q:MAT 11.13+Before John the baptizer had come, how did the people know how God wanted them to live?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~13#Question:Before John the baptizer had come, how did the people know how God wanted them to live?
trans-unit.source: Before John the baptizer had come, how did the people know how God wanted them to live?
trans-unit.target: Kabla Yohana Mbatizaji hajafika, watu walijuaje jinsi Mungu alivyotaka waishi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~13#Question:Before John the baptizer had come, how did the people know how God wanted them to live?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~13#Answer:Before John the baptizer had come, how did the people know how God wanted them to live?-1437669233
trans-unit.source: They knew by the Law [of Moses] and [the writings of] the Prophets [which had been read and taught to them as their guide for living]. (13)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kutokana na Sheria [ya Musa] na [maandishi ya] Manabii [waliokuwa wamesomewa na kufundishwa ili waweze kuongozwa maishani mwao].

group.id: Q:MAT 11.16-17+How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~16#Question:How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwalinganishaje watu wa wakati huo na watoto ambao hawangesikiliza watoto wengine waliokuwa wakipiga filimbi zao na kuimba nyimbo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~16#Question:How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~16#Answer:How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?-770388228
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that the people of that time were like the children who would not dance, when other children tried to interact with them by playing [wedding songs] on their flutes.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watu wa wakati huo walikuwa kama watoto ambao hawangetamba, wakati watoto wengine walipojaribu kushirikiana nao kwa kucheza [nyimbo za arusi] kwenye filimbi zao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~16#Answer:How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~16#Answer:How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?-1692402644
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that the people of that time were like the children who would not mourn/cry, when other children tried to interact with them by singing [funeral] songs. (16-17)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watu wa wakati huo walikuwa kama watoto ambao hawataomboleza/kulia, wakati watoto wengine walipojaribu kuingiliana nao kwa kuimba nyimbo za [mazishi]. (16-17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~16#Answer:How did Jesus compare the people of that time with the children who would not respond to the other children who were playing their flutes and singing songs?

group.id: Q:MAT 11.18-19+How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!11~18#Question:How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?
trans-unit.source: How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?
trans-unit.target: Lile linganisho katika mstari wa 16 na 17 lilifananaje na jinsi watu wengi wa wakati wa Yohana na wa Yesu walivyotenda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~18#Question:How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~18#Answer:How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?1470384570
trans-unit.source: Many of the people would not respond to John nor to Jesus. No matter what John and Jesus did those people were not satisfied. John did not eat or drink/fasted and the people said that he had a demon.
trans-unit.target: Wengi wa watu hawakutaka kumsikiliza Yohana wala Yesu. Haijalishi Yohana na Yesu walifanya nini watu hao hawakuridhika. Yohana hakula wala kunywa/kufunga na watu walisema ana pepo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~18#Answer:How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~18#Answer:How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?-1048660368
trans-unit.source: Jesus ate and drank/did not fast and the people said that he was a glutton and a drunkard. The people also said that Jesus was a friend of tax collectors and sinners. (18-19)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikula na kunywa/hakukufunga na watu walisema alikuwa mlafi na mlevi. Watu pia walisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa rafiki wa watoza ushuru na wenye dhambi (18-19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~18#Answer:How was that comparison in verses 16 and 17 like the way many of the people of John's and Jesus's time acted?

trans-unit.source: It may be necessary to make reference to their wickedness in the translation by a footnote to make Jesus's meaning clear here if the fact of their wickedness is not known/understood by people in the target community.
trans-unit.target: Huenda ikawa lazima kurejezea uovu wao katika tafsiri kwa maelezo ya chini ili kufanya maana ya Yesu iwe wazi hapa ikiwa ukweli wa uovu wao haujulikani/kueleweka na watu katika jamii inayolengwa.

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!11~25#Answer:What do you think were some of the important values/teachings the "ordinary ones" understood more than the "wise"?-1556768876
trans-unit.source: The ordinary people understood that John was God's prophet to prepare people for the Messiah's coming; and that Jesus was the Messiah sent from God. With this kind of understanding they could repent and become people of God's kingdom. (1-25)
trans-unit.target: Watu wa kawaida walielewa kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii wa Mungu kuandaa watu kwa kuja kwa Masihi; na kwamba Yesu alikuwa Masihi aliyetumwa kutoka kwa Mungu. Kwa aina hii ya ufahamu wangeweza kutubu na kuwa watu wa ufalme wa Mungu. (1-25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~25#Answer:What do you think were some of the important values/teachings the "ordinary ones" understood more than the "wise"?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!11~25#Note:What do you think were some of the important values/teachings the "ordinary ones" understood more than the "wise"?703040704
trans-unit.source: Don't expect new hearers of the text to necessarily produce all of the parts of this answer; but if they do, great. For some difficult questions, part of the questioning process is to eliminate any far out, wrong answers that do not agree with scripture. Here the "these things" refers back to general discussion in the context concerning the Kingdom of God and the introduction of the Messiah king. It is difficult to know exactly what all is covered by "these things" here. The context in that sentence helps by showing that it takes a simple humble spirited person, helped by God, to understand. This indicates that "these things" are spiritual matters. Then we look for spiritual matters which individuals need to understand in this context. This searching back is going to be difficult for anyone with only a rather quick going over of the text. Rereading verses 1-25, after the question is read, may help. The meaning may need to be made more explicit.
trans-unit.target: Usisubiri wasikilizaji wapya wa maandishi kutoa sehemu zote za jibu hili; lakini wakifanya hivyo, ni vizuri. Kwa baadhi ya maswali magumu, sehemu ya mchakato wa kuuliza ni kuondoa majibu yoyote ya mbali, yasiyo sahihi ambayo hayakubaliani na maandiko. Hapa "mambo haya" yanarejelea mazungumzo ya jumla katika muktadha unaohusu Ufalme wa Mungu na kuletwa kwa mfalme wa Masihi. Ni vigumu kujua ni nini hasa kinachofunikwa na "mambo haya" hapa. Muktadha katika hilo unasaidia sentensi kwa kuonyesha kwamba inachukua mtu wa roho ya unyenyekevu, akisaidiwa na Mungu, kuelewa. Hii inaonyesha kwamba "mambo haya" ni mambo ya kiroho. Kisha tunatafuta mambo ya kiroho ambayo watu wanahitaji kuelewa katika muktadha huu. Utafutaji huu wa nyuma utakuwa mgumu kwa mtu yeyote kwa kupitia kifupi tu ya maandishi. Kusoma tena mistari 1-25, baada ya swali kusomwa, kunaweza kusaidia. Maana inaweza kuhitaji kufanywa wazi zaidi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!11~25#Note:What do you think were some of the important values/teachings the "ordinary ones" understood more than the "wise"?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 12.1-14+What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~1#Question:What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimshtaki Yesu na wanafunzi wake kwa kufanya nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~1#Question:What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?528488193
trans-unit.source: They accused them of harvesting the grain on the Sabbath day. They said that this was work. They accused them of eating on the Sabbath day. They said that this was work. (2)
trans-unit.target: Waliwashtaki kwa kuvuna nafaka siku ya Sabato. Walisema kuwa hiyo ni kazi. Waliwashtaki kwa kula siku ya Sabato. Walisema kuwa hiyo ni kazi. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?-342010099
trans-unit.source: They accused Jesus of healing someone on the Sabbath day, which they said was work. (10)
trans-unit.target: Walimshtaki Yesu kwa kumponya mtu siku ya Sabato, ambayo walisema ilikuwa kazi. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees accuse Jesus and the disciples of doing in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.1-14+What do you think the term "the Sabbath" means?

trans-unit.source: What do you think the term "the Sabbath" means?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri neno "Sabato" linamaanisha nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~1#Answer:What do you think the term "the Sabbath" means?1958063707
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Sabbath is the name of the seventh and last day of the week. The Jews observed a strict day of rest from the normal work that they did on the other six days of the week.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno: Sabato ni jina la siku ya saba na ya mwisho ya juma. Wayahudi walifuata sheria kali ya kupumzika kutoka kwa kazi ya kawaida ambayo walifanya katika siku sita zilizobaki za juma.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~1#Answer:What do you think the term "the Sabbath" means?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!12~1#Note:What do you think the term "the Sabbath" means?1395134835
trans-unit.source: See "Sabbath" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "Sabato" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~1#Note:What do you think the term "the Sabbath" means?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.3-8+What do you think is the reason that Jesus reminded them about what David did?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~3#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus reminded them about what David did?-1654772636
trans-unit.source: What David did was against God's/the laws given by Moses for carrying out the Jewish ceremonies. Thus, what David did was somewhat like the disciples/a lot like this situation with the disciples harvesting a bit of food on the rest day.
trans-unit.target: Daudi alichofanya kilikuwa kinyume na sheria za Mungu/ sheria zilizotolewa na Musa kwa ajili ya kutekeleza sherehe za Kiyahudi. Kwa hivyo, kile Daudi alifanya kilikuwa kidogo kama wanafunzi/ mengi kama hali hii na wanafunzi kuvuna chakula kidogo siku ya kupumzika.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~3#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus reminded them about what David did?

trans-unit.target: Daudi alikuwa amefanya nini ambacho kilikuwa kama vile wanafunzi walivyokuwa wakifanya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~3#Alternate:What had David done that was somewhat like/a bit like what the disciples were doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~3#Answer:What had David done that was somewhat like/a bit like what the disciples were doing?-1038899902
trans-unit.source: David had gone against the law concerning special bread that was kept in the temple. Only the priests were allowed to eat that bread. When he and his men had arrived at the temple hungry, he had asked the priest and received from him some of the special bread and ate it. He gave some of the bread to his men and they, too, ate some of it. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Daudi alikuwa amepinga sheria kuhusu mkate wa pekee uliowekwa hekaluni. Makuhani peke yao ndio walioruhusiwa kula mkate huo. Wakati yeye na watu wake walipofika hekaluni wakiwa na njaa, alimwuliza kuhani na kupokea kutoka kwake mkate wa pekee na kula. Akampa baadhi ya mkate watu wake nao pia wakala. (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~3#Answer:What had David done that was somewhat like/a bit like what the disciples were doing?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.5+From reading verse 5, do you think Jesus thought the Pharisees had or had not read the part in the Old Testament law that said that the priests could work in the temple area on the Sabbath? Or did he think that they had not read that part, since that portion of the Old Testament said that they could work on the Sabbath, and it would not be sin for them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~5#Question:From reading verse 5, do you think Jesus thought the Pharisees had or had not read the part in the Old Testament law that said that the priests could work in the temple area on the Sabbath? Or did he think that they had not read that part, since that portion of the Old Testament said that they could work on the Sabbath, and it would not be sin for them?
trans-unit.source: From reading verse 5, do you think Jesus thought the Pharisees had or had not read the part in the Old Testament law that said that the priests could work in the temple area on the Sabbath? Or did he think that they had not read that part, since that portion of the Old Testament said that they could work on the Sabbath, and it would not be sin for them?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kusoma mstari wa 5, je, unafikiri Yesu alifikiri kwamba Mafarisayo walikuwa wamesoma au hawakuwa wamesoma sehemu ya sheria ya Agano la Kale iliyosema kwamba makuhani wangeweza kufanya kazi katika eneo la hekalu siku ya Sabato? Au je, alifikiri kwamba hawakuwa wamesoma sehemu hiyo, kwa kuwa sehemu hiyo ya Agano la Kale ilisema kwamba wangeweza kufanya kazi siku ya Sabato, na haingekuwa dhambi kwao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~5#Question:From reading verse 5, do you think Jesus thought the Pharisees had or had not read the part in the Old Testament law that said that the priests could work in the temple area on the Sabbath? Or did he think that they had not read that part, since that portion of the Old Testament said that they could work on the Sabbath, and it would not be sin for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~5#Answer:From reading verse 5, do you think Jesus thought the Pharisees had or had not read the part in the Old Testament law that said that the priests could work in the temple area on the Sabbath? Or did he think that they had not read that part, since that portion of the Old Testament said that they could work on the Sabbath, and it would not be sin for them?1439175007
trans-unit.source: He assumed that they had read it. He was just reminding them of another case when it was all right for people to do some work on the Sabbath. (5)
trans-unit.target: Alifikiri kwamba walikuwa wamesoma, lakini alikuwa akiwakumbusha tu kisa kingine ambapo ilikuwa halali kwa watu kufanya kazi fulani siku ya Sabato. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~5#Answer:From reading verse 5, do you think Jesus thought the Pharisees had or had not read the part in the Old Testament law that said that the priests could work in the temple area on the Sabbath? Or did he think that they had not read that part, since that portion of the Old Testament said that they could work on the Sabbath, and it would not be sin for them?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?-1090273933
trans-unit.source: The kingdom of God for which he and his disciples were working was greater than the temple.
trans-unit.target: Ufalme wa Mungu ambao yeye na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakiufanyia kazi ulikuwa mkubwa kuliko hekalu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?1128688275
trans-unit.source: He and the kingdom of God were greater than the temple. If work could be carried out on the Sabbath for the temple service, how much more it could be done for him and/or for God's kingdom which they were promoting. (6)
trans-unit.target: Yeye na ufalme wa Mungu walikuwa wakubwa kuliko hekalu. Kama kazi ingeweza kufanywa siku ya Sabato kwa ajili ya huduma ya hekalu, ni kiasi gani zaidi ingeweza kufanywa kwa ajili yake na/au kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu ambao walikuwa wakiutangaza. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~6#Answer:Who or what did Jesus say was more important than the temple?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.7+What did Jesus say the Pharisees did not understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~7#Question:What did Jesus say the Pharisees did not understand?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say the Pharisees did not understand?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema Mafarisayo hawakuelewa nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~7#Question:What did Jesus say the Pharisees did not understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~7#Answer:What did Jesus say the Pharisees did not understand?1095456548
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that the Pharisees did not understand what God meant when he said that he desired that people have mercy on others. But rather they were ruthless to others; and then later they sought God's forgiveness when they had not been merciful to others. (7)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Mafarisayo hawakuelewa kile Mungu alichomaanisha aliposema kwamba alitaka watu wawe na huruma kwa wengine. Badala yake walikuwa na ukatili kwa wengine; na kisha baadaye walitafuta msamaha wa Mungu wakati hawakuwa na huruma kwa wengine. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~7#Answer:What did Jesus say the Pharisees did not understand?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.7+What people would the Pharisees not have condemned, if they had understood and obeyed the way God wanted them to be merciful?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~7#Question:What people would the Pharisees not have condemned, if they had understood and obeyed the way God wanted them to be merciful?
trans-unit.source: What people would the Pharisees not have condemned, if they had understood and obeyed the way God wanted them to be merciful?
trans-unit.target: Ni watu gani ambao Mafarisayo hawangewahukumu, ikiwa wangeelewa na kutii jinsi Mungu alivyotaka wawe wenye rehema?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~7#Question:What people would the Pharisees not have condemned, if they had understood and obeyed the way God wanted them to be merciful?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~7#Answer:What people would the Pharisees not have condemned, if they had understood and obeyed the way God wanted them to be merciful?-1819163433
trans-unit.source: They would have been merciful and not spoken out against Jesus's disciples for picking grains of wheat/harvesting food when they were hungry. (7)
trans-unit.target: Wangeweza kuwa wenye rehema na wasingesema dhidi ya wanafunzi wa Yesu kwa kuvuna nafaka za ngano/kuvuna chakula walipokuwa na njaa. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~7#Answer:What people would the Pharisees not have condemned, if they had understood and obeyed the way God wanted them to be merciful?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.3-8+What do you think it means when a person condemns someone else?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~3#Question:What do you think it means when a person condemns someone else?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means when a person condemns someone else?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini mtu anapomhukumu mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~3#Question:What do you think it means when a person condemns someone else?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~3#Answer:What do you think it means when a person condemns someone else?910161125
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: When a person condemns someone else he pronounces the other person guilty of committing a crime and declares that the person will be punished for what he has done. (See "condemn" in KBT in the "judge, judgment" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Wakati mtu anamhukumu mtu mwingine yeye hutamka mtu mwingine kuwa na hatia ya kufanya uhalifu na kutangaza kwamba mtu huyo ataadhibiwa kwa kile alichofanya. (Tazama "hukumu" katika KBT katika "hakimu, hukumu" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~3#Answer:What do you think it means when a person condemns someone else?

trans-unit.source: He said that he is the one who made/preordained/predetermined/sets the rules for the Sabbath. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba yeye ndiye aliyefanya/kuamuru/kuamua/kuweka sheria za Sabato. (8)

group.id: Q:MAT 12.11-12+How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~11#Question:How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: How did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~11#Question:How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~11#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?-1146090912
trans-unit.source: He said that if any of them had a sheep which fell into a large/big hole on the Sabbath, they would pull it out, which was work (as the Old Testament said they could do on the Sabbath). Then he said that people are much more valuable than sheep, so it is lawful to/all right by God's law to do good to people on the Sabbath day as well. (11-12)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba ikiwa yeyote kati yao alikuwa na kondoo aliyeanguka kwenye shimo kubwa siku ya Sabato, wangemtoa, ambayo ilikuwa kazi (kama Agano la Kale lilivyosema wangeweza kufanya siku ya Sabato). Kisha akasema kwamba watu ni wa thamani zaidi kuliko kondoo, kwa hivyo ni halali kwa sheria ya Mungu kuwafanyia watu mema siku ya Sabato pia. (11-12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~11#Answer:How did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.source: Matthew 12:15-21 God had chosen Jesus as his servant. // Jesus is God's chosen servant.

group.id: Q:MAT 12.15-21+What part of the quotation from Isaiah (verses 17-21) did Jesus fulfill in the verses 15-16 of this chapter (the paragraph preceding the quotation)?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~15#Question:What part of the quotation from Isaiah (verses 17-21) did Jesus fulfill in the verses 15-16 of this chapter (the paragraph preceding the quotation)?
trans-unit.source: What part of the quotation from Isaiah (verses 17-21) did Jesus fulfill in the verses 15-16 of this chapter (the paragraph preceding the quotation)?
trans-unit.target: Ni sehemu gani ya nukuu kutoka Isaya (mistari 17-21) ambayo Yesu alitimiza katika mistari 15-16 ya sura hii (aya inayotangulia nukuu hiyo)?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~15#Question:What part of the quotation from Isaiah (verses 17-21) did Jesus fulfill in the verses 15-16 of this chapter (the paragraph preceding the quotation)?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~15#Answer:What part of the quotation from Isaiah (verses 17-21) did Jesus fulfill in the verses 15-16 of this chapter (the paragraph preceding the quotation)?1170539355
trans-unit.source: Jesus did just as Isaiah had said God's faithful servant (the Messiah king) would do. He did not promote himself loudly in the streets. Rather he left the area where the Pharisees were and he even asked those, whom he had helped, not to make him known [to others].
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya kama vile Isaya alivyokuwa amesema mtumishi mwaminifu wa Mungu (mfalme wa Kimesiya) angefanya. Yeye hakujitukuza mwenyewe kwa sauti kubwa barabarani. Badala yake aliondoka mahali ambapo Mafarisayo walikuwa na hata aliwauliza wale, ambao alikuwa amewasaidia, wasimjulishe [kwa wengine].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~15#Answer:What part of the quotation from Isaiah (verses 17-21) did Jesus fulfill in the verses 15-16 of this chapter (the paragraph preceding the quotation)?

trans-unit.source: By using the quote from Isaiah's writings, what was Matthew making clear about Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kutumia nukuu kutoka maandishi ya Isaya, Mathayo alikuwa akieleza wazi nini juu ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~17#Alternate:By using the Old Testament quotation/quote from Isaiah's writings, what was Matthew teaching/making clear about Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~17#Answer:By using the Old Testament quotation/quote from Isaiah's writings, what was Matthew teaching/making clear about Jesus?-64116980
trans-unit.source: Matthew was teaching/revealing to/showing his readers that the promise which/that God had made through Isaiah was being fulfilled in/by Jesus. That promise was that God's chosen Servant, the Messiah, would be revealed to them; and Matthew wanted to emphasize that Jesus must truly be the predicted Christ for whom they had been waiting. (17-21)
trans-unit.target: Mathayo alikuwa akiwafundisha/kuwafunulia/kuwaonyesha wasomaji wake kwamba ahadi ambayo/ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameitoa kupitia Isaya ilikuwa ikitimizwa ndani/kwa Yesu. Ahadi hiyo ilikuwa kwamba Mtumishi aliyechaguliwa na Mungu, Masihi, angefichuliwa kwao; na Mathayo alitaka kusisitiza kwamba Yesu lazima kweli awe ndiye Kristo aliyetabiriwa ambaye walikuwa wakimngojea. (17-21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~17#Answer:By using the Old Testament quotation/quote from Isaiah's writings, what was Matthew teaching/making clear about Jesus?

trans-unit.target: Akasema, ikiwa ni lazima kufanya mapatano na Shetani ili kufukuza pepo, basi ilikuwaje kwamba baadhi ya watu wao wenyewe walidai kuwa wanafukuza pepo? (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~22#Answer:What were some of the details/incidents/points Jesus used to show that he did not have an agreement with Beelzebub to cast out demons?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.22-37+What did Jesus say it would prove to people if they realized that he really had cast out demons?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say it would prove to people if they realized that he really had cast out demons?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ingethibitikaje kwa watu ikiwa wangetambua kwamba kwa kweli alikuwa amewafukuza roho waovu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~22#Question:What did Jesus say it would prove to people if they realized that he really had cast out demons?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~22#Answer:What did Jesus say it would prove to people if they realized that he really had cast out demons?-605711507
trans-unit.source: It would show that he truly was the offspring of king David. Therefore they could know that God was ruling over them. (28)
trans-unit.target: Ingeonyesha kwamba kweli alikuwa mzao wa mfalme Daudi. Kwa hiyo wangeweza kujua kwamba Mungu alikuwa akitawala juu yao. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~22#Answer:What did Jesus say it would prove to people if they realized that he really had cast out demons?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.23+What did the people, who were watching, think when he caused the man to be able to see and speak?

trans-unit.source: What did the people, who were watching, think when he caused the man to be able to see and speak?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.23+What did they think was the reason that Jesus could do such things?

trans-unit.source: What did they think was the reason that Jesus could do such things?
trans-unit.target: Walifikiri ni kwa nini Yesu angeweza kufanya mambo hayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~23#Question:What did they think was the reason that Jesus could do such things?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~23#Answer:What did they think was the reason that Jesus could do such things?-1820951874
trans-unit.source: They were thinking that he must be the offspring of David, that is the Messiah, whom the prophets had said God would send to them someday. (23)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakifikiri kwamba lazima awe mzao wa Daudi, yaani Mesiya, ambaye manabii walikuwa wamesema kwamba Mungu angewatuma siku moja.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~23#Answer:What did they think was the reason that Jesus could do such things?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.24+Who is this Beelzebub?

trans-unit.target: Beelzebuli huyo ni nani?

trans-unit.source: That is what they called the leader of the demons, who is usually called Satan. (24)

group.id: Q:MAT 12.22-29+How do you think Jesus knew what the Pharisees were thinking?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alijua jinsi gani mawazo ya Mafarisayo?

trans-unit.source: He had often heard them talking and probably he could tell from the looks on their faces, something about their attitude toward him at that time. Also he is God so he knows everything.

trans-unit.source: Who was the strong man Jesus was really talking about in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani aliyekuwa mwanamume mwenye nguvu ambaye Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~29#Question:Who was the strong man Jesus was really talking about in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~29#Answer:Who was the strong man Jesus was really talking about in these verses?1344873317
trans-unit.source: Jesus was referring to Satan. (29)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akirejezea Shetani. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~29#Answer:Who was the strong man Jesus was really talking about in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.29+What did Jesus mean when he said that you have to tie up a strong man well before you can rob from his house?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~29#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that you have to tie up a strong man well before you can rob from his house?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he said that you have to tie up a strong man well before you can rob from his house?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema kwamba ni lazima umfunge mtu mwenye nguvu vizuri kabla ya kuiba kutoka nyumbani mwake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~29#Question:What did Jesus mean when he said that you have to tie up a strong man well before you can rob from his house?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~29#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that you have to tie up a strong man well before you can rob from his house?1308771068
trans-unit.source: He was saying/teaching them that Satan would not allow just anyone to cast out the demons that are controlled by him. That is, Jesus is more powerful than Satan. (29)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiwaambia/kuwafundisha kwamba Shetani hatamruhusu mtu yeyote tu awafukuze pepo ambao wanadhibitiwa naye. Hiyo ni, Yesu ana nguvu kuliko Shetani. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~29#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he said that you have to tie up a strong man well before you can rob from his house?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.30+What did Jesus want people to understand by what he said in verse 30?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~30#Question:What did Jesus want people to understand by what he said in verse 30?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus want people to understand by what he said in verse 30?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka watu waelewe nini aliposema maneno hayo katika mstari wa 30?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~30#Question:What did Jesus want people to understand by what he said in verse 30?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~30#Answer:What did Jesus want people to understand by what he said in verse 30?1115106251
trans-unit.source: People either decide for Jesus and help him gather people to himself; or else, they are helping Satan by discouraging people from following Jesus. (30)
trans-unit.target: Watu ama huamua kwa ajili ya Yesu na kumsaidia kukusanya watu kwake; au, wanamsaidia Shetani kwa kuwavunja moyo watu wasimfuate Yesu. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~30#Answer:What did Jesus want people to understand by what he said in verse 30?

trans-unit.target: Je, waweza kuwazia jambo fulani ambalo Mafarisayo walifanya ambalo lingemfanya Yesu aseme hivyo?

trans-unit.source: The response of the Pharisees was that he could only do that because he had a connection with Satan. By being against Jesus, the Pharisees were discouraging people from following Jesus. (24, 30)
trans-unit.target: Jibu la Mafarisayo lilikuwa kwamba angeweza kufanya hivyo kwa sababu tu alikuwa na uhusiano na Shetani. Kwa kuwa dhidi ya Yesu, Mafarisayo walikuwa wakivunja moyo watu wasimfuate Yesu. (24, 30)

trans-unit.source: When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~32#Alternate:When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?

trans-unit.target: Watu wanaposoma hili, unafikiri wanapaswa kutarajia Mungu asamehe dhambi za aina gani, au asisamehe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~32#Alternate:When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!12~32#Alternate:When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?-566564272
trans-unit.source: When people read this, what kind of sins do you think people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaposoma haya, unafikiri ni dhambi za aina gani watu wanapaswa kutarajia Mungu awasamehe, au asisamehe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~32#Alternate:When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~32#Answer:When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?-193753348
trans-unit.source: They should expect that God will forgive all kinds of sin, but deliberately defaming the Holy Spirit is very dangerous. It is possible to sin in such a way/commit a sin which/do something that God can never forgive. (32)
trans-unit.target: Wanapaswa kutarajia kwamba Mungu atasamehe kila aina ya dhambi, lakini kumkufuru Roho Mtakatifu kwa makusudi ni hatari sana. Inawezekana kufanya dhambi kwa namna ambayo Mungu hawezi kamwe kusamehe. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~32#Answer:When they/people read this, what kind of sins do you think they/people should expect that God will forgive, or will not forgive?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.30-32+Will God forgive people who defame other people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~30#Question:Will God forgive people who defame other people?
trans-unit.source: Will God forgive people who defame other people?
trans-unit.target: Je, Mungu atawasamehe watu wanaowachongea wengine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~30#Question:Will God forgive people who defame other people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~30#Answer:Will God forgive people who defame other people?-763243582
trans-unit.source: Yes, God will forgive people who defame other people, according to verse 31.
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, Mungu atawasamehe watu wanaowachafua wengine, kulingana na mstari wa 31.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~30#Answer:Will God forgive people who defame other people?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.30-32+What sin will God forgive according to verse 32?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~30#Question:What sin will God forgive according to verse 32?
trans-unit.source: What sin will God forgive according to verse 32?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na mstari wa 32, Mungu atasamehe dhambi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~30#Question:What sin will God forgive according to verse 32?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~30#Answer:What sin will God forgive according to verse 32?226109880
trans-unit.source: Verse 32 states/relates/says that God/he will forgive people who defame the Son of Man. (This phrase "son of man" can be understood as parallel to verse 31 with the same meaning as the word "man" in that verse. But probably it is better to understand Jesus to be referring to a specific man, that is, himself, Jesus the Messiah (in his human form) here in verse 32.
trans-unit.target: Mstari wa 32 unasema kwamba Mungu atawapa msamaha watu wanaomtukana Mwana wa Adamu (msemo huu "mwana wa Adamu" unaweza kueleweka kama sawa na mstari wa 31 na maana sawa na neno "mtu" katika mstari huo. Lakini labda ni bora kuelewa Yesu akimaanisha mtu maalum, yaani, yeye mwenyewe, Yesu Masihi (katika sura yake ya kibinadamu) hapa katika mstari wa 32.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~30#Answer:What sin will God forgive according to verse 32?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.31-32+What does it say in verse 31 and 32 about those who defame the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~31#Question:What does it say in verse 31 and 32 about those who defame the Holy Spirit?
trans-unit.source: What does it say in verse 31 and 32 about those who defame the Holy Spirit?
trans-unit.target: Inasema nini katika mstari wa 31 na 32 kuhusu wale wanaouvunjia heshima Roho Takatifu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~31#Question:What does it say in verse 31 and 32 about those who defame the Holy Spirit?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~31#Answer:What does it say in verse 31 and 32 about those who defame the Holy Spirit?-209169891
trans-unit.source: It says that God will not forgive those who defame/speak against the Holy Spirit. (31-32)
trans-unit.target: Inasema kwamba Mungu hatawasamehe wale wanaomkufuru/wanasema dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu. (31-32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~31#Answer:What does it say in verse 31 and 32 about those who defame the Holy Spirit?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.33+What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about a good tree bearing good fruit and a bad tree bearing bad fruit?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~33#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about a good tree bearing good fruit and a bad tree bearing bad fruit?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about a good tree bearing good fruit and a bad tree bearing bad fruit?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alizungumza kuhusu mti mzuri unaozaa matunda mazuri na mti mbaya unaozaa matunda mabaya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~33#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about a good tree bearing good fruit and a bad tree bearing bad fruit?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~33#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about a good tree bearing good fruit and a bad tree bearing bad fruit?-1358104235
trans-unit.source: It is our experience that a good tree will have good fruit and that a bad tree will have bad fruit. It just does not happen the other way around. Of course Jesus was pointing out that the same is true with people. (33)
trans-unit.target: Ni uzoefu wetu kwamba mti mzuri utazaa matunda mazuri na mti mbaya utazaa matunda mabaya. Ni tu haina kutokea kwa njia nyingine. Bila shaka Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia kwamba sawa na watu. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~33#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus talked about a good tree bearing good fruit and a bad tree bearing bad fruit?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.34+Whom did Jesus call the offspring of vipers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~34#Question:Whom did Jesus call the offspring of vipers?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus call the offspring of vipers?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliita nani uzao wa nyoka-vipiri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~34#Question:Whom did Jesus call the offspring of vipers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~34#Answer:Whom did Jesus call the offspring of vipers?-208156635
trans-unit.source: He was talking to the Pharisees or to the Pharisees plus any others who were there who thought as/in the same manner as they did. (34)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akiongea na Mafarisayo au Mafarisayo pamoja na wengine wowote waliokuwapo ambao walifikiri kama/kwa njia ile ile walivyofikiri wao. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~34#Answer:Whom did Jesus call the offspring of vipers?

trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that Jesus called them the offspring of vipers/poisonous snakes?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaita wazao wa nyoka-vipiri/nyoka wenye sumu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~34#Question:What do you think was the reason that Jesus called them the offspring of vipers/poisonous snakes?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaita wazao wa nyoka?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu aliwaita wazao wa nyoka wenye sumu?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~34#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus called them the offspring of vipers/poisonous snakes?1404221720
trans-unit.source: He called them that because they were evil. (34)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaita hivyo kwa sababu walikuwa waovu. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~34#Answer:What do you think was the reason that Jesus called them the offspring of vipers/poisonous snakes?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.36+What do you think Jesus meant by "careless words"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~36#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by "careless words"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant by "careless words"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema "maneno ya upumbavu"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~36#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by "careless words"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~36#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by "careless words"?1656074214
trans-unit.source: He meant anything a person/people might say without first considering if what he/they said would result in good being done rather than bad being done. (36)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kitu chochote ambacho mtu/watu wanaweza kusema bila kwanza kuzingatia ikiwa kile alichosema kitasababisha mema kufanywa badala ya mabaya kufanywa. (36)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~36#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by "careless words"?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.37+To what was Jesus referring when he talked about people being acquitted and about them being condemned?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~37#Question:To what was Jesus referring when he talked about people being acquitted and about them being condemned?
trans-unit.source: To what was Jesus referring when he talked about people being acquitted and about them being condemned?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akirejezea nini alipozungumza juu ya watu kutetewa na kuhukumiwa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~37#Question:To what was Jesus referring when he talked about people being acquitted and about them being condemned?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~37#Answer:To what was Jesus referring when he talked about people being acquitted and about them being condemned?112104134
trans-unit.source: He warned them to prepare themselves for God's final judgment. He said what a person says will make a great difference in whether God can accept that person or not accept them. (37)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya kujitayarisha kwa hukumu ya mwisho ya Mungu. Alisema kile mtu anasema kitakuwa na tofauti kubwa katika kama Mungu anaweza kumkubali mtu huyo au la. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~37#Answer:To what was Jesus referring when he talked about people being acquitted and about them being condemned?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!12~38#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 12:38-45 The Pharisees and Teachers of the Law asked Jesus to do a sign/miracle for them.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 12:38-45 Mafarisayo na Walimu wa Sheria walimwomba Yesu awaonyeshe ishara/mwujiza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 12.38-45+What did some of the Pharisees say that they wanted Jesus to do in verse 38?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~38#Question:What did some of the Pharisees say that they wanted Jesus to do in verse 38?
trans-unit.source: What did some of the Pharisees say that they wanted Jesus to do in verse 38?
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo walisema kwamba walitaka Yesu afanye nini katika mstari wa 38?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Question:What did some of the Pharisees say that they wanted Jesus to do in verse 38?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~38#Answer:What did some of the Pharisees say that they wanted Jesus to do in verse 38?1327190087
trans-unit.source: They said that they wanted him to do something supernatural which they could see. That might prove to them that he had power from God. (38)
trans-unit.target: Wakasema kwamba walitaka afanye jambo la ajabu ambalo wangeweza kuliona, ili kwamba waweze kuthibitishiwa kwamba alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Answer:What did some of the Pharisees say that they wanted Jesus to do in verse 38?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.38-45+Since Jesus had just cured a man who had been blind and could not speak, what do you think was the reason that those Pharisees asked Jesus to do something miraculous?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~38#Question:Since Jesus had just cured a man who had been blind and could not speak, what do you think was the reason that those Pharisees asked Jesus to do something miraculous?
trans-unit.source: Since Jesus had just cured a man who had been blind and could not speak, what do you think was the reason that those Pharisees asked Jesus to do something miraculous?
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa ametoka tu kumponya mtu aliyekuwa kipofu na asiyeweza kusema, unafikiri ni kwa nini Mafarisayo hao walimwomba Yesu afanye muujiza?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Question:Since Jesus had just cured a man who had been blind and could not speak, what do you think was the reason that those Pharisees asked Jesus to do something miraculous?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~38#Answer:Since Jesus had just cured a man who had been blind and could not speak, what do you think was the reason that those Pharisees asked Jesus to do something miraculous?-665115267
trans-unit.source: They wanted him to prove that he had power from God. But also they asked that because they did not believe that he was the one sent from God (and they did not want to believe).
trans-unit.target: Walitamani aonyeshe kwamba alikuwa na nguvu kutoka kwa Mungu. Lakini pia waliuliza hivyo kwa sababu hawakuamini kwamba alikuwa ametumwa kutoka kwa Mungu (na hawakutaka kuamini).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Answer:Since Jesus had just cured a man who had been blind and could not speak, what do you think was the reason that those Pharisees asked Jesus to do something miraculous?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.38-41+About whom was Jesus probably talking when he said, "this generation"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~38#Question:About whom was Jesus probably talking when he said, "this generation"?
trans-unit.source: About whom was Jesus probably talking when he said, "this generation"?
trans-unit.target: Yaelekea Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani aliposema, "kizazi hiki"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Question:About whom was Jesus probably talking when he said, "this generation"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~38#Answer:About whom was Jesus probably talking when he said, "this generation"?1992342732
trans-unit.source: The scribes and Pharisees were the ones who asked to see a sign/miracle. So he was talking about them, and probably also everyone else living at that time who had not believed in him, but who would hear of people killing him and of his coming to life again after three days. (38-41)
trans-unit.target: Waandishi na Mafarisayo ndio waliouliza kuona ishara/mwujiza. Kwa hiyo alikuwa akiongea juu yao, na labda pia juu ya kila mtu mwingine aliyeishi wakati huo ambaye hakuwa amemwamini, lakini ambaye angesikia juu ya watu kumwua na kufufuka kwake tena baada ya siku tatu (38-41).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~38#Answer:About whom was Jesus probably talking when he said, "this generation"?
