group.id: Q:MAT 12.39+What do you think Jesus meant when he called them an "adulterous" group of people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~39#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he called them an "adulterous" group of people?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant when he called them an "adulterous" group of people?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini alipowaita kikundi cha watu "wazinzi"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~39#Question:What do you think Jesus meant when he called them an "adulterous" group of people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~39#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he called them an "adulterous" group of people?-654915297
trans-unit.source: He meant that they were breaking their covenant with God as/in the same manner as some people break their marriage promise or covenant. He meant that they were unfaithful to God and that they were doing evil. (39)
trans-unit.target: Maana yake ni kwamba walikuwa wanavunja ahadi yao kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kama vile watu wengine wanavyovunja ahadi zao za ndoa au ahadi. Maana yake ni kwamba walikuwa hawaamini kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na kwamba walikuwa wakifanya maovu. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~39#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant when he called them an "adulterous" group of people?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.39-41+The "sign of Jonah" is mentioned in verses 39-41. What sort of sign was that?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~39#Question:The "sign of Jonah" is mentioned in verses 39-41. What sort of sign was that?
trans-unit.source: The "sign of Jonah" is mentioned in verses 39-41. What sort of sign was that?
trans-unit.target: "Ishara ya Yona" inatajwa katika mstari wa 39-41. Hiyo ilikuwa ishara ya aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~39#Question:The "sign of Jonah" is mentioned in verses 39-41. What sort of sign was that?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~39#Answer:The "sign of Jonah" is mentioned in verses 39-41. What sort of sign was that?477690497
trans-unit.source: Jonah was saved from drowning in the sea by God, who sent a sea monster to swallow him. After three days and nights the sea monster spewed/vomited/spit him out onto the land. Likewise he/Jesus would be resurrected from death after three days. (39-41) (See the OT text concerning Jonah.)
trans-unit.target: Yona aliokolewa kutoka kuzama baharini na Mungu, ambaye alituma jitu la baharini kummeza. Baada ya siku tatu na usiku jitu la baharini lilimtapika/kumruka/kumtemea kwenye nchi kavu. Vivyo hivyo yeye/Yesu angefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu baada ya siku tatu. (39-41) (Tazama maandishi ya OT kuhusu Yona.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~39#Answer:The "sign of Jonah" is mentioned in verses 39-41. What sort of sign was that?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.41+Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~41#Question:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nani aliposema kwamba, 1. Kitu fulani au, 2. Mtu mkuu kuliko Yona alikuwapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~41#Question:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?-2009344713
trans-unit.source: 1. If we understand/consider what he said to mean "something greater than Jonah," then Jesus meant the message about the kingdom of God, a message greater than the one proclaimed by Jonah.
trans-unit.target: 1. Kama tunaelewa/kuzingatia kile alichosema kinamaanisha "kitu kikubwa kuliko Yona", basi Yesu alimaanisha ujumbe kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu, ujumbe mkubwa kuliko ule uliotangazwa na Yona.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?1034601261
trans-unit.source: 2. If we understand/consider what Jesus said to mean "someone greater than Jonah," then, of course, he would be referring to himself—the Messiah as being greater than the prophet Jonah. (41)
trans-unit.target: 2. Kama tunaelewa/kuzingatia kile Yesu alisema kumaanisha "mtu mkuu kuliko Yona", basi, bila shaka, angekuwa anajirejezea mwenyewe Masihi kuwa mkuu kuliko nabii Yona. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~41#Answer:Whom did Jesus mean when he said that, 1. Something or, 2. Someone greater than Jonah was there?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.41+What did Jesus mean by his statement that, at the time of judgment, the people of Nineveh would be a witness against the Jewish people of Jesus's time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~41#Question:What did Jesus mean by his statement that, at the time of judgment, the people of Nineveh would be a witness against the Jewish people of Jesus's time?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean by his statement that, at the time of judgment, the people of Nineveh would be a witness against the Jewish people of Jesus's time?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini kwa taarifa yake kwamba, wakati wa hukumu, watu wa Ninawi wangekuwa mashahidi dhidi ya Wayahudi wa wakati wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~41#Question:What did Jesus mean by his statement that, at the time of judgment, the people of Nineveh would be a witness against the Jewish people of Jesus's time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~41#Answer:What did Jesus mean by his statement that, at the time of judgment, the people of Nineveh would be a witness against the Jewish people of Jesus's time?-2077792975
trans-unit.source: He meant that the Nineveh people had repented when they were warned by Jonah, but the Jewish people of Jesus time refused to repent although/even though Jesus was greater than Jonah, the one who told the Ninevites to repent. (41)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha kwamba watu wa Ninawi walikuwa wametubu walipokuwa wameonywa na Yona, lakini Wayahudi wa wakati wa Yesu walikataa kutubu ingawa Yesu alikuwa mkuu kuliko Yona, yule aliyewaambia Waninawi watubu. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~41#Answer:What did Jesus mean by his statement that, at the time of judgment, the people of Nineveh would be a witness against the Jewish people of Jesus's time?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.42+If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~42#Question:If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?
trans-unit.source: If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa maandishi yaliyotafsiriwa yana "Malkia wa Kusini", bila kutaja nchi yake, Sheba, basi uliza: Malkia huyo alitoka wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Question:If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~42#Answer:If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?-1964297500
trans-unit.source: The queen came from a country far south of where the Jews lived. (42)
trans-unit.target: Malkia alitoka nchi iliyokuwa mbali kusini mwa mahali Wayahudi walipoishi. (42)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Answer:If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!12~42#Note:If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?-2049780620
trans-unit.source: It will probably be best to mention Sheba in the text or in a footnote so it will be understood that she was not from Israel. (42)
trans-unit.target: Labda itakuwa bora kumtaja Sheba katika maandishi au katika maelezo ya chini ili ieleweke kwamba hakuwa wa Israeli.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Note:If the translated text has "Queen of the South," without mentioning her country, Sheba, then ask: From where did the queen come?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.42+How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~42#Question:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?
trans-unit.source: How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?
trans-unit.target: Nini kile malkia alifanya kushuhudia dhidi ya / kulaumu watu wa kizazi cha Yesu, wakati Mungu anahukumu watu wa dunia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Question:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!12~42#Alternate:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?1465712313
trans-unit.source: How will what the queen did testify against the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?
trans-unit.target: Ni jinsi gani yale ambayo malkia alifanya yatashuhudia dhidi ya watu wa kizazi cha Yesu, wakati ambapo Mungu atahukumu watu wa dunia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Alternate:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!12~42#Alternate:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?-763063764
trans-unit.source: How will what the queen did testify convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?
trans-unit.target: Yale aliyoyashuhudia malkia yatashuhudiaje watu wa kizazi cha Yesu, wakati ambapo Mungu atahukumu watu wa dunia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Alternate:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~42#Answer:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?1292407855
trans-unit.source: The Queen of Sheba came all the way to Israel in order to hear some of King Solomon's wisdom. The Jews of Jesus day refused to listen to the Messiah, who had much greater wisdom than Solomon had. Therefore, God will judge/punish them. (42)
trans-unit.target: Malkia wa Sheba alikuja mpaka Israeli ili kusikia baadhi ya hekima ya Mfalme Sulemani. Wayahudi wa siku za Yesu walikataa kumsikiliza Masihi, ambaye alikuwa na hekima kubwa kuliko Sulemani. Kwa hiyo, Mungu atawahukumu/kuwaadhibu. (42)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~42#Answer:How will what the queen did testify against/convict the people of Jesus's generation, at the time when God judges the people of earth?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.43-45+What did Jesus mean when he talked about a number of unclean spirits coming and taking up residence where only one of them had been living previously?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~43#Question:What did Jesus mean when he talked about a number of unclean spirits coming and taking up residence where only one of them had been living previously?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he talked about a number of unclean spirits coming and taking up residence where only one of them had been living previously?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema juu ya roho wachafu kadhaa kuja na kukaa mahali ambapo mmoja wao tu alikuwa akiishi hapo awali?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Question:What did Jesus mean when he talked about a number of unclean spirits coming and taking up residence where only one of them had been living previously?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~43#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he talked about a number of unclean spirits coming and taking up residence where only one of them had been living previously?-274201354
trans-unit.source: He was warning the Jewish nation that it was about to happen to them, since they did not repent and did not truly turn to God. (43-45)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akionya taifa la Kiyahudi kwamba lilikuwa karibu liwatokee, kwa kuwa hawakujuta na hawakumgeukia Mungu kikweli.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he talked about a number of unclean spirits coming and taking up residence where only one of them had been living previously?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.43+What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~43#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni sababu gani Yesu alizungumza juu ya roho mbaya kwenda kupitia maeneo kavu / maeneo yasiyo na watu, kama roho mbaya ilizunguka wakati haikuwa na mahali pa kukaa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!12~43#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?2062525969
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema roho mwovu alikuwa akizunguka katika maeneo makavu, kwa kuwa roho mwovu alikuwa akizunguka-zunguka wakati ambapo hakuwa na mahali pa kukaa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!12~43#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?770745103
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema roho mwovu alikuwa akizunguka katika maeneo yasiyo na watu, kwa kuwa roho mwovu alikuwa akizunguka-zunguka wakati ambapo hakuwa na mahali pa kukaa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Alternate:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~43#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?1226988152
trans-unit.source: By speaking of dry places/uninhabited places, Jesus disclosed/revealed/showed that the evil spirit expected to find another person in whom he could live again. (43)
trans-unit.target: Kwa kusema juu ya mahali pakavu/mahali pasipo na watu, Yesu alifunua/alifunua/alionyesha kwamba roho mwovu alitarajia kupata mtu mwingine ambaye angeweza kuishi tena ndani yake. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus talked about the evil spirit going through dry places/uninhabited places, as the evil spirit wandered around when it had no place to stay?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.43+What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~43#Question:What do you think an evil spirit is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think an evil spirit is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri roho mwovu ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Question:What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~43#Answer:What do you think an evil spirit is?-435459682
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The terms "evil spirit", "unclean spirit", and "demon" are used interchangeably in the New Testament. They all refer to spiritual beings who serve Satan as his agents, being under his authority. These spiritual beings have power to oppress a human being and even to take control of him.
trans-unit.target: Tafuta Maneno Muhimu: Maneno "roho mwovu", "roho mchafu", na "roho mwovu" yanatumiwa kwa njia tofauti katika Agano Jipya. Yote yanahusu viumbe wa roho ambao humtumikia Shetani wakiwa mawakala wake, wakiwa chini ya mamlaka yake. Viumbe hao wa roho wana nguvu za kumnyanyasa mwanadamu na hata kumtawala.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Answer:What do you think an evil spirit is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!12~43#Note:What do you think an evil spirit is?917898767
trans-unit.source: See "evil spirit" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "roho mwovu" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~43#Note:What do you think an evil spirit is?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.49-50+What did Jesus mean when he pointed to his disciples and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~49#Question:What did Jesus mean when he pointed to his disciples and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers"?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean when he pointed to his disciples and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers"?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini alipowaonyesha wanafunzi wake na kusema, "Tazama, mama yangu na ndugu zangu"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~49#Question:What did Jesus mean when he pointed to his disciples and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!12~49#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he pointed to his disciples and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers"?-970271241
trans-unit.source: He meant that those, who do according to what God wants, are in close relationship to him, just like brothers, and sisters and a mother. (49-50)
trans-unit.target: Alidhani kwamba wale wanaofanya kulingana na mapenzi ya Mungu, wana uhusiano wa karibu naye, kama vile ndugu, dada na mama.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~49#Answer:What did Jesus mean when he pointed to his disciples and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers"?

group.id: Q:MAT 12.48-50+Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!12~48#Question:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri Yesu alikataa kwenda na kuzungumza na familia yake mwenyewe?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~48#Question:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!12~48#Note:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?1937648408
trans-unit.source: Matthew did not tell us about that, but only about what Jesus was able to teach the people because of their coming to see him.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo hakutuambia juu ya hilo, bali tu juu ya yale ambayo Yesu aliweza kufundisha watu kwa sababu ya wao kuja kumwona.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~48#Note:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!12~48#Note:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?848763666
trans-unit.source: Jewish teachers used to begin/start with something that was happening and then teach something else from it. When the crowd mentioned family, Jesus started from that thought and taught about his close relationship to people who obey God. This was the important part/component of the teaching which Matthew wanted to emphasize. He did not bother to go back and tell us more about this incident and whether Jesus talked with his mother and brothers afterward or not. He probably did.
trans-unit.target: Walimu Wayahudi walikuwa wakianza na kitu ambacho kilikuwa kinatokea na kisha kufundisha kitu kingine kutoka kwa hilo. Umati ulipotaja familia, Yesu alianza kutoka kwa wazo hilo na kufundisha kuhusu uhusiano wake wa karibu na watu wanaomtii Mungu. Hii ilikuwa sehemu muhimu ya mafundisho ambayo Mathayo alitaka kusisitiza. Hakujishughulisha kurudi na kutuambia zaidi juu ya tukio hili na ikiwa Yesu alizungumza na mama yake na ndugu zake baadaye au la. Labda alifanya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!12~48#Note:Do you think that Jesus refused to go and talk to his own family?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.1-9+What do you think a parable is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~1#Question:What do you think a parable is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a parable is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mfano ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~1#Question:What do you think a parable is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~1#Answer:What do you think a parable is?-813048918
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A parable is a story which shows its meaning indirectly by using picture language to make a comparison. The parts of the comparison are generally not explained. The listeners themselves must think much about the meaning hidden in each part of the picture language. Jesus taught spiritual truths in this story form.
trans-unit.target: Mfano ni hadithi ambayo inaonyesha maana yake kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja kwa kutumia lugha ya picha ili kufanya kulinganisha. Sehemu za kulinganisha kwa ujumla hazieleweki. Wasikilizaji wenyewe lazima wafikirie sana juu ya maana iliyofichwa katika kila sehemu ya lugha ya picha. Yesu alifundisha kweli za kiroho katika fomu hii ya hadithi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~1#Answer:What do you think a parable is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!13~1#Note:What do you think a parable is?903541393
trans-unit.source: See "parable" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "mfano" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~1#Note:What do you think a parable is?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.10-17+What do you think was the reason that he spoke to them mostly in parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~10#Question:What do you think was the reason that he spoke to them mostly in parables?
trans-unit.source: What do you think was the reason that he spoke to them mostly in parables?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini alizungumza nao hasa kwa mifano?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~10#Question:What do you think was the reason that he spoke to them mostly in parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~10#Answer:What do you think was the reason that he spoke to them mostly in parables?990425552
trans-unit.source: He spoke to them mostly in parables because they did not want to hear what he taught them/would teach them nor did they want to accept/receive it and turn to God. (They would probably have rejected his message immediately and stopped coming to hear him, if he had talked to them in plain speech.) (11-15)
trans-unit.target: Aliongea nao zaidi katika mifano kwa sababu hawakutaka kusikia kile alichowafundisha/angewafundisha wala hawakutaka kukubali/kupokea na kumgeukia Mungu. (Labda wangekataa ujumbe wake mara moja na kuacha kuja kumsikiliza, ikiwa angeongea nao kwa lugha ya wazi.) (11-15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~10#Answer:What do you think was the reason that he spoke to them mostly in parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~10#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about the way Jesus taught?1924604961
trans-unit.source: They wanted to know why he always spoke in parables to the crowds of people. (10)
trans-unit.target: Walitaka kujua ni kwa nini sikuzote aliongea kwa mifano na umati wa watu. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~10#Answer:What did the disciples want to know about the way Jesus taught?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~11#Question:What was Jesus's first reply to their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~11#Answer:What was Jesus's first reply to their question?15475148
trans-unit.source: He said that God had given them an understanding of what previously had been unknown about God's kingdom/the way God would rule over people, but he had not given that understanding to other people. (11)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Mungu alikuwa amewapa ufahamu wa kile ambacho hapo awali hakikujulikana kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu/njia ambayo Mungu angewatawala watu, lakini hakuwa amewapa watu wengine ufahamu huo. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~11#Answer:What was Jesus's first reply to their question?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.12+Verse 12 sounds like an often-repeated saying; and we know that Jesus used it on at least one other occasion, applied to something else. What do you think he meant in this verse?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~12#Question:Verse 12 sounds like an often-repeated saying; and we know that Jesus used it on at least one other occasion, applied to something else. What do you think he meant in this verse?
trans-unit.source: Verse 12 sounds like an often-repeated saying; and we know that Jesus used it on at least one other occasion, applied to something else. What do you think he meant in this verse?
trans-unit.target: Mstari wa 12 unaonekana kuwa usemi unaorudiwa mara nyingi; na tunajua kwamba Yesu alitumia usemi huo angalau mara moja zaidi, akirejelea jambo lingine.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~12#Question:Verse 12 sounds like an often-repeated saying; and we know that Jesus used it on at least one other occasion, applied to something else. What do you think he meant in this verse?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~12#Answer:Verse 12 sounds like an often-repeated saying; and we know that Jesus used it on at least one other occasion, applied to something else. What do you think he meant in this verse?-205067259
trans-unit.source: Jesus was saying that God will give much more understanding of him and his kingdom to the people who already have some understanding. As for those who have almost no understanding of him and his kingdom, he will take way even the little that they do know. (12)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akisema kwamba Mungu atawapa ufahamu zaidi juu yake na ufalme wake kwa watu ambao tayari wana ufahamu fulani. Kwa wale ambao hawana ufahamu wowote juu yake na ufalme wake, atachukua njia hata kidogo wanachojua. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~12#Answer:Verse 12 sounds like an often-repeated saying; and we know that Jesus used it on at least one other occasion, applied to something else. What do you think he meant in this verse?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.13+What is the reason that he spoke to them in parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~13#Question:What is the reason that he spoke to them in parables?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that he spoke to them in parables?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini aliwaambia kwa mifano?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~13#Question:What is the reason that he spoke to them in parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~13#Answer:What is the reason that he spoke to them in parables?1330601317
trans-unit.source: He spoke to them in parables because they saw him doing miracles, but they did not understand what they were seeing. And even though they heard Jesus's message, it did not mean anything to them. So he used parables, which was the right thing to do when speaking to a rather hostile audience who were not really trying to learn from him. (13)
trans-unit.target: Aliongea nao kwa mifano kwa sababu walimwona akifanya miujiza, lakini hawakuelewa kile walichokuwa wakiona. Na ingawa walisikia ujumbe wa Yesu, haukumaanisha chochote kwao. Kwa hivyo alitumia mifano, ambayo ilikuwa jambo sahihi kufanya wakati wa kuzungumza na hadhira yenye uadui ambao hawakujaribu kujifunza kutoka kwake. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~13#Answer:What is the reason that he spoke to them in parables?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.14-15+How did what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel fit what Jesus said about the crowds following him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~14#Question:How did what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel fit what Jesus said about the crowds following him?
trans-unit.source: How did what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel fit what Jesus said about the crowds following him?
trans-unit.target: Maneno ya nabii Isaya juu ya watu wa Israeli yalipatanaje na yale ambayo Yesu alisema juu ya umati uliomfuata?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~14#Question:How did what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel fit what Jesus said about the crowds following him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~14#Answer:How did what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel fit what Jesus said about the crowds following him?1925249341
trans-unit.source: The people to whom Jesus spoke/The people about whom Isaiah wrote were set in their ways/calloused in heart and would not listen to the message Jesus wanted to tell them, nor learn from what he was doing among them. (14-15)
trans-unit.target: Watu ambao Yesu alizungumza nao/Watu ambao Isaya aliandika juu yao walikuwa wamewekwa katika njia zao/walikuwa na moyo mgumu na hawangesikiliza ujumbe ambao Yesu alitaka kuwaambia, wala kujifunza kutokana na kile alichokuwa akifanya miongoni mwao. (14-15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~14#Answer:How did what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel fit what Jesus said about the crowds following him?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.15+What is the reason that the people about whom Isaiah wrote and the people whom Jesus was teaching did not want to respond to God's message?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~15#Question:What is the reason that the people about whom Isaiah wrote and the people whom Jesus was teaching did not want to respond to God's message?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the people about whom Isaiah wrote and the people whom Jesus was teaching did not want to respond to God's message?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu iliyofanya watu ambao Isaya aliandika juu yao na watu ambao Yesu alikuwa akifundisha wasitake kuitikia ujumbe wa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~15#Question:What is the reason that the people about whom Isaiah wrote and the people whom Jesus was teaching did not want to respond to God's message?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~15#Answer:What is the reason that the people about whom Isaiah wrote and the people whom Jesus was teaching did not want to respond to God's message?-219264054
trans-unit.source: If they had listened, they would have learned from the message and understood in their hearts what he was teaching them. Then they would have turned to him and he would have placed/put them in a right relationship with God. (15)
trans-unit.target: Na lau kama wangeli sikia, basi wangeli jifunza katika yale aliyo wafunza, na wangeli yafahamu yaliyomo katika nyoyo zao, kisha wangeli mgeukia, naye ange wapa njia ya haki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~15#Answer:What is the reason that the people about whom Isaiah wrote and the people whom Jesus was teaching did not want to respond to God's message?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.16-17+What was it that the disciples saw and heard that other people before them had longed to see and hear?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~16#Question:What was it that the disciples saw and heard that other people before them had longed to see and hear?
trans-unit.source: What was it that the disciples saw and heard that other people before them had longed to see and hear?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliona na kusikia nini ambacho watu wengine kabla yao walitamani sana kuona na kusikia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~16#Question:What was it that the disciples saw and heard that other people before them had longed to see and hear?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~16#Answer:What was it that the disciples saw and heard that other people before them had longed to see and hear?-486028651
trans-unit.source: Other people, who had lived before them, had longed to see the Messiah and to hear more about how God would rule over people after he/the Messiah came. (16-17)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengine, ambao walikuwa wameishi kabla yao, walikuwa wametamani kumwona Masihi na kusikia zaidi juu ya jinsi Mungu atakavyotawala juu ya watu baada ya yeye / Masihi kuja. (16-17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~16#Answer:What was it that the disciples saw and heard that other people before them had longed to see and hear?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!13~18#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 13:18-23 Jesus explained the parable about the farmer who sowed seed.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 13:18-23 Yesu alifafanua mfano wa mkulima aliyepanda mbegu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~18#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 13.18-23+What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~18#Question:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaeleza wanafunzi wake nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~18#Question:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~18#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?1909621575
trans-unit.source: He explained the meaning of the parable of the farmer. (18)
trans-unit.target: Alieleza maana ya mfano wa mkulima. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~18#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.18+By what he said in verse 18, what did Jesus want the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~18#Question:By what he said in verse 18, what did Jesus want the disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: By what he said in verse 18, what did Jesus want the disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Kwa yale aliyosema katika mstari wa 18, Yesu alitaka wanafunzi wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~18#Question:By what he said in verse 18, what did Jesus want the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~18#Answer:By what he said in verse 18, what did Jesus want the disciples to do?-1565890501
trans-unit.source: He wanted the disciples to listen so that they would understand what the parable about the sower meant. (18)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka wanafunzi wasikilize ili waelewe maana ya mfano wa mpanzi. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~18#Answer:By what he said in verse 18, what did Jesus want the disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.19+What does the seed which fell on the pathway represent?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~19#Question:What does the seed which fell on the pathway represent?
trans-unit.source: What does the seed which fell on the pathway represent?
trans-unit.target: Mbegu iliyoanguka kwenye njia inafananisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~19#Question:What does the seed which fell on the pathway represent?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~19#Answer:What does the seed which fell on the pathway represent?-2081924841
trans-unit.source: It represents the people who hear the message about the kingdom, but do not understand it. (19)
trans-unit.target: Huwakilisha watu wanaosikia ujumbe juu ya ufalme, lakini hawauelewi. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~19#Answer:What does the seed which fell on the pathway represent?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.19+What do you think Jesus meant by "the evil one"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~19#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by "the evil one"?
trans-unit.source: What do you think Jesus meant by "the evil one"?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema "yule mwovu"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~19#Question:What do you think Jesus meant by "the evil one"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~19#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by "the evil one"?-1699156810
trans-unit.source: The evil one refers to Satan. (19)
trans-unit.target: Mwovu huyo ni Shetani. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~19#Answer:What do you think Jesus meant by "the evil one"?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.20+How do you think rock in the soil would cause seed not to grow well?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~20#Question:How do you think rock in the soil would cause seed not to grow well?
trans-unit.source: How do you think rock in the soil would cause seed not to grow well?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri jiwe katika udongo lingewezaje kusababisha mbegu zisiongezeke vizuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~20#Question:How do you think rock in the soil would cause seed not to grow well?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~20#Answer:How do you think rock in the soil would cause seed not to grow well?-1649553711
trans-unit.source: Some of the soil had patches where only a bit of soil covered rock underneath. The roots of the new seedlings could go down only to the rock and could not draw enough moisture to stay alive. (20)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya udongo ulikuwa na vipande ambapo udongo kidogo tu ulifunika mwamba chini. Mizizi ya miche mipya ingeweza kwenda chini tu kwenye mwamba na haikuweza kuchukua unyevu wa kutosha ili kuendelea kuishi. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~20#Answer:How do you think rock in the soil would cause seed not to grow well?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.20-21+To what sort of people did Jesus say this part of his parable was to be applied?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~20#Question:To what sort of people did Jesus say this part of his parable was to be applied?
trans-unit.source: To what sort of people did Jesus say this part of his parable was to be applied?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema sehemu hii ya mfano wake ilihusu watu wa aina gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~20#Question:To what sort of people did Jesus say this part of his parable was to be applied?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~20#Answer:To what sort of people did Jesus say this part of his parable was to be applied?-899227293
trans-unit.source: The seed on rocky soil represents people who hear God's truth and enjoy it, but they discontinue/quit following God just a short time later. (20-21)
trans-unit.target: Mbegu kwenye udongo wa mwamba huwakilisha watu wanaosikia kweli ya Mungu na kuifurahia, lakini wanaacha/kuacha kumfuata Mungu muda mfupi baadaye. (20-21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~20#Answer:To what sort of people did Jesus say this part of his parable was to be applied?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.21+What causes them to stop following God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~21#Question:What causes them to stop following God?
trans-unit.source: What causes them to stop following God?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini huwafanya waache kumfuata Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~21#Question:What causes them to stop following God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~21#Answer:What causes them to stop following God?776244818
trans-unit.source: Any difficulties related to their following God, including their being persecuted by others will cause them to stop following him. (21)
trans-unit.target: Matatizo yoyote yanayohusiana na kumfuata Mungu, kutia ndani kuteswa na wengine, yatawafanya waache kumfuata. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~21#Answer:What causes them to stop following God?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.22+What did Jesus say about the people who are represented in the parable by the seed that fell among the thorny weeds?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~22#Question:What did Jesus say about the people who are represented in the parable by the seed that fell among the thorny weeds?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the people who are represented in the parable by the seed that fell among the thorny weeds?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu watu wanaowakilishwa katika mfano wa mbegu iliyoanguka katikati ya magugu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~22#Question:What did Jesus say about the people who are represented in the parable by the seed that fell among the thorny weeds?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~22#Answer:What did Jesus say about the people who are represented in the parable by the seed that fell among the thorny weeds?1380972637
trans-unit.source: The seed which fell among the thorny weeds represents people who hear God's message and accept it. However, they become so concerned about this life and about having money that the message can not have any good influence on them. (22)
trans-unit.target: Na zile zilizoanguka katikati ya miiba ni watu wanaosikia neno la Mungu na kulikubali, lakini wanahangaika sana juu ya maisha haya na juu ya kuwa na pesa hivi kwamba ujumbe hauwezi kuwa na ushawishi wowote mzuri juu yao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~22#Answer:What did Jesus say about the people who are represented in the parable by the seed that fell among the thorny weeds?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.23+What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~23#Question:What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa mbegu iliyoanguka kwenye udongo mzuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~23#Question:What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~23#Answer:What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?-645477080
trans-unit.source: It grew up and produced thirty, sixty or even one hundred times more than what was sown. (23)
trans-unit.target: Zilikua na kuzaa matunda mara thelathini, na sitini, na hata mara mia zaidi ya yale yaliyopandwa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~23#Answer:What happened to the seed that fell on good soil?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.23+What do you think people, who read this, will understand about the thirty, sixty and one hundred fold increase to mean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~23#Question:What do you think people, who read this, will understand about the thirty, sixty and one hundred fold increase to mean?
trans-unit.source: What do you think people, who read this, will understand about the thirty, sixty and one hundred fold increase to mean?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri watu, wanaosoma hii, wataelewa nini kuhusu ongezeko la mara thelathini, sitini na mia moja?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~23#Question:What do you think people, who read this, will understand about the thirty, sixty and one hundred fold increase to mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~23#Answer:What do you think people, who read this, will understand about the thirty, sixty and one hundred fold increase to mean?-1425121549
trans-unit.source: This increase means that the message did what was expected of it. That is, the message was received by a person who took it seriously. That person not only started, but also continued to serve God as expected. (23)
trans-unit.target: Ongezeko hili linamaanisha kwamba ujumbe ulifanya kile kilichotarajiwa. Hiyo ni, ujumbe ulipokelewa na mtu ambaye aliuchukua kwa uzito. Mtu huyo sio tu alianza, lakini pia aliendelea kumtumikia Mungu kama ilivyotarajiwa. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~23#Answer:What do you think people, who read this, will understand about the thirty, sixty and one hundred fold increase to mean?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!13~24#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 13:24-30 Jesus told the parable about weeds.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 13:24-30 Yesu alitoa mfano kuhusu magugu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 13.24-30+What plan of action did the farmer take when he realized there were weeds mixed with the wheat in his field?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~24#Question:What plan of action did the farmer take when he realized there were weeds mixed with the wheat in his field?
trans-unit.source: What plan of action did the farmer take when he realized there were weeds mixed with the wheat in his field?
trans-unit.target: Mkulima alifanya nini alipotambua kwamba kulikuwa na magugu yaliyochanganyika na ngano katika shamba lake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Question:What plan of action did the farmer take when he realized there were weeds mixed with the wheat in his field?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~24#Answer:What plan of action did the farmer take when he realized there were weeds mixed with the wheat in his field?1344221015
trans-unit.source: He told his workers to allow the weeds to grow there until harvest time when his harvesters could easily tell the difference between the weeds and the wheat (because of the seed heads being quite different). They could then gather the weeds to burn them; and they would store the wheat in his storehouse. (30)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wafanyakazi wake waache magugu yakue hapo mpaka wakati wa mavuno ambapo wavunaji wake wangeweza kutofautisha kwa urahisi kati ya magugu na ngano (kwa sababu vichwa vya mbegu vilikuwa tofauti kabisa). Kisha wangeweza kukusanya magugu ili kuyachoma; na wangehifadhi ngano katika ghala lake. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Answer:What plan of action did the farmer take when he realized there were weeds mixed with the wheat in his field?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.24-30+To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~24#Question:To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?
trans-unit.source: To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akirejezea nani aliposema juu ya mtu aliyepanda mbegu nzuri, akapanga jinsi ya kuitunza, kisha akawapa watumishi wake kazi ya kuvuna ngano?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Question:To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~24#Answer:To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?1915813886
trans-unit.source: Jesus was talking about God, who is the owner of the field and he is the one who will be in charge of/supervising the "harvest". (24)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza juu ya Mungu, ambaye ni mmiliki wa shamba na yeye ndiye atakayewajibika kwa/kuangalia "mavuno". (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Answer:To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~24#Answer:To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?-784908194
trans-unit.source: He was talking about people who truly belong to God as his "harvest". (24-30)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza juu ya watu ambao kwa kweli ni mali ya Mungu wakiwa "mavuno" yake (24-30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Answer:To whom was Jesus referring when he talked about a man who sowed good seed, planned how to care for it and then would have his servants harvest the wheat?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.24+What is the kingdom of heaven like?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~24#Question:What is the kingdom of heaven like?
trans-unit.source: What is the kingdom of heaven like?
trans-unit.target: Ufalme wa mbinguni ni kama nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Question:What is the kingdom of heaven like?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~24#Answer:What is the kingdom of heaven like?2046879871
trans-unit.source: It is like the story of a man who sowed good seed. (24)
trans-unit.target: Ni kama mfano wa mtu aliyepanda mbegu njema. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~24#Answer:What is the kingdom of heaven like?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.26+Do you think that the weeds started to grow about the same time as the wheat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~26#Question:Do you think that the weeds started to grow about the same time as the wheat?
trans-unit.source: Do you think that the weeds started to grow about the same time as the wheat?
trans-unit.target: Je, unafikiri magugu yalianza kukua wakati uleule kama ngano?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~26#Question:Do you think that the weeds started to grow about the same time as the wheat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~26#Answer:Do you think that the weeds started to grow about the same time as the wheat?-1538867690
trans-unit.source: Both started to grow about the same time, (but the servants did not realize it until the seed heads formed). (26)
trans-unit.target: Vyote viwili vikaanza kukua karibu wakati uleule, (lakini watumishi hawakujua hilo mpaka mbegu zilipoanza kuota). (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~26#Answer:Do you think that the weeds started to grow about the same time as the wheat?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.26-28+How had the weed seeds come into the garden?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~26#Question:How had the weed seeds come into the garden?
trans-unit.source: How had the weed seeds come into the garden?
trans-unit.target: Mbegu za magugu zilifikaje katika bustani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~26#Question:How had the weed seeds come into the garden?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~26#Answer:How had the weed seeds come into the garden?1970002344
trans-unit.source: An enemy of the owner had secretly planted them there. (26-28)
trans-unit.target: Adui wa mwenye shamba alikuwa amepanda miti hiyo kisiri (26-28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~26#Answer:How had the weed seeds come into the garden?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.29-30+What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~29#Question:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?
trans-unit.source: What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?
trans-unit.target: Mpango wa mwenye shamba wa kutenganisha magugu na ngano halisi ulikuwa nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~29#Question:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!13~29#Alternate:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?805058937
trans-unit.source: What was the owner's plan to separate the weeds from the real wheat?
trans-unit.target: Mkulima alipanga nini ili kutenganisha magugu na ngano halisi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~29#Alternate:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!13~29#Alternate:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?-672048232
trans-unit.source: What was the owner's plan for separating the weeds from the real wheat?
trans-unit.target: Mpango wa mwenye shamba ulikuwa nini wa kutenganisha magugu na ngano halisi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~29#Alternate:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~29#Answer:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?-315695617
trans-unit.source: His plan was to allow both to grow together until the time of harvest. Then he would have his servants cut the weeds first and bundle them for burning. After that they would harvest the wheat to keep for him. (29-30)
trans-unit.target: Mpango wake ulikuwa ni kuruhusu yote mawili yakue pamoja mpaka wakati wa mavuno. Ndipo angewaambia watumishi wake wakate magugu kwanza na kuyafunga kwa vifungo ili kuyachoma. Baada ya hapo wangevuna ngano ili kuihifadhi kwa ajili yake (29-30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~29#Answer:What was the owner's plan to separate/for separating the weeds from the real wheat?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!13~31#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 13:31-35 Jesus taught a parable about a mustard seed and a parable about yeast.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 13:31-35 Yesu alifundisha mfano wa mbegu ya haradali na mfano wa chachu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 13.31-35+What do these two parables show about the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~31#Question:What do these two parables show about the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.source: What do these two parables show about the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.target: Mifano hii miwili inaonyesha nini juu ya ufalme wa mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~31#Question:What do these two parables show about the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~31#Answer:What do these two parables show about the kingdom of heaven?-1205923216
trans-unit.source: Those who believed Jesus were a small group now. Many would believe Jesus in the future. (31-33)
trans-unit.target: Wale waliomwamini Yesu walikuwa kundi dogo sasa. wengi wangemwamini Yesu katika siku zijazo. (31-33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~31#Answer:What do these two parables show about the kingdom of heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.31-35+What did Matthew say about Jesus in verses 34-35?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~31#Question:What did Matthew say about Jesus in verses 34-35?
trans-unit.source: What did Matthew say about Jesus in verses 34-35?
trans-unit.target: Mathayo alisema nini juu ya Yesu katika mistari 34-35?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~31#Question:What did Matthew say about Jesus in verses 34-35?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~31#Answer:What did Matthew say about Jesus in verses 34-35?-1292259023
trans-unit.source: Matthew made/makes it clear that it was to be expected that Jesus would teach in parables, since that had been predicted in the Old Testament. Then the fact that he spoke in parables was a proof of his being the Messiah. (34-35)
trans-unit.target: Mathayo aliweka wazi kwamba ilitazamiwa kwamba Yesu angefundisha kwa mifano, kwani hiyo ilikuwa imetabiriwa katika Agano la Kale. Halafu ukweli kwamba alizungumza kwa mifano ilikuwa ni uthibitisho wa yeye kuwa Masihi. (34-35)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~31#Answer:What did Matthew say about Jesus in verses 34-35?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.32+What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~32#Question:What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?
trans-unit.source: What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alitaja ndege ambao wanapata mahali pa kupumzika au kujenga viota kwenye matawi ya mtende?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~32#Question:What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~32#Answer:What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?1866971621
trans-unit.source: It showed that the plant was large. Therefore, God will rule over many people.
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, Mungu atawatawala watu wengi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~32#Answer:What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~32#Answer:What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?513063220
trans-unit.source: Also it may or may not indicate that Jesus meant that religious sects, or others like them, would try to take advantage of the great size and influence of God's kingdom on earth. (32)
trans-unit.target: Pia inaweza au inaweza kuonyesha kwamba Yesu alimaanisha kwamba madhehebu ya kidini, au wengine kama wao, wangejaribu kutumia ukubwa na ushawishi mkubwa wa ufalme wa Mungu duniani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~32#Answer:What do you think might be the reason that Jesus mentioned the birds resting in or nesting in the branches of the mustard plant?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.33+How much bread do you think the flour, that the woman used, might make?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~33#Question:How much bread do you think the flour, that the woman used, might make?
trans-unit.source: How much bread do you think the flour, that the woman used, might make?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri unga ambao mwanamke huyo alitumia ungeweza kutengeneza mkate mwingi kadiri gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~33#Question:How much bread do you think the flour, that the woman used, might make?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~33#Answer:How much bread do you think the flour, that the woman used, might make?-728115410
trans-unit.source: There would have been about 55 lbs or 25 kilos of flour. So she could have made many loaves of bread. The main point to understand is that it was a huge batch of bread which shows the potential/capability of yeast to increase the volume of the batch. Therefore, the kingdom of God will spread and have great influence. (33)
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, ni lazima iwe kwamba mwanamke huyo alikuwa na kiasi cha kilo 25 cha unga. Kwa hiyo angeweza kuoka mikate mingi. Jambo kuu la kuelewa ni kwamba ilikuwa ni kundi kubwa la mkate ambalo linaonyesha uwezo/uwezo wa chachu kuongeza kiasi cha kundi. Kwa hiyo, ufalme wa Mungu utaenea na kuwa na ushawishi mkubwa. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~33#Answer:How much bread do you think the flour, that the woman used, might make?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.34-35+Was it right for Jesus to teach in parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~34#Question:Was it right for Jesus to teach in parables?
trans-unit.source: Was it right for Jesus to teach in parables?
trans-unit.target: Je, ilikuwa sawa kwa Yesu kufundisha kwa mifano?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~34#Question:Was it right for Jesus to teach in parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~34#Answer:Was it right for Jesus to teach in parables?714835031
trans-unit.source: Yes, it had been predicted in the Old Testament that the Messiah would speak in parables. (34-35)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo, ilikuwa imetabiriwa katika Agano la Kale kwamba Mesiya angezungumza kwa mifano. (34-35)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~34#Answer:Was it right for Jesus to teach in parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~36#Question:What happened after Jesus returned/went home?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~36#Question:What happened after Jesus returned/went home?

trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya Yesu kurudi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~36#Alternate:What happened after Jesus returned/went home?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!13~36#Alternate:What happened after Jesus returned/went home?1131493366

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~36#Answer:What happened after Jesus returned/went home?1266667089

group.id: Q:MAT 13.37+Who did Jesus say was the one who sowed the good seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~37#Question:Who did Jesus say was the one who sowed the good seed?
trans-unit.source: Who did Jesus say was the one who sowed the good seed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nani aliyepanda mbegu nzuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~37#Question:Who did Jesus say was the one who sowed the good seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~37#Answer:Who did Jesus say was the one who sowed the good seed?2020721135
trans-unit.source: He said that the Son of Man, that is he himself, sowed the good seed. (37)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba Mwana wa Adamu, yaani yeye mwenyewe, alipanda mbegu nzuri. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~37#Answer:Who did Jesus say was the one who sowed the good seed?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.38+What did Jesus mean in his parable when he referred to the field?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~38#Question:What did Jesus mean in his parable when he referred to the field?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus mean in his parable when he referred to the field?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini katika mfano wake aliposema kuhusu shamba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Question:What did Jesus mean in his parable when he referred to the field?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~38#Answer:What did Jesus mean in his parable when he referred to the field?1257911206
trans-unit.source: When he talked of the field, he meant the people. (38)
trans-unit.target: Alipokuwa akisema juu ya shamba, alimaanisha watu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Answer:What did Jesus mean in his parable when he referred to the field?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.38+What did Jesus say that he meant when he talked of the good seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~38#Question:What did Jesus say that he meant when he talked of the good seed?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that he meant when he talked of the good seed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema alimaanisha nini alipozungumza kuhusu mbegu nzuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Question:What did Jesus say that he meant when he talked of the good seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~38#Answer:What did Jesus say that he meant when he talked of the good seed?809030049
trans-unit.source: He told them that, when he spoke of the good seed, he was referring to the people whom God ruled. (38)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba, alipozungumza juu ya mbegu nzuri, alikuwa akimaanisha watu ambao Mungu alitawala. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Answer:What did Jesus say that he meant when he talked of the good seed?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.38+What did Jesus tell them that he was really saying when he mentioned weeds in his parable?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~38#Question:What did Jesus tell them that he was really saying when he mentioned weeds in his parable?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell them that he was really saying when he mentioned weeds in his parable?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia kwamba alimaanisha nini hasa alipotaja magugu katika mfano wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Question:What did Jesus tell them that he was really saying when he mentioned weeds in his parable?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~38#Answer:What did Jesus tell them that he was really saying when he mentioned weeds in his parable?2072848572
trans-unit.source: He told them that the weeds stood for those who were not his people, but they were people who belonged to the evil one. (38)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba magugu yaliwakilisha wale ambao hawakuwa watu wake, bali walikuwa watu wa yule mwovu. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Answer:What did Jesus tell them that he was really saying when he mentioned weeds in his parable?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.38+What will people think that "the evil one" means?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~38#Question:What will people think that "the evil one" means?
trans-unit.source: What will people think that "the evil one" means?
trans-unit.target: Watu watafikiri "yule mwovu" anamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Question:What will people think that "the evil one" means?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~38#Answer:What will people think that "the evil one" means?285713655
trans-unit.source: The evil one is/means the devil-as also in the next verse. (38)
trans-unit.target: Mwovu ni/anamaanisha shetani - kama vile pia katika aya inayofuata. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~38#Answer:What will people think that "the evil one" means?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.39+When Jesus mentioned the harvest time, what did he mean?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~39#Question:When Jesus mentioned the harvest time, what did he mean?
trans-unit.source: When Jesus mentioned the harvest time, what did he mean?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimaanisha nini aliposema juu ya wakati wa mavuno?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~39#Question:When Jesus mentioned the harvest time, what did he mean?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~39#Answer:When Jesus mentioned the harvest time, what did he mean?-2118473182
trans-unit.source: He meant the end of this time on earth [when he returns]. (39)
trans-unit.target: Alimaanisha mwisho wa wakati huu duniani [wakati atakaporudi]. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~39#Answer:When Jesus mentioned the harvest time, what did he mean?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.40-41+What will happen at that time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~40#Question:What will happen at that time?
trans-unit.source: What will happen at that time?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kitakachotukia wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~40#Question:What will happen at that time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~40#Answer:What will happen at that time?-1522746204
trans-unit.source: Just as people gathered/would gather up the weeds and burned/would burn them at harvest time, God will send his angels to gather all those who do evil and all those who cause other people to do evil. He will have them thrown into the place of fire. (40-41)
trans-unit.target: Kama vile watu wanavyokusanya magugu wakati wa mavuno na kuyachoma, Mungu atatuma malaika zake kukusanya wale wote wanaofanya mabaya na wale wanaosababisha wengine kutenda mabaya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~40#Answer:What will happen at that time?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.42+What do you think is the reason that they will gnash their teeth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~42#Question:What do you think is the reason that they will gnash their teeth?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that they will gnash their teeth?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini watakuwa waking'ang'ania meno yao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~42#Question:What do you think is the reason that they will gnash their teeth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~42#Answer:What do you think is the reason that they will gnash their teeth?-1817965214
trans-unit.source: They will gnash their teeth because God will severely punish them. (42)
trans-unit.target: Na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkali wa kuadhibu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~42#Answer:What do you think is the reason that they will gnash their teeth?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.43+What do you think verse 43 means when it refers to God's people shining like the sun?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~43#Question:What do you think verse 43 means when it refers to God's people shining like the sun?
trans-unit.source: What do you think verse 43 means when it refers to God's people shining like the sun?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mstari wa 43 unamaanisha nini unaposema kwamba watu wa Mungu wanang'aa kama jua?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~43#Question:What do you think verse 43 means when it refers to God's people shining like the sun?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~43#Answer:What do you think verse 43 means when it refers to God's people shining like the sun?-1980509135
trans-unit.source: It means that they will be pure and very pleasing to God. They will reflect his glory/show how great God is. (43)
trans-unit.target: Maana yake ni kwamba watakuwa safi na watampendeza sana Mungu. Watamwakilisha utukufu wake/watamwonyesha jinsi Mungu alivyo mkuu. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~43#Answer:What do you think verse 43 means when it refers to God's people shining like the sun?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.43+When or where do you think that will happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~43#Question:When or where do you think that will happen?
trans-unit.source: When or where do you think that will happen?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri hilo litatukia lini au wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~43#Question:When or where do you think that will happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~43#Answer:When or where do you think that will happen?1652855844
trans-unit.source: That will happen in the age/future time to come in God's eternal kingdom. (43)
trans-unit.target: Hiyo itatokea katika enzi/wakati ujao katika ufalme wa milele wa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~43#Answer:When or where do you think that will happen?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.40-43+What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that people who have ears need to listen?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~40#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that people who have ears need to listen?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that people who have ears need to listen?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni kwa nini Yesu alisema kwamba watu walio na masikio wanahitaji kusikiliza?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~40#Question:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that people who have ears need to listen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~40#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that people who have ears need to listen?-1410306330
trans-unit.source: He said that they needed to listen because it/that/this is a very important matter. If people choose to be those who do evil, they will experience a terrible end, being put in the fire; but if they follow God they will experience God's glory forever. (40-43)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanahitaji kusikiliza kwa sababu ni jambo muhimu sana. Kama watu watachagua kuwa wale wanaofanya mabaya, watapata mwisho mbaya, wa kutupwa motoni; lakini kama watamfuata Mungu watapata utukufu wa Mungu milele (40-43).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~40#Answer:What do you think is the reason that Jesus said that people who have ears need to listen?

trans-unit.source: Matthew 13:44-46 Jesus told a parable about hidden treasure.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 13:44-46 Yesu alitoa mfano kuhusu hazina iliyofichwa.
