group.id: Q:MAT 13.44-46+What will people learn from the two parables Jesus told in verses 44-46?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~44#Question:What will people learn from the two parables Jesus told in verses 44-46?
trans-unit.source: What will people learn from the two parables Jesus told in verses 44-46?
trans-unit.target: Watu watajifunza nini kutokana na mifano miwili aliyoyasema Yesu katika mistari ya 44-46?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~44#Question:What will people learn from the two parables Jesus told in verses 44-46?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~44#Answer:What will people learn from the two parables Jesus told in verses 44-46?-249485737
trans-unit.source: When people realize the value of being part of the kingdom of heaven they will gladly give up all their possessions/they have in order to be included in that kingdom. (44-46)
trans-unit.target: Watu wanapotambua thamani ya kuwa sehemu ya ufalme wa mbinguni wataacha kwa furaha mali zao zote ili waweze kuingizwa katika ufalme huo. (44-46)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~44#Answer:What will people learn from the two parables Jesus told in verses 44-46?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.44+What will people who read this parable learn about the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~44#Question:What will people who read this parable learn about the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.source: What will people who read this parable learn about the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.target: Watu wanaosoma mfano huu watajifunza nini kuhusu ufalme wa mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~44#Question:What will people who read this parable learn about the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~44#Answer:What will people who read this parable learn about the kingdom of heaven?-488762717
trans-unit.source: This parable shows how very valuable being a part of the kingdom is. They begin to value everything else less important than their relationship to God. (44)
trans-unit.target: Mfano huu unaonyesha jinsi ilivyo ya thamani sana kuwa sehemu ya ufalme. Wanaanza kuthamini kila kitu kingine ambacho ni cha chini ya uhusiano wao na Mungu. (44)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~44#Answer:What will people who read this parable learn about the kingdom of heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.45-46+How is the kingdom of heaven like a merchant's search for fine pearls?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~45#Question:How is the kingdom of heaven like a merchant's search for fine pearls?
trans-unit.source: How is the kingdom of heaven like a merchant's search for fine pearls?
trans-unit.target: Ufalme wa mbinguni umefananaje na mfanya biashara mmoja mwenye kutafuta lulu nzuri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~45#Question:How is the kingdom of heaven like a merchant's search for fine pearls?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~45#Answer:How is the kingdom of heaven like a merchant's search for fine pearls?2061379721
trans-unit.source: The people, who discover the kingdom of heaven for what it truly is, are like a merchant who searched for and found a most valued pearl. People, who understand the kingdom of heaven, change the whole focus of their lives by becoming a part of the kingdom of heaven. (45-46)
trans-unit.target: Watu, ambao wanaugundua ufalme wa mbinguni kwa kile ulicho kweli, ni kama mfanyabiashara aliyetaka na kupata lulu yenye thamani kubwa. Watu, ambao wanaelewa ufalme wa mbinguni, hubadilisha mwelekeo mzima wa maisha yao kwa kuwa sehemu ya ufalme wa mbinguni. (45-46)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~45#Answer:How is the kingdom of heaven like a merchant's search for fine pearls?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!13~47#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 13:47-52 Jesus told a parable about people using nets to catch fish.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 13:47-52 Yesu alitoa kielezi cha watu waliokuwa wakitumia nyavu ili kuvua samaki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~47#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 13.47-52+What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~47#Question:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaeleza wanafunzi wake nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~47#Question:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~47#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?-1172768720
trans-unit.source: He explained the meaning of the parable about people using nets to catch fish.
trans-unit.target: Alieleza maana ya mfano wa watu wanaotumia nyavu ili kuvua samaki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~47#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.47-48+In these verses how did the people catch the fish?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~47#Question:In these verses how did the people catch the fish?
trans-unit.source: In these verses how did the people catch the fish?
trans-unit.target: Katika mistari hii watu walivua samaki jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~47#Question:In these verses how did the people catch the fish?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~47#Answer:In these verses how did the people catch the fish?-1634642835
trans-unit.source: They threw a net into the water and pulled out whatever fish were caught by the net. (47-48)
trans-unit.target: Walitupa wavu ndani ya maji na kuvuta samaki wowote ambao walichukua na wavu (47-48)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~47#Answer:In these verses how did the people catch the fish?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.48+What did the fishermen do after they caught the fish?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~48#Question:What did the fishermen do after they caught the fish?
trans-unit.source: What did the fishermen do after they caught the fish?
trans-unit.target: Wavuvi walifanya nini baada ya kupata samaki?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~48#Question:What did the fishermen do after they caught the fish?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~48#Answer:What did the fishermen do after they caught the fish?-1184671229
trans-unit.source: They separated the good, that is, the edible ones from the bad or useless ones. They kept the edible ones and threw away the rejected ones. (48)
trans-unit.target: Walitofautisha walio wazuri, yaani, wale wenye kuliwa na wale wasiofaa kitu au wasiofaa kitu, na wakawa na wale wenye kuliwa na kutupa wale wasiotakiwa. (48)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~48#Answer:What did the fishermen do after they caught the fish?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.49+When did Jesus say that people would be separated, as the fish were?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~49#Question:When did Jesus say that people would be separated, as the fish were?
trans-unit.source: When did Jesus say that people would be separated, as the fish were?
trans-unit.target: Ni wakati gani Yesu alisema kwamba watu wangetenganishwa, kama vile samaki walivyotenganishwa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~49#Question:When did Jesus say that people would be separated, as the fish were?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~49#Answer:When did Jesus say that people would be separated, as the fish were?-392811318
trans-unit.source: At the end of this present age, that is, the end of this present time. (49)
trans-unit.target: Katika mwisho wa enzi hii ya sasa, yaani, mwisho wa wakati huu wa sasa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~49#Answer:When did Jesus say that people would be separated, as the fish were?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.49+At the end of this present time, who will separate people into the two groups, that is, those who are acceptable to God and those who are not?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~49#Question:At the end of this present time, who will separate people into the two groups, that is, those who are acceptable to God and those who are not?
trans-unit.source: At the end of this present time, who will separate people into the two groups, that is, those who are acceptable to God and those who are not?
trans-unit.target: Mwishoni mwa wakati huu wa sasa, ni nani atakayetenganisha watu katika vikundi viwili, yaani, wale wanaokubalika kwa Mungu na wale wasiokubalika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~49#Question:At the end of this present time, who will separate people into the two groups, that is, those who are acceptable to God and those who are not?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~49#Answer:At the end of this present time, who will separate people into the two groups, that is, those who are acceptable to God and those who are not?-1463358514
trans-unit.source: God's angels will do that work. (49)
trans-unit.target: Malaika wa Mungu watafanya kazi hiyo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~49#Answer:At the end of this present time, who will separate people into the two groups, that is, those who are acceptable to God and those who are not?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.50+What will the angels do with those who are wicked?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~50#Question:What will the angels do with those who are wicked?
trans-unit.source: What will the angels do with those who are wicked?
trans-unit.target: Malaika watawafanya nini waovu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~50#Question:What will the angels do with those who are wicked?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~50#Answer:What will the angels do with those who are wicked?83458711
trans-unit.source: The angels will throw the wicked into hell to be punished. (50)
trans-unit.target: Na wale walio dhulumu watatupwa katika Jahannamu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~50#Answer:What will the angels do with those who are wicked?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.50+How can we know from verse 50 that those people will receive severe punishment?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~50#Question:How can we know from verse 50 that those people will receive severe punishment?
trans-unit.source: How can we know from verse 50 that those people will receive severe punishment?
trans-unit.target: Twaweza kujuaje kutokana na mstari wa 50 kwamba watu hao watapokea adhabu kali?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~50#Question:How can we know from verse 50 that those people will receive severe punishment?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~50#Answer:How can we know from verse 50 that those people will receive severe punishment?-2048321175
trans-unit.source: They will receive severe punishment in the place of fire because Jesus declared that they will cry and clamp their teeth together. (50)
trans-unit.target: Watapokea adhabu kali katika mahali pa moto kwa sababu Yesu alitangaza kwamba watalia na kusaga meno yao pamoja. (50)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~50#Answer:How can we know from verse 50 that those people will receive severe punishment?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.51+To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~51#Question:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?
trans-unit.source: To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza na nani katika mstari wa 51, alipowauliza kama walielewa kile ambacho alikuwa akiwafundisha/kuwaambia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Question:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!13~51#Alternate:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?-2111468151
trans-unit.source: To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza na nani katika mstari wa 51, alipowauliza kama walielewa yale aliyokuwa akiwafundisha?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Alternate:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!13~51#Alternate:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?-1089088139
trans-unit.source: To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been telling them?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumza na nani katika mstari wa 51, alipowauliza kama walielewa aliyowaambia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Alternate:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~51#Answer:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?-1520902531
trans-unit.source: He was talking to his disciples.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza na wanafunzi wake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Answer:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!13~51#Note:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?229996758
trans-unit.source: See verse 36.
trans-unit.target: Ona mstari wa 36.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Note:To whom do you think Jesus was talking in verse 51, when he asked them if they understood what he had been teaching/telling them?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.51+Did the disciples understand what Jesus was teaching them with these parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~51#Question:Did the disciples understand what Jesus was teaching them with these parables?
trans-unit.source: Did the disciples understand what Jesus was teaching them with these parables?
trans-unit.target: Je, wanafunzi walielewa kile ambacho Yesu alikuwa akiwafundisha kwa mifano hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Question:Did the disciples understand what Jesus was teaching them with these parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~51#Answer:Did the disciples understand what Jesus was teaching them with these parables?-471580901
trans-unit.source: Yes they did. (51)
trans-unit.target: Ndiyo walifanya hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~51#Answer:Did the disciples understand what Jesus was teaching them with these parables?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.52+Whom do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of "the teachers of the law" in verse 52?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~52#Question:Whom do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of "the teachers of the law" in verse 52?
trans-unit.source: Whom do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of "the teachers of the law" in verse 52?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri Yesu alikuwa akizungumzia nani alipotaja "walimu wa sheria" katika mstari wa 52?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Question:Whom do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of "the teachers of the law" in verse 52?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~52#Answer:Whom do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of "the teachers of the law" in verse 52?-2094182592
trans-unit.source: He meant the disciples. They were the ones whom he was teaching about the kingdom [and almost all Jewish people were taught the Old Testament scriptures from the time they were small. The Jews often called those scriptures "the law."] (52)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu wanafunzi. Walikuwa ni wale ambao alikuwa akiwafundisha kuhusu ufalme [na karibu Wayahudi wote walifundishwa maandiko ya Agano la Kale tangu wakati walipokuwa wadogo. Wayahudi mara nyingi waliyaita maandiko hayo "sheria"] (52)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Answer:Whom do you think Jesus meant when he spoke of "the teachers of the law" in verse 52?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.52+To whom did Jesus compare a teacher of the law?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~52#Question:To whom did Jesus compare a teacher of the law?
trans-unit.source: To whom did Jesus compare a teacher of the law?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimlinganisha mwalimu wa sheria na nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Question:To whom did Jesus compare a teacher of the law?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~52#Answer:To whom did Jesus compare a teacher of the law?1076960732
trans-unit.source: He compared a teacher of the law with the owner of a house. (52)
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha mwalimu wa sheria na mwenye nyumba. (52)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Answer:To whom did Jesus compare a teacher of the law?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.52+In what way did Jesus say that a teacher of the law was like the owner of a house?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~52#Question:In what way did Jesus say that a teacher of the law was like the owner of a house?
trans-unit.source: In what way did Jesus say that a teacher of the law was like the owner of a house?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba mwalimu wa sheria alikuwa kama mwenye nyumba katika maana gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Question:In what way did Jesus say that a teacher of the law was like the owner of a house?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~52#Answer:In what way did Jesus say that a teacher of the law was like the owner of a house?-1787930061
trans-unit.source: He said that a teacher of the law, who had been taught about the kingdom of heaven, was like the owner of a house who brought new treasures and old treasures out of his storeroom. (52)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba kila mwandishi, ambaye amefundishwa juu ya ufalme wa mbinguni, ni kama mwenye nyumba atoaye katika hazina yake vitu vipya na vya zamani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Answer:In what way did Jesus say that a teacher of the law was like the owner of a house?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.52+What do you know about the teachers of the law?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~52#Question:What do you know about the teachers of the law?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about the teachers of the law?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu walimu wa sheria?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Question:What do you know about the teachers of the law?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~52#Answer:What do you know about the teachers of the law?751758942
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The TEV and NIV translate "scribe" as "teacher of the law." The scribes were important people in the Jewish religious system. They were experts in knowing and interpreting the laws of Moses and in applying them to everyday life. (See "teacher of the law" in KBT in the "scribe" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Taarifa ya neno muhimu: TEV na NIV hutafsiri "mwandishi" kama "mwalimu wa sheria". Waandishi walikuwa watu muhimu katika mfumo wa kidini wa Kiyahudi. Walikuwa wataalam katika kujua na kutafsiri sheria za Musa na kuzitumia katika maisha ya kila siku. (Tazama "mwalimu wa sheria" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "mwandishi").
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~52#Answer:What do you know about the teachers of the law?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!13~53#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 13:53-58 The people of Nazareth rejected Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 13:53-58 Watu wa Nazareti walimkataa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~53#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 13.53-58+What did the people of Nazareth do concerning Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~53#Question:What did the people of Nazareth do concerning Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the people of Nazareth do concerning Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu wa Nazareti walimtendeaje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~53#Question:What did the people of Nazareth do concerning Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~53#Answer:What did the people of Nazareth do concerning Jesus?-1462305123
trans-unit.source: They rejected him. (57)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakamkanusha.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~53#Answer:What did the people of Nazareth do concerning Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.53-54+Where did Jesus go after he finished teaching about the parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~53#Question:Where did Jesus go after he finished teaching about the parables?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go after he finished teaching about the parables?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi baada ya kumaliza kufundisha juu ya mifano?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~53#Question:Where did Jesus go after he finished teaching about the parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~53#Answer:Where did Jesus go after he finished teaching about the parables?-190935244
trans-unit.source: He went to his hometown [which was Nazareth]. (53-54)
trans-unit.target: Alienda kwenye mji wake [uliokuwa Nazareti]. (53-54)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~53#Answer:Where did Jesus go after he finished teaching about the parables?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.54+What did Jesus do there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~54#Question:What did Jesus do there?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do there?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini huko?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Question:What did Jesus do there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:What did Jesus do there?2060355754
trans-unit.source: He taught the people in the synagogue. (54)
trans-unit.target: Aliwafundisha watu katika sinagogi. (54)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:What did Jesus do there?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.54+How did the people respond to what Jesus taught to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~54#Question:How did the people respond to what Jesus taught to them?
trans-unit.source: How did the people respond to what Jesus taught to them?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu aliwafundisha?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Question:How did the people respond to what Jesus taught to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:How did the people respond to what Jesus taught to them?-409794070
trans-unit.source: They were amazed/surprised about what he taught to them. (54)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakistaajabia yale aliyowafundisha.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:How did the people respond to what Jesus taught to them?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.54-57+What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~54#Question:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu wa Nazareti walimkataa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Question:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?957298248
trans-unit.source: They rejected him because they knew him and his family.
trans-unit.target: Walimkataa kwa sababu walimjua yeye na familia yake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?-712357505
trans-unit.source: They knew that he was [only] the carpenter's son.
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba alikuwa [tu] mwana wa seremala.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?-2019827512
trans-unit.source: They knew his mother, Mary.
trans-unit.target: Walimjua mama yake, Maria.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?-1010904324
trans-unit.source: They knew his brothers and sisters.
trans-unit.target: Waliwajua ndugu na dada zake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?1509412766
trans-unit.source: Therefore, they did not understand how he could know anything about what he taught to them. (54-57)
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, hawakuelewa jinsi angeweza kujua chochote kuhusu yale aliyowafundisha.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~54#Answer:What is the reason that the people of Nazareth rejected Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.57+Where did Jesus say that people do not honor a prophet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~57#Question:Where did Jesus say that people do not honor a prophet?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus say that people do not honor a prophet?
trans-unit.target: Ni wapi ambapo Yesu alisema kwamba watu hawamheshimu nabii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~57#Question:Where did Jesus say that people do not honor a prophet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~57#Answer:Where did Jesus say that people do not honor a prophet?-460814445
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that people do not honor a prophet in his own hometown and in his own family. (57)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watu hawamheshimu nabii katika mji wake wa nyumbani na katika familia yake mwenyewe (57).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~57#Answer:Where did Jesus say that people do not honor a prophet?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.58+What is the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~58#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu iliyomfanya Yesu asifanye miujiza mingi huko?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~58#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~58#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there?-1096278385
trans-unit.source: He did not do many miracles there because the people did not believe in him. (58)
trans-unit.target: Wala hakufanya miujiza mingi huko, kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~58#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not do many miracles there?

group.id: Q:MAT 13.58+What do you think it means to have faith in someone?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!13~58#Question:What do you think it means to have faith in someone?
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to have faith in someone?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri imani katika mtu fulani humaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~58#Question:What do you think it means to have faith in someone?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!13~58#Answer:What do you think it means to have faith in someone?-1809390536
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Faith is the quality of trusting someone. It is the act of wholeheartedly and steadfastly believing in the existence, power, and benevolence of a supreme being. (See "faith" in KBT in the "believe, believing, belief, faith, trust" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Uhakiki wa neno muhimu: Imani ni sifa ya kumwamini mtu. Ni kitendo cha kuamini kwa moyo wote na kwa uthabiti katika uwepo, nguvu, na wema wa mtu mkuu. (Tazama "imani" katika KBT katika "kuamini, kuamini, imani, imani, uaminifu" kuingia.)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!13~58#Answer:What do you think it means to have faith in someone?

trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Herod put John in prison?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Herode alimtia Yohana gerezani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~3#Alternate:What is the reason that Herod [ordered his soldiers to] put John in prison?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~3#Answer:What is the reason that Herod [ordered his soldiers to] put John in prison?420755776
trans-unit.source: Herod [ordered his soldiers to] put John in prison because John had said that it was against the [Mosaic] law for Herod to be married to Herodias, since [she also had been married to Herod's brother, Philip]. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Herode [aliamuru askari wake] wamweke Yohana gerezani kwa sababu Yohana alikuwa amesema kwamba ilikuwa kinyume cha sheria [ya Kimusa] kwa Herode kuolewa na Herodia, kwa kuwa [alikuwa pia ameolewa na Filipo ndugu ya Herode]. (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~3#Answer:What is the reason that Herod [ordered his soldiers to] put John in prison?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!14~3#Note:What is the reason that Herod [ordered his soldiers to] put John in prison?-179233539
trans-unit.source: The Mosaic law forbade a man to marry his brother's wife while the brother was still alive.
trans-unit.target: Sheria ya Musa ilikataza mwanamume kumwoa mke wa ndugu yake wakati ndugu yake alikuwa hai.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~3#Note:What is the reason that Herod [ordered his soldiers to] put John in prison?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~5#Answer:What is the reason that Herod did not kill John?-1201213533
trans-unit.source: He did not kill John because the Jews believed that he was a prophet. (5)
trans-unit.target: Hakumwua Yohana kwa sababu Wayahudi walimwamini kuwa nabii. (5)

group.id: Q:MAT 14.6-7+What is the reason that Herod promised to give the daughter of Herodias whatever she wanted?

trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Herod promised to give the daughter of Herodias whatever she wanted?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Herode alimwahidi binti ya Herodia chochote alichotaka?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~6#Question:What is the reason that Herod promised to give the daughter of Herodias whatever she wanted?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~6#Answer:What is the reason that Herod promised to give the daughter of Herodias whatever she wanted?727288600
trans-unit.source: Herod promised to give her whatever she wanted because she had danced in front of Herod and his guests on his birthday and that had pleased him very much. (6-7)
trans-unit.target: Herode alimwahidi kumpa chochote alichotaka kwa sababu alikuwa amecheza mbele ya Herode na wageni wake kwenye siku yake ya kuzaliwa na hiyo ilimpendeza sana. (6-7)

group.id: Q:MAT 14.15+What is the reason that the disciples wanted Jesus to send the crowds away?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~15#Answer:What is the reason that the disciples wanted Jesus to send the crowds away?1931408726
trans-unit.source: They wanted Jesus to send the crowds away so the people could buy some food for themselves. (15)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~16#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?583058087

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~22#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~22#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?-1389845431
trans-unit.source: He told them to get into the boat and go to the other side [of Lake Galilee]. (22)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia waingie katika mashua na kwenda upande ule mwingine [wa Ziwa Galilaya]. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~22#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.23+What is the reason that Jesus went up on a mountainside?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~23#Question:What is the reason that Jesus went up on a mountainside?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus went up on a mountainside?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomfanya Yesu apande mlima?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~23#Question:What is the reason that Jesus went up on a mountainside?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~23#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus went up on a mountainside?149383070
trans-unit.source: He went up on a mountainside to pray. (23)
trans-unit.target: Alipanda mlimani kusali. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~23#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus went up on a mountainside?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.24+What happened to the boat that the disciples were using?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~24#Question:What happened to the boat that the disciples were using?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the boat that the disciples were using?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa mashua ambayo wanafunzi walikuwa wakitumia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~24#Question:What happened to the boat that the disciples were using?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~24#Answer:What happened to the boat that the disciples were using?-1354814798
trans-unit.source: The boat was tossed/beaten by the waves because the wind was blowing against the boat. (24)
trans-unit.target: Mashua ilipigwa na mawimbi kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa ukivuma dhidi ya mashua. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~24#Answer:What happened to the boat that the disciples were using?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.26+How did the disciples react when they saw Jesus walking on top of the water?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~26#Question:How did the disciples react when they saw Jesus walking on top of the water?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples react when they saw Jesus walking on top of the water?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje walipomwona Yesu akitembea juu ya maji?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~26#Question:How did the disciples react when they saw Jesus walking on top of the water?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~26#Answer:How did the disciples react when they saw Jesus walking on top of the water?290540616
trans-unit.source: They were all terribly afraid because they thought they were seeing a spirit/ghost. (26)
trans-unit.target: Wote walikuwa na hofu sana kwa sababu walidhani kwamba walikuwa wakiona roho/roho. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~26#Answer:How did the disciples react when they saw Jesus walking on top of the water?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.27+What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~27#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~27#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~27#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?905173445
trans-unit.source: He told them who he was so that they would not be afraid. (27)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia yeye ni nani ili wasiogope. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~27#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.28+What did Peter tell Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~28#Question:What did Peter tell Jesus to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter tell Jesus to do?
trans-unit.target: Petro alimwambia Yesu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~28#Question:What did Peter tell Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~28#Answer:What did Peter tell Jesus to do?63678844
trans-unit.source: Peter told Jesus that he should command Peter to come to him on the water. (28)
trans-unit.target: Petro alimwambia Yesu kwamba anapaswa amwamuru Petro aje kwake juu ya maji. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~28#Answer:What did Peter tell Jesus to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.29+What did Jesus say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~29#Question:What did Jesus say to Peter?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to Peter?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~29#Question:What did Jesus say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~29#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter?375090879
trans-unit.source: Jesus told Peter to come [to him]. (29)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro aje kwake. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~29#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.29+What did Peter do after Jesus told him to come to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~29#Question:What did Peter do after Jesus told him to come to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter do after Jesus told him to come to him?
trans-unit.target: Petro alifanya nini baada ya Yesu kumwambia aje kwake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~29#Question:What did Peter do after Jesus told him to come to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~29#Answer:What did Peter do after Jesus told him to come to him?633002936
trans-unit.source: Peter got out of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus. (29)
trans-unit.target: Petro akatoka katika mashua na kutembea juu ya maji kumwendea Yesu. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~29#Answer:What did Peter do after Jesus told him to come to him?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.30+What is the reason that Peter became afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~30#Question:What is the reason that Peter became afraid?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Peter became afraid?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Petro aliogopa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~30#Question:What is the reason that Peter became afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~30#Answer:What is the reason that Peter became afraid?1256552963
trans-unit.source: He became afraid because he saw how the strong wind [was causing large/high waves]. (30)
trans-unit.target: Aliogopa kwa sababu aliona jinsi upepo ulivyokuwa na nguvu [ulivyokuwa ukisababisha mawimbi makubwa/ya juu].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~30#Answer:What is the reason that Peter became afraid?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.30+What happened to Peter after he became afraid?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~30#Question:What happened to Peter after he became afraid?
trans-unit.source: What happened to Peter after he became afraid?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa Petro baada ya yeye kuwa na hofu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~30#Question:What happened to Peter after he became afraid?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~30#Answer:What happened to Peter after he became afraid?-149524184
trans-unit.source: He started to sink [into the water]. (30)
trans-unit.target: Akaanza kuzama.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~30#Answer:What happened to Peter after he became afraid?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.31+How was Peter rescued from drowning?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~31#Question:How was Peter rescued from drowning?
trans-unit.source: How was Peter rescued from drowning?
trans-unit.target: Petro aliokolewaje asizame?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~31#Question:How was Peter rescued from drowning?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~31#Answer:How was Peter rescued from drowning?-1789546169
trans-unit.source: Jesus reached out his hand and caught Peter. (31)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliunyosha mkono wake na kumkamata Petro. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~31#Answer:How was Peter rescued from drowning?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.31+What did Jesus ask Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~31#Question:What did Jesus ask Peter?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask Peter?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza Petro nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~31#Question:What did Jesus ask Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~31#Answer:What did Jesus ask Peter?1678359544
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked Peter why he had not believed [that he could walk on the water/that Jesus could make him walk on the water]. (31)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza Petro kwa nini hakuamini [kwamba angeweza kutembea juu ya maji/kwamba Yesu angeweza kumfanya atembee juu ya maji]. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~31#Answer:What did Jesus ask Peter?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.32+What happened after Jesus and Peter climbed into the boat?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~32#Question:What happened after Jesus and Peter climbed into the boat?
trans-unit.source: What happened after Jesus and Peter climbed into the boat?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya Yesu na Petro kupanda ndani ya mashua?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~32#Question:What happened after Jesus and Peter climbed into the boat?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~32#Answer:What happened after Jesus and Peter climbed into the boat?87558413
trans-unit.source: The wind stopped blowing after they climbed into the boat. (32)
trans-unit.target: Walipoingia ndani ya mashua, upepo uliacha kuvuma. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~32#Answer:What happened after Jesus and Peter climbed into the boat?

group.id: Q:MAT 14.34-35+What did the people in the place/region of Gennesaret do when they recognized Jesus?

trans-unit.source: What did the people in the place/region of Gennesaret do when they recognized Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu katika eneo la Genesareti walifanya nini walipomtambua Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~34#Question:What did the people in the place/region of Gennesaret do when they recognized Jesus?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!14~34#Alternate:What did the people in the place/region of Gennesaret do when they recognized Jesus?423877352

trans-unit.target: Watu katika eneo la Genesareti walifanya nini walipomtambua Yesu?

trans-unit.source: They told other/the people to bring all those who were sick to Jesus. (34-35)

group.id: Q:MAT 14.36+What did the people beg Jesus to let them do?

trans-unit.source: What did the people beg Jesus to let them do?
trans-unit.target: Watu walimsihi Yesu awape ruhusa ya kufanya nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!14~36#Answer:What did the people beg Jesus to let them do?-700937223
trans-unit.source: They begged him to let the sick people touch the edge of his cloak/garment. (36)
trans-unit.target: Walimsihi waache wagonjwa waguse tu pindo la vazi lake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~36#Answer:What did the people beg Jesus to let them do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!14~36#Question:What happened to all of the sick people who had touched Jesus's cloak/garment?
trans-unit.source: What happened to all of the sick people who had touched Jesus's cloak/garment?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa wagonjwa wote waliokuwa wamegusa vazi/vazi la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!14~36#Question:What happened to all of the sick people who had touched Jesus's cloak/garment?

trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia kwa wagonjwa wote waliokuwa wamegusa vazi la Yesu?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!14~36#Alternate:What happened to all of the sick people who had touched Jesus's cloak/garment?548165531

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!15~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 15:1-20 Jesus explained what caused a person to be unacceptable to God. // Jesus explained the reason people sin.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 15:1-20 Yesu alieleza ni nini kinachomfanya mtu asiwe mwenye kukubalika kwa Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 15.1-20+What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~1#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake ni nini kilichomfanya mtu kuwa mwenye dhambi/kutokubalika kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~1#Alternate:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?1781230587
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake ni nini kilichomfanya mtu awe mtenda dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Alternate:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~1#Alternate:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?-1719511355
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake ni nini kinachofanya mtu asiwe mwenye kukubalika kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Alternate:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?1538585612
trans-unit.source: He said it is what comes out of a person's mouth that makes him sinful since those deeds/actions come from the heart. (18)
trans-unit.target: Alisema ni kile kinachotoka kinywani mwa mtu ambacho humfanya kuwa mwenye dhambi kwa kuwa matendo/vitendo hivyo vinatoka moyoni. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples made a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.1-20+What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~1#Question:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.target: Ni sababu gani ambayo mawazo/mawazo yanayotoka moyoni humfanya mtu kuwa mwenye dhambi/asiyokubalika kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Question:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?1570791923
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the thoughts that come from the heart make a person sinful?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya mawazo yanayotoka moyoni kumfanya mtu awe mwenye dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?1458821146
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the thoughts that come from the heart make a person unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini mawazo yanayotoka moyoni humfanya mtu asiwe mwenye kukubalika kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?271368321
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya mawazo yanayotoka moyoni kumfanya mtu awe mwenye dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?493876338
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the ideas that come from the heart make a person unacceptable to God?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya kwamba mawazo yanayotoka moyoni humfanya mtu asiwe mwenye kukubalika kwa Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Alternate:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~1#Answer:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?1515766333
trans-unit.source: Those thoughts/ideas make a person sinful/unacceptable because evil deeds, such as murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony and slander come from the evil thoughts/ideas that originate in the heart. (19)
trans-unit.target: Mawazo/mawazo hayo humfanya mtu kuwa mwenye dhambi/asiyekubalika kwa sababu matendo maovu, kama vile mauaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushuhuda wa uongo na uchongezi hutoka katika mawazo/mawazo maovu yanayotokana na moyo. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Answer:What is the reason that the thoughts/ideas that come from the heart make a person sinful/unacceptable to God?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.1-2+What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law ask Jesus about his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~1#Question:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law ask Jesus about his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law ask Jesus about his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na waandishi fulani walimwuliza Yesu nini kuhusu wanafunzi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Question:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law ask Jesus about his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~1#Answer:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law ask Jesus about his disciples?-105837731
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus why his disciples broke the tradition of the elders by not washing their hands before they ate. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu kwa nini wanafunzi wake walivunja mapokeo ya wazee kwa kutoosha mikono yao kabla ya kula. (1-2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~1#Answer:What did some Pharisees and teachers of the law ask Jesus about his disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.2+What do you think an elder is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~2#Question:What do you think an elder is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think an elder is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mzee ni nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~2#Question:What do you think an elder is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~2#Answer:What do you think an elder is?-1147296835
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The elders were the ancestors of the people. // An elder was an ancestor of the Jewish people.
trans-unit.target: Key Term Check: Wazee walikuwa mababu wa watu. // Mzee alikuwa babu wa watu wa Kiyahudi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~2#Answer:What do you think an elder is?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.3+What did Jesus reply to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~3#Question:What did Jesus reply to them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply to them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~3#Question:What did Jesus reply to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~3#Answer:What did Jesus reply to them?106685634
trans-unit.source: He replied by asking them why they broke the command of God in order to do what they taught. (3)
trans-unit.target: Aliwajibu kwa kuwauliza kwa nini walivunja amri ya Mungu ili kufanya yale waliyofundisha. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~3#Answer:What did Jesus reply to them?
