trans-unit.source: Which commandment did Jesus use as an example to show that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law broke a commandment of God?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitumia amri gani kuwa kielelezo cha kuonyesha kwamba Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria walivunja amri ya Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~4#Alternate:Which command/commandment did Jesus use as an example to show that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law broke a command/commandment of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~4#Answer:Which command/commandment did Jesus use as an example to show that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law broke a command/commandment of God?1179342874
trans-unit.source: He used the command/commandment of God that people should honor their father and mother. (4)
trans-unit.target: Alitumia amri ya Mungu kwamba watu wanapaswa kuheshimu baba na mama yao. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~4#Answer:Which command/commandment did Jesus use as an example to show that the Pharisees and the teachers of the law broke a command/commandment of God?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.5-6+How did the Pharisees and the teachers of the law break that command of God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~5#Question:How did the Pharisees and the teachers of the law break that command of God?
trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees and the teachers of the law break that command of God?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria walikiukaje amri hiyo ya Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~5#Question:How did the Pharisees and the teachers of the law break that command of God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~5#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the teachers of the law break that command of God?2069395266
trans-unit.source: They broke that command by not giving something to their father or mother that would have helped them because they had already dedicated that item/object to God. According to their teaching, anything dedicated to God could not be used for any other purpose. (5-6)
trans-unit.target: Walivunja amri hiyo kwa kutompa baba yao au mama yao kitu ambacho kingeweza kuwasaidia kwa sababu tayari walikuwa wamemtolea Mungu kitu hicho. Kulingana na mafundisho yao, kitu chochote kilichotolewa kwa Mungu hakingeweza kutumiwa kwa kusudi lingine lolote.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~5#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the teachers of the law break that command of God?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.10-11+What did Jesus tell the people made a person sinful?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~10#Question:What did Jesus tell the people made a person sinful?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the people made a person sinful?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia watu nini kilichomfanya mtu awe mtenda dhambi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~10#Question:What did Jesus tell the people made a person sinful?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~10#Answer:What did Jesus tell the people made a person sinful?-1678954890
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them that what goes into a person's mouth does not make him sinful, but what comes out of his mouth makes him sinful/unacceptable to God. (10-11)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia kwamba kile kinachoingia kinywani mwa mtu hakimfanyi kuwa mwenye dhambi, lakini kile kinachotoka kinywani mwake humfanya kuwa mwenye dhambi/kutokubalika kwa Mungu. (10-11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~10#Answer:What did Jesus tell the people made a person sinful?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.12+How did the Pharisees feel about what Jesus had said to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~12#Question:How did the Pharisees feel about what Jesus had said to them?
trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees feel about what Jesus had said to them?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walihisije kuhusu yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amewaambia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~12#Question:How did the Pharisees feel about what Jesus had said to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~12#Answer:How did the Pharisees feel about what Jesus had said to them?-70774288
trans-unit.source: They were offended by what he had said to them. (12)
trans-unit.target: Waliumizwa na yale ambayo alikuwa amewaambia. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~12#Answer:How did the Pharisees feel about what Jesus had said to them?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.15+What did Peter want Jesus to explain to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~15#Question:What did Peter want Jesus to explain to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter want Jesus to explain to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Petro alitaka Yesu awaeleze nini wanafunzi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~15#Question:What did Peter want Jesus to explain to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~15#Answer:What did Peter want Jesus to explain to the disciples?1588226896
trans-unit.source: He wanted Jesus to explain the parable in verse 11. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka Yesu aeleze mfano huo katika mstari wa 11. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~15#Answer:What did Peter want Jesus to explain to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.20+In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~20#Question:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?
trans-unit.source: In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?
trans-unit.target: Ni katika njia gani mtu alijifanya mwenye dhambi/asiye kukubalika kwa Mungu alipola bila kunawa mikono yake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~20#Question:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~20#Alternate:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?402042632
trans-unit.source: In what way did a person make himself sinful when he ate without washing his hands?
trans-unit.target: Mtu alijifanyaje kuwa mwenye dhambi kwa kula bila kunawa mikono?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~20#Alternate:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~20#Alternate:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?460005542
trans-unit.source: In what way did a person make himself unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?
trans-unit.target: Ni katika njia gani mtu alijifanya kuwa asiyefaa kwa Mungu alipola bila kunawa mikono?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~20#Alternate:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~20#Answer:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?1590604483
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that a person would not make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands. (20)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba mtu hawezi kujifanya mwenye dhambi/kutokubalika kwa Mungu wakati anakula bila kunawa mikono yake. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~20#Answer:In what way did a person make himself sinful/unacceptable to God when he ate without washing his hands?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!15~21#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 15:21-28 A woman from another nation/Canaan begged Jesus to heal her daughter.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 15:21-28 Mwanamke wa taifa jingine/Mkanaani alimsihi Yesu amponye binti yake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~21#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 15.21-28+What is the reason that a woman from Canaan came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~21#Question:What is the reason that a woman from Canaan came to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that a woman from Canaan came to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani mwanamke Mkanaani alimwendea Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~21#Question:What is the reason that a woman from Canaan came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that a woman from Canaan came to Jesus?1845517609
trans-unit.source: She came to him because her daughter was demon-possessed. She asked him to help her. (22, 25)
trans-unit.target: Alikuja kwake kwa sababu binti yake alikuwa amepagawa na roho mwovu. Alimwomba amsaidie (22, 25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~21#Answer:What is the reason that a woman from Canaan came to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.23+What did his disciples tell Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~23#Question:What did his disciples tell Jesus to do?
trans-unit.source: What did his disciples tell Jesus to do?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wake walimwambia Yesu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~23#Question:What did his disciples tell Jesus to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~23#Answer:What did his disciples tell Jesus to do?-1913999050
trans-unit.source: They told him to send the woman away because she continually shouted at them as she followed them. (23)
trans-unit.target: Walimwambia amfukuze mwanamke huyo kwa sababu aliendelea kuwapiga kelele alipokuwa akiwafuata.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~23#Answer:What did his disciples tell Jesus to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.24-26+What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~24#Question:What did Jesus say to the woman?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mwanamke huyo nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~24#Question:What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~24#Answer:What did Jesus say to the woman?-665002001
trans-unit.source: He told her that he was sent only to the people of Israel, who are like lost sheep. (24)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia kwamba alikuwa ametumwa kwa watu wa Israeli tu, ambao walikuwa kama kondoo waliopotea. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~24#Answer:What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~24#Answer:What did Jesus say to the woman?-354206083
trans-unit.source: He told her that it was not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs. (26)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia kwamba si sawa kuchukua mkate wa watoto na kuwatupia mbwa wao. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~24#Answer:What did Jesus say to the woman?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!15~24#Note:What did Jesus say to the woman?40337202
trans-unit.source: A popular attitude of the Jews toward the Gentiles, at that time, was that the Gentiles were like dogs. See comments in UBS Translator's guide for this verse.
trans-unit.target: Mtazamo wa Wayahudi ulioenea kwa watu wa Mataifa, wakati huo, ulikuwa kwamba watu wa Mataifa walikuwa kama mbwa. Ona maelezo katika mwongozo wa UBS Translator's kwa mstari huu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~24#Note:What did Jesus say to the woman?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.27+What did the woman reply to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~27#Question:What did the woman reply to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the woman reply to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke huyo alimjibuje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~27#Question:What did the woman reply to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~27#Answer:What did the woman reply to Jesus?60472214
trans-unit.source: She told him that even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia kwamba hata mbwa hula makombo ya chakula yanayoanguka kutoka mezani pa mabwana zao (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~27#Answer:What did the woman reply to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!15~27#Note:What did the woman reply to Jesus?1568919757
trans-unit.source: She was saying that even dogs have some rights. They are allowed to eat the scraps from their masters' table. She meant that he could help her a little just as dogs were/are fed. See comments in UBS Translator's guide for this verse.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akisema kwamba hata mbwa wana haki fulani. Wanaruhusiwa kula vipande vya chakula kutoka meza ya mabwana zao. Alidhani kwamba anaweza kumsaidia kidogo kama vile mbwa walivyolishwa. Tazama maoni katika mwongozo wa UBS Translator kwa mstari huu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~27#Note:What did the woman reply to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.28+What is the reason that Jesus did what she had requested?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~28#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did what she had requested?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus did what she had requested?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alifanya kama alivyoombwa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~28#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did what she had requested?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~28#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did what she had requested?-1041683953
trans-unit.source: He did what she requested because she had great faith [in him]. (28)
trans-unit.target: Alifanya alichoomba kwa sababu alikuwa na imani kubwa [kwake] (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~28#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did what she had requested?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.28+What happened to the woman's daughter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~28#Question:What happened to the woman's daughter?
trans-unit.source: What happened to the woman's daughter?
trans-unit.target: Binti ya mwanamke huyo alipatwa na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~28#Question:What happened to the woman's daughter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~28#Answer:What happened to the woman's daughter?-1239989587
trans-unit.source: Her daughter was healed [by Jesus]. (28)
trans-unit.target: Binti yake akaponywa [na Yesu] (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~28#Answer:What happened to the woman's daughter?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!15~29#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 15:29-39 Jesus fed four thousand men, plus women and children.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 15:29-39 Yesu aliwalisha wanaume elfu nne, pamoja na wanawake na watoto.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~29#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 15.29-39+What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~29#Question:What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini hasa alichofanya Yesu katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~29#Question:What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~29#Answer:What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?-1033975176
trans-unit.source: He healed many people. (30)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaponya watu wengi. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~29#Answer:What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~29#Answer:What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?-196219025
trans-unit.source: He fed four thousand men, plus women and children. (38)
trans-unit.target: Aliwalisha wanaume elfu nne, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~29#Answer:What were the main deeds that Jesus did in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.30+Whom did the people bring to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~30#Question:Whom did the people bring to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Whom did the people bring to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Watu walimletea nani Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~30#Question:Whom did the people bring to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~30#Answer:Whom did the people bring to Jesus?462963905
trans-unit.source: They brought people who could not walk, people who could not see, people whose hands and/or feet had been injured, people who could not talk and many other sick people. (30)
trans-unit.target: Walileta watu ambao hawakuweza kutembea, watu ambao hawakuweza kuona, watu ambao mikono na / au miguu yao ilikuwa imejeruhiwa, watu ambao hawakuweza kuzungumza na wagonjwa wengine wengi. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~30#Answer:Whom did the people bring to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.30+What did Jesus do for all of those sick people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~30#Question:What did Jesus do for all of those sick people?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do for all of those sick people?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafanyia nini wagonjwa hao wote?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~30#Question:What did Jesus do for all of those sick people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~30#Answer:What did Jesus do for all of those sick people?1768124773
trans-unit.source: He healed them all. (30)
trans-unit.target: Akawaponya wote. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~30#Answer:What did Jesus do for all of those sick people?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.31+What is the reason that the people praised God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~31#Question:What is the reason that the people praised God?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the people praised God?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichowafanya watu wamsifu Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~31#Question:What is the reason that the people praised God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~31#Answer:What is the reason that the people praised God?-396705486
trans-unit.source: They praised God because they saw people who had been mute, speaking. They saw people who had been crippled, healed. They saw people who had been lame, walking. And they saw people who had been blind, able to see. (31)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi walimwamini Mungu, wakampa sifa, walipowaona bubu wakiongea, viwete wakitembea na vipofu wakiona.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~31#Answer:What is the reason that the people praised God?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.32+What is the reason that Jesus felt compassion for those people?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~32#Question:What is the reason that Jesus felt compassion for those people?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus felt compassion for those people?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichomfanya Yesu awahurumie watu hao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~32#Question:What is the reason that Jesus felt compassion for those people?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus felt compassion for those people?-1816187711
trans-unit.source: He felt compassion for them because they had been with him for three days and they had nothing to eat. Jesus did not want to send them away hungry. (32)
trans-unit.target: Aliwahurumia, kwa sababu walikuwa wamekaa naye siku tatu, na hawakuwa na chakula. Yesu hakutaka kuwaacha waende zao wakiwa na njaa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus felt compassion for those people?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.32+What is the reason that Jesus did not want to send the people away hungry?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~32#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did not want to send the people away hungry?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus did not want to send the people away hungry?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Yesu hakutaka kuwaacha watu waende zao wakiwa na njaa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~32#Question:What is the reason that Jesus did not want to send the people away hungry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want to send the people away hungry?536291062
trans-unit.source: He did not want to send the people away hungry because he was concerned that they might collapse/faint on their way home. (32)
trans-unit.target: Hakutaka kuwaaga watu wakiwa na njaa kwa sababu aliogopa kwamba huenda wakazimia njiani. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus did not want to send the people away hungry?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.34+How much food did the disciples have?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~34#Question:How much food did the disciples have?
trans-unit.source: How much food did the disciples have?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa na chakula kingi kadiri gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~34#Question:How much food did the disciples have?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~34#Answer:How much food did the disciples have?2032623783
trans-unit.source: They had seven loaves and a few small fish. (34)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na mikate saba na samaki wadogo wachache. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~34#Answer:How much food did the disciples have?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.35-36+What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~35#Question:What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini kwa ile mikate na samaki baada ya kuambia umati uketi chini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~35#Question:What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~35#Answer:What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?-1821643592
trans-unit.source: He took the loaves and the fish and thanked [God] for them.
trans-unit.target: Anachukua mikate na samaki na kushukuru [Mungu] kwa ajili yao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~35#Answer:What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~35#Answer:What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?-229124711
trans-unit.source: Then he broke the loaves and the fish into pieces and gave the pieces of bread and fish to the disciples, who then gave them to the people. (35-36)
trans-unit.target: Kisha akaimega ile mikate na samaki na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, nao wakawapa watu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~35#Answer:What did Jesus do with the loaves and the fish after he had told the crowd to sit on the ground?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.37+How did the people feel after they ate?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~37#Question:How did the people feel after they ate?
trans-unit.source: How did the people feel after they ate?
trans-unit.target: Watu walihisije baada ya kula?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~37#Question:How did the people feel after they ate?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~37#Answer:How did the people feel after they ate?1567450883
trans-unit.source: They all ate as much as they wanted. // They were all satisfied. (37)
trans-unit.target: Wote walikula na kushiba.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~37#Answer:How did the people feel after they ate?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.37+How much food remained/was left over?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~37#Question:How much food remained/was left over?
trans-unit.source: How much food remained/was left over?
trans-unit.target: Ni kiasi gani cha chakula kilichobaki?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~37#Question:How much food remained/was left over?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~37#Alternate:How much food remained/was left over?1710668632
trans-unit.source: How much food remained?
trans-unit.target: Ni chakula kiasi gani kilichobaki?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~37#Alternate:How much food remained/was left over?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!15~37#Alternate:How much food remained/was left over?2129716351
trans-unit.source: How much food was left over?
trans-unit.target: Ni chakula kiasi gani kilichobaki?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~37#Alternate:How much food remained/was left over?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~37#Answer:How much food remained/was left over?-1201456065
trans-unit.source: The disciples gathered/picked up seven baskets full of broken pieces. (37)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wakakusanya vikapu saba vilivyojaa vipande vilivyovunjika. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~37#Answer:How much food remained/was left over?

group.id: Q:MAT 15.39+Where did Jesus go after he had sent the crowd away?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!15~39#Question:Where did Jesus go after he had sent the crowd away?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go after he had sent the crowd away?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi baada ya kuufungua umati?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~39#Question:Where did Jesus go after he had sent the crowd away?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!15~39#Answer:Where did Jesus go after he had sent the crowd away?-84963907
trans-unit.source: He entered/got into the boat and went to the area/region of Magadan. (39)
trans-unit.target: Aliingia/kupanda mashua na kwenda eneo/eneo la Magadani. (39)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!15~39#Answer:Where did Jesus go after he had sent the crowd away?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!16~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 16:1-4 The Pharisees and Sadducees asked Jesus to show them a sign/miracle (to prove that he came from God).
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 16:1-4 Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walimwomba Yesu awaonyeshe ishara/mwujiza (ili kuthibitisha kwamba alitoka kwa Mungu).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 16.1-4+What is the reason that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~1#Question:What is the reason that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walimjia Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Question:What is the reason that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~1#Answer:What is the reason that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus?-1572309307
trans-unit.source: They came to him so that they could test him. (1)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwendea ili wamjaribu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Answer:What is the reason that the Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.1+What did the Pharisees and the Sadducees ask Jesus to do, in order to test him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~1#Question:What did the Pharisees and the Sadducees ask Jesus to do, in order to test him?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees and the Sadducees ask Jesus to do, in order to test him?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo walimwomba Yesu afanye nini, ili kumjaribu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Question:What did the Pharisees and the Sadducees ask Jesus to do, in order to test him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees and the Sadducees ask Jesus to do, in order to test him?-1354728805
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus to show them a sign from heaven. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walimwomba Yesu awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Answer:What did the Pharisees and the Sadducees ask Jesus to do, in order to test him?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.1+What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~1#Question:What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani walimwomba Yesu awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Question:What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~1#Answer:What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?-913643641
trans-unit.source: They wanted him to show them a sign from heaven [to prove that he came from God]. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walimtaka awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni [ili kuthibitisha kwamba alitoka kwa Mungu]. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Answer:What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!16~1#Note:What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?840921089
trans-unit.source: Also See Matthew 12:38.
trans-unit.target: Ona pia Mathayo 12:38.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~1#Note:What is the reason that they wanted Jesus to show them a sign from heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.2-3+What did Jesus say to the Pharisees and the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~2#Question:What did Jesus say to the Pharisees and the Sadducees?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the Pharisees and the Sadducees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini Mafarisayo na Masadukayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~2#Question:What did Jesus say to the Pharisees and the Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~2#Answer:What did Jesus say to the Pharisees and the Sadducees?1691653949
trans-unit.source: He told them that they were able to predict the weather by looking at the sky, but they were not able to explain the signs/events that were happening at that time. (2-3)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba walikuwa na uwezo wa kutabiri hali ya hewa kwa kuangalia angani, lakini hawakuweza kuelezea ishara/matukio yaliyokuwa yakitokea wakati huo. (2-3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~2#Answer:What did Jesus say to the Pharisees and the Sadducees?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.4+What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~4#Question:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini ambacho kingetolewa kwa kizazi kiovu na chenye uzinzi/kiasicho na uaminifu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~4#Question:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!16~4#Alternate:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?1222475618
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous generation?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kizazi kiovu na chenye uzinzi kingepokea nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~4#Alternate:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!16~4#Alternate:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?-1642630847
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and unfaithful generation?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kizazi kiovu na kisicho na uaminifu kingepokea nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~4#Alternate:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~4#Answer:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?1130380890
trans-unit.source: He said that the only sign that would be given to it was the sign of Jonah. (4)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba ishara pekee ambayo ingetolewa ni ile ishara ya Yona. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~4#Answer:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!16~4#Note:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?840986625
trans-unit.source: Also See Matthew 12:39.
trans-unit.target: Ona pia Mathayo 12:39.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~4#Note:What did Jesus say would be given to a wicked and adulterous/unfaithful generation?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!16~5#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 16:5-12 Jesus told his disciples to beware of the wrong teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 16:5-12 Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wajihadhari na mafundisho yasiyo ya kweli ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~5#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 16.5-12+About what did Jesus warn his disciples in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~5#Question:About what did Jesus warn his disciples in these verses?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus warn his disciples in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya wanafunzi wake kuhusu nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~5#Question:About what did Jesus warn his disciples in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~5#Answer:About what did Jesus warn his disciples in these verses?-205895926
trans-unit.source: He warned them about what the Pharisees and the Sadducees taught. (12)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya kuhusu mafundisho ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~5#Answer:About what did Jesus warn his disciples in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.5+What did the disciples forget to bring with them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~5#Question:What did the disciples forget to bring with them?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples forget to bring with them?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walisahau kuleta nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~5#Question:What did the disciples forget to bring with them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~5#Answer:What did the disciples forget to bring with them?1164091316
trans-unit.source: They had forgotten to bring bread. (5)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wamesahau kuleta mkate. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~5#Answer:What did the disciples forget to bring with them?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.6+About what did Jesus warn the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~6#Question:About what did Jesus warn the disciples?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus warn the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya wanafunzi wake kuhusu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~6#Question:About what did Jesus warn the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~6#Answer:About what did Jesus warn the disciples?-1605275301
trans-unit.source: He warned them about the yeast [that is, the teachings] of the Pharisees and Sadducees. (6)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaonya kuhusu chachu [yaani, mafundisho] ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~6#Answer:About what did Jesus warn the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.7+What had the disciples thought when Jesus warned them about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~7#Question:What had the disciples thought when Jesus warned them about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?
trans-unit.source: What had the disciples thought when Jesus warned them about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu walifikiri nini Yesu alipowaonya kuhusu chachu ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~7#Question:What had the disciples thought when Jesus warned them about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~7#Answer:What had the disciples thought when Jesus warned them about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?1383060137
trans-unit.source: They thought Jesus had warned them because they had forgotten to bring bread. (7)
trans-unit.target: Walidhani Yesu alikuwa amewaonya kwa sababu walikuwa wamesahau kuleta mikate. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~7#Answer:What had the disciples thought when Jesus warned them about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.8+What did Jesus say to the disciples after he heard them talking about not having any bread?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~8#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples after he heard them talking about not having any bread?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the disciples after he heard them talking about not having any bread?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wanafunzi wake baada ya kusikia wakizungumza kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~8#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples after he heard them talking about not having any bread?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~8#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples after he heard them talking about not having any bread?-524497832
trans-unit.source: He told them that they did not believe [in him] very much. (8)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba hawakuamini [kwake] sana. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~8#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples after he heard them talking about not having any bread?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.8+What did Jesus ask the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~8#Question:What did Jesus ask the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza wanafunzi swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~8#Question:What did Jesus ask the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~8#Answer:What did Jesus ask the disciples?-2047895684
trans-unit.source: He asked them why they were talking about not having any bread. (8)
trans-unit.target: Anawauliza kwa nini wanajadiliana kuhusu kutokuwa na mikate. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~8#Answer:What did Jesus ask the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.9-10+About what did Jesus remind them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~9#Question:About what did Jesus remind them?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus remind them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwakumbusha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~9#Question:About what did Jesus remind them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~9#Answer:About what did Jesus remind them?977056096
trans-unit.source: He reminded them about the baskets full of leftover food that they had gathered/picked up after [Jesus] fed the crowd of five thousand people and the crowd of four thousand people. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakumbusha juu ya vikapu vilivyojaa chakula kilichobaki ambacho walikuwa wamekusanya/kuchukua baada ya [Yesu] kulisha umati wa watu elfu tano na umati wa watu elfu nne (9-10).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~9#Answer:About what did Jesus remind them?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.11+About what did Jesus ask the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~11#Question:About what did Jesus ask the disciples?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus ask the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza wanafunzi wake swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~11#Question:About what did Jesus ask the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~11#Answer:About what did Jesus ask the disciples?-1739359410
trans-unit.source: He asked them why they did not understand that he was not teaching/talking to them about bread. (11)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kwa nini hawakuelewa kuwa hakuwa akiwafundisha/kuwaambia juu ya mkate. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~11#Answer:About what did Jesus ask the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.12+About what Jesus was warning them did the disciples finally understand?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~12#Question:About what Jesus was warning them did the disciples finally understand?
trans-unit.source: About what Jesus was warning them did the disciples finally understand?
trans-unit.target: Je! wanafunzi walielewa hatimaye juu ya kile ambacho Yesu alikuwa akiwaonya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~12#Question:About what Jesus was warning them did the disciples finally understand?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~12#Answer:About what Jesus was warning them did the disciples finally understand?-1215979193
trans-unit.source: They understood that Jesus was not warning them about the yeast used in bread, but about what the Pharisees and Sadducees taught. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walielewa kwamba Yesu hakuwa akiwaonya kuhusu chachu inayotumiwa katika mkate, bali kuhusu mafundisho ya Mafarisayo na Masadukayo. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~12#Answer:About what Jesus was warning them did the disciples finally understand?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!16~13#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 16:13-20 Peter declared that Jesus is the Messiah/the Savior whom God had sent.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 16:13-20 Petro alitangaza kwamba Yesu ndiye Mesiya/Mwokozi aliyetumwa na Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 16.13-20+What did Jesus ask his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~13#Question:What did Jesus ask his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza wanafunzi wake swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Question:What did Jesus ask his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~13#Answer:What did Jesus ask his disciples?-782000419
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked them who people said the Son of Man was. (13)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza watu wanasema Mwana wa Adamu ni nani. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Answer:What did Jesus ask his disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.13-20+What did his disciples reply to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~13#Question:What did his disciples reply to him?
trans-unit.source: What did his disciples reply to him?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wake walimjibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Question:What did his disciples reply to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~13#Answer:What did his disciples reply to him?-960943769
trans-unit.source: They told him that some people said that he was John the Baptist, some people said he was Elijah and some people said that he was Jeremiah or one of the prophets. (14)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwambia kwamba watu wengine walisema ni Yohana Mbatizaji, wengine walisema ni Eliya na wengine walisema ni Yeremia au mmoja wa manabii. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Answer:What did his disciples reply to him?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.13-20+Then what did Jesus ask his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~13#Question:Then what did Jesus ask his disciples?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus ask his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Kisha Yesu akawauliza wanafunzi wake nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Question:Then what did Jesus ask his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~13#Answer:Then what did Jesus ask his disciples?75092685
trans-unit.source: He asked them who they said that he was. (15)
trans-unit.target: Akawauliza, Nanyi mwasema ya kwamba mimi ni nani? (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Answer:Then what did Jesus ask his disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.13-20+What did Simon Peter answer to Jesus's question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~13#Question:What did Simon Peter answer to Jesus's question?
trans-unit.source: What did Simon Peter answer to Jesus's question?
trans-unit.target: Simoni Petro alijibuje swali la Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Question:What did Simon Peter answer to Jesus's question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~13#Answer:What did Simon Peter answer to Jesus's question?1713159150
trans-unit.source: Simon Peter said that Jesus was the Messiah, the Son of the living God. (16)
trans-unit.target: Simoni Petro alisema kwamba Yesu alikuwa ndiye Masihi, Mwana wa Mungu aliye hai. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~13#Answer:What did Simon Peter answer to Jesus's question?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.17+According to what Jesus said, how was the information from verse 16 revealed to Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~17#Question:According to what Jesus said, how was the information from verse 16 revealed to Peter?
trans-unit.source: According to what Jesus said, how was the information from verse 16 revealed to Peter?
trans-unit.target: Kulingana na maneno ya Yesu, Petro alifunuliwaje habari iliyo katika mstari wa 16?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~17#Question:According to what Jesus said, how was the information from verse 16 revealed to Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~17#Answer:According to what Jesus said, how was the information from verse 16 revealed to Peter?-815254620
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that his Father in heaven had revealed that information to Peter. (17)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Baba yake wa mbinguni alikuwa amemfunulia Petro habari hiyo. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~17#Answer:According to what Jesus said, how was the information from verse 16 revealed to Peter?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.18+What did Jesus say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~18#Question:What did Jesus say to Peter?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to Peter?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Question:What did Jesus say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~18#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter?1052112812
trans-unit.source: Jesus told Peter that he was like a rock that one or a builder uses to make the foundation of a building. Jesus said that Peter would be like the foundation of the church. (18)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro kwamba alikuwa kama jiwe ambalo mtu au mjenzi hutumia kuweka msingi wa jengo. Yesu alisema kwamba Petro angekuwa kama msingi wa kanisa. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Answer:What did Jesus say to Peter?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!16~18#Note:What did Jesus say to Peter?14382231
trans-unit.source: See comments in UBS handbook on Matthew for this verse.
trans-unit.target: Ona maelezo katika kitabu cha UBS juu ya Mathayo kuhusu mstari huu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Note:What did Jesus say to Peter?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.18+What do you think the church is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~18#Question:What do you think the church is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the church is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri kanisa ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Question:What do you think the church is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~18#Answer:What do you think the church is?1042835262
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In this verse, it is all those who believe in Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Katika mstari huu, ni wale wote wanaomwamini Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Answer:What do you think the church is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!16~18#Note:What do you think the church is?-938114333
trans-unit.source: See "church" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona neno "kanisa" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Note:What do you think the church is?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.18+What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Question:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?

trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kwamba nguvu za Hadesi hazitaweza kufanya dhidi ya kanisa?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that the power of death will not be able to do against the church?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kwamba nguvu za kifo hazingeweza kufanya dhidi ya kanisa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Alternate:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!16~18#Alternate:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?-326517476
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that the gates of Hades will not be able to do against the church?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kwamba milango ya kuzimu haitaweza kufanya dhidi ya kanisa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Alternate:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say that the gates of death will not be able to do against the church?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kwamba malango ya kifo hayataweza kufanya dhidi ya kanisa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Alternate:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~18#Answer:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?-1812950125
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that the power of death/Hades will not be able to overcome/destroy/resist the church. (18)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba nguvu za kifo/Hadesi hazitaweza kushinda/kuharibu/kupinga kanisa. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~18#Answer:What did Jesus say that the power/gates of Hades/death will not be able to do against the church?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.19+What did Jesus tell Peter that he was going to give to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~19#Question:What did Jesus tell Peter that he was going to give to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell Peter that he was going to give to him?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.21-28+What did Jesus explain to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~21#Question:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus explain to his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaeleza wanafunzi wake nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~21#Question:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~21#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?669647397
trans-unit.source: He explained to them that he had to go to Jerusalem where the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law would cause him to suffer very much.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaeleza wanafunzi wake kwamba ni lazima aende Yerusalemu ambako wazee, makuhani wakuu, na walimu wa Sheria wangemfanya ateseke sana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~21#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~21#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?-1659367279
trans-unit.source: Then the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law would have him put to death/executed/killed.
trans-unit.target: Kisha wazee, makuhani wakuu na walimu wa sheria wangemwua/kumwua/kumwua.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~21#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~21#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?615551848
trans-unit.source: On the third day [God] would raise him to life. (21)
trans-unit.target: Siku ya tatu [Mungu] atamfufua. (21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~21#Answer:What did Jesus explain to his disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.23+What did Jesus reply to Peter?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.26+What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~26#Question:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza wanafunzi wake nini katika mstari wa 26?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~26#Question:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~26#Answer:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?-327713944
trans-unit.source: He asked them, "What good would it be if a man owns everything in the world/everything that he wants, but lost his own soul/eternal life?"
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza, "Itamfaidia mtu nini kuupata ulimwengu wote/kila kitu anachotaka, lakini aipoteze nafsi yake/uhai wa milele?"
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~26#Answer:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~26#Answer:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?4581678
trans-unit.source: He also asked them what can a man give in exchange for his own soul/eternal life? (26)
trans-unit.target: Pia aliwauliza ni nini ambacho mtu anaweza kutoa ili kubadilisha nafsi yake/uhai wa milele? (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~26#Answer:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!16~26#Note:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?814148888
trans-unit.source: This is a rhetorical question for which Jesus did not expect an answer.
trans-unit.target: Yesu hakutarajia jibu la swali hilo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~26#Note:What did Jesus ask his disciples in verse 26?

group.id: Q:MAT 16.26+What do you think the answer is to both of his questions?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!16~26#Question:What do you think the answer is to both of his questions?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the answer is to both of his questions?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri jibu la maswali yake mawili ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~26#Question:What do you think the answer is to both of his questions?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!16~26#Answer:What do you think the answer is to both of his questions?-1594161473
trans-unit.source: There is nothing that anyone can give in such an exchange.
trans-unit.target: Hakuna kitu ambacho mtu yeyote anaweza kutoa kwa kubadilishana hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!16~26#Answer:What do you think the answer is to both of his questions?

trans-unit.source: What did Peter volunteer to do?
trans-unit.target: Petro alijitolea kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~4#Question:What did Peter volunteer to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~4#Answer:What did Peter volunteer to do?-909754065
trans-unit.source: He volunteered to make three shelters, one for Jesus, one for Moses and one for Elijah. (4)
trans-unit.target: Alijitolea kujenga vibanda vitatu, kimoja cha Yesu, kimoja cha Musa, na kimoja cha Eliya. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~4#Answer:What did Peter volunteer to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.5+What happened while Peter was still talking?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~5#Question:What happened while Peter was still talking?
trans-unit.source: What happened while Peter was still talking?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotokea Petro alipokuwa bado anazungumza?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~5#Question:What happened while Peter was still talking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~5#Answer:What happened while Peter was still talking?-1193106952
trans-unit.source: A bright cloud covered all six of them/people.
trans-unit.target: Na wingu jangavu likawafunika wote sita.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~5#Answer:What happened while Peter was still talking?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~5#Answer:What happened while Peter was still talking?-1782588289
trans-unit.source: A voice spoke from the cloud and said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him." (5)
trans-unit.target: Sauti kutoka katika wingu ilisema: "Huyu ni Mwanangu, mpendwa wangu; nimemkubali; msikilizeni yeye". (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~5#Answer:What happened while Peter was still talking?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.6+How did the disciples react to hearing the voice?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~6#Question:How did the disciples react to hearing the voice?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples react to hearing the voice?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje waliposikia sauti hiyo?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~6#Answer:How did the disciples react to hearing the voice?650589054
trans-unit.source: They were very afraid. They fell face down to the ground. (6)
trans-unit.target: Waliogopa sana na kuanguka chini kifudifudi (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~6#Answer:How did the disciples react to hearing the voice?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.8+Where did Moses and Elijah go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~8#Question:Where did Moses and Elijah go?
trans-unit.source: Where did Moses and Elijah go?
trans-unit.target: Musa na Eliya walienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~8#Question:Where did Moses and Elijah go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~8#Answer:Where did Moses and Elijah go?202094287
trans-unit.source: They disappeared/vanished. (8)
trans-unit.target: Walipotea/walipotea. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~8#Answer:Where did Moses and Elijah go?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.9+What did Jesus tell the three disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~9#Question:What did Jesus tell the three disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the three disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi watatu wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~9#Question:What did Jesus tell the three disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~9#Answer:What did Jesus tell the three disciples to do?-1865102405
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them not to tell anyone what they had seen until [God] raised the Son of Man from the dead. (9)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaamuru wasimwambie mtu yeyote yale waliyoyaona mpaka [Mungu] atakapokuwa amemfufua Mwana wa binadamu kutoka kwa wafu. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~9#Answer:What did Jesus tell the three disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.13+About whom was Jesus (really) talking in verses 11-13?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~13#Question:About whom was Jesus (really) talking in verses 11-13?
trans-unit.source: About whom was Jesus (really) talking in verses 11-13?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu nani (kwa kweli) katika mstari wa 11-13?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~13#Question:About whom was Jesus (really) talking in verses 11-13?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~13#Answer:About whom was Jesus (really) talking in verses 11-13?92679824
trans-unit.source: He was talking about John the Baptist. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa akizungumza kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~13#Answer:About whom was Jesus (really) talking in verses 11-13?

trans-unit.source: Matthew 17:14-23 Jesus commanded a demon to leave the body of a boy.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 17:14-23 Yesu aliamuru roho mwovu amfukuze mvulana fulani.

group.id: Q:MAT 17.14-23+What miracle did Jesus do in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~14#Question:What miracle did Jesus do in these verses?
trans-unit.source: What miracle did Jesus do in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya muujiza gani katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~14#Question:What miracle did Jesus do in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~14#Answer:What miracle did Jesus do in these verses?-1705762971
trans-unit.source: He commanded a demon to leave the body of a boy and he healed the boy. (18)
trans-unit.target: Aliamuru pepo aondoke katika mwili wa mvulana na akamponya mvulana huyo. (18)

group.id: Q:MAT 17.14-15+What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~14#Question:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini mtu fulani alimwendea Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~14#Question:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~14#Answer:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?-558425179
trans-unit.source: He came to Jesus because his son suffered from having seizures.
trans-unit.target: Alikuja kwa Yesu kwa sababu mwana wake alikuwa na ugonjwa wa kifafa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~14#Answer:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~14#Answer:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?1718367492
trans-unit.source: His son often fell into the fire or into the water.
trans-unit.target: Mara nyingi mwanawe alianguka ndani ya moto au ndani ya maji.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~14#Answer:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~14#Answer:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?877018571
trans-unit.source: He came to ask the Lord to have mercy on his son [and to heal him]. (14-15)
trans-unit.target: Alikuja kumwomba Bwana amhurumie mwanawe [na kumponya]. (14-15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~14#Answer:What is the reason that a man came to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.16+How had the man already tried to have someone heal his son?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~16#Question:How had the man already tried to have someone heal his son?
trans-unit.source: How had the man already tried to have someone heal his son?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alikuwa tayari amejaribuje kupata mtu fulani aponye mwana wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~16#Question:How had the man already tried to have someone heal his son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~16#Answer:How had the man already tried to have someone heal his son?-1422460528
trans-unit.source: He had taken his son to Jesus's disciples, but they could not heal him. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa amempeleka mwanawe kwa wanafunzi wa Yesu, lakini hawakuweza kumponya. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~16#Answer:How had the man already tried to have someone heal his son?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.18+What did Jesus do to heal the boy?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~18#Question:What did Jesus do to heal the boy?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do to heal the boy?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini ili kumponya mvulana huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~18#Question:What did Jesus do to heal the boy?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~18#Answer:What did Jesus do to heal the boy?-1210899145
trans-unit.source: Jesus rebuked the demon and it came out of the boy. The boy was healed at that moment. (18)
trans-unit.target: Yesu akamkemea huyo pepo mchafu, naye akamtoka, na yule mtoto akapona tangu saa ileile.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~18#Answer:What did Jesus do to heal the boy?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.19+What had the disciples asked Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~19#Question:What had the disciples asked Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What had the disciples asked Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walikuwa wamemwuliza Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~19#Question:What had the disciples asked Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~19#Answer:What had the disciples asked Jesus?-1418426916
trans-unit.source: They asked him why they had not been able to command the demon to leave the boy. (19)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza kwa nini hawakuweza kumwamuru pepo huyo amtoe yule mvulana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~19#Answer:What had the disciples asked Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.20+What answer did Jesus give to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~20#Question:What answer did Jesus give to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What answer did Jesus give to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwapa wanafunzi jibu gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Question:What answer did Jesus give to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~20#Answer:What answer did Jesus give to the disciples?-1862208562
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them that (the reason) they could not command the demon to leave the boy was because they had not believed more in God. (20)
trans-unit.target: Yesu akawaambia kwamba (sababu) hawakuweza kumwamuru pepo amtoe yule kijana ni kwa sababu hawakuwa na imani zaidi katika Mungu. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Answer:What answer did Jesus give to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.20+What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~20#Question:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wangeweza kufanya nini ikiwa wangekuwa na imani [kwa Mungu] ndogo kama mbegu ya haradali?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Question:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!17~20#Alternate:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?562016263
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith in God as small as a mustard seed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wangeweza kufanya nini ikiwa wangekuwa na imani katika Mungu iliyo ndogo kama mbegu ya haradali?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Alternate:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!17~20#Alternate:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?-637991725
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith as small as a mustard seed?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema wangeweza kufanya nini ikiwa wangekuwa na imani ndogo kama mbegu ya haradali?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Alternate:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~20#Answer:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?-2113320388
trans-unit.source: He told them that they could tell a mountain to move and it would move.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wangeweza kuiambia mlima uondoke na uondoke.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Answer:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~20#Answer:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?-843284202
trans-unit.source: He told them that nothing would be impossible for them. (20)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba hakuna jambo ambalo wasingeweza kufanya. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~20#Answer:What did Jesus say they could do if they had faith [in God] as small as a mustard seed?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.22-23+What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~22#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba ni nini ambacho kingempata?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~22#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~22#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?-1625546541
trans-unit.source: He told them that [men] would deliver him to other men who would kill him.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba [watu] wangemkabidhi kwa watu wengine ambao wangemuua.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~22#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~22#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?-1210581749
trans-unit.source: He told them that [God] would raise him to life three days later. (22-23)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba [Mungu] angemfufua siku tatu baadaye. (22-23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~22#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.23+How did the disciples react to what Jesus had just told them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~23#Question:How did the disciples react to what Jesus had just told them?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples react to what Jesus had just told them?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amewaambia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~23#Question:How did the disciples react to what Jesus had just told them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~23#Answer:How did the disciples react to what Jesus had just told them?-875197425
trans-unit.source: They were very sad. (23)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa na huzuni sana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~23#Answer:How did the disciples react to what Jesus had just told them?

trans-unit.source: Matthew 17:24-27 Jesus talked about the temple tax.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 17:24-27 Yesu alizungumza kuhusu kodi ya hekalu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~24#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 17.24-27+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~24#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~24#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~24#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?-1737729764
trans-unit.source: Jesus spoke/talked about the temple tax and those who were required to pay it.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumza juu ya kodi ya hekalu na wale waliohitaji kulipa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~24#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.24+What did the collectors of the temple tax ask Peter?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~24#Question:What did the collectors of the temple tax ask Peter?
trans-unit.source: What did the collectors of the temple tax ask Peter?
trans-unit.target: Wakusanya-kodi wa hekalu walimwuliza Petro nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~24#Question:What did the collectors of the temple tax ask Peter?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~24#Answer:What did the collectors of the temple tax ask Peter?-21918440
trans-unit.source: They asked him if Jesus paid the temple tax. (24)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza kama Yesu alilipa kodi ya hekalu. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~24#Answer:What did the collectors of the temple tax ask Peter?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.25+What did Peter reply to their question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~25#Question:What did Peter reply to their question?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter reply to their question?
trans-unit.target: Petro alijibuje swali lao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~25#Question:What did Peter reply to their question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~25#Answer:What did Peter reply to their question?433380602
trans-unit.source: Peter told them that Jesus paid the temple tax. (25)
trans-unit.target: Petro aliwaambia kwamba Yesu alilipa kodi ya hekalu. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~25#Answer:What did Peter reply to their question?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.25+What did Jesus ask Peter about taxes and duties?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~25#Question:What did Jesus ask Peter about taxes and duties?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask Peter about taxes and duties?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza Petro nini kuhusu kodi na ushuru?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~25#Question:What did Jesus ask Peter about taxes and duties?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~25#Answer:What did Jesus ask Peter about taxes and duties?1448789569
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked Peter if kings/rulers collected the taxes and duties from their own sons or from others. (25)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwuliza Petro kama wafalme/watawala walitoza kodi na ushuru kutoka kwa wana wao au kutoka kwa wengine. (25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~25#Answer:What did Jesus ask Peter about taxes and duties?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.26+What did Peter reply to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~26#Question:What did Peter reply to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter reply to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Petro alimjibuje Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~26#Question:What did Peter reply to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~26#Answer:What did Peter reply to Jesus?-564727342
trans-unit.source: Peter said that kings/rulers collected the taxes and duties from others. (26)
trans-unit.target: Petro alisema kwamba wafalme/watawala walitoza kodi na ushuru kutoka kwa wengine. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~26#Answer:What did Peter reply to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.27+What is the reason that Jesus said that Peter should pay the temple tax for himself and for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~27#Question:What is the reason that Jesus said that Peter should pay the temple tax for himself and for Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus said that Peter should pay the temple tax for himself and for Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu alimwambia Petro alipe kodi ya hekalu kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Question:What is the reason that Jesus said that Peter should pay the temple tax for himself and for Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~27#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus said that Peter should pay the temple tax for himself and for Jesus?-276575026
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that Peter should pay the tax for himself and for Jesus so that they would not offend the tax collectors. (27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Petro anapaswa kulipa kodi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya Yesu ili wasiwakosee watoza kodi. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus said that Peter should pay the temple tax for himself and for Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 17.27+What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!17~27#Question:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro afanye nini ili apate pesa za kulipa kodi ya hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Question:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!17~27#Alternate:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?-748667182
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have the money for the temple tax?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro afanye nini ili apate pesa za kulipa kodi ya hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Alternate:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!17~27#Alternate:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?1247798992
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to obtain the money for the temple tax?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro afanye nini ili apate pesa za kulipa kodi ya hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Alternate:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~27#Answer:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?-1277041204
trans-unit.source: Jesus told Peter to go to the lake and catch a fish.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro aende ziwani kuvua samaki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Answer:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~27#Answer:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?-1341748214
trans-unit.source: Then he said that Peter would find the money for the tax in the mouth of the first fish that he caught.
trans-unit.target: Kisha akamwambia Petro kwamba angepata sarafu ya kodi hiyo katika kinywa cha samaki wa kwanza atakayemkamata.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Answer:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!17~27#Answer:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?257500089
trans-unit.source: Jesus told Peter to take that money and give it to the temple tax collectors. (27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Petro achukue fedha hizo na kuwapa watoza kodi wa hekalu. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!17~27#Answer:What did Jesus tell Peter to do in order to have/obtain the money for the temple tax?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!18~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 18:1-9 Jesus told his disciples how to be great in the kingdom of God.

group.id: Q:MAT 18.1-9+What did the disciples ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~1#Question:What did the disciples ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walimwuliza Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~1#Question:What did the disciples ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~1#Answer:What did the disciples ask Jesus?-40331402
trans-unit.source: They asked him who is the greatest/most important in the kingdom of heaven. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza ni nani aliye mkubwa zaidi katika ufalme wa mbinguni. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~1#Answer:What did the disciples ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.1-9+What did Jesus reply to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~1#Question:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu wanafunzi wake jinsi gani?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~1#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?-2027856840

trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha jinsi mwanamume huyo anavyohisi kuhusu kondoo wake mmoja na jinsi Baba wa mbinguni anavyohisi kuhusu watoto wake jinsi gani?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.15+What did Jesus tell the disciples that they should do if their fellow-believer sinned against them?

trans-unit.source: He told them that they should go to that person and tell him what he has done against them. This should be done just between the two of them. (15)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wanapaswa kwenda kwa mtu huyo na kumwambia kile alichowafanyia. Hii inapaswa kufanywa kati yao wawili tu. (15)

trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~17#Answer:What should they do if the offending person will not listen to the church?
