trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~23#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa mbinguni na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~23#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~23#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?237935281
trans-unit.source: He compared the kingdom of heaven to a king who wanted to find out/determine how much money each of his servants owed to him. (23)
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha ufalme wa mbinguni na mfalme aliyetaka kujua/kuamua ni kiasi gani cha fedha kila mmoja wa watumishi wake alichokuwa akimdai. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~23#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.24-25+What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~24#Question:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?
trans-unit.source: What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliamua kufanya nini na mtumishi mmoja aliyemdai pesa nyingi/talenta elfu kumi/milioni za dola?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~24#Question:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!18~24#Alternate:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?1533194874
trans-unit.source: What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliamua kumfanyia nini mtumwa aliyekuwa na deni kubwa la fedha?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~24#Alternate:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!18~24#Alternate:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?604233285
trans-unit.source: What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him ten thousand talents?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliamua kufanya nini na mtumwa aliyekuwa na deni la talanta elfu kumi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~24#Alternate:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!18~24#Alternate:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?-115279759
trans-unit.source: What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him millions of dollars?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliamua kufanya nini na mtumwa mmoja aliyekuwa na deni la mamilioni ya dola?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~24#Alternate:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~24#Answer:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?-470348977
trans-unit.source: The king decided that the servant, his wife, his children and all that he owned should be sold to pay the debt. (24-25)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme akaamuru kwamba mtumwa huyo, mke wake, watoto wake, na vitu vyote alivyokuwa navyo viuzwe ili kulipa deni hilo (24-25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~24#Answer:What did the king decide to do with a servant who owed him much money/ten thousand talents/millions of dollars?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.26+What did the servant beg the king to allow him to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~26#Question:What did the servant beg the king to allow him to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the servant beg the king to allow him to do?
trans-unit.target: Mtumishi huyo alimwomba mfalme ruhusa ya kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~26#Question:What did the servant beg the king to allow him to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~26#Answer:What did the servant beg the king to allow him to do?1516547330
trans-unit.source: The servant begged the king to be patient with him and he would pay back all that he owed to the king. (26)
trans-unit.target: Mtumishi huyo alimsihi mfalme amvumilie na atamlipa yote aliyokuwa nayo kwa mfalme. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~26#Answer:What did the servant beg the king to allow him to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.27+What did the king do in response to the request of his servant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~27#Question:What did the king do in response to the request of his servant?
trans-unit.source: What did the king do in response to the request of his servant?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme alifanya nini kwa kuitikia ombi la mtumishi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~27#Question:What did the king do in response to the request of his servant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~27#Answer:What did the king do in response to the request of his servant?-1732891273
trans-unit.source: The king pitied his servant, so he canceled the debt and let him go. (27)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme huyo alimwonea huruma mtumishi huyo, akamwachilia na kumsamehe deni hilo. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~27#Answer:What did the king do in response to the request of his servant?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.28+What did that servant do after he was set free?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~28#Question:What did that servant do after he was set free?
trans-unit.source: What did that servant do after he was set free?
trans-unit.target: Mtumishi huyo alifanya nini baada ya kuachiliwa huru?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~28#Question:What did that servant do after he was set free?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~28#Answer:What did that servant do after he was set free?-241472614
trans-unit.source: He found a fellow servant, who owed him a small amount of money/a few dollars. He demanded that the fellow servant pay back what he owed. (28)
trans-unit.target: Akamkuta mtumwa mwenzake, aliyekuwa na deni lake kiasi kidogo cha fedha/dola chache. Akamdai mtumwa mwenzake alipe deni lake. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~28#Answer:What did that servant do after he was set free?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.29+What did the fellow servant beg the other servant to allow him to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~29#Question:What did the fellow servant beg the other servant to allow him to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the fellow servant beg the other servant to allow him to do?
trans-unit.target: Mtumwa mwenzake alimsihi mtumwa mwenzake amruhusu afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~29#Question:What did the fellow servant beg the other servant to allow him to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~29#Answer:What did the fellow servant beg the other servant to allow him to do?-847357686
trans-unit.source: The fellow servant begged the other servant to be patient with him and he would repay/pay back everything that he owed to him. (29)
trans-unit.target: Mtumwa mwenzake alimsihi mtumwa mwenzake awe na subira naye angelipa/alilipa yote aliyokuwa nayo (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~29#Answer:What did the fellow servant beg the other servant to allow him to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.30+What did the servant do in response to the request of the fellow servant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~30#Question:What did the servant do in response to the request of the fellow servant?
trans-unit.source: What did the servant do in response to the request of the fellow servant?
trans-unit.target: Mtumwa huyo alifanya nini kwa kuitikia ombi la mtumwa mwenzake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~30#Question:What did the servant do in response to the request of the fellow servant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~30#Answer:What did the servant do in response to the request of the fellow servant?-1649447849
trans-unit.source: He refused to be patient with him. Instead he ordered that the fellow servant be put in prison until he could repay/pay back the debt. (30)
trans-unit.target: Lakini yeye hakutaka, bali alimtia gerezani hata atakapolipa ile deni.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~30#Answer:What did the servant do in response to the request of the fellow servant?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.31+What did the other servants tell the king?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~31#Question:What did the other servants tell the king?
trans-unit.source: What did the other servants tell the king?
trans-unit.target: Watumishi wengine walimwambia nini mfalme?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~31#Question:What did the other servants tell the king?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~31#Answer:What did the other servants tell the king?-117580147
trans-unit.source: They told him everything that had happened between the other two servants. (31)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwambia yote yaliyotokea kati ya wale watumishi wawili wengine.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~31#Answer:What did the other servants tell the king?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.32-34+After he heard what the other servants told him, what did the king do to the servant, whose debt he had cancelled?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~32#Question:After he heard what the other servants told him, what did the king do to the servant, whose debt he had cancelled?
trans-unit.source: After he heard what the other servants told him, what did the king do to the servant, whose debt he had cancelled?
trans-unit.target: Baada ya kusikia yale ambayo watumwa wenzake walimwambia, mfalme alimfanyia nini mtumwa ambaye alikuwa amesamehewa deni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~32#Question:After he heard what the other servants told him, what did the king do to the servant, whose debt he had cancelled?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~32#Answer:After he heard what the other servants told him, what did the king do to the servant, whose debt he had cancelled?-981730676
trans-unit.source: He was very angry with the servant for what he had done to his fellow servant. The king had that first servant put in prison and tortured until he could repay/pay back all that he owed to the king. (32-34)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme alikasirika sana na mtumwa huyo kwa kile alichokuwa amemfanyia mtumwa mwenzake. Mfalme huyo aliamuru mtumwa wa kwanza afungwe gerezani na kuteswa hadi aweze kulipa / kulipa yote aliyokuwa nayo kwa mfalme. (32-34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~32#Answer:After he heard what the other servants told him, what did the king do to the servant, whose debt he had cancelled?

group.id: Q:MAT 18.35+What did Jesus tell the disciples would happen to them if they did not forgive their brother?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!18~35#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples would happen to them if they did not forgive their brother?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the disciples would happen to them if they did not forgive their brother?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba ni nini kingetokea ikiwa hawangemsamehe ndugu yao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~35#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples would happen to them if they did not forgive their brother?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!18~35#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples would happen to them if they did not forgive their brother?145188031
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that his heavenly Father would treat them in the same manner/the same way that the king treated his servant for not forgiving his fellow servant. (35)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Baba yake wa mbinguni angewatendea kwa njia ile ile/kwa njia ile ile ambayo mfalme alimtendea mtumwa wake kwa kutomsamehe mtumwa mwenzake. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!18~35#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples would happen to them if they did not forgive their brother?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!19~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 19:1-12 Jesus taught the people that anyone who divorced his wife was breaking God's commandment.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 19:1-12 Yesu aliwafundisha watu kwamba mtu yeyote aliyetaliki mke wake alikuwa akivunja amri ya Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 19.1-12+About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~1#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu nini katika mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~1#Question:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~1#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?1689301993
trans-unit.source: Jesus taught the people about what he/God thought about divorce.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafundisha watu kuhusu kile alichokiona/Mungu alichokiona kuhusu talaka.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~1#Answer:About what did Jesus teach the people in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.1+Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~1#Question:Where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.source: Where did Jesus go?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~1#Question:Where did Jesus go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~1#Answer:Where did Jesus go?729615683
trans-unit.source: He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea on the east side of the Jordan River. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alitoka Galilaya na kwenda kwenye eneo la Yudea upande wa mashariki wa Mto Yordani. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~1#Answer:Where did Jesus go?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.2+Who followed Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~2#Question:Who followed Jesus?
trans-unit.source: Who followed Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomfuata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~2#Question:Who followed Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~2#Answer:Who followed Jesus?2033569143
trans-unit.source: Many people followed him. (2)
trans-unit.target: Watu wengi walimfuata. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~2#Answer:Who followed Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.2+What did Jesus do in Judea?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~2#Question:What did Jesus do in Judea?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do in Judea?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini katika Yudea?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~2#Question:What did Jesus do in Judea?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~2#Answer:What did Jesus do in Judea?-1442481580
trans-unit.source: He healed many sick people. (2)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaponya wagonjwa wengi. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~2#Answer:What did Jesus do in Judea?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.3+What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~3#Question:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimwuliza Yesu nini wakati huo/mahali hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~3#Question:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~3#Alternate:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?1095310012
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimwuliza Yesu nini wakati huo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~3#Alternate:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~3#Alternate:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?-708553718
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus in that place?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimwuliza Yesu nini mahali hapo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~3#Alternate:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~3#Answer:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?189309846
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus if the law allowed a man to divorce his wife for any reason. (3)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu kama sheria iliruhusu mwanamume kumtaliki mke wake kwa sababu yoyote ile. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~3#Answer:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus at that time/in that place?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.3+What is the reason that the Pharisees asked Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~3#Question:What is the reason that the Pharisees asked Jesus that question?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the Pharisees asked Jesus that question?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mafarisayo walimwuliza Yesu swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~3#Question:What is the reason that the Pharisees asked Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~3#Answer:What is the reason that the Pharisees asked Jesus that question?107446420
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus that question because they wanted to test him. (3)
trans-unit.target: Waliuliza swali hilo ili kumjaribu Yesu. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~3#Answer:What is the reason that the Pharisees asked Jesus that question?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.4-6+What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~4#Question:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibu jinsi gani swali aliloulizwa na Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~4#Question:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?2142042611
trans-unit.source: He reminded them that, in the beginning, the Creator made man and woman. (4)
trans-unit.target: Aliwakumbusha kwamba, mwanzoni, Muumba aliwaumba mwanamume na mwanamke. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?1529923855
trans-unit.source: God said it was for that reason that a man would leave his father and mother and be united to his wife and the two would become as one person. (5)
trans-unit.target: Mungu alisema kwamba ni kwa sababu hiyo mwanamume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake naye ataambatana na mke wake nao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?1766161518
trans-unit.source: Therefore, they are no longer two, but as one.
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, wao si wawili tena, bali mwili mmoja.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?1396043445
trans-unit.source: Therefore, what God has joined together no man should separate [by divorce]. (6)
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo, kile ambacho Mungu ameunganisha mtu yeyote asikitenganishe [kwa talaka]. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~4#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.7+What did the Pharisees ask Jesus next?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~7#Question:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus next?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus next?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimwuliza Yesu swali gani baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~7#Question:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus next?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~7#Answer:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus next?1047860246
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus why Moses had written a law that allowed a man to divorce his wife and send her away. (7)
trans-unit.target: Walimwuliza Yesu kwa nini Musa aliandika sheria iliyomruhusu mwanamume kumtaliki mke wake na kumfukuza. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~7#Answer:What did the Pharisees ask Jesus next?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.8+What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~8#Question:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alijibu jinsi gani swali aliloulizwa na Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~8#Question:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~8#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?594242309
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the Pharisees that Moses allowed them to divorce their wives because their [the Jews'] hearts were very hard/they were so hard to teach/they were so stubborn.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia Mafarisayo kwamba Musa aliwaruhusu wawaachane na wake zao kwa sababu mioyo yao [ya Wayahudi] ilikuwa migumu sana/ilikuwa vigumu sana kufundisha/ilikuwa migumu sana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~8#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~8#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?1022897002
trans-unit.source: Jesus also told them that [God] had not intended, from the beginning [of creation], that a man should divorce his wife. (8)
trans-unit.target: Yesu pia aliwaambia kwamba [Mungu] hakukusudia, tangu mwanzo [wa uumbaji], kwamba mwanamume amtaliki mke wake. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~8#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.9+For what reason did Jesus say that a man could divorce his wife?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~9#Question:For what reason did Jesus say that a man could divorce his wife?
trans-unit.source: For what reason did Jesus say that a man could divorce his wife?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba mwanamume angeweza kumtaliki mke wake kwa sababu gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~9#Question:For what reason did Jesus say that a man could divorce his wife?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~9#Answer:For what reason did Jesus say that a man could divorce his wife?-2122892184
trans-unit.source: He said that a man could divorce his wife if she had been unfaithful/committed adultery in the marriage. (9)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba mwanamume angeweza kumtaliki mke wake ikiwa alikuwa amefanya uzinzi katika ndoa. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~9#Answer:For what reason did Jesus say that a man could divorce his wife?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.9+What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~9#Question:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mwanamume alikuwa akifanya nini ikiwa alimtaliki mkewe, wakati alikuwa mwaminifu kwake, na akaoa mwanamke mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~9#Question:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~9#Alternate:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?421244055
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a man was committing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mwanamume alikuwa akifanya nini ikiwa alimtaliki mke wake, ingawa alikuwa amekuwa mwaminifu kwake, na kuoa mwanamke mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~9#Alternate:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~9#Alternate:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?1306636943
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say a man was doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema mwanamume alikuwa akifanya nini ikiwa alimtaliki mke wake, ingawa alikuwa amekuwa mwaminifu kwake, na kuoa mwanamke mwingine?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~9#Alternate:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~9#Answer:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?-1711517388
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that a man, who divorced his wife when she had been faithful to him and married another woman, was committing adultery. (9)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba mwanamume, ambaye humtaliki mke wake wakati amekuwa mwaminifu kwake na kuoa mwanamke mwingine, anafanya uzinzi. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~9#Answer:What did Jesus say a man was committing/doing if he divorced his wife, when she had been faithful to him, and he married another woman?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.10+What did the disciples say to Jesus in response to what he had just said about divorce?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~10#Question:What did the disciples say to Jesus in response to what he had just said about divorce?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples say to Jesus in response to what he had just said about divorce?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walimwambia Yesu nini kwa kuitikia yale aliyokuwa ametoka tu kusema juu ya talaka?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~10#Question:What did the disciples say to Jesus in response to what he had just said about divorce?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~10#Answer:What did the disciples say to Jesus in response to what he had just said about divorce?-2009126080
trans-unit.source: The disciples told Jesus that it would be better for a man not to marry a woman if that is the only situation in which a man may divorce his wife. (10)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walimwambia Yesu kwamba ingekuwa bora kwa mwanamume kutomwoa mwanamke ikiwa hiyo ndiyo hali pekee ambayo mwanamume anaweza kumtaliki mke wake. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~10#Answer:What did the disciples say to Jesus in response to what he had just said about divorce?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.12+What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~12#Question:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nini zilikuwa sababu za wanaume fulani kutooa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~12#Question:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~12#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?-15124858
trans-unit.source: He said that some men are eunuchs/not capable of marriage because they were born that way.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanaume fulani ni matowashi kwa sababu walizaliwa hivyo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~12#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~12#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?-660086441
trans-unit.source: He said that some men were forced to be eunuchs by other men.
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanaume fulani walilazimishwa na wanaume wengine kuwa matowashi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~12#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~12#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?2125951813
trans-unit.source: He said that some men decided not to marry because they wanted to spend all of their time serving God. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alisema kwamba wanaume fulani waliamua kutooa kwa sababu walitaka kutumia wakati wao wote katika kumtumikia Mungu. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~12#Answer:What did Jesus say were the reasons that some men do not marry?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!19~13#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 19:13-15 People brought small children to Jesus, and he blessed them.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 19:13-15 Watu walimletea Yesu watoto wadogo, naye akawabariki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~13#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 19.13-15+What is the reason that people brought little children to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~13#Question:What is the reason that people brought little children to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that people brought little children to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini watu walimletea Yesu watoto wadogo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~13#Question:What is the reason that people brought little children to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~13#Answer:What is the reason that people brought little children to Jesus?-626823910
trans-unit.source: They brought little children to Jesus because they wanted him to place his hands on them and pray for them/ask God to bless them. (13)
trans-unit.target: Waliwaleta watoto wadogo kwa Yesu kwa sababu walitaka aweke mikono yake juu yao na kuwaombea/amwombe Mungu awabariki. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~13#Answer:What is the reason that people brought little children to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.13+What did the disciples say to the people who brought the children to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~13#Question:What did the disciples say to the people who brought the children to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples say to the people who brought the children to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu waliwaambia nini watu waliokuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~13#Answer:What did the disciples say to the people who brought the children to Jesus?-204513112
trans-unit.source: The disciples rebuked/scolded the people for bringing the children. (13)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliwakemea/kuwakemea watu kwa kuwaleta watoto. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~13#Answer:What did the disciples say to the people who brought the children to Jesus?

trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that they should allow/permit the little children to come to him. (14)

trans-unit.source: He placed his hands on them and prayed for them/asked God to bless them. (15)
trans-unit.target: Aliweka mikono yake juu yao na kuomba kwa ajili yao / aliuliza Mungu kuwabariki. (15)

trans-unit.target: Yesu alizungumza na mwanamume mmoja tajiri kuhusu jambo ambalo alipaswa kufanya ili apate uzima wa milele.

group.id: Q:MAT 19.16+What did the man ask Jesus?

trans-unit.source: He asked Jesus what good deed he needed to do to have/receive eternal life. (16)
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza Yesu ni tendo gani zuri alihitaji kufanya ili apate/kupokea uzima wa milele. (16)

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~20#Question:Then what did the man ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~20#Answer:Then what did the man ask Jesus?2136345581
trans-unit.source: He asked him what else he needed to do [to receive eternal life]. (20)
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza ni nini kingine alichohitaji kufanya [ili apokee uhai wa milele]. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~20#Answer:Then what did the man ask Jesus?

trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia afanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~21#Question:What did Jesus tell him to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~21#Answer:What did Jesus tell him to do?-856840575
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the man that, if he wanted to be perfect/the way God wanted him to be, he should sell his possessions and give [the money] to the poor. Then he should follow Jesus/become a disciple of Jesus. (21)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia mtu huyo kwamba, kama alitaka kuwa mkamilifu/ jinsi Mungu alivyotaka awe, anapaswa kuuza mali zake na kuwapa [pesa] maskini. Kisha anapaswa kumfuata Yesu/ kuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu. (21)

trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~21#Answer:What would the man have had as a result of selling his possessions and giving the money to the poor?

trans-unit.source: He felt very sad because he was very rich/had many possessions [and he did not want to give them away]. (22)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~24#Answer:What did Jesus say would be easier than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God?-48654876
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that it would be easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God/become one of God's people/receive eternal life. (24)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba ingekuwa rahisi kwa ngamia kupita katika tundu la sindano kuliko kwa tajiri kuingia katika ufalme wa Mungu/kuwa mmoja wa watu wa Mungu/kupokea uzima wa milele. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~24#Answer:What did Jesus say would be easier than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.24+What do you think the kingdom of God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~24#Question:What do you think the kingdom of God is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the kingdom of God is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ufalme wa Mungu ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~24#Question:What do you think the kingdom of God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~24#Answer:What do you think the kingdom of God is?-1499181227
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The kingdom of God has the significance of God's rule in the lives of men, rather than of a territory over which God rules.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno: Ufalme wa Mungu una maana ya utawala wa Mungu katika maisha ya watu, badala ya eneo ambalo Mungu anatawala.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~24#Answer:What do you think the kingdom of God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!19~24#Note:What do you think the kingdom of God is?517268396
trans-unit.source: See "kingdom of God" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "ufalme wa Mungu" katika tafsiri ya Union Version.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~24#Note:What do you think the kingdom of God is?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.25+How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~25#Question:How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?
trans-unit.source: How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi waliitikiaje waliposikia yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa ametoka tu kusema?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~25#Question:How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~25#Answer:How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?1774265796
trans-unit.source: They were very amazed/surprised.
trans-unit.target: Walishangaa sana.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~25#Answer:How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~25#Answer:How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?31366776
trans-unit.source: They asked Jesus, who could be saved/receive eternal life? (25)
trans-unit.target: Walimuuliza Yesu, ni nani angeweza kuokolewa/kupokea uzima wa milele? (25)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~25#Answer:How did the disciples react when they heard what Jesus had just said?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.26+What did Jesus reply to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~26#Question:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus reply to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu wanafunzi wake jinsi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~26#Question:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~26#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?1937272226
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them that it is impossible for men to save themselves, but he said that God can save them because he can do anything. (26)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia kwamba haiwezekani kwa wanadamu kujiokoa wenyewe, lakini alisema kwamba Mungu anaweza kuwaokoa kwa sababu anaweza kufanya chochote. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~26#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.27+What is the reason that Peter asked Jesus the question in verse 27?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~27#Question:What is the reason that Peter asked Jesus the question in verse 27?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Peter asked Jesus the question in verse 27?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Petro alimwuliza Yesu swali hilo katika mstari wa 27?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~27#Question:What is the reason that Peter asked Jesus the question in verse 27?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~27#Answer:What is the reason that Peter asked Jesus the question in verse 27?-510773042
trans-unit.source: He wanted to know what they (he and the other disciples) would receive [from God] because they had given up/for giving up everything they owned/possessed to follow him/be his disciples. (27)
trans-unit.target: Alitaka kujua nini wao (yeye na wanafunzi wengine) wangepokea [kutoka kwa Mungu] kwa sababu walikuwa wameacha/kwa kuacha kila kitu walichokuwa nacho/walicho nacho ili wamfuate/wawe wanafunzi wake. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~27#Answer:What is the reason that Peter asked Jesus the question in verse 27?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.28-29+What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~28#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wafanye nini ili kujibu swali la Petro?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~28#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~28#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?-1771975223
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne [to rule everyone], they would sit on twelve thrones to rule the twelve tribes of Israel. (28)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi kwamba, Mwana wa Adamu atakapoketi katika kiti chake cha utukufu [kuwatawala wote], wao wataketi katika viti kumi na viwili vya enzi, wakitawala kabila kumi na mbili za Israeli. (28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~28#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~28#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?-1727737702
trans-unit.source: Jesus also told them that anyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or fields/land for his sake/in order to serve him, would receive a hundred times as much [from God]. They will also inherit/receive eternal life [from God]. (29)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia pia kwamba kila mtu aliyeacha nyumba, au ndugu, au dada, au baba, au mama, au watoto, au mashamba/maeneo kwa ajili yake/ili kumtumikia atapokea mara mia zaidi [kutoka kwa Mungu] na pia ataurithi/kupokea uzima wa milele [kutoka kwa Mungu] (29).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~28#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to answer Peter's question?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.28+What do you think "glorious" means?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~28#Question:What do you think "glorious" means?
trans-unit.source: What do you think "glorious" means?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri neno "utukufu" linamaanisha nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~28#Question:What do you think "glorious" means?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~28#Answer:What do you think "glorious" means?49898395
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Glorious in this verse means magnificent, amazing, splendid, wonderful, associated with God and his presence. (See "glorious" in KBT in the "glory" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Neno Angalia: Utukufu katika mstari huu unamaanisha utukufu, ajabu, uzuri, ajabu, kuhusishwa na Mungu na uwepo wake. (Ona "utukufu" katika KBT katika kiingilio cha "utukufu").
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~28#Answer:What do you think "glorious" means?

group.id: Q:MAT 19.30+What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!19~30#Question:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu watu hao, ambao ni wa kwanza/wa muhimu zaidi sasa, na wale ambao ni wa mwisho/wa chini sana sasa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~30#Question:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?143085055
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about those people, who are first now, and those who are last now?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya watu hao, wale walio wa kwanza sasa, na wale walio wa mwisho sasa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?614071181
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about those people, who are most important now, and those who are least important now?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya watu hao, ambao sasa ni wa maana zaidi, na wale ambao sasa ni wa maana kidogo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?143085055
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about those people, who are first now, and those who are last now?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya watu hao, wale walio wa kwanza sasa, na wale walio wa mwisho sasa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?614071181
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about those people, who are most important now, and those who are least important now?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini juu ya watu hao, ambao sasa ni wa maana zaidi, na wale ambao sasa ni wa maana kidogo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~30#Alternate:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!19~30#Answer:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?1395178055
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that those people, who are most important now, will be least important later/in the future kingdom of God. Those people, who are least important now, will be most important later/in the future kingdom of God. (30)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba wale watu, ambao ni muhimu sana sasa, watakuwa muhimu kidogo baadaye/katika ufalme wa Mungu wa baadaye.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!19~30#Answer:What did Jesus say about those people, who are first/most important now, and those who are last/least important now?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!20~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 20:1-16 Jesus told a parable about a man who hired men to work in his vineyard.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 20:1-16 Yesu alisimulia mfano wa mtu aliyeajiri wafanyakazi katika shamba lake la mizabibu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 20.1-16+To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~1#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa mbinguni na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~1#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~1#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?-703531309
trans-unit.source: He compared it to a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire men to work in his vineyard. (1)
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha jambo hilo na mwenye shamba la mizabibu ambaye alitoka asubuhi na mapema ili kuajiri wafanyakazi katika shamba lake la mizabibu. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~1#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.2+What did the landowner agree to pay each man for working in his vineyard?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~2#Question:What did the landowner agree to pay each man for working in his vineyard?
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner agree to pay each man for working in his vineyard?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alikubali kuwalipa kiasi gani wafanyakazi katika shamba lake la mizabibu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~2#Question:What did the landowner agree to pay each man for working in his vineyard?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~2#Answer:What did the landowner agree to pay each man for working in his vineyard?648356798
trans-unit.source: He agreed to pay each man a denarius (the usual daily wage). (2)
trans-unit.target: Alikubali kuwalipa dinari moja (mshahara wa kawaida wa siku moja) (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~2#Answer:What did the landowner agree to pay each man for working in his vineyard?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.3-4+What did the landowner do at about 9:00 am?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~3#Question:What did the landowner do at about 9:00 am?
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner do at about 9:00 am?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alifanya nini saa tatu hivi asubuhi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~3#Question:What did the landowner do at about 9:00 am?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~3#Answer:What did the landowner do at about 9:00 am?1318222170
trans-unit.source: He went to the marketplace and hired more men to work in his vineyard. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Alienda sokoni na kuajiri wafanyakazi zaidi katika shamba lake la mizabibu (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~3#Answer:What did the landowner do at about 9:00 am?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.4+How much money did the landowner agree to pay those new workers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~4#Question:How much money did the landowner agree to pay those new workers?
trans-unit.source: How much money did the landowner agree to pay those new workers?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alikubali kuwalipa wafanyakazi hao wapya kiasi gani cha pesa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~4#Question:How much money did the landowner agree to pay those new workers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~4#Answer:How much money did the landowner agree to pay those new workers?-551606573
trans-unit.source: He agreed to pay them whatever was right/a fair wage. (4)
trans-unit.target: Alikubali kuwalipa chochote kilichokuwa haki/mshahara wa haki. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~4#Answer:How much money did the landowner agree to pay those new workers?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.5-7+What did the landowner do at about Noon, 3:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~5#Question:What did the landowner do at about Noon, 3:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.?
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner do at about Noon, 3:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alifanya nini karibu saa sita mchana, saa tisa alasiri na saa kumi na moja alasiri?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~5#Question:What did the landowner do at about Noon, 3:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~5#Answer:What did the landowner do at about Noon, 3:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.?-226138632
trans-unit.source: He hired more men to work in his vineyard. (5-7)
trans-unit.target: Aajiri wanaume zaidi wafanye kazi katika shamba lake la mizabibu (5-7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~5#Answer:What did the landowner do at about Noon, 3:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m.?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.8+What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~8#Question:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?
trans-unit.target: Mmiliki wa ardhi alimwambia foreman wake afanye nini, jioni ilipofika/saa 6:00 jioni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~8#Question:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~8#Alternate:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?-1585635742
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimwambia msimamizi wake afanye nini, jioni ilipofika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~8#Alternate:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~8#Alternate:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?-2023192975
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, at 6:00 p.m.?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimwambia msimamizi wake afanye nini saa 12 jioni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~8#Alternate:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~8#Answer:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?-2064911543
trans-unit.source: He told his foreman to pay all the workers beginning/starting with those who were hired last. (8)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia msimamizi wake awalipie wafanyakazi wote kuanzia wale walioajiriwa mwisho. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~8#Answer:What did the landowner tell his foreman to do, when the evening came/at 6:00 p.m.?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.9-10+How much did the foreman pay each worker?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~9#Question:How much did the foreman pay each worker?
trans-unit.source: How much did the foreman pay each worker?
trans-unit.target: Msimamizi wa kazi alimlipa kila mfanyakazi kiasi gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~9#Question:How much did the foreman pay each worker?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~9#Answer:How much did the foreman pay each worker?-906129834
trans-unit.source: He paid each worker a denarius. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Aliwalipa kila mfanyakazi dinari moja (9-10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~9#Answer:How much did the foreman pay each worker?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.10+What is the reason that those, who were hired first, expected to receive more than a denarius?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~10#Question:What is the reason that those, who were hired first, expected to receive more than a denarius?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that those, who were hired first, expected to receive more than a denarius?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wale walioajiriwa kwanza wanatarajia kupokea zaidi ya dinari moja?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~10#Question:What is the reason that those, who were hired first, expected to receive more than a denarius?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~10#Answer:What is the reason that those, who were hired first, expected to receive more than a denarius?1294432923
trans-unit.source: They expected to receive more than a denarius because that is what the foreman paid the workers who were hired later in the day. (10)
trans-unit.target: Walitazamia kupokea zaidi ya dinari moja kwa sababu hiyo ndiyo kiasi ambacho msimamizi wa kazi aliwalipa wafanyakazi walioajiriwa baadaye mchana. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~10#Answer:What is the reason that those, who were hired first, expected to receive more than a denarius?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.11-12+How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~11#Question:How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?
trans-unit.source: How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?
trans-unit.target: Wale wafanyakazi walioajiriwa kwanza walihisije walipopata mshahara uleule ambao wale walioajiriwa mwisho walipokea?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~11#Question:How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~11#Answer:How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?-1104698406
trans-unit.source: They complained to the landowner. (11)
trans-unit.target: Walilalamika kwa mwenye shamba. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~11#Answer:How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~11#Answer:How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?-1999689787
trans-unit.source: They told the landowner that he paid the workers, who were hired last, the same amount that he paid them; and the last ones, whom he hired, had worked only one hour. (12)
trans-unit.target: Walimwambia mwenye shamba kwamba aliwapa wafanyakazi walioajiriwa mwisho, kiasi kilekile cha pesa; na wale wa mwisho, ambao aliwaajiri, walifanya kazi kwa saa moja tu. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~11#Answer:How did the workers, who were hired first, react to receiving the same pay as those workers who were hired last?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.13-15+What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~13#Question:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimjibu nini mmoja wa wafanyakazi waliofadhaika/wasioridhika/waliovunjika moyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Question:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~13#Alternate:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?925103220
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled workers?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimjibuje mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye hasira?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Alternate:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~13#Alternate:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?1887512871
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner reply to one of the displeased workers?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimjibuje mfanyakazi mmoja aliyekasirika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Alternate:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~13#Alternate:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?926299304
trans-unit.source: What did the landowner reply to one of the disappointed workers?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimjibuje mfanyakazi mmoja aliyevunjika moyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Alternate:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?630728524
trans-unit.source: The landowner told that worker that he was not being unfair to him.
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimwambia mfanyakazi huyo kwamba hakuwa akimtendea isivyo haki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?1534992513
trans-unit.source: He reminded the worker that he had agreed to work for a denarius. (13)
trans-unit.target: Alimkumbusha mfanyakazi huyo kwamba alikuwa amekubali kufanya kazi kwa dinari moja (13).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?-891683068
trans-unit.source: He told the worker that he wanted to pay the man/men, who was/were hired last, the same amount that he had paid him. (14)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia mfanyakazi kwamba alitaka kulipa mtu / wanaume, ambaye alikuwa / walikuwa kuajiriwa mwisho, kiasi sawa na yeye alikuwa amemlipa. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?552356185
trans-unit.source: The landowner told the worker that he had the right to do what he wanted to do with his own money. (15)
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimwambia mfanyakazi huyo kwamba alikuwa na haki ya kufanya kile alichotaka na pesa zake mwenyewe. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~13#Answer:What did the landowner reply to one of the disgruntled/displeased/disappointed workers?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.15+Of what did the landowner accuse the worker?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~15#Question:Of what did the landowner accuse the worker?
trans-unit.source: Of what did the landowner accuse the worker?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimshtaki mfanyakazi huyo kwa jambo gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~15#Question:Of what did the landowner accuse the worker?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~15#Answer:Of what did the landowner accuse the worker?476832878
trans-unit.source: He accused the worker of being envious/jealous because the landowner was generous with his money. (15)
trans-unit.target: Alimshtaki mfanyakazi kuwa mwenye wivu/wivu kwa sababu mwenye shamba alikuwa mkarimu kwa pesa zake. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~15#Answer:Of what did the landowner accuse the worker?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.16+What did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~16#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~16#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~16#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples?-2078044227
trans-unit.source: Jesus told his disciples that those people, who are least important now, will be the most important later. Those people, who are most important now, will be the least important later. (16)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba wale watu ambao ni wa chini sana sasa, watakuwa wa juu zaidi baadaye. Wale watu ambao ni wa juu zaidi sasa, watakuwa wa chini sana baadaye. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~16#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!20~16#Note:What did Jesus tell his disciples?-841636990
trans-unit.target: Ona saa 19:30.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~16#Note:What did Jesus tell his disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.18+What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~18#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba ni nini ambacho kingempata?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~18#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~18#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to him?-824676556
trans-unit.source: He told his disciples, that in Jerusalem, he/the Son of Man would be handed over/betrayed [by someone] to the chief priests and to the teachers of the law. (18)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia wanafunzi wake, kwamba huko Yerusalemu, yeye/Mwana wa Adamu atakabidhiwa/kutolewa [na mtu] kwa makuhani wakuu na walimu wa sheria. (18)

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~18#Question:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?
trans-unit.source: What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na walimu wa sheria walikuwa [wakipanga] kumfanyia nini yeye/Mwana wa Adamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~18#Question:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~18#Alternate:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?-1917976712
trans-unit.source: What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law planning to do to him?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi wanapanga kumfanyia nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~18#Alternate:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~18#Alternate:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?-1881427211
trans-unit.source: What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law planning to do to the Son of Man?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na waandishi wanapanga kufanya nini na Mwana wa binadamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~18#Alternate:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~18#Answer:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?1150950614
trans-unit.source: They were [planning] to condemn/sentence him to death/die. (18)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa [wakipanga] kumhukumu/kumhukumu kifo/kufa. (18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~18#Answer:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~18#Answer:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?-2083437720
trans-unit.source: They were [planning] to hand him over to the Gentiles/non-Jews/Romans who would mock/make fun of, flog/whip him and who would crucify him. (19)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa [wakipanga] kumkabidhi kwa wasio Wayahudi/ wasio Wayahudi/ Waroma ili wamdhihaki/wamdhihaki, wamchape/wamchape na wamsulibishe. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~18#Answer:What were the chief priests and the teachers of the law [planning] to do to him/the Son of Man?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.19+What do you think happened to a person whom the soldiers crucified?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~19#Question:What do you think happened to a person whom the soldiers crucified?
trans-unit.source: What do you think happened to a person whom the soldiers crucified?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kilichompata mtu ambaye askari walimtundika mtini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~19#Question:What do you think happened to a person whom the soldiers crucified?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~19#Answer:What do you think happened to a person whom the soldiers crucified?-1193334968
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: During that time/those years Roman soldiers crucified people by either tying their arms to a crossbeam or pounding nails through their wrists. Then they pulled the person up on an upright post, which was planted in the ground. Then they tied or nailed the person to the post at his ankles. (See "crucify" in KBT in the "cross" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Katika kipindi hicho, askari Waroma waliwatundika watu misumari kwa kuwafunga mikono yao kwenye mlingoti au kwa kuwapiga misumari kwenye viwiko vyao. Kisha walimvuta mtu juu ya nguzo iliyosimama, ambayo ilipandwa ardhini. Kisha walimfunga au kumtundika mtu kwenye nguzo kwenye vifundo vya miguu yake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~19#Answer:What do you think happened to a person whom the soldiers crucified?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.19+What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to him on the third day after he was crucified?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~19#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to him on the third day after he was crucified?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to him on the third day after he was crucified?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba ni nini kingetokea kwake siku ya tatu baada ya kusulubiwa kwake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~19#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to him on the third day after he was crucified?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to him on the third day after he was crucified?589759171
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them that [God] would raise him back to life. (19)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia kwamba [Mungu] angemfufua. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to him on the third day after he was crucified?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.22+What did Jesus say to her two sons?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~22#Question:What did Jesus say to her two sons?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to her two sons?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wana wake wawili?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~22#Question:What did Jesus say to her two sons?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~22#Answer:What did Jesus say to her two sons?-1032966691
trans-unit.source: He told them that they did not know/understand what they were asking. (22)
trans-unit.target: Akawaambia kwamba hawajui/hawaelewi wanachoomba. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~22#Answer:What did Jesus say to her two sons?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.22+What did Jesus ask her two sons?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~22#Question:What did Jesus ask her two sons?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask her two sons?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza nini wana wake wawili?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~22#Question:What did Jesus ask her two sons?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~22#Answer:What did Jesus ask her two sons?-464094412
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked them if they were able to drink the cup that he was going to drink. // Jesus asked them if they were willing to suffer in the same way that he would suffer. (22)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza kama wanaweza kunywa kikombe ambacho alikuwa anakwenda kunywa. // Yesu aliwauliza kama walikuwa tayari kuteseka kwa njia ile ile ambayo yeye kuteseka. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~22#Answer:What did Jesus ask her two sons?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.22+What did her two sons answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~22#Question:What did her two sons answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did her two sons answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wana wake wawili walimjibu Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~22#Question:What did her two sons answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~22#Answer:What did her two sons answer Jesus?-1552273163
trans-unit.source: They said that they were able to/could drink the cup that he would drink. // They said that they were willing to suffer in the same way that he would be suffering. (22)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba wangeweza kunywa kikombe ambacho angekinywa. // Walisema kwamba walikuwa tayari kuteseka kwa njia ile ile ambayo angeteseka. (22)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~22#Answer:What did her two sons answer Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.23+What did Jesus say to them next?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~23#Question:What did Jesus say to them next?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to them next?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini baadaye?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~23#Question:What did Jesus say to them next?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~23#Answer:What did Jesus say to them next?83177193
trans-unit.source: He told them that they surely would drink from his cup/suffer in the same way that he would be suffering. (23)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba bila shaka wangekunywa kikombe chake/kuteseka kwa njia ileile ambayo angeteseka. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~23#Answer:What did Jesus say to them next?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.23+Whom did Jesus say would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~23#Question:Whom did Jesus say would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side?
trans-unit.source: Whom did Jesus say would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ni nani ambaye angeamua ni nani wangeketi kwenye mkono wake wa kuume na ni nani wangeketi kwenye mkono wake wa kushoto?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~23#Question:Whom did Jesus say would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~23#Answer:Whom did Jesus say would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side?1216009910
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that his Father/God would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side. (23)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba Baba yake/Mungu ndiye atakayeamua ni nani atakayeketi upande wake wa kulia na ni nani atakayeketi upande wake wa kushoto. (23)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~23#Answer:Whom did Jesus say would decide who would sit on his right side and who would sit on his left side?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.24+How did the other ten disciples react when they heard what the two brothers had requested of Jesus?

trans-unit.source: How did the other ten disciples react when they heard what the two brothers had requested of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wengine kumi waliitikiaje waliposikia kile ambacho ndugu hao wawili walikuwa wamemwomba Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~24#Question:How did the other ten disciples react when they heard what the two brothers had requested of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~24#Answer:How did the other ten disciples react when they heard what the two brothers had requested of Jesus?-1677425697
trans-unit.source: They were angry with the two brothers. (24)
trans-unit.target: Waliwakasirikia ndugu hao wawili. (24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~24#Answer:How did the other ten disciples react when they heard what the two brothers had requested of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.25+About what did Jesus remind the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~25#Question:About what did Jesus remind the disciples?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus remind the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwakumbusha wanafunzi wake nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~25#Question:About what did Jesus remind the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~25#Answer:About what did Jesus remind the disciples?1655668804
trans-unit.source: Jesus reminded the disciples that the rulers of the Gentiles exercised complete control over them and the officials of the Gentiles ruled harshly over them. (25)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwakumbusha wanafunzi kwamba watawala wa Mataifa walikuwa na mamlaka kamili juu yao na maofisa wa Mataifa waliwatawala kwa ukali (25).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~25#Answer:About what did Jesus remind the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.26-27+In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~26#Question:In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?
trans-unit.source: In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwa njia gani kwamba hawapaswi kuwa kama watawala wa Mataifa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~26#Question:In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~26#Answer:In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?1929583729
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that whoever wanted to be great/important among them must be their servant. (26)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi kwamba yeyote anayetaka kuwa mkubwa/muhimu miongoni mwao lazima awe mtumishi wao. (26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~26#Answer:In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~26#Answer:In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?1936406018
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that whoever wanted to be first/important among them must be their slave. (27)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi kwamba yeyote anayetaka kuwa wa kwanza/wa muhimu miongoni mwao lazima awe mtumwa wao. (27)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~26#Answer:In what way did Jesus tell the disciples that they must not be like the rulers of the Gentiles?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kuwa mtumwa wa mtu fulani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~26#Alternate:What do you think it means to be a slave of someone/something?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!20~26#Alternate:What do you think it means to be a slave of someone/something?-275184964
trans-unit.source: What do you think it means to be a slave of something?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri inamaanisha nini kuwa mtumwa wa kitu fulani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~26#Alternate:What do you think it means to be a slave of someone/something?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means that the person is totally responsible to and dependent upon another person, or the person has become completely subservient to a dominating influence. (See "slave" in KBT in the "servant, slave" entry.)
trans-unit.target: Mtihani wa neno muhimu: Inamaanisha kwamba mtu anajibika kabisa na anategemea mtu mwingine, au mtu huyo amekuwa mtumwa kabisa kwa ushawishi mkubwa. (Tazama "mtumwa" katika KBT katika "mtumwa, mtumwa" kuingia.)

group.id: Q:MAT 20.29+Who followed Jesus as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~29#Question:Who followed Jesus as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho?
trans-unit.source: Who followed Jesus as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho?
trans-unit.target: Ni nani waliomfuata Yesu wakati yeye na wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakitoka Yeriko?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~29#Answer:Who followed Jesus as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho?1511189360
trans-unit.source: A large crowd of people followed him. (29)

group.id: Q:MAT 20.30+What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~30#Question:What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?
trans-unit.source: What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?
trans-unit.target: Vipofu wawili waliokuwa wameketi kando ya barabara walifanya nini waliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa akipita karibu nao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~30#Question:What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~30#Answer:What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?-2034278330
trans-unit.source: They shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!" (30)
trans-unit.target: Walipaaza sauti hivi: "Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, uturehemu!" (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~30#Answer:What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!20~30#Note:What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?-1953038944
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~30#Note:What did two blind men, who were sitting by the roadside, do when they heard that Jesus was passing by them?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.31+What did the crowd tell the two blind men to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~31#Question:What did the crowd tell the two blind men to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the crowd tell the two blind men to do?
trans-unit.target: Umati uliwaambia wanaume hao wawili vipofu wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~31#Question:What did the crowd tell the two blind men to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~31#Answer:What did the crowd tell the two blind men to do?1458441658
trans-unit.source: The crowd rebuked/scolded the two blind men and told them to be quiet. (31)
trans-unit.target: Umati uliwakemea/kuwafokea vipofu hao wawili na kuwaambia wanyamaze. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~31#Answer:What did the crowd tell the two blind men to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.31+What did the two blind men do after the crowd rebuked them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~31#Question:What did the two blind men do after the crowd rebuked them?
trans-unit.source: What did the two blind men do after the crowd rebuked them?
trans-unit.target: Wale wanaume wawili vipofu walifanya nini baada ya kukemewa na umati?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~31#Question:What did the two blind men do after the crowd rebuked them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~31#Answer:What did the two blind men do after the crowd rebuked them?-1194943049
trans-unit.source: The two blind men shouted even louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!" (31)
trans-unit.target: Vipofu wawili walipaaza sauti kubwa zaidi, "Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi, uturehemu!" (31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~31#Answer:What did the two blind men do after the crowd rebuked them?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.32+What did Jesus ask the two blind men?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~32#Question:What did Jesus ask the two blind men?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask the two blind men?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza nini wanaume wawili vipofu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~32#Question:What did Jesus ask the two blind men?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~32#Answer:What did Jesus ask the two blind men?-912717420
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked the two blind men what they wanted him to do for them. (32)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza vipofu hao wawili wanataka awafanyie nini. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~32#Answer:What did Jesus ask the two blind men?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.33+What did the two blind men want Jesus to do for them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~33#Question:What did the two blind men want Jesus to do for them?
trans-unit.source: What did the two blind men want Jesus to do for them?
trans-unit.target: Vipofu hao wawili walitaka Yesu awafanyie nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~33#Question:What did the two blind men want Jesus to do for them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~33#Answer:What did the two blind men want Jesus to do for them?-642587245
trans-unit.source: They wanted Jesus to heal their eyes so that they could see. (33)
trans-unit.target: Walitamani Yesu aponye macho yao ili waweze kuona. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~33#Answer:What did the two blind men want Jesus to do for them?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.34+What did Jesus do for the two blind men?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~34#Question:What did Jesus do for the two blind men?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do for the two blind men?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwafanyia nini vipofu wawili?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~34#Question:What did Jesus do for the two blind men?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~34#Answer:What did Jesus do for the two blind men?-1888070886
trans-unit.source: He felt compassion/pity for them. He touched their eyes and immediately they could see. (34)
trans-unit.target: Akawahurumia, akawagusa macho yao, mara wakapata kuona.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~34#Answer:What did Jesus do for the two blind men?

group.id: Q:MAT 20.34+What did the two men do after they were able to see again?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!20~34#Question:What did the two men do after they were able to see again?
trans-unit.source: What did the two men do after they were able to see again?
trans-unit.target: Wanaume hao wawili walifanya nini baada ya kuona tena?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~34#Question:What did the two men do after they were able to see again?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!20~34#Answer:What did the two men do after they were able to see again?-1888835257
trans-unit.source: They followed Jesus/became disciples of Jesus. (34)
trans-unit.target: Walimfuata Yesu/wakawa wanafunzi wa Yesu. (34)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!20~34#Answer:What did the two men do after they were able to see again?
