group.id: Q:MAT 21.1-11+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~1#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~1#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~1#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?1298307868
trans-unit.source: The author wrote about what happened as Jesus was entering Jerusalem.
trans-unit.target: Mwandikaji aliandika juu ya jambo lililotukia Yesu alipokuwa akiingia Yerusalemu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~1#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.1-2+As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~1#Question:As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walipokaribia Yerusalemu na kufika Betfage Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wawili wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~1#Question:As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~1#Answer:As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?-2124444057
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them to go to the (village of) Bethphage and there they would find a donkey and her colt that were tied [to a post].
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia waende (kijiji cha) Bethfage na huko watapata punda na mwana-punda wake wakiwa wamefungwa [kwa nguzo].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~1#Answer:As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~1#Answer:As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?995622120
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them to untie the donkey and her colt and to bring them to him. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wamfungue punda na mwana-punda wake na kumletea (1-2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~1#Answer:As Jesus and his disciples approached Jerusalem and came to the (village of) Bethphage what did Jesus tell two of his disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.3+What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~3#Question:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.source: What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.target: Wale wanafunzi wawili walipaswa kusema nini ikiwa mtu yeyote angewauliza wanafanya nini / kwa nini wanachukua punda na mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~3#Question:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~3#Alternate:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?916254697
trans-unit.source: What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi hao wawili walipaswa kusema nini ikiwa mtu fulani angewauliza walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~3#Alternate:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~3#Alternate:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?-233837190
trans-unit.source: What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them why they were taking the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi hao wawili walipaswa kusema nini ikiwa mtu fulani angewauliza kwa nini walikuwa wakichukua punda na mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~3#Alternate:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~3#Answer:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?-2052024462
trans-unit.source: The two disciples were supposed to tell that person that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt. (3)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi hao wawili walipaswa kumwambia mtu huyo kwamba Bwana alihitaji punda na mwana-punda. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~3#Answer:What were the two disciples supposed to say if anyone asked them what they were doing/why they were taking the donkey and the colt?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.3+What would that person do after the two disciples told him that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~3#Question:What would that person do after the two disciples told him that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.source: What would that person do after the two disciples told him that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo angefanya nini baada ya wanafunzi hao wawili kumwambia kwamba Bwana alihitaji punda na mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~3#Question:What would that person do after the two disciples told him that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~3#Answer:What would that person do after the two disciples told him that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt?252006622
trans-unit.source: That person would immediately permit/allow them to take the donkey and the colt. (3)
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo angewaruhusu mara moja kuchukua punda na mwana-punda. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~3#Answer:What would that person do after the two disciples told him that the Lord needed the donkey and the colt?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.4-5+What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~4#Question:What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?
trans-unit.source: What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?
trans-unit.target: Mambo hayo yote yangetimiza nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~4#Question:What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~4#Answer:What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?491886294
trans-unit.source: The occurring/occurrence of all those events were the fulfillment of prophecies written by Isaiah and Zechariah many years before that time. (4-5)
trans-unit.target: Matukio hayo yote yalikuwa ni utimizo wa unabii ulioandikwa na Isaya na Zekaria miaka mingi kabla ya wakati huo.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~4#Answer:What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!21~4#Note:What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?1369910140
trans-unit.source: See Isaiah 62:11 and Zechariah 9:9.
trans-unit.target: Ona Isaya 62:11 na Zekaria 9:9.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~4#Note:What would be fulfilled by all of those events taking place?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.7+What did those two disciples do with the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~7#Question:What did those two disciples do with the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.source: What did those two disciples do with the donkey and the colt?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi hao wawili walifanya nini na punda na mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~7#Question:What did those two disciples do with the donkey and the colt?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~7#Answer:What did those two disciples do with the donkey and the colt?1634474407
trans-unit.source: They brought the donkey and the colt [to Jesus] and placed their cloaks/outer garments on the donkey and the colt. (7)
trans-unit.target: Walileta punda na mwana-punda [kwa Yesu] na kuweka kanzu zao/mavazi yao ya nje juu ya punda na mwana-punda. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~7#Answer:What did those two disciples do with the donkey and the colt?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.7+Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~7#Question:Then what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~7#Question:Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~7#Answer:Then what did Jesus do?1029544477
trans-unit.source: He sat on the colt. (7)
trans-unit.target: Aliketi juu ya mwana-punda. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~7#Answer:Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!21~7#Note:Then what did Jesus do?1380752728
trans-unit.source: See Mark 11:2 and Luke 19:30.
trans-unit.target: Ona Marko 11:2 na Luka 19:30.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~7#Note:Then what did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.8-9+What did the large crowd of people do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~8#Question:What did the large crowd of people do?
trans-unit.source: What did the large crowd of people do?
trans-unit.target: Umati mkubwa wa watu ulifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~8#Question:What did the large crowd of people do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~8#Answer:What did the large crowd of people do?-10124788
trans-unit.source: Some of the people in the crowd spread their cloaks/outer garments on the road.
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya watu katika umati huo walitayarisha mavazi yao ya nje/mavazi ya nje barabarani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~8#Answer:What did the large crowd of people do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~8#Answer:What did the large crowd of people do?1699839349
trans-unit.source: Other people in the crowd cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
trans-unit.target: Wengine katika umati huo walikata matawi ya miti na kuyatawanya barabarani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~8#Answer:What did the large crowd of people do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~8#Answer:What did the large crowd of people do?-1893122018
trans-unit.source: The crowd of people who were walking [on the road] ahead of Jesus and behind Jesus shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Hosanna in the highest!" (8-9)
trans-unit.target: Umati wa watu waliokuwa wakitembea [katika barabara] mbele ya Yesu na wale waliokuwa wakimfuata walipaaza sauti, "Hosana Mwana wa Daudi!" "Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana!" "Hosana katika mahali pa juu!" (8-9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~8#Answer:What did the large crowd of people do?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.10-11+What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~10#Question:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu [akiwa amepanda huyo/mwana-punda]?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~10#Question:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~10#Alternate:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?1275191125
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem riding on that colt?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu akiwa amepanda mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~10#Alternate:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~10#Alternate:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?90748026
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem riding on the colt?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu akiwa amepanda mwana-punda?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~10#Alternate:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~10#Alternate:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?236474246
trans-unit.source: What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~10#Alternate:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~10#Answer:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?1645246883
trans-unit.source: The crowd of people in the city became very excited and asked the crowd of people, who were with Jesus, who he was.
trans-unit.target: Umati wa watu katika jiji hilo uliguswa moyo sana na kuuliza umati wa watu waliokuwa pamoja na Yesu ni nani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~10#Answer:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~10#Answer:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?357496708
trans-unit.source: The crowd of people, who were with Jesus, answered that he was Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee. (10-11)
trans-unit.target: Umati wa watu, waliokuwa pamoja na Yesu, wakajibu kwamba huyo ndiye Yesu, nabii kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya. (10-11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~10#Answer:What happened when Jesus entered Jerusalem [riding on that/the colt]?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!21~12#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 21:12-17 Jesus drove out the traders from the temple courtyard.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 21:12-17 Yesu aliwafukuza wafanyabiashara kutoka katika ua wa hekalu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~12#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 21.12-17+What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~12#Question:What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifanya nini alipoingia katika eneo la hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~12#Question:What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~12#Answer:What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?-525522332
trans-unit.source: He drove everyone out of the temple courtyard who were buying and selling [animals and other items to be used for sacrifices].
trans-unit.target: Aliwafukuza wote waliokuwa wakiuza na kununua [wanyama na vitu vingine vilivyotumiwa kwa ajili ya dhabihu] katika ua wa hekalu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~12#Answer:What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~12#Answer:What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?-1517475343
trans-unit.source: He overturned the tables of the moneychangers and the benches of those who were selling doves. (12)
trans-unit.target: Alizipindua meza za wale waliokuwa wakibadili pesa na viti vya wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~12#Answer:What did Jesus do when he entered the temple area?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.13+What did Jesus say to the moneychangers and to the people who were buying and selling?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~13#Question:What did Jesus say to the moneychangers and to the people who were buying and selling?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the moneychangers and to the people who were buying and selling?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wale waliokuwa wakibadili pesa na watu waliokuwa wakinunua na kuuza?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~13#Question:What did Jesus say to the moneychangers and to the people who were buying and selling?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~13#Answer:What did Jesus say to the moneychangers and to the people who were buying and selling?150925450
trans-unit.source: He told them that it is written [in the scriptures] that [God] said, "My house will be called a house of prayer." (13)
trans-unit.target: Naye akawaambia kwamba imeandikwa [katika maandiko] kwamba [Mungu] alisema, 'Nyumba yangu itaitwa nyumba ya sala.' " (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~13#Answer:What did Jesus say to the moneychangers and to the people who were buying and selling?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.13+Of what did Jesus accuse the moneychangers and the people who were buying and selling [animals and other items]?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~13#Question:Of what did Jesus accuse the moneychangers and the people who were buying and selling [animals and other items]?
trans-unit.source: Of what did Jesus accuse the moneychangers and the people who were buying and selling [animals and other items]?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.21-22+What did Jesus reply to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~21#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?866127604
trans-unit.source: He told them that, if they had faith [in God] and did not doubt [what he could/can do], they also could do what he had done to the fig tree.
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba, ikiwa wangekuwa na imani [kwa Mungu] na wasitilie shaka [kile ambacho angeweza/angeweza kufanya], wao pia wangeweza kufanya kama alivyofanya kwa mtini.

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~21#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?-54123533
trans-unit.source: He told them that they could also command/order that mountain to throw itself into the sea and it would happen. (21)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wanaweza pia kuamuru mlima huo ujitupe baharini na utafanyika. (21)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~21#Answer:What did Jesus reply to the disciples?-63660661
trans-unit.source: He told them that, if they believed [in God], they would receive whatever they asked of him in prayer. (22)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba chochote watakachoomba katika sala yake, watapata, wakimwamini [Mungu].

trans-unit.source: Jesus asked them which of the two sons did what their father told them to do. (31)
trans-unit.target: Yesu akawauliza ni yupi kati ya hao wawili aliyetimiza aliyoamriwa na baba yao? (31)

trans-unit.source: They answered him that the first son had done what his father had told him to do. (31)
trans-unit.target: Wakamwambia kwamba yule wa kwanza alifanya kama vile baba yake alivyomwamuru afanye. (31)

group.id: Q:MAT 21.31+What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~31#Question:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wakuu wa makuhani na wazee?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~31#Question:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~31#Answer:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders?-1856009113
trans-unit.source: He told them that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God in their place/in place of them. (31)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba watoza ushuru na makahaba walikuwa wakiingia katika ufalme wa Mungu badala yao/mahali pao. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~31#Answer:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.32+What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~32#Question:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yesu kuwaambia makuhani wakuu na wazee kwamba wakusanya kodi na makahaba walikuwa wakiingia katika ufalme wa Mungu badala yao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~32#Question:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?1642342756
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that to them because John [the Baptist] came to them to teach them the way of righteousness/how to live the way that God wants them to live.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia hivyo kwa sababu Yohana [Mbatizaji] alikuja kwao kuwafundisha njia ya uadilifu/jinsi ya kuishi kwa njia ambayo Mungu anataka waishi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?-749721256
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the chief priest and the elders that they did not believe what John taught to them, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wakuu wa makuhani na wazee kwamba hawakuamini yale ambayo Yohana aliwafundisha, lakini wakusanya - kodi na makahaba walimwamini.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?415828953
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that they refused to repent/change their minds even after they saw/knew that the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed John. (32)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia makuhani wakuu na wazee kwamba walikataa kutubu/kubadilisha mawazo yao hata baada ya kuona/kujua kwamba watoza ushuru na makahaba walimwamini Yohana. (32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~32#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the chief priests and the elders that the tax collectors and the prostitutes were entering the kingdom of God instead of them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~36#Question:What did the tenants do to the next group of servants that the landowner sent to them?
trans-unit.source: What did the tenants do to the next group of servants that the landowner sent to them?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima walifanya nini kwa kikundi cha watumishi kilichofuata ambacho mwenye shamba aliwatuma kwao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~36#Question:What did the tenants do to the next group of servants that the landowner sent to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~36#Answer:What did the tenants do to the next group of servants that the landowner sent to them?474388592
trans-unit.source: The tenants treated them the same way that they had treated the first three servants. (36)
trans-unit.target: Wakodishaji waliwatendea kama vile walivyowatendea wale watumishi watatu wa kwanza. (36)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~36#Answer:What did the tenants do to the next group of servants that the landowner sent to them?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.37+Whom did the landowner send to the tenants last?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~37#Question:Whom did the landowner send to the tenants last?
trans-unit.source: Whom did the landowner send to the tenants last?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye shamba alimtuma nani mwisho kwa wakulima?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~37#Question:Whom did the landowner send to the tenants last?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~37#Answer:Whom did the landowner send to the tenants last?-1498708478
trans-unit.source: He sent his son to them. (37)
trans-unit.target: Akamtuma mwanawe kwao. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~37#Answer:Whom did the landowner send to the tenants last?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.37+What is the reason that the landowner sent his son to the tenants?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~37#Question:What is the reason that the landowner sent his son to the tenants?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the landowner sent his son to the tenants?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mwenye shamba alimtuma mwana wake kwa wakulima?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~37#Question:What is the reason that the landowner sent his son to the tenants?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~37#Answer:What is the reason that the landowner sent his son to the tenants?-1472826777
trans-unit.source: He sent his son to the tenants because he believed that the tenants would respect his son. (37)
trans-unit.target: Alimtuma mwanawe kwa wakulima kwa sababu aliamini kwamba wakulima wangemheshimu mwanawe. (37)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~37#Answer:What is the reason that the landowner sent his son to the tenants?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.38+What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~38#Question:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?
trans-unit.source: What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?
trans-unit.target: Wakaaji hao waliamini wangepata nini kwa kumuua mwana wa mwenye shamba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~38#Question:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~38#Alternate:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?-1962753567
trans-unit.source: What did the tenants believe they would obtain if they killed the landowner's son?
trans-unit.target: Wale wapangaji waliamini wangepata nini kwa kumwua mwana wa mwenye shamba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~38#Alternate:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!21~38#Alternate:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?-1203390635
trans-unit.source: What did the tenants believe they would secure if they killed the landowner's son?
trans-unit.target: Walimu hao waliamini wangepata nini kwa kumuua mwana wa mwenye shamba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~38#Alternate:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~38#Answer:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?352978150
trans-unit.source: They believed that they would obtain/secure/acquire the son's inheritance/property/vineyard. (38)
trans-unit.target: Waliamini kwamba wangepata/kulinda/kununua urithi/mali/shamba la mizabibu la mwana wao. (38)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~38#Answer:What did the tenants believe they would obtain/secure if they killed the landowner's son?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.39+What did the tenants do to the landowner's son?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~39#Question:What did the tenants do to the landowner's son?
trans-unit.source: What did the tenants do to the landowner's son?
trans-unit.target: Wakulima hao walimfanyia nini mwana wa mwenye shamba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~39#Question:What did the tenants do to the landowner's son?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~39#Answer:What did the tenants do to the landowner's son?-474950644
trans-unit.source: They killed him. (39)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakamwua.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~39#Answer:What did the tenants do to the landowner's son?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.40+What did Jesus ask the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~40#Question:What did Jesus ask the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza nini wakuu wa makuhani na wanaume wazee?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~40#Question:What did Jesus ask the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~40#Answer:What did Jesus ask the chief priests and the elders?-450341960
trans-unit.source: He asked them what they thought the landowner would do to the tenants when he returned/came to his vineyard. (40)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza wanafikiri mwenye shamba atawatendea nini wakulima hao atakaporudi/kufika kwenye shamba lake la mizabibu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~40#Answer:What did Jesus ask the chief priests and the elders?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.41+What did the chief priests and the elders answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~41#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and the elders answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na wazee walimjibu Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~41#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~41#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders answer Jesus?-1477146391
trans-unit.source: They answered him that the landowner would kill those tenants violently/brutally/cruelly/in a painful way. (41)
trans-unit.target: Walijibu kwamba mwenye nyumba angewaua wapangaji hao kwa jeuri/kijeuri/kikatili/kwa njia yenye maumivu. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~41#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders answer Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.41+Then what did they say the landowner would do after he had killed those tenants?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~41#Question:Then what did they say the landowner would do after he had killed those tenants?
trans-unit.source: Then what did they say the landowner would do after he had killed those tenants?
trans-unit.target: Basi walisema mwenye shamba angefanya nini baada ya kuwaua hao wapangaji?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~41#Question:Then what did they say the landowner would do after he had killed those tenants?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~41#Answer:Then what did they say the landowner would do after he had killed those tenants?2016670468
trans-unit.source: They said that he would rent his vineyard to other tenants who would give him his share of the crop/grapes at harvest time. (41)
trans-unit.target: Walisema kwamba angeikodisha shamba lake la mizabibu kwa wapangaji wengine ambao wangempa sehemu yake ya mazao/zabibu wakati wa mavuno. (41)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~41#Answer:Then what did they say the landowner would do after he had killed those tenants?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.42+About what did Jesus remind the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~42#Question:About what did Jesus remind the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.source: About what did Jesus remind the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwakumbusha wakuu wa makuhani na wanaume wazee nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~42#Question:About what did Jesus remind the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~42#Answer:About what did Jesus remind the chief priests and the elders?133010780
trans-unit.source: He asked them if they had never read the passage of scripture that he quoted from Psalm 118:22-23. (42)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza kama walikuwa wamewahi kusoma andiko alilonukuu kutoka Zaburi 118:22-23.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~42#Answer:About what did Jesus remind the chief priests and the elders?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.43+What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders was going to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~43#Question:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders was going to happen to them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders was going to happen to them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wakuu wa makuhani na wazee kwamba ni nini kingewapata?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~43#Question:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders was going to happen to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders was going to happen to them?438780185
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them that [God] would take away from them [the privilege of belonging to] the kingdom of God; and he will give it to people who will obey his will. // God will stop ruling you evil/disobedient/rebellious people/Jews. He will rule people who will do/obey His will. (43)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia kwamba [Mungu] atachukua kutoka kwenu [pendeleo la kuwa wa] ufalme wa Mungu; na atawapa watu ambao watatii mapenzi yake. // Mungu ataacha kutawala watu waovu / wasiotii / waasi / Wayahudi. Atatawala watu ambao watafanya / kutii mapenzi yake. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~43#Answer:What did Jesus tell the chief priests and the elders was going to happen to them?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.45+About whom did the chief priests and the Pharisees know Jesus was talking in his parables?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~45#Question:About whom did the chief priests and the Pharisees know Jesus was talking in his parables?
trans-unit.source: About whom did the chief priests and the Pharisees know Jesus was talking in his parables?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na Mafarisayo walijua Yesu alikuwa akizungumza juu ya nani katika mifano yake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~45#Question:About whom did the chief priests and the Pharisees know Jesus was talking in his parables?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~45#Answer:About whom did the chief priests and the Pharisees know Jesus was talking in his parables?-781749026
trans-unit.source: They knew he was talking about them. (45)
trans-unit.target: Walijua kwamba alikuwa akisema juu yao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~45#Answer:About whom did the chief priests and the Pharisees know Jesus was talking in his parables?

group.id: Q:MAT 21.46+What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees did not arrest Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!21~46#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees did not arrest Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees did not arrest Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo hawakumkamata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~46#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees did not arrest Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!21~46#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees did not arrest Jesus?1442925456
trans-unit.source: They did not arrest Jesus because they were afraid of the crowd/people. The people believed that Jesus was a prophet. (46)
trans-unit.target: Hawakumkamata Yesu kwa sababu waliogopa umati wa watu ambao walimwona kuwa nabii. (46)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!21~46#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees did not arrest Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!22~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 22:1-14 Jesus told a parable about a wedding feast.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 22:1-14 Yesu alitoa mfano kuhusu karamu ya arusi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 22.1-14+About what parable did Jesus tell to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~1#Question:About what parable did Jesus tell to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.source: About what parable did Jesus tell to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia makuhani wakuu na wazee mfano gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~1#Question:About what parable did Jesus tell to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~1#Answer:About what parable did Jesus tell to the chief priests and the elders?1231782069
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the chief priests and the elders a parable about a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son. (2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wakuu wa makuhani na wazee mfano juu ya mfalme aliyeandaa karamu ya arusi kwa ajili ya mwana wake. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~1#Answer:About what parable did Jesus tell to the chief priests and the elders?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.2+To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~2#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa mbinguni na nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~2#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~2#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?-892407191
trans-unit.source: Jesus compared the kingdom of heaven to a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son. (2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifananisha ufalme wa mbinguni na mfalme aliyemwandalia mwanawe karamu ya arusi. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~2#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.3+How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~3#Question:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.source: How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Watu, ambao mfalme alikuwa amewaalika kwenye karamu ya harusi, waliitikiaje wakati watumishi wa mfalme waliwaalika/waliwaambia waje kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~3#Question:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!22~3#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?-100495156
trans-unit.source: How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Watu, walioalikwa kwenye karamu ya arusi ya mfalme, waliitikiaje wakati watumishi wa mfalme walipowaalika waje kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~3#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!22~3#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?1123041123
trans-unit.source: How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king told them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Watu, walioalikwa kwenye karamu ya arusi ya mfalme, waliitikiaje wakati watumishi wa mfalme walipowaambia waje kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~3#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~3#Answer:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?-398351861
trans-unit.source: Those people refused to come to the banquet. (3)
trans-unit.target: Watu hao walikataa kuja kwenye karamu hiyo. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~3#Answer:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when the servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.4-6+How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~4#Question:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.source: How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Watu, ambao mfalme alikuwa amewaalika kwenye karamu ya arusi, waliitikiaje wakati watumishi wengine wa mfalme waliwaalika/waliwaambia waje kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~4#Question:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!22~4#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?-1440048417
trans-unit.source: How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Watu, walioalikwa kwenye karamu ya arusi ya mfalme, waliitikiaje walipoalikwa na watumishi wengine wa mfalme kuja kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~4#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!22~4#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?720686141
trans-unit.source: How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king told them to come to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Watu, walioalikwa kwenye karamu ya arusi ya mfalme, waliitikiaje wakati watumishi wengine wa mfalme walipowaambia waje kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~4#Alternate:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~4#Answer:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?816222581
trans-unit.source: One person went to his field/farm/Some people went to their fields/farms, one person went to his business/some people went to their businesses. The rest of the people beat the servants and killed them. (4-6)
trans-unit.target: Basi, wakaenda, mmoja shambani kwake, mwingine kwenye biashara yake; na wengine wakawapiga watumishi na kuwaua.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~4#Answer:How did the people, whom the king had invited to the wedding banquet, respond when other servants of the king invited/told them to come to the banquet?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.7+Then what did the king do when he heard what had happened to his servants?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~7#Question:Then what did the king do when he heard what had happened to his servants?
trans-unit.source: Then what did the king do when he heard what had happened to his servants?
trans-unit.target: Kisha mfalme alifanya nini aliposikia yaliyokuwa yametukia kwa watumishi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~7#Question:Then what did the king do when he heard what had happened to his servants?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~7#Answer:Then what did the king do when he heard what had happened to his servants?-453637501
trans-unit.source: He sent his army/soldiers and they killed those people who had killed his servants. His soldiers also burned their city. (7)
trans-unit.target: Akawatuma askari wake wakawaua wale waliowaua watumishi wake, wakauteketeza mji wao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~7#Answer:Then what did the king do when he heard what had happened to his servants?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.9+Then whom did the king tell his servants to invite to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~9#Question:Then whom did the king tell his servants to invite to the banquet?
trans-unit.source: Then whom did the king tell his servants to invite to the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Basi mfalme aliwaambia watumishi wake wawaalike nani kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~9#Question:Then whom did the king tell his servants to invite to the banquet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~9#Answer:Then whom did the king tell his servants to invite to the banquet?-35980865
trans-unit.source: The king told his servants to go out into the streets and to invite anyone they found to the banquet. (9)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliwaambia watumishi wake waende katika njia kuu na kumwalika kwenye karamu yeyote ambaye wangepata. (9)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~9#Answer:Then whom did the king tell his servants to invite to the banquet?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.10+What did the king's servants do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~10#Question:What did the king's servants do?
trans-unit.source: What did the king's servants do?
trans-unit.target: Watumishi wa mfalme walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~10#Question:What did the king's servants do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~10#Answer:What did the king's servants do?701452441
trans-unit.source: His servants went into the streets and invited all the people, including the bad people and the good people, they found to the banquet. They invited so many people to the banquet that the place where they were celebrating the wedding was filled with people. (10)
trans-unit.target: Basi wale watumishi wakaenda katika njia, wakawaita watu wote waliowaona, wabaya kwa wema, waje arusini; na nyumba ya arusi ikajaa wageni.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~10#Answer:What did the king's servants do?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.11+What did the king notice that concerned him about one man at the banquet?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~11#Question:What did the king notice that concerned him about one man at the banquet?
trans-unit.source: What did the king notice that concerned him about one man at the banquet?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliona nini kilichomfanya awe na wasiwasi kuhusu mtu mmoja kwenye karamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~11#Question:What did the king notice that concerned him about one man at the banquet?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~11#Answer:What did the king notice that concerned him about one man at the banquet?-1748841778
trans-unit.source: The king noticed that one man at the banquet was not wearing wedding clothes. (11)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliona kwamba mtu mmoja kwenye karamu hakuwa amevaa mavazi ya arusi. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~11#Answer:What did the king notice that concerned him about one man at the banquet?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.12+What did the king ask the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~12#Question:What did the king ask the man?
trans-unit.source: What did the king ask the man?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme alimwuliza mwanamume huyo swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~12#Question:What did the king ask the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~12#Answer:What did the king ask the man?2040056748
trans-unit.source: The king asked the man how he entered/was admitted to the banquet without wearing wedding clothes. (12)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme alimwuliza mtu huyo jinsi alivyoingia/alikubaliwa kwenye karamu bila kuvaa mavazi ya harusi. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~12#Answer:What did the king ask the man?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.12+What did the man answer/say to the king?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~12#Question:What did the man answer/say to the king?
trans-unit.source: What did the man answer/say to the king?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamume huyo alimjibu mfalme nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~12#Question:What did the man answer/say to the king?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!22~12#Alternate:What did the man answer/say to the king?-1358387233
trans-unit.source: What did the man answer to the king?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alimjibuje mfalme?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~12#Alternate:What did the man answer/say to the king?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!22~12#Alternate:What did the man answer/say to the king?-2080901757
trans-unit.source: What did the man say to the king?
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alimwambia nini mfalme?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~12#Alternate:What did the man answer/say to the king?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~12#Answer:What did the man answer/say to the king?616738773
trans-unit.source: He did not answer/say anything. (12)
trans-unit.target: Hakusema/hakusema chochote. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~12#Answer:What did the man answer/say to the king?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.13+What did the king tell his servants to do to the man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~13#Question:What did the king tell his servants to do to the man?
trans-unit.source: What did the king tell his servants to do to the man?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme aliwaambia watumishi wake wamfanyie nini mtu huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~13#Question:What did the king tell his servants to do to the man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~13#Answer:What did the king tell his servants to do to the man?-2065978740
trans-unit.source: The king told his servants to tie the man's hands and feet and to throw him outside into the darkness. In that darkness [people are punished]. [Those people] will weep and gnash their teeth/They will cry bitterly and gnash/grit their teeth in pain. (13)
trans-unit.target: Mfalme akawaambia watumishi wake wamfunge mtu huyo mikono na miguu, wamtupe nje gizani; ndiko kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno, na kulia na kusaga meno. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~13#Answer:What did the king tell his servants to do to the man?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!22~15#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 22:15-22 Some Pharisees asked Jesus if they should pay taxes to Caesar/the king of Rome.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 22:15-22 Mafarisayo fulani walimwuliza Yesu kama inafaa kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari/mfalme wa Roma.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~15#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 22.15-22+What did the Pharisees make plans to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~15#Question:What did the Pharisees make plans to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees make plans to do?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walipanga kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~15#Question:What did the Pharisees make plans to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~15#Answer:What did the Pharisees make plans to do?1188528677
trans-unit.source: They made plans to try to tempt/lure/trick Jesus to say something wrong [so that they could criticize him]. (15)
trans-unit.target: Walifanya mipango ya kujaribu kumshawishi/kumshawishi/kumdanganya Yesu aseme jambo fulani baya [ili waweze kumchambua]. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~15#Answer:What did the Pharisees make plans to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.17+What did some of the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~17#Question:What did some of the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did some of the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Mafarisayo na wafuasi wa Herode walimwuliza Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~17#Question:What did some of the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~17#Answer:What did some of the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?1739517575
trans-unit.source: They asked him if it was right to pay taxes to Caesar or not. (17)
trans-unit.target: Waliuliza kama ilikuwa halali kumlipa Kaisari kodi au la. (17)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~17#Answer:What did some of the Pharisees' disciples and the Herodians ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.21+What did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~21#Question:What did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~21#Question:What did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~21#Answer:What did Jesus answer them?1852680974
trans-unit.source: He told them to give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar and to God what belongs to God. (21)
trans-unit.target: Akawaambia, Basi, vya Kaisari mpeni Kaisari, na vya Mungu mpeni Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~21#Answer:What did Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.22+How did the Pharisees and the Herodians react to the answer that Jesus gave to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~22#Question:How did the Pharisees and the Herodians react to the answer that Jesus gave to them?
trans-unit.source: How did the Pharisees and the Herodians react to the answer that Jesus gave to them?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo na wafuasi wa Herode waliitikiaje jibu ambalo Yesu aliwapa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~22#Question:How did the Pharisees and the Herodians react to the answer that Jesus gave to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~22#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the Herodians react to the answer that Jesus gave to them?-753916383
trans-unit.source: They were amazed [that he had answered their question without being trapped by them]. Then they went away from him. (22)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakamwacha, wakenda zao, wakistaajabu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~22#Answer:How did the Pharisees and the Herodians react to the answer that Jesus gave to them?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!22~23#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 22:23-33 Some Sadducees asked/questioned Jesus about people rising back to life after having been dead.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 22:23-33 Masadukayo fulani walimwuliza Yesu kuhusu watu wanaofufuliwa baada ya kufa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~23#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 22.23-33+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~23#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~23#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~23#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?-542073027
trans-unit.source: Some Sadducees came to Jesus and told him about seven brothers who, one after the other, had married the same widow according to the law of Moses. They had done that because the law said that, if a man died without having any children, his brother must marry the widow and have children for him. (24-26)
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo fulani walimwendea Yesu na kumwambia kuhusu ndugu saba ambao, mmoja baada ya mwingine, walikuwa wameoa mjane mmoja kulingana na sheria ya Musa. Walikuwa wamefanya hivyo kwa sababu sheria iliagiza kwamba ikiwa mtu angekufa bila kuwa na watoto, ndugu yake angemuoa mjane huyo na kumzalia ndugu yake watoto. (24-26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~23#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.28+What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~28#Question:What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo walimwuliza Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~28#Question:What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~28#Answer:What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?-1217060963
trans-unit.source: They asked him, of the seven brothers, whose wife would the woman be at the resurrection/when God raises people from the dead. (28)
trans-unit.target: Basi siku ya ufufuo atakuwa mke wa nani katika wale saba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~28#Answer:What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!22~28#Note:What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?-1206038970
trans-unit.source: The Sadducees believed that God did not raise people back to life after they died.
trans-unit.target: Masadukayo waliamini kwamba Mungu hakufufua watu baada ya wao kufa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~28#Note:What did the Sadducees ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.30+What did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~30#Question:What did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus answer them?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwajibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~30#Question:What did Jesus answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~30#Answer:What did Jesus answer them?1308031328
trans-unit.source: He told them that at the resurrection people will not be marrying each other nor be given in marriage. He said that people will be like the angels in heaven. (30)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba katika ufufuo watu hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika mbinguni. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~30#Answer:What did Jesus answer them?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.33+How did the people react to what Jesus said to them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~33#Question:How did the people react to what Jesus said to them?
trans-unit.source: How did the people react to what Jesus said to them?
trans-unit.target: Watu waliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu aliwaambia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~33#Question:How did the people react to what Jesus said to them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~33#Answer:How did the people react to what Jesus said to them?2098341300
trans-unit.source: They were amazed/impressed by what he said to them. (33)
trans-unit.target: Nao wakashangaa kwa maneno yake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~33#Answer:How did the people react to what Jesus said to them?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!22~34#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 22:34-40 A Pharisee asked Jesus which of God's commandments is greatest/most important.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 22:34-40 Farisayo mmoja alimwuliza Yesu ni amri ipi iliyo kuu/muhimu zaidi kati ya amri za Mungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~34#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 22.34-40+What did one of the Pharisees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~34#Question:What did one of the Pharisees ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did one of the Pharisees ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mfarisayo mmoja alimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~34#Question:What did one of the Pharisees ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~34#Answer:What did one of the Pharisees ask Jesus?265714858
trans-unit.source: He asked Jesus which commandment is the greatest/most important in the law. (36)
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza Yesu ni amri ipi iliyo kuu/muhimu zaidi katika sheria. (36)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~34#Answer:What did one of the Pharisees ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.34-40+What is the reason that the Pharisee asked Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~34#Question:What is the reason that the Pharisee asked Jesus that question?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the Pharisee asked Jesus that question?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Farisayo alimwuliza Yesu swali hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~34#Question:What is the reason that the Pharisee asked Jesus that question?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~34#Answer:What is the reason that the Pharisee asked Jesus that question?-889122519
trans-unit.source: The Pharisee asked Jesus that question to test/trap/trick him. (35)
trans-unit.target: Farisayo alimwuliza Yesu swali hilo ili kumjaribu/kumtega/kumdanganya. (35)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~34#Answer:What is the reason that the Pharisee asked Jesus that question?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.37-39+What answer did Jesus give to the Pharisee?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~37#Question:What answer did Jesus give to the Pharisee?
trans-unit.source: What answer did Jesus give to the Pharisee?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimjibuje Farisayo huyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~37#Question:What answer did Jesus give to the Pharisee?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~37#Answer:What answer did Jesus give to the Pharisee?1518467685
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the Pharisee that the greatest commandment is to love the Lord your God with all your being/heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. Jesus also told him that the second greatest commandment is to love your neighbor as you love yourself. (37-39)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia Farisayo kwamba amri kuu ni kumpenda Bwana Mungu wako kwa nafsi yako yote na kwa akili yako yote. Yesu pia alimwambia kwamba amri ya pili ni kumpenda jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe (37-39)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~37#Answer:What answer did Jesus give to the Pharisee?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!22~41#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 22:41-46 Jesus asked the Pharisees who the Messiah was.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 22:41-46 Yesu aliwauliza Mafarisayo Masihi alikuwa nani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~41#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 22.41-46+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~41#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~41#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~41#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?1795509855
trans-unit.source: Jesus asked the Pharisees several questions about who they thought the Messiah was.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza Mafarisayo maswali kadhaa kuhusu maoni yao kumhusu Masihi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~41#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.42+What did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~42#Question:What did Jesus ask the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus ask the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwauliza Mafarisayo swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~42#Question:What did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~42#Answer:What did Jesus ask the Pharisees?2004991322
trans-unit.source: He asked them whose son was the Messiah. (42)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza Masihi ni mwana wa nani? (42)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~42#Answer:What did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.42+What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~42#Question:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimjibu Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~42#Question:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~42#Answer:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?-2038683594
trans-unit.source: They told Jesus that the Messiah was the son of David. (42)
trans-unit.target: Walimwambia Yesu kwamba Mesiya alikuwa mwana wa Daudi. (42)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~42#Answer:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.43-45+Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~43#Question:Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu aliwauliza Mafarisayo swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~43#Question:Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~43#Answer:Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?1126506708
trans-unit.source: He asked the Pharisees why David called Messiah "Lord." (43)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza Mafarisayo kwa nini Daudi alimwita Mesiya "Bwana" (43)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~43#Answer:Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~43#Answer:Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?-1488475400
trans-unit.source: He also asked the Pharisees: How could the Messiah be the son of David, since David called him "Lord"? (45)
trans-unit.target: Pia aliwauliza Mafarisayo: Mesiya anawezaje kuwa mwana wa Daudi, kwa kuwa Daudi anamwita "Bwana"? (45)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~43#Answer:Then what did Jesus ask the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MAT 22.46+What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!22~46#Question:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Mafarisayo walimjibu Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~46#Question:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!22~46#Answer:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?-1266475194
trans-unit.source: None of the Pharisees could answer Jesus. From that moment on none of them was brave enough to ask Jesus any more questions. (46)
trans-unit.target: Hakuna mtu aliyeweza kumjibu Yesu neno. Na tangu siku hiyo hakuna aliyethubutu kumwuliza tena maswali mengine.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!22~46#Answer:What did the Pharisees answer Jesus?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!23~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 23:1-39 Jesus warned the Pharisees and Teachers of the Law that God will judge/condemn them because of their hypocrisy.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 23:1-39 Yesu aliwaonya Mafarisayo na Walimu wa Sheria kwamba Mungu angewahukumu kwa sababu ya unafiki wao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 23.1-39+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!23~1#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~1#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~1#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?-1204777942
trans-unit.source: Jesus warned the Pharisees and the teachers of the law about all the hypocritical deeds they were doing.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya Mafarisayo na waandishi kuhusu unafiki wao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~1#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 23.3+What did Jesus say to his disciples and the crowds about obeying the teachers of the law and the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!23~3#Question:What did Jesus say to his disciples and the crowds about obeying the teachers of the law and the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to his disciples and the crowds about obeying the teachers of the law and the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia nini wanafunzi wake na umati kuhusu kutii waandishi na Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~3#Question:What did Jesus say to his disciples and the crowds about obeying the teachers of the law and the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~3#Answer:What did Jesus say to his disciples and the crowds about obeying the teachers of the law and the Pharisees?-1692385483
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them that they must obey what the teachers of the law and the Pharisees taught/said. Jesus also told the people that they should not do what the teachers of the law and the Pharisees did because they did not do/practice what they taught. (3)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia kwamba ni lazima watii yale ambayo walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo walifundisha/kusema. Yesu pia aliwaambia watu kwamba hawapaswi kufanya yale ambayo walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo walifanya kwa sababu hawakufanya/kutenda yale waliyofundisha. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~3#Answer:What did Jesus say to his disciples and the crowds about obeying the teachers of the law and the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MAT 23.4-7+What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!23~4#Question:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwashutumu waandishi na Mafarisayo kwa kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~4#Question:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?181986324
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they imposed heavy obligations that were difficult to obey and they did/would not do anything to make it easier for the people to obey those laws. (4)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba waliweka wajibu mzito ambao ulikuwa mgumu kutii na hawakufanya/hawangefanya chochote ili iwe rahisi kwa watu kutii sheria hizo. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?119151669
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they did everything/their religious acts in public so that other people would see them. (5)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba walifanya kila kitu/ vitendo vyao vya kidini hadharani ili watu wengine wawaone. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?-529682274
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they loved the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues. (6)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba walipenda mahali pa heshima kwenye karamu na viti vya mbele katika masinagogi. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?67892209
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they loved to be greeted by people in the marketplaces and to be called "Rabbi" by other people. (7)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba walipenda kusalimiwa na watu sokoni na kuitwa "Rabi" na watu wengine. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~4#Answer:What did Jesus accuse the teachers of the law and the Pharisees of doing?

group.id: Q:MAT 23.8+What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi"?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!23~8#Question:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi"?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi"?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake na umati kwamba hawapaswi kuruhusu yeyote awaite "Rabi"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~8#Question:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi"?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~8#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi"?831583245
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi" because they had only one Master and they were all brothers/fellow believers. (8)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba hawapaswi kuruhusu mtu yeyote awaite "Rabi" kwa sababu walikuwa na Mwalimu mmoja tu na wote walikuwa ndugu/waamini wenzi. (8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~8#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not let anyone call them "Rabbi"?

group.id: Q:MAT 23.9+What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not call anyone on earth "father" [who was not their biological father]?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!23~9#Question:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not call anyone on earth "father" [who was not their biological father]?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not call anyone on earth "father" [who was not their biological father]?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake na umati kwamba hawapaswi kumwita yeyote duniani "baba" [ambaye hakuwa baba yao wa kimwili]?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~9#Question:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not call anyone on earth "father" [who was not their biological father]?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!23~9#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus told his disciples and the crowds that they should not call anyone on earth "father" [who was not their biological father]?1166536680

group.id: Q:MAT 23.13-32+What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!23~13#Question:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?
trans-unit.source: What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?
trans-unit.target: Ni maonyo gani saba ambayo Yesu aliwapa waandishi na Mafarisayo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Question:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?2006142734
trans-unit.source: 1. Jesus warned them that they were preventing others from entering the kingdom of heaven/God. (13)
trans-unit.target: 1. Yesu aliwaonya kwamba walikuwa wanawazuia wengine kuingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni/Mungu. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?339296245
trans-unit.source: 2. Jesus warned them that they did everything that they could to persuade one person to believe like a Jew, and after he believed as they did, they made him twice as much a son/child of Hell/twice as much a worker for the devil/much more deserving of punishment in Hell/twice as evil as they were. (15)
trans-unit.target: 2. Yesu aliwaonya kwamba walifanya kila walichoweza kumshawishi mtu mmoja aamini kama Myahudi, na baada ya yeye kuamini kama walivyofanya, walimfanya mara mbili zaidi mwana/mtoto wa Jahannamu/mara mbili zaidi mfanyakazi wa shetani/mwenye kustahili zaidi adhabu ya Jahannamu/mara mbili mbaya kuliko wao. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?-684877509
trans-unit.source: 3. Jesus warned them that they were wrong in saying that the gold in the temple was more important than the temple (itself). And that the gift a person brought was more important than the altar when they made an oath. (16-22)
trans-unit.target: 3. Yesu aliwaonya kwamba walikuwa wamekosea kwa kusema kwamba dhahabu iliyokuwa hekaluni ilikuwa muhimu zaidi kuliko hekalu (yenyewe). Na kwamba zawadi ambayo mtu alileta ilikuwa muhimu zaidi kuliko madhabahu walipoapa (16-22).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?-100778781
trans-unit.source: 4. Jesus warned them that they put too much emphasis/more importance on tithing on everything that they owned. They included very small items such as mint, dill and cumin, while they ignored the more important requirements of the law such as justice, mercy and faithfulness. (23-24)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya kwamba waliweka mkazo mkubwa sana/uhitaji mkubwa zaidi juu ya kutoa zaka kwa kila kitu walichokuwa nacho. Walijumuisha vitu vidogo sana kama vile mint, dill na cumin, wakati walipuuza mahitaji muhimu zaidi ya sheria kama vile haki, rehema na uaminifu. (23-24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?127516224
trans-unit.source: 5. Jesus warned them that they did deeds to make others/people think that they were good/righteous, but inside their hearts/thoughts they were full of extortion/force/violence and self-indulgence/self-centeredness. (25-26)
trans-unit.target: 5. Yesu aliwaonya kwamba walifanya matendo ili kuwafanya wengine/watu wafikiri kwamba walikuwa wema/waadilifu, lakini ndani ya mioyo yao/mawazo yao walikuwa wamejaa unyang'anyi/nguvu/jeuri na kujifurahisha/kujitanguliza. (25-26)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?1933658169
trans-unit.source: 6. Jesus warned them that from/on the outside they appeared to be righteous/good to people, but on the inside/in their hearts/minds they were full of hypocrisy and wickedness. (27-28)
trans-unit.target: 6. Yesu aliwaonya kwamba kwa nje walionekana kuwa wenye haki/wema kwa watu, lakini ndani ya mioyo yao/akili zao walikuwa wamejaa unafiki na uovu (27-28)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?-1763751929
trans-unit.source: 7. Jesus warned them that to cover up their evil and to make others/people think that they were good/righteous, they built monuments to mark the graves of/for the/God's prophets/spokesmen whom their ancestors killed long ago. They even decorated the graves/monuments of the righteous to honor them. They said that, if they had lived during the time of their ancestors, they would not have killed the prophets. But Jesus told them that, since they had tried so hard to cover up their evil intentions, they were just like their ancestors who had killed the prophets. He told them to go ahead and finish what their ancestors had started. (29-32)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaonya kwamba ili kuficha uovu wao na kuwafanya wengine/watu wafikiri kuwa wao ni wema/waadilifu, walijenga makaburi ya/kwa/nabii/wasemaji wa Mungu ambao mababu zao waliwaua zamani. Hata walipamba makaburi/makaburi ya waadilifu kuwaheshimu. Walisema kwamba, kama wangekuwa wameishi wakati wa mababu zao, wasingekuwa wamewaua manabii. Lakini Yesu aliwaambia kwamba, kwa kuwa walijaribu sana kuficha nia zao mbaya, walikuwa kama mababu zao ambao waliwaua manabii. Aliwaambia waendelee na kumaliza kile ambacho mababu zao walikuwa wameanza. (29-32)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~13#Answer:What were the seven warnings that Jesus gave to the teachers of the law and to the Pharisees?

group.id: Q:MAT 23.34+What did Jesus tell the teachers of the law and the Pharisees he was going to do?

trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wangewafanya nini manabii, watu wenye hekima na walimu hao?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!23~34#Alternate:What did Jesus say that the teachers of the law and the Pharisees would do to those/these prophets, wise men and teachers?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!23~34#Answer:What did Jesus say that the teachers of the law and the Pharisees would do to those/these prophets, wise men and teachers?788511018
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that they would kill and crucify some of them. They would flog some of them and they would pursue/chase others from town to town [in order to kill them]. (34)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba baadhi yao watawaua na kuwasulubisha, wengine watawapiga mijeledi, na wengine watawafuatia kutoka mji hadi mji [ili kuwaua].

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: An altar is a kind of table or platform where sacrifices of animals or other offerings are made to God. Several different kinds of altars are mentioned in the New Testament.
trans-unit.target: Uhakiki wa neno muhimu: Madhabahu ni aina ya meza au jukwaa ambapo dhabihu za wanyama au matoleo mengine hufanywa kwa Mungu. Aina kadhaa tofauti za madhabahu zinatajwa katika Agano Jipya.
