group.id: Q:MAT 24.14+What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~14#Question:What do you think the gospel is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think the gospel is?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri injili ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~14#Question:What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~14#Answer:What do you think the gospel is?2112068392
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The word "gospel" is a translation of the Greek noun euangelion. In the New Testament the noun euangelion is used in a restricted sense. It does not mean just any kind of good news, but specifically the good news or joyful report that God has made a way of salvation for sinful human beings. In the New Testament it is used always with this one sense and is usually translated in the RSV and most modern English versions as "gospel".
trans-unit.target: Neno "injili" ni tafsiri ya neno la Kigiriki euangelion. Katika Agano Jipya neno euangelion linatumiwa kwa maana ndogo. Haimaanishi aina yoyote ya habari njema, lakini haswa habari njema au ripoti ya furaha kwamba Mungu amefanya njia ya wokovu kwa wanadamu wenye dhambi. Katika Agano Jipya hutumiwa kila wakati na maana hii moja na kawaida hutafsiriwa katika RSV na matoleo mengi ya kisasa ya Kiingereza kama "injili".
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~14#Answer:What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!24~14#Note:What do you think the gospel is?-1635459669
trans-unit.source: See "gospel" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "gospel" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~14#Note:What do you think the gospel is?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.30+Then what will happen?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~30#Question:Then what will happen?
trans-unit.source: Then what will happen?
trans-unit.target: Kisha ni nini kitakachotokea?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~30#Question:Then what will happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~30#Answer:Then what will happen?-863942267
trans-unit.source: Jesus said the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky and all the people on the earth will mourn/cry out in fear.
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema ishara ya Mwana wa Adamu itaonekana mbinguni na watu wote duniani wataomboleza / kulia kwa hofu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~30#Answer:Then what will happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~30#Answer:Then what will happen?-1768666829
trans-unit.source: The people on the earth will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky.
trans-unit.target: Watu duniani watamwona Mwana wa binadamu akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~30#Answer:Then what will happen?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~30#Answer:Then what will happen?-1950115079
trans-unit.source: The people on the earth will see the power and the great glory that the Son of Man has [from God]. (30)
trans-unit.target: Watu duniani wataona nguvu na utukufu mkubwa ambao Mwana wa Adamu ana [kutoka kwa Mungu]. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~30#Answer:Then what will happen?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.31+What will the Son of Man send his angels out to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~31#Question:What will the Son of Man send his angels out to do?
trans-unit.source: What will the Son of Man send his angels out to do?
trans-unit.target: Mwana wa Adamu atawatuma malaika zake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~31#Question:What will the Son of Man send his angels out to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man send his angels out to do?-553568997
trans-unit.source: The Son of Man will send his angels out to gather/bring together all those people from all over the earth whom he has chosen to be his people. (31)
trans-unit.target: Mwana wa Adamu atawatuma malaika zake, nao watawakusanya wateule wake toka pepo zote za dunia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man send his angels out to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.32-33+What lesson did Jesus want his disciples to learn from the fig tree?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~32#Question:What lesson did Jesus want his disciples to learn from the fig tree?
trans-unit.source: What lesson did Jesus want his disciples to learn from the fig tree?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alitaka wanafunzi wake wajifunze somo gani kutokana na mtini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~32#Question:What lesson did Jesus want his disciples to learn from the fig tree?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~32#Answer:What lesson did Jesus want his disciples to learn from the fig tree?-1717501414
trans-unit.source: He told them that they know that summer is near when the twigs of the fig tree become tender and the leaves come out. In the same way they will know that the time, when this age/world will end, is near when they see all the things happening about which he has told them. (32-33)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba mkiona matawi ya mtini yameiva na majani yamechipuka, mnajua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia; vivyo hivyo mkiona mambo yote haya, mtajua ya kuwa mwisho wa dunia hii umekaribia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~32#Answer:What lesson did Jesus want his disciples to learn from the fig tree?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.43+To what did Jesus compare his return to the world?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~43#Question:To what did Jesus compare his return to the world?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare his return to the world?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha kurudi kwake ulimwenguni na nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~43#Answer:To what did Jesus compare his return to the world?350141339
trans-unit.source: He compared his return to the world to a thief coming to break into a house. (43)
trans-unit.target: Alilinganisha kurudi kwake ulimwenguni na mwizi kuja kuvunja nyumba.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~43#Answer:To what did Jesus compare his return to the world?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.43+What would the owner of the house have done if he had known when the thief was coming?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~43#Question:What would the owner of the house have done if he had known when the thief was coming?
trans-unit.source: What would the owner of the house have done if he had known when the thief was coming?
trans-unit.target: Mwenye nyumba angefanya nini ikiwa angejua mwizi atakuja wakati gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~43#Question:What would the owner of the house have done if he had known when the thief was coming?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~43#Answer:What would the owner of the house have done if he had known when the thief was coming?2139699973
trans-unit.source: He would have kept watch/been prepared and would not have allowed/permitted the thief to break into his house. (43)
trans-unit.target: Angekuwa amekaa macho/alikuwa amejitayarisha na asingemruhusu/kumruhusu mwizi kuingia nyumbani mwake. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~43#Answer:What would the owner of the house have done if he had known when the thief was coming?

trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!24~44#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return?-1642981802

trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yesu kuwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba lazima wawe tayari kwa ajili ya kurudi kwake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~44#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!24~44#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return?-1414066949

trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~44#Alternate:What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return?

trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return because they did not know when he will return. (44)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi kwamba lazima wawe tayari kwa kurudi kwake kwa sababu hawakujua atarudi lini. (44)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~44#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples that they must be ready/prepared for his return?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.45+What does a faithful and wise servant do for his master who has put him in charge of his servants?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~45#Question:What does a faithful and wise servant do for his master who has put him in charge of his servants?
trans-unit.source: What does a faithful and wise servant do for his master who has put him in charge of his servants?
trans-unit.target: Mtumwa mwaminifu na mwenye busara humfanyia nini bwana - bwana wake ambaye amemweka juu ya watumishi wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~45#Question:What does a faithful and wise servant do for his master who has put him in charge of his servants?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~45#Answer:What does a faithful and wise servant do for his master who has put him in charge of his servants?-2038432675
trans-unit.source: A faithful and wise servant gives the other servants their food at the proper/right time. (45)
trans-unit.target: Mtumwa mwaminifu mwenye akili huwapa watumishi wengine chakula chao kwa wakati ufaao/wafaao.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~45#Answer:What does a faithful and wise servant do for his master who has put him in charge of his servants?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.47+What will the master do for the faithful servant when he returns?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~47#Question:What will the master do for the faithful servant when he returns?
trans-unit.source: What will the master do for the faithful servant when he returns?
trans-unit.target: Bwana-mkubwa atamfanyia mtumwa mwaminifu nini atakaporudi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~47#Question:What will the master do for the faithful servant when he returns?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~47#Answer:What will the master do for the faithful servant when he returns?-798372969
trans-unit.source: The master will entrust the faithful servant with all of his possessions/property. (47)
trans-unit.target: Bwana atamkabidhi mtumwa mwaminifu mali zake zote.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~47#Answer:What will the master do for the faithful servant when he returns?

group.id: Q:MAT 24.48-51+What will the master do to his servant, whom he has put in charge of his servants, if that servant has been wicked and has beaten his fellow servants? And if he has eaten and has drunk with people who are drunkards?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!24~48#Question:What will the master do to his servant, whom he has put in charge of his servants, if that servant has been wicked and has beaten his fellow servants? And if he has eaten and has drunk with people who are drunkards?
trans-unit.source: What will the master do to his servant, whom he has put in charge of his servants, if that servant has been wicked and has beaten his fellow servants? And if he has eaten and has drunk with people who are drunkards?
trans-unit.target: Bwana wake atamfanyia nini mtumishi ambaye amemweka juu ya watumishi wake, ikiwa mtumishi huyo ni mbaya na anaanza kuwapiga watumishi wenzake, na kula na kunywa na walevi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~48#Question:What will the master do to his servant, whom he has put in charge of his servants, if that servant has been wicked and has beaten his fellow servants? And if he has eaten and has drunk with people who are drunkards?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!24~48#Answer:What will the master do to his servant, whom he has put in charge of his servants, if that servant has been wicked and has beaten his fellow servants? And if he has eaten and has drunk with people who are drunkards?847685902
trans-unit.source: The master will punish that servant. He will put him in a place with the other people, who only pretended to obey him. In that place [they will be punished so badly that] they will cry bitterly and gnash/grit their teeth [in pain]. (48-51)
trans-unit.target: Bwana wake atamwadhibu mtumwa huyo, na kumweka mahali pamoja na watu wengine, ambao walifanya tu kumtii, huko [watapata adhabu mbaya sana hivi kwamba] kutakuwa na kilio cha uchungu na kusaga meno [kwa uchungu].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!24~48#Answer:What will the master do to his servant, whom he has put in charge of his servants, if that servant has been wicked and has beaten his fellow servants? And if he has eaten and has drunk with people who are drunkards?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.1-13+What did Jesus say about the ten virgins?

trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say about the ten virgins?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema nini kuhusu mabikira kumi?

trans-unit.source: Jesus said that five of them were wise and that five of them were foolish. (2)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watano kati yao walikuwa wenye busara na watano walikuwa wapumbavu. (2)

group.id: Q:MAT 25.3+What is the reason that Jesus said five of the virgins were foolish?

trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus said five of the virgins were foolish?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yesu kusema kwamba watano wa mabikira walikuwa wapumbavu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~3#Question:What is the reason that Jesus said five of the virgins were foolish?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~3#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus said five of the virgins were foolish?-1734261764
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that five of the virgins were foolish because they did not take any oil with their lamps. (3)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watano kati ya wale mabikira walikuwa wapumbavu kwa sababu hawakuchukua mafuta pamoja na taa zao. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~3#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus said five of the virgins were foolish?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.4+What is the reason that Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~4#Question:What is the reason that Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yesu kusema kwamba watano wa mabikira walikuwa wenye busara?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~4#Question:What is the reason that Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~4#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise?170382257
trans-unit.source: Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise because they took oil in jars along with their lamps. (4)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema kwamba watano kati ya wale mabikira walikuwa wenye busara kwa sababu walikuwa na mafuta katika vyombo pamoja na taa zao. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~4#Answer:What is the reason that Jesus said that five of the virgins were wise?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.6-8+What did the foolish virgins want from the wise virgins when the bridegroom was about to arrive?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~6#Question:What did the foolish virgins want from the wise virgins when the bridegroom was about to arrive?
trans-unit.source: What did the foolish virgins want from the wise virgins when the bridegroom was about to arrive?
trans-unit.target: Mabikira wapumbavu waliwaambia mabikira wenye busara wafanye nini bwana-arusi alipokuwa karibu kufika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~6#Question:What did the foolish virgins want from the wise virgins when the bridegroom was about to arrive?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~6#Answer:What did the foolish virgins want from the wise virgins when the bridegroom was about to arrive?-176742583
trans-unit.source: The foolish virgins wanted the wise virgins to give them some of their oil because the flame of each of their lamps was about to go out. (6-8)
trans-unit.target: Mabikira wapumbavu waliomba mabikira wenye busara wawape baadhi ya mafuta yao kwa sababu moto wa kila mmoja wao ulikuwa karibu kuzimika (6-8)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~6#Answer:What did the foolish virgins want from the wise virgins when the bridegroom was about to arrive?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.9+What did the wise virgins tell the foolish virgins to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~9#Question:What did the wise virgins tell the foolish virgins to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the wise virgins tell the foolish virgins to do?
trans-unit.target: Mabikira wenye busara waliwaambia mabikira wapumbavu wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~9#Question:What did the wise virgins tell the foolish virgins to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~9#Answer:What did the wise virgins tell the foolish virgins to do?-1668634036
trans-unit.source: The wise virgins told the foolish virgins that they would not give them any of their oil since they might not have enough oil for all of them. The wise virgins told the foolish virgins to go and buy some oil for their lamps. (9)
trans-unit.target: Mabikira wenye busara waliwaambia mabikira wapumbavu kwamba hawangetoa mafuta yao kwa sababu huenda wasingewapa mafuta ya kutosha wote.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~9#Answer:What did the wise virgins tell the foolish virgins to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.10+What happened while the foolish virgins were on their way to buy oil?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~10#Question:What happened while the foolish virgins were on their way to buy oil?
trans-unit.source: What happened while the foolish virgins were on their way to buy oil?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia mabikira wapumbavu walipokuwa wakienda kununua mafuta?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~10#Question:What happened while the foolish virgins were on their way to buy oil?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~10#Answer:What happened while the foolish virgins were on their way to buy oil?-261299123
trans-unit.source: The bridegroom arrived and the five wise virgins went in with him to the wedding banquet. Then [the servants] closed the door. (10)
trans-unit.target: Bwana-arusi akaja, na wale mabikira watano wenye busara wakaingia pamoja naye kwenye karamu ya arusi. Ndipo [watumishi] wakafunga mlango.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~10#Answer:What happened while the foolish virgins were on their way to buy oil?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.11-12+What did the bridegroom say to the foolish virgins when they arrived at the wedding banquet later and asked him to open the door?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~11#Question:What did the bridegroom say to the foolish virgins when they arrived at the wedding banquet later and asked him to open the door?
trans-unit.source: What did the bridegroom say to the foolish virgins when they arrived at the wedding banquet later and asked him to open the door?
trans-unit.target: Bwana-arusi aliwaambia nini wale mabikira wapumbavu walipofika kwenye karamu ya arusi baadaye na kumwomba afungue mlango?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~11#Question:What did the bridegroom say to the foolish virgins when they arrived at the wedding banquet later and asked him to open the door?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~11#Answer:What did the bridegroom say to the foolish virgins when they arrived at the wedding banquet later and asked him to open the door?770919752
trans-unit.source: The bridegroom told them that he did not know them [therefore/so he would not allow/permit them to come inside to the banquet]. (11-12)
trans-unit.target: Bwana harusi aliwaambia kuwa hakuwajua [kwa hivyo / kwa hivyo hakuwaacha / kuwaruhusu kuingia kwenye karamu]. (11-12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~11#Answer:What did the bridegroom say to the foolish virgins when they arrived at the wedding banquet later and asked him to open the door?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!25~14#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 25:14-30 Jesus told a parable about a master who entrusted money to his three servants.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 25:14-30 Yesu alisimulia mfano wa bwana-mkubwa aliyewakabidhi watumwa wake watatu pesa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~14#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 25.14-30+To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~14#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven in these verses?
trans-unit.source: To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alilinganisha ufalme wa mbinguni na nini katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~14#Question:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~14#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven in these verses?-542531035
trans-unit.source: Jesus compared the kingdom of heaven to a man who, when he went on a journey, entrusted [some of] his property/money to his servants. (14)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alifananisha ufalme wa mbinguni na mtu ambaye, alipokuwa akisafiri, aliwapa watumishi wake mali yake/pesa zake. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~14#Answer:To what did Jesus compare the kingdom of heaven in these verses?

trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo/bwana alimpa kila mmoja wa watumishi wake watatu nini?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~15#Answer:What did the man/master entrust to each of his three servants?-654698696
trans-unit.source: The man gave five talents/bags of money to one servant. He gave two talents/bags of money to another servant. He gave one talent/bag of money to another servant. (15)
trans-unit.target: Mtu huyo alimpa mtumishi mmoja talanta tano/mfuko wa fedha. Akampa mtumishi mwingine talanta mbili/mfuko wa fedha. Akampa mtumishi mwingine talanta moja/mfuko wa fedha. (15)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~19#Answer:What did the master of the three servants do when he returned?-9813903
trans-unit.source: The master of the three servants met with each one of them to determine/find out how much they had earned with his money. (19)
trans-unit.target: Bwana wa wale watumishi watatu alikutana na kila mmoja wao ili kujua kiasi walichopata kutokana na pesa zake. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~19#Answer:What did the master of the three servants do when he returned?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.20-21+How did the master reward the servant who had earned five more bags of money?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~20#Question:How did the master reward the servant who had earned five more bags of money?
trans-unit.source: How did the master reward the servant who had earned five more bags of money?
trans-unit.target: Bwana-mkubwa alimthawabishaje mtumwa aliyekuwa amechuma mifuko mitano zaidi ya fedha?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~20#Question:How did the master reward the servant who had earned five more bags of money?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~20#Answer:How did the master reward the servant who had earned five more bags of money?1158254772
trans-unit.source: The master rewarded him by telling him that he would promote him to a higher position/put him in charge of many matters/promote him to more important responsibilities. (20-21)
trans-unit.target: Bwana-mkubwa alimthawabisha kwa kumwambia kwamba angempandisha cheo/kumweka asimamie mambo mengi/kumpandisha cheo kwenye madaraka muhimu zaidi. (20-21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~20#Answer:How did the master reward the servant who had earned five more bags of money?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~22#Answer:How did the master reward the servant who had earned two more bags of money?292109504

trans-unit.source: What did the master do to the servant who hid the one bag of money in the ground and returned it to his master?
trans-unit.target: Bwana-mkubwa alimtendeaje mtumwa aliyeficha mfuko mmoja wa fedha ardhini na kumrudishia bwana-mkubwa wake?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~28#Alternate:What did the master do to the servant who hid the one talent/bag of money in the ground and returned it to his master?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~28#Answer:What did the master do to the servant who hid the one talent/bag of money in the ground and returned it to his master?919025007
trans-unit.source: The master [told other servants] to take the one talent/bag of money away from that servant and give it to the servant who had ten talents/bags of money. (28)
trans-unit.target: Bwana [aliwaambia watumishi wengine] wamchukue talanta moja/mfuko wa fedha kutoka kwa mtumwa huyo na kumpa mtumwa aliyekuwa na talanta kumi/mfuko wa fedha. (28)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~28#Answer:What did the master do to the servant who hid the one talent/bag of money in the ground and returned it to his master?-274548763
trans-unit.source: Then the master [told other servants] to throw that servant outside into the darkness (away from him), where [he would be punished, so that] he would cry bitterly and gnash/grit his teeth [in pain]. (30)
trans-unit.target: Kisha bwana [akawaambia watumishi wengine] mtupeni mtumwa huyo nje katika giza (aliko mbali naye), [kwa hiyo] atalia kwa uchungu na kusaga meno [kwa maumivu].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~28#Answer:What did the master do to the servant who hid the one talent/bag of money in the ground and returned it to his master?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!25~31#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 25:31-46 When Jesus comes back to this world he will judge everyone and separate those, who are righteous/good in God's sight, from those who are not righteous.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 25:31-46 Yesu atakaporudi katika ulimwengu huu atawahukumu wote na kuwatenganisha wale, ambao ni waadilifu/wema machoni pa Mungu, na wale ambao si waadilifu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~31#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 25.31-46+What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~31#Question:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?
trans-unit.source: What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?
trans-unit.target: Mwana wa binadamu atafanya nini atakaporudi duniani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~31#Question:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?-1736941420
trans-unit.source: He will sit on his throne in heavenly glory. (31)
trans-unit.target: Ataketi katika kiti chake cha enzi katika utukufu wa mbinguni. (31)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?1036662499
trans-unit.source: When all the nations/people are gathered [by his angels] to stand in front of him he will separate the people. He will separate them as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats. (32)
trans-unit.target: Na mataifa yote yatakapo kusanywa mbele zake, ndipo atakapotenganisha watu, kama vile mchungaji atenganishavyo kondoo na mbuzi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?2026075868
trans-unit.source: He will put/send the sheep/the righteous people on/to his right and the goats/the wicked people on/to his left. (33)
trans-unit.target: Naye atawaweka kondoo/waadilifu kwenye/kuume kwake na mbuzi/waovu kwenye/kushoto kwake. (33)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~31#Answer:What will the Son of Man do when he returns to the earth?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.37-39+What will the righteous people ask the Lord?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~37#Question:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?
trans-unit.source: What will the righteous people ask the Lord?
trans-unit.target: Watu wenye haki watamwomba nini Bwana?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~37#Question:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~37#Answer:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?-1253907735
trans-unit.source: They will ask him, "When did we see you hungry and fed you? When did we see you thirsty and we gave you something to drink?" (37)
trans-unit.target: Watasema: Ni lini tulikuona una njaa tukakulisha, au una kiu tukakunywesha?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~37#Answer:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~37#Answer:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?-1770073566
trans-unit.source: They will ask him, "When did we see you as a stranger and we invited you in [to our homes]; or saw you needing clothes, and we gave you clothes?" (38)
trans-unit.target: Watasema: Ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgeni tukakukaribisha, au ukiwa uchi tukakuvika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~37#Answer:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~37#Answer:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?32793319
trans-unit.source: They will ask him, "When did we see you sick or in prison, and we went to visit you?" (39)
trans-unit.target: Watasema: Ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgonjwa au mfungwa nasi tukakujia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~37#Answer:What will the righteous people ask the Lord?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.40+What will the King answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~40#Question:What will the King answer them?
trans-unit.source: What will the King answer them?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme atawajibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~40#Question:What will the King answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~40#Answer:What will the King answer them?1373947183
trans-unit.source: He will answer them that whenever they did any of those good deeds for the least [important] of those people who belong to him, they also were doing/did those good deeds for him. (40)
trans-unit.target: Atawaambia: Walipo mfanyia wema mmoja katika watu wake, basi wamemfanyia wema yeye.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~40#Answer:What will the King answer them?

trans-unit.target: Mwana wa Adamu atawaambia nini wale watu aliowatuma kwa mkono wake wa kushoto?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.42-43+What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~42#Question:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini Mfalme atawaambia hivyo wale walio upande wake wa kushoto?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~42#Question:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?-1808290844
trans-unit.source: The King will say that to those people on his left because:
trans-unit.target: Mfalme atawaambia watu walio upande wake wa kushoto kwa sababu:
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?169587128
trans-unit.source: When he was hungry and thirsty, they did not give him anything to eat and drink. (42)
trans-unit.target: Alipokuwa na njaa na kiu, hawakumpa chakula wala maji.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?395999159
trans-unit.source: When he was a stranger, they did not invite him in [to their homes].
trans-unit.target: Alipokuwa mgeni, hawakumkaribisha [nyumbani mwao].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?1512749127
trans-unit.source: When he needed clothes, they did not give him any clothes.
trans-unit.target: Alipokuwa na uhitaji wa mavazi, hawakumpa mavazi yoyote.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?1791539768
trans-unit.source: When he was sick and in prison, they did not care for/visit/look after him. (43)
trans-unit.target: Alipokuwa mgonjwa na gerezani, hawakumjali/kumtembelea/kumtunza. (43)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~42#Answer:What is the reason that the King will say that to those people on his left?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.44+What will those people ask the King?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~44#Question:What will those people ask the King?
trans-unit.source: What will those people ask the King?
trans-unit.target: Watu hao watamwuliza Mfalme swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~44#Question:What will those people ask the King?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~44#Answer:What will those people ask the King?1940509020
trans-unit.source: They will ask him, "When did we see you hungry or thirsty, or a stranger, or needing clothes, or sick, or in prison and we did not help you?" (44)
trans-unit.target: Watasema: Ni lini tulikuona una njaa, au una kiu, au ukiwa mgeni, au u uchi, au ukiwa mgonjwa, au ukiwa kifungoni, nasi hatukuja kukuhudumia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~44#Answer:What will those people ask the King?

group.id: Q:MAT 25.45+What will the King answer them?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!25~45#Question:What will the King answer them?
trans-unit.source: What will the King answer them?
trans-unit.target: Mfalme atawajibu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~45#Question:What will the King answer them?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!25~45#Answer:What will the King answer them?1167785466
trans-unit.source: He will answer, "What you did not do for those who were the least [important] people, you did not do it for me." (45)
trans-unit.target: Atasema: Mlikosa kuwafanyia hawa wakubwa wangu, basi mlikosa kunitendea mimi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!25~45#Answer:What will the King answer them?

trans-unit.source: Matthew 26:1-5 The religious leaders plotted privately/secretly to kill Jesus.

group.id: Q:MAT 26.1-5+What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders assembled in the palace of Caiaphas, the high priest?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~1#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders assembled in the palace of Caiaphas, the high priest?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders assembled in the palace of Caiaphas, the high priest?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini wakuu wa makuhani na wazee walikusanyika katika jumba la Kayafa, kuhani wa cheo cha juu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders assembled in the palace of Caiaphas, the high priest?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~1#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders assembled in the palace of Caiaphas, the high priest?-333607129
trans-unit.source: They assembled there to plot how they would arrest Jesus and kill him. (3-4)
trans-unit.target: Wakakusanyika huko ili kupanga jinsi watakavyomkamata Yesu na kumwua (3-4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders assembled in the palace of Caiaphas, the high priest?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.1-5+What do you know about the high priest?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~1#Question:What do you know about the high priest?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about the high priest?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu kuhani mkuu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Question:What do you know about the high priest?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~1#Answer:What do you know about the high priest?-683415735
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He was the one supreme priest, that is, the chief of all the priests, who was chosen for a special function.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu Kuchunguza: Yeye ndiye aliyekuwa kuhani mkuu, yaani, mkuu wa makuhani wote, aliyechaguliwa kwa ajili ya kazi ya pekee.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Answer:What do you know about the high priest?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!26~1#Note:What do you know about the high priest?-939856612
trans-unit.source: See "high priest" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "kuhani mkuu" katika Kiswahili cha Kiingereza.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Note:What do you know about the high priest?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.1-2+What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~1#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to the Son of Man?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to the Son of Man?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba ni nini kingeenda kumpata Mwana wa binadamu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Question:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to the Son of Man?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to the Son of Man?883142080
trans-unit.source: He told them that in two days the Passover feast would begin. He told them that it was during that time that [someone] would hand the Son of Man over [to his enemies] to be crucified. (1-2)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba baada ya siku mbili sikukuu ya Pasaka ingeanza. Aliwaambia kwamba wakati huo ndipo [mtu fulani] atakapomtoa Mwana wa Adamu [kwa adui zake] ili asulubiwe. (1-2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~1#Answer:What did Jesus tell his disciples was going to happen to the Son of Man?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.5+What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~5#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani wakuu wa makuhani na wazee waliamua kutomkamata Yesu wakati wa sikukuu ya Kupitwa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~5#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~5#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast?-1520185378
trans-unit.source: They decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast because, if they arrested him at that time, they thought the people might riot. (5)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua wasimkamate Yesu wakati wa sikukuu ya Pasaka, kwa sababu waliogopa kwamba ikiwa wangemkamata wakati huo watu wangefanya ghasia. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~5#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders decided not to arrest Jesus during the Passover feast?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!26~6#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 26:6-13 A woman took perfume and poured it on Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 26:6-13 Mwanamke mmoja alichukua manukato na kumimina juu ya Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~6#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 26.6-13+What did a woman do with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~6#Question:What did a woman do with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume?
trans-unit.source: What did a woman do with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume?
trans-unit.target: Mwanamke mmoja alifanya nini na chupa ya alabasta yenye marashi ya bei ghali?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~6#Question:What did a woman do with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~6#Answer:What did a woman do with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume?-185646739
trans-unit.source: She poured the perfume on Jesus's head while he was reclining/eating at the table. (7)
trans-unit.target: Alimimina mafuta hayo yenye marashi juu ya kichwa cha Yesu alipokuwa ameketi/alipokuwa akila. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~6#Answer:What did a woman do with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.6+Where was Jesus staying?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~6#Question:Where was Jesus staying?
trans-unit.source: Where was Jesus staying?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akikaa wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~6#Question:Where was Jesus staying?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~6#Answer:Where was Jesus staying?1579219411
trans-unit.source: He was staying in Bethany at the house of Simon the Leper. (Simon used to be a leper.) (6)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alikuwa akikaa Bethania katika nyumba ya Simoni mwenye ukoma (ambaye alikuwa ameugua ukoma). (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~6#Answer:Where was Jesus staying?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.8-9+What is the reason that the disciples were upset at the woman for pouring the perfume on Jesus's head?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~8#Question:What is the reason that the disciples were upset at the woman for pouring the perfume on Jesus's head?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the disciples were upset at the woman for pouring the perfume on Jesus's head?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wanafunzi walikasirika kwa sababu ya mwanamke kumwaga marashi kwenye kichwa cha Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~8#Question:What is the reason that the disciples were upset at the woman for pouring the perfume on Jesus's head?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~8#Answer:What is the reason that the disciples were upset at the woman for pouring the perfume on Jesus's head?-65879937
trans-unit.source: They were upset because they said that the perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money could have been given to the poor people. (8-9)
trans-unit.target: Yangaliweza kuuzwa kwa bei kubwa, wakapewa maskini.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~8#Answer:What is the reason that the disciples were upset at the woman for pouring the perfume on Jesus's head?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.10-13+What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~10#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~10#Question:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?-170671581
trans-unit.source: Jesus told them to stop criticizing the woman since she had done a wonderful thing to him. (10)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia waache kumshutumu mwanamke huyo kwa kuwa alikuwa amemfanyia jambo la ajabu. (10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?-1484951583
trans-unit.source: He told them that they would always have poor people with them, but that they would not always have him. (11)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba sikuzote mlikuwa na maskini pamoja nanyi, lakini hamtakuwa naye sikuzote. (11)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?1304728823
trans-unit.source: He told them that when the woman poured the perfume on him she was preparing his body/him for burial. (12)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba wakati mwanamke huyo alipomimina manukato juu yake alikuwa akiutayarisha mwili wake kwa ajili ya mazishi. (12)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?501727119
trans-unit.source: He told them that wherever people preach the gospel in the world they will also tell what this woman has done in memory of her. (13)
trans-unit.target: Akawaambia kwamba popote watu watahubiri injili ulimwenguni wataeleza pia kile mwanamke huyu amefanya kwa kumbukumbu lake. (13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~10#Answer:What did Jesus say to the disciples?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.14-16+About what plans of Judas did the author write in these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~14#Question:About what plans of Judas did the author write in these verses?
trans-unit.source: About what plans of Judas did the author write in these verses?
trans-unit.target: Ni mipango gani ya Yuda ambayo mwandikaji aliandika katika mistari hii?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~14#Question:About what plans of Judas did the author write in these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~14#Answer:About what plans of Judas did the author write in these verses?-1453026546
trans-unit.source: The author wrote about the decision Judas made to betray Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Mwandishi wa kitabu hicho aliandika kuhusu uamuzi wa Yuda wa kumsaliti Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~14#Answer:About what plans of Judas did the author write in these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.14-15+What did Judas ask the chief priests?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~14#Question:What did Judas ask the chief priests?
trans-unit.source: What did Judas ask the chief priests?
trans-unit.target: Yuda aliwauliza nini wakuu wa makuhani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~14#Question:What did Judas ask the chief priests?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~14#Answer:What did Judas ask the chief priests?-944851043
trans-unit.source: He asked them how much money they would give to him if he betrayed Jesus to them/turned Jesus over to them. (14-15)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza wangempa pesa ngapi ikiwa angewatia Yesu mikononi mwao. (14-15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~14#Answer:What did Judas ask the chief priests?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.15+How much money did the chief priests give to Judas?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~15#Question:How much money did the chief priests give to Judas?
trans-unit.source: How much money did the chief priests give to Judas?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu walimpa Yuda fedha ngapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~15#Question:How much money did the chief priests give to Judas?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~15#Answer:How much money did the chief priests give to Judas?-1816241788

group.id: Q:MAT 26.28+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~28#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.target: Agano ni nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~28#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~28#Answer:What is a covenant?392048828
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is an agreement, a binding promise, usually made by two people who are of equal status. If the person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Today it would be called a contract. But the Greek word that is used in the Bible for covenants strongly implies that the terms of the agreement were stated by the person on only one side of the discussion, not both sides. Usually God is the one who states/decides/says what will happen, that is, what he will do and what people must do. He binds himself to the other party.
trans-unit.target: Mkataba wa mkataba: Mkataba wa mkataba ni makubaliano, ahadi ya kisheria, ambayo kwa kawaida hufanywa na watu wawili ambao wana hadhi sawa. Ikiwa mtu aliye upande mmoja wa agano hafanyi kama vile wote wawili wamekubaliana, kwa kawaida kuna adhabu kali kwake au analipa fidia kwa mtu mwingine. Leo ingekuwa inaitwa mkataba. Lakini neno la Kigiriki ambalo linatumiwa katika Biblia kwa maagano linaonyesha kwa nguvu kwamba masharti ya makubaliano yalitolewa na mtu aliye upande mmoja tu wa majadiliano, sio pande zote mbili. Kawaida Mungu ndiye anayesema / kuamua / kusema nini kitatokea, yaani, nini atafanya na nini watu lazima wafanye. Anajifunga mwenyewe kwa upande mwingine.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~28#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!26~28#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Ona "agano" katika Kiswahili cha kawaida.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~28#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.target: Akarudi kwa wale wanafunzi watatu na kuwapata wamelala tena.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~43#Answer:What did Jesus do after he had prayed for a while?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.44+Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~44#Question:Then what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~44#Question:Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~44#Answer:Then what did Jesus do?524904167
trans-unit.source: He went away and prayed again to his Father. (44)
trans-unit.target: Alikwenda tena na kusali kwa Baba yake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~44#Answer:Then what did Jesus do?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.45-46+Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~45#Question:Then what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Jesus do?
trans-unit.target: Basi Yesu alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~45#Question:Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~45#Answer:Then what did Jesus do?1386549880
trans-unit.source: He returned to the three disciples. He then told them that they needed to arise/wake up because he was about to be betrayed [by someone] into the hands of sinners/his enemies. (45-46)
trans-unit.target: Alirudi kwa wanafunzi watatu. Kisha akawaambia kwamba walihitaji kuamka/kuamka kwa sababu alikuwa karibu kusalitiwa [na mtu] mikononi mwa watenda dhambi/adui zake. (45-46)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~45#Answer:Then what did Jesus do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!26~47#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 26:47-56 The religious leaders sent people to arrest Jesus and Judas betrayed Jesus to his enemies.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 26:47-56 Viongozi wa kidini walituma watu wamkamate Yesu, naye Yuda akamsaliti Yesu kwa adui zake.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~47#Section Heading

trans-unit.source: A large crowd came with Judas. The chief priests and the elders of the people had sent them. // They had been sent by the chief priests and the elders of the people. They were armed with swords and clubs. (47)
trans-unit.target: Basi, Yuda akaenda pamoja na umati wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliotumwa na makuhani wakuu na wazee wa watu.

group.id: Q:MAT 26.56+What did the disciples of Jesus do after the men arrested Jesus?

trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi wa Yesu walifanya nini baada ya watu hao kumkamata Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~56#Question:What did the disciples of Jesus do after the men arrested Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~56#Answer:What did the disciples of Jesus do after the men arrested Jesus?1696380217
trans-unit.source: All of his disciples deserted him and ran away. (56)
trans-unit.target: Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha, wakakimbia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~56#Answer:What did the disciples of Jesus do after the men arrested Jesus?

trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~57#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?-1779477826
trans-unit.source: The author wrote, in these verses, that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin tried/decided to condemn Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Mwandishi aliandika, katika mistari hii, kwamba makuhani wakuu na Sanhedrini nzima walijaribu / waliamua kumhukumu Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~57#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.source: Where did the men, who had arrested Jesus, take him?
trans-unit.target: Wanaume waliomkamata Yesu walimpeleka wapi?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~57#Answer:Where did the men, who had arrested Jesus, take him?-1086930874
trans-unit.source: They took Jesus to [the palace of] Caiaphas, the high priest. (57)
trans-unit.target: Wakampeleka Yesu kwa Kayafa, kuhani mkuu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~57#Answer:Where did the men, who had arrested Jesus, take him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~57#Question:Who else had come to [the palace of] Caiaphas?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~57#Answer:Who else had come to [the palace of] Caiaphas?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.58+What did Peter do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~58#Question:What did Peter do?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter do?
trans-unit.target: Petro alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~58#Question:What did Peter do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~58#Answer:What did Peter do?1711467338
trans-unit.source: Peter followed Jesus at a distance up to the courtyard of the high priest. He sat down with the guards inside the courtyard to learn/find out what would happen to Jesus. (58)
trans-unit.target: Petro alimfuata Yesu kwa mbali mpaka kwenye ua wa kuhani mkuu. Akaketi pamoja na walinzi ndani ya ua ili kujua/kuona kitakachotokea kwa Yesu (58)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~58#Answer:What did Peter do?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.59+What is the reason that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~59#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wakuu wa makuhani na Sanhedrini nzima walikuwa wakitafuta ushahidi bandia dhidi ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~59#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~59#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus?-1270827227
trans-unit.source: They were looking for false evidence against Jesus/people who would lie about what Jesus had done so that they could have him killed. (59)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wakitafuta ushahidi wa uongo dhidi ya Yesu/watu ambao wangesema uongo kuhusu kile Yesu alikuwa amefanya ili waweze kumuua. (59)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~59#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.60+How much evidence could they find against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~60#Question:How much evidence could they find against Jesus?
trans-unit.source: How much evidence could they find against Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wangeweza kupata ushahidi mwingi kadiri gani dhidi ya Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~60#Question:How much evidence could they find against Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~60#Answer:How much evidence could they find against Jesus?-188273272
trans-unit.source: They could not find any evidence from false witnesses whose testimonies/accusations/stories agreed so that they could use those stories to have Jesus killed. (60)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuweza kupata ushahidi wowote kutoka kwa mashahidi wa uwongo ambao ushuhuda/mashtaka/hadithi zao zilipatana ili waweze kutumia hadithi hizo kumuua Yesu. (60)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~60#Answer:How much evidence could they find against Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.63+What did the high priest ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~63#Question:What did the high priest ask Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the high priest ask Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kuhani mkuu alimwuliza Yesu swali gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~63#Question:What did the high priest ask Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~63#Answer:What did the high priest ask Jesus?903137315
trans-unit.source: He asked Jesus if he was the Christ, the Son of God. (63)
trans-unit.target: Alimwuliza Yesu kama alikuwa Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu. (63)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~63#Answer:What did the high priest ask Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.64+What did Jesus answer the high priest?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~64#Question:What did Jesus answer the high priest?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus answer the high priest?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimjibu jinsi gani kuhani mkuu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~64#Question:What did Jesus answer the high priest?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~64#Answer:What did Jesus answer the high priest?-1000090701
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the high priest that what he said was true/it was true what he said. (64)
trans-unit.target: Yesu alimwambia kuhani mkuu kuwa alichosema ni kweli/ni kweli alichosema (64)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~64#Answer:What did Jesus answer the high priest?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.65+How did the high priest react to what Jesus said to him?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~65#Question:How did the high priest react to what Jesus said to him?
trans-unit.source: How did the high priest react to what Jesus said to him?
trans-unit.target: Kuhani mkuu aliitikiaje yale ambayo Yesu alimwambia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~65#Question:How did the high priest react to what Jesus said to him?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~65#Answer:How did the high priest react to what Jesus said to him?-1767149925
trans-unit.source: The high priest tore his clothes and said that Jesus was blaspheming [God]. (65)
trans-unit.target: Kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake na kusema kwamba Yesu alikuwa amekufuru [Mungu]. (65)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~65#Answer:How did the high priest react to what Jesus said to him?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.65+What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~65#Question:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?
trans-unit.source: What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri mtu hufanya nini anapomtukana Mungu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~65#Question:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~65#Answer:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?-44696921
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He claims to be equal with God in some way.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu: Anadai kwamba yeye ni sawa na Mungu kwa njia fulani.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~65#Answer:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!26~65#Note:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?866551347
trans-unit.source: -OR-
trans-unit.target: - AU -
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~65#Note:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!26~65#Note:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?1376902579
trans-unit.source: He speaks evil against God. He insults God and defames him and his character so that others will not honor nor respect him.
trans-unit.target: Yeye husema mabaya juu ya Mungu. Humtukana Mungu na kumshushia heshima yeye na tabia yake hivi kwamba wengine hawamheshimu wala kumheshimu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~65#Note:What do you think that a person does when he blasphemes God?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.66+What did the high priest ask the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~66#Question:What did the high priest ask the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin?
trans-unit.source: What did the high priest ask the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin?
trans-unit.target: Kuhani wa cheo cha juu aliwauliza nini wakuu wa makuhani na Sanhedrini nzima?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~66#Question:What did the high priest ask the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~66#Answer:What did the high priest ask the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin?-2094749850
trans-unit.source: He asked them what they thought about Jesus saying that he was the Son of God. (66)
trans-unit.target: Aliwauliza wanafikiri nini kuhusu Yesu kusema kwamba yeye ni Mwana wa Mungu (66).
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~66#Answer:What did the high priest ask the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.66+What did the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin answer the high priest?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~66#Question:What did the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin answer the high priest?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin answer the high priest?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na Sanhedrini nzima walijibu nini kwa kuhani wa cheo cha juu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~66#Question:What did the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin answer the high priest?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~66#Answer:What did the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin answer the high priest?-1765524601
trans-unit.source: They answered him that Jesus was [guilty of blaspheming] and so he was worthy of death/deserved to die. (66)
trans-unit.target: Wakamjibu kwamba Yesu alikuwa [na hatia ya kukufuru] na hivyo alistahili kufa/alipaswa kufa. (66)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~66#Answer:What did the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin answer the high priest?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.67-68+What did some members of the Sanhedrin do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~67#Question:What did some members of the Sanhedrin do to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did some members of the Sanhedrin do to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Washiriki fulani wa Sanhedrini walimtendea Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~67#Question:What did some members of the Sanhedrin do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~67#Answer:What did some members of the Sanhedrin do to Jesus?327211647
trans-unit.source: Some members of the Sanhedrin spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Other members of the Sanhedrin slapped him. They asked him [sarcastically], "Prophesy to us, Christ. Who hit you?" (67-68)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya wale waliokuwepo walimtemea mate usoni, wakampiga makofi, wengine wakampiga makofi, wakamwambia, "Tubashirie, Kristo, ni nani aliyekupiga!" (67-68)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~67#Answer:What did some members of the Sanhedrin do to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.69-70+What did Peter say to a servant girl when she came to him and said that he had been with Jesus?

trans-unit.source: What did Peter say to a servant girl when she came to him and said that he had been with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Petro alimwambia nini kijakazi alipomjia na kumwambia kwamba alikuwa pamoja na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~69#Question:What did Peter say to a servant girl when she came to him and said that he had been with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~69#Answer:What did Peter say to a servant girl when she came to him and said that he had been with Jesus?-1424096660
trans-unit.source: Peter told the servant girl, in front of all the people there, that he had not been with Jesus. (69-70)
trans-unit.target: Petro alimwambia kijakazi, mbele ya watu wote waliokuwako, kwamba hakuwa pamoja na Yesu (69-70)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~69#Answer:What did Peter say to a servant girl when she came to him and said that he had been with Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.71-72+What did Peter say to the people when another girl told the people that he had been with Jesus of Nazareth?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~71#Question:What did Peter say to the people when another girl told the people that he had been with Jesus of Nazareth?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter say to the people when another girl told the people that he had been with Jesus of Nazareth?
trans-unit.target: Petro aliwaambia watu nini msichana mwingine alipowaambia kwamba alikuwa pamoja na Yesu wa Nazareti?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~71#Question:What did Peter say to the people when another girl told the people that he had been with Jesus of Nazareth?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~71#Answer:What did Peter say to the people when another girl told the people that he had been with Jesus of Nazareth?67716297
trans-unit.source: Peter told the people that he did not know Jesus. This time he denied knowing Jesus with an oath/by declaring before God that what he said was true. (71-72)
trans-unit.target: Petro aliwaambia watu kwamba hamjui Yesu. Wakati huu alikanusha kumjua Yesu kwa kiapo/kwa kutangaza mbele za Mungu kwamba aliyosema ni kweli. (71-72)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~71#Answer:What did Peter say to the people when another girl told the people that he had been with Jesus of Nazareth?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.73-74+What did Peter say to those people, who had been standing near him, when they said to him that he surely was one of the disciples of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~73#Question:What did Peter say to those people, who had been standing near him, when they said to him that he surely was one of the disciples of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter say to those people, who had been standing near him, when they said to him that he surely was one of the disciples of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Petro aliwaambia nini wale watu, waliokuwa wamesimama karibu naye, walipomwambia kwamba kwa hakika yeye alikuwa mmoja wa wanafunzi wa Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~73#Question:What did Peter say to those people, who had been standing near him, when they said to him that he surely was one of the disciples of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~73#Answer:What did Peter say to those people, who had been standing near him, when they said to him that he surely was one of the disciples of Jesus?-133411235
trans-unit.source: Peter called down/invoked curses on himself and told them that he did not know the man/Jesus. (73-74)
trans-unit.target: Petro alijiita/alijiita laana juu yake mwenyewe na kuwaambia kwamba hamjui mtu huyo/Yesu. (73-74)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~73#Answer:What did Peter say to those people, who had been standing near him, when they said to him that he surely was one of the disciples of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.74+What happened after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~74#Question:What happened after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time?
trans-unit.source: What happened after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotukia baada ya Petro kumkana Yesu mara ya tatu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~74#Question:What happened after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~74#Answer:What happened after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time?1190135480
trans-unit.source: A rooster crowed after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time. (74)
trans-unit.target: jogoo aliwika baada ya Petro kumkana Yesu mara ya tatu (74)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~74#Answer:What happened after Peter denied that he knew Jesus the third time?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.75+What did Peter remember after the rooster crowed?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~75#Question:What did Peter remember after the rooster crowed?
trans-unit.source: What did Peter remember after the rooster crowed?
trans-unit.target: Petro alikumbuka nini baada ya jogoo kuwika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~75#Question:What did Peter remember after the rooster crowed?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~75#Answer:What did Peter remember after the rooster crowed?-898529845
trans-unit.source: He remembered that Jesus had told him that he would disown/deny Jesus three times before the rooster crowed. (75)
trans-unit.target: Alikumbuka kwamba Yesu alikuwa amemwambia kwamba atamkana/kumkana Yesu mara tatu kabla jogoo hajawika. (75)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~75#Answer:What did Peter remember after the rooster crowed?

group.id: Q:MAT 26.75+Then what did Peter do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!26~75#Question:Then what did Peter do?
trans-unit.source: Then what did Peter do?
trans-unit.target: Kisha Petro akafanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~75#Question:Then what did Peter do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!26~75#Answer:Then what did Peter do?560058224
trans-unit.source: He went outside and wept/cried bitterly/in great sorrow. (75)
trans-unit.target: Basi, akatoka nje, akalia kwa uchungu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!26~75#Answer:Then what did Peter do?

trans-unit.source: What did Judas do after he threw the thirty silver coins into the temple?
trans-unit.target: Yuda alifanya nini baada ya kutupa zile sarafu thelathini za fedha hekaluni?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~1#Question:What did Judas do after he threw the thirty silver coins into the temple?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~1#Answer:What did Judas do after he threw the thirty silver coins into the temple?-870469569
trans-unit.source: After Judas threw the thirty silver coins into the temple he left/went out and hanged himself [to death]. (5)
trans-unit.target: Baada ya Yuda kutupa sarafu thelathini za fedha ndani ya hekalu aliondoka/kutoka nje na akajinyang'anya [kufa]. (5)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~1#Answer:What did Judas do after he threw the thirty silver coins into the temple?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.1+What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~1#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do with Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na wazee wanaamua kumfanya Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~1#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~1#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do with Jesus?1532756811
trans-unit.source: They decided to have Jesus put to death/have someone kill/execute him. (1)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua kumfanya Yesu auawe/kufanya mtu fulani amuue/kumwua. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~1#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do with Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.3+What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~3#Question:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yuda kurudisha vipande thelathini vya fedha kwa makuhani wakuu na wazee?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~3#Question:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!27~3#Alternate:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?-1627622987
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yuda kurudisha vile vipande thelathini vya fedha kwa wakuu wa makuhani na wazee?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~3#Alternate:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!27~3#Alternate:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?43658949
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini sababu ya Yuda kurudisha vile vipande thelathini vya fedha kwa wakuu wa makuhani na wazee?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~3#Alternate:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~3#Answer:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?1177320852
trans-unit.source: Judas returned the thirty silver coins to them because he had heard that Jesus had been condemned to die by the chief priests and the elders. He grieved/regretted/felt bad about what he had done to Jesus. (3)
trans-unit.target: Yuda aliwarudishia wale vipande thelathini vya fedha kwa sababu alikuwa amesikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amehukumiwa kifo na wakuu wa makuhani na wazee. Alihuzunishwa/alijuta/alihisi vibaya juu ya yale aliyokuwa amemfanyia Yesu. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~3#Answer:What is the reason that Judas returned the thirty pieces of silver/silver coins to the chief priests and the elders?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.4+What did Judas say to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~4#Question:What did Judas say to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.source: What did Judas say to the chief priests and the elders?
trans-unit.target: Yuda aliwaambia nini wakuu wa makuhani na wazee?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~4#Question:What did Judas say to the chief priests and the elders?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~4#Answer:What did Judas say to the chief priests and the elders?828011564
trans-unit.source: He told them that he had sinned by betraying innocent blood/an innocent man. (4)
trans-unit.target: Aliwaambia kwamba alikuwa ametenda dhambi kwa kumsaliti mtu asiye na hatia. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~4#Answer:What did Judas say to the chief priests and the elders?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.4+How concerned were the chief priests and the elders about Judas?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~4#Question:How concerned were the chief priests and the elders about Judas?
trans-unit.source: How concerned were the chief priests and the elders about Judas?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na wazee walihangaikia Yuda kadiri gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~4#Question:How concerned were the chief priests and the elders about Judas?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~4#Answer:How concerned were the chief priests and the elders about Judas?-1309764361
trans-unit.source: They were not concerned about him. They told him that what he had done was his business/own problem. (4)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuwa na wasiwasi juu yake. Walimwambia kwamba kile alichokuwa amefanya kilikuwa ni biashara yake/tatizo lake mwenyewe. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~4#Answer:How concerned were the chief priests and the elders about Judas?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.6+What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders could not put the money back into the temple treasury?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~6#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders could not put the money back into the temple treasury?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders could not put the money back into the temple treasury?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa nini wakuu wa makuhani na wazee hawakuweza kurudisha fedha hizo katika hazina ya hekalu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~6#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders could not put the money back into the temple treasury?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~6#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders could not put the money back into the temple treasury?-963919590
trans-unit.source: They could not put the money back into the temple treasury because [Moses'] law would not allow them to put money into the treasury that was blood money/money that had been used to have someone killed. (6)
trans-unit.target: Hawakuweza kurudisha fedha hizo kwenye hazina ya hekalu kwa sababu sheria ya [Musa] haikuwaruhusu kuweka fedha katika hazina ambayo ilikuwa pesa za damu/pesa ambazo zilitumiwa kumwangamiza mtu. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~6#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the elders could not put the money back into the temple treasury?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.7+What did the chief priests and the elders do with the thirty silver coins?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~7#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders do with the thirty silver coins?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and the elders do with the thirty silver coins?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na wazee walifanya nini na vile vipande thelathini vya fedha?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~7#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders do with the thirty silver coins?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~7#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders do with the thirty silver coins?-710060050
trans-unit.source: They used the thirty silver coins to buy the potter's field that would be used as a place to bury foreigners. (7)
trans-unit.target: Walitumia vile vipande 30 vya fedha kununua shamba la mfinyanzi ambalo lingetumiwa kuwa mahali pa kuzikia wageni. (7)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~7#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders do with the thirty silver coins?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.17-18+What is the reason that the governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~17#Question:What is the reason that the governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini gavana huyo aliuliza umati ikiwa wamwachilie huru Baraba au Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~17#Question:What is the reason that the governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~17#Answer:What is the reason that the governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?556613783
trans-unit.source: The governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus because he knew that [the leaders of the Jews] had handed Jesus over to him because they were jealous/envious of Jesus. (17-18)
trans-unit.target: Gavana aliuliza umati ikiwa anapaswa kuwafungulia Baraba au Yesu kwa sababu alijua kwamba [viongozi wa Wayahudi] walikuwa wamemkabidhi Yesu kwa sababu walikuwa na wivu / wivu wa Yesu. (17-18)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~17#Answer:What is the reason that the governor asked the crowd if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.17-21+What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~17#Question:What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Umati ulimwambia nini gavana alipowauliza kama wanapaswa kumfungulia Baraba au Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~17#Question:What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~17#Answer:What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?-887116154
trans-unit.source: The crowd told him to release Barabbas. (17, 21)
trans-unit.target: Umati ulimwambia amfungue Baraba (17, 21)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~17#Answer:What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them if he should release Barabbas or Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~22#Answer:What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them what he should do with Jesus?1984645704

trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~22#Answer:What did the crowd tell the governor when he asked them what he should do with Jesus?

trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~20#Question:What is the reason that the crowd told the governor to release Barabbas and to crucify Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~20#Answer:What is the reason that the crowd told the governor to release Barabbas and to crucify Jesus?-923211472
trans-unit.source: The crowd told the governor to release Barabbas and to crucify Jesus because the chief priests and the elders had persuaded/convinced/caused them to make that decision. (20)
trans-unit.target: Umati huo ulimwambia gavana amfungue Baraba na kumsulibisha Yesu kwa sababu makuhani wakuu na wazee walikuwa wamewashawishi/washawishi/wafanye uamuzi huo. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~20#Answer:What is the reason that the crowd told the governor to release Barabbas and to crucify Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.19+What is the reason that Pilate's wife sent him a message and told him not to have anything to do with Jesus?
