trans-unit.source: What is the reason that Pilate's wife sent him a message and told him not to have anything to do with Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini mke wa Pilato alimpelekea ujumbe na kumwambia asiwe na uhusiano wowote na Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~19#Question:What is the reason that Pilate's wife sent him a message and told him not to have anything to do with Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~19#Answer:What is the reason that Pilate's wife sent him a message and told him not to have anything to do with Jesus?-2046028276
trans-unit.source: She told Pilate not to have anything to do with Jesus because she had suffered much in a dream/a nightmare/a bad dream because of him. (19)
trans-unit.target: Alimwambia Pilato asiwe na uhusiano wowote na Yesu kwa sababu alikuwa ameteseka sana katika ndoto/maono mabaya/ndoto mbaya kwa sababu yake. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~19#Answer:What is the reason that Pilate's wife sent him a message and told him not to have anything to do with Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.23-24+What did Pilate finally do when the crowd insisted that Jesus be crucified and they were beginning to riot?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~23#Question:What did Pilate finally do when the crowd insisted that Jesus be crucified and they were beginning to riot?
trans-unit.source: What did Pilate finally do when the crowd insisted that Jesus be crucified and they were beginning to riot?
trans-unit.target: Hatimaye Pilato alifanya nini wakati umati uliposisitiza kwamba Yesu atundikwe mtini nao wakaanza ghasia?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~23#Question:What did Pilate finally do when the crowd insisted that Jesus be crucified and they were beginning to riot?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~23#Answer:What did Pilate finally do when the crowd insisted that Jesus be crucified and they were beginning to riot?1898134845
trans-unit.source: When Pilate realized that he could not change the people's minds he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd (to show that he was not guilty). He told them that he was innocent of this man's blood/death. He told them that they were to blame for his death. (23-24)
trans-unit.target: Pilato alipoona kwamba hawezi kubadili mawazo ya watu alichukua maji na kunawa mikono yake mbele ya umati (kuonyesha kwamba hakuwa na hatia). aliwaambia kwamba hakuwa na hatia ya damu/kifo cha mtu huyu. aliwaambia kwamba walikuwa na hatia ya kifo chake (23-24)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~23#Answer:What did Pilate finally do when the crowd insisted that Jesus be crucified and they were beginning to riot?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~25#Answer:What did the people/crowd answer/tell Pilate that they were willing to accept?2138226116
trans-unit.source: They told Pilate that they were willing to accept, for themselves and for their descendants, the blame for having Jesus killed. (25)

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~26#Answer:Then what did Pilate do with Barabbas and Jesus?-195230966
trans-unit.source: Pilate released Barabbas. Pilate had his soldiers whip/scourge Jesus. Then he ordered his soldiers to crucify him. (26)

trans-unit.source: In these verses the author wrote about what the soldiers did to Jesus before they crucified him.
trans-unit.target: Katika mistari hiyo mwandishi aliandika kuhusu kile ambacho askari walimfanyia Yesu kabla ya kumtundika.

group.id: Q:MAT 27.28-31+What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~28#Question:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the soldiers do to Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Askari walimfanyia Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~28#Question:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?-54243277
trans-unit.source: They stripped his clothes off of him and put a scarlet/red robe on him. (28)
trans-unit.target: Wakamvua nguo zake, wakamvika vazi jeusi.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?-569783938
trans-unit.source: They twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. (29)
trans-unit.target: Walifanyiza taji la miiba na kuliweka juu ya kichwa chake. (29)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?472798091
trans-unit.source: They put a staff/reed/stick in his right hand and then they knelt in front of him and mocked/made fun of him. (29)
trans-unit.target: Wakamtia fimbo katika mkono wake wa kulia, na wakamsujudia na kumdhihaki.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?-971189463
trans-unit.source: They spit on him and then they took the staff/reed/stick and hit him on the head again and again with it. (30)
trans-unit.target: Wakamtemea mate, kisha wakachukua fimbo/mti/fimbo na kumpiga kichwani tena na tena kwa fimbo hiyo. (30)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?-1306666664
trans-unit.source: After they had mocked/made fun of him they took the scarlet/red robe off of him and put his own clothes back on him. Then they led/took Jesus away to crucify him. (31)
trans-unit.target: Basi walipokwisha kumfanyia mzaha, wakamvua ile kanzu, wakamvika mavazi yake, wakamchukua wamsulibishe.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~28#Answer:What did the soldiers do to Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.32+What do you know about the cross?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~32#Question:What do you know about the cross?
trans-unit.source: What do you know about the cross?
trans-unit.target: Unajua nini kuhusu msalaba?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~32#Question:What do you know about the cross?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~32#Answer:What do you know about the cross?895188716
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The Romans constructed the cross of two pieces of wood. One piece was a thick wooden post, which was placed/planted upright into a hole in the ground. The other piece was the crossbeam, which was fastened across the upright post so that it formed a + or T shape.
trans-unit.target: Muhimu wa Muda Check: Warumi kujengwa msalaba wa vipande viwili vya mbao. kipande kimoja kilikuwa ni mzigo mzito wa mbao, ambayo ilikuwa kuwekwa / kupandwa wima katika shimo katika ardhi. kipande kingine kilikuwa crossbeam, ambayo ilikuwa fastened katika msalaba wima ili kuunda + au T sura.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~32#Answer:What do you know about the cross?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!27~32#Note:What do you know about the cross?-376395312
trans-unit.source: See "cross" in KBT.
trans-unit.target: Angalia "msalaba" katika KBT.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~32#Note:What do you know about the cross?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.54+What is the reason that the centurion and the soldiers with him, who were guarding Jesus, said, "Surely he was the Son of God"?

trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the centurion and the soldiers with him, who were guarding Jesus, said, "Surely he was the Son of God"?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini yule ofisa-jeshi na askari-jeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye, waliokuwa wakimlinda Yesu, walisema: "Hakika huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu"?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~54#Question:What is the reason that the centurion and the soldiers with him, who were guarding Jesus, said, "Surely he was the Son of God"?

trans-unit.source: They said that because they had felt the earthquake and they saw everything else that had happened. (54)
trans-unit.target: Walisema hivyo kwa sababu walikuwa wamehisi tetemeko la dunia na walikuwa wameona kila kitu kingine kilichokuwa kimetukia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~54#Answer:What is the reason that the centurion and the soldiers with him, who were guarding Jesus, said, "Surely he was the Son of God"?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!27~57#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 27:57-61 Joseph of Arimathea took the body of Jesus and laid/buried it in a tomb/cave.

trans-unit.target: Yusufu alienda kwa Pilato kuomba mwili wa Yesu. (58)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~57#Answer:What is the reason that Joseph went to Pilate?

trans-unit.source: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth. Then he laid it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. (58-60)
trans-unit.target: Yosefu akauchukua ule mwili akauzungushia sanda safi ya kitani, akauweka katika kaburi lake jipya alilokuwa amechonga katika mwamba.

group.id: Q:MAT 27.57+Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~57#Question:Who was Joseph?
trans-unit.source: Who was Joseph?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alikuwa nani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~57#Question:Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~57#Answer:Who was Joseph?2068369930
trans-unit.source: He was a rich man from (the town of) Arimathea.
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mtu tajiri kutoka (mji wa) Arimathea.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~57#Answer:Who was Joseph?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~57#Answer:Who was Joseph?-1091922764
trans-unit.source: He was a disciple of Jesus. (57)
trans-unit.target: Alikuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~57#Answer:Who was Joseph?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.60+What did Joseph do after he had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~60#Question:What did Joseph do after he had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb?
trans-unit.source: What did Joseph do after he had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb?
trans-unit.target: Yosefu alifanya nini baada ya kuweka mwili wa Yesu katika kaburi lake mwenyewe jipya?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~60#Question:What did Joseph do after he had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~60#Answer:What did Joseph do after he had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb?363206619
trans-unit.source: After Joseph had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb, he rolled a large/big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb. Then he went away. (60)
trans-unit.target: Baada ya Yusufu kuweka mwili wa Yesu katika kaburi lake mwenyewe jipya, akaling'oa jiwe kubwa mbele ya mlango wa kaburi. Kisha akaondoka. (60)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~60#Answer:What did Joseph do after he had laid the body of Jesus in his own new tomb?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.61+What were Mary Magdalene and the other Mary doing?

trans-unit.target: Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikuwa wakifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~61#Question:What were Mary Magdalene and the other Mary doing?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~61#Answer:What were Mary Magdalene and the other Mary doing?1187669532
trans-unit.source: They were sitting opposite/across from the tomb. (61)
trans-unit.target: Walikuwa wameketi kinyume na kaburi. (61)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~61#Answer:What were Mary Magdalene and the other Mary doing?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!27~62#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 27:62-66 Pilate sent soldiers to guard the tomb of Jesus/the cave where Jesus had been buried.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 27:62-66 Pilato alituma askari walinde kaburi la Yesu/pango ambapo Yesu alikuwa amezikwa.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 27.62-66+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~62#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Question:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~62#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?-1574645779
trans-unit.source: The author wrote about the chief priests and the Pharisees asking Pilate to make Jesus's tomb more secure.
trans-unit.target: Mwandikaji aliandika juu ya wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakimwomba Pilato aweke ulinzi zaidi juu ya kaburi la Yesu.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.62-64+What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~62#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?
trans-unit.target: Ni kwa sababu gani makuhani wakuu na Mafarisayo walimwomba Pilato awaamuru askari wake walinde kaburi mpaka siku ya tatu baada ya Yesu kufa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Question:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!27~62#Alternate:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?1518479671
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walimwomba Pilato awaamuru askari-jeshi wake walinde kaburi mpaka siku ya tatu baada ya Yesu kufa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Alternate:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!27~62#Alternate:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?34778990
trans-unit.source: What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini wakuu wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walimwomba Pilato awaamuru askari-jeshi wake walinde kaburi mpaka siku ya tatu baada ya Yesu kufa?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Alternate:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~62#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?-1043194334
trans-unit.source: They wanted Pilate to order his soldiers to guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died because they remembered that Jesus had said that, after three days, he would rise again to life. They thought that, if the soldiers did not guard the tomb, the disciples of Jesus would come and steal the body and then they would declare/proclaim/say that [God] had raised Jesus from the dead. (62-64)
trans-unit.target: Walitamani Pilato awaamuru askari wake kulinda kaburi mpaka siku ya tatu baada ya Yesu kufa kwa sababu walikumbuka kwamba Yesu alisema kwamba, baada ya siku tatu, atafufuka tena. Walifikiri kwamba, kama askari hawalinzi kaburi, wanafunzi wa Yesu wangeweza kuja na kuiba mwili na kisha watatangaza / kutangaza / kusema kwamba [Mungu] alimfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu. (62-64)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~62#Answer:What is the reason that the chief priests and the Pharisees asked Pilate to order his soldiers to secure/guard the tomb until the third day after Jesus had died?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.65+What did Pilate tell the chief priests and the Pharisees to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~65#Question:What did Pilate tell the chief priests and the Pharisees to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Pilate tell the chief priests and the Pharisees to do?
trans-unit.target: Pilato aliwaambia makuhani wakuu na Mafarisayo wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~65#Question:What did Pilate tell the chief priests and the Pharisees to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~65#Answer:What did Pilate tell the chief priests and the Pharisees to do?-77990851
trans-unit.source: Pilate told them to take some of his soldiers and make the tomb as secure as they possibly could/knew how. (65)
trans-unit.target: Pilato aliwaambia wachukue baadhi ya askari wake na kufanya kaburi salama kama vile wangeweza/walijua jinsi gani. (65)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~65#Answer:What did Pilate tell the chief priests and the Pharisees to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 27.66+Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!27~66#Question:Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?
trans-unit.source: Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?
trans-unit.target: Basi makuhani wakuu na Mafarisayo walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~66#Question:Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!27~66#Answer:Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?1701811244
trans-unit.source: They went to the tomb and made it secure by putting a seal/mark on the stone; and they left the soldiers there to guard the tomb. (66)
trans-unit.target: Basi wakaenda, wakalitia muhuri jiwe, na kulilinda kaburi, pamoja na askari.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~66#Answer:Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?

trans-unit.id: n:!MAT!27~66#Note:Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?-319534465
trans-unit.source: They put a seal/mark on the stone so that they would know whether/if anyone had moved it.
trans-unit.target: Waliweka muhuri/alama kwenye jiwe ili wajue kama mtu yeyote alikuwa amelitembea.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!27~66#Note:Then what did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!28~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 28:1-10 God raised Jesus from death. // Jesus awakened/rose from death and lives again.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 28:1-10 Mungu alimfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu. // Yesu aliamka/alifufuka kutoka kwa wafu na anaishi tena.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~1#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 28.1-10+Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~1#Question:Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was?
trans-unit.source: Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was?
trans-unit.target: Malaika aliwaambia wanawake hao kwamba Yesu alikuwa wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~1#Question:Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~1#Answer:Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was?-279849636
trans-unit.source: The angel told the women that Jesus was not in the tomb because he had risen from the dead. (6)
trans-unit.target: Malaika aliwaambia wanawake hao kwamba Yesu hakuwa kaburini kwa sababu alikuwa amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. (6)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~1#Answer:Where did the angel tell the women that Jesus was?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.1+Where did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go the day after the Sabbath day?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~1#Question:Where did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go the day after the Sabbath day?
trans-unit.source: Where did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go the day after the Sabbath day?
trans-unit.target: Mariamu Magdalene na Mariamu yule mwingine walienda wapi siku iliyofuata siku ya Sabato?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~1#Question:Where did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go the day after the Sabbath day?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~1#Answer:Where did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go the day after the Sabbath day?263411713
trans-unit.source: They went to look at the tomb [where the body of Jesus lay]. (1)
trans-unit.target: Walienda kutazama kaburi [ambapo mwili wa Yesu ulikuwa umelazwa]. (1)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~1#Answer:Where did Mary Magdalene and the other Mary go the day after the Sabbath day?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.2+What happened very suddenly?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~2#Question:What happened very suddenly?
trans-unit.source: What happened very suddenly?
trans-unit.target: Ni nini kilichotokea ghafula sana?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~2#Question:What happened very suddenly?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~2#Answer:What happened very suddenly?-1646850979
trans-unit.source: Suddenly there was a violent earthquake because an angel had come down from heaven. (2)
trans-unit.target: Ghafula, tetemeko kubwa la nchi likatokea kwa sababu malaika alikuwa ameshuka kutoka mbinguni. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~2#Answer:What happened very suddenly?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.2+What did the angel do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~2#Question:What did the angel do?
trans-unit.source: What did the angel do?
trans-unit.target: Malaika huyo alifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~2#Question:What did the angel do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~2#Answer:What did the angel do?1764511140
trans-unit.source: He went to the tomb, rolled back the stone [from the entrance] and sat on it. (2)
trans-unit.target: Alienda kwenye kaburi, akalirusha lile jiwe [kutoka kwenye mlango] na kuketi juu yake. (2)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~2#Answer:What did the angel do?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.3+What did the angel look like?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~3#Question:What did the angel look like?
trans-unit.source: What did the angel look like?
trans-unit.target: Malaika huyo alionekanaje?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~3#Question:What did the angel look like?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~3#Answer:What did the angel look like?-1060178393
trans-unit.source: The angel was bright like lightning and his clothes were white as snow/very white. (3)
trans-unit.target: Malaika huyo alikuwa na umbo la umeme na mavazi yake yalikuwa meupe kama theluji/nyeupe sana. (3)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~3#Answer:What did the angel look like?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.4+How did the guards react when they saw the angel?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~4#Question:How did the guards react when they saw the angel?
trans-unit.source: How did the guards react when they saw the angel?
trans-unit.target: Walinzi waliitikiaje walipomwona malaika?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~4#Question:How did the guards react when they saw the angel?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~4#Answer:How did the guards react when they saw the angel?-807909710
trans-unit.source: The guards were so afraid of the angel that they shook and fell to the ground and lay motionless/still like dead men. (4)
trans-unit.target: Walinzi wakaingiwa na hofu ya malaika hata wakataharuki na kuanguka chini na kuanguka kama wafu. (4)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~4#Answer:How did the guards react when they saw the angel?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.7+What did the angel tell the women to tell to the disciples of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~7#Question:What did the angel tell the women to tell to the disciples of Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the angel tell the women to tell to the disciples of Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Malaika aliwaambia wanawake hao wawaambie wanafunzi wa Yesu nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~7#Question:What did the angel tell the women to tell to the disciples of Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~7#Answer:What did the angel tell the women to tell to the disciples of Jesus?975044097
trans-unit.source: The angel told the women to go and tell the disciples of Jesus that Jesus had risen from the dead and he was going ahead of them into Galilee. That is where they would see him. (7)
trans-unit.target: Malaika aliwaambia wanawake hao waende na kuwaambia wanafunzi wa Yesu kwamba Yesu alikuwa amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu na kwamba alikuwa akienda mbele yao kuingia Galilaya.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~7#Answer:What did the angel tell the women to tell to the disciples of Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.9-10+What did Jesus say to the women?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~9#Question:What did Jesus say to the women?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus say to the women?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanawake hao nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~9#Question:What did Jesus say to the women?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~9#Answer:What did Jesus say to the women?1326092981
trans-unit.source: He greeted them. Then he told them not to be afraid. He told them to go and tell his brothers/disciples to go to Galilee where they would see him. (9-10)
trans-unit.target: Kisha akawaambia wasiogope. Akawaambia waende kuwaambia ndugu zake/wanafunzi wake waende Galilaya, huko watamwona. (9-10)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~9#Answer:What did Jesus say to the women?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!28~11#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 28:11-15 The guards told the chief priests what had happened.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 28:11-15 Walinzi waliwaeleza wakuu wa makuhani lililokuwa limetukia.
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~11#Section Heading

group.id: Q:MAT 28.11-15+What did some of the guards tell to the chief priests?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~11#Question:What did some of the guards tell to the chief priests?
trans-unit.source: What did some of the guards tell to the chief priests?
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya walinzi waliwaambia nini wakuu wa makuhani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~11#Question:What did some of the guards tell to the chief priests?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~11#Answer:What did some of the guards tell to the chief priests?1206380216
trans-unit.source: Some of the guards told the chief priests everything that had happened [at the tomb]. (11)
trans-unit.target: Baadhi ya wale walinzi wakawaambia wakuu wa makuhani mambo yote yaliyotukia [kwenye kaburi].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~11#Answer:What did some of the guards tell to the chief priests?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.12-13+What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~12#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu na wazee waliamua kufanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~12#Question:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~12#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do?-25279976
trans-unit.source: They decided to give the guards/soldiers a large amount of money. Then they told them that, [if anyone asked them what had happened at the tomb], they were to say that the disciples of Jesus came during the night and stole/took his body while they were asleep. (12-13)
trans-unit.target: Waliamua kuwapa walinzi/askari kiasi kikubwa cha fedha. Kisha wakawaambia, [ikiwa mtu yeyote atawauliza kile kilichotokea kwenye kaburi], ni lazima waseme kwamba wanafunzi wa Yesu walikuja usiku na kuiba mwili wake wakati walikuwa wamelala (12-13)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~12#Answer:What did the chief priests and the elders decide to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.14+What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~14#Question:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu waliwaambia askari-jeshi kwamba wangefanya nini, ikiwa gavana angesikia [kwamba wanafunzi wa Yesu walikuwa wamekuja na kuiba mwili wa Yesu, wakati askari-jeshi walikuwa wamelala]?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~14#Question:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!28~14#Alternate:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?-430646815
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu waliwaambia askari-jeshi kwamba wangefanya nini, ikiwa gavana angesikia kwamba wanafunzi wa Yesu walikuwa wamekuja na kuiba mwili wa Yesu, wakati askari-jeshi walikuwa wamelala?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~14#Alternate:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?

trans-unit.id: l:!MAT!28~14#Alternate:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?-341553426
trans-unit.source: What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard?
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu waliwaambia askari-jeshi kwamba wangefanya nini ikiwa gavana angejua jambo hilo?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~14#Alternate:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~14#Answer:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?-941016867
trans-unit.source: The chief priests assured/told the soldiers that they would talk to the governor and convince him that the soldiers were innocent so that they would stay out of trouble. (14)
trans-unit.target: Makuhani wakuu waliwahakikishia/waliwaambia askari kwamba watazungumza na gavana na kumsadikisha kwamba askari walikuwa wasio na hatia ili wasiingie katika matatizo. (14)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~14#Answer:What did the chief priests tell the soldiers that they would do, if the governor heard [that the disciples of Jesus had come and stolen the body of Jesus, while the soldiers were sleeping]?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.15+What did the soldiers do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~15#Question:What did the soldiers do?
trans-unit.source: What did the soldiers do?
trans-unit.target: Askari-jeshi hao walifanya nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~15#Question:What did the soldiers do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~15#Answer:What did the soldiers do?-921116224
trans-unit.source: The soldiers took the money and did as the chief priests told them to do. (15)
trans-unit.target: Askari wakazichukua zile fedha, wakafanya kama walivyoagizwa na wakuu wa makuhani. (15)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~15#Answer:What did the soldiers do?

trans-unit.id: h:!MAT!28~16#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: Matthew 28:16-20 Jesus told his disciples what they must do from now on.
trans-unit.target: Mathayo 28:16-20 Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake jambo ambalo ni lazima wafanye kuanzia sasa na kuendelea.

group.id: Q:MAT 28.16-20+What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

trans-unit.source: What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?
trans-unit.target: Unafikiri ni nini kichwa kikuu cha mistari hiyo?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~16#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?1189073186
trans-unit.source: Jesus told his disciples to go and make disciples from every nation/people group. (19)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waende na kufanya wanafunzi kutoka kwa kila taifa/kikundi cha watu. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~16#Answer:What do you think is the basic theme of these verses?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.16+Where did the eleven disciples go?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~16#Question:Where did the eleven disciples go?
trans-unit.source: Where did the eleven disciples go?
trans-unit.target: Wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja walienda wapi?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~16#Question:Where did the eleven disciples go?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~16#Answer:Where did the eleven disciples go?1559471560
trans-unit.source: They went to Galilee to a mountain, where Jesus had told them to go. (16)
trans-unit.target: Wakaenda Galilaya mpaka mlima ule ambao Yesu alikuwa amewaagiza waende. (16)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~16#Answer:Where did the eleven disciples go?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.17+What did the disciples do, when they saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~17#Question:What did the disciples do, when they saw Jesus?
trans-unit.source: What did the disciples do, when they saw Jesus?
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walifanya nini walipomwona Yesu?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~17#Question:What did the disciples do, when they saw Jesus?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~17#Answer:What did the disciples do, when they saw Jesus?2106140231
trans-unit.source: When the disciples saw Jesus they worshiped him, but some of them doubted [that it was Jesus]. (17)
trans-unit.target: Wanafunzi walipomwona Yesu walimsujudia, lakini baadhi yao waliona shaka [kwamba alikuwa Yesu].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~17#Answer:What did the disciples do, when they saw Jesus?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.19-20+What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~19#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?
trans-unit.source: What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake wafanye nini?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~19#Question:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?1302850921
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples to go everywhere and teach people from every people group to be [his] disciples/followers.
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waende kila mahali na kuwafundisha watu wa kila kikundi cha watu wawe wanafunzi/wafuasi [wake].
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?-572814721
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples to baptize the new disciples in the name of/authority of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. (19)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi kubatiza wanafunzi wapya kwa jina/mamlaka ya Baba na ya Mwana na ya Roho Mtakatifu. (19)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?76546221
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples to teach the new disciples to obey everything that he had taught to them. (20)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi kuwafundisha wanafunzi wapya kutii yote ambayo alikuwa amewafundisha. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~19#Answer:What did Jesus tell the disciples to do?

group.id: Q:MAT 28.20+How long did Jesus say that he would be with the disciples?

trans-unit.id: q:!MAT!28~20#Question:How long did Jesus say that he would be with the disciples?
trans-unit.source: How long did Jesus say that he would be with the disciples?
trans-unit.target: Yesu alisema angekuwa na wanafunzi wake kwa muda gani?
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~20#Question:How long did Jesus say that he would be with the disciples?

trans-unit.id: a:!MAT!28~20#Answer:How long did Jesus say that he would be with the disciples?-1485403402
trans-unit.source: Jesus told the disciples that he would be with them always, until this age/world ends. (20)
trans-unit.target: Yesu aliwaambia wanafunzi wake kwamba atakuwa pamoja nao siku zote, mpaka mwisho wa ulimwengu huu. (20)
trans-unit.note: !MAT!28~20#Answer:How long did Jesus say that he would be with the disciples?

group.id: Q:PHP 1.2+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!PHP!1~2#Question:Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.note: !PHP!1~2#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!PHP!1~2#Answer:Who do you think God is?-468230897
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In English, the term "God" with a capital "G" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a lower case "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways. In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralised.
trans-unit.note: !PHP!1~2#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!PHP!1~2#Note:Who do you think God is?-22475676
trans-unit.source: See "God" in KBT.

group.id: Q:PHP 1.7+What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.id: q:!PHP!1~7#Question:What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.note: !PHP!1~7#Question:What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.id: a:!PHP!1~7#Answer:What do you think the gospel is?-317692804
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The word "gospel" is a translation of the Greek noun euangelion. In the New Testament the noun euangelion is used in a restricted sense. It does not mean just any kind of good news, but specifically the good news, or joyful report, that God has made a way of salvation for sinful human beings. In the New Testament it is always used with this one sense and is usually translated in the RSV, and most modern English versions, as "gospel".
trans-unit.note: !PHP!1~7#Answer:What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.id: n:!PHP!1~7#Note:What do you think the gospel is?-1635459669
trans-unit.source: See "gospel" in KBT.

group.id: Q:REV 1.1+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!REV!1~1#Question:Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.note: !REV!1~1#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!REV!1~1#Answer:Who do you think God is?1014921725
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.note: !REV!1~1#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!REV!1~1#Note:Who do you think God is?-1713399034
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralised. (Or, if it can be pluralised, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods". In one language, the plural form of God, meant "God and those who follow him" and was an appropriate way to translate "saints".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !REV!1~1#Note:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!REV!1~4#Answer:What do you think he meant by "spirit" in this verse?-441071637
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The seven spirits are generally understood as a way of talking about the Holy Spirit. The imagery seems to be derived from Zechariah 4. Some commentators think they refer to the seven chief angels or archangels, who are known also from Jewish tradition. But the fact that the seven spirits are grouped with the eternal God and Jesus Christ suggests that the Holy Spirit is meant, not angelic beings. He is God's spirit through whom he acts, reveals His will, and empowers individuals.
trans-unit.note: !REV!1~4#Answer:What do you think he meant by "spirit" in this verse?

This word was used by the Jews as a name for the place where righteous people go, either when they die or when they rise from the dead and have been vindicated on the day of Judgment. It was located in the "third heaven" in Jewish thought of the time. (See "paradise" in KBT in the "heaven" entry.)
trans-unit.note: !REV!2~7#Answer:Where do you think paradise is?

group.id: Q:REV 2.20+What do you know about prophets?

trans-unit.note: !REV!2~20#Question:What do you know about prophets?

trans-unit.id: a:!REV!2~20#Answer:What do you know about prophets?635492662
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A prophet is someone who speaks for God and is inspired by Him. He often foretells future events. Prophets were mainly spokespersons who called His people to obedience by appealing to Israel's past and future. A false prophet was a person who claimed to be a prophet of God but was not. His messages were deceptive and led to confusion. "Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess". Apparently, this was a code name for a prominent woman in the church who taught false teachings while claiming to speak messages from God.
trans-unit.note: !REV!2~20#Answer:What do you know about prophets?

trans-unit.source: See "prophet" in KBT.

trans-unit.id: a:!REV!4~8#Answer:What does it mean to you to have someone as your lord?1953250623
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A lord is someone who has power and exercises it responsibly. To call someone your lord means that you have given them control over your life. group.id: Q:REV 9.1+What do you think the abyss is?

trans-unit.note: !REV!9~1#Question:What do you think the abyss is?

trans-unit.id: a:!REV!9~1#Answer:What do you think the abyss is?481793816
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The word "abyss" (Greek abussos) literally means a place that is so deep that it has no bottom to it. In Jewish tradition it referred first to the water under the earth, "the deep". It also referred to the place where certain evil spirits were put in prison and tormented after being expelled from heaven. They will be kept there till the Judgment. The abyss (bottomless pit) has this meaning in Rev. 9:1, 2, 11; 11:7; 17:8; 20:1, 3. (See "abyss" in KBT in the "Hell" entry.)
trans-unit.note: !REV!9~1#Answer:What do you think the abyss is?

group.id: Q:REV 11.19+What do you think a covenant is?

trans-unit.id: q:!REV!11~19#Question:What do you think a covenant is?
trans-unit.source: What do you think a covenant is?
trans-unit.note: !REV!11~19#Question:What do you think a covenant is?

trans-unit.id: a:!REV!11~19#Answer:What do you think a covenant is?-2061303456
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Here it refers to the agreement made at the time of Moses. A covenant is a strong, binding agreement made between two people, an act in which they commit themselves to one another. In the case of the covenant which God has made with his people, God is the initiator of the covenant; it is he who makes a promise and states the terms. (It is not a negotiated agreement between two equal parties in which terms are discussed until agreed upon.)
trans-unit.note: !REV!11~19#Answer:What do you think a covenant is?

trans-unit.id: n:!REV!11~19#Note:What do you think a covenant is?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !REV!11~19#Note:What do you think a covenant is?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Like the English word "sign," the Greek word sêmeion is used to refer to all kinds of signs, such as signs or marks that distinguish one thing from another, or signs that give a warning. trans-unit.id: a:!REV!14~6#Answer:What do you think "eternal gospel" means?1359090949
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It means unchanging, a message that God wanted people to repent. It means that this message is valid forever. In this context, the "eternal gospel" refers to the call to fear God in verse 7; it also refers to "the gospel", otherwise it would not be described as "eternal". trans-unit.id: a:!REV!15~5#Answer:What do you think the tabernacle is?1518219253
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: It is a place to worship God. The tabernacle was the portable sanctuary that the people of Israel built under God's direction in the early years of their history, while they were traveling in the wilderness. God was present in the tabernacle in a very special way. In some passages the reference is not to the man-made tabernacle which existed in this world, but to the corresponding tabernacle in heaven, the spiritual reality which the earthly tabernacle represents. (See "tabernacle" in KBT in the "tent" entry.)
trans-unit.note: !REV!15~5#Answer:What do you think the tabernacle is?

group.id: Q:ROM 2.28-29+What is a true Jew?

trans-unit.source: It is not cutting of the foreskin, but cutting the evil out of ones heart.

group.id: Q:ROM 2.28-29+Can we be truly circumcised by following the law truly?

trans-unit.id: q:!ROM!2~28#Question:Can we be truly circumcised by following the law truly?

trans-unit.id: a:!ROM!2~28#Answer:Can we be truly circumcised by following the law truly?1551161736
trans-unit.source: It is not possible to follow all the law perfectly. So it is God's Holy Spirit who must take the evil from our hearts. Cutting the foreskin is not necessary.
trans-unit.note: !ROM!2~28#Answer:Can we be truly circumcised by following the law truly?

group.id: Q:1CO 9.16-17+Do you understand why Paul cannot boast about the fact that he preached to them, but he can boast that when he preached, he did not collect money from them?

trans-unit.note: !1CO!9~16#Question:Do you understand why Paul cannot boast about the fact that he preached to them, but he can boast that when he preached, he did not collect money from them?

trans-unit.id: a:!1CO!9~16#Answer:Do you understand why Paul cannot boast about the fact that he preached to them, but he can boast that when he preached, he did not collect money from them?-1974377637
trans-unit.source: If it had been true that he chose of his own will to preach, then he could rightly claim payment. But as it was God who forced him to become a preacher, like a master makes a slave work for him, he cannot claim a reward, he is only doing his duty. If he fails to preach, God will punish him.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!9~16#Answer:Do you understand why Paul cannot boast about the fact that he preached to them, but he can boast that when he preached, he did not collect money from them?

trans-unit.source: Bible scholars and historians have offered many different interpretations of this passage and attempted to provide cultural information to explain (or explain away) Paul's teaching.

trans-unit.id: n:!1CO!11~5#Note:What does it mean for a woman to shave her head?1528348522
trans-unit.source: Different denominations and churches have taken very different approaches to understanding and applying this teaching. Respondents who are part of a church may attempt to use their church's teaching to explain this. The translation should not unnecessarily favor a particular denominational interpretation.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!11~5#Note:What does it mean for a woman to shave her head?

trans-unit.id: n:!1CO!11~5#Note:What does it mean for a woman to shave her head?-1073622788
trans-unit.source: Respondents who are unchurched or unfamiliar with the Bible or ancient cultures may attempt to understand this using their own culture. The translation should attempt to avoid confusion that might arise from the cultural context.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!11~5#Note:What does it mean for a woman to shave her head?

trans-unit.id: l:!1CO!13~4#Alternate:What shows that we have love for our fellow man?-354664927
trans-unit.source: What actions or attitudes show that we have true love?
trans-unit.note: !1CO!13~4#Alternate:What shows that we have love for our fellow man?

trans-unit.id: a:!1CO!13~4#Answer:What shows that we have love for our fellow man?1822163079
trans-unit.source: We are patient with him, we are kind, we are not jealous, we don't boast, we are not proud and we don't insult others. We don't force others to do what we want, we don't get angry and we don't seek revenge. We are not happy when someone does wrong, we are happy when someone does good. We are patient with our fellow man in everything, we trust him in everything, we hope that he will not do what is not good and we are always patient.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!13~4#Answer:What shows that we have love for our fellow man?

group.id: Q:1CO 14.22+Looking at verses 21 and 22, say how speaking in foreign languages is a warning to those who don't believe.

trans-unit.id: a:!1CO!14~22#Answer:Looking at verses 21 and 22, say how speaking in foreign languages is a warning to those who don't believe.121438186
trans-unit.source: If people refuse to believe God's words when he speaks to them in their own language, he sends people speaking foreign languages. This warns them that God is not happy with them. A sign without an interpretation is a worry to people.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!14~22#Answer:Looking at verses 21 and 22, say how speaking in foreign languages is a warning to those who don't believe.

group.id: Q:1CO 14.23-25+Show how verse 22 does not contradict 23-24.

trans-unit.id: q:!1CO!14~23#Question:Show how verse 22 does not contradict 23-24.
trans-unit.source: Show how verse 22 does not contradict 23-24.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!14~23#Question:Show how verse 22 does not contradict 23-24.

trans-unit.id: a:!1CO!14~23#Answer:Show how verse 22 does not contradict 23-24.-606542365
trans-unit.source: When God sends people speaking in foreign languages to us it is God warning us. If we speak in a language that is the gift of the Holy Spirit it does not help our fellow believers, and it seems like madness to those who do not belong to our church. But if we speak in our own language what God reveals to us (prophesy) and a non-member comes in and hears us, maybe that person will hear God speaking to him and will repent of his sins and believe that God is truly among us.
trans-unit.note: !1CO!14~23#Answer:Show how verse 22 does not contradict 23-24.

group.id: Q:1JN 1.5-10+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!1JN!1~5#Question:Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.note: !1JN!1~5#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!1JN!1~5#Answer:Who do you think God is?1014921725
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.note: !1JN!1~5#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!1JN!1~5#Note:Who do you think God is?-1713399034
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralised. (Or, if it can be pluralised, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods". In one language, the plural form of God, meant "God and those who follow him" and was an appropriate way to translate "saints".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !1JN!1~5#Note:Who do you think God is?

group.id: Q:1JN 1.9+What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?

trans-unit.id: a:!1JN!1~9#Answer:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?534404470
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: Forgiveness always involves two people, one of whom has done something wrong to the other and offended him. Forgiveness takes place when the one who was offended sets aside his right to justice and decides not to punish the offender as he deserved. If the one who offended repents and accepts this forgiveness, then the result is that the relationship between the two, which was broken by the offence, is restored, and the guilt of the offender is removed.
trans-unit.note: !1JN!1~9#Answer:What do you think happens when someone forgives someone else?

group.id: Q:1JN 4.10+What do you think atonement means?

trans-unit.id: q:!1JN!4~10#Question:What do you think atonement means?
trans-unit.source: What do you think atonement means?
trans-unit.note: !1JN!4~10#Question:What do you think atonement means?

trans-unit.id: a:!1JN!4~10#Answer:What do you think atonement means?-923120647
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The penalty for sin was death, but "God graciously permitted the death of a sacrificial victim to substitute for the death of the sinner". The sin of the person having been transferred to the victim, atonement was made; that is, fellowship between the person and God was restored. Thus it is through the blood of Christ, which represents his life given as an atonement, that human beings receive forgiveness. (See "atonement" in KBT in the "reconcile" entry.)
trans-unit.note: !1JN!4~10#Answer:What do you think atonement means?

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He is a person sent by Jesus Christ. The general meaning of the Greek word apostolos is "envoy", "appointed representative", "someone who is sent on a mission". In the New Testament it develops the specific sense of an appointed representative of Jesus Christ. group.id: Q:1PE 1.1+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: q:!1PE!1~1#Question:Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.source: Who do you think God is?
trans-unit.note: !1PE!1~1#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!1PE!1~1#Answer:Who do you think God is?-399724789
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: He is the supreme being to be worshipped. In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.note: !1PE!1~1#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!1PE!1~1#Note:Who do you think God is?-1713399034
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralised. (Or, if it can be pluralised, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods". In one language, the plural form of God, meant "God and those who follow him" and was an appropriate way to translate "saints".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !1PE!1~1#Note:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!1PE!1~12#Answer:What do you think the gospel is?2112068392
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: The word "gospel" is a translation of the Greek noun euangelion. In the New Testament the noun euangelion is used in a restricted sense. It does not mean just any kind of good news, but specifically the good news or joyful report that God has made a way of salvation for sinful human beings. In the New Testament it is used always with this one sense and is usually translated in the RSV and most modern English versions as "gospel".
trans-unit.note: !1PE!1~12#Answer:What do you think the gospel is?

trans-unit.source: See "gospel" in KBT.

trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In this verse the Greek noun hierateuma "priesthood" is used. group.id: Q:1PE 3.18-19+What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: q:!1PE!3~18#Question:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?
trans-unit.source: What do you think happens when someone is baptized?
trans-unit.note: !1PE!3~18#Question:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: a:!1PE!3~18#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?815307159
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In ordinary language the Greek verb baptizô (and related words) had both literal and figurative uses. The literal sense of baptizô was "to plunge or drench or immerse something", usually in water. In religious contexts, however, it came to have two more specific senses:
trans-unit.note: !1PE!3~18#Answer:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: n:!1PE!3~18#Note:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?2023529010
trans-unit.source: (a) to wash someone or something in or with water to make him or it ceremonially clean
trans-unit.note: !1PE!3~18#Note:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

trans-unit.id: n:!1PE!3~18#Note:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?1096184324
trans-unit.source: (b) to wash someone in or with water as part of their initiation into the religious community. When a person is baptized he is showing publicly his commitment to and union with Jesus Christ. (See "baptize, baptism" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !1PE!3~18#Note:What do you think happens when someone is baptized?

group.id: Q:1PE 3.21+Peter told them that baptism saves them. What did he mean by that?

trans-unit.id: q:!1PE!3~21#Question:Peter told them that baptism saves them. What did he mean by that?
trans-unit.source: Peter told them that baptism saves them. What did he mean by that?

trans-unit.id: a:!1PE!3~21#Answer:Peter told them that baptism saves them. What did he mean by that?1834759182
trans-unit.source: When believers are baptized, it is not the baptismal water that makes them clean before God and acceptable to him, but it is a sign to God that they are making an appeal to him for or from a clear conscience through [their faith in] the resurrection of Jesus Christ. (21)
trans-unit.note: !1PE!3~21#Answer:Peter told them that baptism saves them. What did he mean by that?

trans-unit.id: h:!1PE!4~1#Section Heading
trans-unit.source: 1 Peter 4:1-11 Since Christ suffered physically, all believers/Christians should be prepared to suffer for doing the will of God. By enduring physical suffering as Christ did, believers/Christians are given the ability to live lives that are free from the power of sin.

group.id: Q:2JN 1.9+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!2JN!1~9#Answer:Who do you think God is?1014921725
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.note: !2JN!1~9#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!2JN!1~9#Note:Who do you think God is?-1713399034
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralised. (Or, if it can be pluralised, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods". In one language, the plural form of God, meant "God and those who follow him" and was an appropriate way to translate "saints".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !2JN!1~9#Note:Who do you think God is?

group.id: Q:3JN 1.6+Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.note: !3JN!1~6#Question:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: a:!3JN!1~6#Answer:Who do you think God is?1014921725
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: In English, the term "God" with a capital "g" is used to refer to the one supreme Creator. The term "god" with a small "g", as in "a god" or "many gods", can refer to any spiritual being that people worship. The Greek word theos can be used in the same two ways.
trans-unit.note: !3JN!1~6#Answer:Who do you think God is?

trans-unit.id: n:!3JN!1~6#Note:Who do you think God is?-1713399034
trans-unit.source: In many languages the term for God is a proper name and cannot be used to refer to anyone except the one supreme creator of the world. It cannot be pluralised. (Or, if it can be pluralised, the meaning may be something very different from the English "gods". In one language, the plural form of God, meant "God and those who follow him" and was an appropriate way to translate "saints".) (See "God" in KBT.)
trans-unit.note: !3JN!1~6#Note:Who do you think God is?

group.id: Q:PSA 89.1-52+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!PSA!89~1#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.note: !PSA!89~1#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!PSA!89~1#Answer:What is a covenant?-1463256525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!89~1#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!PSA!89~1#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!89~1#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!PSA!89~1#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!89~1#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.source: The psalmist wanted God to think about this as a reason why he should help him. (50-51).

group.id: Q:PSA 105.1-45+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!PSA!105~1#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.note: !PSA!105~1#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!PSA!105~1#Answer:What is a covenant?-1463256525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!105~1#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!PSA!105~1#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!105~1#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!PSA!105~1#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!105~1#Note:What is a covenant?

group.id: Q:PSA 132.1-18+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!PSA!132~1#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.note: !PSA!132~1#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!PSA!132~1#Answer:What is a covenant?-1463256525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!132~1#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!PSA!132~1#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!132~1#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!PSA!132~1#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.note: !PSA!132~1#Note:What is a covenant?

group.id: Q:PRO 5.18+Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: q:!PRO!5~18#Question:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?
trans-unit.source: Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Question:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: a:!PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?1092339307
trans-unit.source: One's wife is a source of blessing and refreshment.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: a:!PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?-866390425
trans-unit.source: As a fountain gives forth water, a wife produces children.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: a:!PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?763570017
trans-unit.source: In an arid place, a source of pure water is valuable and worthy of protection.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: a:!PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?-788401926
trans-unit.source: Although this idea is not explicitly referenced here, one would naturally want to protect the purity of a fountain or cistern used for drinking water. In the same way, the son is being warned to avoid impurity that would diminish the happiness to be found in a fulfilling relationship with his wife.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Answer:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!5~18#Note:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?-1828498589
trans-unit.source: Omit this question if the translation does not use figurative language here.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Note:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!5~18#Note:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?-1547486201
trans-unit.source: The Hebrew word for "fountain," is derived from the root meaning "to dig," which goes back to the idea of a "cistern" in verse 15. In Hebrew thought, a wife who bore children was regarded as "blessed" and as a blessing to her husband.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Note:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!5~18#Note:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?-472416034
trans-unit.source: In places where a well or fountain is usually communal and cannot be thought of as private property, give careful consideration about how best to convey this idea.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Note:Why do you think Solomon refers to the wife as a "fountain"?

trans-unit.id: l:!PRO!5~18#Alternate:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?683642205
trans-unit.source: Is this verse saying that you should treat your first wife differently from your other wives?
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Alternate:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?

trans-unit.id: l:!PRO!5~18#Alternate:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?-1000092394
trans-unit.source: Is this verse saying that you can only enjoy wife while you are both young?
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Alternate:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?

trans-unit.id: a:!PRO!5~18#Answer:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?305941699
trans-unit.source: No. The wife one marries in one's youth is to continue to be loved and cherished even in old age (as described in verse 19).
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Answer:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!5~18#Note:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?911947863
trans-unit.source: Select appropriate wording for this question based on your knowledge of their practices regarding polygamy.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Note:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!5~18#Note:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?-586200267
trans-unit.source: We know that Solomon ended up having many wives, but this verse and the surrounding context speak of a single wife and suggest an intimate marriage relationship that would not likely exist in the context of a polygamous arrangement. (See Ecc. 9:9 and Mal. 2:14)
trans-unit.note: !PRO!5~18#Note:Does this verse mean that it is okay to have more than one wife?

trans-unit.id: a:!PRO!31~1#Answer:Who is the author introduced at the start of this chapter?1397515423

trans-unit.note: !PRO!31~1#Answer:Who is the author introduced at the start of this chapter?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!31~1#Note:Who is the author introduced at the start of this chapter?687679111
trans-unit.source: Scholars generally regard it as unclear whether the entire chapter can be attributed to King Lemuel.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!31~1#Note:Who is the author introduced at the start of this chapter?

trans-unit.id: n:!PRO!31~1#Note:Who is the author introduced at the start of this chapter?-1049811067
trans-unit.source: The name Lemuel means “for God” or “devoted to God.” Since there is no biblical or other historical record of a king by that name, it could be that Lemuel was a pet name for Solomon, used by his mother, and that Solomon wrote down her advice as she would have expressed it. Other theories are that Lemuel is actually King Hezekiah or a fictional character.
trans-unit.note: !PRO!31~1#Note:Who is the author introduced at the start of this chapter?

trans-unit.source: There is a long list. Unless a respondent is a good reader and very thorough, they will probably not be able to remember or list all the characteristics. But after hearing or reading this passage, at least one or two prominent ideas should stand out.

group.id: Q:JER 31.31-33+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!JER!31~31#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.note: !JER!31~31#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!JER!31~31#Answer:What is a covenant?-1463256525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do.
trans-unit.note: !JER!31~31#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!JER!31~31#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !JER!31~31#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!JER!31~31#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.note: !JER!31~31#Note:What is a covenant?

group.id: Q:EXO 34.10-12+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!EXO!34~10#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.note: !EXO!34~10#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!EXO!34~10#Answer:What is a covenant?-1463256525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do.
trans-unit.note: !EXO!34~10#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!EXO!34~10#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !EXO!34~10#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!EXO!34~10#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.note: !EXO!34~10#Note:What is a covenant?

group.id: Q:DEU 5.2-3+What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: q:!DEU!5~2#Question:What is a covenant?
trans-unit.source: What is a covenant?
trans-unit.note: !DEU!5~2#Question:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: a:!DEU!5~2#Answer:What is a covenant?-1463256525
trans-unit.source: Key Term Check: A covenant is an agreement, an especially binding promise. If a person on one side of the covenant does not do as both have agreed, there usually is a strong punishment for him or he pays compensation to the other person. Similar agreements now are called contracts. When God makes an agreement with people, however, he makes a firm promise of what he will do and says what they must do.
trans-unit.note: !DEU!5~2#Answer:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!DEU!5~2#Note:What is a covenant?-454030446
trans-unit.source: See "covenant" in KBT.
trans-unit.note: !DEU!5~2#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.id: n:!DEU!5~2#Note:What is a covenant?-1172814261
trans-unit.source: If the language has a special name to refer to these kinds of agreements, ask the respondent to tell you the kinds of situations in which the people make the agreements. Listen for any points where it would not be appropriate to state that God made that kind of an agreement. Then adjust the translation as necessary.
trans-unit.note: !DEU!5~2#Note:What is a covenant?

trans-unit.note: !JON!3~8#Alternate:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?

trans-unit.source: Why do you think the king commanded the people to put sackcloth on their animals?
trans-unit.note: !JON!3~8#Alternate:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!JON!3~8#Note:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?-189372020
trans-unit.source: This was (at least) to show [God] the extent of their sorrow for their sins [so he would relent and not punish them]. It is also possible that because the people had used their animals in sinful ways (e.g., as sacrifices to idols, or for transporting people or objects used in their pagan worship), they reasoned that the animals also needed to included in the mourning process.
trans-unit.note: !JON!3~8#Note:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!JON!3~8#Note:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?-668922854
trans-unit.source: Although some commentators have suggested that the word "animals" might refer to people who are like ignorant animals (in their disregard for God), the explicit wording in v. 7 indicating the animals included in the ban strongly suggests otherwise.
trans-unit.note: !JON!3~8#Note:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?

trans-unit.id: n:!JON!3~8#Note:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?-1140268478
trans-unit.source: It is interesting to note that in God's final words to Jonah at the end of the book, he mentions the animals in his explanation to Jonah for why he is showing compassion on Nineveh.
trans-unit.note: !JON!3~8#Note:Why do you think the king wanted the animals to wear mourning clothes?
